messages.沈潜で敵の精神力をじわじわ削るシンプルな人格。出撃しないときも、サポートパッシブ: A straightforward Identity that wears down enemy SP with Sinking. When not deployed, his support passive, Information Neutralization, can help the ally with the lowest SP.
messages.沈潜付与: S1「弾く」・S2「突き刺す」・S3「連撃」で沈潜を付与。S2はⅡコ: **Inflicting Sinking**: S1 Deflect, S2 End-stop Stab, and S3 Enjamb inflict Sinking. On hit, Coin Ⅱ of S2 also increases Sinking Count by 1.
messages.サポートパッシブ「情報中和」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も低: **Support passive — Information Neutralization (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: If the 1 ally with the lowest SP lost SP during the turn, that ally recovers 10 SP at Turn End. This applies while Yi Sang is in the team but not participating in battle.
messages.脆弱付与: S3のⅢコイン的中時、対象の精神力が0未満なら次のターンに脆弱1を付: **Inflicting Fragile**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 inflicts 1 Fragile next turn if the target's SP is below 0.
messages.バトルパッシブ「情報伝達」(憂鬱×4・共鳴): 操作パネルで自分より後ろの味方2: **Combat passive — Information Relay (4 Gloom Resonance)**: Gives 1 Damage Up to the 2 allies behind him on the dashboard.
messages.出撃時はS1・S2で沈潜を重ねて敵の精神力を削る。S3の脆弱は対象の精神力が0未: When deployed, build Sinking with S1 and S2 to drain enemy SP. S3 only inflicts Fragile when the target is below 0 SP, so this effect rarely activates outside a Sinking team. Information Relay requires 4 Gloom Resonance; aim for it in a team with enough Gloom skills.
messages.出撃させないときは控えに置き、「情報中和」で精神力を消耗する味方の回復役として使: When he is not deployed, use Information Neutralization to support allies who spend SP. It only targets the 1 ally with the lowest SP and only activates on a turn when that ally loses SP.
messages.麻痺・脆弱・貫通脆弱を「次のターン」に付与し、敵が動く前から弱らせておくデバッフ: A debuffer who applies Paralyze, Fragile, and Pierce Fragility for the following turn, weakening enemies before they act. He works best alongside Pierce attackers.
messages.S3「ムリネ」: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインが的中するたびに最終コインの効果付与数が+1。Ⅲコ: **S3 — Moulinet**: Each hit from Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ increases the amount of the final Coin's effect by +1. On hit, Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1 Pierce Fragility next turn, up to 3 if both Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ hit.
messages.S2「リポスト」: マッチ勝利時に次のターン麻痺3を付与。Ⅱコイン的中時に次のタ: **S2 — Riposte**: On Clash Win, inflicts 3 Paralyze next turn. On hit, Coin Ⅱ inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. The latter is an On Hit effect, so an Unopposed Attack can also apply it.
messages.バトルパッシブ「観察」(暴食×4・共鳴): マッチ進行時、相手のマッチ威力-2。: **Combat passive — Acute Studies (4 Gluttony Resonance)**: Applies -2 Clash Power to his opponent in a Clash, helping his Gluttony S2 win Clashes.
messages.サポートパッシブ「分析」(暴食×3・共鳴): 最大体力値の最も高い味方がマッチ進: **Support passive — Observational Eye (3 Gluttony Resonance)**: The ally with the highest Max HP gains +1 Clash Power in a Clash.
messages.破裂: S1・S2・S3で破裂や破裂回数も付与するが、付与量は少なく副次的。: **Rupture**: S1, S2, and S3 also inflict Rupture or Rupture Count, but the amounts are small and secondary to his main role.
messages.付与はどれも次のターンに効くため、そのターンに動く味方ではなく次のターンの攻撃を: Paralyze, Fragile, and Pierce Fragility take effect next turn, so use them to prepare for the following turn's attacks rather than to help allies acting this turn. Land every Coin of S3 to maximize Pierce Fragility, then follow up with allies who mainly use Pierce skills. S2's Paralyze requires a Clash Win, and S2 has low Power. Match it against a weak skill, or activate Acute Studies through Gluttony Resonance to improve its chances.
messages.相手が1体のボスや集中戦闘で特に役割を持ちやすい。: He is particularly useful against a single boss and in Focused Encounters.
messages.マッチに勝つたびに呼吸回数が増え、コイン威力が伸びていく安定型の斬撃アタッカー。: A steady Slash attacker who gains Poise Count from Clash Wins and builds up Coin Power. Longer battles let him accumulate Poise and land repeated Critical Hits.
messages.バトルパッシブ「冷静」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ勝利時に呼吸回: **Combat passive — Poised (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains +1 Poise Count on Clash Win. Gains +1 Coin Power for every 5 Poise Count, up to +3. His Pride S1, Striker’s Stance, helps him meet the requirement himself. The Coin Power bonus requires Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.呼吸の獲得: S1は使用時に呼吸回数2、Ⅰコインで次のターンに呼吸を得る。S3「: **Gaining Poise**: S1 gains 2 Poise Count on use, and its Coin Ⅰ grants Poise next turn. S3, Flank Thrust, gains 2 Poise on use. S2, Heel Turn, increases Poise Count next turn on Clash Win.
messages.クリティカルの火力: S3のⅢコインはクリティカル発動時にダメージ量+50%/7: **Critical damage**: On a Critical Hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 deals +50%/70% damage, depending on Uptie tier, while his Counter defense skill deals +70% damage.
messages.サポートパッシブ「師事」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も高い味: **Support passive — Bestow (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the highest SP gains +1 additional Poise Count from skill effects.
messages.序盤はS1で呼吸を貯めつつ、基本威力が高く最低値の高いS2・S3で確実にマッチを: Early on, build Poise with S1 and use S2 and S3, whose higher Base Power gives them higher minimum rolls, to secure Clash Wins. Each win activates Poised and adds Poise Count, replenishing the 1 Count lost after a Critical Hit or at Turn End. In a long battle, he can reach 15 Poise Count for +3 Coin Power. Once Poise is established, aim for heavy Critical damage with Coin Ⅲ of S3 or Counter.
messages.耐久力が低いので反撃は耐性で受けられる場面に限るのが無難で、呼吸を配る剣契頭目の: His low durability makes Counter safest when his resistances let him take the incoming hit. A Blade Lineage team with Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault, who supplies Poise, greatly improves his performance.
messages.剣契頭目(ムルソー): 自分のスキル・コイン効果で呼吸を得るたびに、呼吸が最も少: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508) (Meursault)**: His Swordplay of the Homeland passive (3 Pride Resonance, Uptie Ⅱ) gives +1 Poise Potency and Count to the 2 Blade Lineage Identities with the least Poise whenever he gains Poise Potency or Count through his own skill or Coin effects. This helps Blade Lineage Salsu build Poise faster.
messages.剣契殺手(ウーティス): 同じ剣契所属の人格。剣契頭目の戦闘開始時の「本国剣術」: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:1102) (Outis)**: Another Blade Lineage Identity who can receive Swordplay of the Homeland from Blade Lineage Mentor at Combat Start. With at least 6 Blade Lineage members participating, the additional Poise becomes 2.
messages.まずはストーリーを進め、遊びながらできることを増やそう。: Start with the story and unlock more activities as you play.
messages.最初はメインストーリーを進めるのがおすすめ。新しいコンテンツや育成先が順に開くの: Start by progressing through the main story. New activities and upgrade options unlock along the way, so there is no need to take too many detours until battles become difficult.
messages.囚人はキャラクター、人格は戦闘で選ぶバージョン、E.G.Oは戦闘中に資源を使って: A Sinner is a character; an Identity is a version of that character selected for battle. E.G.O are powerful skills activated by spending resources during combat. Each Identity has different skills and strengths. Select a Sinner from the list to browse their Identities.
messages.手持ちから出撃メンバーを選ぼう: Choose your deployed team from what you own
messages.まずは使える人格を中心に編成し、それぞれのスキルと耐性を見てみよう。最初から状態: Build around the Identities available to you, and look at their skills and resistances. You do not need to commit to a single status effect or affiliation from the start. Each Identity page explains its role and how to use it.
messages.全員を一度に育てず、よく使う人格から整える。: Focus on the Identities you use most rather than upgrading everyone at once.
messages.まずは出撃する人格を育てる: Upgrade the Identities you plan to deploy first
messages.使う予定の人格を優先し、レベルと同期化を強化しよう。レベルは基礎能力、同期化はス: Prioritize levels and Uptie for the Identities you intend to use. Levels improve basic stats, while Uptie unlocks and strengthens skills and passives. Check the required materials and upgrade effects before spending resources.
messages.詰まった場所に合わせて強化する: Upgrade according to what is holding you back
messages.敵とのレベル差が大きいならレベル、スキルやパッシブが未解放なら同期化を見直そう。: If enemies greatly outlevel you, review your levels. If skills or passives are still locked, review Uptie. Use enemy information on the deployment screen and your team's current upgrades as a guide, rather than a fixed level based only on story progress.
messages.素材は足りないものから集める: Farm the materials you are missing
messages.人格学習チケットが足りなければ経験値採光、同期化素材が足りなければ紐採光を候補に: Consider EXP Luxcavation when you need Identity Training Tickets, or Thread Luxcavation when you need Uptie materials. Check unlocks and rewards in the game, and keep some Enkephalin for story progression.
messages.E.G.Oの強化は必要になってから: Upgrade E.G.O when you need to
messages.E.G.Oは解析で強化できる。素材を一度に使い切らず、よく使うE.G.Oや効果を: Threadspin upgrades E.G.O. Avoid spending all your materials at once; first check which E.G.O you use often and what each upgrade provides.
messages.毎日は採光、週ごとは鏡ダンジョンを目安に、育成素材と交換用の報酬を集めよう。: Use daily Luxcavations and weekly Mirror Dungeon runs to gather upgrade materials and rewards for the Dispenser.
messages.毎日の採光で育成素材を補充する: Replenish upgrade materials through daily Luxcavations
messages.経験値採光では人格のレベル上げに使う人格学習チケット、紐採光では人格の同期化やE: EXP Luxcavation provides Identity Training Tickets for levels. Thread Luxcavation provides Thread for Uptie and E.G.O Threadspin. Choose EXP when you need levels, or Thread when you need Uptie. If daily bonus rewards remain, use them on the materials you need before the daily reset.
messages.エンケファリンを採光に使うか、モジュールに変える: Spend Enkephalin on Luxcavations or convert it into Modules
messages.エンケファリンはストーリーや採光に使い、モジュールは鏡ダンジョンや採光のスキップ: Enkephalin is used for the story and Luxcavations, while Modules are used for activities such as Mirror Dungeons and skipping Luxcavations. Keep Enkephalin when you plan to progress the story. Convert what you will not use soon, or what would otherwise exceed the cap, into Modules. Skipping Luxcavations saves time but gives fewer rewards per Module than fighting normally.
messages.毎週の鏡ダンジョンでパス報酬を進める: Advance the Battle Pass with weekly Mirror Dungeon runs
messages.鏡ダンジョンのクリア報酬ではバトルパス経験値を得られ、週のボーナスを使うと追加報: Mirror Dungeon completion rewards include Battle Pass EXP, with additional rewards when you use weekly bonuses. Bonuses reset each week, so check how many remain on the reward screen. Start with a difficulty you can clear reliably; try Hard once you have unlocked it.
messages.集めた報酬を育成と交換に回す: Put your rewards toward upgrades and the Dispenser
messages.採光はすぐ使う育成素材、鏡ダンジョンはバトルパスや自我の破片ボックスを集めるのに: Luxcavations are useful for upgrade materials you need immediately. Mirror Dungeons help you advance the Battle Pass and obtain Egoshard Crates. Farm Luxcavations for an Identity you want to upgrade, or collect shards through Mirror Dungeon rewards when you have an Identity or E.G.O in mind for the Dispenser.
messages.戦闘に詰まったとき: When you get stuck in battle
messages.負けた原因を一つずつ見て、育成か操作かを切り分けよう。: Review the causes of defeat one at a time to work out whether you need upgrades or a different approach.
messages.敵と味方のレベル・耐性を見比べる: Compare enemy and ally levels and resistances
messages.敵のレベルが高い、攻撃タイプへの耐性が合わないなど、出撃前の情報に手がかりがある: Pre-battle information can reveal problems such as an enemy level advantage or poor resistance matchups. Replacing an Identity that is weak to the enemy's attack type may be enough to make the battle easier.
messages.味方のスキルを敵の攻撃に割り当てると、攻撃同士のマッチが起きる。敵の強い攻撃を止: Assigning an ally's skill against an enemy attack can create a Clash. To stop a dangerous attack, check your chances of winning before committing a skill. The forecast does not always determine the final outcome.
messages.精神力は通常コインの表が出る確率に関わる。スキルの基本威力・コイン威力や効果文も: SP affects the chance of rolling Heads on normal Coins. Read Base Power, Coin Power, and skill effects, and check whether you have met the conditions that let each Identity perform well.
messages.ボスの説明を読んで、編成を見直す: Read the boss's mechanics and adjust your team
messages.ボスのパッシブや部位の説明に、対処方法が書かれていることがある。苦手な状態異常や: A boss's passive and part descriptions may explain how to deal with it. Once you identify useful status effects or attack types, adjust your Identities, resistances, and support. The boss guides cover difficult encounters in Chapters 3–7; start with the battle you are stuck on.
messages.鏡ダンジョン・人格の交換について: Mirror Dungeons and obtaining Identities from the Dispenser
messages.鏡ダンジョンの報酬を、バトルパスと自我の破片につなげる。: Turn Mirror Dungeon rewards into Battle Pass progress and Egoshards.
messages.鏡ダンジョンはバトルパスを進める場所: Mirror Dungeons advance the Battle Pass
messages.鏡ダンジョンをクリアするとバトルパス経験値を獲得できる。パス報酬には育成素材や自: Clearing a Mirror Dungeon grants Battle Pass EXP. Pass rewards include upgrade materials and Egoshard Crates. If you are stuck in the story, upgrade the Identities you need before trying a run.
messages.高難易度を急ぐ必要はない。今の編成で安定して進める難易度を選び、報酬受け取り時に: There is no need to rush into a higher difficulty. Choose one your current team can handle reliably, and check bonus uses, extra rewards, and Module costs when claiming rewards. Hard has unlock requirements; follow the in-game information.
messages.通常の「自我の破片ボックス」はランダムな囚人の破片、「自我の破片セレクトボックス: An Egoshard Crate gives shards for a random Sinner. A Nominable Egoshard Crate lets you choose the Sinner when opening it. Either type gives 1–3 shards per Crate. If you know which Identity or E.G.O you want, prioritize Nominable Crates so you can choose the corresponding Sinner.
messages.ボックスから集めた囚人ごとの自我の破片は、自販機でその囚人の人格やE.G.Oと交: Each Sinner's Egoshards can be exchanged for that Sinner's Identities or E.G.O at the Dispenser. Requirements and available seasons differ by item, so check the item you want before opening Nominable Crates for the corresponding Sinner.
messages.人格・E.G.Oによって交換できる時期や条件が異なる。自販機に並んでいるかを確認: Dispenser availability and conditions vary by Identity and E.G.O. Check whether the item is available before deciding which Sinner's shards to collect. Requirements and availability may change, so use the latest in-game information.
messages.抽出と交換を使い分ける: Choose between Extraction and the Dispenser
messages.欲しいものが自販機にあるなら、抽出を続ける前に必要な破片と手持ちを比べよう。交換: If the item you want is available in the Dispenser, compare its shard cost with what you own before continuing to Extract. The Dispenser lets you choose an item, but collecting shards takes time. Check current Extraction offerings and limited-time availability before deciding.
messages.迷ったらゲーム内の最新表示を見て、使い道を決めてから消費する。: When unsure, check the latest in-game information and decide how you will use a resource before spending it.
messages.狂気は抽出やエンケファリン回復などに使える。使い道を決める前に、今開催中の抽出内: Lunacy can be used for Extraction, Enkephalin refills, and other purposes. Check the current Extraction offerings and consider how often you play before deciding how to spend it.
messages.シーズンが変わると、交換対象やパス報酬などが切り替わる。破片やボックスを使う前に: A new season changes Dispenser availability, Pass rewards, and other content. Check the Dispenser and in-game notices before spending shards or opening Crates.
messages.用語が分からないとき: When you do not understand a term
messages.戦闘中に見慣れない言葉が出たら、用語辞典で共通の仕組みを確認しよう。人格固有の効: Look up unfamiliar combat terms in the glossary. For effects unique to an Identity, also read the effect descriptions on that Identity's detail page.
messages.まずはストーリーを進めよう。戦闘に詰まったら育成を見直し、毎日の採光と毎週の鏡ダ: Start with the story. When battles become difficult, review your upgrades and strengthen your team through daily Luxcavations and weekly Mirror Dungeon runs.
messages.ゲーム開始前の抽出で迷ったら、リセマラガイドへ →: Unsure about your starting pulls? Read the reroll guide →
messages.おすすめ人格と終了ライン、端末ごとの注意点を確認。: Recommended Identities, when to stop, and platform-specific considerations.
messages.敵の狙い・速度を見て、1ターンのマッチを割り当てる例を追う。: Follow a sample turn, using enemy targets and Speed to assign Clashes.
messages.ゲーム内で確認できる報酬・解放条件を優先する。抽出内容やシーズン報酬など更新され: Follow the rewards and unlock requirements shown in the game. Recheck changing information, such as Extraction offerings and seasonal rewards, when you play.
messages.鏡ダンジョンから人格交換まで: From Mirror Dungeon rewards to the Dispenser
messages.通常報酬や上限後の超過報酬にボックス: Obtain Crates from regular and post-cap rewards
messages.集めた破片で人格・E.G.Oを選ぶ: Choose Identities or E.G.O using your shards
messages.誰の破片が出るかランダム。特定の交換先が決まっていないとき向け。: The Sinner is random. Useful when you do not have a specific Dispenser item in mind.
messages.開封時に囚人を選べる。交換したい人格・E.G.Oに合わせて使える。: Choose a Sinner when opening it, according to the Identity or E.G.O you want.
messages.鏡ダンジョン1回分のバトルパス進行目安: Battle Pass progress from one Mirror Dungeon clear
messages.上限後のセレクトボックス: Nominable Crates after the Pass cap
messages.最終層までクリアした場合の報酬。ハードの数値は、その週のボーナスをまだ使っていな: Rewards assume completion of the final floor. Hard values assume that none of that week's bonuses have been used before claiming rewards. Each level requires 10 EXP; the table starts at 0 progress. Leftover progress carries over. Crate counts apply after all regular Pass rewards have been claimed: each additional level gives 1 Crate on the free Pass, or 3 in total with the purchased Limbus Pass.

messages.タブでスキルを切り替えられる。表示威力は固有の強化や攻撃レベル差による補正を含ま: Use the tabs to switch skills. Displayed Power excludes unique buffs and adjustments from Offense Level differences.
messages.敵のステータス・効果・行動は更新で変わることがある。戦闘中の表示も確認する。: Updates may change enemy stats, effects, or behavior. Also check the information shown during battle.
messages.負け方から対処を探す: Find a response based on how you lost
messages.ターン数は通常の進行の目安。HPの削り方や混乱で順番が変わるため、敵が使うスキル: Turn numbers indicate a typical sequence. HP loss and Stagger can change the order, so also check the names of the skills the enemy is using.
messages.1人で複数の役割を兼ねても大丈夫。まずマッチに勝てる主力を決め、危険な攻撃への対: One ally can fill several roles. First choose a main fighter who can win Clashes, then assign responsibilities for dangerous attacks and special mechanics.
messages.※解析段階Ⅱで取得、E.G.O使用後、次ターンから戦闘終了まで効果発動: Unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ. After using this E.G.O, the effect lasts from the following turn until the end of battle.
messages.攻撃スキルコインの判定時、効果威力分の固定ダメージを受ける\n攻撃スキルコインの:
When an attack skill Coin is rolled, take fixed damage equal to this effect's Potency.
After the Coin roll, reduce Count by 1.
messages.マッチ敗北時にコインが破壊されない。\n攻撃スキルに該当コインがあれば、被ダメー:
This Coin is not destroyed on Clash Lose.
If an attack skill contains this Coin, attack with it after taking damage.
On Clash Lose, the Power of the remaining unbroken Coin becomes 1.
messages.1ターンの間、スキルでの被ダメージが数値に比例して増加(最大10): For 1 turn, damage taken from skills increases in proportion to this value (maximum 10).
messages.敵Xは味方Aを、敵Yは味方Cを狙っている。まず敵の各スロットを選び、攻撃先・効果: Enemy X targets ally A, while enemy Y targets ally C. Select each enemy slot to check its target, effects, and danger. In this example, deal with X's attack first because you do not want it to hit A.
messages.速いBで引き受ける: Redirect with the faster ally B
messages.Bの攻撃スキルをXのスロットへドラッグする。Bの速度6はXの速度4より高いため、: Drag B's attack skill onto X's slot. B has 6 Speed, higher than X's 4, so B can redirect X's attack to themself. Check the Clash forecast and choose a skill likely to win.
messages.Cは自分の攻撃に対応: Have C answer the attack targeting them
messages.Cの攻撃スキルをYのスロットへ指定する。Yは元からCを狙っているので、Cの速度3: Assign C's attack skill to Y's slot. Y already targets C, so C can Clash despite having 3 Speed against Y's 5. Check this forecast and the skill effects as well.
messages.残ったAもXへ攻撃する。Aの速度2ではXの攻撃先を奪わないため、BとXのマッチを: Have the remaining ally A attack X too. A's 2 Speed cannot redirect X, so A can attempt an Unopposed Attack while B keeps the Clash against X. After assigning everyone, check again that X targets B and Y targets C.
messages.行動未指定：A・C。Xの狙いはAからBへ変更。: Actions unassigned: A, C. X's target changes from A to B.
messages.行動未指定：A。BとCがそれぞれマッチを担当。: Action unassigned: A. B and C each take a Clash.
messages.全員の指定が完了。Aが攻撃しても、Xのマッチ担当はBのまま。: All actions assigned. B still takes the Clash against X even when A attacks.
messages.最初に決めるのは、誰がどの攻撃を受け持つか。敵の狙いを見て、危険な攻撃から順に対: First decide who will handle each attack. Check the enemies' targets and deal with the most dangerous attacks first.
messages.通常の単体攻撃・攻撃スキルでのマッチを扱う入門例。図はゲーム画面の再現ではなく、: This introductory example covers normal single-target attacks and Clashes between attack skills. The diagram simplifies the relationship between 2 enemy slots and 3 ally slots; it does not recreate the game screen. Values and danger levels are fictional examples. Last checked: October 22, 2026.
messages.同じ盤面で、4つの判断を追う: Follow 4 decisions on the same board
messages.この例ではBがXに、CがYに勝ちやすい攻撃スキルを持つと仮定する。速度の数字はマ: Assume that B has an attack skill likely to beat X, and C has one likely to beat Y. Speed does not indicate Clash strength.
messages.図は指定した時点の関係を示す。実際の行動順や、混乱・死亡などで行動が止まるかは別: The diagram shows the assignments at the selected point. Check actual action order and possible interruptions, such as Stagger or death, separately. An Unopposed Attack may also fail to happen if, for example, its user is defeated first.
messages.速度は「引き受けられるか」に使う: Use Speed to determine who can redirect
messages.敵より速ければ、攻撃先を自分へ変更できる。: If you are faster than the enemy, you can redirect its attack to yourself.
messages.同速の4では通常引き受けられない。: Matching its 4 Speed normally does not let you redirect the attack.
messages.自分を狙う攻撃に対応: Respond to an attack already targeting you
messages.元から自分が対象なら、遅くても攻撃を合わせてマッチできる。: If you are already the target, you can assign an attack to Clash even when you are slower.
messages.速さだけを見て諦めなくてよい。: Do not give up just because you are slower.
messages.引き受ける → マッチ予測を見る → 効果文も読む: Redirect → check the Clash forecast → read the effects
messages.速度が高くてもマッチに勝てるとは限らない。予測は確定結果ではなく、コインの出目や: Higher Speed does not guarantee a Clash Win. A forecast is not a fixed result: Coin rolls and changing combat conditions can affect the outcome.
messages.勝ちにくい攻撃を、そのまま開始しない: Reconsider attacks you are unlikely to beat
messages.同じ味方の別スキルや、使用可能なE.G.Oへ替えた予測を確認する。E.G.Oは資: Check the forecast with another skill from the same ally, or an available E.G.O. For E.G.O, also check resource and SP costs.
messages.敵より速く、勝ちやすいスキルを持つ味方を探す。替えた結果、その味方が受け持ってい: Look for an ally faster than the enemy who has a skill likely to win. Check whether reassigning that ally would leave another attack unanswered.
messages.守備でしのげるか: Can a defense skill help you survive?
messages.回避は成功すれば攻撃を避けられるが、失敗の危険がある。通常の防御はシールドで被害: A successful Evade avoids an attack, but failure is a risk. A normal Guard reduces harm with a Shield; it does not cancel the enemy's attack. A normal Counter assumes that you will take a hit, so do not casually use it to protect an ally near death. For defense skills that can Clash, check their individual effect descriptions.
messages.特殊な攻撃は、個別の説明を優先する: Follow the individual rules for special attacks
messages.「マッチ不可」「対象変更不可」は別の制限だ。破壊不能コインはマッチに勝っても攻撃: Unclashable and unredirectable are different restrictions. Unbreakable Coins leave an attack in play even after you win the Clash. Redirecting a multi-target attack's main target does not necessarily protect its other targets. Do not judge these attacks solely by the diagram for a normal single-target attack.
messages.開始前は、敵側からもう一度見る: Before starting, check from the enemies' side again
messages.見落とした攻撃や、危険な効果はないか。: Have you missed an attack or a dangerous effect?
messages.複数人で同じスロットを狙い、マッチ担当が変わっていないか。: Has targeting the same slot with several allies changed who takes the Clash?
messages.残りHP・耐性・混乱区間・精神力は大丈夫か。: Check remaining HP, resistances, Stagger Thresholds, and SP.
messages.同じ敵スロットへ複数の指定をすると、最後に成立した対象変更が優先される。図の例で: When several allies target the same enemy slot, the last successful redirection takes priority. Even in this example, check the arrows once more at the end. If they differ from your plan, reassign the relevant skill and review the board after everyone has an action.

messages.指令を遂行しながら自身を強化でき、代行 [ヘルメス]を溜めた後のFurioso-: He strengthens himself by fulfilling Prescripts, then uses accumulated Procuration [Hermes] to unleash Furioso-Replica. A candidate to develop as a main fighter even before you assemble specific teammates.
messages.解禁Ⅲになるまでは指令を無視するとカルマが溜まる。印付きスキルと対象を確認し、暴: Ignoring Prescripts builds Karmic Consequence until Unlock Ⅲ. Check the marked skills and targets, and keep 1 Gluttony, 1 Gloom, and 1 Pride resource Owned to activate his passive. He favors longer battles that allow setup.
messages.序盤のバリアと保護、出血回数を増やす攻撃を両立できる。生体材料を育てると拘束解除: She combines early Shield and Protection with attacks that increase Bleed Count. Building Corpus Ingredient leads into The Self Unbound, where an enhanced S3 can target multiple enemies. A main fighter and support option for Bleed teams.
messages.生体材料は回数を消耗して威力を育てる仕組み。解除後S3の広域化にも生体材料の威力: Corpus Ingredient consumes Count to build Potency. Increasing its Potency is also necessary to make S3 hit multiple targets after the transformation. She does not start at maximum damage, and benefits from allies who inflict Bleed.
messages.S3か守備で保存神域を張り、味方がスキルを使うときにバリアを配れる。自分もバリア: S3 or her defense skill creates a Sanctum of Conservation, granting Shield when allies use skills. Her own Shield helps her survive, and accumulating Blessing of the Obsidian God transforms her defense skill into a powerful attack. A new-season option who can support the allies you already own.
messages.神域の残りと加護の蓄積を見てS3・守備を使い分けよう。初動には準備が必要で、ル・: Choose between S3 and defense according to the Sanctum's remaining duration and accumulated Blessing. Her opening requires setup; Le Noir allies can accelerate it through follow-up attacks.
messages.コートとバリアで攻撃を引き受けながら保存を育て、アルミュール・エヴェイエへ移ると: She takes attacks with her Overcoat and Shield while building Preservation. Armure Éveillée then lets her attack with Unbreakable Coins and an enhanced S3. A new-season option who can fill both defensive and offensive roles.
messages.コートが100になるか、60以上で守備を使うと次のターンに強化形態へ移る。強化形: Reach 100 Overcoat, or use defense with at least 60, to enter the enhanced form next turn. Using skills depletes that form; reaching 0 returns her to the Overcoat. Keep track of her form and Preservation Potency.
messages.初めて守備を装着したターンの終了時に猛虎標弾へ切り替えられ、強化S3で大きく攻め: At the end of the first turn in which he equips a defense skill, he can switch to Savage Tigermark Rounds and attack with an enhanced S3. His setup has a clear trigger, making him a candidate for concentrating damage into a planned attack window.
messages.怠惰3保有のパッシブを発動させると、猛虎標弾がある間は基本攻撃スキルの全コインが: With his 3 Sloth Owned passive active, all Coins of his Base Attack Skills become Unbreakable while Savage Tigermark Rounds remain. Overheat weakens his Clashes on the turn after he runs out of ammunition, so manage his ammo.
messages.同じ敵・部位を攻撃し続けると点穴が溜まり、コイン再使用へつながる。狙う相手を決め: Repeatedly attacking the same enemy or part builds Nerve Strike and enables Coin reuse. His focus on a single target is straightforward, making him a candidate to develop for single bosses even with a small roster.
messages.別の敵・部位に点穴を付けると、前の点穴は消える。憤怒2・傲慢2保有のパッシブを有: Applying Nerve Strike to another enemy or part removes it from the previous target. His passive, requiring 2 Wrath and 2 Pride Owned, also lets him build it through Clash Wins. Short fights with frequently changing targets make his setup harder to use.
messages.同じ敵とのマッチで決闘高潮を溜め、強化S3で振動爆発を重ねられる。完成されゆく教: Clashing with the same enemy builds The Duel Escalates, enabling repeated Tremor Bursts with an enhanced S3. Maturing Textbook also provides lasting improvements. A Season 7 candidate whose damage grows during the fight.
messages.強化S3には対象の決闘高潮5が必要で、対象を絞れる集中戦闘向き。火傷と振動を付与: The enhanced S3 requires 5 The Duel Escalates on its target, favoring Focused Encounters where you can choose a consistent opponent. Allies who inflict Burn and Tremor help him use Tremor - Scorch. He can also pair with The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion.
messages.試着室を経て新装になると、S2・S3のコイン再使用と回復で攻め続けられる。新シー: After entering the Changing Room and emerging with Full Makeover, Coin reuse on S2 and S3 and healing let her keep attacking. An offensive and durable option for players building a new-season Bleed team.
messages.自傷で体力を削り、体力10%以下で守備を構えるか、体力が0になるダメージを受けて: She lowers her own HP, then enters the Changing Room by preparing defense at 10% HP or lower, or by taking damage that would reduce her HP to 0. HP loss from Base Skills alone cannot reduce her below 1 HP. Setting up the transformation can make her difficult if simple controls are your priority.
messages.予知眼がある間は条件付きの自動回避でしのぎ、過熱へ移ると処分で大きく攻められる。: While she has The Eye of Precognition, conditional automatic Evades help her survive. After entering Overheat, Disposal provides a major attack. A candidate for a main fighter in longer battles, with both offensive and defensive strengths.
messages.予知の発動は1ターン1回。予知眼・加速弾・過熱の管理が必要で、常に回避できるわけ: Precognition activates only once per turn. The Eye of Precognition, Acceleration Rounds, and Overheat require management; she cannot always Evade. The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice Heathcliff can add follow-up attacks or defensive support depending on whether she has the Eye.
messages.幼年期のS1・S2で味方を回復・強化し、絶え間ない飢えを溜めると高貴な品格へ移っ: In his early form, S1 and S2 heal and strengthen allies. Accumulating Relentless Hunger leads into Noble Dignity, where he attacks with Bleed. An option for developing new-season Le Rouge or Charge teams.
messages.味方の体力を消耗する技が多く、編成・操作の準備が要る。ル・ルージュの味方に使う支: Many of his skills consume allies' HP, so team preparation and careful skill selection matter. Even support skills used on Le Rouge allies reduce their HP. Until your team is ready, focus on support in his early form and limit use of S3, which consumes allies' HP. The transformation unlocks at Uptie Ⅲ.
messages.ウアジェトの目[先鋒]で、条件付きで敵コインの有利な面が出る確率を下げ、自身の攻: The Udjat [Vanguard] can conditionally reduce the chance that enemy Coins roll their favorable side while strengthening her own attacks. Aggro and Protection also help her take dangerous enemy attacks.
messages.初手から目を得るには憂鬱3共鳴が必要で、維持にも共鳴や敵へのパニックタイプ変更効: Obtaining the Eye immediately requires 3 Gloom Resonance. Maintaining it also involves Resonance and effects that change an enemy's Panic Type; she does not keep it automatically. Bring allies with Gloom skills, and watch S3's ammunition.
messages.守備でランプを溜めて眩惑を付けると、S3の全コインが破壊不能になり追加ダメージも: Build Lamp with defense, then apply Dazzle to make every Coin of S3 Unbreakable and enable additional damage. In Focused Encounters, he can draw enemy attacks to himself regardless of Speed, giving him both offensive and defensive roles against bosses.
messages.守備でランプを8まで溜めた後、次のターンに眩惑を付ける準備が要る。眩惑の被ダメー: He needs to build Lamp to 8 with defense, then prepare to apply Dazzle next turn. Allies who maintain Burn and Sinking help exploit Dazzle's increased damage taken. He favors boss battles over short fights in which the Dazzled target dies quickly.
messages.炎蝶の棺を溜めるほど攻撃が強くなり、棺30で強化S3や守備からの正午の解体を使え: Building Fire Butterfly Coffin strengthens her attacks. At 30 Coffin, she can use an enhanced S3 or Dismemberment at High Noon through defense. The latter's healing combines with Battle Instinct's buffs, making her a candidate for a main fighter in long battles.
messages.立ち上がりと自身の火傷に注意。正午の解体で戦闘感覚3を得た後は、憤怒3保有のパッ: Watch her opening setup and self-inflicted Burn. After Dismemberment at High Noon grants 3 Battle Instinct, her 3 Wrath Owned passive can replenish Coffin. Overheated Coffin prevents defense from transforming on the same turn as the enhanced S3, so plan when to heal.
messages.弾丸を撃ち切ったときの広域攻撃、混乱した敵への追撃、花びらを溜めた後の恍惚とした: A multi-target attack after exhausting ammunition, follow-up attacks against Staggered enemies, and Magnificent End after building Petals all add attacks beyond her selected skills. A main-fighter option for Sinking or Tremor teams.
messages.花びらを得るパッシブは怠惰1・憂鬱2保有が条件。沈潜ダメージや振動爆発を起こす仲: The passive that grants Petals requires 1 Sloth and 2 Gloom Owned. Allies who trigger Sinking damage or Tremor Burst help with setup. Reloading costs SP, and defense gives her Fragile next turn, so do not overextend just to gain follow-up attacks.
messages.胞子を付けて火傷回数を補給し、仲間が付与した火傷を長持ちさせられる。広域のS2と: Spore replenishes Burn Count, helping Burn inflicted by allies last longer. He can choose between a multi-target S2 and an S3 that deals more damage against fewer targets, making him a candidate for starting a Burn team.
messages.単独の火力だけでなく、火傷を積む仲間と組んだときの価値が高い。胞子の追加ダメージ: Much of his value comes from teammates who build Burn, rather than his damage alone. Spore's additional damage has conditions, including Spore buildup. Refilling ammunition and reloading consume SP, so watch both ammo and SP.
messages.同じスキルを続けて使い組札を合わせると光札が育ち、追撃の光斬へつながる。捨てる効: Using the same skill repeatedly to match her Hand builds Bright【光】 and leads into the Kōzan [光斬] follow-up attack. Discard helps align her skills. A candidate for players who want damage from learning a consistent turn-by-turn selection pattern.
messages.最も左のスロットで使うスキルと組札の属性を確認しよう。光札には回数制限があり、威: Check the skill used in the leftmost slot and its match with the Hand's affinity. Bright【光】 has a Count limit; a Kōzan [光斬] check below 3 Potency cancels the attack. Choosing a different skill every time makes her strengths harder to use.
messages.精神力が高い加護では守備役、精神力を下げた絶望では減算コインの攻撃役を担える。守: At high SP, Blessing gives her a defensive role. Lowering SP into Despair turns her into an attacker with negative Coins. She can enter Despair through defense, making her a candidate to develop around a chosen approach.
messages.絶望を維持したい場合は涙で研ぎ澄ますを2で止める。3で放出すると精神力が回復して: To maintain Despair, stop Tear-sharpened at 2. Releasing it at 3 restores SP and returns her to Blessing. Some SP loss from Base Skills and similar sources has a floor, but this does not block all SP damage or E.G.O SP costs.
messages.暁の火30でS3か守備が明け方へ変わり、広域攻撃と自己回復、全味方への夜明け迎え: At 30 Light of Daybreak, S3 or defense becomes Crack of Dawn, combining a multi-target attack, self-healing, and Dawnherald for all allies. He supports allies who use Burn and is a candidate for developing a Dawn Office team.
messages.夜明け迎えの攻撃強化は火傷を付与するスキル向け。憤怒2・怠惰2保有のパッシブで、: Dawnherald's offensive bonus is for skills that inflict Burn. His passive, requiring 2 Wrath and 2 Sloth Owned, helps build Light of Daybreak while Dawnherald is active. Rebuild it after Crack of Dawn, and watch his self-inflicted Burn during setup.
messages.主力になる人格を引いて、物語を始めよう。理想の組み合わせを揃える必要はない。: Pull an Identity you want as a main fighter, then begin the story. You do not need a perfect lineup.
messages.リセマラは必須ではない。迷ったら、主力候補1体を目安に。: Rerolling is optional. If unsure, aim for 1 main-fighter candidate.
messages.多くの人格・E.G.Oは、遊びながら集める自我の破片で交換できる。序盤を楽にした: Many Identities and E.G.O can be obtained with Egoshards earned while playing. Reroll if you want an easier start, or begin when you pull an Identity you like. Dispenser availability has timing and eligibility restrictions, so check how to obtain the Identity you want first.
messages.使いたい主力候補を1体: 1 main-fighter candidate you want to use
messages.下の候補の使い方と注意点を読み、育てたい1体が引けたら終了の目安。好きな人格で始: Read the candidates' practical notes and cautions below. Pulling 1 you want to develop is a reasonable stopping point. Starting with an Identity you simply like is also valid.
messages.もう少し狙うなら: If you want to aim a little higher
messages.同時に出撃できる人格が増えると編成を組みやすい。候補全員や特定の組み合わせが揃う: Having more Identities that can deploy together makes team building easier. You do not need to keep rerolling until you have every candidate or a specific combination.
messages.同じ囚人の人格は同時出撃できない。ファウストの人格を2種類引いても、出撃できるフ: You cannot deploy multiple Identities of the same Sinner at once. Pulling 2 different Faust Identities still lets you deploy only 1 Faust. Duplicate copies of the same Identity do not increase the number of units you can deploy either.
messages.新しいシーズンの人格を中心に、攻守の役割と育てた後の強みから選んだ各囚人の候補。: Candidates for each Sinner, mainly from newer seasons, chosen for their offensive or defensive roles and strengths after upgrading. They are listed in Sinner order, not ranked by strength. You do not need them all.
messages.時点のS8。抽出ごとに排出対象が異なるため、狂気を使う前に「提供一覧」で候補の名: during Season 8. Each Extraction has a different pool, so check the candidate's name in its offering list before spending Lunacy. Not every candidate is necessarily available from the New Manager's Welcome Extraction.
messages.人格名を選ぶと性能・使い方へ。「理由」でこのページの詳しい説明へ移動。: Select an Identity's name for its stats and guide, or Reasons for its detailed explanation on this page.
messages.支援や変身を得意とする候補には、仲間や準備が必要な場合もある。選んだ理由と注意点: Candidates focused on support or transformations may need teammates or setup. Read the reasons and cautions before deciding to stop.
messages.開催時に狙いたい限定人格の候補。火力だけでなく、回復や編成への貢献も見て6人格を: Limited Identities to consider while the event is running. These 6 were chosen for healing and team contributions as well as damage. They are listed in Sinner order; you do not need them all.
messages.ヴァルプルギスの夜の開催中に、引く抽出の提供一覧に載っている場合に狙おう。開催外: Only aim for these during Walpurgis Night if they appear in the offering list of the Extraction you will use. Outside the event, leave them out of your reroll targets and choose from the regular candidates.
messages.気になる囚人の説明を開いて確認しよう。性能は同期化Ⅳを基準にしており、入手直後か: Expand the explanation for a Sinner you are interested in. These descriptions assume Uptie Ⅳ; not every part of the playstyle is available immediately after obtaining the Identity.
messages.使う前に知っておきたいこと: What to know before using it
messages.性能・使い方を詳しく見る →: View stats and the full guide →
messages.人格は普段の戦闘で使うスキルを決める。E.G.Oは資源を消費して使う特殊な技で、: Identities determine the skills you use in ordinary combat. E.G.O are special skills that consume resources and also require suitable team building and upgrades. When rerolling, first check whether you have an Identity that can serve as a main fighter.
messages.E.G.Oとのセット引きは必須にしない: Do not require a matching E.G.O pull
messages.有用なE.G.Oが一緒に出たらうれしいが、それだけを理由に主力人格のいる結果を捨: A useful E.G.O is a welcome bonus, but its absence is not a reason to discard an account with a good main-fighter Identity. Check the corresponding Sinner's pages for ways to use any E.G.O you obtain.
messages.スマホ版の未連携アカウントで行う流れ。既に遊んでいるアカウントを削除しないよう、: These steps are for an unlinked account on mobile. Check which account you are managing so you do not delete progress you already want to keep.
messages.スマホ版で未連携の状態から開始する: Start with an unlinked mobile account
messages.チュートリアルを進めるかスキップする。結果を決めるまでは外部アカウントと連携しな: Play or skip the tutorial. Do not link an external account until you have chosen the result you want to keep.
messages.配布を受け取り、抽出の提供一覧を確認する: Claim starting rewards and check the Extraction pool
messages.新人管理人記念抽出などの対象・必要な狂気・確定枠を確認する。狙う人格が載っていな: Check the available items, Lunacy cost, and guarantees for the New Manager's Welcome Extraction or other Extractions. If your target Identity is not listed, repeating that Extraction will not produce it.
messages.抽出して、終了ラインと比べる: Extract and compare the result with your stopping point
messages.使いたい主力がいるか、囚人が偏っていないかを見る。終了するなら、削除せずアカウン: Check whether you have a main fighter you want to use and whether your pulls are concentrated on the same Sinner. If you are finished, protect the account instead of deleting it.
messages.やり直す場合のみ、未連携データを削除する: Delete unlinked data only if you want to start over
messages.「設定 → 環境設定 → アカウント → アカウント削除」へ進む。画面上の対象・: Go to Settings → Preferences → Account → Delete Account. Read the displayed account details and deletion conditions, and confirm that this is the temporary reroll account before proceeding.
messages.新人管理人記念抽出は狂気1600で20回、000人格またはE.G.Oが1つ確定。: The New Manager's Welcome Extraction offers 20 pulls for 1600 Lunacy, guaranteeing 1 000 Identity or E.G.O. Excluding the initial download, a reroll takes roughly 1–2 minutes, depending on your device, connection, and starting rewards. Check starting Lunacy and guarantees in the game before Extracting.
messages.Steam版は起動時にアカウントが連携されるため、スマホの未連携データと同じ手順: The Steam version links an account on startup, so you cannot reroll with the same procedure as an unlinked mobile account. If you want to play on PC, one option is to choose a result on mobile and link it afterward. Always check which progress will be retained when linking. Linked accounts have a deletion waiting period; read the conditions on the deletion screen.
messages.終わったら、物語へ: Once you are done, begin the story
messages.続けるデータを決めたら、ゲーム内の案内に従って連携し、ユーザーIDを控えておこう: Once you have chosen the account to keep, follow the in-game linking instructions and save your user ID.
messages.主力を育てながらストーリーを進める: Progress the story while upgrading your main fighters
messages.引いた人格のレベル・同期化を少しずつ上げる。足りない役割は初期人格や00人格も使: Gradually improve your Identities' levels and Uptie. Use starting Identities and 00 Identities to fill missing roles. The beginner guide explains daily activities and Egoshard exchanges.
messages.初心者ガイドで、次にすることを見る →: See what to do next in the beginner guide →
messages.育成・採光・鏡ダンジョン・交換を順番に案内。: A step-by-step guide to upgrades, Luxcavations, Mirror Dungeons, and the Dispenser.
messages.【リンバス】リセマラガイド｜おすすめ人格と終了ライン｜Limbus Assist: Reroll Guide: Recommended Identities and When to Stop | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)のリセマラガイド。おすすめの人格・E.G: A Limbus Company reroll guide covering recommended Identities and E.G.O, the reasons for each choice, when to stop, and the reroll procedure.
messages.出撃時はS1・S2で沈潜を重ねて敵の精神力を削る。S3の脆弱は対象の精神力が0未: When deployed, build Sinking with S1 and S2 to drain enemy SP. S3 only inflicts Fragile when the target is below 0 SP, so this effect rarely activates outside a Sinking team. Information Relay requires 4 Gloom Resonance; aim for it in a team with enough Gloom skills. When he is not deployed, use Information Neutralization to support allies who spend SP. It only targets the 1 ally with the lowest SP and only activates on a turn when that ally loses SP.
messages.付与はどれも次のターンに効くため、そのターンに動く味方ではなく次のターンの攻撃を: Paralyze, Fragile, and Pierce Fragility take effect next turn, so use them to prepare for the following turn's attacks rather than to help allies acting this turn. Land every Coin of S3 to maximize Pierce Fragility, then follow up with allies who mainly use Pierce skills. S2's Paralyze requires a Clash Win, and S2 has low Power. Match it against a weak skill, or activate Acute Studies through Gluttony Resonance to improve its chances. He is particularly useful against a single boss and in Focused Encounters.
messages.序盤はS1で呼吸を貯めつつ、基本威力が高く最低値の高いS2・S3で確実にマッチを: Early on, build Poise with S1 and use S2 and S3, whose higher Base Power gives them higher minimum rolls, to secure Clash Wins. Each win activates Poised and adds Poise Count, replenishing the 1 Count lost after a Critical Hit or at Turn End. In a long battle, he can reach 15 Poise Count for +3 Coin Power. Once Poise is established, aim for heavy Critical damage with Coin Ⅲ of S3 or Counter. His low durability makes Counter safest when his resistances let him take the incoming hit. A Blade Lineage team with Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault, who supplies Poise, greatly improves his performance.
messages.軽いコストで敵の攻撃威力を下げ、次のターンに味方全員へクイックを配る、速度支援向: A low-cost starting E.G.O for Speed support: lowers enemy Attack Power and grants Haste to all allies next turn.
messages.攻撃威力減少: 的中時に攻撃威力減少2を付与する。解析Ⅱ以前は表面的中時だけ。: **Attack Power Down**: Inflicts 2 on hit. At Threadspin Ⅱ or below, requires a Heads Hit.
messages.クイック: 的中時に次のターンの全味方へクイック1(解析Ⅲで3)を付与し、味方の: **Haste**: On hit, grants all allies 1 Haste next turn, increased to 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.束縛(解析Ⅳ): 的中時に次のターンへ束縛2を付与する。: **Bind (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: On hit, inflicts 2 Bind next turn.
messages.パッシブ「沈黙」: 被ダメージ時に次のターンの自分へ束縛3が付く。弱点・脆弱属性: **Passive — Silence**: Taking damage gives Yi Sang 3 Bind next turn and enables a +20% damage bonus that turn when attacking an Attack Type or Sin affinity to which the target is Weak or Fatal, once per turn. Account for the 3 Bind he can receive.
messages.攻撃加重値1の単体向け。単体の敵に撃って攻撃威力減少とクイックを配り、後続の味方: With 1 Attack Weight, it is for a single target. Use it on an enemy to apply Attack Power Down and grant Haste, supporting the rest of the team.
messages.必要資源は怠惰3・憤怒1、精神消耗は10。侵蝕スキルはない。: Costs 3 Sloth, 1 Wrath, and 10 SP. Has no Corrosion skill.
messages.耐性は憂鬱・嫉妬が脆弱(×2)、怠惰が抵抗(×0.75)。: Sin resistances: Fatal to Gloom and Envy (×2); Endured against Sloth (×0.75).
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、攻撃威力減少が的中時に、クイックが3になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Power, changes Attack Power Down to an On Hit effect, and raises Haste to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 束縛2が加わる。クイック3だけで足りる場面が多く、優先度は低いと考えられる: **Ⅳ**: Adds 2 Bind. The 3 Haste is often enough for its role, so this upgrade can be a lower priority.
messages.奥歯事務所フィクサー: S2が怠惰、S3が憤怒で、必要資源(怠惰3・憤怒1)をま: **[Molar Office Fixer](persona:0105)**: Sloth S2 and Wrath S3 can supply both required affinities: 3 Sloth and 1 Wrath.
messages.南部リウ協会3課: S1が怠惰、S2が憤怒で、同じく必要資源を出せる。: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112)**: Sloth S1 and Wrath S2 also supply its required affinities.
messages.火傷の合計が多い敵ほど強くなる、攻撃加重値5の斬撃広域で、各対象へ火傷をばらまく: A Burn-focused Slash E.G.O with 5 Attack Weight that spreads Burn and grows stronger with the total Burn across its targets. This guide assumes Threadspin Ⅴ.
messages.火傷の付与: Ⅰコインが的中時に火傷4、表面的中時はさらに火傷6を付与する(解析: **Inflicting Burn**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 4 Burn on hit, plus another 6 on a Heads Hit, from Threadspin Ⅳ onward.
messages.火傷合計による強化: 攻撃前に全攻撃対象の火傷の合計6につき最終威力+1(最大4: **Total Burn bonuses**: Before attacking, gains +1 Final Power per 6 total Burn Potency across all attack targets, up to +4, and +1% damage per Potency, up to +30%.
messages.パッシブ「火の粉」: 憤怒属性または火傷を付与するスキルの使用時、全攻撃対象の火: **Passive — Ember**: Active from the turn after E.G.O use. When using a Wrath skill or a skill that inflicts Burn, gains +1 Clash Power if the attack targets have at least 6 Burn Potency in total. On Clash Win, inflicts Burn equal to Wrath Resonance × 2 on the main target, up to 8 per skill.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 火傷による強化の上限が覚醒より高く(最終威力最大+6、ダメージ量最: **Corrosion**: Attacks random targets without distinguishing friend from foe. Has higher Burn-based bonus caps than Awakening: up to +6 Final Power and +45% damage. After use, gains Blazing: next turn, the first Base Attack Skill gains +2 Final Power, but each of its hits consumes the user's HP.
messages.火傷を扱う編成で、複数の敵へ一気に火傷を配る使い方が基本。: Use it in a Burn team to spread Burn across several enemies at once.
messages.必要資源は憤怒5・怠惰1・暴食1で憤怒に偏る。精神消耗は覚醒20・侵蝕20・OC: Costs 5 Wrath, 1 Sloth, and 1 Gluttony, making Wrath the main resource requirement. SP cost: 20 Awakening, 20 Corrosion, 30 Overclock.
messages.解析Ⅲまでは威力が低いので、使うなら解析Ⅳ以上と考えられる。: Its Power is low through Threadspin Ⅲ, so aim for Threadspin Ⅳ or higher if using it.
messages.Ⅱ: 「火の粉」が解放され、マッチ勝利時に(憤怒完全共鳴の数÷2)の火傷を付与す: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Ember, which inflicts Burn equal to half the Wrath Absolute Resonance count on Clash Win at this tier.
messages.Ⅲ: 表面的中時の火傷が2から4になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Burn inflicted on a Heads Hit from 2 to 4.
messages.Ⅳ: 的中時にも火傷4、表面的中時に火傷6が付き、攻撃加重値が3から5になる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds 4 Burn on hit and raises the extra Burn on a Heads Hit to 6. Attack Weight rises from 3 to 5.
messages.Ⅴ: 基本威力が12から14、コイン威力が+8から+12になる。「火の粉」が強化: **Ⅴ**: Base Power rises from 12 to 14 and Coin Power from +8 to +12. Improves Ember, and the Corrosion Coin becomes Unbreakable.
messages.南部リウ協会3課: S1〜S3がすべて火傷を付与し、S2(憤怒)で必要資源の憤怒: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112)**: All 3 Base Attack Skills inflict Burn, and Wrath S2 helps supply the main resource requirement.
messages.開花E.G.O::壇香梅: パッシブ「満開」が2名以上を攻撃するときのダメージ量: **[Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104)**: Full Bloom grants +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets, fitting this multi-target E.G.O. Gluttony S1 and Sloth S2 also supply required resources.
messages.麻痺と怠惰脆弱を付与しつつ、パッシブで毎ターン保護を得られる、器用な怠惰のE.G: A versatile Sloth E.G.O that inflicts Paralyze and Sloth Fragility while its passive grants protection every turn.
messages.麻痺と怠惰脆弱: 覚醒スキルが的中時に怠惰脆弱1(解析Ⅲで2)、表面的中時に麻痺: **Paralyze and Sloth Fragility**: Awakening inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility on hit, increased to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ. A Heads Hit inflicts 2 Paralyze, increased to 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ. Paralyze therefore depends on the Coin landing Heads.
messages.最後方を攻撃: 覚醒スキルは最後方の対象を攻撃する(一般戦闘限定)。解析Ⅳで攻撃: **Rearmost target**: Awakening attacks the rearmost target in Normal Encounters. At Threadspin Ⅳ, its Attack Weight becomes 3.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 打撃・攻撃加重値3で、敵味方識別不可。的中時に怠惰脆弱1、解析Ⅲか: **Corrosion**: A Blunt skill with 3 Attack Weight that cannot distinguish friend from foe. Inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility on hit. From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 2 Paralyze on hit instead of only on a Heads Hit, and a Heads Hit also inflicts 3 Bind next turn.
messages.パッシブ「ドルハルバン」: 毎ターン、打撃保護と怠惰保護3を得る。使うだけで耐久: **Passive — Dol Hareubang**: Gains 3 Blunt Protection and 3 Sloth Protection each turn, improving durability after activation.
messages.敵に麻痺と怠惰脆弱を付けて味方を助けるデバッファーとして使う。麻痺は表面が必要な: Use it to support allies by inflicting Paralyze and Sloth Fragility. Awakening needs Heads for Paralyze; from Threadspin Ⅲ, Corrosion can apply it more reliably on hit.
messages.必要資源は怠惰4・憂鬱1、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: Costs 4 Sloth and 1 Gloom. Awakening and Corrosion each cost 20 SP.
messages.耐性は怠惰が耐性(×0.5)、暴食・憂鬱が脆弱(×2)。: Sin resistances: Ineffective against Sloth (×0.5); Fatal to Gluttony and Gloom (×2).
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、覚醒スキルの怠惰脆弱・麻痺の付与量が増える。侵蝕スキルは麻痺: **Ⅲ**: Raises Power and the amount of Sloth Fragility and Paralyze on Awakening. Corrosion applies Paralyze on hit and inflicts 3 Bind next turn on a Heads Hit.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒スキルが加重値3の広域になり、侵蝕スキルの威力が大きく上がる。: **Ⅳ**: Awakening becomes a multi-target skill with 3 Attack Weight, and Corrosion gains substantial Power.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課: S3と守備が怠惰で、必要資源の怠惰を出せる。: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0108)**: Sloth S3 and defense supply the Sloth resource requirement.
messages.開花E.G.O::壇香梅: S2と守備が怠惰で、同じく怠惰を出せる。: **[Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104)**: Sloth S2 and defense likewise supply Sloth resources.
messages.充電を消費して威力を伸ばし、破裂を消費して傲慢ダメージを上乗せする、高威力の単体: A powerful single-target E.G.O that spends Charge for damage and Rupture Count for additional Pride damage.
messages.充電の消費: 攻撃前に充電回数を消耗し、消耗した分だけダメージ量が増える(最大5: **Spending Charge**: Before attacking, consumes Charge Count and increases damage according to the amount spent, up to +50%, or +75% at Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.破裂の消費: 的中時、ダメージ量の(対象の破裂×7.5%、解析Ⅲで10%)分の傲: **Spending Rupture**: On hit, deals additional Pride damage equal to the damage dealt × the target's Rupture Potency × 7.5%, increased to 10% at Threadspin Ⅲ, then consumes 5 Rupture Count. The additional damage is capped at 75% of the hit's damage, increased to 100% at Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.次元の亀裂: 解析Ⅲから、充電を消耗した的中時に次元の亀裂3(解析Ⅳで5)を付与: **Dimensional Rift**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, a hit after consuming Charge inflicts 3 Dimensional Rift, increased to 5 at Threadspin Ⅳ. At Turn End, increases Rupture Count by that amount.
messages.パッシブ「彷徨う者」: ターン開始時にダメージを受けていなければ充電回数が4増え: **Passive — Rambling Man**: At Turn Start, gains 4 Charge Count if he took no damage on the previous turn. Hitting an enemy slower than himself increases Rupture Count by 1, up to 3 times per turn.
messages.最後方の対象を攻撃する(一般戦闘限定)。充電と破裂をあらかじめ溜めて撃つ。: Attacks the rearmost target in Normal Encounters. Prepare Charge and Rupture before using it.
messages.覚醒はコイン威力が+18と大きく、裏が出ると威力が大きく下がる。精神力が高いとき: Awakening has a large +18 Coin Power bonus, so Tails greatly lowers its roll. Use it at high SP.
messages.必要資源は怠惰3・暴食3、精神消耗は覚醒25・侵蝕30・OC45。: Costs 3 Sloth and 3 Gluttony. SP cost: 25 Awakening, 30 Corrosion, 45 Overclock.

messages.沈潜を扱う編成で、憂鬱共鳴を狙って撃つ。: Use it in a Sinking team and aim for Gloom Resonance.

messages.引き裂かれた追憶と呼吸: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+1)の追憶を得て(最大7。解析Ⅳ: **Torn Memory and Poise**: Before attacking, gains Torn Memory equal to the highest Resonance + 1, up to 7, then gains 1 Poise per Memory. messages.味方討伐: 倒せたら自分と味方2名へ呼吸2(解析Ⅲで3)を付与し、解析Ⅲから倒し: **Killing an ally**: Grants 2 Poise to himself and 2 allies, increased to 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ. messages.パッシブ「次」: 攻撃終了時に対象が死亡したなら呼吸回数+2(1ターンにつき最大: **Passive — Next**: Active from the turn after E.G.O use. After attacking, if a target died, gains 2 Poise Count, up to 2 times per turn.

messages.味方を倒すと資源を得られるため(解析Ⅲ以降)、実質のコストは軽くなる。: From Threadspin Ⅲ, killing an ally generates resources, reducing the effective cost.
messages.共鳴数に応じて追憶が増え、ダメージ補正が伸びる(解析Ⅳは傲慢共鳴なら2倍)。: Higher Resonance generates more Torn Memory and raises the damage bonus. At Threadspin Ⅳ, Pride Resonance doubles the Resonance contribution.

messages.Ⅲ: 追憶によるダメージ補正とクリティカルダメージの上限が上がり、味方討伐時に資: **Ⅲ**: Raises the Memory-based damage bonus and Critical damage cap, and adds resource gains when an ally is killed.
messages.Ⅳ: 補正とクリティカルダメージの上限がさらに伸び、スキル2の属性の資源も得られ: **Ⅳ**: Further raises damage bonuses and the Critical damage cap, and adds resources matching the ally's S2 affinity. These are substantial improvements, making this a relatively high-priority upgrade if using the E.G.O.
messages.N社E.G.O::凶弾: S3と守備が傲慢で、パッシブ「凶弾」(傲慢×6)が味方: **[N Corp. E.G.O:: Fell Bullet](persona:0113)**: Pride S3 and defense supply resources. His Fell Bullet passive, requiring 6 Pride Owned, uses allied deaths and Torn Memory, matching this E.G.O's mechanics.

messages.コイン威力強化: 攻撃前にメインターゲットの火傷と沈潜の合計が15以上(解析Ⅳは: **Coin Power bonus**: Before attacking, gains +1 Coin Power if the main target's combined Burn and Sinking Potency reaches 15, lowered to 10 at Threadspin Ⅳ. Its unboosted Clash range is only 4–16, so plan around meeting this condition.
messages.火傷と沈潜の付与: Ⅰコインで火傷と沈潜回数を増やし、Ⅲコインは沈潜÷3(最大5: **Inflicting Burn and Sinking**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Burn Potency and increases Sinking Count; Coin Ⅲ inflicts Burn equal to Sinking Potency ÷ 3, up to 5. messages.割れた世界とⅣコイン: Ⅱコインが今ターンと次のターンに割れた世界を付け、Ⅳコイ: **Shattered World and Coin Ⅳ**: If they hit without being broken, Coin Ⅱ applies Shattered World for this turn and next turn, and Coin Ⅳ triggers Burn once, consuming 1 Burn Count. messages.呼吸: 攻撃前に呼吸を得て(最大共鳴数、最大7)、クリティカルを出しやすくする。: **Poise**: Before attacking, gains Poise equal to the highest Resonance, up to 7, improving Critical chance. Coin Ⅲ increases Burn Count on a Critical Hit.

messages.先に他の人格で火傷と沈潜を溜め、基準を満たした敵に撃つ。: Use other Identities to build Burn and Sinking first, then attack a target that meets the threshold.

messages.蜘蛛の巣人差し指の親方: 3つの攻撃スキルが沈潜を付与し、憂鬱・傲慢の資源も出せ: **[The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather](persona:0115)**: All 3 attack skills inflict Sinking, and he supplies Gloom and Pride resources. Burn needs another source.

messages.パッシブ(解析Ⅱで解放): 哀悼のイサンは基本スキルの的中時に振動2が付き、沈潜: **Passive (unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ)**: While equipped at this tier, Solemn Lament Yi Sang's Base Skills inflict 2 Tremor on hit, once per skill; both the Identity and his Base Skills count as inflicting Sinking and Tremor. After Reloading, restores 10 SP and Discards 1 Base Attack Skill, up to 2 times per turn. Equipping a defense skill also restores 10 SP at Turn End.
messages.蝶の付与と消耗: Ⅰ〜Ⅳコインの的中で対象にランダムに蝶を付与し(1・2・2・3: **Applying and spending Butterfly**: Coins Ⅰ–Ⅳ randomly apply Butterfly to their targets on hit, in amounts of 1, 2, 2, and 3. Coin Ⅴ consumes all of his own ammunition, The Living & The Departed, inflicts 3 Sinking and 3 Tremor, and triggers Tremor Burst. Butterfly on the target and Yi Sang's own ammunition are separate resources.
messages.解析で伸びる火力: 解析ⅢでⅤコインに、対象の全蝶に応じた憂鬱ダメージが加わる。: **Damage from Threadspin upgrades**: Threadspin Ⅲ adds Gloom damage on Coin Ⅴ based on all Butterfly on the target. Threadspin Ⅳ adds Gloom Fragility and Gloom Resist Down to Coin Ⅳ, plus Sinking Count increases on Coins Ⅰ–Ⅳ.
messages.哀悼イサン専用の効果: 使用するイサン人格が哀悼なら、攻撃前に(憂鬱共鳴数+1): **Benefits exclusive to Solemn Lament Yi Sang**: Before attacking, that Identity gains ammunition equal to Gloom Resonance + 1, up to 7, then Reloads after attacking. Reloading costs SP equal to (30 − remaining ammunition) ÷ 2.
messages.解析Ⅱで解放されるパッシブが主な価値で、スキルは強化パーツのおまけ程度に使うと考: The passive unlocked at Threadspin Ⅱ is its main value. Treat the attack itself as a secondary benefit of activating this upgrade.

messages.Ⅲ: Ⅴコインに蝶に応じた憂鬱ダメージが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds Butterfly-based Gloom damage to Coin Ⅴ.

messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::厳粛な哀悼: このE.G.Oの専用効果(蝶・再装填・振動: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Solemn Lament](persona:0110)**: The Identity that receives this E.G.O's special Butterfly, Reload, and Tremor benefits. Gloom S2 and defense help supply its resources.

messages.沈潜編成のトドメ役。味方と溜めた沈潜をS3の沈潜殺到で一気に発動させ、振動回数を: A finisher for Sinking teams. S3's Sinking Deluge cashes in the Sinking built by his allies, while spending his own Tremor Count turns S2 into a multi-target skill that spreads Sinking.
messages.S3「血を宿した香り」: Ⅲコイン的中時、対象の沈潜が6以上なら沈潜殺到。自分の: **S3 — Bloodsteeped Scent**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ triggers Sinking Deluge if the target has at least 6 Sinking Potency. With at least 10 Tremor Count on himself, it also deals additional damage equal to 30%/40% of the damage dealt. S3 gains 6 Tremor Count on use, so having at least 4 before use meets that condition. Losing the Clash costs him 20 SP. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S2「刹那の花風」: 戦闘開始時に自分の振動回数を6消耗して攻撃加重値3のスキル: **S2 — Moment's Floral Breeze**: At Combat Start, consumes 6 of his Tremor Count to become a skill with 3 Attack Weight. Each Coin inflicts 2 Sinking next turn. Gains +1 Coin Power if the main target has at least 6 Sinking Count.
messages.S1「萌え出る蕾」: 使用時に振動回数2/3を得る。Ⅱ・Ⅲコインで次のターンに沈: **S1 — Sprouting Bud**: Gains 2/3 Tremor Count on use. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ increase Sinking Count next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「満開」(怠惰×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 2名以上を攻撃すると: **Combat passive — Full Bloom (4 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Deals +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets.
messages.沈潜編成で使う。S2とS1を同じ敵に当てると、次のターンに沈潜の威力(S2)と回: Use him in a Sinking team. Hitting the same enemy with S2 and S1 sets up Sinking Potency from S2 and Count from S1 for the next turn. Add his allies' Sinking, then use S3 once the target has at least 6 Sinking Potency: Sinking Deluge deals SP damage equal to Sinking Count × Sinking Potency in one burst. Damage beyond the target's -45 SP floor becomes Gloom damage; against targets without SP, the entire amount becomes Gloom damage. Sinking is removed after the Deluge, so save it for a decisive moment. S1 and S3 build his own Tremor Count; with at least 6 at Combat Start, S2 gains Attack Weight and can benefit from Full Bloom's +30% by attacking multiple targets. Tremor Count falls by 1 at Turn End. Starting from 0, S3's +6 alone leaves only 5 next turn, and S1 alone also falls short. Build at least 7 beforehand, for example by using S3 and S1 in the same turn when he has multiple action slots. He struggles to supply Full Bloom's Sloth requirement alone, so bring allies with Sloth skills.
messages.S1を捨てて自分の振動回数を溜め、主力のS2・S3を何度も回して振動爆発を起こす: A Blunt attacker who Discards S1 to build his own Tremor Count and cycle through his stronger S2 and S3 for repeated Tremor Bursts. Each Burst lets his passive inflict Defense Level Down, improving the damage of allies who attack afterward.
messages.捨てて振動回数を溜める: S2「ギャンブラー」・S3「奥歯軋り」・ガードは使用時: **Discard to build Tremor Count**: On use, S2 Gamble, S3 Grinding the Molars, and Guard each Discard 1 of the lowest-ranked skills from his skill slots. Discarding S1 Stay Calm or S2 gives him 3/4 Tremor Count. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S2「ギャンブラー」: Ⅰコイン的中時に振動回数を2/3増加させ、自分の振動回数: **S2 — Gamble**: On hit, Coin Ⅰ increases the target's Tremor Count by 2/3. If Yi Sang has at least 5 Tremor Count, it triggers Tremor Burst, then reduces the target's Tremor Count by 2.
messages.S3「奥歯軋り」: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10消耗してコイン威力+1/2。Ⅰコ: **S3 — Grinding the Molars**: On use, consumes 10 of his Tremor Count for +1/2 Coin Power. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 4 Tremor, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 2 Defense Level Down. If he consumed Tremor Count on use, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅲ also trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.バトルパッシブ「こういうときこそ…」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 振動爆: **Combat passive — In Times Like These... (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: For every 4 points by which his Tremor Burst raises an enemy's Stagger Threshold, inflicts 1 Defense Level Down, up to 5 per enemy per turn.
messages.S2・ガードでS1を捨てて自分の振動回数を貯める。S2は自分の振動回数が5以上あ: Use S2 or Guard to Discard S1 and build his own Tremor Count. S2 is a main attack that triggers Tremor Burst once he has at least 5 Tremor Count. It does not inflict Tremor Potency, so the size of the Burst depends on the Potency already on the enemy; Coin Ⅰ of S3, which inflicts 4 Tremor, is his only source of it. S2 adds 2/3 Tremor Count to the target before the Burst removes 2, so only Uptie Ⅳ's +3 keeps the target's Count from falling after the additional 1 Count lost at Turn End. Once Yi Sang has at least 10 Tremor Count, use S3 for 2 Tremor Bursts and Defense Level Down to help subsequent attacks. S3 Discards before checking whether it can spend Tremor Count, so include the Count gained from Discarding S1 or S2. His Burst conditions check his own Tremor Count, which takes time to build. He suits longer battles and can support Tremor Identities that struggle to inflict Count.
messages.充電を手段にして破裂威力と破裂回数を大量に付与する、破裂編成向けの人格。S1→S: An Identity for Rupture teams who uses Charge to inflict substantial Rupture Potency and Count. S1 followed by S2 can bring Charge Count to 10, enabling the enhanced S2 that supplies much of his Rupture.
messages.S2「エネルギー循環」: 使用時に充電回数が2/6/7増加。充電回数10以上なら: **S2 — Energy Cycle**: Gains 2/6/7 Charge Count on use. At 10 or more Charge Count, gains +1 Coin Power, and Coin Ⅱ adds 3 Rupture and 2 Rupture Count on top of its normal 3 Rupture. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S1「次元を裂く」: 使用時とⅠコイン的中時に充電回数が2ずつ増加し、破裂2を付: **S1 — Dimensional Slit**: Gains 2 Charge Count on use and another 2 when Coin Ⅰ hits; that Coin also inflicts 2 Rupture. At 10 or more Charge Count, gains +2 Coin Power.
messages.S3「次元の狭間」: 充電回数15未満なら10消耗してコイン威力+1、15あれば: **S3 — Dimensional Rift**: With 10–14 Charge Count, spends 10 for +1 Coin Power. With 15, spends 15 for +2 Coin Power and increases the target's Rupture Count by 3 before attacking. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 2/3 Rupture for every 5 Charge Count spent, up to 6/9. Spending 15 also lets it inflict 2 Dimensional Rift.
messages.バトルパッシブ「空にした頭」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Emptied Thought (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, gains 1 Haste next turn for every 5 Charge Count, up to 2/3. When he consumes Charge Count through a skill, grants 3 Charge Barrier to the ally with the lowest current HP percentage.
messages.サポートパッシブ「整理師範教育」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 充電回数が: **Support passive — Cleanup Demonstration (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the most Charge Count deals +1.5% damage per Rupture Potency on the target, up to +15%.
messages.破裂編成に入れ、破裂威力と破裂回数の供給役として使う。同じターンにS1が先に動い: Use him to supply Rupture Potency and Count in a Rupture team. The extra Rupture Count on S2 and S3 requires Uptie Ⅳ. If S1 acts first in the same turn and Coin Ⅰ hits, he gains 4 Charge Count from its on-use and on-hit effects. S2's on-use gain then reaches 10 at the tiers that grant 6/7, enabling its additional Rupture and Count. If S1 was used on the previous turn instead, Turn End removes 1 Count: the +6 tier of S2 reaches only 9, while the +7 tier reaches 10. At 15 Charge Count, spend it on S3 to deliver 3 Rupture Count, substantial Rupture Potency, and Dimensional Rift together. He fits Rupture teams better than Charge teams and also works well with his Dimension Shredder E.G.O.
messages.呼吸を整えたうえでS2のクリティカルによるコイン再利用を連鎖させ、一撃の大火力を: A Pierce attacker who prepares Poise, then chains Critical Hits into Coin reuse on S2 for a major burst of damage. Bleed is a secondary benefit; S2's damage is his main attraction.
messages.S2「刺して刺して刺す」: Ⅱコインがクリティカル的中時にそのコインを再利用(最: **S2 — Relentless Stabbing**: Coin Ⅱ reuses itself on a Critical Hit, up to 1/3 times. With at least 5 Poise Potency, gains +2/+3 Clash Power. Gains 2 Poise Count on use, and Coin Ⅰ grants 2 Poise. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S3「急襲」: 使用時に呼吸5を得る。呼吸7以上ならコイン威力+1。Ⅱコインで出: **S3 — Ambush**: Gains 5 Poise on use. At 7 or more Poise Potency, gains +1 Coin Power. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 4 Bleed and increases Bleed Count by 4/6 on a Critical Hit.
messages.S1「掘り穿つ」: 的中時に呼吸回数が2増加。Ⅱコインで次のターンに束縛1と出血: **S1 — Impale**: On hit, gains 2 Poise Count. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 1 Bind next turn and 2 Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「1等航海士の銛」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): クリティカ: **Combat passive — The First Mate's Harpoon (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On a Critical Hit, increases the Bleed Potency inflicted by his skills by 2, up to 6 activations per turn.
messages.S1で呼吸回数を維持しつつ、S3で呼吸を一気に得てクリティカル率を上げてからS2: Maintain Poise Count with S1, then use S3 to gain Poise Potency and raise his Critical chance before using S2. Each Critical Hit on Coin Ⅱ reuses that Coin, so higher Poise makes the chain and its damage more reliable. His unboosted rolls are low; where possible, prepare Poise before committing S2 to a decisive attack. He is not especially good at building Poise alone, so outside help improves consistency. With 3 Pride Resonance, The Pequod Captain Ishmael's Captain of the Pequod passive grants 4 Poise to the 1/2 allies other than herself with the lowest SP when she defeats an enemy. Selection depends on SP, so Yi Sang is not guaranteed to receive it. Pairing with Captain Ishmael, or using him in Mirror Dungeons where Poise is easier to supplement, helps him perform.
messages.スキルを捨ててバリアを張りながら、挑発値で攻撃を引き受けつつ打撃で殴る、タンク兼: A tank and Blunt attacker who Discards skills for Shield, draws attacks with Aggro, and hits back with Blunt skills. Sinking is secondary.
messages.捨ててバリア: S1「知識消耗」・S2「締め閉じる」は使用時にランクが最も高いス: **Discard for Shield**: S1 Expend Knowledge and S2 Seal Shut each Discard 1 of his highest-ranked skills on use. His defense skill, Fixated Study, Discards 2 random skills in ascending rank order. A Discarded skill grants Shield equal to Insight × a percentage of his Max HP; Discarding S3 Grace of Knowledge gives the largest percentage, 9%/12%. Insight becomes the rank of the last skill Discarded. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.挑発: S2(挑発値3)・S3(挑発値8/10)・守備(挑発値3/5)は、次のタ: **Aggro**: S2, S3, and defense give their slot Aggro next turn: 3 from S2, 8/10 from S3, and 3/5 from defense.
messages.打撃の主力: S2は3コイン、S3は4コインの打撃スキル。S3は捨てる効果を持た: **Main Blunt attacks**: S2 has 3 Coins and S3 has 4. S3 does not Discard, so using it does not grant Shield. S3 gains +1 Coin Power below 50% HP.
messages.バトルパッシブ「沈む知識」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメージ時、攻: **Combat passive — Sinking Knowledge (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When taking damage, inflicts 1 Sinking on the attacker. While he has Shield, inflicts 1 additional Sinking, up to 4 times.
messages.S1・S2を使って高ランクのスキルを捨て、バリアを得ながら次のスキルを引き寄せる: Use S1 and S2 to Discard high-ranked skills, gain Shield, and draw further into his skill pool. Faster cycling also lets him use his stronger S2 and S3 more often. Draw attacks with the Aggro from S2, S3, or defense, absorb them with Shield, and deal Blunt damage in return. Sinking Knowledge adds a little Sinking each time he is hit, but treat it as a bonus. Losing a Clash against an enemy with little Sinking can instead restore that enemy's SP; there is no need to give up Clash Wins just to trigger the passive.
messages.敵のマイナス効果の数で火力が伸びる貫通アタッカー。マイナス効果を盛った敵に撃つS: A Pierce attacker whose damage scales with the number of negative effects on his target. Against a heavily debuffed enemy, S2 Sanguine Pointillism becomes a major attack through its chain of Coin reuses.
messages.S2「血点描画」: Ⅰコイン的中時に20/40%の確率でコインを1回再使用し、対: **S2 — Sanguine Pointillism**: On hit, Coin Ⅰ has a 20%/40% chance to reuse itself, increased by 20 percentage points per negative effect on the target, up to 2 reuses per skill. Each hit adds 1 Bleed Count and inflicts 2/3 Count of a random negative effect. Inflicting a new type of negative effect may improve the chance of the next reuse. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.S3「滴血の彩色」: Ⅳコインは対象のマイナス効果1つにつき与ダメージ量+15/: **S3 — Hematic Coloring**: Coin Ⅳ deals +15%/25% damage per negative effect on the target, up to +75%/125%. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict more Bleed Count and Potency if the target has at least 4/3 negative effects.
messages.ランダムな状態異常と「血点描派」: S1〜S3の一部のコインで火傷・出血・振動・: **Random ailments and Sanguine Pointillist**: Certain Coins on S1–S3 randomly inflict Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking. However, his always-active Sanguine Pointillist passive makes him count only as an Identity that inflicts Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「課題評価」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 的中時、対象の出: **Combat passive — Assignment Evaluation (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On hit against a target with at least 6/4 Bleed Potency, restores 2 SP, plus 1 per negative effect on the target, up to 3 additional SP. If his SP is at its maximum when this recovery occurs, gains 1/2 Offense Level Up next turn. Activates up to 4 times per turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「美学見習い」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も: **Support passive — Practices on Aesthetics (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the ally with the lowest SP hits, they recover 2 SP per negative effect on the target, up to 6, plus another 3 if the target has Bleed. Activates up to 2 times per turn.
messages.S1・S3で出血と複数種のマイナス効果を敵に重ね、数が揃ったところでS2を撃って: Use S1 and S3 to build Bleed and several different negative effects, then use S2 to chain its Coin reuses. Coin Ⅳ of S3 also scales sharply with the number of negative effects, giving him another strong attack against debuffed targets. At 6/4 Bleed Potency on the target, Assignment Evaluation sustains his SP and grants Offense Level Up if he is at maximum SP. He can supply several ailments alone, but allies who add further debuffs improve his performance. Focused Encounters make it easier to keep those effects on one enemy, and Ring teams help supply multiple debuffs. Early on, S2's relatively high minimum roll helps him win Clashes.
messages.特殊沈潜「蝶」をばら撒き、沈潜編成の沈潜を、精神力を持つ敵にも憂鬱ダメージとして: A Pierce attacker who spreads Butterfly, a special form of Sinking that lets Sinking teams deal Gloom damage even to enemies with SP. Allies also recover SP when they attack enemies with Butterfly.
messages.蝶(特殊沈潜、最大15): 威力=生きた蝶、回数=死んだ蝶とみなす。被ダメージ時: **Butterfly (special Sinking; maximum 15)**: Potency represents The Living, and Count represents The Departed. When its bearer takes a hit, the attacker recovers SP equal to The Living ÷ 4, with a minimum of 1. If the bearer's SP is below 0 when hit, deals Gloom damage equal to The Departed × Sinking Potency ÷ 5, capped at 30 in total. At Turn End, The Departed is reset to 0; the bearer receives Sinking equal to The Living, then The Living becomes The Departed.
messages.特殊弾丸と再装填: 戦闘開始時に生きた蝶・死んだ蝶を10ずつ保有し、各コインで消: **Special ammunition and Reload**: Starts battle with 10 of The Living and 10 of The Departed. Each Coin inflicts Butterfly according to the ammunition it consumes. Running out of ammunition cancels all remaining Coins and triggers Reload. When obtaining ammunition, each round has a 70% chance to be The Departed at 0 SP or above, or The Living below 0 SP.
messages.S3「葬儀はイサンより、以上。」: マッチ勝利時に沈潜回数3増加。Ⅲコインで弾を: **S3 — Goodbye Now, a Sorrow in You**: Increases Sinking Count by 3 on Clash Win. Coin Ⅲ consumes all remaining ammunition to inflict Butterfly; Coin Ⅳ deals Gloom damage equal to all Butterfly on the target. Reloads after the attack.
messages.S2「残りし者へ厳粛な哀悼を」: 攻撃後に最大共鳴数だけ弾を得る(最大6、完全共: **S2 — Solemn Lament for the Living**: After attacking, gains ammunition equal to the highest Resonance, up to 6. Absolute Resonance doubles this amount, up to 12; at 4 or more Absolute Resonance, Reloads instead.
messages.バトルパッシブ「撃テ。撃タン。」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分のスキ: **Combat passive — Fire.IShallFire. (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Reloads if his own skill kills a target. Gaining ammunition grants 2 Haste next turn, once per turn.
messages.沈潜編成に入れ、味方の沈潜付与と合わせて蝶を重ねる。蝶はターン終了時に生きた蝶を: Use him in a Sinking team, adding Butterfly to the Sinking inflicted by his allies. At Turn End, The Living applies Sinking and becomes The Departed, so the setup can strengthen Gloom damage from Sinking on the following turn as well. You do not need to spend it immediately; applying Butterfly in preparation for allied attacks next turn also works. S3 expends all ammunition to inflict a large amount of Butterfly, making it useful both to finish an enemy with accumulated Sinking and to prepare the next turn. Reloading costs SP, so actively seek Clash Wins and consider allies who can restore his SP. Both S3 and his defense skill, FromTheCoffinAButterflyTakesFlight, always Reload; account for that cost when managing his SP.
messages.死ぬこと自体が本領の人格。「好餌妖精」で攻撃を集めて倒れ、死亡時のパッシブで最後: An Identity whose main payoff comes from dying. Fairy Lure draws attacks until he falls, then his on-death passive inflicts substantial Rupture on his last attacker and supplies 8 E.G.O resources.
messages.バトルパッシブ「外見もまた在りしL社のE.G.Oに比し幻想体により近き形にて抽出: **Combat passive — This is reflected in their appearance, more closely resembling the source Abnormality than E.G.O of the former L Corp. do (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On death, inflicts 4/5 Rupture and 2/3 Rupture Count on his last attacker, and gains 2 resources of each of the 4 least-owned Sin affinities. Having Fairy Lure doubles the Rupture Potency inflicted. If there was no attacker, targets the enemy with the lowest Rupture Count instead. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.好餌妖精(最大5): S3と守備で好餌妖精2/3を得る(1ターンにつき1回)。タ: **Fairy Lure (maximum 5)**: S3 and defense grant 2/3 Fairy Lure, once per turn. At Turn Start, his leftmost dashboard slot gains 10 Aggro, and he takes +50% damage. When hit, inflicts 1 Rupture on the attacker, up to 3 times per enemy skill, plus 1 more below 50% HP. This hit-triggered Rupture stops applying at 15 or more Rupture Potency on the attacker. Loses 1 Fairy Lure at Turn End.
messages.マッチ敗北で強化: S1・S2は自分を狙うスキルの数に応じてマッチ敗北時の最終威: **Benefits from Clash Losses**: S1 and S2 gain Final Power after losing a Clash based on the number of skills targeting him. Losing also increases the Rupture they inflict by 1/2: Potency for S1, Count for S2. All their Coins are inherently Unbreakable. If the target has at least 15 Rupture Potency and 3 Count, S1 stops inflicting Potency and S2 stops inflicting Count.
messages.挑発: S1・S2・S3・守備は使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る(S3・守備は6: **Aggro**: On use, S1, S2, S3, and defense grant Aggro next turn. S3 and defense grant 6/8.
messages.サポートパッシブ「E.G.Oの崩壊するとき、肥料のごとく分解さる。」(暴食×5・: **Support passive — E.G.O disintegration is not unlike decomposition of compost (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 ally with the lowest current HP dies, gains 2 resources of each of the 2 least-owned Sin affinities.
messages.まず暴食×3を保有してバトルパッシブを有効にし、S3か守備で好餌妖精を得て挑発値: First Own 3 Gluttony to activate his combat passive. Gain Fairy Lure with S3 or defense, then draw attacks with Aggro. Each hit adds Rupture to the attacker. When he dies with Fairy Lure, his passive delivers doubled Rupture Potency and additional Count to his last attacker while generating 8 E.G.O resources. S1 and S2 can inflict Rupture even after a Clash Loss, so winning is not essential to their role. Because the plan involves him dying and being replaced, he suits Chain Battles that bring in another Identity afterward. He is less suitable for battles without replacements. One approach is deliberately leaving him at a low level so that he falls sooner.
messages.火傷アタッカーと、味方の精神力回復を兼ねる人格。: An Identity who combines Burn damage with SP recovery for his allies.
messages.火傷で強化: 攻撃スキルは対象の火傷が多いほどコイン威力・ダメージ量が上がる。: **Scales with Burn**: His attack skills gain Coin Power or damage as the target's Burn increases.
messages.S3「剣の流れ」: Ⅳコインで対象の火傷威力だけ憤怒属性ダメージ(最大30)を与: **S3 — Flow of the Sword**: Coin Ⅳ deals Wrath damage equal to the target's Burn Potency, up to 30, then reduces Burn Count by 2. After attacking, restores SP to the 1 ally other than himself with the lowest SP.
messages.守備「炎反」(反撃): 被ダメージ直前に対象の火傷だけバリアを得る(最大10/1: **Defense — Flame Counter**: Immediately before taking damage, gains Shield equal to the target's Burn Potency, up to 10/15, once per turn. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.バトルパッシブ「内なる熱血」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Inner Ardor (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, restores 5 + the highest Resonance SP, up to 10, to the 1 ally with the lowest SP, excluding himself and allies in Panic or E.G.O Corrosion. At 4 or more Wrath Resonance, affects 1 additional ally. Each recipient with a Base Skill that inflicts Burn receives 5 additional SP.
messages.火傷を付与する人格と組み、火傷を積んで火力を伸ばしつつ、パッシブとS3で味方の精: Pair him with Burn Identities to build Burn for his damage while his passive and S3 support allied SP.
messages.炎拳事務所生存者(グレゴール): S1〜S3が火傷を付与する基本スキルなので、パ: **[Firefist Office Survivor](persona:1211) (Gregor)**: His S1–S3 are Base Skills that inflict Burn, making him eligible for the extra SP recovery from Inner Ardor.
messages.南部リウ協会5課(ホンル): 控えに置くと、サポートパッシブで精神力が最も高い味: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604) (Hong Lu)**: On the bench, his support passive increases the Burn Count inflicted by the ally with the highest SP by 1.
messages.「引き裂かれた追憶」を7まで溜め、S3で味方を撃ち倒して、その代償に敵へ超火力の: A Pierce attacker who builds Torn Memory to 7, shoots down an ally with S3, and turns that sacrifice into a devastating hit against an enemy. Reliably killing the chosen ally is central to his plan.
messages.S3「対象調整射撃」: 戦闘開始時に追憶が7なら、メインターゲットに味方を優先指: **S3 — Target Readjustment Fire**: At Combat Start, having 7 Torn Memory prioritizes an ally as the main target, favoring the target with the lowest HP. Coin Ⅰ is Unbreakable and only damages the main target; if that target is an ally, this attack changes their Pierce resistance to Fatal. If Coin Ⅰ kills an ally, Coin Ⅱ, also Unbreakable, gains +30%/40% damage per Torn Memory, up to +210%/280%. After attacking, loses SP equal to Torn Memory × 2, up to 14. If he had 7 Torn Memory at Combat Start, consumes it all afterward; if the attack killed an ally under that condition, recovers 20 SP. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.引き裂かれた追憶(最大7): S1「隙把握」・S2「貫かん」・守備「前方支援」で: **Torn Memory (maximum 7)**: Gained through S1 See Through Defenses, S2 Punch Through, and defense Front Line Support. Each stack increases S1 and S2 damage. His always-active Volatilized Memory passive removes all stacks at Turn End, then grants the same amount next turn.
messages.呼吸回数の始動: S1は使用時に呼吸回数1/2増加、的中時に1増加。守備は的中時: **Starting Poise Count**: S1 gains 1/2 Poise Count on use and another 1 on hit. Defense gains 2 Poise Potency and 2 Count on hit. S2 gains Potency but does not increase Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「凶弾」(傲慢×6・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の攻撃で味方を死: **Combat passive — Fell Bullet (6 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Killing an ally with his own attack grants Fell Bullet next turn. Torn Memory consumed by his Fell Bullet E.G.O is restored in the same amount next turn.
messages.序盤はS1と守備で呼吸回数を作りながら追憶を貯める。S2は呼吸回数を増やさないの: Early on, use S1 and defense to establish Poise Count while building Torn Memory. S2 does not add Count, so avoid opening with it on turn 1. At 7 Torn Memory, use S3 to shoot an ally. If Coin Ⅰ fails to kill them, Coin Ⅱ does not receive its enhanced damage bonus, so prepare a suitable target beforehand. A simple approach is to bring a low-level Identity into a slot vacated by a withdrawn ally and use them as the target. He is harder to use outside Chain Battles, where losing an ally is a lasting disadvantage. S3 at 6 or fewer Torn Memory, or S2 with accumulated Memory, can still provide some damage without the full setup.
messages.脚力【午】を切らさずにマッチを取り、「敵陣走破」を溜めてバリアと火力を得る、破裂: A Rupture and Tremor tank-attacker who maintains Strider【Wu】, wins Clashes, and builds Linebreaker for Shield and damage. At 5 Linebreaker, S3 becomes the multi-target Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator. He also works with Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael.
messages.脚力【午】(最大3): 守備「突撃前、整えん。」で次のターンに、S3「先鋒走破」: **Strider【Wu】 (maximum 3)**: Defense, Preparation Afore the Charge., grants 3 next turn; S3 Cavalry's Vanguard Charge and Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator grant 3 on use. At Turn End, grants 2 Haste and Aggro equal to its value × 2 for the next turn. Inflicts Tremor on the main target before attacking. Its value decreases by 1 at Turn End.
