messages.敵陣走破(最大5): バトルパッシブ「黒風馬脚」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Linebreaker (maximum 5)**: His combat passive, Obsidian Stormrider (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), grants 1 when he wins a Clash with Strider【Wu】, starts an attack at least 2 Speed faster than his target, or triggers 2 Tremor Bursts with his own skills. Gains up to 3 per turn; Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator cannot generate it. At Turn Start, Linebreaker grants Shield equal to its value × 10. While he has Shield, gains Defense Level equal to Shield ÷ 10, up to 5.
messages.速度と敵陣走破で強化: 自分の速度が対象より高いと各スキルが強化され、S2「月刀: **Speed and Linebreaker bonuses**: Being faster than the target improves his skills. S2 Crescent Blade Strike, with a Speed advantage of at least 2, and S3 gain damage based on Linebreaker. At 3 or more Linebreaker, all Coins on S3 become Unbreakable.
messages.「黒風馬脚月斬」: 敵陣走破が5ならS3が全て消耗してこれとして発動。4枚の破壊: **Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator**: At 5 Linebreaker, S3 consumes it all to activate as this skill. It has 4 Unbreakable Coins and grants 1 Commanding Cry to every ally other than himself next turn. His always-active Adept Vanguard passive also grants him 3 Offense Level Up this turn and next turn when he grants Commanding Cry. If this passive has already granted him Offense Level Up, the new grant applies only next turn.
messages.家主候補イシュメールとの連携: 常時発動パッシブ「狗馬之心」により、家主候補のイ: **Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael synergy**: With her deployed, his always-active The Steed's Houndlike Loyalty passive lets her gain 3 Poise Potency when she inflicts Rupture Potency or Count through skill effects other than E.G.O skills, up to 2 times per turn. At Turn Start, she gains 1 Attack Power Up, plus another 1 at 10 or more Poise Potency. After Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator, she uses Crimson Spring as an Assist Attack, once per turn.
messages.序盤に守備かS3で脚力【午】を得て、攻撃スキルでマッチに勝ち敵陣走破を稼ぐ。敵陣: Start with defense or S3 to gain Strider【Wu】, then win Clashes with attack skills to build Linebreaker. It improves both his Shield and damage, so refresh Strider regularly with defense or S3. Use its Aggro to take attacks and its accumulated Shield to absorb them. At 5 Linebreaker, use Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator to distribute Commanding Cry and gain Offense Level Up himself. Obsidian Stormrider's requirement of 5 Gluttony Owned is substantial, so other Heishou Identities with Gluttony skills help. Family Hierarch Candidate Ishmael gains Poise and Attack Power bonuses from the partnership and can follow Crescent Decapitator with an Assist Attack.
messages.指令に従って印付きスキルを使い、「代行 [ヘルメス]」を9まで溜めては「Furi: An Identity for longer battles who repeatedly follows Prescripts with marked skills, builds Procuration [Hermes] to 9, and unleashes Furioso-Replica before rebuilding.
messages.代行 [ヘルメス](最大9): 常時発動パッシブ「神託端末機[カドゥケウス]」に: **Procuration [Hermes] (maximum 9)**: His always-active Oracle Device [Caduceus] passive grants 1 when he uses a Prescript-marked skill. With his combat passive Imitation of a Life active (1 Gluttony, 1 Gloom, and 1 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), Unbreakable Coin hits from Base Attack Skills grant 1, and Attack End grants more equal to the remaining Unbreakable Coins. He can gain only Unlock tier + 2 per turn; before Unlock - II, he cannot hold more than 8.
messages.「Furioso-Replica」: ターン開始時に代行 [ヘルメス]が9ならS: **Furioso-Replica**: At Turn Start with 9 Procuration [Hermes], S3 transforms into this skill, with only 1 copy allowed on the dashboard. If Procuration [Hermes] increases to 9 during the turn, Imitation of a Life checks this at Turn End and changes a Base Skill into S3 next Turn Start if S3 is absent. All 9 Coins are Unbreakable, and the attack distributes its hits across multiple targets. After attacking, inflicts 5 Burn, 3 Bind, and 3 Fragile next turn on every target it hit, then consumes all Procuration [Hermes].
messages.指令と解禁: ターン開始時に操作スロットの基本攻撃スキルに指令の印が付く(最大2: **Prescripts and Unlock**: At Turn Start, up to 2 Base Attack Skills on his dashboard receive Prescript marks. This process is disabled while he is Staggered, unable to act, in Panic, or in E.G.O Corrosion. The task changes with Unlock tier: initially use a marked skill; at Unlock - I, land a hit with it. Before Unlock - II, fulfilling the Prescript grants 4 SP and 1 Grace of the Prescript at Turn End; if the main target has the Prescript's Target effect, this becomes 8 SP and 3 Grace. At Unlock - II, fulfilling Prescript: [Device] III grants only 4 SP; the reward becomes 8 SP and 3 Grace only when Procuration [Hermes] reaches 9 through fulfillment. Reaching 3/6/9 Grace grants Unlock - I/II/III. Failing a Prescript grants 5 Karmic Consequence, except at Unlock - III. Slash-separated values indicate different Uptie tiers.
messages.傷を隠した仮面: ステージに初めて登場したときに得る(攻撃レベル+2、防御レベル: **Wound-casing Mask**: Gained on his first appearance in the stage, granting +2 Offense Level and -2 Defense Level. His first Stagger of the battle or first use of Furioso-Replica changes it at Turn End into Sizzling Wound: +3 Offense Level, -3 Defense Level, -25% damage taken from unopposed attacks, +15% Unbreakable Coin damage from Base Attack Skills, and 1 Burn and 1 Bleed at Turn Start. If the change was triggered by Stagger, also removes that Stagger, except Forced Stagger.
messages.呼吸と沈潜: S1〜S3は自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計が6以上でコイン威力が上が: **Poise and Sinking**: S1–S3 gain Coin Power from his own Poise Potency and the target's Sinking Potency, with the bonus starting at a combined 6 and reaching up to +2 depending on Uptie tier.
messages.1ターン目から暴食・憂鬱・傲慢を1つずつ揃えて「模造された生」を有効にし、毎ター: From turn 1, gather 1 Gluttony, 1 Gloom, and 1 Pride resource to activate Imitation of a Life. Use Prescript-marked skills each turn to avoid Karmic Consequence while building Procuration [Hermes]. Once you reach 9 at Unlock - II or higher, use Furioso-Replica and rebuild. The gain limit puts the first use around turns 5–6 and later uses roughly 3–4 turns apart when fulfillment and hits go as planned, favoring longer fights such as boss battles. His Mask removes the first eligible Stagger once and changes into his enhanced state, helping him recover from an early Stagger.
messages.烏瞰刀: S2が怠惰、S3が憤怒で、必要資源(怠惰3・憤怒1)をまとめて出せる。: **[Crow’s Eye View](ego:0101)**: Sloth S2 and Wrath S3 can supply both required affinities: 3 Sloth and 1 Wrath.
messages.烏瞰刀: S1が怠惰、S2が憤怒で、同じく必要資源を出せる。: **[Crow’s Eye View](ego:0101)**: Sloth S1 and Wrath S2 also supply its required affinities.
messages.4本目のマッチの火: S1〜S3がすべて火傷を付与し、S2(憤怒)で必要資源の憤: **[4th Match Flame](ego:0102)**: All 3 Base Attack Skills inflict Burn, and Wrath S2 helps supply the main resource requirement.
messages.4本目のマッチの火: パッシブ「満開」が2名以上を攻撃するときのダメージ量+30: **[4th Match Flame](ego:0102)**: Full Bloom grants +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets, fitting this multi-target E.G.O. Gluttony S1 and Sloth S2 also supply required resources.
messages.願いの石: S3と守備が怠惰で、必要資源の怠惰を出せる。: **[Wishing Cairn](ego:0103)**: Sloth S3 and defense supply the Sloth resource requirement.
messages.願いの石: S2と守備が怠惰で、同じく怠惰を出せる。: **[Wishing Cairn](ego:0103)**: Sloth S2 and defense likewise supply Sloth resources.
messages.次元裂き: 充電と破裂の両方を扱い、S1(怠惰)・S2(暴食)で必要資源も出せる: **[Dimension Shredder](ego:0104)**: Uses both Charge and Rupture. Sloth S1 and Gluttony S2 also supply its required affinities.
messages.次元裂き: 破裂を扱う人格で、S1(怠惰)・S3(暴食)で必要資源を出せる。: **[Dimension Shredder](ego:0104)**: Uses Rupture, while Sloth S1 and Gluttony S3 supply the required affinities.
messages.狐雨: パッシブ「満開」が2名以上を攻撃するときのダメージ量+30%で、広域のこ: **[Sunshower](ego:0105)**: Full Bloom grants +30% damage when attacking at least 2 targets, fitting this multi-target E.G.O. Sloth S2 and defense help supply its resources.
messages.狐雨: S3と守備が怠惰で、必要資源の怠惰を出せる。: **[Sunshower](ego:0105)**: Sloth S3 and defense supply the Sloth resource requirement.
messages.過ぎし日: S1(憂鬱)・守備(憂鬱)で必要資源を出せる。沈潜を付与し、パッシブ: **[Bygone Days](ego:0106)**: Gloom S1 and defense supply Gloom resources. He inflicts Sinking, and his passive also uses Gloom Resonance.
messages.過ぎし日: S2・守備が憂鬱で、沈潜を扱う。パッシブ「撃テ。撃タン。」も憂鬱共鳴: **[Bygone Days](ego:0106)**: Uses Sinking and has Gloom S2 and defense. Fire.IShallFire. also activates through Gloom Resonance.
messages.凶弾: S3と守備が傲慢で、パッシブ「凶弾」(傲慢×6)が味方の討伐と追憶を扱う: **[Fell Bullet](ego:0107)**: Pride S3 and defense supply resources. His Fell Bullet passive, requiring 6 Pride Owned, uses allied deaths and Torn Memory, matching this E.G.O's mechanics.
messages.凶弾: S1と守備が傲慢で、必要資源(傲慢6)と傲慢共鳴を稼げる。呼吸を扱う。: **[Fell Bullet](ego:0107)**: Pride S1 and defense help supply the 6 Pride requirement and build Pride Resonance. He also uses Poise.
messages.三千大世界: S1〜S3がすべて火傷を付与し、憤怒・嫉妬の資源も出せる。: **[Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0108)**: All 3 Base Attack Skills inflict Burn, and he supplies Wrath and Envy resources.
messages.三千大世界: S3は的中時に沈潜回数を増やし、傲慢の資源も出せる。S2は次のター: **[Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0108)**: S3 increases Sinking Count on hit and supplies Pride. S2 inflicts 2 Sinking next turn, while successful Evades inflict 1 Sinking. The Count helps maintain Sinking but does not increase the Potency used for this E.G.O's threshold. S2's Potency arrives next turn. Using a Base Skill and this E.G.O in the same turn also requires multiple action slots.
messages.三千大世界: 3つの攻撃スキルが沈潜を付与し、憂鬱・傲慢の資源も出せる。火傷は別: **[Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0108)**: All 3 attack skills inflict Sinking, and he supplies Gloom and Pride resources. Burn needs another source.
messages.厳粛な哀悼: このE.G.Oの専用効果(蝶・再装填・振動付与)の対象になる人格。: **[Solemn Lament](ego:0109)**: The Identity that receives this E.G.O's special Butterfly, Reload, and Tremor benefits. Gloom S2 and defense help supply its resources.
messages.厳粛な哀悼: 沈潜と振動を扱う人格で、このE.G.Oと系統が噛み合う。: **[Solemn Lament](ego:0109)**: Uses both Sinking and Tremor, matching this E.G.O's effects.
messages.人格が戦闘で使う行動。攻撃だけでなく、防御や回避もスキルの一種だ。: An action an Identity uses in battle. Guard and Evade are skills too.
messages.人格の攻撃スキルは、基本的にスキル1を3枚、スキル2を2枚、スキル3を1枚持つ。: An Identity's usual attack pool contains 3 copies of Skill 1, 2 of Skill 2, and 1 of Skill 3. Skill 3 unlocks at Uptie Ⅲ. Each skill slot shows 2 available choices and a preview of the next skill.
messages.スキルスロットごとに、今使えるスキルを1つ選んでターンを始める。攻撃スキルが実際: Select 1 available skill for each slot before starting the turn. An attack skill is consumed when actually used, and the next skills move forward to refill the choices. If the attack never happens because the enemy dies or the Identity is Staggered first, it remains available. An Identity with multiple slots shares the same skill pool across all slots.
messages.通常戦闘ではスキル欄を左から右へつなぐ。集中戦闘では各スロットから敵のスキルへつ: In Normal Encounters, connect skills from left to right. In Focused Encounters, connect each slot to an enemy skill to choose its target. You can also replace an attack with a defense skill.
messages.スキルの効果文では、使用時・マッチ勝利時・的中時など、発動するタイミングも確認す: Read activation timing such as On Use, On Clash Win, and On Hit alongside the skill's effects.
messages.「的中時」の効果は、スキルを選んだだけでは発動しない。攻撃を当てる必要がある。: An On Hit effect requires the attack to land; selecting the skill alone does not activate it.
messages.スキル1・2・3の枚数は基本構成。人格固有の効果で変化する場合は、個別ページや効: The Skill 1/2/3 counts describe the standard pool. Identity-specific effects can change it; check the relevant skill descriptions.
messages.今使えるスキルを選び、次のターンへ送る: Choose an available skill and advance the skill pool
messages.START後、そのスキルを使用: Press START and use that skill
messages.次のスキルが順に補充される: The following skills refill the choices in order
messages.通常の攻撃スキルを実際に使った場合の流れ。守備へ切り替えてターンを進めると、守備: This shows an ordinary attack being used. Replacing it with defense and advancing the turn consumes the original attack even if the defense does not activate. Canceling the replacement does not consume it.
messages.glossary-aliases:skill: S1, S2, S3, Attack Skill, Defense Skill
messages.今使える2つから1つ選ぶ ／ START後、そのスキルを使用 ／ 次のスキルが順: Choose 1 of the 2 available skills / Press START and use that skill / The following skills refill the choices in order
messages.スキルの威力を表・裏の結果で変化させる仕組み。枚数は攻撃の回数にも関わる。: A skill's Coins change its Power according to Heads or Tails. Their number also affects how many attacks it makes.
messages.加算コインは表が出ると威力を増やし、減算コインは表が出ると威力を減らす。符号と枚: Positive Coins increase Power on Heads; negative Coins decrease it on Heads. Read both the sign and the number of Coins.
messages.マッチでは残っているコインを振って威力を比べる。攻撃では、通常は残ったコインごと: During a Clash, the remaining Coins are rolled to compare Power. During an attack, each remaining Coin normally produces a hit.
messages.コインが多いだけで、必ずマッチに勝てるわけではない。: More Coins do not guarantee a Clash Win.
messages.破壊不能コインなど、通常のコインとは異なる挙動もある。: Special types such as Unbreakable Coins behave differently from ordinary Coins.
messages.裏と表は分岐だ。追加効果や威力補正がない例だ。: Heads and Tails are alternative outcomes. This example has no additional effects or Power modifiers.
messages.glossary-aliases:coin: Coin Toss, Positive Coin, Negative Coin
messages.マッチの強さや攻撃の計算に使われる数値。基本威力にコインや効果の補正が加わる。: A value used to resolve Clashes and calculate attacks. Coin results and other effects modify Base Power.
messages.補正のない加算コインのマッチでは、基本威力に「コイン威力 × 表が出た枚数」を足: For positive Coins without other modifiers, Clash Power is Base Power + Coin Power × the number of Heads.
messages.マッチ威力増加などの効果や攻撃レベル差で、比較する数値は変わる。攻撃時はコインご: Clash Power effects and differences in Offense Level can change the compared values. Attack Power is calculated separately for each Coin, so maximum Power is not total damage.
messages.攻撃威力増加・減少は攻撃スキルの最終威力に、マッチ威力増加・減少はマッチ中だけの: Attack Power Up/Down modifies attack skills' Final Power. Clash Power Up/Down applies only to the comparison during a Clash. Distinguish effects that still apply once the attack begins.
messages.威力10でも、与えるダメージが必ず10になるわけではない。: 10 Power does not necessarily deal 10 damage.
messages.「マッチ威力増加」は、攻撃時の威力増加とは区別する。: Clash Power Up is different from a Power increase that also applies during the attack.
messages.基本4・コイン+3・2枚でのマッチ: Clash with Base Power 4, Coin Power +3, and 2 Coins
messages.3つは出目ごとの場合分けだ。効果・レベル差などの補正は省略している。: These are 3 possible outcomes. Other effects and level differences are omitted.
messages.コイン威力の強化は対応する数値を増やし、弱化は減らす。減算コインは負の数値として: A Coin Boost adds to the relevant Coin Power; a Coin Drop subtracts from it. Negative Coin Power is a signed negative value.
messages.加算コイン強化・減算コイン強化は対応するコイン威力に数値を加え、弱化は数値を引く: Plus Coin Boost and Minus Coin Boost add their value to the corresponding Coin Power; Drops subtract it. For negative Coins, moving closer to 0 reduces the amount subtracted on Heads.
messages.これは基本威力や最終威力を直接変える効果とは別枠だ。コインの表裏、枚数、マッチで: This is separate from directly changing Base Power or Final Power. Also consider Heads/Tails, Coin count, and whether a Coin was broken during the Clash.
messages.「強化」「弱化」の名前だけで数値の符号を決めず、加算・減算のどちらのコインか確認: Check whether the Coin is positive or negative before interpreting a Boost or Drop; its name alone does not determine the resulting sign.
messages.加算コイン威力+1に加算コイン強化1：+2になる: +1 positive Coin Power with 1 Plus Coin Boost becomes +2
messages.減算コイン威力-2に減算コイン強化1：-1になる: -2 negative Coin Power with 1 Minus Coin Boost becomes -1
messages.表が出たとき、加算は増加量が増え、減算は減少量が減る: On Heads, the positive Coin adds more and the negative Coin subtracts less
messages.裏ではコインによる加減算は0。基本威力などは別に計算する: On Tails, the Coin contributes 0; Base Power and other modifiers are calculated separately
messages.コイン威力だけを比較した例。基本威力・最終威力の補正や、破壊不能コインがマッチ敗: This compares Coin Power only. It excludes Base Power and Final Power modifiers and the handling of Unbreakable Coins after a Clash Loss.
messages.glossary-aliases:skill-power: Base Power, Coin Power, Clash Power, Maximum Power, Coin Boost, Coin Drop
messages.加算コイン威力+1に加算コイン強化1：+2になる ／ 減算コイン威力-2に減算コ: +1 positive Coin Power with 1 Plus Coin Boost becomes +2 / -2 negative Coin Power with 1 Minus Coin Boost becomes -1 / On Heads, the positive Coin adds more and the negative Coin subtracts less / On Tails, the Coin contributes 0; Base Power and other modifiers are calculated separately
messages.スキル同士で威力を競う仕組み。通常の攻撃スキル同士では、勝った側が攻撃する。: A contest of Power between skills. With ordinary attack skills, the winner gets to attack.
messages.通常の攻撃マッチでは双方がコインを振り、威力の低い側は通常コインを1枚失う。同値: Both sides roll their remaining Coins. The side with lower Power loses 1 ordinary Coin. Ties are rerolled, and the contest continues until one side runs out of Coins.
messages.通常の攻撃スキル同士では、攻撃レベルが高い側のマッチ威力に、相手との攻撃レベル差: In an ordinary attack Clash, the higher-Offense-Level skill gains +1 Clash Power per 3 levels of difference: no bonus at a difference of 2, +1 at 3–5, and +2 at 6–8. Compare the skills' Offense Levels, not the Identities' levels themselves.
messages.通常は勝った側が残ったコインで攻撃する。相手の攻撃を止めるために、どのスキルをマ: The winner normally attacks with their remaining Coins. Choosing the right skill for a Clash helps stop enemy attacks.
messages.「有利」表示でも、必ず勝つとは限らない。: A favorable prediction does not guarantee victory.
messages.破壊不能コインを持つ相手は、マッチに負けても攻撃する場合がある。: An enemy with Unbreakable Coins may still attack after losing the Clash.
messages.マッチ可能な守備スキルもある。勝利後の処理は、そのスキルの効果文を確認する。: Some defense skills can also Clash. Read their descriptions for what happens afterward.
messages.自分がマッチに勝ち、攻撃へ: The ally wins the Clash and attacks
messages.マッチ時の10が、そのまま攻撃ダメージになるわけではない。: The 10 rolled during the Clash is not automatically the attack's damage.
messages.glossary-aliases:match: Clash, Clash Win, Clash Loss, Power Comparison
messages.振った結果：自分10・敵7 ／ 敵のコインが破壊される ／ 自分がマッチに勝ち、: Rolled Power: ally 10, enemy 7 / The enemy's Coin breaks / The ally wins the Clash and attacks
messages.コインの表の出やすさなどに関わる値。体力とは別のパラメーターだ。: A value that affects Heads chance and other mechanics. It is separate from HP.
messages.精神力は-45から+45まで変化する。通常のコインは表面確率が「50%＋精神力」: SP ranges from -45 to +45. Ordinary Coins have a Heads chance of 50% + SP: 5% at -45, 50% at 0, and 95% at +45. Negative Coins lose Power on Heads, so higher SP is not always beneficial.
messages.通常はマッチ勝利や敵の討伐で上がり、E.G.O使用や味方の死亡で下がる。人格ごと: SP normally rises through Clash Wins and enemy kills, and falls through E.G.O use and allied deaths. Check each Identity's Sanity tab: some use different conditions or amounts.
messages.精神力がない敵は、精神力0の敵とは別に扱う。沈潜などの効果を読むときは区別する。: An enemy without SP is different from an enemy at 0 SP. Keep that distinction when reading effects such as Sinking.
messages.精神力と体力は別だ。精神力を回復してもHPは回復しない。: SP and HP are separate. Restoring SP does not restore HP.
messages.精神力を持たない敵もいる。: Some enemies do not have SP.
messages.精神力と通常コインの表面確率: SP and ordinary Coin Heads chance
messages.通常の加算コインを前提にした確率。人格固有のコイン効果・精神力補正は別途確認する: These are ordinary positive-Coin probabilities. Check Identity-specific Coin effects and SP modifiers separately.
messages.精神力-45：表5% ／ 精神力0：表50% ／ 精神力+45：表95%: -45 SP: 5% Heads / 0 SP: 50% Heads / +45 SP: 95% Heads
messages.行動ができなくなり、攻撃を受けた際の耐性も不利になる危険な状態だ。: A dangerous state that prevents actions and worsens incoming-damage resistances.
messages.体力バーの混乱区間を越えると混乱し、そのターンと次のターンの間は行動できなくなる: Crossing a Stagger Threshold on the HP bar causes Stagger, preventing action for the rest of this turn and next turn. Slash, Pierce, and Blunt resistances become Fatal.
messages.混乱区間が複数ある場合は段階があり、混乱+・混乱++では攻撃タイプ耐性がさらに悪: Multiple thresholds allow deeper Stagger states. Stagger+ and Stagger++ worsen Attack Type resistances further. On recovery, crossed thresholds disappear and the next threshold becomes relevant.
messages.集中戦闘の敵は部位ごとに混乱区間を持つ。ある部位が混乱しても、他の部位まで行動不: Focused Encounter enemies have separate Stagger Thresholds for their parts. Staggering one part does not necessarily disable the others. This is also different from breaking a part by depleting its HP.
messages.精神力の低下によるパニックとは別の仕組みだ。: Stagger is separate from Panic caused by low SP.
messages.混乱区間の移動など、HPを削る以外に混乱へ関わる効果もある。: Effects that move Stagger Thresholds can cause Stagger without relying only on HP damage.
messages.そのターンと次ターンの間、該当する人格・部位が行動不能: The affected Identity or part cannot act for this turn and next turn
messages.復帰すると越えた区間が消え、次の区間が基準になる: On recovery, the crossed threshold disappears and the next one takes its place
messages.部位破壊や強制混乱など、個別の敵ギミックは別に扱う。: Part breaks, Forced Stagger, and enemy-specific mechanics are separate cases.
messages.HPが混乱区間を越える ／ そのターンと次ターンの間、該当する人格・部位が行動不: HP crosses the threshold / The affected Identity or part cannot act for this turn and next turn / On recovery, the crossed threshold disappears and the next one takes its place
messages.斬撃・貫通・打撃の区分。相手の物理耐性と組み合わせてダメージに関わる。: Slash, Pierce, or Blunt. It affects damage together with the target's physical resistance.
messages.人格全体ではなく、各攻撃スキルにタイプがある。S1とS3で異なるタイプを使う人格: Each attack skill has its own type. An Identity can use different types on S1 and S3.
messages.相手の弱点を調べる際は、使うスキルのタイプと相手の対応する耐性を見比べる。: To exploit a weakness, compare the selected skill's type with the target's matching resistance.
messages.同じ人格でも、全スキルが同じ攻撃タイプとは限らない。: An Identity's skills do not necessarily all share one Attack Type.
messages.耐性を見る組み合わせ: Match the skill to the resistance
messages.罪悪属性は別の区分だ。攻撃タイプだけで最終ダメージは決まらない。: Sin affinity is a separate classification. Attack Type alone does not determine final damage.
messages.使うスキル：貫通 ／ 相手の耐性：貫通の欄 ／ その倍率を確認: Selected skill: Pierce / Target resistance: Pierce column / Check that resistance value
messages.憤怒・色欲・怠惰・暴食・憂鬱・傲慢・嫉妬の7属性。資源や共鳴にも関わる。: The 7 affinities: Wrath, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, Gloom, Pride, and Envy. They also govern resources and Resonance.
messages.攻撃スキルには、攻撃タイプとは別に罪悪属性が設定される。同じ斬撃でも罪悪属性が違: Attack skills have a Sin affinity separate from Attack Type. Two Slash skills can have different affinities. Some defense skills have no Sin affinity.
messages.罪悪属性は相手の耐性のほか、E.G.Oに使う資源やパッシブの条件を考える際にも確: Check Sin affinity for enemy resistances, E.G.O resources, and passive requirements.
messages.資源の「保有」と、そのターンのスキル選択に関わる「共鳴」は別の条件だ。: Owned resources and Resonance from this turn's skill selection are different conditions.
messages.斬撃と憤怒は別々の情報だ。色だけでなく属性名も見る。: Slash and Wrath are separate properties. Read the names as well as the colors.
messages.glossary-aliases:sin: Sin, Wrath, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, Gloom, Pride, Envy
messages.攻撃スキルを確認 ／ 攻撃タイプ：斬撃 ／ 罪悪属性：憤怒: Check an attack skill / Attack Type: Slash / Sin affinity: Wrath
messages.攻撃を受ける側の、ダメージの通りやすさ。耐性欄の数値が大きいほど、受ける量が増え: How readily the defender takes damage. A larger displayed resistance value generally means more damage taken.
messages.攻撃タイプに対する耐性と罪悪属性に対する耐性を区別して確認する。耐性欄の数値は1: Check Attack Type resistance and Sin resistance separately. Their reference value is 1: higher values increase damage, and lower values reduce it.
messages.味方の物理耐性の基本値は人格で決まり、人格ページの斬・貫・打の欄に表示される。一: An ally's Identity determines their base physical resistances, shown in the Slash, Pierce, and Blunt columns. E.G.O determines Sin resistances. Battle begins with the equipped ZAYIN E.G.O's resistances; after an E.G.O attack finishes, its Sin resistances replace the current ones.
messages.最終ダメージでは両方の耐性や他の補正が組み合わさるため、表示数値をそのまま最終ダ: Final damage combines both resistances with other modifiers. The displayed values are not direct ratios of final damage.
messages.脆弱・保護は、1ターンのスキル被ダメージ量を増減させる効果。耐性欄を書き換える効: Fragile and Protection modify skill damage taken for 1 turn. They do not rewrite the resistance table and are handled separately in damage calculation. Affinity-specific versions apply only to the named affinity.
messages.弱点を突けても、マッチに勝ちやすくなるとは限らない。ダメージとマッチ威力を分けて: Exploiting a weakness does not necessarily improve Clash odds. Damage and Clash Power are different.
messages.耐性×0.5を「最終ダメージが必ず半分」、×2.0を「必ず2倍」とは読まない。: Do not read ×0.5 as guaranteed half damage or ×2.0 as guaranteed double damage.
messages.状態効果の「脆弱」は被ダメージを増やす別の効果だ。耐性欄の表記と混同しないこと。: The Fragile status is a separate damage-taken effect; do not confuse it with a resistance label.
messages.耐性欄の数値と、ダメージへの方向: Resistance values and their effect on damage
messages.棒の長さは耐性欄の数値の比較で、最終ダメージ比ではない。もう一方の耐性やレベル差: Bar length compares displayed resistance values, not final damage ratios. The other resistance and level differences also affect calculation.
messages.耐性は攻撃の通りやすさ、脆弱・保護は期間限定の被ダメージ補正。: Resistance affects damage effectiveness; Fragile and Protection temporarily modify damage taken.
messages.脆弱1につき被ダメージ量が10%増え、保護1につき10%減る。どちらも通常は最大: Each 1 Fragile increases damage taken by 10%; each 1 Protection reduces it by 10%. Both normally cap at 10 and last for 1 turn. Other modifiers still affect final damage.
messages.ダメージ量増加・減少は攻撃する側のスキルダメージを増減する。対象属性が書かれてい: Damage Up and Damage Down modify the attacker's skill damage. If an affinity is specified, only that affinity is affected.
messages.これらは威力補正と違い、マッチの勝敗を直接変える数値ではない。マッチ威力、攻撃威: Unlike Power modifiers, these do not directly determine Clash results. Distinguish Clash Power, Attack Power, and damage effects.
messages.耐性・脆弱・保護・ダメージ量補正は複数の補正の一部。最終ダメージを単独の数値だけ: Resistance, Fragile, Protection, and damage modifiers are only parts of the calculation. One value alone does not determine final damage.
messages.マッチ威力：マッチの勝敗に関わる: Clash Power: affects who wins the Clash
messages.ダメージ量増加：攻撃側のダメージに関わる: Damage Up: modifies the attacker's damage
messages.脆弱・保護：受ける側のスキルダメージに関わる: Fragile and Protection: modify the defender's skill damage taken
messages.属性別の効果は対象属性を確認する。補正の重なり方や最終値の算出はダメージ計算を参: Check the named affinity for affinity-specific effects. See damage calculation for how modifiers combine.
messages.glossary-aliases:resistance: Weakness, Physical Resistance, Sin Resistance, Resistance Value, Fragile, Protection, Damage Up, Damage Down
messages.×0.5：軽減する方向 ／ ×1.0：耐性の基準 ／ ×2.0：増加する方向: ×0.5: reduces damage / ×1.0: reference value / ×2.0: increases damage
messages.マッチ威力：マッチの勝敗に関わる ／ ダメージ量増加：攻撃側のダメージに関わる: Clash Power: affects who wins the Clash / Damage Up: modifies the attacker's damage / Fragile and Protection: modify the defender's skill damage taken
messages.状態効果の強さと、残りの発動・持続に関わる値。減るタイミングは効果ごとに異なる。: Values describing a status effect's strength and remaining activations or duration. When Count decreases depends on the effect.
messages.状態効果では、威力と回数を分けて扱うものがある。「威力を付与」と「回数を増加」は: Some statuses track Potency and Count separately. Inflicting Potency and increasing Count are different changes.
messages.例えば火傷はターン終了時、破裂は攻撃を受けたときに働く。何をきっかけに発動し、回: Burn normally activates at Turn End; Rupture activates when the bearer is hit. Check each effect's trigger and when its Count decreases.
messages.同じ効果を重ねたときの加算・上限・回数消耗は、効果ごとに違う。一般ルールとして一: Stacking, caps, and Count consumption differ between effects. Read each description rather than assuming one universal rule.
messages.回数2が、必ず「あと2ターン」を意味するわけではない。: 2 Count does not necessarily mean 2 turns remaining.
messages.スキル威力と状態効果の威力は別の値だ。: Skill Power and status Potency are separate values.
messages.次の発動後：回数が尽きる: After the next activation, Count runs out
messages.威力・回数を途中で増減させる効果や特殊な補正はないものとする。: Assumes no effects that change Potency or Count during the sequence and no special modifiers.
messages.攻撃を受ける：追加ダメージ5 ／ 回数が2から1へ ／ 次の発動後：回数が尽きる: Take a hit: 5 additional damage / Count falls from 2 to 1 / After the next activation, Count runs out
messages.ターン終了時にダメージが発生する状態効果。威力と回数で、1回の被害と持続を分けて: A status that deals damage at Turn End. Potency determines damage per activation; Count tracks duration.
messages.通常の火傷は、ターン終了時に威力に応じた固定ダメージを与え、その後に回数が1減る: Ordinary Burn deals fixed damage equal to its Potency at Turn End, then loses 1 Count.
messages.威力を増やす効果と回数を増やす効果は別だ。攻撃を何回当てたかではなく、ターン終了: Increasing Potency and increasing Count are different effects. Turn End, rather than the number of attack hits, is its normal trigger.
messages.固定ダメージでも、敵が持つ火傷への軽減などの特殊効果は別途確認する。: Even fixed damage can interact with special enemy effects that reduce Burn damage.
messages.黒炎など、火傷と関係する固有効果まで同じ処理とは限らない。: Related effects such as Dark Flame do not necessarily follow the same rules.
messages.火傷：威力5・回数2を維持した場合: Burn maintained at 5 Potency and 2 Count
messages.途中の付与・消耗、火傷ダメージへの補正、特殊効果はない例。: No additional applications, consumption, Burn damage modifiers, or special effects occur in this example.
messages.1回目のターン終了：5ダメージ・回数2→1 ／ 2回目のターン終了：5ダメージ・: First Turn End: 5 damage, Count 2 → 1 / Second Turn End: 5 damage, Count 1 → 0
messages.付与された対象が攻撃スキルのコイン判定を行うと、ダメージを受ける状態効果。: A status that damages its bearer when they roll attack-skill Coins.
messages.通常の出血は、攻撃スキルコインの判定時に威力分の固定ダメージが発生し、判定後に回: Ordinary Bleed deals fixed damage equal to its Potency when an attack Coin is rolled, then loses 1 Count after the roll.
messages.相手の攻撃が当たったときに働く破裂とは異なる。マッチ中の判定でも出血が働くため、: Unlike Rupture, it does not wait for an enemy attack to hit the bearer. Bleed also activates during Clashes, so watch when the bearer acts.
messages.マッチでコインをまとめて振る処理と、攻撃時に順番に判定する処理を、単純に同じ発動: Do not simply count simultaneous Clash rolls and sequential attack rolls as identical numbers of activations.
messages.通常の守備スキルも、攻撃スキルと同じように出血を発動させるとは扱わない。: Ordinary defense skills do not trigger Bleed in the same way as attack skills.
messages.出血を持つ対象が攻撃コインの判定を行う: A Bleeding unit rolls an attack Coin
messages.対象が攻撃コインを判定: The unit rolls an attack Coin
messages.対象が出血ダメージを受け、回数が減る: The unit takes Bleed damage and loses Count
messages.ここでいう対象は、出血を付与された側。コインが表か裏かにかかわらず判定が発動のき: The unit here is the bearer of Bleed. The roll triggers it regardless of Heads or Tails.
messages.対象が出血を持つ ／ 対象が攻撃コインを判定 ／ 対象が出血ダメージを受け、回数: The unit has Bleed / The unit rolls an attack Coin / The unit takes Bleed damage and loses Count
messages.通常は振動爆発を通じて混乱区間を前進させる状態効果。付与だけでダメージが発生する: A status normally used to raise Stagger Thresholds through Tremor Burst. Applying it alone does not deal damage.
messages.通常の振動は、振動爆発の効果を持つ攻撃を受けると、威力に応じて混乱区間が前進する: When an attack triggers Tremor Burst, ordinary Tremor raises Stagger Thresholds according to its Potency. Its Count falls by 1 after Turn End.
messages.振動を付与する役割と、振動爆発を起こす役割を分けて見る。振幅変換などによって、通: Distinguish applying Tremor from triggering Tremor Burst. Amplitude Conversion and similar effects can change its behavior.
messages.振動の威力を、そのまま通常の追加ダメージとして数えない。: Do not treat Tremor Potency as ordinary additional damage.
messages.同じ「振動」を含む名前でも、変換後の効果は個別に確認する。: Read each converted Tremor effect separately, even if its name still includes Tremor.
messages.振動爆発の効果を通す: Land an effect that triggers Tremor Burst
messages.混乱区間の前進が必ず即座の混乱を意味するわけではない。変換された振動の追加効果は: Raising a threshold does not always cause immediate Stagger. Additional effects of converted Tremor are outside this diagram.
messages.相手に振動を付与 ／ 振動爆発の効果を通す ／ 混乱区間が前進する: Inflict Tremor on the enemy / Land an effect that triggers Tremor Burst / The Stagger Threshold rises
messages.付与された対象が攻撃を受けると、通常の攻撃とは別にダメージが発生する状態効果。: A status that deals damage separately from the normal attack when its bearer is hit.
messages.通常の破裂は、攻撃スキルを受けたときに威力分の固定ダメージが発生し、その後に回数: Ordinary Rupture deals fixed damage equal to its Potency when the bearer is hit by an attack skill, then loses 1 Count.
messages.回数を使い切ると続かないため、威力だけでなく回数の補充も確認する。出血のように対: It ends when Count runs out, so maintain Count as well as Potency. Unlike Bleed, it does not wait for the bearer's own attack Coin rolls.
messages.回数2は「2ターン持続」の意味ではない。: 2 Count does not mean a duration of 2 turns.
messages.敵の破裂ダメージ軽減など、固有の補正は別途確認する。: Check enemy-specific modifiers such as Rupture damage reduction separately.
messages.通常の攻撃ダメージは図の数値に含めない。途中の付与・消耗や特殊な補正はない例。: Normal attack damage is excluded. There are no additional applications, consumption, or special modifiers.
messages.1回目の被弾：追加ダメージ5・回数2→1 ／ 2回目の被弾：追加ダメージ5・回数: First hit: 5 additional damage, Count 2 → 1 / Second hit: 5 additional damage, Count 1 → 0
messages.攻撃でダメージを受けた対象の精神力を削る状態効果。精神力のない相手には扱いが変わ: A status that damages SP when its bearer takes attack damage. It behaves differently against targets without SP.
messages.通常の沈潜は、攻撃スキルによる被ダメージ時に威力分の精神力ダメージを与え、その後: Ordinary Sinking deals SP damage equal to its Potency when the bearer takes damage from an attack skill, then loses 1 Count.
messages.精神力のない対象には、憂鬱属性のダメージとして働く。精神力が0の対象と、精神力そ: Against targets without SP, it deals Gloom damage instead. A target at 0 SP is different from one that has no SP at all.
messages.精神力ダメージを、そのままHPへのダメージと数えない。: SP damage is not automatically HP damage.
messages.精神力のない相手へのダメージは、憂鬱耐性などの影響を確認する。: Against targets without SP, account for Gloom resistance and other relevant modifiers.
messages.同じ沈潜でも、対象によって働き方が変わる: Sinking behaves differently depending on the target
messages.沈潜を持つ対象が攻撃でダメージを受ける: A target with Sinking takes attack damage
messages.精神力なし：憂鬱属性ダメージ: Has no SP: takes Gloom damage
messages.分岐のどちらでも、通常は発動後に回数が1減る。沈潜殺到などの別効果は含めない。: In either branch, ordinary Sinking loses 1 Count after activation. Separate effects such as Sinking Deluge are excluded.
messages.沈潜を持つ対象が攻撃でダメージを受ける ／ 精神力あり：精神力ダメージ ／ 精神: A target with Sinking takes attack damage / Has SP: takes SP damage / Has no SP: takes Gloom damage
messages.威力に応じてクリティカルの発生確率が上がる状態効果。回数は発動と持続に関わる。: A status whose Potency raises Critical Hit chance. Count governs activation and persistence.
messages.通常の呼吸は、威力1につきクリティカル確率が5%となる。クリティカルが発動すると: Ordinary Poise gives 5% Critical Hit chance per 1 Potency. A Critical Hit adds a modifier to damage calculation.
messages.回数はクリティカル発動後とターン終了時に1減る。威力を高めても、回数が尽きれば維: Count falls by 1 after a Critical Hit and at Turn End. High Potency cannot sustain the effect once Count runs out.
messages.呼吸の威力は、コイン威力を直接増やす数値ではない。: Poise Potency does not directly increase Coin Power.
messages.クリティカルで最終ダメージが常に1.2倍になるとは限らない。人格固有の強化や条件: A Critical Hit does not always multiply final damage by 1.2. Account for Identity-specific bonuses and conditions.
messages.呼吸威力10：通常のクリティカル確率: 10 Poise Potency: ordinary Critical Hit chance
messages.確定ではなく、半分の確率: A half chance, not a guarantee
messages.呼吸回数があり、確率への特殊な補正がない例。クリティカル率と、コインが表になる確: Assumes Poise Count remains and there are no special chance modifiers. Critical Hit chance and Coin Heads chance are separate.
messages.呼吸威力10 ／ 10 × 5% = 50% ／ 確定ではなく、半分の確率: 10 Poise Potency / 10 × 5% = 50% / A half chance, not a guarantee
messages.スキルの条件や消費に使う蓄積資源。充電があるだけで、一律に攻撃が強くなるわけでは: A stored resource used for skill conditions and costs. Having Charge does not universally strengthen attacks.
messages.通常の充電回数は最大20まで蓄積でき、ターン終了時に1減る。スキルごとの条件や消: Ordinary Charge Count can stack up to 20 and falls by 1 at Turn End. Skills use it according to their own requirements and costs.
messages.何回数で強化されるか、消費が必要かは人格・スキルによって異なる。充電威力を参照す: Thresholds and consumption differ by Identity and skill. Some special effects check Charge Potency rather than Count; read them separately.
messages.充電回数はE.G.Oに使う罪悪資源とは別の値。: Charge Count is separate from the Sin resources used for E.G.O.
messages.特殊な上限や維持・消費の効果がある場合は、人格側の説明を優先する。: Identity-specific descriptions take precedence for special caps, upkeep, and consumption rules.
messages.充電回数を確認してスキルを選ぶ: Check Charge Count before choosing a skill
messages.スキルの必要条件・消費量と比べる: Compare it with the skill's requirement and cost
messages.条件を満たすスキルを選ぶ: Choose a skill whose condition is met
messages.必要回数を全人格共通の値として決めない。ターン終了時の減少も考慮する。: Do not assume every Identity needs the same Charge Count. Account for the decrease at Turn End.
messages.現在の充電回数を見る ／ スキルの必要条件・消費量と比べる ／ 条件を満たすスキ: Check current Charge Count / Compare it with the skill's requirement and cost / Choose a skill whose condition is met
messages.対象のコイン威力を、数値の枚数分だけ1ターンの間0に固定するマイナス効果。: A debuff that fixes the Coin Power of a stated number of the target's Coins at 0 for 1 turn.
messages.麻痺1なら、そのターンに使うスキルのコイン1枚分のコイン威力が0になる。基本威力: 1 Paralyze fixes the Coin Power of 1 Coin used that turn at 0. It does not directly reduce Base Power or Final Power by 1.
messages.加算コインでは表が出ても麻痺したコインの威力は加算されない。減算コインでは本来の: A paralyzed positive Coin adds no Power even on Heads. A paralyzed negative Coin loses its usual subtraction, so Paralyze can sometimes prevent a Power decrease.
messages.麻痺はコインの使用順に消費される。マッチで先に使われたコインに適用されるため、マ: Paralyze is consumed in Coin-use order. Coins used during a Clash can consume it first; whether any remains for the attack depends on Coin count and Clash results.
messages.麻痺の枚数とスキルの残りコイン数を混同しない。破壊不能コインやコイン効果が関わる: Do not confuse Paralyze stacks with the skill's remaining Coins. Check specific descriptions when Unbreakable Coins or Coin effects are involved.
messages.加算コイン：表でも麻痺分は加算されない: Positive Coin: the paralyzed Coin adds nothing on Heads
messages.減算コイン：マイナスのコイン威力が0になる: Negative Coin: negative Coin Power becomes 0
messages.基本威力や他の威力補正とは別に確認: Check Base Power and other Power modifiers separately
messages.麻痺が適用されるコインの順序や、マッチと攻撃での処理はスキルの状態によって変わる: The order in which Paralyze is applied, and its handling during Clashes and attacks, depend on the skill's current state.
messages.加算コイン：表でも麻痺分は加算されない ／ 減算コイン：マイナスのコイン威力が0: Positive Coin: the paralyzed Coin adds nothing on Heads / Negative Coin: negative Coin Power becomes 0 / Check Base Power and other Power modifiers separately
messages.マッチに負けても残る特殊なコイン。勝つだけでは相手の攻撃を止めきれない。: A special Coin that remains after a Clash Loss. Winning alone may not stop the opponent's attack.
messages.攻撃スキルに含まれる場合、マッチ敗北後も残った該当コインで攻撃する。通常はマッチ: When present in an attack skill, these Coins remain and attack after a Clash Loss, normally after the winner's attack resolves.
messages.敗北で元のコイン威力が1になるが、その後のコイン威力増加などは別に適用される。元: A lost Clash changes the original Coin Power to 1; subsequent Coin Power bonuses still apply separately. Distinguish inherently Unbreakable Coins from Coins changed by an effect.
messages.摘出コインには破壊され得る。名前から「何があっても破壊されない」とは判断しない。: Excision Coins can break them. Unbreakable does not mean indestructible under every circumstance.
messages.マッチに勝つ意味がなくなるわけではない。弱体化や被害の軽減、回避なども検討する。: Winning a Clash still matters. Consider weakening the attack, reducing damage, or Evading it.
messages.相手の残った破壊不能コインが攻撃: The opponent's remaining Unbreakable Coins attack
messages.基本的な仕組みの図。個別の効果・制限は使用するスキルや戦闘の説明も確認する。: This diagram shows the basic mechanic. Check the skill or encounter description for specific effects and restrictions.
messages.マッチに勝つ ／ 自分の攻撃を処理 ／ 相手の残った破壊不能コインが攻撃: Win the Clash / Resolve your attack / The opponent's remaining Unbreakable Coins attack
messages.マッチ中に破壊不能コインを壊せる特殊コイン。自身がマッチに負けたときの挙動は破壊: A special Coin that can break Unbreakable Coins during a Clash. When it loses a Clash itself, it behaves like an Unbreakable Coin.
messages.通常のコインはマッチ中に壊れると、その後は威力比較に使われない。摘出コインは破壊: An ordinary Coin that breaks during a Clash no longer contributes to later Power comparisons. An Excision Coin can also break Unbreakable Coins.
messages.摘出コインを持つ側がマッチに負けた場合は、そのコイン自体は壊れずに残る。攻撃スキ: If the side with an Excision Coin loses the Clash, that Coin remains unbroken. In an attack skill, it attacks after taking damage, with its unbroken Coin Power changed to 1.
messages.つまり「相手の破壊不能コインに干渉する特性」と「自分が負けたときにコインが残る特: It therefore has 2 properties: breaking the opponent's Unbreakable Coins, and remaining after its own Clash Loss.
messages.破壊不能コインを壊せても、マッチに勝つとは限らない。コイン破壊とマッチ勝利は別に: Being able to break Unbreakable Coins does not guarantee a Clash Win. Coin destruction and Clash victory are separate results.
messages.コインの残数、マッチ後に攻撃が行われる順序、個別効果の処理はスキルの条件も確認す: Check the skill's conditions for remaining Coins, attack order after the Clash, and individual effects.
messages.摘出コインが持つ二つの性質: The two properties of Excision Coins
messages.相手の破壊不能コインをマッチ中に破壊できる: Can break enemy Unbreakable Coins during a Clash
messages.自分はマッチ敗北でもコインが残り、被ダメージ後に攻撃する: Survives its own Clash Loss and attacks after taking damage
messages.上は同時に持つ特性の比較で、一回のマッチで必ずこの順に発生する説明ではない。相手: These are concurrent properties, not a guaranteed sequence in every Clash. Breaking an opposing Coin does not guarantee victory.
messages.摘出コインが持つ二つの性質 ／ 相手の破壊不能コインをマッチ中に破壊できる ／: The two properties of Excision Coins / Can break enemy Unbreakable Coins during a Clash / Survives its own Clash Loss and attacks after taking damage
messages.囚人に装備し、条件を満たして戦闘中に使う特殊なスキル。人格の通常スキルとは別に扱: A special skill equipped to a Sinner and used in battle when its requirements are met. It is separate from an Identity's ordinary skills.
messages.囚人ごとにZAYIN・TETH・HE・WAW・ALEPH各クラスのE.G.Oを装: Each Sinner can equip E.G.O in the ZAYIN, TETH, HE, WAW, and ALEPH classes. In battle, spend the required Sin resources to replace an attack skill with E.G.O.
messages.E.G.O使用には罪悪資源と精神力が必要。使用スキルの威力・効果だけでなく、使用: E.G.O use requires Sin resources and SP. Check not only its Power and effects, but also the Sin resistances it will apply and the passive that begins next turn.
messages.通常使用では覚醒スキルを選ぶ。精神力の低さによるランダム侵蝕や、長押しで選ぶオー: Normal use selects Awakening. Random Corrosion caused by low SP, or Overclock chosen by holding the icon, can use Corrosion instead.
messages.資源が足りることと、安全に使えることは別。精神力や攻撃対象も見る。: Having enough resources does not mean it is safe to use. Check SP and targets too.
messages.使用したいE.G.Oと必要資源を選ぶ: Choose the E.G.O and check its resource cost
messages.精神力・侵蝕確率・使用後の耐性を確認: Check SP, Corrosion chance, and the resulting resistances
messages.覚醒か侵蝕か、対象と効果を確認して使う: Confirm Awakening or Corrosion, targets, and effects before use
messages.E.G.Oや戦闘条件によって精神力の負担と対象指定は異なる。個別のE.G.O説明: SP costs and targeting depend on the E.G.O and encounter conditions. Check its individual description.
messages.使用したいE.G.Oと必要資源を選ぶ ／ 精神力・侵蝕確率・使用後の耐性を確認: Choose the E.G.O and check its resource cost / Check SP, Corrosion chance, and the resulting resistances / Confirm Awakening or Corrosion, targets, and effects before use
messages.E.G.Oを通常使用するときのスキル。侵蝕スキルとは性能・対象などが異なる。: The skill normally selected when using E.G.O. Its effects and targeting differ from Corrosion.
messages.E.G.Oを通常の手順で使用したときに選ばれるスキル。罪悪資源はE.G.Oへの変: Normal E.G.O use selects Awakening. Sin resources are spent when converting the skill to E.G.O; SP is spent before the attack begins.
messages.使用前に表示される侵食確率は、精神力コストを払った後の予測値をもとに決まる。実際: The displayed Corrosion chance uses the predicted SP after paying the cost, although the actual deduction occurs before attacking. Normally, a prediction of -24 or higher does not Corrode; at -25 or lower, Awakening may change into Corrosion at the displayed chance. Check it before use.
messages.侵蝕スキルがあるか、侵蝕時に対象を指定できるかはE.G.Oごとに異なる。: Whether Corrosion exists, and whether its target can be selected, depends on the E.G.O.
messages.覚醒と侵蝕の説明を混ぜず、それぞれの効果文を確認する。: Read Awakening and Corrosion separately rather than combining their effects.
messages.E.G.Oの必要資源と精神力を確認: Check the E.G.O's resource and SP requirements
messages.精神力消費後の侵蝕確率を見る: Check Corrosion chance after the projected SP cost
messages.覚醒スキルと対象を確認して発動: Confirm the Awakening skill and its target, then activate
messages.侵蝕確率は戦闘中のE.G.O選択画面に表示される。初期E.G.Oには侵蝕スキルが: The E.G.O selection screen displays Corrosion chance. Starting E.G.O has no Corrosion skill.
messages.E.G.Oの必要資源と精神力を確認 ／ 精神力消費後の侵蝕確率を見る ／ 覚醒ス: Check the E.G.O's resource and SP requirements / Check Corrosion chance after the projected SP cost / Confirm the Awakening skill and its target, then activate
messages.精神力の悪化などでE.G.Oの侵蝕スキルが発動する現象。味方を巻き込む危険もある: Activation of an E.G.O Corrosion skill, often through low SP. It can put allies at risk.
messages.人格の精神力が-45に達すると、次ターンからE.G.O侵食状態になり、通常の指示: Reaching -45 SP causes the Identity to enter E.G.O Corrosion from the next turn, preventing normal commands. Targets follow the Corrosion skill's own rules and may not be selectable.
messages.侵蝕状態でなくても、E.G.O使用時に精神力消費後の値が-25以下なら、表示され: Even outside that state, using E.G.O with projected SP at -25 or lower after its cost can trigger Corrosion at the displayed chance. This random skill change alone does not cause the E.G.O Corrosion state.
messages.E.G.Oの選択画面で侵蝕確率と侵蝕スキルの対象条件を確認する。: Check the selection screen's Corrosion chance and the Corrosion skill's targeting rules.
messages.精神力が低くても、全ての人格・装備で同じ挙動になるとは扱わない。: Low SP does not produce identical behavior for every Identity and equipment setup.
messages.狙って侵蝕スキルを使うオーバークロックと、自動で起きる侵蝕を区別する。: Distinguish deliberate Overclock from automatic Corrosion.
messages.精神力-45に到達：次ターンからE.G.O侵食状態になる: Reach -45 SP: enter E.G.O Corrosion next turn
messages.精神力消費後-25以下：E.G.O使用時に侵蝕スキルの確率が発生: At -25 or lower after the SP cost: E.G.O use has a Corrosion chance
messages.侵蝕状態か、侵蝕スキルだけの発動かを分けて確認: Check whether this is a Corrosion state or only a Corrosion skill activation
messages.ランダム侵蝕とE.G.O侵蝕状態は別。侵蝕状態では指示不能、ランダム侵蝕では通常: These are separate mechanics. The Corrosion state prevents commands; random Corrosion normally leaves the Identity under player control.
messages.精神力-45に到達：次ターンからE.G.O侵食状態になる ／ 精神力消費後-25: Reach -45 SP: enter E.G.O Corrosion next turn / At -25 or lower after the SP cost: E.G.O use has a Corrosion chance / Check whether this is a Corrosion state or only a Corrosion skill activation
messages.追加の負担を払って侵蝕スキルを選ぶE.G.Oの使用方法。: A way to deliberately select a Corrosion skill by paying an additional cost.
messages.E.G.O選択アイコンを長押しし、通常の1.5倍の罪悪資源と精神力を使って侵蝕ス: Hold the E.G.O selection icon to use Corrosion at 1.5 times the normal Sin resource and SP cost. Fractional resource costs round up.
messages.必要資源の1.5倍以上を持っていれば安定オーバークロックとなり、侵食スキルの対象: With at least 1.5 times the required resources, Stable Overclock permits target selection according to the Corrosion skill's rules. With at least the normal cost but less than 1.5 times it, Unstable Overclock cannot distinguish friend from foe, and missing resources become negative.
messages.侵蝕スキルは覚醒スキルと効果・対象が異なる。コストを増やしても常に強いわけではな: Corrosion differs from Awakening in effects and targets. Paying more does not always make it better; read the skill before use.
messages.自動侵蝕と同じ操作・同じ対象指定ができるとは限らない。: Do not assume automatic Corrosion uses the same controls or permits the same targeting.
messages.必要資源3のE.G.Oの場合: An E.G.O with a resource cost of 3
messages.安定OCには1.5倍を切り上げて5必要: Stable Overclock needs 1.5 times the cost, rounded up to 5
messages.3〜4なら不安定OC。対象を指定できず、資源不足が負数になる: At 3–4, Overclock is unstable: no target selection, and insufficient resources become negative
messages.資源倍率の仕組みを示す例。精神力コストも1.5倍になる。: This example illustrates resource scaling. The SP cost also becomes 1.5 times its normal value.
messages.通常コスト3を用意 ／ 安定OCには1.5倍を切り上げて5必要 ／ 3〜4なら不: Have the normal cost of 3 / Stable Overclock needs 1.5 times the cost, rounded up to 5 / At 3–4, Overclock is unstable: no target selection, and insufficient resources become negative
messages.E.G.Oの性能を段階的に強化する育成。人格の同期化とは対象が異なる。: E.G.O progression that upgrades effects by tier. It is separate from Identity Uptie.
messages.解析による変化は、対象E.G.Oの段階別の性能・解放条件を見比べる。: Compare the E.G.O's tier-specific values and unlock conditions to understand each upgrade.
messages.必要素材や解放される効果は対象・段階ごとに確認する。: Check materials and unlocked effects for the specific E.G.O and tier.
messages.人格の同期化段階とE.G.Oの解析段階を混同しない。: Do not confuse Identity Uptie tiers with E.G.O Threadspin tiers.
messages.解析前後の性能を比較: Compare its effects before and after Threadspin
messages.必要素材と解放条件を確認: Check required materials and unlock conditions
messages.E.G.Oを選ぶ ／ 解析前後の性能を比較 ／ 必要素材と解放条件を確認: Choose an E.G.O / Compare its effects before and after Threadspin / Check required materials and unlock conditions
messages.人格のスキルやパッシブなどを段階的に強化・解放する育成。: Identity progression that unlocks and upgrades skills and passives by tier.
messages.人格ページに複数の段階値がある場合、現在の同期化で使える値と効果を確認する。: When multiple tier values are shown, check which values and effects the current Uptie can use.
messages.解放前のスキルや追加効果を前提に編成しない。人格とE.G.Oの育成は別に扱う。: Do not build around locked skills or effects. Identity and E.G.O progression are separate.
messages.最大段階の解説が、未育成の人格でもそのまま成立するとは限らない。: A guide written for maximum Uptie may not apply unchanged to an unupgraded Identity.
messages.育成後の運用を考える: Consider how the upgraded Identity will be used
messages.現在の同期化を確認 ／ 解放・強化される効果を比較 ／ 育成後の運用を考える: Check the current Uptie tier / Compare unlocked and improved effects / Consider how the upgraded Identity will be used
messages.E.G.Oの使用やパッシブ条件に関わる、罪悪属性別の資源。: Resources stored by Sin affinity, used for E.G.O and passive requirements.
messages.罪悪属性を持つスキルを使用すると、その属性の罪悪資源を1つ得る。マッチに負けても: Actually using a skill with a Sin affinity generates 1 resource of that affinity, even after a Clash Loss. It generates nothing if canceled before use by Stagger, death, or similar causes.
messages.E.G.Oは表示された資源を消費する。一方、保有型パッシブは通常ターン開始時の所: E.G.O consumes its displayed resource cost. Owned passives normally check resources at Turn Start; resources gained later in that turn do not activate them retroactively.
messages.共鳴条件はそのターンに選んだスキルの属性列、保有条件は所持資源数を見る。似た条件: Resonance checks this turn's selected skill affinities; Owned checks stored resources. Similar-looking requirements use different information.
messages.条件に「保有」とあるだけで、その個数を毎回消費するとは読まない。: An Owned requirement does not itself mean those resources are consumed each time.
messages.罪悪属性スキルを使用して資源を得る: Use a skill with a Sin affinity to gain resources
messages.E.G.Oの使用時に必要資源を消費: Spend the required resources when using E.G.O
messages.保有型パッシブはターン開始時の所持量で判定: Owned passives check the resources held at Turn Start
messages.人格固有の資源獲得・消費効果や、パッシブの条件文は個別に確認する。: Read Identity-specific resource generation, consumption, and passive requirements separately.
messages.罪悪属性スキルを使用して資源を得る ／ E.G.Oの使用時に必要資源を消費 ／: Use a skill with a Sin affinity to gain resources / Spend the required resources when using E.G.O / Owned passives check the resources held at Turn Start
messages.そのターンに選ぶ同じ罪悪属性のスキルの組み合わせ。資源の保有数とは別の条件。: Selecting multiple skills of the same Sin affinity in one turn. It is separate from the number of stored resources.
messages.味方が同じ罪悪属性のスキルを同じターンに複数選ぶと、その属性で共鳴する。連続して: Multiple allied skills of the same affinity selected in one turn create Resonance. They count even when they are not adjacent in the chain.
messages.共鳴した攻撃スキルは攻撃レベルが上がり、マッチやダメージで有利になる。一般に、同: Resonating attack skills gain Offense Level, helping Clashes and damage. In general, matching skills farther to the right gain a larger ordinary Resonance bonus.
messages.共鳴を条件にするパッシブは指定属性と必要数を確認する。完全共鳴も共鳴条件として数: For Resonance passives, check the required affinity and count. Absolute Resonance also counts toward Resonance requirements.
messages.資源を沢山持っていても、共鳴条件を満たしたことにはならない。: A large resource stock does not satisfy a Resonance condition by itself.
messages.右側の憤怒スキルほど補正を受ける: The Wrath skill farther right receives the larger bonus
messages.共鳴補正の正確な値は共鳴数で変わる。強いスキルやマッチを優先する。: Exact bonuses depend on Resonance count. Still prioritize strong skills and suitable Clashes.
messages.選択列：憤怒・憂鬱・憤怒 ／ 憤怒は2つ選ばれているので憤怒共鳴 ／ 右側の憤怒: Selected chain: Wrath, Gloom, Wrath / 2 Wrath skills create Wrath Resonance / The Wrath skill farther right receives the larger bonus
messages.同じ罪悪属性のスキルを3つ以上連続させる組み合わせ。: A chain of at least 3 consecutive skills with the same Sin affinity.
messages.同じ罪悪属性のスキルを3つ以上連続して並べると完全共鳴になる。完全共鳴は共鳴の一: Selecting at least 3 matching skills consecutively creates Absolute Resonance. It is a form of Resonance and also satisfies Resonance-count requirements.
messages.完全共鳴に参加するスキルは、連続列の数に応じた攻撃レベル補正を受ける。ただし通常: Participating skills receive an Offense Level bonus based on the consecutive chain's length. This does not stack additively with ordinary Resonance; each skill receives whichever bonus is higher.
messages.効果文が完全共鳴数を参照する場合、同属性の総数ではなく、連続列の数を確認する。: When an effect checks Absolute Resonance, count the consecutive chain, not all matching skills in the turn.
messages.同属性の総数と、連続する数を取り違えない。: Do not confuse the total number of matching skills with the number in a consecutive chain.
messages.憤怒・憂鬱・憤怒なら完全共鳴ではなく憤怒共鳴2: Wrath, Gloom, Wrath gives 2 Wrath Resonance, not Absolute Resonance
messages.混在する長い列では、各スキルが通常共鳴と完全共鳴のどちらの高い補正を受けるか個別: In longer mixed chains, each skill individually receives the higher of its ordinary and Absolute Resonance bonuses.
messages.憤怒・憤怒・憤怒を連続して選ぶ ／ 憤怒の完全共鳴数は3 ／ 憤怒・憂鬱・憤怒な: Select Wrath, Wrath, Wrath consecutively / Wrath Absolute Resonance is 3 / Wrath, Gloom, Wrath gives 2 Wrath Resonance, not Absolute Resonance
messages.戦闘参加中の人格が、条件に応じて発揮する効果。: An effect an Identity activates while participating in battle, subject to its conditions.
messages.保有・共鳴などの発動条件と、実際に効果が働くタイミングを分けて読む。: Read the Owned or Resonance requirement separately from when the effect activates.
messages.解放に必要な同期化や、1ターンの回数制限なども確認する。: Check the Uptie needed to unlock it and any limits such as activations per turn.
messages.サポートパッシブと同時に働くとは限らない。出撃状態を確認する。: Combat and support passives do not necessarily operate together. Check whether the Identity is deployed.
messages.参加中の人格を見る ／ 必要資源・共鳴を確認 ／ 発動タイミングと対象を確認: Check the participating Identity / Check resource or Resonance requirements / Check activation timing and targets
messages.編成中で戦闘に参加していない人格が、条件に応じて味方などへ与える効果。: An effect provided by an Identity in the team but not participating in battle, subject to its conditions.
messages.控えの人格の説明から、発動条件と対象となる味方を確認する。: Read the benched Identity's description for activation requirements and affected allies.
messages.戦闘に出る場合のバトルパッシブとは別の効果として読む。: This is separate from the combat passive used when deployed.
messages.未編成人格まで自動で支援すると考えない。: Unassigned Identities do not automatically provide support.
messages.控えに編成: Assign the Identity to the bench
messages.控えに編成 ／ 発動条件を満たす ／ 対象・同率時の条件を確認: Assign the Identity to the bench / Meet the activation requirement / Check targets and tie-breaking rules
messages.行動順や、集中戦闘でマッチを取りに行けるかに関わる値。: A value affecting action order and the ability to intercept attacks in Focused Encounters.
messages.人格が持つ速度範囲の中から、毎ターンの速度が決まる。通常は速度が高い行動から処理: Each turn rolls Speed within the Identity's range. Faster actions normally resolve first, but Clashes and tied Speed also affect order. Check the on-screen arrows.
messages.通常の攻撃マッチは双方の高い方の速度で行動が組まれ、一方攻撃は攻撃側の速度で行動: An ordinary attack Clash is scheduled using the faster participant's Speed; an unopposed attack uses the attacker's Speed. A slow ally Clashing with a fast enemy can therefore act earlier than their own Speed suggests.
messages.集中戦闘で他の味方への攻撃を引き受けるには敵より速い必要がある。同速では引き受け: Intercepting an attack aimed at another ally requires higher Speed than the enemy. Tied Speed is insufficient. If the attack already targets you, you can Clash regardless of Speed.
messages.クイックは1ターン速度を数値分増やし、束縛は数値分減らす。速度は行動順や集中戦闘: Haste increases Speed by its value for 1 turn; Bind decreases it. Compare the resulting Speeds when planning action order and redirection.
messages.速ければスキル威力まで自動で上がるわけではない。: Being faster does not automatically increase Skill Power.
messages.同速なら常に編成順で動くわけではない。集中戦闘ではスキルを指定した順や、マッチ・: Equal Speed does not always resolve by deployment order. In Focused Encounters, selection order and whether actions are Clashes or unopposed also matter; check the actual action order.
messages.どちらも速度を変える1ターン効果。速度差を通じて行動順や対象変更に影響する。: Both modify Speed for 1 turn, affecting action order and redirection through Speed differences.
messages.クイックは速度を増やし、束縛は速度を減らす。表示の数値だけ速度が変わる。: Haste raises Speed and Bind lowers it by their displayed values.
messages.集中戦闘で他の味方を狙う攻撃を引き受けるには、敵スロットより速い必要がある。束縛: Intercepting an attack aimed at another ally requires being faster than the enemy slot. Bind can make that requirement harder to meet.
messages.速度が同じ場合の行動順や、敵スキルの個別ルールは速度の数値だけでは決まらない。: Speed alone does not determine tie order or override enemy-specific skill rules.
messages.変化後の速度で行動順・対象変更を確認: Recheck action order and redirection after the change
messages.効果は基本的に1ターン。個別説明に異なる期間や追加条件があればそちらを優先する。: These effects normally last 1 turn. A specific description can give a different duration or additional conditions.
messages.そのターンの速度を見る ／ 敵の速度と攻撃先を確認 ／ マッチ可能な組み合わせを: Check this turn's Speed / Check enemy Speed and targets / Choose valid Clash pairings
messages.クイック：自分の速度が上がる ／ 束縛：対象の速度が下がる ／ 変化後の速度で行: Haste: raises your Speed / Bind: lowers the target's Speed / Recheck action order and redirection after the change
messages.相手のスキルとマッチせずに行う攻撃。マッチ勝利とは別の状態。: An attack made without Clashing against the opponent's skill. It is different from a Clash Win.
messages.マッチが組まれていない攻撃は、相手の行動を打ち消すとは限らない。: An attack without a Clash does not necessarily cancel the opponent's action.
messages.相手が先に混乱するか、攻撃が残るかを考えて選ぶ。: Consider whether the target will be Staggered first and whether its attack will remain.
messages.一方攻撃を選んだだけで、相手からの攻撃が消えるわけではない。: Selecting an unopposed attack does not by itself remove an incoming attack.
messages.マッチを組まない攻撃 ／ 相手の残る行動を確認 ／ 行動順と混乱を考慮: An attack without a Clash / Check the opponent's remaining actions / Consider action order and Stagger
messages.通常はバリアによって被害を受け止める守備スキル。: A defense skill that normally absorbs incoming damage with Shield.
messages.防御を構えた攻撃対象の攻撃前に、守備威力に応じたバリアを得る。バリアはそのターン: Before the attack from the slot you targeted with Guard, gain Shield based on Defense Power. It lasts only that turn and disappears at the turn boundary even if some remains.
messages.バリアは体力の代わりにダメージを受ける。受けるダメージを軽減するが、攻撃が的中し: Shield takes damage in place of HP. It reduces HP loss but does not prevent every On Hit status or effect.
messages.防御威力は、自身の防御レベルと攻撃側の攻撃レベルの差で補正される。耐性や体力その: Guard Power is modified by the difference between your Defense Level and the attacker's Offense Level. Check it separately from resistance and HP. Clashable Guard differs from ordinary Guard.
messages.防御は回避のように攻撃や的中時効果を無効化しない。: Unlike Evade, Guard does not negate the hit or its On Hit effects.
messages.通常防御とマッチ可能ガードを混同しない。: Do not confuse ordinary Guard with Clashable Guard.
messages.防御を敵の攻撃スロットへ向ける: Aim Guard at the enemy attack slot
messages.指定した攻撃の前にバリアを得る: Gain the Shield before the selected attack
messages.バリアで受けた分と、残る的中効果を確認: Check absorbed damage and any remaining On Hit effects
messages.バリア量は守備威力やレベル差などで変わる。具体値は画面表示とスキル条件を確認。: Shield amount depends on Defense Power, level differences, and other effects. Check the displayed values and skill conditions.
messages.防御を敵の攻撃スロットへ向ける ／ 指定した攻撃の前にバリアを得る ／ バリアで: Aim Guard at the enemy attack slot / Gain the Shield before the selected attack / Check absorbed damage and any remaining On Hit effects
messages.回避威力と相手の攻撃威力を比べ、成功した攻撃を避ける守備スキル。: A defense skill that compares Evade Power with incoming Attack Power and avoids attacks on success.
messages.回避は指定した攻撃の1コイン目で判定する。回避威力が攻撃威力以上ならそのコインの: Evade first checks against the first Coin of the selected attack. Evade Power equal to or above Attack Power avoids that Coin's damage and On Hit effects; a lower result takes the hit without reduction.
messages.成功すると、失敗するまで同じターンの後続コインや別の攻撃にも再使用する。同じ値で: After success, Evade is reused against later Coins and attacks in that turn until it fails. Ties count as success. It does not respond to ordinary Counters. If multiple Evades target one enemy skill and the earlier Evade avoids everything, later Evades do not activate.
messages.反撃は攻撃を受けた後に反撃する別の守備方式で、回避の成否とは関係しない。: Counter is a separate defense method that attacks after taking a hit; it does not depend on Evade success.
messages.必中など、回避に関わる個別効果や特殊処理は相手の説明も確認する。: Check enemy descriptions for special rules such as attacks that cannot be Evaded.
messages.攻撃コインと回避の威力を比べる: Compare attack-Coin Power with Evade Power
messages.回避威力が同値以上なら、その攻撃を無効化: Equal or higher Evade Power negates that attack
messages.失敗するまで後続の攻撃にも再使用: Reuse against later attacks until failure
messages.回避に失敗すると攻撃をそのまま受ける。複数回避や特殊コインの処理は個別条件も確認: A failed Evade takes the attack without reduction. Multiple Evades and special Coins can have additional rules.
messages.同じ人格の回避と攻撃を同じ敵スロットに向け、マッチ後の攻撃に回避を備える操作。: Assign an Evade and an attack from the same Identity to the same enemy slot, keeping Evade ready for attacks after the Clash.
messages.集中戦闘で、同じ人格に行動枠が2つ以上あるときに使える。まず回避を敵の攻撃スロッ: Requires at least 2 action slots on the same Identity in a Focused Encounter. First aim Evade at the enemy attack slot, then aim an attack from another slot at that same enemy slot. The attack Clashes, while the Evade is shown as an unopposed defense.
messages.破壊不能コインを持つ攻撃にマッチ勝利すると、自分の攻撃後に残った敵コインが攻撃し: After you win against an attack with Unbreakable Coins, the remaining enemy Coins attack after your own attack. The waiting Evade can avoid these hits and their On Hit effects, combining Clash-based Coin weakening with Evade.
messages.回避は指定先の敵スロットから本人が攻撃されると発動する。破壊不能コインがなくても: Evade activates when its chosen enemy slot attacks that Identity. It can also provide insurance after a Clash Loss, even without Unbreakable Coins.
messages.同じ敵スロットへ、同じ人格の別々の行動枠から指定する。別の味方がマッチして攻撃を: Both actions must come from different slots of the same Identity and target the same enemy slot. If another ally intercepts the attack and the Evading Identity is not attacked by that slot, Evade does not activate.
messages.マッチ勝利で破壊不能コインが弱体化しても、回避成功は保証されない。残ったコインの: Winning the Clash and weakening Unbreakable Coins does not guarantee Evade success. Check remaining Coin Power and individual effects.
messages.マッチ可能ガード・マッチ可能反撃は、この方法でマッチ勝利後の残存コインに反応しな: Clashable Guard and Clashable Counter do not respond to post-victory remaining Coins in this way. Evading a multi-target attack does not protect other allies from their own hits.
messages.回避を先に指定し、同じ敵スロットへ攻撃を重ねる: Assign Evade first, then an attack to the same enemy slot
messages.① 回避を敵スロットへ指定: ① Assign Evade to the enemy slot
messages.② 同じ人格の別枠から攻撃を指定: ② Assign an attack from another slot of the same Identity
messages.攻撃でマッチ勝利 → 自分が攻撃: Win with the attack → resolve your attack
messages.残った破壊不能コインの攻撃 → 待機した回避で判定: Remaining Unbreakable Coins attack → the waiting Evade rolls
messages.図はマッチ勝利後も敵の破壊不能コインが攻撃する場合。敵を倒すなどして攻撃自体が来: This shows Unbreakable Coins attacking after a Clash Loss. If the enemy dies or the attack otherwise never occurs, the waiting Evade does not activate.
messages.1枠の回避が成功すると、同じターンの後続攻撃にも再使用される。残りの行動枠で攻撃: One slot's successful Evade can be reused against subsequent attacks in the same turn, leaving other slots free to attack.
messages.単独出撃では攻撃が1人に集中するため、回避の再使用が役立つ。実際に最初に受ける敵: Solo deployment concentrates incoming attacks, making Evade reuse valuable. Aim Evade at the first enemy attack that will actually reach you, and attack with the other slots. Backup Evade can also handle Unbreakable Coins.
messages.最初の回避が成功すれば、同じスキルの次のコインや、その後に受ける別スキルの攻撃に: After the first success, reuse Evade against the next Coin of that skill and attacks from later skills. Each reuse does not require another action slot.
messages.単独出撃専用の効果ではなく、複数人の出撃でも同じ人格が後続の攻撃を受ければ再使用: This is not exclusive to solo deployment. It also works in larger teams when later attacks hit the same Identity.
messages.回避は指定先の攻撃を受けるまで発動しない。後から来る攻撃に指定すると、それより前: Evade does not begin until its selected attack reaches you. Targeting a later attack leaves earlier hits unprotected. Check resolution order, including your own Clashes.
messages.回避コインは再使用のたびに振る。成功が続くとは限らず、失敗したコインの攻撃は軽減: The Evade Coin rerolls on every reuse. Success is not guaranteed: a failed Coin deals its damage without reduction and ends reuse of that Evade.
messages.別の回避も用意していれば、失敗後の次のコインからそちらを使える場合がある。同じ敵: Another prepared Evade may take over from the next Coin after failure. Multiple Evades on the same enemy skill do not all activate if the first avoids every hit.
messages.1枠の回避で後続攻撃も避ける: One Evade slot handles later attacks
messages.敵の攻撃A・1コイン目：回避成功: Enemy attack A, first Coin: Evade succeeds
messages.攻撃A・次のコイン：再使用して成功: Attack A, next Coin: reuse succeeds
messages.後続コインで失敗：その攻撃を受け、再使用終了: A later Coin fails: take that hit, then reuse ends
messages.成功と失敗の一例。裏置きは回避を待機させる操作で、連続回避は成功した回避を再使用: One example of success and failure. Backup Evade is the assignment technique; repeated Evade is the reuse mechanic. Evade does not carry over to the next turn.
messages.glossary-aliases:evade: Backup Evade, Evade Reuse, Solo Deployment
messages.攻撃コインと回避の威力を比べる ／ 回避威力が同値以上なら、その攻撃を無効化 ／: Compare attack-Coin Power with Evade Power / Equal or higher Evade Power negates that attack / Reuse against later attacks until failure
messages.① 回避を敵スロットへ指定 ／ ② 同じ人格の別枠から攻撃を指定 ／ 攻撃でマッ: ① Assign Evade to the enemy slot / ② Assign an attack from another slot of the same Identity / Win with the attack → resolve your attack / Remaining Unbreakable Coins attack → the waiting Evade rolls
messages.敵の攻撃A・1コイン目：回避成功 ／ 攻撃A・次のコイン：再使用して成功 ／ 後: Enemy attack A, first Coin: Evade succeeds / Attack A, next Coin: reuse succeeds / Later attack B: reuse succeeds / A later Coin fails: take that hit, then reuse ends
messages.通常は相手の攻撃を受けた後に攻撃を返す守備スキル。: A defense skill that normally retaliates after taking an enemy attack.
messages.通常の反撃は攻撃を軽減せず、ターン中に初めて攻撃スキルを受けた直後に一方攻撃で反: An ordinary Counter does not reduce incoming damage. It makes an unopposed retaliation immediately after the first attack skill received that turn, responding to the actual first attacker rather than the enemy selected when setting it.
messages.通常反撃は1つの敵スキルにつき1回。反撃前に混乱・死亡すると発動できず、反撃の一: An ordinary Counter triggers once per enemy skill. Stagger or death before retaliation prevents it, and ordinary defense skills cannot defend against its unopposed attack.
messages.マッチ可能反撃は攻撃を受ける前に敵スキルとマッチする特殊な守備スキル。勝てば相手: Clashable Counter is a special defense skill that Clashes before taking the enemy attack. Winning stops that attack; its handling after a loss differs from ordinary Counter.
messages.通常の反撃は、攻撃を受けずに相手を止める手段ではない。: Ordinary Counter does not stop the enemy without taking a hit first.
messages.通常反撃：先に攻撃を受ける: Ordinary Counter: take the hit first
messages.攻撃直後、反撃で一方攻撃: Immediately afterward, make an unopposed Counter attack
messages.マッチ可能反撃：敵スキルと先にマッチ: Clashable Counter: Clash with the enemy skill first
messages.反撃前の混乱・死亡や、各スキル固有の条件で発動しない場合がある。: Stagger, death before retaliation, and skill-specific conditions can prevent activation.
messages.通常反撃：先に攻撃を受ける ／ 攻撃直後、反撃で一方攻撃 ／ マッチ可能反撃：敵: Ordinary Counter: take the hit first / Immediately afterward, make an unopposed Counter attack / Clashable Counter: Clash with the enemy skill first
messages.スキルが攻撃対象のスロットをどれだけ巻き込めるかに関わる値。: A value governing how many target slots an attack can cover.
messages.攻撃加重値は、攻撃スキルが対象にできるスロット数の目安。2以上なら複数スロットへ: Attack Weight indicates how many slots a skill can target. At 2 or more, it becomes a multi-target attack.
messages.実線のメインターゲットと破線のサブターゲットが表示され、マッチするのはメインター: The main target uses a solid line; subtargets use dashed lines. Only the main target Clashes. Subtargets are usually automatic, though selected slots can influence them in Focused Encounters.
messages.敵の部位・スロットによっては、1つの対象に加重値を複数使う。スロット加重値が2な: Some parts or slots consume more than one unit of Attack Weight. A slot with weight 2 uses more of the available weight, leaving less for other targets.
messages.加重値3を常に「敵3体へ攻撃」とは読まない。: 3 Attack Weight does not always mean 3 enemy characters.
messages.残りの加重値でサブターゲットを決める: Allocate remaining Attack Weight to subtargets
messages.マッチはメイン、攻撃は各対象へ: Clash with the main target; attack all covered targets
Targets may be individual enemy slots or parts rather than separate characters. Some E.G.O and skills use special targeting rules.
messages.メインターゲットを選ぶ ／ 残りの加重値でサブターゲットを決める ／ マッチはメ: Select the main target / Allocate remaining Attack Weight to subtargets / Clash with the main target; attack all covered targets
messages.スキルの攻撃能力を表すレベル。マッチやダメージの補正に関わる。: A skill's offensive level, used in Clash and damage modifiers.
messages.人格の育成レベルと、スキル・効果で補正された攻撃レベルは区別する。: Distinguish the Identity's training level from Offense Level after skill and effect modifiers.
messages.通常の攻撃スキル同士のマッチでは、双方の攻撃レベル差が関わる。ダメージでは攻撃側: Ordinary attack Clashes compare both skills' Offense Levels. Damage compares the attacker's Offense Level with the defender's Defense Level.
messages.コイン威力と攻撃レベルは別の数値。: Coin Power and Offense Level are separate values.
messages.相手の対応するレベルと比較: Compare it with the opponent's relevant level
messages.スキルの攻撃レベルを見る ／ 相手の対応するレベルと比較 ／ 補正を考える: Check the skill's Offense Level / Compare it with the opponent's relevant level / Account for the modifier
messages.受けるダメージや守備スキルの計算に関わるレベル。: A level used to calculate damage taken and defense skills.
messages.攻撃側とのレベル差による補正を確認する。: Check modifiers from the level difference with the attacker.
messages.耐性・バリア・防御レベルは別の要素として読む。: Resistance, Shield, and Defense Level are separate factors.
messages.防御レベルが高くても、全ての攻撃や状態効果が無効になるわけではない。: High Defense Level does not negate every attack or status effect.
messages.攻撃側のレベルと比較: Compare it with the attacker's level
messages.耐性など他の要素も確認: Also check resistances and other factors
messages.自分の防御レベルを見る ／ 攻撃側のレベルと比較 ／ 耐性など他の要素も確認: Check your Defense Level / Compare it with the attacker's level / Also check resistances and other factors
messages.精神力の悪化によって起こる状態。体力に関わる混乱とは別の仕組み。: A state caused by low SP, separate from HP-related Stagger.
messages.精神力が-45になるとパニックまたはE.G.O侵食になる。どちらになるかは装備E: Reaching -45 SP causes Panic or E.G.O Corrosion, depending on equipped E.G.O and Identity-specific rules.
messages.パニック中は人格固有の行動・解除条件が適用されるため、パニックという名前だけで行: Panic behavior and recovery conditions are Identity-specific. The name alone does not imply one universal behavior; read the Sanity section and effects.
messages.E.G.O使用時、精神力コストを消費した後の精神力が-25以下なら、表示された確: When using E.G.O at -25 SP or lower after its cost, the displayed chance can produce a Corrosion skill. This is separate from the E.G.O Corrosion state that begins next turn after reaching -45 SP.
messages.精神力がない敵に同じ方法でパニックを起こせるとは扱わない。: Enemies without SP cannot be assumed to Panic in the same way.
messages.E.G.Oの精神力コスト消費後-25以下：侵蝕スキルの確率が発生: At -25 or lower after an E.G.O SP cost: a chance of Corrosion
messages.精神力-45：次ターンからパニックまたはE.G.O侵食状態: At -45 SP: Panic or E.G.O Corrosion from next turn
messages.発生後の行動・解除条件は人格とE.G.Oの説明を確認: Check Identity and E.G.O descriptions for behavior and recovery
messages.E.G.Oの精神力コスト消費後-25以下：侵蝕スキルの確率が発生 ／ 精神力-4: At -25 or lower after an E.G.O SP cost: a chance of Corrosion / At -45 SP: Panic or E.G.O Corrosion from next turn / Check Identity and E.G.O descriptions for behavior and recovery
messages.敵味方の攻撃の組み合わせを、集中戦闘のようには自由に指定しない戦闘形式。: A battle format where you cannot assign attack pairings as freely as in Focused Encounters.
messages.パネル上でスキルを左から右へつないで選ぶ。集中戦闘のように敵スロットへ自由に割り: Select skills by connecting the panel from left to right. Instead of freely assigning enemy slots, pairings follow the Speed-based formation.
messages.敵味方のスロット数に差があると、一方攻撃も生じる。ターン経過による枠の増加や、最: Different slot counts can create unopposed attacks. Check arrows to see slot growth across turns and who will actually be targeted.
messages.集中戦闘で使うマッチの取り方を、そのまま当てはめない。: Do not directly apply Focused Encounter redirection rules to Normal Encounters.
messages.戦闘形式を確認 ／ スキルを選択 ／ 予測されるマッチを確認: Check the encounter format / Select skills / Check the predicted Clashes
messages.敵のスキルや部位へ攻撃先を指定する戦闘形式。マッチと一方攻撃を選び分ける。: A battle format where you target enemy skills or parts and choose between Clashes and unopposed attacks.
messages.自分のチェーンパネルのスキルから、敵の頭上にあるスキルスロットへドラッグして攻撃: Drag from your chain-panel skill to a skill slot above an enemy. Read enemy arrows to see who is being targeted.
messages.自分へ向いた攻撃は、自分が敵より遅いか同速でもマッチできる。他の味方を狙う攻撃を: You can Clash with an attack already aimed at you even when slower or tied. Intercepting an attack aimed at another ally requires higher Speed than that enemy slot. See Target Redirection and Interception for details.
messages.複数の味方で同じスロットを指定すると、最後に成立した対象変更で向き先が変わる。全: When several allies select the same enemy slot, the last valid redirection determines its target. After all assignments, check Clashes, unopposed attacks, and defenses again before pressing START.
messages.部位を持つ敵は、部位ごとのスキル・HP・混乱状態も確認する。部位と本体のHPへの: For enemies with parts, check each part's skills, HP, and Stagger state. See Parts and Part Breaks for shared HP damage and the difference between broken and excisable parts.
messages.攻撃先を選べても、全ての組み合わせでマッチを奪えるわけではない。: Free targeting does not mean every pairing can take over a Clash.
messages.敵のスキルを見る ／ 速度と攻撃先を確認 ／ マッチ・一方攻撃を割り当てる: Inspect enemy skills / Check Speed and targets / Assign Clashes and unopposed attacks
messages.ストーリ進行で解放される、ダンテが戦闘に介入する5つの能力。解放状況と使用回数を: 5 abilities unlocked through story progress that let Dante intervene in battle. Check unlocked abilities and remaining uses.
messages.光の苗木は6-44以降のストーリ進行で解放され、能力や回数はさらに進めると増える: The Sapling of Light unlocks through story progress from 6-44 onward, with more abilities and uses unlocked later. Check the menu for what is currently available.
messages.通常は6-44クリア後に1日1回、8-30クリア後に1日2回使える。同じ能力は1: Normally usable once per day after clearing 6-44, and twice per day after 8-30. Each individual ability is limited to once per day. Uses refresh at the daily reset.
messages.使った戦闘に勝利すると回数を消費する。敗北・リトライ・撤退では基本的に消費せず戻: A use is consumed when you win the battle. Losses, retries, and withdrawals normally return it, but exceeding 100 turns consumes the use without counting as a victory.
messages.鏡屈折鉄道など一部の挑戦型コンテンツは、通常の日次回数と別に挑戦中の使用上限があ: Some challenge content, including Refraction Railway, has its own per-run limits instead of the ordinary daily allowance. Follow the content's specific rules.
messages.通常は苗木全体で共通する1日の使用回数があり、同じ能力は1日1回まで。鏡屈折鉄道: The ordinary daily allowance is shared across Sapling abilities, and each ability can be used only once per day. Content such as Refraction Railway has separate per-run limits; check the current ability menu and battle counter.
messages.回数を使った直後ではなく、戦闘に勝利して消費確定となる点に注意。: The use becomes final on victory, rather than immediately when the button is pressed.
messages.回数と能力の選び方: Choosing an ability and managing uses
messages.戦闘前に解放済み能力と残り回数を確認: Check unlocked abilities and remaining uses before battle
messages.今日の共通残回数か、挑戦中の回数かを確認: Check whether the limit is daily or per challenge run
messages.勝利で消費、敗北などで返還されるか確認: Check whether victory consumes it or a loss returns it
messages.回数の判定はコンテンツによる差がある。挑戦型コンテンツはそのルールを優先する。: Consumption rules vary by content. Challenge-specific rules take precedence.
messages.使用したターン、敵全体の速度を半減する。: Halves all enemies' Speed for the turn in which it is used.
messages.速度は小数点以下を切り捨てる。例：速度5は2になる。: Rounds Speed down. For example, Speed 5 becomes 2.
messages.速度差を縮めてマッチの相手を取りやすくする能力。敵のスキル威力やコインを直接弱め: The smaller Speed gap makes interception easier. It does not directly weaken Skill Power or Coins.
messages.全ての敵が対象。マッチに勝つことやダメージを増やすことを直接保証しない。: Affects all enemies. It does not directly guarantee a Clash Win or increased damage.
messages.半減して小数点以下切り捨て。: Halve the value, then round down.
messages.E.G.O1つの資源コストを0にする。: Sets the resource cost of 1 E.G.O use to 0.
messages.罪悪資源は不要になるが、精神力消費は残る。通常使用とオーバークロックの両方で資源: Sin resources become unnecessary, but the SP cost remains. Both ordinary use and Overclock have a resource cost of 0.
messages.通常の侵食判定は残る。安定オーバークロック分の資源がなくても、不安定扱いとして敵: Normal Corrosion checks still apply. Lacking resources for Stable Overclock does not make the Overclock unstable or cause indiscriminate targeting.
messages.SUPERBIAの効果回数は、E.G.Oを戦闘開始まで進めたときに消費される。: SUPERBIA's effect count is consumed when the E.G.O proceeds to Combat Start.
messages.精神力不足による侵食の可能性は消えない。: It does not remove Corrosion risk from low SP.
messages.資源消費を0にするが、他のコストは無料にならない。: Resource consumption becomes 0; other costs do not become free.
messages.使用してから3ターン、基本攻撃・防御レベルを場の人数で平均化する。: Averages base Offense and Defense Levels across combatants for 3 turns after use.
messages.場のキャラの基本攻撃レベル・防御レベルの平均値（小数点以下切り捨て）にする。味方: Uses the average base Offense and Defense Levels of characters on the field, rounded down. Allied NPCs are excluded.
messages.効果中は囚人に攻撃レベル+3・防御レベル+6も加わる。ただし基本レベルとは別の加: While active, Sinners also gain +3 Offense Level and +6 Defense Level. These are added separately from base levels.
messages.スキルレベルや、基本値を変えない外付けのレベル増減補正は平均化後に適用される。: Skill-level differences and external level modifiers that do not change base values apply after averaging.
messages.敵が攻撃レベル増加などを後から受けている場合、レベル差がまるごとなくなるとは限ら: Later enemy Offense Level Up and similar effects can still leave a level difference.
messages.囚人は攻撃+3・防御+6を追加: Sinners gain another +3 Offense and +6 Defense
messages.基本値の平均化と、その後のレベル補正を分けて考える。: Distinguish averaged base values from subsequent level modifiers.
messages.行動可能な囚人1人をそのターン強化する。: Strengthens 1 Sinner who can act for the current turn.
messages.対象には攻撃ダメージ+100%、加算コイン威力+1、減算最終威力+1などの強化が: Offensive bonuses include +100% attack damage, +1 positive Coin Power, and +1 negative-Coin Final Power. These offensive bonuses apply only to Base Skills, not E.G.O.
messages.そのターンは体力が10より下がらず、混乱しない。混乱区間を通過すると区間が消える: For that turn, HP cannot fall below 10 and the Sinner cannot be Staggered. Crossed Stagger Thresholds are removed, making later Stagger less likely too.
messages.体力は効果中に10まで減ることがあるが、10より下にはならない。効果が終わった後: HP can fall to 10 while active, but not below it. This survival effect does not persist after the ability ends.
messages.混乱中など行動不能の囚人は対象に選べない。: Cannot select a Sinner unable to act, such as one who is Staggered.
messages.攻撃ダメージ増加を理由に、個別効果を含むE.G.Oのダメージまで増えると推測しな: Do not assume the attack damage bonus also boosts E.G.O damage or its special effects.
messages.E.G.Oはダメージ+100%の対象外: E.G.O does not receive the +100% damage bonus
messages.効果中の死亡防止や混乱無効も同じ囚人に適用される。: The survival and Stagger-prevention effects apply to that same Sinner.
messages.囚人1人のコインをそのターン表または裏に固定する。: Fixes 1 Sinner's Coin results to Heads or Tails for the current turn.
messages.使用時に選んだ表面か裏面の結果を対象囚人のコインに適用する。: The selected face is applied to that Sinner's Coins.
messages.出目の運によるブレはなくなるが、マッチに必ず勝てる、ダメージが最大になるとは限ら: Removing Coin-roll randomness does not guarantee Clash victory or maximum damage.
messages.対象はIRAと同じく行動可能な囚人。: Like IRA, requires a Sinner who can act.
messages.囚人1人と表・裏を選ぶ: Choose 1 Sinner and Heads or Tails
messages.そのターンはその面が出る: Their Coins show that face this turn
messages.表裏の希望がスキルで合っているか確認: Check that the chosen face suits the skills
messages.コイン出目の固定はマッチ勝利を保証しない。: Fixed Coin results do not guarantee a Clash Win.
messages.glossary-aliases:sapling: PIGRITIA, SUPERBIA, MOROSITAS, IRA, LUXURIA, Dante Abilities
messages.戦闘前に解放済み能力と残り回数を確認 ／ 今日の共通残回数か、挑戦中の回数かを確: Check unlocked abilities and remaining uses before battle / Check whether the limit is daily or per challenge run / Use the ability when needed / Check whether victory consumes it or a loss returns it
messages.使用前 速度5 ／ 使用したターンの速度 → 2: Before use: Speed 5 / Speed for the activation turn → 2
messages.罪悪資源が不足 ／ 資源コスト0でE.G.Oを使う ／ 精神力は消費する: Insufficient Sin resources / Use E.G.O at 0 resource cost / SP is still consumed
messages.場の基本レベルを平均化 ／ 囚人は攻撃+3・防御+6を追加 ／ 外付け補正はその: Average the field's base levels / Sinners gain another +3 Offense and +6 Defense / Apply external modifiers afterward
messages.囚人にIRAを付与 ／ 基本スキルのダメージが増加 ／ E.G.Oはダメージ+1: Apply IRA to a Sinner / Base Skill damage increases / E.G.O does not receive the +100% damage bonus
messages.囚人1人と表・裏を選ぶ ／ そのターンはその面が出る ／ 表裏の希望がスキルで合: Choose 1 Sinner and Heads or Tails / Their Coins show that face this turn / Check that the chosen face suits the skills
messages.集中戦闘で、敵のスキルの向き先を自分へ変える操作。元の攻撃先と速度の両方を確認す: Changing an enemy skill's target to yourself in a Focused Encounter. Check both the original target and Speed.
messages.集中戦闘では、自分のスキルを敵のスキルスロットへドラッグして指定する。敵の攻撃が: Drag your skill to an enemy skill slot. If its attack already targets you, an attack skill can Clash even when your Speed is lower or tied.
messages.他の味方を狙う攻撃を引き受けるには、その敵スロットより高い速度が必要だ。同速では: Intercepting an attack aimed at another ally requires higher Speed than that enemy slot. Equal Speed is insufficient. If the condition is not met, targeting it with an attack leaves the enemy's target unchanged and both attacks are unopposed.
messages.対象変更とマッチ成立は別だ。守備スキルでも向き先を変えられるが、通常の防御・回避: Redirection and Clashing are separate. Defense skills can also redirect, but ordinary Guard or Evade defends instead of creating an attack Clash. Some Unclashable attacks can still be redirected.
messages.同じ敵スロットに複数の味方で指定する際は、最後に成立した対象変更が優先される。全: If multiple allies select the same slot, the last valid redirection takes precedence. Recheck arrows after all selections to ensure the attack has not returned to the ally you intended to protect.
messages.引き受けられることと、マッチに勝てることは別だ。速度とスキル威力を分けて見る。: Being able to intercept does not guarantee a Clash Win. Check Speed and Skill Power separately.
messages.対象変更不可などの個別ルールがあるスキルには、通常の条件をそのまま当てはめない。: Skills with rules such as unchangeable targets can override normal redirection.
messages.広域攻撃の主対象を引き受けても、副対象の味方まで攻撃を受けなくなるとは限らない。: Intercepting a multi-target attack's main target does not necessarily remove its subtarget hits on other allies.
