messages.速度5の味方Bが、速度4の敵から味方Aを庇う: Ally B at Speed 5 protects A from an enemy at Speed 4
messages.味方B5が敵スロットへ攻撃を指定: Ally B5 assigns an attack to the enemy slot
messages.変更後：味方B5と敵4がマッチ: After: ally B5 Clashes with enemy 4
messages.通常の単体攻撃で、対象変更を妨げる効果がない例。Bが速度4なら他の味方から引き受: An ordinary single-target attack with no redirection restriction. At Speed 4, B could not intercept for another ally. A can Clash at Speed 3 because the attack already targets A.
messages.glossary-aliases:target-redirect: Interception, Redirect Target, Take Over a Clash, Protect an Ally, Tied Speed
messages.変更前：敵4 → 味方A3 ／ 味方B5が敵スロットへ攻撃を指定 ／ 変更後：味: Before: enemy 4 → ally A3 / Ally B5 assigns an attack to the enemy slot / After: ally B5 Clashes with enemy 4
messages.スキルを1つ選ぶための行動枠。囚人の人数・コイン枚数・攻撃加重値とは別に数える。: An action slot used to choose 1 skill. It is separate from Sinner count, Coin count, and Attack Weight.
messages.1つのスロットにつき攻撃・守備などのスキルを1つ選ぶ。同じ人格が2スロットを持て: Choose 1 attack or defense skill per slot. An Identity with 2 slots can select separate actions. Multiple Coins in one skill do not mean multiple action slots.
messages.通常のスロット増加では、ターン経過で混乱・死亡していない味方1名の枠が1つ増える: Under ordinary slot-growth rules, 1 living, non-Staggered ally gains 1 slot as turns advance. Allies with fewer slots take priority; ties favor earlier deployment order.
messages.標準の上限は、通常戦闘では味方合計12枠、集中戦闘ではステージの最大出撃人数分だ: The standard allied total cap is 12 in Normal Encounters, or the stage's maximum deployment count in Focused Encounters. Starting a Focused Encounter below capacity lets living, active allies gain slots up to that cap; they do not all start with the maximum.
messages.編成順は出撃させる囚人を選んだ順番で、速度による行動順とは別だ。敵の枠数や、枠を: Deployment order is the order in which Sinners were selected, not Speed-based action order. Check the encounter for enemy slot counts and special slot changes.
messages.少人数では、枠が増えるまでの最初のターンの手数が少ない。単純に人数を減らすほど有: Smaller teams have fewer actions on the opening turns before slots grow. Fewer members are not automatically better.
messages.死亡した味方の分を、残った味方が必ず全て埋められるとは考えない。死亡分も合計枠の: Do not assume survivors can replace every dead ally's slots. Dead allies' slots still count toward the total slot cap.
messages.混乱や行動キャンセルが起きると、選んだ枠数と実行できる行動数は一致しない。: Stagger or canceled actions can make the number of executed actions lower than the number of selected slots.
messages.出撃上限5名の集中戦闘へ、A・B・Cの3名で出撃: Deploy A, B, and C in a Focused Encounter with capacity 5
messages.3ターン目：A2・B2・C1＝合計5枠で上限: Turn 3: A2 + B2 + C1 = 5 slots, reaching the cap
messages.編成順はA→B→C。全員が生存し、混乱しておらず、特殊な枠増減がない例。4ターン: Deployment order is A → B → C. Everyone is alive and not Staggered, with no special slot changes. Turn 4 also has 5 total slots; C does not gain another 1.
messages.glossary-aliases:skill-slot: Action Slot, Slot Growth, Deployment Order, Undersized Team
messages.1ターン目：A1・B1・C1＝合計3枠 ／ 2ターン目：A2・B1・C1＝合計4: Turn 1: A1 + B1 + C1 = 3 slots / Turn 2: A2 + B1 + C1 = 4 slots / Turn 3: A2 + B2 + C1 = 5 slots, reaching the cap
messages.通常の防御・回避同士を対応させ、攻撃に反応する守備を発動させない方法。威力を競っ: Pairing ordinary Guard or Evade skills so neither receives the attack needed to activate. It is not a contest of Power.
messages.通常の防御・回避は、基本的に指定した敵スロットから攻撃されることで発動する。その: Ordinary Guard and Evade generally activate when the selected enemy slot attacks. If that slot is also a defense skill, no attack comes and neither ordinary defense activates.
messages.集中戦闘で敵の通常回避などを使わせたくないときは、味方の防御・回避をそのスロット: To offset an enemy's ordinary Evade in a Focused Encounter, aim an ally's Guard or Evade at it. Redirecting a defense aimed at someone else also requires meeting the Speed condition.
messages.その後に別の味方の攻撃を同じ敵スロットへ向けると、対象が再び変わる場合がある。全: An attack assigned afterward by another ally can change its target again. Once all selections are complete, check which slot the enemy defense actually faces.
messages.スキル全体の効果を消去する処理ではない。「戦闘開始時」の効果は、相殺を狙っても別: Offset does not erase every effect on a skill. Combat Start effects still activate independently.
messages.通常の反撃は相殺できない。向けた相手に関係なく最初に受けた攻撃で発動するため、別: Ordinary Counter cannot be offset: it responds to the first attack actually received regardless of its selected target, so another ally's hit can still trigger it.
messages.マッチ可能ガード・マッチ可能反撃などの特殊な守備は、通常防御・回避と同じ処理と決: Do not assume Clashable Guard and Clashable Counter follow ordinary Guard/Evade rules. Read their descriptions.
messages.味方の守備も発動させないため、その守備で得る予定だったバリアや使用時効果を前提に: Your defense also does not activate, so do not rely on its Shield or On Use effects.
messages.敵の通常回避へ、味方の通常防御を対応させる: Pair an enemy's ordinary Evade with an ally's ordinary Guard
messages.敵の通常回避 ⇄ 味方の通常防御: Enemy ordinary Evade ⇄ allied ordinary Guard
messages.互いに指定先からの攻撃がない: Neither receives an attack from its selected slot
messages.対象変更が成立し、後から他の指定で向き先を変えていない例。攻撃マッチや通常反撃の: Assumes valid redirection with no later reassignment. This is not an attack Clash or an ordinary Counter. Combat Start effects are handled separately.
messages.glossary-aliases:defense-offset: Offset, Defense Offset, Offset Guard, Offset Evade
messages.敵の通常回避 ⇄ 味方の通常防御 ／ 互いに指定先からの攻撃がない ／ 両方とも: Enemy ordinary Evade ⇄ allied ordinary Guard / Neither receives an attack from its selected slot / Neither ordinary defense activates
messages.「いつ・誰に・何を・どれだけ」を分けて読む。スキルを選んだだけで、全ての効果が働: Separate when, who, what, and how much. Selecting a skill does not activate every effect.
messages.効果文は、角括弧の発動条件、対象、効果の種類、数値、適用されるターンを順に確認す: Read the bracketed trigger, target, effect type, value, and applicable turn in order. Effects listed under a Coin number belong to that Coin.
messages.スキルの「戦闘開始時」は、そのターンの選択を終えてSTARTを押した直後。「戦闘: Combat Start on a skill means immediately after selections are complete and START is pressed. It is not the same as entering an encounter or Turn Start. Check specific descriptions when localization or individual effects use different wording.
messages.通常の攻撃スキルの「使用時」はマッチに入る直前、一方攻撃なら攻撃の直前。「マッチ: For ordinary attack skills, On Use occurs immediately before the Clash, or before the attack if unopposed. On Clash Win requires an actual Clash victory and does not trigger from an unopposed attack.
messages.「攻撃前」はマッチの後に実際の攻撃へ進む直前。「的中時」は攻撃が当たったときの条: Before Attack occurs after the Clash, just before attacking. On Hit requires the attack to land and does not activate if Evaded. On Heads Hit and On Tails Hit also require the stated Coin face.
messages.「付与」「獲得」という語だけで対象を決めない。「自分」「対象」「味方」などの指定: Do not infer the recipient from Inflict or Gain alone: read self, target, or ally. Do not include next-turn effects in this turn's Power or Speed calculations.
messages.使用時効果を、マッチに勝てば防げる的中時効果と混同しない。: Do not confuse On Use effects with On Hit effects that a Clash Win can prevent.
messages.「マッチ勝利時」が先に発動しても、その後の攻撃が必ず的中するとは限らない。: An On Clash Win effect does not guarantee the subsequent attack will land.
messages.同じタイミングの複数効果の細かな優先順まで、この基本図で一律には決めない。特殊コ: This basic timeline does not determine every priority among simultaneous effects. Special Coins, defense skills, and individual mechanics need their own descriptions.
messages.通常攻撃でマッチに勝ち、相手へ的中するまで: From START to a successful ordinary attack
messages.マッチ直前：使用時: Immediately before the Clash: On Use
messages.通常コインの攻撃で勝利・的中する場合の基本図。敗北すればこの攻撃へ進む経路は止ま: This shows an ordinary-Coin attack that wins and hits. A Clash Loss stops this path; an unopposed attack skips Clash and On Clash Win.
messages.誰に働く効果かと、いつ有効になるかを別々に読む。: Read who receives an effect separately from when it becomes active.
messages.たとえば「的中時、次のターンに対象へ束縛1を付与」という説明なら、的中が条件、攻: For example, On Hit, inflict 1 Bind on the target next turn requires a hit, affects the attack target, and becomes active next turn. It does not lower Speed this turn.
messages.「自分が獲得」「味方に付与」などの対象指定も確認する。威力を付与するのか回数を増: Also read targets such as self gains or grant to allies. Check whether the effect changes Potency or Count and how duration or consumption works.
messages.「次のターン」は発動条件とは別の指定だ。条件を満たしていなければ、翌ターンに自動: Next turn is separate from the trigger. The effect does not appear automatically next turn if its activation condition was not met.
messages.例示用の効果文：的中時、次のターンに対象へ束縛1を付与: Example effect: On Hit, inflict 1 Bind on the target next turn
messages.今ターン：指定の攻撃が的中: This turn: the specified attack hits
messages.次のターン：対象に束縛1が適用: Next turn: 1 Bind applies to the target
messages.特定人格のスキル引用ではなく、条件・対象・適用ターンを読むための例。重複付与や特: This is an illustrative effect, not a quotation from a particular Identity. Stacking and special immunities are omitted.
messages.glossary-aliases:effect-timing: Activation Timing, Combat Start, On Use, On Clash Win, Before Attack, On Hit, On Heads Hit, On Tails Hit, Inflict, Gain, This Turn, Next Turn
messages.START：戦闘開始時 ／ マッチ直前：使用時 ／ 威力を競う：マッチ ／ 勝敗: START: Combat Start / Immediately before the Clash: On Use / Compare Power: Clash / Victory determined: On Clash Win / Immediately before attacking: Before Attack / Attack lands: On Hit
messages.今ターン：指定の攻撃が的中 ／ 次のターン：対象に束縛1が適用 ／ そのターンの: This turn: the specified attack hits / Next turn: 1 Bind applies to the target / Check Speed during that turn
messages.集中戦闘の敵は部位ごとにHP・混乱区間・行動を持つ。部位を狙うと本体HPにも影響: Focused Encounter enemies can have separate HP, Stagger Thresholds, and actions for each part. Attacking a part also affects main-body HP.
messages.集中戦闘の敵に部位がある場合、部位ごとにHP・混乱区間・スキルが分かれている。部: An enemy's parts have their own HP, thresholds, and skills. Staggering a part stops that part's actions.
messages.部位のスロットを狙った攻撃は、部位と本体の両方へダメージを与える。ダメージ計算に: An attack aimed at a part's slot damages both the part and the main body. Damage calculation uses that targeted part's resistances.
messages.部位HPがなくなると部位破壊が起きる。破壊後は攻撃タイプ耐性が弱点相当になるのが: Depleting part HP breaks it. Physical resistances generally worsen afterward, but whether it stops acting, regenerates, or becomes stronger depends on the enemy.
messages.「摘出可能」な部位は破壊中に攻撃対象へ選べなくなる。部位破壊と同時に必ず行動が止: Excisable parts cannot be selected while broken. A break does not always immediately stop actions, so check the enemy description.
messages.部位のHPを0にしても本体が倒れるとは限らない。本体HPと部位HPの両方を確認す: Reducing a part to 0 HP does not necessarily defeat the main body. Watch both HP values.
messages.部位破壊後の行動や復活などには例外がある。: Post-break actions and regeneration have exceptions.
messages.部位を狙う攻撃は、部位と本体へ届く: An attack on a part reaches both part and body
messages.攻撃先に選んだ部位: The part selected as the target
messages.同じ攻撃が部位HPと本体HPに反映: The same attack reduces part HP and main-body HP
messages.HPバーの長さや減少量は模式図。数値・割合・ダメージ配分を示すものではない。: HP-bar lengths and decreases are schematic, not exact values, ratios, or damage allocations.
messages.HPを削り切った後の部位の状態は、敵の種類で変わる。: The state after a part loses all HP depends on the enemy.
messages.部位HPが0になると破壊状態になる。多くの場合はその部位の行動がキャンセルされ、: At 0 part HP, the part becomes broken. In many cases its actions are canceled and its Attack Type resistances become Fatal.
messages.摘出可能な部位は破壊中に対象に選べない。一方、破壊後も攻撃を続ける敵や、復活・強: An excisable part cannot be targeted while broken. Other enemies keep attacking, revive, or strengthen after a break; follow their individual descriptions.
messages.「部位破壊」の表示だけで、敵全体の行動停止や撃破を判断しない。: A Part Broken message alone does not prove the entire enemy is disabled or defeated.
messages.部位HPが0になった後の分岐: What happens after part HP reaches 0
messages.摘出可能：破壊中は対象に選べない: Excisable: cannot be selected while broken
messages.それ以外：敵ごとの破壊後の行動を確認: Otherwise: check the enemy's post-break behavior
messages.基本的な分類図。復活・行動継続・強化などの例外は敵の個別情報で確認する。: This is a basic classification. Check individual enemies for exceptions such as revival, continued actions, or strengthening.
messages.glossary-aliases:part: Part HP, Main Body HP, Part Stagger, Part Break, Excisable Part, Part Excision
messages.攻撃先に選んだ部位 ／ 同じ攻撃が部位HPと本体HPに反映 ／ 参照する耐性は攻: The part selected as the target / The same attack reduces part HP and main-body HP / Use the targeted part's resistances
messages.部位HPが0になる ／ 摘出可能：破壊中は対象に選べない ／ それ以外：敵ごとの: Part HP reaches 0 / Excisable: cannot be selected while broken / Otherwise: check the enemy's post-break behavior
messages.鏡ダンジョンのギフト前提の編成: Teams built around Mirror Dungeon Gifts
messages.特定の編成を組まなくても活躍しやすい人格。キーワードがそろわないうちの主力や、編: Identities that perform well without a specialized team. Use them as main fighters while building your roster or to fill a spare slot. Includes limited Walpurgis Night Identities.
messages.軸になるキーワードや所属ごとに、組み方と回し方をまとめた。手持ちに無い人格は、各: Team building and rotation guides organized by core keyword or affiliation. If you lack a listed Identity, check the flexible and alternative slots in that team.
messages.火傷＋出血など、選んだキーワードを全て持つ人格に絞り込む。キーワード別の人格一覧: Find Identities with every selected keyword, such as Burn and Bleed together. Also browse lists for individual keywords.
messages.裏置きの候補をサポートパッシブから探す: Find bench options by support passive
messages.全人格のサポートパッシブを必要資源の罪悪属性ごとに並べ、編成でたまる資源だけで発: Browse support passives by their required Sin resources, then filter for those your team's resources can activate.
messages.指令を遂行しながら自分を強化し、代行 [ヘルメス]を溜めた後のFurioso-R: Fulfills Prescripts to strengthen himself and build Procuration [Hermes] for Furioso-Replica. A main fighter for longer battles that allow setup.
messages.序盤のバリアと保護、出血回数を増やす攻撃を両立する。生体材料を育てると、強化した: Combines early Shield and Protection with Bleed Count application. Building Corpus Ingredient lets her enhanced S3 attack multiple enemies.
messages.S3か守備で保存神域を張り、味方がスキルを使うときにバリアを配る。ル・ノワールの: S3 or defense creates a Sanctum of Conservation that grants Shield when allies use skills. Le Noir teammates accelerate her setup.
messages.コートとバリアで攻撃を引き受けながら保存を育て、強化形態に移ると破壊不能コインと: Takes attacks with her Overcoat and Shield while building Preservation, then attacks in her enhanced form with Unbreakable Coins and an improved S3. Fills both defensive and offensive roles.
messages.初めて守備を装着したターンの終了時に猛虎標弾へ切り替え、強化S3で火力をまとめる: Switches to Savage Tigermark Rounds at the end of the first turn he equips defense, enabling a powerful enhanced S3. His Clashes weaken on the turn after ammunition runs out.
messages.同じ敵・部位を攻撃し続けると点穴が溜まり、コイン再使用につながる。狙う相手を決め: Repeated attacks on the same enemy or part build Nerve Strike for Coin reuse. A main fighter suited to single bosses and consistent targeting.
messages.同じ敵とのマッチで決闘高潮を溜め、強化S3で振動爆発を重ねる。対象を絞れる集中戦: Clashes with the same enemy build The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts with an enhanced S3. Suits Focused Encounters where he can maintain a target.
messages.試着室を経て新装になると、S2・S3のコイン再使用と回復で攻め続けられる。出血編: After the Changing Room leads to Full Makeover, S2/S3 Coin reuse and healing let her keep attacking. Bleed teams strengthen her further.
messages.予知眼がある間は条件付きで自動回避し、過熱へ移ると処分で大きく攻める。守りと攻め: Uses conditional automatic Evades with The Eye of Precognition, then unleashes Disposal during Overheat. An offensive and defensive main fighter for longer battles.
messages.条件付きで敵コインの有利な面が出る確率を下げ、自分の攻撃も強化する。挑発値と保護: Conditionally reduces enemy Coins' chance to roll their favorable face while strengthening her own attacks. Aggro and Protection help her take dangerous attacks.
messages.守備でランプを溜めて眩惑を付けると、S3の全コインが破壊不能になる。集中戦闘では: Builds Lamp with defense, then applies Dazzle to make all S3 Coins Unbreakable. Can draw attacks to himself in Focused Encounters, covering offense and defense against bosses.
messages.炎蝶の棺を溜めるほど攻撃が強くなり、棺30で強化S3や守備からの正午の解体を使え: Building Fire Butterfly Coffin strengthens attacks. At 30 Coffin, she can use enhanced S3 or Dismemberment at High Noon through defense. Combines damage and healing in long battles.
messages.同じスキルを続けて使い組札を合わせると光札が育ち、追撃の光斬につながる。毎ターン: Repeating the same skill to match her Hand builds Bright【光】 for the Kōzan [光斬] follow-up attack. Turn-by-turn skill selection determines her damage.
messages.精神力が高い加護では守備役、精神力を下げた絶望では減算コインの攻撃役を担う。守備: High-SP Blessing provides defense; low-SP Despair provides negative-Coin offense. Her defense skill lets her enter Despair deliberately.

messages.マッチ・耐性・状態異常・E.G.Oなど、共通の仕組みを調べる。人格固有の効果は、: Look up shared mechanics such as Clashes, resistances, statuses, and E.G.O. For Identity-specific effects, check the terms on that Identity's page.

messages.18ターン以内を狙う中指編成。共鳴・広域攻撃への対処・後半の集中攻撃を整理する。: A Middle team aiming for 18 cumulative turns or less. Covers Absolute Resonance, area attacks, and focused damage in Phase 2.
messages.18ターン以内向け。獲物の守備・束縛・弾の処理を分担し、主力を後半の削りへ残す。: For 18 cumulative turns or less: divide the handling of Prey defense, Bind, and ammunition, and save your main attackers for damage in the second half.
messages.1名の固定編成で進める決闘。専用の能力補正とHP下限があるため、この戦闘のために: A duel with 1 fixed combatant, special stat bonuses, and an HP floor. There is no need to prepare a different Identity for this battle.
messages.2ターン目から毎ターン3名に付く禁止規則を守り、なめされた罪人を減らして本体の破: From Turn 2, obey the rules applied to three Sinners each turn. Eliminate Tanned Prisoners to weaken the body’s Unbreakable area attacks. Punishment is Unclashable and does not activate defense: plan targets and skill types first. Clear adds while damaging the body, and prepare for a forced turn end around half HP.
messages.2ターン目の盲目を、麻痺込みでも勝てる技で止める。その後は漂流物を先に破壊し、彷: Stop turn 2's Blind Obsession with a skill that wins under Paralyze. Destroy Flotsam to trigger self-damage through “Wayward Blind Obsession”. Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit recurring Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss before it regenerates.
messages.2体の敵が交代する5段階の長期戦。特定の囚人を守り、最初の両手は足並みをそろえて: A 5-phase endurance battle in which 2 enemies alternate. Protect the required Sinner, damage both hands together the first time, and handle the body's Shield on the second appearance.
messages.2体の敵が続けて現れる長期戦。序盤は燭台を先に壊し、その後は毎ターン付く停止と鼓: A long battle through successive forms. Destroy candles first, then assign major clashes using Stillness and Thumping Pulse each turn. In the final form, avoid nailed Attack Skills. Let Meursault receive Shift + Delete while keeping other allies alive.
messages.2体を均等に削らず、片方へ火力を集める。攻撃を当てるほど強化されるため、今倒さな: Focus damage on one enemy rather than lowering both evenly. Hits strengthen them, so minimize attacks on the one you are not killing yet.
messages.3つの形態と続けて戦う。1つ目は回避を破り、2つ目は印付きの囚人でマッチに勝ち、: Fight 3 forms consecutively. Break Evade in the first, win Clashes with marked Sinners in the second, and break the Shield in the third. Reduce each form's Ego and damage it during Stagger.
messages.3ターンごとの全体強化とWave移行が重ならないように進める。道中で精神力・手数: Avoid overlapping the teamwide buff every 3 turns with a Wave transition. Prepare SP, actions, and healing resources along the way, then prevent nail-induced Forced Stagger in the final Wave.
messages.3人の敵と戦う。攻撃役を早めに止め、指揮役の命令に備えよう。獲物の印を受ける役と: Fight 3 enemies. Stop the main attacker early and prepare for the commander's orders. Assign a defender to take Prey Mark and attackers to deplete the Assist Barrier.
messages.3人の敵を決まった順に集中して倒す。1人目を倒すときにはフィナーレの準備を済ませ: Focus down 3 enemies in a set order. Prepare the finale before defeating the first, and account for action-change conditions that differ from their solo battles.
messages.4人で挑む2人戦。片方の敵の呼吸と月下青刀を減らし、もう片方の大技は先に別々の攻: A 4-member battle against 2 enemies. Reduce one enemy's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken the other's major skill by landing 3 separate attacks first. Hold back during Iron Veil turns.
messages.6段階の長期戦。序盤はホンルを守り、後半は宝玉→輿→残りの取り巻きの順で妨害源を: A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; later, remove interference in the order jewel, palanquin, then remaining adds. After gaining Joy, use Hong Lu's Clash Wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.
messages.D-02支部・1層「情報チーム連絡通路」: D-02 Branch, Floor 1: Information Team Passage
messages.D-02支部・2層「重要幻想体隔離所」: D-02 Branch, Floor 2: Critical Abnormality Containment
messages.HP0まで倒す必要はない。乖離のバリアを削り切るか、11ターン目終了まで耐えれば: You do not need to reduce HP to 0. Deplete the Disjunction Shield or survive through the end of Turn 11 to progress. Have fast Sinners beat Silent Regard and Phantom Step first to make later major attacks safer.
messages.HP1で止まるのは自家発電が残っているため。まず胴体を削り、移行後の蠢く頭・尾へ: Self-charge keeps it alive at 1 HP. Damage the Body first, then beat “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” after the transition to exhaust its stacks. Breaking the Shield is a separate approach.
messages.HP80%・60%・40%で戦い方が変わる。速度10の破壊不能攻撃へ事前に備え、: Behavior changes at 80%, 60%, and 40% HP. Prepare for the Speed 10 Unbreakable attack, and win Clashes to limit damage and lifesteal through each phase.
messages.HPを削り切るほか、特定の大技へマッチで勝ち、助力者の記憶を5までためて終える方: Besides depleting HP, win specific major clashes to build Pwie's Memories to 5 and follow the final sequence. Check Bleed and L'Abject each turn, and preserve Sinners with Shared with Pwie for the ending.
messages.J-03支部・2層「部品組み立て室」: J-03 Branch, Floor 2: Component Assembly Room
messages.J-03支部・3層「眠りに就いた隣人たちの城」: J-03 Branch, Floor 3: Castle of Slumbering Neighbors
messages.K-02支部・2層「聖所への道」: K-02 Branch, Floor 2: Path to the Sanctuary
messages.【リンバス】ボス攻略一覧｜Limbus Assistant: Limbus Company Boss Guides | Limbus Assistant
messages.まず4本の蝋燭をHP1まで削って全て点灯させる。本体の耐性が戻ったら集中攻撃する: Reduce all 4 Candles to 1 HP to light them. Once the boss's normal resistances return, focus damage on it or break every lit Candle's Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage and Stagger.
messages.まずは打撃で右腕を集中攻撃。長引くなら3ターン目にお札を返し、4ターン目の5枚攻: Focus Blunt attacks on the Right Arm first. If the fight lasts, return talismans on turn 3 to weaken turn 4's 5-Coin attack. Distinguish talismans on your Sinners from those returned to the enemy.
messages.まず取り巻きを減らし、落酒への勝利でひとくちを抑える。ホンルは集中攻撃されるが、: Clear the adds first and win against “Waterfall” to limit Swig. Hong Lu takes focused attacks, but his death does not immediately cause defeat here. Bring reserves to recover the fight.
messages.まず確認：戦闘に詰まったときの基本: Start here: when a battle has you stuck
messages.イベントは走る、走る、走らないの順で戦闘を回避できる。戦う場合は事前のHP減少に: Choose Run., Run., then Don't run. to avoid the event battle. If fighting, account for the initial HP loss and win easier Clashes to weaken the enemy and reveal the Head.

messages.センクが私たちのフィクサーに仕掛けてきたとてつもない決闘について: On the Tremendous Duel the Cinq Brought Upon Our Fixer
messages.ダンジョンで集める「とある印」と、危険な攻撃へのマッチが攻略の軸。前半の注視を対: The dungeon's special marks and Clashes against dangerous skills are central. Handle Gaze early, then Stagger and break the large mouth in the second half to reduce attacks.
messages.ネタバレを避けるため、一覧ではボス名を出さず、章ごとに閉じてある。: Chapters start collapsed and show stage titles rather than boss names to limit spoilers.
messages.ヒースクリフ・ロージャは暴食技と害虫を処理し、大きな火力と危険なマッチは味方NP: Heathcliff and Rodion handle Gluttony skills and pests, while the allied NPC handles dangerous clashes and supplies major damage. Using Unbreakable Coins against Gluttony skills strengthens the enemy; check the NPC's clash targets first.
messages.ホンルを最後まで生かし、敵側の特定の1体への無用な攻撃を避ける。後半はホンル本人: Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on the designated enemy. In the second half, Hong Lu must win 3 Dialogues to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.
messages.ボスが調理しようとしている革の財布を先に倒し、食事による回復と強化を抑える戦闘。: Defeat the Leather Wallet being prepared as food to limit healing and buffs from meals. Repeatedly preventing meals triggers another major attack through hunger. Track cooking outcomes and both Unbreakable area skills while lowering the body below 30% HP.
messages.マッチで強化を削り、両腕をそろえて破壊する。片腕だけでは再生されるため、残すHP: Win Clashes to strip buffs and break both arms together. One broken arm regenerates, so coordinate remaining HP and action order, then finish the next phase quickly.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)のボス攻略一覧。ストーリーの章別攻略と、: Limbus Company boss guides by story chapter, plus NORMAL and HARD Reflectrials. Find answers to common failures, enemy skills and passives, and teams aiming for 18 turns or fewer.
messages.ワープ特急殺人事件・従える者: Murder on the WARP Express: The One Who Commands
messages.保存とウーステッド生地を育て、毎ターンのバリアと条件付き破壊不能で戦う敵。攻撃を: These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted for renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus one enemy to reduce actions. Distinguish Count gained when the body is hit while Shielded from the other enemy's damage reflection during defense.
messages.保存威力が上がり切る前にバリアを崩して攻める。広域乱射が出たら強い技でマッチに勝: Break the Shield before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against Unfocused Volley with a strong skill to halve damage and prevent Stagger. Another enemy follows immediately after victory.
messages.傘に気を取られて精神力を削られ続けないよう、弱い攻撃で精神力を稼ぎ、強い攻撃は本: Build SP by winning against weaker attacks, and direct strong attacks at the Fox rather than spending the whole fight chasing umbrellas. Prepare for area attacks and SP loss, break Parts, and finish the Fox.
messages.全員へ攻撃を通して強化を削る。模倣する反撃へ強い技を最初に当てないよう、行動順と: Hit every enemy to remove buffs. Check order and area coverage so a powerful skill does not hit the imitating Counter first.
messages.全攻撃にマッチするより、受ける攻撃と攻める時間を決めよう。前のウェーブで準備し、: Choose which attacks to take and when to deal damage. Prepare in earlier Waves, then concentrate strong Blunt skills during Test of the Big Brother.
messages.全部の攻撃へ無理にマッチしなくてよい。勝ちやすい溢れ出る哀しみを止めて弱体化させ: You need not Clash with every attack. Stop the easier “Overflowing Sorrow” to weaken the enemy, then break the revealed head for a major opening.
messages.出撃できる3名が決まっており、各2スロットから始まる。第1Waveで精神力と資源: The 3 deployable Sinners are fixed, each starting with 2 slots. Prepare SP and resources in Wave 1, focus Pierce damage during Stagger, and shorten the period spent taking Unclashable attacks afterward.
messages.出現した緑色の粘液を捕食される前に倒し、本体の粘液が尽きたときに弱点の部位へ集中: Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the vulnerable Part when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.
messages.初回クリア向け。帳簿の蓄積と守備の使い分けを覚え、24ターン以内も目指す。: For a first clear: learn Written in the Book buildup and when to defend, with 24 cumulative turns or less as a further goal.
messages.前の戦闘からの連戦。コートが100になると覚醒し、基本攻撃が全て破壊不能へ変わる: Continues directly from the previous battle. At 100 Overcoat, awakens and makes all basic attack Coins Unbreakable. Winning against major skills reduces damage by 75%, so save HP and strong skills for their clasher.
messages.前半の形態では取り巻きを処理し、後半の形態では出血と拘束を管理する長期戦。凝結し: A long fight: handle adds in the first form, then manage Bleed and restraints in the second. Have an ally defeat the crystallized dream to turn it into support and prepare for major attacks.
messages.前半は指令対象への的中を防ぎ、後半は味方NPCの援護を使って生き残る戦闘。火力だ: Prevent hits on the Prescript's Target early, then survive with allied NPC support later. Use Ryōshū's resource generation and healing rather than pursuing damage alone, and maintain the Assist Defense conditions.
messages.前哨戦の子方を半分まで削ると味方の援軍が参戦する。後半は親方の予知眼を先に減らし: Reducing the opening Apprentice to half HP brings allied reinforcements. Later, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before killing the Apprentice. Adjust NPC targets and weaken “Disposal”, whose target cannot be changed.
messages.取り巻き→1人目→2人目の順に倒す戦闘。1人目へ攻撃を集めすぎず、2人目には通常: Defeat adds, then the first opponent, then the second. Do not overcommit to the first; against the second, use ordinary Guard and Evade to limit repeated area attacks while SP is low.
messages.取り巻きが残るほど通常反撃のコインが増える。最初に攻撃する囚人の耐性とHPを確認: More surviving adds mean more Coins on the ordinary Counter. Check the first attacker's resistances and HP, clear adds, then Stagger and finish. Prepare for the major attack after the boss is isolated.
messages.取り巻きの妨害を抑え、本体の条件付き強化を防ぐ。取り巻き撃破では本体の手数が増え: Prevent add debuffs to deny the boss's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases its actions but lowers its Offense Level. Handle the extra attacks while finishing it.
messages.取り巻きの撃破が本体の手数と強化につながる。取り巻きはいなし、本体の危険な大技を: Defeating adds gives the boss more actions and buffs. Contain the adds and stop the boss's dangerous skills instead. Concentrate damage during the first Stagger and limit time facing Counters after recovery.
messages.取り巻きを処理してから、腕、顔の順に本体を攻める。途中の判定に使う対象を用意し、: Clear adds, then attack the arm and face in order. Prepare an appropriate Sinner for the intermediate check and preserve HP.
messages.味方NPC2人との共闘。大技は囚人の先行攻撃で弱めてからNPCに受けてもらう。後: Fight alongside 2 allied NPCs. Weaken major skills with Sinner attacks before leaving them to NPCs. Later, incapacitate the Apprentice first to reduce the Nursefather's Protection and Assist Defense.
messages.囚人3人で子方を倒し、親方は味方NPCに任せる。終盤は火力勝負をやめ、守る対象の: Use three Sinners against the Apprentice and leave the Nursefather to allied NPCs. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect the designated NPC from every hit for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets the charge.
messages.回復を減らすマッチを取り、部位破壊で攻める隙を作る。破壊した瞬間に全ての攻撃が止: Win the Clashes that reduce healing and break parts to create openings. A break does not instantly stop every attack, so maintain the rest of that turn's pairings.
messages.固定の1名で進めるイベント戦。追加ダメージを持つ攻撃にマッチを合わせ、専用の能力: An event battle with 1 fixed combatant. Clash against attacks with additional damage and use the special stat bonuses.
messages.夢へと至らんとした偉大なフィクサーについての物語・最終戦: The Tale of the Great Fixer Who Sought the Dream: Final Battle
messages.夢へと至らん・病人の運命: To Reach the Dream: A Sick Person's Fate
messages.家主審査2次戦・鴻園に最も必要なもの: Second Hierarch Trial: What Hongyuan Needs Most
messages.対象変更不可の接客技は、狙われた囚人が攻撃と守備のどちらを装着するかで対処する。: Customer-service skills cannot be redirected. The targeted Sinner must equip the correct action: defense against the refusal to allow a fitting, and an attack against the invitation to try something on. Read each instruction and switch accordingly.
messages.左腕へ火力を集中するのが基本。長引くなら、高揚を妖精酒で酔いへ変え、捕食のダメー: Focus damage on the Left Arm. If the fight lasts, use Fairy Wine to convert Morale Boost into Tipsy, nullify Predation's damage, and trigger Stagger. The opening and later versions of the same skill differ in whether they can Clash.
messages.序盤に行動スロットと精神力を整えて増援に備える。回避は守備で相殺し、弱い攻撃を何: Prepare action slots and SP for reinforcements. Offset Evade with defense rather than letting weak attacks be repeatedly dodged.
messages.序盤のマッチで精神力を整え、的中による回復と速度強化を止める。目印はマッチ勝利で: Build SP in opening Clashes and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark applies even if you win, so prepare next turn's defense too. Save damage for after the HP floor.
messages.序盤は保有する時間で攻撃・防御レベルが高い。耐性と守備でしのぎ、時間の消耗を待つ: Stored time gives high Offense and Defense Levels early. Survive with resistances and defense while it is spent. Limit who attacks during the warning turn, then manage targets next turn.
messages.序盤は取り巻きを倒して本体の保護を減らす。攻撃側へ出血を返す棘と、マッチに勝って: Clear adds early to reduce the boss's Protection. Watch thorns that return Bleed to attackers and Unbreakable Coins that remain after Clash Wins; exploit the later Stagger for concentrated damage.
messages.後半は良秀1人の一騎打ちになる。落望へ先に勝って敵の攻撃を弱め、怨望・非望へも攻: The second half becomes a solo duel with Ryōshū. Beat Dismay first to weaken enemy attacks, and also target Resentment and Futility. All enemy Coins become Unbreakable, so prepare to survive hits even after clash wins.
messages.復活する取り巻きを処理して調査の機会を作る。装置を止める選択肢を選び、停止後も一: Clear reviving adds to create a chance to investigate. Choose the option that stops the device, then finish without allowing unopposed attacks even after it stops.
messages.打撃の連続攻撃を受けながら、通常パターンと試着室を行き来する戦闘。試着室のバリア: A Blunt-heavy fight alternating between the normal pattern and Changing Room. Its 500 Shield need not be broken immediately; waiting with defense is an option. In the normal pattern, recognize the skill reduced when unopposed and prepare for Unbreakable attacks below half HP.
messages.指令対象を守って指令の達成を阻止し、カルマで敵を弱める。大技は良秀、後半の憂鬱3: Protect the Prescript's Target to deny fulfillment and build Karmic Consequence on the enemy. Assign the major skill to Ryōshū, and match physical types against the 3 Gloom skills later. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after Clash Wins.
messages.操作するのはファウストとイシュメール。親方は味方NPCに任せ、2人は子方へ集中す: You control Faust and Ishmael. Leave the Nursefather to the allied NPC and focus the pair on the Apprentice. The NPC's Abate the Smoke removes partywide Stagger; the animation is no reason to stop attacking.
messages.攻撃を受けて開花がたまると、味方が花に閉じ込められる。マッチで開花を抑え、花の処: Hits build Blooming and can trap allies in flowers. Limit Blooming by winning Clashes, deal with the flowers, and prepare for the second-phase duel.
messages.時間殺人時間・恐怖の時計塔: Timekilling Time: The Dread Clock Tower
messages.最初のウェーブで精神力と資源を整え、その後は各ウェーブ4ターン以内に敵を倒す。弱: Prepare SP and resources in the first Wave, then clear each later Wave within 4 turns. Exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies first and cancel multiple actions together.
messages.最初の贖罪の月桂冠を強い囚人へ渡し、その囚人に大技のマッチと本体への攻撃を任せる: Give the first Laurel Wreath of Atonement to a strong Sinner for major clashes and attacks on the body. The others handle adds, normal skills, and SP recovery. Prevent lethal attacks triggered by Panic or Corrosion, protect the Assist Unit, and aim for a quick finish.
messages.最速の囚人が観望へ勝って敵を弱め、印の付いた本人が確定された相手を止める。ムルソ: Have the fastest Sinner beat Silent Regard to weaken the enemy, while each marked Sinner stops “Destinated Opponent”. Reduce Meursault and Outis's Bladetrail, deplete each stage's Shield, and finish by reaching half HP.
messages.木の扱いは戦闘ごとに変わる。1戦目では虚栄の木をHP1にして敵に倒させ、2戦目で: Handle trees differently in each battle. In the first, reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP and let the enemy defeat them. In the second, defeat Trees of Desires to reduce Protection and Seeds.
messages.枝と根の攻撃へマッチを取り、余った攻撃で果実を壊す。果実破壊による全身の脆弱を使: Clash against branch and root attacks and use spare actions on the fruit. Destroying fruit applies Fragile across the body. If the fight lasts, stop the branches to prevent the area attack. HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns.
messages.次の4-48とは別の戦闘。7人の手数でバリアを削り、棘が付いたときは古傘へ攻撃を: A different fight from the following 4-48. Use 7 members' actions to remove the Shield and redirect attacks to old umbrellas when thorns appear. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Heads/Tails odds.
messages.毎ターン、お直し対象になった囚人を守備に回し、ほかの囚人で攻撃して混乱を取る戦闘: Each turn, have the Alteration Target defend while the other Sinners attack to Stagger the boss. Attacks from the target greatly increase her Power. Stagger removes Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors; exploit the opening with 3 Fragile.
messages.毎ターン「舌に刺さった針」を受けた囚人に守備スキルを装着し、針釘の蓄積を防ぐ戦闘: Equip Defense Skills on Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle each turn to prevent Naildle buildup. Defeat Needlekin quickly in the first half to limit body buffs and area attacks. After the transition at 1,087 HP, finish without relying on Stagger.
messages.洗礼[赤]を守備・E.G.Oで減らし、出血を抱えたまま基本攻撃を連打しないことが: Reduce Baptism [Crimson] with defense and E.G.O instead of repeatedly using basic attacks while Bleeding. Destroy the Lifecord during Rampage, when its Protection and Assist Defense are inactive, then attack the Body. Win low-HP-targeting Unbreakable area clashes with healthy Sinners to limit damage.
messages.減算コインの敵には、精神力を下げるほど不利になることがある。斬撃・傲慢の火力で混: Lowering a Minus Coin enemy's SP can make it more dangerous. Use Slash and Pride damage to Stagger it, and arrange attacks to break the Shield before “To Claim Their Bones”.
messages.漆黒の中へ・2層 右心房: Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Right Atrium
messages.漆黒の中へ・2層 腱の橋: Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Tendon Bridge
messages.漆黒の中へ・3層 心臓前の集結地点: Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Assembly Point Before the Heart
messages.漆黒の中へ・3層最終戦: Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Final Battle
messages.爆砕斬を後に処理し、獲物には守備も使う。マッチ勝利後に残る破壊不能の被弾を抑え、: Resolve Blasting Shatterslash late and use defense skills on Prey holders. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after clash wins, and prepare healing and damage for buffs that progress with HP loss and elapsed turns.
messages.特定の囚人が倒れると敗北する戦闘。変更できる攻撃はほかの囚人で引き受け、その囚人: A required Sinner's defeat causes a loss. Have other Sinners intercept changeable attacks and save strong skills for attacks only that Sinner can handle.
messages.獲物と破壊不能コインへの基本対処。大技の前に回復し、24ターン以内も目指す。: Basic handling of Prey and Unbreakable Coins. Heal before major attacks, and aim for 24 cumulative turns or less.
messages.白い月の騎士と勇敢なドンキホーテの鮮烈な争いについて: On the Vivid Clash Between the Knight of the White Moon and the Valiant Don Quixote
messages.目印付きの囚人から強化攻撃をそらし、後半は捕縛された本人で解除用のマッチに勝つ。: Redirect enhanced attacks away from marked Sinners. Later, the captured Sinner must win the freeing Clash. Similar skill names can require different defenders.
messages.破壊不能の広域はマッチに勝ったうえで受け切る準備が必要。出血と低HPを放置せず、: Prepare to survive Unbreakable area attacks even after winning their Clashes. Maintain HP and manage Bleed to prevent the fixed-target instant-kill skill from appearing.
messages.第1段階は設計図を先に倒して捕捉を妨げ、第2段階はムルソーのスキル番号を合わせて: In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing”. In Phase 2, match Meursault’s skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to lower body HP. Protect Meursault: the previous battle’s survival effect does not carry over.
messages.絡まりを守備や洗い流すで減らし、奈落の顎門の再使用を防ぐ戦闘。部位を混乱させると: Reduce Tangling through defense and “Cleansing” to prevent “Abyssal Maw” reuse. Part Stagger ends the turn and brings Pool of Black Water next turn. Clear pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks on the Assist Unit.
messages.美しいドゥルシネーアとドンキホーテに起こったことについて: On What Befell the Fair Dulcinea and Don Quixote
messages.肉斬骨断・5.5-23と剣鬼の心象最終戦: “Yield My Flesh” to Claim Their Bones: 5.5-23 and the Final Battle of the Sword Demon's Mind
messages.肉斬骨断・黒い雲: Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones: Black Clouds
messages.血袋と前半の敵で準備を整え、後半の敵が宿した血をマッチ勝利とHP削りで減らす。血: Prepare against bloodbags and the opening enemy, then reduce the later enemy's stored blood with Clash Wins and HP damage. Evade the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood and prevent large lifesteal healing.
messages.親方は味方NPCに任せ、囚人3人は子方へ集中する。援護防御に任せる攻撃へ守備やマ: Leave the Nursefather to the allied NPC while 3 Sinners focus on the Apprentice. Do not assign defense or Clashes to attacks intended for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.
messages.記憶の中の九人会・1層: The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 1
messages.記憶の中の九人会・2層: The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 2
messages.記憶の中の九人会・3層のイベント: The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 3 Event
messages.記憶の中の九人会・終盤2戦: The League of Nine in Memory: Final 2 Battles
messages.負けた原因を一つずつ見て、育成か操作かを切り分ける。: Review one cause of defeat at a time to separate progression issues from tactical decisions.
messages.負けやすい場面の対処と、敵のスキル・パッシブを確認しよう。: Find answers to dangerous situations and check enemy skills and passives.
messages.道中で精神力と資源を整え、沈潜と妨害を防ぐ。最初の混乱はターン終了時に解除される: Prepare SP and resources along the way while limiting Sinking and disruption. The first Stagger ends at Turn End, so concentrate follow-up damage within that same turn.
messages.難易度別の攻略。HARDは18ターン以内を目指す編成と立ち回りを扱う。: Guides by difficulty. HARD covers teams and rotations aiming for 18 turns or fewer.
messages.【リンバス】スキルとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Skill Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「スキル」の解説。人格が戦闘で使う: Skill in Limbus Company. An action an Identity uses in battle. Guard and Evade are skills too.
messages.【リンバス】コインとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Coin Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「コイン」の解説。スキルの威力を表: Coin in Limbus Company. A skill's Coins change its Power according to Heads or Tails. Their number also affects how many attacks it makes.
messages.【リンバス】スキル威力とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Skill Power Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「スキル威力」の解説。マッチの強さ: Skill Power in Limbus Company. A value used to resolve Clashes and calculate attacks. Coin results and other effects modify Base Power.
messages.【リンバス】マッチとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Clash Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「マッチ」の解説。スキル同士で威力: Clash in Limbus Company. A contest of Power between skills. With ordinary attack skills, the winner gets to attack.
messages.【リンバス】精神力とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Sanity Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「精神力」の解説。コインの表の出や: Sanity in Limbus Company. A value that affects Heads chance and other mechanics. It is separate from HP.
messages.【リンバス】混乱とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Stagger Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「混乱」の解説。行動ができなくなり: Stagger in Limbus Company. A dangerous state that prevents actions and worsens incoming-damage resistances.
messages.【リンバス】攻撃タイプとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Attack Type Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「攻撃タイプ」の解説。斬撃・貫通・: Attack Type in Limbus Company. Slash, Pierce, or Blunt. It affects damage together with the target's physical resistance.
messages.【リンバス】罪悪属性とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Sin Affinity Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「罪悪属性」の解説。憤怒・色欲・怠: Sin Affinity in Limbus Company. The 7 affinities: Wrath, Lust, Sloth, Gluttony, Gloom, Pride, and Envy. They also govern resources and Resonance.
messages.【リンバス】耐性とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Resistance Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「耐性」の解説。攻撃を受ける側の、: Resistance in Limbus Company. How readily the defender takes damage. A larger displayed resistance value generally means more damage taken.
messages.【リンバス】威力と回数とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Potency and Count Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「威力と回数」の解説。状態効果の強: Potency and Count in Limbus Company. Values describing a status effect's strength and remaining activations or duration. When Count decreases depends on the effect.
messages.【リンバス】火傷とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Burn Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「火傷」の解説。ターン終了時にダメ: Burn in Limbus Company. A status that deals damage at Turn End. Potency determines damage per activation; Count tracks duration.
messages.【リンバス】出血とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Bleed Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「出血」の解説。付与された対象が攻: Bleed in Limbus Company. A status that damages its bearer when they roll attack-skill Coins.
messages.【リンバス】振動とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Tremor Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「振動」の解説。通常は振動爆発を通: Tremor in Limbus Company. A status normally used to raise Stagger Thresholds through Tremor Burst. Applying it alone does not deal damage.
messages.【リンバス】破裂とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Rupture Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「破裂」の解説。付与された対象が攻: Rupture in Limbus Company. A status that deals damage separately from the normal attack when its bearer is hit.
messages.【リンバス】沈潜とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Sinking Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「沈潜」の解説。攻撃でダメージを受: Sinking in Limbus Company. A status that damages SP when its bearer takes attack damage. It behaves differently against targets without SP.
messages.【リンバス】呼吸とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Poise Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「呼吸」の解説。威力に応じてクリテ: Poise in Limbus Company. A status whose Potency raises Critical Hit chance. Count governs activation and persistence.
messages.【リンバス】充電とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Charge Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「充電」の解説。スキルの条件や消費: Charge in Limbus Company. A stored resource used for skill conditions and costs. Having Charge does not universally strengthen attacks.
messages.【リンバス】麻痺とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Paralyze Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「麻痺」の解説。対象のコイン威力を: Paralyze in Limbus Company. A debuff that fixes the Coin Power of a stated number of the target's Coins at 0 for 1 turn.
messages.【リンバス】破壊不能コインとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Unbreakable Coin Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「破壊不能コイン」の解説。マッチに: Unbreakable Coin in Limbus Company. A special Coin that remains after a Clash Loss. Winning alone may not stop the opponent's attack.
messages.【リンバス】摘出コインとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Excision Coin Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「摘出コイン」の解説。マッチ中に破: Excision Coin in Limbus Company. A special Coin that can break Unbreakable Coins during a Clash. When it loses a Clash itself, it behaves like an Unbreakable Coin.
messages.【リンバス】E.G.Oとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: E.G.O Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「E.G.O」の解説。囚人に装備し: E.G.O in Limbus Company. A special skill equipped to a Sinner and used in battle when its requirements are met. It is separate from an Identity's ordinary skills.
messages.【リンバス】E.G.O覚醒スキルとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: E.G.O Awakening Skill Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「E.G.O覚醒スキル」の解説。E: E.G.O Awakening Skill in Limbus Company. The skill normally selected when using E.G.O. Its effects and targeting differ from Corrosion.
messages.【リンバス】E.G.O侵蝕とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: E.G.O Corrosion Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「E.G.O侵蝕」の解説。精神力の: E.G.O Corrosion in Limbus Company. Activation of an E.G.O Corrosion skill, often through low SP. It can put allies at risk.
messages.【リンバス】オーバークロックとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Overclock Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「オーバークロック」の解説。追加の: Overclock in Limbus Company. A way to deliberately select a Corrosion skill by paying an additional cost.
messages.【リンバス】幻想解析とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Threadspin Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「幻想解析」の解説。E.G.Oの性: Threadspin in Limbus Company. E.G.O progression that upgrades effects by tier. It is separate from Identity Uptie.
messages.【リンバス】同期化とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Uptie Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「同期化」の解説。人格のスキルやパ: Uptie in Limbus Company. Identity progression that unlocks and upgrades skills and passives by tier.
messages.【リンバス】罪悪資源とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Sin Resources Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「罪悪資源」の解説。E.G.Oの使: Sin Resources in Limbus Company. Resources stored by Sin affinity, used for E.G.O and passive requirements.
messages.【リンバス】共鳴とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Resonance Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「共鳴」の解説。そのターンに選ぶ同: Resonance in Limbus Company. Selecting multiple skills of the same Sin affinity in one turn. It is separate from the number of stored resources.
messages.【リンバス】完全共鳴とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Absolute Resonance Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「完全共鳴」の解説。同じ罪悪属性の: Absolute Resonance in Limbus Company. A chain of at least 3 consecutive skills with the same Sin affinity.
messages.【リンバス】バトルパッシブとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Combat Passive Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「バトルパッシブ」の解説。戦闘参加: Combat Passive in Limbus Company. An effect an Identity activates while participating in battle, subject to its conditions.
messages.【リンバス】サポートパッシブとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Support Passive Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「サポートパッシブ」の解説。編成中: Support Passive in Limbus Company. An effect provided by an Identity in the team but not participating in battle, subject to its conditions.
messages.【リンバス】速度とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Speed Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「速度」の解説。行動順や、集中戦闘: Speed in Limbus Company. A value affecting action order and the ability to intercept attacks in Focused Encounters.
messages.【リンバス】一方攻撃とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Unopposed Attack Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「一方攻撃」の解説。相手のスキルと: Unopposed Attack in Limbus Company. An attack made without Clashing against the opponent's skill. It is different from a Clash Win.
messages.【リンバス】防御とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Guard Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「防御」の解説。通常はバリアによっ: Guard in Limbus Company. A defense skill that normally absorbs incoming damage with Shield.
messages.【リンバス】回避とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Evade Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「回避」の解説。回避威力と相手の攻: Evade in Limbus Company. A defense skill that compares Evade Power with incoming Attack Power and avoids attacks on success.
messages.【リンバス】反撃とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Counter Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「反撃」の解説。通常は相手の攻撃を: Counter in Limbus Company. A defense skill that normally retaliates after taking an enemy attack.
messages.【リンバス】攻撃加重値とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Attack Weight Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「攻撃加重値」の解説。スキルが攻撃: Attack Weight in Limbus Company. A value governing how many target slots an attack can cover.
messages.【リンバス】攻撃レベルとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Offense Level Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「攻撃レベル」の解説。スキルの攻撃: Offense Level in Limbus Company. A skill's offensive level, used in Clash and damage modifiers.
messages.【リンバス】防御レベルとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Defense Level Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「防御レベル」の解説。受けるダメー: Defense Level in Limbus Company. A level used to calculate damage taken and defense skills.
messages.【リンバス】パニックとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Panic Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「パニック」の解説。精神力の悪化に: Panic in Limbus Company. A state caused by low SP, separate from HP-related Stagger.
messages.【リンバス】通常戦闘とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Normal Encounter Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「通常戦闘」の解説。敵味方の攻撃の: Normal Encounter in Limbus Company. A battle format where you cannot assign attack pairings as freely as in Focused Encounters.
messages.【リンバス】集中戦闘とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Focused Encounter Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「集中戦闘」の解説。敵のスキルや部: Focused Encounter in Limbus Company. A battle format where you target enemy skills or parts and choose between Clashes and unopposed attacks.
messages.【リンバス】光の苗木とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Sapling of Light Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「光の苗木」の解説。ストーリ進行で: Sapling of Light in Limbus Company. 5 abilities unlocked through story progress that let Dante intervene in battle. Check unlocked abilities and remaining uses.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「対象変更・マッチの引き受け」の解: Target Redirection and Interception in Limbus Company. Changing an enemy skill's target to yourself in a Focused Encounter. Check both the original target and Speed.
messages.【リンバス】スキルスロットとは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Skill Slot Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「スキルスロット」の解説。スキルを: Skill Slot in Limbus Company. An action slot used to choose 1 skill. It is separate from Sinner count, Coin count, and Attack Weight.
messages.【リンバス】守備スキルの相殺とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Defense Skill Offset Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「守備スキルの相殺」の解説。通常の: Defense Skill Offset in Limbus Company. Pairing ordinary Guard or Evade skills so neither receives the attack needed to activate. It is not a contest of Power.
messages.【リンバス】効果文の読み方とは｜用語辞典｜Limbus Assistant: Reading Effect Descriptions Explained | Limbus Company Glossary | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「効果文の読み方」の解説。「いつ・: Reading Effect Descriptions in Limbus Company. Separate when, who, what, and how much. Selecting a skill does not activate every effect.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)の用語「部位と部位破壊」の解説。集中戦闘: Parts and Part Breaks in Limbus Company. Focused Encounter enemies can have separate HP, Stagger Thresholds, and actions for each part. Attacking a part also affects main-body HP.
messages.START後、選んだスキルを使用: After START, use the selected skill
messages.両方を同じ敵スロットへ指定: Assign both to the same enemy slot
messages.互いに指定先から攻撃が来ない: Neither receives an attack from its target
messages.各ターン開始時の行動枠。□1つが1スロット: Slots at each Turn Start. Each square is 1 slot.
messages.同じスキルでも、表の枚数でマッチ威力が変わる: The same skill rolls different Clash Power with different numbers of Heads.
messages.同じ回避を再使用し、コインを振り直す: Reuse the same Evade and reroll its Coin
messages.味方Bが攻撃を指定：速度5 ＞ 敵の速度4: Ally B assigns an attack: Speed 5 > enemy Speed 4
messages.出撃上限5名・味方3名 ／ 編成順 A → B → C: Capacity 5, allies 3 / Deployment order A → B → C
messages.回避に使う行動枠は1つ: Only 1 action slot is used for Evade
messages.回避判定も、防御のバリア獲得も発動しない: Neither Evade rolls nor Guard Shield activate
messages.変更後：Aに向いていた、この攻撃をBが引き受ける: After: B intercepts this attack originally aimed at A
messages.失敗したコインを避け直すことはできない: Cannot retry Evade against the failed Coin
messages.成功すれば被ダメージ・的中時効果を防ぐ: Success prevents damage and On Hit effects
messages.指定先からの攻撃で回避が発動: The selected slot's attack triggers Evade
messages.次のスキルが順に欄へ補充される: The next skills refill the choices in order
messages.残り0枚 → 自分が勝利して攻撃へ: 0 Coins remain → You win and attack
messages.確率を示す図。発動順や回数を示すものではない。: This shows probability, not activation order or Count.
messages.縦線は耐性×1.0の位置。棒は耐性の数値を表し、最終ダメージ比を表すものではない: The vertical line marks ×1.0 resistance. Bars show resistance values, not final damage ratios.
messages.行動枠A：一方防御で待機: Slot A: defense waits without a Clash
messages.行動枠Bの攻撃で勝利: Slot B's attack wins the Clash
messages.通常の反撃は相殺できない。戦闘開始時の効果も、この不発とは別。: Ordinary Counter cannot be offset. Combat Start effects also resolve separately.
