messages.回避で「時限漂流」を得て、味方の攻撃に合わせてS1「次元斬り」で追撃し、充電を稼: A Charge Identity that gains Dimensional Castaway by evading, then follows up allies' attacks with S1 Dimensional Slice to build Charge. Use enhanced S3 at 15 Charge Count, then continue the evade-and-follow-up cycle.
messages.充電を貯め、消耗して束縛・攻撃威力減少・麻痺を付与するデバッファー。: A debuffer that builds Charge and spends it to inflict Bind, Attack Power Down, and Paralyze.
messages.S3「機会狙い」の高い威力でマッチに競り勝ち、大きなダメージを入れるアタッカー。: An attacker that uses the high Power of S3 Opportunistic Slash to win clashes and deal heavy damage. Fragile defensively; Poise, Rupture, and Haste are minor bonuses.
messages.色欲共鳴でバトルパッシブ「口笛」を発動させ、味方の精神力をすばやく回復するサポー: A support Identity that activates her combat passive, Whistles, through Lust Resonance to quickly restore allies' SP. In Bleed teams, Nails provide Bleed Count while Gaze boosts allies' Pierce and Blunt damage.
messages.威力が高くコインも多い、癖の少ない斬撃アタッカー。破裂がなくても戦える。破裂編成: A straightforward Slash attacker with high Power and many Coins, capable of fighting without Rupture. In Rupture teams, use S1 followed by S2 to reach at least 6 Rupture and gain the bonuses from Weakness Analyzed and Rupture.
messages.S1で自分の振動回数を貯め、S2・S3を複数攻撃化して振動を撒き、振動爆発させる: A Blunt attacker that builds her own Tremor Count with S1, then turns S2 and S3 into attacks that hit multiple targets to spread and burst Tremor. S2's debuffs and the combat passive's Defense Level Down also support the whole Tremor team's damage.
messages.S1・S2で呼吸回数を貯め、S3「舞い散る紅梅」のマッチ勝利で呼吸に変え、クリテ: Build Poise Count with S1 and S2, convert it into Poise by winning a clash with S3 Red Plum Blossoms Scatter, then rapidly stack 10 Red Plum Blossom through critical hits to inflict Slash Fragility. She struggles to build the Poise needed for critical hits alone and relies on support such as a Blade Lineage team.
messages.S3「接客道四式 封心」で「邸宅の木霊」を付け、バトルパッシブでマッチ勝利ごとに: A Sinking applicator that inflicts Echoes of the Manor with S3 Reception Arts 4: Heartseal and adds 3 Sinking per clash win through her combat passive. S2 and S3 against enemies with Echoes also help sustain Sinking Count.
messages.S3「40Y-3充電」で充電回数を補給して嫉妬脆弱を入れ、次のターンに嫉妬共鳴3: A Blunt attacker that replenishes Charge Count and inflicts Envy Fragility with S3 40Y-3 Charge, then spends all that Count on S2 Charge Countercurrent next turn with at least 3 Envy Resonance. Built for longer fights, growing stronger as repeated spending raises Charge Potency.
messages.自分に火傷を溜めて体力を削り、瀕死で「紅炎殺 最大感応【劣化侵蝕】」を撃って自爆: A Blunt attacker that stacks Burn on herself to lose HP, then self-destructs with A.B.S Max Attunement 【Degraded Corrosion】 when near death. Self-destruction and replacement by the next unit complete her cycle; the explosion itself is her main payoff.
messages.毎ターン守備を装着して援護防御を発動させ、援護防御専用スキルを強化S3「黒獣 卯: A Rupture attacker whose core loop is equipping a defense skill every turn to trigger Assist Defense, transforming the assist-only skill into enhanced S3 Ascendant Heishou - Mao Technique: Cloudsplitting Manifestation, and repeatedly using it.
messages.呼吸と出血で強化されるS1〜S3を振り回す斬撃アタッカー。呼吸を自力では維持しに: A Slash attacker whose S1–S3 gain bonuses from Poise and Bleed. She struggles to sustain Poise alone and performs best with outside Poise support. Bow's Glimmer [閃弓] offers a way to turn a turn spent unable to attack into greater damage later.
messages.毎ターンの「指令」を遂行して指令の加護を貯め、呼吸と沈潜で戦う人差し指の人格。: An Index Identity that fulfills each turn's Prescript to build Grace of the Prescript, fighting with Poise and Sinking.
messages.アイアンメイデンと、回避「始まった展示会」以外の全スキルが持つ出血回数増加で敵の: A Charge and Bleed Identity that sustains enemy Bleed Count through Iron Maiden and Count increases on every skill except the evade, The Exhibition Begins. Build the special Charge, Corpus Ingredient, to 3 Potency to increase Bleed application and expand S3's area after releasing restraints.
messages.「炎蝶の棺」を30まで溜めて強化S3を撃ち、守備から出す「正午の解体」で戦闘感覚: A Burn and Tremor attacker that builds Fire Butterfly Coffin to 30 for enhanced S3. Her full cycle begins after using Dismemberment at High Noon through defense to gain 3 Combat Instinct and a large heal; passive Coffin generation then lets her keep using enhanced S3 regularly.
messages.威力の大半をコイン威力に頼る、精神力しだいの貫通アタッカー。精神力を高く保ってマ: A Pierce attacker whose Power comes mainly from Coin Power, making SP crucial. Maintain high SP to win clashes, then press the advantage with the 3-Coin S3 For Justice! At Uptie Ⅳ, she can also stack Bleed.
messages.S2・S1で充電を10以上貯め、5コインのS3「空間切断」をコイン威力+4の状態: Use S2 and S1 to build at least 10 Charge, then unleash the 5-Coin S3 Rip Space with +4 Coin Power for both clash strength and damage.
messages.2コインのS2「双撃」でマッチを支え、強力な敵スキルには1コインの切り札S3「過: A Slash Identity that relies on the 2-Coin S2 Dual Strike for clashes and saves the single-Coin S3 Overbreathe to stop strong enemy skills. S3 gains a bonus at 10 or more Speed.
messages.釘を付与する他のN社人格と組み、パッシブで増える振動回数を供給しながら、S2「執: A durable Tremor Identity that works with other N Corp. Identities applying Nails. Her passive helps supply Tremor Count, and S2 Enactment! bursts Tremor.
messages.中指の味方と嫉妬の完全共鳴を作り、守備の反撃「倍返し」を攻撃レベルの高い「正義の: A Blunt Identity that forms Envy Absolute Resonance with Middle allies, converting her defense counter, Multifold Retribution, into the high-Offense-Level A Just Vengeance to retaliate for heavy damage.
messages.全攻撃スキルで破裂回数を補い、破裂編成の回数を維持しつつ、挑発値と自己回復で攻撃: An Identity that adds Rupture Count with every attack skill to sustain a Rupture team, while taking enemy attacks through Aggro and self-healing.
messages.自分で呼吸を貯めながら、クリティカルとパッシブで味方に呼吸を配る剣契のサポーター: A Blade Lineage support and attacker that builds her own Poise and shares it through critical hits and her passive. Allies without Poise receive priority, so surrounding her with allies that use Poise makes the distribution more effective.
messages.守備で「時間貸与」を得て、クイックとマッチ威力増加で序盤からマッチを制するタンク: A tank that gains Borrow Time through defense and wins early clashes with Haste and Clash Power Up. Stack Tremor, then apply Time Moratorium with S3 to release stored damage as Sloth damage; Tremor - Chain also lowers the enemy's Clash Power.
messages.血鬼の味方と組んで戦場の出血ダメージを「血餐」に貯め、それを消耗して得た硬血15: Fight alongside Bloodfiends to accumulate Bleed damage dealt on the field as Bloodfeast. Spend it to gain at least 15 Hardblood and enhance S3 into Ascendant Sancho Hardblood Arts - La Sangre, then strike enemies with high Bleed for heavy damage.
messages.呼吸からクイックを得て速度差でスキルを強化し、序盤からマッチに強く出る貫通人格。: A Pierce Identity that gains Haste from Poise and enhances skills through Speed differences, giving her strong early clashes. Stack her pressure-point effect on the same enemy, then use the saved S3 Prithee, let this be an enlightening bout. She also works independently outside Burn teams.
messages.魔法少女形態で愛/憎悪とマジカル・アルカナを貯めて逆転形態に移り、マジカル・アル: Build Love/Hate and Magical Arcana in Magical Girl form to enter Reversed form. Then use Reversed form's S3 Reversed Beats / Reversed Arcana Slave, with Attack Weight increased by Magical Arcana and Hysteria, to sweep multiple enemies.
messages.破裂と沈潜が大量に付いた敵ほど火力が伸びる打撃人格。「鴻園の君主」ホンルの連携で: A Blunt Identity that deals more damage against enemies with large amounts of Rupture and Sinking. When brought out of standby by The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu's coordination, she can use S3 Crushing Horns [破碎角] with 3 Burgeoning of Horns [發角] already active.
messages.1ターン目に解禁-Ⅰまで進めて「開花E.G.O::代行」状態になり、攻撃レベルと: An Index Identity that reaches Unlock Ⅰ on turn 1 to enter Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration, then clashes at nearly full strength from turn 2 with increased Offense Level and Speed. Accumulating Poise raises her damage further.
messages.S3か守備で「保存神域」を張り、全味方にバリアを配って戦線を支える振動・充電人格: A Tremor and Charge Identity that creates Sanctum of Conservation with S3 or defense, giving all allies Shield to hold the line. Blessing of the Obsidian God also improves her own durability; at 100 Blessing, her defense becomes With Each Smite, I Sever Thine Advent! with 3 Attack Weight.
messages.S3「描き出す」を使うターンに自分の斬撃ダメージをまとめて底上げし、S3→S2「: A Slash attacker that boosts her Slash damage on the turn she uses S3 Brushstroke, ideally landing S3 before S2 Splatter. Her passive also increases damage taken, making her an offense-focused Identity.
messages.高いスキルレベルと大きな最大値でマッチに勝ちにいく斬撃人格。S3「スワッシュ」を: A Slash Identity that seeks clash wins through high skill levels and high maximum Power. Land S3 Swash after winning its clash to inflict 5 Slash Fragility and boost single-target damage next turn. Few Coins make her performance highly dependent on SP.
messages.出血回数を大きく増やして出血編成を支える人格。速度が低めなので、味方がマッチを取: An Identity that supports Bleed teams by adding substantial Bleed Count. Her relatively low Speed favors landing unopposed attacks after allies have taken the clashes, adding Count to those enemies.
messages.体力の減った敵をS3「何でも料理できるさ」で仕留める火力役。S2「しょ・が」は精: A damage dealer that finishes weakened enemies with S3 I Can Cook Anything. At high SP, S2 I.H. is her main tool for clashes and damage, while kills let her passive heal allies.
messages.充電を貯めながらS2「跳躍」を主力に戦い、充電が貯まったらS3「次・魔・空・切」: A Slash attacker that mainly uses S2 Leap while building Charge, then spends it on S3 D.D.E.D.R. for heavy damage. Much of her strength comes from Coin Power, so her performance varies greatly with SP.
messages.呼吸を貯めてクリティカルを出し、S3で弾丸を撃って振動と破裂をまとめて入れる人格: An Identity that builds Poise for critical hits, then fires ammunition with S3 to apply both Tremor and Rupture.
messages.敵の火傷が6以上・10以上になるとマッチ威力・コイン威力・ダメージ量が上がる火傷: A Burn attacker whose Clash Power, Coin Power, and damage improve at enemy Burn thresholds of 6 and 10. She cannot increase Burn Count herself and belongs with allies that sustain it.
messages.呼吸回数を貯めてから、加重値の上がったS2「応接道第七式 捕捉」で複数の敵をまと: A Slash attacker that builds Poise Count, then cuts through multiple enemies with increased-Attack-Weight S2 Receiving Arts 7: Capture. Critical hits against enemies marked with B.M. can deal greatly increased critical damage based on the Speed difference.
messages.S2「圧着ぜんまいスパナ」で自分の振動回数を敵に移し、S1「ねじの抜けた奴らめ」: S2 Compression Wind-up Spanner transfers her Tremor Count to the enemy, while S1 Got a Screw Loose? grants her Count based on the enemy's. Repeating this cycle supplies large amounts of Tremor Count.
messages.「赤眼」と「懺悔」でスキルを強化しながら戦い、通常のS3「ドタマを割る」で一気に: Fight with skills enhanced by Red Eyes and Penitence, use regular S3 Skullbuster to build both quickly, then unleash Serious Skullbuster when its conditions are met for heavy damage and ally healing. A self-sufficient Identity that performs consistently across teams.
messages.1ターン目の守備「脚力。解放。ふっ。」で「脚力【卯】」を得て速度10以上を狙いや: A Slash attacker that uses Strider. Unleashed. Heh on turn 1 to gain Strider【Mao】 and more easily reach 10 Speed. Reused S1 Blinkstep and a powerful S3 deal damage while sustaining Rupture Count; allies supply Rupture Potency.
messages.敵に「視線」を集めて「軽蔑」に変え、強化S3で一気に撃ち抜く出血・振動の人格。: A Bleed and Tremor Identity that gathers Gaze on enemies, converts it into Contempt, then fires enhanced S3 for a burst of damage.
messages.味方の攻撃に合わせて毎ターン「おい、下がれ」で追撃し、実質2回行動で火力を出す人: An Identity that follows up an ally's attack each turn with Hey, Back Off, effectively attacking twice. S3 Aiding Strike and defense's Protector's Stance build Poise to enhance every skill while also reducing damage taken.
messages.弾丸を撃ち切ったときの「止まらない物語」、混乱か精神力-40未満の敵への「ばぁん: A Sinking and Tremor Identity that adds damage beyond her selected skills through three follow-ups: Stories that Never Cease when ammunition runs out, Bang. Bang. against Staggered enemies or those below -40 SP, and Magnificent End at 30 Petals. Particularly suited to Sinking teams.
messages.守備「残像歩」で蜘蛛の巣所属の味方を自ら「天殺」で倒し、その死と引き換えに大きな: A Poise, Burn, and Bleed Identity whose full strength comes from using defense's Phantom Step [殘像步] to kill a House of Spiders ally with Slay the Heavens - Tiansha [天殺], gaining major bonuses in exchange. Requires multiple House of Spiders Identities to realize that potential.
messages.特殊充電「保存」とバリアで「コート」を育て、「アルミュール・エヴェイエ」に変えて: A Tremor Identity that develops her coat through the special Charge, Preservation, and Shield, then turns it into Armure Éveillée to go on the offensive.
messages.防御レベルが高く速度が遅い、攻撃を受け止めるタンク寄りの人格。振動は自分で積んで: A slow, tank-oriented Identity with high Defense Level. He can stack and burst Tremor himself, but his damage is modest.
messages.S3「練武崩拳」の火傷回数増加で火傷を長く保ち、火傷が6以上の敵を起点に周りへ火: An Identity for Liu Association Burn teams. S3 Perfected Death Fist extends Burn through Count increases, while enemies with at least 6 Burn serve as sources for spreading Burn to nearby enemies.
messages.充電を消耗して斬撃脆弱と防御レベル減少を入れる、斬撃のデバッファー。: A Slash debuffer that spends Charge to inflict Slash Fragility and Defense Level Down.
messages.S3「異端抹殺」で釘を入れてから、S2「罪を洗い流さん」で束縛と攻撃威力減少を重: A Nails tank whose main pattern is applying Nails with S3 Annihilate Heretics, then using S2 You Are Cleansed of Sin to add Bind and Attack Power Down and hinder enemy actions.
messages.全スキルで振動威力を付与する振動の供給役。振動回数は自分では増やせないため、振動: A Tremor applicator that inflicts Potency with every skill. He cannot increase Tremor Count himself, so he works in Tremor teams alongside allies that provide Count.
messages.充電回数を10以上貯めてS3「サイの突進」を撃ち、出血回数を一気に増やすのが本領: A durable Bleed enabler whose main payoff is building at least 10 Charge Count, then using S3 Rhino Ram to add a large amount of Bleed Count.
messages.中指編成で、S2の両隣への嫉妬強化と精神力の回復を担う支援役。サポートパッシブで: A Middle-team support that uses S2 to provide Envy buffs and SP recovery to adjacent allies. His support passive also restores SP from the bench, and that recovery is a major strength.
messages.S3「肉斬」でわざとマッチに負け、貯めた呼吸で特殊反撃「骨断」を撃つ(俗に「肉斬: The Blade Lineage leader's main payoff is deliberately losing the clash with S3 Yield My Flesh, then spending accumulated Poise on the special counter To Claim Their Bones. Maintain 3 Pride Resonance for Swordplay of the Homeland to strengthen all Blade Lineage allies.
messages.破裂編成で、マッチに強いスキルと攻撃レベル減少で敵の攻撃を受け止める「時間稼ぎ」: A Rupture-team tank that buys time through strong clashing skills and Offense Level Down. He struggles to sustain Rupture Count himself.
messages.スキルを「捨てる」味方に知識鍛錬を配り、捨てたときのバリアで味方の耐久を底上げす: A Blunt support tank that grants Erudition to allies using Discard and improves their durability with Shield when they discard skills. His own Sinking application is modest.
messages.呼吸を貯めてパッシブでクイックを得て、敵との速度差でスキルを強化する貫通アタッカ: A Pierce attacker that builds Poise, gains Haste through his passive, and enhances skills through Speed differences. In Rupture teams, he can attack without reducing the Rupture established by allies.
messages.早めに猛虎標弾へ切り替えて、天退星と破壊不能コイン、強化S3「超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬」: A Thumb Identity that wants to switch to Savage Tigermark Rounds early and attack through Tiantui Star [天退星], Unbreakable Coins, and enhanced S3 Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬]. Manage ammunition so the Overheat period after running dry does not coincide with the decisive phase of battle.
messages.色欲共鳴で「硬血甲冑」を減らさずに5まで保ち、強化S3「ウヴェルテューレ」を撃つ: Maintain 5 Hardblood Armor through Lust Resonance without losing it, then unleash enhanced S3 Ouvertüre. He also supports La Manchaland allies by sharing Armor and granting them Focused Performance.
messages.「胞子」で毎ターン火傷回数を増やし、火傷を途切れさせない火傷回数の供給役。S3「: A Burn Count supplier that adds Count every turn through Spore to keep Burn active. S3 Field Test - Dust Spark grows stronger when focused on a single target.
messages.「引き裂かれた色彩」を5以上積んだ敵に強化S3「野獣派-出品作展開」を当てる出血: A Bleed and Sinking Identity that lands enhanced S3 Le Fauvisme - Reveal Submission on enemies with at least 5 of Mauled Color. Designed to be paired with Ring Fauvist Docent Rodion, who applies that effect.
messages.沈潜と破裂を付与し、ダメージを受けなかったターンの次にS2・S3を強化する人格。: An Identity that inflicts Sinking and Rupture, enhancing S2 and S3 on the turn after taking no damage.
messages.出血回数が4未満の敵にS2「雲の切開」を当て、コインを倍に増やして大ダメージを出: A Slash attacker that doubles S2 Cloud Cutter's Coins against enemies with less than 4 Bleed Count for heavy damage. S3 Cloudburst also disrupts enemies through Paralyze.
messages.表面のコインで追加ダメージを出し、弱った敵を連続で仕留める人格。: An Identity that deals bonus damage on Heads Coins and chains kills against weakened enemies.
messages.火傷回数を増やして火傷編成を支える人格。サポートパッシブ「暖かいですよね？」で控: An Identity that supports Burn teams by adding Burn Count. His main role is usually on the bench, where Isn’t It Warm? increases allies' Burn Count application.
messages.「K社アンプル」の割合回復とバトルパッシブの大回復で倒れにくいタンク。守備とパッ: A durable tank sustained by K Corp Ampule's percentage healing and the combat passive's large heals. Defense and the passive share the Ampule cap, so managing that shared allowance defines his play pattern.
messages.充電を貯めて充電力場を自分と味方に配る、守りのサポーター。: A defensive support that builds Charge and provides Charge Barrier to himself and allies.
messages.クイックで速度を上げ、出血を付与しながら弱った敵を仕留める人格。: An Identity that raises Speed with Haste, applies Bleed, and finishes weakened enemies.
messages.S3を捨てて「探求した知識」を3にし、コインを再使用するS1「知識消耗」を主力に: A Slash attacker that discards S3 to reach 3 Insight, then relies on Coin reuse from S1 Expend Knowledge. Maintaining 3 Insight requires managing which discardable skills remain in his slots.
messages.S1・S2で自分の振動回数を10以上貯め、S3「犯人はあなたですね！」で振動-反: A Tremor team's finisher: build at least 10 of his own Tremor Count through S1 and S2, then use S3 You're the Culprit! to Entangle Tremor - Reverb and trigger Tremor Burst 3 times.
messages.破裂を大量に付与し、破裂の多い敵や血鬼・血袋の敵に強化された打撃を当てる人格。破: An Identity that inflicts large amounts of Rupture and deals enhanced Blunt damage against enemies with high Rupture or Bloodfiend/Bloodbag enemies. At 15 Rupture Potency and 3 Count or more, S2 and S3 stop applying Rupture, making Count maintenance a challenge.
messages.終止符事務所フィクサー(ヒースクリフ)と組んで、S2「ターゲット指定」・S3「人: A Pierce attacker that pairs with Full-Stop Office Fixer Heathcliff to add follow-ups and coordinated attacks to S2 Target Marked and S3 Full-Stop to Life. Designed around that partnership and much weaker without Heathcliff.
messages.S3「集中」で充電回数をまとめて得て、次にS2「精神の鞭」で10消耗する流れを繰: A Blunt attacker for longer fights. Repeatedly gain a large amount of Charge Count with S3 Concentration, then spend 10 with S2 Mind Whip to grow Charge Potency. As it develops, both S2 and S3 deal more damage.
messages.黒獣の味方に追加行動をさせる司令塔。S3で黒獣と3連撃を組み、守備で黒獣を入れ替: A commander that grants Heishou allies extra actions. S3 coordinates a three-hit sequence with Heishou allies, while defense swaps Heishou units and lets the incoming unit use S3 as well.
messages.生体材料(特殊充電)の威力を3まで育てて出血付与を強化し、マイナス効果を5種重ね: A Bleed attacker that grows the special Charge, Corpus Ingredient, to 3 Potency to improve Bleed application, then triggers S2's follow-up against enemies carrying 5 types of negative effect.
messages.敵1体に「捕縛」を掛けて追い詰め、呼吸と出血で仕留める人格。: An Identity that marks a single enemy with Trussed, then corners and finishes it through Poise and Bleed.
messages.同じ敵(部位)を殴り続けて「点穴 - ホンル」を3まで積み、各スキルのコイン再使: An Identity specialized for single targets. Keep attacking the same enemy or part to build 3 Nerve Strike - Hong Lu, then use Coin reuse on each skill to deliver Burn and damage.
messages.S2「撃ち落とす」を手元に来るたびに使って次のターンの攻撃威力増加とダメージ量増: A Blunt attacker that uses S2 Smackdown whenever it appears to gain Attack Power Up and Damage Up next turn, then overpowers clashes with Blunt S2 and S3.
messages.被弾と自傷で自分の体力をわざと低くし、強化されたS3「閃撃」(高い同期化段階では: An Identity that grows stronger at low HP. Deliberately lose HP through enemy hits and self-damage, then strike with enhanced S3 Flashing Strike; at higher Uptie, it gains area coverage below 50% HP.
messages.速度6以上で味方より先にS3「迅速制圧」を撃ち、そのターン中に効く脆弱を入れて、: A Pierce attacker built for short fights and spending all his ammunition. At 6 or more Speed, use S3 Quick Suppression before allies act to inflict Fragile for the current turn, then let the following attacks finish the enemy.
messages.S2「浄…化！」の加算コイン弱化で敵のコイン威力を下げ、味方のマッチを有利にする: A support-oriented Identity that lowers enemy Coin Power with S2 Puri…fy!'s Plus Coin Drop, helping allies win clashes. With at least 4 N Corp. Fanatics deployed, his own Coin Power also rises.
messages.S1でわざとマッチに負けて精神力を一気に下げ、低い精神力で主力のS2「泥濘踏み」: A negative-Coin Identity that deliberately loses clashes with S1 to rapidly lower SP, then uses the main S2 Puddle Stomp at low SP to deal heavy damage while consuming Sinking.
messages.相手の脆弱属性で攻撃するときに、破裂を何回にも分けて付与してパッシブの付与値+1: When attacking a weak resistance, apply Rupture in multiple instances so the passive's +1 application bonus applies each time. S2 The Wrap-up sustains Rupture Count, and S3 Forensics triggers the accumulated Rupture through 4 hits.
messages.挑発値で攻撃を受け、味方の被弾と自分の失った体力で強くなる出血の人格。: A Bleed Identity that draws attacks through Aggro and grows stronger as allies are hit and he loses HP.
messages.味方が付けた振動を足場に、振動の多い敵へ強化されたスキルでマッチと火力を受け持つ: A main attacker for Tremor teams, using allies' Tremor application to enhance his clashes and damage against high-Tremor enemies. His own Tremor application is modest.
messages.充電回数を消耗するたびに充電(威力)が育ち、戦闘が長引くほどスキルが強くなる充電: A Charge Identity whose Charge Potency grows whenever he spends Charge Count, strengthening his skills over longer battles. Photoelectricity also helps replenish allies' Charge Count.
messages.敵にとどめを刺して棺を集めるほど強くなり、デュラハン騎乗中に撃つ「悲嘆し、哀嘆し: A Sinking attacker that grows stronger by finishing enemies and gathering Coffins. While riding Dullahan, Lament, Mourn, and Despair and the area-enhanced Memorial Procession let him overpower groups.
messages.回避「戦闘呼吸」と「精密照準」で呼吸を一気に積み、S2「ヘッドショット」・S3「: A Pierce attacker that rapidly builds Poise through the evade Combat Poise and Precision Aim, then deals heavy critical damage with S2 Headshot and S3 Goin' for the Bullseye. S1 spends most of his ammunition, so managing it determines how long he stays on the field.
messages.S3「雷鳴斬り」で次のターンの強化を仕込み、その次のターンに守備「裏路地の掟」を: A Kurokumo Clan Slash Identity with strong Bleed application. His main pattern is using S3 Thundercleave to prepare next turn's bonuses, then using defense's Rules of the Backstreets with Coin reuse on that turn.
messages.バリアと防御レベル増加で非常に打たれ強い充電の人格。S2で充電回数を稼ぎ、守備「: A highly durable Charge Identity protected by Shield and Defense Level Up. Build Charge Count with S2, endure attacks and replenish Charge through CCA Overcharge, then unleash the main S3 Rip Space - CCA Overdrive at maximum enhancement.
messages.自分と敵に火傷を積みながら積極的にマッチして血闘本能を20まで貯め、自分の火傷を: A Burn and Rupture Slash attacker that stacks Burn on himself and enemies while actively clashing to build 20 Battleblood Instinct. With at least 20 Burn on himself, unleash enhanced S3 Rooster's Rampaging Blades Under the Ensanguined Heaven [血天下鷄舞亂刀].
messages.中指編成で嫉妬完全共鳴6を作り、守備「お返し」から「オレのヘアクーポォオオオン!: A Middle commander and attacker that forms 6 Envy Absolute Resonance in a Middle team, then uses Payback to counter with MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!! At 15 Vengeance Tattoo, unleash COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!
messages.同じ敵とマッチを重ねて決闘高潮を5まで積み、強化S3で振動-灼熱に変換して振動爆: A Burn and Tremor Identity that repeatedly clashes with the same enemy to build 5 The Duel Escalates, then uses enhanced S3 to convert Tremor to Tremor - Scorch and trigger repeated bursts. The resulting Maturing Textbook further strengthens the next cycle.
messages.速度の高さで先に動き、最大値の高い1コインスキルで敵の危険なスキルをマッチで止め: A guard tank that acts early through high Speed and stops dangerous enemy skills with high-maximum-Power single-Coin clashes. S3's Blunt Fragility also helps allies' Blunt attacks deal damage.
messages.強力な2コインのS1でマッチを取りながら充電を貯め、前のターンまでに必要数を貯め: Build Charge while clashing with a strong 2-Coin S1, then use the 4-Coin S3 Mind Whip after gathering enough Charge on previous turns to inflict Sinking and raise Stagger Thresholds. Manual control is essential because of the risk of friendly fire.
messages.体力50%未満でS2「閃撃」にコインが追加され、火力とマッチ力が大きく跳ね上がる: Below 50% HP, S2 Flashing Strike gains Coins and becomes much stronger in both clashes and damage. Deliberately lowering HP and repeatedly using enhanced S2 is her main pattern.
messages.S2「振動弾」で大量の振動を入れ、振動編成の味方の条件を一気に満たす供給役(準備: A supplier that uses S2 Quake Rounds to immediately apply large amounts of Tremor and fulfill allies' Tremor conditions without preparation. S3 Suppress's Rupture and 5 Fragile raise the damage of allies acting later that turn.
messages.挑発値で攻撃を集め、マッチに負けても振動と破裂を返すタンク。: A tank that draws attacks with Aggro and retaliates with Tremor and Rupture even after losing a clash.
messages.火傷編成で、高いマッチ力と火傷条件による強化で押す人格。速度の遅さを活かして味方: An Identity for Burn teams that combines strong clashes with bonuses from Burn conditions. Her low Speed lets allies apply Burn before she attacks, enabling those bonuses from turn 1.
messages.沈潜の威力と回数を両方とも大量に入れる、沈潜編成の中核となる貫通人格。守備「迅速: A core Pierce Identity for Sinking teams that applies large amounts of both Sinking Potency and Count. Defense's Nimble Steps has high Base Power, helping her evade even at low SP early in battle.
messages.S2「最後まで追跡するぞ！」で両隣の味方に攻撃レベル増加を配り、確率で操作パネル: A Pierce commander that grants Offense Level Up to adjacent allies with S2 Pursue Them to the End! and can order an Assist Attack from an ally to her right on the dashboard. More Resonance makes her stronger, and she generally wants to take the finishing blow herself.
messages.速度で敵を上回り、呼吸と沈潜で戦う人格。S3で束縛と斬撃脆弱を入れる。: An Identity that outpaces enemies and fights with Poise and Sinking. S3 inflicts Bind and Slash Fragility.
messages.自分の振動回数を防御レベル増加に変え、挑発値で攻撃を集めながら振動爆発で殴り返す: A tank that converts her Tremor Count into Defense Level Up, draws attacks with Aggro, and strikes back through Tremor Burst.
messages.出血とマイナス効果を積み、黒雲会の味方を強化しながらS3で出血を連続発動させる人: An Identity that stacks Bleed and negative effects, strengthens Kurokumo Clan allies, and repeatedly triggers Bleed with S3.
messages.攻撃レベルで上回る相手に破裂を厚く入れ、呼吸を貯めてS3「赤春」のクリティカルで: A Rupture and Poise Identity that applies heavy Rupture against enemies she surpasses in Offense Level, then builds Poise for a powerful critical S3 Crimson Spring. Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept Yi Sang helps cover her shortages in Poise and Power.
messages.最も左のスロットで同じスキルを連続して使い、組札を合わせ続けて光札を5まで貯め、: A Tremor and Sinking Identity that repeatedly uses the same skill in her leftmost slot to keep matching card combinations, building 5 Bright cards for maximum-Power Kōzan [光斬] follow-ups. Discard helps arrange the required hand.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6以上のとき、守備の反撃がS3「ヴァイオレット・ブレイク・スラム」に: A Middle Identity whose defense counter becomes S3 Violet~ Breaking Slam at 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance. Her core loop is taking hits to build The Middle - Grudge, then spending them on S3 counter to develop The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos.
messages.毎ターン傲慢共鳴3でドッケビの腕を得て、クイック3以上を保ちながらドッケビの火を: A Blade Lineage Poise attacker that gains Dokkaebi Arms each turn through 3 Pride Resonance. Maintain at least 3 Haste while building 15 Dokkaebi Fire to repeatedly trigger Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame. Deliberately losing defense clashes to use To Claim Their Bones is another main pattern.
messages.S2・S3の自傷で自分の体力を積極的に削り、体力が0になるダメージを受けた瞬間に: A Bleed Pierce attacker that aggressively loses HP through S2 and S3's self-damage. Upon taking otherwise lethal damage, she enters the Changing Room and returns in enhanced Full Makeover form. That transformed state is where she reaches full strength.
messages.出血を付与する味方と組み、出血6以上の敵にS3「処断」を当てて最後のコインの与ダ: A Bleed attacker that works with Bleed-applying allies, then lands S3 Slay against enemies with at least 6 Bleed to increase its final Coin's damage. On the bench, Gambler also raises allies' damage.
messages.出血を付与する味方と組んで敵の出血を6以上にし、呼吸を貯めた状態で1コインのS3: Work with allies to put at least 6 Bleed on an enemy, then build Poise and land a critical with single-Coin S3 Sky-clearing Cut to inflict 10 Bleed. At 5 or more Poise, her passive Dark Cloud Blade also turns her counter into Sky-clearing Cut.
messages.釘と出血を付与し、狂信やN社の仲間の数で火力が上がるN社の人格。: An N Corp. Identity that applies Nails and Bleed, gaining damage through Fanatic and the number of N Corp. allies.
messages.充電回数を3以上に保ってS2「振動圧着」のコインを再使用させ、最大4コイン・振動: A Tremor and Charge attacker that maintains at least 3 Charge Count to reuse S2 Vibration Compression's Coins, reaching up to 4 Coins, 12 Tremor application, and Tremor Burst. Alone, she normally alternates S1 for Charge with S2; suitable Tremor and Charge Gifts can let her use S2 repeatedly.
messages.呼吸回数をバリアに変え、挑発値で攻撃を集める守りの人格。: A defensive Identity that turns Poise Count into Shield and draws attacks with Aggro.
messages.4コインのS2・S3を主力として撃ち続け、その使用時効果でランクの低いスキル(主: A Blunt tank and attacker that repeatedly uses the 4-Coin S2 and S3, discarding lower-rank skills, mainly S1, through their On Use effects to gain Shield. Draw attacks with Aggro and convert damage taken into stronger Blunt damage next turn.
messages.主力のS2「炎手撃-燃」で火傷回数を積み、火傷を周囲の敵へ広げる火傷パーティの回: A Burn team's Count supplier that mainly uses S2 Fiery Knifehand-Combust to add Burn Count and spread Burn to nearby enemies. Allies build Potency, then she finishes a fully stacked target with S3 Pinpoint Blitz's Wrath damage.
messages.束縛で敵を遅らせ、振動で混乱区間を進め、時間貸与中は「時間猶予」でダメージを溜め: An Identity that slows enemies with Bind, raises Stagger Thresholds through Tremor, and makes enemies accumulate damage under Time Moratorium while Borrow Time is active.
messages.「デリバリーキャリア-ロージャ」を溜めるほどS2・S3の威力とダメージ量が大きく: A Slash attacker whose S2 and S3 gain substantial Power and damage as Courier Trunk - Rodion builds, while a large Shield helps her take attacks. Rupture teams enable her full strength early. In longer battles, defense also offers a way to retreat.
messages.S2「撒き散らし、磨り潰されよ」で戦闘開始時に自分と味方へ攻撃威力増加を配り、序: A Bleed and Rupture Pierce Identity that grants Attack Power Up to herself and allies at Combat Start with S2 In Finely Ground Mistfall, providing reliable early clashes. In Bleed teams, Bloodfeast develops Blooming Thorn, and longer battles can enable enhanced S3 Ascendant Don Quixote Hardblood Arts - The Finale.
messages.「巳腕」を得て呼吸を溜め、強化されたスキルのクリティカルで攻めるサイクルを回す、: A slow-starting Poise and Rupture Identity that gains Serpent Arm, builds Poise, and attacks through enhanced critical skills. Aim for 20 Poise, giving 100% critical chance, and maximum Coin Power on every skill.
messages.精神力0以上の「加護」(加算コインのタンク)と0未満の「絶望」(減算コインの沈潜: An Identity that actively switches through defense between Blessing at nonnegative SP, a positive-Coin tank, and Despair below 0 SP, a negative-Coin Sinking Pierce attacker. Choose the intended form in advance. For Despair, use defense early to sharply lower SP, then keep Tear-sharpened at 2 to maintain high damage and heavy Sinking application.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を貯め、S3「精神の鞭」で一気に放出する充電・沈潜の打撃人格: A Charge and Sinking Blunt Identity that builds Charge Count with S1 and S2, then spends it in one burst with S3 Mind Whip. Using S3 at 15 or more Count maximizes the damage bonus for spending beyond 10.
messages.引き裂かれた色彩[ルージュ]・[ブル]と「果敢なタッチ」の3種を敵に切らさず重ね: A Bleed-team amplifier and attacker that maintains both Mauled Color [Rouge] and Mauled Color [Bleu] plus Touche Hardie on enemies, increasing Bleed and Sinking damage by up to 20%. More types of negative effect enhance every skill and turn defense into the powerful Critique.
messages.「予知眼」で攻撃を読み、それが尽きると強化技「処分」で火傷と振動を叩き込む親指の: A Thumb master that reads attacks with The Eye of Precognition, then unleashes enhanced Disposal for Burn and Tremor when it runs out.
messages.S1「ルトゥーシュ(Retouche)」を味方に使い、戦闘開始時に充電回数・攻撃: A buffer for Charge Identities that uses S1 Retouche on allies to provide Charge Count, Offense Level Up, Shield, and other bonuses at Combat Start. This tank-oriented Tremor and Charge Identity also shares Shield through S2, S3, and defense, taking dangerous attacks with reliable clashes.
messages.マッチに勝って火力を上げ、破裂を付与する斬撃のアタッカー。: A Slash attacker that wins clashes to increase damage and applies Rupture.
messages.呼吸回数を10以上溜めてから、1コインのS3「骨断」で大きなクリティカルと麻痺5: A Poise Identity that builds at least 10 Poise Count, then aims for a large critical hit and 5 Paralyze with single-Coin S3 To Claim Their Bones. Weak alone; designed for a Blade Lineage team with support from Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault or Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀].
messages.速度の低さを活かして一方攻撃を引き受け、S2「制圧」の次ターンのダメージ量減少と: A tank that uses low Speed to take unopposed attacks and protects allies with S2 Suppress's Damage Down and Protection for the next turn.
messages.高い体力・防御レベルと強力な守備「回避」で敵の攻撃を透かす回避タンク。マッチはS: An evade tank with high HP, high Defense Level, and a strong Evade. Take clashes with S3 Pañata Party, while landing S1 and S2 unopposed to apply Sinking.
messages.全スキルが減算コイン(コイン威力がマイナス)の打撃アタッカー。スキルを使うたびに: A Blunt attacker whose skills all have negative Coin Power. Skills lower his SP, making Tails more likely and preserving high Power. His main attack is S3 Self-destructive Purge, with 30 Base Power and 3 Coins.
messages.自分のお札を5まで溜め、S3「破裂符」で敵にお札5を押し付けて、敵が攻撃を受ける: Build 5 Talismans on himself, then use S3 Rupturing Talisman to transfer 5 to the enemy, causing Rupture application whenever that enemy is hit. Talismans consume Rupture Count quickly, so allies that supply Count are essential.
messages.S2「落ち着いて…」で自分の振動回数を溜め、10以上になったらS3「ギャンブラー: A Tremor Count supplier that builds his own Count through S2 Steady..., then transfers it all to the enemy with S3 Gamble at 10 or more. He can barely trigger enemy Tremor Bursts himself and needs allies that excel at bursting.
messages.高い速度で敵との速度差を作り、速度差で全攻撃スキルを強化して戦う自己完結型の貫通: A self-sufficient Pierce attacker that uses high Speed to create Speed differences and enhance all his attack skills. S2 Engagement is his main attack.
messages.精神力を40以上にして「不安定E.G.O::蜜蝋の翼」に変身し、広域化するS2「: Reach at least 40 SP to transform into Volatile E.G.O::Waxen Pinion, then apply heavy Burn with the area-enhanced S2 Sunset Blade and Blazing Strike. Deploying him alongside Dawn Office Fixer Faust and Dawn Office Rep Gregor is close to essential.
messages.自分の振動回数を防御レベル増加に変え、味方にも防御レベル増加を配る守りの人格。: A defensive Identity that converts his Tremor Count into Defense Level Up and also grants Defense Level Up to allies.
messages.デリバリーキャリアを溜めてコイン威力と破裂回数の付与を伸ばす、打撃の破裂人格。破: A Blunt Rupture Identity that builds Courier Trunk to improve Coin Power and Rupture Count application. Finish enemies with at least 15 Rupture and 3 Count using S3 Poludnitsa... I trust you! Avoid using S1 or S2 on enemies in that state.
messages.被弾で敵に復讐対象を付け、攻撃・反撃で回収して仕返し帳簿を溜める中指の打撃人格。: A Middle Blunt Identity that marks enemies for vengeance when hit, then collects those marks through attacks and counters to build The Book of Vengeance. His main payoff is reaching a total Envy Absolute Resonance count of at least 6, turning defense into an S3 Write 'em all down counter that takes hits and collects marks together.
messages.特殊弾丸「灼熱推進弾」で火傷と振動を重ね、S3で振動爆発を重ねる親指の人格。味方: A Thumb Identity that applies Burn and Tremor through special Scorch Propellant Ammo, then triggers repeated Tremor Bursts with S3. He can also replenish allies' ammunition.
messages.血炎でS2のコイン再使用とS3の破壊不能化を引き出し、火傷と破裂を重ねる斬撃アタ: A Slash attacker that uses Bloodflame [血炎] to enable S2 Coin reuse and Unbreakable Coins on S3, stacking Burn and Rupture. Suited to The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu teams that swap him out of standby with other Heishou Identities, since leaving standby or returning grants 3 Bloodflame [血炎].
messages.序盤は守備「守」を連打して呼吸を溜め、25を超えた呼吸威力を月下青刀に変えてから: A Poise Identity for longer battles. Repeatedly use defense's Defend [守] early to build Poise, convert Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade, then fight with critical Coin reuse from S2 Nameless Slash [無名斬] and S3 Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺].
messages.幼年期状態ではS1・S2で味方を回復・強化しながら「絶え間ない飢え」を溜め、「ラ: In Childhood, build Relentless Hunger while S1 and S2 heal and buff allies. Equip La Voracité to awaken Noble Dignity, then go on the offensive through Bleed and L'Abject. The usual pattern is roughly 3 turns supporting in Childhood before transitioning to Noble Dignity.
messages.3コインのS1「抜剣」を主力にマッチを取り、速度で上回る相手にはS2、体力の多い: A fragile, offense-focused Identity that mainly clashes with her 3-Coin S1 Draw of the Sword. Use S2 against slower enemies and S3 against enemies with high HP.
messages.S2「刺法」で次のターンの斬撃ダメージ量増加を得て、斬撃のS3「腰撃勢」で体力の: Use S2 Acupuncture to gain Slash Damage Up next turn, then finish weakened enemies with Slash S3 Decisive Dive. On the bench, Double Tap supports allies landing finishing blows.
messages.速度が最も低い味方を支援し、沈潜と攻撃威力減少を入れる指揮官。: A commander that supports the slowest ally while inflicting Sinking and Attack Power Down.
messages.マッチ相手の威力を下げ、破裂・防御レベル減少・弱点分析で敵を崩す人格。: An Identity that lowers her clash opponent's Power and breaks enemies down through Rupture, Defense Level Down, and Weakness Analyzed.
messages.S2や守備でS1「待て！」を捨ててパネルを入れ替え、ランクの高いS2「引き裂く」: Use S2 or defense to discard S1 Wait Up! and cycle the dashboard, repeatedly using the higher-rank S2 Slice and S3 Daring Decision. She triggers many Tremor Bursts but relies on allies to apply the enemy's Tremor.
messages.攻撃スキルの挑発値で敵の攻撃を引き寄せ、スキルレベルの高い回避「ルトレット」でか: An evade tank that draws attacks through Aggro on her attack skills, then repeatedly avoids them with the high-skill-level Retraite. S2 Punition is her main attack.
messages.火傷を積める味方と組み、特殊火傷「黒炎」で防御レベルを下げつつ(黒炎×火傷)の傲: Pair with Burn-applying allies, then use special Burn Dark Flame to lower Defense Level and add Pride damage equal to Dark Flame × Burn. Build roughly 3–4 Magic Bullets, then use S3 Magic Bullet Fire to shoot multiple enemies together.
messages.沈潜編成で、S3で付けた「邸宅の木霊」によって以後の沈潜付与のたびに確率で沈潜回: A Sinking attacker that applies Echoes of the Manor with S3, giving subsequent Sinking applications a chance to increase Count, then overpowers clashes against enemies below 0 SP.
messages.マイナス効果の多い敵にS2「血描画」を当て、確率のコイン再使用で出血回数を一気に: A Ring Identity that uses S2 Sanguine Painting against enemies with many negative effects, rapidly adding Bleed Count through probabilistic Coin reuse. Prepares enemies for allies that rely on Bleed Count in Ring or Bleed teams.
messages.充電回数6を消耗するS2「充電跳躍」で自分と味方2名に充電力場を配り、充電編成全: A W Corp. buffer that spends 6 Charge Count on S2 Charged Leap to grant Charge Barrier to herself and 2 allies, improving the whole Charge team's Shield and Charge supply. Slow to start and better suited to longer fights.
messages.血餐を消耗して「血染めの鋏の刃」を育て、「裁縫対象」を付けた敵を出血で切り刻むラ: La Manchaland's barber spends Bloodfeast to develop Blood-tinged Scissorblades, then cuts up enemies marked as Sewing Target through Bleed.
messages.速度で敵を上回り、破裂と「呪殺【迅速】」で削る黒獣の速攻の人格。: A fast Heishou Identity that outpaces enemies and wears them down with Rupture and Deathrite【Haste】.
messages.守備「時間貸与 - 共振」で時間貸与を切らさず、クイックとマッチ威力増加を得て序: A Tremor Identity that keeps Borrowed Time active through Borrowed Time - Microcavity, gaining Haste and Clash Power Up for strong early clashes. S2's Amplitude Conversion and S3's Time Moratorium weaken enemies while sustaining Tremor Count.
messages.「ウアジェトの目[先鋒]」を切らさずに保ち、敵コインの表面確率を下げながら、強化: Maintain The Udjat [Vanguard] to lower enemy Coins' Heads chance while enhanced S2 and S3 win clashes from turn 1. Aggro and Protection also let her shield allies.
messages.中指編成で嫉妬完全共鳴6を保ち、守備「ルール違反」の反撃を「怨念スタンピング」に: A Middle master that maintains 6 Envy Absolute Resonance in a Middle team, transforms Rule Violation's counter into Stamp of Vengeance while unlocking her sword, then crushes enemies with Lævateinn's exclusive skill.
messages.癖のないスキルで扱いやすい初期人格。状態異常は単独ではほとんど活きず、本領は編成: An easy-to-use starting Identity with straightforward skills. His status effects do little alone; his main role is often on the bench, where Gene Code G-0 provides healing every turn.
messages.火傷編成で、他の人格が保つ火傷回数の上に多コインで火傷威力を積み、対象の火傷6以: A Blunt Identity for Burn teams that stacks Burn Potency through multiple Coins while allies maintain Count, then gains bonuses against targets with at least 6 Burn. On the bench, Rushing Heart also improves allies' damage.
messages.全スキルの与ダメージ吸血で長期戦をしぶとく耐える人格。マッチは1コインのS2「四: An Identity that endures long battles through damage-based lifesteal on every skill. Use single-Coin S2 Dismember for clashes. Another strength is supplying almost all the resources for his own Legerdemain E.G.O.
messages.マッチは弱いので自分は一方攻撃に回り、麻痺や束縛を入れて味方のマッチを助ける支援: A support with weak clashes that prefers unopposed attacks, applying Paralyze and Bind to help allies clash. In dungeons, Culinary Aid's bench healing is his main attraction.
messages.振動回数を伸ばしてから破裂を大量に付与し、充電を破裂回数に変える人格。: An Identity that builds Tremor Count before applying heavy Rupture, then converts Charge into Rupture Count.
messages.出血のある敵への表面的中で「不当収益」を最大4まで貯め、S3「予定された決裂」の: A Pierce attacker built around a single burst. Heads hits against Bleeding enemies build up to 4 Unjust Enrichment, which Coin Ⅱ of S3 Foregone Conclusion releases while spending ammunition. This slow starter performs best in dungeons or teams with several allies maintaining Bleed.
messages.出血の付与は他の人格に任せ、S2・S3で攻撃レベル減少を入れるデバッファー。対象: A debuffer that leaves Bleed application to allies and inflicts Offense Level Down with S2 and S3. At enemy Bleed thresholds of 7 and 10, he can leave Offense Level Down, Attack Power Down, and Plus Coin Drop for the next turn to help allies clash.
messages.沈潜と沈潜回数を積み、S3で沈潜を吸収して次のターンの火力に変える人格。: An Identity that stacks Sinking Potency and Count, then absorbs Sinking through S3 to boost next turn's damage.
messages.自傷の出血で「血餐」を供給しながら、減った体力と貯めた「血に染まった手」を元手に: An unconventional tank that supplies Bloodfeast through self-inflicted Bleed, then converts lost HP and accumulated Bloodied Hand into both heavy damage and healing with S3 The Unforgivable Sin. Best suited to Focused Encounters supporting Bloodfiend allies that consume Bloodfeast.
messages.「12区産燃料」を使い込み、50以下の「過熱燃料」状態で火力を上げ、尽きる前に守: A Burn attacker that spends District 12 Fuel, gains damage while in the Overheated Fuel state at 50 or less, and uses defense to refill to 100 before running dry. His heavy Burn Count application also makes him a Count-maintenance option for Burn teams.
messages.「巳腕」で呼吸を一気に貯め、呼吸20前後まで育ててから、強化されたスキル、特に1: A slow starter that rapidly builds Poise through Serpent Arm, aims for around 20 Poise, then strikes with enhanced skills, especially single-Coin S3 Serpentshear Puncturing Arm. Attacking enemies with Rupture accelerates Poise generation, so Rupture-applying allies speed up his start.
messages.出血・振動と「傷」を重ね、弱った敵に処刑技「メルチェ」でとどめを刺す人格。: An Identity that stacks Bleed, Tremor, and Open Wound, then finishes weakened enemies with the execution skill Mercé.
messages.守備で「ランプ」を8にして敵に「眩惑」を付け、眩惑のある敵をS3「灯りに眩惑され: A Sinking and Burn Identity that uses defense to reach 8 Lamp, applies Dazzle, then attacks dazzled enemies with S3 Salvation for those Enchanted by the Lamp. His greatest strength is repeatedly maintaining Dazzle on a boss in Focused Encounters for both increased damage taken and skill enhancements. Requires a team that sustains Burn or Sinking.
messages.高い速度で「光電」を撒き、パッシブ「前へ出たまえ。サポートするとしよう。」で編成: A Charge supplier that spreads Photoelectricity at high Speed and uses Take the Lead. I'll Provide You Support. to distribute Charge Count to allies earlier in deployment order. At 3 or more Charge, enhanced S3 Maximum Output - Ultra High-voltage Current Discharge inflicts Rupture and Charged Sting to raise the Charge team's damage.
messages.「暁の火」を30まで貯めて強化S3「明け方」を撃ち、全味方に「夜明け迎え」3を配: A Burn and Tremor Identity that builds 30 Light of Daybreak for enhanced S3 Crack of Dawn, granting 3 Dawnherald to all allies. Dawnherald accelerates Light of Daybreak generation, potentially enabling Crack of Dawn every 3–4 turns and maintaining the buff. Deploying all 3 Dawn Office members completes the passive coordination.
messages.編成の要。S1〜S3のすべてで火傷回数を増やし、ほぼ単独で火傷を維持できる。火傷: The team's anchor. Every skill from S1 to S3 increases Burn Count, letting him sustain Burn almost single-handedly. Higher enemy Burn also raises his Coin Power.
messages.敵の火傷でコイン威力が上がり、自分の火傷でも火力が伸びる。体力0になる一撃を1回: Enemy Burn raises his Coin Power, while his own Burn also improves damage. Can survive an otherwise lethal hit once.
messages.S1〜S3で火傷を付与し、火傷と振動の合計でコイン威力が上がる。パッシブでメイン: Applies Burn with S1–S3 and gains Coin Power from the combined Burn and Tremor total. His passive raises damage based on the main target's Burn.
messages.S2・S3で火傷を付与し、火傷と出血の合計で威力が上がる。S3「空間斬」は合計に: S2 and S3 apply Burn, with Power bonuses based on the combined Burn and Bleed total. S3 Rend Space [空間斬] gains up to +5 Base Power from that total.
messages.S1〜S3がすべて火傷を付与し、パッシブで味方の精神力を支える。S3は火傷回数を: All of S1–S3 apply Burn, while his passive supports allies' SP. S3 reduces Burn Count by 2, making him easier to replace than other priority picks.
messages.傲慢共鳴3で「本国剣術」を発動し、剣契の味方に呼吸と威力強化を配る。単独でも「肉: Activate Swordplay of the Homeland with 3 Pride Resonance to give Blade Lineage allies Poise and Power bonuses. Even alone, losing with Yield My Flesh to use To Claim Their Bones is powerful.
messages.毎ターン傲慢共鳴3とクイックを保ち、追撃「相戦清潾火」を繰り返す呼吸アタッカー。: A Poise attacker that maintains 3 Pride Resonance and Haste each turn to repeatedly trigger Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame. Pairing her with the Blade Lineage Mentor improves her Poise performance and Offense Level.
messages.毎ターンの指令を遂行して加護を貯め、1ターン目から威力と精神力を得る。胸痛を撃つ: Fulfill each turn's Prescript to build Grace of the Prescript and gain Power and SP from turn 1. Her resource affinities also suit a Faust using Thoracalgia.
messages.指令に従って代行を9まで溜め、S3「Furioso-Replica」を撃つ。人差: Follow Prescripts to build 9 Procuration, then use S3 Furioso-Replica. Durable for an Index Identity and exceptionally strong in long fights.
messages.代行状態でスキルが入れ替わり、攻撃レベルと速度が上がる。呼吸が貯まるほど火力が伸: Her Procuration state replaces her skills and raises Offense Level and Speed. More Poise means greater damage.
messages.25を超えた呼吸威力を月下青刀に変え、バリアとクリティカルを得る。長期戦に強く、: Convert Poise Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade for Shield and critical hits. Strong in long fights, weak in short ones.
messages.単体でも強い呼吸人格で、蜘蛛の巣所属の味方を天殺で倒すとさらに大きく強化される。: A strong Poise Identity even alone, with much greater bonuses after killing a House of Spiders ally with Slay the Heavens - Tiansha [天殺].
messages.精神力0以上の「加護」(タンク)と0未満の「絶望」(沈潜・貫通アタッカー)を守備: Uses defense to switch between Blessing, a tank at 0 SP or higher, and Despair, a Sinking Pierce attacker below 0 SP. A team centerpiece with top-tier Sinking application and physical damage.
messages.指令に従って代行を9まで溜め、S3「Furioso-Replica」を撃つ。耐久: Follow Prescripts to build 9 Procuration, then use S3 Furioso-Replica. Durable and strong in long battles.
messages.弾切れ・混乱した敵・花びら30で発動する3種の追撃で、手元のスキルとは別にダメー: Three follow-ups triggered by empty ammunition, Staggered enemies, and 30 Petals add damage beyond her selected skills. Their accessible triggers also make her useful in Regular Encounters.
messages.最も左のスロットで同じスキルを使い続けて光札を貯め、追撃「光斬」を最大威力で放つ: Keep using the same skill in her leftmost slot to gather Bright cards, then unleash maximum-Power Kōzan [光斬] follow-ups. Discard helps arrange the required hand.
messages.守備で時間貸与を切らさず、クイックとマッチ威力増加で序盤からマッチを取る中核。S: A core pick that maintains Borrowed Time through defense and wins early clashes with Haste and Clash Power Up. S2 converts Tremor to Tremor - Chain to lower enemy Clash Power while also sustaining Tremor Count.
messages.時間貸与で序盤からマッチを制するタンク。S3の時間猶予で溜めたダメージを怠惰ダメ: A tank that controls early clashes through Borrowed Time. S3's Time Moratorium releases accumulated damage as Sloth damage, while Tremor - Chain lowers enemy Clash Power.
messages.予知眼で攻撃をいなし、尽きると強化技「処分」で火傷と振動を叩き込む。振動-灼熱を: Handles attacks with The Eye of Precognition, then inflicts Burn and Tremor through enhanced Disposal when it runs out. Combines survivability with damage involving Tremor - Scorch.
messages.同じ敵とマッチを重ねて決闘高潮を積み、強化S3で振動-灼熱の振動爆発を重ねる。集: Repeatedly clash with the same enemy to build The Duel Escalates, then use enhanced S3 for repeated Tremor - Scorch bursts. Particularly strong in Focused Encounters.
messages.猛虎標弾で破壊不能コインと強化S3を押し出し、振動-灼熱の振動爆発を起こす。弾切: Uses Savage Tigermark Rounds for Unbreakable Coins and enhanced S3, triggering Tremor - Scorch bursts. Avoid having his post-ammunition Overheat overlap the decisive phase.
messages.高い速度で光電を撒き、パッシブで編成順が前の味方へ充電回数を配る、随一の充電供給: An outstanding Charge supplier that spreads Photoelectricity at high Speed and gives Charge Count to earlier allies through his passive. Place him fourth, or third, in deployment order.
messages.精神力に応じて加算コインと減算コインを切り替え、逆転形態の広域S3で敵をまとめて: Switches between positive and negative Coins based on SP, then sweeps groups with Reversed form's area S3. Prioritize activating her passive immediately after AEDD Gregor's.
messages.バリアと防御レベル増加で非常に打たれ強い。守備で耐えつつ充電を補い、主力のS3を: Highly durable through Shield and Defense Level Up. Endure through defense while replenishing Charge, then use his main S3 at maximum enhancement.
messages.充電人格、特にW社の味方を強化するバッファー。充電力場を配り、充電編成の潤滑油に: A buffer for Charge Identities, especially W Corp. allies. Sharing Charge Barrier helps the whole team's cycle run smoothly.
messages.生体材料(特殊充電)を育てて出血付与を強化し、マイナス効果を5種重ねた敵にS2の: Develop Corpus Ingredient, a special Charge, to improve Bleed application, then trigger S2's follow-up against enemies with 5 types of negative effect. Area S3 also handles groups.
messages.アイアンメイデンと、ほぼ全スキルの出血回数増加で敵の出血回数を維持する。薬指が5: Maintains enemy Bleed Count through Iron Maiden and Count increases on almost every skill. With at least 5 Ring members, she starts at 10 Corpus Ingredient for a stronger opening.
messages.敵のマイナス効果の数で火力が伸びる貫通アタッカー。S2のコイン再使用の連鎖が主力: A Pierce attacker whose damage rises with the number of enemy negative effects. S2's chain of Coin reuse is his main attack, making him a near-priority pick even in Bleed teams outside the Ring.
messages.引き裂かれた色彩と果敢なタッチを重ね、出血・沈潜のダメージを最大+20%に引き上: An amplifier and attacker that stacks Mauled Color and Touche Hardie to increase Bleed and Sinking damage by up to 20%.
messages.血鬼の味方と組んで出血ダメージを血餐に貯め、硬血15以上でS3を強化する。長期戦: Fight with Bloodfiend allies to gather Bleed damage as Bloodfeast, then enhance S3 at 15 or more Hardblood. Reaches full strength in longer fights.
messages.黒獣に追加行動させる司令塔。S3で黒獣と3連撃を組み、守備で消耗した黒獣を退却さ: A commander that grants Heishou extra actions. S3 coordinates a three-hit sequence with Heishou allies; defense retreats a spent Heishou and lets the incoming one use S3. Among the frailest Identities, but has an effect that lets him survive lethal damage.
messages.毎ターン守備で援護防御を発動させ、強化S3を撃ち続ける「奥義ループ」が本領。単体: Her core technique loop uses defense each turn to trigger Assist Defense and repeatedly unleash enhanced S3. Strong alone and essential alongside the Lord.
messages.脚力【午】を切らさずにマッチを取り、敵陣走破を溜めてバリアと火力を得るタンク兼ア: A tank and attacker that maintains Strider【Wu】 for clashes and builds Linebreaker for Shield and damage.
messages.守備で脚力【卯】を得て速度10以上を狙い、S1の再使用とS3で破裂回数を維持しな: Gain Strider【Mao】 through defense to aim for at least 10 Speed, then use S1 reuse and S3 to deal damage while sustaining Rupture Count.
messages.速度で敵を上回り、破裂と呪殺【迅速】で削る速攻の人格。君主との連携で一方攻撃時に: A fast Identity that outpaces enemies and deals damage through Rupture and Deathrite【Haste】. Coordination with the Lord increases Rupture Count on unopposed attacks.
messages.破裂・呼吸の貫通アタッカー。対象の破裂が15・回数3以上なら破裂回数を減らさずに: A Pierce attacker using Rupture and Poise. Against targets with at least 15 Rupture Potency and 3 Count, he attacks without reducing Count, maintaining allies' setup while dealing damage. His many Coins trigger Rupture repeatedly.
messages.デリバリーキャリアを溜めるほどS2・S3が大きく伸びる斬撃アタッカー。破裂6ごと: A near-essential Slash attacker for Rupture teams: Courier Trunk greatly strengthens S2 and S3, and every 6 Rupture also raises Coin Power, enabling full strength early. In long battles, defense offers a way to retreat.

messages.編成例の優先枠: Priority picks from the team build
messages.剣契頭目ムルソーが傲慢共鳴3で「本国剣術」を発動し、剣契の味方に呼吸と威力強化を: Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault activates Swordplay of the Homeland with 3 Pride Resonance, giving Blade Lineage allies Poise and Power bonuses. Use at least 3 Pride skills each turn and maintain Drink to the Fallen through Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀].
messages.傲慢共鳴3で剣契の味方に呼吸を配り、「肉斬」で負けて「骨断」を撃つ中核。: The core unit: grants Blade Lineage allies Poise through 3 Pride Resonance and loses with Yield My Flesh to use To Claim Their Bones.
messages.傲慢共鳴3とクイックを保ち、追撃「相戦清潾火」を繰り返す。: Maintain 3 Pride Resonance and Haste to repeatedly trigger Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame.
messages.マッチに勝つたびに呼吸が積み上がる、剣契殺手で最も強くなる人格。: Builds Poise with each clash win and gains the most among the Blade Lineage Salsu.
messages.紅梅で斬撃脆弱を入れる。剣契で不足しがちな怠惰・憂鬱を出せる。: Inflicts Slash Fragility through Red Plum Blossom. Supplies Sloth and Gloom, which Blade Lineage often lacks.
messages.呼吸のない味方へ呼吸を配る。速度が高く先に動ける。: Shares Poise with allies that lack it. High Speed lets her act early.
messages.傲慢の守備で呼吸を貯め、月下青刀のバリアで固くなる。: Builds Poise through Pride defense and gains durability from Moonlit Azure Blade's Shield.
messages.傲慢・斬撃が主体の呼吸人格で、剣契と並べて動かしやすい。: A Poise Identity focused on Pride and Slash, easy to use alongside Blade Lineage.
messages.剣契頭目に持たせ、追慕酒で剣契の味方を強化する中核。: Equip on the Blade Lineage Mentor: Drink to the Fallen makes this the core E.G.O for strengthening Blade Lineage allies.
messages.全味方に呼吸を配り、毎ターン回復する。: Gives all allies Poise and heals every turn.
messages.使うたびに強化され、呼吸で伸びる広域。: An area attack that grows stronger with each use and benefits from Poise.
messages.序盤に精神力の低い味方を回復する。: Restores low-SP allies early in battle.
messages.人差し指の3人で立ち上がりを早め、蜘蛛の巣所属を3人そろえて刀良秀の天殺を活かす: The 3 Index members accelerate the opening, while 3 House of Spiders members enable Blade Ryōshū's Tiansha. The Blade Lineage Mentor's Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones is strong even alone, and his Blade Lineage coordination with LCD Ishmael remains available.
messages.指令を遂行して加護を貯め、1ターン目から威力と精神力を得る。: Fulfills Prescripts to build Grace, gaining Power and SP from turn 1.
messages.代行を9まで溜めてS3を撃つ。耐久もあり長期戦に強い。: Builds 9 Procuration for S3. Durable and strong in long battles.
messages.1ターン目に代行状態になり、2ターン目から全力でマッチする。: Enters Procuration on turn 1 and clashes at full strength from turn 2.
messages.呼吸を溜めて月下青刀のバリアと火力を得る蜘蛛の巣の人格。: A House of Spiders Identity that builds Poise for Moonlit Azure Blade's Shield and damage.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の味方を天殺して大きく強化される火力役。: A damage dealer that gains major bonuses by using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally.
messages.「肉斬」でわざと負け、呼吸で伸びる「骨断」を撃つ。: Deliberately lose with Yield My Flesh to unleash To Claim Their Bones, enhanced by Poise.
messages.剣契頭目と並べると呼吸性能と攻撃レベルが上がる。: Gains better Poise performance and Offense Level alongside the Blade Lineage Mentor.
messages.剣契頭目に持たせ、追慕酒で耐久と火力を得る。: Equip on the Blade Lineage Mentor for durability and damage through Drink to the Fallen.
messages.剣契頭目の「本国剣術」は傲慢共鳴3で発動し、剣契の味方に呼吸と威力強化を配る。《: The Mentor's Swordplay of the Homeland activates at 3 Pride Resonance, granting Blade Lineage allies Poise and Power bonuses. Giving him Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀] greatly strengthens the whole group. Resources lean toward Wrath and Pride, so add units that supply Sloth and Gluttony.
messages.呼吸を配り、剣契の味方を強化する中核。: The core unit that distributes Poise and strengthens Blade Lineage allies.
messages.剣契として呼吸と攻撃レベルが上がり、追撃で火力を出す。: Gains Poise and Offense Level as a Blade Lineage member, then deals damage through follow-ups.
messages.剣契頭目の補助で、剣契殺手の中で最も強くなる。: Gains the most among the Blade Lineage Salsu from the Mentor's support.
messages.怠惰・憂鬱を出し、紅梅で斬撃脆弱を入れる。: Supplies Sloth and Gloom and inflicts Slash Fragility through Red Plum Blossom.
messages.味方に呼吸を配るサポーター兼アタッカー。: A support and attacker that distributes Poise to allies.
messages.同じ指令の仕組みを持つ3人で、1ターン目から威力と精神力を得て立ち上がりが早い。: All 3 share the Prescript system, gaining Power and SP from turn 1 for a fast opening.
messages.加護で攻撃レベルとS3を強化する。: Grace enhances Offense Level and S3.
messages.刀良秀は単体でも強いが、蜘蛛の巣所属の味方を天殺するとさらに強くなる。蜘蛛の巣の: Blade Ryōshū is strong alone, but becomes stronger after using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally. These 3 form the House of Spiders package.
messages.蜘蛛の巣所属で、長期戦の軸になる。: A House of Spiders member that anchors longer fights.
messages.蜘蛛の巣所属で、バリアで自分を固める。: A House of Spiders member that protects himself with Shield.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の味方を天殺して強化を得る。: Gains bonuses by using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally.
messages.鴻園の君主は黒獣と組んで初めて真価を発揮する。黒獣-巳の2人に加え、呼吸人格では: The Lord of Hongyuan reaches full strength alongside Heishou. In addition to the 2 Si Branch members, Mao Branch Adept also pairs well with him despite lacking the Poise keyword. The Lord is extremely fragile, so avoid losing clashes.
messages.S3で黒獣と連携し、守備で黒獣を入れ替える司令塔。: A commander that coordinates with Heishou through S3 and swaps them through defense.
messages.巳腕で呼吸を溜め、広域のS3で攻めるスロースターター。: A slow starter that builds Poise through Serpent Arm and attacks with area S3.
messages.巳腕で呼吸を溜め、1コインのS3で貫くスロースターター。: A slow starter that builds Poise through Serpent Arm and strikes with a single-Coin S3.
messages.呼吸人格ではないが、黒獣として君主の追加行動と入れ替えの恩恵を受けられる。ファウ: Lacks the Poise keyword, but benefits from the Lord's extra actions and swaps as a Heishou. As Faust, she can also use Thoracalgia.
messages.捕縛を掛けた敵を呼吸と出血で仕留める。傲慢・斬撃が主体で、剣契組と動かしやすい。: Finishes Trussed enemies through Poise and Bleed. A Pride and Slash focus makes him easy to use with Blade Lineage.
messages.回避と精密照準で呼吸を一気に積み、クリティカルで大ダメージを出す。弾切れで退却す: Rapidly builds Poise through evade and Precision Aim, then deals heavy critical damage. Retreats after running out of ammunition, making him better for short fights.
messages.S3と守備で呼吸を貯め、毎ターンの追撃で実質2回行動する。耐久も高い。: Builds Poise through S3 and defense, then effectively acts twice through a follow-up every turn. Also durable.
messages.味方に攻撃レベル増加を配り、援護攻撃を命じる指揮官型の貫通アタッカー。: A Pierce commander that distributes Offense Level Up and orders Assist Attacks.
messages.呼吸を貯めて速度差でスキルを強化する貫通アタッカー。: A Pierce attacker that builds Poise and enhances skills through Speed differences.
messages.マッチに勝つたびに呼吸が積み上がる。剣契頭目と組むと大きく強化される。: Builds Poise with every clash win. Greatly strengthened by the Blade Lineage Mentor.
messages.味方に呼吸を配る。呼吸を扱う味方で固めると活きる。: Shares Poise with allies. Best surrounded by allies that use Poise.
messages.呼吸の供給を受けて紅梅を積む。単独では呼吸を伸ばしにくい。: Uses external Poise supply to build Red Plum Blossom. Struggles to build Poise alone.
messages.速度差で全スキルを強化する自己完結の貫通アタッカー。: A self-sufficient Pierce attacker that enhances every skill through Speed differences.
messages.終止符事務所フィクサー(ヒースクリフ)とのセット運用が前提の貫通アタッカー。: A Pierce attacker designed to be paired with Full-Stop Office Fixer Heathcliff.
messages.剣契頭目に持たせると、初回は傲慢×3で撃てて追慕酒で剣契全体を強化する。剣契型の: On the Blade Lineage Mentor, the first use costs 3 Pride and Drink to the Fallen strengthens the whole Blade Lineage team. The core E.G.O for this variant.
messages.全味方に呼吸を配り、使用後は毎ターン体力を回復する。この編成の主な回復手段。: Gives all allies Poise and restores HP every turn after use. The team's main source of healing.
messages.使うたびに強化され、呼吸で伸びる傲慢の広域。撃てれば怠惰資源の不足も補える。: A Pride area attack that strengthens with repeated use and Poise. Using it can also help address the Sloth resource shortage.
messages.戦闘序盤に撃ち、精神力の低い味方4人を回復して立ち上がりを安定させる。: Use early to restore SP to 4 low-SP allies and stabilize the opening.
messages.呼吸を溜めてクリティカルで攻める人格で固め、ファウストの胸痛で呼吸と回復を配る長: A team for longer fights, built from Identities that accumulate Poise for critical hits, with Faust's Thoracalgia supplying Poise and healing. Choose between a Blade Lineage variant centered on the Mentor and an Index and House of Spiders variant.
messages.呼吸が溜まるほどスキルが強くなる人格が多く、戦闘が長引くほど火力が上がる。: Many members gain stronger skills as Poise accumulates, increasing damage as the battle continues.
messages.胸痛は全味方に呼吸を配り、使用後は毎ターン体力も回復する。: [Thoracalgia](ego:0208) gives all allies Poise and restores HP every turn after use.
messages.傲慢スキルが多く、傲慢共鳴を条件にする効果を発動しやすい。: Many skills are Pride, making Pride Resonance conditions easy to fulfill.
messages.剣契型: 剣契頭目が傲慢共鳴3で「本国剣術」を発動し、剣契の味方に呼吸と威力強化: **Blade Lineage**: [Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508) activates Swordplay of the Homeland with 3 Pride Resonance to grant allies Poise and Power bonuses. Giving him [Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀]](ego:0509) greatly strengthens the whole group. Some Salsu are weak alone but become effective with the Mentor's support.
messages.人差し指・蜘蛛の巣型: 人差し指の3人は指令の遂行で1ターン目から威力と精神力を: **Index and House of Spiders**: The 3 Index members gain Power and SP by fulfilling Prescripts from turn 1, making their opening fast. [Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415) is strong alone and gains further bonuses by using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally.
messages.剣契頭目は単独でも「肉斬」でわざと負けて撃つ「骨断」が強いので、どちらの型にも入: The Blade Lineage Mentor fits either variant, since deliberately losing with Yield My Flesh to use To Claim Their Bones is strong even alone.
messages.序盤は守備や呼吸を得るスキルで呼吸を溜める。蜘蛛の巣小指の子方は呼吸威力25超を: Build Poise early through defense and Poise-granting skills. [The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice](persona:1015) converts Poise Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade for Shield.
messages.剣契型は毎ターン傲慢スキルを3つ以上使って傲慢共鳴3を起こし、本国剣術とLCD現: The Blade Lineage variant uses at least 3 Pride skills each turn for 3 Pride Resonance, maintaining Swordplay of the Homeland and [LCD OSIR Team](persona:0815)'s passive.
messages.戦闘序盤に表象放出機で精神力の低い味方を回復すると、立ち上がりが安定する。: Use [Representation Emitter](ego:0201) early to restore low-SP allies and stabilize the opening.
messages.鴻園の君主を使うなら、黒獣-巳や黒獣-卯 筆頭と一緒に入れる。黒獣がいないと真価: If using [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613), include Si Branch members or [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212). He does not reach full strength without Heishou.
messages.呼吸が溜まるまでは火力が低く、短期決戦は苦手。: Damage is low until Poise builds, making short fights a weakness.
messages.剣契型は資源が憤怒と傲慢に偏り、回復E.G.Oを撃ちにくい。怠惰・憂鬱を出せる剣: Blade Lineage resources lean toward Wrath and Pride, making healing E.G.O harder to use. Include [Blade Lineage Salsu Faust](persona:0208) for Sloth and Gloom, or other Identities that supply Gluttony.
messages.【リンバス】呼吸編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Poise Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの呼吸編成。呼吸を溜めてクリティカルで攻める人格で固め、ファウストの胸痛: Limbus Company Poise team guide: Identities that build Poise for critical hits, with Faust's Thoracalgia supplying Poise and healing for long fights. Covers the Blade Lineage variant and the Index and House of Spiders variant, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.火傷を付与できる人格だけで固める形。火傷の量で火力が伸びるので、夜明組・親指組が: A lineup consisting entirely of Burn-applying Identities. Damage rises with accumulated Burn, so it works without the Dawn Office or Thumb packages. Add Hornet and Don Quixote to the 5 priority picks, and support Burn Count from the bench.
messages.火傷回数を切らさない要。: The anchor that keeps Burn Count from running out.
messages.火傷と血闘本能を溜めて強化S3を撃つ主力。: A main attacker that builds Burn and Battleblood Instinct for enhanced S3.
messages.予知眼が尽きたら「処分」で火傷と振動を叩き込む。: When The Eye of Precognition runs out, unleash Disposal for Burn and Tremor.
messages.S3「空間斬」で火傷ダメージを加速する。: S3 Rend Space [空間斬] accelerates Burn damage.
messages.精神力を支え、火傷を配る潤滑油。: Keeps the team running by supporting SP and spreading Burn.
messages.点穴を重ねて単体を削る。火傷以外でも戦える枠。: Stacks Nerve Strike to wear down a single target. Also works outside Burn teams.
messages.精神力が最も高い味方の火傷回数の付与値を+1する。: Increases the Burn Count applied by the ally with the highest SP by 1.
messages.火傷と憤怒脆弱をばらまいてから攻める。: Spread Burn and Wrath Fragility before attacking.
messages.回復と火傷・出血の付与。: Healing plus Burn and Bleed application.
messages.広域・火傷・回復を同時にこなす。: Combines area damage, Burn, and healing.
messages.単体に火傷と脆弱を残す。: Leaves Burn and Fragile on a single target.
messages.夜明組3人の火傷と、親指組の振動を組み合わせ、振動-灼熱の振動爆発で憤怒ダメージ: Combine Burn from the 3 Dawn Office members with the Thumb package's Tremor, converting Tremor Bursts into Wrath damage through Tremor - Scorch. Higher damage than physical Burn, but both Burn and Tremor Count need attention.
messages.変身して火傷回数をばらまく。夜明の追撃で資源も稼ぐ。: Transforms to spread Burn Count. Dawn Office follow-ups also generate resources.
messages.棺を溜めて強化S3と「正午の解体」を撃つ火力役。: A damage dealer that builds Coffin for enhanced S3 and Dismemberment at High Noon.
messages.明け方で夜明け迎えを配り、精神力と耐久を支える。: Crack of Dawn distributes Dawnherald while supporting SP and durability.
messages.予知眼と「処分」。子方と組で動く。: Uses The Eye of Precognition and Disposal. Deploy alongside the Apprentice.
messages.決闘高潮で振動爆発を重ねる。: The Duel Escalates enables repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.猛虎標弾の破壊不能コインと強化S3で振動を足す。: Adds Tremor through Savage Tigermark Rounds' Unbreakable Coins and enhanced S3.
messages.火傷を加速する火力枠。: A damage slot that accelerates Burn.
messages.火傷回数の付与値を+1して火傷を維持する。: Increases Burn Count application by 1 to sustain Burn.
messages.火傷が溜まった敵に撃ち、振動-灼熱の火力を伸ばす。: Use against enemies with accumulated Burn to raise Tremor - Scorch damage.
messages.憤怒脆弱を付けて憤怒ダメージを伸ばす。: Inflicts Wrath Fragility to raise Wrath damage.
messages.火傷と出血を撒き、味方に精神力を配る。: Spreads Burn and Bleed while giving allies SP.
messages.魔弾ウーティスと《魔弾》で付与する黒炎で、ターン終了時に(黒炎×火傷)の傲慢ダメ: Dark Flame applied by Magic Bullet Outis and the Magic Bullet E.G.O deals Dark Flame × Burn as Pride damage at Turn End, multiplying Burn's damage output. Pride damage can also burn through enemies resistant to Wrath. Best against single bosses and weak against ordinary groups. Outis's S3 can shoot allies at low SP, so omit the You Branch and Dawn Office Identities that inflict Burn on themselves.
messages.魔弾を3以上にし、4以上の共鳴と同時に《魔弾》を撃つ。魔弾7のS3で0に戻す流れ: Reach at least 3 Magic Bullets, use the Magic Bullet E.G.O with at least 4 Resonance, then use S3 at 7 Magic Bullets to reset to 0. Repeat this cycle.
messages.S1〜S3すべてで火傷回数を増やし、黒炎が参照する火傷を保つ。: Every skill from S1 to S3 increases Burn Count, sustaining the Burn used by Dark Flame.
messages.火傷と振動を付与する親方。予知眼で攻撃をいなす。: A Nursefather that applies Burn and Tremor and handles attacks with The Eye of Precognition.
messages.火傷を加速する火力役。: A damage dealer that accelerates Burn.
messages.胞子で火傷回数を供給し、火傷を途切れさせない。: Spore supplies Burn Count to keep Burn active.
messages.点穴を重ねて単体を削り、火傷も上乗せする。: Stacks Nerve Strike to damage a single target while adding Burn.
messages.味方が入れた火傷を条件に強化され、S3で火傷回数も増やす。: Gains bonuses from allies' Burn application and adds Burn Count with S3.
messages.魔弾ウーティスのS3で減る精神力を支える。: Offsets the SP lost through Magic Bullet Outis's S3.
messages.魔弾の数だけ火傷と黒炎を配る中核。: The core E.G.O, spreading Burn and Dark Flame based on Magic Bullet count.
messages.3人同時に出すと夜明事務所の連携追撃が揃い、火傷の量と回数、憂鬱・嫉妬の資源まで: Deploying all 3 completes the Dawn Office's coordinated follow-ups, supplying Burn Potency and Count alongside Gloom and Envy resources. Their raw damage exceeds the Firefist option. All are Walpurgisnacht-exclusive, so choose according to your roster. Adding the Thumb package shifts the lineup toward Tremor - Scorch.
messages.精神力40で変身し、広域化したS2で火傷回数をばらまく。夜明の2人がいれば精神力: Transforms at 40 SP and spreads Burn Count through area S2. The other 2 Dawn Office members restore his SP, enabling an earlier transformation.
messages.炎蝶の棺を30まで溜めて強化S3と「正午の解体」を撃つ火力役。火傷ダメージでは混: Builds 30 Fire Butterfly Coffin for enhanced S3 and Dismemberment at High Noon. Burn damage cannot Stagger her or reduce her HP below 1.
messages.暁の火30で強化S3「明け方」を撃ち、全味方に夜明け迎え(火傷付与スキルのダメー: At 30 Light of Daybreak, enhanced S3 Crack of Dawn grants all allies Dawnherald, increasing damage from Burn-applying skills by 10%. Also supports SP recovery and durability.
messages.親方が予知眼で攻撃を読み、子方が決闘高潮を積んで振動爆発を重ねる。親方に予知眼が: The Nursefather reads attacks with The Eye of Precognition, while the Apprentice builds The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts. While the Nursefather has The Eye of Precognition, a hit from the Apprentice's Base Skill triggers his own La Spada di Palermo follow-up once per turn. The Apprentice and the You Branch Adept are both Heathcliff, so choose one.
Handles attacks with The Eye of Precognition, then unleashes enhanced Disposal for Burn and Tremor when it runs out. Rodion can also use the healing E.G.O Into the Sunset, Pursuance, and Indicant's Trial.
messages.決闘高潮5で強化S3の振動爆発を重ね、教本を得て強くなる。親方が予知眼 過熱のと: At 5 The Duel Escalates, enhanced S3 triggers repeated Tremor Bursts and gains Textbook to grow stronger. When the Nursefather's eye is overheated, he gains Assist Defense to protect him.
messages.君主ホンルが守備で黒獣を入れ替え、待機解除のたびに酉の2人を交互に動かす。耐久力: The Lord Hong Lu swaps Heishou units through defense, alternating the 2 You Branch units whenever they leave standby. They are fragile, so avoid losing clashes.
messages.君主の尊命は基本スキル3として撃たれるので、強化S3を温存したまま血闘本能と火傷: The Lord's order is used as Base Skill 3, letting him build Battleblood Instinct and Burn while saving enhanced S3.
messages.待機解除・復帰のたびに血炎3を得て、S2の再使用とS3の破壊不能化につなげる。: Gains 3 Bloodflame [血炎] whenever leaving standby or returning, enabling S2 reuse and Unbreakable Coins on S3.
messages.火傷人格ではないが、S3で黒獣と3連撃を組み、守備で入れ替えた酉にもS3を撃たせ: A commander outside the Burn keyword that coordinates a three-hit S3 sequence with Heishou and lets an incoming You Branch unit use S3 after a defense swap.
messages.呼吸からクイックを得て速度差で押し、点穴を3まで重ねてS3を撃つ。火傷は上乗せだ: Gains Haste from Poise, exploits Speed differences, and builds 3 Nerve Strike before using S3. Burn is a bonus, but her self-sufficiency makes her easy to fit into an open slot.
messages.同じ敵に点穴を3まで積み、コイン再使用で火傷と火力を伸ばす。ドンキホーテと点穴を: Builds 3 Nerve Strike on the same enemy and uses Coin reuse to raise Burn and damage. Do not deploy with Don Quixote, since they compete over Nerve Strike.
messages.猛虎標弾で破壊不能コインとS3を押し出すが、弾切れ後は火傷を付与できなくなる。ホ: Savage Tigermark Rounds enable Unbreakable Coins and S3, but Burn application stops after ammunition runs out. Choose him or Hornet; he fits better in lineups involving Tremor.
messages.胞子で毎ターン火傷回数を増やし、火傷を途切れさせない。範囲攻撃もあり、通常戦闘で: Spore increases Burn Count each turn to keep Burn active. Area attacks make him strong in both Regular and Focused Encounters.
messages.黒炎で防御レベルを下げ、(黒炎×火傷)の傲慢ダメージを上乗せする。憤怒耐性の敵に: Dark Flame lowers Defense Level and adds Dark Flame × Burn as Pride damage, working even against Wrath-resistant enemies. Watch her SP costs.
messages.自分に火傷を溜め、最後に「最大感応」で自爆して後続に攻撃レベル増加を渡す。自爆以: Stacks Burn on herself before self-destructing through Max Attunement and passing Offense Level Up to the next unit. Avoid accidental death before the explosion.
messages.敵の火傷が6・10以上で強化される火傷アタッカー。自分では火傷回数を増やせないの: A Burn attacker enhanced at enemy Burn thresholds of 6 and 10. Cannot add Burn Count herself, so pair her with Count suppliers.
messages.速度が遅いので、味方が火傷を入れた後に殴ると1ターン目から強化条件を満たせる。S: Low Speed lets allies apply Burn before she attacks, enabling bonuses from turn 1. S3 also adds Burn Count.
messages.S2で火傷回数を積み、回数6以上の敵から周囲へ火傷を広げる回数供給役。S3は火傷: Supplies Burn Count with S2 and spreads Burn to nearby enemies from a target with at least 6 Count. Save S3 until Burn has accumulated.
messages.灼熱推進弾でS3の振動爆発を重ねる。弾丸人格のカポIIIIなどに弾を補給できる。: Scorch Propellant Ammo enables repeated Tremor Bursts on S3. Can replenish ammunition for Identities such as Capo IIII.
messages.サポートパッシブ(同期化Ⅲ、憤怒×4保有時)で、精神力が最も高い味方1名の火傷回: At Uptie Ⅲ, with 4 Wrath Owned, the support passive increases the Burn Count applied by the 1 ally with the highest SP by 1.
messages.単体の敵に火傷6と脆弱を残し、次のターンの味方の火力を底上げする。必要資源が軽い: Leaves 6 Burn and Fragile on a single enemy, increasing allies' damage next turn. Low resource cost.
messages.火傷を溜めた敵ほどダメージが伸びる広域で、パッシブで4つ目のスキルを強化する。解: An area attack that grows stronger against enemies with more Burn; its passive enhances the fourth skill. Assumes Threadspin Ⅴ.
messages.火傷と憤怒脆弱を広域にばらまき、次のターンの憤怒火力を底上げする。解析Ⅴなら、同: Spreads Burn and Wrath Fragility over an area to raise next turn's Wrath damage. At Threadspin Ⅴ, it raises total damage more than Pursuance of the same rank.
messages.火傷の合計が多い敵ほど強くなる広域で、各対象に火傷をばらまく。解析Ⅴ前提。: An area attack that grows stronger against enemies with more total Burn and spreads Burn to each target. Assumes Threadspin Ⅴ.
messages.攻撃加重値7の破壊不能の広域で、火傷の量に応じて伸びる。使用後の精神力の消耗が重: An Unbreakable area attack with 7 Attack Weight that scales with Burn. Its ongoing SP drain after use is heavy.
messages.体力の低い味方を回復しつつ火傷と出血を撒く。親方ロージャを入れたときの回復役。: Heals low-HP allies while spreading Burn and Bleed. A healing option when using Nursefather Rodion.
messages.広域攻撃・火傷付与・味方最大3名の回復を同時にこなす。憤怒が余りやすい火傷編成に: Combines area damage, Burn application, and healing for up to 3 allies. Suits Burn teams that tend to have surplus Wrath.
messages.体力の低い味方2名を回復する怠惰のE.G.O。回復量は撃つ人格の最大体力で決まる: A Sloth E.G.O that heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP. Healing scales with the user's maximum HP, so use it with Rodion.
messages.火傷と振動を押し付け、振動爆発の混乱で火傷を拡散する。ホーネットやカポIIIIを: Inflicts Burn and Tremor, spreading Burn when Tremor Bursts cause Stagger. With Hornet or Capo IIII deployed, use it against an enemy with accumulated Burn.
messages.3枚目のコインを再使用して火傷と出血を撒き、味方に精神力も配る。使い手はシンクレ: Reuses Coin 3 to spread Burn and Bleed while also giving allies SP. Used by Sinclair.
messages.火傷と黒炎を大量に配る。魔弾ウーティスを入れる黒炎編成向き。: Applies large amounts of Burn and Dark Flame. Suits Dark Flame teams using Magic Bullet Outis.
messages.火傷を付与できる人格で固め、全員で敵の火傷を育てながら殴る、長期戦に強い編成。火: A team for longer fights, built from Burn-applying Identities that attack while collectively increasing enemy Burn. Variants include physical Burn, Burn and Tremor with Dawn Office and Thumb units, and Dark Flame, which amplifies Burn damage through Magic Bullet Outis.
messages.優先枠の多くが、対象の火傷の量に応じてコイン威力や威力が上がる。火傷を溜めるほど: Many priority picks gain Coin Power or Power based on the target's Burn. Building Burn raises the whole team's damage.
messages.強化の条件には「対象の火傷が6以上」「6につき+1(最大2)」といった軽いものが: Many requirements are modest, such as at least 6 Burn or +1 per 6 Burn, up to +2. This suggests that even a small number of Burn users can support the core pattern.
messages.炎拳事務所生存者が編成の要。S1〜S3のすべてで火傷回数を増やし、ほぼ単独で火傷: [Firefist Office Survivor](persona:1211) is the anchor. Every skill from S1 to S3 adds Burn Count, almost sustaining Burn alone. His passive, which increases another enemy's Burn Count after killing or Staggering a Burning enemy during Wrath Resonance, is supplementary.
messages.序盤は火傷を付与するスキルで、敵に火傷を溜める。: Start by building Burn on enemies with Burn-applying skills.
messages.火傷は回数が尽きると止まるので、炎拳事務所生存者のスキルと裏置きの南部リウ協会5: Burn stops when Count runs out. Sustain it with Firefist Office Survivor's skills and benched [Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604): at Uptie Ⅲ with 4 Wrath Owned, he adds 1 to the Burn Count applied by the ally with the highest SP. [Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112)'s S3 reduces Burn Count by 2, so avoid it when Count is low.
messages.炎拳事務所生存者・南部リウ協会3課のS2と、4人のS3が憤怒なので、憤怒の資源が: Firefist Office Survivor and Liu Assoc. South Section 3 have Wrath S2s, and 4 members have Wrath S3s, making Wrath resources easy to accumulate. This supports Wrath E.G.O such as Rodion's [4th Match Flame](ego:0902).
messages.回復は、蜘蛛の巣親指の親方(ロージャ)を入れたときに使える夕焼けの中へや指定裁判: Cover healing through E.G.O such as [Into the Sunset](ego:0909) and [Indicant's Trial](ego:0908), available when deploying The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather Rodion.
messages.夜明組・親指組・酉組の入れ方: Adding Dawn Office, Thumb, or You Branch units
messages.優先枠の代わりに、まとまりで入れる選択肢がある。手持ちの揃い方で決める。: These coordinated packages can replace priority picks. Choose according to the units you own.
messages.夜明組は夜明事務所フィクサー(シンクレア)・夜明事務所フィクサー(ファウスト)・: The Dawn Office package assumes all 3 together: [Dawn Office Fixer Sinclair](persona:1009), [Dawn Office Fixer Faust](persona:0216), and [Dawn Office Rep](persona:1216). Their coordination triggers follow-ups and supplies Gloom and Envy resources. Raw damage exceeds the Firefist option, but all are Walpurgisnacht-exclusive.
messages.親指組は蜘蛛の巣親指の親方と蜘蛛の巣親指の子方の組。親方に予知眼がある間、子方が: The Thumb package pairs [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916) with [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice](persona:0716). While the Nursefather has The Eye of Precognition, a hit from the Apprentice's Base Skill triggers his own La Spada di Palermo follow-up once per turn. The Apprentice shares a Sinner with [Heishou Pack - You Branch Adept](persona:0714), so choose one.
messages.酉組は鴻園の君主が黒獣を入れ替えて回す。耐久力が低いので、マッチ負けに注意する。: The You Branch package uses [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613) to swap Heishou units. They are fragile, so take care not to lose clashes.
messages.夜明組と親指組をどちらも入れると、振動を絡めた「振動-灼熱」寄りの編成になる。火: Combining both Dawn Office and Thumb units shifts the team toward Tremor - Scorch. Both Burn Count and Tremor Count need attention.
messages.魔弾(ウーティス)と《魔弾》で付与する黒炎は、ターン終了時に(黒炎×対象の火傷): Dark Flame applied by Outis's [Magic Bullet](persona:1107) Identity and [Magic Bullet](ego:1108) E.G.O deals Pride damage equal to Dark Flame × the target's Burn at Turn End. More Burn means more damage; its Pride affinity also works against Wrath-resistant enemies.
messages.魔弾を3以上にし、4以上の共鳴と同時に《魔弾》を撃つ。魔弾7のS3で0に戻す、を: Reach at least 3 Magic Bullets, use the Magic Bullet E.G.O alongside at least 4 Resonance, then use S3 at 7 Magic Bullets to reset to 0. Repeat.
messages.魔弾ウーティスのS3は精神力を大きく消耗し、精神力10以下だと50%の確率で味方: Magic Bullet Outis's S3 consumes substantial SP and has a 50% chance to hit allies at 10 SP or less. Support her SP with benched [Liu Assoc. South Section 3](persona:0112), and omit the You Branch or Dawn Office Identities that inflict Burn on themselves.
messages.単体ボス向けで、エンジンがかかるまで時間がかかる。雑魚戦は苦手。: Best against a single boss. Slow to get going and poor against ordinary groups.
messages.優先枠で最も多い罪悪属性は憤怒(基本スキル30枚中8枚)なので、憤怒に耐性のある: Wrath is the most common affinity among the priority picks, with 8 of their 30 Base Skills, so Wrath-resistant enemies are somewhat troublesome. The Dark Flame variant can use Pride damage instead.
messages.強化の条件が軽いので、空いた枠は火傷を持たない汎用の強い人格でも埋められる。手持: The enhancement conditions are modest, so open slots can also take strong general-purpose Identities without Burn. If a priority pick is missing, check the flexible and alternative slots below.
messages.【リンバス】火傷編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Burn Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの火傷編成。火傷を付与できる人格で固め、全員で敵の火傷を育てながら殴る、: Limbus Company Burn team guide: Burn-applying Identities that grow enemy Burn together for long fights. Covers the physical Burn, Burn and Tremor (Dawn Office and Thumb), and Dark Flame (Magic Bullet Outis) variants, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.編成の軸。できるだけ入れたい人格: The team's core: include these Identities where possible
messages.優先枠で埋まらない残りの枠の候補: Candidates for slots left after the priority picks
messages.サポートパッシブのため控えに置く人格: Identities kept on the bench for their support passives
messages.メンバーの効果文をもとにした解説。: A guide based on the team members' effects.
messages.必須の人格以外の枠は自由: Slots other than the required Identities are flexible
messages.同じ所属などで組むと強いまとまり: Groups that work well together through affiliations and other synergies
messages.ほかの裏置き候補をサポートパッシブ一覧で探す →: Find more bench options in the support passive list →
messages.沈潜で敵の精神力を削りつつ、火力は人格の物理攻撃で出す形。沈潜の維持にはこだわら: Lower enemy SP through Sinking while dealing damage through the Identities' physical attacks. Maintaining Sinking is not the main goal, so individually strong Sinking Identities fit well. Surplus Gloom makes healing E.G.O easy to use.
messages.加護と絶望を切り替える中心。絶望状態の沈潜付与と火力は最強格。: The centerpiece, switching between Blessing and Despair. Despair offers top-tier Sinking application and damage.
messages.代行を貯めてS3を撃つ長期戦役。: A long-battle option that builds Procuration for S3.
messages.3種の追撃で、手元のスキルとは別にダメージを重ねる。: Three follow-ups add damage beyond her selected skills.
messages.同じスキルを連続して使い、光札を貯めて追撃「光斬」を放つ。: Repeatedly uses the same skill to gather Bright cards and unleash Kōzan [光斬] follow-ups.
messages.指令を遂行して1ターン目から威力と精神力を得る。: Fulfills Prescripts for Power and SP from turn 1.
messages.敵を倒すほど強くなる。雑魚の多い通常戦闘で強い。: Grows stronger with kills. Strong in Regular Encounters with many ordinary enemies.
messages.敵コインの表面確率を下げ、1ターン目からマッチを取る。: Lowers enemy Coins' Heads chance and wins clashes from turn 1.
messages.サポートパッシブで、精神力が最も低い味方の精神力を15回復する。人差し指所属には: The support passive restores 15 SP to the ally with the lowest SP. Index members also receive Damage Up.
messages.沈潜を大量に積み、絶望状態への移行も助ける。: Applies heavy Sinking and also helps transition into Despair.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力をまとめて回復する。: Restores HP and SP to all allies together.
