messages.沈潜の人差し指3人に、呼吸で強い黒獣2人を足す形。君主以外のS3が憂鬱なので、憂: Add 2 units from the strong Poise-oriented Heishou package to the 3 Sinking Index members. Every S3 except the Lord's is Gloom, making healing through Gloom resources easy. Can fight without relying on E.G.O.
messages.沈潜・呼吸の両方を扱い、パワーが高い。: Uses both Sinking and Poise and has high Power.
messages.沈潜・呼吸の両方を扱い、立ち上がりが早い。: Uses both Sinking and Poise with a fast opening.
messages.沈潜・呼吸の両方を扱い、代行状態でマッチを取る。: Uses both Sinking and Poise, clashing in the Procuration state.
messages.追撃で火力を重ねる沈潜枠。: A Sinking slot that adds damage through follow-ups.
messages.光札を貯めて追撃を放つ沈潜枠。: A Sinking slot that gathers Bright cards for follow-ups.
messages.沈潜人格ではないが、広域で多コインのS3を君主のS3で呼び出せる。: Lacks the Sinking keyword, but the Lord's S3 can call her multi-Coin area S3.
messages.沈潜人格ではないが、黒獣-巳を追加行動させる司令塔。食いしばりがあり安定する。: A commander outside the Sinking keyword that grants Si Branch extra actions. An effect that lets him survive lethal damage adds reliability.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力を回復する。: Restores HP and SP to all allies.
messages.沈潜の回数を維持できる人格で固め、沈潜そのもののダメージで倒す形。厳粛な哀悼イサ: Use Identities that maintain Sinking Count and defeat enemies through Sinking's own damage. Solemn Lament Yi Sang's Butterfly lets Sinking deal Gloom damage even to enemies with SP.
messages.特殊沈潜「蝶」を撒き、沈潜を憂鬱ダメージとして通す。単体ボスに極めて強い。: Spreads the special Sinking, Butterfly, letting Sinking deal Gloom damage. Extremely strong against single bosses.
messages.沈潜の威力と回数を両方大量に入れる中核。: A core unit that applies heavy Sinking Potency and Count.
messages.S3で「邸宅の木霊」を付け、マッチ勝利ごとに沈潜を入れる。: S3 applies Echoes of the Manor, while each clash win applies Sinking.
messages.邸宅の木霊で沈潜回数を伸ばし、精神力0未満の敵を押し切る。: Echoes of the Manor increases Sinking Count, helping overpower enemies below 0 SP.
messages.沈潜を積み、S3で吸収して次のターンの火力に変える。: Stacks Sinking, then absorbs it with S3 to raise next turn's damage.
messages.絶望状態で沈潜付与と火力を両立する。: Combines Sinking application and damage in Despair.
messages.追撃で火力を重ねる。振動・沈潜の両方を扱う。: Adds damage through follow-ups. Uses both Tremor and Sinking.
messages.精神力が高いうちに撃つと最大8コインで蝶を大量に付与する。: Used at high SP, it can apply heavy Butterfly through up to 8 Coins.
messages.厳粛な哀悼イサンに専用効果を与える。: Grants exclusive effects to Solemn Lament Yi Sang.
messages.3人とも沈潜・呼吸の両方を扱い、指令の遂行で1ターン目から威力と精神力を得る。代: All 3 use both Sinking and Poise and gain Power and SP by fulfilling Prescripts from turn 1. The Proxy also has an excellent support passive, so benching her is an option.
messages.2人とも沈潜人格ではないが、呼吸で強い。君主のS3で黒獣-巳のS3を呼び出せるの: Neither has the Sinking keyword, but the package is strong through Poise. The Lord's S3 can call Si Branch's S3, so place Si Branch first in deployment order.
messages.黒獣-巳に尊命を命じて追加行動させる司令塔。: A commander that orders Si Branch to take extra actions.
messages.広域乱射で多コインのS3を持ち、君主に呼び出される側。: Has a multi-Coin, multi-target S3 for the Lord to call.
messages.代行状態で攻撃レベルと速度が上がる。サポートパッシブも優秀で、裏置きにも向く。: Procuration raises Offense Level and Speed. An excellent support passive also makes her suitable for the bench.
messages.敵を倒して棺を集めるほど強くなる。雑魚の多い通常戦闘で強化条件を満たしやすい。: Grows stronger by killing enemies and gathering Coffins. Regular Encounters with many ordinary enemies make his conditions easier to fulfill.
messages.ウアジェトの目で敵コインの表面確率を下げ、1ターン目からマッチを取る。編成に依存: The Udjat lowers enemy Coins' Heads chance, helping win clashes from turn 1. Works independently of the rest of the team.
messages.守備でランプを貯めて敵に眩惑を付け、集中戦闘のボスに被ダメージ増加を与え続ける。: Builds Lamp through defense to apply Dazzle, continually increasing a boss's damage taken in Focused Encounters.
messages.充電を育てるほどS2・S3の火力が伸びる長期戦向けの打撃アタッカー。初動は弱い。: A Blunt attacker for longer fights whose S2 and S3 grow stronger with Charge. Weak opening.
messages.破裂と沈潜が多い敵ほど火力が伸びる打撃人格。: A Blunt Identity that deals more damage against enemies with more Rupture and Sinking.
messages.スキルを捨てる味方に知識鍛錬とバリアを配る支援役の打撃タンク。: A Blunt support tank that grants Erudition and Shield to allies using Discard.
messages.沈潜を蝶で憂鬱ダメージとして通す。沈潜で倒したいなら、親方イサンより優先する。: Butterfly lets Sinking deal Gloom damage. Prioritize him over Nursefather Yi Sang when aiming to win through Sinking damage.
messages.沈潜の威力と回数を両方大量に入れる、沈潜を軸にするときの中核。: A core unit for status-focused Sinking teams, applying large amounts of both Potency and Count.
messages.邸宅の木霊を付け、マッチ勝利ごとに沈潜を入れる。沈潜回数も維持しやすい。: Applies Echoes of the Manor and adds Sinking with every clash win. Also helps sustain Sinking Count.
messages.邸宅の木霊で沈潜回数を伸ばし、精神力0未満の敵をマッチで押し切る。: Echoes of the Manor increases Sinking Count, helping win clashes against enemies below 0 SP.
messages.沈潜を積み、S3で吸収して火力に変える。サポートパッシブは精神力を減らすので注意: Stacks Sinking, then absorbs it through S3 for damage. Be careful: his support passive lowers SP.
messages.S3の沈潜殺到で溜めた沈潜を一気に発動させる、沈潜に尖らせた玄人向けの選択肢。耐: A specialized option for experienced players: S3's Sinking Deluge releases accumulated Sinking at once. Among the frailest Identities.
messages.サポートパッシブで、精神力が最も低い味方が敵を混乱させるか倒すと精神力を7回復す: The support passive restores 7 SP when the ally with the lowest SP Staggers or kills an enemy.
messages.広域で沈潜を大量に積む。精神力の低い序盤に撃ち、絶望状態への移行を助けることもで: Applies heavy Sinking over an area. Using it at low SP early in battle can also help transition into Despair.
messages.5枠広域の攻撃と同時に、味方全員の体力と精神力を回復する。資源は重いが憂鬱が余る: An attack with 5 Attack Weight that also restores HP and SP to all allies. Expensive, but this team's surplus Gloom makes it easier to use.
messages.敵の沈潜と憂鬱共鳴で回復量が伸び、体力の低い味方2名を回復する。: Healing scales with enemy Sinking and Gloom Resonance, restoring the 2 allies with the lowest HP.
messages.沈潜を消費して精神力を回復する覚醒と、憂鬱脆弱を押し込む侵蝕を持つ。: Awakening consumes Sinking to restore SP, while Corrosion inflicts Gloom Fragility.
messages.精神力が高いうちに撃つと最大8コインで蝶を大量に付与する。沈潜維持型で沈潜を通す: At high SP, up to 8 Coins apply large amounts of Butterfly. Enables Sinking damage in the sustained-Sinking variant.
messages.厳粛な哀悼イサンに振動付与などの専用効果を与える。: Grants exclusive effects, including Tremor application, to Solemn Lament Yi Sang.
messages.沈潜で敵の精神力を削りながら殴る編成。火力を人格の物理攻撃で出す「物理沈潜型」、: A team that attacks while lowering enemy SP through Sinking. Choose physical Sinking for damage through Identity attacks, Sinking and Poise with Heishou, or sustained Sinking to maintain the status and rely on its damage.
messages.殴るついでに敵の精神力を削れ、憂鬱が弱点の敵には特に強い。: Lowers enemy SP while attacking and is especially strong against enemies weak to Gloom.
messages.憂鬱資源が余りやすく、水袋や過ぎし日などの回復E.G.Oを撃ちやすい。: Gloom tends to accumulate, making healing E.G.O such as [Fluid Sac](ego:0202) and [Bygone Days](ego:0807) easy to use.
messages.涙で研ぎ澄まされた剣(ロージャ)は、沈潜付与も物理火力も最強格の中心人格。: [Sword Sharpened with Tears](persona:0913) Rodion is the centerpiece, offering top-tier Sinking application and physical damage.
messages.物理沈潜型: 沈潜の維持にはこだわらず、単体で強い沈潜人格を並べる。最も汎用性が: **Physical Sinking**: Use individually strong Sinking Identities without focusing on maintaining the status. The most generally applicable variant.
messages.沈潜・呼吸型: 人差し指の3人が沈潜・呼吸の両方を扱えるので、残りに呼吸で強い黒: **Sinking and Poise**: The 3 Index members use both statuses. Add the strong Poise users [Heishou Pack - Si Branch](persona:0912) and [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613). Putting Si Branch first in deployment order lets the Lord's S3 call her S3.
messages.沈潜維持型: 沈潜回数を維持できる人格で固め、厳粛な哀悼(イサン)の蝶で沈潜を憂: **Sustained Sinking**: Use Count-sustaining Identities and [Solemn Lament](persona:0110) Yi Sang's Butterfly to deal Sinking as Gloom damage. Strong against single bosses. For a more specialized approach, [Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104) Yi Sang releases accumulated Sinking through S3's Sinking Deluge. Extremely fragile and suited to experienced players.
messages.涙で研ぎ澄まされた剣は、守備で加護と絶望を切り替える。絶望で戦うなら、氷の脚を撃: Sword Sharpened with Tears switches between Blessing and Despair through defense. If choosing Despair, a strong sequence is using [Rime Shank](ego:0903) to lower SP before transitioning.
messages.沈潜回数を稼ぐには「邸宅の木霊」が重要。バトラーの人格のS3で付与できる。: Echoes of the Manor is important for building Sinking Count. Butler Identities can apply it through S3.
messages.人差し指代行者は出撃させても強いが、裏置きにすると精神力が最も低い味方の精神力を: [The Index Proxy](persona:0314) is strong when deployed, but benching her enables a support passive that restores 15 SP to the ally with the lowest SP.
messages.雑魚の多い通常戦闘では、ワイルドハントが敵を倒して強化されやすい。: In Regular Encounters with many ordinary enemies, [Wild Hunt](persona:0710) can easily gain bonuses through kills.
messages.敵の精神力を大きく削るため、精神力を持ち減算コインを主体にする敵には極端に弱い。: Because it sharply lowers enemy SP, this team is extremely weak against enemies with SP that mainly use negative Coins.
messages.憂鬱以外では色欲の資源が不足しやすいので、色欲を使うE.G.Oは残量に気を付ける: Lust resources are often scarce despite abundant Gloom, so monitor your reserves when using Lust-costing E.G.O.
messages.エドガー家 継承者はサポートパッシブで精神力を減らす。精神力0未満で強くなる涙で: [Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)'s support passive lowers SP. Pairing him with Sword Sharpened with Tears, who grows stronger below 0 SP, can avoid that drawback.
messages.【リンバス】沈潜編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Sinking Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの沈潜編成。沈潜で敵の精神力を削りながら殴る編成。火力を人格の物理攻撃で: Limbus Company Sinking team guide: attack while draining enemy SP with Sinking. Covers the physical Sinking, Sinking and Poise (with Heishou), and sustained Sinking variants, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.敵のマイナス効果の数で強くなる薬指の人格を5人並べ、出血を維持しながら戦う形。単: Deploy 5 Ring Identities that grow stronger with the number of enemy negative effects, fighting while maintaining Bleed. Best against single targets, but the Ring Nursefather's area S3 also handles groups.
messages.生体材料を育てて出血付与を強化し、広域のS3で多数の敵も攻める中核。: The core unit: develops Corpus Ingredient to enhance Bleed application and uses area S3 against groups.
messages.出血回数を維持し、敵の攻撃を受けることで能力が発動する。: Maintains Bleed Count and activates abilities by taking enemy attacks.
messages.マイナス効果を盛った敵にS2を撃ち、コイン再使用を連鎖させる。: Uses S2 against enemies stacked with negative effects to chain Coin reuse.
messages.色彩と果敢なタッチを重ね、出血・沈潜のダメージを引き上げる増幅役。: An amplifier that stacks Mauled Color and Touche Hardie to raise Bleed and Sinking damage.
messages.色彩を5以上積んだ敵に強化S3を当てる。ドーセントとセットで使う。: Lands enhanced S3 against enemies with at least 5 Mauled Color. Use together with the Docent.
messages.マイナス効果を稼ぎやすく、弱った敵に処刑技でとどめを刺す。: Readily adds negative effects and finishes weakened enemies with an execution skill.
messages.呼吸を溜めてクリティカルで殴る火力役。スキルと追撃の「相戦清潾火」で出血も重ねる: A damage dealer that builds Poise for critical hits. Skills and the Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame follow-up also add Bleed.
messages.味方を回復しつつ、敵に出血・呪い・釘を撒く。: Heals allies while inflicting Bleed, Curse, and Nails on enemies.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの人格で戦場の出血を「血餐」に貯め、室長のS3を強化して戦う形: Use La Manchaland Identities to collect Bleed damage on the field as Bloodfeast and enhance the Manager's S3. The One Who Grips's Whistles quickly raises SP. Focus on cycling Bloodfeast rather than building enemy Bleed.
messages.血餐を消耗して硬血を15以上にし、S3を強化する中核。: The core unit: spends Bloodfeast to reach at least 15 Hardblood and enhance S3.
messages.色欲共鳴の口笛で味方の精神力を素早く回復し、水袋も撃てる。: Whistles quickly restores allies' SP through Lust Resonance. Can also use Fluid Sac.
messages.S2で自分と味方に攻撃威力増加を配り、序盤から安定してマッチする。: S2 grants Attack Power Up to herself and allies for reliable clashes from the opening.
messages.自傷の出血で血餐を供給する燃料役。ガードして口笛に専念させてもよい。: Supplies Bloodfeast through self-inflicted Bleed. Can simply guard to focus on enabling Whistles.
messages.硬血甲冑を配り、ラ・マンチャランドの味方を支援する。: Distributes Hardblood Armor to support La Manchaland allies.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドではないが、出血人格として優先して入れてよい。: Not from La Manchaland, but still worth prioritizing as a Bleed Identity.
messages.広域のS3で出血を付与する薬指の親方。: A Ring Nursefather that applies Bleed through area S3.
messages.出血と血餐を溜めてから撃つ、全コイン破壊不能の大型広域。: A large area attack with every Coin Unbreakable. Use after accumulating Bleed and Bloodfeast.
messages.共鳴の数に応じて複数の味方を回復する。: Heals multiple allies based on Resonance count.
messages.5人そろえると、身体派(親方・子方)の生体材料が10から始まり初動が強くなる。他: With all 5 together, the Corporist Nursefather and Apprentice start with 10 Corpus Ingredient for a stronger opening. Unlike the other Ring members, these 2 scale with their own Corpus Ingredient, so plan around 5 Ring members.
messages.広域のS3を持つ身体派。: A Corporist Ring member with area S3.
messages.出血回数を維持する身体派。: A Corporist Ring member that sustains Bleed Count.
messages.マイナス効果の数で伸びる点描派。: A Pointillist that scales with the number of negative effects.
messages.色彩で出血ダメージを増やす野獣派。: A Fauvist that increases Bleed damage through Mauled Color.
messages.ドーセントの色彩で強化S3を撃つ野獣派。: A Fauvist that uses the Docent's Mauled Color to enable enhanced S3.
messages.室長は他のラ・マンチャランド人格がいるとスキルが強化される。神父の自傷が血餐の燃: The Manager's skills strengthen alongside other La Manchaland Identities. The Priest's self-damage fuels Bloodfeast, while the Princess and Prince support allies. Including the Barber alongside the Manager makes Bloodfeast harder to cycle.
messages.血餐を消耗してS3を強化する中核。: The core unit that spends Bloodfeast to enhance S3.
messages.攻撃威力増加を配り、出血・破裂を付与する。: Distributes Attack Power Up while applying Bleed and Rupture.
messages.硬血甲冑と演技集中で味方を支援する。: Supports allies through Hardblood Armor and Focused Performance.
messages.血餐で鋏の刃を育てるアタッカー。室長がいると血餐が溜まりにくい。: An attacker that develops Scissorblades through Bloodfeast. The Manager makes Bloodfeast harder to accumulate.
messages.赤き神は高貴な品格に目覚めると火力・出血付与ともに非常に強いが、S2・S3が味方: After awakening Noble Dignity, the Crimson God has exceptional damage and Bleed application, but S2 and S3 also hurt allies. Le Rouge Identities take priority for that damage and have strong self-healing, so pairing him with Boutique reduces this drawback. More Le Rouge Identities make the package stronger.
messages.3ターンほど幼年期で味方を回復・強化し、高貴な品格に目覚めてから出血とラブジェク: Spend roughly 3 turns healing and buffing allies in Childhood, then awaken Noble Dignity to attack through Bleed and L'Abject.
messages.自傷で試着室を経て強化形態「新装」に変わる。赤き神の攻撃を優先して受け、自己回復: Uses self-damage to enter the Changing Room and transform into Full Makeover. Prioritizes taking the Crimson God's attacks and endures through self-healing.
messages.色欲共鳴の口笛で味方の精神力を素早く回復する。釘で出血回数を稼ぎ、水袋も撃てる。: Whistles quickly restores allies' SP through Lust Resonance. Nails add Bleed Count, and she can use Fluid Sac. After the opening, the Ring Apprentice is stronger.
messages.出血・振動と傷を重ね、弱った敵に処刑技「メルチェ」でとどめを刺す。マイナス効果を: Stacks Bleed, Tremor, and Open Wound before finishing weakened enemies with Mercé. Readily builds negative effects.
messages.火傷・出血の人格で、マイナス効果を稼ぎやすい。広域攻撃が得意。: A Burn and Bleed Identity that readily adds negative effects and excels at area attacks.
messages.赤眼と懺悔でスキルを強化し、強化S3で大ダメージと回復を行う。最後の一押しに向く: Red Eyes and Penitence enhance skills, while enhanced S3 delivers heavy damage and healing. Good for the final push.
messages.自傷で体力を削り、試着室を経て強化形態「新装」に変わる出血の貫通アタッカー。下準: A Bleed Pierce attacker that loses HP through self-damage, enters the Changing Room, then transforms into Full Makeover. High damage and survivability once setup is complete.
messages.視線を集めて軽蔑に変え、強化S3で撃ち抜く出血・振動の人格。: A Bleed and Tremor Identity that gathers Gaze, converts it into Contempt, then fires enhanced S3.
messages.幼年期で味方を支援した後、高貴な品格で出血を大量に付与する。S2・S3は味方も傷: Supports allies in Childhood, then applies heavy Bleed in Noble Dignity. S2 and S3 also hurt allies, so pair with Le Rouge Identities.
messages.色彩を5以上積んだ敵に強化S3を当てる。ドーセントとのセットが前提。: Lands enhanced S3 on enemies with at least 5 Mauled Color. Requires the Docent alongside him.
messages.血餐で鋏の刃を育て、出血で切り刻む。室長と同時に編成すると力を出しにくい。: Develops Scissorblades through Bloodfeast and cuts enemies up with Bleed. Struggles to reach full strength alongside the Manager.
messages.充電回数を10以上貯めたS3で出血回数を一気に増やす、硬い出血起点役。: A durable Bleed enabler that builds at least 10 Charge Count before S3 to add heavy Bleed Count.
messages.攻撃威力増加を配り、序盤から安定してマッチする。出血編成以外でも扱いやすい。: Distributes Attack Power Up for reliable early clashes. Also easy to use outside Bleed teams.
messages.自傷の出血で血餐を供給しつつ、S3で大ダメージと大回復を狙う変則タンク。: An unconventional tank that supplies Bloodfeast through self-inflicted Bleed while aiming for heavy damage and healing with S3.
messages.サポートパッシブで、精神力が最も低い味方を、同じ所属の味方が生存していればターン: The support passive restores 10 SP at Turn End to the ally with the lowest SP if an ally of that unit's affiliation remains alive.
messages.味方を回復しつつ、敵に出血・呪い・釘を撒く出血向けの回復E.G.O。: A healing E.G.O for Bleed teams that restores allies while inflicting Bleed, Curse, and Nails on enemies.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力をまとめて回復する。資源が0から始まる戦闘ではコストを稼ぎ: Restores HP and SP to all allies. Hard to fund in battles starting with zero resources.
messages.全コイン破壊不能の大型広域。出血と血餐を溜めた血鬼編成で一気に大ダメージを狙う。: A large area attack with every Coin Unbreakable. Bloodfiend teams can aim for a heavy burst after building Bleed and Bloodfeast.
messages.罪悪共鳴の数に応じて複数の味方を回復し、共鳴した属性のバフを配る。: Heals multiple allies based on Sin Resonance count and grants buffs matching the resonating affinities.
messages.出血を付与・維持できる人格で固めて戦う編成。薬指の人格を5人並べる「薬指型」と、: A team built from Identities that apply and maintain Bleed. Choose a Ring variant with 5 Ring members, or a Bloodfiend variant that cycles Bloodfeast through La Manchaland Identities.
messages.薬指の人格は出血付与が得意でフィジカルも高く、出血を現実的に維持しながら戦える。: Ring Identities combine strong Bleed application with strong physical performance, making sustained Bleed practical.
messages.敵のマイナス効果の数で強くなるスキルが多く、デバフを重ねるほど全員の火力が伸びる: Many skills scale with the number of enemy negative effects, so stacking debuffs raises the whole team's damage.
messages.薬指点描派スチューデントは、薬指型でも血鬼型でもほぼ優先して入る。: [The Ring Pointillist Student](persona:0109) is a near-priority pick in both Ring and Bloodfiend variants.
messages.薬指型: 薬指が5人以上いると、身体派の薬指の親方と薬指の子方の生体材料が10か: **Ring**: With at least 5 Ring members, the Corporist [Ring Nursefather](persona:0614) and [Ring Apprentice](persona:0215) start with 10 Corpus Ingredient for a stronger opening. Best against single targets, though the Nursefather's area S3 also handles groups.
messages.血鬼型: ラ・マンチャランド室長が、他のラ・マンチャランド人格と出血ダメージで貯: **Bloodfiends**: [The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310) enhances S3 using Bloodfeast accumulated through other La Manchaland Identities and Bleed damage. [The One Who Grips](persona:0204)'s Whistles quickly raises SP. Play on the assumption that enemy Bleed will not build very high.
messages.薬指型は、薬指野獣派ドーセントの色彩を5以上積んだ敵に、薬指野獣派スチューデント: In the Ring variant, stack at least 5 Mauled Color from [The Ring Fauvist Docent](persona:0915), then land [The Ring Fauvist Student](persona:0515)'s enhanced S3.
messages.残りの枠は出血を持つ人格で固める。マイナス効果を稼ぎやすい夜の錐カピターノやホー: Fill remaining slots with Bleed Identities. [Night Awls Capitano](persona:1213) and [Hornet【Alteration】](persona:0514) are excellent at accumulating negative effects.
messages.血鬼型のラ・マンチャランド神父は血餐の燃料役。スキルでダメージを狙うより、ガード: [The Priest of La Manchaland](persona:1210) fuels Bloodfeast in the Bloodfiend variant. Often, guarding to focus on enabling Whistles is better than trying to deal damage with his skills.
messages.オートクチュール::ル・ルージュ 赤き神(シンクレア)とル・ルージュ ブティーク: [Haute Couture:: The Crimson God of Le Rouge](persona:1016) Sinclair and [Haute Couture:: Boutique du Rouge](persona:0816) Ishmael also make a strong pair. The Crimson God's S2 and S3 hurt allies, but Le Rouge Identities take priority for those hits and endure through self-healing. More Le Rouge Identities make the package stronger.
messages.回復は呪いの釘(ロージャ)と水袋(ファウスト)が中心。血鬼型は渇望-ミルカラ(ド: Healing mainly comes from Rodion's [Hex Nail](ego:0907) and Faust's [Fluid Sac](ego:0202). The Bloodfiend variant can aim for a large burst through Don Quixote's [Yearning-Mircalla](ego:0307).
messages.薬指型はほぼ固定編成で、5人そろわないと身体派の初動が弱い。: The Ring variant has a largely fixed lineup. Without all 5, the Corporist members have a weak opening.
messages.水袋は、資源が0から始まる通常戦闘ではコストを稼ぎにくい。: Fluid Sac is hard to fund in Regular Encounters starting with zero resources.
messages.【リンバス】出血編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Bleed Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの出血編成。出血を付与・維持できる人格で固めて戦う編成。薬指の人格を5人: Limbus Company Bleed team guide: Identities that apply and maintain Bleed. Covers the Ring variant with 5 Ring members and the Bloodfiend variant that cycles Bloodfeast with La Manchaland Identities, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.AEDDグレゴールと電信柱で充電を配り、充電人格を並べる形。充電が溜まれば次々と: Deploy Charge Identities and supply Charge through AEDD Gregor and Telepole. Once charged, they can sweep enemy after enemy, but early clash strength is low. AEDD Gregor gives Charge to allies earlier in deployment order, so place him fourth, or third.
messages.編成順が前の味方へ充電回数を配る中核。4番(3番)に置く。: The core Charge Count supplier for earlier allies. Place him fourth, or third.
messages.愛/憎悪を貯めて逆転形態に移り、広域のS3でなぎ払う。: Builds Love/Hate to enter Reversed form, then sweeps enemies with area S3.
messages.バリアと防御レベル増加で非常に打たれ強く、S3を最大強化で撃つ。: Highly durable through Shield and Defense Level Up, then unleashes S3 at maximum enhancement.
messages.S2で自分と味方に充電力場を配り、W社の味方を強化する。: S2 gives Charge Barrier to herself and allies, strengthening W Corp. allies.
messages.スキルを強化しながら戦い、強化S3で大ダメージと味方の回復を行う自己完結型。: A self-sufficient Identity that enhances her skills and uses enhanced S3 for heavy damage and ally healing.
messages.充電を育てるほど強い打撃アタッカー。耐久は最低クラス。: A Blunt attacker that grows stronger with Charge. Among the frailest Identities.
messages.絶望状態で高火力と大量の沈潜を押し付ける。: Delivers high damage and heavy Sinking in Despair.
messages.サポートパッシブで、最速の味方が充電を得るか消耗するスキルを使うとクイック1を付: The support passive grants 1 Haste when the fastest ally uses a skill that gains or consumes Charge.
messages.軽いコストで自分と味方全体に充電回数を配る中核。: The core E.G.O: distributes Charge Count to the user and all allies at low cost.
messages.憂鬱と嫉妬が余りやすいので、連打して体力と精神力を回復する。: Surplus Gloom and Envy allow repeated uses to restore HP and SP.
messages.攻撃した味方に充電を配る。: Distributes Charge to allies that attack.
messages.充電で加重値を伸ばし、味方に回復を配る。: Charge increases Attack Weight while the E.G.O provides ally healing.
messages.ル・ノワールの2人とお直し室で振動を積み、振動-保存の振動爆発で削る形。ル・ノワ: Build Tremor with the Le Noir pair and Alteration Shop, then deal damage through Tremor - Conservation bursts. Bursts triggered by Le Noir Identities do not reduce Tremor Count, allowing repeated bursts while preserving the stack. The Brand Manager's Judgment! triggers alongside the Footwear Hall's attacks, so use both together. Alteration Shop mainly supports the earliest ally, so put the Brand Manager first. Put AEDD Gregor fourth to supply Charge to the first 3; Preservation increases like Charge.
messages.S3で振動-保存へ振幅変換して振動爆発する中核。S3・守備で保存神域を得て、全味: The core unit, using S3 to convert Tremor to Conservation and burst it. S3 and defense grant Sanctum of Conservation to share Shield with all allies and lower enemy Speed. Place her first.
messages.コートを溜めてバリアで耐え、アルミュール・エヴェイエ状態になるとS3が「ワンキッ: Builds her coat and endures through Shield. In Armure Éveillée, S3 becomes Single Kick and triggers repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.編成順が前の味方へ充電回数を配る中核。4番に置く。: The core Charge Count supplier for earlier allies. Place him fourth.
messages.回避と追撃で動く充電破裂人格。資源を集めやすい。: A Charge and Rupture Identity that acts through evade and follow-ups. Generates resources readily.
messages.戦闘開始時、編成順が最も早い味方(充電人格を優先)と体力の比率が最も低い味方に、: At Combat Start, grants Offense Level Up and Shield to the earliest ally, prioritizing Charge Identities, and the ally with the lowest HP percentage. S2 and S3 also trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.サポートパッシブで、編成順1番の味方がスキルで振動爆発させると、25%の確率で振: The support passive has a 25% chance to add 1 Tremor Burst when the first deployed ally bursts Tremor with a skill, once per turn. Lacks the Charge keyword, but fits this burst-focused variant.
messages.軽いコストで自分と味方全体に充電回数を配る。保存も同じく増える。: Distributes Charge Count to the user and all allies at low cost. Preservation increases in the same way.
messages.ル・ノワールの2人をそろえると、毎ターンの追撃で充電威力の溜まりがほぼ2倍になる: Using both Le Noir Identities nearly doubles their Charge Potency buildup through follow-ups each turn. Alteration Shop Rodion also has strong synergy with Le Noir, distributing Shield to hold the line.
messages.保存神域で全味方にバリアを配る。充電回数を意識しなくてよい。: Sanctum of Conservation gives all allies Shield. Does not require close Charge Count management.
messages.コートを育ててから攻撃形態に変わり、火力を出す。: Develops her coat before entering an offensive form to deal damage.
messages.S1で味方に充電回数・攻撃レベル増加・バリアを配るバッファー。強い充電人格を1番: A buffer that gives allies Charge Count, Offense Level Up, and Shield through S1. Put a strong Charge Identity first.
messages.どちらも出血を扱う充電人格で、最新の充電アタッカーとして強い。この2人を主軸にす: Both are Charge Identities using Bleed and are strong modern Charge attackers. If building around these 2, a Bleed team better realizes their strengths.
messages.生体材料を育てて出血付与を強化し、S3の広域でも攻める。: Develops Corpus Ingredient to enhance Bleed application and also attacks through area S3.
messages.赤眼と懺悔でスキルを強化し、強化S3で大ダメージと回復を行う。全てが高水準で、嫉: Red Eyes and Penitence enhance her skills, while enhanced S3 deals heavy damage and heals. Strong across the board and easy to include in Envy Resonance and Fluid Sac setups.
messages.S2を主力に戦い、充電が溜まったらS3で大きく削る。即座に高火力を出せ、火力では: Mainly uses S2, then strikes hard with S3 once Charge builds. Can deliver high damage immediately and exceeds Red Eyes & Penitence in damage output.
messages.充電回数を消耗するたびに充電威力が育つ打撃アタッカー。火力は非常に高いが、耐久は: A Blunt attacker whose Charge Potency grows whenever she spends Count. Extremely high damage, but among the frailest Identities.
messages.絶望状態で高火力と沈潜を押し付ける。充電アタッカーとして申し分ない。: Deals heavy damage and Sinking in Despair. Fully capable as a Charge attacker.
messages.生体材料を育てて出血付与を強化する出血アタッカー。S3は広域。: A Bleed attacker that develops Corpus Ingredient to improve application. S3 is an area attack.
messages.出血回数の維持が得意な充電出血人格。: A Charge and Bleed Identity that excels at maintaining Bleed Count.
messages.味方に充電回数・攻撃レベル増加・バリアを配るタンク寄りのバッファー。強い充電人格: A tank-oriented buffer that grants allies Charge Count, Offense Level Up, and Shield. Put a strong Charge Identity first.
messages.全味方にバリアを配り、戦線を支える。充電人格を少数入れる形でも補助できる。: Distributes Shield to all allies to hold the line. Can also support lineups with only a few Charge Identities.
messages.充電を手段に破裂を大量に付与する、破裂寄りの人格。: A Rupture-oriented Identity that uses Charge to apply heavy Rupture.
messages.S1・S2で充電を貯め、5コインのS3でマッチとダメージを取る。充電の管理に失敗: Builds Charge through S1 and S2, then uses the 5-Coin S3 for clashes and damage. Charge mismanagement has severe consequences.
messages.充電威力を育てるほど強い長期戦向けの打撃アタッカー。初動が非常に弱く、上級者向け: A Blunt attacker for long fights that grows stronger with Charge Potency. A very weak opening makes him better for experienced players.
messages.充電回数を消耗するたびに充電威力が育つ。光電で味方の充電回数も補える。: Charge Potency grows with each expenditure of Charge Count. Photoelectricity also supplies allies' Count.
messages.充電を消耗して束縛・攻撃威力減少・麻痺を入れるデバッファー。単体ボスに強い。: A debuffer that spends Charge to inflict Bind, Attack Power Down, and Paralyze. Strong against single bosses.
messages.全スキルで振動威力を多く付与するので、ル・ノワール型では振動-保存の振動爆発を大: Every skill applies substantial Tremor Potency, increasing Conservation burst damage in the Le Noir variant. Poor at adding Tremor Count. An older 00 Identity with low damage and durability.
messages.軽いコストで自分と味方全体に充電回数を配り、充電編成の下準備を一度で済ませる。こ: Distributes Charge Count to the user and all allies at low cost, completing the team's setup in one use. The core E.G.O for this team.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力をまとめて回復する。憂鬱と嫉妬が余りやすく、連打して押し切: Restores HP and SP to all allies. Surplus Gloom and Envy support repeated use to outlast enemies. Secure Lust as well.
messages.敵に放出電流を付け、攻撃した味方に充電を配る。: Applies Spark Discharge to enemies, distributing Charge to allies that attack them.
messages.充電で加重値を伸ばし、味方に詠唱と回復を配る大型広域。愛と憎悪の人格と特に噛み合: A large area attack that gains Attack Weight through Charge and grants allies Magical Girl's Chant and healing. Particularly compatible with the In the Name of Love and Hate Identity.
messages.体力を払って充電を補充し、すぐ消費してダメージを伸ばす広域。: An area attack that trades HP to replenish Charge, then immediately spends it for more damage.
messages.充電人格を並べ、AEDD(グレゴール)や電信柱(ドンキホーテ)の充電供給で強化条: Deploy Charge Identities and meet their enhancement conditions through Charge supplied by [AEDD](persona:1215) Gregor or Don Quixote's [Telepole](ego:0303). Choose the W Corp. and AEDD variant built around Charge users, or the Le Noir variant that repeatedly bursts Tremor through the Le Noir pair.
messages.W社・AEDD型: 充電が溜まれば次々と敵をなぎ払える、長い通常戦闘向けの形。序: **W Corp. and AEDD**: Suited to long Regular Encounters, sweeping successive enemies once Charge builds. Early clashes are weak, and single-boss damage is modest.
messages.ル・ノワール型: ル・ノワール ブランドマネージャー(ドンキホーテ)とル・ノワー: **Le Noir**: Choose this if you have both [Haute Couture:: Le Noir Brand Manager](persona:0315) Don Quixote and [Haute Couture:: Le Noir Footwear Hall](persona:0416) Ryōshū. The Brand Manager maintains positive Count generation for both Preservation and Tremor, reducing management demands. Conservation bursts from Le Noir Identities do not reduce Tremor Count, allowing repeated bursts even against a single boss. Sanctum of Conservation and Shield also provide high durability.
messages.各人格の強化条件が自分の充電で完結しているので、溜まってしまえば安定して強い。: Each Identity's enhancement conditions rely on its own Charge, making the team consistently strong once Charge has built.
messages.憂鬱と嫉妬の資源が集まりやすく、水袋を連打して回復で押し切れる。: Gloom and Envy resources accumulate readily, allowing repeated [Fluid Sac](ego:0202) uses to outlast enemies through healing.
messages.W社の人格は、W社3級整理要員チーフの充電力場でまとめて強化できる。: [W Corp. L3 Cleanup Captain](persona:1110)'s Charge Barrier can strengthen W Corp. Identities together.
messages.AEDDグレゴールは、自分より編成順が前の味方に充電回数を配るので、4番(3番): AEDD Gregor gives Charge Count to allies earlier in deployment order. Place him fourth, or third.
messages.パッシブは、AEDDグレゴール、愛と憎悪の名の下に(ドンキホーテ)の順に優先して: Prioritize activating AEDD Gregor's passive, then [In the Name of Love and Hate](persona:0312) Don Quixote's. First gather 2 Gloom and 2 Envy, then aim for 4 Envy Resonance.
messages.電信柱・愛と憎悪の名の下に・AEDDはE.G.Oのパッシブが強いので、折を見て撃: Telepole, [In the Name of Love and Hate](ego:0309), and [AEDD](ego:1204) have strong E.G.O passives, so use them when an opportunity arises.
messages.水袋を撃つため、色欲を出せる人格も入れる。: Include a Lust-generating Identity to fuel Fluid Sac.
messages.ブランドマネージャーは、シューズフロアが攻撃する前に「審判！」で一方攻撃する(1: The Brand Manager makes an unopposed Judgment! attack before the Footwear Hall attacks, once per turn. This follow-up nearly doubles Preservation Potency buildup, so deploy both together.
messages.ブランドマネージャーは、初手に反撃かS3を使って保存神域を取る。保存神域は3ター: Open with the Brand Manager's counter or S3 to gain Sanctum of Conservation. It lasts 3 turns, so regularly use S3 or counter to keep it active.
messages.お直し室(ロージャ)は、編成順が最も早い味方(充電人格を優先)を重点的に支えるの: [Alteration Shop](persona:0917) Rodion mainly supports the earliest ally, prioritizing Charge Identities. Put the Brand Manager first.
messages.AEDDグレゴールは4番に置き、前の3人に充電回数を配る。保存も充電と同じく増え: Place AEDD Gregor fourth to supply Charge Count to the first 3 allies. Preservation increases like Charge.
messages.裏置きの20区ユロージヴィ(ホンル)は、編成順1番の味方の振動爆発に、25%の確: Benched [District 20 Yurodivy](persona:0609) Hong Lu has a 25% chance to add 1 Tremor Burst to the first deployed ally's burst.
messages.W社・AEDD型の最大の問題は初動の弱さ。充電が無い序盤はマッチに負けやすく、負: The W Corp. and AEDD variant's main weakness is its opening. Without Charge, clashes are easy to lose; losing also prevents Charge gains, creating a vicious cycle.
messages.耐久の低い人格が多いので、被弾を避けるよう動かす。: Many members have low durability, so play to avoid taking hits.
messages.各人格の充電回数を常に管理する必要がある。W社3級整理要員(ドンキホーテ)とトナ: Constantly manage each Identity's Charge Count. W Corp. L3 Cleanup Agent Don Quixote and the Reindeer Identities have severe penalties for mismanagement; leave them out while learning if needed.
messages.W社・AEDD型は、単体ボスへの火力が控えめ。: The W Corp. and AEDD variant has modest damage against single bosses.
messages.ル・ノワール型は、ル・ノワールの2人がそろわないと「審判！」が出ず、保存威力の溜: Without both Le Noir Identities, Judgment! does not trigger and Preservation Potency builds more slowly.
messages.【リンバス】充電編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Charge Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの充電編成。充電人格を並べ、AEDD(グレゴール)や電信柱(ドンキホーテ: Limbus Company Charge team guide: Charge Identities powered by Charge from AEDD Gregor and Don Quixote's Telepole. Covers the W Corp. and AEDD variant and the Le Noir variant that stacks Tremor Bursts, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.夜明組の火傷と親指組の振動を溜め、振動-灼熱の振動爆発で憤怒ダメージに変える形。: Build Burn through the Dawn Office and Tremor through the Thumb, then convert both into Wrath damage through Tremor - Scorch bursts. This variant has the highest damage; in long fights, the usual approach relies on the Dawn Office trio, the Nursefather, and Blade Ryōshū.
messages.変身して火傷を大量に稼ぎ、追撃で資源も増やす。: Transforms to build heavy Burn and generates resources through follow-ups.
messages.棺を溜めて強化S3を撃つ火力役。振動-灼熱にも変換する。: A damage dealer that builds Coffin for enhanced S3. Also converts Tremor to Tremor - Scorch.
messages.明け方で夜明け迎えを配り、振動爆発も起こす。: Crack of Dawn distributes Dawnherald and also triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.予知眼で攻撃をいなし、「処分」で火傷と振動を叩き込む。: Handles attacks with The Eye of Precognition and unleashes Disposal for Burn and Tremor.
messages.決闘高潮を積み、強化S3で振動爆発を重ねる。: Builds The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts through enhanced S3.
messages.猛虎標弾の強化S3で振動-灼熱の振動爆発を起こす。: Savage Tigermark Rounds enhance S3 to trigger Tremor - Scorch bursts.
messages.振動人格ではないが、単体で非常に強い火力役として長期戦で採用される。: Lacks the Tremor keyword, but is used in long fights as an exceptionally strong independent damage dealer.
messages.振動人格ではないが、サポートパッシブで火傷回数を稼ぎ、振動-灼熱の元になる火傷を: Lacks the Tremor keyword, but the support passive adds Burn Count to sustain the Burn used by Tremor - Scorch.
messages.火傷を付与した敵に撃つと大量の火傷・振動を付与し、振動-灼熱の火力が大きく伸びる: Used against an enemy already carrying Burn, it applies large amounts of Burn and Tremor, greatly raising Tremor - Scorch damage.
messages.憤怒脆弱を付けて、憤怒中心の振動-灼熱ダメージを伸ばす。: Wrath Fragility raises the Wrath-focused damage of Tremor - Scorch.
messages.解析Ⅴで、資源を稼ぎながら大きく回復できる。: At Threadspin Ⅴ, provides substantial healing while generating resources.
messages.振動でマッチ力を上げながら、振動爆発と攻撃を繰り返す形。単体ボスでは、準備が整う: Improve clash strength through Tremor while repeatedly attacking and triggering Tremor Bursts. Against a single boss, use the 2 T Corp. members' Tremor - Chain to lower enemy Clash Power during setup, then convert to Tremor - Reverb when attacking to turn bursts into direct damage.
messages.時間貸与でクイックとマッチ威力を得て序盤からマッチを取る中核。S2で振動-鎖へ変: A core unit that gains Haste and Clash Power through Borrowed Time for strong early clashes. S2 converts Tremor to Tremor - Chain.
messages.挑発値で攻撃を集め、振動爆発で殴り返すタンク。: A tank that draws attacks through Aggro and strikes back with Tremor Burst.
messages.時間貸与で序盤からマッチを制し、振動-鎖で敵のマッチ威力を下げる。: Controls early clashes through Borrowed Time and lowers enemy Clash Power with Tremor - Chain.
messages.強化S3で振動-灼熱の振動爆発を起こす。: Enhanced S3 triggers Tremor - Scorch bursts.
messages.灼熱推進弾でS3の振動爆発を重ね、カポIIIIに弾を補給する。: Scorch Propellant Ammo enables repeated S3 Tremor Bursts and replenishes Capo IIII's ammunition.
messages.振動回数を10以上貯め、S3で振動-反響と振動爆発3回を叩き込む仕上げ役。: A finisher that builds at least 10 Tremor Count, then uses S3 for Tremor - Reverb and 3 Tremor Bursts.
messages.S2・S3で振動を撒き、デバフと防御レベル減少で編成全体の火力を支える。: Spreads Tremor through S2 and S3, while debuffs and Defense Level Down raise the whole team's damage.
messages.弾丸を最後に撃ち切ったコインに追加ダメージを与える。カポIIIIやソルダートII: Adds damage to the Coin that fires the final round, increasing Capo IIII or Soldato II's S3 damage.
messages.大量の振動と連続の振動爆発を押し付けるフィニッシャー。撃った後は振幅が元に戻るの: A finisher that applies heavy Tremor and repeated Tremor Bursts. The Amplitude returns to its original state afterward, so prepare to convert again if the enemy survives.
messages.振動を振動-反響に変換し、振動爆発で怠惰ダメージを広域に与える。: Converts Tremor to Tremor - Reverb and deals Sloth damage over an area through Tremor Burst.
messages.火傷と振動を押し付けて振動爆発させる。: Inflicts Burn and Tremor, then triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.敵に大量の振動を付与してから、《低いなきごえ》で振動-反響に変換し、振動爆発で怠: Apply heavy Tremor, convert it to Tremor - Reverb with Cavernous Wailing, then deal Sloth damage through bursts. Pair Potency and Count suppliers with Heishou and Thumb Identities that trigger repeated bursts. Slow setup makes this better for long fights against single bosses.
messages.S2「振動弾」で大量の振動を即座に入れる供給役。: Immediately supplies heavy Tremor with S2 Quake Rounds.
messages.振動を付与しながら振動爆発を重ねる。脳震盪で振動爆発の混乱区間前進を伸ばし、号令: Applies Tremor while repeatedly bursting it. Concussion increases the Stagger Threshold raised by Tremor Burst, while Commanding Cry also supports allies' clashes.
messages.自分と敵の間で振動回数を循環させ、大量に供給する。: Cycles Tremor Count between herself and the enemy to supply large amounts.
messages.猛虎標弾で強化したS3が大量の振動と3連の振動爆発を押し付ける、振動の主力。: A main Tremor attacker whose Savage Tigermark-enhanced S3 applies heavy Tremor and 3 consecutive bursts.
messages.振動人格ではないが、ファウストの枠で《永続》を撃つために入れる。速い攻撃と破裂で: Lacks the Tremor keyword, but fills Faust's slot to use Everlasting. Fast attacks and Rupture provide damage while Tremor is being prepared.
messages.S3で振動-反響と振動爆発3回を叩き込む仕上げ役。: A finisher that uses S3 for Tremor - Reverb and 3 Tremor Bursts.
messages.振動爆発の回数が多く、振動-反響で火力を稼ぐ。: Triggers many Tremor Bursts to deal damage through Tremor - Reverb.
messages.振動を振動-反響に変換し、振動爆発で怠惰ダメージを広域に与える中核。: The core E.G.O: converts Tremor to Tremor - Reverb and deals Sloth damage over an area through bursts.
messages.大量の振動と連続の振動爆発を押し付けるフィニッシャー。: A finisher that applies heavy Tremor and repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.3人同時に出すと夜明事務所の連携追撃が揃い、圧倒的な火傷威力・回数を稼ぐ。追撃で: Deploying all 3 completes the Dawn Office's coordinated follow-ups and generates overwhelming Burn Potency and Count. Follow-ups also handle ordinary enemies. Combine with the Thumb to convert Burn and Tremor into Wrath damage through Tremor - Scorch.
messages.変身して火傷回数をばらまく。振動は付与しない。: Transforms to spread Burn Count. Does not apply Tremor.
messages.棺を溜めて強化S3と「正午の解体」を撃ち、振動-灼熱へ変換する。: Builds Coffin for enhanced S3 and Dismemberment at High Noon, converting Tremor to Tremor - Scorch.
messages.夜明け迎えを配り、強化したS2で振動爆発も起こす。: Distributes Dawnherald and also triggers Tremor Burst through enhanced S2.
messages.火傷と振動を並に付与し、S3の振動-灼熱による振動爆発で大火力を出す。ソルダート: Applies Burn and Tremor together, then deals heavy damage through S3's Tremor - Scorch bursts. Soldato II's ammunition supply is useful in medium or long fights. Soldato II and Dawn Office Fixer are both Sinclair, so choose one.
messages.予知眼と「処分」の親方。予知眼がある間は子方が追撃し、過熱中は子方が援護防御でか: A Nursefather using The Eye of Precognition and Disposal. The Apprentice follows up while the eye is active and protects him through Assist Defense while it is overheated.
messages.決闘高潮で振動爆発を重ねる子方。: An Apprentice that uses The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.猛虎標弾の強化S3で振動爆発を起こす。: Savage Tigermark Rounds enhance S3 to trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.灼熱推進弾でS3の振動爆発を重ね、弾丸を補給する。: Scorch Propellant Ammo enables repeated S3 bursts while supplying ammunition.
messages.2人とも時間貸与で序盤からマッチを制し、振動-鎖で敵のマッチ威力を下げる。単体ボ: Both control early clashes through Borrowed Time and lower enemy Clash Power with Tremor - Chain. Good for defending during setup against a single boss.
messages.時間猶予で溜めたダメージを怠惰ダメージとして与える。: Releases damage accumulated under Time Moratorium as Sloth damage.
messages.S2で振動-鎖へ変換し、振動回数も維持する。: S2 converts Tremor to Tremor - Chain while also maintaining Count.
messages.灼熱推進弾でS3の振動爆発を重ね、弾丸を使う味方に補給する。S3以外は控えめ。: Scorch Propellant Ammo enables repeated S3 bursts and replenishes ammunition-using allies. Modest outside S3.
messages.S1・S2で振動回数を貯め、S3で振動-反響と振動爆発3回を叩き込む仕上げ役。振: A finisher that builds Tremor Count through S1 and S2, then uses S3 for Tremor - Reverb and 3 bursts. Also has strong basic performance independently of Tremor.
messages.S1で振動回数を貯め、S2・S3を複数攻撃にして振動を撒く。デバフと防御レベル減: Builds Tremor Count with S1, then makes S2 and S3 hit multiple targets to spread Tremor. Debuffs and Defense Level Down support the whole team's damage.
messages.味方が付けた振動を足場に、振動の多い敵へ強化スキルでマッチと火力を受け持つ。: Uses allies' Tremor application to enhance clashes and damage against enemies with high Tremor.
messages.S2「振動弾」で大量の振動を即座に入れ、味方の条件を一気に満たす。S3の脆弱で後: S2 Quake Rounds immediately supplies heavy Tremor to fulfill allies' conditions. S3's Fragile also raises damage from allies acting later.
messages.S1を捨ててS2・S3を連発し、振動爆発を多く起こす。振動-反響で火力を稼ぐのが: Discards S1 to repeatedly use S2 and S3 for many Tremor Bursts. Excels at dealing damage through Tremor - Reverb.
messages.3種の追撃でダメージを重ねる。振動爆発に関わりながら火力を伸ばす。: Three follow-ups add damage while contributing to Tremor Bursts.
messages.光札を貯めて追撃「光斬」を放つ。振動爆発に関わりながら火力を伸ばす。: Gathers Bright cards for Kōzan [光斬] follow-ups, raising damage while contributing to Tremor Bursts.
messages.振動人格ではないが、パッシブで味方の精神力を支え、立ち上がりを速める。: Lacks the Tremor keyword, but her passive supports allies' SP for a faster opening.
messages.S1を捨てて自分の振動回数を溜め、S2・S3で振動爆発を繰り返す。パッシブで防御: Discards S1 to build his own Tremor Count, then repeatedly bursts Tremor through S2 and S3. His passive also spreads Defense Level Down.
messages.自分の振動回数を溜めて敵に移す、振動回数の供給役。自分では振動爆発をほぼ起こせな: A Count supplier that builds his own Tremor Count and transfers it to enemies. Can barely trigger Tremor Burst himself.
messages.全スキルで振動威力を付与する供給役。振動回数は味方に任せる。: Supplies Tremor Potency through every skill. Relies on allies for Count.
messages.充電回数を保ってS2のコインを再使用し、振動付与と振動爆発で大ダメージを出す。: Maintains Charge Count to reuse S2's Coins, dealing heavy damage through Tremor application and Burst.
messages.自分と敵の間で振動回数を循環させ、振動回数を大量に供給する。: Cycles Tremor Count between herself and enemies to supply large amounts.
messages.サポートパッシブで、弾丸を最も少なく持つ味方が最後の弾丸を撃ったコインに追加ダメ: The support passive adds damage to the Coin on which the ally with the least ammunition fires their final round. Raises the S3 damage of Thumb ammunition users.
messages.振動人格ではないが、サポートパッシブで火傷回数の付与値を+1し、振動-灼熱の元に: Lacks the Tremor keyword, but the support passive adds 1 to Burn Count application, sustaining the Burn used by Tremor - Scorch.
messages.火傷を付与した敵に撃つと大量の火傷・振動を付与し、振動-灼熱の火力が爆発的に伸び: Against an enemy already carrying Burn, it applies heavy Burn and Tremor, dramatically raising Tremor - Scorch damage. The most important E.G.O for that variant.
messages.大量の振動と連続の振動爆発を怠惰ダメージで押し付けるフィニッシャー。撃った後は振: A finisher that delivers heavy Tremor and repeated bursts as Sloth damage. The Amplitude returns to its original state afterward.
messages.振動を振動-反響に変換して振動爆発を起こし、怠惰ダメージを広域に与える。: Converts Tremor to Tremor - Reverb and triggers bursts for Sloth damage over an area.
messages.火傷と憤怒脆弱をばらまく。与ダメージが憤怒中心の振動-灼熱型と相性がよい。: Spreads Burn and Wrath Fragility, fitting the Wrath-focused damage of Tremor - Scorch teams.
messages.広域攻撃・火傷付与・味方最大3名の回復を同時にこなす。: Combines area attacks, Burn application, and healing for up to 3 allies.
messages.解析Ⅴ前提。体力の低い味方に回復・クイック・資源獲得量+1を配る。: Assumes Threadspin Ⅴ. Gives low-HP allies healing, Haste, and +1 resource generation.
messages.操作パネル左端のスキルのコイン威力を底上げする。: Raises the Coin Power of the skill in the leftmost dashboard slot.
messages.振動を付与してマッチ力を上げ、振動爆発で攻める編成。火傷と振動を振動-灼熱で憤怒: A team that applies Tremor to improve clashes and attacks through Tremor Bursts. Choose Tremor - Scorch to turn Burn and Tremor into Wrath damage, physical Tremor around the T Corp. pair to alternate Chain and Reverb, or Tremor - Reverb through Cavernous Wailing to turn bursts into direct damage.
messages.振動-灼熱は、回数が余りがちな火傷と振動を手早く憤怒ダメージに変えられる。: Tremor - Scorch quickly converts Burn and Tremor, which tend to have surplus Count, into Wrath damage.
messages.混乱の踏み倒しや自己回復を持つ人格が多く耐久力が高い。回復E.G.Oも豊富で、破: Many members can bypass Stagger or heal themselves, giving the team high durability. Plenty of healing E.G.O also help against Unbreakable Coins.
messages.夜明組の追撃を使えば、単体特化に見えて雑魚処理もこなせる。: Dawn Office follow-ups let the team handle ordinary enemies despite appearing specialized for single targets.
messages.振動-灼熱型: 夜明組3人の火傷と、親指組の振動を合わせる。火力が最も高い。夜明: **Tremor - Scorch**: Combine Burn from all 3 Dawn Office members with the Thumb's Tremor. This variant has the highest damage. The Dawn Office trio must be deployed together and is Walpurgisnacht-exclusive, so choose according to your roster.
messages.物理振動型: T社3級強制徴収職職員とT社3級徴収職職員が中心。単体ボスでは、準: **Physical Tremor**: Build around [T Corp. Class 3 VDCU Staff](persona:1113) and [T Corp. Class 3 Collection Staff](persona:0309). Against a single boss, lower enemy Clash Power with Tremor - Chain during setup, then convert to Reverb when attacking to turn bursts into direct damage.
messages.振動-反響型: 振動の威力と回数を供給する人格に、振動爆発を重ねる黒獣-午 筆頭: **Tremor - Reverb**: Pair Potency and Count suppliers with repeated-burst users such as [Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept](persona:0114) and [The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512). Convert and burst through Hong Lu's [Cavernous Wailing](ego:0606). Use [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212) as Faust and give her Everlasting. Slow setup and demanding play make this better for long fights against single bosses.
messages.パッシブはどの人格も強力なので、序盤のうちに発動させる。振動-灼熱型なら、追撃を: Every member has a strong passive, so activate them early. In the Scorch variant, prioritize the 2 Dawn Office members that trigger follow-ups.
messages.カポーテ(ムルソー)は、ある程度火傷を付与した敵に撃つと大量の火傷・振動を付与し: Use Meursault's [Capote](ego:0504) against an enemy with some Burn already applied. It adds heavy Burn and Tremor, greatly increasing Scorch damage.
messages.永続は大量の振動爆発を押し付けるフィニッシャー。撃った後は振幅が元に戻るので、倒: [Everlasting](ego:0206) is a finisher that forces many Tremor Bursts. The Amplitude returns to its original state afterward, so prepare to convert again if the enemy survives.
messages.振動-灼熱型の与ダメージは憤怒中心なので、憤怒脆弱を付ける4本目のマッチの火(ロ: Scorch damage is mainly Wrath, making Rodion's [4th Match Flame](ego:0902), which applies Wrath Fragility, a strong option.
messages.振動-灼熱型は斬撃が主体で、打撃に弱い人格が多い。与ダメージが憤怒中心なので、敵: The Scorch variant mainly uses Slash, and many members are weak to Blunt. Since damage is Wrath-focused, enemy Wrath resistance strongly affects the matchup.
messages.火傷と振動の両方の回数を見る必要があり、扱いは難しい。ただし回数の収支はどちらも: Managing both Burn and Tremor Count makes the team demanding. However, both have stable Count generation, so they are unlikely to run out once the cycle is established.
messages.【リンバス】振動編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Tremor Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの振動編成。振動を付与してマッチ力を上げ、振動爆発で攻める編成。火傷と振: Limbus Company Tremor team guide: apply Tremor to win Clashes and attack through Tremor Bursts. Covers the Tremor - Scorch, physical Tremor (T Corp.), and Tremor - Reverb (Cavernous Wailing) variants, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.中指の人格で常に嫉妬完全共鳴6を発動し、守備からS3を反撃で連打する形。受けては: Maintain 6 Envy Absolute Resonance with Middle Identities and repeatedly use S3 counters through defense. Clash normally against attacks you cannot afford to take; counter weaker attacks. Lamp Gregor in position 7 is guaranteed to act last, preserving Envy Resonance.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6で守備の反撃を「怨念スタンピング」に変え、剣を解放する中核。: The core unit: 6 Envy Absolute Resonance turns her counter into Stamp of Vengeance while unlocking her sword.
messages.中指を強力に支えるバッファー兼エース。: A buffer and ace attacker that strongly supports Middle teams.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6以上で守備の反撃がS3になる。: At least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance turns her defense counter into S3.
messages.被弾で復讐対象を付け、共鳴6以上で守備がS3の反撃になる。: Taking hits marks enemies for vengeance; at least 6 Resonance turns defense into an S3 counter.
messages.S2で両隣の嫉妬を強化し、精神力を回復する。: S2 enhances adjacent allies' Envy and restores SP.
messages.守備の反撃を「正義の仕返し」に変えて大ダメージを返す。: Turns her defense counter into A Just Vengeance for heavy retaliation.
messages.7番に置けば嫉妬共鳴を邪魔しない。眩惑で被ダメージを上げ、憂鬱・傲慢も稼ぐ。: In position 7, does not disrupt Envy Resonance. Dazzle increases damage taken, while skills also generate Gloom and Pride.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で体力と精神力を少し回復する、定番の裏置き。: A standard bench pick that restores a little HP and SP through Envy Resonance.
messages.嫉妬資源を足りない資源に変換し、2名を回復する。: Converts Envy resources into missing affinities and heals 2 allies.
messages.嫉妬共鳴6で味方全体に嫉妬ダメージ量増加を配る。: At 6 Envy Resonance, grants all allies Envy Damage Up.
messages.完全共鳴したターンに攻撃・防御レベル+5。: Grants +5 Offense and Defense Level on turns with Absolute Resonance.
messages.中指6人の完全共鳴で全体の体力を22%回復する。: The 6 Middle members' Absolute Resonance enables 22% HP healing for everyone.
messages.嫉妬資源だけで撃てる回復E.G.O。: A healing E.G.O that costs only Envy resources.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6を保ち、守備の反撃を「怨念スタンピング」に変えて殴りながら剣を解放: An ace attacker that maintains 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, transforms her defense counter into Stamp of Vengeance while unlocking her sword, then crushes enemies with Lævateinn.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6を作り、守備から反撃を撃つ。中指編成を強烈に支えるバッファー兼エー: Forms 6 Envy Absolute Resonance and counters through defense. A buffer and ace attacker that strongly supports the Middle.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6以上で守備の反撃がS3になる。被弾で怨恨を貯め、反撃のS3で刺青を: At least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance turns defense into an S3 counter. Taking hits builds Grudge, and the S3 counter develops her tattoos.
messages.被弾で敵に復讐対象を付け、嫉妬完全共鳴6以上で守備がS3の反撃になる打撃人格。: A Blunt Identity that marks enemies for vengeance when hit; at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance turns defense into an S3 counter.
messages.S2で両隣の嫉妬を強化し、精神力を回復する支援役。00人格。: A 00 support that enhances adjacent allies' Envy and restores SP with S2.
messages.守備の反撃を攻撃レベルの高い「正義の仕返し」に変える。: Turns her defense counter into the high-Offense-Level A Just Vengeance.
messages.7番に置くと確定で最も遅く動き、嫉妬共鳴を邪魔しない。貫通耐性で破壊不能コインも: Position 7 guarantees the slowest action, preserving Envy Resonance. Pierce resistance also helps take Unbreakable Coins.
messages.確定で最も遅く動くので共鳴を邪魔しにくい。守備が嫉妬で、S3の次ターンデバフが強: Guaranteed to act slowest, making Resonance easier to preserve. Envy defense, powerful next-turn S3 debuffs, and high durability.
messages.守備が嫉妬の回避で、痛い攻撃を避けられる。水袋の資源も出せる。: Envy evade avoids dangerous attacks. Also generates Fluid Sac resources.
messages.守備が嫉妬の防御で、水袋の資源も出せる。体力は低め。: Envy guard and Fluid Sac resource generation, but relatively low HP.
messages.素のスペックが高い。1ターン目に共鳴を邪魔する確率がある。: Strong basic performance. May disrupt Resonance on turn 1.
messages.嫉妬の回避と追撃のS1を持つ。精神力が高い戦闘で活躍しやすい。: Has an Envy evade and an S1 follow-up. Easier to use in battles with high SP.
messages.嫉妬が多く、減算S3が広域になる。集団戦では中指の末妹と入れ替える価値がある。: Many Envy skills and an area negative-Coin S3. Worth swapping in for the Middle Little Sister in group fights.
messages.嫉妬2共鳴で体力最低の味方の反撃威力+2。中指の子方と同じ囚人なので、人格が揃わ: At 2 Envy Resonance, grants +2 Counter Power to the lowest-HP ally. Shares a Sinner with the Middle Apprentice, making her an alternative while your roster is incomplete.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で、体力と精神力の比率が最も低い味方をそれぞれ3回復する。: Envy Resonance restores 3 HP and 3 SP to the allies with the lowest respective percentages.
messages.守備を装着した味方が被弾すると攻撃者に出血を付与し、枯渇しがちな出血回数を稼ぐ。: When an ally with defense equipped is hit, inflicts Bleed on the attacker and supplies the often-scarce Bleed Count.
messages.マッチ勝利で余った嫉妬資源を足りない資源に変換し、2名を回復する。嫉妬資源が4を: On clash win, converts surplus Envy into missing resources and heals 2 allies. Some passives stop below 4 Envy resources, so watch reserves.
messages.嫉妬資源だけで撃てる。最大4名の体力・精神力を回復し、次ターンに威力減少を付与す: Costs only Envy. Heals HP and SP for up to 4 allies and inflicts Power Down next turn.
messages.憤怒1・嫉妬4で撃てる。嫉妬共鳴6で味方全体に嫉妬ダメージ量増加を配る。: Costs 1 Wrath and 4 Envy. At 6 Envy Resonance, grants Envy Damage Up to all allies.
messages.完全共鳴したターンに攻撃・防御レベル+5。色欲・傲慢の資源がネックになる。: Grants +5 Offense and Defense Level on Absolute Resonance turns. Lust and Pride resources are the bottleneck.
messages.中指6人の完全共鳴で、全体に嫉妬ダメージ量増加2・威力増加2を配り、体力を22%: With all 6 Middle members in Absolute Resonance, grants everyone 2 Envy Damage Up and 2 Power Up and restores 22% HP.
messages.最大4名に詠唱を付与し、最大5名を回復する。: Grants Magical Girl's Chant to up to 4 allies and heals up to 5.
messages.全体回復の汎用E.G.O。色欲2・憂鬱4が要る。: A general-purpose team heal. Requires 2 Lust and 4 Gloom.
messages.共鳴を連打するので毎ターンの回復が長期戦に向く。資源は重い。: Frequent Resonance enables healing each turn, fitting long fights. Expensive resource cost.
messages.中指の人格で毎ターン嫉妬完全共鳴6を発動し、守備からS3を反撃で連打する編成。圧: Maintain 6 Envy Absolute Resonance each turn with Middle Identities and repeatedly use S3 counters through defense. Overwhelming damage, but frequent hits make the team demanding. [The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115) Outis and [The Middle Big Brother](persona:0715) Heathcliff are the core.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6を保つとバフを得て、守備の反撃がS3に変わる。マッチの勝敗に関係な: Maintaining 6 Envy Absolute Resonance grants buffs and turns defense counters into S3. Attack enemies regardless of clash outcomes.
messages.各中指の人格は1ターンに最大2回まで反撃をS3に変えられるので、4人編成でスロッ: Each Middle Identity can convert counters into S3 up to twice per turn. Even with 4 deployed members and 7 slots, all slots can be counters without wasting them.
messages.どんな時でも完全共鳴できるよう、守備が嫉妬の人格を多く入れる。無理に適当な人格を: Include many Envy-defense Identities to guarantee Absolute Resonance. Deploying fewer members is better for consistent maximum strength than forcing in unsuitable units.
messages.中指の人格は6人しかいないので、7人目の選び方が重要。ランプ(グレゴール)は7番: Only 6 Middle Identities are available, making the seventh choice important. [Lamp](persona:1214) Gregor in position 7 is guaranteed to act last and preserves Envy Resonance. Also generates Gloom and Pride.
messages.W社2級整理要員(ファウスト)も確定で最も遅く動き、守備が嫉妬で共鳴を邪魔しにく: W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent Faust is also guaranteed to act slowest, and Envy defense helps preserve Resonance. Bringing Faust enables Fluid Sac or Thoracalgia healing.
messages.裏置きは、嫉妬共鳴で体力・精神力を少し回復する赤眼･懺悔(良秀)が定番。: [Red Eyes & Penitence](persona:0410) Ryōshū is a standard bench pick for small HP and SP recovery through Envy Resonance.
messages.受けてはいけない攻撃には通常のスキルでマッチ勝利し、弱い攻撃に反撃を使う。一方攻: Use normal skills to win clashes against attacks you cannot afford to take, and counters against weak attacks. Consult the damage preview when taking unopposed attacks.
messages.混乱している味方がいると、スロットの途中に空きができて完全共鳴が非常に起きにくく: A Staggered ally leaves gaps between slots, making Absolute Resonance extremely difficult.
messages.嫉妬以外の資源は溜まりにくい。私はチョキを出すね、そっちは？(ウーティス)はマッ: Resources other than Envy accumulate slowly. Outis's [I'll Go fer Scissors. How 'Bout You?](ego:1109) converts surplus Envy into missing resources on clash win. Some passives stop below 4 Envy resources, so watch your reserves.
messages.中指6人が完全共鳴したときの茨の花園(グレゴール)は、全体に嫉妬ダメージ量増加2: When all 6 Middle members form Absolute Resonance, Gregor's [Garden of Thorns](ego:1205) grants everyone 2 Envy Damage Up and 2 Power Up and restores 22% HP.
messages.主な火力は打撃・嫉妬属性なので、どちらかに耐性のある敵は苦手。: Main damage is Blunt and Envy, so enemies resistant to either are troublesome.
messages.被弾がそのまま負けにつながる敵には反撃を振れないので、根本的に苦手。: Counters are fundamentally unsuitable against enemies whose hits can directly cause defeat.
messages.常に攻撃を受けに回るので、体力の回復手段を用意する。: The team constantly takes attacks, so prepare HP recovery.
messages.【リンバス】嫉妬共鳴編成(中指)の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistan: Envy Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの嫉妬共鳴編成(中指)。中指の人格で毎ターン嫉妬完全共鳴6を発動し、守備: Limbus Company Envy Resonance team guide (The Middle): Middle Identities trigger 6 Envy Absolute Resonance every turn and repeatedly counter with S3 through defense. Overwhelming damage but demanding play, with the Middle Nursefather and Big Brother at its core.
messages.ファウストのE.G.O《穴》で敵をまとめて吹き飛ばして周回する形。侵蝕版の《穴》: Farm by sweeping enemies with Faust's Hollow E.G.O. Corrosion targets randomly without distinguishing allies, so deploy Faust alone. Bring Tier Ⅲ Grand Welcome through Gift Observation for +5 Pride at stage start, enabling the Corrosion attack with 7 Attack Weight from turn 1. Tier Ⅲ Sharp Needle & Thread adds fixed damage to defeat groups together.
messages.《穴》の使い手。体力が多く、速度4〜7とファウストの人格で最も速い部類。: Uses Hollow. High HP and 4–7 Speed place her among the fastest Faust Identities.
messages.初回は傲慢2だけで撃て、侵蝕版の7枠攻撃で敵をまとめて倒す中核。: The core E.G.O: the first use costs only 2 Pride, enabling the Corrosion attack with 7 Attack Weight to clear groups.
messages.《穴》の使い手。体力が283と多く、速度4〜7とファウストの人格で最も速い部類な: Uses Hollow. A good fit with 283 HP and 4–7 Speed, among the fastest Faust Identities.
messages.体力が299とファウストの人格で最も多く、貫通が脆弱でないので《穴》の使い手の代: An alternative Hollow user with 299 HP, the highest among Faust Identities, and no Pierce weakness.
messages.体力が265と高く、貫通が脆弱でないので《穴》の使い手の代わりになる。卯筆頭より: An alternative Hollow user with 265 HP and no Pierce weakness. Slower than Mao Branch Adept.
messages.戦闘で初めて使うときは必要資源が傲慢2だけになり、そのときも侵蝕版の7枠攻撃を撃: The first use in an Encounter costs only 2 Pride and can still use the Corrosion attack with 7 Attack Weight. Requires Threadspin Ⅲ or higher; Ⅳ is preferable for the larger damage bonus from spending Charge.
messages.S8で追加されたファウストのE.G.O《穴》を使って、鏡ダンジョンを周回する方法: Farm Mirror Dungeons with Faust's Season 8 E.G.O [Hollow](ego:0211). Only a strong Faust Identity and Hollow are required, keeping decisions simple. However, this uses Hard on floor 5 and requires a Starlight reserve, so learn Mirror Dungeons first. Unsuitable for deep-floor progression.
messages.《穴》は戦闘で初めて使うとき、必要資源が傲慢2つだけになる。このときでも、侵蝕版: Hollow's first use in an Encounter costs only 2 Pride. Even then, its Corrosion version can be used through Overclock with 7 Attack Weight.
messages.ギフト観測で「Ⅲ盛大な歓待」(ステージ開始時に傲慢資源+5)を持ち込めば、1ター: Bring Tier Ⅲ Grand Welcome through Gift Observation for +5 Pride resources at stage start, enabling Corrosion on turn 1.
messages.「Ⅲ鋭い糸と針」は、毎ターン最初に敵へダメージを与えたスキルのダメージ量の半分を: Tier Ⅲ Sharp Needle & Thread adds fixed damage equal to half the damage of the first skill that damages an enemy each turn. With area attacks, each target takes half the total damage dealt across all targets, defeating multiple enemies together.
messages.侵蝕版の《穴》は敵味方を区別せず、ランダムな対象を攻撃する。ほかの囚人を出撃させ: Hollow's Corrosion attacks random targets without distinguishing allies. Deploy Faust alone to avoid hitting other Sinners.
messages.使い手: 黒獣-卯 筆頭(ファウスト)は体力が283と多く、速度4〜7とファウス: **User**: [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212) Faust fits well with 283 HP and 4–7 Speed, among the fastest Faust Identities. Alternatives should have high HP and no Pierce weakness, such as the highest-HP [The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice](persona:0215) or the slower [Zwei Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0205).
messages.《穴》: 解析は最低でもⅢ。Ⅳでは充電を消耗したときのダメージ量の上昇が大きくな: **Hollow**: At least Threadspin Ⅲ. Prefer Ⅳ for the larger damage bonus from spending Charge.
messages.加護: 始まりの星・星間旅行。: **Blessings**: Star of the Beginning and Interstellar Travel.
messages.ギフト観測: Ⅲ盛大な歓待、Ⅲ鋭い糸と針。: **Gift Observation**: Tier Ⅲ Grand Welcome and Tier Ⅲ Sharp Needle & Thread.
messages.パック: ノーマルのカジノブアー、ヘルズチキン、感情に惑わされるもの、憎悪と絶望: **Packs**: Normal Flat-broke Gamblers, Hell's Chicken, Emotional Seduction, and Hatred and Despair. Choose Hard Line 2 on floor 5.
messages.通常戦闘・集中戦闘は、侵蝕版の《穴》で吹き飛ばす。幻想体戦と連続戦闘はできるだけ: Clear Regular and Focused Encounters with Hollow's Corrosion. Avoid Abnormality and Chain Encounters where possible. If unavoidable, bring in follow-up Identities as needed, at the cost of more time.
messages.第一層から第四層まではノーマルで進め、第五層でハードに切り替えて2号線を選ぶ。: Play floors 1–4 on Normal, then switch to Hard and choose Line 2 on floor 5.
messages.第一層から第三層のボスは、侵蝕版の《穴》で一撃で倒せる。絶望の騎士と薔薇の表示板: Hollow's Corrosion can defeat floor 1–3 bosses in one hit. With the required Gifts, Knight of Despair and Sign of Roses can be defeated in 2 turns using regular Hollow followed by Boucher un trou.
messages.第四・第五層のショップで、ファウストの精神力を最大にしておく。: Restore Faust to maximum SP at the floor 4 and 5 shops.
messages.集めたいギフトは、呼吸のⅣ明鏡止水++とⅣ驕慢の欠片、沈潜のⅣ美的感覚++とⅣ蚕: Seek Tier Ⅳ Clear Mirror, Calm Water++ and Fragment of Conceit for Poise, plus Tier Ⅳ Artistic Sense++ and Fragment of Decay for Sinking. Floors 1–3 still fall to one Corrosion hit without them, so collecting them gradually before Knight of Despair is sufficient.
messages.Ⅲ盛大な歓待は、傲慢資源がある程度集まれば不要になる。Ⅲのギフトが必要になったら: Grand Welcome becomes unnecessary once enough Pride resources accumulate. It can be used as fusion material when a Tier Ⅲ Gift is needed.
messages.星明かりの収支は基本的にマイナス。周回するときは元手を十分に用意しておく。: Starlight balance is generally negative. Prepare a sufficient reserve before farming.
messages.第五層でハードを使うため、ハードが解放されていないと組めない。: Requires Hard on floor 5, so unavailable until Hard is unlocked.
messages.E.G.Oの演出が長い。画面のクリック・タップで加速できる。: The E.G.O animation is long. Click or tap to speed it up.
messages.【リンバス】穴周回の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Hollow Farming | Mirror Dungeon Setup and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの穴周回。S8で追加されたファウストのE.G.O《穴》を使って、鏡ダンジ: Farm Mirror Dungeons with Faust's Hollow in Limbus Company. Review solo setup, Gifts, Blessings, pack choices, and the farming rotation.
messages.黒獣型(鴻園の君主中心): Heishou (built around the Lord of Hongyuan)
messages.鴻園の君主を軸に、黒獣の人格で固める形。黒獣は全員が破裂を持つが、破裂ダメージは: Build around the Lord of Hongyuan and Heishou Identities. Every Heishou has Rupture, but status damage is a bonus; the lineup relies on modern Identities' strength. The Lord's defense retreats a Heishou and brings a reserve Heishou out to use S3, so include reserve options such as Wei Branch, the 2 Si members, and the 2 You members. Deploy Cinq Assoc. West Section 3 Meursault, who attacks without reducing Rupture, and the near-essential Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3 Rodion.
messages.黒獣に追加行動させ、守備で入れ替える中核。耐久は非常に低い。: The core commander, granting Heishou extra actions and swapping them through defense. Extremely fragile.
messages.援護防御から奥義ループを回す、単体でも強力な必須枠。: An essential, independently strong pick whose technique loop starts from Assist Defense.
messages.脚力【午】でマッチを取り、敵陣走破でバリアと火力を得る。: Strider【Wu】 supports clashes, while Linebreaker provides Shield and damage.
messages.速度10以上を狙い、S1の再使用とS3で破裂回数を維持する。: Aims for at least 10 Speed and sustains Rupture Count through S1 reuse and S3.
messages.速度で上回り、破裂と呪殺で削る。黒獣丸染で一方攻撃時に破裂回数が増える。: Outpaces enemies and deals damage through Rupture and Deathrite. Heishou Bolus Contamination adds Rupture Count on unopposed attacks.
messages.味方が整えた破裂を減らさずに殴る貫通アタッカー。: A Pierce attacker that hits without reducing the Rupture established by allies.
messages.破裂6ごとにもコイン威力が上がり、破裂編成では早くからフルパワーを出す。: Every 6 Rupture also increases Coin Power, enabling full strength early in Rupture teams.
messages.君主で使うと一度だけ死亡を無効にし、体力を60%回復する。: When used by the Lord, negates death once and restores 60% HP.
messages.破裂・出血・暴食脆弱をまとめて配る広域。: An area attack that applies Rupture, Bleed, and Gluttony Fragility together.
messages.暴食共鳴を活かして全味方に呼吸と回復を配る。: Uses Gluttony Resonance to give all allies Poise and healing.
messages.午組(黒獣-午 筆頭+家主候補): Wu pair (Wu Branch Adept + Family Hierarch Candidate)
messages.黒獣-午 筆頭と家主候補は特別に強いシナジーを持つ。家主候補は午筆頭と組むと呼吸: Wu Branch Adept and Family Hierarch Candidate have particularly strong synergy. The Candidate gains Poise and Power alongside the Adept.
messages.敵陣走破5で広域S3に変わり、家主候補とも連携する。: At 5 Linebreaker, S3 becomes an area attack. Also coordinates with the Family Hierarch Candidate.
messages.攻撃レベルで上回る相手に破裂を厚く入れ、S3のクリティカルで大ダメージを狙う。: Applies heavy Rupture against enemies she surpasses in Offense Level, then aims for heavy critical damage through S3.
messages.破裂と沈潜が多い敵ほど火力が伸びる打撃人格。君主の連携で待機解除されると強化され: A Blunt Identity that deals more damage against enemies with high Rupture and Sinking. Can unleash enhanced S3 when brought out of standby through the Lord's coordination.
messages.巳腕で呼吸を溜め、広域で多コインのS3で攻めるスロースターター。: A slow starter that builds Poise through Serpent Arm, then attacks with multi-Coin area S3.
messages.巳腕で呼吸を溜め、1コインのS3で貫く。君主との連携で破裂ダメージのたびに呼吸回: Builds Poise through Serpent Arm and strikes with a single-Coin S3. Coordination with the Lord grants Poise Count whenever Rupture deals damage.
messages.火傷と血闘本能を溜めて強化S3を撃つ。自傷の火傷で君主の入れ替えの機会を奪いやす: Builds Burn and Battleblood Instinct for enhanced S3. Self-inflicted Burn can easily consume opportunities for the Lord's swaps.
messages.血炎でS2の再使用とS3の破壊不能化を引き出す。待機解除・復帰で血炎3を得る。: Bloodflame [血炎] enables S2 reuse and Unbreakable Coins on S3. Gains 3 Bloodflame when leaving standby or returning.
messages.攻撃レベルで上回る相手に破裂を厚く入れ、呼吸を貯めてS3のクリティカルで大ダメー: Applies heavy Rupture against enemies she surpasses in Offense Level, then builds Poise for heavy critical damage through S3.
messages.毎ターンの追撃で実質2回行動し、S3と守備で呼吸を貯める。高い耐久を持つ。: A follow-up each turn effectively grants 2 actions, while S3 and defense build Poise. Highly durable.
messages.速度6以上で先にS3を撃ち、脆弱を入れて後続の攻撃で削り切る短期決戦型。: A short-fight option that uses S3 early at 6 or more Speed to apply Fragile, letting allies acting later finish the enemy.
messages.破裂回数の付与が群を抜いて得意。振動回数を伸ばしてから破裂を大量に付与する。: An exceptional Rupture Count supplier that builds Tremor Count before applying heavy Rupture.
messages.充電を手段に破裂威力と回数を大量に付与する、破裂寄りのW社の人格。: A Rupture-focused W Corp. Identity that uses Charge to apply heavy Rupture Potency and Count.
messages.攻撃威力増加を配り、序盤から安定してマッチする出血・破裂の人格。: A Bleed and Rupture Identity that distributes Attack Power Up for reliable early clashes.
messages.S2で大量の振動を入れ、S3で破裂と脆弱5を入れて後続の火力を上げる。: S2 applies heavy Tremor, while S3's Rupture and 5 Fragile increase damage from allies acting later.
messages.自傷のタイムリミットを作り、致死の場面で加重値7の広域を叩き込む。君主で使うと一: Creates a self-damage time limit and delivers an area attack with 7 Attack Weight at the lethal moment. When used by the Lord, negates death once and restores 60% HP. Choose the timing carefully.
messages.破裂・出血・暴食脆弱をまとめて配り、後続の戦いを楽にする広域。: An area attack that applies Rupture, Bleed, and Gluttony Fragility together, making subsequent attacks easier.
messages.全味方に呼吸を配り、使用後は毎ターン回復する。暴食共鳴を活かせる。: Gives all allies Poise and heals every turn after use. Benefits from Gluttony Resonance.
messages.複数の敵を斬りながら、体力の低い味方2名を回復する暴食の広域。: A Gluttony area attack that cuts through multiple enemies while healing the 2 lowest-HP allies.
messages.黒獣-卯 筆頭と資源が完全に一致する。入手機会が限られる。: Its resource affinities match Mao Branch Adept perfectly. Availability is limited.
messages.鴻園の君主(ホンル)を軸に、全員が破裂を持つ黒獣の人格で固める編成。破裂ダメージ: Build around [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613) Hong Lu and Heishou Identities, all of which have Rupture. Rupture damage is mainly a bonus; the team relies on the latest Heishou's strength and the Lord's extra actions.
messages.君主のS3は、編成順が若い黒獣のS3を呼び出して3連撃にする。黒獣のS3はスキル: The Lord's S3 calls the S3 of an early-deployed Heishou for a three-hit sequence. Many Heishou S3s grant effects that enhance their skills, stabilizing the opening.
messages.君主は、待機人員から出てきた黒獣の精神力を20回復させ、S3で攻撃させる(人格ご: The Lord restores 20 SP to an incoming reserve Heishou and has them use S3, up to 2 times per Identity per Encounter.
messages.君主はステージ開始時、待機人員を含めた黒獣の人数に応じて「全ての黒獣の主」を得て: At stage start, the Lord gains Leash-holder of All Heishou based on the number of Heishou, including reserves, increasing Speed, Offense Level, and Defense Level.
messages.黒獣-卯 筆頭など単体でも強い人格が多く、君主に黒獣を1〜2人添えるだけでも最低: Many members, such as [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212), are strong alone. Adding just 1–2 Heishou to the Lord can provide basic functionality.
messages.待機人員にも黒獣を入れ、序盤に君主の守備「黒獣利爪」で消耗した黒獣を退却させ、出: Include Heishou among reserves. Early in battle, use the Lord's defense Heishou Keenclaw [黑獣利爪] to retreat a spent Heishou and have the incoming one use S3.
messages.君主のS3で連携すると、黒獣ごとに異なる永続バフ「黒獣丸染」を得る。黒獣-卯(ウ: Coordinating through the Lord's S3 grants Heishou Bolus Contamination, a permanent buff that differs by Heishou. Particularly attractive are the Rupture Count increase for [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch](persona:1112) Outis and Poise Count increase for [Heishou Pack - Si Branch](persona:1212) Gregor.
messages.黒獣-午 筆頭と家主候補は特別に強いシナジーを持つ。: [Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept](persona:0114) and [Family Hierarch Candidate](persona:0812) have particularly strong synergy.
messages.黒獣以外では、西部センク協会3課(ムルソー)が強い。破裂付与は少ないが、対象の破: Outside Heishou, [Cinq Assoc. West Section 3](persona:0511) Meursault is strong. His Rupture application is modest, but against targets with at least 15 Potency and 3 Count, he attacks without reducing Count, maintaining allies' setup while dealing damage.
messages.北部ヂェーヴィチ協会3課(ロージャ)は、デリバリーキャリアに加えて破裂6ごとにも: [Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3](persona:0910) Rodion is near-essential: in addition to Courier Trunk, every 6 Rupture increases Coin Power, enabling full strength early. Retreat through defense if the battle drags on.
messages.黒獣の人格は全員が暴食のスキルを持つので、暴食を中心に使うE.G.Oと相性がよい: Every Heishou has a Gluttony skill, making Gluttony-focused E.G.O compatible. Wrath is harder to generate.
messages.回復は水袋や提灯(シンクレア)、暴食共鳴を活かした胸痛が候補。: Healing options include [Fluid Sac](ego:0202), Sinclair's [Lantern](ego:1004), and [Thoracalgia](ego:0208), which benefits from Gluttony Resonance.
messages.汚血泣涙を君主で使うと、一度だけ死亡を無効にして体力を60%回復する。自傷がある: Using [Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:0608) with the Lord negates death once and restores 60% HP. Self-damage makes using it too early counterproductive.
messages.君主は体力が非常に低い。黒獣利爪の回復は毎ターン1人だけで、混乱した人格は退却・: The Lord has extremely low HP. Heishou Keenclaw heals only 1 ally per turn, and Staggered Identities cannot retreat or heal through it. Prepare another healing option.
messages.黒獣-酉の2人は自傷の火傷を持ち、黒獣利爪の機会を奪いがち。相手が憤怒弱点でなけ: The 2 You Branch members carry self-inflicted Burn and tend to consume opportunities for Heishou Keenclaw. Choose their use carefully unless the enemy is weak to Wrath.
messages.【リンバス】破裂編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Rupture Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの破裂編成。鴻園の君主(ホンル)を軸に、全員が破裂を持つ黒獣の人格で固め: Limbus Company Rupture team guide: Heishou Identities built around The Lord of Hongyuan Hong Lu. Rupture damage is a bonus; the team relies on the latest Heishou Identities and the Lord's extra actions. Covers priority, flexible, and bench roles.
messages.天殺は、出撃メンバーのうち編成順が最も遅い蜘蛛の巣の人格から対象になる。そこで天: Tiansha targets deployed House of Spiders members from the latest deployment position. Place the Nursefathers to sacrifice last so they die first. Reserves enter in order after allies die, and incoming House members can become the next targets. Put the Pinky Apprentice, who has the lowest Tiansha priority, first among reserves, then non-House Identities. Remove Phantom Step after 3 sacrifices. Deaths do not grant extra slots while reserves remain.
messages.天殺で〈再会〉の強化を集める中核。蜘蛛の巣の味方がいる限り、ダメージを肩代わりさ: The core unit, gathering Saikai bonuses through Tiansha. Redirects damage to House of Spiders allies while any remain.
messages.盾として残す親方。パワーが高い。: A powerful Nursefather kept as a shield.
messages.盾として残す。代行状態でマッチを取る。: Kept as a shield. Clashes in Procuration.
messages.盾として残す子方。決闘高潮を積んで振動爆発を重ねる。: An Apprentice kept as a shield. Builds The Duel Escalates for repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.天殺する子方。〈再会〉で毎ターン体力最大値10%のバリアを得る。: An Apprentice to sacrifice. Saikai grants Shield equal to 10% max HP each turn.
messages.天殺する親方。この編成では強みを活かしきれない。〈再会〉で被ダメージ量-20%。: A Nursefather to sacrifice, since this lineup cannot fully use her strengths. Saikai grants -20% damage taken.
messages.天殺する親方。〈再会〉で「身体が響かす旋律」を得る。: A Nursefather to sacrifice. Saikai grants Somatic Frisson-inspiring Melody.
messages.待機人員の先頭。天殺で味方が死ぬと出場するが、天殺の優先順位が最も低いので狙われ: First reserve. Enters when Tiansha kills an ally, but his lowest Tiansha priority helps keep him alive as a shield.
messages.天殺で味方が死ぬと出場する。蜘蛛の巣ではないので天殺されず、火傷の維持と夜明け迎: Enters after a Tiansha death. Cannot be sacrificed because he is not a House member; supports Blade Ryōshū through sustained Burn and Dawnherald.
messages.出場しないまま、呼吸を最も多く持つ味方の斬撃クリティカルダメージ量を+15%する: Without entering battle, grants +15% Slash critical damage to the ally with the most Poise.
messages.資源が完全に一致し、広域で羅生によりダメージが伸びる。基本のWAW。: Matching resource affinities and area damage enhanced by Entangled Life. The standard WAW choice.
messages.4つ目のスキルを強化するパッシブが、スロットの多い刀良秀と非常に相性がよい。: Its passive enhances the fourth skill, making it exceptionally compatible with Blade Ryōshū's many slots.
messages.資源が完全に一致し、マッチ威力が高く脆弱も付与できる。: Matching resource affinities, high Clash Power, and Fragile application.
messages.天殺に頼りすぎず、蜘蛛の巣の人格とムルソー・グレゴールの強い人格を並べる形。天殺: Rely less on Tiansha and pair House of Spiders members with strong Meursault and Gregor Identities. If sacrificing, the last-positioned Thumb Nursefather is targeted first. Reserves enter after deaths and can become the next targets if they are House members, so their order matters too. Every House Nursefather has a special Burn-applying S3, making sustained Burn increase damage.
messages.単体でも強く、必要に応じて天殺して強化を得る。: Strong alone; gains bonuses through Tiansha when needed.
messages.盾として残す人差し指の親方。代行を貯めてS3を撃つ。: An Index Nursefather kept as a shield. Builds Procuration for S3.
messages.盾として残す人差し指の子方。: An Index Apprentice kept as a shield.
messages.蜘蛛の巣ではないので天殺されない。火傷を維持し、S3の夜明け迎えで刀良秀を支える: Cannot be sacrificed because he is not a House member. Maintains Burn and supports Blade Ryōshū with S3's Dawnherald.
messages.蜘蛛の巣ではないので天殺されない。弾丸がある限り火傷回数を維持できる。: Not a House member, so cannot be sacrificed. Maintains Burn Count while ammunition lasts.
messages.親方の次に天殺の対象になる。〈再会〉ではマッチ勝利時に振動爆発を起こす。: Targeted after the Nursefathers. Saikai triggers Tremor Burst on clash wins.
messages.天殺するなら最初の対象になる親方。〈再会〉では守備のコイン威力が上がる。: The first Nursefather targeted if using Tiansha. Saikai raises defense Coin Power.
messages.4つ目のスキルを強化する。火傷を溜めた敵ほど伸びる。: Enhances the fourth skill. Grows stronger against enemies with accumulated Burn.
messages.広域で羅生によりダメージが伸びる。: Area damage enhanced by Entangled Life.
messages.回避「残像歩」で蜘蛛の巣の味方を天殺し、〈再会〉で強化と精神力を得る中核。同期Ⅲ: The core unit: equip evade Phantom Step [殘像步] to sacrifice House allies through Tiansha, gaining Saikai bonuses and SP. With her at Uptie Ⅲ and the recommended level, the other House members can be at any level or Uptie.
messages.〈再会〉の効果が強力なので、進んで天殺したい親方。: A preferred Nursefather sacrifice because the Saikai effect is powerful.
messages.蜘蛛の巣編成では強みを活かしきれないので、天殺の候補になる親方。〈再会〉で被ダメ: A Nursefather sacrifice candidate because this lineup cannot fully use her strengths. Saikai grants -20% damage taken.
messages.パワーが高く、盾として残すのに向く親方。〈再会〉で最終コインが破壊不能になる。: A powerful Nursefather suited to keeping as a shield. Saikai makes the final Coin Unbreakable.
messages.火傷と振動を扱う親方。〈再会〉で守備のコイン威力が上がる。: A Nursefather using Burn and Tremor. Saikai raises defense Coin Power.
messages.親方を天殺すると絶縁の効果で以降の天殺が1ターンに2回になる。残したい人格がいる: Sacrificing a Nursefather grants String Severance, allowing 2 subsequent Tiansha kills per turn. Plan ahead for anyone you want to keep. Among Apprentices, the Middle member is hard to fully utilize here, while the Ring member gives strong defensive Saikai, making both sacrifice candidates.
messages.初動が弱く天殺の順も最後になるので、盾として残す。: Weak opening and last in Tiansha priority, so keep him as a shield.
messages.〈再会〉で毎ターン体力最大値10%のバリア。天殺の候補。: Saikai grants Shield equal to 10% max HP each turn. A sacrifice candidate.
messages.この編成では活かしきれないので、天殺の候補。〈再会〉で防御レベル+2。: Hard to fully use in this lineup, making him a sacrifice candidate. Saikai grants +2 Defense Level.
messages.人差し指の子方として扱われる。盾として残す。: Treated as the Index Apprentice. Keep her as a shield.
messages.〈再会〉でマッチ勝利時に振動爆発を起こす。: Saikai triggers Tremor Burst on clash wins.
messages.弾丸がある限り火傷回数を維持でき、マッチ威力も高い。長期戦では息切れしやすい。: Maintains Burn Count while ammunition lasts and has high Clash Power. Tends to run out of steam in long battles.
messages.火傷回数の維持能力が高く、自己回復回避で長期戦にも対応できる。: Strong Burn Count maintenance, with a self-healing evade that also handles longer battles.
messages.いつでも一人で火傷回数を維持できるグッドスタッフ。: A strong general-purpose pick that can maintain Burn Count alone at any time.
messages.適度にマッチ可能反撃を合わせて火傷回数を維持できる。S3の夜明け迎えで刀良秀を支: Maintains Burn Count with well-timed clashable counters. S3's Dawnherald supports Blade Ryōshū.
messages.眩惑で敵の被ダメージ量を大きく上げ、精神力のケアもできる。火傷回数の維持は苦手。: Dazzle greatly raises enemy damage taken and also helps manage SP. Poor at maintaining Burn Count.
messages.最大体力が最も高い味方1名の、攻撃スキルによる被ダメージ量-10%。刀良秀の耐久: The ally with the highest max HP takes 10% less damage from attack skills, improving Blade Ryōshū's durability.
messages.体力が最も低い味方がマッチ勝利時に体力5回復。スロットの多い刀良秀なら回復量が積: The lowest-HP ally heals 5 HP on clash wins. Blade Ryōshū's many slots let this healing accumulate.
messages.呼吸を最も多く持つ味方の斬撃クリティカルダメージ量+15%。火力を伸ばす。: The ally with the most Poise gains +15% Slash critical damage.
messages.資源が完全に一致し、精神力の減少が分割なのでケアしやすい。広域で羅生によりダメー: Matching resource affinities and split SP costs make it easier to manage. Area damage grows through Entangled Life.
messages.4つ目のスキルの最終威力+4。スロットが多く必然殺でスキルを多く使う刀良秀と、こ: The fourth skill gains +4 Final Power. Exceptionally suited to Blade Ryōshū's many slots and extra skill uses through Inevitable Termination.
messages.侵蝕で味方を倒して恩恵を得る。全員を天殺せず盾を残すときの最後の一押しになる。: Corrosion kills allies for benefits. A final push when keeping some allies as shields instead of sacrificing everyone through Tiansha.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀(良秀)を軸に、蜘蛛の巣の親方・子方の人格を並べる編成。刀良秀が蜘蛛: Build around [Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415) Ryōshū with House Nursefathers and Apprentices. She grows stronger by sacrificing House allies through Slay the Heavens - Tiansha [天殺], making the team useful across story, Mirror Dungeons, and Luxcavations.
messages.刀良秀は、蜘蛛の巣の味方が死ぬたびに〈再会〉で強化される。蜘蛛の巣の味方がいる限: Blade Ryōshū gains Saikai bonuses whenever a House ally dies. While House allies remain, she can redirect damage to them.
messages.同期Ⅲで推奨レベルまで育てた刀良秀がいれば、他の蜘蛛の巣の人格は同期・レベル不問: Once Blade Ryōshū is at Uptie Ⅲ and the recommended level, other House Identities can be at any level or Uptie, keeping investment low.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の親方は全員が火傷を付与する特殊S3を持つので、火傷も扱える。ただし火傷: Every House Nursefather has a special Burn-applying S3, so the team can use Burn too. It remains strong without maintaining Burn.
messages.刀良秀の回避「残像歩」を装着すると、戦闘開始時に蜘蛛の巣の人格を指定し、その人格: Equipping Phantom Step [殘像步] marks a House Identity at Combat Start, kills them through Tiansha after their action ends, and grants Saikai bonuses and SP.
messages.天殺の対象は、出撃メンバーのうち編成順が最も遅い蜘蛛の巣の人格から選ばれる(小指: Tiansha selects deployed House members from the latest deployment position, with the Pinky Apprentice last in priority. Put Nursefathers you want to sacrifice at the end so they are killed first.
messages.味方が死ぬと、待機人員が編成順に出場する。出場した人格が蜘蛛の巣なら、編成順が遅: When an ally dies, reserves enter in order. Incoming House members occupy a late position and can become the next Tiansha targets. Put the lowest-priority Pinky Apprentice first among reserves, followed by non-House Meursault and Gregor, to sacrifice only the intended units.
messages.天殺したい人数を倒したら、残像歩を外して天殺を止める。: After sacrificing the intended number, remove Phantom Step to stop Tiansha.
messages.待機人員が残っている間は、死亡によるスロット増加は起きない。スロットを早く増やし: Deaths do not increase slots while reserves remain. Deploying fewer total units is an option if you want slots to grow sooner.
messages.基本の流れは、1ターン目に親方を天殺して絶縁1を得る、2ターン目も天殺して計3人: The basic sequence is: sacrifice a Nursefather on turn 1 for 1 String Severance, sacrifice again on turn 2 to reach 3 deaths and 45 SP, then use Rend Space - String Connection at the end of turn 3 to complete Blade Ryōshū's setup.
messages.親方を天殺すると、絶縁の効果で以降の天殺が1ターンに2回になる。残したい人格がい: A Nursefather sacrifice grants String Severance, enabling 2 Tiansha kills per turn afterward. Plan in advance for anyone you want to keep.
messages.天殺の候補は、〈再会〉が強力な薬指の親方、この編成では活かしきれない中指の親方・: Candidates include the [Ring Nursefather](persona:0614) for powerful Saikai, the underutilized [Middle Nursefather](persona:1115) and Middle Apprentice, and the Ring Apprentice for defensive Saikai. Keeping the Index pair and Pinky Apprentice as shields is the safer choice.
messages.全員を天殺する運用は耐久面のデメリットが大きく、ギフトで補える鏡ダンジョン以外で: Sacrificing everyone has major defensive drawbacks and is unreliable outside Mirror Dungeons, where Gifts can compensate.
messages.ムルソーとグレゴールには蜘蛛の巣の人格がいないので、天殺の対象にならない。: Neither Meursault nor Gregor has a House Identity, so neither can be targeted by Tiansha.
messages.横に立って戦うなら、カポIIII(ムルソー)・炎拳事務所生存者・夜明事務所代表(: For fighting alongside her, choose Capo IIII Meursault, Firefist Office Survivor, or Dawn Office Rep Gregor. To support Blade Ryōshū, choose Hornet【Alteration】 Meursault or Lamp Gregor.
messages.裏置きは、耐久ならLCB囚人(ムルソー)・G社課長代理(グレゴール)、火力なら剣: For bench durability, choose LCB Sinner Meursault or G Corp. Manager Corporal Gregor. For damage, choose Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault.
