messages.WAWは三千大世界が基本。資源が完全に一致し、広域で羅生によりダメージが伸びる。: [Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0409) is the standard WAW choice. Its resource affinities match perfectly, and Entangled Life enhances its area damage.
messages.HEは4本目のマッチの火(良秀)が最も相性がよい。4つ目に使うスキルの最終威力+: Ryōshū's [4th Match Flame](ego:0402) is the best-fitting HE. Its +4 Final Power for the fourth skill activates quickly with Blade Ryōshū's many slots.
messages.ZAYINは初期E.G.Oの森羅炎象で十分。: The starting E.G.O [Forest for the Flames](ego:0401) is sufficient for ZAYIN.
messages.斬撃に耐性のある敵は少し苦手。: Enemies resistant to Slash are somewhat troublesome.
messages.特定の囚人の死亡で敗北になるストーリーの戦闘では、その囚人を天殺しないよう注意す: In story fights where a particular Sinner's death causes defeat, avoid sacrificing that Sinner through Tiansha.
messages.全員参加の一部コンテンツはスロットが上限を超えて復活しないので、全員を天殺すると: In some all-participant content, slots do not regenerate beyond the cap. Sacrificing everyone can leave fewer than 7 slots.
messages.【リンバス】蜘蛛の巣編成の組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: House of Spiders Team | Building and Rotation | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの蜘蛛の巣編成。蜘蛛の巣の刀(良秀)を軸に、蜘蛛の巣の親方・子方の人格を: Limbus Company House of Spiders team guide: built around Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū with House of Spiders Nursefathers and Apprentices. Blade Ryōshū grows stronger by using Tiansha on House allies, and the team works in story, Mirror Dungeons, and Luxcavation.
messages.口笛は、回復対象がN社の狂信者なら狂信も付与する。N社の人格で固め、握る者の釘で: Whistles also grants Fanatic when its healing targets an N Corp. Fanatic. Fill the team with N Corp. Identities and use The One Who Grips's Nails to enable Fanatic more often. Fell Bullet Yi Sang and Contempt, Awe Ryōshū can also be paired here.
messages.口笛で精神力と狂信を配り、釘で狂信の発動機会を増やす中核。: The core unit: Whistles supplies SP and Fanatic, while Nails create more opportunities for Fanatic to activate.
messages.狂信を得ることに関しては随一で、ダメージ増加の効果も多い。マッチ威力は低め。: Excels at gaining Fanatic and has many damage bonuses. Clash Power is relatively low.
messages.S1と守備が色欲で口笛を発動させやすい。狂信があると強化されるが、自分では狂信を: Lust S1 and defense make Whistles easy to trigger. Enhanced by Fanatic, but cannot gain it independently.
messages.全スキルが減算の打撃アタッカー。同期ⅣかつN社編成なら、味方にダメージ量+10%: A Blunt attacker using negative Coins on every skill. At Uptie Ⅳ in an N Corp. team, grants allies a +10% damage buff.
messages.S3が色欲。憂鬱を持つので水袋を撃つ助けになる。: Lust S3 helps Whistles, while Gloom helps fuel Fluid Sac.
messages.味方を倒して強力な攻撃を撃つ貫通アタッカー。軽蔑、畏敬と組むと、味方を倒さずに火: A Pierce attacker that kills allies to unleash powerful attacks. With Contempt, Awe, can deal damage without killing allies.
messages.視線を軽蔑に変え、強化S3で撃ち抜く。凶弾イサンの火力を引き出す。: Converts Gaze into Contempt and fires enhanced S3, enabling Fell Bullet Yi Sang's damage.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力を回復する。小鎚ヒースクリフが憂鬱を補える。: Restores HP and SP to all allies. Kleinhammer Heathcliff can supply Gloom.
messages.嫉妬脆弱と貫通脆弱を付与し、注視と合わせて貫通アタッカーを支える。: Inflicts Envy Fragility and Pierce Fragility, supporting Pierce attackers alongside Gaze.
messages.バトルパッシブ「口笛」(色欲4共鳴)で、戦闘開始時に精神力が最も低い味方2名の精: Whistles, the combat passive at 4 Lust Resonance, restores 15 SP to the 2 lowest-SP allies at Combat Start. Enables a fast opening in battles starting at 0 SP. Early on, evading to activate Whistles can often contribute more than attacking.
messages.S2と守備が色欲で口笛に参加しやすい。握る者の釘・注視はマイナス効果なので、S2: Lust S2 and defense easily contribute to Whistles. The One Who Grips's Nails and Gaze count as negative effects, helping guarantee S2 reuse, while Gaze also raises Pierce damage.
messages.握る者+薬指点描派スチューデント: The One Who Grips + Ring Pointillist Student
messages.握る者のS2で付く釘・注視・出血だけで、薬指点描派スチューデントのS2の再使用が: Nails, Gaze, and Bleed from The One Who Grips's S2 alone help guarantee the Ring Pointillist Student's S2 reuse. Both have Lust attacks and defense, making Whistles Resonance easy to form.
messages.S2で釘と注視を入れ、口笛で精神力を回復する。: S2 applies Nails and Gaze, while Whistles restores SP.
messages.マイナス効果の数で火力が伸び、S2のコイン再使用が連鎖する。: Scales with negative-effect count and chains S2 Coin reuse.
messages.口笛の回復対象がN社の狂信者なら狂信も付与される。握る者の釘で狂信の発動機会も増: Whistles grants Fanatic when healing an N Corp. Fanatic, while The One Who Grips's Nails create more opportunities for it to activate. Großhammer Meursault has no Lust and cannot contribute to Whistles, so choose him or Mittelhammer Don Quixote when focusing on Lust.
messages.口笛と釘で狂信を支える。: Supports Fanatic through Whistles and Nails.
messages.口笛を発動させやすく、狂信で強化される。: Easily triggers Whistles and gains bonuses from Fanatic.
messages.同期ⅣかつN社編成でダメージ量+10%のバフを配る。: Grants a +10% damage buff at Uptie Ⅳ in an N Corp. team.
messages.色欲を持たないので口笛には参加できない。: Has no Lust, so cannot contribute to Whistles.
messages.S1と守備が色欲。S2を主力に戦い、充電が貯まったらS3で大きく削る斬撃アタッカ: Lust S1 and defense. A Slash attacker that mainly uses S2, then hits hard with S3 once Charge builds.
messages.S1が色欲。デリバリーキャリアを溜めるほどS2・S3が伸び、大量のバリアで攻撃も: Lust S1. Courier Trunk enhances S2 and S3, while large Shields help take attacks.
messages.S1が色欲。単体でも強い呼吸人格で、蜘蛛の巣の味方を天殺するとさらに強い。: Lust S1. A strong standalone Poise Identity that gains further bonuses by using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally.
messages.S1が色欲。代行状態で攻撃レベルと速度が上がる。: Lust S1. Procuration raises Offense Level and Speed.
messages.S1が色欲。同じ敵とマッチを重ねて振動爆発を重ねる。: Lust S1. Repeated clashes with the same enemy lead to repeated Tremor Bursts.
messages.S3と回避が色欲。生体材料を育てて出血付与を強化する。: Lust S3 and evade. Develops Corpus Ingredient to enhance Bleed application.
messages.S3と反撃が色欲。色彩で出血・沈潜のダメージを引き上げる。: Lust S3 and counter. Mauled Color raises Bleed and Sinking damage.
messages.S3と反撃が色欲。自己完結型で、強化S3で味方も回復する。: Lust S3 and counter. Self-sufficient, with ally healing through enhanced S3.
messages.N社の狂信者。狂信を得ることに関しては随一で、ダメージ増加の効果も多い。: An N Corp. Fanatic that excels at gaining Fanatic and has many damage bonuses.
messages.N社の狂信者。精神力が減りすぎたときに口笛でカバーできる減算コインの打撃アタッカ: An N Corp. Fanatic and negative-Coin Blunt attacker. Whistles can cover SP falling too low.
messages.N社の人格。軽蔑、畏敬の良秀と組むと、味方を倒さずに火力を出せる。: An N Corp. Identity that can deal damage without killing allies when paired with Contempt, Awe Ryōshū.
messages.N社の人格。視線と軽蔑で凶弾イサンの火力を引き出す。: An N Corp. Identity that enables Fell Bullet Yi Sang's damage through Gaze and Contempt.
messages.S1が色欲。デリバリーキャリアで威力を伸ばす打撃の破裂人格。: Lust S1. A Blunt Rupture Identity that raises Power through Courier Trunk.
messages.S1が色欲。味方が火傷を入れた後に殴ると強化条件を満たしやすい。: Lust S1. Attacking after allies apply Burn makes enhancement conditions easier to meet.
messages.S1が色欲。高い速度とクイックで先に動き、マッチを取り続ける。: Lust S1. High Speed and Haste enable early actions and repeated clash wins.
messages.S1と守備が色欲で、口笛に参加しやすい。: Lust S1 and defense make contributing to Whistles easy.
messages.S1が色欲。出血回数が4未満の敵にS2を当て、大ダメージを出す。: Lust S1. S2 deals heavy damage against enemies with less than 4 Bleed Count.
messages.サポートパッシブで、速度が最も高い味方の釘付与値+1。握る者が最速でないと効果が: The support passive increases the fastest ally's Nails application by 1. Has no effect unless The One Who Grips is fastest.
messages.味方全員の体力と精神力をまとめて回復する。握る者は色欲と嫉妬を供給でき、憂鬱は他: Restores HP and SP to all allies. The One Who Grips supplies Lust and Envy; other Sinners must cover Gloom.
messages.嫉妬脆弱と貫通脆弱を付与する。速度の速い握る者が撃つと、そのターンに活かしやすい: Inflicts Envy Fragility and Pierce Fragility. Fast-acting The One Who Grips can use it to benefit the same turn's attacks.
messages.握る者(ファウスト)のバトルパッシブ「口笛」を軸に、色欲スキルを持つ人格を揃える: Build around [The One Who Grips](persona:0204) Faust's Whistles combat passive and Identities with Lust skills. This is a less powerful foundation than other team archetypes and is included as a supplementary option.
messages.色欲4共鳴で口笛を発動すると、戦闘開始時に精神力が最も低い味方2名の精神力を15: At 4 Lust Resonance, Whistles restores 15 SP to the 2 lowest-SP allies at Combat Start. This accelerates the opening in story and other battles starting at 0 SP.
messages.E.G.Oを使った後に下がった精神力も立て直せる。: Also restores SP lost after using E.G.O.
messages.握る者と薬指点描派スチューデント(イサン)の組み合わせが強い。握る者のS2で付く: The One Who Grips pairs strongly with [The Ring Pointillist Student](persona:0109) Yi Sang. Nails, Gaze, and Bleed from her S2 are negative effects, helping guarantee his S2 reuse.
messages.口笛は、回復対象がN社の狂信者なら狂信も付与する。握る者の釘も狂信の発動機会を増: Whistles also grants Fanatic when healing N Corp. Fanatics. The One Who Grips's Nails create more opportunities for Fanatic to activate, making her compatible with them.
messages.N社中鎚(ドンキホーテ)はS1と守備が色欲で、口笛を発動させやすい。狂信があると: [N Corp. Mittelhammer](persona:0304) Don Quixote has Lust S1 and defense, making Whistles easy to trigger. She gains bonuses from Fanatic but cannot gain it alone, so Whistles fits her well.
messages.N社中鎚(ロージャ)は狂信を得ることに関しては随一。握らんとする者(シンクレア): [N Corp. Mittelhammer](persona:0904) Rodion excels at gaining Fanatic. At Uptie Ⅳ in an N Corp. team, [The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005) Sinclair grants allies a +10% damage buff.
messages.N社大鎚(ムルソー)は色欲を持たず口笛に参加できないので、色欲を軸にするなら中鎚: N Corp. Großhammer Meursault has no Lust and cannot contribute to Whistles, so choose him or Mittelhammer Don Quixote when focusing on Lust.
messages.N社小鎚(ヒースクリフ)は裏置きにすると、速度が最も高い味方の釘付与値+1。握る: Benched [N Corp. Kleinhammer](persona:0704) Heathcliff increases the fastest ally's Nails application by 1. Has no effect unless The One Who Grips is fastest.
messages.N社の凶弾(イサン)と軽蔑、畏敬(良秀)は、組むと凶弾が味方を倒さずに火力を出せ: Together, N Corp.'s [Fell Bullet](persona:0113) Yi Sang and [Contempt, Awe](persona:0412) Ryōshū let Fell Bullet deal damage without killing allies.
messages.編成の過半数が色欲スキルを持つのが望ましい。攻撃スキルと守備の両方に色欲を持つ人: Ideally, more than half the team has Lust skills. Having 2 Identities with both Lust attacks and Lust defense makes Resonance easier to form.
messages.守備が色欲の人格は、手元に色欲スキルが無くても守備を出せば色欲共鳴をつなげられる: Lust defense can connect Lust Resonance even without a Lust attack available. Prioritize Uptie Ⅳ for Identities whose defense becomes Lust at that stage.
messages.握る者は、口笛編成でなくても色欲の多い編成に入れれば口笛を吹ける。蜘蛛の巣編成は: The One Who Grips can activate Whistles in any Lust-heavy team. House of Spiders teams have many Lust S1 users, including [Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415) Ryōshū and [The Index Proxy](persona:0314) Don Quixote. The Bloodfiend Bleed variant already includes her.
messages.立ち上がりの局面では、握る者は無理に攻撃するより、回避で口笛を吹いたほうが編成に: During the opening, evading to activate Whistles often contributes more than forcing The One Who Grips to attack.
messages.握る者のS2で付く注視は、貫通・打撃スキルによる被ダメージを20%増やす。貫通・: Gaze from her S2 increases damage taken from Pierce and Blunt skills by 20%. Pair her with those attack types.
messages.回復は水袋(ファウスト)が中心。握る者は色欲と嫉妬を供給できるので、憂鬱は他の囚: Healing mainly comes from Faust's [Fluid Sac](ego:0202). The One Who Grips supplies Lust and Envy, so use other Sinners to cover Gloom.
messages.精神力の立ち上がりは速いが、長期戦の適性は高くない。: SP builds quickly, but the team is not especially suited to long battles.

messages.リンバスの口笛編成。握る者(ファウスト)のバトルパッシブ「口笛」を軸に、色欲スキ: Limbus Company Whistles team guide: Lust-skill Identities built around The One Who Grips Faust's Whistles passive. A lighter core than other teams, included as a bonus guide with priority, flexible, and bench roles.

messages.【リンバス】1-11 終末カレンダー（1章）の攻略｜Limbus Assista: 1-11 Doomsday Calendar (Canto I) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)1-11「終末カレンダー（1章）」の攻略: Doomsday Calendar (Canto I) guide for Limbus Company 1-11. Defeat the initial Clay Dolls, then attack the arms and face in order. In phases 2 and 3, reduce 1 Clay Doll to 0 HP so you can weaken the boss through a check without spending a Sinner's HP. Even success at the final check carries a large cost, so also aim to defeat the main body beforehand.
messages.最初の土偶を倒し、腕、顔の順に本体を攻める。第2・第3段階で土偶を1体HP0にし: Defeat the initial Clay Dolls, then attack the arms and face in order. In phases 2 and 3, reduce 1 Clay Doll to 0 HP so you can weaken the boss through a check without spending a Sinner's HP. Even success at the final check carries a large cost, so also aim to defeat the main body beforehand.
messages.1章ダンジョン2層の個体。本体Lv6・HP336、腕各62、顔143。取り巻きは: The Floor 2 encounter in the Canto I dungeon. Main body: Lv. 6, 336 HP; arms: 62 HP each; face: 143 HP. The boss-fight adds have Lv. 6, 40 HP, and Defense Level 3, unlike the Lv. 5 dolls encountered earlier or Lv. 7 event versions.
messages.本体の攻撃・守備Lvは敵Lv−5、土偶は敵Lv+3。腕の共通技は使用部位別に掲載: Main-body Offense and Defense Levels are enemy level − 5; Clay Dolls use enemy level + 3. Shared arm skills are listed separately by Part. “Live Offering” has Base Power 10 and Coin Power −6; “Universe Aflame” has 45 and −10. The first final-phase use targets the enemy's allies with 4 Attack Weight; later uses target Sinners with 10 Attack Weight and are listed separately.
messages.第1段階は土偶2体を全てHP0へ。第2段階は両腕破壊または本体HP70%以下で顔: In phase 1, reduce both Clay Dolls to 0 HP. In phase 2, destroying both arms or reducing main-body HP to 70% or less exposes the face. In phase 3, reaching 25% HP or less starts the final phase.
messages.第2・第3段階では、その段階の土偶を1体HP0にすると土偶を捧げる選択が使える。: In phases 2 and 3, reducing 1 of that phase's Clay Dolls to 0 HP unlocks the option to offer a Clay Doll. Offering a Sinner costs HP even on success.
messages.最終判定は成功しても担当HP−100・全員精神力−30。HP25%より上から本体: Even a successful final check costs the selected Sinner 100 HP and all Sinners 30 SP. Defeating the main body from above 25% HP skips the final phase. Defeating it also suppresses the Clay Dolls.
messages.本体を攻撃できない: I cannot attack the main body
messages.第1段階は本体を攻撃できない。土偶2体を全てHP0にして第2段階へ進む。腕は第2: The main body cannot be attacked in phase 1. Reduce both Clay Dolls to 0 HP to start phase 2. Arms become targetable in phase 2; the face in phase 3.
messages.土偶を倒したのに討伐時効果が出ない: Defeating a Clay Doll did not trigger On Kill effects
messages.取り巻きの土偶はHP0でも死亡せず、行動不能・対象外になる。本体を倒すと同時に制: At 0 HP, the Clay Doll adds do not die; they become unable to act and untargetable. They are suppressed when the main body is defeated, so reducing a doll to 0 HP alone does not necessarily trigger On Kill effects.
messages.土偶を捧げる選択が使えない: I cannot choose to offer a Clay Doll
messages.その段階でHP0にした土偶が必要。第1段階で倒した分を次の判定に持ち越せるとは考: You need a Clay Doll reduced to 0 HP during the current phase. Do not expect phase 1 dolls to carry over into the next check; prepare 1 during each of phases 2 and 3.
messages.判定に成功したのに味方が大きく削れた: An ally lost a lot of HP despite passing the check
messages.囚人を捧げる判定は成功時もHPを失う。第2段階は20、第3段階は30、最終判定は: Offering a Sinner costs HP even on success: 20 in phase 2, 30 in phase 3, and 100 at the final check. Prepare Clay Dolls for the intermediate checks; for the last one, consider both HP and SP costs when choosing a Sinner.
messages.第3段階から攻撃可能。破壊後も追撃でき、行動も止まらない。: Targetable from phase 3 onward. Can still be attacked after destruction and continues acting.
messages.最終段階への移行時、顔の破壊状態を解除して部位HPを全回復する。本体HPの全回復: Entering the final phase removes the face's broken state and fully restores its Part HP, not the main body's HP.
messages.第2段階だけ攻撃可能。摘出時は行動キャンセル・スロット削除、追撃不可。: Targetable only during phase 2. Removal cancels actions and deletes slots; cannot be attacked afterward.
messages.両腕の破壊、または本体HP70%以下で第3段階へ進む。: Destroying both arms or reducing main-body HP to 70% or less starts phase 3.
messages.片腕を壊しても、残った腕の行動は確認する。: After breaking one arm, still check the remaining arm's actions.
messages.第1段階2体、第2段階に新しく3体。HP0で行動不能・対象外になり、その時点では: 2 appear in phase 1, followed by 3 new dolls in phase 2. At 0 HP they cannot act or be targeted, but do not die at that point.
messages.第2段階では1体をHP0にすると、その段階の判定で土偶を捧げられる。: In phase 2, reducing 1 doll to 0 HP makes it available as an offering for that phase's check.
messages.第3段階に4体出現。HP0で行動不能・対象外になる。: 4 appear in phase 3. At 0 HP they cannot act or be targeted.
messages.第3段階でHP0にした土偶を捧げると、囚人のHPを使わず熱気を止められる。: Offering a doll reduced to 0 HP during phase 3 stops Frenzy without spending a Sinner's HP.
messages.土偶2体を全てHP0にする: Reduce both Clay Dolls to 0 HP
messages.本体は行動せず、こちらからも攻撃できない。土偶2体を攻撃する。打撃・怠惰が有効。: The main body does not act and cannot be attacked. Attack the 2 Clay Dolls; Blunt and Sloth are effective.
messages.HP0になった土偶は死亡せず行動不能・対象外になる。全てHP0にすると第2段階へ: At 0 HP, dolls do not die but become unable to act and untargetable. Reducing all of them to 0 HP starts phase 2. Waiting only for the main body to attack will not advance the fight.
messages.腕を攻め、判定用の土偶を1体用意する: Attack the arms and prepare 1 doll for the check
messages.本体が両腕から攻撃し、新たな土偶3体が出る。腕には斬撃、土偶には打撃が有効。両腕: The main body attacks with both arms, and 3 new Clay Dolls appear. Slash is effective against arms; Blunt against dolls. Break both arms or reduce main-body HP to 70% or less to advance.
messages.判定までにこの段階の土偶1体をHP0にしておくと、土偶を捧げる選択で本体全部位へ: Before the check, reduce 1 doll from this phase to 0 HP. Offering it inflicts 3 Attack Power Down on all main-body Parts. Defeating every doll is not required to advance.
messages.土偶がない場合は色欲有利判定。成功でも担当HP−20。失敗ではさらに担当精神力−: Without a doll, take a Lust-favored check. Even success costs the selected Sinner 20 HP. Failure also costs them 15 SP and grants 3 Damage Up and 3 Fragile to all main-body Parts. Choose a Sinner with enough HP.
messages.判定の予告と発生を確認する。両腕が混乱・破壊されていると、一時的にイベントが発生: Watch for the check warning and the event itself. If both arms are Staggered or destroyed, the event may be temporarily delayed. Removed arms cannot be attacked further.
messages.第3段階・顔と燃え上がる土偶4体: Phase 3: face and 4 Burning Clay Dolls
messages.熱気を止め、顔を削る: Stop Frenzy and damage the face
messages.通常の土偶が消え、燃え上がる終末土偶4体へ入れ替わる。本体は防御だけになるが、熱: The normal dolls disappear and are replaced by 4 Burning Clay Dolls. The main body only Guards, but Frenzy inflicts 3 Burn on all Sinners each turn.
messages.この段階でも土偶を1体HP0にして、判定で捧げる。本体HP−100と熱気消失を、: Again, reduce 1 doll to 0 HP and offer it during the check. This removes 100 main-body HP and stops Frenzy without costing a Sinner HP. Defeating every doll is not required to advance.
messages.土偶がない場合は憂鬱有利判定で、成功でも担当HP−30。失敗時も本体HP−100: Without a doll, take a Gloom-favored check; even success costs the selected Sinner 30 HP. Failure still removes 100 main-body HP, but also costs the Sinner 15 SP, inflicts 10 Burn on all Sinners, and does not grant the successful removal of Frenzy.
messages.第3段階イベントの発生時点は資料の説明に差がある。固定ターン数で待たず、実際の予: The exact timing of the phase 3 event is not consistently documented. Follow the warning and prepare a doll before the check rather than waiting a fixed number of turns. Defeating the boss from above 25% HP skips the final phase.
messages.本体HP25%以下・最終段階: Main-body HP at 25% or less / final phase
messages.初回の猶予で判定か撃破を選ぶ: Use the first-turn opening to pass the check or finish the boss
messages.顔は部位破壊状態を解除して部位HPが全回復する。本体HPまで戻るわけではない。初: The face's broken state is removed and its Part HP fully restored; main-body HP is not restored. The first “Universe Aflame” targets the boss's allied Clay Dolls, cannot be Clashed, and has 4 Attack Weight.
messages.終了時の最終判定は怠惰が有利。成功すると制圧完了になるが、担当HP−100・全囚: The final check at Turn End favors Sloth. Success completes suppression but costs the selected Sinner 100 HP and all Sinners 30 SP. Failure still costs the selected Sinner 100 HP, costs all Sinners 45 SP, and grants 5 Damage Up and 5 Fragile to all main-body Parts.
messages.以後は加重値10の燃え上がる宇宙が囚人へ向く。減算コインで高威力のため、初回の猶: Later “Universe Aflame” uses target Sinners with 10 Attack Weight. It is a powerful Minus Coin skill, so defeat the main body or pass the check during the initial opening. After failure, check current Clash predictions and remaining HP, block with strong skills, and finish the boss.
messages.本体を倒せば残りの土偶も同時に制圧される。土偶を全て片付けてから本体へ向かう必要: Defeating the main body suppresses the remaining Clay Dolls at the same time. You do not need to clear every doll first.
messages.第2段階に両腕から使う。マッチを取り、空いた攻撃を腕へ回す。腕を摘出すると行動が: Used by both arms during phase 2. Clash against it and direct spare attacks at the arms. Removing an arm stops its actions, but also makes that Part untargetable.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに束縛1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.
messages.的中で翌ターンの束縛1。第2段階では土偶の攻撃もあるため、遅くなって引き受けられ: On Hit, inflicts 1 Bind next turn. Phase 2 also includes Clay Doll attacks; stop it with a Clash before reduced Speed prevents you from redirecting attacks.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3 next turn.
messages.基本威力10からコイン威力−6の減算スキル。表が出るほど弱くなる。的中の出血回数: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 10 and Coin Power −6. Heads makes it weaker. Use the current Clash prediction to prevent its On Hit Bleed Count increase.
messages.第3段階の本体はこの防御だけを使う。ただし熱気による火傷と土偶の攻撃は続くので、: In phase 3, the main body uses only this Guard skill. Frenzy's Burn and the dolls' attacks continue, so the phase is not free of damage.
messages.最終段階2ターン目以降・囚人が対象: Final phase, turn 2 onward / targets Sinners
messages.最終段階2ターン目以降は囚人対象・加重値10。表面でも35の減算スキルなので、判: From turn 2 of the final phase onward, targets Sinners with 10 Attack Weight. Its Minus Coin still rolls 35 on Heads; do not treat it like the weak Clashes from before the check. Block with strong skills and defeat the main body.
messages.最終段階初回・敵の味方が対象・マッチ不可: First use in the final phase / targets the enemy's allies / Unclashable
messages.最終段階初回は土偶が対象のマッチ不可攻撃。囚人への広域と区別し、この猶予に本体H: The first final-phase use is an Unclashable attack against Clay Dolls. Distinguish it from the area attack against Sinners, and use the opening to check main-body HP and prepare for the check.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに出血回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1 next turn.
messages.表面で的中すると翌ターンの出血回数が1増える。1段階目は土偶を全てHP0へ、2段: A Heads hit adds 1 Bleed Count next turn. In phase 1, aim to reduce all dolls to 0 HP; in phase 2, prepare 1 at 0 HP for the check.
messages.Ⅱ[表面的中時]次のターンに出血回数が1増加: Ⅱ[On Heads Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1 next turn.
messages.2枚目が表面で的中すると翌ターンの出血回数が1増える。HP0にした後は対象外にな: A Heads hit on Coin 2 adds 1 Bleed Count next turn. A doll becomes untargetable at 0 HP, so move attacks to another enemy afterward.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに火傷1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn next turn.
messages.的中で翌ターンに火傷1。熱気の全体火傷と重なるので、判定に使う土偶を狙いつつ必要: On Hit, inflicts 1 Burn next turn. This stacks with Frenzy's teamwide Burn, so take necessary Clashes while targeting the doll needed for the check.
messages.[表面的中時]次のターンに火傷回数が1増加: [On Heads Hit] Increase Burn Count by 1 next turn.
messages.表面的中で翌ターンの出血回数・火傷回数が各1増える。すでに火傷を受けている囚人へ: A Heads hit adds 1 Bleed Count and 1 Burn Count next turn. Avoid letting it hit Sinners who already have Burn unopposed.
messages.2枚目の表面的中で翌ターンの出血回数・火傷回数が各1増える。判定の代償でHPが減: A Heads hit on Coin 2 adds 1 Bleed Count and 1 Burn Count next turn. Also watch Sinners whose HP was reduced by the check's cost.
messages.終末土偶を全て討伐すると次の段階へ移る。: Advance to the next phase when all Doomsday Clay Dolls are defeated.
messages.土偶のHPを全て0にする。偶像崇拝により通常の死亡とは異なるが、段階移行には数え: Reduce every doll to 0 HP. Idolatry makes this different from normal death, but it still counts toward phase progression.
messages.腕が全て破壊されるか、本体HPが70%以下になると次の段階へ移る。: Advance to the next phase when all arms are destroyed or main-body HP reaches 70% or less.
messages.片腕だけの破壊では確定で進まない。本体HPと残る腕を確認する。: Breaking only one arm does not guarantee progression. Check main-body HP and the remaining arm.
messages.毎ターン、全ての敵へ火傷3を付与する。: Inflict 3 Burn on all enemies each turn.
messages.囚人側が火傷を受ける。第3段階の判定を成功させて消すか、早めに本体を倒す。: Sinners receive the Burn. Remove it by passing the phase 3 check, or defeat the main body quickly.
messages.本体HPが25%以下になると最終段階へ移る。: Advance to the final phase when main-body HP reaches 25% or less.
messages.25%より上から削り切る攻撃を狙う。移行したら初回の猶予を使う。: Aim to finish the boss from above 25% HP. If it advances, use the first-turn opening.
messages.死亡せず、行動不能・ターゲット不可になる。終末カレンダーの制圧と同時に制圧される: Does not die; becomes unable to act and untargetable. Suppressed when Doomsday Calendar is suppressed.
messages.土偶のHP0で敵討伐時の効果が出るとは考えない。判定の材料には使える。: Reducing a doll to 0 HP does not necessarily trigger On Kill effects. It can still be used for the check.
messages.土偶2体のHP0で第2段階、両腕破壊または本体HP70%以下で第3段階、本体HP: Reducing 2 dolls to 0 HP starts phase 2. Destroying both arms or reaching 70% main-body HP starts phase 3. Reaching 25% main-body HP starts the final phase. Reaching 0 main-body HP suppresses every enemy regardless of phase.
messages.第2・第3段階の土偶全滅は必須ではない。必要な判定用の1体を用意して本体へ火力を: Clearing all dolls in phases 2 and 3 is not required. Prepare 1 for the check, then direct damage at the main body.
messages.第2・第3段階で、その段階中にHP0にした土偶がいると選べる。第2段階は攻撃威力: Available in phases 2 and 3 if a doll was reduced to 0 HP during that phase. Phase 2 inflicts 3 Attack Power Down; phase 3 removes 100 main-body HP and Frenzy. No Sinner HP is spent.
messages.前の段階の土偶を持ち越せるとは考えず、各段階で新たに1体を用意する。: Prepare 1 new doll during each phase; do not expect dolls from the previous phase to carry over.
messages.第2段階は色欲有利、第3段階は憂鬱有利。成功でも担当HPがそれぞれ20・30減る: Phase 2 favors Lust and phase 3 favors Gloom. Even success costs the selected Sinner 20 and 30 HP respectively. The final check favors Sloth, costs the selected Sinner 100 HP, and also reduces every Sinner's SP.
messages.成功確率だけで選ばず、代償後のHPと混乱も確認する。成功値の括弧内外には表記差が: Consider remaining HP and Stagger risk after paying the cost, not just success chance. Required values have differing parenthetical listings, so choose using the prediction displayed in battle.
messages.腕は摘出時に行動キャンセル・スロット削除となり追撃不可。顔は破壊後も行動し、最終: Removing an arm cancels its actions, deletes its slots, and prevents further attacks against it. The face continues acting after destruction; the final phase removes its broken state and fully restores its Part HP.
messages.部位破壊だけで全行動が止まるとは考えない。段階に応じて攻撃先を変える。: Breaking a Part does not necessarily stop all actions. Change targets to match the phase.
messages.取り巻きのHP0は通常の討伐ではない。敵討伐時の効果に頼らない。: Reducing an add to 0 HP is not a normal kill. Do not rely on On Kill effects.
messages.第2・第3段階で土偶を捧げるには、その段階中の土偶をHP0にする必要がある。: Offering a doll in phases 2 and 3 requires reducing a doll from that same phase to 0 HP.
messages.囚人を捧げる判定は成功してもHPを失う。特に最終判定のHP100・全員精神力低下: Offering a Sinner costs HP even on success. In particular, remember the final check's 100 HP cost and teamwide SP loss.
messages.顔は破壊後も行動し、最終段階で部位HPを回復する。顔破壊による即時停止を前提にし: The face continues acting after destruction and restores Part HP in the final phase. Do not rely on breaking it to stop actions immediately.
messages.燃え上がる宇宙は初回が土偶向け、その後が囚人向け。対象・加重値・マッチ可否を混同: “Universe Aflame” first targets Clay Dolls, then Sinners. Keep its targets, Attack Weight, and Clashability distinct.
messages.出撃5名。ダンジョン推奨Lv7を目安に育成し、HPと精神力を整えて入る。: Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the dungeon's recommended Lv. 7 as a guide, and enter with healthy HP and SP.
messages.腕への斬撃、顔・土偶への打撃が有効。怠惰は全体に通りやすい。色欲は本体に通りにく: Slash is effective against arms; Blunt against the face and dolls. Sloth is broadly effective. Lust is resisted by the main body but favored for the phase 2 check.
messages.土偶を捧げれば途中のHP損失を避けられる。最終判定を使うならHP100の代償に備: Offering Clay Dolls avoids intermediate HP costs. If using the final check, prepare for its 100 HP cost and identify a Sinner suited to Sloth checks.
messages.第1段階を進め、第2・第3段階で代償のない判定を使えるようにする。: Reduce dolls to 0 HP to advance phase 1 and enable checks without an HP cost in phases 2 and 3.
messages.摘出とHP割合による移行を進め、最終段階前の撃破も狙う。: Progress through removal and HP-based transitions, while also aiming to defeat the boss before the final phase.
messages.HPに余裕がある判定担当: Check role with HP to spare
messages.土偶を用意できなかったときや最終判定で、代償による被害を抑える。: Limit the damage from costs when no doll is ready or when taking the final check.
messages.【リンバス】1-11 黒檀女王の林檎（1章）の攻略｜Limbus Assista: 1-11 Ebony Queen's Apple (Canto I) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)1-11「黒檀女王の林檎（1章）」の攻略: Ebony Queen's Apple (Canto I) guide for Limbus Company 1-11. Clash against branch and root attacks and use spare actions on the fruit. Destroying fruit applies Fragile across the body. If the fight lasts, stop the branches to prevent the area attack. HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns.
messages.1-11の1層個体。Lv6、本体HP456。最初の2ターンはHP1未満にならず死: The Floor 1 encounter in 1-11: Lv. 6, 456 main-body HP. During the first 2 turns, its HP cannot fall below 1 and it cannot die. The HP entry distinguishes main-body and Fruit HP; other entries show Part HP. These stats differ from the Thread Luxcavation and Mirror Dungeon versions.
messages.使用部位ごとに全8表示へ分けた。右枝と左枝の色褪せた枝はアイコン以外が共通。根の: All 8 skill entries are listed by the Part that uses them. The right and left Stems' “Pale Stem” skills differ only in their icons. The Roots' attack is also called Vine Spike in the action table, but is listed here as “Root Spike” from the skill table. On Heads Hit and On Hit are distinct conditions.
messages.枝・根の攻撃にマッチを取り、空いた攻撃を果実へ集める。果実を壊すと全部位に脆弱2: Clash against Stem and Root attacks, and direct spare attacks at the Fruit. Destroying the Fruit grants 2 Fragile to all Parts.
messages.最初の2ターンは本体HPが1未満にならない。削り切れなくても火力不足と判断せず、: Main-body HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns. If it survives, continue through the event checks and the next turn; this does not mean your damage is insufficient.
messages.長期戦では5ターン周期の皆の痛みに注意する。枝を片方でも混乱・破壊して止める。摘: In longer fights, watch for “Shared Pain” on the 5-turn cycle. Stagger or destroy either Stem to stop it. Removed Stems cannot be attacked further.
messages.HPが1で止まって倒せない: Its HP stops at 1 and it will not die
messages.1章の個体には最初の2ターンの死亡防止がある。通常の攻撃と判定イベントを進め、そ: The Canto I version cannot die during the first 2 turns. Continue normal attacks and event checks, then defeat it afterward.
messages.果実は通常1ターン後に再生する。破壊中の全身脆弱を使って削る。再生後の果実を弱ら: The Fruit normally regenerates after 1 turn. Deal damage while all Parts have Fragile. After it regenerates, weaken it and pass the resulting check to stop further regeneration.
messages.枝を壊した後に攻撃を選べない: I cannot target a Stem after destroying it
messages.枝は摘出可能部位。破壊後は追撃不可になり、その枝の行動も止まる。残った部位へ攻撃: Stems are removable Parts. Destroying one makes it untargetable and stops its actions. Reassign attacks to the remaining Parts.
messages.皆の痛みは両枝がそろっていると使う。予兆が出たら片方の枝を混乱・破壊して止める。: “Shared Pain” is used when both Stems remain. When its warning appears, Stagger or destroy either Stem to stop it. If you cannot do so in time, Clash with a strong skill.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能。破壊時に果実の行動をキャンセルし、破壊中は行動しない。: Can still be attacked after destruction. Destruction cancels the Fruit's actions, and it does not act while broken.
messages.通常は1ターン後に再生。再生後の果実に対する判定成功後は再生しない。: Normally regenerates after 1 turn. Passing the check against the regenerated Fruit prevents further regeneration.
messages.摘出可能。破壊時に行動キャンセルとスロット破壊。破壊後の追撃不可。: Removable. Destruction cancels actions and destroys its slots. Cannot be attacked after destruction.
messages.斬撃弱点・貫通耐性。どちらかの枝を止めると皆の痛みを防げる。: Weak to Slash and resistant to Pierce. Stopping either Stem prevents “Shared Pain”.
messages.摘出可能。右枝とは異なり、通常の混乱区間はない。: Removable. Unlike the Right Stem, it has no normal Stagger Threshold.
messages.破壊時に行動キャンセルとスロット破壊。破壊後の追撃不可。: Destruction cancels actions and destroys its slots. Cannot be attacked after destruction.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能。破壊後は行動しない。スロット加重値は2。: Can still be attacked after destruction, but stops acting. Its slot weight is 2.
messages.根の破壊、または根を掘り返す判定成功で、毎ターンの束縛付与を止められる。: Destroying the Roots or passing the check to dig them up stops the Bind inflicted each turn.
messages.必要なマッチを取り、空いた攻撃で果実を壊す: Take necessary Clashes and break the Fruit with spare attacks
messages.集中戦闘では攻撃先を自分で選ぶ。まず枝と根から来る攻撃にマッチを取り、残る攻撃を: In Focused Encounters, choose targets manually. First Clash against incoming Stem and Root attacks, then focus remaining attacks on the Fruit.
messages.果実は打撃弱点で部位HP21。壊すと全部位に脆弱2が付くため、その隙に本体を削る: The Fruit is weak to Blunt and has 21 Part HP. Destroying it grants 2 Fragile to all Parts, creating an opening to damage the main body. Stems and Roots are weak to Slash, so their physical weaknesses differ from the Fruit's.
messages.最初の2ターンは本体HPが1未満にならない。火力が足りてもこの間は終わらないため: Main-body HP cannot fall below 1 during the first 2 turns. Even with sufficient damage, the fight cannot end during this period; check remaining attacks and events.
messages.2ターン目終了時の判定: Check at the end of turn 2
messages.根の判定で毎ターンの束縛を止める: Pass the Roots check to stop the recurring Bind
messages.根を掘り返す判定は憤怒が有利。成功すると絡みつく根が消え、毎ターンの束縛1が止ま: Wrath is favored in the check to dig up the Roots. Success removes Entangling Roots and stops the 1 Bind inflicted every turn.
messages.失敗しても即敗北ではない。根を部位破壊することでも止められる。判定の成功値は4（: Failure is not an immediate defeat: destroying the Roots also stops the effect. The required check value is listed as 4 (6 in parentheses), so use the success prediction shown in battle to choose a Sinner.
messages.片方の枝を止めて広域を防ぐ: Stop either Stem to prevent the area attack
messages.両枝が残っていると、5ターン周期でどちらかが加重値5の皆の痛みを使う。光が集まる: If both Stems remain, one uses “Shared Pain” with 5 Attack Weight on a 5-turn cycle. Watch for the gathering-light warning and check the skill name.
messages.右枝はHP40%に混乱区間がある。混乱・破壊で片方を止めるか、本体を先に倒す。左: The Right Stem has a Stagger Threshold at 40% HP. Stagger or destroy either Stem, or defeat the main body first. The Left Stem has no Stagger Threshold, so handle them differently.
messages.摘出した枝は追撃できず、行動も止まる。枝の残存数に応じた根の強化も減るので、残っ: Removed Stems cannot be attacked and no longer act. Removing them also reduces the Roots' bonuses based on remaining Stems; reassign attacks to the remaining Parts.
messages.再生した果実への判定・終盤: Regenerated Fruit check / finishing the fight
messages.再生を止める機会と脆弱を使って倒す: Use the chance to stop regeneration and exploit Fragile
messages.果実は通常、破壊から1ターン後に戻る。再生した果実を弱らせると、次の判定の予告が: The Fruit normally returns 1 turn after destruction. Weakening the regenerated Fruit triggers a warning for the next check. Its exact HP requirement is unconfirmed, so watch for the warning.
messages.傲慢が有利な判定に成功すると果実を破壊し、本体が混乱する。以後の果実は再生しない: Passing the Pride-favored check destroys the Fruit and Staggers the main body. The Fruit will no longer regenerate. The required value is listed as 5 (7 in parentheses), so choose a Sinner using the current prediction.
messages.判定が出る前でも、最初の2ターンを過ぎて本体HPを削り切ればよい。果実破壊の脆弱: You can also defeat the main body before that check appears, once the first 2 turns have passed. Exploit Fragile from breaking the Fruit rather than waiting unnecessarily for an event.
messages.枝の通常攻撃。空いた攻撃は果実へ回しつつ、こちらには勝てるスキルでマッチを取る。: The Stems' normal attack. Clash with a skill that can win while directing spare attacks to the Fruit. Removing a Stem stops attacks from that Stem.
messages.1枚コインだが素の最大威力は9。不信と同じ予測と思い込まず、現在のマッチ予測を見: Has 1 Coin, but its unmodified maximum Power is 9. Check the current Clash prediction rather than assuming it matches “Distrust”. A removed Stem cannot be attacked further.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]出血回数が3回増加: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.
messages.表面で的中すると出血回数が3増える。マッチに勝って防ぐ。枝が残る間は根の攻撃威力: A Heads hit increases Bleed Count by 3. Prevent it by winning the Clash. Remaining Stems also increase the Roots' Attack Power, so track which Stems are still active.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに脆弱1を付与: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.加重値5の広域。両枝が残ったまま5ターン周期を迎えると使うため、予兆が見えたらど: An area attack with 5 Attack Weight. Used on the 5-turn cycle if both Stems remain; when warned, Stagger or destroy either Stem, or defeat the main body before it activates.
messages.果実の防御。枝・根の攻撃へ必要なマッチを取ったうえで、空いた攻撃を果実へ集中する: The Fruit's Guard skill. Take necessary Clashes against Stem and Root attacks, then focus spare attacks on the Fruit. Breaking it grants 2 Fragile to all Parts.
messages.全部位が脆弱2を得る。破壊された果実は1ターン後に再生する。: All Parts gain 2 Fragile. Destroyed Fruit regenerates after 1 turn.
messages.果実を壊して全体へのダメージを増やす。再生を止める判定に成功するまでは戻る。: Break the Fruit to increase damage against all Parts. It returns until the check to stop regeneration succeeds.
messages.根が未破壊のターン開始時: At Turn Start, while the Roots are not destroyed
messages.囚人側が毎ターン遅くなる。根の破壊か、2ターン目の判定成功で止める。: Sinners become slower each turn. Stop it by destroying the Roots or passing the turn 2 check.
messages.破壊されていない腕の数だけ、根が攻撃威力増加2を得る。: The Roots gain 2 Attack Power Up for each undestroyed arm.
messages.枝を破壊すれば、広域だけでなく根の強化も抑えられる。根の技の素の威力だけで判断し: Breaking Stems suppresses both the area attack and the Roots' bonuses. Do not judge Root skills solely by their unmodified Power.
messages.開始2ターンの死亡防止: Death prevention for the first 2 turns
messages.1章個体は戦闘開始から2ターンの間、HPが1未満にならず死亡しない。: For the first 2 turns of combat, the Canto I version cannot fall below 1 HP or die.
messages.HP1で止まっても攻略失敗ではない。必要なマッチとイベントを進める。: Stopping at 1 HP does not mean the strategy failed. Continue the necessary Clashes and events.
messages.破壊時に行動をキャンセルし、破壊中は行動しない。通常は1ターン後に再生する。果実: Destruction cancels its actions, and it does not act while broken. Normally regenerates after 1 turn. Passing the Fruit check prevents further regeneration and Staggers the main body.
messages.破壊による全体脆弱を使う。再生後イベントのHP条件を未確認の数値で固定しない。: Exploit the Fragile applied across all Parts when it breaks. Do not assume an unconfirmed HP requirement for the event after regeneration.
messages.破壊時に行動キャンセル・スロット破壊。破壊後の追撃不可。皆の痛みは両枝がある場合: Destruction cancels actions and destroys slots. Cannot be attacked afterward. “Shared Pain” is used only when both Stems remain.
messages.片方の枝を止めると広域を防げる。破壊後は残る部位へ攻撃を移す。: Stopping either Stem prevents the area attack. After destruction, move attacks to the remaining Parts.
messages.最初の2ターンは本体を倒せない。HP1で止まることを火力不足と判断しない。: The main body cannot die during the first 2 turns. Stopping at 1 HP does not indicate insufficient damage.
messages.右枝はHP40%に混乱区間があるが、左枝にはない。: The Right Stem has a Stagger Threshold at 40% HP; the Left Stem has none.
messages.果実・根は破壊後も追撃可能、枝は摘出後に追撃不可。部位ごとの違いを確認する。: Fruit and Roots can still be attacked after destruction; removed Stems cannot. Check each Part's behavior.
messages.果実を再生させない判定の発生HPは未確定。半分以下と断定しない。: The HP requirement for the check that stops Fruit regeneration is unconfirmed. Do not assume it is half HP or less.
messages.表面的中時の効果を、的中すれば必ず起こる効果に読み替えない。: An On Heads Hit effect does not activate on every hit.
messages.出撃5名。ダンジョン推奨Lv7を目安に、マッチへ勝てる主力をそろえる。: Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the dungeon's recommended Lv. 7 as a guide and prepare a core team that can win Clashes.
messages.果実には打撃、枝・根には斬撃が有効。罪悪は憤怒・傲慢が通りやすい。根と果実の判定: Blunt is effective against the Fruit; Slash against Stems and Roots. Wrath and Pride deal good damage and are useful for the Roots and Fruit checks.
messages.攻撃を防ぎながら、右枝の混乱や枝の摘出で広域と根の強化を抑える。: Stop attacks while suppressing the area attack and Root bonuses through Right Stem Stagger or Stem removal.
messages.空いた手で果実を壊し、全身への脆弱を作る。: Use spare actions to break the Fruit and apply Fragile across all Parts.
messages.根の束縛停止や果実の再生停止を狙う。イベント画面の予測で選ぶ。: Aim to stop Bind from the Roots and regeneration from the Fruit. Choose using the prediction on the event screen.
messages.【リンバス】1-11 黄金色の林檎（1章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 1-11 Golden Apple (Canto I) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)1-11「黄金色の林檎（1章）」の攻略。: Golden Apple (Canto I) guide for Limbus Company 1-11. In form 1, win Clashes against “Golden Fruit” to reduce healing. At 1 HP, an event check leads to the next form. In form 2, break the Head to stop all Parts next turn, then use that opening to defeat the main body.
messages.第1形態は黄金の果実へのマッチ勝利で回復を減らす。HP1で判定イベントを経て次の: In form 1, win Clashes against “Golden Fruit” to reduce healing. At 1 HP, an event check leads to the next form. In form 2, break the Head to stop all Parts next turn, then use that opening to defeat the main body.
messages.1章ダンジョン3層の最終戦。第1形態はLv8・本体HP316・胴体214、第2形: The final battle on Floor 3 of the Canto I dungeon. Form 1: Lv. 8, 316 main-body HP, 214 Body HP. Form 2: Lv. 8, 383 main-body HP, 50 Head HP, 201 Body HP. HP entries distinguish main-body and Part HP. Stats from Thread Luxcavation or enhanced versions do not apply.
messages.1章の通常個体の全6技。強化された個体の高威力版とは異なる。第1形態の攻撃・守備: All 6 skills of the normal Canto I version. These differ from the higher-Power skills of enhanced versions. Form 1 uses enemy level − 2 for Offense and Defense Levels; form 2 uses enemy level + 2. Breaking the Head stops actions next turn, not on the turn it breaks.
messages.黄金の果実にはマッチで勝つ。敵に20ダメージを与え、黄金色を1減らしてターン開始: Win Clashes against “Golden Fruit”. This deals 20 damage to the enemy and reduces Golden Sheen by 1, lowering its Turn Start healing.
messages.第1形態はHP1で止まり、ターン終了時に判定が発生する。成功・失敗のどちらでも第: Form 1 stops at 1 HP and triggers a check at Turn End. Both success and failure lead to form 2, so its survival is not a bug.
messages.第2形態は打撃で頭を壊し、翌ターンの全部位行動停止を作る。破壊したターンはまだ攻: In form 2, break the Head with Blunt attacks to stop all Parts next turn. It still attacks on the turn the Head breaks, so maintain your Clashes.
messages.削ってもHPが回復して戦闘が終わらない: It keeps healing and the fight will not end
messages.第1形態は黄金色1につきターン開始時に10回復し、開始時は3なので30回復する。: Form 1 heals 10 HP per Golden Sheen at Turn Start. It starts with 3, healing 30 HP. Win against “Golden Fruit” to reduce this value, and focus your attacks.
messages.HP1から減らない: Its HP will not drop below 1
messages.1章では第1形態のHPを1にして、ターン終了時の判定へ進む。胴体破壊だけで切り替: In Canto I, reduce form 1 to 1 HP and proceed to the Turn End check. Other encounters may change forms on Body destruction alone; that condition does not apply here.
messages.頭を壊したのに攻撃が止まらない: Breaking the Head did not stop the attacks
messages.頭破壊による全部位の停止は翌ターン。破壊したターン中は攻撃してくるので、残る技へ: Head destruction stops all Parts next turn. It still attacks on the turn the Head breaks, so Clash against the remaining skills.
messages.形態移行後に弱体化が消えた: Debuffs disappeared after the form change
messages.第2形態は別の敵として扱われ、第1形態へ付けたデバフはリセットされる。移行後は新: Form 2 is treated as a separate enemy, resetting debuffs applied to form 1. After the change, choose actions based on the new HP and attacks.
messages.黄金色3で開始。破壊後も追撃可能で、行動も続く。: Starts with 3 Golden Sheen. Can still be attacked after destruction and continues acting.
messages.1章では本体HP1でターン終了時の判定が発生し、次の形態へ移る。: In Canto I, reaching 1 main-body HP triggers a Turn End check and a transition to the next form.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能。破壊したターンの攻撃は止まらない。: Can still be attacked after destruction. Attacks do not stop on the turn it breaks.
messages.次の1ターンは全部位が行動しない。頭は破壊から1ターン後に再生する。: All Parts stop acting for the next 1 turn. The Head regenerates 1 turn after destruction.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能で、行動も続く。スロット加重値は2。: Can still be attacked after destruction and continues acting. Its slot weight is 2.
messages.破壊すると次のターンから全部位に攻撃威力減少2が付く。: Destruction grants 2 Attack Power Down to all Parts from the next turn onward.
messages.回復を減らして本体HP1まで削る: Reduce healing and bring main-body HP down to 1
messages.黄金色3で戦闘が始まる。ターン開始時に黄金色×10のHPを回復するので、黄金の果: The battle starts with 3 Golden Sheen. At Turn Start, it heals Golden Sheen × 10 HP, so prioritize winning against “Golden Fruit”. Each win deals 20 damage and removes 1 Golden Sheen.
messages.打撃・怠惰が有効。第1形態の通常行動は、発芽2つ・黄金の果実1つ・硬い黄金1つと: Blunt and Sloth are effective. Form 1 alternates between 2 “Sprout”, 1 “Golden Fruit”, and 1 “Solid Gold”, and 2 “Golden Fruit” plus 2 “Solid Gold”. Take necessary Clashes and use spare actions to damage the main body.
messages.胴体を壊しても追撃でき、行動も続く。1章は本体HP1になったターンの終了時にイベ: The Body remains targetable and active after destruction. In Canto I, the event occurs at the end of the turn when main-body HP reaches 1; do not apply Part-break conditions from other encounters.
messages.本体HP1・ターン終了時の判定: Main-body HP at 1 / Turn End check
messages.失敗時の追加被害を避けて移行する: Avoid failure's extra damage while changing forms
messages.判定は怠惰が有利で、グレゴールには+4の補正がある。成功値は6（括弧内9）の表記: The check favors Sloth, and Gregor receives a +4 bonus. The required value is listed as 6 (9 in parentheses), so choose using the success prediction displayed in battle.
messages.成功しても失敗しても次の形態へ進む。失敗時は担当HP−25と、全部位へのダメージ: Both success and failure lead to the next form. Failure costs the selected Sinner 25 HP and grants 3 Damage Up to all Parts for 2 turns. Aim for success; if you fail, watch for increased damage immediately after the transition.
messages.第2形態は別の敵扱いで、第1形態のデバフは持ち越されない。新しい本体HP383を: Form 2 is treated as a different enemy; debuffs from form 1 do not carry over. Switch to reducing its new 383 main-body HP.
messages.第2形態・頭があるターン: Form 2 / turns with the Head intact
messages.頭を壊すターンもマッチを維持する: Maintain Clashes on the turn you break the Head
messages.頭の部位HPは50で打撃弱点。崩れる果肉・捕獲に強いスキルを合わせ、的中による出: The Head has 50 Part HP and is weak to Blunt. Match strong skills against “Deteriorating Flesh” and “Entangle”, preventing Bleed, Fragile, and main-body healing while damaging the Head.
messages.頭を壊すと翌ターンに全部位が行動しなくなる。破壊した瞬間に全攻撃が止まるわけでは: Breaking the Head stops all Parts next turn. It does not cancel every attack immediately, so maintain the current turn's Clashes.
messages.胴体の養分吸収も2枚目が当たるとHP回復する。頭への攻撃だけに手を使い切らず、必: The Body's Nutrient Absorption also heals HP if its second Coin hits. Keep enough actions for necessary Clashes rather than spending everything on the Head.
messages.全身が止まる隙に本体へ火力を集める: Focus damage on the main body while all Parts are inactive
messages.頭破壊後の1ターンは全部位が停止する。強い攻撃を集めて本体を削り切る。頭は再生す: All Parts stop for 1 turn after Head destruction. Focus strong attacks to finish the main body. The Head regenerates, so prepare for attacks to resume if the boss survives.
messages.頭は打撃2、胴体は斬撃2・打撃1.5。手札の物理属性で狙う部位を選ぶ。胴体を破壊: The Head has ×2 Blunt resistance; the Body has ×2 Slash and ×1.5 Blunt. Choose targets based on your skills' physical types. Breaking the Body also grants 2 Attack Power Down to all Parts from next turn onward, helping recovery.
messages.第2形態には通常の混乱区間がない。HP区間による混乱ではなく、頭破壊の専用停止を: Form 2 has no normal Stagger Thresholds. Use the special shutdown from Head destruction rather than HP-based Stagger.
messages.第1形態の通常攻撃。黄金の果実に勝つ手札を残しつつ、必要なマッチを取る。: Form 1's normal attack. Take necessary Clashes while reserving skills that can beat “Golden Fruit”.
messages.マッチに勝つと敵へ20ダメージを与え、黄金色を1減らせる。回復を抑える要の技なの: Winning the Clash deals 20 damage to the enemy and removes 1 Golden Sheen. This skill is key to reducing its healing, so match it with a strong skill.
messages.第1形態の防御。まず攻撃へのマッチ、とくに黄金の果実への勝利を優先し、残った手で: Form 1's Guard skill. Prioritize Clashes against attacks, especially winning against “Golden Fruit”, then use spare actions on the main body.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]本体の体力を3回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal 3 HP for the main body.
messages.2枚目の的中で本体HPを3回復する。頭の攻撃だけでなく、胴体からの攻撃にも必要な: Coin 2 heals 3 main-body HP on hit. Take necessary Clashes against Body attacks as well as Head attacks.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時] 次のターンに出血回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3 next turn.
messages.的中すると翌ターンに出血回数+3と脆弱2。頭に強いスキルを合わせ、的中効果を防ぎ: On Hit, adds 3 Bleed Count and inflicts 2 Fragile next turn. Use strong skills against the Head to prevent these effects while reducing its 50 HP. Head destruction stops actions from next turn onward.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]本体の体力を10回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal 10 HP for the main body.
messages.2枚目の的中で本体HP10回復と翌ターン出血5。頭を壊したターンも残りの攻撃は動: Coin 2 heals 10 main-body HP on hit and inflicts 5 Bleed next turn. Remaining attacks still happen on the turn the Head breaks, so do not abandon Clashes in reliance on destruction alone.
messages.黄金色の数値に比例してHPを回復する。黄金色の効果では、ターン開始時に数値×10: Heal HP proportional to Golden Sheen. Its effect heals stacks × 10 HP at Turn Start.
messages.黄金の果実に勝って数値を減らす。開始時3のままでは毎ターン30回復する。: Win against “Golden Fruit” to reduce the stacks. Leaving it at its initial 3 stacks allows 30 HP healing each turn.
messages.次の1ターンの間、全部位が行動しない。破壊された頭は1ターン後に再生する。: All Parts stop acting for the next 1 turn. The destroyed Head regenerates after 1 turn.
messages.破壊したターンの攻撃は残る。翌ターンの安全な時間に本体へ攻撃を集中する。: Attacks remain on the turn it breaks. Focus on the main body during the safe opening next turn.
messages.次のターンから全部位が攻撃威力減少2を得る。: All Parts gain 2 Attack Power Down from the next turn onward.
messages.頭を壊して止めるだけでなく、胴体破壊でも以後の攻撃を弱められる。: Besides stopping actions by breaking the Head, you can weaken later attacks by breaking the Body.
messages.開始時3。ターン開始時に数値×10のHPを回復する。黄金の果実でマッチに敗北する: Starts at 3. At Turn Start, heal stacks × 10 HP. Losing a Clash with “Golden Fruit” reduces stacks by 1.
messages.囚人側がマッチに勝てば回復を減らせる。守備への一方攻撃だけでなく、黄金の果実への: Winning the Clash as a Sinner reduces its healing. Prioritize “Golden Fruit” rather than only making unopposed attacks against Guard.
messages.第1形態はHP0にならず、HP1になったターン終了時に判定が発生する。成功・失敗: Form 1 cannot reach 0 HP. At the end of the turn when it reaches 1 HP, a check occurs. Both success and failure lead to form 2. Debuffs from form 1 are reset.
messages.本体HP1まで削って判定へ進む。判定成功で戦闘そのものが終わるとは考えない。: Reduce main-body HP to 1 and proceed to the check. Passing it does not end the battle itself.
messages.頭を壊すと翌1ターンの全部位の行動が止まる。破壊したターンは行動が続き、頭は1タ: Breaking the Head stops all Parts for the following 1 turn. Actions continue on the turn it breaks, and the Head regenerates after 1 turn.
messages.今の攻撃をマッチで防ぎ、翌ターンに火力をまとめる。通常の混乱とは別の効果。: Clash against current attacks and concentrate damage next turn. This effect is separate from normal Stagger.
messages.第1形態のHP1は段階移行の条件。通常の撃破待ちと取り違えない。: Reaching 1 HP in form 1 triggers phase progression. It is not a normal kill awaiting resolution.
messages.移行時の判定失敗はHP25損失と2ターンの敵ダメージ量増加3。成功しても第2形態: Failing the transition check costs 25 HP and grants the enemy 3 Damage Up for 2 turns. Even success continues into form 2.
messages.頭を壊したターンは全身がまだ行動する。翌ターンの停止を即時キャンセルと混同しない: All Parts still act on the turn the Head breaks. Next turn's shutdown is not an immediate cancellation.
messages.第2形態に通常の混乱区間はない。頭破壊後の停止と、胴体破壊後の威力低下を使う。: Form 2 has no normal Stagger Thresholds. Use the shutdown after Head destruction and reduced Power after Body destruction.
messages.出撃5名。ダンジョン推奨Lv7、敵Lv8を目安に主力のレベルとHP・精神力を整え: Deploy 5 Sinners. Prepare your core team's levels, HP, and SP using the dungeon's recommended Lv. 7 and the enemy's Lv. 8 as guides.
messages.両形態の狙いたい部位へ通る打撃を用意する。憤怒・怠惰も有効。第1形態へ斬撃を集中: Bring Blunt attacks effective against your intended Parts in both forms. Wrath and Sloth are also effective. Focusing Slash on form 1 runs into its ×0.5 resistance.
messages.移行判定は怠惰が有利。グレゴールの補正も確認し、失敗してHP25を失っても崩れな: The transition check favors Sloth. Check Gregor's bonus and choose a Sinner who can withstand losing 25 HP on failure.
messages.黄金色を減らし、第1形態の回復を抑える。: Reduce Golden Sheen to suppress healing in form 1.
messages.第2形態の頭HP50を削り、翌ターンの全部位停止を作る。: Reduce form 2's 50 Head HP to stop all Parts next turn.
messages.移行直後の追加ダメージ強化を避ける。グレゴールの+4補正も使える。: Avoid the damage bonus immediately after the transition. Gregor's +4 bonus can help.
messages.1ターンの間、スキルでの与ダメージが数値に比例して増加(最大10): For 1 turn, increase damage dealt with skills proportional to the value (max 10).
messages.1ターンの間、防御レベルが数値に比例して減少: For 1 turn, decrease Defense Level proportional to the value.
messages.1ターンの間、速度が数値だけ減少: For 1 turn, decrease Speed by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、速度が数値だけ増加: For 1 turn, increase Speed by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、攻撃レベルが数値に比例して増加: For 1 turn, increase Offense Level proportional to the value.
messages.1ターンの間、攻撃スキルの最終威力が数値だけ増加: For 1 turn, increase the Final Power of attack skills by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、攻撃レベルが数値に比例して減少: For 1 turn, decrease Offense Level proportional to the value.
messages.1ターンの間、攻撃スキルの最終威力が数値だけ減少: For 1 turn, decrease the Final Power of attack skills by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、防御レベルが数値に比例して増加: For 1 turn, increase Defense Level proportional to the value.
messages.1ターンの間、加算コインの威力が数値だけ減少: For 1 turn, decrease Plus Coin Power by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、スキルでの被ダメージが数値に比例して減少(最大10): For 1 turn, decrease damage taken from skills proportional to the value (max 10).
messages.1ターンの間、スキルでの与ダメージが数値に比例して減少(最大10): For 1 turn, decrease damage dealt with skills proportional to the value (max 10).
messages.1ターンの間、守備スキルの最終威力が数値だけ増加: For 1 turn, increase the Final Power of Defense Skills by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、守備スキルの最終威力が数値だけ減少: For 1 turn, decrease the Final Power of Defense Skills by the value.
messages.1ターンの間、加算コインの威力が数値だけ増加: For 1 turn, increase Plus Coin Power by the value.
messages.URLを確認するか、攻略一覧から探す。: Check the URL or browse the guide list.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)2-18「アイド（2-18）」の攻略。取: Aida (2-18) guide for Limbus Company 2-18. Avoid clearing the initial adds too quickly; let allied action slots grow before facing the reinforcements. Offset Evade with Defense Skills to stop repeated SP loss. Defeating Aida greatly reduces the remaining enemies' SP.
messages.取り巻きを急いで倒しすぎず、味方の行動スロットを増やしてから増援を迎える。回避に: Avoid clearing the initial adds too quickly; let allied action slots grow before facing the reinforcements. Offset Evade with Defense Skills to stop repeated SP loss. Defeating Aida greatly reduces the remaining enemies' SP.
messages.2-18の通常戦闘。敵は全てLv13。最初は取り巻き4名、増援は取り巻き6名とア: A regular encounter in 2-18. All enemies are Lv. 13. Starts with 4 adds; reinforcements consist of 6 adds and Aida. Adds have 68 HP and Defense Level 13; Aida has 267 HP and Defense Level 11. Targeting is not freely assignable as it is in Focused Encounters.
messages.取り巻き2種とアイドの全14技。共通名でもコイン枚数と効果が異なる技は別に掲載す: All 14 skills used by Aida and the 2 add types. Skills sharing a name are listed separately when their Coin counts or effects differ. The Attack Power Down value for “¿Eso es todo?” is unspecified; do not assume it is 3 like Paralyze. The Stagger Threshold reduction from “Pañata Party~!”'s Heads hit applies to the user itself.
messages.出撃5名を推奨Lv13程度まで育て、最初の4名で味方の行動スロットと精神力を整え: Raise 5 Sinners to around the recommended Lv. 13. Use the first 4 enemies to build action slots and SP rather than entering reinforcements before your main attackers have enough actions.
messages.回避に弱い攻撃を重ねない。回避へ向くスロットを守備に替えて相殺し、精神力を削られ: Avoid repeatedly attacking Evade with weak skills. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it and stop repeated SP loss.
messages.アイドの初期スロットは3・最大5。必要な攻撃を防ぎながら斬撃で削り、倒したときの: Aida starts with 3 slots and can reach 5. Block necessary attacks while dealing Slash damage, then use the remaining enemies' 45 SP loss on her defeat to finish the fight.
messages.増援が出た途端に一方攻撃を大量に受ける: Reinforcements immediately overwhelm me with unopposed attacks
messages.最初の敵を倒すのが速いと、味方のスロットが増えきらないまま増援を迎える。主力の手: Defeating the initial enemies too quickly can bring reinforcements before allied slots have fully increased. If your core lacks actions, spend the opening taking winning Clashes before advancing.
messages.回避されるたび精神力が下がって勝てなくなる: Repeated Evades drain SP until I cannot win
messages.回避は成功すると再使用され、精神力も削ってくる。回避へ向くスロットを守備に替えて: Successful Evades are reused and also reduce SP. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it. If attacking through it, use the prediction to choose a skill that can reliably beat it.
messages.敵を削ってもなかなか混乱しない: The enemy will not Stagger despite taking damage
messages.アイドは回避成功で混乱区間を5後退させる。パニャータパーティ～！にも自身の区間を: Aida lowers her Stagger Threshold by 5 on a successful Evade. “Pañata Party~!” also lowers her own Threshold. Limit failed attacks against Evade and enemy unopposed attacks.
messages.増援で出現。初期3スロット・最大5。戦闘上の撃破で残る敵全体の精神力が45減る。: Appears with reinforcements. Starts with 3 slots, up to 5. Defeating her in combat reduces all remaining enemies' SP by 45.
messages.毎ターン敵全体の精神力を10回復。自身の精神力20以上では開始時に攻撃・守備威力: Heals 10 SP for all enemies each turn. At 20 SP or higher, gains 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up at Turn Start.
messages.初期2名・増援3名。初期1スロット、増加時は最大2。: 2 initially; 3 in reinforcements. Starts with 1 slot, increasing to a maximum of 2.
messages.オーレ！で回避し、成功時に攻撃側の精神力を5減らす。平和の踊りは全味方を守備強化: Uses “¡Olé!” to Evade, reducing the attacker's SP by 5 on success. “Danza de Paz” strengthens all allies' Defense Skills.
messages.回避技はなく、自分の攻撃威力を上げる。低精神力の対象には興が乗った刺突が強化され: Has no Evade skill and increases its own Attack Power. “Puñales Joviales” becomes stronger against targets with low SP.
messages.陽気2名・軽快2名から始まる。斬撃が両方に有効。勝てるマッチを取り、味方の精神力: Starts with 2 Mariachi Alegre and 2 Mariachi Vivaz. Slash is effective against both. Take winning Clashes to raise allied SP.
messages.通常戦闘ではターン経過で味方のスロットが増える。増援との手数差に困る場合は、最初: In regular encounters, allied slots increase as turns pass. If reinforcements overwhelm your action count, avoid clearing the initial wave immediately; build more actions for your main attackers first.
messages.回避に向いた弱い手札は守備に替えて相殺する。敵の速度と自動で結ばれる攻撃先の線を: Replace weak skills aimed at Evade with Defense Skills to Offset it. Check enemy Speed and automatically assigned targeting lines; do not assume the free retargeting available in Focused Encounters.
messages.危険な攻撃を防ぎ、斬撃を通す: Block dangerous attacks and deal Slash damage
messages.増援は取り巻き計6名とアイド。アイドは最初から3スロットあり、放置すると最大5ま: Reinforcements include 6 adds and Aida. She starts with 3 slots and can increase to 5 if left alive. Check whether you have enough actions to handle the enemies' multiple attacks.
messages.アイドのこの程度か？には、マッチ敗北による精神力10損失と、的中時の翌ターン弱体: Aida's “¿Eso es todo?” costs the target 10 SP if she wins the Clash and applies debuffs next turn on hit. Prioritize winning with strong skills or available E.G.O.
messages.敵は毎ターン全体精神力を回復する。こちらの精神力が低いまま回避へ攻撃を重ねると不: The enemies heal SP across their team every turn. Repeatedly attacking Evade while your own SP is low prolongs the disadvantage; recover through Offsetting and winning Clashes.
messages.回避による区間後退を防いで決着をつける: Prevent Evade from lowering her Threshold and finish the fight
messages.アイドは斬撃2・打撃0.5。打撃だけで押すより、斬撃を通して混乱区間へ届かせる。: Aida has ×2 Slash and ×0.5 Blunt resistance. Use Slash to reach her Stagger Threshold rather than relying only on Blunt. Successful Evades lower the Threshold, so keep Offsetting them with Defense Skills.
messages.戦闘上の撃破でパーティーお開きが発動し、残る敵全体の精神力が45減る。その隙に残: Defeating her in combat activates Se Acabó la Fiesta, reducing all remaining enemies' SP by 45. Finish the survivors during this opening.
messages.取り巻きが残っているうちは、アイドへの攻撃だけに全ての手を使わない。精神力を削る: While adds remain, do not spend every action attacking Aida. Also prevent SP-draining Clash and On Hit effects.
messages.各コインの的中で敵自身の精神力が2回復する。取り巻きにもマッチを取り、敵だけが表: Each Coin heals the enemy's own SP by 2 on hit. Clash against adds as well, preventing enemies from gaining an increasing Heads advantage.
messages.[使用時]次のターン、全味方へ守備威力増加1を付与: [On Use] Grant 1 Defense Power Up to all allies next turn.
messages.使用時に翌ターンの全味方へ守備威力増加1を付ける。マッチ勝利だけでは止まらないた: On Use, grants all allies 1 Defense Power Up next turn. Winning the Clash does not stop this effect, so watch for stronger Evades.
messages.[回避成功時]対象の精神力を-5: [On Evade] Reduce the target's SP by 5.
messages.回避成功で攻撃側の精神力が5減る。回避へ向く手を守備に替えて相殺し、余った攻撃で: A successful Evade reduces the attacker's SP by 5. Switch the action aimed at Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it, then use spare attacks against other enemies.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象の精神力を-5: [Clash Win] Reduce the target's SP by 5.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力減少2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.敵のマッチ勝利でこちらの精神力が5減る。3枚目の的中では翌ターンに攻撃威力減少2: If the enemy wins the Clash, your Sinner loses 5 SP. Coin 3 also inflicts 2 Attack Power Down next turn on hit, so take a Clash you can win.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る: [On Use] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.使用時に翌ターンの攻撃威力増加1を得る。マッチに勝っても使用時効果は残るので、次: On Use, gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Winning the Clash does not remove On Use effects, so check the next prediction again.
messages.精神力が0未満の対象を攻撃時、スキル威力+1: Gain +1 Skill Power when attacking a target with SP below 0.
messages.精神力0未満の相手にはスキル威力+1。4枚コインを一方攻撃で受けると被害が重なる: Gains +1 Skill Power against targets below 0 SP. Taking all 4 Coins unopposed compounds damage, so restore allies with low SP.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに呼吸1を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに呼吸1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに呼吸1を得る: Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]次のターンに呼吸1を得る: Ⅳ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.
messages.使用時の精神力5回復はマッチに勝っても止まらない。4枚コインの的中で翌ターンの呼: Winning the Clash does not stop its On Use healing of 5 SP. Its 4 Coins gain Poise next turn on hit, so avoid letting the attack through unopposed.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象へ10精神力ダメージ: [Clash Win] Deal 10 SP damage to the target.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力減少、麻痺3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Attack Power Down and 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.敵のマッチ勝利でこちらの精神力が10減る。的中すると翌ターンの攻撃威力減少と麻痺: If the enemy wins the Clash, your Sinner loses 10 SP. On Hit also inflicts Attack Power Down and 3 Paralyze next turn, so match it with a winning skill or E.G.O.
messages.[回避成功時]混乱区間を5後退。対象に5精神力ダメージ: [On Evade] Lower own Stagger Threshold by 5. Deal 5 SP damage to the target.
messages.回避成功で敵の混乱区間が5後退し、攻撃側の精神力が5減る。回避へ向くスロットを守: A successful Evade lowers the enemy's own Stagger Threshold by 5 and reduces the attacker's SP by 5. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it instead of letting weak attacks be repeatedly dodged.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.2枚目の的中で翌ターンの攻撃威力増加2を得る。精神力と威力の強化を重ねさせないよ: Coin 2 gains 2 Attack Power Up next turn on hit. Use the current prediction to take a Clash and prevent SP and Power bonuses from compounding.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに守備威力増加2を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Defense Power Up next turn.
messages.2枚目の的中で翌ターンの守備威力増加2を得る。次の回避も強まるので、的中を防ぐか: Coin 2 gains 2 Defense Power Up next turn on hit, strengthening the next Evade. Prevent the hit or retain an action for Offsetting it with defense.
messages.[使用時]精神力が0未満の敵を攻撃するとき、対象の精神力に比例してクリティカル発: [On Use] When attacking an enemy below 0 SP, increase critical hit chance based on the target's SP.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]ダメージの50%混乱区間を後退: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Lower own Stagger Threshold by 50% of the damage dealt.
messages.精神力0未満の相手には、精神力に応じてクリティカル率が増す。表面での1枚目の的中: Critical chance increases against targets below 0 SP according to their SP. A Heads hit on Coin 1 lowers the enemy's own Stagger Threshold, so avoid taking it unopposed with low SP.
messages.毎ターン・自分の精神力20以上: Every turn / own SP at 20 or higher
messages.自分を含む全味方の精神力を10回復。自身の精神力が20以上ならターン開始時に攻撃: Heal 10 SP for all allies, including self. At Turn Start, if own SP is at least 20, gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up.
messages.長期戦で敵の精神力が戻る。現在の威力と回避の予測を確認し、勝てる手札を使う。: Enemies regain SP during longer fights. Check current Power and Evade predictions and use skills that can win.
messages.アイドを倒すと残る敵が弱る。本人の撃破を狙いつつ、処理中の一方攻撃にも備える。: Defeating Aida weakens the remaining enemies. Aim to finish her while also preparing for unopposed attacks during the process.
messages.最初は取り巻き4名。増援で取り巻き6名とアイドが出る。味方・敵ともターン経過で手: Starts with 4 adds. Reinforcements bring 6 adds and Aida. Both sides gain actions as turns pass; Aida starts with 3 slots and can reach 5.
messages.序盤を急ぎすぎて手数不足になるなら、初期敵とのマッチで準備する。: If rushing the opening leaves you short of actions, prepare by taking Clashes against the initial enemies.
messages.陽気な組織員とアイドの回避は、成功時に攻撃側の精神力を5減らす。アイドは混乱区間: Successful Evades by Mariachi Alegre and Aida reduce the attacker's SP by 5. Aida also lowers her own Stagger Threshold by 5.
messages.回避を守備で相殺し、弱い攻撃を何度も避けられる展開を止める。: Offset Evade with Defense Skills to stop weak attacks from being repeatedly dodged.
messages.士気低下では開始時に攻撃威力減少2、パニックでは攻撃威力減少4を得る。取り巻きの: At Turn Start, Low Morale grants 2 Attack Power Down; Panic grants 4 Attack Power Down. Adds enter Low Morale at -20 SP or lower; Aida's threshold is unknown. Panic occurs at -45 SP.
messages.敵の精神力を下げることは攻撃抑制につながるが、毎ターンの回復もある。現在の状態を: Lowering enemy SP can suppress their attacks, but they also heal each turn. Check their current state.
messages.これは通常戦闘。集中戦闘のように攻撃先を自由に割り当てる手順にはしない。: This is a regular encounter. Do not follow a plan that assumes freely assigned targets as in Focused Encounters.
messages.序盤を速く終えすぎると、味方のスロット不足のまま増援へ進むことがある。: Clearing the opening too quickly may bring reinforcements while allied action slots are still insufficient.
messages.アイドは斬撃弱点・打撃耐性。弱点を取り違えない。: Aida is weak to Slash and resistant to Blunt. Keep those resistances distinct.
messages.この程度か？の攻撃威力減少量は未記載。麻痺3と同じ量を補わない。: The Attack Power Down value of “¿Eso es todo?” is unspecified. Do not fill it in as 3 just because Paralyze has that value.
messages.主力5名を推奨Lv13程度まで育てる。マッチに勝てるレベルと、斬撃の手札をそろえ: Raise 5 core Sinners to around the recommended Lv. 13. Prepare levels that can win Clashes and a selection of Slash skills.
messages.使えるE.G.Oがあれば、不利なマッチの立て直しに残す。回避は強い技で毎回突破す: If E.G.O is available, save it to recover unfavorable Clashes. Offset Evade with defense instead of always trying to overpower it.
messages.取り巻きとアイドの斬撃弱点を突き、混乱と撃破を進める。: Exploit the adds' and Aida's Slash weakness to Stagger and defeat them.
messages.回避へ向くスロットの守備: Defense Skills in slots targeting Evade
messages.回避成功による精神力低下と区間後退を防ぐ。: Prevent SP loss and lowered Stagger Thresholds from successful Evades.
messages.回避・マッチ敗北で下がった精神力を戻し、敵との表面確率差を抑える。: Restore SP lost through Evades and failed Clashes to reduce the Heads chance gap between your team and the enemies.
messages.【リンバス】2-19 バーバヤーガ（2章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 2-19 Baba Yaga (Canto II) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)2-19「バーバヤーガ（2章）」の攻略。: Baba Yaga (Canto II) guide for Limbus Company 2-19. Build SP and E.G.O resources in Wave 1, then defeat all enemies within 4 turns in each of Waves 2–4. Rather than Clashing against every attack, use fast Blunt attacks to Stagger enemies and stop their remaining actions. The deadline causes a forced defeat that HP cannot withstand.
messages.第1ウェーブで精神力とE.G.O資源を整え、第2〜第4ウェーブは各4ターン以内に: Build SP and E.G.O resources in Wave 1, then defeat all enemies within 4 turns in each of Waves 2–4. Rather than Clashing against every attack, use fast Blunt attacks to Stagger enemies and stop their remaining actions. The deadline causes a forced defeat that HP cannot withstand.
messages.2章ダンジョン3層の4ウェーブ戦。直接戦う敵4種は全てLv15・HP41。鉱山の: A 4-Wave battle on Floor 3 of the Canto II dungeon. All 4 enemy types fought directly are Lv. 15 with 41 HP. Miner Slaves are also Lv. 15 here, unlike the Lv. 14 versions encountered earlier. Progress by clearing each Wave rather than attacking Baba Yaga's main body.
messages.隣人2種・鉱山の奴隷2種は、それぞれ同じ技を使うため使用者別に全12表示へ分ける: The 2 Neighbor types share skills, as do the 2 Miner Slave types, giving 12 entries separated by user. “Slicing Smack”'s +1 Skill Power On Use is not included in its displayed Base Power. “Foot Stomp” and “Beak Smash” use Minus Coins.
messages.第1ウェーブには制限時間がない。3体へのマッチで精神力を上げ、使いたいE.G.O: Wave 1 has no time limit. Raise SP through Clashes against its 3 enemies and collect resources for the E.G.O you plan to use before advancing.
messages.第2〜第4ウェーブはそれぞれ4ターン以内に全滅させる。そのウェーブの5ターン目開: Clear each of Waves 2–4 within 4 turns. At the start of that Wave's fifth turn, Baba Yaga’s Coming! reaches 0 and forces defeat.
messages.敵は全員打撃弱点で、HP50%に混乱区間がある。速い攻撃で混乱させ、同じ敵の残り: Every enemy is weak to Blunt and has a Stagger Threshold at 50% HP. Use fast attacks to Stagger them and stop their remaining actions. Multi-target Blunt E.G.O is also effective.
messages.味方のHPが残っていたのに全滅した: My team was wiped out despite having HP remaining
messages.近寄るバーバヤーガ0で出撃人員が死亡し、強制敗北する。回復や防御では制限時間を延: At 0 Baba Yaga’s Coming!, deployed units die and the fight ends in defeat. Healing or defense cannot extend the time limit. Watch the remaining counter in each Wave and keep attacking.
messages.敵の行動が多く、全てにマッチを合わせられない: There are too many enemy actions to Clash against them all
messages.敵1体を先に混乱させると、その敵の後続行動も止められる。速い打撃を当て、止まる敵: Staggering an enemy before it acts also stops its later actions. Use a fast Blunt attack, then direct other actions toward remaining enemies instead of wasting them on other slots of an enemy that will be stopped.
messages.敵を減らしたのに最後の1体が硬い: The last enemy became tough despite clearing the others
messages.肌を抉る恐怖で、このウェーブ中に倒れた味方の数だけ保護を得る。可能なら同じターン: Shuddering Terror grants Protection based on how many of the enemy's allies died during the Wave. If possible, defeat multiple enemies in the same turn; use strong attacks against weaknesses to finish survivors.
messages.第1ウェーブ2体、第2ウェーブ2体、第3ウェーブ2体。部位破壊不可。: 2 in Wave 1, 2 in Wave 2, and 2 in Wave 3. Parts cannot be broken.
messages.打撃2・憤怒2。味方の死亡で保護を得るため、数を減らした後の残敵も確認する。: ×2 Blunt and ×2 Wrath resistance. Gains Protection when allies die, so reassess survivors after reducing enemy numbers.
messages.第1ウェーブ1体、第2ウェーブ2体、第3ウェーブ1体。眠りから目覚めた隣人と能力: 1 in Wave 1, 2 in Wave 2, and 1 in Wave 3. Shares stats and skills with Slumber-broken Neighbor.
messages.2ウェーブ目以降はウェーブ開始時に近寄るバーバヤーガ4を得る。: From Wave 2 onward, gains 4 Baba Yaga’s Coming! at the start of each Wave.
messages.第3ウェーブ2体、第4ウェーブ2体。ボス戦はLv15・HP41。道中のLv14・: 2 in Wave 3 and 2 in Wave 4. In this boss fight, Lv. 15 with 41 HP, unlike the earlier Lv. 14, 40 HP version.
messages.打撃・怠惰2。氷を吐くは最大12なので、弱い通常敵と見て一方攻撃を通さない。: ×2 Blunt and ×2 Sloth resistance. “Ice Chuck” has a maximum Power of 12, so do not let it through unopposed as if it were a weak normal enemy's attack.
messages.第4ウェーブ3体。凍りゆく鉱山の奴隷と能力・技は共通。: 3 in Wave 4. Shares stats and skills with Freezing Miner Slave.
messages.部位破壊不可。2ウェーブ目以降は各ウェーブ4ターン以内の撃破が必要。: Parts cannot be broken. From Wave 2 onward, all enemies in each Wave must be defeated within 4 turns.
messages.時間制限のない間に準備する: Prepare while there is no time limit
messages.眠りから目覚めた隣人2体・再び起き上がった隣人1体。ここには4ターン制限がない。: 2 Slumber-broken Neighbors and 1 Rearisen Neighbor. The 4-turn limit does not apply here.
messages.勝てるマッチで精神力を上げ、後の打撃広域E.G.Oを使う資源を用意する。無用に被: Raise SP through winning Clashes and prepare resources for later multi-target Blunt E.G.O. There is no need to take unnecessary hits to stockpile resources, but avoid rushing ahead with low SP.
messages.敵全滅で次のウェーブへ進む。後のウェーブでは期限が付くため、HP・精神力・手札を: Defeating all enemies advances to the next Wave. Later Waves have deadlines, so check HP, SP, and available skills before finishing this one.
messages.先行混乱で複数行動を止める: Stagger enemies before they act to stop multiple actions
messages.隣人2種が2体ずつ。全敵に近寄るバーバヤーガ4が付き、毎ターン減っていく。: 2 of each Neighbor type. All enemies receive 4 Baba Yaga’s Coming!, decreasing each turn.
messages.全ての敵は打撃2で、HP50%に混乱区間がある。速い打撃で混乱させ、同じ敵の残る: Every enemy has ×2 Blunt resistance and a Stagger Threshold at 50% HP. Stagger them with fast Blunt attacks to stop their remaining actions. Check that the attacker will move before the enemy.
messages.そのウェーブの5ターン目開始時までに全敵を倒す。4ターン目の終了時に火傷などで倒: Defeat all enemies before the start of this Wave's fifth turn. Burn or other damage at the end of turn 4 can still finish them in time, but do not rely solely on uncertain damage over time.
messages.打撃広域で行動数を減らす: Reduce enemy actions with multi-target Blunt attacks
messages.眠りから目覚めた隣人2体・再び起き上がった隣人1体・凍りゆく鉱山の奴隷2体。制限: 2 Slumber-broken Neighbors, 1 Rearisen Neighbor, and 2 Freezing Miner Slaves. The countdown starts at 4 again when this Wave begins.
messages.使えるなら表象放出機や虚幻境などの打撃広域E.G.Oで複数を混乱・撃破へ進める。: If available, use multi-target Blunt E.G.O such as Representation Emitter or Land of Illusion to Stagger or defeat several enemies. Check Attack Weight and actual targets; do not assume every enemy will be hit.
messages.奴隷の氷を吐くは最大12。弱い手札で負けるより、先に混乱させるか強いマッチで防ぐ: The slaves' “Ice Chuck” reaches 12 Power. Rather than losing with a weak skill, Stagger them first or block with a strong Clash. More enemy deaths grant Protection to survivors, so also aim for multiple kills in the same turn.
messages.怠惰・打撃で最後の敵を倒す: Finish the last enemies with Sloth and Blunt
messages.凍りゆく鉱山の奴隷2体・寒がる鉱山の奴隷3体。全て打撃2・怠惰2で、残る手札とE: 2 Freezing Miner Slaves and 3 Shivering Miner Slaves. All have ×2 Blunt and ×2 Sloth resistance. Use remaining skills and E.G.O to clear them before the deadline.
messages.嘴で壊すの束縛があると次の先行攻撃が難しくなる。必要なマッチを取り、混乱した敵は: Bind from “Beak Smash” can prevent early attacks next turn. Take necessary Clashes and quickly finish Staggered enemies.
messages.4ウェーブを全て制圧すれば戦闘が終わる。近寄るバーバヤーガ0は通常の高ダメージ技: Suppressing all 4 Waves ends the fight. At 0, Baba Yaga’s Coming! causes forced defeat rather than a normal high-damage attack; remaining HP cannot keep you alive.
messages.最大8の斬撃。打撃で先に混乱へ届かせれば、この敵の後続行動も止められる。混乱を狙: A Slash attack with a maximum Power of 8. A Blunt attack that Staggers it first also stops its later actions. Check that the intended attacker acts first.
messages.[使用時]自分に10ダメージ。スキル威力+1: [On Use] Take 10 damage. Gain +1 Skill Power.
messages.素の2〜6に使用時の威力+1が加わる。使用時の自傷10はマッチに勝っても起きるが: Its unmodified 2–6 range gains +1 Power On Use. The 10 self-damage still occurs if you win the Clash, but do not assume self-damage will reliably kill it.
messages.基本11・コイン−9の減算スキル。表面的中では翌ターンに脆弱1。低い側の威力だけ: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 11 and Coin Power −9. A Heads hit inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. Use the current prediction to Clash or Stagger it first rather than looking only at the lower end of its range.
messages.最大8の貫通。期限内に倒す必要があるため、全ての攻撃へ1つずつマッチを取るだけで: A Pierce attack with a maximum Power of 8. With the deadline in mind, exploit weaknesses to Stagger enemies rather than only assigning a separate Clash to every attack.
messages.最大12の1枚技。弱い手札で受けず、強いマッチか先行混乱で止める。打撃弱点なので: A 1-Coin skill with a maximum Power of 12. Stop it with a strong Clash or an earlier Stagger instead of facing it with a weak skill. Blunt attacks and multi-target Blunt E.G.O are effective against its user's weakness.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに束縛1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.
messages.基本4・コイン−1の2枚技。2枚目の的中で翌ターン束縛1。次のターンに先行混乱を: Base Power 4, Coin Power −1, and 2 Coins. Coin 2 inflicts 1 Bind next turn on hit. Take necessary Clashes so reduced Speed does not prevent you from Staggering enemies first next turn.
messages.このウェーブ中に味方が死亡する: An ally dies during this Wave
messages.このウェーブで死亡した味方の数だけ保護を得る（最大5）。: Gain Protection equal to the number of allies who died during this Wave (max 5).
messages.1体ずつ時間をかけると残敵が硬くなる。同じターンの複数撃破や弱点への強い攻撃を使: Taking too long to defeat enemies one by one makes survivors tougher. Use multiple kills in the same turn or strong attacks against weaknesses to finish within 4 turns.
messages.第2〜第4ウェーブの開始時、敵全体に4を付与。ターン経過で1ずつ減り、そのウェー: At the start of Waves 2–4, grant 4 to all enemies. Decreases by 1 as each turn passes. If it reaches 0 at the start of that Wave's fifth turn, all deployed units die, forcing defeat. Backup and support units are excluded from this instant death, but cannot prevent defeat.
messages.各ウェーブを4ターン以内に終える。第1ウェーブには付かないので、その間に精神力と: Finish each Wave within 4 turns. The effect is absent in Wave 1, so use that time to prepare SP and resources.
messages.直接戦う敵はHP50%に混乱区間があり、混乱させるとその敵の残る行動を止められる: Enemies fought directly have Stagger Thresholds at 50% HP. Staggering one stops its remaining actions.
messages.敵の全行動へ別々のマッチを割り当てるだけでなく、速い打撃1つで混乱させて複数行動: Instead of assigning a separate Clash to every enemy action, use 1 fast Blunt attack to Stagger an enemy and stop several actions.
messages.制限は戦闘全体の4ターンではなく、第2〜第4ウェーブそれぞれの4ターン。: The limit is 4 turns for each of Waves 2–4, not 4 turns for the entire fight.
messages.第1ウェーブには制限がないが、第2ウェーブ以降は回復や防御だけでは進まない。: Wave 1 has no limit, but from Wave 2 onward, healing and defense alone will not advance the fight.
messages.期限切れは即死と強制敗北。HPを多く残していても耐えられない。: The deadline causes instant death and forced defeat. Even a large amount of remaining HP cannot withstand it.
messages.残敵には死亡した味方の数に応じた保護が付く。最後の1体への火力も確保する。: Survivors gain Protection based on the number of their allies who died. Retain enough damage to finish the final enemy.
messages.鉱山の奴隷のこの戦闘での値はLv15・HP41。道中のLv14・HP40を流用し: Miner Slaves in this encounter are Lv. 15 with 41 HP. Do not use the earlier Lv. 14, 40 HP stats.
messages.出撃5名。ダンジョン推奨Lv15を目安に育成し、第1ウェーブで精神力と資源を整え: Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the dungeon's recommended Lv. 15 as a guide and prepare SP and resources in Wave 1.
messages.全敵が打撃弱点。隣人には憤怒・傲慢、奴隷には怠惰も有効。貫通は0.75なので、貫: All enemies are weak to Blunt. Wrath and Pride also work against Neighbors; Sloth works against the slaves. Pierce resistance is ×0.75, making a Pierce-only team less effective.
messages.使える打撃広域E.G.Oと、その資源・精神力消費を確認する。広域がなくても、速い: Check available multi-target Blunt E.G.O and its resource and SP costs. Without it, you can still progress by repeatedly using fast Blunt attacks to Stagger enemies and defeat them individually.
messages.敵を先に混乱させ、行動数の不利を減らす。: Stagger enemies before they act to reduce the action-count disadvantage.
messages.複数の敵をまとめて混乱・撃破し、期限内の全滅を助ける。: Stagger or defeat multiple enemies together to help clear each Wave before the deadline.
messages.保護の付いた最後の敵を期限内に処理する。: Defeat the final enemy with Protection before the deadline.
messages.【リンバス】2-19 お前ぶたれたい？しこたま？（2章）の攻略｜Limbus A: 2-19 You Want To Get Beat? Hurtily? (Canto II) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)2-19「お前ぶたれたい？しこたま？（2: You Want To Get Beat? Hurtily? (Canto II) guide for Limbus Company 2-19. Defeat adds to trigger revivals, then investigate the factory. After the warning, Stagger or defeat the main body. Choose “No.” 3 times at the control panel to stop all enemy revivals without losing HP. After shutdown, keep Clashing to block attacks and finish the enemies.
