messages.取り巻きを倒して復活を進め、工場を調査する。予告後に本体を混乱・撃破させ、操作盤: Defeat adds to trigger revivals, then investigate the factory. After the warning, Stagger or defeat the main body. Choose “No.” 3 times at the control panel to stop all enemy revivals without losing HP. After shutdown, keep Clashing to block attacks and finish the enemies.
messages.2章ダンジョン2層の個体。本体Lv13・防御Lv15・部位HP90。開始本体HP: The Floor 2 encounter in the Canto II dungeon. Main body: Lv. 13, Defense Level 15, 90 Part HP. Starting main-body HP is inconsistently listed as 152 or 120 and remains unconfirmed. Add HP is also inconsistent, with 51 main-body HP and 52 Part HP listed; it is not treated as confirmed. Do not infer HP from enemy level or other encounters.
messages.本体6技と取り巻き2種各4技の全14表示。ぱにっしゅ☆めんとは基本3・コイン+6: All 14 entries: 6 main-body skills and 4 for each add type. “PUNISH☆MENT” has Base Power 3, +6 Coin Power, and 2 Coins; its +2 On Use Power is not included in Base Power. “Don’t Stop Me?!” and “So Busy…” are Minus Coin Guard skills. Surgery's damage bonus applies separately even to low-Power skills after shutdown.
messages.最初は取り巻き2名を優先してHP0にし、敵全体で復活による施術増加を計2進める。: Prioritize reducing both adds to 0 HP, triggering a total of 2 Surgery increases from revivals across the enemy team. There is no need to repeatedly defeat the main body.
messages.調査の選択では「工場を調査する。」を選ぶ。次の予告後に本体を混乱・撃破させたら、: Choose “Investigate the factory.” After the next warning, Stagger or defeat the main body, then select “No.” a total of 3 times at the control panel.
messages.工場を止めた後も施術の強化は残る。ひ・じょう・じ・たい！！！に勝ち、脆弱が付いた: Surgery's bonuses remain after stopping the factory. Beat “E-MER-GEN-CY!!!” and finish enemies while they have Fragile. Do not let low-Power attacks through unopposed.
messages.強化工場稼働で復活し、施術が1ずつ増える。工場停止イベントで復活を止めるか、施術: Upgrade Factory at Work revives them and increases Surgery by 1. Stop revivals through the shutdown event or continue defeating them until Surgery reaches 5. Normally, use the 2 adds to meet the investigation requirement.
messages.本体を追撃しても施術が一度しか増えない: Extra attacks on the main body increase Surgery only once
messages.HP0にした同じターンの追撃で何段階も増えるわけではない。別の敵を倒すか、次の復: Repeated attacks during the same turn in which an enemy reaches 0 HP do not add multiple stages. Defeat another enemy or wait for the next revival before attacking again.
messages.調査を選んだのに次の予告が出ない: I investigated, but the next warning never appeared
messages.最初の調査イベント開始時に本体が死亡状態だと、次の予告・イベントが発生しない場合: If the main body is dead when the first investigation event begins, the next warning or event may not occur. Use adds for the investigation requirement, then Stagger or defeat the main body after the next warning.
messages.工場を止めたら味方全員が30ダメージを受けた: Stopping the factory dealt 30 damage to every ally
messages.「そうでない。」が3回になる前に5回目の入力へ達すると、停止の代償に全員HP−3: Reaching the fifth input before giving “No.” 3 times stops the factory at a cost of 30 HP for everyone. Avoid extra choices and select “No.” 3 times.
messages.施術1で開始。破壊後も追撃可能で行動も続く。: Starts with 1 Surgery. Remains targetable and continues acting after Part destruction.
messages.強化工場稼働による復活時は部位も復活し、部位HPを全回復する。表示速度とは別に施: Revival through Upgrade Factory at Work also revives the Part and fully restores its HP. Surgery grants Haste in addition to the displayed Speed.
messages.1名。部位破壊不可。打撃・憤怒・傲慢が有効。: 1 enemy. Part cannot be broken. Blunt, Wrath, and Pride are effective.
messages.工場が動いている間は復活する。最初の調査条件を進める対象にする。: Revives while the factory is running. Use it to progress the first investigation requirement.
messages.1名。部位破壊不可。せっせと！ではなく頑張って！などの貫通技を使う。: 1 enemy. Part cannot be broken. Uses Pierce skills such as “Work Hard!” rather than “Stay Diligent!”.
messages.工場が動いている間は復活する。討伐後の追撃だけで施術を何段階も増やすことはできな: Revives while the factory is running. Further attacks after defeating it cannot advance Surgery through multiple stages.
messages.開幕〜最初の調査予告: Opening to the first investigation warning
messages.取り巻き2名で復活の条件を進める: Use the 2 adds to progress the revival requirement
messages.本体には必要なマッチを取り、空いた打撃を取り巻きへ集める。本体は貫通、取り巻きは: Take necessary Clashes against the main body, and direct spare Blunt attacks at adds. Pierce is effective against the main body; Blunt against adds. Wrath and Pride also deal good damage.
messages.取り巻きをそれぞれHP0にし、復活による施術増加を敵全体で計2進める。1体の本体: Reduce each add to 0 HP to trigger a total of 2 Surgery increases from revivals across the enemy team. Progress the requirement using the low-HP adds rather than repeatedly damaging the main body.
messages.本体が最初の調査イベント時点で死亡していると次の調査が起きない例外がある。基本手: If the main body is dead at the first investigation event, an exception can prevent the next investigation. For the standard route, trigger the warning through the adds instead of defeating the main body first.
messages.工場調査を選び、次の予告を待つ: Investigate the factory and wait for the next warning
messages.「工場を調査する。」を選ぶ。ここで判定のサイコロを振る必要はない。: Choose “Investigate the factory.” No dice check is needed here.
messages.調査しない選択では、工場停止による攻略ができなくなる。その場合は施術5まで倒し続: Choosing not to investigate closes the shutdown route. In that case, keep defeating enemies until Surgery reaches 5.
messages.調査後のターン開始時に出る「一番大きい奴を狙え！」の予告を確認し、その後に本体を: After investigating, watch for the Turn Start warning “Go for the Big One!”, then Stagger the main body or reduce it to 0 HP.
messages.そうでないを3回選び、代償なく工場を止める: Select “No.” 3 times to stop the factory without a cost
messages.操作盤では「そうでない。」を合計3回選ぶ。敵全体の強化工場稼働が消え、復活しなく: At the control panel, choose “No.” a total of 3 times. Upgrade Factory at Work is removed from all enemies, preventing revivals.
messages.3回に届かないまま5回目の入力へ進むと、全囚人HP−30の代償付きで停止する。5: If the fifth input is reached before 3 “No.” inputs, shutdown costs all Sinners 30 HP. There is no cost if the fifth input is also the third negative answer, but choosing it 3 times consecutively from the start avoids this complication.
messages.停止直後は敵が脆弱を得て、ひ・じょう・じ・たい！！！中心の行動になる。復活が消え: Immediately after shutdown, enemies gain Fragile and mainly use “E-MER-GEN-CY!!!”. Removing revivals does not instantly defeat every enemy.
messages.低威力技にも勝って倒し切る: Win even the low-Power Clashes and finish the fight
messages.ひ・じょう・じ・たい！！！は素の最大4だが、施術のダメージ増加がある。被害を受け: “E-MER-GEN-CY!!!” has an unmodified maximum Power of 4, but Surgery increases its damage. Win Clashes before taking hits and defeat the enemies with Fragile.
messages.調査ルートを使わない場合は、復活のたびに増す施術を5まで進める。施術増加で最大H: Without the investigation route, keep triggering revivals until Surgery reaches 5. Increasing Surgery lowers max HP but raises Speed and damage, so do not let attacks through.
messages.施術の加算は同一ターンの追撃で繰り返し起こらない。行動中の別の敵や、次の復活後へ: Extra hits in the same turn do not repeatedly add Surgery. Redirect attacks to another active enemy or attack after the next revival.
messages.基本9・コイン−7の減算技。表面が出ると弱まる。施術によるダメージ強化はあるため: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 9 and Coin Power −7. Heads makes it weaker. Surgery still increases its damage, so do not allow an unopposed attack based only on the lower end of its Power range.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンにクイック2を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 2 Haste next turn.
messages.素の最大13。的中で翌ターンクイック2も得るため、現在のマッチ予測を確認して防ぐ: Its unmodified maximum Power is 13. On Hit also grants 2 Haste next turn, so check the current Clash prediction and stop it.
messages.2枚コインの各的中で敵自身に3ダメージ。自傷だけで倒れることを待たず、危険な攻撃: Each of its 2 Coins deals 3 damage to the user on hit. Do not simply wait for self-damage to finish it; deal damage while Clashing against dangerous attacks.
messages.[使用時]自分に10ダメージ。スキル威力+2: [On Use] Take 10 damage. Gain +2 Skill Power.
messages.素の3〜15に使用時のスキル威力+2が加わり5〜17。自傷10は使用時なので、マ: Its unmodified 3–15 range becomes 5–17 with +2 Skill Power On Use. The 10 self-damage also occurs On Use; winning the Clash alone does not stop the Power increase. Use a strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.工場停止後に使う。素の最大4でも施術でダメージが増しているため、低威力を理由に一: Used after factory shutdown. Even with an unmodified maximum Power of 4, Surgery increases its damage. Do not let it through unopposed just because its Power is low; keep winning Clashes to finish it.
messages.減算コインの防御で表示は5〜7。危険な攻撃へのマッチを優先し、残った攻撃で本体を: A Minus Coin Guard skill with a displayed 5–7 range. Prioritize Clashes against dangerous attacks, then use spare actions to Stagger or defeat the main body. Part destruction alone does not stop its actions.
messages.基本3・コイン−1の2枚技。比較的低威力なので、勝てる手札を使って取り巻きをHP: Base Power 3, Coin Power −1, and 2 Coins. Its relatively low Power makes it suitable for winning Clashes while reducing adds to 0 HP and progressing the investigation requirement.
messages.使用時に自傷10とスキル威力+1。素の2〜8より実際の予測が高くなる。勝てるマッ: On Use, takes 10 self-damage and gains +1 Skill Power. The actual prediction is higher than the unmodified 2–8 range. Win Clashes while progressing the adds' revivals.
messages.基本6・コイン−2の防御。敵をHP0にした後の同ターンの追撃では施術を何段階も進: A Guard skill with Base Power 6 and Coin Power −2. After an enemy reaches 0 HP, further attacks that turn do not advance Surgery multiple stages; target another active enemy instead.
messages.素の2〜11に使用時の威力+1が加わる。取り巻きでも最大12になるため、弱い敵だ: Its unmodified 2–11 range gains +1 Power On Use. Even an add can reach 12, so do not allow an unopposed attack merely because it is a lesser enemy.
messages.減算2枚で素の1〜3。危険な高威力技に強い手を残し、こちらは勝てる手札で処理する: A 2-Coin Minus skill with an unmodified 1–3 range. Reserve stronger skills for dangerous high-Power attacks and handle this one with a skill that can win.
messages.本体は保護を持つ。取り巻きの保護1とは分けて、通りやすい貫通・憤怒・傲慢を使う。: The main body has Protection. Distinguish it from the adds' 1 Protection and use effective Pierce, Wrath, or Pride attacks.
messages.次のターンに施術1を得て復活する。: Revive next turn with 1 additional Surgery.
messages.工場停止で復活を止めるか、施術5まで進める。同ターンの追撃で施術を何段階も増やせ: Stop revivals by shutting down the factory, or progress Surgery to 5. Extra attacks in the same turn do not add multiple Surgery stages.
messages.本体より保護は少ない。取り巻きへの打撃で調査条件を進める。: Has less Protection than the main body. Use Blunt attacks against adds to progress the investigation requirement.
messages.5になると死亡する。数値ごとに最大HPが20%ずつ下がり、与ダメージが増す。毎タ: Dies at 5. Each stack reduces max HP by 20% and increases damage dealt. Gain Haste equal to the value each turn. Damage increases are listed in increments of 20, but the unit is unconfirmed.
messages.復活するほどHPは減るが、速度と攻撃の被害は増す。現在の最大HPへ毎回20%を掛: Revivals reduce HP but increase Speed and damage. Do not repeatedly multiply the current max HP by 20%, or treat the damage bonus as an unconfirmed flat damage increase.
messages.敵全体で復活による施術増加が計2進むと調査の機会が出る。調査を選び、次の予告後に: A total of 2 Surgery increases from revivals across the enemy team creates an investigation opportunity. Investigate, then Stagger or defeat the main body after the next warning to reach the control panel.
messages.取り巻き2名を使って最初の条件を進める。本体の死亡状態による例外を避けるため、次: Use both adds to meet the initial requirement. To avoid the exception involving the main body's dead state, do not finish it before the next warning.
messages.敵全体の復活パッシブが消え、脆弱を得て行動パターンが変化する。施術そのものは停止: All enemies lose their revival passive, gain Fragile, and change behavior. Shutdown is not stated to remove Surgery itself.
messages.低威力の攻撃にもマッチを取り、残るダメージ強化を受けずに終える。: Clash even against low-Power attacks and finish the fight without taking hits strengthened by the remaining damage bonus.
messages.最初の調査時に本体が死亡状態だと、次の調査イベントが起きない例外がある。: If the main body is dead during the first investigation, an exception can prevent the next investigation event.
messages.部位破壊だけでは本体の行動は止まらず、復活時には部位も戻る。: Part destruction alone does not stop the main body's actions, and revival restores the Part as well.
messages.ぱにっしゅ☆めんとの使用時強化を含めると5〜17。素の3〜15だけでマッチを判断: Including its On Use bonus, “PUNISH☆MENT” rolls 5–17. Do not judge the Clash using only its unmodified 3–15 range.
messages.工場停止後も施術のダメージ増加を警戒する。素の威力が低いことと被弾が軽いことは同: After shutdown, still account for Surgery's damage bonus. Low Power does not necessarily mean a hit deals little damage.
messages.開始HPには記載差があり未確定。特定のHP値からの固定手順を前提にしない。: Starting HP is inconsistent and unconfirmed. Do not rely on a fixed sequence based on one specific HP value.
Deploy 5 Sinners. Use the Canto II dungeon's recommended Lv. 15 as a guide and prepare a core team that can win Clashes, plus any available E.G.O.
messages.本体へ貫通、取り巻きへ打撃が有効。憤怒・傲慢も通る。施術で速くなるため、速度も確: Pierce is effective against the main body; Blunt against adds. Wrath and Pride also work well. Check Speed as Surgery makes enemies faster.
messages.最初の調査条件を本体の撃破に頼らず進める。: Meet the first investigation requirement without relying on defeating the main body.
messages.本体へ勝つ高威力の手札: High-Power skills for the main body
messages.ぱにっしゅ☆めんとを防ぎ、予告後に本体を混乱・撃破へ進める。: Stop “PUNISH☆MENT”, then Stagger or defeat the main body after the warning.
messages.施術が残った低威力攻撃を素通しせず、脆弱の間に倒す。: Do not let low-Power attacks through while Surgery remains. Finish the enemies during Fragile.

messages.【リンバス】3-18 執念のグイド（3-18）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 3-18 Guido the Persistent (3-18) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)3-18「執念のグイド（3-18）」の攻: Guido the Persistent (3-18) guide for Limbus Company 3-18. Avoid having the next Wave arrive on a Whistle turn, which occurs every 3 turns. Build SP, action slots, and healing resources along the way, then prevent forced Stagger from 5 Nails in the final Wave. Defeating Guido greatly reduces the remaining enemies' SP.
messages.3ターンごとの口笛と、次のWaveの登場が重ならないように進める。道中で精神力・: Avoid having the next Wave arrive on a Whistle turn, which occurs every 3 turns. Build SP, action slots, and healing resources along the way, then prevent forced Stagger from 5 Nails in the final Wave. Defeating Guido greatly reduces the remaining enemies' SP.
messages.3-18の通常戦闘・全3Wave、敵は全てLv27。グイドHP373・防御Lv2: A regular 3-Wave encounter in 3-18; all enemies are Lv. 27. Guido has 373 HP and Defense Level 27. The 7 other enemy types use this stage's 85, 102, or 149 HP values, not those of Guido in 3-13 or lower-level versions from other stages. This is not a Focused Encounter with freely assignable targets.
messages.グイド8技と道中の敵26技。減算コインは減算前の基本威力を表示する。叩くの麻痺量: Guido's 8 skills and 26 skills from the other enemies. Minus Coin skills show Base Power before subtraction. “Knock”'s Paralyze value and “Ponderous Inquisition”'s Attack Power Down value are unspecified; do not infer them from neighboring effects.
messages.主力Lv27・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に5名を用意し、打撃とHP回復をそろえる。第1Wa: Prepare 5 Sinners around Lv. 27 and Uptie Ⅲ or higher, with Blunt attacks and HP healing. Build SP and action slots instead of rushing through Wave 1.
messages.口笛は第3・第6・第9ターンと続く。次のWaveが口笛のターンに登場しないよう、: Whistles occur on turns 3, 6, 9, and so on. Check the total turn count before ending a Wave so the next Wave does not arrive on a Whistle turn.
messages.罪を…洗い流さん！へ強いスキルやE.G.Oを残す。HP50%未満の強化へ入ったら: Save strong skills or E.G.O for “Be Cleansed… of Sin!” Once the below-50% HP bonuses activate, aim to Stagger and finish Guido rather than continuing to chip away.
messages.Waveが変わった途端に一方攻撃で崩れる: Unopposed attacks overwhelm me as soon as the Wave changes
messages.味方の行動スロットが少ないまま進み、口笛も重なると不利になる。序盤で手数と精神力: Advancing with too few allied slots becomes especially dangerous when Whistles coincide. Build actions and SP early, and avoid ending a Wave on a turn whose number is a multiple of 3 minus 1.
messages.釘がなかったのに強制混乱させられた: A Sinner was forcibly Staggered despite having no Nails
messages.罪を…洗い流さん！は1枚目の表面的中で釘5を付け、2枚目で強制混乱させる。事前の: “Be Cleansed… of Sin!” inflicts 5 Nails on a Heads hit with Coin 1, then forces Stagger with Coin 2. Starting at 0 Nails is not safe; stop the skill with a Clash.
messages.口笛のたびにシンクレアは精神力30減少を受ける。減算人格でも侵蝕の危険があるため: Each Whistle costs Sinclair 30 SP. Even a Minus Coin Identity risks Corrosion, so check equipped E.G.O and SP. Replace him with another trained Sinner if necessary.
messages.第3Waveに1名。初期スロット1・最大5、各スロットの加重値は2。: 1 appears in Wave 3. Starts with 1 slot and can reach 5; each slot has a weight of 2.
messages.HP50%未満から次ターンの弱体解除と、毎ターンの狂信・威力強化が加わる。: Below 50% HP, gains debuff removal next turn and recurring Fanatic and Power bonuses each turn.
messages.生存中は敵側の精神力を毎ターン回復し、倒すと残敵の精神力が−45になる。: Heals enemy SP every turn while alive. Defeating him reduces remaining enemies' SP by 45.
messages.第1Waveに1名。釘と出血を付ける。: 1 in Wave 1. Inflicts Nails and Bleed.
messages.味方が死亡すると、翌ターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る。: When an ally dies, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.第1Waveに1名。束縛と麻痺を付ける。: 1 in Wave 1. Inflicts Bind and Paralyze.
messages.第1Waveに1名。この種の最大スロットは3。通常反撃を使う。: 1 in Wave 1. This type has up to 3 slots and uses an ordinary Counter.
messages.第1・第2Waveに各1名。通常反撃と威力低下に注意する。: 1 each in Waves 1 and 2. Watch for ordinary Counters and Power reduction.
messages.第2Waveに1名。釘・出血と束縛・麻痺を付ける。: 1 in Wave 2. Inflicts Nails, Bleed, Bind, and Paralyze.
messages.第2・第3Waveに各1名。釘5以上への重々しい異端審判が危険。: 1 each in Waves 2 and 3. “Ponderous Inquisition” is dangerous against targets with at least 5 Nails.
messages.第2・第3Waveに各1名。敵側の精神力回復を抑える。: 1 each in Waves 2 and 3. Prevent its healing of enemy SP.
messages.口笛の前に敵を減らし、手数を整える: Reduce enemy numbers before Whistles and build your actions
messages.崇める・従う・拷問する・審問に長けた異端審問官が各1名。打撃で混乱を取り、釘と妨: 1 each of Servile, Compliant, Scourging, and Interrogative N Corp. Inquisitors. Stagger them with Blunt attacks and reduce hits that inflict Nails or disruptive effects.
messages.第3ターンから3ターンごとに口笛が鳴る。敵の精神力・攻撃威力・守備威力・狂信が増: Whistles sound every 3 turns starting on turn 3. They increase enemy SP, Attack Power, Defense Power, and Fanatic, so avoid leaving every enemy unharmed until just before they sound.
messages.最後の敵を倒す前に総ターン数を確認する。第2・第5・第8ターンなどで終えると、次: Check the total turn count before defeating the last enemy. Ending on turns 2, 5, 8, and so on makes the next Wave arrive alongside Whistles. If needed, adjust by defending for 1 turn, but do not force a delay when your team is already badly hurt.
messages.審問に長けた・苦痛を楽しむ・執着する・無上の喜びに浸る異端審問官が各1名。主力の: 1 each of Interrogative, Sadistic, Obsessive, and Joyous N Corp. Inquisitors. Maintain your core team's SP and reserve resources for healing E.G.O and other needs.
messages.釘5以上への重々しい異端審判は翌ターンの麻痺10につながる。釘の多い囚人へ一方攻: Against targets with at least 5 Nails, “Ponderous Inquisition” leads to 10 Paralyze next turn. Do not let it hit a Sinner with many Nails unopposed; account for the next Whistles when checking predictions.
messages.敵を倒すと残敵に翌ターンの攻撃威力増加が付く。人数を減らす利点は大きいが、次の強: Defeating an enemy grants the survivors Attack Power Up next turn. Reducing enemy numbers is valuable, but do not assign weak Clashes while ignoring the upcoming bonus.
messages.強制混乱を止め、ボス撃破で残敵を弱める: Prevent forced Stagger and weaken survivors by defeating the boss
messages.グイドと執着する・無上の喜びに浸る異端審問官が各1名。罪を…洗い流さん！へ高威力: Guido and 1 each of Obsessive and Joyous N Corp. Inquisitors. Use high-Power skills against “Be Cleansed… of Sin!” to prevent forced Stagger.
messages.大業を遂行せよ…！の全体狂信は使用時。マッチに勝っても次のターンへ残るため、釘を: “The Great Task Will Be Done…!” grants teamwide Fanatic On Use. It remains next turn even if you win the Clash, so prevent hits against Sinners with Nails. Against an ordinary Counter, also check the first attacker's resistances.
messages.HP50%未満では執念が発動する。HP60%の混乱で火力を集め、半分をまたぐとき: Persistence activates below 50% HP. Focus damage during the Stagger at 60% HP; when crossing half HP, prepare enough damage to reach the next Stagger or finish him.
messages.グイドを倒すと残った敵の精神力が−45になる。最後の取り巻きにも攻撃を通し、口笛: Defeating Guido reduces the remaining enemies' SP by 45. Attack the last adds and finish before Whistles let them recover.
messages.体力が50%未満のとき、付与するN社の釘+1: While below 50% HP, inflict +1 additional Nails.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Nails next turn.
messages.3枚の的中で翌ターンの釘が増える。敵HP50%未満では付与量も増すため、釘を持つ: Hits from all 3 Coins add Nails next turn. Below 50% enemy HP, the amount also increases; avoid repeated hits against Sinners who already have Nails.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血5を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed next turn.
messages.3-18では最大14。3-13の最大10とは異なる。翌ターンの出血5も防ぐため、: Reaches 14 Power in 3-18, unlike the 10 maximum in 3-13. To also prevent 5 Bleed next turn, use the current prediction to choose a winning skill.
messages.使用時に保護2を得る。攻撃がこの防御へ向く場合は守備での相殺を検討し、削りの停滞: Gains 2 Protection On Use. If an attack targets this Guard, consider Offsetting it with defense to keep damage flowing.
messages.基本威力8・コイン威力−4の通常反撃。守備で相殺できないため、最初に攻撃する囚人: An ordinary Counter with Base Power 8 and Coin Power −4. It cannot be Offset with defense, so check the first attacker's Pierce and Pride resistances and remaining HP.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]次のターン、全味方へ狂信1を付与: [Clash Win] Grant 1 Fanatic to all allies next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]精神力の最も低い味方2名の精神力が10回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal 10 SP for the 2 allies with the lowest SP.
messages.敵がマッチに勝つと翌ターンの全味方へ狂信1。的中では敵側の低精神力2名を回復する: An enemy Clash win grants all its allies 1 Fanatic next turn. On Hit heals the 2 lowest-SP enemies, so stop it with a winning skill.
messages.大業を遂行せよ…！: The Great Task Will Be Done…!
messages.[使用時]次のターン、全味方へ狂信1を付与: [On Use] Grant 1 Fanatic to all allies next turn.
messages.翌ターンの全体狂信1は使用時効果。マッチ勝利でも発動自体は止まらないため、翌ター: Teamwide 1 Fanatic next turn is an On Use effect. Winning the Clash does not stop its activation; check Nails and enemy bonuses next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象のN社の釘が5以上なら、混乱状態にする: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Nails, Stagger them.
messages.最優先で止める。1枚目の表面的中で釘5を付け、2枚目の的中だけで強制混乱へつなが: Stop this as the highest priority. A Heads hit on Coin 1 inflicts 5 Nails, so Coin 2's hit can immediately force Stagger. Even a Sinner at 0 Nails is not safe; reserve high-Power skills or E.G.O.
messages.N社の釘がある対象を攻撃時、与ダメージ量+100%: Deal +100% damage when attacking a target with Nails.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに破裂10を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 10 Rupture next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに脆弱5を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Fragile next turn.
messages.基本威力11の減算2枚。釘を持つ対象には与ダメージ+100%、的中で翌ターンの破: A 2-Coin Minus skill with Base Power 11. Deals +100% damage against targets with Nails, and its hits inflict 10 Rupture and 5 Fragile next turn. Prioritize preventing hits on allies with Nails.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに出血2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed next turn.
messages.3枚目の的中で翌ターンの出血2を付ける。序盤の勝てるマッチに使い、精神力を上げな: Coin 3 inflicts 2 Bleed next turn on hit. Use a winning Clash early to raise SP while limiting attrition.
messages.各コインの的中で翌ターンの釘1が付く。後続の釘5条件へつながるため、一方攻撃を受: Each Coin inflicts 1 Nails next turn on hit. This enables later 5-Nails conditions, so avoid taking repeated unopposed attacks.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに出血3を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed next turn.
messages.基本威力8・コイン威力−3の減算2枚。表面的中の釘と翌ターンの出血を防ぎ、口笛後: A 2-Coin Minus skill with Base Power 8 and Coin Power −3. Prevent Nails on a Heads hit and Bleed next turn; account for bonuses after Whistles when checking the prediction.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺、守備威力減少1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict Paralyze and 1 Defense Power Down next turn.
messages.2枚目で翌ターンの麻痺・守備威力減少を付ける。麻痺の数値は未記載であり、守備威力: Coin 2 inflicts Paralyze and Defense Power Down next turn. The Paralyze value is unspecified and must not be assumed to match the 1 Defense Power Down.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに束縛3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bind next turn.
messages.翌ターンの束縛3で行動順が遅くなる。勝てるマッチを取り、次のWaveの主力へ妨害: The 3 Bind next turn delays action order. Take a winning Clash to avoid carrying disruption into the next Wave on a key Sinner.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘、出血1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails and 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘、出血1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails and 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘、出血1を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails and 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.3枚の的中で翌ターンの釘と出血が重なる。主力の釘を増やされる前に止める。: All 3 Coins can stack Nails and Bleed next turn. Stop it before Nails accumulate on your main attackers.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンにN社の釘1を付与: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Nails next turn.
messages.貫通の通常反撃で、表面的中すると翌ターンの釘1も付く。攻撃を当てる最初の囚人の耐: An ordinary Pierce Counter that also inflicts 1 Nails next turn on a Heads hit. Check the resistances and HP of the first Sinner whose attack lands.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに脆弱2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile next turn.
messages.敵をマッチで負かすと翌ターンに脆弱2を得る。こちらが被弾すると逆に脆弱を付けられ: Making the enemy lose the Clash gives it 2 Fragile next turn. If your Sinner is hit instead, they receive Fragile, so choose a skill that can win.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象のN社の釘が5以上なら、次のターンに束縛10を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Nails, inflict 10 Bind next turn.
messages.基本威力6・減算3枚。釘5以上の対象への3枚目で翌ターンの束縛10が付く。釘の多: A 3-Coin Minus skill with Base Power 6. Coin 3 inflicts 10 Bind next turn against targets with at least 5 Nails. Do not let it hit a Sinner with many Nails.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに束縛3、麻痺2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bind and 2 Paralyze next turn.
messages.2枚目で翌ターンの束縛3・麻痺2を付ける。次の口笛やWave移行へ妨害を残さない: Coin 2 inflicts 3 Bind and 2 Paralyze next turn. Stop it to avoid carrying disruption into the next Whistles or Wave transition.
messages.[マッチ敗北]次のターンに攻撃威力減少2を得る: [Clash Lose] Gain 2 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.単コイン最大14。敵を負かすと翌ターンに攻撃威力減少2を得るが、被弾するとこちら: A single Coin reaching 14 Power. Losing the Clash gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down next turn; if your Sinner is hit, they receive it instead. Use a skill that can beat its current bonuses.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンにN社の釘2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Nails next turn.
messages.的中で翌ターンの釘2を付ける。最終Waveで罪を…洗い流さん！と組み合わさるため: On Hit inflicts 2 Nails next turn, setting up “Be Cleansed… of Sin!” in the final Wave. Limit Nails buildup.
messages.使用時に保護1を得る。攻撃がこの防御へ向く場合は相殺を検討し、次の口笛までに敵を: Gains 1 Protection On Use. If an attack targets this Guard, consider Offsetting it and reduce enemy numbers before the next Whistles.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]次のターン、ランダムな味方2名へ狂信1を付与: [Clash Win] Grant 1 Fanatic to 2 random allies next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed next turn.
messages.敵のマッチ勝利で翌ターンにランダムな味方2名へ狂信1を付ける。最大14へ勝てる手: An enemy Clash win grants 1 Fanatic to 2 random allies next turn. Use a skill that can beat its 14 maximum Power to limit teamwide strengthening.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象のN社の釘が5以上なら、次のターンに攻撃威力減少、麻痺10を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Nails, inflict Attack Power Down and 10 Paralyze next turn.
messages.基本威力7・減算3枚。釘5以上への3枚目で翌ターンに麻痺10と攻撃威力減少を付け: A 3-Coin Minus skill with Base Power 7. Against targets with at least 5 Nails, Coin 3 inflicts 10 Paralyze and Attack Power Down next turn. The latter's value is unspecified. Stop it before it ruins your core team's skills.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに束縛3、攻撃威力減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 3 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.表面的中で翌ターンに束縛3・攻撃威力減少2。低HPの囚人だけでなく、次のマッチ主: A Heads hit inflicts 3 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down next turn. Protect not only low-HP Sinners, but also those needed for the next Clashes.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]精神力の最も低い味方2名の精神力が15回復: [Clash Win] Heal 15 SP for the 2 allies with the lowest SP.
messages.敵がマッチに勝つと低精神力の味方2名を15回復する。精神力差を広げられないよう、: An enemy Clash win heals 15 SP for its 2 lowest-SP allies. Choose a winning skill to prevent the SP gap from widening.
messages.次のターン開始時に攻撃威力増加1を得る。: At the start of the next turn, gain 1 Attack Power Up.
messages.敵を減らした次のターンも、強化込みで予測を見る。: After reducing enemy numbers, still account for their bonuses in next turn's predictions.
messages.次のターン開始時にダメージ増加2を得る。: At the start of the next turn, gain 2 Damage Up.
messages.低HPの囚人への連続的中と撃破を防ぐ。: Prevent repeated hits and kills against low-HP Sinners.
messages.握る者の金鎚: Hammer of the One Who Grips
messages.生存中はターン開始時に全味方の精神力10回復。死亡すると全味方の精神力が−45に: While alive, heal 10 SP for all allies at Turn Start. On death, reduce all allies' SP by 45.
messages.本体を倒すと残った取り巻きも弱められる。: Defeating the main enemy also weakens the remaining adds.
messages.口笛や全体狂信の次のターンに被弾しない。: Avoid hits on turns after Whistles or teamwide Fanatic.
messages.次のターン開始時に自身のマイナス効果を除去し、毎ターン狂信4・攻撃威力増加1・守: At the start of the next turn, remove own negative effects; each turn, gain 4 Fanatic, 1 Attack Power Up, and 1 Defense Power Up.
messages.半分をまたいだ後は、次の混乱と撃破まで火力をまとめる。: After crossing half HP, concentrate damage toward the next Stagger and the kill.
messages.3ターンごとに全ての敵の精神力が15回復し、攻撃威力増加1・守備威力増加1・狂信: Every 3 turns, all enemies heal 15 SP and gain 1 Attack Power Up, 1 Defense Power Up, and 2 Fanatic. If Sinclair is deployed, he loses 30 SP.
messages.総ターン数で管理し、次のWave登場と重ならないよう調整する。: Track the total turn count and avoid overlapping the next Wave's arrival with Whistles.
messages.釘を持つ対象を攻撃するとき、数値分だけ最終威力が増加する。グイドは狂信があるだけ: When attacking a target with Nails, increase Final Power by this value. Guido also gains Thou Shalt Hammer's damage bonus simply by having Fanatic.
messages.釘と敵の狂信を同時に確認する。: Check both allied Nails and enemy Fanatic.
messages.罪を…洗い流さん！は強制混乱、重々しい異端審判は翌ターンの麻痺10、荒々しい異端: “Be Cleansed… of Sin!” forces Stagger; “Ponderous Inquisition” leads to 10 Paralyze next turn; “Assertive Inquisition” leads to 10 Bind next turn.
messages.釘を増やす攻撃から抑え、条件を満たした主力への的中を防ぐ。: Stop attacks that add Nails and prevent hits on key Sinners who already meet the condition.
messages.口笛の周期はWaveごとに数え直さず、戦闘の総ターン数で確認する。: Whistles follow the encounter's total turn count; the cycle does not restart each Wave.
messages.攻撃先を自由に変更できない通常戦闘。弱いマッチを守備へ替える場合も、実際に受ける: This is a regular encounter without free retargeting. When replacing a weak Clash with defense, check which attack will actually hit that Sinner.
messages.通常反撃は守備で相殺できない。貫通弱点や低HPの囚人を最初の攻撃者にしない。: Ordinary Counters cannot be Offset with defense. Do not make a low-HP Sinner or one weak to Pierce the first attacker.
messages.グイドの3-13個体とはHP・速度・スキル・執念の有無が異なる。: Guido in 3-13 differs in HP, Speed, skills, and whether Persistence is present.
messages.主力Lv27・同期Ⅲ以上、出撃5名を目安にする。打撃は全員の弱点。: Aim for 5 deployed Sinners around Lv. 27 and Uptie Ⅲ or higher. Every enemy is weak to Blunt.
messages.HP回復と高威力マッチのE.G.Oを用意し、道中で必要な資源をためる。: Prepare HP-healing and high-Power E.G.O, and collect their resources along the way.
messages.シンクレアを使うなら口笛の精神力減少を考慮し、侵蝕するE.G.Oの装備と精神力を: If using Sinclair, account for the Whistles' SP loss and manage SP and equipped E.G.O that can Corrode.
messages.敵を混乱させ、口笛前に頭数を減らす。: Stagger enemies and reduce their numbers before Whistles.
messages.罪を…洗い流さん！へ高威力の手を残す。: Reserve high-Power skills for “Be Cleansed… of Sin!”.
messages.3Waveの出血・釘による消耗を立て直す。: Recover from Bleed and Nails attrition across the 3 Waves.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)3-22「全てのある異端審問官・進もうと: Everything There of an Inquisitor and Proceeding Inquisitor (Canto III) guide for Limbus Company 3-22. Deal attack damage to every enemy to reduce Instincts, lowering Power and Protection. However, a strong first hit against the imitation Counter lets it return that skill's Power. Hit enemies readying the Counter first with a fast Sinner's weak skill, and keep them out of multi-target E.G.O attacks.

messages.全員へ攻撃ダメージを通して本能を減らし、威力と保護を落とす。ただし模倣反撃へ強い: Deal attack damage to every enemy to reduce Instincts, lowering Power and Protection. However, a strong first hit against the imitation Counter lets it return that skill's Power. Hit enemies readying the Counter first with a fast Sinner's weak skill, and keep them out of multi-target E.G.O attacks.
messages.3章ダンジョン2層・聖具室の4体戦。Lv26の全てのある異端審問官2体（本体30: A 4-enemy battle in the Sacristy on Floor 2 of the Canto III dungeon. There are 2 Lv. 26 Everything There of an Inquisitor units (302 main-body HP, 211 Part HP, Defense Level 30) and 2 Proceeding Inquisitors (242 main-body HP, 170 Part HP, Defense Level 28). These differ from the Floor 1 Lv. 24 and Floor 3 Lv. 29 versions and fixed-slot Refraction Railway versions.
messages.両種の共通4技を使用者別に全8表示。中途半端な模倣の威力・コイン威力・枚数は受け: The 4 shared skills are listed by user, giving 8 entries. “Imperfect Imitation”'s Power, Coin Power, and Coin count depend on the attack it receives, so fixed values are not shown. It copies those numbers but retains Lust, Slash, and the enemy's own level; it does not copy On Hit or On Use effects.
messages.開幕から全員へ攻撃ダメージを通して本能を下げる。1以上の攻撃ダメージで本能が1減: Deal attack damage to every enemy from the opening to lower Instincts. Each instance of at least 1 attack damage reduces Instincts by 1, lowering Power and Protection.
messages.中途半端な模倣は通常反撃で相殺不可。最初に当てるのは速い囚人の弱い技にし、広域E: “Imperfect Imitation” is an ordinary Counter and cannot be Offset. Make a fast Sinner's weak skill the first hit, and check that multi-target E.G.O does not also hit that enemy.
messages.攻撃ダメージを受けない相手は終了時にHP5%回復・本能1獲得。放置を避けたいが、: An enemy that takes no attack damage heals 5% HP and gains 1 Instincts at Turn End. Avoid leaving enemies untouched, but do not force a strong hit into a Counter when no safe weak skill is available.
messages.強いE.G.Oを撃ったら反撃で倒された: A strong E.G.O attack got my Sinner killed by the Counter
messages.模倣反撃は最初に受けた攻撃の威力・コイン威力・枚数をコピーする。広域の追加対象に: The imitation Counter copies the Power, Coin Power, and Coin count of the first attack received. It also activates if hit as an additional target of a multi-target attack. Land a fast Sinner's weak skill first, or exclude that enemy from the multi-target attack.
messages.火傷を付けたのに敵が回復して強くなった: The enemy healed and grew stronger despite having Burn
messages.本能低下と回復阻止に必要なのは、1以上の攻撃ダメージ。状態異常ダメージだけでは条: Reducing Instincts and preventing healing requires at least 1 attack damage. Status damage alone does not satisfy the condition.
messages.弱い技で触っているのに本能が下がらない: Weak hits are not reducing Instincts
messages.保護や耐性で攻撃ダメージが0になると、傷付けられた腕は発動しない。少なくとも1ダ: If Protection or resistances reduce attack damage to 0, Damaged Arms does not activate. Choose a skill that can deal at least 1 damage. Against a Counter, also avoid using excessive Power.
messages.2体出現。本能4で開始し、本能分の攻撃威力増加・保護を得る。: 2 enemies. Start with 4 Instincts and gain Attack Power Up and Protection equal to Instincts.
messages.通常の行動数は2。本能で技が変化する。部位破壊後も行動し、追撃も可能。: Normally has 2 actions. Skills change with Instincts. Continues acting and remains targetable after Part destruction.
messages.2体出現。本能2で開始。本能4未満は1行動、4以上で2行動になる。: 2 enemies. Start with 2 Instincts; has 1 action below 4 Instincts and 2 actions at 4 or more.
messages.部位破壊後も行動し、追撃可能。もう一方の種と初期本能・防御Lvを混同しない。: Continues acting and remains targetable after Part destruction. Keep its starting Instincts and Defense Level distinct from the other type.
messages.反撃を確認して全体の本能を落とす: Check Counters and lower Instincts across the enemy team
messages.全てのある異端審問官2体は本能4、進もうとする異端審問官2体は本能2で始まる。本: The 2 Everything There of an Inquisitor units start with 4 Instincts; the 2 Proceeding Inquisitors start with 2. More Instincts means more Attack Power Up and Protection.
messages.各敵へ1以上の攻撃ダメージを通し、本能を減らす。斬撃0.5・貫通0.75なので、: Deal at least 1 attack damage to each enemy to reduce Instincts. With ×0.5 Slash and ×0.75 Pierce resistance, Blunt is the better physical option. Wrath and Envy are also effective.
messages.最初に反撃を構えた敵を確認する。広域で全員へ触る前に、模倣反撃を強い数値で誘発し: First identify enemies readying Counters. Before hitting everyone with a multi-target attack, check actual targets to avoid triggering a high-Power imitation Counter.
messages.対象へ攻撃する囚人のうち、一番速い担当に弱い手札を使わせる。威力・コイン威力・枚: Among Sinners attacking that enemy, give the fastest one a weak skill. Its Power, Coin Power, and Coin count are copied, so do not make a strong many-Coin skill or E.G.O the first hit.
messages.反撃の罪悪・攻撃タイプ・レベルは敵側のまま。こちらが打撃や別の罪悪を使っても、色: The Counter keeps the enemy's Sin affinity, attack type, and level. Even if your attack is Blunt or another affinity, the response remains Lust and Slash. Also account for its 10 SP damage On Use.
messages.通常反撃は守備で相殺できない。安全な弱い手がないときは、HP回復・本能増加を許し: Ordinary Counters cannot be Offset with defense. If no safe weak skill is available, avoid a reckless attack even if that allows HP healing and Instincts gain. Staggering it with the first attack can prevent the Counter, but Protection and resistances make this reliable only when the attack can certainly reach the Threshold.
messages.攻撃ダメージを受けなかった敵は、終了時にHP5%回復と本能1を得る。特に本能3の: Enemies that took no attack damage heal 5% HP and gain 1 Instincts at Turn End. In particular, leaving an enemy at 3 Instincts untouched lets it return to 4 and become aggressive.
messages.殻を直すは的中で最大HP10%回復・本能1。強いスキルでマッチに勝ち、攻撃ダメー: “Adjust Shell” heals 10% max HP and grants 1 Instincts on hit. Win the Clash with a strong skill and also deal attack damage. Status damage alone cannot prevent the healing condition.
messages.本能を落としても、反撃を見ずに強い攻撃を当てると危険。全敵の本能・構えている技を: Even after lowering Instincts, blindly hitting a Counter with a strong attack is dangerous. Check every enemy's Instincts and readied skills, then Stagger and defeat weakened enemies.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象へ5精神力ダメージ: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal 5 SP damage to the target.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象へ5精神力ダメージ: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal 5 SP damage to the target.
messages.2枚それぞれの的中で精神力5ダメージ。低い表示威力でも本能分の攻撃威力増加があり: Each of the 2 Coins deals 5 SP damage on hit. Even low displayed Power is strengthened by Attack Power Up from Instincts; hits also damage your SP. Win Clashes while reducing Instincts.
messages.[使用時]対象に10精神力ダメージ: [On Use] Deal 10 SP damage to the target.
messages.通常反撃・受けた技の威力と枚数を模倣: Ordinary Counter / copies the received skill's Power and Coin count
messages.通常反撃で、受けた技の威力・コイン威力・枚数をコピーする。最初に当てるのは速い囚: An ordinary Counter that copies the received skill's Power, Coin Power, and Coin count. Land a fast Sinner's weak skill first. Multi-target E.G.O also triggers it, so do not lead with a strong skill. It cannot be Offset with defense.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]体力を最大値の10%回復。本能1を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal 10% of max HP. Gain 1 Instincts.
messages.的中で最大HP10%回復と本能1獲得。攻撃威力増加を含む予測を見て強いマッチを取: On Hit heals 10% max HP and grants 1 Instincts. Account for Attack Power Up in the prediction and use a strong Clash to stop healing and renewed bonuses.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]体力を最大値の10%回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal 10% of max HP.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに出血10を付与。: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 10 Bleed next turn.
messages.1枚目の的中で最大HP10%回復、2枚目の的中で翌ターン出血10。本能4以上の攻: Coin 1 heals 10% max HP on hit; Coin 2 inflicts 10 Bleed next turn. Used by aggressive enemies with at least 4 Instincts, so do not increase damage taken by matching it with a weak skill.
messages.本能の数だけ攻撃威力増加と保護を得る。: Gain Attack Power Up and Protection equal to Instincts.
messages.本能を下げると攻撃・防御の両方を弱められる。次ターンの予測も確認する。: Lowering Instincts weakens both offense and defense. Check next turn's predictions as well.
messages.攻撃で1以上のダメージを受ける: Take at least 1 damage from an attack
messages.0ダメージや状態異常ダメージでは減らせない。1以上を通す手で全体を弱める。: Neither 0 damage nor status damage reduces it. Weaken all enemies with skills that deal at least 1 attack damage.
messages.1ターンの間、攻撃ダメージを受けない: Take no attack damage for 1 turn
messages.ターン終了時にHPを5%回復し、本能1を得る。: At Turn End, heal 5% HP and gain 1 Instincts.
messages.無用な放置を避ける。ただし危険な反撃へ強い技を投げてまで止める必要はない。: Avoid leaving enemies untouched unnecessarily, but do not force a strong skill into a dangerous Counter just to prevent recovery.
messages.本能4以上では攻撃的、4未満では防御的な技を使う。: Use aggressive skills at 4 or more Instincts and defensive skills below 4.
messages.本能3の相手を放置して4へ戻さないよう、攻撃ダメージを通す。: Deal attack damage so an enemy at 3 Instincts does not recover to 4.
messages.開始時は全てのある異端審問官4、進もうとする異端審問官2。開始時に数値分の攻撃威: Everything There of an Inquisitor starts with 4 Instincts; Proceeding Inquisitor starts with 2. At Turn Start, gain Attack Power Up and Protection equal to the value. Taking at least 1 attack damage reduces it by 1; a turn with no attack damage adds 1 at Turn End.
messages.攻撃すると本能が増える獣型とは逆。全体へ攻撃を通して強化を落とす。: This works opposite to the beast type whose Instincts increases when attacked. Land attacks across the team to reduce their bonuses.
messages.受けた攻撃の威力・コイン威力・枚数をコピーする。色欲・斬撃と敵自身のレベルを使い: Copies the Power, Coin Power, and Coin count of the attack received. Uses Lust, Slash, and the enemy's own level without copying the original skill's On Use or On Hit effects. An ordinary Counter that cannot be Offset.
messages.速い担当の弱い技を先に当てる。広域の追加対象にした場合も反撃が起きるため、対象を: Land a fast Sinner's weak skill first. Being hit as an additional target of a multi-target attack also triggers the Counter, so check targets.
messages.強い技を最初に当てると模倣される。広域E.G.Oの巻き込みも反撃を誘発する。: A strong first hit is copied. Hitting it with a multi-target E.G.O also triggers the Counter.
messages.通常反撃は守備で相殺できない。回避との相殺手順を流用しない。: Ordinary Counters cannot be Offset with defense. Do not apply the procedure used to Offset Evade.
messages.本能を減らすには1以上の攻撃ダメージが必要。火傷・出血などだけでは足りない。: Reducing Instincts requires at least 1 attack damage. Burn, Bleed, or other status damage alone is insufficient.
messages.部位を破壊しても攻撃は続く。破壊による全行動停止を前提にしない。: Attacks continue after Part destruction. Do not assume breaking a Part stops every action.
messages.鏡屈折鉄道個体の固定スロット数は、この聖具室の個体へ流用しない。: Do not apply the Refraction Railway version's fixed slot count to this Sacristy encounter.
messages.出撃5名。敵Lv26。本能の初期強化があるため、現在のマッチ予測で殻を直すへ勝つ: Deploy 5 Sinners against Lv. 26 enemies. Initial Instincts bonuses are active, so use current Clash predictions to prepare skills that beat “Adjust Shell”.
messages.1以上のダメージを通す手と、反撃へ最初に当てる弱い技を分けて確認する。物理は打撃: Distinguish skills that can deal at least 1 damage from weak skills intended to trigger the Counter first. Blunt, Wrath, and Envy are effective.
messages.広域E.G.Oは反撃の対象も見て使う。威力の高い技を無条件で全員へ当てる手順には: Check Counter targets before using multi-target E.G.O. Do not hit every enemy with a high-Power skill unconditionally.
messages.最初に模倣させる技の威力を抑える。: Keep the copied skill's Power low.
messages.本能と保護を削り、無被弾の回復を止める。: Reduce Instincts and Protection, and prevent healing from taking no attack damage.
messages.回復と本能の再獲得を的中前に防ぐ。: Prevent healing and renewed Instincts before the hit lands.
messages.【リンバス】3-22 四つ足の獣（3章・1層）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 3-22 Four-legged Beast (Canto III, Floor 1) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)3-22「四つ足の獣（3章・1層）」の攻: Four-legged Beast (Canto III, Floor 1) guide for Limbus Company 3-22. Focus damage on one beast instead of damaging both evenly. Each attack hit increases Instincts, leading to Frenzy; at 50% HP or less, Frenzy occurs every turn. Use fewer-Coin skills or defense against the beast you are not finishing yet, and defeat them one at a time.
messages.2体を均等に削らず、片方へ火力を集める。攻撃の的中ごとに本能が増えて狂乱し、HP: Focus damage on one beast instead of damaging both evenly. Each attack hit increases Instincts, leading to Frenzy; at 50% HP or less, Frenzy occurs every turn. Use fewer-Coin skills or defense against the beast you are not finishing yet, and defeat them one at a time.
messages.3章ダンジョン1層のボス戦。Lv25・HP361の四つ足の獣2体で、道中のLv2: The Floor 1 boss battle in the Canto III dungeon: 2 Four-legged Beasts at Lv. 25 with 361 HP each. This does not include the Lv. 28 versions encountered earlier or Crawling Inquisitors. The Stagger Threshold is 25%, but its corresponding HP value is unconfirmed.
messages.気の立った警戒は威力範囲2〜10、コイン2枚・威力+8の数値が整合しないため、表: “Sharp Alertness” has inconsistent values: a 2–10 Power range, 2 Coins, and +8 Coin Power. Its displayed Power and Base Power are therefore marked unconfirmed. Other skill ranges also exclude Frenzy's 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.敵は同じ獣が2体。片方に攻撃を集め、もう片方の本能まで無用に増やさない。: There are 2 identical beasts. Focus attacks on one without unnecessarily raising the other's Instincts.
messages.攻撃コインの的中ごとに本能1が増え、終了時に4以上なら狂乱する。火傷・出血などの: Each attack Coin hit adds 1 Instincts. At Turn End, 4 or more triggers Frenzy. Damage from statuses such as Burn and Bleed does not cause this increase.
messages.HP50%以下では毎ターン狂乱する。半分まで削って放置せず、そのまま混乱・撃破へ: At 50% HP or less, Frenzy occurs every turn. Do not leave a beast near half HP; continue through Stagger to the kill.
messages.2体とも急に攻撃が強くなった: Both enemies suddenly became much stronger
messages.均等に攻撃すると両方の本能が4以上になり、同時に狂乱する。片方へ攻撃を集め、残す: Splitting attacks evenly can raise both enemies to 4 or more Instincts, triggering Frenzy together. Focus on one and handle the other with defense or fewer-Coin skills.
messages.1回しか攻撃していないのに本能が大きく増えた: Instincts rose sharply after only one skill
messages.スキル1回につき1ではなく、攻撃コインを振って的中するたびに増える。4枚が当たる: It increases for each attack Coin that rolls and hits, not just once per skill. A skill landing 4 Coins can reach 4 in a single use.
messages.混乱させたいのに先に狂乱される: Frenzy activates before I can Stagger it
messages.混乱区間はHP25%と深い。HP50%以下で毎ターン狂乱するため、半分付近から強: Its Stagger Threshold is deep, at 25% HP. At 50% HP or less, it enters Frenzy every turn, so concentrate strong attacks from around half HP onward. Avoid chipping away at both enemies.
messages.同じ個体が2体。部位破壊不可。斬撃・憤怒が有効で、貫通は通りにくい。: 2 identical enemies. Parts cannot be broken. Slash and Wrath are effective; Pierce is resisted.
messages.HP50%以下では毎ターン狂乱。混乱区間より先にこの条件を踏む。: Frenzy occurs every turn at 50% HP or less, before the Stagger Threshold is reached.
messages.倒す相手を1体決める: Choose one enemy to finish first
messages.斬撃・憤怒を使って片方を集中的に削る。もう片方は必要なマッチだけを取り、守備やコ: Focus Slash and Wrath damage on one beast. Take only necessary Clashes against the other, using defense or skills with 1–2 Coins.
messages.多枚数技で両方へ攻撃すると、被ダメージのたびに本能が増える。広域を使う場合も、両: Hitting both with many-Coin skills raises their Instincts with each damaging hit. Before using multi-target attacks, check whether you can handle both enemies entering Frenzy.
messages.本能3以下のときは攻撃1つと回避2つが基本。回避は守備で相殺できるため、今倒さな: At 3 or less Instincts, the usual pattern is 1 attack and 2 Evades. Defense Skills can Offset Evade, so there is no need to force hits on the beast you are not finishing yet.
messages.本能4以上・HP50%以下: 4 or more Instincts / 50% HP or less
messages.強化後の攻撃を防ぎ、脆弱を使う: Block enhanced attacks and exploit Fragile
messages.終了時に本能4以上なら狂乱となり、1ターンの攻撃威力増加3・脆弱3と行動変更があ: At Turn End, 4 or more Instincts triggers Frenzy, granting 3 Attack Power Up and 3 Fragile for 1 turn and changing behavior. During Frenzy, taking damage does not add Instincts.
messages.狂乱すると全スロットが攻撃になり、ズタズタの出血・脆弱や、狂暴な追撃の回数追加が: During Frenzy, all slots become attacks. “Tear Apart”'s Bleed and Fragile, and “Furious Chase”'s Count increases, are dangerous. Do not judge them solely by unmodified Power; block with strong skills or E.G.O.
messages.脆弱3の間は倒す機会でもある。行動前に混乱させるなら、速い囚人の一方攻撃とマッチ: The 3 Fragile also creates a chance to finish it. If aiming to Stagger it before it acts, check the order of fast Sinners' unopposed attacks and the Clash roles. If too slow, maintain Clashes against dangerous attacks.
messages.HP50%以下では本能の値だけにかかわらず毎ターン狂乱する。削った敵を放置せず、: At 50% HP or less, Frenzy occurs every turn regardless of Instincts alone. Do not leave a wounded beast alive; push through the 25% Stagger to the kill.
messages.残る1体にも同じ手順を使う: Repeat the process on the survivor
messages.先に倒す相手を決めることで、2体分の狂乱へ同時に対処する負担を減らせる。残った敵: Choosing one enemy to finish first reduces the burden of facing 2 Frenzied beasts at once. Check the survivor's Instincts, HP, and current skills.
messages.出血や脆弱が残った味方のHPを整え、残る獣へ攻撃を集める。気の立った警戒の威力は: Restore HP for allies with lingering Bleed or Fragile, then focus attacks on the remaining beast. “Sharp Alertness”'s Power is unconfirmed; do not rely on one fixed number to decide whether an attack can beat it.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに出血1を付与: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[表面的中時]次のターンに出血1を付与: Ⅱ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[表面的中時]次のターンに出血1を付与: Ⅲ[On Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.3枚それぞれの表面的中で翌ターンに出血1。集中攻撃していない方の獣には、多枚数の: Each of the 3 Coins inflicts 1 Bleed next turn on a Heads hit. Against the beast you are not focusing, use defense or fewer-Coin skills rather than many-Coin attacks to limit Instincts gain.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに出血1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed next turn.
messages.2枚の的中で翌ターンに出血1ずつ。通常時にも使うため、狂乱していないから無害とは: Both Coins inflict 1 Bleed next turn on hit. It is also used outside Frenzy, so take necessary Clashes using the current prediction rather than treating it as harmless.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血4を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに出血4を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに出血4を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]次のターンに出血4を付与: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed next turn.
messages.4枚それぞれの的中で翌ターンに出血4・脆弱1。素の最大7でも狂乱の攻撃威力増加が: Each of the 4 Coins inflicts 4 Bleed and 1 Fragile next turn on hit. Its unmodified maximum Power is only 7, but Frenzy adds Attack Power Up, and hits worsen next turn's damage as well. Block with a strong skill.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血回数が6増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 6 next turn.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに破裂回数が6増加: [On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 6 next turn.
messages.基本13・コイン−10の減算技。的中すると翌ターンの出血回数・破裂回数が各6増え: A Minus Coin skill with Base Power 13 and Coin Power −10. On Hit increases Bleed Count and Rupture Count by 6 each next turn. Take a strong Clash rather than looking only at the low end of the displayed range.
messages.威力範囲とコイン数値が不一致: Power range and Coin values are inconsistent
messages.回避。威力範囲とコイン数値が整合しないため最大値を断定しない。攻撃が通るたび本能: An Evade skill whose Power range and Coin values do not agree, so its maximum is not treated as confirmed. Each successful attack adds Instincts; avoid forcing many-Coin attacks through the other beast's Evade. Use defensive Offsetting as well.
messages.本能1を得る。ターン終了時に本能が4以上なら狂乱する。: Gain 1 Instincts. At Turn End, enter Frenzy if Instincts is at least 4.
messages.多枚数の的中ほど本能が増える。今倒さない敵への不要な攻撃を控える。: More Coin hits mean more Instincts. Avoid unnecessary attacks on the enemy you are not finishing yet.
messages.攻撃威力増加3・脆弱3を得て、行動パターンが変わる。狂乱中は被ダメージで本能が増: Gain 3 Attack Power Up and 3 Fragile, and change behavior. While Frenzied, taking damage does not increase Instincts.
messages.強い攻撃を防ぎ、脆弱がある間に混乱・撃破を狙う。: Block strong attacks and aim to Stagger or finish the enemy while it has Fragile.
messages.半分まで削って放置しない。先に1体を倒してからもう1体へ移る。: Do not leave it at half HP. Defeat one beast before moving to the other.
messages.攻撃コインを振って的中したときのダメージごとに1増える。終了時4以上で狂乱する。: Increases by 1 for each damaging attack Coin hit. At 4 or more at Turn End, enter Frenzy. Damage from statuses such as Bleed does not increase it.
messages.本能を減らす敵とは逆の性質。敵2体への攻撃を均等に分けない。: This works opposite to enemies whose Instincts decrease when hit. Do not divide attacks evenly between the 2 beasts.
messages.1ターンの攻撃威力増加3・脆弱3と行動変更。被ダメージ時に本能を得なくなる。HP: Grants 3 Attack Power Up and 3 Fragile for 1 turn and changes behavior. Taking damage no longer grants Instincts. Occurs every turn at 50% HP or less.
messages.危険な攻撃に勝ち、増えた被ダメージを利用して対象を倒し切る。: Win against dangerous attacks and exploit the increased damage taken to finish the target.
messages.この戦闘はLv25の獣2体。這い回る異端審問官を先に倒す別の構成の手順を使わない: This fight contains 2 Lv. 25 beasts. Do not use a different encounter's plan that starts by defeating Crawling Inquisitors.
messages.本能は攻撃スキル1回ではなく、的中したコインごとに増える。: Instincts increases per Coin hit, not once per attack skill.
messages.HP50%以下の常時狂乱は、HP25%の混乱より先に発生する。: Recurring Frenzy at 50% HP or less activates before the 25% HP Stagger Threshold.
messages.気の立った警戒の威力数値には不整合がある。2〜10や計算上の2〜18を確定値とし: “Sharp Alertness” has inconsistent Power values. Neither the listed 2–10 nor the calculated 2–18 range is treated as confirmed.
messages.出撃5名。1層ボスはLv25。斬撃・憤怒の主力と、残す相手へ使う少ないコインの手: Deploy 5 Sinners. The Floor 1 bosses are Lv. 25. Prepare core Slash and Wrath attackers, plus fewer-Coin skills and defense for the enemy you leave alive.
messages.狂乱の大きい威力へ勝つ技やE.G.Oを残す。回避の相殺も使い、無用に本能を増やさ: Reserve skills or E.G.O that can beat Frenzy's increased Power. Offset Evade as well to avoid unnecessary Instincts gain.
messages.1体を倒し切る斬撃火力: Slash damage to finish one enemy
messages.半端に2体を狂乱させず、HP50%から混乱・撃破へ進める。: Avoid leaving both in Frenzy; push from 50% HP through Stagger to the kill.
messages.残す相手の本能を増やしにくくする。: Limit Instincts gain on the enemy left for later.
messages.多枚数の出血・脆弱付与を防ぐ。: Prevent many-Coin attacks from inflicting Bleed and Fragile.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)3-22「クローマー」の攻略。ダンジョン: Kromer guide for Limbus Company 3-22. The key is collecting A Sign in the dungeon and winning Clashes against dangerous skills. Handle Gaze in the first half; in the second, Stagger and break the Maw to reduce enemy attacks.

messages.3章ダンジョンの前半・後半を掲載。本体HPと部位HPは別に表記し、鏡ダンジョン個: Covers both halves of the Canto III dungeon encounter. Main-body and Part HP are listed separately, and these stats and passives are distinct from the Mirror Dungeon version.
messages.boss-copy:kromer:lead: The key is collecting A Sign in the dungeon and winning Clashes against dangerous skills. Handle Gaze in the first half; in the second, Stagger and break the Maw to reduce enemy attacks.
messages.ダンジョン内で「とある印」を3つ集め、出血・火傷への回復と強化を抑える。: Collect 3 copies of A Sign in the dungeon to suppress healing and bonuses triggered by Bleed and Burn.
messages.「処断せん！」には勝てるスキルを残す。勝つと敵が混乱し、攻める機会になる。: Reserve a skill that can beat “I Shall Claim Your Life!” Winning Staggers the enemy and creates a damage opening.
messages.後半は大口の混乱・破壊を狙う。HP30%未満の味方に即死の的中を通さない。: In the second half, aim to Stagger and break the Maw. Do not allow the instant-kill hit to land on an ally below 30% HP.
messages.敵が毎ターン回復してしまう: The enemy keeps healing every turn
messages.出血・火傷に反応するパッシブが原因。「とある印」の所持数を確認しよう。印3つでこ: The passive reacts to Bleed and Burn. Check how many copies of A Sign you have. With 3, its healing and Power increase are disabled, so Bleed and Burn Identities are not categorically unusable in this fight.
messages.味方が急に混乱して集中攻撃される: An ally suddenly becomes Staggered and focused down
messages.前半の「握り締める」が付ける注視を確認。戦闘開始時に付くためマッチ勝利だけでは消: Check the Gaze applied by “The Gripping” in the first half. It is applied at Combat Start and is not removed merely by winning the Clash. Prepare faster allies to redirect attacks next turn.
messages.HPが残っている味方が即死した: An ally died instantly despite having HP remaining
messages.後半の「栄誉の掌握」は、対象HP30%未満の表面的中で即死する。回復するか、ほか: In the second half, “Honorable Grip” instantly kills a target below 30% HP on a Heads hit. Heal them or have another Sinner take the Clash to prevent the hit.
messages.倒したと思ったら形態が変わった: I thought I had won, but the enemy changed forms
messages.前半のHPを削ると後半へ移る。E.G.O資源と強いスキルを前半に全部使い切らず、: Depleting the first half's HP starts the second half. Do not spend all E.G.O resources and strong skills in the first half; save some for the Maw's dangerous attacks.
messages.資料で本体HPと胴体HPの記載が異なるため併記。画面で攻撃対象のHPと混乱区間を: Main-body and Body HP are listed differently, so both values are shown. Check the targeted Part's HP and Stagger Threshold in battle.
messages.HPを削り切っても1で止まり、ターン終了後に後半へ移る。: HP stops at 1 even after being depleted; the second half begins after Turn End.
messages.精神力を持たない敵。精神力低下でコイン確率が変わる人間型の敵と混同しない。: Has no SP. Do not treat her like a humanoid enemy whose Coin odds change when SP is lowered.
messages.完全な人間を夢見るクローマー・大口: Kromer the Dreamer of Human Wholeness — Maw
messages.大口は破壊後も攻撃できるが、スキルを使わなくなる。危険な広域や即死攻撃を減らせる: The Maw remains targetable after destruction but stops using skills, reducing dangerous area and instant-kill attacks.
messages.喜悦中は口の物理耐性が脆弱へ変わる。大口を混乱させると喜悦解除を狙える。: During Ecstatic, the Maw's physical resistances become Fatal. Staggering the Maw can end Ecstatic.
messages.本体HP50%未満の純粋では全物理耐性が脆弱になり、速度が下がる一方でダメージ量: Purity below 50% main-body HP makes all physical resistances Fatal and lowers Speed, but increases damage dealt.
messages.完全な人間を夢見るクローマー・右腕: Kromer the Dreamer of Human Wholeness — Right Arm
messages.破壊後も追撃できるが行動は残る。大口破壊のように全スキルが止まるわけではない。: Remains targetable and continues acting after destruction. Breaking an arm does not stop all its skills as breaking the Maw does.
messages.片腕の破壊で羽ばたきが弱い攻撃へ変わる場面がある。破壊後も実際のスキル表示を確認: Breaking one arm can replace a flapping skill with a weaker attack. Continue checking the actual displayed skills after destruction.
messages.完全な人間を夢見るクローマー・左腕: Kromer the Dreamer of Human Wholeness — Left Arm
messages.「とある印」を集め、HPと資源を整える: Collect A Sign and prepare HP and resources
messages.ダンジョン探索で「とある印」を3つ集める。これで出血・火傷による敵の回復と威力増: Collect 3 copies of A Sign while exploring the dungeon. This suppresses the enemy's healing and Power increase triggered by Bleed and Burn.
messages.主力のレベルは30を目安に、同期Ⅲのスキルも確認。HPが低い囚人は回復地点で立て: Aim for core Sinners around Lv. 30 and check their Uptie Ⅲ skills. Restore low-HP Sinners at recovery points and enter the final battle with E.G.O resources remaining.
messages.印が足りない場合は、敵に出血・火傷を付けるスキルを使うと次のターンに回復と強化を: Without enough Signs, skills that inflict Bleed or Burn allow healing and bonuses next turn. Review Sign collection before replacing your entire team.
messages.混乱した味方へ攻撃を通さない: Prevent attacks from reaching Staggered allies
messages.「握り締める」は戦闘開始時に次のターンの注視を付ける。対象は混乱し被ダメージが増: “The Gripping” applies Gaze for next turn at Combat Start. The target becomes Staggered and takes more damage, so check next turn's incoming attacks.
messages.「狂笑」は使用時に精神力を10減らす。マッチに勝てば精神力被害が一切ないわけでは: “Cackle” reduces SP by 10 On Use. Winning the Clash does not prevent all SP damage, and Plus Coin predictions may also become less reliable.
messages.「浄化」や注視中の味方へ向く攻撃は、速くて勝てる囚人が引き受ける。N社の釘が重な: Have a faster Sinner who can win redirect “Purify” and attacks aimed at allies with Gaze. Stacked Nails can also force Stagger, so stop dangerous skills with strong skills or E.G.O.
messages.前半・処断せん！: First half / “I Shall Claim Your Life!”
messages.勝利で混乱させ、前半を突破する: Win to Stagger her and clear the first half
messages.「処断せん！」は敵がマッチに負けると混乱する。勝てる高威力スキルやE.G.Oを残: Kromer becomes Staggered if she loses the Clash with “I Shall Claim Your Life!” Reserve a high-Power skill or E.G.O that can beat it.
messages.可能なら速い囚人がマッチを取り、混乱した後にほかの主力の攻撃が入るようにする。攻: If possible, let a faster Sinner take the Clash so other attackers hit after she becomes Staggered. Check Speed and actual predictions to confirm attack order.
messages.前半を削り切っても後半がある。混乱中の火力を活用しつつ、必要なE.G.O資源とH: The second half follows even after depleting the first half's HP. Exploit the Stagger window while retaining necessary E.G.O resources and HP.
messages.危険な大口を混乱・破壊する: Stagger and break the dangerous Maw
messages.大口は貫通が有効。危険な攻撃へ対処しながら集中し、混乱・破壊を狙う。腕の麻痺・束: Pierce is effective against the Maw. Focus on it while handling dangerous attacks, aiming to Stagger and break it. Also stop arm attacks where practical, since their Paralyze and Bind disrupt later Clashes.
messages.喜悦では大口の物理耐性が弱くなる。大口の混乱は攻撃を止める好機にもなるが、固定タ: Ecstatic weakens the Maw's physical resistances. Staggering it creates an opening to stop attacks; judge by displayed skills and status rather than a fixed turn alone.
messages.「栄誉の掌握」をHP30%未満の味方へ通さない。回復か対象変更で即死を防ぐ。: Do not let “Honorable Grip” hit an ally below 30% HP. Heal or redirect to prevent instant death.
messages.「懺悔せよ！」は加重値5の強い広域。大口を先に破壊できなければ高威力役でマッチす: “Repent!!” is a strong area attack with 5 Attack Weight. If the Maw cannot be broken first, Clash with a high-Power skill.
messages.本体HP50%未満〜終了: Below 50% main-body HP to the finish
messages.純粋の弱点を突き、イベントを越えて倒す: Exploit Purity's weaknesses and finish through the event
messages.純粋になると全部位の物理耐性が脆弱になり、束縛3とダメージ量増加3を得る。攻める: Purity makes all Parts' physical resistances Fatal and grants 3 Bind and 3 Damage Up. It is an opening to attack, but the enemy's hits also become harder.
messages.HPが減るとイベント判定が来る。憤怒有利の判定に成功すると敵が混乱するので、画面: An event check occurs as HP falls. Passing the Wrath-favored check Staggers the enemy; choose a Sinner using the displayed success prediction. Failure reduces the selected Sinner's SP by 30.
messages.本体を削り切っても1で止まり、ターン終了のイベント後に勝利する。部位のHPだけを: Main-body HP stops at 1 even after being depleted, and victory follows the Turn End event. Do not judge victory solely from Part HP.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに出血6を付与。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 6 Bleed next turn.
messages.次ターンに出血を残す。勝てるマッチで止め、主力のHPを守る。: Leaves Bleed next turn. Stop it with a winning Clash to protect your main attackers' HP.
messages.Ⅰ：[戦闘開始時] 次のターン、対象へ握る者の注視を付与。: Ⅰ：[Combat Start] Inflict Gaze of the One Who Grips on the target next turn.
messages.戦闘開始時なのでマッチ勝利だけで防げない。次ターンに混乱した囚人を守る担当を用意: Its Combat Start effect cannot be prevented merely by winning the Clash. Prepare someone to protect the Sinner who will be Staggered next turn.
messages.[使用時] 対象の精神力に10ダメージ。: [On Use] Deal 10 SP damage to the target.
messages.Ⅰ：[表面的中時] 次のターンに攻撃威力増加1。: Ⅰ：[On Heads Hit] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.マッチ前の精神力低下を含めて考える。主力が低精神力なら勝率表示を過信しない。: Account for SP loss before the Clash. Do not overtrust the win prediction if your main attacker already has low SP.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[的中時] それぞれ次のターンにN社の釘1を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Nails next turn.
messages.釘をためると浄化の混乱条件へつながる。主力へ通し続けない。: Accumulated Nails enables “Purify”'s Stagger condition. Do not let repeated hits land on your main attackers.
messages.[使用時] 対象のHP30%未満ならスキル威力+2。: [On Use] If the target is below 30% HP, gain +2 Skill Power.
messages.Ⅳ：[的中時] 対象のN社の釘5以上なら混乱させ、釘を取り除く。: Ⅳ：[On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Nails, Stagger them and remove Nails.
messages.4枚と条件強化がある。低HP・釘の多い味方から引き受け、高威力スキルやE.G.O: Has 4 Coins and a conditional Power increase. Redirect it away from low-HP allies or those with many Nails, then stop it with a high-Power skill or E.G.O.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 対象を混乱させ、次のターンに脆弱10を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Stagger the target and inflict 10 Fragile next turn.
messages.このマッチには勝ちたい。速い囚人で勝てれば、混乱後の追撃も入れやすい。: Prioritize winning this Clash. A fast Sinner winning it also makes follow-up attacks after Stagger easier.
messages.[回避成功時] 攻撃者の精神力に5ダメージ。: [On Evade] Deal 5 SP damage to the attacker.
messages.守備で相殺してから攻める。回避に弱い攻撃を何度も当てて精神力を失わない。: Offset it with defense before attacking. Do not lose SP by repeatedly throwing weak attacks into Evade.
messages.追加の固有効果なし。右腕と左腕ではコインの数と威力が異なる。: No additional unique effects. Right and Left Arms have different Coin counts and Power.
messages.腕ごとの数値を確認し、勝てるマッチで止める。大口への攻撃だけで危険なマッチを放置: Check each arm's values and stop it with a winning Clash. Do not ignore dangerous Clashes while focusing only on the Maw.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ・Ⅳ：[的中時] それぞれ次のターンに麻痺1と束縛1を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ・Ⅳ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze and 1 Bind next turn.
messages.通すと次ターンのマッチと速度が大きく崩れる。低い表示威力でも4枚の的中を防ぎたい: Hits badly disrupt next turn's Clashes and Speed. Prevent all 4 Coins from hitting even if displayed Power is low.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ次のターンに麻痺1と束縛1を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze and 1 Bind next turn.
messages.腕破壊後も行動は残る。威力が低いからと状態異常を通し続けない。: Arms still act after destruction. Do not keep allowing status effects through merely because their Power is low.
messages.腕側の高威力攻撃。大口破壊後もこれらの攻撃は残るため、マッチ担当を確保する。: A high-Power arm attack. These attacks remain after Maw destruction, so retain Sinners to Clash against them.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[的中時] それぞれ次のターンに脆弱1と出血2を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile and 2 Bleed next turn.
messages.通すと次ターンの被害も増える。大口を削りながらマッチで止める。: Hits also increase next turn's damage taken. Stop it with a Clash while damaging the Maw.
messages.[使用時] 対象のHP30%未満ならダメージ量+100%。: [On Use] If the target is below 30% HP, deal +100% damage.
messages.Ⅰ：[表面的中時] 対象HP30%未満なら即死させ、自分のHP30回復、次のター: Ⅰ：[On Heads Hit] If the target is below 30% HP, instantly kill them, heal 30 HP for self, and gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.低HPの味方が狙われたら回復か対象変更。受け切れるHPダメージの予測でも、即死条: Heal or redirect if a low-HP ally is targeted. Check the instant-death condition separately even if the predicted HP damage looks survivable.
messages.[使用時] 対象HP30%未満ならダメージ量+100%。: [On Use] If the target is below 30% HP, deal +100% damage.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 次のターンに脆弱5と出血5を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 5 Fragile and 5 Bleed next turn.
messages.強い広域なのでE.G.Oなどを残す。先に大口を混乱・破壊する方法も有効。: A strong area attack, so retain E.G.O or other strong skills. Staggering or breaking the Maw beforehand is also effective.
messages.固有の追加効果の記載なし。守備レベルの補正は資料でも不明。: No additional unique effects are listed. The Defense Level adjustment is also unknown.
messages.攻撃の弱い通常時を準備に使いつつ、大口へダメージを集めて混乱・破壊を狙う。: Use normal turns with weaker attacks to prepare, while focusing damage on the Maw to Stagger and break it.
messages.boss-copy:kromer:passives.0.name: You Must Accept the Pain!
messages.開始時、破壊されていない部位が出血または火傷: At Turn Start, an undestroyed Part has Bleed or Burn
messages.最大HP15%分を回復し攻撃威力増加3。とある印の数に応じて弱まり、3つで両方0: Heal 15% of max HP and gain 3 Attack Power Up. Both weaken with the number of copies of A Sign and reach 0 with 3 copies.
messages.印3つを集めてから挑む。鏡ダンジョン個体はこの条件が異なる。: Collect 3 Signs before challenging her. The Mirror Dungeon version has different conditions.
messages.boss-copy:kromer:passives.1.name: You Must Accept the Pain!
messages.資料表記：とある印3以下: Listed condition: 3 or fewer copies of A Sign
messages.シンクレアが毎ターン束縛1と麻痺1を得る。: Sinclair gains 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze each turn.
messages.シンクレアを使う場合は付与された状態を確認し、無理なマッチを任せない。: If using Sinclair, check applied statuses and avoid assigning him Clashes he cannot handle.
messages.とある印3以上: At least 3 copies of A Sign
messages.シンクレアが毎ターン攻撃威力増加1と保護2を得る。: Sinclair gains 1 Attack Power Up and 2 Protection each turn.
messages.印を集めるとシンクレアを支援する効果も得られる。: Collecting Signs also provides effects that support Sinclair.
messages.次のターン開始時にクイック2とダメージ量増加5。: At the start of the next turn, gain 2 Haste and 5 Damage Up.
messages.即死や低HPへの攻撃を通すと残る味方も危険になる。: Allowing instant death or hits on low-HP allies also endangers the remaining team.
messages.3ターン目以降の周期・本能に応じる: Cycle from turn 3 onward / depends on Instincts
messages.喜悦状態へ移り、大口が強い攻撃を使う。資料には周期表と本能条件の記述があるため、: Enter Ecstatic, and the Maw uses strong attacks. Both a cycle table and Instincts conditions are described, so prioritize the current status display.
messages.大口の弱点化と危険なスキルを確認し、混乱で解除を狙う。: Check the Maw's weakened resistances and dangerous skills, and aim to end the state by Staggering it.
messages.残りの戦闘は純粋状態になる。: Enter Purity for the rest of the encounter.
messages.弱点化を使って攻めるが、敵のダメージ強化もある。: Exploit weakened resistances, but remember the enemy's damage bonus.
messages.破壊された腕に攻撃威力減少2。: The destroyed arm gains 2 Attack Power Down.
messages.腕は破壊しても動くが弱体化する。攻撃先に迷ったら、大口の停止と腕の弱体化を使い分: Arms remain active after destruction but become weaker. When choosing targets, distinguish stopping the Maw from weakening an arm.
messages.ダンジョンで集めるギフト。所持数で敵の出血・火傷への回復と強化を弱め、3つで無効: A Gift collected in the dungeon. Its count weakens healing and bonuses triggered by Bleed and Burn, disabling them at 3 copies. Also affects support conditions for Sinclair.
messages.出血・火傷を一律禁止にせず、まず探索で集めた数を確認する。: Check how many you collected before ruling out all Bleed and Burn options.
messages.握る者の注視: Gaze of the One Who Grips
messages.1ターン混乱し、クローマーからの被ダメージ+100%。: Staggered for 1 turn and takes +100% damage from Kromer.
messages.付く次のターンに速い味方で攻撃を引き受ける。: Have faster allies redirect attacks on the following turn when it applies.
messages.boss-copy:kromer:mechanics.2.name: Accept the Pain!
messages.前半が長引くと付く同名の状態効果は、与・被ダメージ量+100%、守備スキル最終威: The status Accept the Pain!, applied during a prolonged first half, increases damage dealt and taken by 100% and reduces Defense Skill Final Power by 5. It is separate from the passive You Must Accept the Pain!, which reacts to Bleed and Burn.
messages.長期戦の守備で急に受け切れなくなる場合がある。混乱の好機で前半を突破する。: Defense may suddenly become insufficient in a long fight. Use Stagger openings to clear the first half.
messages.大口の全物理耐性が脆弱に変わる。強い大口の攻撃へ切り替わる。: All of the Maw's physical resistances become Fatal. It switches to strong Maw attacks.
messages.大口へ集中して混乱を狙う。状態とスキル名を優先して判断する。: Focus on the Maw to Stagger it. Prioritize current status and skill names when deciding actions.
messages.全部位に束縛3・ダメージ量増加3。全物理耐性が脆弱へ変わる。: All Parts gain 3 Bind and 3 Damage Up. All physical resistances become Fatal.
messages.遅くなった敵への対象変更と弱点を使い、危険な攻撃を止めながら決着へ進む。: Use weakened resistances and redirect attacks away from the slower enemy, stopping dangerous skills as you finish the fight.
messages.前半と後半は連続する。前半の突破だけで全資源を使い切らない。: The two halves are consecutive. Do not exhaust all resources just to clear the first half.
messages.とある印3つで回復パッシブを無効化できる。古い『出血・火傷人格は使えない』という: 3 copies of A Sign disable the healing passive. Do not replace your team based on the outdated assumption that Bleed and Burn Identities cannot be used.
messages.握り締めるの注視と狂笑の精神力被害は、的中したときだけの効果ではない。: “The Gripping”'s Gaze and “Cackle”'s SP damage do not activate only on hit.
messages.腕は破壊後も行動、大口は破壊後に行動しない。部位破壊の意味が異なる。: Arms act after destruction; the Maw does not. Part destruction has different effects on each.
messages.喜悦の周期は資料内に記述の差がある。固定ターンの手順として断定せず、表示された状: Descriptions of Ecstatic's cycle are inconsistent. Do not treat a fixed-turn sequence as certain; respond to the displayed status and Maw skills.
messages.主力はLv30を目安に同期Ⅲまでのスキルを確認。ダンジョンの回復・編成変更地点で: Aim for core Sinners around Lv. 30 and check skills through Uptie Ⅲ. Restore HP and adjust your team at dungeon recovery and team-change points.
messages.前半は打撃と色欲が通りにくい。後半の大口には貫通が有効で、憤怒・傲慢も弱点になる: Blunt and Lust are resisted in the first half. Pierce is effective against the Maw in the second half, and Wrath and Pride also exploit weaknesses. Choose attackers while prioritizing Clash strength.
messages.危険な単体・広域へ勝てるE.G.Oと、その罪悪資源を準備する。HP30%未満の囚: Prepare E.G.O that can beat dangerous single-target and area attacks, along with the required Sin resources. Also check ways to heal Sinners below 30% HP.
messages.とある印を3つ集める。特定の人格がなくても攻略でき、専用の開幕混乱を持つ人格の取: Collect 3 copies of A Sign. No specific Identity is required; obtaining an Identity with a special opening Stagger is not mandatory.
messages.処断・懺悔のマッチ担当: Clash roles for I Shall Claim Your Life! and Repent!!
messages.高威力スキルやE.G.Oを残す。前半の勝利から混乱と追撃へつなぐ。: Reserve high-Power skills or E.G.O. Turn a first-half Clash win into Stagger and follow-up damage.
messages.速く動いて注視中の味方を守る役: Fast allies to protect the Sinner with Gaze
messages.次ターンの混乱対象を確認し、危険な攻撃を引き受ける。: Identify next turn's Staggered target and redirect dangerous attacks.
messages.後半の大口を攻める貫通役: Pierce attackers for the second-half Maw
messages.部位の弱点を突き、広域と即死スキルを止める混乱・破壊を狙う。: Exploit the Part's weakness and aim to Stagger or break it, stopping area and instant-kill skills.
messages.【リンバス】3-22 蠢く異端審問官（3章・2層）の攻略｜Limbus Assi: 3-22 Slithering Inquisitor (Canto III, Floor 2) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)3-22「蠢く異端審問官（3章・2層）」: Slithering Inquisitor (Canto III, Floor 2) guide for Limbus Company 3-22. Win Clashes to reduce Instincts and make it defensive, then break both arms together. Leaving only one arm broken lets it regenerate based on the surviving arm's HP. Once the Body appears, Poison accumulates; focus damage and finish it while it has 5 Fragile.
messages.3-22「K-02 Branch, Floor 2: Path to the S: 3-22 · K-02 Branch, Floor 2: Path to the Sanctuary
messages.マッチで本能を減らして防御的にし、両腕をそろえて破壊する。片腕を壊したまま放置す: Win Clashes to reduce Instincts and make it defensive, then break both arms together. Leaving only one arm broken lets it regenerate based on the surviving arm's HP. Once the Body appears, Poison accumulates; focus damage and finish it while it has 5 Fragile.
messages.3章2層・聖所への道の単体ボス。Lv26・本体HP677、腕各237、両腕破壊後: A single boss on the Path to the Sanctuary, Floor 2 of the Canto III dungeon. Lv. 26, 677 main-body HP, 237 HP per arm, and 203 Body HP after both arms break. Defense Level 30, Speed 2–4. Differs from the one-armed Slithering Beast and Refraction Railway versions.
messages.蠢く異端審問官の7種を使用部位ごとに全11表示へ分ける。表示威力は腕破壊による両: The Slithering Inquisitor's 7 skill types give 11 entries separated by Part. Displayed Power excludes “Swinging Arms”' reduction from broken arms. Pained Writhing has Base Power 7, −1 Coin Power, and 3 Coins; “Pained Struggle” has 11, −5, and 2 Coins. Keep Poison, self-damage, On Hit, and Combat Start conditions distinct.
messages.ねじ切る・両腕で引っ叩くにマッチで勝つと本能が減る。本能0で防御的になり、4まで: Winning Clashes against “Coil Up” and “Thrashing Arms” reduces Instincts. It becomes defensive at 0 and resumes attacking when Instincts returns to 4. This differs from other enemies that lose Instincts simply from attack damage.
messages.片腕だけの破壊を放置しない。破壊から2ターン後、もう片方が残っていればその腕のH: Do not leave only one arm broken. If the other survives, the broken arm regenerates 2 turns after destruction with the same HP as the surviving arm. Aim to break both in the same turn.
messages.両腕を壊すと胴体が出て、全体への毒と5行動の攻撃に移る。本体は脆弱5を得るため、: Breaking both arms reveals the Body and starts a phase with teamwide Poison and 5 attacks. The boss gains 5 Fragile, so concentrate damage to finish it rather than prolonging the fight with healing.
messages.片腕を壊したのに元に戻った: The arm I broke came back
messages.脱皮で、もう片方の腕が残っていると再生する。片方を先に壊すなら、残りの腕もすぐ壊: Molt regenerates a broken arm if the other remains. If breaking one first, weaken the other enough to break it soon afterward. Regeneration HP is based on the surviving arm's current HP.
messages.本能が3になっても攻撃が止まらない: It keeps attacking even at 3 Instincts
messages.実際の防御的への切り替えは本能0。0にした後は防御の息を殺すで再獲得し、4まで戻: The actual switch to defensive behavior occurs at 0 Instincts. Afterward, “Held Breath” restores Instincts, and attacking resumes at 4. Do not assume any value below 4 immediately makes it defensive.
messages.腕を殴るたび味方に毒が付く: Attacking the arms keeps inflicting Poison on my team
messages.ターン開始時の部位HPが50%未満だと、腐りゆく皮膚で攻撃者へ毒3が返る。低HP: If a Part starts the turn below 50% HP, Rotting Skin returns 3 Poison to the attacker. Finish breaking low-HP arms instead of leaving them until next turn.
messages.両腕を壊した後に全員が削られる: Everyone takes damage after both arms break
messages.胴体出現後は全体への毒があり、胴体技も毒や麻痺を付ける。本体の脆弱5と技の自傷を: Revealing the Body brings teamwide Poison, and Body skills also inflict Poison or Paralyze. Exploit 5 Fragile and the skills' self-damage; focus strong attacks to finish quickly.
messages.出現時に本能4。摘出可能で、破壊時に行動キャンセル・スロット削除、破壊後の追撃不: Starts with 4 Instincts. Removable: destruction cancels actions and deletes slots; cannot be attacked afterward.
messages.片腕だけを壊すと、残る腕のHPに合わせて再生する。再生時はバフ・デバフもリセット: If only one arm is broken, it regenerates to match the surviving arm's HP. Regeneration also resets buffs and debuffs.
messages.右腕と同じ能力値。摘出時に行動キャンセル・スロット削除、破壊後は追撃不可。: Same stats as the Right Arm. Removal cancels actions and deletes slots; cannot be attacked afterward.
messages.行動は両腕にランダムに振り分けられ、片側に偏る場合もある。技がない腕も攻撃対象に: Actions are randomly assigned between the arms and may favor one side. An arm with no skill can still be targeted.
messages.両腕破壊後に攻撃できる。部位破壊不可。脆弱5と全体毒の段階に入る。: Targetable after both arms break. Cannot be broken. Begins the phase with 5 Fragile and teamwide Poison.
messages.毒を付ける3行動と麻痺を付ける2行動の計5行動。技の使用時に自身もHPを消費する: Has 5 actions: 3 that inflict Poison and 2 that inflict Paralyze. Its skills also consume its own HP On Use.
messages.本能を減らすマッチに勝つ: Win the Clashes that reduce Instincts
messages.開幕は本能4で攻撃的。ねじ切る・両腕で引っ叩くは、こちらがマッチに勝つと敵が本能: Starts aggressive with 4 Instincts. When you win a Clash against “Coil Up” or “Thrashing Arms”, the enemy loses 1 Instincts. Block them while damaging the arms.
messages.巻き付く腕の麻痺3や、両腕振り回しの出血・麻痺を通すと次のマッチも苦しくなる。貫: Allowing “Coiling Arms”' 3 Paralyze or “Swinging Arms”' Bleed and Paralyze makes later Clashes harder. Use strong winning skills, mainly Pierce and Sloth.
messages.開始時は3行動だが、進行すると最大5行動になる。両腕への配分はランダムで、片腕に: Starts with 3 actions and can reach 5 as the fight progresses. Assignment between arms is random, and one arm may receive most skills. Check the actual skills and targets.
messages.両腕の残りHPをそろえる: Bring both arms' remaining HP into line
messages.本能0になると息を殺す中心の防御的な行動に切り替わる。戦闘開始時効果で本能が戻る: At 0 Instincts, it switches to defensive actions centered on “Held Breath”. Combat Start effects restore Instincts, so use this window to damage and break both arms.
messages.同じターンに両腕を壊せるよう、攻撃を分ける。片腕を先に壊すと行動は減るが、もう片: Split attacks so both arms can break in the same turn. Breaking one first reduces actions, but it regenerates 2 turns later if the other remains. Break the second before regeneration.
messages.低HPの腕を次のターンへ残すと、開始時HP50%未満で腐りゆく皮膚が働き、攻撃者: Leaving a low-HP arm until next turn activates Rotting Skin if it starts below 50% HP, returning 3 Poison to attackers. Finish it with concentrated attacks rather than many weak hits over several turns.
messages.本能4まで戻ると攻撃を再開する。3になっただけですぐ防御的になるわけではないため: Attacks resume when Instincts returns to 4. Reaching 3 does not immediately make it defensive; check its current mode and skills.
messages.毒が積み重なる前に本体を倒す: Defeat the main body before Poison stacks up
messages.胴体が出現し、敵は毎ターン脆弱5を得て全体へ毒10を付ける段階に入る。胴体には通: The Body appears, beginning a phase in which the enemy gains 5 Fragile each turn and inflicts 10 Poison across your team. The Body has no normal Stagger Threshold.
messages.苦痛の身悶え3つと苦痛の足掻き2つの計5行動。前者は的中ごと翌ターン毒3、後者は: Has 5 actions: 3 Pained Writhing and 2 “Pained Struggle”. The former inflicts 3 Poison next turn on each hit; the latter inflicts 6 Paralyze next turn on each hit. Win Clashes with strong skills while dealing damage.
messages.どちらの技も使用時HP12を消費し、翌ターンの自身の出血や回数増加がある。自傷と: Both skills consume 12 HP On Use and add Bleed or Bleed Count to the user next turn. Exploit self-damage and 5 Fragile, and finish main-body HP with Pierce and Sloth.
messages.毒は終了時に数値分のHPダメージを与え、半分になる。残りHPを見ずにターンを終え: At Turn End, Poison deals HP damage equal to its value, then halves. Check remaining HP before ending the turn, and use available healing or status removal to survive if needed.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.的中で翌ターンに麻痺3。後のマッチが崩れないように防ぐ。下位種の蠢く獣の同名技よ: On Hit inflicts 3 Paralyze next turn. Stop it to protect later Clashes. It is stronger than the lower-tier Slithering Beast's same-named skill and inflicts a different amount of Paralyze.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]体力を20回復、出血回数が5増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal 20 HP and increase Bleed Count by 5.
messages.マッチに勝つと敵は本能1を失う。2枚目が当たるとHP20回復と出血回数+5がある: Winning the Clash makes the enemy lose 1 Instincts. Coin 2 heals 20 HP and increases Bleed Count by 5 on hit, so winning both reduces Instincts and prevents healing.
messages.破壊された腕の数だけスキル威力減少: Reduce Skill Power by the number of destroyed arms.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに出血2、麻痺1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに出血2、麻痺1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに出血4、麻痺2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and 2 Paralyze next turn.
messages.3枚の的中で出血・麻痺が重なる。壊した腕の数だけスキル威力が下がるが、片腕だけの: Its 3 Coins stack Bleed and Paralyze on hit. Skill Power drops with each broken arm, but a lone broken arm regenerates. Work toward breaking both together.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]混乱区間を10前進、次のターンに束縛5を付与。: Ⅰ[On Hit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 10 and inflict 5 Bind next turn.
messages.マッチに勝つと本能1を減らせる。1枚目の的中は混乱区間10前進と翌ターン束縛5な: Winning the Clash reduces Instincts by 1. Coin 1 raises the target's Stagger Threshold by 10 and inflicts 5 Bind next turn on hit, disrupting later actions if you lose. Win with a strong skill.
messages.戦闘開始時に本能1を得る防御。防御的な間は腕を壊す好機だが、使わせ続けると本能4: A Guard skill that gains 1 Instincts at Combat Start. Defensive behavior is an opening to break the arms, but repeated use restores 4 Instincts and resumes attacks.
messages.[使用時]体力12消耗。次のターンに出血3を得る: [On Use] Consume 12 HP. Gain 3 Bleed next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに毒3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Poison next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに毒3を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Poison next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに毒3を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Poison next turn.
messages.両腕破壊後の胴体技。使用時に敵がHP12を消費し、翌ターンに自分へ出血3。3枚の: A Body skill used after both arms break. The enemy consumes 12 HP On Use and gains 3 Bleed next turn. Each of its 3 Coins inflicts 3 Poison next turn on hit, so quickly finish the main body while it has Fragile.
messages.[使用時]体力12消耗。次のターンに自分の出血回数が3増加: [On Use] Consume 12 HP. Increase own Bleed Count by 3 next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺6を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 6 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺6を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 6 Paralyze next turn.
messages.基本11・コイン−5の2枚技。使用時にHP12を消費し、翌ターンの自身の出血回数: Base Power 11, Coin Power −5, and 2 Coins. Consumes 12 HP On Use and increases own Bleed Count by 3 next turn. Prevent the 6 Paralyze inflicted next turn by each hit and avoid a prolonged Poison fight.
messages.説明は本能4以上で攻撃的・4未満で防御的。実際は0で防御的になり、再び4以上にな: The description says aggressive at 4 or more Instincts and defensive below 4. In practice, it switches to defensive at 0 and becomes aggressive again at 4 or more.
messages.本能が3へ下がっただけで攻撃が止まる前提にしない。0まで下げた後の猶予で腕を壊す: Do not assume attacks stop as soon as Instincts drops to 3. Use the opening after reaching 0 to break the arms.
messages.ターン開始時の部位HPが50%未満: Part HP is below 50% at Turn Start
messages.ダメージを受けたとき、攻撃者に毒3を付与する。: When taking damage, inflict 3 Poison on the attacker.
