messages.低HPの腕を長く残すほど攻撃側に毒が積もる。できるだけ同じターンに破壊へ届かせる: Leaving low-HP arms alive longer stacks more Poison on attackers. Reach destruction in the same turn where possible.
messages.腕を破壊した後も、もう一方の腕が残る: One arm is broken while the other remains
messages.実際の再生は破壊から2ターン後。残った腕と同じHPで破壊された腕が再生する。: Actual regeneration occurs 2 turns after destruction. The broken arm returns with the same HP as the surviving arm.
messages.片腕だけを壊して放置しない。両腕のHPを調整し、再生前に両方を壊す。: Do not leave only one arm broken. Adjust both arms' HP and destroy both before regeneration.
messages.毎ターン脆弱5を得て、全ての敵へ毒10を付与する。: Each turn, gain 5 Fragile and inflict 10 Poison on all enemies.
messages.囚人側の毒が増える段階。脆弱5と技の自傷を利用し、長引かせず倒す。: This phase builds Poison on Sinners. Exploit 5 Fragile and skill self-damage to finish without delay.
messages.開始時4。ねじ切る・両腕で引っ叩くのマッチ敗北で1減少。実際には0で防御的になり: Starts at 4. Losing a Clash with “Coil Up” or “Thrashing Arms” reduces it by 1. In practice, 0 triggers defensive behavior; “Held Breath” restores it at Combat Start, and 4 resumes attacks.
messages.攻撃を当てるだけで減る別の敵とは違う。指定の技へのマッチ勝利でモードを抑える。: Unlike other enemies, it does not lose Instincts simply from being hit. Control its mode by winning Clashes against the specified skills.
messages.片腕破壊から2ターン後、もう一方が残っていれば、その腕の現在HPと同じ値で再生す: 2 turns after one arm breaks, if the other remains, it regenerates with the surviving arm's current HP. Buffs and debuffs on the regenerated Part reset.
messages.両腕を同じターンに壊すのが基本。残す腕を高HPのまま放置しない。: Normally, break both arms in the same turn. Do not leave the surviving arm at high HP.
messages.ターン終了時に数値分のダメージを受け、数値が半分になる。: At Turn End, take damage equal to this value, then halve the value.
messages.低HPの部位を殴る際と両腕破壊後に増える。ターン終了時の被害まで見て、残りHPを: Increases when attacking low-HP Parts and after both arms break. Account for Turn End damage and maintain enough remaining HP.
messages.本能4未満ですぐ防御的になるという説明だけでは実際の挙動と合わない。0で切り替わ: The description that any value below 4 causes defensive behavior does not match actual behavior. It switches at 0 and resumes attacks when restored to 4.
messages.腕の再生は実際には2ターン後。1ターン後の再生という表記だけで手順を固定しない。: Actual arm regeneration takes 2 turns. Do not base the plan solely on a description saying it takes 1 turn.
messages.腕を摘出すると追撃不可。残りの腕や出現後の胴体へ攻撃を割り当て直す。: Removed arms cannot be attacked further. Reassign attacks to the surviving arm or the Body once it appears.
messages.腐りゆく皮膚は部位HPを参照する。全体HPだけで毒の反応を判断しない。: Rotting Skin checks Part HP. Do not judge its Poison response solely from overall HP.
messages.片腕の下位種である蠢く獣の数値・技・毒量を流用しない。: Do not use the stats, skills, or Poison values of the lower-tier, one-armed Slithering Beast.
messages.出撃5名。敵Lv26・防御Lv30。マッチへ勝つレベルと、高威力技・E.G.Oを: Deploy 5 Sinners against a Lv. 26 enemy with Defense Level 30. Check levels needed to win Clashes and available high-Power skills or E.G.O.
messages.貫通1.5・怠惰2が有効で、打撃0.5は通りにくい。腕をそろえて壊す手数と、胴体: Pierce ×1.5 and Sloth ×2 are effective; Blunt ×0.5 is resisted. Prepare enough actions to break both arms together and damage for the Body phase.
messages.毒による終了時被害を見込み、HPを整える。使える回復・状態解除があれば、腕破壊後: Prepare HP for Poison's Turn End damage. If healing or status removal is available, retain it for survival after arm destruction.
messages.特定の技へ勝ち、防御的な時間を作る。: Win against the specified skills to create a defensive opening.
messages.両腕をそろえて壊す火力: Damage to break both arms together
messages.再生を防ぎ、毒を受けるターンを減らす。: Prevent regeneration and reduce the number of turns spent taking Poison.
messages.胴体への貫通・怠惰火力: Pierce and Sloth damage for the Body
messages.脆弱5の間に削り、毒との長期戦を避ける。: Deal damage during 5 Fragile and avoid a prolonged Poison fight.
messages.【リンバス】4-6 真鍮の雄牛 - 涙を流す（4-6）の攻略｜Limbus As: 4-6 Brazen Bull - Tearful (4-6) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-6「真鍮の雄牛 - 涙を流す（4-6: Brazen Bull - Tearful (4-6) guide for Limbus Company 4-6. You need not Clash with every attack. Stop the easier “Overflowing Sorrow” to weaken the enemy, then break the revealed head for a major opening.
messages.4-6のストーリー個体。4-3のドローン同伴戦、4章ダンジョンのイベント、採光・: The story encounter in 4-6. Its HP and action conditions differ from the drone encounter in 4-3, the Canto IV dungeon event, Luxcavation, and Mirror Dungeons. The Head is initially absent; end a turn with at least 3 Unresolved Sorrow to reveal it next turn.
messages.通常個体の6技。2種類の突進をコイン数で区別した。資料脚注に従い、一部の火傷・沈: The regular encounter's 6 skills. The two charging attacks are distinguished by Coin count. Some Burn and Sinking effects are listed as [Heads Hit], following the source footnotes. The Japanese description of Inconsolable Sorrow duplicates another passive's description; its response also includes the footnote's interpretation.
messages.主力Lv30・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に5名を用意。打撃を受ける耐性と、憂鬱・怠惰の火力: Prepare 5 Sinners, aiming for Level 30 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Check their Blunt resistances and Gloom/Sloth damage options.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみへ優先して勝つ。勝つたび雄牛が弱まり、3回で次ターンに頭が現れる。: Prioritize winning against “Overflowing Sorrow”. Each win weakens the Bull; after 3 wins, the Head appears next turn.
messages.頭へ火力を集める。頭の混乱で次ターン全体混乱、破壊でさらに以後の攻撃威力減少3。: Focus damage on the Head. Staggering it Staggers all Parts next turn; breaking it also gives all Parts 3 Attack Power Down for the rest of the battle.
messages.全員でマッチしているのに負け続ける: Everyone is Clashing, but you keep losing
messages.突進は最大14・17。弱いスキルを無理に合わせるより、打撃に強い囚人の守備で受け: The charging attacks roll up to 14 and 17. Use a Blunt-resistant Sinner's Defense Skill against attacks you cannot beat, saving stronger skills and damage for the Head.
messages.頭を選べず、硬い胴体しか殴れない: You can only target the resistant Body, not the Head
messages.頭は溢れ出る哀しみを3回マッチで負かすと次ターンに現れる。最初から選べないのは正: The Head appears the turn after you win 3 Clashes against “Overflowing Sorrow”. It is normal for it to be unavailable at the start.
messages.頭が現れてから余計に押し切られる: The fight gets harder once the Head appears
messages.頭は最大18・20の技を使い、マッチ勝利で強化される。高威力E.G.Oで止めるか: The Head uses skills that roll up to 18 and 20, and gains buffs from Clash wins. Stop them with powerful E.G.O, or defend while focusing your other attacks on the Head.
messages.火傷がいつまでも減らず倒れる: Burn keeps dealing damage until your Sinners fall
messages.押し潰すで火傷回数を増やされている。火傷の多い低HPの味方から対象を替え、マッチ: “Pin Down” increases Burn Count. Redirect it away from low-HP allies with heavy Burn, and prevent hits by winning the Clash or Evading.
messages.胴体は斬撃・貫通が通りにくく、打撃が有効。憂鬱なら2倍、怠惰は1.5倍。: The Body resists Slash and Pierce but is weak to Blunt. Gloom deals 2× damage; Sloth deals 1.5×.
messages.胴体の各スキルスロットは加重値2。加重値のある技でも、必ず複数スロットへ当たると: Each of the Body's skill slots has a weight of 2. Even a skill with multiple Attack Weight will not necessarily hit multiple slots.
messages.胴体と耐性が異なり、貫通・傲慢が有効。頭への担当を選び直す。: Its resistances differ from the Body's: Pierce and Pride are effective. Reassign your attackers when the Head appears.
messages.混乱すると次ターンに全部位が混乱。破壊すると以後は全部位の攻撃威力が3下がる。: Staggering it Staggers all Parts next turn. Breaking it reduces all Parts' Attack Power by 3 for the rest of the battle.
messages.破壊したターンは追撃できるが、ターン終了後に頭のスロットが消え、追撃できなくなる: You can keep attacking it on the turn it breaks. Its slots disappear at Turn End, preventing further attacks on the Head.
messages.打撃を受ける担当と、頭を壊す火力を用意: Prepare Blunt-resistant defenders and damage to break the Head
messages.推奨Lv30を目安に5名を育て、同期Ⅲでスキル3まで使えるようにする。打撃が苦手: Raise 5 Sinners toward the recommended Level 30, with Uptie III to unlock Skill 3. Check resistances so your whole team is not weak to Blunt.
messages.胴体には打撃・憂鬱・怠惰が有効。頭には貫通・傲慢が通りやすいため、手持ちの中から: Blunt, Gloom, and Sloth work well against the Body. Pierce and Pride work well against the Head, so select attackers for both Parts from your roster.
messages.最大20の頭の技へ勝つE.G.Oと、その資源を確認。回復手段があれば火傷による消: Check which E.G.O can beat the Head's maximum roll of 20, and save the resources to use them. Healing also helps manage Burn damage.
messages.勝てない突進は耐性と守備で受ける: Use resistances and Defense Skills against charges you cannot beat
messages.初手は突進と押し潰すが並ぶ。勝てるものへはマッチし、勝ち目の薄いものは打撃に強い: The opening includes charging attacks and “Pin Down”. Clash where you can win; otherwise, use a Blunt-resistant Sinner's Defense Skill.
messages.守備も被害ゼロではない。対象のHP・混乱区間と予測ダメージを見て、受けられる担当: Defense Skills do not guarantee zero damage. Check the target's HP, Stagger Thresholds, and predicted damage before choosing who takes the hit.
messages.押し潰すは火傷回数を増やす。すでに火傷が多い囚人へ通さず、強い技や回避を合わせる: “Pin Down” increases Burn Count. Keep it away from Sinners already carrying heavy Burn, and answer it with a strong skill or Evade.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみに勝って、頭を出す: Beat “Overflowing Sorrow” to reveal the Head
messages.溢れ出る哀しみは最大11で、ほかの攻撃より勝ちやすい。優先してマッチし、精神力低: “Overflowing Sorrow” rolls up to 11, making it easier to beat than the other attacks. Prioritize its Clash to prevent SP loss and a raised Stagger Threshold.
messages.こちらが勝つたび、雄牛に拭えぬ哀しみが1増える。次のターンから数値分の攻撃威力減: Each win gives the Bull 1 Unresolved Sorrow. From the next turn, it applies Attack Power Down equal to its value, making other Clashes easier too.
messages.数値3以上でターンを終えると次ターンに頭が出る。強いスキルを全部使い切らず、頭の: End a turn with at least 3 to reveal the Head next turn. Save powerful skills so you can stop the Head's high rolls.
messages.頭を混乱・破壊して全体の攻撃機会へ: Stagger and break the Head to create a team-wide opening
messages.貫通・傲慢など頭の弱点へ火力を集中する。HP179で、防御も胴体より低い。: Focus damage on the Head's weaknesses, including Pierce and Pride. It has 179 HP and lower Defense than the Body.
messages.頭の技に負けると次ターンの攻撃も強化される。勝てるE.G.Oを合わせるか、耐性の: Losing to the Head's skills also strengthens its attacks next turn. Use E.G.O that can win, or defend with a resistant Sinner while directing unopposed attacks at the Head.
messages.頭を混乱させると次ターンに全部位が混乱する。頭を破壊すれば、以後は全部位が攻撃威: Staggering the Head Staggers all Parts next turn. Breaking it gives all Parts 3 Attack Power Down for the rest of the battle. Land your remaining attacks that turn, then finish the Body.
messages.最大14の打撃。勝てない場合は打撃に強い囚人の守備で受け、勝てるマッチと火力を別: A Blunt attack that rolls up to 14. If you cannot win, use a Blunt-resistant Sinner's Defense Skill and save your winning skills and damage for other actions. Watch for added Burn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]火傷回数が３増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Burn Count by 3.
messages.火傷回数を3増やす。すでに火傷の多い囚人へ通すと消耗が長引くので、勝てる担当か回: Increases Burn Count by 3. Landing on a Sinner already carrying heavy Burn prolongs the damage, so prevent the hit with a winning skill or Evade.
messages.[的中時]ダメージ量の20%混乱区間を前進: [On Hit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 20% of damage dealt.
messages.最大17で、的中すると火傷だけでなく混乱区間も前進する。低HPの囚人に無理なマッ: Rolls up to 17 and raises the target's Stagger Threshold as well as inflicting Burn. Avoid forcing low-HP Sinners into losing Clashes; use a powerful skill or a resistant defender.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の精神力を15減少: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 15.
messages.[的中時]ダメージ量の50%、対象の混乱区間を前進: [On Hit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.優先してマッチに勝つ技。勝つと雄牛の拭えぬ哀しみが増え、次ターンから攻撃が弱まる: Prioritize winning this Clash. It gives the Bull Unresolved Sorrow, weakening its attacks from next turn and revealing the Head at a total of 3. Letting it hit costs 15 SP and raises the target's Stagger Threshold.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]次のターンにクイック、攻撃威力増加１を得る: [Clash Win] Gain Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.頭が使う最大18の打撃。負けると敵が次ターンにクイックと攻撃威力増加を得る。勝て: The Head's Blunt attack, rolling up to 18. Losing gives the enemy Haste and Attack Power Up next turn. Use a winning E.G.O, or defend while focusing other unopposed attacks on the Head.
messages.2枚・最大20で、負けたマッチから敵の強化が続く。弱い技で無理にマッチせず、強い: A 2-Coin attack that rolls up to 20; losing the Clash lets the enemy keep building buffs. Reassign it to a stronger skill. If an earlier attack can Stagger or break the Head, use that opening.
messages.頭部が破壊されると次のターンに全部位が混乱状態になる。以降、戦闘中は全部位が攻撃: When the Head is broken, all Parts become Staggered next turn. All Parts then gain 3 Attack Power Down for the rest of the battle.
messages.次ターンの全体混乱と、以後の攻撃威力減少3を得るために頭を狙う。破壊したターンの: Target the Head to Stagger all Parts next turn and apply lasting 3 Attack Power Down. Use the rest of the breaking turn for follow-up attacks too.
messages.ターン終了時に拭えぬ哀しみが3つ以上ある場合、次のターンに頭が生成されてスキルパ: At Turn End, if Unresolved Sorrow is at least 3, the Head appears next turn and the skill pattern changes.
messages.ターン終了時に拭えぬ哀しみ3以上: At least 3 Unresolved Sorrow at Turn End
messages.溢れ出る哀しみに3回勝つと次ターンに頭が現れる。現れる前に高威力技と火力を残して: Win against “Overflowing Sorrow” 3 times to reveal the Head next turn. Save powerful skills and damage before it appears.
messages.頭の破壊後・拭えぬ哀しみ3以上: After the Head breaks; at least 3 Unresolved Sorrow
messages.日本語本文は頭の生成とあるが、資料脚注では頭破壊後に次ターン混乱する効果とされる: The Japanese description says the Head is created, but the source footnote interprets this as a next-turn Stagger after the Head breaks. Do not plan around repeatedly revealing new Heads.
messages.boss-copy:brazen-bull:passives.3.name: Taken by the Horns
messages.頭部が混乱状態になると、次のターンに全部位が混乱状態になる。: When the Head becomes Staggered, all Parts become Staggered next turn.
messages.頭を混乱させるだけでも次ターンの全体混乱につながる。そこから破壊へ火力を集中する: Simply Staggering the Head also Staggers all Parts next turn. Focus damage on breaking it from there.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみのマッチ敗北で雄牛が得る。ターン開始時に数値分の攻撃威力減少。ター: The Bull gains this when it loses a Clash with “Overflowing Sorrow”. At Turn Start, gain Attack Power Down equal to its value. Having at least 3 at Turn End leads to the Head appearing.
messages.この技へ勝つことが敵の弱体化と頭の出現の両方につながる。: Winning against this skill both weakens the enemy and helps reveal the Head.
messages.頭が現れ、雄牛の使用技が切り替わる状態。: The state in which the Head appears and the Bull's skill set changes.
messages.頭が現れたら弱点とマッチ担当を切り替え、混乱・破壊を狙う。: When the Head appears, adjust for its weaknesses and reassign Clashes to Stagger and break it.
messages.次のターン開始時、攻撃威力減少・麻痺・束縛のどれかを数値分得て消える。: At the next Turn Start, gain Attack Power Down, Paralyze, or Bind equal to its value, then remove this effect.
messages.頭の技を受けた囚人の次ターンの予測を確認し、同じ担当に固定しない。: Check next turn's predictions for Sinners hit by the Head's skills; do not keep assigning the same defender automatically.
messages.4-3では頭が出現しない。このページの頭を出す手順は4-6が対象。: The Head does not appear in 4-3. This page's instructions for revealing it apply to 4-6.
messages.胴体と頭は耐性が違う。頭にも打撃だけを集中すればよいとは限らない。: The Body and Head have different resistances. Focusing only Blunt damage on the Head is not always the best choice.
messages.拭えぬ哀しみの弱体化は次のターン開始時。勝った直後の同ターンの攻撃まで弱まるとは: Unresolved Sorrow weakens attacks at the next Turn Start. Winning its Clash does not immediately weaken the remaining attacks that same turn.
messages.頭の破壊後はターン終了で追撃先が消える。以後は胴体へ攻撃を戻す。: After the Head breaks, its slots disappear at Turn End. Return your attacks to the Body afterward.
messages.主力Lv30・同期Ⅲ以上。勝てない攻撃を受ける打撃耐性、強いマッチ用E.G.O、: Aim for Level 30 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Check Blunt resistance for attacks you cannot beat, strong Clashing E.G.O, and HP healing.
messages.胴体用の打撃・憂鬱火力と、頭用の貫通・傲慢火力を手持ちから選ぶ。: Select Blunt/Gloom damage for the Body and Pierce/Pride damage for the Head from your roster.
messages.勝ち目の薄い攻撃を守備で受け、味方の手数とHPを守る。: Use Defense Skills against attacks you are unlikely to beat, preserving allies' actions and HP.
messages.最大11の技へ安定して勝ち、弱体化と頭の出現を進める。: Reliably beat its maximum roll of 11 to weaken the Bull and reveal the Head.
messages.高威力技が続く前に混乱・破壊し、全体混乱で決着を狙う。: Stagger and break the Head before its powerful skills build momentum, then use the all-Part Stagger to finish the fight.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-48「ドンベクE.G.O::壇香梅」: Dongbaek E.G.O::Spicebush guide for Limbus Company 4-48. Hits build Blooming and can trap allies in flowers. Limit Blooming by winning Clashes, deal with the flowers, and prepare for the second-phase duel.
messages.回避には防御・回避を合わせて相殺し、開花を増やさない。: Offset Evades with Guard or Evade to prevent extra Blooming.
messages.「燦然たる春風」の前に、じきに咲き出す花を倒す。: Defeat Soon-to-bloom Flowers before “Magnificent Spring Breeze”.
messages.「土を被せなきゃ」は、次の2回のマッチにも勝てる囚人で受ける。: Assign “Must Cover With Dirt” to a Sinner who can also win the next 2 Clashes.
messages.精神力にかかわらず、通常コインの表・裏はそれぞれ50%。味方側の精神力は通常どお: Normal Coin Heads/Tails odds are 50% each regardless of SP. Your own Sinners' SP still matters as usual.
messages.HP50%で後半へ移行。移行前にその境界を越えて一気に削り切ることはできない。: The second phase begins at 50% HP. You cannot burst past this boundary and finish her before the transition.
messages.前半が続いた場合は7ターン目から6ターン周期で混乱する。後半は対決に勝って混乱を: If the first phase continues, she Staggers on turn 7 and every 6 turns afterward. In the second phase, win the duel to Stagger her.
messages.残っている数に応じて「燦然たる春風」を強化する花。味方を閉じ込める「満開の花」と: These flowers strengthen “Magnificent Spring Breeze” according to how many remain. They are separate from the Fully Bloomed Flowers that trap allies.
messages.5ターン目の「ぱっと開いた花」にはマッチ勝利だけで倒せる効果がある。: On turn 5, “Fully Bloomed” allows you to defeat these flowers simply by winning the Clash.
messages.満開になった味方に対応して出現する。通常はこの花を倒すと、その味方を解放できる。: Appears for a Sinner in Full Bloom. Normally, defeating the corresponding flower frees that Sinner.
messages.対決の効果で閉じ込められた花は、対決中には倒せない。救出方法を混同しないこと。: Flowers trapping allies through Dueling cannot be defeated during the duel. Use the correct rescue method.
messages.強いスキルでマッチに勝ち、回避を相殺する: Win Clashes with strong skills and offset Evades
messages.精神力が低い序盤は、勝てるマッチから積み重ねる。開花を受けると精神力が下がり、次: Start with Clashes you can win while your SP is low. Blooming reduces SP, making subsequent Clashes harder.
messages.敵の回避「え辛い残り香」には、敵より速い囚人の防御・回避を指定して相殺する。攻撃: Offset “Piquant Scent” by targeting it with a faster Sinner's Guard or Evade. This prevents repeated Evades from building up Blooming.
messages.3ターン目から花が出現する。ドンベクの攻撃への対処と並行して花の攻撃にもマッチを: Flowers begin appearing on turn 3. Handle their attacks alongside Dongbaek's, and build E.G.O resources for dangerous area attacks.
messages.花を減らしてから「燦然たる春風」を止める: Reduce the flower count before stopping “Magnificent Spring Breeze”
messages.5ターン目はドンベクが防御を構え、花が成長した状態で補充される。「ぱっと開いた花: On turn 5, Dongbaek defends and the flowers are replenished in a grown state. Winning a Clash against “Fully Bloomed” defeats the flower, so use this turn to remove them.
messages.次の「燦然たる春風」は、残る花1体ごとに最終威力が5上がる。花がなければ表示威力: The following “Magnificent Spring Breeze” gains +5 Final Power per remaining flower. Without flowers it rolls 16–20; with 4 remaining it rolls 36–40.
messages.花を倒したうえで、春風には強いスキルやE.G.Oを合わせる。前半の通常パターンで: After clearing flowers, answer Spring Breeze with strong skills or E.G.O. The normal first-phase pattern has 2 Spring Breeze slots, so assign an answer to both.
messages.春風と同じターンに花を倒す場合は、花への攻撃が先に終わる必要がある。速度の速い囚: If you defeat flowers on the Spring Breeze turn, those attacks must resolve first. Assign faster Sinners to flowers and slower Sinners to Clash with Spring Breeze.
messages.HP50%以下へ移行後: After transitioning at 50% HP or less
messages.「土を被せなきゃ」に、対決を任せる囚人を合わせる: Assign your intended duelist to “Must Cover With Dirt”
messages.後半に移ると春風を使うパターンを経て「土を被せなきゃ」が来る。HPを早く削るとタ: In the second phase, “Must Cover With Dirt” follows a pattern involving Spring Breeze. Reaching the HP boundary early changes the turn timing, so check the enemy's current skill names.
messages.「土を被せなきゃ」とマッチする囚人が、次のターンからの対決担当になる。レベルと精: The Sinner Clashing with “Must Cover With Dirt” becomes the duelist from next turn. Choose someone with high Level and SP who can use strong skills or E.G.O.
messages.担当者以外が一斉に花に捕らわれるのは、この場面の仕組み。通常の開花による拘束と救: Everyone except the duelist being trapped in flowers at once is part of this mechanic. The rescue method differs from ordinary Blooming captures.
messages.「崩れゆく花」に2回勝ち、混乱中に攻める: Beat “Withering Flower” twice, then attack during Stagger
messages.対決担当は「崩れゆく花」（表示威力8〜11）とのマッチに2回勝とう。ドンベクはマ: The duelist must win 2 Clashes against “Withering Flower”, which rolls 8–11. Dongbaek gains 3 Scattering Petals each time she loses a Clash.
messages.花びらが6以上になるとターン終了時にドンベクが混乱し、味方が解放される。花を攻撃: At 6 or more petals, Dongbaek Staggers at Turn End and your allies are freed. Prioritize winning the duel rather than attacking flowers to rescue them.
messages.対決に勝った後は、混乱しているドンベクへ強い攻撃を集める。倒し切れない場合も、再: After winning the duel, focus strong attacks on the Staggered Dongbaek. If she survives, continue managing Blooming and Spring Breeze.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ破裂2と開花1を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture and 1 Blooming.
messages.序盤にマッチ勝利を積む候補。開花が多い味方へ通さないようにする。: A candidate for building early Clash wins. Keep it away from allies with high Blooming.
messages.複数の味方へ開花を広げる攻撃。勝ちやすいスキルで止めたい。: Spreads Blooming to multiple allies. Stop it with a skill that can win reliably.
messages.次のターンに花を2体生成。既に4体いる場合は、最も成長の低い花1体の段階を1上げ: Create 2 flowers next turn. If 4 already exist, raise the growth stage of the least-grown flower by 1 instead.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 破裂回数を3増やし、開花3を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3 and inflict 3 Blooming.
messages.開花3の的中を防ぐ。花の生成は的中時の効果ではないため、マッチに勝っても花への対: Prevent the hit that inflicts 3 Blooming. Flower creation is not an [On Hit] effect, so prepare to handle the flowers even if you win the Clash.
messages.[使用時] 対象に開花3を付与。: [On Use] Inflict 3 Blooming on the target.
messages.マッチで勝っても使用時の開花3は防げない。既に開花が多い味方から対象を引き受け、: Winning the Clash does not prevent the 3 Blooming inflicted [On Use]. Redirect it away from allies with high Blooming and stop the additional stacks from hits.
messages.生きている「じきに咲き出す花」1体ごとに最終威力+5。: Gain +5 Final Power for each living Soon-to-bloom Flower.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 精神力を15減らし、開花3を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Reduce SP by 15 and inflict 3 Blooming.
messages.先に花を倒して強化を減らし、E.G.Oなどでマッチする。表の16〜20は花による: Defeat flowers first to reduce the power buff, then Clash with E.G.O or another strong skill. The listed 16–20 excludes flower buffs. Letting it hit while waiting for flowers to disappear afterward is dangerous.
messages.[使用時] 次のターンに対象へ「対決」を付与。: [On Use] Inflict Dueling on the target next turn.
messages.このスキルとマッチする囚人を選ぶことが、対決担当の選択になる。次の2回のマッチま: Choosing who Clashes with this skill also chooses your duelist. Assign a Sinner who can win the following 2 Clashes too.
messages.ダメージを与えるよりマッチに勝つことが重要。2回勝って花びらを6にし、混乱につな: Winning Clashes matters more than dealing damage. Win twice to reach 6 petals and trigger Stagger.
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可。敵味方の識別をしない広域攻撃。満開状態の対象へのダメー: Unclashable and cannot be redirected. An indiscriminate area attack that deals +100% damage to targets in Full Bloom.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 満開状態の対象を混乱させ、満開を解除。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Stagger targets in Full Bloom and remove Full Bloom.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 脆弱2を付与。Ⅲ：[的中時] 破裂5を付与し、破裂回数を5増やす: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile. Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 5 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 5.
messages.対決で勝って、代わりに混乱させることを目指す。これが来てからE.G.Oでマッチし: Win the duel to Stagger her instead. Once this attack arrives, attempting to Clash with E.G.O cannot stop it.
messages.[回避成功時] 攻撃した対象へ開花1を付与。: [On Evade] Inflict 1 Blooming on the attacker.
messages.敵より速い囚人の防御・回避をこの回避へ指定して相殺する。回避を残したまま連続攻撃: Target this Evade with a faster Sinner's Guard or Evade to offset it. Avoid attempting repeated attacks while leaving the Evade active.
messages.本体へ攻撃を集中するより花の処理や次のマッチの準備を優先。守備で相殺しても戦闘開: Prioritize flowers or preparation for the next Clashes over focusing attacks on Dongbaek. Offsetting with a Defense Skill does not remove the Protection gained at Combat Start.
messages.本体だけでなく花の攻撃も確認し、余った行動でマッチや撃破を狙う。: Check flower attacks as well as Dongbaek's, and use spare actions to Clash or defeat them.
messages.開花がたまった味方へ2枚とも通さないようにする。: Avoid letting both Coins hit an ally who already has high Blooming.
messages.複数の味方が開花を受けるので、放置せずマッチするか先に花を倒す。: Multiple allies can receive Blooming, so Clash with it or defeat the flower first rather than ignoring it.
messages.春風の強化元になる花なので、防御していても倒す価値がある。: This flower strengthens Spring Breeze, so it is worth defeating even while it defends.
messages.HPを削り切る必要はない。マッチで勝てるスキルを1つずつ割り当て、春風の前に花を: You do not need to deplete its HP. Assign one winning skill to each flower and reduce their numbers before Spring Breeze.
messages.対応する囚人を行動不能にし、精神力を減らす。精神力が-45に達すると、回復後に味: Disables the corresponding Sinner and reduces their SP. At -45 SP, they recover and enter a state in which they attack allies.
messages.通常の満開は2ターン解除されなければターン終了時に解除。対決による満開は別扱い。: Ordinary Full Bloom is removed at Turn End if it remains uncleared for 2 turns. Full Bloom caused by Dueling is handled separately.
messages.通常の拘束なら、対応する花を早く倒して救出する。対決中の花は倒せないので、対決の: For ordinary captures, defeat the corresponding flower quickly to rescue the Sinner. Duel flowers cannot be defeated; free those allies by winning the duel.
messages.燦然たる春風のマッチにドンベクが敗北: Dongbaek loses a Clash with “Magnificent Spring Breeze”
messages.春風を止めると被害を防ぎつつ精神力も削れる。: Stopping Spring Breeze prevents damage and also reduces her SP.
messages.成長3の花を用意する。既存の花も成長3になり、じきに咲き出す花と満開の花の合計が: Prepare stage-3 flowers. Existing flowers also reach growth stage 3, and more are added until Soon-to-bloom Flowers and Fully Bloomed Flowers total 4.
messages.序盤に倒した花だけで安心せず、補充後の花を処理する。: Removing early flowers is not enough; deal with the replenished flowers too.
messages.後半へ移行する。移行前はHPが50%未満にならない。: Transition to the second phase. HP cannot fall below 50% before the transition.
messages.境界付近で強い攻撃を一度に使い切らず、後半のマッチにも残す。: Avoid spending all your strong attacks at the HP boundary; save some for second-phase Clashes.
messages.後半の特殊スキルで1名を指定: One Sinner selected by the second-phase special skill
messages.特殊スキルを使うターンから次の2ターンは混乱・パニックにならない。担当がイサンな: Dongbaek cannot become Staggered or enter Panic on the special skill's turn or the following 2 turns. If the duelist is Yi Sang, Dongbaek gains 1 Attack Power Up. If Yi Sang wins the duel, all allies gain 3 Damage Up next turn. If Dongbaek wins, she restores her own SP to maximum.
messages.イサンには専用の補正があるが、担当をイサンに固定する必要はない。勝てる囚人を選ぶ: Yi Sang has special modifiers, but does not have to be your duelist. Choose a Sinner who can win.
messages.パニックタイプを変える効果を受ける: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.パニックタイプを変更せず、代わりに精神力のない対象向けの効果を受ける。: Panic Type does not change. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.パニックタイプ変更を前提にした作戦は避ける。: Avoid strategies that depend on changing her Panic Type.
messages.成長1を持って出現し、成長に伴ってHPが増える。: Appears with growth stage 1; HP increases as it grows.
messages.成長した花を残すほど処理が重くなる。春風までに倒せる行動を確保する。: Grown flowers take more effort to remove. Reserve enough actions to defeat them before Spring Breeze.
messages.ターン終了時に5未満なら、数値×5の精神力ダメージを受け、開花が1減る。5以上な: At Turn End, if below 5, take SP damage equal to the value × 5 and reduce Blooming by 1. At 5 or more, take Sloth damage equal to the value as a percentage of Max HP and enter Full Bloom.
messages.開花4でも精神力を20失うため、5未満なら安全とはいえない。的中を防ぎ、回避も相: Even 4 Blooming costs 20 SP, so staying below 5 is not automatically safe. Prevent hits and offset Evades.
messages.味方が花に捕らわれ、行動できなくなる。通常の満開では精神力も減る。: An ally is trapped in a flower and cannot act. Ordinary Full Bloom also reduces SP.
messages.通常は対応する満開の花を倒して救出。対決で拘束された味方は、対決に勝って救出する: Normally, defeat the corresponding Fully Bloomed Flower to rescue the ally. For allies trapped by Dueling, win the duel instead.
messages.担当以外の味方が満開になる。「崩れゆく花」にドンベクがマッチ敗北するたび花びら+: All allies except the duelist enter Full Bloom. Each time Dongbaek loses a Clash with “Withering Flower”, she gains 3 petals. At 6 or more, she Staggers at Turn End.
messages.担当者が2回のマッチに勝つことが目標。対決中の花を壊すことはできない。: The duelist must win 2 Clashes. The flowers cannot be destroyed during the duel.
messages.「満開の花のように…」は使用時にも開花を付ける。マッチに勝てば開花をまったく受け: “Like Flowers in Full Bloom...” also inflicts Blooming [On Use]. Winning the Clash does not prevent all Blooming from this skill.
messages.「じきに咲き出す花」は春風を強化する花。「満開の花」は味方を拘束する花。春風の強: Soon-to-bloom Flowers strengthen Spring Breeze. Fully Bloomed Flowers trap allies. Target the former to reduce Spring Breeze's power.
messages.春風は花の数に応じて威力が変わる。花が残った状態の予測を、そのまま花処理後の勝敗: Spring Breeze's power changes with the flower count. Predictions made while flowers remain do not necessarily reflect the Clash after they are defeated. Check action order too.
messages.精神力を下げてもドンベクの表・裏の確率は変わらない。-25以下では攻撃威力増加2: Lowering SP does not change Dongbaek's Heads/Tails odds. At -25 or lower, she also gains 2 Attack Power Up, so partially lowering SP can strengthen her attacks. Panic at -45 causes Stagger, but she resists Stagger and Panic during Dueling.
messages.ターン数の案内は通常の進行の目安。早くHP50%へ到達した場合や混乱を挟んだ場合: Turn numbers describe the usual pattern. If you reach 50% HP early or cause Stagger, prioritize the enemy's current skill names when deciding your actions.
messages.主力はレベル35以上をひとつの目安に、マッチで負ける人格から育てる。主力は同期Ⅲ: Aim for Level 35 or higher on your main units, starting with Identities that lose Clashes. Check their skills and passives through Uptie III too.
messages.出撃上限は7名。育成済みが少なければ4〜5名で出撃し、編成順の先頭から行動枠が増: The deployment limit is 7. If fewer Sinners are trained, another option is deploying 4–5 and using the extra action slots gained in deployment order. You have fewer actions on turn 1, so still account for attacks left unanswered.
messages.春風が2枠並ぶ場面に向け、2名が強いスキルやE.G.Oでマッチできるよう準備する: Prepare 2 Sinners with strong skills or E.G.O for the turn with 2 Spring Breeze slots. Check whether your team's skills supply the necessary Sin Resources.
messages.手持ちだけでマッチが足りなければ、サポート人格を借りることも検討する。特定の人格: If your roster cannot cover the Clashes, consider borrowing a Support Identity. No specific Identity is required to clear this fight.
messages.レベルと精神力が安定し、強いスキルやE.G.Oで2回続けてマッチできる囚人。対決: A Sinner with reliable Level and SP who can win 2 consecutive Clashes using strong skills or E.G.O. Check their remaining skills and resources before the duel starts.
messages.本体は斬撃×1.5、傲慢×2.0、暴食×1.5。花にも斬撃・傲慢・暴食が通りやす: Dongbaek takes 1.5× Slash, 2.0× Pride, and 1.5× Gluttony damage. Flowers are also weak to Slash, Pride, and Gluttony. Prioritize winning Clashes before exploiting weaknesses.
messages.敵より速い囚人に防御・回避を使わせる。毎ターン全員で攻撃せず、1枠を相殺へ回して: Use a faster Sinner's Guard or Evade. Instead of attacking with everyone each turn, spend one slot on offsetting to limit Blooming buildup.
messages.花を減らした後の春風とマッチできる高威力スキルやE.G.Oを用意する。ダメージだ: Prepare high-power skills or E.G.O that can Clash with Spring Breeze after flowers are removed. Avoid spending all necessary resources or SP just to deal damage.
messages.【リンバス】4-47 ロボトミーE.G.O::狐雨 - ドンベクの攻略｜Limb: 4-47 Lobotomy E.G.O::Sunshower - Dongbaek Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-47「ロボトミーE.G.O::狐雨: Lobotomy E.G.O::Sunshower - Dongbaek guide for Limbus Company 4-47. This is a separate fight from Spicebush in 4-48. Use 7 Sinners to wear down the Shield, and attack Old Umbrellas when Thorns is active. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Coin flip probabilities.
messages.4-48の壇香梅とは別の戦闘。7人の手数でバリアを削り、棘が付いたときは古傘へ攻: This is a separate fight from Spicebush in 4-48. Use 7 Sinners to wear down the Shield, and attack Old Umbrellas when Thorns is active. Distinguish SP-based buffs and Panic from Coin flip probabilities.
messages.4-47のドンベク。HP500とは別に開始時バリア1200。資料の部位情報では、: Dongbaek in 4-47 has 500 HP plus a starting Shield of 1200. The source's Part data lists fixed 50% Heads/Tails odds regardless of SP. Although another note suggests low SP strengthens negative Coins, this guide keeps Coin odds separate from the Low Morale passive's power buff.
messages.通常技7つ。減算技は大きい側を基本威力として表示する。全て沈んでしまえは26−1: 7 regular skills. Negative-Coin skills show the higher value as Base Power. “Sink It All” has 26 Base Power, -10 Coin Power, and 7 Attack Weight. The Japanese skill and status descriptions use different wordings for Corroding Heart, so check the status actually applied next turn. Old Umbrellas have no listed skills; no attacks or Defense Skills have been added for them.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。HP500に加え、バリア1200を削る火力: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. You need enough damage for a 1200 Shield as well as 500 HP.
messages.棘のあるターンは本体へ無理に連打せず、HP9の古傘を倒して次ターンの保護・攻撃強: When Thorns is active, avoid repeatedly hitting Dongbaek. Defeat the 9-HP Old Umbrellas to gain Protection and an attack buff next turn.
messages.精神力−45でパニック混乱するが、復帰時に最大へ戻って強化される。低精神力なら減: At -45 SP, Panic Staggers her, but she recovers to maximum SP and gains buffs afterward. Low SP does not guarantee stronger negative-Coin rolls.
messages.HP500のはずなのに全然減らない: She has 500 HP, but your attacks barely reduce it
messages.開始時にバリア1200を持つ。まずバリアを削り、残る本体へ火力を通す。弱点の打撃: She starts with a 1200 Shield. Break through it before damaging her remaining HP. Check her weaknesses to Blunt, Gloom, and Pride.
messages.本体を殴った自分のHPが急に減る: Your own HP suddenly drops when you hit her
messages.触るな...!の戦闘開始時効果で棘が付くと、ダメージの50%が返る。古傘があるな: “Don't Touch Me...!” grants Thorns at Combat Start, reflecting 50% of damage taken. Attack Old Umbrellas instead when they are present.
messages.精神力を下げたのにマッチが楽にならない: Lowering her SP does not make Clashes easier
messages.表裏は各50%固定。さらに精神力−10以下では攻撃威力増加2が付く。低精神力をそ: Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each. At -10 SP or lower, she also gains 2 Attack Power Up. Low SP does not directly mean low power; look for the opening when Panic Staggers her.
messages.前に読んだ開花・対決の説明が当てはまらない: Blooming and Dueling advice does not match this fight
messages.それは次の4-48・壇香梅の仕組み。4-47はバリア、精神力、棘と古傘を扱う別の: Those are mechanics for the next encounter, Spicebush in 4-48. This fight in 4-47 revolves around Shield, SP, Thorns, and Old Umbrellas.
messages.精神力の表裏確率は各50%固定。精神力−10以下で士気低下、−45でパニック。: Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each regardless of SP. Low Morale starts at -10 SP; Panic starts at -45.
messages.通常進行では5ターン目に古傘4体の召喚と精神力最大回復。以後も周期的に起こり、混: In the usual pattern, turn 5 summons 4 Old Umbrellas and restores her SP to maximum. This recurs periodically, with timing shifted by Stagger.
messages.ターン終了時に消える。行動スキルはない。さすらいの狐が連れる古傘とはHP・効果が: Disappears at Turn End and has no action skills. Its HP and effects differ from the Old Umbrellas accompanying Drifting Fox.
messages.撃破でドンベクの沈潜回数+5、全囚人の沈潜−2、次ターンに全囚人が保護1・攻撃威: On defeat: Dongbaek gains +5 Sinking Count; all Sinners lose 2 Sinking and gain 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.7名の戦力と、強い減算技へ勝つ手段を用意: Prepare 7 combat-ready Sinners and answers to strong negative-Coin skills
messages.推奨Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。人数が増える初戦なので、普段の5名だけで手: Aim for 7 Sinners at the recommended Level 35 and Uptie III or higher. This is the first fight with the higher deployment limit; using only your usual 5 leaves potential actions unused.
messages.打撃・憂鬱・傲慢が有効。強い通常技とE.G.O、沈潜を受けた後の精神力・HP回復: Blunt, Gloom, and Pride are effective. Prepare strong regular skills and E.G.O, plus SP and HP recovery for Sinking damage.
messages.全て沈んでしまえは加重値7・基本威力26。敵の精神力が低くても最大値を出し得るの: “Sink It All” has 7 Attack Weight and 26 Base Power. It can roll its maximum even at low SP, so save a winning skill and the resources to use it.
messages.危険な攻撃へ勝ち、残る手数で削る: Win dangerous Clashes and use spare actions to deal damage
messages.ドンベクは基本4スロットに対してこちらは7名。危険な技をマッチで止め、余る手数を: Dongbaek normally has 4 slots against your 7 Sinners. Stop dangerous skills with Clashes and use spare actions for unopposed attacks to wear down the Shield.
messages.爽やかな記憶の的中は沈潜・破裂を重ねる。棘の生えた追憶で回数も増えるので、低HP: “Stinging Memories” stacks Sinking and Rupture on hit. “Thorny Memories” also raises their Count, so keep them away from low-HP or low-SP Sinners.
messages.自己防御は守備ではなく減算の打撃。敵の精神力よりも、その技の基本威力と現在の攻撃: “Self-defense” is a negative-Coin Blunt attack, not a Defense Skill. Choose its opponent based on Base Power and current Attack Power Up rather than the enemy's SP.
messages.状態による強化と混乱の機会を見分ける: Distinguish status buffs from Stagger openings
messages.毎ターン終了に精神力が10減り、マッチ敗北や回避失敗でも下がる。精神力−10以下: She loses 10 SP at every Turn End, and also loses SP from Clash losses or failed Evades. At -10 SP or lower, she gains 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind at the next Turn Start.
messages.−45のパニックで混乱したら火力をまとめる。通常の混乱区間だけを待つ必要はない。: When Panic at -45 SP Staggers her, concentrate your damage. You do not have to wait for an ordinary HP Stagger Threshold.
messages.復帰時は精神力最大回復とクイック2・攻撃威力増加2。次ターンも動けないと考えず、: After recovering, she restores SP to maximum and gains 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up. Prepare healing and strong Clashes rather than assuming she will remain unable to act next turn.
messages.反射中は古傘を倒して次へつなぐ: Defeat Old Umbrellas while reflection is active
messages.触るな...!で棘が付くと、本体へ与えたダメージの50%が返る。守備の相殺だけで: “Don't Touch Me...!” grants Thorns, reflecting 50% of damage dealt to Dongbaek. Offsetting the Defense Skill does not remove the reflection.
messages.HP9の古傘へ攻撃を回して倒す。敵の沈潜回数を増やし、全員の沈潜を減らし、次ター: Redirect attacks to the 9-HP Old Umbrellas and defeat them. This raises the enemy's Sinking Count, reduces all Sinners' Sinking, and grants Protection and an attack buff next turn.
messages.傘はターン終了で消えるため、次のターンまで処理を先延ばしにしない。反射の有無と混: The umbrellas disappear at Turn End, so do not postpone dealing with them until next turn. Check Thorns and Stagger before returning attacks to Dongbaek.
messages.基本26の広域を止め、次ターンの弱体化を確認: Stop the 26-Base-Power area attack, then check next turn's debuffs
messages.広域へ勝てる高威力技を使う。勝っても使用時の精神力−30・沈潜5と、次ターンの状: Use a powerful skill that can win against the area attack. Winning does not cancel its [On Use] effects: -30 SP, 5 Sinking, and the status applied next turn.
messages.的中すると精神力低下・沈潜・毒が重なる。主対象だけでなく追加対象のHPも事前に整: On hit, it combines SP loss, Sinking, and Poison. Prepare the HP of secondary targets as well as the primary target.
messages.次のターンに攻撃威力減少・脆弱・束縛の状態が付いているなら、その隙にバリアと本体: If Attack Power Down, Fragile, and Bind are applied next turn, use that opening to focus damage on the Shield and Dongbaek.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜2、破裂2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]沈潜2、破裂2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]沈潜2、破裂2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Rupture.
messages.3枚の的中ごとに沈潜と破裂を付ける。勝てる通常技で止め、味方の精神力を上げる。低: Each of its 3 Coins inflicts Sinking and Rupture on hit. Stop it with a winning regular skill to build your ally's SP. Avoid letting it hit a low-HP Sinner unopposed.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 2.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]破裂回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 2.
messages.沈潜・破裂の回数を増やす。既に状態異常が重なった囚人を守り、後続の追加ダメージを: Increases Sinking and Rupture Count. Protect Sinners already carrying these statuses to limit subsequent extra damage.
messages.[マッチ敗北]自分の精神力を8減少、沈潜3を得る: [Clash Lose] Lose 8 SP and gain 3 Sinking.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに束縛2、攻撃威力減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.名前は守備のようだが打撃攻撃。基本10から5を引く減算技なので、裏面でも最大10: Despite its name, this is a Blunt attack. It starts at 10 Base Power and subtracts 5 on Heads, so Tails still rolls its maximum of 10. Beating it reduces the enemy's SP by 8, but does not change her Coin odds.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]破裂回数が3増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.
messages.基本13・コイン−4が2枚。的中すると破裂回数と混乱区間を進める。士気低下時の攻: 13 Base Power with two -4 Coins. On hit, it increases Rupture Count and raises the Stagger Threshold. Low Morale's Attack Power Up also applies, so choose a strong opponent using the current prediction.
messages.[使用時]精神力を30減少、沈潜5を得る。次のターンに侵蝕する心を得る。: [On Use] Lose 30 SP and gain 5 Sinking. Gain Corroding Heart next turn.
messages.基本26・コイン−10、加重値7。高い基本威力を持つE.G.Oなどで止める。勝っ: 26 Base Power, -10 Coin Power, and 7 Attack Weight. Stop it with a high-Base-Power E.G.O or another strong skill. Winning does not cancel its [On Use] self-inflicted effects or next-turn status. Prepare for SP loss, Sinking, and Poison on hit.
messages.回避は基本8・コイン−5。守備を向けて相殺すれば一方攻撃を通しやすい。回避失敗で: An Evade with 8 Base Power and -5 Coin Power. Offset it with a Defense Skill to let unopposed attacks through more easily. A failed Evade lowers her SP, but low SP does not change its Heads/Tails odds.
messages.戦闘開始時に棘を得て、被ダメージの50%を攻撃者へ返す。相殺で棘まで消せるとは考: At Combat Start, gain Thorns and reflect 50% of damage taken to the attacker. Offsetting does not remove Thorns; attack the summoned Old Umbrellas instead to gain buffs next turn.
messages.バリア体力1200を保有して戦闘を開始: Start the battle with a 1200-HP Shield.
messages.HP500に加えてバリア1200がある。見た目のHPだけで残りの必要火力を判断し: She has a 1200 Shield in addition to 500 HP. Do not judge the damage still needed from the visible HP alone.
messages.毎ターン終了時、精神力が10減少: Lose 10 SP at every Turn End.
messages.毎ターン精神力が下がり、士気低下やパニックへ進む。確率の変化ではなく、状態による: SP falls every turn, leading to Low Morale and Panic. Watch for status buffs and Stagger rather than changes to Coin odds.
messages.士気低下状態のなら、ターン開始時に攻撃威力増加2、束縛3を得る: At Turn Start, if in Low Morale, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind.
messages.攻撃威力増加2と束縛3が付く。敵が遅くなる機会に担当を替えるが、マッチの強化は見: Grants 2 Attack Power Up and 3 Bind. Her reduced Speed makes reassignment easier, but do not overlook the increase in Clash power.
messages.パニックで混乱する。隙に火力を出せるが、復帰後の回復と強化も準備する。: Panic Staggers her, creating an opening for damage. Prepare for her SP recovery and buffs afterward.
messages.パニック状態から復帰した場合、精神力を最大値まで回復してクイック2、攻撃威力増加: When recovering from Panic, restore SP to maximum and gain 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up.
messages.精神力を最大まで戻し、クイック2・攻撃威力増加2。パニックで無力化し続けられる前: Restores SP to maximum and grants 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up. Do not assume Panic will keep her disabled indefinitely.
messages.パニックタイプを変更するバフ獲得時、パニックタイプが変更されない。\nその代わり: Effects that would change Panic Type do not change it. Instead, apply the effects intended for targets without SP.
messages.パニックの上書きではなく、マッチと本人の精神力低下・バリア削りを使って攻略する。: Win through Clashes, her own SP loss, and breaking the Shield rather than overriding her Panic Type.
messages.このユニットが破壊されるたび、ドンベクの沈潜回数が5増加し、全囚人の沈潜が2減少: Whenever this unit is destroyed, increase Dongbaek's Sinking Count by 5 and reduce all Sinners' Sinking by 2. All Sinners gain 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.敵の沈潜回数を5増やし、全囚人の沈潜を2減らす。次ターンの保護1と攻撃威力増加2: Raises the enemy's Sinking Count by 5 and reduces all Sinners' Sinking by 2. It also grants 1 Protection and 2 Attack Power Up next turn, making umbrellas useful targets while Thorns is active.
messages.受けたダメージの50%を攻撃者へ返す。触るな...!の戦闘開始時に得る。: Reflect 50% of damage taken to the attacker. Gained at Combat Start from “Don't Touch Me...!”.
messages.本体への連打を避け、古傘の撃破や回復へ手数を回す。: Avoid repeatedly hitting Dongbaek; spend actions defeating Old Umbrellas or healing instead.
messages.資料の状態欄は侵蝕される心、技の効果欄は侵蝕する心。状態欄ではターン開始時に攻撃: The Japanese status name and skill effect use different wordings for Corroding Heart. The status description grants 2 Attack Power Down, 2 Fragile, and 5 Bind at Turn Start.
messages.全て沈んでしまえの後、実際に付いた状態を確認して攻撃の機会にする。: After “Sink It All”, check the status actually applied and use it as an opening to attack.
messages.的中後の残りHPだけで安心せず、終了時ダメージにも耐えられるよう回復する。: Surviving the initial hit is not enough; heal so your Sinners can also survive Turn End damage.
messages.4-48の開花・対決はこの戦闘にはない。狐雨と壇香梅を区別する。: Blooming and Dueling from 4-48 do not appear here. Distinguish Sunshower from Spicebush.
messages.ドンベクの表裏確率は精神力にかかわらず各50%。精神力の低下とパッシブの強化・パ: Dongbaek's Heads/Tails odds are fixed at 50% each regardless of SP. Judge SP loss separately from passive buffs and Panic Stagger.
messages.棘は戦闘開始時に得るため、守備を相殺しただけでは反射がなくならない。: Thorns is gained at Combat Start, so offsetting the Defense Skill alone does not remove reflection.
messages.古傘はHP9・行動なし。4章ダンジョンの狐の古傘のHP82や回数追加効果を流用し: Old Umbrellas here have 9 HP and no actions. Do not use the 82 HP or Count effects of the Fox's umbrellas in the Canto IV dungeon.
Prepare 7 main units around Level 35 and Uptie III or higher. Build around Blunt/Gloom damage and check your answer to a maximum roll of 26 and its E.G.O resource costs.
messages.沈潜・破裂・毒の消耗へHPと精神力の回復を用意。反射中に本体へ全員で攻撃する作戦: Prepare HP and SP recovery for Sinking, Rupture, and Poison. Avoid having everyone attack Dongbaek while reflection is active.
messages.士気低下中の強化技や基本26の広域を止める。: Stop skills boosted by Low Morale and the 26-Base-Power area attack.
messages.マッチに使わない手数でバリア1200と本体を削る。: Use actions not needed for Clashes to wear down the 1200 Shield and Dongbaek's HP.
messages.反射中の消耗を避け、次ターンの強化へつなげる。: Avoid reflection damage while setting up next turn's buffs.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 紳士妖精（4章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistant: 4-54 Fairy Gentleman (Canto IV) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「紳士妖精（4章）」の攻略。左腕: Fairy Gentleman (Canto IV) guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Focus damage on the Left Arm. If the fight lasts, use Fairy Wine to convert Morale Boost into Tipsy, nullify Predation's damage, and trigger Stagger. The opening and later versions of the same skill differ in whether they can Clash.
messages.4-54「The League of Nine in Memory, Floor: 4-54 · The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 1
messages.4章ダンジョン1層の通常個体。本体HP1354と左腕364・胴体849は別の値。: The regular encounter on Floor 1 of the Canto IV dungeon. Overall HP is 1354; Left Arm HP is 364 and Body HP is 849. Fairy Wine likewise has 11 overall HP and 2 HP on its Barrel Part. Do not substitute Luxcavation or Mirror Dungeon HP and power values.
messages.通常個体の8技。これ食べちゃうぞ！は初手のマッチ不可・対象変更不可と、後のマッチ: 8 skills from the regular encounter. “I'll Have This!” has an opening version that is unclashable and cannot be redirected, plus a later version that can Clash. The listed damage bonus per Morale Boost is +100% for the later version and +10% for the opening version. Displayed power excludes conditional bonuses such as +5 Clash Power against targets without Tipsy.
messages.貫通・傲慢・怠惰を軸に、HPの低い左腕へ火力を集中。HP・精神力・資源はダンジョ: Focus Pierce, Pride, and Sloth damage on the lower-HP Left Arm. Prepare HP, SP, and resources within the dungeon.
messages.1ターン目の捕食はマッチも対象変更も不可。狙われた本人が守備と耐性で受ける。: Turn 1's Predation attack is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Its original target must use their own Defense Skill and resistances.
messages.長引くなら高揚を酒で酔いへ変える。酔い付きで捕食を受けると無傷・敵HP−50、酔: If the fight lasts, use Fairy Wine to convert Morale Boost into Tipsy. Taking the Predation hit with Tipsy deals 0 damage and removes 50 enemy HP; at 5 Tipsy, it also Staggers the enemy.
messages.初手の捕食へマッチを組めない: You cannot Clash with the opening Predation attack
messages.1ターン目の技だけはマッチ不可・対象変更不可。狙われた本人の回避・防御で備える。: Only the turn-1 version is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Prepare the original target's Evade or Guard. The later skill with the same name can Clash.
messages.高揚を集めたら捕食で大ダメージを受けた: Building Morale Boost makes Predation deal huge damage
messages.高揚は普段は攻撃を強めるが、捕食の被害も増やす。5ターン目の強い捕食までに、妖精: Morale Boost normally increases your damage, but also increases damage taken from Predation. Attack Fairy Wine's Defense Skill to convert it into Tipsy before the stronger attack on turn 5.
messages.酔いを付けたのに敵が混乱しない: The enemy does not Stagger despite your Sinner having Tipsy
messages.ダメージ無効化と敵HP−50は酔い付きで起こるが、混乱には酔い5以上が必要。捕食: Any Tipsy can nullify the damage and remove 50 enemy HP, but Stagger requires at least 5 Tipsy. Check the value before Predation.
messages.妖精酒を壊したら敵が強くなった: The enemy becomes stronger after Fairy Wine is destroyed
messages.再出現した酒へ敵が今度はダメだ！を的中させると回復・強化を得る。対象線を確認し、: If “Not This Time!” hits the respawned wine, the enemy gains healing and buffs. Check targeting lines; redirect it with a faster Sinner or destroy the wine first.
messages.胴体よりHPが低い基本の集中先。貫通と傲慢が有効。: The usual focus target, with less HP than the Body. Pierce and Pride are effective.
messages.マッチによって高揚を得る技が多い。捕食前に酒へ変換する担当を決める。: Many skills grant Morale Boost during Clashes. Decide who will convert it through Fairy Wine before Predation.
messages.分けて飲もう！は使用時に本体・胴体を回復。マッチ勝利だけでは回復を取り消せない。: “Let's Share the Drink!” heals overall and Body HP [On Use]. Winning its Clash does not cancel the healing.
messages.初手と5ターン目以降の捕食は別性能。マッチ可否・高揚・酔いの数値を確認する。: The opening Predation attack differs from the version used from turn 5 onward. Check whether it can Clash, along with Morale Boost and Tipsy values.
messages.通常進行では3ターン目に出現。ターン開始時に場にないと、その2ターン後に出現する: Normally appears on turn 3. If absent at Turn Start, it appears 2 turns later. After destruction, it normally respawns 3 turns later.
messages.高揚を酔いへ変える守備を使う。再出現後は紳士妖精の攻撃対象にもなる。: Uses a Defense Skill that converts Morale Boost into Tipsy. After respawning, it also becomes a target for Fairy Gentleman's attacks.
messages.左腕を削る火力と、初手の受けを用意: Prepare Left Arm damage and a way to survive the opening hit
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。貫通・傲慢・怠惰を選び、左腕へ集中できる手: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring Pierce, Pride, and Sloth damage and skills you can focus on the Left Arm.
messages.初手の捕食はマッチも対象変更もできない。各囚人の貫通耐性・守備と、回復手段を確認: The opening Predation attack is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Check each Sinner's Pierce resistance, Defense Skill, and healing options.
messages.戦闘開始時にランダムな1名へ高揚5が付く。誰が得たかを見て、後の酒の変換担当を決: At Combat Start, one random Sinner receives 5 Morale Boost. Check who receives it before choosing who will use the wine later.
messages.初手の捕食を受け、左腕へ火力を集める: Survive the opening Predation attack and focus on the Left Arm
messages.初手のこれ食べちゃうぞ！は、狙われた本人の回避・防御で対応する。攻撃でマッチを取: Answer the opening “I'll Have This!” with the original target's own Evade or Guard. An Attack Skill cannot Clash with it.
messages.ほかの弱い打撃には通常技で勝ち、振動と束縛の的中を防ぐ。マッチすると高揚も増える: Beat the other weak Blunt attacks with regular skills to prevent Tremor and Bind on hit. Clashing also builds Morale Boost.
messages.残りの攻撃を左腕へまとめる。本体・胴体の回復をマッチ勝利で止められると思わず、攻: Focus your remaining attacks on the Left Arm. Do not split damage under the assumption that winning Clashes stops the overall and Body healing.
messages.酒の守備へ高揚を持つ囚人を向ける: Direct a Sinner with Morale Boost at the wine's Defense Skill
messages.妖精酒が現れたら、高揚のある囚人の攻撃を酒の守備へ向け、同数の酔いへ変える。酔い: When Fairy Wine appears, attack its Defense Skill with a Sinner who has Morale Boost to convert the same amount into Tipsy. If they can reach 5 Tipsy, you can also aim for Stagger.
messages.酒は脆い。別の攻撃で先に倒さないよう、酒へ向く攻撃と行動順を確認する。酔いはマッ: The wine is fragile. Check attacks and action order so another attack does not destroy it first. Tipsy reduces Clash Power, so avoid assigning the converted Sinner to an immediate high-power Clash.
messages.左腕への火力だけで早く倒せるなら、仕組みを全部使う必要はない。火力が足りず5ター: If Left Arm damage can end the fight quickly, you do not need to use every mechanic. Use the wine as preparation when your damage is insufficient and the fight reaches turn 5.
messages.酔い付きの担当へ捕食を当てて無害化: Let a Sinner with Tipsy take the hit to nullify Predation
messages.後のこれ食べちゃうぞ！はマッチでき、対象変更も可能。酔い付きの囚人の通常の防御を: The later “I'll Have This!” can Clash and be redirected. Target it with a Sinner's regular Guard while they have Tipsy. Redirecting an attack aimed at another Sinner requires higher Speed than the enemy.
messages.酔い付きで的中を受けると被ダメージ0となり、紳士妖精のHPが50減る。酔い5以上: Taking the hit with Tipsy reduces incoming damage to 0 and removes 50 Fairy Gentleman HP. At 5 or more Tipsy, it also Staggers him. Evading or winning an attacking Clash does not trigger this [On Hit] Stagger.
messages.的中後に高揚・酔いは消えるので、同じ囚人で何本も無効化できるとは限らない。残りの: The hit consumes Morale Boost and Tipsy, so one Sinner may not nullify multiple attacks. Beat remaining Predation attacks, or attacks you cannot redirect to a Tipsy Sinner, with strong skills. Without Tipsy, the enemy gains +5 Clash Power and can roll 21. Targets with Morale Boost take increased damage, so choose someone with less of it.
messages.酒を敵に渡さず、混乱の機会で倒す: Deny the enemy the wine and finish during Stagger
messages.再出現した妖精酒へ今度はダメだ！が向いたら、速い囚人で引き取って勝つか、こちらが: If “Not This Time!” targets respawned Fairy Wine, redirect and beat it with a faster Sinner, or destroy the wine first. A successful enemy hit grants 10% HP healing and buffs next turn.
messages.酔いによる混乱を起こすと、その後に暴食判定のイベントがある。成功率を見て担当を選: After causing Stagger through Tipsy, a Gluttony check event follows. Choose a Sinner based on the displayed success chance. Success gives that Sinner 10% HP healing, 2 Attack Power Up, 2 Haste, and 2 Protection; failure gives those benefits to the enemy.
messages.左腕を削り、混乱の隙に本体へ攻撃をまとめて決着を狙う。: Wear down the Left Arm, then concentrate attacks during Stagger to finish the enemy.
messages.マッチ進行時、高揚1を付与: During the Clash, inflict 1 Morale Boost.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]振動5を付与、振動回数2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2.
messages.マッチを進めると担当が高揚1を得る。勝って振動の的中を防ぎつつ、後で妖精酒へ変換: The Clashing Sinner gains 1 Morale Boost. Win to prevent Tremor on hit while building Morale Boost to convert through Fairy Wine later.
messages.マッチ進行時、高揚2を付与: During the Clash, inflict 2 Morale Boost.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに束縛2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.
messages.マッチで高揚2。使用時に本体と胴体を5%回復するので、勝つだけでは回復を止められ: Clashing grants 2 Morale Boost. The skill heals overall and Body HP by 5% [On Use], so winning does not stop the healing. Focusing damage on the lower-HP Left Arm is a straightforward approach.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の振動回数分、振動爆発: Ⅱ[On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst a number of times equal to the target's Tremor Count.
messages.振動を持つ対象を優先し、2枚目で回数分の振動爆発を起こす。振動の多い低HPの囚人: Prioritizes targets with Tremor; its second Coin triggers Tremor Burst according to their Count. Keep it away from low-HP Sinners with heavy Tremor and assign a winning skill.
messages.対象に酔いが無いなら、マッチ威力+5: If the target has no Tipsy, gain +5 Clash Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象が高揚を持っているなら、高揚の数値分ダメージ量+10％: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Morale Boost, deal +10% damage per stack.
messages.[的中時]対象が酔いを持っているなら与ダメージが0になり、自分の体力が-50: [On Hit] If the target has Tipsy, deal 0 damage and lose 50 own HP.
messages.[的中時]高揚あるいは酔いを全て消耗: [On Hit] Consume all Morale Boost or Tipsy.
messages.1ターン目の捕食。マッチも対象変更もできないので、狙われた本人の回避・防御と貫通: Turn 1's Predation attack is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Prepare the original target's Evade, Guard, and Pierce resistance. The attack is stronger without Tipsy, and damage increases with Morale Boost.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象が高揚を持っているなら、高揚の数値分ダメージ量+100%: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Morale Boost, deal +100% damage per stack.
messages.5ターン目以降の強い捕食。高揚のある対象ではダメージが大きく増える。酔い付きの囚: The stronger Predation attack from turn 5 onward deals much more damage to targets with Morale Boost. A Sinner with Tipsy takes 0 damage and removes 50 enemy HP; at 5 Tipsy, the enemy also Staggers. If Tipsy is unavailable, win the Clash with a strong skill.
messages.妖精酒を優先して攻撃: Prioritize Fairy Wine as a target.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]妖精酒を攻撃した場合、次のターンに体力を10％回復、攻撃威力増加2,: Ⅰ[On Hit] If attacking Fairy Wine, heal 10% HP and gain 2 Attack Power Up, 2 Haste, and 2 Protection next turn.
messages.妖精酒を優先して攻撃し、的中すると次ターンに回復と強化を得る。速い囚人が引き取っ: Prioritizes Fairy Wine and grants healing and buffs next turn on hit. Redirect and win with a faster Sinner, or destroy the wine first to prevent the enemy from landing the hit.
messages.回避は最大13。通常の攻撃を何度も避けられるなら守備を向けて相殺する。ただし酒の: The Evade rolls up to 13. If it repeatedly avoids regular attacks, offset it with a Defense Skill. First reserve enough actions for wine conversion and Predation handling.
messages.[使用時]相手の高揚を数値分、酔いに変換: [On Use] Convert the opponent's Morale Boost into the same amount of Tipsy.
messages.高揚を持つ囚人の攻撃をこの守備へ向け、高揚を同数の酔いに変える。変換担当を決める: Attack this Defense Skill with a Sinner who has Morale Boost to convert it into the same amount of Tipsy. Do not destroy the wine with another faster attack before deciding who will use it.
messages.酔いが5以上の敵に「これ食べちゃうぞ！」を的中させたら、混乱状態になる。: If “I'll Have This!” hits a target with at least 5 Tipsy, become Staggered.
messages.酔い5以上の対象へ捕食が的中: Predation hits a target with at least 5 Tipsy
messages.酔い1〜4でもダメージ0と敵HP−50にはなるが、混乱には5が必要。: Even 1–4 Tipsy nullifies the damage and removes 50 enemy HP, but Stagger requires 5.
messages.内部からの良くわからない香りで高揚感が生じる。\nウェーブ開始時、ランダムな囚人: An unidentifiable scent from within creates a feeling of elation. At Wave Start, inflict 5 Morale Boost on one random Sinner.
messages.ランダムな1名の高揚5を確認し、その囚人を酒の変換担当の候補にする。: Check which random Sinner has 5 Morale Boost and consider using them for wine conversion.
messages.毎ターン、数値分のダメージ量増加を得る（最大5）。酔いがあると得られない。捕食の: Each turn, gain Damage Up equal to its value, up to 5. No benefit is gained while Tipsy is present. Also increases damage taken from Predation.
messages.普段の火力に使いつつ、捕食が来る前に酒で酔いへ変える。: Use it for normal damage, then convert it into Tipsy through the wine before Predation arrives.
messages.数値分マッチ威力が減る（最大5）。捕食が的中するとダメージ0・敵HP−50となり: Reduce Clash Power by its value, up to 5. When Predation hits, incoming damage becomes 0 and the enemy loses 50 HP; at 5 or more, the enemy also Staggers. Consumed on hit.
messages.捕食を受ける担当に使う。弱い状態で別の高威力マッチまで引き受けない。: Use it on the Sinner taking Predation. Avoid also assigning them to other high-power Clashes while their power is reduced.
messages.紳士妖精が強い技を使うことを示す状態。初手と後の捕食技でマッチ可否や強化量が異な: Indicates that Fairy Gentleman will use a powerful skill. The opening and later Predation attacks differ in Clash availability and buff amounts.
messages.同名技でも、そのターンに使う技の条件を確認する。: Even when skill names match, check the conditions on the version being used that turn.
messages.初手の捕食と後の捕食は別性能。マッチ不可なのは初手の方。: Opening and later Predation attacks have different properties. Only the opening version is unclashable.
messages.酔いがあるだけでも捕食のダメージは0になるが、敵の混乱には酔い5以上が必要。: Any Tipsy nullifies Predation's damage, but Staggering the enemy requires at least 5 Tipsy.
messages.捕食の的中で高揚・酔いは消える。酔い1つで複数の捕食を全て無効化できるとは考えな: Predation consumes Morale Boost and Tipsy on hit. Do not assume one application of Tipsy can nullify multiple Predation attacks.
messages.分けて飲もう！の回復は使用時。マッチ勝利で防ぐ効果と混同しない。: “Let's Share the Drink!” heals [On Use]. Do not confuse this with an effect prevented by winning its Clash.
messages.妖精酒は変換担当が使う前に壊さない。一方で再出現後は、敵への的中による回復・強化: Do not destroy Fairy Wine before your chosen Sinner uses it. After it respawns, also prevent enemy hits that grant healing and buffs.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上。左腕へ貫通・傲慢・怠惰の火力を集める。: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Focus Pierce, Pride, and Sloth damage on the Left Arm.
messages.初手の捕食に備える貫通耐性・守備と、長期戦の高揚から酔いへの変換担当を確認する。: Check Pierce resistance and Defense Skills for the opening Predation attack, plus a Morale Boost-to-Tipsy converter for a longer fight.
messages.回復のある胴体へ分散せず、低HPの部位から本体を削る。: Wear down the enemy through the lower-HP Part rather than splitting damage into the healing Body.
messages.酒へ高揚を渡し、捕食を無害化して混乱を作る。: Convert Morale Boost through the wine to nullify Predation and create a Stagger opening.
messages.後の捕食や、敵が酒を狙う技の対象を調整する。: Adjust targets for later Predation attacks and enemy skills aimed at the wine.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 誰も泣かぬように（4章）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 4-54 So That No One Will Cry (Canto IV) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「誰も泣かぬように（4章）」の攻: So That No One Will Cry (Canto IV) guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Focus Blunt attacks on the Right Arm first. If the fight lasts, return talismans on turn 3 to weaken turn 4's 5-Coin attack. Distinguish talismans on your Sinners from those returned to the enemy.

messages.4章ダンジョン1層の通常個体。本体HP1223、胴体760、右腕326。部位HP: The regular encounter on Floor 1 of the Canto IV dungeon. Overall HP is 1223, Body HP is 760, and Right Arm HP is 326; do not add Part HP to determine overall HP. Both Parts can act and remain targetable after breaking. The broken Right Arm's -20% damage does not mean it stops acting.
messages.通常技5つ。スキルによる使用時の札付与はマッチ勝利でも残る。移転するお札は効果欄: 5 regular skills. Talismans applied [On Use] remain even if you win the Clash. “Transferring Talisman” lists [On Use], while the footnote places talisman application after the attack; attack its Defense Skill and check the actual transfer. This excludes Mirror Dungeon enhanced skills and Unbreakable Coins.
messages.打撃・憤怒・傲慢でHP326の右腕へ火力を集中。4ターン目の大技に混乱を合わせて: Focus Blunt, Wrath, and Pride damage on the 326-HP Right Arm. Time its Stagger to stop the turn-4 major attack.
messages.お札を返すなら、3ターン目の移転するお札へ札持ちの攻撃を向ける。返した札12以上: To return talismans, attack “Transferring Talisman” on turn 3 with a Sinner carrying them. At least 12 returned talismans apply 5 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.札を持つ囚人へ火傷が返るパッシブがある。火傷を大量に付ける編成では長期化させない: A passive returns Burn to Sinners carrying talismans. Avoid prolonging the fight with a team that stacks large amounts of Burn.
messages.絡みゆくお札・積もりゆく呪いは使用時にも札を付ける。勝利で全て防げるわけではない: “Entangling Talisman” and “Cumulating Curse” also apply talismans [On Use]. Winning cannot prevent all of them. Check each Sinner's stacks and choose who will return them on turn 3.
messages.3ターン目に何を狙えばよいか分からない: You do not know what to target on turn 3
messages.札の多い囚人の攻撃を移転するお札の守備へ向ける。自分の札を消して敵へ同数を返し、: Attack “Transferring Talisman”'s Defense Skill with Sinners carrying many talismans. Their stacks are removed and the same amount returns to the enemy; aim for 12 total. If you have enough damage, Staggering the Right Arm is another option.
messages.4ターン目の5枚攻撃へ勝てない: You cannot beat the turn-4 5-Coin attack
messages.3ターン目までに返した札12以上なら、次ターン攻撃威力減少5。あるいは右腕を混乱: Return at least 12 talismans by turn 3 to apply 5 Attack Power Down next turn. Alternatively, Stagger the Right Arm to stop its action. If neither is ready, prepare strong skills or a Blunt-resistant defender.
messages.燃やしたら味方も火傷になった: Applying Burn also burns your allies
messages.ストーリー個体は燃え移る火種を持つ。敵の火傷が、札を持つ対象へ次ターンに返る。火: The story encounter has Spreading Ember. The enemy's Burn returns next turn to targets carrying talismans. If Burn will not finish the fight, use another damage source.
messages.誰も泣かぬように（右腕）: So That No One Will Cry (Right Arm)
messages.胴体よりHPが低く、通常攻略の集中先。混乱でそのターンの行動を止め、大技を遅らせ: The usual focus target, with less HP than the Body. Stagger it to stop its actions that turn and delay its major attack.
messages.破壊後も行動・追撃可能。腕の与ダメージが20%下がるが、5枚技が永久に消えるわけ: Can still act and be attacked after breaking. The Arm deals 20% less damage, but its 5-Coin skill is not permanently removed.
messages.誰も泣かぬように（胴体）: So That No One Will Cry (Body)
messages.札を増やす技と返す守備を持つ。3ターン目の守備へ札持ちの攻撃を向ける。: Has talisman-stacking skills and the Defense Skill used to return them. Attack its turn-3 Defense Skill with Sinners carrying talismans.
messages.右腕と耐性は共通。打撃・憤怒・傲慢が通りやすく、斬撃・色欲・嫉妬は通りにくい。: Shares the Right Arm's resistances. Blunt, Wrath, and Pride are effective; Slash, Lust, and Envy are resisted.
messages.右腕を削る打撃と、札を返す担当を用意: Prepare Blunt damage for the Right Arm and Sinners to return talismans
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。打撃・憤怒・傲慢が有効で、右腕へ火力を集中: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Blunt, Wrath, and Pride are effective; focusing the Right Arm brings an earlier Stagger.
messages.大技までに火力が足りない場合に備え、打撃に強い受け役とHP回復、札を返す役を考え: If damage is insufficient before the major attack, prepare a Blunt-resistant defender, HP healing, and Sinners to return talismans.
messages.火傷編成では燃え移る火種に注意。敵の火傷が札持ちへ返るため、長期戦の安全策とは考: Burn teams must account for Spreading Ember. Enemy Burn returns to talisman carriers, so it is not a safe plan for a long fight.
messages.まず右腕へ集中し、札の枚数を確認: Focus the Right Arm first and check talisman stacks
messages.危険な攻撃へ勝ち、余る手数を右腕へ向ける。部位の混乱で大技を遅らせ、その間に本体: Win dangerous Clashes and direct spare actions at the Right Arm. The basic plan is to delay the major attack through Part Stagger while reducing overall HP.
messages.絡みゆくお札は使用時に札2、積もりゆく呪いは使用時に札1を付ける。勝っていても札: “Entangling Talisman” applies 2 talismans [On Use]; “Cumulating Curse” applies 1. They remain even if you win, so check each Sinner's status.
messages.札9以上では次ターン開始に攻撃威力減少2。大技担当に札を集め過ぎず、返す役を分け: At 9 or more talismans, gain 2 Attack Power Down next Turn Start. Keep excessive stacks off your major-attack Clash specialists and use separate talisman returners.
messages.移転するお札は2枠。札の多い囚人の攻撃を、それぞれの守備へ向ける。自分の札が消え: There are 2 “Transferring Talisman” slots. Assign attacks from Sinners with many talismans to each Defense Skill. Their stacks disappear and the enemy gains the same amount of Reattached Curse Talisman.
messages.返した札9以上ならターン終了に束縛5、12以上なら攻撃威力減少5。次ターンの大技: At Turn End, 9 or more returned talismans grant 5 Bind; 12 or more grant 5 Attack Power Down. Aim for 12 to weaken next turn's major attack. Transfer occurs after the attack, so check the actual stacks too.
messages.札を集める一例は、受け役2名が1ターン目の絡みゆくお札へマッチして札2を得て、2: One example uses 2 defenders: each Clashes with “Entangling Talisman” on turn 1 to receive 2 talismans, then Guards against “Cumulating Curse” on turn 2. Its [On Use] effect raises stacks to 3, and the first hit raises them to 6. Returning 6 each on turn 3 makes 12 total.
messages.別の味方に向く攻撃を受け役へ変更するには、敵より高い速度が必要。対象線とHPを確: Redirecting another ally's attack to the defender requires higher Speed than the enemy. Check targeting lines and HP. This example intentionally takes hits; if resistances or HP are insufficient, prioritize Right Arm Stagger or strong ordinary Clashes instead.
messages.3ターン目終了の判定: Check at the end of turn 3
messages.追加のお札で弱体化を補う: Use extra talismans to complete the debuff setup
messages.怠惰の判定に成功すると、敵へ貼り直された呪いの札5を追加し、担当は次ターンにクイ: Passing the Sloth check adds 5 Reattached Curse Talisman to the enemy and gives the chosen Sinner 2 Haste next turn. Check the displayed success chance.
messages.成功時の追加5も12枚達成の助けになる。判定失敗では担当が持つ札が全て消えるため: The extra 5 stacks help reach 12. Failure removes all talismans from the chosen Sinner, so avoid risking a defender on the assumption of success.
messages.弱体化か腕の混乱を使い、被害を抑える: Use debuffs or Arm Stagger to limit damage
messages.右腕から誰も泣かぬようにが2本。基本3＋3×5で最大18。札12以上による攻撃威: The Right Arm uses 2 copies of So That No One Will Cry. Each has 3 Base Power plus 5 Coins of +3, rolling up to 18. Answer them with 5 Attack Power Down from at least 12 returned talismans, or Stagger the Right Arm.
messages.準備が間に合わなければ、高威力技でマッチするか、打撃・憂鬱の耐性がある担当の守備: If setup is incomplete, Clash with powerful skills or use a defender resistant to Blunt and Gloom. Check HP and Stagger Thresholds; keep the attacks away from low-HP Sinners.
messages.大技を使ったターン終了には、貼り直された呪いの札が消える。長引いて次の周期へ入る: Reattached Curse Talisman is removed at the end of the major-attack turn. If the fight reaches another cycle, prepare to return talismans again. The broken Arm remains targetable, so focus damage to finish the enemy.
messages.[使用時]対象に絡み付いた呪いの札2を付与: [On Use] Inflict 2 Entangled Curse Talisman on the target.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに破裂2を付与。破裂回数2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 2 next turn.
messages.使用時に札2を付けるので、勝っても札は残る。的中の次ターン破裂は防げるため、通常: Applies 2 talismans [On Use], so they remain even if you win. You can still prevent next-turn Rupture on hit, so normally win the Clash. If deliberately taking it to collect talismans, check HP and stacks.
messages.[使用時]対象に絡み付いた呪いの札1を付与: [On Use] Inflict 1 Entangled Curse Talisman on the target.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の持つ絡み付いた呪いの札の枚数分、絡み付いた呪いの札を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Entangled Curse Talisman equal to the target's current stacks.
messages.Ⅱ[表面的中時]次のターンに破裂5を付与: Ⅱ[Heads Hit] Inflict 5 Rupture next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[表面的中時]次のターンに破裂2を付与。破裂回数2増加: Ⅲ[Heads Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 2 next turn.
messages.使用時に札1、1枚目が当たると今の札枚数分を追加。札2からなら使用時で3、1枚目: Applies 1 talisman [On Use], then adds the target's current amount on the first hit. Starting from 2 gives 3 on use and 6 after the first hit. Win the Clash to limit stacks unless deliberately collecting them for return.
messages.[ターン終了時]貼り直された呪いの札が全て消滅: [Turn End] Remove all Reattached Curse Talisman.
messages.Ⅴ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺5を付与: Ⅴ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Paralyze next turn.
messages.右腕の5枚技・最大18。返した札12以上で次ターン攻撃威力減少5を付けるか、右腕: The Right Arm's 5-Coin skill rolls up to 18. Return at least 12 talismans to apply 5 Attack Power Down next turn, or Stagger the Arm to stop it. Its final hit inflicts 5 Paralyze next turn, plus 5 Bind on Heads.
messages.[使用時]対象の絡み付いた呪いの札を全て消滅。消滅させた分、貼り直された呪いの札: [On Use] Remove all Entangled Curse Talisman from the target. Gain Reattached Curse Talisman equal to the amount removed.
messages.資料脚注：札の付与タイミングは攻撃後。: Timing note: the source footnote places talisman application after the attack.
messages.札の多い囚人の攻撃を、この守備へ向けて札を返す。本人の札を全て消し、同数を敵の貼: Attack this Defense Skill with a Sinner carrying many talismans to return them. All their stacks are removed and become the same amount of Reattached Curse Talisman on the enemy. The footnote places application after the attack, so check action order and the result.
messages.[使用時]対象の持つ絡み付いた呪いの札の枚数分、絡み付いた呪いの札を付与: [On Use] Inflict Entangled Curse Talisman equal to the target's current stacks.
messages.使用時に対象の札を同数追加する。マッチ勝利だけではこの増加を取り消せない。札の少: Doubles the target's talismans [On Use]. Winning the Clash does not cancel this increase. Check whether a faster Sinner with fewer stacks can redirect it.
messages.ターン終了時、自分に火傷があるなら次のターンに保有している数値分の火傷を、絡み付: At Turn End, if this unit has Burn, inflict Burn equal to its value next turn on all targets with Entangled Curse Talisman.
messages.ターン終了時に敵自身が火傷を持つ: Enemy has Burn at Turn End
messages.札持ちの対象へ次ターンに火傷が返る。ストーリー個体の効果を、未所持の鏡個体と混同: Burn returns next turn to targets carrying talismans. This applies to the story encounter; do not confuse it with Mirror Dungeon versions lacking this passive.
messages.腕部位破壊時、腕の与ダメージ量 -20%: When the Arm Part breaks, the Arm deals 20% less damage.
messages.腕の与ダメージが20%下がるが、行動自体は続く。破壊後も攻撃して本体を削り切る。: The Arm deals 20% less damage but can still act. Keep attacking after the break to finish the enemy.
messages.囚人に付く札。数値ごとに与ダメージ+1%。9以上でターン開始時に攻撃威力減少2。: Talismans applied to Sinners. Deal +1% damage per stack. At Turn Start, if at 9 or more, gain 2 Attack Power Down. Attack “Transferring Talisman” to return them to the enemy.
messages.通常は8以下に抑え、返す役と大技のマッチ担当を分ける。: Normally keep stacks at 8 or fewer, and separate talisman returners from major-attack Clash specialists.
messages.敵へ返した札。9以上でターン終了時に束縛5、12以上で攻撃威力減少5を得る。: Talismans returned to the enemy. At Turn End, gain 5 Bind at 9 or more stacks and 5 Attack Power Down at 12 or more.
messages.3ターン目に12以上を用意し、次の5枚技を弱める。自分に付く札の数値と混同しない: Reach at least 12 on turn 3 to weaken the following 5-Coin skill. Distinguish these from the talismans on your Sinners.
messages.札は使用時にも付く。マッチに勝つだけでは全て防げない。: Talismans also apply [On Use]. Winning Clashes cannot prevent all of them.
messages.右腕を破壊しても行動は残る。混乱による一時停止と、破壊による与ダメージ低下は別。: Breaking the Right Arm does not stop it acting. Temporary action loss from Stagger differs from reduced damage after breaking.
messages.札6を2名で集める方法は被弾を伴う。HPが足りなければ無理に再現せず、腕の混乱を: Collecting 6 talismans on 2 Sinners requires taking hits. If HP is insufficient, aim for Arm Stagger instead of forcing this setup.
messages.火傷を返す対象は札を持つ対象。鏡でこのパッシブがない個体の感覚で火傷を積まない。: Burn returns to targets carrying talismans. Do not stack Burn as if this were a Mirror Dungeon version without that passive.
messages.4ターン目の通常技は破壊不能ではない。鉄道や鏡の強化個体の仕様を持ち込まない。: The regular turn-4 skill does not have Unbreakable Coins. Do not apply the rules of enhanced Railway or Mirror Dungeon versions here.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上。打撃・憤怒・傲慢で右腕を狙い、大技前の混乱を目指す。: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Focus Blunt, Wrath, and Pride on the Right Arm to Stagger it before the major attack.
messages.長引く場合に備え、打撃耐性の受け役・HP回復・お札返しの担当を用意する。: For a longer fight, prepare a Blunt-resistant defender, HP healing, and talisman returners.
messages.低HPの部位から混乱と破壊を取り、本体を削る。: Stagger and break the lower-HP Part to wear down overall HP.
messages.3ターン目に返した札12以上を作り、次ターンの大技を弱める。: Build at least 12 returned talismans on turn 3 to weaken next turn's major attack.
messages.5枚技の的中と、次ターンの麻痺・束縛による立て直しの遅れを防ぐ。: Prevent the 5-Coin skill's hits and avoid recovery being delayed by next-turn Paralyze and Bind.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 さすらいの狐（4章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 4-54 Drifting Fox (Canto IV) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「さすらいの狐（4章）」の攻略。: Drifting Fox (Canto IV) guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Build SP by winning against weaker attacks, and direct strong attacks at the Fox rather than spending the whole fight chasing umbrellas. Prepare for area attacks and SP loss, break Parts, and finish the Fox.
messages.4-54「The League of Nine in Memory, Floor: 4-54 · The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 2
messages.傘に気を取られて精神力を削られ続けないよう、弱い攻撃で精神力を稼ぎ、強い攻撃は狐: Build SP by winning against weaker attacks, and direct strong attacks at the Fox rather than spending the whole fight chasing umbrellas. Prepare for area attacks and SP loss, break Parts, and finish the Fox.
messages.4章ダンジョン2層の個体。本体HP889と部位HPは別の値。頭260・胴体607: The Floor 2 encounter in the Canto IV dungeon. Overall HP is 889; Head HP is 260 and Body HP is 607. These are separate values, not a sum determining overall HP. Do not substitute Luxcavation or Mirror Dungeon HP and resistances. Broken Parts remain targetable and can still act.
messages.通常個体の7種類を使用部位別に10表示。哀しみの反動はスキル表が頭、行動表が胴体: 7 regular skill types shown as 10 entries by Part. “Sorrowful Recoil” is assigned to the Head in the skill table but the Body in the action table, so it appears under both; check the actual slots. Old Umbrella's listed range of 1–1 conflicts with its 1 (+1) Coin entry. This guide shows 1 Base Power plus a +1 Coin, for 1–2, without substituting another encounter's values.
Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring SP recovery and E.G.O that can beat an area attack rolling up to 20.
messages.怠惰の弱い技へ勝って精神力を上げ、暴食の多コイン攻撃は強い担当で止める。傘を全部: Build SP by beating weak Sloth skills, and stop the multi-Coin Gluttony attacks with stronger skills. Do not prioritize clearing every umbrella above everything else.
messages.3ターン目の精神力−20と、その後の広域へ備える。部位破壊による弱体化を使い、H: Prepare for -20 SP on turn 3 and the area attack afterward. Use Part-break debuffs, then finish the Fox quickly once overall HP reaches 15% or less.
messages.精神力が低くなり、急にマッチに勝てない: Low SP suddenly makes Clashes hard to win
messages.沈潜の的中に加え、待ちわびるで全員の精神力が20下がる。通常技で勝てるうちに精神: Besides Sinking on hit, “Waiting” reduces everyone's SP by 20. Build SP while regular skills can still win and save recovery options. Offsetting alone does not prevent the SP loss.
messages.傘へ勝っているのに状態異常が増える: Statuses increase even when you beat umbrella attacks
messages.古傘の全体への回数追加は攻撃後効果。マッチ勝利で的中を防ぐだけでは取り消せない。: The umbrella's team-wide Count increase is an [After Attack] effect. Winning the Clash to prevent hits does not cancel it. Consider Staggering or defeating the umbrella before it acts.
messages.傘を倒すほど本体へ手が回らない: Clearing umbrellas leaves no actions to damage the Fox
messages.狐の危険な攻撃を止めた残りの手数で傘を削る。広域があれば複数処理し、なくても1体: Use spare actions after stopping the Fox's dangerous attacks to damage umbrellas. Area attacks can clear several; otherwise, remove them one at a time. Defeating the Fox also defeats the remaining umbrellas.
messages.頭を壊したのに広域を使われた: The Head still uses an area attack after breaking
messages.ストーリーの部位情報は破壊後も行動とされる。頭破壊による攻撃レベル低下は使えるが: The story encounter's Part data allows actions after breaking. The Head break's Offense Level Down helps, but does not remove all future actions.
messages.斬撃が有効。破壊後も行動・追撃可能。破壊で狐に毎ターン攻撃レベル減少5。: Weak to Slash. Remains targetable and can act after breaking. Breaking it applies 5 Offense Level Down to the Fox every turn.
messages.本体HP15%以下では毎ターン広域を使い、古傘の補充が続く。: At 15% overall HP or less, uses an area attack every turn and keeps replenishing Old Umbrellas.
messages.貫通が有効。破壊後も行動・追撃可能。破壊で狐に毎ターン脆弱3。: Weak to Pierce. Remains targetable and can act after breaking. Breaking it applies 3 Fragile to the Fox every turn.
messages.待ちわびるは頭・胴体のどちらかが使用する。片方を混乱させただけで精神力低下を確実: Either the Head or Body can use “Waiting”. Staggering only one Part does not guarantee preventing the SP loss.
messages.開始時4体。召喚後に6体を超えない範囲で補充される。狐の撃破時に残りも倒れる。: Starts with 4. Summons replenish them without exceeding 6. Remaining umbrellas die when the Fox is defeated.
messages.撃破すると次ターンの撃破者にクイック2、狐の全部位に束縛2と傘の破片1。終盤に新: Defeating one grants its killer 2 Haste next turn and inflicts 2 Bind and 1 Umbrella Splinters on all Fox Parts. Umbrellas newly summoned late in the fight have 30% more HP.
messages.持ち越した資源で精神力と広域対策を用意: Use carried-over resources to prepare SP recovery and area-attack answers
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。前の戦闘からHP・精神力・E.G.O資源を: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Prepare HP, SP, and E.G.O resources in earlier fights, saving enough for healing and winning against the area attack.
messages.狐は憂鬱・暴食が弱点。物理は頭が斬撃、胴体が貫通に弱い。打撃だけを集中すると通り: The Fox is weak to Gloom and Gluttony. Its Head is weak to Slash, and its Body to Pierce. Focusing only Blunt damage is ineffective.
messages.古傘には怠惰が有効。広域があれば複数を処理できるが、必須ではない。手数で1体ずつ: Old Umbrellas are weak to Sloth. Area attacks can clear several but are optional; you can also remove them one at a time with spare actions.
messages.弱い技で勝ち、危険な技と傘に手数を配る: Win easy Clashes and divide actions between dangerous skills and umbrellas
messages.狐の怠惰攻撃は最大10。勝てる通常技を合わせ、精神力を上げる。暴食の反動・激流に: The Fox's Sloth attacks roll up to 10. Use winning regular skills to build SP, and reserve stronger skills for Gluttony attacks “Sorrowful Recoil” and “Sorrowful Torrent”.
messages.古傘の技は弱いが、攻撃後に全員へ沈潜・破裂の回数を追加する。余る攻撃で混乱・撃破: Old Umbrella skills are weak, but increase everyone's Sinking and Rupture Count after attacking. Use spare attacks to Stagger or defeat them before they act.
messages.傘を倒すと狐に束縛と傘の破片が付く。速くなった撃破者を次ターンの引き受けに使い、: Defeating umbrellas applies Bind and Umbrella Splinters to the Fox. Use the killer's increased Speed to redirect attacks next turn, freeing more actions to damage the Fox.
messages.精神力−20を見込み、部位へ攻撃を集中: Plan for -20 SP and focus damage on Parts
messages.待ちわびるは戦闘開始時に全員の精神力を20下げる。守備の相殺でこの効果を取り消す: “Waiting” reduces everyone's SP by 20 at Combat Start. Offsetting the Defense Skill cannot cancel it. Prepare healing and the skills needed for subsequent Clashes before Combat Start.
messages.攻撃が少ない機会に部位へ火力を集中する。斬撃なら頭、貫通なら胴体へ弱点を突く。: Use this turn's fewer attacks as an opening to focus damage on Parts. Exploit the Head with Slash or the Body with Pierce.
messages.頭の破壊は攻撃レベル低下、胴体の破壊は脆弱3につながる。どちらも破壊後に追撃でき: Breaking the Head applies Offense Level Down; breaking the Body applies 3 Fragile. Both remain targetable after breaking, but a break does not guarantee stopping their actions.
messages.広域へ勝ち、部位破壊後の本体を削る: Beat the area attack and damage the Fox after breaking Parts
messages.何かを探す鳴き声は最大20・加重値5。強いE.G.Oでマッチし、追加対象のHPも: “Cries Seeking Something” rolls up to 20 with 5 Attack Weight. Clash using a strong E.G.O, and check secondary targets' HP. More umbrellas increase damage on Heads Hit.
messages.勝っても次ターンの古傘召喚は予約される。傘をゼロにし続けることだけに固執せず、弱: Winning does not cancel the Old Umbrella summon scheduled for next turn. Focus damage on the weakened Fox instead of insisting on keeping the umbrella count at zero.
messages.本体HP15%以下では毎ターン広域と傘の補充が続く。火力で倒し切れるなら本体を優: At 15% overall HP or less, area attacks and umbrella summons continue every turn. Prioritize finishing the Fox if your damage is sufficient; otherwise, reserve a winning answer to the area attack while wearing it down.
messages.最大10の1枚攻撃。勝てる通常技でマッチし、沈潜の付与を防ぐ。精神力の低い囚人を: A 1-Coin attack that rolls up to 10. Clash with a winning regular skill to prevent Sinking. Also use it to rebuild a low-SP Sinner's SP.
messages.boss-copy:wayward-fox:skills.1.name: Raging Withdrawal
messages.沈潜の威力と回数を増やす。精神力が削られた味方へ通すと次のマッチも不利になるので: Increases Sinking Potency and Count. Keep it away from low-SP allies to avoid making subsequent Clashes harder, and assign a winning opponent.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]破裂回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 3.
messages.最大13の2枚攻撃で破裂を付ける。怠惰の弱い技より強いスキルを使い、破裂を抱えた: A 2-Coin attack that rolls up to 13 and inflicts Rupture. Use a stronger skill than for the weak Sloth attacks, and protect low-HP allies carrying Rupture.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]破裂回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 2.
messages.最大14で破裂を増やす。傘から破裂回数を付けられた囚人に通すと追加ダメージが続く: Rolls up to 14 and adds Rupture. Landing on Sinners whose Rupture Count was raised by umbrellas prolongs extra damage, so win with a strong skill.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに古傘を召喚: [On Use] Summon Old Umbrellas next turn.
messages.[表面的中時]古傘の数だけダメージ量+15%: [Heads Hit] Deal +15% damage per Old Umbrella.
messages.加重値5・最大20。高威力E.G.Oで止める。表面的中時は古傘の数でダメージも増: 5 Attack Weight and a maximum roll of 20. Stop it with a powerful E.G.O. Heads Hit damage also increases with the number of Old Umbrellas. Winning the Clash does not cancel the next-turn summon scheduled [On Use].
messages.[戦闘開始時]全ての敵の精神力を-20: [Combat Start] Reduce all enemies' SP by 20.
