messages.戦闘開始時に全囚人の精神力を20減らす。守備を相殺してもこの効果は取り消せない。: Reduces all Sinners' SP by 20 at Combat Start. Offsetting the Defense Skill does not cancel this effect. Prepare recovery and check the predictions afterward.
messages.[攻撃後]全ての敵の破裂回数2,沈潜回数2増加: [After Attack] Increase all enemies' Rupture Count and Sinking Count by 2.
messages.古傘の攻撃は弱いが、攻撃後に全囚人へ破裂・沈潜の回数を2ずつ増やす。マッチ勝利だ: Old Umbrella's attack is weak, but increases all Sinners' Rupture and Sinking Count by 2 after attacking. Winning the Clash does not cancel the [After Attack] effect; Stagger or defeat it before it acts.
messages.残り体力が15%のとき、毎ターン速度が1に固定。攻撃威力減少1得る\n新しく召喚: At 15% remaining HP, Speed is fixed at 1 every turn and gain 1 Attack Power Down. Newly summoned Old Umbrellas have 30% more HP. Use “Cries Seeking Something” every turn.
messages.速度1になるが、毎ターン広域と次の傘召喚が続く。終盤に傘だけを追い続けず、本体を: Speed falls to 1, but area attacks and subsequent umbrella summons continue every turn. Finish the Fox rather than spending the end of the fight chasing umbrellas.
messages.背中部位を破壊時、毎ターン脆弱3を得る、破裂2を追加付与: When the Back Part is broken, gain 3 Fragile every turn and inflict 2 additional Rupture.
messages.本体へ毎ターン脆弱3が入り、削りやすくなる。破壊後も追撃できるので残りの火力をま: Applies 3 Fragile to the Fox every turn, making it easier to damage. The Part remains targetable after breaking, so focus your remaining attacks.
messages.頭の傘部位破壊時、毎ターン攻撃レベル減少5を得る、沈潜2を追加付与: When the Head's Umbrella Part is broken, gain 5 Offense Level Down every turn and inflict 2 additional Sinking.
messages.毎ターン攻撃レベル減少5で以後のマッチが楽になる。ただし頭の行動そのものが無くな: The 5 Offense Level Down each turn makes later Clashes easier. It does not remove the Head's actions.
messages.自分が倒されると、倒した囚人が次のターンにクイック2を得る。\nさすらいの狐の全: When defeated, the Sinner who defeated this unit gains 2 Haste next turn. Inflict 2 Bind and 1 Umbrella Splinters on all Parts of Drifting Fox.
messages.倒した囚人は次ターンに速くなり、狐は束縛と傘の破片を受ける。余る手数で倒して本体: The killer becomes faster next turn, while the Fox receives Bind and Umbrella Splinters. Use spare actions to defeat umbrellas and create more openings to attack the Fox.
messages.古傘の撃破で狐へ付与。ターン終了時、数値×5の破裂を得る。: Applied to the Fox when an Old Umbrella is defeated. At Turn End, gain Rupture equal to the value × 5.
messages.傘を倒す手数を本体への追加ダメージにもつなげる。鏡の個体での消滅条件を持ち込まな: Turn umbrella cleanup into extra damage on the Fox too. Do not apply Mirror Dungeon removal conditions here.
messages.待ちわびるの精神力−20は戦闘開始時。守備を相殺するだけでは防げない。: “Waiting”'s -20 SP applies at Combat Start. Offsetting the Defense Skill alone cannot prevent it.
messages.古傘の回数追加は攻撃後、鳴き声の召喚は使用時。どちらもマッチに勝つだけで全効果が: Umbrella Count increases apply [After Attack]; the cry's summon applies [On Use]. Winning Clashes does not cancel all of either skill's effects.
messages.頭と胴体は破壊後も行動する。部位破壊で広域を永久に封じたと判断しない。: The Head and Body can still act after breaking. A Part break does not permanently disable the area attack.
messages.採光は資源・精神力0スタートなど別の条件。このページは4章ダンジョンの準備と通常: Luxcavation uses different conditions, including starting with 0 resources and SP. This page covers Canto IV dungeon preparation and the regular encounter's values.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上。精神力回復と最大20の広域へ勝つ手段を用意する。: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Prepare SP recovery and an answer to the area attack's maximum roll of 20.
messages.頭への斬撃か胴体への貫通を軸に、憂鬱・暴食の火力を選ぶ。傘処理用に怠惰や広域があ: Build around Slash for the Head or Pierce for the Body, with Gloom and Gluttony damage. Sloth or area attacks help with umbrellas.
messages.沈潜と待ちわびるによる低下から、次のマッチを立て直す。: Recover from Sinking and “Waiting”'s SP loss to stabilize subsequent Clashes.
messages.通常の技では分が悪い最大20の鳴き声を止める。: Stop “Cries Seeking Something”'s maximum roll of 20, which is difficult for ordinary skills to beat.
messages.傘の行動を減らし、部位破壊による弱体化から本体を削り切る。: Reduce umbrella actions, then use Part-break debuffs to finish the Fox.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 真鍮の雄牛 - 涙を流す（4章ダンジョン）の攻略｜Limb: 4-54 Brazen Bull - Tearful (Canto IV Dungeon) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「真鍮の雄牛 - 涙を流す（4章: Brazen Bull - Tearful (Canto IV Dungeon) guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Choose Run., Run., then Don't run. to avoid the battle. Fighting begins after every Sinner takes 15 HP damage, so check remaining HP. Beat “Overflowing Sorrow” to reveal the Head, then Stagger and break it to weaken the Bull.
messages.4-54「The League of Nine in Memory, Floor: 4-54 · The League of Nine in Memory, Floor 3 Event
messages.イベントは走る、走る、走らないの順で戦闘を回避できる。戦う場合は全員HP15ダメ: Choose Run., Run., then Don't run. to avoid the battle. Fighting begins after every Sinner takes 15 HP damage, so check remaining HP. Beat “Overflowing Sorrow” to reveal the Head, then Stagger and break it to weaken the Bull.
messages.4-54ダンジョン3層の任意イベント戦。敵Lv33・胴体HP549・防御Lv40: An optional Floor 3 event battle in the 4-54 dungeon. Enemy Level 33; Body HP 549 and Defense Level 40; after meeting its condition, Head HP 179 and Defense Level 29. This differs from 4-6's 523 Body HP and Level 30. The dungeon deployment limit is 7. This excludes 4-3, where the Head does not appear, and enhanced Mirror Dungeon versions.
messages.通常個体の共通6技を使用し、実際の攻撃レベルはLv33から換算する。火傷・沈潜の: Uses the regular encounter's 6 shared skills, with actual Offense Levels calculated from Level 33. Some Burn and Sinking effects require Heads Hit. Inconsolable Sorrow is described as a Stagger effect after the Head breaks.
messages.消耗を避けるなら、走る、走る、走らないで戦闘を回避する。全員HP・精神力20回復: To avoid attrition, choose Run., Run., then Don't run. to skip the battle. Every Sinner recovers 20 HP and SP, and you gain Cooled Tear.
messages.戦う場合はイベントで全員HP15ダメージ。主力Lv33・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、残H: If you fight, the event deals 15 HP damage to every Sinner. Aim for Level 33 and Uptie III or higher on your main units; check remaining HP and healing resources.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみに優先して勝ち、拭えぬ哀しみ3以上で頭を出す。貫通・傲慢で頭を混乱: Prioritize beating “Overflowing Sorrow”, reaching at least 3 Unresolved Sorrow to reveal the Head. Use Pierce and Pride to Stagger and break it, then attack during the all-Part Stagger.
messages.戦いたくないのに戦闘になる: The event starts a battle you wanted to avoid
messages.最初と2回目は走る、3回目で走らないを選ぶ。途中で止まるか3回目も走ると、全員H: Choose Run. the first and second times, then Don't run. the third time. Stopping earlier or running a third time deals 15 HP damage to everyone and starts the battle.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみへ勝ち、敵の拭えぬ哀しみを3以上にする。終了時の判定から翌ターンに: Beat “Overflowing Sorrow” to raise the enemy's Unresolved Sorrow to at least 3. Its Turn End check reveals the Head next turn; it is not available from the start.
messages.頭が現れてから押し切られる: The Head overwhelms you after appearing
messages.頭の攻撃は最大18・20。出現前に強い手と資源を残し、頭へ貫通・傲慢を集めて混乱: The Head's attacks roll up to 18 and 20. Save strong skills and resources before it appears, then focus Pierce and Pride to Stagger and break it.
messages.打撃・憂鬱・怠惰で削る。各スロットの加重値は2。: Use Blunt, Gloom, and Sloth damage. Each slot has a weight of 2.
messages.胴体は破壊できない。頭の出現条件を先に作る。: The Body cannot be broken. Meet the Head's appearance condition first.
messages.貫通・傲慢が有効。胴体とは耐性が違う。: Pierce and Pride are effective. Resistances differ from the Body's.
messages.破壊したターンは追撃できるが、終了時にスロットが消え、以降は追撃できない。: You can keep attacking it on the turn it breaks, but its slots disappear at Turn End, preventing further attacks.
messages.頭の混乱・破壊は翌ターンの全体混乱へつながる。: Staggering or breaking the Head leads to all-Part Stagger next turn.
messages.戦うか、回復して通過するかを選ぶ: Choose between fighting and passing through with recovery
messages.走る、走る、走らないの順なら戦闘を避け、全員HP・精神力20回復と冷めた涙を得る: Choosing Run., Run., then Don't run. avoids combat, restores 20 HP and SP to every Sinner, and grants Cooled Tear. Choose this to preserve your team for later fights.
messages.最初か2回目で走らない、または3回目も走ると、全員HP15ダメージと戦闘になる。: Choosing Don't run. on the first or second choice, or Run. on the third, deals 15 HP damage to every Sinner and starts combat. Victory grants Hot Tears.
messages.冷めた涙は被ダメージ時に次ターンの保護1、熱い涙は憤怒の被ダメージ−10%と、被: Cooled Tear grants 1 Protection next turn when hit. Hot Tears reduces Wrath damage taken by 10% and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn when hit. Each Sinner's on-damage effect activates once per turn.
messages.戦闘開始〜頭出現前: Battle start / before the Head appears
messages.事前のHP15ダメージを考慮し、勝てない突進を耐性と守備で受ける。火傷の多い囚人: Account for the initial 15 HP damage. Use resistances and Defense Skills against charges you cannot beat, and keep “Pin Down” away from Sinners with heavy Burn.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみは基本範囲7〜11で、敵のほかの攻撃より勝ちやすい。優先してマッチ: “Overflowing Sorrow”'s base range is 7–11, making it easier to beat than the other attacks. Prioritize its Clash to prevent SP loss and a raised Stagger Threshold.
messages.勝つたび拭えぬ哀しみ1が増える。弱体化は次のターン開始時、頭は数値3以上で終えた: Each win adds 1 Unresolved Sorrow. Weakening starts at the next Turn Start; the Head appears the turn after ending with at least 3 stacks. Do not assume the remaining attacks that same turn are already weakened.
messages.頭出現後〜決着: After the Head appears / finishing the fight
messages.頭を混乱・破壊して本体を削る: Stagger and break the Head, then finish the Bull
messages.頭には貫通・傲慢を集中する。HP179・防御Lv29で、胴体より壊しやすい。頭の: Focus Pierce and Pride on the Head. With 179 HP and Defense Level 29, it is easier to break than the Body. Also save answers to its maximum rolls of 18 and 20.
messages.頭が混乱すると翌ターンに全部位が混乱する。破壊するとさらに以後の攻撃威力減少3が: Staggering the Head Staggers all Parts next turn. Breaking it also grants lasting 3 Attack Power Down, so focus damage to break it.
messages.破壊したターンの追撃を使い、終了後は胴体へ攻撃を戻す。毎ターン頭を追撃できる前提: Use follow-up attacks on the breaking turn, then return to the Body afterward. The Head does not remain targetable every turn; finish the fight during the all-Part Stagger opening.
messages.最大14の打撃。マッチに勝てない場合は耐性と守備で受け、溢れ出る哀しみを止める手: A Blunt attack that rolls up to 14. If you cannot win, use resistances and a Defense Skill while saving an answer to “Overflowing Sorrow”. The second Coin's Burn requires Heads Hit.
messages.火傷回数を3増やす。火傷の多い低HPの囚人へ通さず、勝てる手や回避で的中を抑える: Increases Burn Count by 3. Keep it away from low-HP Sinners with heavy Burn, and prevent hits with winning skills or Evade.
messages.最大17。的中で混乱区間を前進させるため、HPだけでなく混乱までの余裕も確認する: Rolls up to 17. Hits raise the Stagger Threshold, so check Stagger margin as well as HP. Burn on Coins 2 and 3 requires Heads Hit.
messages.優先して勝つ。敵のマッチ敗北で拭えぬ哀しみ1が増え、次ターンの弱体化と頭の出現へ: Prioritize winning. The enemy's Clash loss adds 1 Unresolved Sorrow, leading to next-turn weakening and the Head appearing. Also prevents the hit's 15 SP loss and raised Stagger Threshold.
messages.最大18。敵のマッチ勝利で翌ターンのクイック・攻撃威力増加1が付く。強い手で止め: Rolls up to 18. An enemy Clash win grants Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Stop it with a strong skill, or arrange earlier damage to Stagger or break the Head.
messages.最大20の2枚攻撃。頭へ集中する火力を残しつつ、高威力E.G.Oなどで止める。的: A 2-Coin attack that rolls up to 20. Stop it with powerful E.G.O while saving damage for the Head. Hits apply next-turn disruption; Heads Hits also add Sinking.
messages.次のターンに全部位が混乱する。以降、戦闘中は全部位が攻撃威力減少3を得る。: All Parts become Staggered next turn. All Parts then gain 3 Attack Power Down for the rest of the battle.
messages.頭を壊し、全体混乱と弱体化を利用する。: Break the Head to exploit the all-Part Stagger and debuff.
messages.終了時に拭えぬ哀しみ3以上: At least 3 Unresolved Sorrow at Turn End
messages.次のターンに頭が生成され、行動パターンが変わる。: The Head appears next turn and the action pattern changes.
messages.頭出現の前に強いマッチと破壊用の火力を残す。: Save strong Clashing skills and breaking damage before the Head appears.
messages.終了時に拭えぬ哀しみ3以上、かつ頭が破壊済み: At least 3 Unresolved Sorrow at Turn End, with the Head already broken
messages.頭を毎ターン出し直す効果とは扱わず、破壊後は本体の混乱を攻める。: This does not recreate the Head every turn. After breaking it, attack during the Bull's Stagger.
messages.次のターンに全部位が混乱する。: All Parts become Staggered next turn.
messages.頭への集中攻撃を全体の攻撃機会へつなぐ。: Turn focused Head damage into an opening to attack all Parts.
messages.溢れ出る哀しみのマッチ敗北で敵が得る。開始時に数値分の攻撃威力減少、終了時に3以: The enemy gains this after losing a Clash with “Overflowing Sorrow”. At Turn Start, gain Attack Power Down equal to its value. At Turn End, if at least 3, change to Expanding Sorrow.
messages.この技に勝ち続け、敵の弱体化と頭の出現を狙う。: Keep beating this skill to weaken the enemy and reveal the Head.
messages.使用スキルのパターンが切り替わる。頭出現後は強い頭の攻撃が加わる。: Changes the skill pattern. Strong Head attacks join the pattern once the Head appears.
messages.頭用の高威力マッチを用意し、混乱・破壊を急ぐ。: Prepare high-power Clashes for the Head and aim to Stagger and break it quickly.
messages.付与された囚人を同じマッチ担当に固定せず、次ターンの予測を見直す。: Recheck next turn's predictions instead of keeping affected Sinners assigned to the same Clashes.
messages.任意イベント戦であり、ダンジョン突破のために必ず戦う必要はない。: This optional event battle is not required to clear the dungeon.
messages.4-6とは敵レベル・胴体HP・防御レベルが異なる。: Enemy Level, Body HP, and Defense Level differ from 4-6.
messages.胴体には打撃・憂鬱、頭には貫通・傲慢が有効。頭出現後は火力の担当を替える。: Blunt and Gloom work against the Body; Pierce and Pride work against the Head. Reassign attackers after the Head appears.
messages.頭破壊後の追撃はそのターン限り。次のターンには胴体へ戻す。: The broken Head remains targetable only for the rest of that turn. Return to the Body next turn.
messages.主力Lv33・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にし、イベントで失うHP15を考慮する。: Aim for Level 33 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, accounting for the event's 15 HP damage.
messages.頭の技を止める高威力E.G.Oと、貫通・傲慢の火力を用意する。: Prepare powerful E.G.O to stop the Head's skills, along with Pierce and Pride damage.
messages.回避して回復と冷めた涙を得る選択もあるため、ダンジョン全体のHP・資源から判断す: You can also avoid combat to recover and gain Cooled Tear. Decide based on HP and resources across the whole dungeon.
messages.拭えぬ哀しみを増やし、敵の弱体化と頭の出現を進める。: Build Unresolved Sorrow to weaken the enemy and reveal the Head.
messages.頭への貫通・傲慢火力: Pierce / Pride damage for the Head
messages.頭を混乱・破壊し、全体混乱につなぐ。: Stagger and break the Head to trigger all-Part Stagger.
messages.イベントのHP減少と火傷の消耗を抑える。: Limit attrition from the event's HP loss and Burn.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 ドンラン・開花E.G.O::舎音の攻略｜Limbus As: 4-54 Dongrang / Effloresced E.G.O::Farmwatch Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「ドンラン・開花E.G.O::舎: Dongrang / Effloresced E.G.O::Farmwatch guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Handle the trees differently in each battle. Against Dongrang, Who Denies All, reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP and let him defeat them. Against Farmwatch, defeat Trees of Desires to reduce Protection and Seeds.
messages.4-54「The League of Nine in Memory: Final: 4-54 · The League of Nine in Memory: Final 2 Battles
messages.木の扱いは戦闘ごとに変わる。全てを否定するドンランでは虚栄の木をHP1にして敵に: Handle the trees differently in each battle. Against Dongrang, Who Denies All, reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP and let him defeat them. Against Farmwatch, defeat Trees of Desires to reduce Protection and Seeds.
messages.4章ダンジョン終盤の別々の2戦を1ページで案内する。前の戦闘は3形態、次は開花E: This page covers 2 separate fights at the end of the Canto IV dungeon. The first has 3 forms; the second is Effloresced E.G.O::Farmwatch. These are separate from Mirror Dungeon versions. Overall and Part HP are listed separately where they differ.
messages.全てを否定するドンランは3形態、舎音はHPに応じて使用スキルが変わる。吸収する木: Dongrang, Who Denies All has 3 forms; Farmwatch changes skills according to HP. Absorbing Trees do not act. Source descriptions differ on details such as tree respawn counts, so check actual enemy placement and statuses too.
messages.前の戦闘の虚栄の木は、囚人でHP1にしてからドンランに倒させる。4体分の空虚さで: In the first fight, reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP with your Sinners, then let Dongrang defeat them. Aim to Stagger him through Emptiness from all 4 trees.
messages.舎音の欲望の木は早めに倒す。木が残るほど本体の保護と攻撃が強まり、種で味方の手数: Defeat Farmwatch's Trees of Desires early. Surviving trees strengthen his Protection and damage, while Seeds can reduce your available actions.
messages.最大23・27の広域に勝てるE.G.Oを残す。HP境界のイベントで止まる分も考え: Save E.G.O that can beat area attacks rolling up to 23 and 27. Allocate damage around the HP boundaries where events halt further HP loss.
messages.虚栄の木がHP1から倒せない: You cannot finish Trees of Vanity at 1 HP
messages.前の戦闘では正常な挙動。囚人がHP1へ削った後、ドンランの木への攻撃を通すと、回: This is intended in the first fight. After your Sinners reduce a tree to 1 HP, let Dongrang's attack hit it to cause self-damage and debuffs instead of healing him.
messages.木を放置したら本体が硬くなった: Leaving trees alive makes Dongrang harder to damage
messages.生きた木が本体へ保護などを与えている。舎音では木を倒し、前の戦闘では虚栄の木を弱: Living trees grant Protection and other buffs. Against Farmwatch, defeat the trees. In the earlier fight, weaken Trees of Vanity and let Dongrang finish them.
messages.囚人が木に閉じ込められて動けない: A Sinner is trapped in a tree and cannot act
messages.舎音が付ける種が5に達したため。混乱していない囚人が2ターン養分吸収状態になる。: Farmwatch's Seeds have reached 5. A Sinner who is not Staggered enters Nutrient Absorption for 2 turns. Prevent repeated “Dissemination”, “Facilitate”, and “Overgrowth” hits on allies carrying Seeds.
messages.HPが途中から減らなくなった: HP stops decreasing partway through the fight
messages.前の戦闘は形態移行の下限、舎音はHP85%・50%のイベントがある。そのターンに: The first fight has form-transition HP limits; Farmwatch has events at 85% and 50% HP. Save some damage for the next stage's trees and major skills instead of spending everything that turn.
messages.胴体HP0で段階移行／空虚さ4でも混乱: Form transition at 0 Body HP / also Staggers at 4 Emptiness
messages.胴体HP0のターン終了時に姿とスキルが変化し、部位HPを回復して混乱も解除する。: At Turn End with 0 Body HP, his appearance and skills change, Part HP recovers, and Stagger is removed. Overall HP cannot fall below 931 until the second form ends.
messages.最初の形態は行動周期の4ターン目に混乱する。: The first form Staggers on turn 4 of its action cycle.
messages.虚栄の木4体が出現。囚人では倒せずHP1で止まるので、先に弱らせてから敵の攻撃で: 4 Trees of Vanity appear. Sinners cannot defeat them; their HP stops at 1. Weaken them first, then let enemy attacks finish them.
messages.味方も攻撃し、スキルを使うたび最大HP2%分の自傷。加重値7の大技へ備える。: Also attacks allies and loses 2% of Max HP each time he uses a skill. Prepare for the 7-Attack-Weight major skill.
messages.95（囚人の攻撃では1まで）: 95 (Sinner attacks can only reduce it to 1)
messages.第2形態で4体。切なる成果・輝く虚栄を持ち、ドンランの攻撃だけで討伐できる。: 4 appear in the second form. They have Earnest Accomplishment and Radiant Vanity, and only Dongrang can defeat them.
messages.先に囚人がHP1にすると空虚な栄誉へ変化。ドンランに倒させたときの効果が回復・強: Reducing one to 1 HP with a Sinner first grants Empty Honor. When Dongrang defeats it, the result changes from healing and buffs to self-damage and debuffs.
messages.第3形態で出現。こちらは囚人で討伐でき、倒した囚人が回復と強化を得る。: Appears in the third form. Sinners can defeat this tree, and the Sinner who does gains healing and buffs.
messages.前の虚栄の木と同じくHP1で放置する必要はない。ドンランに取られる前に倒したい。: Unlike earlier Trees of Vanity, it need not be left at 1 HP. Defeat it before Dongrang takes it.
messages.養分になってください3回使用の次ターン: The turn after using “Please Be My Nutrient” 3 times
messages.HP85%・50%（1780・1047）でそのターンの本体HP減少が止まり、イベ: At 85% and 50% HP (1780 and 1047), overall HP stops decreasing for the turn, triggering events and action changes.
messages.精神力は持つが、コインの表裏は精神力によらず各50%。精神力を下げるだけで裏面ば: He has SP, but Heads/Tails odds remain 50% each regardless of it. Lowering SP does not make him consistently roll Tails.
messages.本体HPと胴体HPを資料通り併記。イベントで止まったHPへ大技を重ねすぎない。: Overall and Body HP are listed separately as given in the source. Avoid wasting major attacks when an event has halted HP loss.
messages.開幕4体。生存中は本体にダメージ量増加・保護を与え、自身も種を付ける。: Starts with 4. While alive, they grant Dongrang Damage Up and Protection, and also inflict Seeds themselves.
messages.HP境界で追加される。パッシブは2体ずつ、攻略欄は1回目3本・2回目2本と記述が: More appear at HP boundaries. The passive lists 2 each time, while the strategy description lists 3 on the first occasion and 2 on the second. Check the actual count before assigning attacks.
messages.種5で、混乱していない囚人を閉じ込めて出現。囚人は2ターン行動できず、本体に養分: Appears when 5 Seeds trap a Sinner who is not Staggered. The Sinner cannot act for 2 turns and provides nutrients to Dongrang.
messages.欲望の木と合わせ最大6体。拘束された囚人の復帰タイミングは状態欄を確認し、木の撃: A maximum of 6 combined with Trees of Desires. Check the trapped Sinner's status for their return timing; do not assume defeating the tree immediately frees them.
messages.7人の主力と、広域を止める資源を用意する: Prepare 7 main units and resources to stop area attacks
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、ダンジョン内でHP・精神力・E.G.O資源を整: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Prepare HP, SP, and E.G.O resources within the dungeon. Pierce works well against both bosses.
messages.最大23・27の広域へ勝てるE.G.Oを確認する。表面が出る前提だけでなく、精神: Check E.G.O that can beat maximum rolls of 23 and 27. Consider SP and Clash predictions rather than relying only on rolling Heads.
messages.このページは別々の2戦を扱う。前のドンランを倒した後も舎音との戦闘があるので、次: This page covers 2 separate battles. Farmwatch follows the earlier Dongrang fight, so check your next battle's team and healing after defeating him.
messages.印の対象を守り、混乱の周期で攻める: Protect marked targets and attack during the Stagger cycle
messages.あなたもがらんどうですねの使用で次ターンの印が付く。印付きは狙われやすく、束縛と: “You're Empty As Well” applies a mark for next turn [On Use]. Marked Sinners are targeted more often, receive Bind, and take extra damage, so redirect Clashes with faster allies.
messages.間引くの的中は回復と強化につながる。勝つと敵へ次ターン脆弱が付くので、勝てる主力: “Thinning” heals and buffs Dongrang on hit. Winning the Clash gives him Fragile next turn, so assign a main unit who can win.
messages.4ターン目の混乱中に攻める。胴体HP0のターン終了で姿が変わり、部位HPと混乱が: Attack during turn 4's Stagger. At Turn End with 0 Body HP, the form changes, Part HP recovers, and Stagger is removed. Do not assume Stagger carries into the next form.
messages.虚栄の木をHP1にしてから倒させる: Reduce Trees of Vanity to 1 HP before letting him defeat them
messages.虚栄の木4体が出たら、ドンランから木へ向かう攻撃線を見る。囚人の攻撃が先に入る順: When 4 Trees of Vanity appear, check Dongrang's targeting lines to the trees. Arrange for Sinner attacks to reduce those trees to 1 HP before his attacks resolve.
messages.囚人は木を倒せない。HP1にすると空虚な栄誉へ変わるので、その後はドンランの木へ: Sinners cannot defeat these trees. Reaching 1 HP grants Empty Honor; afterward, let Dongrang's attack hit the tree. If he defeats it before that setup, he gains healing and buffs.
messages.準備した木を敵に倒させると、敵がHPを失い空虚さを得て弱体化する。空虚さ4で混乱: Defeating prepared trees makes him lose HP, gain Emptiness, and suffer debuffs. At 4 Emptiness, you can trigger Stagger.
messages.木がなくなるとがらんどうになっちゃったへ変化する。弱いマッチへ勝ちながら本体を削: When the trees are gone, he switches to “It's All Empty”. Win these easier Clashes while reducing his HP and advancing to the next form.
messages.しこりの成った木は囚人で先に倒す: Have Sinners defeat Resentful Trees first
messages.しこりの成った木はHP35で、囚人が倒せる。倒した側が最大HP5%回復と次ターン: Resentful Trees have 35 HP and can be defeated by Sinners. The killer recovers 5% of Max HP and gains Haste and Attack Power Up next turn, so assign a Sinner who needs healing or those benefits.
messages.全部燃えちゃったは最大23・加重値7。強いE.G.Oを合わせ、もう遅いよの脆弱5: “It's All Burned Up” rolls up to 23 with 7 Attack Weight. Answer it with a strong E.G.O, and also prevent “It's Too Late Now”'s 5 Fragile.
messages.第3形態はスキル使用ごとに自傷するが、放置して安全に終わるわけではない。マッチを: The third form damages itself with each skill use, but leaving it alone is not a safe way to win. Stop its attacks through Clashes while finishing it.
messages.欲望の木を減らし、種の蓄積を止める: Reduce Trees of Desires and prevent Seeds buildup
messages.開幕は本体と欲望の木4体。木1体ごとに本体へ保護とダメージ量増加が付くため、広域: The fight starts with Dongrang and 4 Trees of Desires. Each tree grants Protection and Damage Up, so remove them early using area E.G.O or spare actions.
messages.本体の播種・促進と木の育ちゆく成果へマッチし、種をためない。種5未満は終了時に1: Clash with “Dissemination”, “Facilitate”, and the trees' “Growing Results” to limit Seeds. Below 5, Seeds decrease by 1 at Turn End, so preventing repeated hits on vulnerable Sinners matters.
messages.種5で吸収する木へ囚われると、2ターン行動不能になり本体が回復する。過剰成長の回: At 5 Seeds, an Absorbing Tree traps the Sinner for 2 turns and heals Dongrang. Avoid taking “Overgrowth” intentionally for its healing.
messages.イベント後の木を確認し、収穫を止める: Check trees after the event and stop the harvest
messages.HP85%付近（1780）で本体HPの減少が止まりイベント。追加された木の数と配: At about 85% HP (1780), HP loss stops and an event occurs. Check the added trees' number and placement, then reduce his Protection.
messages.収穫の時間は最大19。弱い通常スキルで無理に受けず、勝てる主力やE.G.Oを使う: “Time of Harvest” rolls up to 19. Use a winning main unit or E.G.O rather than forcing a weak regular skill into the Clash.
messages.HP50%付近（1047）でもイベントと行動変化がある。境界を越えられないターン: Another event and action change occur at about 50% HP (1047). Avoid spending too many major attacks on Dongrang alone during a turn when HP cannot cross the boundary.
messages.大技へ備え、木と本体への火力を配分する: Prepare for major skills and divide damage between trees and Dongrang
messages.養分になってくださいは最大27・加重値7。表示を確認して高威力E.G.Oで止める: “Please Be My Nutrient” rolls up to 27 with 7 Attack Weight. Check the prediction and stop it with powerful E.G.O. Tree healing and creation apply [On Use], even if you win the Clash.
messages.大技を3回使用すると次ターンに敵が混乱する。狙える攻撃機会だが、わざと危険な戦闘: After using the major skill 3 times, he Staggers next turn. Use this opening if it occurs, but there is no need to deliberately prolong a dangerous fight.
messages.欲望の木と吸収する木が残ると強化と回復が続く。種を防ぎつつ木を減らし、保護が薄く: Trees of Desires and Absorbing Trees sustain buffs and healing while alive. Prevent Seeds, reduce the trees, then focus Pierce, Gluttony, Pride, or other effective damage on Dongrang once his Protection falls.
messages.[使用時]次のターンにがらんどうの証を付与: [On Use] Inflict Empty Mark next turn.
messages.使用時に次ターンの印が付く。マッチに勝っても印は残るので、印付きの囚人を次ターン: Applies next turn's mark [On Use]. Winning the Clash does not remove it, so prepare to protect the marked Sinner next turn.
messages.破裂の威力と回数を両方増やす。印付きの主力へ的中を重ねさせず、勝てるマッチで止め: Increases both Rupture Potency and Count. Prevent repeated hits on marked main units by winning its Clash.
messages.がらんどうの印の対象へのダメージ補正あり。資料では「50%」の増減記号が欠けてい: Has a damage modifier against targets with Empty Mark. The source omits the increase/decrease sign for 50%, so check the in-battle effect description.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]ダメージ量だけ体力を回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal HP equal to damage dealt.
messages.対象にがらんどうの印があれば、次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る: If the target has Empty Mark, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]ダメージ量だけ体力を回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal HP equal to damage dealt.
messages.的中すると敵が回復し、印の対象からは強化も得る。マッチで勝つと敵に次ターン脆弱が: Hits heal the enemy and grant buffs against marked targets. Winning the Clash gives him Fragile next turn, also creating an opening to attack.
messages.加重値3の広域。出血10を複数人へ通さないよう、強いスキルやE.G.Oで勝とう。: An area attack with 3 Attack Weight. Win using a strong skill or E.G.O to prevent 10 Bleed from hitting multiple Sinners.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血3を付与。ダメージ量の25%分、体力を回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. Heal HP equal to 25% of damage dealt.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血3を付与。ダメージ量の25％分、体力を回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. Heal HP equal to 25% of damage dealt.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象のランダムなプラス効果を吸収し、次のターンに得る: Ⅲ[On Hit] Absorb a random positive effect from the target and gain it next turn.
messages.木を攻撃する行動。対象の虚栄の木を先に囚人でHP1へ削り、空虚な栄誉を付けてから: An action that attacks trees. First use Sinners to reduce the targeted Tree of Vanity to 1 HP and grant Empty Honor, then let Dongrang finish it. Check action order and targeting lines.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象のランダムなプラス効果を吸収し、次のターンに得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Absorb a random positive effect from the target and gain it next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血回数が5増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 5.
messages.ランダムな対象への攻撃なので、囚人と木のどちらを狙っているかを見る。虚栄の木なら: Attacks a random target, so check whether it is aimed at a Sinner or tree. Reduce a Tree of Vanity to 1 HP first; have Sinners defeat a Resentful Tree first instead.
messages.虚栄の木がなくなると使う弱い攻撃。マッチ勝利で敵へ破裂も付くので、この間に本体を: A weak attack used after Trees of Vanity are gone. Winning also applies Rupture to the enemy, so use this time to reduce his HP.
messages.脆弱5の的中を通すと続く広域が危険になる。早い攻撃順で止め、全体攻撃への備えも残: A hit applying 5 Fragile makes the following area attack dangerous. Stop this early in the action order while saving an answer to the area attack.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]脆弱2、破裂5、出血5を付与。ダメージ量の10%分、体力を回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile, 5 Rupture, and 5 Bleed. Heal HP equal to 10% of damage dealt.
messages.加重値7・最大23の広域。手持ちの高威力E.G.Oを優先して合わせる。しこりの成: An area attack with 7 Attack Weight and a maximum roll of 23. Prioritize answering it with powerful E.G.O. Also use the buffs Sinners gain from defeating Resentful Trees.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに束縛1、麻痺1を付与: Ⅰ[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[表面的中時]次のターンに束縛1、麻痺1を付与: Ⅱ[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.表面的中で束縛・麻痺が重なる。次ターンのマッチ担当を守るため、2枚とも止めたい。: Heads Hits stack Bind and Paralyze. Stop both Coins to protect next turn's Clash specialists.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに脆弱1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに種3を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Seeds next turn.
messages.最後のコインで次ターンの種3。種がたまった囚人には特に通さず、拘束による手数不足: The final Coin inflicts 3 Seeds next turn. Keep it away from Sinners already carrying Seeds to avoid losing actions to capture.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]種1を付与。対象に種がある場合、種を追加で1付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Seeds. If the target has Seeds, inflict 1 additional Seeds.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]種1を付与。対象に種がある場合、種を追加で1付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Seeds. If the target has Seeds, inflict 1 additional Seeds.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]種1を付与。対象に種がある場合、追加で1付与*2: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Seeds. If the target has Seeds, inflict 1 additional Seeds. (Source footnote 2.)
messages.種がある対象には追加で種が付く。種5の拘束に近い味方から対象を替え、マッチで止め: Applies additional Seeds to targets already carrying them. Redirect away from allies approaching capture at 5 Seeds, and stop it with a Clash.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]種3、過剰回復を付与。対象の体力を15回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Seeds and Overheal. Heal the target by 15 HP.
messages.回復してくれる攻撃に見えるが、種3と過剰回復を付ける。わざと受けて回復しようとし: It may look like a healing attack, but also applies 3 Seeds and Overheal. Avoid taking it intentionally for recovery.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]脆弱3、出血10を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Fragile and 10 Bleed.
messages.対象が養分吸収状態の時、体力を20回復して次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る*3: If the target is in Nutrient Absorption, heal 20 HP and gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn. (Source footnote 3.)
messages.養分吸収時の回復と攻撃威力増加は、対象と使用者の表記に曖昧さがあるため戦闘中の表: The wording is ambiguous about who receives the Nutrient Absorption healing and Attack Power Up; check the in-battle display.
messages.基本でも最大19と高い。囚われた味方を狙われる前に吸収する木のHPと解除条件を確: Even without extra modifiers, it rolls up to 19. Check the Absorbing Tree's HP and release conditions before it targets a trapped ally, and stop it with a winning skill. Winning also reduces the enemy's SP.
messages.[使用時]全ての欲望の木の体力を15回復。欲望の木が無い場合は1つ生成。: [On Use] Heal all Trees of Desires by 15 HP. If none exist, create 1.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]体力を10回復、種を3付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal 10 HP and inflict 3 Seeds.
messages.最大27・加重値7の大技。高威力E.G.Oを残して合わせる。使用時の木の回復・生: A major skill rolling up to 27 with 7 Attack Weight. Save powerful E.G.O to answer it. Winning the Clash does not prevent its [On Use] tree healing or creation.
messages.木の攻撃も種を増やす。本体だけにマッチを集めず、木の早期撃破や広域で敵の手数を減: Tree attacks also build Seeds. Do not assign all Clashes to Dongrang; defeat trees early or use area attacks to reduce enemy actions.
messages.防御中に攻撃を集中するか、本体の危険な攻撃へ対処するかを選ぶ。木を残すと保護とダ: Choose between focusing attacks on the defending tree and handling Dongrang's dangerous attacks. Surviving trees keep granting Protection and damage buffs.
messages.回復につながる的中や未処理の木を放置せず、回復される前に対処する。: Handle healing-triggering attacks and surviving trees before they restore his HP.
messages.敵味方を識別せず攻撃し、使用ごとに最大HP2%を失う。: Attacks indiscriminately and loses 2% of Max HP with each skill use.
messages.味方の木も狙う。しこりの成った木は囚人で先に倒して強化を取る。: Also targets allied trees. Have Sinners defeat Resentful Trees first to claim their buffs.
messages.木が生存している開始時: Turn Start while the tree is alive
messages.ドンランに保護1・攻撃威力増加1。: Dongrang gains 1 Protection and 1 Attack Power Up.
messages.木を弱らせて敵に倒させ、強化の供給を止める。: Weaken the tree and let Dongrang defeat it to stop the supply of buffs.
messages.ドンランのみ討伐可能。囚人がHP1にすると囚人を回復して空虚な栄誉を得る。その準: Only Dongrang can defeat it. If a Sinner reduces it to 1 HP, it heals that Sinner and gains Empty Honor. If Dongrang defeats it without that setup, he heals and gains buffs next turn.
messages.木への攻撃順を確認し、囚人が先にHP1へ削る。: Check attack order so Sinners reduce the tree to 1 HP first.
messages.囚人がHP1にした木をドンランが討伐: Dongrang defeats a tree reduced to 1 HP by a Sinner
messages.ドンランがHPを失い空虚さ1、次ターン弱体化。: Dongrang loses HP, gains 1 Emptiness, and suffers debuffs next turn.
messages.木を倒せないこと自体が仕組み。準備できた木への敵の攻撃は通す。: Sinners being unable to defeat the tree is part of the mechanic. Let enemy attacks hit prepared trees.
messages.倒した対象が最大HP5%回復、次ターンにクイック1・攻撃威力増加1。: The killer heals 5% of Max HP and gains 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.虚栄の木と違い、囚人で倒してよい。敵より先に取る。: Unlike Trees of Vanity, Sinners can defeat these. Take them before Dongrang does.
messages.欲望の木2体を生成し行動パターンが変わる（パッシブ欄の値）。: Creates 2 Trees of Desires and changes the action pattern (the count listed in the passive).
messages.資料の攻略欄と出現数に差があるので、再出現した実数を確認して処理する。: The strategy description lists different counts, so check the actual respawned trees and deal with them.
messages.収穫の時間でマッチ敗北: Loses a Clash with “Time of Harvest”
messages.勝つと精神力も下げられるが、通常コイン確率は各50%で固定されている点に注意。: Winning also reduces his SP, but normal Coin odds remain fixed at 50% each.
messages.ターン開始時に保護2を得て精神力0へ戻る。: At Turn Start, gain 2 Protection and return to 0 SP.
messages.精神力を下げ続けるだけで無力化できない。木の保護と実際の耐久も確認する。: Continually lowering SP alone cannot disable him. Check tree-granted Protection and his actual durability too.
messages.自然な攻撃機会として使うが、最大27の広域を何度も受ける前提で編成しない。: Use it as an opening when it occurs, but do not build a team around repeatedly taking the maximum-27 area attack.
messages.パニックを変える効果: An effect that changes Panic Type
messages.種類を変更せず、精神力のない対象へ適用される効果を受ける。: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.別のパニックへ上書きする攻略は前提にしない。: Do not base your strategy on overriding his Panic with another type.
messages.この木が生存している開始時: Turn Start while this tree is alive
messages.ドンランがダメージ量増加1・保護1を得る。: Dongrang gains 1 Damage Up and 1 Protection.
messages.本体が硬いときは残っている木を確認。木を減らしてから火力を集める。: If Dongrang is hard to damage, check the remaining trees. Reduce them before focusing damage on him.
messages.敵に狙われ、開始時に束縛2。ドンランからの被ダメージ+50%。スキル欄ではがらん: Prioritized by enemy attacks. At Combat Start, gain 2 Bind; take +50% damage from Dongrang. The Japanese skill text also uses an alternate wording for this mark.
messages.付いた次ターンの攻撃線を見て、速い囚人で守る。: Check targeting lines next turn and protect the marked Sinner with faster allies.
messages.準備した虚栄の木を敵が倒すと増え、4でドンランが混乱する。: Increases when the enemy defeats prepared Trees of Vanity. At 4, Dongrang becomes Staggered.
messages.囚人が先に木をHP1へ削る手順を繰り返す。: Repeat the process of reducing trees to 1 HP with Sinners first.
messages.終了時に5以上なら、混乱していない囚人を2ターンの養分吸収状態にする。5未満なら: At Turn End, if at 5 or more, place a Sinner who is not Staggered into Nutrient Absorption for 2 turns. If below 5, reduce the value by 1.
messages.すでに種がある味方への的中を優先して防ぐ。: Prioritize preventing hits on allies who already carry Seeds.
messages.囚人が行動できず、毎ターン終了時にドンランのHP10回復。: The Sinner cannot act, and Dongrang heals 10 HP at every Turn End.
messages.付いてからより、種をためないマッチ配分で予防する。: Prevent the status by assigning Clashes to avoid Seeds buildup rather than waiting until capture occurs.
messages.ドンランが回復させた量を蓄積。50以上でその数値分の暴食ダメージと次ターン脆弱5: Accumulates the amount Dongrang heals the target. At 50 or more, take that much Gluttony damage and gain 5 Fragile next turn, then remove the effect.
messages.敵の回復を安全な支援と考えず、過剰成長を止める。: Do not treat the enemy's healing as safe support; stop “Overgrowth”.
messages.虚栄の木・しこりの成った木・欲望の木は同じ処理ではない。虚栄はHP1にして敵へ、: Trees of Vanity, Resentful Trees, and Trees of Desires require different handling. Reduce Vanity to 1 HP and let the enemy finish it; have Sinners defeat Resentful Trees and Trees of Desires.
messages.舎音の精神力を下げても表面率は各50%のまま。精神力−45への対処と、コイン確率: Farmwatch's Heads odds remain 50% even when SP falls. Distinguish handling -45 SP from changing Coin probabilities.
messages.舎音のHP境界後の木の本数は資料内で差がある。固定本数だけを前提に攻撃を割り振ら: Source descriptions differ on the tree count after Farmwatch's HP boundaries. Do not assign attacks based only on a fixed count.
messages.吸収する木のHP22は掲載しているが、破壊した瞬間に拘束が解除されるかは資料だけ: Absorbing Trees are listed with 22 HP, but the source does not establish whether destroying one immediately releases the captive. Check the status display rather than assuming instant rescue.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上。ダンジョンの回復地点や資源の持ち越しを利用して最終戦へ: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Use dungeon healing points and carried-over resources to prepare for the final fights.
messages.貫通攻撃を軸に、前戦は憂鬱・嫉妬、舎音は暴食・傲慢など、その戦闘の弱点へ合わせる: Build around Pierce and adjust to each fight's weaknesses: Gloom/Envy for the first, Gluttony/Pride for Farmwatch. Do not assume their resistances are identical.
messages.木を減らす広域と、大技へマッチする高威力E.G.Oの資源を確保する。所持していな: Save resources for area attacks to clear trees and powerful E.G.O to Clash with major skills. If you lack area attacks, divide regular attacks to remove trees one at a time.
messages.本体のマッチを取った残りの手数で木を削る。攻撃順を調整しやすい速い囚人がいると扱: Use actions left after covering Dongrang's Clashes to damage trees. Faster Sinners help arrange the required action order.
messages.全部燃えちゃった・養分になってくださいの広域を止める。毎ターンの低威力攻撃に大技: Stop “It's All Burned Up” and “Please Be My Nutrient”. Avoid spending all major skills on routine low-power attacks.
messages.保護が減った本体へ火力を集め、種や破裂・出血による消耗を立て直す。: Focus damage once Dongrang's Protection falls, and recover from attrition caused by Seeds, Rupture, and Bleed.
messages.【リンバス】4-54 衝撃ムカデ（4章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistant: 4-54 Shock Centipede (Canto IV) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)4-54「衝撃ムカデ（4章）」の攻略。H: Shock Centipede (Canto IV) guide for Limbus Company 4-54. Self-charge keeps it alive at 1 HP. Damage the Body first, then beat “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” after the transition to exhaust its stacks. Breaking the Shield is a separate approach.
messages.4章ダンジョン2層の通常個体。9章、鉄道、鏡の強化個体とは別。本体HP1183・: The regular encounter on Floor 2 of the Canto IV dungeon, separate from enhanced Canto IX, Railway, and Mirror Dungeon versions. Overall HP is 1183, Head HP is 424, and Body HP is 739. The Head stops acting after breaking; the Body can still act.
messages.通常個体の9技。とぐろを巻くはスキル表では胴体、行動表では頭の技とされるため、頭: 9 regular skills. “Coil Up” is assigned to the Body in the skill table but the Head in the action table; it is listed under the Head here, so check the Shield's target. “Wrapping Coil”'s 1-Coin entry conflicts with an effect labeled Coin Ⅱ. Do not substitute enhanced versions' power or slot counts at 1 HP.
messages.胴体の混乱と本体HP1を目指す。開幕の頭バリアを割り切れないなら、胴体へ火力を集: Aim to Stagger the Body and reduce overall HP to 1. If you cannot fully break the opening Head Shield, focus damage on the Body.
messages.HP1になったら自家発電の数値を見る。蠢く頭・尾は使用時−2、こちらのマッチ勝利: At 1 HP, check Self-charge. “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” consume 2 [On Use] and another 3 when you win the Clash.
messages.とぐろの次のターンの広域へ、高威力技を残す。低HPの囚人と、前の的中で麻痺した囚: Save powerful skills for the area attack on the turn after “Coil Up”. Protect low-HP Sinners and those Paralyzed by earlier hits.
messages.HP1から何度殴っても倒れない: Repeated attacks cannot finish it at 1 HP
messages.自家発電が残る間はHP1に固定される。ダメージを追加するだけでなく、移行後の蠢く: Self-charge locks overall HP at 1 while stacks remain. Make it use “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” after the transition, and win those Clashes to consume stacks rather than simply adding more damage.
messages.ずっとマッチに勝っているのに発電が増える: Self-charge increases despite winning every Clash
messages.通常の噛みつき・尻尾は使用時+2、マッチ敗北時−1。勝っても差し引き増える。HP: The regular “Bite” and “Tail Poke” gain 2 [On Use] and consume 1 [Clash Lose]. Even when you win, the net result is an increase. These differ from the consumption skills used after reaching 1 HP.
messages.頭を殴っても本体が削れない: Attacking the Head does not reduce overall HP
messages.頭には現在HP分のバリアがある。割り切る火力がないなら、胴体の混乱と本体HP1を: The Head has a Shield equal to its current HP. If your damage cannot fully break it, prioritize Body Stagger and reaching 1 overall HP.
messages.HP1にした後の攻撃で主力が倒れる: Your main units fall to the attacks after reaching 1 HP
messages.移行後は低HPを優先して蠢く頭・尾が向く。速い囚人で引き取り、最大17へ勝てる技: After the transition, “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” prioritize low-HP targets. Redirect them with faster Sinners and save healing and skills that can beat a maximum roll of 17.
messages.現在の頭HP分のバリアを得る。開幕は頭HP424に相当するバリア。: Gains a Shield equal to current Head HP. The opening Shield corresponds to 424 Head HP.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能だが、頭の行動は止まる。頭を壊しても本体の自家発電によるHP1固: Remains targetable after breaking, but the Head stops acting. Breaking it may still leave Self-charge locking overall HP at 1.
messages.胴体への貫通が有効。頭のバリアを避け、混乱と本体HP1を狙う基本の攻撃先。: Weak to Pierce. The usual target for bypassing the Head's Shield, causing Stagger, and reaching 1 overall HP.
messages.破壊後も行動・追撃可能。HP1移行後も蠢く尾を使うため、そのマッチで発電を減らす: Can still act and be attacked after breaking. It continues using “Wriggling Tail” after reaching 1 HP; use that Clash to consume Self-charge.
messages.胴体への火力と、移行後の強いマッチをそろえる: Prepare Body damage and strong Clashes for after the transition
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名。胴体用の貫通、頭用の打撃、共通で通りやすい: Prepare 7 Sinners, aiming for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring Pierce for the Body, Blunt for the Head, and Gloom/Sloth damage effective against both.
messages.超高圧電気放出と、HP1後の蠢く尾へ勝てるE.G.Oを用意する。開幕だけで高威力: Prepare E.G.O that can beat “High-voltage Electric Discharge” and “Wriggling Tail” after reaching 1 HP. Do not spend all powerful skills in the opening.
messages.前の戦闘からHPと精神力を整える。移行後は低HPの囚人が優先されるため、回復と速: Prepare HP and SP in earlier fights. Low-HP Sinners are prioritized after the transition, so healing and a fast redirector help.
messages.バリアを割るか、胴体を削るか決める: Choose between breaking the Shield and damaging the Body
messages.とぐろを巻くと頭の現在HP分のバリアを得る。基本は胴体へ火力を集中し、バリアに手: “Coil Up” grants a Shield equal to current Head HP. The usual plan is to focus the Body for Stagger without losing actions to the Shield.
messages.頭のバリアを割り切れる火力があるなら、頭へ集中する別の方法もある。割ると発電を消: If you can fully break the Head Shield, focusing the Head is another option. Breaking it consumes Self-charge and Staggers all Parts next turn. Partially damaging the Shield does not trigger this effect.
messages.バリアがある時間に頭・胴体へ火力を半分ずつ分けると、どちらの目的も達成しにくい。: Splitting damage between the Head and Body while the Shield is active makes either goal harder to achieve. Choose one based on your current skills.
messages.広域へ勝ち、胴体の混乱を狙う: Beat the area attack and aim for Body Stagger
messages.超高圧電気放出は加重値5。自家発電が10を超えると被害が増えるため、強い技でマッ: “High-voltage Electric Discharge” has 5 Attack Weight. Damage increases above 10 Self-charge, so Clash with a strong skill and check secondary targets' HP.
messages.前の攻撃で麻痺を受けた囚人はコイン威力が出にくい。大技の担当を現在の状態で選び直: Sinners Paralyzed by earlier hits may fail to gain Coin Power. Reassign the major-attack Clash based on their current statuses.
messages.胴体の混乱を狙って火力をまとめ、本体をHP1へ追い込む。通常技に勝つだけでは発電: Focus damage to Stagger the Body and bring overall HP to 1. Winning regular Clashes does not keep reducing Self-charge; do not wait in the normal phase for it to reach zero.
messages.残る発電を、蠢く頭・尾への勝利で使い切らせる: Beat “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail” to exhaust remaining Self-charge
messages.初めて死を迎えると、そのターンの行動が全て止まり、自家発電が同数追加される。最大: On its first death, all actions that turn are canceled and Self-charge increases by its current amount. Up to 20 stacks can remain, so the battle continues at 1 HP.
messages.次の行動が蠢く頭・尾へ変わったら、低HPに向く攻撃を速い担当へ替え、勝てる通常技: When its skills change to “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail”, redirect low-HP-targeting attacks with faster Sinners and use winning regular skills or E.G.O. Each consumes 2 [On Use] and another 3 if you win, for 5 total per skill.
messages.頭を破壊済みだと頭の技は出ず、残る尾で発電を減らすことになる。必ず1ターンで終わ: If the Head is already broken, its skills do not appear, leaving the Tail to consume Self-charge. Do not assume the fight will end in 1 turn; survive until no stacks remain.
messages.火傷などターン境界のダメージでHP1へ移行すると、直ちに同じ行動へ切り替わらない: Reaching 1 HP through turn-boundary damage such as Burn may not immediately trigger the same action change. Check current skill names and Self-charge; win when the consumption skills appear.
messages.boss-copy:shock-centipede:skills.0.name: Bite
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.使用時に自家発電+2、こちらが勝つと敵の自家発電−1。勝利は的中と増加量を抑える: Gains 2 Self-charge [On Use] and loses 1 when you win the Clash. Winning prevents hits and limits the increase, but does not continually reduce its stacks on its own.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに束縛2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.
messages.出血と次ターンの束縛を防ぐためマッチする。使用時+2・敗北時−1なので、マッチ勝: Clash to prevent Bleed and next-turn Bind. Gaining 2 [On Use] and consuming 1 [Clash Lose] means Clash wins alone cannot reduce Self-charge to zero.
messages.資料は1コインだが束縛の効果番号がⅡとなっている。番号は未確定として掲載。: The source lists 1 Coin but labels the Bind effect Coin Ⅱ. Its Coin assignment is unconfirmed.
messages.脆弱を通すと後続の被害が増える。マッチ勝利で的中を防ぐ。資料は1枚技だが束縛にⅡ: Fragile increases subsequent damage, so win the Clash to prevent the hit. The source lists 1 Coin but labels Bind as Coin Ⅱ, leaving that effect's Coin assignment unconfirmed.
messages.対象に麻痺があればダメージ量+10%: Deal +10% damage if the target has Paralyze.
messages.使用時に自家発電が1増え、最後の的中で麻痺3。次のコイン頼みの技が弱くなるので、: Gains 1 Self-charge [On Use] and inflicts 3 Paralyze on the final hit. This weakens skills relying on Coin Power; avoid automatically assigning a Paralyzed Sinner to next turn's major Clash.
messages.3枚攻撃。麻痺のある対象にはダメージが増えるため、低HPや麻痺付きの囚人へ通さな: A 3-Coin attack that deals more damage to Paralyzed targets. Keep it away from low-HP or Paralyzed Sinners.
messages.保有している自家発電が10を超過しているなら、超過している分だけダメージ量+10: If Self-charge exceeds 10, deal +10% damage per excess stack.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象が蓄電状態のとき、最終ダメージ量の40%分固定ダメージを与える: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Capacitor, deal fixed damage equal to 40% of final damage.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]麻痺3、蓄電1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze and 1 Capacitor.
messages.加重値5。自家発電10超過でダメージが上がり、蓄電付きには追加の固定ダメージがあ: 5 Attack Weight. Damage increases above 10 Self-charge, with additional fixed damage against targets with Capacitor. Win using a powerful skill. The Self-charge consumption does not list a Clash outcome requirement.
messages.このスキルスロットがあるとき、現在の頭部の体力分バリアを得る。: While this skill slot is present, gain a Shield equal to the Head's current HP.
messages.現在の頭HP分のバリアを得る。バリアを割り切る作戦なら頭へ火力を集中し、割れない: Gains a Shield equal to current Head HP. Focus the Head if you plan to fully break it; otherwise, damage the Body to reach 1 overall HP. Offsetting alone does not count as removing the Shield.
messages.体力が最も低い敵を優先的に攻撃: Prioritize the enemy with the lowest HP.
messages.HP1移行後の技。使用時に発電−2、こちらが勝つとさらに−3で合計5減る。低HP: Used after reaching 1 HP. Consumes 2 Self-charge [On Use] and another 3 if you win, for 5 total. It targets low-HP Sinners, so check whether a faster ally can redirect it.
messages.HP1移行後の最大17。勝てるE.G.Oを合わせ、使用時−2とマッチ敗北時−3で: Used after reaching 1 HP, with a maximum roll of 17. Win using E.G.O to consume 2 Self-charge [On Use] plus 3 [Clash Lose], for 5 total. Avoid losing with a weak skill and letting the attack hit.
messages.死を迎えると該当するターンのスキルがすべてキャンセル。\n保有している自家発電の: On death, cancel all skills for that turn. Gain Self-charge equal to its current amount.
messages.そのターンの全行動が止まり、自家発電が同数追加される。HP1でも終わらない理由な: All actions that turn stop and Self-charge increases by its current amount. This is why the fight continues at 1 HP; prepare the next Clashes to consume its stacks.
messages.5ターンごとに頭部体力分のバリアを得る。: Every 5 turns, gain a Shield equal to Head HP.
messages.頭の現在HP分のバリアがある。頭への火力が本体削りへ直結しない時間があることを確: The Shield equals current Head HP. Be aware that damage to the Head may not directly reduce overall HP while it remains.
messages.とぐろを巻くを使用後、バリアを全て消耗するたびに自家発電を消耗。\n全部位が次の: After using “Coil Up”, fully depleting the Shield consumes Self-charge. All Parts become Staggered next turn.
messages.バリアを割り切ると発電を消費し、次ターンに全部位混乱。狙うなら頭へ火力を集中し、: Fully breaking the Shield consumes Self-charge and Staggers all Parts next turn. If pursuing this route, focus the Head rather than leaving the Shield only partially damaged.
messages.最大20。死を迎えた後も残っていれば、全て消費するまで本体HPを1に固定する。初: Maximum 20. If stacks remain after death, overall HP stays locked at 1 until all are consumed. The first transition adds stacks equal to the current amount.
messages.通常段階での増加を抑えつつ、HP1移行後の消費技へ勝って使い切らせる。: Limit buildup during the normal phase, then win against the consumption skills after reaching 1 HP to exhaust the remaining stacks.
messages.超高圧電気放出が参照する専用状態。付与されていると同技の的中時に最終ダメージの4: A unique status checked by “High-voltage Electric Discharge”. If present, its hit deals additional fixed damage equal to 40% of final damage.
messages.付与済みの囚人へ再び大技を通さず、担当と回復を確認する。: Keep the major attack away from Sinners already carrying it; check assignments and healing.
messages.HP1固定はバグではなく自家発電の効果。追加ダメージだけで押し切ろうとしない。: The 1-HP lock is Self-charge's effect. Adding more damage alone will not finish the fight.
messages.通常の自家発電獲得と、HP1後の消費は別。マッチ勝利を続ければ通常段階でも必ずゼ: Normal Self-charge gains differ from consumption after reaching 1 HP. Repeated Clash wins do not guarantee reaching zero in the normal phase.
messages.頭を破壊しても本体が即座に倒れるとは限らず、移行後の技も減る。残る発電の数値を確: Breaking the Head may not immediately defeat the enemy, and also removes some post-transition skills. Check remaining Self-charge.
messages.5ターン目のイベントはHP1移行でキャンセルされることがある。イベント成功による: The turn-5 event may be canceled by the transition to 1 HP. Do not make its successful Self-charge reduction a required step.
messages.9章や鉄道の衝撃ムカデとは別個体。強化技や特殊な出撃条件を混ぜない。: This is separate from Canto IX and Railway Shock Centipedes. Do not apply their enhanced skills or special deployment conditions here.
messages.主力Lv35・同期Ⅲ以上。胴体へ通る貫通と、憂鬱・怠惰の火力を用意する。: Aim for Level 35 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Prepare Pierce for the Body, plus Gloom and Sloth damage.
messages.加重値5の広域と最大17の移行後攻撃へ勝つ技を残し、低HPの囚人を回復しておく。: Save winning skills for the 5-Attack-Weight area attack and the post-transition attack rolling up to 17. Heal low-HP Sinners beforehand.
messages.頭のバリアを避けて混乱を取り、本体HP1へ進める。: Bypass the Head Shield to cause Stagger and reach 1 overall HP.
messages.広域を止め、移行後は発電を1技あたり5減らす。: Stop the area attack, then consume 5 Self-charge per skill after the transition.
messages.低HP狙いの蠢く頭・尾から消耗した囚人を守る。: Protect weakened Sinners from “Wriggling Head” and “Wriggling Tail”'s low-HP targeting.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-30「リカルド」の攻略。全攻撃にマッ: Ricardo guide for Limbus Company 5-30. Choose which attacks to take and when to deal damage. Prepare in earlier Waves, then concentrate strong Blunt skills during Test of the Big Brother.
messages.頼れる中指末弟の外見: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle appearance
messages.頼れる中指末弟のスキル: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle skills
messages.Sturdy Little Brother of the Middleの外見: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle appearance
messages.Sturdy Little Brother of the Middleのスキル: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle skills
messages.厳格な中指末弟の外見: Stern Little Brother of the Middle appearance
messages.厳格な中指末弟のスキル: Stern Little Brother of the Middle skills
messages.Stern Little Brother of the Middleの外見: Stern Little Brother of the Middle appearance
messages.Stern Little Brother of the Middleのスキル: Stern Little Brother of the Middle skills
messages.イシュメール以外にも生存者を残し、危険な単体攻撃はイシュメールで受ける。: Keep at least one ally besides Ishmael alive, and let Ishmael take dangerous single-target attacks.
messages.前の2ウェーブで精神力とE.G.O資源をため、主力の強い打撃スキルを残す。: Build SP and E.G.O resources in the first 2 Waves, saving your main units' strong Blunt skills.
messages.「兄貴の試験」で被ダメージが3倍になる間に、リカルドの混乱とHP50%を狙う。: During Test of the Big Brother, Ricardo takes triple damage. Use this opening to Stagger him and reach 50% HP.
messages.E.G.Oでもマッチに勝てない: Even E.G.O cannot win the Clashes
messages.リカルドは攻撃レベルが高く、表の威力以上にマッチが強い。強い単体攻撃をイシュメー: Ricardo's high Offense Level makes his Clashes stronger than the listed rolls suggest. Consider directing strong single-target attacks at Ishmael while Blunt attackers deal unopposed damage.
messages.ヘアクーポンの広域攻撃で全滅する: The hair-coupon area attack wipes out your team
messages.まず試験中に混乱させる速攻を目指す。間に合わない場合は打撃・憤怒耐性と保護を用意: First aim to Stagger him during the Test before it arrives. If you cannot, prepare Blunt/Wrath resistance and Protection. Reducing HP damage does not remove the Stagger Threshold increase, so Guard alone may not keep you safe.
messages.生存条件は5-30限定で、ほかの味方が生存していることが必要。全員が倒れる広域攻: Her survival condition applies only in 5-30 and requires another ally to remain alive. It cannot prevent an area attack from defeating everyone together. It does not support a plan where Ishmael survives alone indefinitely.
messages.ゲーム内ではHPやレベルなどが???表示。HP・防御Lv・各スキルのレベルは実測: HP, Level, and other values appear as ??? in-game. HP, Defense Level, and skill levels are based on measurements; skill levels are estimates.
messages.HP50%に初めて到達したターンの終了時に勝利扱いになる。HP0まで削る必要はな: Victory triggers at the end of the turn when he first reaches 50% HP. You do not need to reduce him to 0 HP.
messages.第3ウェーブ開始から9ターン目終了時にも勝利扱いになるが、広域攻撃を耐える準備が: Victory also triggers at the end of turn 9 of Wave 3, but this requires preparing to survive his area attacks.
messages.混乱しても行動パターンは飛ばされない。立て直す猶予として使う。: Stagger does not skip his action pattern. Use it as time to recover.
messages.頼れる中指末弟: Sturdy Little Brother of the Middle
messages.前の2ウェーブとリカルドの取り巻きとして登場。打撃が有効。: Appear in the first 2 Waves and as Ricardo's allies. Weak to Blunt.
messages.倒すと残る中指が強化されるが、放置して麻痺やコイン弱化を受け続けるのも危険。: Defeating them buffs the remaining Middle members, but leaving them alive to keep inflicting Paralyze and Coin debuffs is also dangerous.
messages.厳格な中指末弟: Stern Little Brother of the Middle
messages.精神力を上げ、最後に使うスキルを残す: Build SP and save skills for the final Wave
messages.勝てるマッチで主力の精神力を上げ、必要なE.G.O資源をためる。EX条件はステー: Win manageable Clashes to build your main units' SP and the necessary E.G.O resources. The EX condition is simply clearing the stage, so there is no need to rush.
messages.勝ちにくい攻撃は、防御枠への一方攻撃で先に混乱させる方法もある。次のターンに麻痺: Against difficult attacks, unopposed attacks aimed at a Defense slot can Stagger the enemy before it acts. Avoid carrying Paralyze or Plus Coin Drop into next turn.
messages.第2ウェーブの終わりは強い打撃スキルを使い切らず温存。イシュメール以外のHPも残: Save strong Blunt skills at the end of Wave 2. Enter Wave 3 with HP remaining on allies besides Ishmael.
messages.取り巻きを止め、主力を守る: Stop the adds and protect your main units
messages.リカルドの強い攻撃はイシュメールで引き受ける。別の味方が生きている間はHP1未満: Let Ishmael take Ricardo's strong attacks. While another ally is alive, her HP cannot fall below 1, but she can still suffer Stagger and statuses.
messages.イシュメールへ元から向いている攻撃を、わざわざ別の主力で引き受けない。対象変更で: Do not redirect attacks already aimed at Ishmael onto another main unit unnecessarily. For attacks that can be redirected, check Speed and targeting arrows.
messages.取り巻きは次のターンに強い攻撃を使う。余った枠や広域攻撃で混乱・撃破を狙い、本体: The adds use strong attacks next turn. Stagger or defeat them with spare slots or area attacks, saving strong skills against Ricardo for the Test.
messages.「兄貴の試験」を見てから一気に攻める: Wait for Test of the Big Brother, then concentrate damage
messages.試験中はリカルドが受けるスキルダメージが3倍。打撃の多コインスキルを主力にし、混: During the Test, Ricardo takes triple skill damage. Use multi-Coin Blunt skills to reach his Stagger Threshold.
messages.回避には別の囚人の守備を合わせて相殺し、主力の攻撃が避けられないようにする。戦闘: Offset his Evade with another Sinner's Defense Skill so your main attackers can land their hits. Offsetting does not cancel the Test gained at Combat Start.
messages.攻撃レベル差のため、勝てないマッチを全員にさせる必要はない。耐えられる担当が受け: The Offense Level gap means you need not force everyone into losing Clashes. Let a durable Sinner take attacks while your other main units attack unopposed.
messages.混乱すると試験は解除される。残った試験の数だけでなく、混乱とHP50%までの距離: Stagger removes the Test. Choose subsequent skills based on his Stagger state and distance from 50% HP, as well as the remaining Test stacks.
messages.再び試験を得る回避が来たら、次の攻撃機会として使う。強い打撃を集めてHP50%到: When another Evade grants the Test, use it as a fresh damage opening. Focus strong Blunt skills to reach 50% HP.
messages.「俺のヘアクーポォオオオン！！！」が見えたら、表示20〜28だけで勝てると思わな: When “MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!” appears, its displayed 20–28 is not the full Clash calculation. Account for the Offense Level gap and buffs based on the target's SP.
messages.長期戦を選ぶなら、イシュメール以外にも打撃・憤怒に耐える役を残し、保護や回復を継: For a longer survival strategy, keep someone besides Ishmael resistant to Blunt and Wrath, with ongoing Protection and healing. With a normal team, try ending the fight quickly first.
messages.boss-copy:ricardo:skills.0.name: Punching
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ打撃の追加ダメージ3。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal 3 additional Blunt damage.
messages.表示威力3〜9でも攻撃レベルが高い。予測を確認し、勝てるE.G.Oや回避、イシュ: Despite a displayed range of 3–9, its Offense Level is high. Check predictions and choose between winning E.G.O, Evade, or having Ishmael take it.
messages.boss-copy:ricardo:skills.1.name: Kicking
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ打撃の追加ダメージ5。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal 5 additional Blunt damage.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 次のターンに麻痺3を付与。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.主力に次ターンの麻痺を残さない。マッチで止められなければ受ける役を決める。: Keep next-turn Paralyze off your main attackers. If you cannot stop it with a Clash, choose who will take the hit.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 対象の精神力を5減らす。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 5.
messages.本体への攻撃には反撃も返ってくる。試験前の軽い攻撃を耐久の低い囚人で出さず、反撃: Attacking Ricardo also triggers his Counter. Avoid weak attacks from fragile Sinners before the Test, and check who receives the Counter.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 敵側全員に攻撃威力増加1。囚人側の精神力が最も低い2名に攻撃威力: [Combat Start] Grant all enemies 1 Attack Power Up. Inflict 2 Attack Power Down on the 2 Sinners with the lowest SP.
messages.戦闘開始時の強化・弱体化はマッチで取り消せない。主力の威力が下がっていないか予測: Clashing cannot cancel these Combat Start buffs and debuffs. Check predictions to see whether your main units' power has fallen.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 兄貴の試験2を得る。次のターンに束縛5を得る。: [Combat Start] Gain 2 Test of the Big Brother. Gain 5 Bind next turn.
messages.別枠の守備で回避を相殺し、打撃スキルを集中。試験は戦闘開始時に付くため、相殺して: Offset the Evade with a separate Defense slot, then concentrate Blunt skills. The Test applies at Combat Start and remains after offsetting.
messages.対象の精神力が0未満ならコイン威力+3。: If the target's SP is below 0, gain +3 Coin Power.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 自分の精神力を10回復し、対象に次のターンの束縛2と攻撃威力減少: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Heal 10 own SP; inflict 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down on the target next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 対象の精神力を20減らす。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 20.
messages.高威力の単体攻撃。無理なマッチよりイシュメールで受け、ほかの主力を攻撃へ回す選択: A powerful single-target attack. Letting Ishmael take it while other main units attack is a useful alternative to forcing a losing Clash.
messages.召喚は的中時ではない。止めても次に末弟が増える前提で攻撃先を確認する。: The summon is not an [On Hit] effect. Plan for more Little Brothers next turn even if you stop this attack.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 兄貴の試験2を得る。次のターンに束縛5とダメージ量増加5を得る。: [Combat Start] Gain 2 Test of the Big Brother. Gain 5 Bind and 5 Damage Up next turn.
messages.守備で相殺してから攻める。次は広域攻撃が迫るので、混乱かHP50%まで進めたい。: Offset with a Defense Skill before attacking. The area attack is approaching, so aim for Stagger or 50% HP now.
messages.メイン対象の精神力が0未満なら最終威力+5。: If the main target's SP is below 0, gain +5 Final Power.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 混乱区間を30前進し、次のターンに麻痺1を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30 and inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.攻撃レベル差もあり高威力。来る前の混乱を狙う。受けるなら打撃・憤怒耐性や保護が必: The Offense Level gap makes this especially powerful. Aim to Stagger him before it arrives. Surviving it requires Blunt/Wrath resistance or Protection; Ishmael alone cannot protect everyone.
messages.Ⅰ：[表面的中時] 次のターンに麻痺1を付与。: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.次のターンのマッチを崩す麻痺を防ぐ。序盤の精神力回復にも使いやすいマッチ。: Prevent Paralyze from weakening next turn's Clashes. Also a manageable early Clash for building SP.
messages.[マッチ敗北] 次のターンにダメージ量増加1を得る。: [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 次のターンに束縛2を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] このウェーブで倒れた中指所属の味方の数だけ固定ダメージを追加。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal additional fixed damage equal to the number of allied Middle members defeated this Wave.
messages.勝った後も次ターンの強化を確認。倒れた末弟が増えると固定ダメージも増える。: Check next turn's buffs even after winning. More defeated Little Brothers also means more fixed damage.
messages.Ⅰ：[表面的中時] 次のターンに攻撃威力減少1を付与。: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに麻痺2を付与。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Paralyze next turn.
messages.強いスキルで止めるか、行動前に混乱させる。弱いスキルで無理にマッチして弱体化を受: Stop it with a strong skill or Stagger the enemy before it acts. Avoid forcing a weak skill into the Clash and taking its debuffs.
messages.[ターン終了時] バリアが残っていれば、次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る。: [Turn End] If Shield remains, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.攻撃を止めるだけでなく、防御側の枠を狙って混乱・撃破する選択肢もある。: Besides stopping Attack Skills, you can target its Defense slot to Stagger or defeat it.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに麻痺2を付与。[裏面的中時] 混乱区間を8前進。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Paralyze next turn. [Tails Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 8.
messages.減算コインなので精神力が低いほど高い威力が出やすい。敵の精神力と予測を見て担当を: Its negative Coins roll higher more often at low SP. Choose its opponent based on enemy SP and current predictions.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 混乱区間を30前進し、固定ダメージ20と次のターンの麻痺3を与え: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30, deal 20 fixed damage, and inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.反撃のある相手を低耐久の主力で殴らない。攻撃前の混乱・撃破、またはイシュメールで: Do not hit a Countering enemy with a fragile main attacker. Consider Staggering or defeating it before it attacks, or letting Ishmael take the Counter.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 次のターンにダメージ量減少2を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Damage Down next turn.
messages.Ⅰ：[表面的中時] 次のターンに加算コイン弱化1を付与。: Ⅰ：[Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに加算コイン弱化1を付与。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.
messages.boss-copy:ricardo:passives.0.name: Vengeance Tattoo
messages.中指所属の味方が倒れるたび: Whenever an allied Middle member is defeated
messages.戦闘中、攻撃レベル増加1を得る。最大5。: Gain 1 Offense Level Up for the rest of the battle, up to 5.
messages.末弟の撃破には本体強化も伴う。取り巻き処理後は試験中の集中攻撃へつなぐ。: Defeating Little Brothers also strengthens Ricardo. Follow add cleanup with focused damage during the Test.
messages.自分を含む敵側全員の精神力を10回復。: Heal 10 SP for all enemies, including this unit.
messages.長引くほど敵が高精神力になりやすい。マッチだけで崩そうとせず混乱と打撃ダメージを: A longer fight lets the enemy maintain high SP. Aim for Stagger and Blunt damage rather than trying to break them through Clashes alone.
messages.中指所属の味方が倒れる: An allied Middle member is defeated
messages.次のターンに加算コイン強化1を得る。最大2。: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn, up to 2.
messages.末弟を倒した次のターンは通常より強い。予測を見直す。: The turn after defeating a Little Brother is stronger than usual. Recheck predictions.
messages.リカルドを攻撃したスキルのダメージが12未満: A skill attacking Ricardo deals less than 12 damage
messages.弱い攻撃をばらまくと精神力を失う。試験中の強い打撃を主軸にする。: Scattering weak attacks costs SP. Build your plan around strong Blunt attacks during the Test.
messages.次のターン開始時にパニックを解除し、精神力を0に戻す。: At the next Turn Start, remove Panic and reset SP to 0.
messages.精神力低下だけで長く行動を止められるとは考えない。: Do not assume SP loss alone will keep him disabled for long.
messages.次のターンに防御レベル減少6を得る。: Gain 6 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.勝てるマッチを選ぶ意味はあるが、これを狙って無理なマッチを増やす必要はない。: Winning manageable Clashes still helps, but do not force extra losing Clashes just to chase this effect.
messages.パニックタイプ変更の効果を受ける: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.タイプは変わらず、精神力のない敵向けの効果が適用される。: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.
messages.パニックタイプ変更を攻略の前提にしない。: Do not base the strategy on changing Panic Type.
messages.残った末弟の攻撃も確認する。: Check the remaining Little Brothers' attacks too.
messages.次のターンに減算コイン強化1を得る。1ターンに最大2回。: Gain 1 Minus Coin Boost next turn, up to twice per turn.
messages.減算の「報復」は低精神力と強化が重なると危険。: Negative-Coin Vengeance becomes dangerous when low SP and buffs combine.
messages.次のターンに加算コイン強化1を得る。: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn.
messages.人数が減ってもマッチが弱くなるとは限らない。: Fewer enemies does not necessarily mean weaker Clashes.
messages.スキルダメージと振動爆発による混乱区間ダメージを3倍に受ける。ターン終了時に1減: Take triple skill damage and triple Stagger Threshold damage from Tremor Burst. Decrease by 1 at Turn End. Removed on Stagger. If it expires without Stagger, gain 5 Damage Up next turn.
messages.強い打撃スキルをこの間へ集める。混乱で解除された後は3倍を前提に計算しない。: Concentrate strong Blunt skills during this window. After Stagger removes it, stop calculating damage with the triple multiplier.
messages.イシュメールは精神力-25で戦闘開始。ターン開始時に精神力が0未満なら攻撃威力増: Ishmael starts combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if her SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.負の精神力は加算コインの表が出にくくなる。強化だけを見てマッチを任せすぎない。: Negative SP lowers Heads odds on Plus Coins. Do not assign too many Clashes to her based only on the power buff.
messages.ほかの味方が生きている間、イシュメールはHP1未満にならない。退却不可。広域攻撃: While another ally is alive, Ishmael's HP cannot fall below 1. She cannot retreat. This does not protect her if an area attack defeats her together with all remaining allies.
messages.イシュメール以外の生存者を必ず守る。後のエイハブ戦などには引き継がれない。: Always protect at least one survivor besides Ishmael. This condition does not carry into later fights such as Ahab.
messages.反撃は本体を殴ることで返ってくる。マッチだけを避けても、低耐久の主力が無傷で攻め: Attacking Ricardo triggers his Counter. Avoiding his Clashes does not guarantee fragile attackers can deal damage safely.
messages.回避を相殺しても戦闘開始時のバフは消えない。兄貴の試験はそのまま利用できる。: Offsetting Evade does not remove Combat Start buffs. You can still use Test of the Big Brother.
messages.HP50%到達か第3ウェーブ9ターン目終了で勝利扱い。耐久策は可能だが、保護・回: Victory triggers at 50% HP or at the end of turn 9 of Wave 3. A survival strategy is possible, but waiting without suitable Protection, healing, and resistances is dangerous.
messages.射影戦闘のリカルドとは別の攻略。ここでのイシュメールの生存条件をほかのコンテンツ: This guide is separate from Ricardo's Reflectrial. Do not apply Ishmael's survival condition here to other content.
messages.主力はステージ推奨のLv40を目安に、打撃の強い人格から育てる。同期Ⅲまでのスキ: Aim for the recommended Level 40, starting with strong Blunt Identities. Check their skills and passives through Uptie III too.
messages.イシュメールは必須。別の生存者を残す前提なら、育成が足りなくても攻撃を受ける役と: Ishmael is mandatory. Provided another ally survives, she can take attacks even if underleveled.
messages.打撃耐性を優先し、憤怒・嫉妬の罪悪耐性も確認。E.G.O使用後の耐性を含めて考え: Prioritize Blunt resistance and check Wrath/Envy Sin resistances too, including resistance changes after using E.G.O.
messages.育成済みが少なければ4〜5名で出撃し、編成順の先頭から行動枠を増やす方法もある。: If few Sinners are trained, you can deploy 4–5 and gain extra action slots in deployment order. Keep your defender and Blunt damage rather than removing units indiscriminately.
messages.速度や行動枠を確保し、主力へ向く攻撃を引き受ける。ほかの味方の生存も同時に守る。: Secure Speed and action slots to redirect attacks away from main attackers while also keeping other allies alive.
messages.試験中に削る打撃アタッカー: Blunt attacker for the Test window
messages.高威力の多コインスキルを温存して使う。サポートで借りる場合も、打撃火力と耐性が合: Save high-power multi-Coin skills for this opening. If borrowing Support, choose an Identity with suitable Blunt damage and resistances.
messages.主力の攻撃を回避されないようにし、必要なら攻撃威力減少や保護で被害を抑える。: Help main attackers land their hits, using Attack Power Down or Protection to limit damage when needed.
messages.【リンバス】5-36 皮膚の予言者（5章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 5-36 Skin Prophet (Canto V) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-36「皮膚の予言者（5章）」の攻略。: Skin Prophet (Canto V) guide for Limbus Company 5-36. Reduce all 4 Candles to 1 HP to light them. Once the boss's normal resistances return, focus damage on it or break every lit Candle's Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage and Stagger.
messages.5-36「Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Tendon: 5-36 · Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Tendon Bridge
messages.同じ本体の耐性強化中と復帰後を分けた表示で、HP942は引き継ぐ。蝋燭は4体・各: The enhanced-resistance and restored-resistance entries describe the same boss, retaining its 942 HP. There are 4 Candles with 26 HP each; they light at 1 HP rather than falling to 0. Breaking their 20-point Shields after lighting is a separate step. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.
messages.本体の反撃を避け、まず4本の蝋燭を点灯する。: Avoid triggering the boss's Counter; light all 4 Candles first.
messages.全点灯後は本体集中か、4本のバリアを同時に壊すか決める。: After all are lit, choose between focusing the boss and breaking all 4 Shields in the same turn.
messages.減算コインの9章2節へ麻痺を使わず、火傷と回復を管理する。: Do not use Paralyze to weaken negative-Coin 9:2. Manage Burn and healing instead.
messages.耐性強化中は全て0.5。蝋燭を倒そうとせず、HP1にして全て点灯させる。全点灯後: While resistance buffs are active, all resistances are 0.5. Reduce all Candles to 1 HP to light them rather than trying to defeat them. Once all are lit, normal resistances return, making Gloom especially effective.
messages.蝋燭がHP1で死なない: Candles do not die at 1 HP
messages.HP1で点灯し、倒れないのが仕様。本体への攻撃機会を作る操作になる。点灯後のバリ: Candles light at 1 HP and cannot die. This creates an opening to attack the boss. Breaking their Shields after lighting extinguishes them next turn; these are separate steps.
messages.麻痺を付けたのに広域が強い: The area attack remains strong despite Paralyze
messages.9章2節は基本威力20・コイン威力−4の減算技。麻痺でコイン威力を0にすると下が: 9:2 has 20 Base Power and -4 Coin Power. Paralyze sets Coin Power to 0, preventing the usual power reduction. Use strong Clashes or extinguish every Candle instead of treating Paralyze as a debuff here.
messages.4本へ攻撃を分ける手数と火傷への回復を用意する: Prepare attacks for all 4 Candles and healing for Burn
messages.推奨Lv40・出撃6名。蝋燭は4体なので、1体へ全攻撃を集中せず、それぞれHP1: Recommended Level 40; deploy 6 Sinners. Divide attacks so each of the 4 Candles reaches 1 HP rather than focusing everything on one.
messages.本体の耐性復帰後は憂鬱・怠惰・斬撃が有効。憤怒への耐性と火傷による消耗、HP回復: Once normal resistances return, Gloom, Sloth, and Slash are effective. Prepare Wrath resistance and HP healing for Burn attrition too.
messages.イシュメールは低精神力で開始する。初手の回復や守備を考え、全ての点灯を本人のマッ: Ishmael starts at low SP. Consider opening recovery or defense rather than relying on her winning every Clash needed to light Candles.
messages.本体の通常反撃を起動せず4本を点灯する: Light all 4 without triggering the boss's normal Counter
messages.蝋燭はHP1にすると点灯する。1体ずつ倒そうとせず、4本へ攻撃を分けて全点灯を狙: Candles light when reduced to 1 HP. Divide attacks across all 4 instead of trying to defeat them one at a time.
messages.本体の露わにならん・燃え上がらんはマッチ不可。強い技でマッチを奪おうとせず、回避: “All Shall be Revealed” and “All Shall Burn” are unclashable. Use Evade or other damage mitigation rather than trying to redirect them into a strong attacking Clash.
messages.この段階の本体には通常反撃もある。広域を使うときは副対象に本体を不用意に巻き込ま: The boss also has a normal Counter during this phase. Check Attack Weight and targets when using area attacks to avoid accidentally including the boss as a secondary target.
messages.火が消えて4ターン後は本体が蝋燭を点灯する。手数が足りないときも、本体の反撃を無: The boss lights the Candles 4 turns after they go out. If you lack actions, you need not keep triggering its Counter unnecessarily.
messages.本体集中か、全消灯の誘導かを選ぶ: Choose between focusing the boss and extinguishing all Candles
messages.本体の耐性が元に戻り、攻撃が通る。火力が十分なら蝋燭を触らず本体へ集中し、9章2: The boss's normal resistances return and attacks can deal effective damage. If your damage is sufficient, leave Candles alone and focus the boss to Stagger it before 9:2.
messages.火力で押し切れなければ、全ての蝋燭が張るバリア20を同じターンに削り切る。次ター: Otherwise, fully deplete every Candle's 20-point Shield in the same turn. All go out next turn, triggering 6:5's self-damage and Stagger.
messages.本体へ殴る方針と全消灯狙いを中途半端に混ぜると、反撃の火傷を受けるだけで全消灯に: Splitting actions between damaging the boss and extinguishing Candles can leave you taking Counter Burn without extinguishing them all. Choose the turn's goal before assigning attacks.
messages.減算コインへ強いマッチを合わせる: Use a strong Clash against negative Coins
messages.9章2節は20からコイン1枚ごとに4下がる技。麻痺を付けるとその減少を消してしま: 9:2 starts at 20 and loses 4 power per Coin. Paralyze removes that reduction, so do not use it to weaken this skill.
messages.強い技で勝って的中による火傷・最大HP減少を防ぐ。ただし敵のマッチ敗北時効果で火: Win with a strong skill to prevent Burn and Max HP reduction on hit. However, the enemy's [Clash Lose] effect still applies 10 Burn and next-turn Marked, so victory does not mean taking no damage.
messages.表号を持つ対象は追加の最大HP割合ダメージを受ける。HP回復と憤怒耐性を確認し、: Marked targets take additional damage based on Max HP. Check HP recovery and Wrath resistance, and recover before the area attack.
messages.使用後は蝋燭が回復・消灯する。倒し切れなければ最初の点灯手順へ戻る。: Afterward, Candles heal and go out. If the boss survives, repeat the lighting process.
messages.4本のバリアを同時に消耗: Deplete all 4 Shields in the same turn
messages.全消灯が間に合うと9章2節の代わりに6章5節を使う。これはマッチ不可・対象変更不: If all Candles go out in time, the boss uses 6:5 instead of 9:2. This unclashable, unredirectable skill makes the boss take the damage itself.
messages.次ターンの本体混乱を使って攻撃する。自傷技へ囚人のE.G.Oを当ててマッチしよう: Attack during the boss's Stagger next turn. Save healing and damage skills rather than attempting to Clash with the self-damaging skill using a Sinner's E.G.O.
messages.蝋燭が回復した後は再度点灯する。火傷の蓄積を放置せず、必要なら同じ手順で次の隙を: Light the Candles again after they heal. Manage Burn buildup and repeat the process for another opening if needed.
messages.4体・HP26。HP0にならずHP1で点灯し、全点灯で本体の耐性が戻る。点灯後の: 4 Candles with 26 HP each. They light at 1 HP rather than reaching 0; lighting all restores the boss's normal resistances. Breaking their 20-point Shields afterward extinguishes them next turn.
messages.最初の点灯と、全消灯を狙うバリア破壊を分けて操作する。: Treat initial lighting and Shield-breaking to extinguish all Candles as separate steps.
messages.本体や蝋燭の一部の攻撃に優先して狙われる印。9章2節の的中時には最大HP5%分の: A mark prioritized by some boss and Candle attacks. A hit from 9:2 also deals additional damage equal to 5% of Max HP.
messages.持っている囚人のHPを戻し、強いマッチや耐性で守る。: Heal the marked Sinner and protect them with strong Clashes or resistances.
messages.5章ダンジョンの補助。イシュメールのLvが40未満なら40へ上がり、同期化・幻想: A Canto V dungeon aid. Raises Ishmael to Level 40 if below 40 and assists Uptie/Threadspin to IV. Grants Compulsion each battle.
messages.イシュメールだけを急いで育成するより、ほかの主力と耐性・回復も整える。: Prepare other main units, resistances, and healing rather than rushing to raise only Ishmael.
messages.イシュメールが精神力−25で戦闘開始。ターン開始時、精神力0未満なら攻撃威力増加: Ishmael begins combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.精神力回復と耐久を優先し、低精神力での侵蝕にも注意する。: Prioritize SP recovery and durability, and watch for E.G.O Corrosion at low SP.
messages.点灯した蝋燭の反撃は通常反撃。マッチに勝って止める技として扱わない。: Lit Candles use normal Counters. These cannot be stopped by winning a Clash.
messages.9章2節へ勝っても敗北時効果の火傷は残る。的中を防ぐことと全効果を消すことは別。: Winning against 9:2 still leaves its [Clash Lose] Burn effect. Preventing hits does not cancel every effect.
messages.全消灯を狙うなら同じターンに4本全てのバリアを削る。1本だけ壊して同じ混乱を期待: To extinguish all Candles, deplete all 4 Shields in the same turn. Breaking just one does not trigger the same Stagger opening.
messages.耐性強化中と復帰後は同じHPゲージ。2体の本体を順に倒す戦闘ではない。: Enhanced-resistance and restored-resistance entries share one HP gauge. You do not defeat two separate bosses in sequence.
messages.各蝋燭を点灯させる手数、本体へ通す憂鬱・怠惰・斬撃、HP回復を用意する。: Prepare enough actions to light each Candle, Gloom/Sloth/Slash damage for the boss, and HP recovery.
messages.9章2節用の高威力技を残す。麻痺は減算コインへの弱体化手段にならない。: Save a powerful answer to 9:2. Paralyze does not weaken its negative Coins.
messages.耐性復帰と混乱の攻撃機会を生かす。: Exploit restored resistances and Stagger openings.
messages.全消灯を狙う手数・広域: Actions / area attacks to extinguish all Candles
messages.同じターンに全バリアを壊し、自傷へ誘導する。: Break every Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage.
messages.広域へ勝った後も残る消耗を戻す。: Recover from attrition that remains even after winning the area-attack Clash.
messages.蝋燭が全回復して消灯した状態から、全点灯するまで全耐性0.5。: After Candles fully heal and go out, all resistances are 0.5 until every Candle is lit.
messages.本体を攻撃すると通常反撃を起動する。まず蝋燭へ攻撃を回す。: Attacking the boss triggers its normal Counter. Attack Candles first.
messages.部位破壊後も追撃可能・行動も続く。: Remains targetable and can still act after Part break.
messages.同じ本体の残区間を引き継ぐ: Retains the same boss's remaining thresholds
messages.全点灯後の本来の耐性。憂鬱2.0・怠惰1.5・斬撃1.2。: Normal resistances after all Candles are lit: Gloom 2.0, Sloth 1.5, Slash 1.2.
messages.全消灯を狙う場合は、全ての蝋燭のバリアを同じターンに削る。: To extinguish all Candles, damage every Candle's Shield in the same turn.
messages.9章2節・6章5節の終了時に蝋燭が全回復し、部位も復活して火が消える。: At the end of 9:2 or 6:5, Candles fully heal, their Parts revive, and the flames go out.
messages.HP0にならず、HP1で部位破壊・点灯。点灯中に行動する。: Cannot reach 0 HP. At 1 HP, the Part breaks and lights. Acts while lit.
messages.全点灯時はバリア20の通常反撃を使用。バリアを削り切ると次ターンに消灯する。: When all are lit, uses a normal Counter with a 20-point Shield. Fully depleting the Shield extinguishes it next turn.
messages.火が消えた状態から4ターン後には、本体も全てをHP1にして点灯させる。: 4 turns after the flames go out, the boss also reduces all Candles to 1 HP and lights them.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]灯った蝋燭の数だけ精神力ダメージ: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal SP damage equal to the number of lit Candles.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]灯った蝋燭の数だけ精神力ダメージ: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal SP damage equal to the number of lit Candles.
messages.表号を優先し、点灯数に応じた精神力ダメージ。通常技で止め、本体への集中火力を続け: Prioritizes Marked targets, dealing SP damage according to the lit Candle count. Stop it with a regular skill while continuing to focus damage on the boss.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに憤怒脆弱を1付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Wrath Fragility next turn.
messages.[的中時]対象に火傷があれば、火傷3付与: [On Hit] If the target has Burn, inflict 3 Burn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに憤怒脆弱を1付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Wrath Fragility next turn.
messages.憤怒脆弱と火傷を増やす。次の9章2節を重くしないよう、強い通常技で止める。: Adds Wrath Fragility and Burn. Stop it with a strong regular skill to avoid making the following 9:2 more dangerous.
messages.表号のある対象へ的中時、体力最大値の5%分追加で減少。: On hitting a Marked target, deal additional damage equal to 5% of Max HP.
messages.[マッチ敗北]火傷10を付与。対象へ次のターンに表号を付与。: [Clash Lose] Inflict 10 Burn. Inflict Marked on the target next turn.
messages.[ターン終了時]全ての蝋燭を体力最大値まで回復: [Turn End] Heal all Candles to Max HP.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の体力の最大値を10%減少: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce the target's Max HP by 10%.
messages.[的中時]火傷5付与、火傷回数が２増加: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の体力の最大値を10%減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce the target's Max HP by 10%.
messages.基本威力20・2枚−4の広域。麻痺で弱めようとしない。勝って的中を防いでも、敵の: An area attack with 20 Base Power and two -4 Coins. Do not use Paralyze to weaken it. Even when you prevent hits by winning, the enemy's [Clash Lose] effect applies 10 Burn and Marked, so prepare healing.
messages.対象のダメージを自分が受ける。次のターンに混乱する。: Take the target's damage instead. Become Staggered next turn.
messages.表号のないランダムな敵へ次のターンに表号を付与。: Inflict Marked next turn on a random enemy without Marked.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]自分の体力の最大値を10%減少: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce own Max HP by 10%.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]自分の体力の最大値を10%減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce own Max HP by 10%.
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可の自傷技。全消灯で誘導し、次ターンの本体混乱へ攻撃をまと: An unclashable, unredirectable self-damaging skill. Trigger it by extinguishing all Candles, then concentrate attacks during the boss's Stagger next turn.
messages.マッチ不可の色欲・貫通。回避などで的中を防ぎ、本体の反撃を起動せず蝋燭へ攻撃する: An unclashable Lust/Pierce attack. Prevent hits with Evade or similar options, and attack Candles without triggering the boss's Counter.
Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Burn, inflict 3 Burn.
messages.マッチ不可。火傷持ちへ火傷3を追加するので、回避やHP回復を使う。: Unclashable. Adds 3 Burn to targets already carrying Burn, so use Evade or HP recovery.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象に火傷5付与、火傷回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.
messages.耐性強化中の本体へ攻撃すると起動する通常反撃。蝋燭の点灯を先に進め、不要な火傷を: A normal Counter triggered by attacking the boss during enhanced resistances. Light the Candles first to avoid unnecessary Burn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]火傷6付与、火傷回数2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 6 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.
messages.点灯した蝋燭の攻撃。表号を優先し、火傷6・回数2を付ける。全点灯までの途中で放置: A lit Candle's attack. Prioritizes Marked targets and applies 6 Burn and 2 Count. Avoid leaving these attacks unchecked while working toward lighting all Candles.
messages.バリアが全て消耗されると、次のターンに火が消える。: When the Shield is fully depleted, the flame goes out next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]火傷1、火傷回数1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Burn Count.
messages.通常反撃とバリア20。全消灯を狙うなら全蝋燭のバリアを同じターンに削り切る。火傷: A normal Counter with a 20-point Shield. To extinguish all Candles, deplete every Shield in the same turn. Account for Burn from Counters too.
messages.火が消えてから4ターン後ごとに、消えた蝋燭があれば自分で全ての蝋燭を灯す。全ての: Every 4 turns after the flames go out, if any Candles are unlit, light all Candles and set their HP to 1.
