messages.本体が蝋燭を灯す。自力で早く灯せるなら4ターン待つ必要はない。: The boss lights the Candles. You need not wait 4 turns if you can light them sooner yourself.
messages.蝋燭が消えて蝋燭の体力が全快した状態なら、全ての蝋燭が灯るまで耐性が上昇。\n全: While Candles are unlit and at full HP, resistances increase until every Candle is lit. When all Candles are lit, resistances decrease.
messages.全耐性0.5と復帰後を分け、全点灯してから火力を使う。: Distinguish universal 0.5 resistances from restored resistances, and deal damage after all Candles are lit.
messages.体力が0にならない。\n体力が1のとき、火が灯って攻撃スキルを使用する。: HP cannot reach 0. At 1 HP, the flame lights and Attack Skills are used.
messages.倒れないのは仕様。点灯へ必要なダメージだけを分けて与える。: Its survival is intended. Divide only the damage needed to light each Candle.
messages.全ての蝋燭が灯っているとき、防御スキルを使用する。\nバリアが全て消耗されると、: Use a Defense Skill when all Candles are lit. When the Shield is fully depleted, the flame goes out next turn.
messages.全消灯を狙うときは4本全てのバリアへ攻撃を配る。: To extinguish all Candles, divide attacks across all 4 Shields.
messages.【リンバス】5-36 歩く真珠（5章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistant: 5-36 Ambling Pearl (Canto V) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-36「歩く真珠（5章）」の攻略。出現: Ambling Pearl (Canto V) guide for Limbus Company 5-36. Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the Pearl when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.
messages.5-36「Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Right A: 5-36 · Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Right Atrium
messages.出現した緑色の粘液を捕食される前に倒し、本体の粘液が尽きたときに真珠へ集中する。: Defeat summoned Green Slimes before they are eaten, then focus the Pearl when the boss's slime runs out. Avoid repeatedly attacking the resistant Shell, and prepare for Larva's SP loss and the area attack every 4 turns.
messages.本体HP1229と真珠774・殻431は別の値で、部位の合計を本体HPとしない。: Overall HP is 1229; Pearl HP is 774 and Shell HP is 431. Part HP is not added to determine overall HP. The summoned 25-HP Green Slimes are separate units. Listed resistances are normal values, separate from changes caused by the special Stagger at 0 slime or Part breaks. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.
messages.HP25の緑色の粘液を本体の捕食より先に倒す。: Defeat the 25-HP Green Slimes before the boss eats them.
messages.幼虫を増やす攻撃へ勝ち、精神力を守る。: Win against Larva-inflicting attacks to protect SP.
messages.本体の粘液が0になった攻撃機会は真珠へ集中する。: Focus the Pearl during the opening at 0 slime.
messages.硬くてダメージが通らない: The enemy is too resistant to damage
messages.殻は全耐性0.7で、混乱しても元の耐性を保つ。召喚された粘液を倒して補充を防ぎ、: All Shell resistances are 0.7 and remain unchanged on Stagger. Defeat summoned slimes to prevent replenishment, then focus the Pearl during the special Stagger triggered by 0 slime.
messages.幼虫は開始時に数値分の精神力ダメージを与え、終了時に現在HPが最も高い味方へ移る: Larva deals SP damage equal to its value at Turn Start and transfers to the ally with the highest current HP at Turn End. Prioritize winning against “Corrosive Slime” and “Paralytic Fluid”. “Devouring Fluid” also applies Larva [On Use], so Clash wins cannot prevent all of it.
messages.本体の捕食が召喚粘液へ成功すると3補充する。自分の速い攻撃で粘液を先に倒す。4タ: Successful Predation on a summoned slime restores 3 stacks. Defeat it first with a faster attack. The area attack every 4 turns and recovery from the special Stagger also restore 10, so Predation is not the only cause.
messages.回復と粘液を倒す手数を用意する: Prepare healing and enough actions to defeat slimes
messages.推奨Lv40・出撃6名。イシュメールの低精神力を前提に、ほかの主力へ強いマッチと: Recommended Level 40; deploy 6 Sinners. Account for Ishmael's low SP by giving other main units strong Clashes and healing options.
messages.本体への憤怒・傲慢、複数の召喚個体を削る広域が候補。硬い殻への火力だけで組まず、: Consider Wrath/Pride damage against the boss and area attacks for multiple summons. Prioritize winning against Larva-inflicting attacks rather than building solely to damage the resistant Shell.
messages.HP・精神力回復を残す。毒によるHP消耗と幼虫による精神力消耗は別の問題として対: Save HP and SP recovery. Poison's HP damage and Larva's SP loss require separate answers.
messages.幼虫を増やす技を優先して止める: Prioritize stopping skills that add Larva
messages.腐食粘液・麻痺液体へ勝ち、幼虫と麻痺を減らす。毒を持つ囚人は追加の麻痺や防御Lv: Beat “Corrosive Slime” and “Paralytic Fluid” to limit Larva and Paralyze. Poisoned Sinners receive extra Paralyze or Defense Level Down, so assign healthier main units to these Clashes.
messages.蚕食液体は使用時に幼虫3を付ける。勝っても使用時効果は残るので、精神力回復と部位: “Devouring Fluid” inflicts 3 Larva [On Use]. This remains even when you win, so use SP recovery and action cancellation from Part breaks too.
messages.緑色の粘液の消費は戦闘開始時。マッチに勝っても消費と次ターンの召喚までは取り消さ: Green Slime is consumed at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not cancel that consumption or next turn's summon.
messages.本体より先に召喚個体を倒す: Defeat summons before the boss acts
messages.召喚された粘液はHP25。速い囚人や広域で倒し、終了時の毒と本体の捕食を防ぐ。: Summoned slimes have 25 HP. Use faster Sinners or area attacks to prevent Turn End Poison and the boss's Predation.
messages.捕食はマッチ不可・対象変更不可。本体の50〜51という威力へE.G.Oで挑まず、: Predation is unclashable and cannot be redirected. Instead of challenging its 50–51 roll with E.G.O, defeat the targeted slime first so the attack cannot resolve.
messages.同名の緑色の粘液でも、本体の数値と召喚個体は別。本体の数値を直接殴って減らす操作: The boss's Green Slime status and the summoned units share a name but are separate. You do not directly attack the status to reduce its value.
messages.専用混乱の攻撃機会に真珠を集中する: Focus the Pearl during the special Stagger opening
messages.本体の粘液が0のターン開始時は混乱し、真珠の耐性が弱まる。強い攻撃を真珠へ集めて: At Turn Start with 0 slime, the boss Staggers and the Pearl's resistances weaken. Focus strong attacks on the Pearl to reduce overall HP.
messages.普通の攻撃で殻を混乱させることと、粘液0の専用混乱は別。殻の元耐性0.7を見て、: Staggering the Shell through ordinary attacks differs from the special Stagger at 0 slime. Its normal resistances are 0.7; avoid repeatedly attacking only the Shell.
messages.専用混乱を抜けると粘液10を補充する。倒し切れなければ再び召喚粘液を処理し、次の: Recovery from the special Stagger restores 10 slime. If the boss survives, clear summoned slimes again to create another opening.
messages.広域へ強いマッチを残し、終盤は倒し切る: Save a strong area-attack answer, then finish the boss
messages.沸き立つ緑色の粘液は最大25、加重値は本体の粘液で増える。高威力の技を残して止め: “Effervescent Green Slime” rolls up to 25, with Attack Weight increasing according to the boss's slime. Save a powerful skill to stop its combined Poison, SP loss, and Larva application.
messages.この広域は戦闘開始時に粘液10を得る。マッチ勝利で補充まで防げるわけではない。: This area attack gains 10 slime at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not prevent that replenishment.
messages.本体HP10%以下は広域を繰り返す行動になる。召喚物だけを追い続けず、本体を倒せ: At 10% overall HP or less, the boss repeatedly uses its area attack. If you can finish it, concentrate damage rather than chasing only summons.
messages.本体の数値は最大10。減少すると次ターンに同名の召喚個体が出現する。召喚個体は最: The boss's status has a maximum of 10. When it decreases, summoned units with the same name appear next turn. There can be up to 3 summons, each with 25 HP. Predation on one restores 3 stacks.
messages.状態効果と召喚個体を区別し、捕食より先に個体を倒す。: Distinguish the status from summoned units, and defeat the summons before Predation.
messages.ターン終了時に数値分のHPダメージを受け、その後数値が半分になる。: At Turn End, take HP damage equal to its value, then halve the value.
messages.召喚粘液を処理して追加付与を抑え、HP回復も残す。: Clear summoned slimes to limit further application, and save HP healing.
messages.ターン開始時、数値分の精神力ダメージ。終了時に現在HPが最も高い味方へ移る。: At Turn Start, take SP damage equal to its value. At Turn End, transfer to the ally with the highest current HP.
messages.付与する技への勝利と精神力回復を使う。被弾した1人だけの問題とは考えない。: Win against the skills applying it and use SP recovery. It does not remain only the first affected Sinner's problem.
messages.殻の混乱では元の耐性を保つ。真珠の専用弱化と混ぜない。: The Shell retains its normal resistances on Stagger. Do not confuse this with the Pearl's special weakening.
messages.粘液の消費・補充が戦闘開始時なら、マッチ勝利でも取り消せない。: Slime consumption and replenishment at Combat Start cannot be canceled by winning Clashes.
messages.蚕食液体の幼虫3は使用時。本体の攻撃を全て止めても精神力管理が必要になる。: “Devouring Fluid” applies 3 Larva [On Use]. SP management remains necessary even if you stop all Attack Skills.
messages.回避成功でも毒を付けられる。溢れ出した毒は別の守備で相殺するなど、回避を何度も再: Successful Evades can also inflict Poison. Offset “Overflowing Poison” with another Defense Skill to avoid letting the enemy reuse it repeatedly.
messages.主力は推奨Lv40。イシュメールにはダンジョンの補助を使い、初手の低精神力を回復: Aim for the recommended Level 40. Use the dungeon aid for Ishmael, supporting her low opening SP with recovery or resistances.
messages.幼虫付与を止める高威力マッチ、召喚粘液用の速い攻撃・広域、HP・精神力回復を用意: Prepare powerful Clashes against Larva application, fast attacks or area damage for summons, and HP/SP recovery.
messages.精神力低下の連鎖を止める。: Stop the chain of SP loss.
messages.捕食による補充と終了時の毒を減らす。: Reduce Predation replenishment and Turn End Poison.
messages.粘液0の隙に本体HPを進める。: Use the 0-slime opening to reduce overall HP.
messages.粘液10で開始し、攻撃の戦闘開始時効果で消費する。: Starts with 10 slime and consumes it through attacks' Combat Start effects.
messages.部位破壊後も追撃可能。破壊時はその部位の行動がキャンセルされる。: Remains targetable after breaking. Breaking the Part cancels its actions at that moment.
messages.本体の粘液が0のターン開始時は専用混乱と真珠の耐性弱化。通常の混乱と区別する。: At Turn Start with 0 slime, the boss enters a special Stagger and the Pearl's resistances weaken. Distinguish this from normal Stagger.
messages.混乱しても元の耐性を保つ。通常の混乱だけで大幅に柔らかくなるとは考えない。: Retains its normal resistances on Stagger. Ordinary Stagger does not make it dramatically easier to damage.
messages.最大3体。行動はしないが、終了時のパッシブで毒を付与する。: Up to 3. They do not act, but their Turn End passive inflicts Poison.
messages.本体に捕食されると粘液3を補充するため、先に倒す。: The boss's Predation restores 3 slime when it eats one, so defeat it first.
messages.本体を倒すと自動的に撃破される。終盤は本体を倒し切る判断も使う。: Automatically defeated when the boss dies. In the final stretch, consider finishing the boss instead.
messages.勝って毒の的中付与を防ぐ。戦闘開始時の粘液消費と次ターンの召喚は勝利だけでは止ま: Win to prevent Poison on hit. Winning alone does not cancel Combat Start slime consumption or next turn's summon.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の毒だけ防御レベル減少を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Defense Level Down equal to the target's Poison.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の毒だけ防御レベル減少を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict Defense Level Down equal to the target's Poison.
messages.幼虫と毒に応じた防御Lv減少を付ける。毒性粘液より精神力への影響が大きく、勝てる: Inflicts Larva and Poison-based Defense Level Down. Its SP impact is greater than “Toxic Fluid”'s, so assign a main unit who can win.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象に毒があれば、麻痺1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Poison, inflict 1 Paralyze.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象に毒があれば、麻痺1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Poison, inflict 1 Paralyze.
messages.各コインで幼虫2。毒のある相手には麻痺も付くため、優先してマッチを止める。: Each Coin applies 2 Larva. Poisoned targets also receive Paralyze, so prioritize stopping this Clash.
messages.最大16の2枚技。使用時の幼虫3は勝利でも残る。的中の毒と次ターン麻痺を防ぎ、回: A 2-Coin skill rolling up to 16. The 3 Larva applied [On Use] remains even if you win. Prevent Poison and next-turn Paralyze on hit, and prepare recovery.
messages.[戦闘開始時]緑色の粘液だけ攻撃加重値が増加: [Combat Start] Increase Attack Weight by Green Slime's value.
messages.[表面的中時]次のターンに麻痺1,防御レベル減少3を付与: [Heads Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze and 3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.最大25の広域。粘液に応じた加重値増加と10補充は戦闘開始時。強いマッチで的中を: An area attack rolling up to 25. Slime-based Attack Weight and replenishment of 10 apply at Combat Start. Prevent hits with a strong Clash, then handle slimes after replenishment too.
messages.boss-copy:walking-pearl:skills.5.name: Predation
messages.緑色の粘液を攻撃時に倒す: Defeat Green Slime when attacking it.
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可で召喚粘液を倒す。囚人がマッチするのではなく、速い攻撃で: An unclashable, unredirectable attack that defeats a summoned slime. Use faster attacks to defeat its target and prevent replenishment rather than attempting to Clash with a Sinner.
messages.[回避成功時]対象に毒5を付与: [On Evade] Inflict 5 Poison on the target.
messages.回避成功のたびに毒5。守備で相殺するか強い攻撃で突破し、弱い多段攻撃を無計画に当: Each successful Evade inflicts 5 Poison. Offset with a Defense Skill or break through with a strong attack; avoid unplanned weak multi-hit attacks.
messages.ターン開始時、自分の緑色の粘液が0なら混乱状態になる。真珠の属性耐性が0.5ずつ: At Turn Start, if this unit has 0 Green Slime, become Staggered and reduce the Pearl's Sin resistances by 0.5 each. When Stagger ends, gain 10 Green Slime.
messages.専用混乱の隙に真珠を集中する。通常の混乱・殻の耐性とは区別する。: Focus the Pearl during the special Stagger opening. Distinguish this from ordinary Stagger and the Shell's resistances.
messages.蚕食液体を使用するターンに速度が1になる。: Speed becomes 1 on turns using “Devouring Fluid”.
messages.速度1になり、召喚粘液を先に処理しやすい。: Speed falls to 1, making it easier to remove summons before the boss acts.
messages.貝殻部位は混乱しても本来の耐性を保つ。: The Shell Part retains its original resistances even while Staggered.
messages.殻は元の耐性を保つため、真珠への集中を優先する。: The Shell retains its normal resistances, so prioritize focusing the Pearl.
messages.歩く真珠に倒されるとき、緑色の粘液3を付与。: When defeated by Ambling Pearl, grant 3 Green Slime.
messages.速い囚人で粘液を先に倒し、3補充を防ぐ。: Defeat the slime with a faster Sinner to prevent replenishment of 3 stacks.
messages.ターン終了時、全ての敵へ毒を(2+生存している緑色の粘液)だけ付与。: At Turn End, inflict Poison on all enemies equal to 2 + the number of living Green Slimes.
messages.生き残る個体ごとに毒が発生する。行動しなくても放置しない。: Each surviving slime applies Poison. Do not leave them alone just because they have no actions.
messages.【リンバス】5-36 エイハブ・クィークェグ・スターバックの攻略｜Limbus: 5-36 Ahab / Queequeg / Starbuck Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-36「エイハブ・クィークェグ・スター: Ahab / Queequeg / Starbuck guide for Limbus Company 5-36. Stop Starbuck's attacks early and prepare for Ahab's orders. Assign a Sinner to take Prey Mark and others to deplete the Assist Barrier.
messages.攻撃役のスターバックを早めに止め、エイハブの命令に備えよう。獲物の印を受ける役と: Stop Starbuck's attacks early and prepare for Ahab's orders. Assign a Sinner to take Prey Mark and others to deplete the Assist Barrier.
messages.まずはスターバックの混乱・撃破を狙い、攻撃回数を減らす。: Stagger or defeat Starbuck first to reduce enemy attacks.
messages.「最後まで追跡しろ！」は貫通に耐える囚人で受け、次のターンの集中攻撃に備える。: Let a Pierce-resistant Sinner face “Track Them to the End!”, preparing for focused attacks next turn.
messages.援護防御中はクィークェグのバリアを削る。エイハブとのマッチを無理に作ろうとしない: During Assist Defense, deplete Queequeg's Shield rather than forcing Clashes with Ahab.
messages.援護防御が攻撃先をクィークェグへ移している。操作ミスではない。印を受けた役の耐久: Assist Defense redirects your attacks to Queequeg. This is intended. Keep the marked defender alive and deplete the Shield, or Stagger Ahab on the order turn to cancel it.
messages.1人に攻撃が集中して倒される: One Sinner takes every attack and falls
messages.獲物の印が付いていないか確認。印は被ダメージも50%増やすため、付く前に耐久役へ: Check for Prey Mark. It also increases damage taken by 50%, so redirect the mark-applying attack to a durable Sinner beforehand. Ishmael's survival condition from Ricardo's fight does not apply here.
messages.削ったのに全回復される: Ahab fully heals after you damage her
messages.エイハブは前半でHP50%未満になるか所定の行動を終えると、後半へ移って回復する: In the first half, falling below 50% HP or completing the specified action pattern triggers the second half and healing. Stopping Starbuck first is easier to manage than spending all damage on Ahab immediately.
messages.610 → 後半に645へ回復: 610 → heals to 645 in the second half
messages.部位HP60%・30%（前半366・183）: 60% / 30% Part HP (366 / 183 in the first half)
messages.5章ダンジョン3層の3人戦。E.G.O形態の最終戦や鏡屈折鉄道の個体とは別。: The 3-person encounter on Floor 3 of the Canto V dungeon. Separate from the final E.G.O fight and Refraction Railway versions.
messages.前半では撃破できず、HP50%未満または行動パターン5の終了で後半へ。自分のバフ: Cannot be defeated in the first half. Below 50% HP or after action pattern 5 ends, transitions to the second half, removing her buffs, debuffs, and Stagger while restoring overall and Part HP.
messages.後半へ移る際に本体の最大HPは645になるが、部位の最大HPは変わらない。: Overall Max HP becomes 645 during the transition, but Part Max HP does not change.
messages.エイハブを倒すとほかの2人も倒れ、戦闘に勝利する。: Defeating Ahab also defeats the other 2 enemies and wins the battle.
messages.エイハブへの攻撃を引き受ける耐久役。HP0で一度だけ最大HPの50%まで回復する: A durable defender who intercepts attacks aimed at Ahab. Once per battle at 0 HP, recovers to 50% of Max HP.
messages.混乱中は援護防御が働かない。後半はバリアを削り切るだけでは混乱しないため、通常の: Assist Defense does not function while Staggered. In the second half, depleting the Shield alone no longer causes Stagger; aim for normal Stagger Thresholds.
messages.マイナスの混乱区間は資料の表記。通常のHPだけで到達する区間ではなく、混乱区間を: Negative Stagger Thresholds are listed as in the source. Normal HP loss alone does not reach them; effects that move Stagger Thresholds are involved.
messages.攻撃回数とコイン再使用が危険な攻撃役。3人の中でHPが低く、混乱区間も多い。: A dangerous attacker with many attacks and Coin reuse. Has the lowest HP of the 3 and multiple Stagger Thresholds.
messages.混乱中は援護攻撃が働かない。早めに止めると、通常攻撃と追加の一方攻撃を減らせる。: Assist Attack does not function while Staggered. Stopping him early reduces both regular attacks and extra unopposed attacks.
messages.スターバックを止め、受け役を残す: Stop Starbuck and preserve your defender
messages.スターバックに貫通などの強い攻撃を集め、最初の混乱区間へ押し込む。ほかの危険な攻: Focus strong attacks such as Pierce on Starbuck to reach his first Stagger Threshold. Win other dangerous Clashes and use Defense Skills to offset Evades where needed.
messages.エイハブを早く削りすぎると後半へ進む。準備ができていない場合はスターバック処理と: Damaging Ahab too quickly advances the second half. If unprepared, handle Starbuck and build resources first.
Save HP and SP on a Pierce-resistant defender for the coming focused attacks. Check E.G.O resources carried through the dungeon too.
messages.「最後まで追跡しろ！」とマッチする役は、次のターンに集中攻撃を受ける。貫通耐性・: The Sinner Clashing with “Track Them to the End!” receives focused attacks next turn. Assign a defender after checking Pierce resistance, Sin resistances, and HP.
messages.印は使用時、命令は戦闘開始時に発動する。マッチに勝つだけで、次ターンの仕組みが消: The mark applies [On Use], while orders activate at Combat Start. Winning the Clash does not cancel next turn's mechanics.
messages.別の方法として、命令したエイハブをこのターンに混乱させると命令を取り消せる。前半: Alternatively, Staggering Ahab on the order turn cancels it. In the first half, aim for her 60% HP Stagger Threshold, but avoid excessive damage: falling below 50% triggers the transition and healing.
messages.受け役を守りながら、バリアを削り切る: Protect your defender while fully depleting the Shield
messages.援護防御中はエイハブへの攻撃がクィークェグへ移り、エイハブとマッチできない。印を: Assist Defense redirects attacks aimed at Ahab to Queequeg, preventing Clashes with Ahab. Prepare Protection and healing for the marked Sinner.
messages.クィークェグの援護防御バリアをそのターンに削り切ることを目指す。残すと援護が続き: Aim to fully deplete Queequeg's Assist Barrier that turn. Leaving it active prolongs assistance and makes Ahab harder to attack.
messages.前半ならバリアを使い切らせることで次ターンのクィークェグの混乱を狙える。スターバ: In the first half, depleting it can Stagger Queequeg next turn. If Starbuck remains, Stagger or defeat him to stop extra attacks too.
messages.エイハブが回復して後半へ: Ahab heals and enters the second half
messages.減算スキルと通常の混乱区間に注意する: Watch negative-Coin skills and normal Stagger Thresholds
messages.取り巻きの攻撃が減算コイン中心へ変化する。敵の精神力が低いほど強くなるので、前半: The crew mainly switches to negative-Coin attacks. Low enemy SP strengthens them, so do not reuse first-half Clash predictions.
messages.クィークェグはバリアを削り切っても、その効果では混乱しなくなる。命令ターンに通常: Depleting Queequeg's Shield no longer causes Stagger through that effect. Consider reaching a normal HP Stagger Threshold on the order turn.
messages.エイハブを混乱させて命令を止める方法も使える。ただし移行を挟んでも既に出た援護が: Staggering Ahab can also stop orders. Assistance already active may persist across the transition, so check the actual attack targets.
messages.スターバックを止めて援護を処理できたら、エイハブの撃破へ火力を集める。全員を倒し: Once Starbuck is stopped and assistance handled, focus damage on defeating Ahab. You do not have to finish all enemies separately.
messages.[使用時] 自分と、自分以外で精神力が最も低い味方1名の精神力を10回復。: [On Use] Heal 10 SP for self and the other ally with the lowest SP.
messages.回避は守備で相殺して攻撃を通す。的中効果を防ぐのと異なり、使用時の精神力回復まで: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill to land attacks. Unlike preventing hit effects, this does not necessarily cancel [On Use] SP healing.
messages.[戦闘開始時] クィークェグへ次のターンの援護防御命令。エイハブが混乱すると命令: [Combat Start] Order Queequeg to use Assist Defense next turn. Cancel the order if Ahab becomes Staggered.
messages.このターンのエイハブの混乱を狙うか、次のバリアを削る準備をする。守備の相殺だけで: Aim to Stagger Ahab this turn or prepare to deplete the next Shield. Offsetting alone cannot cancel the order.
messages.[戦闘開始時] スターバックへ次のターンの援護攻撃命令。エイハブが混乱すると命令: [Combat Start] Order Starbuck to use Assist Attack next turn. Cancel the order if Ahab becomes Staggered.
messages.[使用時] 対象へ次のターンの獲物の印1を付与。: [On Use] Inflict 1 Prey Mark on the target next turn.
messages.耐久役で引き受ける。マッチに勝っても印は付くため、次ターンまで含めて担当を選ぶ。: Assign a durable Sinner. The mark applies even if you win, so account for next turn when choosing the opponent.
messages.止められる間はマッチで出血を防ぐ。援護中の一方攻撃は印の役の耐性と保護で受ける。: Prevent Bleed with Clashes while possible. During assistance, use the marked defender's resistances and Protection against unopposed attacks.
messages.メイン対象のマイナス効果1種類につき最終威力+1。最大5。対象の出血1につきダメ: Gain +1 Final Power per negative effect type on the main target, up to 5. Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 対象の出血の数値だけ火傷を付与。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict Burn equal to the target's Bleed value.
messages.表示3〜12より強くなり得る。出血や弱体化がたまった味方へ通すと、威力とダメージ: Can exceed the listed 3–12. Targets carrying Bleed and debuffs increase both its power and damage.
messages.[回避成功時] 対象の精神力を5減らす。: [On Evade] Reduce the target's SP by 5.
messages.守備で相殺してから攻撃。避けられ続けて主力の精神力を落とさないようにする。: Offset with a Defense Skill before attacking. Avoid letting repeated Evades drain your main units' SP.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 自分以外の味方2名に呼吸4を付与。味方がいなければ自分の呼吸回数: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Grant 4 Poise to 2 other allies. If no allies remain, gain 2 Poise Count instead.
messages.印を再び付ける攻撃。目先のマッチ勝率だけでなく次の集中攻撃に耐えられる役を選ぶ。: Applies the mark again. Choose someone who can survive the next focused attacks rather than considering only the current Clash odds.
messages.[使用時] 自分の精神力を10回復し、自分以外で精神力が最も高い味方1名の精神力: [On Use] Heal 10 own SP and reduce the other ally with the highest SP by 10 SP.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[的中時] それぞれ対象の火傷回数+1。次のターン、自分以外のランダ: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase the target's Burn Count by 1 and inflict 1 Paralyze on one random other ally next turn.
messages.エイハブは高精神力、取り巻きは低精神力へ向かいやすい。取り巻きの減算スキルまで含: Ahab tends toward high SP while her crew falls to low SP. Include their negative-Coin skills when checking predictions.
messages.[使用時] 精神力が最も低い味方1名へ逆らえぬ命令。: [On Use] Grant Undefiable Command to the ally with the lowest SP.
messages.[マッチ敗北] 精神力が最も低い味方1名の混乱区間を20前進。: [Clash Lose] Raise the Stagger Threshold of the ally with the lowest SP by 20.
messages.マッチできるなら勝利を狙い、的中の脆弱を防ぐ。援護中は一方攻撃になる点に注意。: Win the Clash where possible to prevent Fragile on hit. During assistance, it becomes an unopposed attack.
messages.通常時のマッチ候補。出血を積ませず精神力を上げたい。: A normal Clash candidate. Prevent Bleed while building SP.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに攻撃レベル減少3と束縛2を付与。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down and 2 Bind next turn.
messages.次ターンのマッチ・対象変更を邪魔する。主力へ通さないようにする。: Disrupts next turn's Clashes and redirection. Keep it away from main attackers.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 出血1を付与。[クリティカル的中時] ダメージ量の50%だけ対象: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bleed. [On Crit] Raise the target's Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.呼吸があると混乱まで押し込まれやすい。強いスキルやE.G.Oで止める候補。: Poise makes it more likely to push a target into Stagger. Consider stopping it with a strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.クリティカルで呼吸回数を消費しない。対象の出血1につきダメージ量+5%。: Critical Hits do not consume Poise Count. Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.
messages.[使用時] 自分に呼吸がなければターン終了時に混乱。: [On Use] If this unit has no Poise, become Staggered at Turn End.
messages.Ⅰ：クリティカル時のダメージ量+50%。[的中時] 対象を次のターンに混乱させる: Ⅰ：Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit. [On Hit] Stagger the target next turn.
messages.的中するとHPが残っていても次ターン混乱する。広域のため、勝てる担当で止めたい。: A hit Staggers the target next turn even if HP remains. As an area attack, it is worth stopping with a reliable winner.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 呼吸3と呼吸回数5を得る。このターンは自分の呼吸威力だけ最終威力: [Combat Start] Gain 3 Poise and 5 Poise Count. Gain Final Power equal to own Poise Potency this turn; lose 1 Poise Count whenever damaged.
messages.表の8〜9は呼吸の加算前。バリア処理と合わせ、複数回の攻撃で呼吸回数を削る。: The listed 8–9 excludes the Poise bonus. Use multiple hits to reduce Poise Count while depleting the Shield.
messages.[ターン開始時] このスキルを使い、援護防御バリアが0より大きければ援護防御が発: [Turn Start] If using this skill with Assist Barrier above 0, activate Assist Defense.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 最大HPの10%分の援護防御バリアを得る。: [Combat Start] Gain Assist Barrier equal to 10% of Max HP.
messages.エイハブに向けた攻撃先が移る原因。バリアを削り切るか、通常の混乱で援護を止める。: This redirects attacks aimed at Ahab. Deplete the Shield or cause normal Stagger to stop assistance.
messages.スターバックと同じ対象を攻撃するなら最終威力+2。: Gain +2 Final Power if attacking the same target as Starbuck.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 本体・部位のHPをダメージ量の50%回復。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 結縛を付与し、本体・部位のHPをダメージ量の50%回復。: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict Tangle and heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.捕獲と重なると混乱する。低精神力ほど裏が出て強くなるため、相手の精神力も確認する: Combining Tangle with Capture causes Stagger. Low SP favors stronger Tails rolls, so check the enemy's SP too.
messages.援護を長引かせると危険な広域が来る。マッチで止めるか、前のターンから混乱の準備を: Prolonged assistance leads to a dangerous area attack. Stop it with a Clash or prepare Stagger from the preceding turn.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[的中時] それぞれ出血回数+1。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.
messages.ほかの敵が付けた出血を長持ちさせる。早めに混乱させて攻撃回数を減らす。: Extends Bleed applied by other enemies. Stagger him early to reduce attack count.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 次のターンに脆弱1を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに防御レベル減少2を付与。[表面的中時] このコインを: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn. [Heads Hit] Reuse this Coin, up to 3 times.
messages.コイン数欄は再使用前の2枚。通すと攻撃回数と弱体化が増えるので、マッチ勝利か行動: The listed 2 Coins exclude reuse. Letting it hit increases attacks and debuffs, so prioritize winning the Clash or Staggering him before he acts.
messages.[ターン開始時] クィークェグの援護防御バリアが0より大きければ援護攻撃を発動。: [Turn Start] If Queequeg's Assist Barrier is above 0, activate Assist Attack.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血回数+1。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.
messages.エイハブの攻撃後に追加の一方攻撃が来る。スターバックの混乱・撃破か、バリア処理で: An extra unopposed attack follows Ahab's attack. Limit damage by Staggering or defeating Starbuck, or by depleting the Shield.
messages.クリティカル時のダメージ量+50%。対象の出血1につきダメージ量+5%。: Deal +50% damage on Critical Hit and +5% damage per Bleed on the target.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血回数+3。[クリティカル的中時] ダメージ量の50%だけ対象: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3. [On Crit] Raise the target's first Stagger Threshold by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.出血と呼吸が重なると大きな被害になる。印の役が既に混乱しそうなら特に注意する。: Bleed and Poise together cause heavy damage. Be especially careful if the marked defender is near Stagger.
messages.精神力が低いと強くなりやすい。次に使うクリティカル攻撃へも備える。: Tends to grow stronger at low SP. Prepare for the following critical attack too.
messages.クィークェグと同じ対象を攻撃するなら最終威力+2。: Gain +2 Final Power if attacking the same target as Queequeg.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 捕獲と、次のターンの防御レベル減少5を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict Capture. Inflict 5 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 次のターンに脆弱1を付与。[裏面的中時] このコインを再使用。最: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn. [Tails Hit] Reuse this Coin, up to 3 times.
messages.結縛との重複で混乱し、再使用で被害も増える。コイン2枚だけの攻撃と考えず強いマッ: Combining Capture with Tangle causes Stagger, while reuse increases damage. Stop it with a strong Clash rather than treating it as only 2 hits.
messages.クリティカル時のダメージ量+100%。対象の出血1につきダメージ量+5%。: Deal +100% damage on Critical Hit and +5% damage per Bleed on the target.
messages.基本威力20の減算攻撃。敵が低精神力でも弱くならないので、予測と耐性を見て止める: A negative-Coin attack with 20 Base Power. Low enemy SP does not weaken it; check predictions and resistances when answering it.
messages.自分以外の生存する味方の数だけ攻撃・防御レベルが増加。: Increase Offense and Defense Levels by the number of other living allies.
messages.取り巻きを倒すと、敵の手数だけでなくこの強化も減る。: Defeating crew members reduces this buff as well as enemy actions.
messages.開始時、精神力が-45でなければ15回復。終了時にパニックなら解除して精神力を0: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at -45 SP. At Turn End, if in Panic, remove it and reset SP to 0.
messages.精神力が上がりやすい。長期戦では高い表確率を前提に対処する。: SP rises easily. In longer fights, prepare for high Heads odds.
messages.自分以外の味方全員の精神力を0に戻す。: Reset all other allies' SP to 0.
messages.混乱は命令の取り消しにもつながる。ただし低精神力の減算攻撃には別の注意が必要。: Stagger also helps cancel orders, but low-SP negative-Coin attacks still need separate care.
messages.エイハブがHPを回復。クィークェグとスターバックの「船長の命令」が発動しなくなる: Ahab heals. Captain's Orders stops activating for Queequeg and Starbuck.
messages.取り巻きは精神力を維持しにくくなり、減算スキルへ切り替わる。前半と同じ対処を続け: Her crew has less SP recovery and switches to negative-Coin skills. Adjust your first-half strategy.
messages.前半のターン開始時: Turn Start in the first half
messages.精神力が-45でなければ、自分以外の生存味方数×5だけ精神力を回復。開始時に-4: Unless at -45 SP, heal SP equal to the number of other living allies × 5. If at -45 at Turn Start, remove Panic and reset SP to 0 at Turn End.
messages.前半の精神力回復を支える。後半では発動しない。: Provides first-half SP recovery. Does not activate in the second half.
messages.混乱後の精神力も確認。高精神力がそのまま残るとは限らない。: Check SP after Stagger too. Previous high SP may not remain.
messages.ピークォドタウン所属の味方が倒れる: An allied Pequod Town member is defeated
messages.スターバック撃破で呼吸も減らせるが、後半の減算攻撃は低精神力で強くなる。: Defeating Starbuck also reduces Poise, but second-half negative-Coin attacks grow stronger at low SP.
messages.削りかけで放置するなら攻撃への対処を残す。: If leaving her partially damaged, save answers to her attacks.
messages.最大HPの50%まで回復し、次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る。: Recover to 50% of Max HP and gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.一度HP0にしても処理が終わらない。初心者向けの基本方針では、先にスターバックを: Reaching 0 HP once does not finish her. The basic beginner strategy stops Starbuck first.
messages.スキルで付与するマイナス効果の数値が1増える。: Increase the value of negative effects inflicted by skills by 1.
messages.呼吸がある攻撃を通すと弱体化も重くなる。: Letting Poise attacks hit also means stronger debuffs.
messages.ターン終了時HP50%未満・戦闘中1回: Below 50% HP at Turn End / once per battle
messages.次のターンにクイック2と攻撃威力増加2を得る。: Gain 2 Haste and 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.半分まで削ったら次は混乱・撃破までつなぎ、強化された反撃の機会を与えないようにす: After reducing HP by half, push on to Stagger or defeat rather than giving the buffed enemy a chance to retaliate.
messages.パニックタイプ変更効果を受ける: Receives a Panic Type change effect
messages.パニックタイプを変えることを前提にしない。: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.
messages.ピークォド船員の攻撃対象になり、彼らから受けるダメージが50%増える。: Prioritized by Pequod crew attacks and takes 50% more damage from them.
messages.付く前に耐久役で引き受ける。付いてから全攻撃を別の味方へ移せるとは考えない。: Redirect the applying attack to a defender beforehand. Do not assume every attack can be redirected away afterward.
messages.エイハブへの攻撃先がクィークェグの枠へ移る。援護する側のスロット加重値が無限に増: Attacks aimed at Ahab move to Queequeg's slots. The assisting unit's slot weight increases without limit.
messages.エイハブへの広域攻撃も思ったとおりに当たらない場合がある。クィークェグの混乱かバ: Area attacks aimed at Ahab may not land as expected either. Prioritize Staggering Queequeg or depleting her Shield.
messages.受けたダメージ分だけ減り、ターンをまたいで残る。前半はターン終了時に0なら次のタ: Decreases by damage taken and persists across turns. In the first half, reaching 0 at Turn End causes Stagger next turn. This Stagger effect does not occur in the second half.
messages.1ターンで削り切ることを目指す。後半は通常のHP混乱を別に狙う。: Aim to fully deplete it in 1 turn. In the second half, pursue normal HP Stagger separately.
messages.エイハブの攻撃スキル終了後、同じ対象へスターバックが一方攻撃する。反撃スキルと同: After Ahab's Attack Skill ends, Starbuck attacks the same target unopposed using his Counter skill's Coins, effects, and Offense Level.
messages.エイハブの攻撃だけの被害で計算しない。スターバックを先に止める理由のひとつ。: Do not calculate incoming damage from Ahab's attacks alone. This is one reason to stop Starbuck first.
messages.同じ対象に両方が付くと混乱する。既に混乱している対象には重ねて適用されない。: Having both on the same target causes Stagger. Does not apply again to an already Staggered target.
messages.後半の2人の銛を同じ囚人へ通さない。HPに余裕があっても混乱する。: Avoid letting both second-half harpoon attacks hit the same Sinner. Stagger can occur even with plenty of HP.
messages.スキル使用時に現HPの10%を失い、最終威力+1。的中するとエイハブの精神力が8: On skill use, lose 10% of current HP and gain +1 Final Power. On hit, heal Ahab by 8 SP and grant both units 2 Poise.
messages.使用者が削れていても攻撃は強化される。後半のマッチ予測を確認する。: The user's attack is strengthened even while losing HP. Check second-half Clash predictions.
messages.リカルド戦とは違い、イシュメールも通常どおり倒れる。必須出撃を無敵と読み替えない: Unlike Ricardo's fight, Ishmael can be defeated normally here. Mandatory deployment does not mean invulnerability.
messages.前半から後半へ移っても、既に出た援護が残る場合がある。フェーズを進めれば必ず解除: Assistance already active may persist into the second half. Advancing the phase does not guarantee removing it.
messages.クィークェグのバリアを削り切って起こす混乱と、通常のHP区間による混乱は別。後半: Stagger from depleting Queequeg's Shield differs from normal HP Stagger. The former does not occur in the second half.
messages.コイン再使用は表示枚数に含めない。特にスターバックは的中後に攻撃が増えるため、マ: Coin reuse is not included in the displayed count. Starbuck in particular gains extra attacks after hitting, making his Clashes valuable to stop.
messages.主力はLv40を目安に育てる。イシュメールが必須であることと、耐久役を別に用意で: Aim for Level 40 on your main units. Ishmael is mandatory, but you can prepare another Sinner as the defender.
messages.貫通耐性の耐久役を用意。HPだけでなく、暴食・傲慢・嫉妬など受ける攻撃の罪悪耐性: Prepare a Pierce-resistant defender. Check Sin resistances to incoming attacks such as Gluttony, Pride, and Envy as well as HP.
messages.スターバックとエイハブには貫通、クィークェグには打撃が有効。まずマッチに勝てるス: Pierce works against Starbuck and Ahab; Blunt works against Queequeg. First secure winning skills, then exploit weaknesses among those options.
messages.保護・回復・敵の攻撃威力減少を使うなら、必要なE.G.O資源をダンジョン中に準備: Prepare E.G.O resources within the dungeon for Protection, healing, or enemy Attack Power Down. No specific high-rarity Identity is required.
messages.貫通耐性とHPを持ち、印が付く攻撃を引き受けられる役。次の集中攻撃へ保護・回復も: A Sinner with Pierce resistance and HP who can take the mark-applying attack. Support them with Protection and healing for next turn's focused attacks.
messages.初手から混乱を狙い、コイン再使用と援護攻撃を減らす。: Aim for Stagger immediately to reduce Coin reuse and Assist Attack.
messages.エイハブの混乱区間を調整するか、クィークェグへ打撃などを集める。命令ターンと次の: Set up Ahab's Stagger Threshold or focus Blunt and other damage on Queequeg. Shift roles between the order turn and the following assistance turn.
messages.【リンバス】5-36 夢貪る濁流（5章）の攻略｜Limbus Assistant: 5-36 Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent (Canto V) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-36「夢貪る濁流（5章）」の攻略。2: Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent (Canto V) guide for Limbus Company 5-36. Stop turn 2's Blind Obsession with a skill that wins under Paralyze. Destroy Flotsam to trigger self-damage through “Wayward Blind Obsession”. Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit recurring Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss before it regenerates.
messages.5-36「Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Assembl: 5-36 · Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Assembly Point Before the Heart
messages.通常5章個体。本体HP1102と胴体882・蛍光灯330は別の値で、部位の合計を: The regular Canto V encounter. Overall HP is 1102, Body HP is 882, and Fluorescent Lamp HP is 330; Part HP is not added to determine overall HP. The Lamp remains targetable and can act after breaking, then regenerates 2 turns later. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.
messages.最初の盲目へ、麻痺を考慮した高い基本威力・減算技を用意する。: Prepare high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills for the first Blind Obsession, accounting for Paralyze.
messages.漂流物を破壊し、次の盲目を彷徨う盲目へ変える条件を作る。: Destroy Flotsam to meet the condition that changes the next Blind Obsession into “Wayward Blind Obsession”.
messages.蛍光灯を壊して麻痺・束縛を抑え、本体へ攻撃を通す。: Break the Fluorescent Lamp to limit Paralyze and Bind, then damage the boss.
messages.普段は強いE.G.Oなのに盲目へ負ける: Normally strong E.G.O loses to Blind Obsession
messages.2ターン目から麻痺1が付き、1回分のコイン威力が0になる。コイン加算に頼らない高: From turn 2, 1 Paralyze sets Coin Power to 0 for one roll. Use high Base Power or negative Coins that do not rely on Plus Coin Power, or apply enemy power debuffs the turn before.
messages.12未満のダメージは堅牢で無効になる。小さいダメージを何回も積むより、1回ごとの: Harden nullifies damage below 12. Use strong attacks that deal at least 12 per hit rather than many small hits.
messages.蛍光灯を壊したのに沈潜が付く: Sinking still applies after the Lamp breaks
messages.蛍光灯の破片で防げるのは、濁流パッシブの毎ターンの麻痺・束縛・精神力低下。攻撃自: Fluorescence Shard prevents Siltcurrent's recurring Paralyze, Bind, and SP loss. It does not prevent all Sinking from attacks; some skills even increase Sinking Count on targets with the Shard.
messages.麻痺が付いた最初の盲目への回答を作る: Prepare an answer to the first Blind Obsession under Paralyze
messages.推奨Lv40・出撃上限6名。2ターン目の盲目は15〜23で、味方の麻痺1も考慮す: Recommended Level 40; deployment limit 6. Turn 2's Blind Obsession rolls 15–23, with 1 Paralyze affecting your Sinners. Bring high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills.
messages.ムルソーの他人の鎖を使うなら1ターン目に当て、2ターン目の弱体化を準備する。担当: If using Meursault's Chains of Others, land it on turn 1 to prepare turn 2's debuffs. Save its E.G.O resources and the user's SP too.
messages.人数を減らして主力へ追加スロットを渡す方法もあるが、手数の少ない初手が不安定にな: Deploying fewer Sinners can give extra slots to your main units, but fewer opening actions make the start less stable. First try 6 Sinners with assigned answers to dangerous skills and Flotsam.
messages.マッチ不可の地形変化へ無理に勝とうとしない: Do not try to win against the unclashable terrain change
messages.襲いかかる濁流はマッチ不可。高威力E.G.Oでマッチして地形変化を止めることはで: “Crashing Siltcurrent” is unclashable. Powerful E.G.O cannot Clash with it to stop the terrain change. Handle regular Clashes and prepare for next turn instead.
messages.2ターン目から、蛍光灯の破片を持たない囚人へ麻痺1・束縛1・精神力−3が入る。初: From turn 2, Sinners without Fluorescence Shard receive 1 Paralyze, 1 Bind, and -3 SP. Use opening debuffs or healing, and save your main units' answers to Blind Obsession.
messages.逆巻くのターン終了時効果で漂流物が出現する。マッチ勝利だけで出現まで消せるとは考: “Sweep” creates Flotsam at Turn End. Winning the Clash does not cancel its appearance.
messages.麻痺込みのマッチを組み、沈潜殺到を防ぐ: Win under Paralyze to prevent Sinking Deluge
messages.準備した高い基本威力・減算技を盲目へ合わせる。麻痺はコイン判定に影響するため、普: Assign your prepared high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skill to Blind Obsession. Paralyze affects Coin rolls, so do not judge only by the skill's usual maximum.
messages.複数スロットの囚人なら、先に別のマッチで麻痺を消費してから盲目へ挑む方法もある。: A Sinner with multiple slots can spend Paralyze in another Clash before facing Blind Obsession. Check action order and remaining Paralyze.
messages.盲目へ勝てば蛍光灯のHPが最大値の34%減り、敵に専用状態の盲目1が付く。勝利を: Winning against Blind Obsession removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP and gives the enemy 1 Blind Obsession status. Repeated wins also help break the Part.
messages.初回を漂流物だけで必ず回避できるとは考えず、すでに盲目が装着されている場合はマッ: Do not assume Flotsam alone can always prevent the first cast. If Blind Obsession is already slotted, prepare a winning Clash.
messages.次の盲目より前に漂流物を破壊する: Destroy Flotsam before the next Blind Obsession
messages.漂流物はHP50で、12未満のダメージを無効化する。十分な1回ダメージを出せる攻: Flotsam has 50 HP and nullifies damage below 12. Use sufficient damage per hit to turn it into Destroyed Flotsam.
messages.破壊された漂流物があると、次の盲目が彷徨う盲目へ変わる条件になる。敵がすでに装着: Destroyed Flotsam meets the condition for the next Blind Obsession to become “Wayward Blind Obsession”. Do not assume it always immediately replaces a skill the enemy has already slotted.
messages.彷徨う盲目は破壊された漂流物を狙うマッチ不可・対象変更不可技。囚人で奪わず、蛍光: “Wayward Blind Obsession” is unclashable and cannot be redirected, targeting Destroyed Flotsam. Let it resolve to damage the Lamp rather than trying to intercept it with a Sinner.
messages.漂流物を放置して盲目を使わせると、終了時にランダムな囚人へ20ダメージを与えるパ: If intact Flotsam remains when Blind Obsession is used, its passive can deal 20 damage to a random Sinner at Turn End. Do not ignore it just because it has no actions.
messages.破片の支援を得たら本体へ攻撃を通す: Use Shard support to damage the boss
messages.直接攻撃と、盲目への勝利・彷徨う盲目の自傷で蛍光灯を壊す。破壊後も追撃可能。蛍光: Break the Lamp with direct attacks, Clash wins against Blind Obsession, and “Wayward Blind Obsession”'s self-damage. It remains targetable after breaking. The Lamp takes 1.5× Pierce versus the Body's 1.0×, so Pierce attackers can keep targeting it.
messages.破壊すると全囚人が蛍光灯の破片を得て、濁流パッシブの毎ターンの麻痺・束縛・精神力: Breaking it gives all Sinners Fluorescence Shard, exempting them from Siltcurrent's recurring Paralyze, Bind, and SP loss.
messages.破片は呼吸も補助するが、攻撃の沈潜には引き続き勝つ。押し潰す・逆巻くは破片持ちに: The Shard also supports Poise, but you must still stop Sinking attacks. “Press” and “Sweep” add Sinking Count against Shard carriers, so this is not complete status immunity.
messages.蛍光灯は2ターン後に再生する。漂流物の処理を続け、麻痺の少ない攻撃機会に本体を削: The Lamp regenerates 2 turns later. Keep handling Flotsam and use the opening with less Paralyze to finish the boss.
messages.蛍光灯の破壊で全囚人が得る。開始時に呼吸3・回数2。濁流パッシブの毎ターンの弱体: All Sinners gain this when the Lamp breaks. At Turn Start, gain 3 Poise and 2 Poise Count. Siltcurrent's recurring debuffs target Sinners without this effect.
messages.攻撃による沈潜まで全て防ぐ効果ではない。押し潰す・逆巻くの条件も確認する。: It does not prevent all Sinking from attacks. Also check “Press” and “Sweep”'s conditions.
messages.敵が得る専用状態は3で混乱する。囚人へ使う同名の攻撃スキルとは別で、この混乱でも: The enemy's unique status causes Stagger at 3. It is separate from the Attack Skill of the same name. Do not assume this Stagger automatically stops its actions.
messages.勝利や自傷で増やしつつ、装着中の技へ対処を続ける。: Build it through Clash wins and self-damage while continuing to answer the currently slotted skills.
messages.HP50・行動なし。削ると破壊された漂流物へ変わり、次の彷徨う盲目の条件と標的に: 50 HP; no actions. Reducing its HP turns it into Destroyed Flotsam, enabling and becoming the target of the next “Wayward Blind Obsession”.
messages.12以上の1回ダメージを通し、次の盲目の選択より前に破壊しておく。: Deal at least 12 per hit and destroy it before the next Blind Obsession is selected.
messages.ムルソーの基本E.G.O。敵へ次ターンの弱体化を準備する手段。: Meursault's base E.G.O, which can prepare enemy debuffs for next turn.
messages.初回の盲目対策として使う場合は、1ターン目に当てる。: To answer the first Blind Obsession, land it on turn 1.
messages.蛍光灯破壊でも部位の行動は続く。破壊したからマッチ不要とは考えない。: The Lamp can still act after breaking. Do not stop assigning Clashes simply because it is broken.
messages.漂流物の破壊と完全消滅は別。残った破壊物へ彷徨う盲目を使わせる。: Destroying Flotsam differs from removing it entirely. Let “Wayward Blind Obsession” target the remaining wreckage.
messages.最初の麻痺1は加算技の威力を落とす。最大威力ではなく、現在の麻痺と行動順を含めて: The initial 1 Paralyze weakens Plus Coin skills. Choose based on current Paralyze and action order rather than the usual maximum roll.
messages.専用状態の盲目による混乱中も行動への対処を続ける。混乱の演出だけで全員を一方攻撃: Continue answering attacks during Stagger from the Blind Obsession status. Do not switch everyone to unopposed attacks based only on the Stagger animation.
messages.麻痺込みでも勝つ高い基本威力・減算技、初手に当てる弱体化、HP・精神力回復を用意: Prepare high-Base-Power or negative-Coin skills that win under Paralyze, opening enemy debuffs, and HP/SP recovery.
messages.漂流物を破壊する担当と蛍光灯を削る担当を分け、傲慢・嫉妬や斬撃・貫通を使う。: Assign separate Flotsam breakers and Lamp attackers, using Pride/Envy and Slash/Pierce damage.
messages.麻痺下でも勝ち、沈潜殺到を防ぐ。: Win under Paralyze and prevent Sinking Deluge.
messages.以降の盲目を自傷技へ誘導する。: Turn later Blind Obsession casts into self-damaging skills.
messages.継続的な弱体化を抑え、主力の攻撃機会を作る。: Limit recurring debuffs and create openings for your main attackers.
messages.胴体は破壊不可。傲慢・嫉妬が通りやすく、打撃は0.5。: The Body cannot be broken. Pride and Envy are effective; Blunt deals 0.5× damage.
messages.盲目などの共通技は、混乱していない部位を優先して胴体・蛍光灯へ割り振られる。: Shared skills such as Blind Obsession are assigned between Body and Lamp, prioritizing Parts that are not Staggered.
messages.盲目の専用状態による混乱でも、予定している攻撃への対処を省略しない。: Continue answering planned attacks even during Stagger caused by the Blind Obsession status.
messages.破壊後も追撃可能・行動も続く。2ターン後に再生する。: Remains targetable and can act after breaking. Regenerates 2 turns later.
messages.盲目にマッチ敗北、または彷徨う盲目の攻撃後に、部位最大HPの34%が減る。: Losing a Clash with Blind Obsession, or completing “Wayward Blind Obsession”, removes HP equal to 34% of this Part's Max HP.
messages.破壊すると全囚人が蛍光灯の破片を得る。濁流パッシブの毎ターンの弱体化を受けにくく: Breaking it grants all Sinners Fluorescence Shard, reducing exposure to Siltcurrent's recurring debuffs.
messages.行動しない。逆巻くのターン終了時に出現する。: Does not act. Appears at Turn End from “Sweep”.
messages.12未満のダメージは無効。物理3種は2.0なので、十分な1回ダメージを通す。: Damage below 12 is nullified. All 3 physical resistances are 2.0, so use sufficient damage per hit.
messages.削ると消滅せず破壊された漂流物となり、彷徨う盲目の標的になる。: Turns into Destroyed Flotsam rather than disappearing, becoming “Wayward Blind Obsession”'s target.
messages.通常の打撃1枚技。沈潜を増やさせず、盲目へ回す強い手札は残す。: A regular 1-Coin Blunt attack. Prevent Sinking while saving strong skills for Blind Obsession.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]沈潜回数が3増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.
messages.2枚で沈潜回数を増やす。沈潜威力の高い囚人へ一方攻撃を通さない。: Both Coins increase Sinking Count. Keep unopposed hits away from Sinners with high Sinking Potency.
messages.[的中時]対象に蛍光灯の破片があれば、沈潜回数が2増加: [On Hit] If the target has Fluorescence Shard, increase Sinking Count by 2.
messages.蛍光灯の打撃技。破片持ちへは沈潜回数も増えるため、破壊後もマッチを省略しない。: The Lamp's Blunt attack also increases Sinking Count on Shard carriers. Keep Clashing with it even after the Lamp breaks.
messages.[マッチ敗北]自分の蛍光灯部位が、部位全体体力の34%分減少: [Clash Lose] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.
messages.15〜23の4枚技で最後に沈潜殺到。麻痺1込みでも勝てる高い基本威力・減算技を使: A 4-Coin skill rolling 15–23, ending with Sinking Deluge. Use high Base Power or negative Coins that can win despite 1 Paralyze. Winning removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜3を付与、沈潜回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2.
messages.[表面的中時]次のターンに精神力減少効率-2: [Heads Hit] Inflict -2 SP Loss Efficiency next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]沈潜3を付与、沈潜回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2.
messages.マッチ不可で地形を変える。強いE.G.Oでマッチしようとせず、通常技の対処と次タ: Unclashable and changes the terrain. Handle regular skills and prepare for next turn's Blind Obsession instead of attempting to Clash with powerful E.G.O.
messages.[攻撃後]自分の蛍光灯部位が、部位全体体力の34%分減少: [After Attack] This unit's Fluorescent Lamp Part loses HP equal to 34% of the Part's Max HP.
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可で破壊された漂流物を狙う。攻撃後に蛍光灯最大HP34%減: An unclashable, unredirectable attack targeting Destroyed Flotsam. After attacking, removes HP equal to 34% of the Lamp's Max HP. Let the self-damage occur rather than attempting to intercept it.
messages.ターン終了時に漂流物を生成する。勝っても終了時の生成までは消せない。出現後の処理: Creates Flotsam at Turn End. Winning does not cancel its creation, so reserve someone to handle it afterward.
messages.[戦闘開始時]全ての漂流物と破壊された漂流物を破壊: [Combat Start] Destroy all Flotsam and Destroyed Flotsam.
messages.戦闘開始時に専用状態の盲目と漂流物を全て消耗・破壊する。前のターンの破壊物がずっ: Consumes all Blind Obsession status and destroys Flotsam at Combat Start. Old wreckage will not remain usable indefinitely; check the currently slotted skill.
messages.蛍光灯部位が破壊されると、全ての敵へ蛍光灯の破片を付与。蛍光灯部位は2ターン後に: When the Lamp breaks, grant Fluorescence Shard to all enemies. The Lamp regenerates 2 turns later.
messages.破片を得て継続弱体化を抑える。再生までの攻撃機会を使う。: Use Shards to limit recurring debuffs and attack before regeneration.
messages.2ターン目から毎ターン、蛍光灯部位が破壊状態でなければこのターンに呼吸8を得て呼: Each turn from turn 2, if the Lamp is not broken, gain 8 Poise and increase Poise Count by 3 for this turn. If the Lamp is broken, gain 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down for this turn instead.
messages.破壊中は敵も麻痺2・ダメージ量減少2。主力の攻撃をまとめる。: While broken, the enemy receives 2 Paralyze and 2 Damage Down too. Concentrate your main units' attacks.
messages.2ターン目から毎ターン、蛍光灯の破片の無い人格へ束縛1、麻痺1を付与。精神力が3: Each turn from turn 2, inflict 1 Bind and 1 Paralyze on Identities without Fluorescence Shard, and reduce their SP by 3.
messages.蛍光灯を壊して毎ターンの弱体化を抑える。: Break the Lamp to limit recurring debuffs.
messages.強い1回ダメージで漂流物を壊す。小さい連打を合算して考えない。: Break Flotsam with strong individual hits. Small hits are not added together for this condition.
messages.夢貪る濁流が盲目を使用し、ターン終了時に破壊されなければランダムな人格に20ダメ: If Dream-Devouring Siltcurrent uses Blind Obsession and this unit remains intact at Turn End, deal 20 damage to a random Identity.
messages.盲目を使わせるだけでなく、漂流物も先に処理して終了時の被害を抑える。: Remove Flotsam beforehand to limit Turn End damage as well as handling Blind Obsession itself.
messages.死亡したとき、体力が0にならない。破壊された漂流物になる。: On death, HP does not reach 0. Become Destroyed Flotsam.
messages.消えずに残る標的を利用し、彷徨う盲目の自傷へつなぐ。: Use the target that remains to trigger “Wayward Blind Obsession”'s self-damage.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5-36「開花E.G.O::ガスハープー: Effloresced E.G.O::GasHarpoon guide for Limbus Company 5-36. Break Pip's Evade, win Clashes with marked Sinners against Starbuck, and break Queequeg's Shield. Reduce each form's Ego and damage it during Stagger.
messages.5-36「Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Final B: 5-36 · Into the Darkness, Floor 3: Final Battle
messages.ピップは回避を破る、スターバックは印付きの囚人でマッチに勝つ、クィークェグはバリ: Break Pip's Evade, win Clashes with marked Sinners against Starbuck, and break Queequeg's Shield. Reduce each form's Ego and damage it during Stagger.
messages.5章ストーリーの個体を掲載。3形態はそれぞれHP660。攻撃・防御Lvは資料の崇: The Canto V story encounter. Each of the 3 forms has 660 HP. Offense and Defense Levels include Price of Nobility at form start. These form bonuses are estimates in the source: +1 for Pip and +2 for the other 2 forms. SP and in-battle buffs are not fixed to these values.
messages.表示威力は条件強化前。自我による威力・加重値の増加とコイン再使用は各効果を参照。: Displayed power excludes conditional buffs. Check each effect for Ego-based power, Attack Weight, and Coin reuse. Resistances and HP differ from Mirror Dungeon versions.
messages.イシュメールは編成必須。主力はLv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、HPとE.G.O資源: Ishmael is mandatory. Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, entering with HP and E.G.O resources prepared.
messages.各形態の自我を0にして混乱を狙う。印付きの囚人や攻撃順を確認し、勝率だけで自動選: Reduce each form's Ego to 0 to cause Stagger. Check marked Sinners and action order rather than automatically choosing only by Clash odds.
messages.最後は1ターンでバリアを割り切る。前の形態で怠惰耐性のE.G.Oを使い、強いスキ: In the final form, fully break the Shield in 1 turn. Use E.G.O for Sloth resistance in an earlier form, saving strong skills and healing.
messages.不滅の魂は回避失敗でも再使用する。先に濁った潔白へマッチ勝利して守備威力を下げ、: “Undying Soul” is reused even after a failed Evade. First win against “Murky Innocence” to lower Defense Power, then break subsequent Evades to reduce Ego.
messages.獲物の印を持つ囚人がマッチに勝つ必要がある。印は使用時に次ターン分が付くので、毎: A Sinner with Prey Mark must win the Clash. The mark is applied [On Use] for next turn, so check its actual recipient each turn.
messages.最後の形態で精神力と火力が落ち続ける: SP and damage keep falling in the final form
messages.バリアが残ると自我が増え、反撃と精神力ダメージが続く。怠惰・貫通への耐性、回復、: A remaining Shield increases Ego, sustaining Counters and SP damage. Recheck Sloth/Pierce resistance, healing, and your plan to concentrate damage in the same turn.
messages.HPを削ったのに倒せない: Reducing HP does not end the fight
messages.HP1で次の形態へ進む3連戦。クィークェグのHP1で終了イベントになる。前の形態: This is a sequence of 3 forms, transitioning at 1 HP. Reaching 1 HP on Queequeg triggers the final event. Avoid spending all resources in earlier forms.
messages.HP1で形態移行。スターバック・クィークェグへ移る際は状態異常が解除され、精神力: Transitions at 1 HP. On entering Starbuck and Queequeg, statuses are removed but SP carries over.
messages.ピップの自我20から開始。回避失敗で1、罪悪感の重さ使用で3減る。: Starts with 20 Pip's Ego. Lose 1 on a failed Evade and 3 when using “Weight of Guilt”.
messages.スターバックの自我20から開始。印付きの対象とのマッチ敗北で、破壊されたコイン数: Starts with 20 Starbuck's Ego. Losing a Clash to a marked target reduces it by the number of Coins destroyed.
messages.クィークェグの自我30から開始。ターン終了時にバリアなしなら10減り、残っている: Starts with 30 Queequeg's Ego. At Turn End, lose 10 if no Shield remains; otherwise gain 5.
messages.イシュメールと、最後に使う耐性・火力を用意する: Prepare Ishmael and the final form's resistances and damage
messages.イシュメールは編成から外せず退却もできない。ほかの囚人が生存中はHP1で耐えるが: Ishmael cannot be removed from the team or retreat. While other Sinners survive, she endures at 1 HP, but this does not prevent an area attack from defeating everyone together.
messages.主力はLv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。貫通攻撃と傲慢・嫉妬が通りやすいので、育: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Pierce, Pride, and Envy are effective, so build from your trained roster.
messages.最後の反撃は怠惰・貫通。E.G.O使用後は罪悪耐性が変わるため、ピップかスターバ: The final Counter is Sloth/Pierce. E.G.O changes Sin resistances, so prepare Sloth resistance during Pip or Starbuck and save resources for healing and final-form damage.
messages.先に守備威力を下げてから回避を破る: Lower Defense Power first, then break the Evade
messages.速度の高い囚人で濁った潔白へ勝ち、敵に守備威力減少2を付ける。その後に不滅の魂へ: Win against “Murky Innocence” with a fast Sinner to apply 2 Defense Power Down. Then attack “Undying Soul”; each failed Evade reduces Ego by 1.
messages.不滅の魂は失敗しても最大2回再使用する。一般的な回避と違い、1回破れば以降すべて: “Undying Soul” can be reused up to 2 times even after failing. Unlike ordinary Evade, breaking it once does not guarantee all following attacks hit.
messages.罪悪感の重さは使用時に自我を3減らす一方、自我が多いと威力と加重値が上がる。高威: “Weight of Guilt” consumes 3 Ego [On Use], but high Ego increases its power and Attack Weight. Stop the area attack with powerful skills or E.G.O.
messages.自我0ならターン終了後に混乱する。あるいはHPの混乱区間を利用して攻め、HP1ま: At 0 Ego at Turn End, the boss Staggers next turn. You can also use HP Stagger Thresholds, then reduce it to 1 HP to advance.
messages.獲物の印が付いた囚人にマッチを任せる: Assign Clashes to Sinners with Prey Mark
messages.覆い隠された恐れ・貫かれた惰弱さは、使用時に次ターンの獲物の印を付ける。勝っても: “Swathed Fear” and “Punctured Weakness” apply next turn's Prey Mark [On Use]. Winning cannot prevent it, so check who will receive the mark next.
messages.印を持つ囚人でマッチに勝つと、破壊した敵コイン数だけ自我が減る。木霊する嘆息は5: Winning with a marked Sinner reduces Ego by the number of enemy Coins destroyed. “Echoing Cry” has 5 Coins, making it a strong way to reduce Ego.
messages.印がない囚人に木霊する嘆息を受け持たせると、コイン威力が+1される。印付きの担当: “Echoing Cry” gains +1 Coin Power against unmarked Sinners. Save a winning E.G.O for the marked Sinner and protect their HP and SP.
messages.自我0の混乱やHP混乱を使って突破。次はバリアを割る形態なので、使える強いスキル: Use 0-Ego Stagger or HP Stagger to advance. The next form requires Shield breaking, so check your remaining strong skills before transitioning.
messages.反撃への備えを済ませ、バリアを1ターンで割る: Prepare for Counters and break the Shield in 1 turn
messages.広がりゆく白化は戦闘開始時にバリアを張る。自我30ならHP25%分の165で、初: “Insidious Pallidification” grants a Shield at Combat Start. At 30 Ego, it equals 25% of Max HP, or 165, making the opening demanding. Concentrate your main units' attacks in the same turn to fully break it.
messages.反撃は自我に応じて再使用され、バリアがある間は被ダメージ時の精神力低下もある。怠: The Counter is reused according to Ego, and attacking while the Shield remains also costs SP. Preserve your damage dealers with Sloth/Pierce resistance and healing.
messages.ターン終了時にバリアがなければ自我−10、残れば+5。脱色された懺悔は使用時に−: At Turn End, no Shield means -10 Ego; a remaining Shield means +5. “Bleached Atonement” consumes 5 [On Use], but still win its Clash to prevent Forced Stagger on hit.
messages.イベントはイシュメールで判定する。成功予測を確認し、失敗しても続く判定へ進む。自: Ishmael performs the event check. Check the predicted success and continue to later checks even on failure. Use 0-Ego or 50% HP Stagger openings to reach the ending event at 1 HP.
messages.2枚とも出血の威力と回数を増やす。次の攻撃で出血が何度も発動する前に、勝てるマッ: Both Coins increase Bleed Potency and Count. Stop it with a winning Clash before subsequent attacks repeatedly trigger Bleed.
messages.最大体力が最も低い対象を攻撃: Attack the target with the lowest Max HP.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]攻撃レベル減少6を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 6 Offense Level Down.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血回数が3増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.
messages.最大HPの低い囚人を狙う。攻撃レベル低下で次のマッチまで不利になるため、速度が上: Targets the Sinner with the lowest Max HP. Offense Level Down also weakens later Clashes, so redirect it with a faster ally where possible.
messages.回避失敗時にも再使用(最大2回): Reuse even on a failed Evade, up to 2 times.
messages.[回避失敗時]ピップの自我が1減少: [On Evade Fail] Reduce Pip's Ego by 1.
messages.回避に失敗しても最大2回再使用する特殊な回避。先に濁った潔白へ勝って守備威力を下: A special Evade that can be reused up to 2 times even after failing. First beat “Murky Innocence” to lower Defense Power, then break Evades in Speed order to reduce Ego. Offsetting alone does not count as failed Evades.
messages.[マッチ敗北]守備威力減少2を得る。自分の精神力が10減少: [Clash Lose] Gain 2 Defense Power Down and lose 10 SP.
messages.エイハブがマッチに負けると守備威力が2下がる。速い囚人で先に勝ち、その後にほかの: Ahab loses 2 Defense Power when she loses this Clash. Win with a fast Sinner first, then let other Sinners break “Undying Soul” afterward.
messages.最大体力が最も低い対象3名を攻撃: Attack the 3 targets with the lowest Max HP.
messages.[戦闘開始時]ピップの自我5につき基本威力+2,攻撃加重値+1: [Combat Start] Gain +2 Base Power and +1 Attack Weight per 5 Pip's Ego.
messages.[的中時]混乱区間を30前進: [On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30.
messages.[表面的中時]対象の精神力を10減少: [Heads Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 10.
messages.ピップの自我20なら基本威力16・最大18、加重値7まで強化される。使用時に自我: At 20 Pip's Ego, this reaches 16 Base Power, a maximum roll of 18, and 7 Attack Weight. It remains a dangerous area attack even after consuming Ego [On Use]; prepare powerful E.G.O to win.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに獲物の印1を付与: [On Use] Inflict 1 Prey Mark next turn.
messages.[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が4増加: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 4.
messages.獲物の印は使用時に付くので、マッチ勝利だけでは防げない。次ターンの印付き囚人を確: Prey Mark applies [On Use], so winning the Clash cannot prevent it. Check next turn's marked Sinner and assign them Clashes that reduce Ego.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル減少3を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down next turn.
messages.マッチを止めても次ターンの印は残る。印が付いた囚人のHP・精神力と、木霊する嘆息: Stopping the attack does not remove next turn's mark. Preserve the marked Sinner's HP, SP, and an answer to “Echoing Cry”.
messages.対象の出血1につきダメージ量+5%: Deal +5% damage per Bleed on the target.
messages.対象に獲物の印が無いならコイン威力+1: If the target has no Prey Mark, gain +1 Coin Power.
messages.[的中時]ランダムな敵3名に精神力ダメージ3を付与: [On Hit] Deal 3 SP damage to 3 random enemies.
messages.[的中時]スターバックの自我10につき、最後のコインを1回再利用: [On Hit] Reuse the final Coin once per 10 Starbuck's Ego.
messages.獲物の印を持つ囚人で勝つと、破壊した5枚分の自我を削れる。印がない相手にはコイン: A marked Sinner winning destroys 5 Coins' worth of Ego. Unmarked targets increase Coin Power, so do not automatically reassign this to your strongest Sinner. Final-Coin reuse is an [On Hit] effect.
messages.ダメージ量減少を受けるとバリアを割りにくくなる。バリア破壊役を守り、次ターンの印: Damage Down makes Shield breaking harder. Protect your Shield breakers and check next turn's mark and Bleed too.
messages.使用時に自我が5減るが、当たると強制混乱する。マッチ勝利で防ぎ、バリア破壊に使う: Consumes 5 Ego [On Use], but forces Stagger on hit. Win the Clash to prevent this and preserve actions for breaking the Shield.
messages.[戦闘開始時]最大体力の10%分バリアを得る。クィークェグの自我1につき、体力最: [Combat Start] Gain a Shield equal to 10% of Max HP, plus 0.5% of Max HP per Queequeg's Ego.
messages.バリアがある間、被ダメージ時に対象の精神力を5減少。: While Shield remains, reduce the attacker's SP by 5 when taking damage.
messages.被ダメージ時、クィークェグの自我10につき1回、スキルを再使用: When taking damage, reuse the skill once per 10 Queequeg's Ego.
messages.クィークェグの自我30ならバリアは最大HP25%分（165）。怠惰・貫通への耐性: At 30 Queequeg's Ego, the Shield equals 25% of Max HP (165). Prepare Sloth/Pierce resistance and healing, then fully break it in the same turn despite Counter reuse. Attack Power Down does not reduce normal Counter power.
messages.攻撃・防御レベルが増加する。特定スキルでマッチに負けると精神力が減る。: Offense and Defense Levels increase. Losing Clashes with certain skills reduces SP.
messages.形態が変わった後も前の数値で判断せず、実際のマッチ予測と強化を確認する。: After a form change, check actual Clash predictions and buffs rather than relying on the previous form's values.
messages.精神力−45でなければ開始時に15回復。終了時にパニックなら解除し精神力0、次タ: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at -45 SP. At Turn End, if in Panic, remove it and reset SP to 0; gain 2 Attack Power Up and 2 Defense Power Up next turn.
messages.精神力低下を狙うなら、パニック後の立て直しと反撃強化にも備える。: If using SP loss, also prepare for recovery and stronger Counters after Panic.
messages.自我20を得る。終了時、自我1につき精神力3回復。自我0なら次ターン混乱。: Gain 20 Ego. At Turn End, heal 3 SP per Ego. If at 0 Ego, become Staggered next turn.
messages.回避失敗と罪悪感の重さで自我を減らす。資料の状態欄では回復タイミングが異なるが、: Reduce Ego through failed Evades and “Weight of Guilt”. The status description lists different healing timing; this entry follows the passive description.
messages.形態開始・印付き対象とのマッチ敗北: Form start / loses a Clash to a marked target
messages.自我20で開始。印付き相手に負けると、壊されたコイン数だけ減る。開始時、自我5に: Start at 20 Ego. Losing to a marked opponent removes stacks equal to Coins destroyed. At Turn Start, gain 1 Protection per 5 Ego. At Turn End with 0 Ego, become Staggered next turn.
messages.自我が多いと保護も厚い。印付きの囚人でマッチして先に弱める。保護の単位は資料の状: High Ego also means more Protection. Win Clashes with marked Sinners to weaken it first. The Protection ratio differs from the status description, so check the in-battle display too.
messages.スキルで付与するマイナス効果の数値+1。: Increase negative effect values inflicted by skills by 1.
messages.出血や弱体化を受け続けず、マッチで的中を防ぐ。: Prevent hits through Clashes rather than repeatedly taking Bleed and debuffs.
messages.自我30で開始。終了時、バリアが残れば+5、なければ−10。自我0なら次ターン混: Start at 30 Ego. At Turn End, gain 5 if Shield remains or lose 10 otherwise. At 0 Ego, become Staggered next turn.
messages.一度の大ダメージより、同一ターンにバリアを割り切れる配分が大切。: Concentrating enough damage to fully break the Shield in one turn matters more than a single large hit.
messages.失ったHP0.75%につきスキルダメージ+1%、最大100%（HP25%で上限）: Deal +1% skill damage per 0.75% HP lost, up to 100% extra damage at 25% HP.
messages.終盤ほど反撃も重くなる。混乱中に攻め、長引かせない。: Counters grow more dangerous late in the fight. Attack during Stagger and avoid prolonging it.
messages.初期20。回避失敗で1、罪悪感の重さ使用で3減少。終了時0なら次ターン混乱。: Starts at 20. Lose 1 on failed Evade and 3 when using “Weight of Guilt”. If at 0 at Turn End, become Staggered next turn.
messages.守備威力低下を先に入れ、回避を破る攻撃順を作る。: Apply Defense Power Down first, then arrange attacks to break Evades.
messages.初期20。獲物の印を持つ囚人とのマッチで、破壊されたコイン数だけ減少。: Starts at 20. When Clashing with a Sinner carrying Prey Mark, decreases by the number of Coins destroyed.
messages.印がある囚人に勝てるスキルを残す。: Save winning skills for marked Sinners.
messages.初期30。バリアなしの終了時−10、バリアが残ると+5。脱色された懺悔使用時−5: Starts at 30. At Turn End, lose 10 without a Shield or gain 5 if it remains. “Bleached Atonement” consumes 5 [On Use].
messages.バリア破壊を毎ターン狙い、自我0の混乱を作る。: Aim to break the Shield each turn and trigger Stagger at 0 Ego.
messages.ピークォド船員に狙われ、船員からの被ダメージ+50%。: Prioritized by Pequod crew attacks; takes +50% damage from them.
messages.印付きのマッチ担当はHPと精神力を維持する。: Maintain the marked Clash specialist's HP and SP.
messages.反撃を避けようと攻撃を減らしすぎると、バリアが残って自我が増える。受ける役割と攻: Avoiding Counters by attacking too little leaves the Shield intact and increases Ego. Prepare both defenders and damage dealers.
messages.通常反撃には守備威力減少が有効。攻撃威力減少で同じように弱められるとは考えない。: Defense Power Down works against normal Counters. Attack Power Down does not weaken them in the same way.
messages.火傷などターン終了ダメージでHP1にした場合、前半2形態の移行が一時的に遅れるこ: Reaching 1 HP through Turn End damage such as Burn may briefly delay transitions in the first 2 forms.
messages.イシュメールのHP1保護があっても、ほかの全員が同時に倒れる広域では敗北し得る。: Even with Ishmael's 1-HP protection, an area attack defeating all other allies simultaneously can still cause defeat.
messages.主力Lv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、通常スキルで11〜15以上の危険なマッチへ対処: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Check whether regular skills can handle dangerous Clashes of 11–15 or higher, reserving E.G.O for attacks raised further by conditional buffs.
messages.イシュメール必須。ピークォド号船長の専用効果はあるが、特定人格の所持を攻略の必須: Ishmael is mandatory. The Pequod Captain has special effects here, but no specific Identity is required to clear the fight.
messages.怠惰耐性を得るE.G.O、HP・精神力回復、バリアへ火力を集められる複数コイン攻: Prepare E.G.O for Sloth resistance, HP/SP healing, and multi-Coin attacks that concentrate damage on the Shield.
messages.木霊する嘆息を止め、自我を大きく削る。担当がターンごとに変わるので複数人で対応し: Stop “Echoing Cry” to remove substantial Ego. The marked Sinner changes each turn, so prepare several possible specialists.
messages.貫通や傲慢・嫉妬で最後の形態に火力を集中する。反撃を受けても行動できる耐性が大切: Focus Pierce, Pride, or Envy on the final form. Resistances that let attackers keep acting after Counters matter too.
messages.広域を止め、反撃で減ったHPと精神力を戻して火力を維持する。: Stop area attacks and restore HP/SP lost to Counters to sustain your damage.
messages.【リンバス】6-32 奪われ泣き叫ぶヒンドリー（6-32）の攻略｜Limbus: 6-32 Hindley, The Reaved Lamenter (6-32) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-32「奪われ泣き叫ぶヒンドリー（6-: Hindley, The Reaved Lamenter (6-32) guide for Limbus Company 6-32. Win early Clashes to build SP and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark aimed at Heathcliff applies even when you win, so prepare to redirect next turn's attacks. A turn-long 40% HP floor prevents finishing immediately; save major skills for the second half.
messages.序盤のマッチに勝って精神力を整え、的中による回復と速度強化を止める。ヒースクリフ: Win early Clashes to build SP and prevent hit-triggered healing and Speed buffs. The mark aimed at Heathcliff applies even when you win, so prepare to redirect next turn's attacks. A turn-long 40% HP floor prevents finishing immediately; save major skills for the second half.
messages.6-32の集中戦闘。敵Lv43・HP2073・防御Lv42。物理は全て等倍で、憤: The Focused Encounter in 6-32. Enemy Level 43, 2073 HP, Defense Level 42. All physical damage is neutral; Wrath and Envy are effective. Heathcliff is mandatory. This excludes normal Hindley and Wild Hunt versions' values.
messages.全9技。基本範囲は速度差・HP条件・攻撃レベル増加を含まない。クソ野郎は2枚コイ: 9 skills. Base ranges exclude Speed, HP conditions, and Offense Level Up. “Bloody Bastard!” has 2 Coins; conditional reuse is not listed as a permanent third Coin. “Give It Back...!!” is unclashable.
messages.主力Lv43・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にし、序盤に勝てるマッチで精神力を上げる。憤怒・嫉: Aim for Level 43 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Build SP through early winning Clashes, with Wrath/Envy damage and SP recovery.
messages.てめぇだけは･･･の使用時効果を受けた翌ターンは、目印の付いた囚人への攻撃と速度: The turn after “I'll Get You...!”'s [On Use] effect, check attacks aimed at the marked Sinner and the Speed gap. Use faster allies to redirect attacks where possible.
messages.HP40%（829）へ達したターンは下限が働く。大技を使い切らず、強化された後半: Reaching 40% HP (829) activates the floor for that turn. Save major skills for buffed second-half Clashes and the 25% HP Stagger Threshold.
messages.マッチに勝ったのに目印や麻痺が付く: A mark or Paralyze applies despite winning the Clash
messages.てめぇだけは･･･は使用時に翌ターンの目印・脆弱・麻痺・束縛を付ける。的中を防い: “I'll Get You...!” applies next turn's mark, Fragile, Paralyze, and Bind [On Use]. Preventing hits does not remove them. Prepare a fast redirector and Defense Skills for the following attacks.
messages.俺が立つべき場所による、そのターンのHP40%下限。火力を全投入せず、次のターン: A Place for Me applies a 40% HP floor for that turn. Save strong skills for dangerous attacks from next turn rather than spending all damage immediately.
messages.回復され、出血の多い味方から倒される: He heals and defeats allies with heavy Bleed
messages.敵は的中と撃破で回復する。低HP優先の俺の家だ！と目印優先のこの野郎め･･･を止: The enemy heals on hits and kills. Stop “This Is My Home!”, which prioritizes low HP, and “You Little...”, which prioritizes marked targets. Prevent repeated attacks on heavily Bleeding Sinners.
messages.通常時は守備を含め6行動。HP65%以下でマッチ不可の返せ･･･！！を挟む。: Normally has 6 actions including Defense Skills. At 65% HP or less, inserts unclashable “Give It Back...!!” into the pattern.
messages.HP40%（829）の下限を経て後半の行動へ変わる。: After the 40% HP (829) floor, changes to second-half actions.
messages.一度満たしたHP65%・40%の強化条件は、回復しても解除されない。: Once the 65% and 40% HP buff conditions are met, healing does not remove them.
messages.勝てるマッチから精神力を上げる: Build SP through Clashes you can win
messages.片付けてやるなどへ勝てる手を配り、精神力回復の資源を集める。的中を防ぐことで回復: Assign winning skills against attacks such as “I'll Remove You” and build SP-recovery resources. Preventing hits also limits healing and Offense Level Up.
messages.クソ野郎は速度差、俺の家だ！は対象のHP比率で強まる。低HPの囚人が狙われたら、: “Bloody Bastard!” scales with Speed difference; “This Is My Home!” with target HP percentage. If a low-HP Sinner is targeted, redirect eligible attacks with faster allies.
messages.回避を相殺し、HP75%の混乱へ憤怒・嫉妬の火力を集める。最初の混乱解除後は、敵: Offset Evade and focus Wrath/Envy damage during the 75% HP Stagger. After the first Stagger ends, enemy Clash wins can also lead to additional Wrath damage.
messages.マッチ不可と目印の翌ターンへ備える: Prepare for unclashable attacks and the turn after marking
messages.65%以下では直前の行動順に関係なく返せ･･･！！を含む行動が挟まる。マッチ不可: At 65% or less, an action pattern including “Give It Back...!!” is inserted regardless of the preceding sequence. It is unclashable; use the target's defense and remaining HP to limit damage.
messages.てめぇだけは･･･のマッチに勝っても、翌ターンの目印・脆弱・麻痺・束縛は残る。攻: Winning against “I'll Get You...!” does not remove next turn's mark, Fragile, Paralyze, or Bind. Recheck attack targets and Speed gaps next turn.
messages.敵はHP65%以下でマッチ勝利、40%以下で使用時に強化を得る。一度条件を満たす: At 65% HP or less, Clash wins grant buffs; at 40% or less, skill use grants them. Once met, these conditions persist after healing, so avoid prolonging the fight.
messages.下限の後へ火力を残し、25%の混乱を取る: Save damage for after the floor and reach 25% HP Stagger
messages.HP829の下限に達したターンは、その先へ大技を重ねても削り切れない。残りのマッ: On the turn the 829 HP floor is reached, extra major attacks cannot finish him. Check remaining Clashes and defense, saving strong skills for next turn.
messages.後半はここは俺の居場所だ！とこの野郎め･･･が加わる。速度差と目印を見て、強化を: The second half adds “This is My Place!” and “You Little...”. Check Speed gaps and marks, then assign skills that win against the buffed predictions.
messages.HP25%の混乱を取り、的中回復を許さず倒す。負傷者を倒されるとHP200回復と: Reach the 25% HP Stagger and finish him without allowing hit-triggered healing. Killing a wounded Sinner restores 200 HP and grants next-turn buffs, so keep checking remaining HP through the end.
messages.この攻撃スキルが与えたダメージ量の10%だけ、本体および部位体力を回復: Heal overall and Part HP by 10% of damage dealt by this Attack Skill.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]攻撃レベル増加1を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]攻撃レベル増加1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.
messages.与ダメージの10%を回復し、的中で攻撃レベルも増す。序盤の勝ちやすいマッチに使い: Heals 10% of damage dealt and gains Offense Level on hit. Use it as an easier early Clash to limit healing and buffs.
messages.対象より速度が高ければ、マッチ威力+2: If faster than the target, gain +2 Clash Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.[的中時]対象より速度が3以上高ければ、このコインを再使用(最大1回): [On Hit] If at least 3 Speed faster than the target, reuse this Coin once at most.
messages.敵の方が速ければマッチ威力+2、速度差3以上では2枚目を最大1回再使用する。強化: Gains +2 Clash Power when faster, and reuses the second Coin once at a Speed advantage of at least 3. Check Speed and Bleed rather than assigning an answer only to the unbuffed maximum of 11.
messages.体力が最も低い対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritize the target with the lowest current HP.
messages.[使用時]対象の現体力の比率が70%未満なら、マッチ威力+2: [On Use] If the target is below 70% of Max HP, gain +2 Clash Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンにクイック1を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]対象の出血が20以上なら、与ダメージ量+100%: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target has at least 20 Bleed, deal +100% damage.
messages.[敵討伐時]このスキルを再使用(最大1): [On Kill] Reuse this skill once at most.
messages.現在HPが最も低い対象を優先し、HP比率70%未満なら使用時にマッチ威力+2。出: Prioritizes lowest current HP and gains +2 Clash Power [On Use] against targets below 70% HP. Its fourth Coin deals +100% damage at 20 or more Bleed; keep it away from wounded Sinners.
messages.[使用時]速度が最も低い敵の場合、基本威力+3: [On Use] If the target is the slowest enemy, gain +3 Base Power.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに獲物の目印,脆弱2,麻痺3,束縛5を付与: [On Use] Inflict Marked Prey, 2 Fragile, 3 Paralyze, and 5 Bind next turn.
messages.ヒースクリフを優先する。獲物の目印・翌ターンの脆弱2、麻痺3、束縛5は使用時効果: Prioritizes Heathcliff. Marked Prey and next-turn 2 Fragile, 3 Paralyze, and 5 Bind are [On Use] effects and remain after winning. Prepare next turn's defense too.
messages.Ⅰ[表面的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加2を得る: Ⅰ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[表面的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加2を得る: Ⅱ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[表面的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加2を得る: Ⅲ[Heads Hit] Gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、与ダメージ量+30%: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が5以上なら、ダメージ量の50%だけ体力を回復: [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, heal HP equal to 50% of damage dealt.
messages.マッチ不可。勝てるスキルを当てても一方攻撃を受けるため、対象の守備・耐性・残HP: Unclashable. An Attack Skill cannot prevent the unopposed hit, so check the target's Defense Skill, resistances, and HP. Hits against at least 5 Bleed also allow healing.
messages.対象の速度が自分より3以上低ければ、このスキルを再使用(最大1): If the target is at least 3 Speed slower, reuse this skill once at most.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]ダメージ量の50%分、本体および部位体力を回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]ダメージ量の50%分、本体および部位体力を回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal overall and Part HP by 50% of damage dealt.
messages.獲物の目印を持つ相手を優先し、対象が3以上遅いとスキルを最大1回再使用する。各的: Prioritizes Marked Prey, reusing the skill once if the target is at least 3 Speed slower. Each hit heals 50% of damage dealt, so prevent damage through Clashes or defense.
messages.ターン終了時にバリアが残っているなら、次のターンに保護4を得る: At Turn End, if Shield remains, gain 4 Protection next turn.
messages.バリアを終了時まで残すと翌ターンに保護4を得る。相殺するか、発動後に割り切る火力: A Shield remaining at Turn End grants 4 Protection next turn. Offset or prepare enough damage to break it after activation and avoid stalling your damage.
messages.[回避成功時]次のターンに束縛1を付与(最大2): [On Evade] Inflict 1 Bind next turn, up to 2.
messages.回避成功で翌ターンの束縛を最大2まで付ける。守備で相殺し、遅くなった味方が速度差: Successful Evades inflict up to 2 Bind next turn. Offset with a Defense Skill to stop slowed allies from also triggering Speed-based bonuses.
messages.自分の速度が対象より高ければ、コイン威力+1: If faster than the target, gain +1 Coin Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、与ダメージ量+30%: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、与ダメージ量+30%: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、与ダメージ量+30%: Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, deal +30% damage.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、ダメージ量の70%だけ体力を回復: [On Hit] If the target has at least 10 Bleed, heal HP equal to 70% of damage dealt.
messages.対象より速いとコイン威力+1で最大23になる。出血10以上では全コインのダメージ: Gains +1 Coin Power when faster, reaching a maximum of 23. At 10 or more Bleed, every Coin's extra damage and the final healing become dangerous. Save a strong late-fight Clash for this.
messages.パニックだけで長く止まるとは考えない。: Do not assume Panic alone will disable him for long.
messages.パニックタイプを変更する効果を受ける: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.パニックタイプを変更せず、精神力のない対象へ付与される効果を受ける。: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.パニックの種類を変える戦法を前提にしない。: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.
messages.1ターンの間、HPが40%以下にならず、行動パターンが変化する。: For 1 turn, HP cannot fall below 40%, and the action pattern changes.
messages.到達したターンに大技を使い切らない。: Do not spend all major skills on the turn this threshold is reached.
messages.HP65%以下・40%以下を一度満たす: Has reached 65% HP or less / 40% HP or less at least once
messages.65%以下でマッチ勝利時、40%以下で使用時に攻撃レベル増加1・体力回復増加1を: At 65% or less, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 HP Healing Boost on Clash Win. At 40% or less, gain them [On Use]. Once met, the conditions remain active after healing.
messages.回復させて強化を解除することはできない。マッチを止め、後半を短くする。: Healing does not remove these buffs. Win Clashes and shorten the second half.
messages.最初の混乱解除以降にマッチ勝利: Clash Win after the first Stagger ends
messages.攻撃スキル的中時に与ダメージの10%分の憤怒ダメージを追加する。: Attack Skill hits deal additional Wrath damage equal to 10% of damage dealt.
messages.混乱後もマッチ負けから連続的中を許さない。: After Stagger, avoid losing Clashes and allowing repeated hits.
messages.boss-copy:crying-hindley:passives.5.name: Predation
messages.本体・部位HPを200回復。翌ターンにクイック1・防御レベル増加3・攻撃レベル増: Heal 200 overall and Part HP. Gain 1 Haste, 3 Defense Level Up, and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.低HPの囚人へ攻撃を集中させない。: Prevent focused attacks on low-HP Sinners.
messages.翌ターンの速度と攻撃先を見て、引き受け役を決める。: Check next turn's Speed and targets before choosing a redirector.
messages.被ダメージごとにダメージ量の10%分の斬撃追加ダメージを受ける。次のターンに消滅: Whenever damaged, take additional Slash damage equal to 10% of damage taken. Expires next turn. If no damage is taken, it can instead apply 1 Inferiority Complex at the end of the attack and expire.
messages.目印が付いた味方へ一方攻撃を重ねさせず、実際の攻撃先を確認する。: Prevent repeated unopposed hits on marked allies, and check actual targeting lines.
messages.被ダメージごとに、ダメージ量の20%×数値分の追加ダメージを受ける。最大5。: Whenever damaged, take additional damage equal to 20% of damage taken × the value, up to 5 stacks.
messages.効果がある対象の被弾を避け、同じ囚人へ攻撃を集めさせない。: Avoid hits on affected Sinners and prevent attacks from concentrating on the same target.
messages.ヒースクリフは強制編成で、通常は精神力が減る喪失を得る。ワイルドハント人格では果: Heathcliff is mandatory and normally gains SP-draining Bereavement. His Wild Hunt Identity changes it to Unending Bereavement.
messages.本人の育成と精神力維持を用意する。速度低下と麻痺を受けた翌ターンは、ほかの囚人も: Prepare his training and SP maintenance. After Speed debuffs and Paralyze, other Sinners should help redirect next turn's attacks.
messages.マッチ不可の攻撃へ攻撃スキルを合わせても、敵の一方攻撃は止まらない。: Assigning an Attack Skill to an unclashable attack does not stop the enemy's unopposed hit.
messages.目印・麻痺・束縛は使用時に付くため、マッチに勝っただけで翌ターンが安全になるわけ: Marks, Paralyze, and Bind apply [On Use]. Winning the Clash alone does not make next turn safe.
messages.HP40%下限とHP25%の混乱は別の条件。: The 40% HP floor and 25% HP Stagger are separate conditions.
messages.6-34の別戦闘の敗北条件や感情ギミックを、本戦へ持ち込まない。: Do not apply 6-34's defeat condition or emotion mechanics to this fight.
messages.主力Lv43・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にし、ヒースクリフも育成する。: Aim for Level 43 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, including Heathcliff.
messages.憤怒・嫉妬の火力、精神力回復、高威力マッチを用意する。怠惰・傲慢は半減される。: Prepare Wrath/Envy damage, SP recovery, and powerful Clashes. Sloth and Pride damage are halved.
messages.速い引き受け役と、マッチ不可の攻撃を受ける守備を用意する。: Prepare fast redirectors and Defense Skills for unclashable attacks.
messages.精神力を上げ、的中回復と攻撃レベル増加を抑える。: Build SP while limiting hit-triggered healing and Offense Level Up.
messages.目印・麻痺・束縛を受けた味方への変更可能な攻撃を引き受ける。: Redirect eligible attacks away from allies carrying the mark, Paralyze, and Bind.
messages.混乱を取り、HP下限後の戦闘を短くする。: Create Stagger openings and shorten the fight after the HP floor.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-31「ヒンドリー（6-31）」の攻略: Hindley (6-31) guide for Limbus Company 6-31. Stop the adds' Offense Level Down to prevent Hindley's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases his actions but also lowers his Offense Level. Check the added attacks, then use Slash and winning Clashes to finish him.
messages.取り巻きの攻撃レベル減少を抑え、ヒンドリーの条件付き強化を防ぐ。取り巻きを倒すと: Stop the adds' Offense Level Down to prevent Hindley's conditional bonuses. Defeating adds increases his actions but also lowers his Offense Level. Check the added attacks, then use Slash and winning Clashes to finish him.
messages.6-31の通常戦闘。ヒンドリーはLv42・HP869・防御Lv42。鋭敏な団員5: The Regular Encounter in 6-31. Hindley is Level 42 with 869 HP and Defense Level 42. The 5 Sharp and 4 Fierce Henchmen are Level 40 with 176 HP and Defense Level 32. Check initial placement and extra actions in battle. Hindley's and Sharp Henchmen's Stagger values are unconfirmed and are not filled with estimates. Do not substitute 6-32's form or 6-33's henchman values and attack types.
messages.本体5技・取り巻き各4技。基礎の威力と、対象の攻撃レベル減少・マイナス効果で生じ: 5 boss skills and 4 per add. Distinguish base rolls from bonuses based on target Offense Level Down and negative effects. The henchmen's “Get... Out of My...” and “Remo...ve...” are Blunt in this encounter.
messages.主力Lv42・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にし、本体用の斬撃と、取り巻きに通る憂鬱・嫉妬を用: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring Slash for Hindley and Gloom/Envy damage for adds.
messages.取り巻きの攻撃レベル減少を防ぐ。妨害の多い囚人へ潰してやるを通さない。: Prevent the adds' Offense Level Down. Keep “Get Crushed” away from heavily debuffed Sinners.
messages.取り巻き撃破で本体は最大3つ手数が増える一方、死亡人数に応じて攻撃レベルが下がる: Add deaths grant Hindley up to 3 extra actions while lowering his Offense Level according to the number defeated. Recheck Clashes after cleanup and damage him.
messages.本体の攻撃が急に重くなる: The boss's attacks suddenly become much more dangerous
messages.取り巻きの攻撃レベル減少が、本体の追加ダメージや威力強化の条件になる。潰してやる: The adds' Offense Level Down enables Hindley's extra damage and power bonuses. “Get Crushed” prioritizes debuffed targets, so prevent add hits first.
messages.取り巻きを倒してよいか分からない: You are unsure whether to defeat the adds
