messages.本戦は倒すたび本体の攻撃レベルが下がる。手数は最大3つ増えるため、増加後の攻撃へ: Each defeat lowers Hindley's Offense Level here. His actions increase by up to 3, so remove debuff sources while checking that you can answer the extra attacks. Do not directly apply 6-33's plan of leaving adds alive.
messages.ガードはほかの生存味方1名につきバリア20を追加で得る。相殺するか、取り巻きを減: Guard gains 20 extra Shield per other living ally. Offset it, or defeat adds to limit both extra Shield and disruption.
messages.初期3スロット。味方死亡で翌ターンから最大3つ増える。: Starts with 3 slots. Ally deaths add up to 3 more from the following turn.
messages.死亡した味方の人数に応じて、翌ターンから攻撃レベル減少2を得る。: From the following turn, gain 2 Offense Level Down according to the number of defeated allies.
messages.本体だけでは攻撃レベル減少を付与しない。取り巻きの妨害を防ぐ意味が大きい。: Hindley does not inflict Offense Level Down by himself. Preventing the adds' debuffs matters.
messages.戦闘全体で5名。攻撃レベル減少と破裂回数を増やす。: 5 across the battle. Inflicts Offense Level Down and increases Rupture Count.
messages.マッチに負けると、勝った相手の精神力に3ダメージを与える。: On Clash Lose, deals 3 SP damage to the opponent who won.
messages.戦闘全体で4名。防御レベル減少と破裂威力を付ける。: 4 across the battle. Inflicts Defense Level Down and Rupture Potency.
messages.妨害を抑え、処理後の手数へ備える: Limit disruption and prepare for the extra actions after cleanup
messages.取り巻きには憂鬱・嫉妬が有効。鋭敏な団員の攻撃レベル減少を防ぎ、ヒンドリーの追加: Adds are weak to Gloom and Envy. Prevent Sharp Henchmen's Offense Level Down to deny Hindley's extra-damage conditions.
messages.通常戦闘なので、攻撃先とマッチは実際の配置を見る。勝てない攻撃を守備へ替える場合: In this Regular Encounter, check actual targets and Clash pairings. If replacing a losing attack with defense, still confirm who receives each attack.
messages.取り巻きを倒すと翌ターンから本体のスロットが増える。最大3つ増加するため、手数が: Defeating adds increases Hindley's slots from next turn, up to 3 extra. Build SP and prepare powerful skills before the action count rises.
messages.攻撃レベル低下を使い、本体を削る: Use reduced Offense Level to damage the boss
messages.取り巻きの死亡人数に応じて、本体は翌ターンから攻撃レベル減少2を得る。増えた行動: From next turn, Hindley gains 2 Offense Level Down according to defeated ally count. Answer his extra actions using predictions after that reduction.
messages.斬撃は本体へ1.25倍、貫通は半減。本体へ通る火力で削り、取り巻きの妨害が残った: Slash deals 1.25× damage to Hindley; Pierce is halved. Use effective damage and watch attacks aimed at Sinners still carrying add debuffs.
messages.潰してやるはマイナス効果の最も多い対象を優先する。攻撃レベル減少に応じた強化と、: “Get Crushed” prioritizes the target with the most negative effects. Check its Offense Level Down bonuses and reuse at 3 or more debuffs, then assign a strong answer.
messages.被弾強化を止めて削り切る: Stop hit-triggered buffs and finish the fight
messages.雑魚どもが！の的中とボタンを直すぞの後半コインは、敵の攻撃レベルや精神力を回復さ: “Damn Plebs...!” hits and later Coins of “Make Things Right Again” restore the enemy's Offense Level or SP. Avoid repeated unopposed hits even after his action count rises.
messages.本体の精神力−10以下では翌ターンに攻撃レベル増加3を得る。精神力を下げるだけで: At -10 SP or less, Hindley gains 3 Offense Level Up next turn. Lowering SP does not stop every buff; check Clash predictions.
messages.混乱区間は画面の実値を確認し、混乱したら火力を集める。未確定の割合を固定の削り目: Use actual in-battle Stagger Thresholds and concentrate damage when he Staggers. Do not make unconfirmed percentages fixed damage targets.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加1を得る: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.各コインの的中で翌ターンの攻撃レベル増加1を得る。序盤のマッチに使い、的中強化を: Each Coin's hit grants 1 Offense Level Up next turn. Use it as an early Clash target to prevent hit-triggered buffs.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象に攻撃レベル減少があるなら、与ダメージ量20%分の打撃ダメージを: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象に攻撃レベル減少があるなら、与ダメージ量20%分の打撃ダメージを: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.
messages.対象に攻撃レベル減少があると、各的中で与ダメージの20%分の打撃ダメージが追加さ: Against Offense Level Down, each hit adds Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt. Keep it away from Sinners debuffed by the adds.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象の攻撃レベル減少が2以上なら、基本威力+1: [Clash Win] If the target has at least 2 Offense Level Down, gain +1 Base Power.
messages.[使用時]対象に攻撃レベル減少があるなら、ダメージ量+30%: [On Use] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal +30% damage.
messages.攻撃レベル減少のある対象には使用時にダメージ+30%。4枚コインの後半は敵の精神: Deals +30% damage [On Use] against Offense Level Down. The later Coins of this 4-Coin skill also heal enemy SP, so prevent hits on debuffed main units.
messages.マイナス効果が最も多い対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritize the target with the most negative effects.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象の攻撃レベル減少3につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [Clash Win] Gain +1 Coin Power per 3 target Offense Level Down, up to 3.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の攻撃レベル減少2につき、ダメージ量+30%(最大120%): Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal +30% damage per 2 target Offense Level Down, up to 120%.
messages.[表面的中時]対象のマイナス効果が3以上なら、このコインを再使用(最大1回): [Heads Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin once at most.
messages.マイナス効果の最も多い対象を優先する。攻撃レベル減少に応じた追加強化と、弱体3つ: Prioritizes the most-debuffed target. Offense Level Down adds bonuses, while 3 or more debuffs enable second-Coin reuse. Check the remaining HP of heavily debuffed Sinners.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を除く生存している味方1名につき、バリアを20を追加で得る。: [Combat Start] Gain 20 additional Shield per other living ally.
messages.戦闘開始時に、ほかの生存味方1名につきバリア20を追加で得る。取り巻きが多い間は: Gains 20 extra Shield per other living ally at Combat Start. While many adds remain, prioritize offsetting or cleanup rather than wasting weak attacks on it.
messages.破裂回数を3増やす。破裂威力の高い囚人へ通すと固定ダメージが続くため、単コインで: Increases Rupture Count by 3. Even with 1 Coin, it prolongs fixed damage on high-Rupture Sinners; do not underestimate it.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂回数が3以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Count, gain +1 Base Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]攻撃レベル減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]攻撃レベル減少2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down.
messages.攻撃レベル減少と破裂を重ねる。後のヒンドリーの攻撃も強まるため、的中を防ぐ。通常: Stacks Offense Level Down and Rupture, also strengthening Hindley's later attacks. Prevent hits. This regular henchman's attack is Blunt, unlike the Pierce attack of 6-33's covered henchmen.
messages.[使用時]対象に精神力3ダメージ: [On Use] Deal 3 SP damage to the target.
messages.[使用時]対象に破裂があれば、破裂回数3につき基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 3 Rupture Count, up to 3.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]破裂回数が4増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Rupture Count by 4.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]攻撃レベル減少3を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Offense Level Down.
messages.使用時に精神力3ダメージ。破裂回数で基本威力が最大+3になり、出血・攻撃レベル減: Deals 3 SP damage [On Use]. Rupture Count raises Base Power by up to +3, with Bleed, Offense Level Down, and Paralyze on top. Use an answer that wins after those bonuses.
messages.対象に破裂があれば、最終威力+1: If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Final Power.
messages.打撃の通常反撃。破裂がある対象には最終威力+1、的中で出血2。反撃に弱い一方攻撃: A normal Blunt Counter. Gains +1 Final Power against Rupture and inflicts 2 Bleed on hit. Avoid weak unopposed attacks that cannot withstand the Counter.
messages.破裂4を付ける単コイン。破裂回数を増やす敵と組み合わさる前に、勝てるマッチや混乱: A 1-Coin attack applying 4 Rupture. Stop it with a winning Clash or Stagger before combining with enemies that raise Rupture Count.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂威力が3以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Rupture Potency, gain +1 Base Power.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]防御レベル減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]防御レベル減少2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down.
messages.破裂威力3以上で基本威力+1。防御レベル減少と破裂回数を重ねるため、同じ囚人へ続: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 Rupture Potency and stacks Defense Level Down with Rupture Count. Avoid repeated hits on the same Sinner. The 6-31 henchman uses Blunt.
messages.[使用時]対象に破裂があれば、破裂威力4につき基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] If the target has Rupture, gain +1 Base Power per 4 Rupture Potency, up to 3.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]防御レベル減少3を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down.
messages.使用時に精神力3ダメージ、破裂威力に応じて基本威力が最大+3。出血と防御レベル減: Deals 3 SP damage [On Use] and gains up to +3 Base Power from Rupture Potency. Limit Bleed, Defense Level Down, and next-turn Paralyze.
messages.破裂がある対象には最終威力+1の通常反撃。攻撃を当てる最初の囚人のHP・打撃耐性: A normal Counter with +1 Final Power against Rupture. Check the first attacker's HP and Blunt resistance.
messages.パニックで長時間止まる前提にはしない。: Do not rely on Panic to keep him disabled for long.
messages.ターン終了時に精神力−10以下: At -10 SP or less at Turn End
messages.次のターンに攻撃レベル増加3を得る。: Gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.低精神力でも翌ターンのレベル強化を確認する。: Check next turn's Offense Level buff even at low SP.
messages.次のターンからスロットが1増加する。: Gain 1 additional slot from next turn onward.
messages.取り巻き処理後に増えた攻撃へ対応する手を残す。: Save enough skills to answer extra attacks after add cleanup.
messages.死亡した味方の人数に応じて、次のターンから攻撃レベル減少2を得る。: From next turn, gain 2 Offense Level Down according to the number of defeated allies.
messages.手数増加だけを見て取り巻きを残し続けず、妨害源の処理と弱体化も利用する。: Do not preserve every add just to avoid extra actions. Remove debuff sources and use the resulting weakening too.
messages.マッチ判定5回以上で勝利: Wins after at least 5 Clash rolls
messages.長く競り合って負けるマッチは被害も増す。勝てる手や守備を選ぶ。: Losing a long Clash also increases incoming damage. Choose a winning skill or defense.
messages.戦闘開始時、対象が最も低HPの敵: At Combat Start, target is the enemy with the lowest HP
messages.低HPの囚人へ攻撃が重ならないようにする。: Avoid repeated attacks on a low-HP Sinner.
messages.相手の精神力に3ダメージを与える。: Deal 3 SP damage to the opponent.
messages.勝っても精神力が減るが、的中による妨害を防ぐ利点は残る。: Winning still costs SP, but prevents hit-triggered debuffs.
messages.パニック中にも攻撃を進め、立て直される前に処理する。: Keep attacking during Panic to finish the enemy before recovery.
messages.攻撃レベル減少への追撃: Follow-up damage against Offense Level Down
messages.取り巻きが付ける攻撃レベル減少は、本体の追加ダメージ・ダメージ増加・コイン威力強: Offense Level Down inflicted by adds enables the boss's extra damage, damage bonuses, and Coin Power bonuses.
messages.本体の攻撃だけでなく、鋭敏な団員の的中も防ぐ。: Prevent Sharp Henchmen's hits as well as Hindley's attacks.
messages.味方死亡で本体のスロットは翌ターンから最大3つ増える。同時に死亡人数に応じた攻撃: Ally deaths grant Hindley up to 3 extra slots from next turn. He also receives Offense Level Down according to the number defeated.
messages.手数増加へ備えつつ、妨害源を減らして弱体化を使う。: Prepare for extra actions while removing debuff sources and exploiting the weakening.
messages.ヒースクリフを出撃させると通常は精神力が減る喪失を得る。ワイルドハント人格では果: Deployed Heathcliff normally gains SP-draining Bereavement. His Wild Hunt Identity changes it to Unending Bereavement.
messages.本戦では強制出撃ではないため、精神力を維持しにくい場合は別の主力も検討する。: He is not mandatory here, so consider another main unit if maintaining SP is difficult.
messages.6-31は通常戦闘。集中戦闘のように攻撃先を自由に動かす前提にはしない。: 6-31 is a Regular Encounter. Do not assume you can freely redirect attacks as in Focused Encounters.
messages.本体と鋭敏な団員の混乱値は未確定。推定割合で撃破計画を固定しない。: Hindley's and Sharp Henchmen's Stagger values are unconfirmed. Do not plan around estimated percentages.
messages.6-33のデッドラビッツ ボスとは、取り巻き死亡の効果が異なる。: Add deaths have different effects here than against the Dead Rabbits Boss in 6-33.
messages.団員の技は本戦では打撃。6-33の貫通攻撃を流用しない。: Henchman skills here are Blunt. Do not substitute 6-33's Pierce attacks.
messages.主力Lv42・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、斬撃と憂鬱・嫉妬の火力を用意する。: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, with Slash and Gloom/Envy damage.
messages.敵の攻撃は打撃が中心。耐性とHPを確認し、破裂・出血の連続被害を抑える。: Enemy attacks are mainly Blunt. Check resistances and HP to limit repeated Rupture/Bleed damage.
messages.精神力回復や高威力E.G.Oを用意し、増えた本体の手数へ対応する。: Prepare SP recovery and powerful E.G.O to handle Hindley's extra actions.
messages.憂鬱・嫉妬で妨害源を減らし、本体の攻撃レベルを下げる。: Use Gloom/Envy to remove debuff sources and lower Hindley's Offense Level.
messages.貫通半減を避け、取り巻き処理後に本体を削る。: Avoid halved Pierce damage and finish the boss after add cleanup.
messages.取り巻き死亡で増えた手数と、妨害を受けた囚人への攻撃に対応する。: Handle extra actions after add deaths and attacks targeting debuffed Sinners.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-15「ジョセフィーヌ（6-15）」の: Josephine (6-15) guide for Limbus Company 6-15. Build SP and E.G.O resources in earlier Waves, then prevent Sinking and disruption through Clashes in the final Wave. Josephine removes her first Stagger at Turn End, so concentrate follow-up damage that same turn. Faster Sinners also help avoid her Speed-based Clash bonus.
messages.道中で精神力とE.G.O資源を整え、最終Waveの沈潜と妨害をマッチで防ぐ。ジョ: Build SP and E.G.O resources in earlier Waves, then prevent Sinking and disruption through Clashes in the final Wave. Josephine removes her first Stagger at Turn End, so concentrate follow-up damage that same turn. Faster Sinners also help avoid her Speed-based Clash bonus.
messages.6-15の通常戦闘。敵Lv42、ジョセフィーヌHP654・防御Lv40、取り巻き: The Regular Encounter in 6-15. Enemies are Level 42; Josephine has 654 HP and Defense Level 40, while both add types have 189 HP and Defense Level 37. Each of the first 2 Waves has 3 Trained and 2 Hostile Butlers. Josephine and both Butler types appear in the final Wave. Regular Encounter targeting does not allow the same freedom as a Focused Encounter.
messages.ジョセフィーヌ5技と取り巻き各4技を掲載する。鍛錬した個体の招かれざる客の応対は: Josephine has 5 listed skills; each add has 4. Trained Butler's “Interloper Response” has no Coin number on the second Sinking Count line, so none is added here. The adds' Guard skills have no listed weight. Displayed power excludes Speed, Sinking, and Combat Start bonuses.
messages.主力をLv42・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に育て、打撃と斬撃を用意する。序盤の2Waveで: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units, with Blunt and Slash attacks. Build SP and major-skill resources in the first 2 Waves.
messages.沈潜・麻痺・束縛を一方攻撃で重ねられないようにする。ジョセフィーヌより遅い対象へ: Prevent unopposed attacks from stacking Sinking, Paralyze, and Bind. Josephine gains +2 Clash Power against slower targets.
messages.最初の混乱は最大1回、ターン終了時に解除される。翌ターンの一方攻撃を当てにせず、: Her first Stagger is removed at Turn End, once at most. Save strong follow-up attacks for the Stagger turn rather than relying on unopposed attacks next turn.
messages.混乱させたのに翌ターン動いてくる: She acts next turn despite being Staggered
messages.きちんと片付けてやろう…は、そのターンに混乱した場合に最大1回、終了時に混乱を解: I'll Clean You Up... removes Stagger at Turn End if she became Staggered that turn, at most once. It does not negate every Stagger, but use the first opening for same-turn follow-up attacks.
messages.表示威力より強く、精神力も下がり続ける: Skills exceed listed power while your SP keeps falling
messages.速度差のマッチ威力+2、沈潜による基本威力増加、戦闘開始時の攻撃レベル増加がある: She has +2 Clash Power from Speed advantage, Sinking-based Base Power, and Combat Start Offense Level Up. Win Clashes before repeated Sinking hits build up, and use SP recovery.
messages.防御を削っても混乱が遠のく: Attacking her Guard pushes Stagger farther away
messages.鼠野郎め！のバリアが終了時に残ると混乱区間が50後退する。防御を相殺するか、発動: If “Slippery Rat!”'s Shield remains at Turn End, her Stagger Threshold is lowered by 50. Offset Guard or fully break the resulting Shield in the same turn.
messages.最終Waveに出現する。取り巻き死亡で行動スロットが最大2つ増える。実際の行動数: Appears in the final Wave. Add deaths grant up to 2 extra action slots. Check the actual action count in battle.
messages.そのターンに混乱した場合、最大1回だけ終了時に解除し、精神力20回復と翌ターンの: Once at most, if Staggered that turn, remove Stagger at Turn End, heal 20 SP, and gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.対象より速い場合、マッチ威力+2。: Gain +2 Clash Power when faster than the target.
messages.道中2Waveと最終Waveに出現するLv42個体。: Level 42 enemies appearing in the first 2 Waves and the final Wave.
messages.沈潜回数・麻痺・攻撃レベル減少を付与する。: Inflicts Sinking Count, Paralyze, and Offense Level Down.
messages.沈潜・束縛・防御レベル減少を付与する。: Inflicts Sinking, Bind, and Defense Level Down.
messages.マッチで精神力を上げ、妨害を残さない: Build SP through Clashes and prevent lingering debuffs
messages.両Waveとも鍛錬した個体3名・険悪な個体2名。打撃で混乱を取り、残した敵の一方: Each Wave has 3 Trained and 2 Hostile Butlers. Use Blunt to Stagger them and reduce unopposed attacks from remaining enemies.
messages.回復や高威力E.G.Oを使える資源をためる。沈潜の多い囚人は敵の接客道二式を強め: Build resources for healing and powerful E.G.O. Sinners with heavy Sinking strengthen enemy Reception Arts 2 skills, so check Clash odds and debuffs every turn.
messages.ヒースクリフの出撃は強制ではない。通常の喪失で精神力を維持しにくい場合は、別の育: Heathcliff is not mandatory. If ordinary Bereavement makes his SP hard to maintain, consider another trained Sinner.
messages.ジョセフィーヌの攻撃へ勝てる手を合わせる。取り巻きを倒すと本人の行動スロットが増: Assign winning skills against Josephine. Defeating adds increases her action slots, so check her attacks after cleanup too.
messages.奥様の仰せの通り…！は対象の沈潜威力で強まる。一片の埃も…なきように！は戦闘開始: “As Mistress Commands...!” scales with the target's Sinking Potency. “Not Even a Speck of Dust!” grants team-wide buffs at Combat Start, which still activate even if you win the Clash.
messages.鼠野郎め！へ攻撃する場合は、防御の相殺かバリア破壊を選ぶ。弱い攻撃だけを当ててバ: When attacking “Slippery Rat!”, choose between offsetting Guard and breaking the Shield. Avoid leaving it intact after only weak attacks.
messages.混乱を取るターンに追撃する: Follow up on the turn you cause Stagger
messages.最初の混乱は終了時に解除されるため、速い攻撃で混乱を取り、後続の火力を同じターン: The first Stagger ends at Turn End. Cause it with an early attack, then land the rest of your damage that same turn.
messages.解除は最大1回。以降も混乱区間を利用できるが、敵の精神力回復と次ターン強化を含め: Removal occurs at most once. Later Stagger Thresholds remain useful, but recheck predictions after her SP recovery and next-turn buff.
messages.沈潜の多い囚人を低精神力のまま攻撃させ続けない。精神力回復と危険なマッチに資源を: Avoid making heavily Sinking-afflicted Sinners keep attacking at low SP. Spend resources on SP recovery and dangerous Clashes, limit add disruption, and finish the fight.
messages.[使用時]対象の沈潜威力が5以上なら、攻撃レベル減少1を付与: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 Sinking Potency, inflict 1 Offense Level Down.
messages.沈潜と翌ターンの束縛・麻痺を重ねる。使用時の攻撃レベル減少は沈潜威力5以上で発動: Stacks Sinking with next-turn Bind and Paralyze. The [On Use] Offense Level Down activates at 5 Sinking Potency, so check current predictions even when preventing hits.
messages.[使用時]対象の精神力が10以下なら、攻撃レベル減少2を付与: [On Use] If the target has 10 SP or less, inflict 2 Offense Level Down.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに加算コイン弱化1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.
messages.精神力10以下では使用時に攻撃レベルが下がる。的中による翌ターンの加算コイン弱化: At 10 SP or less, the target loses Offense Level [On Use]. Plus Coin Drop next turn and Fragile are also dangerous; keep unopposed hits away from low-SP allies.
messages.[使用時]対象の沈潜威力3につき、基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Gain +1 Base Power per 3 Sinking Potency on the target, up to 3.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]全味方の精神力を5回復: [Clash Win] Heal 5 SP for all allies.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに邸宅の木霊2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Echoes of the Manor next turn.
messages.対象の沈潜威力3ごとに基本威力+1、最大+3。沈潜の多い囚人は表示上の基本範囲よ: Gains +1 Base Power per 3 target Sinking Potency, up to +3. Heavy Sinking makes it stronger than its listed base range. Win with a strong skill to also prevent the third Coin's Echoes of the Manor.
messages.一片の埃も…なきように！: Not Even a Speck of Dust!
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を含む全味方へ攻撃レベル増加3,精神力15回復: [Combat Start] Grant 3 Offense Level Up and heal 15 SP for all allies, including self.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を除く全味方へ脆弱1を付与: [Combat Start] Inflict 1 Fragile on all other allies.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の沈潜威力だけ憂鬱属性追加ダメージを与える。沈潜回数が1減少: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の沈潜威力だけ憂鬱属性追加ダメージを与える。沈潜回数が1減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の沈潜威力だけ憂鬱属性追加ダメージを与える。沈潜回数が1減少: Ⅲ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.
messages.[的中時]対象の沈潜回数が3以上なら、このコインを再使用(最大2回): [On Hit] If the target has at least 3 Sinking Count, reuse this Coin up to 2 times.
messages.戦闘開始時の全体強化と精神力回復はマッチ勝利では止まらない。沈潜に応じた追加ダメ: Winning does not cancel Combat Start team buffs and SP healing. Focus on preventing Sinking-based extra damage and the third Coin's reuse of up to 2 times.
messages.ターン終了時にバリアが残っている場合は、50だけ混乱区間を後退: At Turn End, if Shield remains, lower the Stagger Threshold by 50.
messages.バリアを全て消耗した場合、全ての敵の精神力を10回復: When the Shield is fully depleted, heal 10 SP for all enemies.
messages.バリアを残すと混乱区間が50後退する。攻撃がこの防御へ向く場合は相殺を検討し、発: A remaining Shield lowers the Stagger Threshold by 50. If attacks target this Guard, consider offsetting; if it activates, concentrate enough damage to fully break it. The 10 SP healing on depletion benefits your Sinners.
messages.boss-copy:josephine:skills.5.name: Commence Housekeeping
messages.沈潜に加えて翌ターンの麻痺を付ける。次のマッチ担当が動けなくなる前に、勝てるマッ: Inflicts Sinking and next-turn Paralyze. Win manageable Clashes to prevent hits before your next Clash specialist is weakened.
messages.敵のマッチ勝利で加算コイン強化が付く。沈潜回数も増やすため、沈潜威力の高い囚人へ: The enemy gains Plus Coin Boost on Clash Win. It also increases Sinking Count, so keep hits away from Sinners with high Sinking Potency.
messages.[使用時]対象の沈潜威力5につき、基本威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Gain +1 Base Power per 5 target Sinking Potency, up to 2.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の沈潜回数が4以上なら、このコインを再使用(1回): Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 4 Sinking Count, reuse this Coin once.
messages.[表面的中時]攻撃レベル減少4、麻痺1を付与: [Heads Hit] Inflict 4 Offense Level Down and 1 Paralyze.
messages.沈潜威力で基本威力が上がり、沈潜回数4以上では3枚目を再使用する。麻痺と攻撃レベ: Sinking Potency raises Base Power; at least 4 Sinking Count enables third-Coin reuse. Stop it before Paralyze and Offense Level Down accumulate.
messages.ターン終了時にバリアが残っている場合は、10だけ混乱区画を後退: At Turn End, if Shield remains, lower the Stagger Threshold by 10.
messages.バリアを全て消耗した場合、最後の攻撃者の精神力を10回復: When the Shield is fully depleted, heal the final attacker by 10 SP.
messages.バリアを残すと混乱区間が10後退する。割り切った最後の攻撃者は精神力10回復を得: A remaining Shield lowers the Stagger Threshold by 10. The final attacker who breaks it heals 10 SP, but do not abandon dangerous Clashes just to gain this benefit.
messages.boss-copy:josephine:skills.9.name: Housekeeping Start
messages.翌ターンの束縛で行動順が遅くなる。沈潜の蓄積も防ぎ、次のターンに速い敵の攻撃を受: Next-turn Bind delays action order. Prevent Sinking buildup too, so slowed allies are not repeatedly hit by fast enemies next turn.
messages.1枚目で沈潜威力、2枚目で回数を増やす。負けると敵の加算コインも強まるため、序盤: The first Coin adds Sinking Potency and the second adds Count. Losing also buffs the enemy's Plus Coins, so use winning skills from the start.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の沈潜威力が8以上なら、このコインを再使用(1回): Ⅲ[On Hit] If the target has at least 8 Sinking Potency, reuse this Coin once.
messages.[表面的中時]防御レベル減少4、脆弱1を付与: [Heads Hit] Inflict 4 Defense Level Down and 1 Fragile.
messages.沈潜威力8以上では3枚目を再使用する。防御レベル減少と脆弱が次の被害へつながるた: At least 8 Sinking Potency enables third-Coin reuse. Defense Level Down and Fragile increase subsequent damage, so prioritize protecting heavily Sinking-afflicted allies.
messages.鍛錬した個体と同じバリア。残存時の混乱区間後退を避け、割る場合は同じターンで削り: The same Shield as the Trained Butler's. Avoid leaving it to lower the Stagger Threshold; if breaking it, fully deplete it in the same turn.
messages.パニックにしただけで長時間止まるとは考えず、火力を続ける。: Keep dealing damage rather than assuming Panic will disable the enemy for long.
messages.そのターン中に混乱した場合・最大1回: Became Staggered this turn / at most once
messages.ターン終了時に混乱を解除し、精神力20回復。次のターンに攻撃レベル増加1を得る。: At Turn End, remove Stagger and heal 20 SP. Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.最初の混乱はそのターンの追撃に使う。毎回解除される効果とは扱わない。: Use the first Stagger for follow-up attacks that same turn. This does not remove every Stagger.
messages.ターン終了時にパニックから抜け出した場合: Recovered from Panic at Turn End
messages.次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る。パニック回復の後に判定する。: Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Checked after Panic recovery.
messages.パニック後も翌ターンのマッチ予測を確認する。: Recheck next turn's Clashes after Panic too.
messages.boss-copy:josephine:passives.3.name: Insolent Fool!
messages.対象が自分より遅い: Target is slower than this unit
messages.可能なら速い囚人の手を使い、強化を避ける。: Use a faster Sinner's skill where possible to avoid the bonus.
messages.1つの攻撃スキルが全て表面で全て的中: All Coins of one Attack Skill roll Heads and hit
messages.全コインの的中を許して精神力を伸ばさせない。: Prevent all Coins from hitting to deny this SP recovery.
messages.攻撃時、対象に沈潜があり精神力−15以下: When attacking, the target has Sinking and -15 SP or less
messages.対象1体につき1回、次のターンに攻撃レベル増加3を得る。的中時の精神力低下で条件: Once per target, gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn. Also triggers if SP loss from the hit meets the condition.
messages.精神力が下がった囚人へ連続で攻撃を通さない。: Avoid repeated hits on Sinners whose SP has fallen.
messages.ターン終了時に精神力12回復。次のターンに防御レベル減少2を得る。: At Turn End, heal 12 SP and gain 2 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.取り巻きはこの効果で混乱を解除しない。混乱中に倒して妨害を減らす。: This effect does not remove the adds' Stagger. Defeat them while Staggered to reduce disruption.
messages.パニックによる長時間の停止を前提にしない。: Do not rely on Panic to disable the enemy for long.
messages.最初の混乱はターン終了時に解除され、翌ターンには行動できる。最大1回の効果。: The first Stagger ends at Turn End, allowing actions next turn. Occurs at most once.
messages.混乱させる攻撃と追撃の順序を同じターン内で組む。: Arrange the Staggering attack and follow-up damage within the same turn.
messages.沈潜が増えると基本威力やコイン再使用の条件を満たし、束縛で遅くなると本人のマッチ: Sinking enables Base Power and Coin-reuse conditions. Bind slows your Sinners, also making Josephine's +2 Clash Power more likely to apply.
messages.的中を防ぐマッチと精神力回復で連鎖を切る。: Break the chain with winning Clashes and SP recovery.
messages.ヒースクリフを出撃させると通常は精神力が減る特殊効果を得る。ワイルドハント人格で: Deployed Heathcliff gains a special effect that normally reduces SP: Bereavement. His Wild Hunt Identity changes it to Unending Bereavement.
messages.強制出撃ではないため、精神力を維持しにくい場合はほかの囚人も検討する。: He is not mandatory, so consider other Sinners if maintaining SP is difficult.
messages.混乱解除は最大1回。全ての混乱が無効になる敵ではない。: Stagger removal occurs at most once. The enemy does not negate every Stagger.
messages.戦闘開始時・使用時の強化はマッチ勝利だけでは止まらない。: Winning Clashes alone does not cancel Combat Start or [On Use] buffs.
messages.本戦は通常戦闘。集中戦闘と同じ攻撃先変更の手順を前提にしない。: This is a Regular Encounter. Do not assume Focused Encounter targeting rules apply.
messages.6章後半のワイルドハント版ジョセフィーヌとは別の戦闘。: Separate from Wild Hunt Josephine later in Canto VI.
messages.主力Lv42・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。貫通はボスに半減されるため、打撃と斬撃を用: Aim for Level 42 and Uptie III or higher on your main units. Bring Blunt and Slash; the boss halves Pierce damage.
messages.精神力回復と、妨害を受けたターンにも使える高威力E.G.Oの資源を道中でそろえる: Build resources in earlier Waves for SP healing and powerful E.G.O usable even while debuffed.
messages.沈潜と妨害を受け続ける場合は、主力の育成と序盤のマッチを見直す。: If Sinking and disruption keep building, review your main units' training and opening Clashes.
messages.取り巻きを混乱させ、ボスの最初の混乱を同じターンの追撃へつなぐ。: Stagger adds and turn the boss's first Stagger into same-turn follow-up damage.
messages.速度差による強化と、沈潜を起点にした妨害を防ぐ。: Prevent Speed-based bonuses and Sinking-driven disruption.
messages.【リンバス】6-33 デッドラビッツ ボス（6-33）の攻略｜Limbus As: 6-33 Dead Rabbits Boss (6-33) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-33「デッドラビッツ ボス（6-33: Dead Rabbits Boss (6-33) guide for Limbus Company 6-33. Defeating henchmen gives the boss more slots and SP, plus buffs next turn. Handle the henchmen with clashes or Defense Skills, and let Heathcliff take clashes he can win against the boss. Stop “Upheaval” and focus damage on the boss during its Stagger at 60% HP.
messages.取り巻きを倒すとボスのスロットと精神力が増え、次のターンも強化される。取り巻きは: Defeating henchmen gives the boss more slots and SP, plus buffs next turn. Handle the henchmen with clashes or Defense Skills, and let Heathcliff take clashes he can win against the boss. Stop “Upheaval” and focus damage on the boss during its Stagger at 60% HP.
messages.6-33の集中戦闘。全員Lv44。ボスHP929・防御Lv47、奇妙な団員2名と: Focused Encounter at 6-33. All enemies are Lv.44. The boss has 929 HP and Defense Level 47; the 2 Bizarre Henchmen and 1 Veiled Henchman each have 186 HP and Defense Level 36. Heathcliff is mandatory. The boss takes only 0.8× damage from all three Physical types, so also exploit Sin affinities such as Gloom and Envy. Mirror Dungeon variants are excluded.
messages.ボス5技・取り巻き各4技。反撃はマッチできる攻撃ではなく通常反撃。腹いせの基本範: The boss has 5 skills; each henchman has 4. Their counters are regular Counters, not Clashable attacks. Distinguish “Upheaval”'s base range of 5–17 from its Rupture, Bleed, and Antagonism clash bonuses, and from its Heads Hit bonuses to later Coins. “Smackdown”'s Attack Power Up amount is unspecified; do not infer it from its 1 Damage Up.
messages.主力Lv44・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。初動のマッチが強い人格と、打撃を受けても崩: Aim for Lv.44 and Uptie III or higher on your main team. Prioritize Identities with strong opening clashes and resistances that can withstand Blunt attacks.
messages.取り巻きは倒さずにマッチ・守備でいなし、ボスへ火力を集める。広域攻撃で取り巻きま: Keep the henchmen alive, handle them with clashes or Defense Skills, and focus damage on the boss. If an area attack also kills henchmen, account for the extra slots and next-turn buffs.
messages.腹いせに勝てる強い手を残す。ヒースクリフが勝てるマッチを取り、HP60%の混乱か: Save a strong skill that can beat “Upheaval”. Give Heathcliff clashes he can win, and prepare enough damage to finish the boss after its Stagger at 60% HP.
messages.取り巻きを処理したら急に勝てなくなる: The fight suddenly becomes harder after clearing the henchmen
messages.団員が倒れるたびボスのスロットが戦闘中ずっと増え、精神力15回復も起こる。囚人が: Each henchman's death permanently adds a boss slot for the encounter and heals it for 15 SP. If a Sinner kills the henchman, the boss also gains Attack Power Up and Haste next turn. Start by keeping the henchmen alive and handling their attacks.
messages.ボスは毎ターン精神力15回復があり、対象の現在HPが自分より高いとマッチ威力+2: The boss heals 15 SP every turn and gains +2 Clash Power when the target's current HP exceeds its own. Use Identities with strong opening clashes, and lower the boss's SP through clashes Heathcliff can win.
messages.破裂と出血でマッチが強化され、3枚目では出血威力×回数の貫通ダメージも生じる。強: Rupture and Bleed strengthen the clash, and Coin III deals additional Pierce damage equal to Bleed Potency × Count. Save a strong skill or E.G.O for this attack, and prevent debuffs from building up on the preceding turn.
messages.最初は攻撃2つとガードの3行動。取り巻きが倒れるたびスロットが増える。: Starts with 3 actions: 2 attacks and Guard. Each henchman's death adds a slot.
messages.HP60%以下ではガードが反撃へ変わる。混乱中に火力を集める。: At 60% HP or below, Guard becomes Counter. Focus damage during Stagger.
messages.0%と負の混乱区間は資料の表記を保持する。通常の撃破前に狙う区間は60%。: The listed 0% and negative Stagger Thresholds retain the source values. The threshold normally reachable before defeat is 60%.
messages.本体撃破時、残った取り巻きも死亡する。: Defeating the boss also kills the remaining henchmen.
messages.本体撃破で死亡する。先に倒すとボスのスロットと精神力が増える。: Dies when the boss is defeated. Killing it first increases the boss's slots and SP.
messages.取り巻きを残し、ボスへのマッチを安定させる: Keep the henchmen alive and stabilize clashes against the boss
messages.取り巻きの攻撃は勝てるマッチ・守備でいなし、火力を本体へ回す。無条件に広域攻撃を: Handle henchman attacks with winning clashes or Defense Skills, and direct damage at the boss. Using area attacks indiscriminately can strengthen the boss by killing its henchmen.
messages.ボスはターン開始時に精神力15回復。ヒースクリフが勝てるマッチへ強い手を使うと、: The boss heals 15 SP at Turn Start. Using a strong skill for a clash Heathcliff can win lowers the boss's SP by 10 and inflicts 2 Bind next turn, up to once per turn.
messages.ガードへ向く手は守備で相殺するか、ほかの囚人で攻撃へマッチを取る。不要な防御発動: Offset Guard with a Defense Skill, or have another Sinner clash with an attack instead. Avoid triggering its next-turn buff unnecessarily.
messages.破裂と出血を見て強いマッチを残す: Check Rupture and Bleed, and save a strong clash
messages.取り巻き3名が残る通常の行動では、第3ターンに腹いせと打ち落とす2つを使う。実際: With all 3 henchmen alive, the usual Turn 3 pattern is “Upheaval” and 2 uses of “Smackdown”. Check the actual skills and reserve a strong response.
messages.腹いせは対象の破裂5以上・出血5以上でそれぞれマッチ威力+1。さらに現在HPの比: “Upheaval” gains +1 Clash Power for at least 5 Rupture on its target, and another +1 for at least 5 Bleed. Antagonism can also activate based on current HP, so do not judge it solely by the listed maximum of 17.
messages.弱体化E.G.Oを使う場合は、必要資源と発動順を確認する。手札が悪いまま被弾を重: If using a debuffing E.G.O, check its resource costs and activation order. If a poor hand repeatedly leads to hits, review your opening clashes and team.
messages.混乱中に本体へ火力を集める: Focus damage on the boss during Stagger
messages.HP557の混乱を取ったら、憂鬱・嫉妬など通りやすい火力を本体へ集める。本体を倒: After Staggering the boss at 557 HP, focus effective damage such as Gloom and Envy on it. Defeating it also removes the remaining henchmen.
messages.HP60%以下ではガードが通常反撃へ変わる。反撃は守備で相殺できず、攻撃を受ける: At 60% HP or below, Guard becomes a regular Counter. It cannot be offset with a Defense Skill, and the first Sinner to attack takes the counterattack. Check their remaining HP and resistances.
messages.取り巻きを誤って倒した場合は、増えた行動と次ターンのクイック・攻撃威力増加を見直: If you accidentally kill a henchman, reassess the extra action and next turn's Haste and Attack Power Up. Do not face the next “Upheaval” with the same plan unchanged.
messages.的中で破裂威力・回数が増え、トゲ付きバットの追加ダメージも受ける。序盤から勝てる: Hits build Rupture Potency and Count and also trigger Spiked Bat's extra damage. Win clashes from the opening to prevent Rupture buildup.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加、ダメージ量増加1を得る: [Clash Win] Gain Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn.
messages.[的中時]対象の破裂だけ出血を付与: [On Hit] Inflict Bleed equal to the target's Rupture.
messages.敵のマッチ勝利は翌ターンの強化につながる。破裂に応じて出血も増えるため、被弾後の: An enemy clash win gives it buffs next turn. Rupture also increases the Bleed inflicted, making the subsequent “Upheaval” dangerous.
messages.対象の破裂が5以上なら、マッチ威力+1: If the target has at least 5 Rupture, Clash Power +1.
messages.対象の出血が5以上なら、マッチ威力+1: If the target has at least 5 Bleed, Clash Power +1.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺3を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.[的中時](対象の出血×出血回数)だけ、貫通属性ダメージを与える: [On Hit] Deal Pierce damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency × Bleed Count.
messages.最優先で止める。破裂5以上・出血5以上でそれぞれマッチ威力+1、敵意でさらに強化: Stopping this is the highest priority. At least 5 Rupture and at least 5 Bleed each grant +1 Clash Power, and Antagonism may strengthen it further. Coin III deals Pierce damage equal to Bleed Potency × Count, so reserve a strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.使用時に翌ターンの攻撃威力増加1を得る。攻撃がこの防御へ向く場合は守備で相殺し、: Gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn On Use. If an attack is targeting this Defense Skill, offset it with a Defense Skill to avoid triggering it unnecessarily.
messages.HP60%以下でガードの代わりに使う通常反撃。守備で相殺できないため、最初に攻撃: A regular Counter that replaces Guard at 60% HP or below. It cannot be offset with a Defense Skill. Check the first attacking Sinner's resistances and HP, or aim to finish the boss with that attack.
messages.破裂4を付ける単コイン。倒してボスを強めるより、勝てるマッチや守備でいなす。: A single-Coin attack that inflicts 4 Rupture. Handle it with a winning clash or Defense Skill rather than strengthening the boss by killing its user.
messages.破裂威力3以上では基本威力+1。防御レベル減少と破裂回数を重ねるため、破裂の多い: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 or more Rupture Potency. It adds Defense Level Down and Rupture Count, so do not let it hit a Sinner with heavy Rupture.
messages.使用時の精神力3ダメージはマッチ勝利でも受ける。破裂威力で最大+3の基本威力増加: The 3 SP damage On Use applies even if you win the clash. Rupture Potency can grant up to +3 Base Power; hits also inflict Bleed and Paralyze next turn.
messages.通常反撃。対象に破裂があると最終威力+1、的中で出血も増える。弱い一方攻撃で不用: A regular Counter. Gains +1 Final Power if the target has Rupture and inflicts more Bleed on hit. Do not trigger it carelessly with a weak unopposed attack.
messages.破裂回数を3増やす。すでに破裂威力の高い囚人は、単コインでも被弾を軽く見ない。: Adds 3 Rupture Count. Even a single-Coin hit is dangerous on a Sinner who already has high Rupture Potency.
messages.破裂回数3以上では基本威力+1。攻撃レベル減少と破裂を重ね、次のマッチも弱めるた: Gains +1 Base Power at 3 or more Rupture Count. Inflicts Offense Level Down and Rupture, weakening later clashes too. Prevent its hits.
messages.使用時に精神力3ダメージ、破裂回数に応じて基本威力が最大+3。回数増加・出血・攻: Deals 3 SP damage On Use and gains up to +3 Base Power based on Rupture Count. Its Count increases, Bleed, Offense Level Down, and Paralyze compound, so check the current clash prediction and stop it.
messages.破裂のある対象には最終威力+1の通常反撃。取り巻きを残す方針では、攻撃を当てずに: A regular Counter with +1 Final Power against targets with Rupture. When keeping henchmen alive, avoid hitting them and triggering it.
messages.自分以外で精神力が最も低い味方2名に攻撃威力増加1を付与。味方が死亡するたび、戦: Grant 1 Attack Power Up to the 2 other allies with the lowest SP. Each ally death adds 1 slot for the rest of the encounter.
messages.取り巻きは無理に倒さず、本体へ火力を集める。: Do not force henchman kills; focus damage on the boss.
messages.対象の現在HPが自分より高い: The target's current HP exceeds the user's
messages.HPの比率ではなく現在値を比較する。削れた後も主力へのマッチ予測を見直す。: Compares current HP values, not HP percentages. Recheck clash predictions against your main attackers as the boss loses HP.
messages.マッチ勝利時に精神力5回復。ヒースクリフにマッチ敗北すると精神力10減少・翌ター: Heal 5 SP on Clash Win. On Clash Lose against Heathcliff, lose 10 SP and gain 2 Bind next turn (once per turn). If no skill hits Heathcliff during the turn, lose 5 SP at Turn End.
messages.ヒースクリフへ勝てるマッチを残す。勝てない攻撃まで全て本人に任せない。: Reserve clashes Heathcliff can win for him. Do not make him handle attacks he cannot beat as well.
messages.敵が味方を倒す・1ターン最大3回: An enemy kills an ally / up to 3 times per turn
messages.次のターンに攻撃威力増加1・クイック1を得る。: Gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Haste next turn.
messages.取り巻きの同時撃破で翌ターンを強化しない。: Avoid strengthening the next turn by killing several henchmen at once.
messages.与ダメージの50%分の貫通ダメージを追加で与える。: Deal additional Pierce damage equal to 50% of the damage dealt.
messages.打撃耐性だけで安全と判断せず、マッチで的中自体を止める。: Blunt resistance alone does not guarantee safety. Win clashes to prevent the hits themselves.
messages.ターン開始・終了とパニック解除: Turn Start / Turn End / Panic recovery
messages.開始時に精神力−45でなければ15回復。終了時にパニックなら翌ターンに解除して精: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at −45 SP. If Panicked at Turn End, recover next turn and reset SP to 0. If Panic was removed at Turn End, gain 2 Attack Power Up at the next Turn Start.
messages.精神力を下げるだけで止め続けられない。パニック復帰後も強い手を用意する。: Lowering SP alone cannot keep the boss disabled. Prepare strong responses for its recovery from Panic.
messages.パニックタイプを変更せず、精神力のない対象へ付く効果を受ける。: Panic Type does not change; apply effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.パニックを変更する戦法は前提にしない。: Do not base the strategy on changing Panic Type.
messages.ヒースクリフ人格の退却関連機能が作動しない。: Heathcliff Identities' retreat-related functions do not activate.
messages.退却して交代する手順を組まない。: Do not plan to retreat and swap him out.
messages.負傷した囚人へ取り巻きの攻撃を集中させない。: Avoid letting henchman attacks concentrate on wounded Sinners.
messages.パニックで長く止まる前提にはしない。: Do not assume Panic will disable them for long.
messages.ボスは味方死亡で精神力15回復・スロット+1。囚人が倒すと、翌ターンの攻撃威力増: Ally deaths heal the boss for 15 SP and add 1 slot. If a Sinner lands the kill, the boss also gains Attack Power Up and Haste next turn.
messages.取り巻きを残していなす。倒す場合は増えた手数へ対応できる状態を作る。: Keep the henchmen alive and handle their attacks. If killing one, first prepare to handle the extra action.
messages.ボスのHP60%以下ではガードが通常反撃へ変化する。: At 60% HP or below, the boss replaces Guard with a regular Counter.
messages.混乱中に火力を集め、復帰後に反撃を受ける回数を減らす。: Focus damage during Stagger to reduce the number of counterattacks after it recovers.
messages.ヒースクリフは強制編成。通常は精神力が減る喪失を得るが、ワイルドハント人格では果: Heathcliff is mandatory. He normally gains Bereavement, which lowers SP, but his Wild Hunt Identity gets Unending Bereavement instead.
messages.人格ごとの精神力の扱いを確認し、本人が勝てるマッチと回復を用意する。: Check how the chosen Identity handles SP, and provide winning clashes and recovery for him.
messages.取り巻きを倒せば楽になるとは限らない。本体撃破が残敵の処理にもなる。: Killing henchmen does not necessarily make the fight easier. Defeating the boss also clears the remaining enemies.
messages.通常反撃は守備で相殺できない。HP60%以前のガードと同じ対処にしない。: Regular Counters cannot be offset with Defense Skills. Do not treat them like Guard before 60% HP.
messages.出撃人数を減らして主力の手数を増やす方法もあるが、受けられる総HPと初動の手数が: Bringing fewer Sinners can give your main attackers more actions, but reduces total available HP and opening actions. A solo clear is not required from the outset.
messages.次の6-34の敗北条件を、本戦へ流用しない。: Do not apply the next encounter's 6-34 defeat condition to this fight.
messages.Lv44・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、初動のマッチが強い主力と育成済みヒースクリフを用意: Aim for Lv.44 and Uptie III or higher, with strong opening clashers and a well-developed Heathcliff.
messages.憂鬱・嫉妬の火力、高威力マッチ、精神力回復や敵への弱体化を用意する。資源0から必: Prepare Gloom and Envy damage, strong clash skills, SP recovery, and enemy debuffs. Check whether you can build the required resources from 0.
messages.打撃への耐性を重視しつつ、追加貫通ダメージと出血・破裂も考慮する。: Prioritize Blunt resistance while accounting for the additional Pierce damage, Bleed, and Rupture.
messages.敵の高精神力に対抗し、腹いせを止める。: Compete with the enemy's high SP and stop “Upheaval”.
messages.ボスへのマッチ勝利で精神力減少と束縛を与える。強制編成と退却不能に対応する。: Winning clashes against the boss lowers its SP and inflicts Bind. Account for Heathcliff being mandatory and unable to retreat.
messages.不要な撃破を避けながら、本体へ火力を回す。: Avoid unnecessary kills while directing damage at the boss.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-34「ヒースクリフ？」の攻略。味方ヒ: Heathcliff? guide for Limbus Company 6-34. You lose if allied Heathcliff dies. Have other Sinners intercept attacks that can be redirected, and save his strong skills for attacks only he can handle.
messages.味方ヒースクリフが倒れると敗北する戦闘。変更できる攻撃はほかの囚人で引き受け、本: You lose if allied Heathcliff dies. Have other Sinners intercept attacks that can be redirected, and save his strong skills for attacks only he can handle.
messages.味方ヒースクリフを生存させる。変更可能な攻撃は、速い味方で引き受ける。: Keep allied Heathcliff alive. Use faster allies to intercept attacks that can be redirected.
messages.「爆発する感情」がある間は、ヒースクリフへの的中を防いで解除を狙う。: While Explosive Emotions is active, prevent hits on Heathcliff to work toward removing it.
Prepare Heathcliff's own strong skills or E.G.O for “Time to Repent” and “You Must Suffer More!”.
messages.ほかの囚人が生きているのに敗北する: Losing while other Sinners are still alive
messages.味方ヒースクリフの死亡が敗北条件。単純な総HPより、本人のHP・混乱区間・出血・: Allied Heathcliff's death is the defeat condition. Prioritize his HP, Stagger Thresholds, Bleed, and next-turn Paralyze over the team's total HP.
messages.敵を殴るほど戦況が悪くなる: Attacking the enemy makes things worse
messages.爆発する感情中は、被弾に反応した追加効果がある。特に嫉妬形態では攻撃側に出血が蓄: Explosive Emotions has additional effects that react to incoming hits. In the Envy phase especially, attackers accumulate Bleed. Reduce unnecessary unopposed attacks and save strong attacks for after the emotion is removed.
messages.「贖罪の時間だ」と「もっと苦しむんだな！」は対象変更不可。本人がマッチできるスキ: “Time to Repent” and “You Must Suffer More!” cannot be redirected. Reserve skills and resources that let Heathcliff clash with them. Intercept regular attacks with allies faster than the enemy.
messages.6-34のストーリー個体。鏡ダンジョンの個体とは勝敗条件・一部のパッシブが異なる: The 6-34 story version. Its victory conditions and some passives differ from the Mirror Dungeon version.
messages.HP905へ達したターンは、それ以上HPが減らない。HP40%付近のイベントを挟: On the turn it reaches 905 HP, its HP cannot fall further. An event near 40% HP leads into the latter half.
messages.表の罪悪耐性は感情効果による変化前。爆発する感情の属性と状態をその都度確認する。: The table shows Sin resistances before emotion effects. Check the current Explosive Emotion's affinity and state each time.
messages.味方ヒースクリフは退却できず、倒れると敗北する。: Allied Heathcliff cannot retreat; his death causes defeat.
messages.勝てるマッチを作り、ヒースクリフを守る: Create winning clashes and protect Heathcliff
messages.敵の攻撃は味方ヒースクリフへ集中する。対象変更可能なものは、敵より速い味方に引き: Enemy attacks focus on allied Heathcliff. Have allies faster than the enemy intercept any that can be redirected.
messages.敵はターン開始時に精神力を回復し、味方ヒースクリフは通常「喪失」で精神力が下がる: The enemy recovers SP at Turn Start, while allied Heathcliff normally loses SP through Bereavement. Develop your main team's levels and Uptie, leave him clashes he can win, and use SP recovery.
messages.2ターン目から爆発する感情を得る。ヒースクリフへ的中させない攻撃を増やし、感情を: Explosive Emotions starts on Turn 2. Prevent more skills from hitting Heathcliff to reduce the emotion. Prioritize clashes that stop enemy attacks; there is no need to use every spare skill for an unopposed attack.
messages.憤怒形態は混乱で次へ進む。守備「ガード」を相殺する場合も、次ターン強化が使用時に: Stagger advances the Wrath phase. Even when offsetting Guard, remember that its next-turn buff activates On Use.
messages.対象変更不可の広域へ本人の対処を残す: Save Heathcliff's response for the area attack that cannot be redirected
“You Must Suffer More!” cannot be redirected. Prepare a strong skill or E.G.O for Heathcliff to clash with it, and let allies handle the other attacks.
messages.感情中の攻撃は精神力への被害も伴うため、解除を優先。精神力回復や敵の威力低下を使: Attacking during the emotion also risks SP damage, so prioritize removing it. If using SP recovery or enemy Power Down, check resource availability too.
messages.HP905でそのターンの削りが止まり、イベントを挟む。境界へ大量の火力を重ねず、: Damage stops at 905 HP for that turn, followed by an event. Avoid wasting excessive damage at this boundary and save skills for what follows.
messages.ヒースクリフの判定用スキルを確認する: Check Heathcliff's skills for the check
messages.判定を行えるのはヒースクリフだけ。憤怒・憂鬱・嫉妬が有利な判定なので、本人のスキ: Only Heathcliff can attempt the check. Wrath, Gloom, and Envy are favored; review his skill affinities and the displayed success prediction.
messages.成功すると本人に保護5と攻撃威力増加3。失敗すると保護の代わりに脆弱3が付くため: Success grants him 5 Protection and 3 Attack Power Up. Failure gives 3 Fragile instead of Protection, so preventing subsequent hits becomes especially important.
messages.どちらでも味方全員にダメージ量増加2、敵の混乱区間損傷・振動爆発への影響が2倍に: Either result grants all allies 2 Damage Up and doubles the enemy's susceptibility to Stagger Threshold damage and Tremor Burst. Failing the check does not immediately end the encounter.
messages.出血を確認し、感情が消えてから攻める: Check Bleed and attack after the emotion ends
messages.嫉妬形態では攻撃を重ねると出血が増える。一方攻撃を減らし、ヒースクリフへの的中を: Repeated attacks in the Envy phase build Bleed. Reduce unopposed attacks and prevent hits on Heathcliff to remove the emotion.
messages.出血が多い囚人は、攻撃のコインを振ること自体でHPを失う。多コイン攻撃の連打や少: Sinners with heavy Bleed lose HP just by rolling attack Coins. Avoid repeatedly using multi-Coin attacks or concentrating actions on a small team; check HP and Bleed Count.
“Time to Repent” also cannot be redirected. Save Heathcliff's own skill, using E.G.O to clash if needed.
messages.深い喪失になったら敵の速度と防御レベルが下がる。攻撃先と出血を確認したうえで、残: Deep Bereavement lowers the enemy's Speed and Defense Level. Check attack targets and Bleed, then use your saved strong skills to finish it.
messages.変更できる通常攻撃。速い味方でマッチを引き受け、ヒースクリフへの的中を減らす。: A regular attack that can be redirected. Have a faster ally take the clash to reduce hits on Heathcliff.
messages.[マッチ勝利時] 次のターンに攻撃威力増加1とダメージ量増加1を得る。: [Clash Win] Gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 出血3に加え、対象の破裂の数値だけ出血を付与。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed, plus Bleed equal to the target's Rupture.
messages.マッチ敗北で次ターン強化も許す。破裂が多い味方へ通すと出血も増えるので、勝てる担: Losing the clash also allows next-turn buffs. Hits on allies with heavy Rupture inflict more Bleed, so stop it with someone who can win.
messages.対象の破裂5以上でマッチ威力+1。出血5以上でもマッチ威力+1。: Clash Power +1 if the target has at least 5 Rupture. Another +1 if they have at least 5 Bleed.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 次のターンに麻痺3、現在のターンに出血8を付与。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn and 8 Bleed this turn.
messages.的中後は後続コインも強くなる。表の3〜15は追加強化前の数値なので、主力の強いマ: Hits strengthen later Coins too. The listed 3–15 range is before those bonuses; stop it with a strong clash from a main attacker.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血回数3と破裂回数3を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed Count and 3 Rupture Count.
messages.Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[的中時] それぞれ出血3と破裂3を付与。: Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and 3 Rupture.
messages.Ⅳ：[的中時] 次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る。: Ⅳ：[On Hit] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.味方ヒースクリフ本人で対処する。ほかの味方が速くても引き受けられないため、本人の: Allied Heathcliff must handle this. Even faster allies cannot intercept it, so reserve a high-Power skill or E.G.O for him.
messages.ヒースクリフでマッチする広域攻撃。本人の混乱や麻痺を前のターンから防ぎ、使えるス: An area attack Heathcliff must clash with. Prevent Stagger and Paralyze on him from the preceding turn, and keep a usable skill ready.
messages.[使用時] 次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る。: [On Use] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.守備を相殺して攻撃を通す方法はあるが、既に付いた強化は消せない。次ターンのマッチ: Offsetting the Defense Skill can let an attack through, but cannot remove a buff already gained. Check next turn's clash predictions.
messages.一方攻撃にも反撃が返る。出血やHPが危険な囚人を最初の攻撃役にしないよう、攻撃順: Unopposed attacks can still trigger a counterattack. Check attack order so a Sinner with dangerous Bleed or low HP does not attack first.
messages.全スキルが味方ヒースクリフを狙い、ヒースクリフが死亡すると敵側の勝利になる。: All skills target allied Heathcliff. If Heathcliff dies, the enemy wins.
messages.対象変更可能な攻撃を引き受け、本人の生存を最優先する。: Intercept attacks that can be redirected, and prioritize keeping him alive.
messages.感情系列の効果がある間: While an emotion effect is active
messages.該当する罪悪属性に弱くなり、ほかの罪悪属性には強くなる。被弾に反応して感情ごとの: Becomes weaker to the corresponding Sin affinity and stronger against other Sin affinities. Each emotion has additional effects triggered by incoming hits.
messages.通常の耐性表だけで攻撃を選ばず、現在の感情と追加効果を確認する。: Do not choose attacks using only the normal resistance table. Check the current emotion and its additional effects.
messages.ヒースクリフへ的中させられなかったスキルごとに感情が1減少。ターン開始時に混乱中: Each skill that fails to hit Heathcliff reduces the emotion by 1. If Staggered at Turn Start, reduce it by 3 at Turn End. It can decrease by at most 3 per turn and is removed if its value is 1 at Turn End.
messages.ほかの味方でマッチを引き受けることも、感情を減らすことにつながる。: Having other allies intercept clashes also helps reduce the emotion.
messages.感情獲得から2ターンの猶予中に解除: Remove the emotion within its 2-turn grace period
messages.次の2ターンは深い喪失となり行動パターンが変化。間に合わない場合は感情を解除し、: Enters Deep Bereavement for the next 2 turns, changing its action pattern. If the deadline is missed, remove the emotion and gain 6 Offense Level Up and 3 Haste next turn.
messages.解除できなかった次のターンは強化される。攻撃を続けるより、マッチ担当と守備を見直: Missing the removal deadline leads to buffs next turn. Reassess clash assignments and defenses instead of continuing to attack.
messages.攻撃対象の現HPが自分より高い: The attack target's current HP exceeds the user's
messages.終盤に条件を満たす場合がある。敵のHPが減ったからといってマッチが弱くなるとは限: This may activate late in the fight. Lower enemy HP does not necessarily mean weaker clashes.
messages.マッチ勝利で精神力5回復。味方ヒースクリフにマッチ敗北すると精神力10減少、次の: Heal 5 SP on Clash Win. On Clash Lose against allied Heathcliff, lose 10 SP and gain 2 Bind next turn (once per turn). If no skill hits Heathcliff during the turn, lose 5 SP at Turn End.
messages.本人が勝つ意味は大きいが、全部を任せず、勝てるマッチを本人へ残す。: His clash wins matter, but do not make him handle everything. Leave him clashes he can win.
messages.開始時に精神力が-45でなければ15回復。パニックは次のターンに解除して精神力を: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at −45 SP. Recover from Panic next turn and reset SP to 0; gain 2 Attack Power Up at Turn Start after recovery.
messages.継続回復があるため、序盤の精神力差を放置しない。パニックだけで長く止める作戦にも: Its ongoing recovery makes the early SP gap important. Do not rely too heavily on Panic to disable it for long.
messages.パニックタイプ変更を前提にしない。: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.
messages.味方ヒースクリフ人格の退却機能が作動しない。: Allied Heathcliff Identities' retreat functions do not activate.
messages.退却や控えとの交代で敗北条件を避けることはできない。: Retreating or swapping with a reserve cannot bypass the defeat condition.
messages.通常の味方ヒースクリフに付く。ターン終了時、精神力が-15以上なら10減少。被ダ: Applies to ordinary allied Heathcliff Identities. At Turn End, lose 10 SP if at −15 SP or above. On taking damage, lose 2 SP and gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn (up to 3 times per turn). Gain 3 Attack Power Up if below 0 SP at Turn Start.
messages.加算コイン人格は精神力を上げにくい。精神力回復や勝てるマッチで支える。攻撃威力増: Positive-Coin Identities struggle to build SP. Support them with SP recovery and winning clashes. Do not leave SP low just for the Attack Power Up.
messages.6-34では、ワイルドハント人格の喪失がこの効果へ変わる。ターン開始時に精神力1: In 6-34, this replaces Bereavement on the Wild Hunt Identity. Heal 10 SP at Turn Start. On taking damage, gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn (up to 3 times per turn). Gain 3 Attack Power Up if below 10 SP at Turn Start.
messages.通常の喪失と違い精神力を保ちやすい。ただし人格の耐性によっては被弾が危険なので、: SP is easier to maintain than with normal Bereavement. Incoming hits may still be dangerous depending on the Identity's resistances, so continue checking survival and clashes.
messages.憤怒耐性倍率+0.3、ほかの罪悪耐性倍率-0.5。被弾に反応して攻撃レベル増加な: Wrath resistance multiplier +0.3; other Sin resistance multipliers −0.5. Incoming hits trigger additional effects such as Offense Level Up.
messages.不要な一方攻撃を減らして感情解除を優先する。防御低下だけを好機と見て攻め続けない: Reduce unnecessary unopposed attacks and prioritize removing the emotion. Do not keep attacking solely because of its lowered resistance.
messages.憂鬱耐性倍率+0.3、ほかの罪悪耐性倍率-0.5。攻撃側への精神力ダメージ3など: Gloom resistance multiplier +0.3; other Sin resistance multipliers −0.5. Incoming hits trigger additional effects, including 3 SP damage to the attacker.
messages.こちらの精神力が下がると次のマッチも不安定になる。感情中の攻撃回数を必要な分に絞: Losing SP makes your later clashes less reliable. Limit attacks during the emotion to those needed.
messages.嫉妬耐性倍率+0.3、ほかの罪悪耐性倍率-0.5。被弾時の効果で攻撃側に出血2と: Envy resistance multiplier +0.3; other Sin resistance multipliers −0.5. On taking a hit, inflict 2 Bleed and 2 Bleed Count on the attacker, up to 9 times per turn.
messages.少人数の多コイン連打は出血が集中しやすい。攻撃側のHPと出血も見て、感情が消えて: Repeated multi-Coin attacks from a small team can concentrate Bleed. Check attackers' HP and Bleed, and attack after the emotion ends.
messages.ターン開始時に速度-5、防御レベル減少5。感情を猶予内に解除すると次の2ターン付: At Turn Start, Speed −5 and 5 Defense Level Down. Applies for the next 2 turns after removing the emotion within its grace period.
messages.攻撃先を引き受けやすくなる好機。出血が危険な囚人へ無理に攻撃させず、残した主力を: This makes attacks easier to intercept. Use your saved main attackers without forcing Sinners with dangerous Bleed to attack.
messages.「自己嫌悪」は全攻撃の初期対象をヒースクリフにするが、全攻撃が対象変更不可という: Self-loathing makes Heathcliff the initial target of all attacks; it does not make every attack impossible to redirect. Check the 2 dedicated attacks separately.
messages.E.G.Oは使うだけで安全になるわけではない。本人の精神力消費、必要資源、マッチ: Using E.G.O does not automatically make a clash safe. Check his SP cost, required resources, and clash prediction.
messages.爆発する嫉妬の間に一方攻撃を繰り返すと、出血で攻撃側が倒れることがある。敵のHP: Repeated unopposed attacks during Explosive Envy can kill attackers through Bleed. Watch more than the enemy's HP.
messages.感情解除後も、同じ形態が続く間は2ターン後に再び感情を得る。解除を一度きりの仕組: Even after removal, the emotion returns 2 turns later if the same phase continues. Removing it is not a one-time mechanic.
messages.HP905での停止とイベントはストーリー個体のもの。鏡ダンジョン攻略へそのまま流: The 905 HP floor and event belong to the story version. Do not apply them directly to the Mirror Dungeon version.
messages.主力はLv45を目安に、特にヒースクリフのレベルと同期を整える。打撃への耐性と本: Aim for Lv.45 on your main team, paying particular attention to Heathcliff's level and Uptie. Prioritize Blunt resistance and his clash strength.
messages.ほかの味方には速度が高くマッチできる役を用意。強いヒースクリフをサポートで借りる: Bring fast allies who can clash. Borrowing a strong Heathcliff as support is another option.
messages.本人の高威力スキル・E.G.Oと必要な資源を確認。精神力回復や敵の攻撃威力低下を: Check his high-Power skills, E.G.O, and required resources. SP recovery and enemy Attack Power Down can support the opening.
messages.少人数編成は主力の行動と精神力を増やしやすい反面、嫉妬形態で出血も集中する。通常: A smaller team can give main attackers more actions and SP, but also concentrates Bleed in the Envy phase. Start with a regular team; if reducing its size, keep a plan for Bleed.
messages.対象変更不可に勝てるヒースクリフ: Heathcliff who can beat attacks that cannot be redirected
messages.生存とマッチの両方を担う。強いスキルを通常攻撃へ使い切らず、専用攻撃に残す。: Must both survive and win clashes. Save strong skills for the dedicated attacks instead of spending them all on regular attacks.
messages.速く動いて通常攻撃を引き受ける役: Fast ally to intercept regular attacks
messages.敵より速い囚人がヒースクリフへの被弾を減らす。本人へ全攻撃を任せないために必要。: Sinners faster than the enemy reduce hits on Heathcliff. Needed to avoid making him handle every attack.
messages.開幕の精神力差を補い、感情解除に必要なマッチを安定させる。E.G.Oを使うなら資: Bridge the opening SP gap and stabilize the clashes needed to remove emotions. If using E.G.O, include resource generation in the team.

Protect Heathcliff, bring the first pair of hands down together, and destroy Catherine's Shield as well on her second appearance.

messages.魔王とキャサリンが交代する5段階の長期戦。ヒースクリフを守り、最初の両手は足並み: A long, 5-phase battle alternating between the Erlking and Catherine. Protect Heathcliff, bring the first pair of hands down together, and destroy Catherine's Shield as well on her second appearance.
messages.6-48のみ。魔王の3段階、キャサリンと両手の2段階を分けて掲載している。同じ敵: 6-48 only. Lists the Erlking's 3 appearances and Catherine's 2 appearances with her hands separately. These forms do not appear simultaneously. Summons list both overall HP and part HP.
messages.表示威力は条件補正前。一部の加重値・効果が資料に未記載のため、その欄は不明または: Listed Power is before conditional modifiers. Some Attack Weights and effects are unspecified in the source and are marked unknown or annotated. Identically named attacks can differ by phase or hand; check the current user.
messages.ヒースクリフが倒れると敗北。Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、彼のマッチ力とHPを優: Heathcliff's death causes defeat. Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher, prioritizing his clashes and HP.
messages.キャサリン1回目は両手を同じターンにHP1へ。2回目は両手に加え、本体のバリア3: On Catherine's first appearance, bring both hands to 1 HP on the same turn. On her second, also break the main body's 300 Shield.
messages.最終イベント後も広域攻撃へ対処する。ヒースクリフの生存効果が、ほかの囚人も守るわ: Continue handling area attacks after the final event. Heathcliff's survival effect does not protect the other Sinners.
messages.ほかの味方が生きているのに敗北した: Defeated while other allies were still alive
messages.ヒースクリフの死亡が敗北条件。最終段階で生存効果を得るまでは彼を守る。その後も、: Heathcliff's death is the defeat condition. Protect him until he gains his survival effect in the final phase. Even then, protection at 1 HP requires at least one other ally to remain alive. Also watch combinations of Identities that damage allies.
messages.本体を普通に倒す場面ではない。両手をHP1まで削る。2回目では、その後に本体が得: This is not a normal main-body kill. Bring both hands to 1 HP. On her second appearance, then destroy the 300 Shield the main body gains to advance.
messages.倒したはずの手が回復する: A hand recovers after you thought it was defeated
messages.最初の両手は片方だけを早く落とすと回復する。先に片手を削りすぎず、両方の残HPを: The first pair's recovery triggers if only one hand is brought down early. Avoid overdamaging one hand; watch both HP values and bring them to 1 HP on the same turn.
messages.苦痛の雷を持った囚人が混乱する: A Sinner with Lightning of Suffering becomes Staggered
messages.雷はマッチ勝利で敵を弱めるが、敗北や一方攻撃では自分に張り裂ける心とダメージが返: Lightning weakens the enemy on Clash Win, but a clash loss or unopposed attack inflicts Breaking Heart and damage on its holder instead. Assign the holder to a winning clash.
messages.本体HPを共有する3段階。復帰時は精神力0に戻り、混乱区間も現在HPより下にある: The 3 appearances share overall HP. On returning, SP resets to 0 and Stagger Thresholds below current HP are restored.
messages.最大4体のワイルドハントを順に召喚。HP70%で本体が離脱し、取り巻きも撤退する: Summons Wild Hunt units in sequence, up to 4 at once. At 70% HP, the main body leaves and its summons retreat too.
messages.毎ターンランダムな囚人に苦痛の雷。HP40%で2回目のキャサリンへ移行する。: Applies Lightning of Suffering to a random Sinner each turn. At 40% HP, advances to Catherine's second appearance.
messages.最初のターンに演出とイベント。近づく勇気を得た後、強力な広域へ備える。フェーズ5: A scripted sequence and event occur on the first turn. After gaining Courage to Approach, prepare for strong area attacks. The enemy dies instantly at the end of this phase's Turn 5.
messages.両手HP1で行動不能: Incapacitated when both hands reach 1 HP
messages.手が1体でもHP2以上なら保護10、全耐性0.2。表示耐性は保護解除後の値。: If either hand has at least 2 HP, gains 10 Protection and all resistances become 0.2. Listed resistances are after Protection is removed.
messages.最初からある邪魔するな404を削る必要はない。両手を処理するとイベントへ進む。: You do not need to deplete the initial 404 Away With You. Handling both hands advances to an event.
messages.全てのキャサリンの右手（1回目）: Right Hand of Every Catherine (1st appearance)
messages.片手のHPを1にした次ターン終了時、他方がHP2以上なら、他方の残HPの50%だ: At the end of the turn after this hand reaches 1 HP, if the other hand has at least 2 HP, heal for 50% of that other hand's remaining HP.
messages.ヒースクリフとのマッチ威力−3、彼へのダメージ−50%。彼が倒れると敗北する。: Clash Power −3 against Heathcliff; damage to him −50%. His death causes defeat.
messages.全てのキャサリンの左手（1回目）: Left Hand of Every Catherine (1st appearance)
messages.両手HP1 → バリア300破壊で行動不能: Both hands at 1 HP → destroy 300 Shield to incapacitate
messages.2回目は両手処理だけでは終わらない。邪魔するな300のバリアを削り切る。: Handling both hands is not enough on the second appearance. Deplete the 300 Shield from Away With You.
messages.全てのキャサリンの右手（2回目）: Right Hand of Every Catherine (2nd appearance)
messages.HP1になると離脱。最初の回と異なり、片手が回復するパッシブは記載されていない。: Leaves at 1 HP. Unlike the first appearance, no passive that heals one hand is listed.
messages.全てのキャサリンの左手（2回目）: Left Hand of Every Catherine (2nd appearance)
messages.本体HPと胴体HPは資料の値を併記。6-48の召喚個体で、通常ステージの同名敵と: Lists the source's overall and Body HP separately. These are 6-48 summons, separate from similarly named enemies in regular stages.
messages.ジョセフィーヌ → ヒンドリー → 奪われて泣き叫ぶヒンドリー → リントンの順: Summoned in order: Josephine → Hindley → The Reaved Lamenter → Linton. Units can repeat, up to 4 at once.
messages.ワイルドハント・奪われて泣き叫ぶヒンドリー: The Reaved Lamenter of the Wild Hunt
messages.ヒースクリフを主力として育てる: Develop Heathcliff as a main combatant
messages.出撃上限6名、ヒースクリフ必須。Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、打撃を受ける耐性と: Deployment limit: 6; Heathcliff is mandatory. Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher, with Blunt resistance and skills that can win clashes.
messages.通常ステージなので精神力とE.G.O資源を戦闘中に整える。序盤の勝てるマッチを主: Build SP and E.G.O resources during this regular stage. Give early winning clashes to your main combatants, and gather resources for healing E.G.O too.
messages.育成済みが少ない場合は人数を減らして上位の編成順へスロットを集める選択もある。た: If few Identities are developed, a smaller team can concentrate slots on earlier deployment positions. Check that you still have enough actions for area attacks and multiple hands.
messages.取り巻きの全滅より、本体の移行を狙う: Aim for the main body's transition rather than clearing every summon
messages.ワイルドハントは最大4体まで補充される。本体をHP1707付近まで削ると全員撤退: Wild Hunt summons are replenished up to 4 at once. All retreat when the main body reaches around 1707 HP, so you do not need to kill every summon each time.
messages.お前もこの棺に入れてやろうの使用で次ターンの敵全体が強化される。次の首を刈らんの: Using You'll Get Shoved In This Coffin Too buffs the entire enemy team next turn. Save strong skills for the repeated Behead Heathcliffs attacks, and Stagger summons to reduce incoming attacks.
messages.魔王はヒースクリフを狙う。彼でマッチに勝つと敵の精神力を下げられるが、危険な攻撃: The Erlking targets Heathcliff. Heathcliff's clash wins can lower the enemy's SP, but let faster allies intercept dangerous attacks. Advance at 70% HP.
messages.両手を同じ時期にHP1へ落とす: Bring both hands to 1 HP together
messages.本体はHP1だが、手が残る間は保護10と全耐性0.2で守られる。攻撃は両手へ分け: The main body has 1 HP but is protected by 10 Protection and 0.2 resistances while a hand remains. Split attacks between the hands. You do not need to deplete the initial 404 Away With You.
messages.片手だけHP1にすると、その次のターン終了時に、残る手のHPに応じて回復する。両: If only one hand reaches 1 HP, it heals at the end of the following turn based on the other hand's HP. Damage both first, then bring both to 1 HP on the same turn.
messages.ヒースクリフには敵のマッチ威力−3などの有利な補正がある。残るは苦痛だけ･･･へ: Heathcliff has favorable modifiers, including −3 to the enemy's Clash Power. Beating “Misery is All That Remains...” adds Breaking Heart to the hand, helping Stagger it.
messages.両手HP1でイベント。憂鬱・嫉妬が有利で、ヒースクリフに判定補正がある。成功なら: Both hands at 1 HP trigger an event. Gloom and Envy are favored, and Heathcliff has a check modifier. Success also heals everyone's SP.
messages.苦痛の雷の担当をマッチへ合わせる: Assign the Lightning holder to clashes
messages.毎ターンランダムな囚人へ苦痛の雷が付く。この囚人とのマッチでは魔王の威力が6下が: A random Sinner receives Lightning of Suffering each turn. The Erlking loses 6 Power when clashing against that Sinner. Winning inflicts Breaking Heart on the enemy, causing Stagger at 3.
messages.雷の担当が一方攻撃するかマッチに負けると、逆に自分へ張り裂ける心が付く。効果を見: If the Lightning holder makes an unopposed attack or loses a clash, they gain Breaking Heart instead. Check the effects and take winning clashes.
messages.耐え抜くは守備で相殺して攻撃を通す。本体HP975付近まで削ると2回目のキャサリ: Offset “Withstand” with a Defense Skill to let attacks through. At around 975 main-body HP, advance to Catherine's second appearance.
messages.両手の後に、本体のバリアを割る: Handle both hands, then break the main body's Shield
messages.再び両手をHP1にする。今回は手がHP1で離脱し、最初の回にあった片手の回復パッ: Bring both hands to 1 HP again. This time they leave at 1 HP and lack the first appearance's hand-recovery passive.
messages.本体の張り裂ける心は広域と最大HP割合ダメージを伴う。こちらの強制混乱を避けるた: The main body's Breaking Heart is an area attack with max-HP-based damage. Stop it with a strong clasher to prevent forced Stagger on your side.
messages.初ターン後のイベントは憤怒・嫉妬が有利でヒースクリフに補正。成功で両手の攻撃威力: The event after the first turn favors Wrath and Envy, with a modifier for Heathcliff. Success also lowers both hands' Attack Power.
messages.両手を処理した次のターン、本体がバリア300を得る。残した攻撃を本体へ集めて割り: The turn after both hands are handled, the main body gains 300 Shield. Focus your saved attacks on it and fully break the Shield to enter the final phase.
messages.演出を進め、広域を止めながら戦い切る: Advance the scripted sequence and endure while stopping area attacks
messages.最終段階へ入ると、ほかの味方が1名以上生存中はヒースクリフがHP1で耐える効果を: On entering the final phase, Heathcliff gains an effect that keeps him at 1 HP while at least one other ally is alive. The initial attack cannot be redirected or clashed with; advance to the event after Turn End rather than trying to stop it with a normal clash.
messages.イベント後は通常の人格なら近づく勇気を得る。ワイルドハント人格は色褪せた約束のま: After the event, ordinary Identities gain Courage to Approach. The Wild Hunt Identity retains Faded Promise with the survival effect added. Both require another ally to survive, so prioritize responding to area attacks.
messages.魔王の通り道に残るは、哀しみと絶叫のみは最大20・加重値7。強いE.G.Oを残し: “Sorrow and Lament In The Erlking's Wake.” has a maximum of 20 and Attack Weight 7. Save a strong E.G.O to win, and recover HP and SP if needed.
messages.本体を削り切るか、この段階の5ターン目終了まで進めると戦闘が終わる。イベント直後: The encounter ends when you deplete the main body's HP or reach the end of this phase's Turn 5. After the event, this means surviving roughly 4 more turns.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜回数が3増加、沈潜を3付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3 and inflict 3 Sinking.
messages.沈潜が増えると後続の出血や威力条件にもつながる。勝てるマッチで止め、ヒースクリフ: Sinking buildup also enables later Bleed and Power conditions. Stop it with a winning clash and protect Heathcliff's SP.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加、ダメージ量増加1を得る。: [Clash Win] Gain Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜回数が3増加。沈潜を3付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3. Inflict 3 Sinking.
messages.[的中時]対象の沈潜だけ出血を付与: [On Hit] Inflict Bleed equal to the target's Sinking.
messages.マッチに負けると次ターンの威力まで上がる。低精神力の序盤は強いスキルを優先して合: Losing the clash also strengthens next turn's attacks. Prioritize strong skills against it in the low-SP opening.
messages.[使用時]次のターンにワイルドハントユニット1体を生成*16: [On Use] Create 1 Wild Hunt unit next turn.
messages.召喚は使用時なので、通常のマッチでは止められない。取り巻き全滅に固執せず、本体を: Summoning triggers On Use and cannot be stopped with a normal clash. Focus on advancing the main body to its next phase rather than clearing every summon.
messages.お前もこの棺に入れてやろう: You’ll Get Shoved In This Coffin Too
messages.[戦闘開始時]このターンに振動爆発、混乱区間前進効果が100%増加*17: [Combat Start] Increase Tremor Burst and Stagger Threshold-raising effects by 100% this turn.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに自分を含む全味方へ攻撃威力増加3,ダメージ量増加3を付与: [On Use] Grant 3 Attack Power Up and 3 Damage Up to all allies, including self, next turn.
messages.使用時に次ターンの敵全体を強化する。次の首を刈らんの連打に備え、取り巻きの混乱や: Buffs the entire enemy team next turn On Use. Prepare summon Staggers and high-Power skills for the following repeated Behead Heathcliffs attacks.
messages.序盤は全体強化の次ターンに複数来る。麻痺と出血を通すと立て直しにくいので、主力と: Several appear early on the turn after the teamwide buffs. Paralyze and Bleed make recovery difficult, so stop them with your main combatants and E.G.O. Attack Weight for the first appearance is unspecified in the source.
messages.対象の沈潜が5以上なら、マッチ威力+1: If the target has at least 5 Sinking, Clash Power +1.
messages.沈潜・出血がそれぞれ5以上ならマッチ威力が上がる。状態異常とコイン効果を含む現在: Clash Power rises at 5 or more Sinking and at 5 or more Bleed. Check the current prediction, including status and Coin effects.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]沈潜回数が5増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 5.
messages.加重値3の広域。苦痛の雷を持つ囚人なら有利にマッチできるので、表示効果を確認して: An area attack with Attack Weight 3. A Sinner with Lightning of Suffering has an advantage in the clash; check the displayed effects when assigning it.
messages.boss-copy:erlking-cathy:skills.10.name: Withstand
messages.守備スキルで相殺し、ほかの囚人の攻撃を通しやすくする。相殺しても使用時の強化が必: Offset with a Defense Skill to let other Sinners' attacks through. Do not assume offsetting always removes its On Use buff; check next turn's display too.
messages.boss-copy:erlking-cathy:skills.16.name: Withstand
messages.魔王の通り道に残るは、哀しみと絶叫のみ: Sorrow and Lament In The Erlking's Wake.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]沈潜4,出血4を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and 4 Bleed.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]沈潜、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking and Bleed Count by 2.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]沈潜4,出血4を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and 4 Bleed.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]沈潜、出血回数が2増加: Ⅳ[On Hit] Increase Sinking and Bleed Count by 2.
messages.加重値7・最大20の広域。最終形態で高威力E.G.Oを残す理由になる。ヒースクリ: An area attack with Attack Weight 7 and a maximum of 20. A reason to save high-Power E.G.O for the final phase. It also hits allies other than Heathcliff, so do not rely solely on his survival effect.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の体力最大値の100%分ダメージを与える: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal damage equal to 100% of the target's max HP.
messages.対象変更もマッチもできない終了前の演出に関わる攻撃。通常の即死技としてE.G.O: A scripted attack near the ending that cannot be redirected or clashed with. Do not try to overpower it with E.G.O as a regular instant-kill attack; advance Heathcliff's following event.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.次ターンの防御低下を通さない。魔王の危険なマッチを確保したうえで、余る手数を取り: Prevent next-turn Defense Level Down. Secure responses to the Erlking's dangerous clashes, then use spare actions to Stagger summons.
messages.[使用時]対象のマイナス効果が2以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 2 negative effects, Base Power +1.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.マイナス効果が多い囚人を狙われると威力も増す。HP・精神力が健全な囚人で引き受け: Gains Power against Sinners with many negative effects. Intercept with someone with healthy HP and SP.
messages.[使用時]対象のマイナス効果が5つ以上なら、基本威力+2: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, Base Power +2.
messages.[使用時]対象のマイナス効果が5つ以上なら、ダメージ量+30%: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, damage +30%.
messages.[的中時]対象のマイナス効果が5以上なら、このコインを再使用(2回): [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, reuse this Coin (2 times).
messages.[的中時]対象の解除可能なマイナス効果をランダムに1つ除去: [On Hit] Remove 1 random removable negative effect from the target.
messages.弱体化が5つ以上ある対象への強化とコイン再使用に注意。低HPで弱体化の多い囚人へ: Watch its bonuses and Coin reuse against targets with at least 5 debuffs. Do not let it hit a low-HP Sinner with many debuffs unopposed.
messages.回避には守備を相殺として合わせる。取り巻きを倒すためだけに、魔王の高威力攻撃へ出: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill. Do not spend all E.G.O needed for the Erlking's high-Power attacks just to kill summons.
messages.的中を許すと回復・強化につながる。憤怒など本人の弱点を使い、混乱中に火力を集める: Hits enable healing and buffs. Exploit its weaknesses, such as Wrath, and focus damage during Stagger.
messages.速度差によってマッチと再使用が強化される。遅い囚人へ任せる前に現在の威力を確認す: The Speed difference strengthens its clash and reuse. Check current Power before assigning a slow Sinner.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]対象の「スキル」が20以上なら（資料表記。何の数値かは不明）、与ダメ: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target's “skill” is at least 20 (source wording; the intended value is unclear), damage +100%.
messages.低HPの囚人を狙う4枚攻撃。回復か対象変更で守り、撃破からの再使用を許さない。資: A 4-Coin attack targeting low-HP Sinners. Protect them through healing or redirection, and prevent kill-triggered reuse. Its unclear extra-damage condition means the displayed maximum does not guarantee a safe hit.
messages.バリアが残ると次ターン保護4。攻撃を集めるなら同じターンに割り切り、無理なら本体: Remaining Shield grants 4 Protection next turn. If focusing attacks on it, fully break the Shield that turn; otherwise prioritize advancing the main body's phase.
messages.的中による次ターン強化を防ぐ。取り巻きに使う手数と本体への火力を配分する。: Prevent hit-triggered buffs for next turn. Balance actions spent on summons against damage to the main body.
messages.攻撃レベル低下が多い囚人へ特に危険。対象を替えてマッチし、麻痺・脆弱の連鎖を防ぐ: Especially dangerous against Sinners with heavy Offense Level Down. Redirect and clash to prevent a chain of Paralyze and Fragile.
messages.生存者が多いほどバリアが厚い。全員を倒す必要はないので、防御へ火力を吸われすぎな: More survivors mean a thicker Shield. You do not need to kill everyone, so avoid wasting too much damage on its defense.
messages.沈潜と次ターンの束縛・麻痺が重なる。マッチを取りやすい主力の行動を守ろう。: Combines Sinking with next-turn Bind and Paralyze. Protect the actions of your reliable clashers.
messages.使用時の攻撃レベル低下はマッチに勝つだけでは防げない。低精神力の担当を避け、的中: Winning the clash alone cannot prevent its On Use Offense Level Down. Avoid assigning a low-SP Sinner and prevent the additional On Hit debuffs.
messages.戦闘開始時の味方強化はマッチに勝っても発動する。沈潜が多い相手への再使用が危険な: The Combat Start ally buffs activate even if you win the clash. Reuse against targets with heavy Sinking is dangerous; aim for redirection and an early Stagger.
messages.バリアを残すと混乱区間が後退する。倒し切りにくい場合は本体を削って召喚フェーズ自: Leaving Shield raises the difficulty of reaching its Stagger Threshold by lowering it. If a kill is difficult, damage the main body to end the summoning phase instead.
messages.手が残る間、本体は保護と耐性でほとんど削れない。最初のキャサリンでは本体への攻撃: While hands remain, Protection and resistances make the main body nearly impervious. On Catherine's first appearance, redirect main-body attacks to the hands. Attack the main body after its Shield appears on the second appearance.
messages.彼が不幸にならない世界のため: For a World Without His Suffering
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を除いた全味方へ脆弱2,攻撃威力増加2を付与: [Combat Start] Grant 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up to all other allies.
messages.[戦闘開始時]次のターンに束縛（数値未記載）とダメージ量増加5を得る: [Combat Start] Gain Bind (amount unspecified) and 5 Damage Up next turn.
messages.マッチできず、戦闘開始時に手などを強化する。次の広域の前に両手のHPを1へ近づけ: Cannot be clashed with; buffs the hands and other allies at Combat Start. Bring both hands close to 1 HP before the next area attack.
messages.全ての手の体力が1なら、ダメージ量が0になる: If all hands have 1 HP, damage becomes 0.
messages.マッチできない広域。両手をHP1にするとダメージが0になるため、両手の残HPと攻: An Unclashable area attack. Damage becomes 0 when both hands have 1 HP, so adjust their remaining HP and attack order.
messages.両手を同じ時期にHP1にするため、必要なマッチを止めつつ追撃の量を調整する。: Control follow-up damage while stopping necessary clashes so both hands reach 1 HP together.
messages.束縛を受けると次のターンにマッチを取りにくくなる。速度の高い担当を守りながら手を: Bind makes next-turn clashes harder to intercept. Protect fast clashers while damaging the hands.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル減少2を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Offense Level Down next turn.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル減少1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Offense Level Down next turn.
messages.攻撃レベル低下で後続のマッチが不利になる。勝てる担当に任せ、両手を削る火力も維持: Offense Level Down weakens later clashes. Assign a winning clasher while maintaining damage against both hands.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]体力最大値の15%分ダメージを与える: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal damage equal to 15% of max HP.
messages.手にマッチ勝利すると、その手へ張り裂ける心が付く。的中時の最大HP15%ダメージ: Winning the clash inflicts Breaking Heart on that hand. Weaken it without taking the On Hit damage equal to 15% max HP. The second left hand's On Hit effect is unspecified in the source; do not assume it is identical.
messages.全ての手の体力が1なら*18、ダメージ量が0になる: If all hands have 1 HP, damage becomes 0.
messages.2回目の本体が使う広域。的中の固定ダメージと張り裂ける心を止め、こちらの強制混乱: The main body's area attack on the second appearance. Stop its On Hit fixed damage and Breaking Heart to avoid forced Stagger on your side.
messages.次ターンの麻痺3を防ぐ。両手を処理する終盤のマッチ担当へ通したくない。: Prevent 3 Paralyze next turn. Keep it off clashers needed late in the process of handling both hands.
messages.守備で相殺し、両手へ攻撃を通す。片方だけを先に落とすより、両方のHPを見て配分す: Offset with a Defense Skill to let attacks hit the hands. Allocate damage by watching both HP values instead of bringing only one down early.
messages.ヒースクリフが全スキルのターゲットになる。\nヒースクリフが死亡すると、自分が戦: Heathcliff becomes the target of all skills. If Heathcliff dies, the user wins the encounter.
messages.ヒースクリフが倒れると敗北する。味方の攻撃や混乱による事故も含め、最終段階までは: Heathcliff's death causes defeat. Protect his HP until the final phase, including against accidents caused by ally attacks or Stagger.
messages.対象が自分より現体力が高ければマッチ威力+2,ダメージ量+20%: If the target's current HP exceeds the user's, Clash Power +2 and damage +20%.
messages.対象の現在HPが敵より高い: The target's current HP exceeds the enemy's
messages.本体を削ると発動しやすくなる。残HPの多い囚人へ付け替えるときもマッチ予測を見直: More likely to activate as the main body loses HP. Recheck the clash prediction when redirecting to a Sinner with high remaining HP.
messages.マッチ勝利時、自分の精神力を5回復\nヒースクリフにマッチ敗北時に精神力減少10: On Clash Win, heal 5 SP. On Clash Lose against Heathcliff, lose 10 SP and gain 2 Bind next turn (up to once per turn). If no attack hits Heathcliff during the turn, lose 5 SP at Turn End.
messages.ヒースクリフで勝つと精神力と速度を下げられる。ただし無理なマッチは任せない。: Heathcliff's clash wins lower the enemy's SP and Speed. Do not assign him clashes he cannot safely win.
messages.boss-copy:erlking-cathy:passives.9.name: Heart of Vengeance
messages.ターン開始時に精神力が-45でなければ、精神力が15回復。\nターン終了時にパニ: At Turn Start, heal 15 SP unless at −45 SP. If Panicked at Turn End, recover next turn and reset SP to 0. If Panic was removed at Turn End, gain 2 Attack Power Up at the next Turn Start.
messages.パニック後は精神力と攻撃強化が戻る。沈潜で弱めても次ターンまで無条件に安全とは限: SP and attack buffs return after Panic. Weakening it with Sinking does not guarantee safety next turn.
messages.boss-copy:erlking-cathy:passives.10.name: Heart of Vengeance
messages.boss-copy:erlking-cathy:passives.11.name: Heart of Vengeance
messages.パニックタイプを変更するバフ獲得時、パニックタイプが変更されない。その代わり、精: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.パニックを変える効果を受ける: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.パニックの種類を上書きする作戦は使えない。通常のマッチとHP管理を優先する。: Replacing Panic Type is not an option. Prioritize normal clashes and HP management.
messages.パニック状態なら、ターン終了時に精神力が0になる。: If Panicked, reset SP to 0 at Turn End.
messages.パニックのまま何ターンも固定できないので、攻撃を集める機会に使う。: Panic cannot hold it for multiple turns indefinitely; use the opening to focus damage.
messages.ターン終了時、自分の精神力がー10以下なら次のターンに攻撃レベル増加3を得る。: At Turn End, if at −10 SP or below, gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.取り巻きのHP・速度・精神力や対象の弱体化で強さが変わる。危険な攻撃を止め、本体: Summon strength varies with HP, Speed, SP, and the target's debuffs. Stop dangerous attacks and direct damage toward the main body's phase transition.
messages.マッチ進行時、マッチ威力-1,自分に10ダメージ(このダメージで体力が0にならな: During a clash, Clash Power −1 and take 10 damage (cannot reduce HP to 0).
messages.取り巻きはマッチ威力が1下がり自傷するが、これだけでは倒れない。勝てるマッチで弱: The summon loses 1 Clash Power and damages itself, but this cannot kill it. Weaken it with winning clashes.
messages.マッチ敗北時、攻撃レベル増加3を得る(1ターンにつき1回): On Clash Lose, gain 3 Offense Level Up (once per turn).
messages.マッチ敗北時・各ターン1回: On Clash Lose / once per turn
messages.勝っても取り巻きの攻撃レベルは上がる。次のマッチが同じ条件だと思わず予測を見直す: Winning still raises the summon's Offense Level. Recheck the prediction rather than assuming the next clash has the same conditions.
messages.ターン終了時に混乱状態になった*19とき、混乱状態から抜け出して精神力を20回復: At Turn End, if Staggered, recover from Stagger and heal 20 SP. Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn (maximum 1).
messages.混乱が通常通り次ターンまで続くとは限らない。混乱させたターンに後続の攻撃を入れた: Stagger may not last into the next turn as usual. Land follow-up attacks during the turn you Stagger it.
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態から抜け出した場合*21、次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を: If recovering from Panic at Turn End, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.対象が自分より速度が低ければ、マッチ威力+2: If faster than the target, Clash Power +2.
messages.一つの攻撃スキルの全コインが的中したとき、*221つの攻撃スキルのコインが全て表: If all Coins of an Attack Skill hit and all its Coins are Heads, heal 10 SP.
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、精神力が0になる。: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.
messages.一つの攻撃スキルの全コインが的中したとき、コインが全て表面なら精神力を10回復: If all Coins of an Attack Skill hit and all its Coins are Heads, heal 10 SP.
messages.攻撃スキル使用時、対象の体力が70以下のときに基本威力+1,ダメージ量+20%: On using an Attack Skill, if the target has 70 HP or less, Base Power +1 and damage +20%.
messages.使用時、自分の速度が対象より高いならマッチ威力+2,ダメージ量+20%: On Use, if faster than the target, Clash Power +2 and damage +20%.
messages.自分の体力が65%以下になれば、マッチ勝利時に攻撃レベル増加1,体力回復増加1を: After reaching 65% HP or below, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 HP Healing Boost on Clash Win. After reaching 40% HP or below, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 HP Healing Boost On Use. Once a threshold has been met, its condition continues to apply even after healing.
messages.最初の混乱解除以降にマッチ勝利時、攻撃スキル的中時にダメージ量の10%だけ憤怒ダ: After recovering from the first Stagger, on Clash Win, attack hits deal additional Wrath damage equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
