messages.敵討伐時、本体および部位体力を200回復。\n次のターンにクイック1,防御レベル: On defeating an enemy, heal overall and part HP by 200. Gain 1 Haste, 3 Defense Level Up, and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.大回復と強化を許さないため、低HPの味方へ一方攻撃を通さない。: Do not allow unopposed hits on low-HP allies, preventing the large heal and buffs.
messages.印付きの囚人のHPを守り、速度が足りる別の味方でマッチを引き受ける。: Protect the marked Sinner's HP and have another sufficiently fast ally take the clash.
messages.ターン終了時、両手の体力が1になると行動不能状態になる。: At Turn End, becomes incapacitated when both hands have 1 HP.
messages.最初のキャサリンは両手をHP1にするのが突破条件。本体HP1を通常攻撃で倒そうと: On Catherine's first appearance, both hands reaching 1 HP is the condition to advance. Do not try to kill the 1-HP main body with regular attacks.
messages.ターン開始時に体力が2以上の手があるなら、保護10を得て全耐性が0.2に変更され: At Turn Start, if any hand has at least 2 HP, gain 10 Protection and change all resistances to 0.2. If both hands have 1 HP at Turn Start, remove Protection and restore normal resistances.
messages.ターン開始時に生存する手がある: A hand remains alive at Turn Start
messages.両手が残る間は本体への火力を浪費しない。手の処理後に本体の保護が解除される。: Do not waste main-body damage while the hands remain. Protection is removed after the hands are handled.
messages.ヒースクリフとマッチ進行時にマッチ威力-3,ヒースクリフへの与ダメージ量-50%: Clash Power −3 against Heathcliff and damage to him −50%. Heathcliff's death causes defeat for your team.
messages.ヒースクリフは有利な補正を持つ。強いスキルで手のマッチも担当できるが、生存が最優: Heathcliff has favorable modifiers. Strong skills let him handle hand clashes too, but keeping him alive comes first.
messages.体力が1の間は混乱状態になり、体力が1未満に減少しない。: While at 1 HP, becomes Staggered and cannot fall below 1 HP.
messages.HP1の手は混乱して止まる。残る手へ攻撃を回す。: A hand at 1 HP stops acting due to Stagger. Redirect attacks to the other hand.
messages.体力が1になったターンの次のターン*23が終了時、他の手の体力が2以上なら、その: At the end of the turn after reaching 1 HP, if the other hand has at least 2 HP, heal for 50% of that other hand's remaining HP, rounded down.
messages.片手だけがHP1になった後: After only one hand reaches 1 HP
messages.もう片方が残ると、先に落とした手が回復する。両手のHPをそろえ、同じターンを目標: If the other hand remains, the first hand recovers. Keep their HP close and aim to bring both down on the same turn.
messages.2回目も本体HP1だけを見て倒せると判断しない。両手とバリアを処理する。: The second appearance is not defeated simply because the main body has 1 HP. Handle both hands and the Shield.
messages.ターン終了時、両手の体力が1になると次のターンにバリア(邪魔するな300)を得る: At Turn End, if both hands have 1 HP, gain a Shield (300 Away With You) next turn. Removing the entire Shield incapacitates the user.
messages.2回目はさらに本体のバリア300を割る必要がある。両手処理後の火力を残す。: On the second appearance, you must also break the main body's 300 Shield. Save damage for after handling the hands.
messages.数値×0.2だけ全罪悪耐性が増加し、3で混乱。敵にも囚人にも付く。: Increases all Sin resistance multipliers by value × 0.2 and causes Stagger at 3. Can affect both enemies and Sinners.
messages.苦痛の雷を使って敵へ付け、こちらは的中や雷の失敗でためない。: Use Lightning of Suffering to inflict it on enemies; avoid accumulating it through incoming hits or failed Lightning actions yourself.
messages.マッチ勝利で敵へ張り裂ける心と7ダメージ。敗北・一方攻撃では自身に付与とダメージ: On Clash Win, inflict Breaking Heart and deal 7 damage to the enemy. On Clash Lose or an unopposed attack, inflict it and the damage on self instead. Decreases by 1 at Skill End.
messages.雷を持つ囚人は勝てるマッチに参加させる。: Have the Sinner with Lightning take a winning clash.
messages.苦痛の雷の対象とのマッチで、魔王のマッチ威力−6。: The Erlking's Clash Power −6 against a target with Lightning of Suffering.
messages.威力が高い広域へ合わせる候補にする。: Consider assigning its holder to a high-Power area attack.
messages.残りバリアの値。最初の404と、2回目の両手処理後に出る300では攻略上の扱いが: The remaining Shield value. The initial 404 and the 300 gained after handling the second pair of hands require different responses.
messages.1回目は両手を優先、2回目の300は本体を攻撃して削る。: Prioritize hands on the first appearance; attack the main body to deplete the 300 on the second.
messages.最終イベント後に得る効果。毎ターン攻撃威力増加3・保護5などを得て、ほかの味方が: Gained after the final event. Grants effects including 3 Attack Power Up and 5 Protection each turn, and keeps Heathcliff at 1 HP while at least one other ally is alive. Determination on entering the final phase also protects him at 1 HP; Faded Promise provides the corresponding effect for the Wild Hunt Identity.
messages.味方全員の生存を保証しない。ほかの囚人を広域で全滅させないようにする。: Does not guarantee the whole team's survival. Prevent area attacks from wiping out all other Sinners.
messages.魔王最終段階の効果は速度上限+2、毎ターンダメージ量増加・脆弱3。ヒースクリフが: On the Erlking's final phase, raises maximum Speed by 2 and grants Damage Up and 3 Fragile each turn. Final Power +2 if Heathcliff is the main target. On Clash Lose against him, gain 3 Bind and 3 Damage Down next turn.
messages.キャサリンの同名パッシブとは効果が異なる。最後も実際の威力と速度を見る。: Differs from Catherine's identically named passive. Keep checking actual Power and Speed in the final phase.
messages.ヒースクリフが倒れると即敗北。最終段階のHP1保護にも、ほかの味方が1名以上生存: Heathcliff's death causes immediate defeat. Even the final phase's protection at 1 HP requires at least one other ally alive. Watch combinations of effects that attack allies too.
messages.本体HPの下限と段階移行がある。大火力を当てても、そのターン中に最後まで削り切れ: Main-body HP floors and phase transitions limit damage. Even a large burst cannot necessarily finish the entire fight that turn.
messages.最初の両手を片方だけ倒して放置しない。2回目の本体バリアも忘れない。: Do not bring only one of the first hands down and leave it. Remember the main-body Shield on the second appearance too.
messages.最終段階の終了ターンは、開始直後のイベント前の1ターンを含めて数える。イベント後: The final phase's turn count includes the initial turn before the event. It does not require another 5 turns after the event.
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、ヒースクリフの育成と打撃耐性を確認。強い人格を: Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher. Check Heathcliff's development and Blunt resistance. Even when borrowing a strong support Identity, separately assess its survival after losing a clash.
messages.長期戦用のHP・精神力回復と、終盤の最大20の広域を止めるE.G.Oを用意する。: Prepare HP and SP recovery for a long fight, and E.G.O that can stop the late area attack with a maximum of 20.
messages.憂鬱・嫉妬の攻撃が通りやすい。両手は憤怒・色欲も弱点なので、育成済みの手持ちで火: Gloom and Envy attacks are effective. The hands are also weak to Wrath and Lust; build a team that can split damage using your developed roster.
messages.生存が敗北条件に直結する。本人でのマッチ勝利が敵の弱体化やイベント補正にもつなが: His survival directly determines defeat. His clash wins also weaken enemies, and he receives event check modifiers.
messages.雷の担当が変わっても広域を止められるよう、複数の囚人で強いスキルを使えると安定す: Several Sinners with strong skills make the fight more reliable, letting you stop area attacks even when the Lightning holder changes.
messages.火力を左右へ分け、長期戦のHPと精神力を維持する。: Split damage between left and right while maintaining HP and SP through the long fight.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6-45「ネリー」の攻略。目印付きの囚人: Nelly guide for Limbus Company 6-45. Redirect enhanced attacks away from marked Sinners. Later, the captured Sinner must win the freeing Clash. Similar skill names can require different defenders.
messages.6-45のストーリー個体。鏡ダンジョンなどの個体とは区別する。混乱区間と、最初の: The 6-45 story version, separate from Mirror Dungeon and other variants. Lists Stagger Thresholds alongside the action changes after the first Stagger.
messages.条件強化・再使用前の数値。招かざる客の捕縛は資料のコイン数が1枚なのに効果番号が: Values are before conditional bonuses and Coin reuse. “Interloper Apprehension” is listed as 1 Coin, but its effects are numbered II and III in the source; those effects are shown without Coin numbers. The Binding passive says “Combat End”, but check Binding Technique applications each turn in the latter half.
messages.目印付きへの強化攻撃は、目印のない速い囚人で引き受ける。回避には守備を向けて相殺: Have a fast, unmarked Sinner intercept attacks strengthened against marked targets. Offset Evade with a Defense Skill.
messages.後半の招かざる客の捕縛は、捕縛された本人で勝って解除する。応接道第三式結束は捕縛: In the latter half, the bound Sinner must win against “Interloper Apprehension” to remove the bind. Assign “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” to an unbound Sinner instead.
messages.捕縛術を3まで放置しない。ネリーの混乱による解除は2以下だけ。: Do not let Binding Technique reach 3. Nelly's Stagger only removes values of 2 or less.
messages.普段勝てる技でも急に負ける: Suddenly losing clashes you would normally win
messages.バトラーの目印で崩壊はマッチ威力+10、捕捉は+8。表示上の素の威力ではなく、今: Against a target with Butler's Mark, Collapse gains +10 Clash Power and Capture gains +8. Check bonuses against the current target, not just the listed base range.
messages.捕縛された味方を助けられない: Unable to free a bound ally
messages.解除用の招かざる客の捕縛へ、本人がマッチ勝利する必要がある。別の味方が勝っても本: The bound Sinner must win the clash against “Interloper Apprehension”. Another ally winning does not remove that Sinner's bind.
messages.解除しようとしたら捕縛が悪化した: Trying to remove the bind made it worse
messages.応接道第三式結束は、捕縛された対象へ使用すると捕縛術を増やす別の技。こちらは未捕: “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” is a different skill that increases Binding Technique when used against a bound target. Assign it to an unbound Sinner.
messages.回避の成功で次ターンの行動枠が増える。回避を守備で相殺し、敵の精神力回復も抑える: Successful evades add an action slot next turn. Offset Evade with a Defense Skill to also prevent the enemy's SP recovery.
messages.最初の混乱後にイベントと行動変更がある。後半は捕縛術の解除を優先する。: An event and action changes follow the first Stagger. Prioritize removing Binding Technique in the latter half.
messages.斬撃が通りやすく、貫通は半減。育成済みの斬撃主力を中心にする。: Weak to Slash; takes half damage from Pierce. Build around developed Slash attackers.
messages.斬撃主力と、解除に使う高威力技を用意: Prepare Slash damage and high-Power skills to remove binds
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に6名を用意する。斬撃が有効で、貫通火力だけでは長: Bring 6 Sinners, aiming for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher on your main team. Slash is effective; relying only on Pierce damage can prolong the fight.
messages.捕縛された本人で勝つ必要があるので、1名だけに高威力技を集中させない。各囚人のE: The bound Sinner must win, so do not concentrate all high-Power skills on one Sinner. Check each Sinner's E.G.O and required resources.
messages.回避を相殺する守備と、目印付きから攻撃を引き取る速い囚人を確保する。: Bring Defense Skills to offset Evade and fast Sinners who can intercept attacks aimed at marked allies.
messages.目印のない担当へ強化攻撃を引き取る: Redirect strengthened attacks to unmarked Sinners
messages.招かざる客の目印は使用時に付く。防げなかったと慌てず、次の攻撃の対象を調整する。: “Mark Interloper” applies its mark On Use. If it lands, adjust the targets of subsequent attacks.
messages.崩壊や捕捉を目印付きで受けると威力が大きく上がる。目印のない速い囚人で引き受け、: Collapse and Capture gain substantial Power against marked targets. Have a fast, unmarked Sinner intercept them, and focus other Slash attacks on Nelly.
messages.回避へ守備を向けて相殺する。回避を何度も成功させると精神力と行動枠の両方で不利に: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill. Repeated successful evades put you behind in both SP and action slots.
messages.最初の混乱ターンの終了後: After the end of the first Stagger turn
messages.イベントを越え、捕縛対策へ切り替える: Complete the event and switch to handling binds
messages.イベントは傲慢の判定。資料の判定値は有利17（表示21）、ヒースクリフに+10の: The event uses a Pride check. The source lists Favored 17 (displayed as 21), with a +10 modifier for Heathcliff. Choose the participant using the success chance on screen.
messages.成功なら選択者にダメージ量増加2、失敗なら脆弱2。失敗した囚人の次の被弾に気を付: Success grants the chosen Sinner 2 Damage Up; failure gives 2 Fragile. Watch the failed participant's next incoming hit.
messages.以後は捕縛術を持つ囚人を確認し、解除用の高威力技をその囚人に残す。: From this point, check who has Binding Technique and save a high-Power skill for that Sinner to remove it.
messages.後半・捕縛術付与後: Latter half / after Binding Technique is applied
messages.捕縛は本人で解除、結束は別の囚人へ: Let the bound Sinner remove the bind; assign Binding to someone else
messages.招かざる客の捕縛に対しては、捕縛された本人でマッチ勝利し解除する。速度が低くても: The bound Sinner must win against “Interloper Apprehension” to remove the bind. Even a slow Sinner can clash if the attack originally targets them.
messages.応接道第三式結束は逆に、捕縛された本人へ使用されると数値が増える。捕縛されていな: Conversely, “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” increases the value when used against a bound Sinner. Have a fast, unbound Sinner intercept it.
messages.捕縛術はターン終了で増え、3では継続する混乱に陥る。解除が間に合わない場合はHP: Binding Technique increases at Turn End and causes persistent Stagger at 3. If removal is too slow, aim for the Stagger at 20% HP, but Stagger only removes values of 2 or less.
messages.終盤の瓦解も捕縛付きでは強化される。強化条件を避けてマッチし、残る攻撃を集中して: Dissolution is also strengthened against bound targets late in the fight. Avoid its bonus condition when clashing, then focus the remaining attacks to finish Nelly.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル増加1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Defense Level Up next turn.
messages.バトラーの目印は使用時に付く。マッチに勝っても目印自体を防げるわけではない。以後: Butler's Mark applies On Use; winning the clash does not prevent the mark itself. Redirect subsequent strengthened attacks to unmarked Sinners.
messages.[使用時]対象にバトラーの目印があるなら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +1.
messages.目印付きの対象にはマッチ威力+1。勝って麻痺や敵の呼吸獲得を防ぎ、次のターンの行: Gains +1 Clash Power against marked targets. Win to prevent Paralyze and enemy Poise gain, and check next turn's action order.
messages.目印付きにはマッチ威力+1。束縛を受けると次の強化攻撃を引き受けにくくなるため、: Gains +1 Clash Power against marked targets. Bind makes later strengthened attacks harder to intercept, so prevent its hits.
messages.[使用時]対象より速度が高ければ、マッチ威力+2: [On Use] If faster than the target, Clash Power +2.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.[的中時]対象のマイナス効果が3以上なら、このコインを再使用(最大1回): [On Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin (up to once).
messages.敵の方が速いとマッチ威力+2。マイナス効果が3種類以上ある対象では最後のコインを: Gains +2 Clash Power if the enemy is faster. Reuses the final Coin against targets with at least 3 types of negative effects; choose a Sinner with fewer debuffs.
messages.[使用時]対象にバトラーの目印があるなら、マッチ威力+10: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +10.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の混乱区間がない場合、200だけダメージを与える。: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has no Stagger Threshold, deal 200 damage.
messages.[的中時]200だけ混乱区間を前進: [On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 200.
messages.目印付きにはマッチ威力+10。目印のない速い囚人で引き受ける。通すと混乱区間の前: Gains +10 Clash Power against marked targets. Intercept with a fast, unmarked Sinner. Hits raise the Stagger Threshold or deal heavy extra damage if no threshold remains.
messages.[戦闘開始時]バトラーの目印を持つ敵の数だけ加重値が増加: [Combat Start] Increase Attack Weight by the number of enemies with Butler's Mark.
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットより速度が3以上高ければ、斬撃耐性弱化2を付与: [On Use] If at least 3 Speed faster than the main target, inflict 2 Slash Fragility.
messages.[使用時]対象へバトラーの目印があれば、マッチ威力+8: [On Use] If the target has Butler's Mark, Clash Power +8.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに束縛2を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind next turn.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]次のターンにクイック1を得る: Ⅳ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.
messages.[的中時]対象のマイナス効果が4以上なら、ダメージ量の30%分斬撃ダメージ: [On Hit] If the target has at least 4 negative effects, deal Slash damage equal to 30% of the damage dealt.
messages.目印の数だけ広域化し、主対象に目印があるとマッチ威力+8。目印のない担当でマッチ: Attack Weight rises with the number of marked Sinners, and a marked main target grants +8 Clash Power. Clash with an unmarked Sinner and check the other targets' HP too.
messages.[マッチ敗北時]対象が捕縛術を持っていれば、捕縛術が消滅: [Clash Lose] If the target has Binding Technique, remove it.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少6を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 6 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.[的中時]対象より速度が3以上高ければ、このコインを再利用(最大1回): [On Hit] If at least 3 Speed faster than the target, reuse this Coin (up to once).
messages.資料の効果欄はⅡ・Ⅲと表記されているが、コイン数は1枚。効果番号には誤記の可能性: The source numbers these effects II and III despite listing 1 Coin. The effect numbers may be incorrect.
messages.捕縛術のある囚人がこの技にマッチ勝利すると、その囚人の捕縛術を除去できる。別の囚: A Sinner with Binding Technique removes it by winning against this skill. Do not intercept with another Sinner; use the bound Sinner's strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.[使用時]対象が捕縛術を持っているなら、基本威力+5: [On Use] If the target has Binding Technique, Base Power +5.
messages.[使用時]対象が捕縛術を持っているなら、捕縛術1を付与: [On Use] If the target has Binding Technique, inflict 1 Binding Technique.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少3を付与: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.捕縛術のある囚人では基本威力が上がり、使用時に捕縛術も増える。こちらは捕縛されて: Gains Base Power against a Sinner with Binding Technique and increases it On Use. Have an unbound Sinner intercept this skill—the opposite assignment from the bind-removal skill.
messages.[回避成功時]次のターンのみスロットが1つ増加(最大1回): [On Evade] Gain 1 additional slot for next turn only (up to once).
messages.回避成功で敵が精神力を回復し、次のターンの行動枠も増える。守備スキルを回避へ向け: Successful evades heal the enemy's SP and add an action slot next turn. Offset with a Defense Skill to reduce interference with unopposed attacks.
messages.対象に捕縛術があれば、マッチ威力+10: If the target has Binding Technique, Clash Power +10.
messages.捕縛術が無い対象の場合、このスキルのダメージ量が0になる。: This skill deals 0 damage against targets without Binding Technique.
messages.捕縛術がある対象にはマッチ威力+10。対象を替えられるなら捕縛されていない担当へ: Gains +10 Clash Power against targets with Binding Technique. If possible, redirect it to an unbound Sinner. It deals 0 damage without Binding Technique, but do not assume its On Hit Stagger is also disabled.
messages.マッチ勝利時、対象よりも速度が高ければ精神力が3回復: On Clash Win, heal 3 SP if faster than the target.
messages.自分より遅い対象にマッチ勝利: Win a clash against a slower target
messages.遅い担当で負けると敵の精神力も上がる。速度とマッチ予測を一緒に確認する。: Losing with a slow Sinner also heals the enemy's SP. Check Speed alongside the clash prediction.
messages.boss-copy:nelly:passives.1.name: The Uninvited
messages.混乱状態の敵がいるなら、攻撃スキルで対象を優先的に指定する。\n混乱状態の敵へ的: If an enemy is Staggered, prioritize that enemy with Attack Skills. Deal +20% damage on hits against Staggered enemies.
messages.混乱した味方へ追撃が集中する。速い味方で危険な攻撃を引き受ける。: Follow-up attacks concentrate on Staggered allies. Have fast allies intercept dangerous attacks.
messages.パターンが変更されてから戦闘終了時、次のターンに捕縛術がないランダムな人格1名へ: After the pattern changes, the passive's “Combat End” text describes applying Binding Technique next turn to 1 random Identity without it.
messages.最初の混乱後のパターン変更: Pattern change after the first Stagger
messages.後半は捕縛術の対象を毎ターン確認し、本人が解除用のマッチへ勝てる手札を残す。: Check Binding Technique targets every turn in the latter half, and save a hand that lets the bound Sinner win the removal clash.
messages.混乱状態になると、数値が2以下の全捕縛術が除去: When Staggered, remove all Binding Technique with a value of 2 or less.
messages.捕縛術2以下なら解除される。3まで放置してから混乱させても救出できない。: Removes Binding Technique at 2 or less. Staggering Nelly after it reaches 3 cannot free the Sinner.
messages.精神力低下での隙は使えるが、次ターンもパニックのままとは考えない。: Use the opening created by low SP, but do not assume Panic will continue next turn.
messages.パニックタイプを変更するバフ獲得時、パニックタイプが変更されない。その代わり、精: When gaining a buff that changes Panic Type, Panic Type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.パニックの上書きに頼らず、的中を防いで攻略する。: Win by preventing hits rather than relying on replacing Panic Type.
messages.特定の技のマッチ威力を上げ、捕捉では付与人数に応じて加重値も増やす。: Increases Clash Power on certain skills; Capture also gains Attack Weight based on the number of marked targets.
messages.目印は使用時付与もある。目印のない担当で強化を避ける。: Some marks apply On Use. Use unmarked Sinners to avoid the bonuses.
messages.最大3。ターン終了で数値が増え、次ターンに数値分の束縛。3では消えない混乱状態に: Maximum 3. Increases at Turn End and inflicts Bind equal to its value next turn. At 3, causes Stagger that does not end.
messages.招かざる客の捕縛に本人が勝って解除。ネリーの混乱による一斉解除は数値2以下のみ。: The bound Sinner must beat “Interloper Apprehension” to remove it. Nelly's Stagger removes it from everyone only at values of 2 or less.
messages.捕縛と結束は別の技。解除したい本人に結束を受けさせない。: “Interloper Apprehension” and “Receiving Arts 3: Binding” are different skills. Do not assign Binding to the Sinner you want to free.
messages.捕縛術3は、ネリーを混乱させても捕縛解除の対象にならない。: Binding Technique at 3 is not removed by Release From Binds even if Nelly is Staggered.
messages.目印を付ける使用時効果はマッチ勝利では取り消せない。: Winning the clash does not cancel an On Use mark application.
messages.瓦解は未捕縛の対象へダメージ0だが、的中時の混乱効果がある。安全な一方攻撃として: Dissolution deals 0 damage to unbound targets, but has an On Hit Stagger effect. Do not leave it unchecked as a safe unopposed attack.
messages.斬撃主力、HP回復、捕縛解除用の高威力E.G.Oを用意。解除担当を事前に1名へ固: Prepare Slash attackers, HP recovery, and high-Power E.G.O for removing binds. Do not fix the removal role to one Sinner in advance.
messages.精神力を整え、全員が解除用のマッチを取れる手札・資源を保つ。: Maintain SP and keep skills and resources that let every Sinner take a bind-removal clash.
messages.目印や捕縛術のない囚人へ強化攻撃をそらす。: Redirect strengthened attacks to Sinners without marks or Binding Technique.
messages.捕縛された本人で解除用のマッチに勝つ。: Let the bound Sinner win the removal clash.
messages.混乱を狙いながら、捕縛が進む前に倒し切る。: Aim for Stagger and finish the fight before binds progress too far.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-16「理髪師（7-16）」の攻略。破: The Barber (7-16) guide for Limbus Company 7-16. Prepare to survive Unbreakable area attacks even after winning their Clashes. Maintain HP and manage Bleed to prevent the fixed-target instant-kill skill from appearing.
messages.7-16の単体戦。7章ダンジョンの再戦とはHPと使用技が異なる。基礎Lv70から: The solo boss encounter at 7-16. HP and available skills differ from the Canto VII dungeon rematch. Withered lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 25 from the base Lv.70; additional Scissorblade buffs vary separately. Lists the explicitly stated Stagger Thresholds at 60% and 30%.
messages.条件強化前の数値。広域の加重値は攻撃前に鋏の段階で増えるため、基礎値1を表示。仲: Values are before conditional buffs. Area Attack Weight increases with Scissorblade stage Before Attack, so the base value of 1 is shown. “I'll Cut You Together!”'s Offense Level is unspecified. Reported issues affect Scissorblade consumption and the Attack Weight cap; do not assume consumption weakens the next attack or that the range is capped as expected. “Even Sharper”'s bonus checks the Barber's own Bleed.
messages.ドンキホーテは初期出撃必須。6名＋控え6名で、HP・精神力回復と広域へ勝つ高威力: Don Quixote must be in the initial deployment. Bring 6 Sinners plus 6 reserves, HP and SP recovery, and high-Power E.G.O to beat area attacks.
messages.破壊不能の広域は勝っても出血が残る。先に回復し、マッチ担当が途中で混乱してほかの: Winning against an Unbreakable area attack still leaves Bleed. Heal beforehand and check action order so a clasher is not Staggered before their other clashes.
messages.HP30%以下の囚人を放置しない。即死技は対象変更不可なので、本人で勝つか的中前: Do not leave Sinners at 30% HP or below. The instant-kill skill cannot be redirected; the targeted Sinner must win, or be healed before the hit.
messages.広域に勝ったのに全員が倒れる: Everyone dies despite winning the area clash
messages.破壊不能の的中による出血は残る。勝利は無傷になる条件ではない。大技前に回復し、残: Unbreakable hits still inflict Bleed. Winning does not mean taking no damage. Heal before the big attack, then check how many Coins Sinners can roll with the remaining Bleed.
messages.勝てるはずのマッチが一方攻撃になった: An expected clash became an unopposed attack
messages.先の広域で担当が混乱すると、後のマッチを実行できない。広域を受ける順番と担当の混: A Sinner Staggered by an earlier area attack cannot execute later clashes. Check area-attack order and the clasher's Stagger Thresholds; reassign if needed.
messages.赤い対象線を別の囚人へ移せない: Unable to move a red targeting line to another Sinner
messages.美しくないものはいらないわぁ！！は対象変更不可。HPの低い本人が勝つか、回復を先: I Don't Need Ugly Things!! cannot be redirected. The low-HP target must win, or receive healing first to rise above 30% HP.
messages.理髪師のHPが戻って倒せない: The Barber keeps healing and will not die
messages.出血付きへの的中で吸血する。マッチに勝つと、破壊不能が残ってもこの吸血は抑えられ: She drains HP when hitting targets with Bleed. Winning the clash suppresses this healing even if Unbreakable Coins remain. Beat dangerous attacks rather than simply trading hits.
messages.開始時の血染めの鋏の刃は10で段階Ⅱ。色欲・暴食が有効。: Starts with 10 Blood-tinged Scissorblades, at stage II. Lust and Gluttony are effective.
messages.HP40%で行動変更し、以後は毎ターン出血10と鋏2を得る。: Changes pattern at 40% HP, then gains 10 Bleed and 2 Scissorblades each turn.
messages.通常のドンキホーテには正義溢れる気分である！！、室長人格には血の涙を呑み、吾が適: Ordinary Don Quixote Identities gain HOW RIGHTEOUS!!; the Manager Identity gains I will take responsibility, through my bloody tears. instead. Do not assume either can survive the low-HP instant kill.
messages.回復と控えを用意して、低HPを残さない: Prepare recovery and reserves; do not leave HP low
messages.ステージ推奨Lv48・同期Ⅲ以上を育成の目安に、ドンキホーテを含め6名を選ぶ。ド: Choose 6 Sinners including Don Quixote, aiming for the recommended Lv.48 and Uptie III or higher. Don Quixote cannot be a reserve. Set 6 reserves too so the team can keep fighting after losses.
messages.斬撃を受ける耐性、色欲・暴食の広域に対するE.G.O耐性を確認する。火力は色欲・: Check Slash resistance and E.G.O resistances against Lust and Gluttony area attacks. Lust and Gluttony are effective for damage too.
messages.HP・精神力回復と、高威力の広域マッチ担当を用意。回復の手札と資源を大技前まで残: Prepare HP and SP recovery and a strong area-attack clasher. Save healing skills and resources for before the big attack.
messages.精神力を上げ、裁縫対象への強化を避ける: Build SP and avoid bonuses against the Sewing Target
messages.まず勝てるマッチを取り、味方の精神力を上げる。もっと鋭くは使用時に敵の精神力も回: Start with winning clashes to raise allied SP. “Even Sharper” also heals the enemy's SP On Use, so predictions may differ from last turn.
messages.裁縫対象へチョッキン！が向くとマッチ威力+5。速い別の囚人で引き取り、低HPの味: “SNIP!!” gains +5 Clash Power against the Sewing Target. Have another fast Sinner intercept it and protect low-HP allies.
messages.出血付きの囚人へ一方攻撃を通すと吸血される。破壊不能の攻撃もマッチに勝って吸血を: Unopposed hits on Sinners with Bleed let her drain HP. Win clashes against Unbreakable attacks too to suppress healing.
messages.4ターン目の広域・以後の大技: Turn 4 area attack / later big attacks
messages.事前回復して、広域に勝ってから被弾を受け切る: Heal first, win the area clash, then survive the hits
messages.仲良く切ってあげるぅ！には強いE.G.Oを合わせる。マッチ敗北すると前3枚で出血: Use a strong E.G.O against “I'll Cut You Together!” Losing lets the first 3 Coins forcibly activate Bleed, so prioritize winning.
messages.勝っても前3枚の破壊不能による出血付与は残る。追加対象を含め先に回復し、出血付き: Even after a win, the first 3 Unbreakable Coins still inflict Bleed. Heal all targets beforehand, including additional targets, and check whether they can survive subsequent attacks while Bleeding.
messages.攻撃前に加重値と対象が変わる。初期の対象線だけで対象外と判断しない。先の広域で別: Attack Weight and targets change Before Attack. Do not assume safety from the initial targeting lines. Check actual action order so an earlier area attack does not Stagger another clasher.
messages.再び強まる前に削り、即死条件を避ける: Deal damage before further buffs and avoid instant-kill conditions
messages.後半は毎ターン理髪師の出血と鋏が増える。混乱を利用して攻撃を集中し、無用に長期化: In the latter half, the Barber gains Bleed and Scissorblades each turn. Focus attacks during Stagger and avoid unnecessarily prolonging the fight.
messages.囚人のHPが30%以下だと対象変更不可の即死技へつながる。本人で勝つか、先行回復: A Sinner at 30% HP or below enables an instant-kill attack that cannot be redirected. Win with that Sinner or heal them above 30% HP before it hits. Do not rely on effects that keep HP at 1.
messages.主力が倒れても控えがいれば次ターンに補充される。交代した囚人の精神力と耐性を確認: If a deployed Sinner falls, a reserve enters next turn. Check the replacement's SP and resistances, and recover using your remaining healers and high-Power skills.
messages.綺麗に切ってあげるわねぇ！: I'll Cut You Up All Pretty!
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Clash Power +1.
messages.[使用時]自分の出血回数5につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed Count on self (max 3).
messages.[的中時](血染めの鋏の刃-1)に比例し、コインを再使用(最大2回): [On Hit] Reuse this Coin in proportion to (Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage −1), up to 2 times.
messages.血染めの鋏の刃の段階でコインを再使用する。最初の1枚だけの攻撃とは限らない。出血: Reuses the Coin based on Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage; it is not necessarily just a single-Coin attack. Also check its bonus against targets with heavy Bleed.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大で20消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血染めの鋏の刃1を得て精: [On Use] Consume up to 20 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades and heal 3 SP per 10 Bloodfeast consumed.
messages.-このスキルで血餐を消耗できなければ、出血30を得る: - If this skill cannot consume Bloodfeast, gain 30 Bleed.
messages.[使用時]自分の出血5につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on self (max 2).
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.使用時に血餐を使い、鋏と精神力を増やす。マッチ勝利で使用時の強化は取り消せないが: Consumes Bloodfeast On Use to gain Scissorblades and SP. Winning cannot cancel the On Use buffs, but prevents the Bleed Count increases.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大30消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血染めの鋏の刃1を得て精神: [On Use] Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades and heal 3 SP per 10 Bloodfeast consumed.
messages.[使用時]対象に裁縫対象があればマッチ威力+5: [On Use] If the target is a Sewing Target, Clash Power +5.
messages.裁縫対象へ的中するたびに精神力を5回復: Heal 5 SP each time a hit lands on a Sewing Target.
messages.裁縫対象にはマッチ威力+5。裁縫対象ではない速い囚人に引き受けさせる。: Gains +5 Clash Power against a Sewing Target. Have a fast Sinner without Sewing Target intercept it.
messages.[攻撃前]血染めの鋏の刃段階に比例して攻撃加重値+1(最大2): [Before Attack] Attack Weight +1 per Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage (max 2).
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、マッチ威力+2: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Clash Power +2.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに深く斬られた傷1を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Deep Laceration next turn.
messages.[表面的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が2増加: [Heads Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.加重値は攻撃前に増加し、最初のコインは破壊不能。マッチに勝ったうえで被弾と深く斬: Attack Weight increases Before Attack and Coin I is Unbreakable. Win the clash, then prepare for the hit, Deep Laceration, and Bleed. Do not judge safety solely by the initially displayed additional targets.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.
messages.[的中時]次のターンにて裁縫対象になる: [On Hit] Become a Sewing Target next turn.
messages.2枚目は破壊不能。勝っても深く斬られた傷や次ターンの裁縫対象が残り得るので、次タ: Coin II is Unbreakable. Deep Laceration or next-turn Sewing Target may remain even after a win; check next turn's assignments too.
messages.[攻撃前]血染めの鋏の刃段階に比例して攻撃加重値+1: [Before Attack] Attack Weight +1 per Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大100消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血染めの鋏の刃1を得て精: [On Use] Consume up to 100 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades and heal 3 SP per 10 Bloodfeast consumed.
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中]対象の出血を発動(最大10)。対象の出血回数が1減少: [On Hit after Clash Win] Activate the target's Bleed (max 10); reduce their Bleed Count by 1.
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]血染めの鋏の刃段階に比例し、ダメージ量+40％(最大120％): Ⅳ[On Hit] Damage +40% per Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage (max 120%).
messages.[敵討伐時]このコイン効果で相手を倒した場合、倒した対象への与ダメージ量の50％: [On Kill] If this Coin effect defeats the target, heal for 50% of damage dealt to that target.
An area attack whose first 3 Coins are Unbreakable. Losing the clash also causes immediate Bleed activation, so win with a strong E.G.O. Normal Bleed application remains after a win; heal everyone beforehand.
messages.[使用時]血染めの鋏の刃段階に比例し、マッチ威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Clash Power +1 per Blood-tinged Scissorblade stage (max 3).
messages.[使用時]自分の出血5につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on self (max 3).
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が4増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 4.
messages.マッチ可能な反撃。鋏の段階と本人の出血で強化される。強い担当で処理し、出血の多い: A Clashable Counter, strengthened by Scissorblade stage and the Barber's own Bleed. Assign a strong clasher; do not carelessly attack first with a low-HP Sinner carrying heavy Bleed.
messages.boss-copy:barber:skills.7.name: I Don't Need Ugly Things!!
messages.現体力の比率が最も低い対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritizes the target with the lowest current HP percentage.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の体力が30％以下なら即死: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target is at 30% HP or below, instantly kill them.
messages.[敵討伐時]倒した対象の体力の30％だけ血餐が増加: [On Kill] Increase Bloodfeast by 30% of the defeated target's HP.
messages.対象変更不可。狙われた本人の強い技で勝つか、的中前にHPを30%より上へ戻す。H: Cannot be redirected. Win with the targeted Sinner's strong skill or heal them above 30% HP before the hit. Do not rely on survival at 1 HP to prevent instant death.
messages.boss-copy:barber:passives.0.name: Starved and Withered
messages.表示の攻撃・防御レベルには老衰を反映している。以後の鋏・棘・深刻な負傷などによる: Displayed Offense and Defense Levels account for Withered. Check subsequent changes from Scissorblades, Thorns, Severe Wounds, and other effects too.
messages.裁縫対象に危険な技が集まる。速い別の囚人で引き受けられる攻撃を確認する。: Dangerous skills concentrate on the Sewing Target. Check which attacks another fast Sinner can intercept.
messages.敵の中で全体力の30％だけが残っている敵がいれば、「美しくないものは要らないわぁ: If an enemy has 30% HP remaining, use I Don't Need Ugly Things!!.
messages.囚人のHPが30%以下: A Sinner is at 30% HP or below
messages.対象変更できない即死技に備え、低HPの囚人を回復する。発動されたら狙われた本人で: Heal low-HP Sinners to prepare for the instant-kill skill that cannot be redirected. If it appears, the target must win the clash.
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、次のターン開始時にパニック状態を解除し、精神力が:
If Panicked at Turn End, recover at the next Turn Start and reset SP to 0. On recovery from Panic:
- Consume 30 Bloodfeast; gain 2 Attack Power Up and 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades next turn, and heal 20 SP.
- If unable to consume Bloodfeast, gain 30 Bleed, immediately activate Bleed damage, then reduce Bleed Count by 3. Afterward, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 2 Damage Up next turn, and heal 20 SP.
messages.解除後は精神力が戻り攻撃も強化される。沈潜だけで無力化し続ける作戦にはしない。: Recovery restores SP and strengthens attacks. Do not rely on Sinking alone to keep her disabled.
messages.boss-copy:barber:passives.4.name: It's Not Over Yet
messages.自分の体力が残り40％になったとき、パターン変更\nパターン変更時、毎ターン出血: At 40% HP remaining, change pattern. After the change, gain 10 Bleed and 2 Blood-tinged Scissorblades each turn.
messages.後半は出血と鋏が毎ターン増える。強化を重ねられる前に攻撃を集中する。: Bleed and Scissorblades increase every turn in the latter half. Focus attacks before the buffs stack further.
messages.このキャラクターが戦闘に登場するか、登場する敵リストに含まれているなら、1ターン: If this character appears in the encounter or is in its enemy roster, all characters' Bleed damage increases Bloodfeast from Turn 1. Each time this character enters, reveal the latent blood scattered across the battlefield.
messages.戦場で出血ダメージが発生: Bleed damage occurs on the battlefield
messages.敵味方で共有する資源。自分の出血や敵の自傷でも増えるので、常に枯らせるとは考えな: A resource shared by enemies and allies. Your Bleed and enemy self-damage both increase it; do not assume you can always keep it depleted.
messages.戦闘開始時、血染めの鋏の刃を10得る\n-血染めの鋏の刃が1未満に減少しない\n:
At Combat Start, gain 10 Blood-tinged Scissorblades.
- Cannot fall below 1.
- At 10 or more, changes to Blood-tinged Scissorblades II.
- At 20 or more, changes to Blood-tinged Scissorblades III.
Returns to the previous stage if consumption lowers the value below its threshold.
messages.開始時と鋏の獲得・消費: At the start / on gaining or consuming Scissorblades
messages.初期10で段階Ⅱ。段階が上がると再使用や広域が強くなるため、今の数値を確認する。: Starts at 10, stage II. Higher stages strengthen reuse and area attacks; check the current value.
messages.攻撃的中時、対象へ出血があれば、被ダメージ量の40％だけ部位と本体の体力を回復\: On attack hit against a target with Bleed, heal part and overall HP by 40% of the damage taken by that target. If 100 HP was healed by Attack End, heal 10 SP. This effect does not activate on Unbreakable hits after losing a clash.
messages.出血付きの対象へ的中: On hitting a target with Bleed
messages.マッチ勝利で吸血を抑える。破壊不能で被弾が残っても、理髪師がマッチ敗北した後はこ: Winning suppresses HP drain. Even if Unbreakable hits remain, this healing does not activate after the Barber loses the clash.
messages.パニックの種類を上書きする効果に頼らず、マッチと回復で対応する。: Handle the fight with clashes and recovery rather than relying on replacing Panic Type.
messages.初期10でⅡ、20以上でⅢ。最低1。段階と数値で攻防や技の再使用・加重値が変わる: Starts at 10, stage II; reaches III at 20 or more. Minimum 1. Stage and value change offense, defense, Coin reuse, and Attack Weight.
messages.同じ技でも毎回同じ威力・範囲ではない。攻撃前の強化と追加対象に備える。: The same skill can vary in Power and range. Prepare for Before Attack buffs and additional targets.
messages.理髪師の優先攻撃対象。一部の技がこの対象に対して強化される。ターン終了で消える。: The Barber's priority attack target. Some skills gain bonuses against it. Removed at Turn End.
messages.チョッキン！などは裁縫対象でない担当に引き取る。: Have Sinners without Sewing Target intercept attacks such as “SNIP!!”
messages.マッチ敗北時に出血回数が3増え、出血を発動して回数を1消費する。ターン終了で消え: On Clash Lose, increase Bleed Count by 3, activate Bleed, and consume 1 Count. Removed at Turn End.
messages.付与された囚人は負けるマッチを避ける。出血が重なる前に回復する。: Affected Sinners should avoid losing clashes. Heal before Bleed builds up.
messages.血の涙を呑み、吾が適任を負おう。: I will take responsibility, through my bloody tears.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長のドンキホーテは、通常の専用支援の代わりにこの効果を得る。: The Manager of La Manchaland Don Quixote gains this instead of the normal support effect. On gaining Hardblood, gain 1 extra (up to 5 times per turn). At Turn End, gain 2 Haste and 3 Offense Level Up next turn; every 3 cumulative turns, add another 2 Offense Level Up (max 6). Heal 3 SP on Clash Win; on defeating an enemy, gain 1 Clash Power Up next turn (once per turn each).
messages.室長人格ではクイックと硬血獲得が変わり、通常支援の防御Lv減少もない。実際に付い: The Manager Identity has different Haste and Hardblood gains and lacks the normal support's Defense Level Down. Check the effects actually applied.
messages.この戦闘の理髪師は攻撃・防御レベルが25下がる。: The Barber's Offense and Defense Levels are lowered by 25 in this encounter.
messages.基礎Lv70だけを見て過剰な育成が必要と判断せず、現在の予測を確認する。: Do not assume excessive leveling is needed based solely on the base Lv.70. Check the current prediction.
messages.戦場で発生する出血ダメージを蓄積し、敵味方で共有する。理髪師は鋏や精神力の獲得に: Accumulates Bleed damage across the battlefield and is shared by enemies and allies. The Barber consumes it to gain Scissorblades and SP.
messages.本人の自傷でも増える。味方の出血を抑えても完全に枯れるとは限らない。: Her own self-damage also increases it. Suppressing allied Bleed does not guarantee it runs out completely.
messages.室長以外のドンキホーテの支援効果。ターン終了に次ターンのクイック1・攻撃Lv増加: Support effect for Don Quixote Identities other than the Manager. At Turn End, gain 1 Haste, 3 Offense Level Up, and 3 Defense Level Down next turn. Every 3 cumulative turns, add another 2 Offense Level Up (max 6). Heal 3 SP on Clash Win; on defeating an enemy, gain 1 Clash Power Up next turn (once per turn each).
messages.ドンキホーテも強いマッチを担当できる。一方で防御は下がるため、出血と低HPを放置: Don Quixote can handle strong clashes too. Her Defense Level is reduced, so do not ignore Bleed or low HP. The Manager Identity receives a different support effect instead.
messages.破壊不能はマッチ勝利でも被弾が残る。通常の的中効果と、敗北時だけの出血即時発動を: Unbreakable hits remain after a clash win. Distinguish normal On Hit effects from immediate Bleed activation that occurs only after you lose the clash.
messages.美しくないものはいらないわぁ！！は対象変更不可。HP1で耐える効果も即死対策とし: I Don't Need Ugly Things!! cannot be redirected. Do not rely on effects that keep HP at 1 to prevent its instant kill.
messages.広域の加重値は攻撃前に変わる。初期表示だけで対象外になると決めつけない。: Area Attack Weight changes Before Attack. Do not assume the initial display guarantees a Sinner will not be hit.
messages.資料には鋏消費・加重値上限の不具合報告がある。次の大技が弱まることを前提にしない: Scissorblade consumption and the Attack Weight cap have reported issues. Do not assume the next big attack will become weaker.
messages.ドンキホーテ必須、主力6名＋控え6名。回復E.G.Oの資源と、対象変更不可の技に: Don Quixote is mandatory: 6 deployed Sinners plus 6 reserves. Check healing E.G.O resources and each Sinner's response to attacks that cannot be redirected.
messages.貫通・打撃中心の主力や、色欲・暴食の火力を選ぶ。出血付きで攻撃する際のHPにも余: Choose developed Pierce or Blunt attackers, or Lust and Gluttony damage. Keep enough HP to attack while carrying Bleed.
messages.敗北時の出血即時発動を防ぎ、吸血を抑える。: Prevent immediate Bleed activation on a clash loss and suppress HP drain.
messages.破壊不能の被弾に耐え、低HPへの即死条件を避ける。: Survive Unbreakable hits and avoid the low-HP instant-kill condition.
messages.主力が消耗した後もマッチを取れる戦力を残す。: Maintain reliable clashers after your initial team is worn down.
messages.【リンバス】7-06 西部センク3課 カミーユ（7-06）の攻略｜Limbus: 7-06 Cinq West Section 3 Camille (7-06) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-06「西部センク3課 カミーユ（7-: Cinq West Section 3 Camille (7-06) guide for Limbus Company 7-06. A scripted encounter with a fixed team of one LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns triggers its special sequence. Her HP cannot fall below 10; there is no need to rebuild your team or raise other Identities for a normal boss kill.
messages.7-06「On the Tremendous Duel the Cinq Bro: 7-06 · On the Tremendous Duel the Cinq Brought Upon Our Fixer
messages.囚人ドンキホーテ1名の固定編成で進めるイベント戦。混乱するか4ターン経過すると専: A scripted encounter with a fixed team of one LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns triggers its special sequence. Her HP cannot fall below 10; there is no need to rebuild your team or raise other Identities for a normal boss kill.
messages.7-06専用の数値。敵はLv45・防御Lv45。貫通耐性0.5、色欲・暴食・嫉妬: 7-06 values only. The enemy is Lv.45 with Defense Level 45. Pierce resistance is 0.5, and Lust, Gluttony, and Envy resistances are 1; other resistances are unconfirmed and shown as unknown. Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote is deployed, adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV, with her base E.G.O at Threadspin IV.
messages.表示威力は呼吸・速度差・決闘宣布・集中攻撃による強化前。サリューは混乱時のパッシ: Listed Power is before bonuses from Poise, Speed differences, Declared Duel, and Focused Attack. The Stagger passive mentions “Salut”, but the actual event ends the encounter and unlocks its skill information. Do not treat it as a normal attack you must survive.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテと初期E.G.Oのみの固定編成。Lv45・同期Ⅳ・解析Ⅳへ調整さ: A fixed team of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O only. Adjusted to Lv.45, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed.
messages.ドンキホーテのHPは10未満にならない。混乱または4ターン経過で専用演出へ進み、: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns triggers a special sequence and advances the story. Do not restart because you mistake Stagger for failure.
messages.スロットは1→3→4→4と増え、手札配置も固定。初期E.G.Oは編成されるが、傲: Slots increase as 1 → 3 → 4 → 4, with a fixed skill layout. Her base E.G.O is equipped, but cannot be used because no Pride resources are available. Proceed with regular skills.
messages.この戦闘の専用進行。混乱または4ターン経過で演出を経てストーリーが進む。育成不足: This is the encounter's scripted progression. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns leads through the sequence into the story. There is no need to retry because you think your team is underleveled.
messages.E.G.Oが編成されているのに使えない: E.G.O is equipped but cannot be used
messages.ラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョは固定で入るが、この戦闘では必要な傲慢資源を得られない: La Sangre de Sancho is fixed in the loadout, but the necessary Pride resources cannot be obtained in this encounter. Using E.G.O is not required; proceed with your regular skills.
messages.マッチ予測が前のターンより不利になった: Clash predictions are worse than last turn
messages.敵は呼吸やクイックを得て、決闘宣布と集中攻撃でも強化される。一方、味方も無謀な決: The enemy gains Poise and Haste, with further bonuses from Declared Duel and Focused Attack. Your Sinner also gains Clash Power Up and Bind through Foolhardy Duel, so check the current turn's predictions.
messages.部位破壊不可。固定編成のため、全属性耐性は確認できない。未確認の項目を等倍とは扱: The part cannot be broken. The fixed loadout prevents checking every resistance. Do not treat unconfirmed resistances as neutral.
messages.ドンキホーテのHPは10未満にならない。混乱でイベントへ進むため、HP下限が混乱: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger advances to an event; the HP floor does not also prevent Stagger.
Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote can deploy. She is adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV for this encounter. Her only E.G.O is La Sangre de Sancho at Threadspin IV.
messages.E.G.Oに必要な傲慢資源を得られないため、使用を待つ必要はない。通常スキルで行: The Pride resources needed for E.G.O cannot be obtained, so do not wait to use it. Act with regular skills and advance to the special event.
messages.増えたスロットに手札を割り当てる: Assign skills to the additional slots
messages.1ターン目はアレ1つ。使用時の決闘宣布と呼吸獲得は、マッチに勝っても止まらない。: Turn 1 has one “Allez”. Winning the clash does not prevent its On Use Declared Duel or Poise gain.
messages.2ターン目は応酬・クードロア・フォントで、味方のスロットも3つになる。攻撃を合わ: Turn 2 uses “Parry”, “Coup Droit”, and “Fente”; your Sinner also has 3 slots. Match attacks and proceed using current predictions.
messages.被害を受けると、無謀な決闘によって次のターンのマッチ威力増加と束縛を得る。威力だ: Taking damage grants Clash Power Up and Bind next turn through Foolhardy Duel. Speed changes as well as Power.
messages.通常スキルで進め、演出を待つ: Use regular skills and wait for the sequence
messages.3ターン目は回避のデフォンシヴ2つとクードロア・フォント。4ターン目はクードロア: Turn 3 uses 2 “Défensive” evades, “Coup Droit”, and “Fente”. Turn 4 uses 2 “Coup Droit” and 2 “Fente”. Your Sinner has 4 slots on both turns.
messages.敵の速度7以上では破裂の付与・回数追加が発生し、呼吸7以上ではフォントのコイン威: At 7 Speed or more, the enemy inflicts Rupture or adds Count; at 7 Poise or more, “Fente” gains Coin Power too. Use the fixed hand and check each slot's prediction.
messages.途中でドンキホーテが混乱した場合は、そのままイベントへ進む。HPは10未満になら: If Don Quixote becomes Staggered, continue into the event. Her HP cannot fall below 10, so there is no need to halt progression to find healing E.G.O or another Identity.
messages.専用演出からストーリーへ進む: Continue from the special sequence into the story
messages.必殺技の演出を経て戦闘が終わり、ストーリーが続く。通常の敗北画面と取り違えない。: The finishing-move sequence ends the encounter and the story continues. Do not mistake it for a normal defeat screen.
messages.一騎打ちにはサリュー使用と書かれているが、実際はイベント終了とスキル情報の解禁に: Single Combat says it uses “Salut”, but the actual outcome is an event ending and unlocked skill information. Beating a normal “Salut” is not a requirement.
messages.1ターン目に使う。決闘宣布と呼吸は使用時なので、マッチに勝っても付与・獲得される: Used on Turn 1. Declared Duel and Poise apply On Use, even if you win the clash. Include Declared Duel's Clash Power bonus when checking the next prediction.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]自分の呼吸回数が2増加\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら、破裂3を:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 2 Poise Count.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]呼吸3を得る\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら、破裂3を付与:
Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture.
messages.2〜4ターン目に使う。速度7以上では各コインに破裂付与が付く。マッチに勝てば的中: Used on Turns 2–4. Each Coin inflicts Rupture at 7 Speed or more. Winning the clash prevents those On Hit effects, but becoming Staggered still advances this encounter's special sequence.
messages.[使用時]自分の呼吸が7以上なら、コイン威力+2: [On Use] If at 7 Poise or more, Coin Power +2.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]呼吸3を得る\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら、破裂回数が3増加\:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, increase Rupture Count by 3.
[On Crit] Critical damage +50%.
messages.呼吸7以上で最大威力が素の15から17へ上がる。強化や決闘宣布を含む現在の予測を: At 7 Poise or more, its maximum rises from the base 15 to 17. Check the current prediction including buffs and Declared Duel. After “Coup Droit” inflicts Rupture, beware of damage from added Count too.
messages.イベントで情報解禁・通常手順外: Information unlocked by event / outside normal progression
messages.[使用時]自分の速度が相手より高いとき、速度差2につきコイン威力+1（最大3）: [On Use] If faster than the target, Coin Power +1 per 2 Speed difference (max 3).
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]自分の呼吸回数が4増加\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら破裂3を付:
Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 4 Poise Count.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]呼吸5を得る\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら破裂3を付与、破裂回:
Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 5 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]呼吸5を得る\n[的中時]自分の速度が7以上なら破裂3を付与、破裂回:
Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 5 Poise.
[On Hit] If at 7 Speed or more, inflict 3 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 1.
messages.Ⅳ[クリティカル的中時]クリティカルダメージ量+100%\n[的中時]対象の破裂:
Ⅳ[On Crit] Critical damage +100%.
[On Hit] Damage +5% per 1 Rupture on the target (max 50%).
messages.混乱時のパッシブに記載されるが、実際の進行はイベントによる戦闘終了。通常の4枚技: Mentioned in the Stagger passive, but actual progression ends the encounter through an event. You do not need to survive a normal 4-Coin attack or raise another Identity to beat it.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに脆弱1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.2ターン目に使う。勝てれば翌ターンのクイックと脆弱を抑えられる。技名だけで反撃と: Used on Turn 2. Winning can prevent next-turn Haste and Fragile. Despite its name, this is a regular Pierce attack; assign a clash rather than treating it as a Counter.
messages.3ターン目に2つ使う。回避されると次のターンに加速するが、撃破まで火力を詰める必: Used twice on Turn 3. Successful evades increase next turn's Speed, but you do not need enough damage to kill him. Check the remaining “Coup Droit” and “Fente” as you proceed.
messages.ターン開始時、自分の速度が敵より高い: At Turn Start, faster than the enemy
messages.敵の速度が高いと貫通ダメージも強まる。HP下限はあるが、混乱しない効果ではない。: Higher enemy Speed also strengthens Pierce damage. The HP floor does not prevent Stagger.
messages.精神力7回復。自分の呼吸を4で割った値に応じて、次のターンにクイックを得る（最大: Heal 7 SP. Gain Haste next turn based on Poise divided by 4 (max 3).
messages.敵は毎ターン精神力を戻し、呼吸でも加速する。初手と同じマッチ予測を使い回さない。: The enemy recovers SP each turn and gains Speed through Poise. Do not reuse the opening clash prediction unchanged.
messages.サリューを使用する。実際の進行ではイベントが発生して戦闘が終了し、サリューのスキ: Use “Salut”. In actual progression, an event ends the encounter and unlocks “Salut”'s skill information.
messages.演出に進んだらそのままストーリーを続ける。通常の攻撃を耐え切るための準備は不要。: Once the sequence begins, continue into the story. No preparation to survive a normal attack is needed.
messages.前のターンに攻撃成功したスロットへスキルを使用: Uses a skill against a slot successfully attacked last turn
messages.攻撃成功累計1ターンでマッチ威力+1、2ターンで基本威力+1、3ターンで基本威力: After 1 cumulative turn of successful attacks, Clash Power +1; after 2 turns, Base Power +1; after 3 turns, Base Power +1 and Coin Power +1. Resets if no attack was made last turn.
messages.同じスロットへの攻撃が続くと強化される。各段階を足し合わせた確定補正を作らず、実: Repeated attacks against the same slot strengthen the enemy. Do not sum the stages into an assumed fixed bonus; check the actual prediction.
messages.パニックが次のターンも続く前提にしない。この戦闘では精神力を下げ切ることを勝利条: Do not assume Panic continues next turn. Reducing the enemy's SP fully is not a victory requirement here.
messages.パニックタイプを変更する効果を得るとき: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.パニックタイプを変更せず、代わりに精神力のない対象へ付与される効果を受ける。: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead.
messages.固定編成のイベント戦なので、別のパニックタイプに変える専用編成は考えなくてよい。: A scripted encounter with a fixed team; no special team to change Panic Type is needed.
messages.ドンキホーテが開始時に得る。ターン終了時、戦闘中に失った全体力の10%につき、次: Don Quixote gains this at the start. At Turn End, gain Clash Power Up and Bind next turn per 10% of total HP lost during the encounter (each max 5).
messages.被害でマッチは強まる一方、速度は下がる。現在のHP割合だけに読み替えず、戦闘中の: Taking damage strengthens clashes but lowers Speed. Check this as an effect based on cumulative HP lost during the encounter, not simply current HP percentage.
messages.付与した側が対象とマッチするとマッチ威力+1。攻撃的中時、次のターンにクイック1: The inflicter gains +1 Clash Power against the marked target. On attack hit, gain 1 Haste next turn (up to 4 times per turn). Removed when inflicted on another target; replaced if another character inflicts Declared Duel.
messages.アレの使用時に付く。敵専用スキル内の説明に従い、クイックの発動は攻撃的中時として: Applied by “Allez” On Use. For this enemy-specific skill, Haste triggers on attack hit. Do not assume every clash grants Haste.
messages.ドンキホーテのHPは10未満にならない。混乱するか4ターン経過すると専用のイベン: Don Quixote's HP cannot fall below 10. Stagger or the passage of 4 turns advances to a special event.
messages.混乱を通常の攻略失敗と判断しない。敵のHPを削り切ることやサリューへの勝利を必須: Do not treat Stagger as a normal failure. Depleting enemy HP or beating “Salut” is not required.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテをLv45・同期Ⅳ、初期E.G.Oを解析Ⅳへ調整。スロット数は1: LCB Sinner Don Quixote is adjusted to Lv.45 and Uptie IV, and her base E.G.O to Threadspin IV. Slots follow 1 → 3 → 4 → 4, with a fixed skill layout each turn.
messages.通常のスロット増加や手札抽選とは別の専用進行。追加の人格を育てず、そのまま手札を: This is special progression, separate from normal slot increases and skill draws. Use the provided hand without raising additional Identities.
messages.敵はマッチ勝利で基本6の精神力を回復し、2マッチ目以降は1回ごとに20%ずつ増加: The enemy heals a base 6 SP on Clash Win, increasing by 20% per clash from the 2nd clash onward. On Clash Lose, loses a base 2 SP, increasing by 10% per clash from the 2nd onward. Low Morale grants 2 Offense Level Up at Turn Start, 1 Defense Level Down on Clash Lose (max 3 per turn), and minimum Speed −1. Panic instead grants 4 Offense Level Up at Turn Start, 2 Defense Level Down on Clash Lose (max 6 per turn), and minimum Speed −1. The Low Morale threshold is unknown.
messages.精神力低下だけを一律の弱体化とは考えない。パニックは終了時に精神力0へ戻るため、: Lower SP does not uniformly weaken the enemy. Panic resets SP to 0 at Turn End, so check next turn's state too.
messages.混乱後の演出はストーリーを進めるための専用進行。通常の敗北と取り違えてやり直さな: The sequence after Stagger advances the story. Do not restart because you mistake it for a normal defeat.
messages.HP下限10は混乱を防がない。無傷や混乱なしを攻略の条件にする必要はない。: The 10 HP floor does not prevent Stagger. Taking no damage or avoiding Stagger is not required.
messages.初期E.G.Oは編成されるが傲慢資源を得られず使用できない。E.G.O使用を待た: Her base E.G.O is equipped, but cannot be used without obtainable Pride resources. Proceed with regular skills instead of waiting to use E.G.O.
messages.敵の耐性は一部のみ確認済み。未確認の属性を等倍として数値化しない。: Only some enemy resistances are confirmed. Do not assign neutral values to unconfirmed affinities.
messages.サリューの通常行動での使用条件には未確定な点がある。特定の敵HP割合で出す攻略は: “Salut”'s use conditions outside the event are not fully confirmed. Do not build a strategy around triggering it at a specific enemy HP percentage.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテ1名と初期E.G.Oだけを使用する。Lv45・同期Ⅳ・解析Ⅳへ調: Only one LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O are used. Adjusted to Lv.45, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed for this encounter.
messages.通常の撃破戦とは異なる。固定の手札を割り当て、混乱または4ターン経過後の演出へ進: This is not a normal boss kill. Assign the fixed hand and advance to the sequence after Stagger or 4 turns.
messages.唯一の出撃枠。無謀な決闘とHP下限を持ち、固定の通常手札でイベントまで進める。: The only deployment slot. Has Foolhardy Duel and an HP floor, and proceeds to the event with a fixed hand of regular skills.
messages.、控え6名の連続戦闘: , with 6 reserves in a Chain Battle
messages.【リンバス】7-26 白い月の騎士（7-26）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 7-26 Knight of the White Moon (7-26) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-26「白い月の騎士（7-26）」の攻: Knight of the White Moon (7-26) guide for Limbus Company 7-26. A scripted encounter with only LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Special stat modifiers apply, and a sequence ends the fight after combat begins on Turn 6. Clash against attacks with extra damage and check the final switch to E.G.O.
messages.7-26「On the Vivid Clash Between the Knig: 7-26 · On the Vivid Clash Between the Knight of the White Moon and the Valiant Don Quixote
messages.白い月の騎士の外見: The Knight of the White Moon appearance
messages.白い月の騎士のスキル: The Knight of the White Moon skills
messages.The Knight of the White Moonの外見: The Knight of the White Moon appearance
messages.The Knight of the White Moonのスキル: The Knight of the White Moon skills
messages.白い月の騎士: The Knight of the White Moon
messages.囚人ドンキホーテ1名で進めるイベント戦。専用の能力補正があり、6ターン目の戦闘開: A scripted encounter with only LCB Sinner Don Quixote. Special stat modifiers apply, and a sequence ends the fight after combat begins on Turn 6. Clash against attacks with extra damage and check the final switch to E.G.O.
messages.7-26のイベント戦専用データ。敵のHP・レベル・防御レベル・速度は不明。耐性は: Data for the 7-26 scripted encounter only. Enemy HP, level, Defense Level, and Speed are unknown. All resistances are estimated as neutral, but remain displayed as unknown rather than confirmed values. Your Sinner is adjusted to Lv.50 and Uptie IV, with her base E.G.O at Threadspin IV.
messages.敵の威力とレベルはゲーム内で伏せられている。泉の竜から黒い矢までの威力と、矢以外: Enemy Power and levels are hidden in-game. Power values from “Dragon of the Spring” through “Blak Arwe”, and Lv.50 on skills other than “Arwe”, are estimates. “Mirror of Water” and “Electron Accelerator Rail Activation” have an estimated maximum of 30, but their Base and Coin Power are unknown. “Arwe”'s Power and level are also unconfirmed. Listed Power excludes conditional bonuses.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテとラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョだけの固定編成。Lv50・同期Ⅳ・解: A fixed loadout of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and La Sangre de Sancho only. Adjusted to Lv.50, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV; no other Identity is needed for this encounter.
messages.3・4ターン目の破壊不能は勝っても被弾が残る。蒼白な軌跡や赤い矢の追加ダメージを: Unbreakable attacks on Turns 3 and 4 still hit after a clash win. Win clashes to prevent the extra damage from “Pallid Trace” and “Red Arwe”.
messages.敵のHPを削り切ることを目標にせず、6ターン目のE.G.Oへの切り替わりまで進め: Advance to the E.G.O switch on Turn 6 instead of aiming to deplete enemy HP. A sequence ends the encounter after combat begins.
messages.敵のHPや威力が見えず、育成不足か判断できない: Cannot judge preparation because enemy HP and Power are hidden
messages.数値を伏せた専用戦闘。味方にはLv50・同期Ⅳへの調整と名誉ある決闘による強化が: A special encounter with hidden values. Your Sinner is adjusted to Lv.50 and Uptie IV, with bonuses from Honorable Duel. Check current clash predictions rather than judging preparation or victory conditions like a regular boss.
messages.マッチに勝ったのにダメージを受ける: Taking damage despite winning the clash
messages.微かな軌跡と蒼白な軌跡の1枚目は破壊不能。勝利しても被弾が残るが、2枚目の斬撃脆: Coin I of “Faint Trace” and “Pallid Trace” is Unbreakable. Hits remain after a win, but you can prevent Coin II's Slash Fragility or extra damage.
messages.6ターン目に手札が全てE.G.Oになった: Every skill became E.G.O on Turn 6
messages.この戦闘の専用進行。ラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョが設置されたスロットを確認して戦闘: This is the encounter's scripted progression. Check the slots containing La Sangre de Sancho, begin combat, and proceed into the following sequence.
messages.部位破壊不可。HPを削り切る通常の撃破戦ではなく、6ターン目に演出へ移る。: The part cannot be broken. This is not a normal HP-depletion kill; a sequence begins on Turn 6.
messages.開始時に敵は青色の名誉ある決闘、ドンキホーテは黄色の名誉ある決闘を得る。両者の効: At the start, the enemy gains blue Honorable Duel and Don Quixote gains yellow Honorable Duel. Do not treat their effects as identical.
messages.固定編成と専用強化を確認する: Check the fixed loadout and special buffs
messages.囚人ドンキホーテのみ出撃可能。外見投影は使用不可で、E.G.Oもラ・サングレ・デ: Only LCB Sinner Don Quixote can deploy. Appearance Projection is unavailable, and her only E.G.O is La Sangre de Sancho. Starting SP is 45.
messages.黄色の名誉ある決闘で最大HPが1605になり、混乱区間がなくなる。攻撃スキルの最: Yellow Honorable Duel sets max HP to 1605 and removes Stagger Thresholds. It also gives Attack Skills +15 Final Power; do not judge the clash using normal skill values alone.
messages.1ターン目は泉の竜、2ターン目は秋の蓮花と水の鏡。味方のスロット数も敵と同じにな: Turn 1 uses “Dragon of the Spring”; Turn 2 uses “Lotus in Autumn” and “Mirror of Water”. Your slot count matches the enemy's, but the hand is random. Check clash predictions and assign skills each time.
messages.破壊不能の後ろにある危険な効果を防ぐ: Prevent dangerous effects after the Unbreakable Coin
messages.3ターン目は泉の竜・秋の蓮花・微かな軌跡。微かな軌跡に勝ち、2枚目の斬撃脆弱3を: Turn 3 uses “Dragon of the Spring”, “Lotus in Autumn”, and “Faint Trace”. Beat “Faint Trace” to prevent Coin II's 3 Slash Fragility.
messages.4ターン目は微かな軌跡・蒼白な軌跡・水の鏡。蒼白な軌跡の2枚目には追加ダメージ1: Turn 4 uses “Faint Trace”, “Pallid Trace”, and “Mirror of Water”. Assign a strong attack to “Pallid Trace” to prevent Coin II's extra 100 damage.
messages.両方の軌跡の1枚目は破壊不能。勝利後の被弾まで避けられるとは考えない。水の鏡もマ: Coin I of both Trace skills is Unbreakable; a win does not prevent every hit. “Mirror of Water” is also a Clashable Guard, so do not treat it as a normal defense.
messages.赤い矢・黒い矢・電子加速レール活性化を使う。赤い矢は各コインで追加ダメージ50、: Uses “Red Arwe”, “Blak Arwe”, and “Electron Accelerator Rail Activation”. Each “Red Arwe” Coin deals 50 extra damage; each “Blak Arwe” Coin inflicts 2 Mental Fracture.
messages.矢2つにはそれぞれ勝てる攻撃を合わせる。レールの強化は戦闘開始時に発生するため、: Assign a winning attack to each of the 2 “Arwe” skills. The rail buff activates at Combat Start; stopping it with an attack is not the objective.
messages.専用のE.G.Oで演出へ進む: Advance to the sequence with the special E.G.O
messages.敵が罪悪属性のない矢を使い、味方の全スロットはラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョになる。: The enemy uses “Arwe” without a Sin affinity, and all your slots become La Sangre de Sancho.
messages.戦闘開始後に演出が入り、そのまま戦闘終了となる。敵の残りHPを見て火力不足と判断: After combat begins, a sequence plays and the encounter ends. There is no need to interpret remaining enemy HP as insufficient damage or rebuild a normal boss-kill plan.
messages.1・3ターン目に使う。的中による翌ターンの脆弱を防ぐためマッチを取る。使用時のク: Used on Turns 1 and 3. Clash to prevent next-turn Fragile from its hits. Winning does not stop its On Use Haste.
messages.2・3ターン目に使う。水の鏡だけに強い手札を使い切らず、こちらにも勝てる攻撃を合: Used on Turns 2 and 3. Do not spend every strong skill on “Mirror of Water”; assign a winning attack here too.
messages.3・4ターン目に使う。マッチ勝利で2枚目の斬撃脆弱を防ぐ。1枚目は破壊不能なので: Used on Turns 3 and 4. A clash win prevents Coin II's Slash Fragility. Coin I is Unbreakable, so a hit remains even after a win.
messages.対象より速度が5以上高ければ、マッチ威力+5: If at least 5 Speed faster than the target, Clash Power +5.
messages.4ターン目の優先マッチ。2枚目の追加ダメージを防ぐ。速度差5以上の強化があるため: A priority clash on Turn 4. Prevent Coin II's extra damage. The bonus at a Speed difference of at least 5 means last turn's prediction may not apply.
messages.5ターン目に使う。各コインの追加ダメージを避けるため、勝てる攻撃を合わせる。: Used on Turn 5. Assign a winning attack to prevent each Coin's extra damage.
messages.5ターン目に使う。マッチ勝利で精神の亀裂の付与を防ぐ。精神力が下がると表面を出し: Used on Turn 5. Win the clash to prevent Mental Fracture. Lower SP makes Heads less likely, so take this clash separately from “Red Arwe”.
messages.マッチ可能ガード・威力不明・レベルは推定値: Clashable Guard / Power unknown / level estimated
messages.[マッチ勝利時]このスキルの最終マッチ威力だけ、体力ダメージを与える: [Clash Win] Deal HP damage equal to this skill's final Clash Power.
messages.2・4ターン目に使う。通常の防御と異なり、敵がマッチに勝つとHPダメージを受ける: Used on Turns 2 and 4. Unlike a normal Guard, an enemy clash win deals HP damage to you. Coin behavior after a clash loss is uncertain; do not assume your win removes all Protection and damage.
messages.[戦闘開始時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加10、クイック10を得る: [Combat Start] Gain 10 Attack Power Up and 10 Haste next turn.
messages.5ターン目に使う。強化は戦闘開始時なので、攻撃を当てて阻止する手順にはしない。次: Used on Turn 5. The buff activates at Combat Start, so do not plan to stop it by landing an attack. Next turn advances to the scripted ending.
messages.罪悪属性なし・威力とレベル不明: No Sin affinity / Power and level unknown
messages.6ターン目の専用技。こちらの全スロットがラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョへ変わる。表示: A special Turn 6 skill. All your slots become La Sangre de Sancho. Check the display and begin combat to enter the sequence and end the encounter.
messages.被ダメージ量−20%。マッチ敗北時、攻撃威力増加3を得る。: Damage taken −20%. On Clash Lose, gain 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.勝利後は敵の攻撃威力増加も含めて次の予測を確認する。HPを削り切ることより、専用: After winning, include the enemy's Attack Power Up in subsequent predictions. Keep clashing until the scripted progression rather than trying to deplete its HP.
messages.同じ対象とのマッチ判定数が10回以上: At least 10 clash rolls against the same target
messages.マッチ判定時、現在の合計マッチ判定回数を10で割って小数点以下を切り捨てた値だけ: On a clash roll, Clash Power randomly increases or decreases by the current total number of clash rolls divided by 10, rounded down.
messages.長いマッチでは威力が上下する。判定を重ねれば必ず有利になる効果とは扱わない。: Power fluctuates in long clashes. More clash rolls do not guarantee an advantage.
messages.黄色の専用効果。最大HPが1605になり、混乱区間がなくなる。攻撃スキルの最終威: The special yellow effect. Sets max HP to 1605 and removes Stagger Thresholds. Attack Skill Final Power +15. At Turn End, gain 5 Haste next turn.
messages.固定の囚人人格にも大きな補正がある。通常時の性能を理由に別人格の育成へ戻らず、こ: Even the fixed LCB Sinner Identity receives substantial bonuses. Judge by in-encounter predictions and HP rather than returning to raise another Identity based on normal performance.
messages.敵が開始時に得る青色の専用効果。詳細な能力補正は不明。: The special blue effect gained by the enemy at the start. Detailed stat modifiers are unknown.
messages.同名でも味方の黄色の効果と区別する。最大HP1605・最終威力+15を敵側の数値: Distinguish it from your Sinner's yellow effect despite the shared name. Do not assign its 1605 max HP or +15 Final Power to the enemy.
messages.最大5。数値1につき精神力減少効率+1。5になると消滅して精神力10ダメージ。1: Maximum 5. SP Loss Efficiency +1 per 1 value. At 5, disappears and deals 10 SP damage. Decreases by 1 each turn.
messages.黒い矢の各コインで2ずつ付く。マッチ勝利で的中を防ぎ、精神力の低下を抑える。: Each “Blak Arwe” Coin inflicts 2. Win the clash to prevent hits and limit SP loss.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテ1名と初期E.G.Oのみ。戦闘中はLv50・同期Ⅳ・解析Ⅳへ調整: Only one LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O. Adjusted to Lv.50, Uptie IV, and Threadspin IV. Your slot count matches the enemy's, and the skill layout is random.
messages.複数の味方で攻撃を引き受ける編成は使えない。増えたスロットへ手札を割り当て、危険: You cannot use multiple allies to intercept attacks. Assign the hand to the additional slots and beat skills with dangerous extra effects.
messages.通常のボスのようにHPを削り切る戦闘ではない。6ターン目の専用進行を確認する。: This is not a regular boss fight won by depleting HP. Check the special progression on Turn 6.
messages.不明な敵HP・速度・レベルや耐性を、推定スキルレベルから逆算しない。: Do not derive unknown enemy HP, Speed, level, or resistances from estimated skill levels.
messages.破壊不能の被弾と2枚目の的中効果を分ける。勝利しても被弾は残るが、マッチを取る意: Distinguish Unbreakable hits from Coin II's On Hit effects. Hits remain after a win, but clashing still matters.
messages.水の鏡は敗北後のコイン挙動に不確かな点がある。保護や被害が必ず消えることを前提に: “Mirror of Water”'s Coin behavior after a clash loss is uncertain. Do not assume Protection and damage always disappear.
messages.囚人ドンキホーテと初期E.G.Oの固定編成。戦闘中の調整があるため、攻略用の別人: A fixed loadout of LCB Sinner Don Quixote and her base E.G.O. In-encounter adjustments mean no other Identity or additional E.G.O is needed.
messages.味方の専用強化・ランダムな手札・敵の使用技を確認する。手札の完全固定を前提にした: Check your Sinner's special buffs, random hand, and enemy skills. Adapt to each turn's clash predictions rather than assuming a fully fixed hand.
messages.唯一の出撃枠。専用強化を受け、追加ダメージや精神の亀裂を持つ攻撃へのマッチを担う: The only deployment slot. Receives special buffs and handles clashes against attacks with extra damage or Mental Fracture.
messages.【リンバス】7-36 理髪師・神父・ドゥルシネーアの攻略｜Limbus Assi: 7-36 The Barber / The Priest / Dulcinea Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-36「理髪師・神父・ドゥルシネーア」: The Barber / The Priest / Dulcinea guide for Limbus Company 7-36. Focus enemies down in order: the Barber, the Priest, then Dulcinea. Prepare for “The Finale” before the first kill, and account for phase-transition conditions that differ from the solo encounters.
messages.7-36「To Reach the Dream: A Sick Person's: 7-36 · To Reach the Dream: A Sick Person's Fate
messages.理髪師、神父、ドゥルシネーアの順に集中して倒す。1人目を倒すときにはフィナーレの: Focus enemies down in order: the Barber, the Priest, then Dulcinea. Prepare for “The Finale” before the first kill, and account for phase-transition conditions that differ from the solo encounters.
messages.7章ダンジョン「病人の運命」の再戦。ドンキホーテは出撃不可、6名＋控え5名。HP: The rematch in the Canto VII dungeon's A Sick Person's Fate. Don Quixote cannot deploy; bring 6 Sinners plus 5 reserves. Listed HP is after Crippling Injury. Displayed Offense and Defense Levels account for Withered: −25 for the Barber and Priest, −35 for Dulcinea. Additional Crippling Injury from cumulative turns and other buffs vary separately.
messages.再戦の資料に記載された21技を掲載。単体戦から未掲載の技を補ってはいない。加重値: Lists the 21 skills documented for the rematch, without adding unlisted skills from solo encounters. Attack Weight varies with conditions; the Barber's area attack shows 2, the lower end of the listed 2–4 range, and its Offense Level is unknown. “Beckon the Audience Hither...”'s Final Power bonus is in its effects. Issues have been reported with the Priest's Coin Power bonus.
messages.理髪師→神父→ドゥルシネーアを基本に、1人ずつ倒す。序盤の仲間への支援まで全部引: Default order: the Barber → the Priest → Dulcinea, one at a time. Do not try to intercept every early support action aimed at an enemy ally.
messages.理髪師か神父を倒すと、ドゥルシネーアのHPが高くても終盤行動へ移る。撃破前にフィ: Killing the Barber or Priest triggers Dulcinea's final pattern even if her HP is high. Prepare high-Power skills for “The Finale” and healing before the kill.
messages.ドンキホーテ抜きの6名＋控え5名。出血の多い囚人は、無理に攻撃せず守備を使う判断: 6 Sinners plus 5 reserves, without Don Quixote. Sinners with heavy Bleed may need to defend rather than force an attack.
messages.ドゥルシネーアがほぼ満タンなのにフィナーレが来た: “The Finale” appeared while Dulcinea was nearly at full HP
messages.再戦は本人のHP33%だけでなく、理髪師か神父の撃破などでも終盤行動へ移る。最初: In the rematch, the final pattern can trigger from killing the Barber or Priest, not just Dulcinea reaching 33% HP. Prepare team healing and strong clashes before the first kill.
messages.3人へ攻撃しているのに誰も倒せない: Attacking all 3 enemies but unable to kill anyone
messages.神父のスキルとターン終了効果が仲間を回復する。低HPの理髪師へ攻撃をまとめ、1人: The Priest's skills and Turn End effects heal his allies. Focus attacks on the low-HP Barber and remove enemies one by one. Do not damage everyone, including Dulcinea, evenly from the opening.
messages.敵同士に向く線まで引き受けて手が足りない: Intercepting lines between enemies leaves too few actions
messages.歩みは優雅に…と身振りは美しく…は、敵の仲間に当たると支援になる。全てを横取りせ: “Walk With Grace...” and “Move With Beauty...” support enemy allies when hitting them. Do not intercept everything; prioritize dangerous attacks on Sinners and damage to the Barber.
messages.最後の1人なのに出血で味方が倒れる: Allies die from Bleed despite only one enemy remaining
messages.棘で出血が返り、攻撃のコイン判定でも自身の出血が発動する。HPと出血威力・回数を: Thorns return Bleed, and rolling attack Coins also activates your own Bleed. Check HP, Bleed Potency, and Count; switch endangered Sinners to defense and attack after healing.
messages.HPが低く最初の集中先。単体戦より使用技は少ないが、低HPへの対象変更不可の即死: Lowest HP and the first focus target. Has fewer skills than in the solo encounter, but retains the low-HP instant kill that cannot be redirected.
messages.倒すとドゥルシネーアが終盤行動へ移るので、撃破前に回復と高威力技を準備する。: Her death triggers Dulcinea's final pattern. Prepare healing and high-Power skills before landing the kill.
messages.磨り減ってしまった心3から開始。毎ターン増加し、長期化すると行動が変わる。: Starts with 3 Ailing Heart. Increases each turn and changes his actions if the fight lasts.
messages.自分の出血を使い、仲間のHP・精神力を回復する。理髪師の次に倒す。: Uses his own Bleed to recover allied HP and SP. Defeat him after the Barber.
messages.仲間への支援と囚人への攻撃を使い分ける。本人のHP以外に、仲間の生死・残りHPで: Alternates between supporting allies and attacking Sinners. Ally deaths and remaining HP can change her pattern as well as her own HP.
messages.フィナーレ後は精神力が−45になる。熱気による回復や次ターンの立て直しも確認する: After “The Finale”, SP becomes −45. Check recovery from Fever and the following turn's state too.
messages.ドンキホーテ抜きで回復と集中火力を確保: Prepare recovery and focused damage without Don Quixote
messages.主力Lv50・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、6名と控え5名を選ぶ。ドンキホーテを使えないた: Choose 6 Sinners and 5 reserves, aiming for Lv.50 and Uptie III or higher on your main team. Don Quixote is unavailable; do not rely on her healing, damage, or team effects.
messages.3人とも色欲が通りやすい。育成済みの高威力技、HP・精神力回復、フィナーレに勝つ: All 3 are vulnerable to Lust. Prepare developed high-Power skills, HP and SP recovery, and E.G.O that can beat “The Finale”.
messages.理髪師の即死技も残る。誰かのHPが30%以下なら放置せず、本人が対象変更不可の技: The Barber retains her instant-kill skill. Do not leave anyone at 30% HP or below; check the targeted Sinner's way to beat a skill that cannot be redirected.
messages.理髪師はHP748と最も低い。危険な攻撃をマッチで止め、残りの火力を理髪師へ集め: The Barber has the lowest HP at 748. Stop dangerous attacks with clashes and direct remaining damage at her. Prioritize overcoming the Priest's healing to secure the first kill.
messages.ドゥルシネーアの歩みは優雅に…・身振りは美しく…が仲間へ向いているなら支援。すべ: Dulcinea's “Walk With Grace...” and “Move With Beauty...” are support actions when aimed at allies. You need not intercept them all. Avoid carelessly hitting Dulcinea with area attacks and advancing her buffs early.
messages.理髪師を倒す前に、フィナーレへ勝てる手札と資源、全員のHPを整える。HPが残って: Before killing the Barber, prepare everyone's HP, skills, and resources to beat “The Finale”. Even with HP remaining, check whether other conditions have already triggered the final pattern.
messages.1人撃破・終盤行動への移行: First kill / transition to final pattern
messages.理髪師か神父が倒れると終盤行動へ移行し、最初にフィナーレを使う。ドゥルシネーア本: The Barber's or Priest's death triggers the final pattern, starting with “The Finale”. Dulcinea's own 33% HP threshold is not its only trigger.
messages.加重値6・破壊不能3枚。強いE.G.Oで勝ち、ダメージ半減とその技のダメージによ: Attack Weight 6 with 3 Unbreakable Coins. Win with a strong E.G.O to halve damage and prevent Stagger from this skill's damage. Bleed can still kill, so heal beforehand too.
messages.勝っても1枚目の出血威力・回数の付与は残る。追加対象の囚人に回避を向ける選択肢も: Even after a win, Coin I's Bleed Potency and Count remain. Additional targets can consider Evade, but do not assume everyone will escape unharmed.
messages.発動後は敵の精神力が−45になる。隙を使って残る神父へ火力を集める。: After use, the enemy's SP becomes −45. Use the opening to focus damage on the remaining Priest.
messages.神父の回復を止めて2人目を倒す: Stop the Priest's healing and secure the second kill
messages.神父の使用時回復はマッチに勝つだけでは取り消せない。攻撃を集中し、回復を続けられ: Winning a clash cannot cancel the Priest's On Use healing. Focus attacks and kill him before he keeps restoring allies.
messages.神父は毎ターン自傷し、磨り減ってしまった心が増える。10に達すると脆弱を得る一方: The Priest damages himself each turn and accumulates Ailing Heart. At 10 he gains Fragile, but also heals through attacks; use Stagger to deal damage.
messages.ドゥルシネーアの囚人向け攻撃と広域を強い担当で受け持つ。出血の多い囚人に無理なマ: Assign strong clashers to Dulcinea's Sinner-targeting attacks and area attacks. Do not force repeated clashes on heavily Bleeding Sinners; use healing and defense between attacks.
messages.出血で自滅しない手数を選ぶ: Choose actions that do not kill your own Sinners through Bleed
messages.攻撃枠が少なくても、残る棘と出血は危険。HP・出血回数と、使用するスキルのコイン: Even with few enemy attacks left, Thorns and Bleed remain dangerous. Check HP, Bleed Count, and the Coin count of each skill you plan to use.
messages.回復する前に出血で倒れそうな囚人は守備へ替える。回復を先行させられるなら、回復後: Switch a Sinner to defense if Bleed would kill them before healing. If recovery can act first, let your damage dealers act afterward.
messages.反撃はマッチ可能で、勝つと棘を減らせる。強い担当で処理し、残りは現在の耐性と混乱: The Counter is Clashable; winning reduces Thorns. Handle it with a strong clasher, then focus the remaining attacks using current resistances and Stagger Thresholds.
messages.boss-copy:bloodfiend-trio:skills.5.name: I Don't Need Ugly Things!!
messages.[使用時]自分へ出血20を付与、自分の出血回数が1増加: [On Use] Inflict 20 Bleed on self and increase own Bleed Count by 1.
messages.基本は1枚攻撃。マッチに勝って出血付与を防ぐ。使用時の神父自身の出血は、勝っても: Normally a single-Coin attack. Win to prevent Bleed application. Winning does not cancel the Priest's On Use Bleed on himself.
messages.出血威力と回数を増やす。出血の多い味方へ通すと後の攻撃で消耗するので、勝てる担当: Increases Bleed Potency and Count. Hits on heavily Bleeding allies make later attacks costly; assign a Sinner who can win.
messages.今日は血のことを考えたか？: Did you think about blood today?
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大30まで消耗し、体力が最も低い味方の(本体と部位の)体力を(: [On Use] Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; heal overall and part HP of the ally with the lowest HP by Bloodfeast consumed × 2, rounded down (excludes self).
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]磨り減ってしまった心と血に染まった手2を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain Ailing Heart and 2 Bloodied Hand.
messages.使用時に血餐を消費して仲間を回復する。マッチに勝つだけでは回復を止められないため: Consumes Bloodfeast On Use to heal an ally. Winning the clash alone cannot stop healing; focus one target and finish them.
messages.未だに血のことが頭に浮かぶか？: Are you still thinking about blood?
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大30まで消耗し、体力が最も低い味方の(本体と部位の)体力を(: [On Use] Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; heal overall and part HP of the ally with the lowest HP by Bloodfeast consumed × 2.
messages.[的中時]自分の現体力が最大値の50％以下なら、自分の出血を発動させる。自分の出: [On Hit] If at 50% max HP or below, activate own Bleed and consume 1 Bleed Count.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]磨り減ってしまった心と血に染まった手3を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain Ailing Heart and 3 Bloodied Hand.
messages.[的中時]磨り減ってしまった心が10なら、血に染まった手を追加で3得て次のターン: [On Hit] If Ailing Heart is at 10, gain 3 additional Bloodied Hand and 1 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.使用時の回復に加え1枚目が破壊不能。神父のHPが半分以下だと、その的中で自身の出: Heals On Use and has an Unbreakable first Coin. At half HP or below, that hit activates his own Bleed. Bleed Count application can remain after you win.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大50まで消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血に染まった手1を得る: [On Use] Consume up to 50 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodied Hand per 10 consumed.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の出血5につき血に染まった手1を得る(最大5): Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Bloodied Hand per 5 Bleed on the target (max 5).
messages.使用時に血餐と自傷から血に染まった手を増やす。マッチ勝利で的中による追加獲得を防: Builds Bloodied Hand through Bloodfeast and self-damage On Use. Win to prevent additional On Hit gains, and prepare for the next strengthened attack.
messages.boss-copy:bloodfiend-trio:skills.11.name: How Bountiful...
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大30消耗し、消耗した血餐10につきコイン威力+1: [On Use] Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; Coin Power +1 per 10 consumed.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]ダメージ量だけ体力を回復(最大30): Ⅲ[On Hit] Heal HP equal to damage dealt (max 30).
messages.[的中時]このスキルで血餐を30消耗し、血に染まった手Ⅲが30ならこのコインを1: [On Hit] If this skill consumed 30 Bloodfeast and Bloodied Hand III is at 30, reuse this Coin once.
messages.-このスキルで血餐を消耗できなければ、自分に出血を20付与: - If this skill cannot consume Bloodfeast, inflict 20 Bleed on self.
messages.血餐によるコイン強化と最後の再使用に注意。1枚目は破壊不能で、マッチ敗北時は次タ: Watch Bloodfeast's Coin Power bonus and final-Coin reuse. Coin I is Unbreakable; losing also gives you Fragile next turn. The bonus has reported issues, so check the current prediction.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分の現体力が最大値の50%以上なら、自分の出血を発動させる(最大: [Combat Start] If at 50% max HP or more, activate own Bleed up to 3 times, consuming Count equal to activations. This damage cannot Stagger the user.
messages.[戦闘開始時]全味方の精神力を5回復(自分を含む): [Combat Start] Heal 5 SP for all allies, including self.
messages.戦闘開始時に敵全体の精神力を5回復する守備。守備を相殺する選択肢はあるが、戦闘開: A Defense Skill that heals the entire enemy team for 5 SP at Combat Start. Offsetting is an option, but cannot be assumed to cancel the Combat Start recovery. Secure responses to other attacks first.
messages.boss-copy:bloodfiend-trio:skills.13.name: Blood...
messages.[使用時]対象に出血が6以上あるなら、ダメージ量+20%: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, damage +20%.
messages.対象の出血6以上でダメージが増える。出血の少ない担当でマッチし、回数の追加を防ぐ: Damage rises against targets with at least 6 Bleed. Clash with a Sinner who has little Bleed and prevent added Count.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上ならコイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Coin Power +1.
messages.こちらへ向かう斬撃。出血6以上でコイン威力が上がるため、出血が少なく勝てる担当を: A Slash attack aimed at your side. Gains Coin Power against at least 6 Bleed; choose a winning clasher with little Bleed.
messages.混乱していない味方を優先して指定し、対象が味方ならマッチ威力+10,ダメージ量が: Prioritizes non-Staggered allies; against an ally, Clash Power +10 and damage is fixed at 0.
messages.対象の出血3につき、マッチ威力+1(最大3): Clash Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 3).
messages.-対象が味方なら、この効果の代わりに次のターンまで攻撃レベル増加3を付与: - Against an ally, grant 3 Offense Level Up through next turn instead.
messages.敵の仲間へ向かう支援攻撃なら、その仲間にダメージを与えず次のターンまで攻撃レベル: When aimed at an enemy ally, this support attack deals no damage and grants 3 Offense Level Up through next turn. Not every targeting line is an attack on Sinners; prioritize focusing the Barber.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 3.
messages.-対象が味方なら、この効果の代わりに次のターンまで防御レベル増加3を付与: - Against an ally, grant 3 Defense Level Up through next turn instead.
messages.敵の仲間へ向かう場合は次のターンまで防御レベル増加3の支援。囚人へ向く場合は出血: When aimed at an enemy ally, grants 3 Defense Level Up through next turn. Against a Sinner, increases Bleed Count; check the actual target and effect.
messages.[使用時]自分の祝祭の熱気5または対象の出血6につき、最終威力+1(最大4): [On Use] Final Power +1 per 5 Festive Fever on self or 6 Bleed on the target (max 4).
messages.[使用時]血餐が15未満なら、出血15を得てから即1回発動させて出血回数が1減少: [On Use] If Bloodfeast is below 15, gain 15 Bleed, immediately activate it once, and reduce Bleed Count by 1. Below 10% HP, only the Bleed and Count gain effects activate.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の出血6につき攻撃レベル増加1,防御レベル増加1を得る(それぞれ: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up per 6 Bleed on the target (each max 3).
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中]出血回数が5増加: [On Hit after Clash Win] Increase Bleed Count by 5.
messages.熱気や対象の出血で最終威力が上がる。2枚目は破壊不能で棘を増やす。勝って出血回数: Fever and target Bleed raise Final Power. Coin II is Unbreakable and adds Thorns. Win to prevent the large Bleed Count increase, and prepare for the remaining hit.
messages.メインターゲットは敵、サブターゲットは味方を優先して指定し、対象が味方ならマッチ: Main target prioritizes enemies; additional targets prioritize allies. Against an ally, Clash Power +10 and damage is fixed at 0.
messages.[使用時]自分の累計消耗血餐20につきマッチ威力+1(最大10): [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 20 Bloodfeast consumed cumulatively (max 10).
messages.[使用時]血餐が25未満なら、出血25を得てから即1回発動させ、出血回数が1減少: [On Use] If Bloodfeast is below 25, gain 25 Bleed, immediately activate it once, and reduce Bleed Count by 1. Below 10% HP, only the Bleed and Count gain effects activate.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の祝祭の熱気に比例し、次のターンまで攻撃レベル増加1,防御レベル: Ⅰ[On Hit] Grant 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up through next turn per 3 Festive Fever on the target (each max 3).
messages.-対象が味方なら、この効果の代わりに咲き出す棘5を付与: - Against an ally, grant 5 Blooming Thorn instead.
messages.加重値6。敵側の仲間も追加対象となり、その場合はダメージ0と強化効果。囚人への破: Attack Weight 6. Additional targets can include enemy allies, who take 0 damage and receive buffs instead. Prepare for Unbreakable Bleed Count application on Sinners, checking HP and Count even after a win.
messages.[使用時]自分の祝祭の熱気が5以上なら、マッチ威力+3: [On Use] If at 5 Festive Fever or more, Clash Power +3.
messages.マッチ可能な反撃。熱気5以上でマッチ威力+3。勝つと棘を5減らせるので、強い担当: A Clashable Counter. Gains +3 Clash Power at 5 Fever or more; winning removes 5 Thorns, so assign a strong clasher.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]ダメージ量が(このスキルで消耗した血餐)％だけ増加(最大150％: [Clash Win] Damage increases by the Bloodfeast consumed by this skill as a percentage (max 150%).
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が50％だけ減少し、このスキルのダメージによって対象が混: [Clash Lose] Damage −50%; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中時]破裂6を付与: [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 6 Rupture.
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中時]破裂回数が6増加: [On Hit after Clash Win] Increase Rupture Count by 6.
