messages.[このコインの攻撃終了時]このスキルで消耗した血餐10につき咲き出す棘1を得る(: [After this Coin's attack] Gain 1 Blooming Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast consumed by this skill (max 10).
messages.加重値6、3枚すべて破壊不能。勝つとダメージ半減・この技のダメージでは混乱しなく: Attack Weight 6, with all 3 Coins Unbreakable. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. Heal beforehand because Bleed Potency and Count still apply. Distinguish them from Coin II's Rupture application, which a win prevents.
messages.このキャラクターが戦闘に登場するか、登場する敵リストに含まれているなら、1ターン: If this character appears in the encounter or is in its enemy roster, all characters' Bleed damage increases Bloodfeast from Turn 1. Each time this character enters, reveal more latent blood scattered across the battlefield.
messages.出血が付与された対象を優先して攻撃\nターン終了時、このターンにダメージを与えら:
Prioritizes targets with Bleed.
At Turn End, if no damage was dealt this turn, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.出血対象の選択・ダメージを与えなかったターン: Bleeding-target selection / a turn without dealing damage
messages.攻撃を止めると神父は次ターン脆弱と攻撃レベル増加を得る。削る機会にしつつ、次のマ: Stopping attacks gives the Priest Fragile and Offense Level Up next turn. Use the damage opening, but include the buff in the next clash prediction.
messages.ターン終了時、自分の出血を発動させる(最大50,自分の出血回数を1消耗)。体力が: At Turn End, activate own Bleed (max 50; consume 1 own Bleed Count). Heal the overall and part HP of the allied Bloodfiend with the lowest HP by 50. Does not activate if no ally is wounded.
messages.ターン終了時・負傷した味方血鬼がいる: Turn End / a wounded allied Bloodfiend is present
messages.神父は自傷しながら仲間を回復する。複数を少しずつ削らず、まず1人を集中して倒す。: The Priest heals allies while damaging himself. Focus one enemy down instead of chipping everyone.
messages.ターン終了時に自分の精神力が5減少し、最も精神力が低い味方血鬼の精神力が10回復: At Turn End, lose 5 SP and heal 10 SP for the allied Bloodfiend with the lowest SP. Does not activate if no eligible target has SP.
messages.神父は味方の精神力を回復する。ほかの敵の精神力が低いままと思わず、毎ターン見直す: The Priest restores allied SP. Do not assume other enemies remain at low SP; reassess each turn.
messages.自分の磨り減ってしまった心の数値によってパターンが変更\nターン終了時、磨り減っ: Action pattern changes with Ailing Heart's value. At Turn End, gain 1 Ailing Heart.
messages.長期化で行動が変わる。神父を最後まで放置せず、理髪師の次に倒す。: Longer fights change his actions. Defeat the Priest after the Barber rather than leaving him until last.
messages.-血に染まった手が10以上なら、血に染まった手Ⅱに変化\n-血に染まった手Ⅱが2:
- At 10 Bloodied Hand or more, changes to Bloodied Hand II.
- At 20 Bloodied Hand II or more, changes to Bloodied Hand III.
messages.血餐消費などで強化される。強化された3枚攻撃の再使用も確認する。: Bloodfeast consumption and other effects strengthen it. Check reuse on the strengthened 3-Coin attack too.
messages.次のターンも同じ精神力とは限らない。行動開始前に予測を確認する。: SP may differ next turn. Check predictions before actions begin.
messages.自分の体力が初めて最大値の66％以下になったときのパターンが強化される\nパター:
The first time HP reaches 66% of max or below, strengthen the action pattern:
- Minimum and maximum Speed +1.
- Blooming Thorn becomes Bloodwoven Thorn.
- Each turn, all allies gain 3 Festive Fever and 3 Blooming Thorn.
messages.HP66%以下・再戦の行動変更条件: 66% HP or below / rematch phase-transition conditions
messages.3人戦は仲間の残りHPでも移行する。ドゥルシネーア本人のHPだけで判断しない。: The trio encounter can also change phases based on allied HP. Do not judge solely by Dulcinea's HP.
messages.自分の体力が初めて最大値の33％以下になったときのパターンが強化される\nパター:
The first time HP reaches 33% of max or below, strengthen the action pattern:
- Minimum and maximum Speed +2.
- Use a strong skill, then increase Slash, Pierce, and Blunt resistance multipliers by 0.5, making her more vulnerable.
- Blooming Thorn and Bloodwoven Thorn become Bloodmolded Thorn.
- Each turn, all allies gain 5 Festive Fever and 5 Blooming Thorn.
messages.HP33%以下・再戦の行動変更条件: 33% HP or below / rematch phase-transition conditions
messages.理髪師か神父の撃破でも終盤行動へ移る。倒す前にフィナーレ用のマッチと回復を準備す: Killing the Barber or Priest also triggers the final pattern. Prepare clashes for “The Finale” and healing before the kill.
messages.他の味方へスキル効果でプラスのバフを付与する度に祝祭の熱気1を得る(種類別に1回: Gain 1 Festive Fever whenever a skill grants a positive buff to another ally (once per type). At Turn Start, gain Festive Fever equal to the number of other allies (max 3). At Turn End, heal SP equal to Festive Fever (does not activate at −45 SP). If Festive Fever is at 10 at Turn End, use a strong skill next turn, unless The Parade Repeats for Eternity is active.
messages.仲間への強化・ターン開始と終了: Ally buffs / Turn Start and Turn End
messages.熱気10で大技に注意。本文は次ターンとあるが、資料脚注では開始時の獲得後に10へ: Watch for the big attack at 10 Fever. Although the effect says next turn, reaching 10 through Turn Start gains can trigger it that same turn. Prioritize the currently displayed actions.
messages.ターン終了時パニック状態なら、精神力が0になる: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.
messages.敵味方の出血ダメージを蓄積する共有資源。3人の強化・回復・大技に消費される。: A shared resource accumulating enemy and allied Bleed damage. Consumed for the trio's buffs, healing, and big attacks.
messages.神父や理髪師自身の出血でも増える。味方の出血付与を防ぎ、消耗を抑える。: The Priest's and Barber's own Bleed also increases it. Prevent Bleed application on allies and limit attrition.
messages.理髪師・神父は攻撃と防御Lv−25、ドゥルシネーアは−35。: The Barber's and Priest's Offense and Defense Levels −25; Dulcinea's −35.
messages.基礎レベルと現在のレベルを区別する。深刻な負傷の追加低下はターンで変わる。: Distinguish base levels from current levels. Crippling Injury's additional reduction varies with turns.
messages.最大HPが減少した状態。ターン開始時、累計ターン1につき防御Lvが1下がる（最大: Max HP is reduced. At Turn Start, Defense Level −1 per 1 cumulative turn (max 15).
messages.表のHPは適用後で、もう一度減らす値ではない。ターンによる防御低下は現在の表示で: Listed HP is already after this effect; do not reduce it again. Check the current display for turn-based Defense Level reductions.
messages.神父は3から開始し、ターン終了に1増える。10では脆弱3・精神力減少5があり、与: The Priest starts at 3 and gains 1 at Turn End. At 10, gains 3 Fragile and loses 5 SP, and heals for 40% of damage dealt.
messages.長期化で行動が変わる。脆弱を狙って削るが、吸血もあるため一方攻撃を通さない。: Longer fights change his actions. Use Fragile to deal damage, but prevent unopposed hits because he can also drain HP.
messages.神父の蓄積効果。10以上でⅡ、20以上でⅢへ。スキルの強化・再使用条件になる。: The Priest's accumulating effect. Changes to II at 10 or more and III at 20 or more, enabling skill bonuses and reuse.
messages.これほど豊かであるとは･･･の再使用条件を確認する。: Check the reuse conditions of “How Bountiful...”
messages.仲間への強化や段階移行で増え、精神力回復とスキル強化に使う。10で強い行動に注意: Gained through allied buffs and phase changes; enables SP recovery and skill bonuses. Watch for strong actions at 10.
messages.ターン開始時の獲得で10へ達する場合もある。前ターンの数値だけで判断しない。: Turn Start gains can also reach 10. Do not judge solely by the previous turn's value.
messages.咲き出す棘・血で編んだ棘・血で研いだ棘: Blooming Thorn / Bloodwoven Thorn / Bloodmolded Thorn
messages.攻撃した側へ出血を返す棘。行動の段階が進むと上位の効果へ変わる。: Thorns return Bleed to attackers. Later action phases replace them with stronger effects.
messages.棘のある相手への攻撃後に、自身の出血で倒れないか確認する。: Check whether your own Bleed will kill a Sinner after attacking a target with Thorns.
messages.理髪師か神父の撃破でもフィナーレへ移る。ドゥルシネーアがHP33%になるまで来な: Killing the Barber or Priest also triggers “The Finale”. Do not assume it waits for Dulcinea to reach 33% HP.
messages.中盤への移行は本人HP66%のほか、理髪師か神父HP35%以下、3人の平均HP割: The middle phase triggers at Dulcinea's 66% HP, either the Barber or Priest at 35% HP or below, or the trio's average HP percentage at 75% or below.
messages.終盤へは本人HP33%以下・仲間の撃破のほか、理髪師HP40%以下かつ平均65%: The final phase triggers at Dulcinea's 33% HP or below or an ally's death. It also triggers with the Barber at 40% HP or below and average HP at 65% or below, or the Priest at 35% HP or below and average HP at 59% or below. Confirm the phase from current actions.
messages.破壊不能へ勝っても出血は残る。フィナーレの混乱防止は、そのスキルのダメージに対す: Bleed remains even after winning against Unbreakable Coins. “The Finale”'s Stagger prevention applies to that skill's damage.
messages.単体戦の出撃条件と違い、ドンキホーテは使えない。7-16の理髪師や7-34のドゥ: Unlike the solo encounters, Don Quixote is unavailable. Do not reuse the 7-16 Barber or 7-34 Dulcinea's values.
messages.主力6名＋控え5名。色欲火力、HP・精神力回復、フィナーレ用の高威力技を確保。: 6 deployed Sinners plus 5 reserves. Prepare Lust damage, HP and SP recovery, and high-Power skills for “The Finale”.
messages.出血の多い囚人はコイン数が多い攻撃ほど消耗する。守備や事前回復を使い、全員が毎タ: More Coins mean more Bleed damage for affected Sinners. Use defense or healing beforehand; not everyone has to attack every turn.
messages.理髪師を倒す集中火力: Focused damage to defeat the Barber
messages.神父の回復を上回り、まず1人減らして手数を楽にする。: Overcome the Priest's healing and remove the first enemy to ease the action burden.
messages.1人目の撃破時点からフィナーレへ備える。: Prepare for “The Finale” from the first kill onward.
messages.出血を抱えても戦える控え: Reserves that can fight while carrying Bleed
messages.ドンキホーテ以外の11名で、終盤まで回復と火力を残す。: Use the 11 Sinners other than Don Quixote, preserving recovery and damage for the latter half.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-34「ドゥルシネーア」の攻略。序盤は: Dulcinea guide for Limbus Company 7-34. Clear adds early to reduce the boss's Protection. Watch thorns that return Bleed to attackers and Unbreakable Coins that remain after Clash Wins; exploit the later Stagger for concentrated damage.
messages.7-34「On What Befell the Fair Dulcinea an: 7-34 · On What Befell the Fair Dulcinea and Don Quixote
messages.苦しげなパレードの血袋の外見: Bloodbag of the Painful Parade appearance
messages.苦しげなパレードの血袋のスキル: Bloodbag of the Painful Parade skills
messages.Bloodbag of the Painful Paradeの外見: Bloodbag of the Painful Parade appearance
messages.Bloodbag of the Painful Paradeのスキル: Bloodbag of the Painful Parade skills
messages.後を追うパレードの血袋の外見: Bloodbag of the Rear Parade appearance
messages.後を追うパレードの血袋のスキル: Bloodbag of the Rear Parade skills
messages.Bloodbag of the Rear Paradeの外見: Bloodbag of the Rear Parade appearance
messages.Bloodbag of the Rear Paradeのスキル: Bloodbag of the Rear Parade skills
messages.楽しそうなパレードの血鬼の外見: Bloodfiend of the Joyful Parade appearance
messages.楽しそうなパレードの血鬼のスキル: Bloodfiend of the Joyful Parade skills
messages.Bloodfiend of the Joyful Paradeの外見: Bloodfiend of the Joyful Parade appearance
messages.Bloodfiend of the Joyful Paradeのスキル: Bloodfiend of the Joyful Parade skills
messages.幸せなパレードの血鬼の外見: Bloodfiend of the Happy Parade appearance
messages.幸せなパレードの血鬼のスキル: Bloodfiend of the Happy Parade skills
messages.Bloodfiend of the Happy Paradeの外見: Bloodfiend of the Happy Parade appearance
messages.Bloodfiend of the Happy Paradeのスキル: Bloodfiend of the Happy Parade skills
messages.敵Lvは資料の基礎値。本体の防御Lv・スキルレベルは老衰（−35）を反映。取り巻: Enemy levels show the source's base values. The main body's Defense and skill levels account for Withered (−35). Adds show base Defense and skill levels; also check effects for individual buffs and Withered modifiers.
messages.序盤は本体を急いで削らず、増援を含む取り巻き8体を処理して保護を減らす。: Do not rush damage on the main body. First defeat the 8 adds, including reinforcements, to reduce Protection.
messages.マッチ勝利だけで無傷にはならない。攻撃する囚人の出血威力・回数とHPを毎ターン確: Winning clashes does not prevent every hit. Check attacking Sinners' HP and Bleed Potency and Count every turn.
messages.HP66%・33%で敵が強化される。混乱と強いスキルを使い、後半を長引かせない。: The enemy gains buffs at 66% and 33% HP. Use Stagger and strong skills to keep the latter half short.
messages.本体にダメージが通らない: Unable to damage the main body
messages.毎ターンの保護が原因。まず取り巻きを倒して獲得量を減らす。画面上の3体だけでなく: Protection gained each turn is the cause. Kill adds first to reduce it. Clear later reinforcements as well as the 3 visible enemies to trigger a special Stagger.
messages.破壊不能コインは勝っても攻撃が残る。また、棘を持つ敵へ攻撃すると攻撃側にも出血が: Unbreakable Coins still attack after you win. Attacking an enemy with Thorns also inflicts Bleed on the attacker. Reduce damage through clash wins while assigning attacks to Sinners with low Bleed Count.
messages.後半に急に全滅する: Suddenly wiped out in the latter half
messages.HP66%・33%の強化で棘と大技が重くなる。序盤に本体を削りすぎず保護を落とし: Buffs at 66% and 33% HP strengthen Thorns and big attacks. Reduce Protection before damaging the main body too far, then use Stagger Thresholds to finish the latter half quickly.
messages.HP50%（1372）・取り巻き全滅による混乱: 50% HP (1372) / Stagger from clearing all adds
messages.老衰で攻撃・防御レベル-35。基礎防御Lv87に対し開始時は52。推奨育成の目安: Withered lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 35. Base Defense Level is 87; it starts at 52. Aim for the recommended Lv.50 rather than matching the enemy's Lv.85.
messages.HP66%以下（1812）、33%以下（906）で段階的に強化。最後の大技の後は: Gains further buffs at 66% HP or below (1812) and 33% or below (906). After the final big attack, each Physical resistance multiplier increases by 0.5, making her more vulnerable.
messages.ジア・シーチュンが味方NPCとして参加。ランダムな攻撃先とマッチを確認し、危険な: Jia Xichun joins as an allied NPC. Check her random targets and clashes, and have Sinners intercept dangerous clashes.
messages.本体の保護を減らすためにも処理する。出血・破裂の的中を重ねさせない。: Defeat these to reduce the main body's Protection too. Prevent repeated Bleed and Rupture hits.
messages.HP・耐性は7-34個体の値。通常スキルは7章一般敵と共通。: HP and resistances are for the 7-34 version. Regular skills are shared with common Canto VII enemies.
messages.倒すと本体の保護は減るが、止められぬ歓喜で攻撃側へ出血回数が付くことがある。: Defeating it reduces the main body's Protection, but Unstoppable Bliss may inflict Bleed Count on the attacker.
messages.本体を削る前に、取り巻きを倒す: Defeat adds before damaging the main body
messages.出撃6名と控え6名を用意し、ドンキホーテを編成する。シーチュンの行動は操作できな: Bring 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves, including Don Quixote. Xichun cannot be controlled, so check whether she is entering unfavorable clashes.
messages.本体は毎ターン保護8を得るが、取り巻きが倒れるごとに獲得量が1減る。最初は本体の: The main body gains 8 Protection each turn, reduced by 1 for each dead add. Prioritize adds rather than forcing clashes against the main body's Counter early on.
messages.最初の増援を含む8体を全滅させると本体の特殊な混乱が起こる。まだ増援が残っていな: Clearing all 8 initial enemies, including reinforcements, triggers the main body's special Stagger. Check for remaining reinforcements, then focus strong attacks on the Staggered main body.
messages.倒した取り巻きの効果でE.G.O資源も増える。回復や広域攻撃に使いつつ、出血回数: Defeated adds also grant E.G.O resources. Use these for healing or area attacks, while reducing the attack burden on Sinners whose Bleed Count has risen.
messages.反撃に勝ち、取り巻き処理と混乱をつなぐ: Beat the Counter and turn add kills into a Stagger opening
messages.本体の棘が強化され、敵全体が毎ターン熱気と棘を得る。長期戦ほど不利なので、取り巻: The main body's Thorns strengthen, and the whole enemy team gains Fever and Thorns each turn. Longer fights become worse; clear adds to Stagger the main body.
messages.「それを繰り返すだけ…。」に勝つと棘を5減らせる。熱気5以上でマッチ威力も上がる: Beating “And that's all it does...” removes 5 Thorns. At 5 Fever or more it also gains Clash Power, so assign a strong clasher.
messages.HP50%の混乱区間も使う。取り巻き全滅の混乱と同時に浪費せず、残りHPと攻撃順: Use the Stagger Threshold at 50% HP too. Avoid wasting it alongside the add-clear Stagger; watch remaining HP and attack order when focusing damage.
messages.広域E.G.Oを使う前に、攻撃者の出血回数を確認する。棘を持つ複数の敵へ当てると: Check the attacker's Bleed Count before using area E.G.O. Hitting several enemies with Thorns can add Bleed Potency to the attacker from all of them.
messages.大技に勝ってから、弱化した本体を仕留める: Win against the big attack, then finish the weakened main body
messages.「フィナーレ」は全3枚が破壊不能。勝っても攻撃と出血は残るが、敵のマッチ敗北でダ: All 3 Coins of “The Finale” are Unbreakable. Attacks and Bleed remain after you win, but the enemy's clash loss halves damage and prevents this skill's damage from Staggering its targets.
messages.高威力スキルやE.G.Oで勝つことを優先。その後も出血による死亡まで防げるわけで: Prioritize winning with a high-Power skill or E.G.O. This does not also prevent death from Bleed, so check the clasher's and other allies' HP.
messages.大技の後は物理耐性が弱化する。取り巻きへ攻撃を分散させすぎず、出血がまだ少ない主: Physical resistances weaken after the big attack. Avoid spreading too many attacks across adds; finish the main body with attackers who still have little Bleed.
messages.混乱していない自分側の味方を優先。味方が対象ならマッチ威力+10、ダメージ0。対: Prioritizes non-Staggered allies on its own side. Against an ally, Clash Power +10 and damage is 0. Clash Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 3).
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血3を付与。自分側の味方が対象なら、代わりに次のターンまで攻撃: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. If targeting its own ally, instead grant 3 Offense Level Up through next turn.
messages.敵を強化する枠まで無理に引き受ける必要はない。序盤は取り巻きの処理を優先し、囚人: You do not need to intercept every action that buffs an enemy ally. Prioritize adds early and handle attacks aimed at Sinners.

messages.[攻撃後] 血餐25を消耗。[ターン終了時] 熱気を全消耗。: [After Attack] Consume 25 Bloodfeast. [Turn End] Consume all Fever.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 対象の熱気3につき、次のターンまで攻撃・防御レベル増加1（各最大: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Grant 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up through next turn per 3 Fever on the target (each max 3).

messages.表示4〜12だけで予測しない。累計血餐と棘の形態で強化される。取り巻きにも棘を与: Do not predict it solely from the listed 4–12 range. Cumulative Bloodfeast and Thorn form strengthen it. It also grants Thorns to adds; check attackers' Bleed.

If Bloodfeast is below 50, gain 25 Bleed and 2 Count, immediately activate it twice, and reduce Count by 2. Below 10% HP, only the gain effects apply. Then consume half the Bloodfeast.

messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 与ダメージの50%分HP回復、出血5と破裂5を付与。[このコイン: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Heal HP by 50% of the damage dealt; inflict 5 Bleed and 5 Rupture. [After this Coin's attack] Gain 1 Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast consumed (max 10).
messages.不安定なパレードがたまった後の広域。3枚目は残るが、前の2枚を破壊して回復と被害: An area attack after Imperfect Parade accumulates. Coin III remains, but breaking the first 2 Coins reduces healing and damage. In the final form, the healing effects become SP recovery.
messages.[使用時] 熱気5以上ならマッチ威力+3。: [On Use] If at 5 Fever or more, Clash Power +3.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 咲き出す棘5を得る。[マッチ敗北] 棘5を失う。: [Combat Start] Gain 5 Blooming Thorn. [Clash Lose] Lose 5 Thorns.
messages.序盤は取り巻き処理を優先する余地がある。後半に本体へ攻めるときは高威力役で勝ち、: You can prioritize adds early. When attacking the main body later, win with a high-Power clasher to reduce Thorns before the remaining attacks.
messages.[使用時] 血餐を半分消耗。最終形態の棘でコイン威力+2。: [On Use] Consume half the Bloodfeast. Final-form Thorns grant Coin Power +2.
messages.[マッチ勝利時] 消耗血餐の数値%だけダメージ量増加（最大150%）。[マッチ敗: [Clash Win] Damage increases by the Bloodfeast consumed as a percentage (max 150%). [Clash Lose] Halve damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.
messages.[攻撃後] 消耗血餐の数値だけ精神力が減少。: [After Attack] Lose SP equal to Bloodfeast consumed.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血6、出血回数+6。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 6 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 6.
messages.Ⅱ：[マッチ勝利後的中時] 破裂6、破裂回数+6。: Ⅱ：[On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 6 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 6.
messages.Ⅲ：[このコインの攻撃終了時] 消耗血餐10につき棘1（最大10）。: Ⅲ：[After this Coin's attack] Gain 1 Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast consumed (max 10).
messages.全枚破壊不能でもマッチ勝利は重要。半減と混乱防止を取り、大技の後に弱化した本体へ: Winning matters even when every Coin is Unbreakable. Gain the damage reduction and Stagger prevention, then focus attacks on the weakened main body. Watch for death from Bleed damage.
messages.[使用時] 硬化血液があり、このスキルに破裂付与効果があれば出血回数を追加で1増: [On Use] If the user has Coagulated Blood and this skill inflicts Rupture, increase Bleed Count by an additional 1.
messages.本体の攻撃と合わせて出血が増える。放置せず、混乱・撃破かマッチで止める。: Combines with the main body's attacks to build Bleed. Stop it through a clash, Stagger, or kill.
messages.[使用時] 対象の出血5以上でコイン威力+1。硬化血液3以上かつ破裂付与効果があ: [On Use] Coin Power +1 if the target has at least 5 Bleed. If the user has at least 3 Coagulated Blood and this skill inflicts Rupture, inflict additional Bleed.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 出血2を付与。対象に出血があれば硬化血液1を得る。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed. If the target has Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.出血した味方へ通すほど強くなる。勝てる囚人へ引き受け、増援処理を進める。: Stronger when allowed to hit Bleeding allies. Have a Sinner who can win intercept it, and continue clearing reinforcements.
messages.[使用時] 対象の出血5以上でコイン威力+1。: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, Coin Power +1.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 破裂回数+2、脆弱1を付与。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Rupture Count +2; inflict 1 Fragile.
messages.Ⅳ：[的中時] 出血2を付与。対象の出血10以上ならダメージ量+20%。: Ⅳ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed. If the target has at least 10 Bleed, damage +20%.
messages.強化条件と4枚の的中が重なると痛い。攻撃前に混乱させる方法も使おう。: The bonuses and 4 hits can combine for heavy damage. Staggering the user before it attacks is another option.
messages.[使用時] 対象に出血があれば硬化血液1を得る。: [On Use] If the target has Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.増援を減らすことが本体の保護解除につながる。防御中も倒せる相手は処理する。: Reducing reinforcements helps remove the main body's Protection. Kill targets you can finish even while they defend.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 出血回数+1。対象に出血があれば硬化血液1を得る。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Bleed Count +1. If the target has Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.[使用時]自分の祝祭の熱気が5以上なら、最終威力+1: [On Use] If at 5 Festive Fever or more, Final Power +1.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血2を付与,出血回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.出血・破裂の追加と条件強化を確認。マッチで止めるか、攻撃前に混乱・撃破して被害を: Check the additional Bleed, Rupture, and conditional bonuses. Reduce damage through clashes, or Stagger or kill the enemy before it attacks.

messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.守備で相殺してから攻める。戦闘開始時の強化は相殺だけでは取り消せない。: Offset with a Defense Skill before attacking. Offsetting alone cannot cancel the Combat Start buff.
messages.[使用時]出血15,出血回数2を得てから即2回発動させて出血回数が2減少: [On Use] Gain 15 Bleed and 2 Bleed Count, immediately activate it twice, and reduce Bleed Count by 2.
messages.[ターン終了時]硬化血液,祝祭の熱気を全て消耗: [Turn End] Consume all Coagulated Blood and Festive Fever.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]自分の硬化血液だけ出血,破裂を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Bleed and Rupture equal to the user's Coagulated Blood.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]体力最大値の(祝祭の熱気×2.5)%だけ体力回復(最大20%): Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal HP by (Festive Fever × 2.5)% of max HP (max 20%).
messages.熱気がたまった後の強い攻撃。混乱・撃破を先に狙うか、強いマッチで止める。: A strong attack after Fever accumulates. Aim to Stagger or kill the enemy first, or stop it with a strong clash.

messages.[使用時]出血が20未満なら、出血20を得てから即1回発動させ、出血回数が1減少: [On Use] If below 20 Bleed, gain 20 Bleed, immediately activate it once, and reduce Bleed Count by 1.

messages.破壊不能の2枚目が残る。マッチ勝利で被害を減らし、出血が少ない囚人で受ける。: Unbreakable Coin II remains. Win to reduce damage, and let a Sinner with little Bleed take the remaining hit.

messages.[マッチ勝利後的中]出血4を付与、出血回数が3増加: [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 3.
messages.2枚目は破壊不能。マッチに勝っても棘の獲得を防げるとは限らない。: Coin II is Unbreakable. Winning does not necessarily prevent Thorn gain.
messages.速度最小・最大+1。棘が「血で編んだ棘」に変化。毎ターン自分側全員が熱気3と棘3: Minimum and maximum Speed +1. Thorns become Bloodwoven Thorn. Each turn, all units on her side gain 3 Fever and 3 Thorns.
messages.本体を早く削りすぎず、取り巻きの保護減少を先に進める。: Reduce Protection through add kills before damaging the main body too far.
messages.速度最小・最大+2。棘が「血で研いだ棘」に変化。毎ターン自分側全員が熱気5と棘5: Minimum and maximum Speed +2. Thorns become Bloodmolded Thorn. Each turn, all units on her side gain 5 Fever and 5 Thorns. After the strong skill, each Physical resistance multiplier increases by 0.5, making her more vulnerable.
messages.最後は長期戦を避け、大技後の弱化中に決着を狙う。: Avoid a prolonged final phase; finish during the weakness after the big attack.
messages.ターン終了時、不安定なパレード5以上: At Turn End, at least 5 Imperfect Parade
messages.次のターンに同名の強いスキルを使う。: Uses the strong skill of the same name next turn.
messages.取り巻きを倒した後は次の広域に備える。: Prepare for the next area attack after clearing adds.
messages.開始時に保護8。味方が倒れるごとに毎ターンの獲得量-1。HPダメージを受けなかっ: Starts with 8 Protection. Each ally death reduces the amount gained each turn by 1. At the end of a turn without taking HP damage, gain 2 Haste next turn.
messages.序盤の取り巻き処理が、本体へダメージを通す準備になる。: Clearing adds early prepares the main body to take damage.
messages.生存する取り巻きも追加可能な取り巻きもいない: No living adds or available reinforcements remain
messages.次のターンに熱気と不安定なパレードを全消耗して混乱。ターン開始時点で条件を満たせ: Next turn, consume all Fever and Imperfect Parade and become Staggered. Triggers immediately if the condition is met at Turn Start. Summon 2 Bloodfiend Kindreds on the turn after Stagger.
messages.最初の8体の後も再召喚はある。処理と混乱を攻撃の好機に使う。: Resummoning can occur after the first 8 enemies. Use add clearing and Stagger as openings to attack.
messages.味方への強化・ターン開始/終了時: Ally buffs / Turn Start and Turn End
messages.スキルで味方へプラス効果を付けるごとに熱気1（種類別1回）。開始時は他の味方数だ: Gain 1 Fever whenever a skill grants an ally a positive effect (once per type). At Turn Start, gain Fever equal to other allies present (max 3). At Turn End, heal SP equal to Fever (does not activate at −45 SP). At 10 Fever, prepare a big attack next, unless the Imperfect Parade attack takes priority.
messages.熱気がたまる速度を見て次ターンの広域を予測する。: Watch how quickly Fever builds to predict the next area attack.
messages.受けた出血ダメージを血餐へため、スキルの消耗資源に使う。: Accumulates Bleed damage as Bloodfeast, consumed by skills.
messages.出血は味方のHPを削るだけでなく敵の資源にもなる。: Bleed damages allied HP and also fuels enemy resources.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.7.name: Starved and Withered
messages.老衰により攻撃・防御レベルが35減る。: Withered lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 35.
messages.敵の基礎Lv85だけで育成不足と判断しない。: Do not judge your preparation solely by the enemy's base Lv.85.
messages.パニック後も戦闘が続くことを見込む。: Expect the encounter to continue after Panic.
messages.タイプ変更効果を受ける: Receives a Panic Type change effect
messages.パニックタイプは変わらず、精神力のない敵向けの効果が適用される。: Panic Type stays unchanged; apply the effects intended for enemies without SP instead.
messages.タイプ変更を前提にしない。: Do not rely on changing Panic Type.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.10.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.出血した対象を優先・終了時に与ダメージなし: Prioritizes Bleeding targets / no damage dealt by Turn End
messages.出血した対象を狙う。ダメージを与えられなければ次のターンに脆弱2と攻撃レベル増加: Targets Bleeding enemies. If unable to deal damage, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.出血した主力への攻撃を放置しない。: Do not leave attacks on your Bleeding main combatants unchecked.
messages.ダメージ量の5〜10%分HPを回復。: Heal HP by 5–10% of damage dealt.
messages.マッチで止めると吸血も防げる。: Stopping attacks through clashes also prevents HP drain.
messages.攻撃終了時、対象の出血8以上: At Attack End, target has at least 8 Bleed
messages.条件強化へつながるため早めに処理する。: Enables conditional buffs; clear the enemy early.
messages.スキル使用時、対象の破裂10以上: On Use, target has at least 10 Rupture
messages.破裂の多い囚人へ強い攻撃を通さない。: Do not let strong attacks hit Sinners with heavy Rupture.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.14.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.スキル効果でプラスのバフ効果を得る度に祝祭の熱気1を得る(種類別に1回)\n\n:
Gain 1 Festive Fever whenever a skill grants a positive buff (once per type).
At Turn Start, gain Festive Fever equal to the number of other allies (max 3). At Turn End, lose Festive Fever equal to allies who died this turn.
At 8 Festive Fever or more, use a strong skill next turn.
messages.熱気が8以上になる前に混乱・撃破を狙う。長引くと強いスキルへ切り替わる。: Aim to Stagger or kill it before Fever reaches 8. A longer fight allows the stronger skill.
messages.攻撃的中時、対象に出血があるならダメージ量の15%だけ体力を回復: On attack hit against a target with Bleed, heal HP by 15% of damage dealt.
messages.出血した味方への的中は回復も許す。敵のHPが減っていても攻撃を放置しない。: Hits on Bleeding allies also permit healing. Do not ignore an attack just because the enemy's HP is low.
messages.攻撃終了時、対象の出血が8以上なら、硬化血液を1得る: At Attack End, if the target has at least 8 Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.取り巻きも出血や強化を重ねる。通常スキルへの対処と混乱・撃破を並行しよう。: Adds also accumulate Bleed and buffs. Handle regular skills while seeking Staggers and kills.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.21.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.被ダメージに自分の出血回数が1増加。\n体力が20%減少するたびに硬化血液1,咲: On taking damage, increase own Bleed Count by 1. Each 20% HP lost grants 1 Coagulated Blood and 2 Blooming Thorn. On death, if any ally or enemy is a Bloodfiend, increase Bloodfeast by 30.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.26.name: Thirst for Blood

Gain 1 Festive Fever whenever a skill grants a positive buff (once per type).
At Turn Start, gain Festive Fever equal to the number of other allies (max 3). At Turn End, lose Festive Fever equal to allies who died this turn and heal SP equal to Festive Fever (does not activate at −45 SP).
At 8 Festive Fever or more, use a strong skill next turn.
messages.攻撃的中時、対象に出血があるならダメージ量の20%だけ体力を回復: On attack hit against a target with Bleed, heal HP by 20% of damage dealt.
messages.攻撃終了時、対象の出血が5以上なら、硬化血液を1得る: At Attack End, if the target has at least 5 Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.31.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.-出血が付与された対象を優先して攻撃\n-ターン終了時、このターンにダメージを与:
- Prioritizes targets with Bleed.
- At Turn End, if no damage was dealt this turn, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
- At Turn End, if damage was dealt this turn, heal 5 SP.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.33.name: Starved and Withered
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、精神力が0になる: If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.38.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.boss-copy:dulcinea:passives.40.name: Starved and Withered
messages.最大10。スキルでダメージを受けると攻撃者へ数値の半分（切り上げ）の出血を付け、: Maximum 10. On taking skill damage, inflict Bleed equal to half the value, rounded up, on the attacker, then decrease by 1. Does not expire at Turn End.
messages.攻撃回数だけでなく攻撃者の出血回数を確認。広域で複数の棘に触れる場合も注意。: Check attackers' Bleed Count as well as attack counts. Be careful when an area attack hits several enemies with Thorns.
messages.攻撃者への出血が棘の数値分になる。出血・回数の的中時付与量が中盤+1、最終+2。: Bleed returned to attackers equals the Thorn value. On Hit Bleed Potency and Count increase by 1 in the middle form and 2 in the final form. Bloodfeast-consuming skills also gain 1 Coin Power in the middle form and 2 in the final form. The final form also grants effects including +50% damage.
messages.基本威力表だけでは後半の強さを表せない。形態変化後は予測を見直し、混乱中に攻撃す: Base Power tables alone cannot represent later strength. Recheck predictions after a phase change and attack during Stagger.
messages.最大10。数値3につき攻撃レベル増加1（最大3）。本体は10、取り巻きは8が大技: Maximum 10. Gain 1 Offense Level Up per 3 value (max 3). The main body uses its big attack at 10; adds at 8.
messages.反撃の熱気5以上の強化も確認する。: Check the Counter's bonus at 5 Fever or more too.
messages.血袋の死亡で2、血鬼の死亡で3増える。累計消耗5につき、開始時に脆弱1を得る。: Increases by 2 on a Bloodbag's death and 3 on a Bloodfiend's death. At Turn Start, gain 1 Fragile per 5 consumed cumulatively.
messages.取り巻きを倒して混乱を起こし、脆弱が付いた本体へ攻撃をつなげる。: Kill adds to trigger Stagger, then attack the main body with its Fragile.
messages.取り巻きの死亡時、少ないE.G.O資源3種が各1増える。倒した対象を優先して囚人: On an add's death, gain 1 each of the 3 least abundant E.G.O resources. Inflict 3 Bleed Count on a Sinner, prioritizing the killer. Enemy Fever can also trigger buffs next turn.
messages.倒せたから安全とは限らない。処理役の出血回数も毎ターン見直す。: A kill does not guarantee safety. Recheck the clearing Sinner's Bleed Count every turn.
messages.破壊不能コインはマッチで勝っても残る。勝利は無意味ではなく、通常コインの破壊や勝: Unbreakable Coins remain after a clash win. Winning still matters: it breaks normal Coins and prevents On Hit effects that require the enemy to win the clash.
messages.シーチュンはNPCで、囚人の味方対象効果を受けず、彼女のスキルからE.G.O資源: Xichun is an NPC: she does not receive effects targeting allied Sinners, and her skills do not generate E.G.O resources. Help her if she keeps losing strong clashes.
messages.最初の取り巻き処理前に本体を削り、保護が残ったまま後半へ進めると苦しくなる。: Damaging the main body into later phases before clearing the initial adds leaves Protection active and makes the fight harder.
messages.HP33%以降のフィナーレは大きな出血を残す。混乱しない効果があっても出血による: “The Finale” after 33% HP leaves heavy Bleed. Stagger prevention is separate from death caused by Bleed.
messages.主力は推奨Lv50を目安に、育成できる範囲で上げる。ドンキホーテは必須。: Aim for the recommended Lv.50 on your main team, leveling as your resources allow. Don Quixote is mandatory.
messages.出撃6名に加え控え6名を設定。控えには開始精神力の補正があり、減算人格は符号が反: Set 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves. Reserves receive starting SP modifiers, with the sign reversed for negative-Coin Identities. Plan their order and roles.
messages.マッチ役、出血に耐える耐久・回復役、混乱中に削る火力を用意。回復や広域E.G.O: Prepare clashers, durable Sinners and healers to withstand Bleed, and damage for Stagger openings. Check resource generation for healing and area E.G.O.
messages.本体の色欲・嫉妬、取り巻きの色欲などが有効。出血・破裂の編成は保護以外の削り方に: Lust and Envy are effective against the main body; Lust works well against adds. Bleed and Rupture teams offer damage beyond attacking through Protection, but a dedicated keyword team is not required to win by clearing adds first.
messages.反撃と大技に勝てる役: Clasher for the Counter and big attacks
messages.熱気と後半強化込みのマッチを受け持つ。強いスキルを通常攻撃へ使い切らない。: Handle clashes with Fever and later buffs included. Do not spend every strong skill on regular attacks.
messages.保護を減らしつつ、処理役に蓄積する出血回数とHPを管理する。: Reduce Protection while managing the clearing Sinner's accumulating Bleed Count and HP.
messages.HP50%の混乱とフィナーレ後の弱化へ強い攻撃を残す。: Save strong attacks for the Stagger at 50% HP and the weakness after “The Finale”.
messages.【リンバス】7-36 ドンキホーテ（7章最終ボス）の攻略｜Limbus Assi: 7-36 Don Quixote (Canto VII Final Boss) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-36「ドンキホーテ（7章最終ボス）」: Don Quixote (Canto VII Final Boss) guide for Limbus Company 7-36. A long encounter: clear adds during the Ferris Wheel phase, then manage Bleed and restraints in the humanoid phase. Have allies defeat Coagulated Dreams to turn them into support and prepare for the big attacks.
messages.7-36「The Tale of the Great Fixer Who Sou: 7-36 · The Tale of the Great Fixer Who Sought the Dream: Final Battle
messages.夢見る冒険の記憶の外見: Memories of the Dreaming Adventure appearance
messages.夢見る冒険の記憶のスキル: Memories of the Dreaming Adventure skills
messages.Memories of the Dreaming Adventureの外見: Memories of the Dreaming Adventure appearance
messages.Memories of the Dreaming Adventureのスキル: Memories of the Dreaming Adventure skills
messages.敵Lvは7章ダンジョン個体の基礎値。本体2形態の防御Lv・スキルレベルは老衰と強: Enemy levels are base values for the Canto VII dungeon versions. Both main-body forms' Defense and skill levels account for Withered and the Golden Bough's Forced Arbitration, totaling −40. Adds show values before individual modifiers. Mirror Dungeon-only damage reductions are excluded.
messages.観覧車では取り巻きを処理し、人型では出血と拘束を管理する長期戦。凝結した夢を味方: A long encounter: clear adds during the Ferris Wheel phase, then manage Bleed and restraints in the humanoid phase. Have allies defeat Coagulated Dreams to turn them into support and prepare for the big attacks.
messages.観覧車へ直接ダメージを通そうとせず、ゴンドラと自爆する取り巻きを処理する。: Do not try to damage the Ferris Wheel directly. Handle Gondolas and self-destructing adds.
messages.破壊不能の攻撃にもマッチ勝利を狙い、出血がたまった味方の行動順を調整する。: Aim to win against Unbreakable attacks too, adjusting action order for Sinners with accumulated Bleed.
messages.槍は早く味方で倒して救出。凝結した夢も味方で倒し、大技に備える支援を得る。: Have allies quickly destroy Spears to free Sinners. Defeat Coagulated Dreams with allies too, gaining support for the big attack.
messages.観覧車のHPが減らない: The Ferris Wheel loses no HP
messages.本体を直接削る段階ではない。ゴンドラを倒して「回り回る観覧車」を減らす。召喚の広: This phase is not about directly damaging the main body. Defeat Gondolas to reduce The Endless Wheel. Equip Defense Skills on everyone to handle the summoning area attacks.
messages.破壊不能の攻撃と出血の両方が残る。特に人型の序盤は、出血が多い囚人が追加の出血を: Unbreakable attacks and Bleed both remain. Early in the humanoid phase especially, check whether heavily Bleeding Sinners can act before receiving more Bleed. Use reserves to recover too.
messages.味方が槍に閉じ込められた: An ally is trapped in a Spear
messages.貫いた槍を味方の攻撃で早めに倒す。放置やボスによる撃破では被害が増える。槍を除去: Destroy the Impaling Spear quickly with allied attacks. Leaving it alone or letting the boss kill it causes more harm. Removing the Spear releases its corresponding ally next turn.
messages.削ったのにHPが戻る・ターンが終わる: HP recovers or the turn ends after dealing damage
messages.HPに応じた段階移行がある。境界を越えて一気に倒す戦闘ではない。敵の次のスキル名: HP-based phase transitions prevent clearing everything in a single burst. Check the enemy's next skill and remaining Dreams and Spears, then advance the mechanics.
messages.基礎Lv90だが、開始時に攻撃・防御Lvが計40減る。防御Lv92は補正後52。: Base Lv.90, but starts with a total −40 to Offense and Defense Levels. Defense Level 92 becomes 52 after modifiers. Recommended development target: Lv.50.
messages.約75%・60%・40%・20%付近で行動変更や強制終了がある。境界の細かな判定: Patterns change or turns end forcibly near 75%, 60%, 40%, and 20% HP. Exact boundaries have some uncertainty, so do not plan progression using a fixed damage calculation alone.
messages.「抉り抜き」と「奥義-球」は使用するまで混乱しない。混乱で大技を必ず飛ばせるとは: Cannot be Staggered before using Sundering and The Sphere. Do not assume Stagger can always skip a big attack.
messages.戦闘の最初の形態。直接のスキルや状態異常でHPは減らない。: The encounter's first form. Direct skills and status effects do not reduce its HP.
messages.ゴンドラを処理して専用効果を減らすと人型へ移行する。: Clear Gondolas to reduce its special effect and advance to the humanoid form.
messages.全部で7つ。途中で撤退しても、残った個体は後でHPを引き継いで再登場する。: 7 in total. Remaining Gondolas later return with their HP carried over even if they retreat midway.
messages.自爆ではなく味方の攻撃で倒すとE.G.O資源も得られる。: Defeating them with allied attacks rather than self-destruction also grants E.G.O resources.
messages.囚人を拘束する固有ユニット。資料の本体HPと部位HPが異なるため併記。画面で対象: A special unit that restrains a Sinner. Overall and part HP are listed separately because the values differ. Check the targeted part's HP on screen.
messages.独自の攻撃スキル表はない。救出・時間切れ・ボスによる撃破の条件をパッシブ欄に掲載: Has no separate Attack Skill table. Rescue, timeout, and boss-kill conditions are listed under passives.
messages.後半に4体出現する馬の形のユニット。残っている間はボスへのバリアを供給する。: 4 horse-shaped units appear in the latter half. Supply Shield to the boss while present.
messages.囚人が倒すと味方を支援する冒険の記憶へ変わる。独自の攻撃スキル表はない。: When a Sinner defeats one, it becomes Memories of the Dreaming Adventure and supports allies. Has no separate Attack Skill table.
messages.囚人側を支援するユニット。敵として倒す対象ではない。: A unit supporting the Sinners, not an enemy to defeat.
messages.味方ドンキホーテへの強化が、奥義-球に備えるバリアへ変化する。: Its buffs for allied Don Quixote change into Shield support for The Sphere.
messages.HP・耐性・速度はこのボス戦用の値。通常ステージとは異なる。: HP, resistances, and Speed are specific to this boss encounter, separate from regular-stage values.
messages.通常スキルに加え、登場の次のターンにマッチ不可の自爆を使う。先に混乱・撃破する。: In addition to regular skills, uses an Unclashable self-destruct attack the turn after appearing. Stagger or kill it first.
messages.ゴンドラを壊し、自爆は行動前に止める: Destroy Gondolas and stop self-destruction before it acts
messages.血袋・血鬼は登場した次のターンにマッチ不可の自爆を使う。攻撃を合わせるのではなく: Bloodbags and Bloodfiends use an Unclashable self-destruct attack the turn after appearing. Stagger or kill them beforehand rather than trying to clash.
messages.ゴンドラも処理し、回り回る観覧車を0にする。残った個体は後で再登場するため、撤退: Clear Gondolas too, bringing The Endless Wheel to 0. Remaining units reappear later; do not confuse retreat with defeat.
messages.「終わらぬ祝祭」「永久なる祝祭」は、対象が守備スキルを使用することでダメージを無: “The Infinite Parade” and “The Eternal Festival” deal no damage to targets using Defense Skills. Equip Defense Skills in everyone's action slots before they arrive.
messages.マッチが少なく精神力を上げにくい段階。精神力回復や使いたいE.G.Oパッシブ、人: Few clashes make SP harder to build in this phase. Prepare SP recovery, desired E.G.O passives, and Identity mechanics here.
messages.広域の順番と出血を見てマッチを組む: Assign clashes around area-attack order and Bleed
messages.人型の開幕は「血の欲望」→「血餐の時間」→「14式マント」の順でマッチすることを: As an opening guideline, clash with “Desire for Blood” → “Moment of Bloodfeast” → Hardblood Arts 14: Mantle. Account for “Moment of Bloodfeast” raising enemy SP and Bloodlust, then reduce Bloodlust by beating Mantle afterward.
messages.「硬血式楔」は破壊不能コインを含む広域が複数来る。出血が多い囚人に重ねて通さない: Several “Hardblood Wedge” area attacks can appear with Unbreakable Coins. Check Speed order and all targets to avoid stacking them on heavily Bleeding Sinners.
messages.出血を得る前に動く、付いた出血の回数を消費してから次を受けるなど、同じマッチでも: Action order matters: act before gaining Bleed, or consume existing Count before taking another hit. If Bleed would kill a Sinner before their attack, use healing, defense, or reserves to recover.
messages.拘束する怠惰属性の「貫かれよ」は2枚目が破壊不能。受けたら槍を早めに味方で倒す。: The restraining Sloth version of Be Impaled has an Unbreakable second Coin. If hit, have allies quickly destroy the Spear. If an Identity can Evade, check its Evade Power and prediction too.
messages.大技に勝ち、回復と出血処理の時間を取る: Beat the big attack and make time for healing and Bleed management
messages.「4式-抉り抜き」は累計消耗血餐によってマッチ威力が上がる。高威力役で勝ち、ダメ: Hardblood Arts 4 - Sundering gains Clash Power from cumulative Bloodfeast consumed. Win with a high-Power clasher to halve damage and prevent Stagger from this skill.
messages.使用後は敵の攻撃・防御レベルが下がり、HP73%の混乱も近い。すぐ次の境界まで削: After use, enemy Offense and Defense Levels drop, and the Stagger at 73% HP is close. Stabilize allied HP and Bleed Count rather than rushing straight to the next boundary.
messages.HP約60%で後半へ進む。強いスキルと夢を処理する行動を残し、再び来る広域へ備え: Around 60% HP, advance to the latter half. Save strong skills and actions for handling Dreams and the returning area attacks.
messages.人型後半・HP約60%以下: Latter humanoid phase / roughly 60% HP or below
messages.凝結した夢4体を囚人で倒す: Have Sinners defeat all 4 Coagulated Dreams
messages.「ブラッディ・メアリー・ゴー・ラウンド」はマッチ不可。守備でやり過ごし、次のター: “Bloody-Merry-Go-Round” is Unclashable. Use defense to endure it and prepare to handle the 4 Dreams that appear next turn.
messages.夢が残ると本体にバリアが付く。ボスへの攻撃へ固執せず、囚人が夢へとどめを刺して支: Dreams supply Shield while alive. Rather than insisting on attacking the boss, have Sinners land the kills to transform Dreams into support Memories.
messages.夢をボスに倒されると囚人側へ色欲ダメージと大量の出血が来る。味方で先に処理し、必: If the boss kills a Dream, the Sinners take Lust damage and heavy Bleed. Clear Dreams first with allies and secure the support needed.
messages.後半序盤の「硬血式楔」と「血餐の時間」は、可能なら楔から先にマッチしてから血餐の: Early in the latter half, if possible clash with “Hardblood Wedge” before “Moment of Bloodfeast”. This handles area attacks before the enemy gains more Bloodlust.
messages.記憶の支援で大技を越え、本体を削る: Use Memories' support to survive the big attack, then damage the main body
messages.夢を味方で倒して作った記憶の支援は、この大技のターンに味方へのバリアへ変わる。夢: Memories created by allied Dream kills convert their support into allied Shields on this big-attack turn. Finish handling Dreams before it arrives.
messages.「奥義-球」は高威力で2枚とも破壊不能。支援が整っているかを確認し、マッチ勝率だ: The Sphere has high Power and 2 Unbreakable Coins. Check that support is ready rather than repeatedly spending E.G.O solely on clash odds.
messages.使用後は衝動を全消耗し、脆弱・束縛が付く。残る槍や出血を確認しながら本体へ攻撃を: After use, all Bloodlust is consumed and the boss gains Fragile and Bind. Check remaining Spears and Bleed, then focus attacks on the main body to reach the ending event near 20%.
messages.画面の案内に従って専用E.G.Oを使う: Follow the prompts and use the special E.G.O
messages.ほかの囚人が退場して資源が0になる場面は専用イベント。通常の全滅と勘違いしない。: Other Sinners leaving and resources becoming 0 are part of the event. Do not mistake it for a normal team wipe.
messages.案内に従って光の苗木SUPERBIAを使い、ドンキホーテの「ラ・サングレ・デ・サ: Follow the prompts to use SUPERBIA from the Sapling of Light, then select Don Quixote's La Sangre de Sancho. Clash with the designated opponent even if the prediction is extremely unfavorable.
messages.つばぜり合いの演出では画面のボタンまたはスペースキーの操作案内に従う。この99威: During the weapon-lock sequence, follow the on-screen button or Space-key prompts. You do not need a regular team capable of beating this 99 Power.
messages.マッチ不可。対象が守備スキルを使用するとダメージ量-100%。: Unclashable. Damage −100% if the target uses a Defense Skill.
messages.守備スキルを装着して受ける。予測威力へ攻撃スキルをぶつけてマッチする場面ではない: Equip a Defense Skill to receive it. This is not a clash to answer with an Attack Skill against its predicted Power.
messages.次のターンに爆発するスキルを使う。: Uses an exploding skill next turn.
messages.爆発前に倒す。防御しているから放置してよい相手ではない。: Defeat it before the explosion. A defending enemy is not safe to ignore here.
messages.Ⅰ：[このコインの攻撃終了時] 対象へ色欲ダメージ10を追加して倒れる。: Ⅰ：[After this Coin's attack] Deal 10 additional Lust damage to the target, then die.
messages.行動前の撃破を狙う。マッチ不可なので、攻撃を割り当てただけで止まるとは考えない。: Aim to kill it before it acts. It is Unclashable; assigning an attack does not by itself stop it.
messages.[使用時] 対象の出血5につき基本威力+1（最大3）。血餐を最大30消耗し、10: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 3). Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust per 10 consumed.
messages.出血した味方が対象だと強化される。通常攻撃へ無理に弱いマッチを作らず、残りの広域: Stronger against Bleeding allies. Avoid forcing weak clashes against a regular attack; save responses for the remaining area attacks and restraints.
messages.[使用時] 血餐を最大40消耗。10につき衝動1、精神力3回復。: [On Use] Consume up to 40 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 3 SP per 10 consumed.
messages.[マッチ敗北] 精神力-3、衝動-3。次のターンに防御レベル減少3。: [Clash Lose] SP −3 and Bloodlust −3. Gain 3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ対象の最大HP20%分の色欲ダメージを追加。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal additional Lust damage equal to 20% of the target's max HP.
messages.怠惰属性の拘束技とは別。割合ダメージが大きいのでマッチ勝利で的中を防ぎ、衝動も減: Separate from the restraining Sloth version. Win to prevent the large percentage-based damage and reduce Bloodlust.
messages.出血が最も多い対象を狙う。[使用時] 対象の出血5につきコイン威力+1（最大2）: Targets the unit with the most Bleed. [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 2).
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ出血2・破裂2を付与。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 2 Rupture.
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時] 対象の出血威力×回数分の色欲ダメージを追加。: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Deal additional Lust damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency × Count.
messages.出血が重なった味方への大ダメージを防ぐ。攻撃対象とマッチ予測を毎ターン見直す。: Prevent heavy damage against allies with stacked Bleed. Reassess the target and clash prediction every turn.
messages.[戦闘開始時] 衝動3につき加重値+1（最大2）。[攻撃後] 衝動3を消耗。: [Combat Start] Attack Weight +1 per 3 Bloodlust (max 2). [After Attack] Consume 3 Bloodlust.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血3を付与。[マッチ勝利後的中] 破裂3。[マッチ敗北後的中]: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 3 Rupture. [On Hit after Clash Lose] Consume 1 Bloodlust.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 出血回数+2。[マッチ勝利後的中] 破裂3。[マッチ敗北後的中]: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Bleed Count +2. [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 3 Rupture. [On Hit after Clash Lose] Consume 1 Bloodlust.
messages.広域の1・2枚目が残る。勝利で3枚目と追加効果を防ぎ、衝動を減らす。出血した囚人: The first 2 Coins of the area attack remain. Winning prevents Coin III and additional effects while reducing Bloodlust. Check additional targets to avoid stacking attacks on Bleeding Sinners.
messages.[使用時] 血餐を最大40消耗。10につき衝動1、精神力5回復。: [On Use] Consume up to 40 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 5 SP per 10 consumed.
messages.本編には鏡個体限定のマッチ敗北時80%軽減を当てはめない。血餐の時間より先にマッ: Do not apply the Mirror Dungeon-only 80% damage reduction on Clash Lose to the story version. Consider clashing before “Moment of Bloodfeast”, then managing Bleed Count through later actions.
messages.[使用時] 血餐を最大300消耗。10につき衝動1、精神力3回復。血餐を消耗した: [On Use] Consume up to 300 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 3 SP per 10 consumed. If Bloodfeast was consumed, heal another 30 SP.
messages.敵の強化を一気に進める。開幕は血の欲望の後、マントより前のマッチを目安に、後半序: Rapidly strengthens the enemy. Plan the order with other skills: after “Desire for Blood” but before Mantle in the opening, or after Wedge early in the latter half.
messages.このスキルを使うまで混乱しない。: Cannot become Staggered until this skill is used.
messages.[使用時] 血餐を最大100消耗。10につき衝動1、精神力15回復。累計消耗血餐: [On Use] Consume up to 100 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 15 SP per 10 consumed. Clash Power +1 per 30 Bloodfeast consumed cumulatively (max 15).
messages.[マッチ敗北] ダメージ半減。このスキルのダメージでは対象が混乱しない。: [Clash Lose] Halve damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.
messages.[攻撃後] 増えたマッチ威力分、このターンと次のターンに攻撃・防御レベル減少（最: [After Attack] Gain Offense and Defense Level Down this turn and next turn equal to the Clash Power gained (max 15).
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時] 出血8を付与し、衝動2を消耗。: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 8 Bleed and consume 2 Bloodlust.
messages.条件強化で表示以上の威力になる。勝って被害を減らし、使用後の弱化中に出血処理と回: Conditional bonuses can exceed the listed Power. Win to reduce damage, then use the post-attack weakness to manage Bleed and recover too.
messages.[マッチ勝利時] 対象へ出血4・破裂4を付与。[マッチ敗北] 衝動2を消耗。: [Clash Win] Inflict 4 Bleed and 4 Rupture on the target. [Clash Lose] Consume 2 Bloodlust.
messages.マッチに勝って衝動を減らす。通常の防御と同じつもりで放置しない。: Win to reduce Bloodlust. Do not leave it unchecked as if it were a normal Guard.
messages.衝動10につき基本威力+1。対象の出血5につきコイン威力+1（最大2）。: Base Power +1 per 10 Bloodlust. Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 2).
messages.Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[的中時] それぞれ出血2と出血回数+2。: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.減算コインの反撃。敵の精神力が低くても弱いとは限らない。出血した主力へ無理なマッ: A negative-Coin Counter. Low enemy SP does not necessarily weaken it. Do not force a dangerous clash on a Bleeding main combatant.
messages.マッチ不可。[使用時] 次のターンに凝結した夢を生成。: Unclashable. [On Use] Create Coagulated Dreams next turn.
messages.後半への切り替わりで使う。守備で受け、次に夢4体を味方で倒す準備をする。: Used at the transition into the latter half. Use defense to receive it, then prepare for allies to defeat the 4 Dreams.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時] 混乱し、次のターンに凝結していく血状態になる。[このコインの攻撃: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Stagger the target and inflict Congealing Blood next turn. [After this Coin's attack] Remove up to 25 Bleed Potency from the target; gain that amount on self and increase Bloodfeast by it.
messages.勝っても残る2枚目が拘束する。回避か受け役を決め、生成された槍を味方で早めに除去: Coin II restrains the target and remains after a clash win. Choose an Evade or a Sinner to receive it, then have allies quickly destroy the generated Spear to free them.
messages.ドンキホーテ流硬血奥義-球: Ascendant Don Quixote Hardblood Arts - The Sphere
messages.使うまで混乱しない。共用累積消耗血餐の数値%だけダメージ量増加（最大300%）。: Cannot become Staggered before use. Damage increases by shared cumulative Bloodfeast consumed as a percentage (max 300%).
messages.[使用時] 精神力30回復。衝動10につきマッチ威力+1。: [On Use] Heal 30 SP. Clash Power +1 per 10 Bloodlust.
messages.[攻撃後] 衝動を全消耗。このターンと次のターンに脆弱5、次のターンに束縛2。: [After Attack] Consume all Bloodlust. Gain 5 Fragile this turn and next turn, and 2 Bind next turn.
messages.夢を囚人が倒して得た記憶の支援でバリアを用意する。使用後は大きく弱化するため、そ: Prepare Shields through Memories created by Sinner Dream kills. The boss becomes much weaker after use; finish from that opening.
messages.ドンキホーテ流硬血奥義-ラ・サングレ: Ascendant Don Quixote Hardblood Arts - La Sangre
messages.終了イベントで構える専用スキル。通常の威力勝負で上回る必要はない。: A special skill readied for the ending event. You do not need to overpower it in a normal Power contest.
messages.画面の案内に従いSUPERBIAから味方ドンキホーテの指定E.G.Oを選び、この: Follow the prompts to select allied Don Quixote's designated E.G.O through SUPERBIA, then clash with this skill to advance the sequence.
messages.[戦闘開始時] ランダムな囚人1名へマッチ威力増加1とダメージ量増加1。ボスと凝: [Combat Start] Grant 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Damage Up to 1 random Sinner. Inflict 1 Fragile on the boss and Coagulated Dreams.
messages.味方側の支援スキル。変化後の記憶を攻撃する必要はない。: An allied support skill. You do not need to attack the transformed Memories.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が8以上なら、ダメージ量+20%: [On Use] If the target has at least 8 Bleed, damage +20%.
messages.出血が6以上なら、硬化血液を1得る: If the target has at least 6 Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.[的中時]出血8,血染めの鋏の刃1を得る: [On Hit] Gain 8 Bleed and 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, Base Power +1.
messages.[攻撃後]硬化血液,血染めの鋏の刃全部消耗: [After Attack] Consume all Coagulated Blood and Blood-tinged Scissorblades.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]体力最大値(対象の出血)%だけ体力回復(最大20%): Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal HP by the target's Bleed as a percentage of max HP (max 20%).
messages.[使用時]自分の硬化血液1につき、基本威力+1: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 1 Coagulated Blood on self.
messages.攻撃順と受ける囚人のHPを確認する。出血が多い味方に無理に攻撃させない。: Check attack order and the receiving Sinner's HP. Do not force heavily Bleeding allies to attack.
messages.Ⅰ：[このコインの攻撃終了時] 対象へ色欲ダメージ10を追加し、自分が倒れる。: Ⅰ：[After this Coin's attack] Deal 10 additional Lust damage to the target, then the user dies.
messages.登場した次のターンの自爆。マッチでは止められないため、先に混乱・撃破して阻止する: Self-destructs the turn after appearing. It cannot be clashed with; Stagger or kill it first to stop it.
messages.[マッチ敗北]出血10,出血回数を1得る: [Clash Lose] Gain 10 Bleed and 1 Bleed Count.
messages.[的中時]出血10と血に染まった手1を得る: [On Hit] Gain 10 Bleed and 1 Bloodied Hand.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が4以上なら、ダメージ量+10%: [On Use] If the target has at least 4 Bleed, damage +10%.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が6以上なら、硬化血液を1得る: [On Hit] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]出血回数が2増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.[的中時]出血20と血に染まった手2を得る: [On Hit] Gain 20 Bleed and 2 Bloodied Hand.
messages.[使用時]このスキルで対象へ出血を付与するとき、自分に硬化血液だけ破裂を追加で付: [On Use] When this skill inflicts Bleed on the target, additionally inflict Rupture on self equal to own Coagulated Blood.
messages.[攻撃後]硬化血液,血に染まった手を全て消耗: [After Attack] Consume all Coagulated Blood and Bloodied Hand.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、ダメージ量+20%: [On Use] If the target has at least 6 Bleed, damage +20%.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が5以上なら、硬化血液を1得る: [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, gain 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大で50消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血染めの鋏の刃1を得る: [On Use] Consume up to 50 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades per 10 consumed.
messages.[使用時]このスキルで血餐を消耗できなければ、出血5,硬化血液1を得る: [On Use] If this skill cannot consume Bloodfeast, gain 5 Bleed and 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が5以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, Coin Power +1.
messages.[使用時]血染めの鋏の刃に比例して、マッチ威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Clash Power +1 based on Blood-tinged Scissorblades (max 3).
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]血染めの鋏の刃を最大5消耗し、ダメージ量が(20×消耗した血染めの鋏: Ⅲ[On Hit] Consume up to 5 Blood-tinged Scissorblades; damage increases by (20 × amount consumed)% (max 100%).
messages.[的中時]体力最大値(対象の出血威力)%だけ体力回復(最大30%): [On Hit] Heal HP by the target's Bleed Potency as a percentage of max HP (max 30%).
messages.破壊不能コインと回復がある強い攻撃。敵の強化とこちらの出血を見て、先に混乱させた: A strong attack with an Unbreakable Coin and healing. Check enemy buffs and allied Bleed, and aim to Stagger it first.
messages.[使用時]血染めの鋏の刃が1以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If at 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades or more, Base Power +1.
messages.[使用時]自分の硬化血液が3以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If at 3 Coagulated Blood or more, Coin Power +1.
messages.[使用時]出血5,出血回数を1得る: [On Use] Gain 5 Bleed and 1 Bleed Count.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が5以上なら血に染まった手1を得る: [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 Bleed, gain 1 Bloodied Hand.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大で50消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき硬化血液1を得る: [On Use] Consume up to 50 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Coagulated Blood per 10 consumed.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]このスキルで血餐を消耗できなければ、出血10,血に染まった手1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] If this skill could not consume Bloodfeast, gain 10 Bleed and 1 Bloodied Hand.
messages.[使用時]血に染まった手が1以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If at 1 Bloodied Hand or more, Base Power +1.
messages.[使用時]自分の硬化血液1につき、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 1 Coagulated Blood on self.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]血に染まった手を全て消耗し、対象の出血回数が3増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Consume all Bloodied Hand and increase the target's Bleed Count by 3.
messages.[的中時]自分の硬化血液を全て消耗し、(消耗した硬化血液×3)だけ血餐が増加し: [On Hit] Consume all own Coagulated Blood, increase Bloodfeast by amount consumed × 3, and gain 5 Bleed.
messages.[的中時]体力最大値(対象の出血)%だけ体力回復(最大30%): [On Hit] Heal HP by the target's Bleed as a percentage of max HP (max 30%).
messages.敵Lv90に育成をそろえる必要はない。: You do not need to level your team to the enemy's Lv.90.
messages.老衰と合計40減少。本体スキル欄にこの補正を反映している。: Totals −40 with Withered. Main-body skill values account for this modifier.
messages.召喚された順に、自爆前の処理と次の守備を考える。: Plan add kills before self-destruction and the next defense assignments in summon order.
messages.回り回る観覧車0・追加登場予定なし: The Endless Wheel at 0 / no pending arrivals
messages.ゴンドラの残りと生成予定を確認する。: Check remaining Gondolas and scheduled summons.
messages.永久に回る風車、大観覧車、そして吾ら: The Eternal Cycle of Windmills, Wheels, and Us
messages.ゴンドラがあると攻撃できず、直接スキル・火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜でも本体HP: Cannot be attacked while Gondolas are present. Direct skills, Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking do not reduce the main body's HP.
messages.本体を殴らずゴンドラを処理する。: Clear Gondolas instead of attacking the main body.
messages.敵の攻撃・状態異常で倒れる: Defeated by enemy attacks or status effects
messages.血餐+30、ランダムなE.G.O資源+2。自ら消える場合は発動しない。: Bloodfeast +30 and a random E.G.O resource +2. Does not activate when it removes itself.
messages.自爆を待つより先に倒し、資源も回収する。: Defeat it for resources rather than waiting for self-destruction.
messages.次のターン開始時にパニックを解除して精神力0へ。血餐30を消耗できれば攻撃威力増: At next Turn Start, recover from Panic and reset SP to 0. If able to consume 30 Bloodfeast, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 1 Haste and heal 30 SP. Otherwise, gain 40 Bleed, immediately activate it, and reduce Count by 5. Still gain 2 Attack Power Up and heal 30 SP next turn afterward.
messages.精神力を下げるだけで長く止まる相手ではない。解除後の強化も確認する。: SP reduction alone cannot disable the enemy for long. Check post-Panic buffs too.
messages.部位に付いた火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜の威力が半分になる。: Halve Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking Potency on the part.
messages.境界を越えても同じ数値が残るとは考えない。: Do not assume status values remain unchanged across boundaries.
messages.出血ダメージが共用の血餐になり、ボスのスキルの消耗資源になる。: Bleed damage becomes shared Bloodfeast, consumed by the boss's skills.
messages.出血回数をため込むと敵の強化も進む。: Accumulating Bleed Count also fuels enemy buffs.
messages.段階Ⅱ・Ⅲへ強化。数値が減れば前の段階へ戻る。Ⅱでは消耗スキルのマッチ威力+1、: Changes to stages II and III; returns to a lower stage if value falls. Stage II grants effects including +1 Clash Power to consuming skills; stage III grants +1 Coin Power.
messages.マント・楔などに勝って衝動を減らし、後の攻撃を弱くする。: Win against Mantle, Wedge, and other relevant skills to reduce Bloodlust and weaken later attacks.
messages.ダメージの30%分、本体と部位のHPを回復。マッチ敗北後の破壊不能コイン的中では: Heal overall and part HP by 30% of damage dealt. Does not activate on Unbreakable hits after losing a clash.
messages.破壊不能でも勝つ価値がある。回復を防いで戦闘を短くする。: Winning still matters against Unbreakable attacks. Prevent healing to shorten the encounter.
messages.1ターンで最大HP15%以上回復・出血吸収・対象撃破: Heal at least 15% max HP in one turn / absorb Bleed / kill a target
messages.大きく回復するか出血を吸収すると次のターンに束縛3（各ターン1回）。自分のスキル: Large healing or Bleed absorption grants 3 Bind next turn (once per turn each). Each target killed by the user's own skills grants 2 Offense Level Down and 1 Defense Level Down next turn (up to 3 times).
messages.被害を前提に狙うより、発動後の速度とレベルを見て立て直す。: Rather than deliberately taking damage to trigger this, check Speed and levels after it activates and recover.
messages.次のターン、対応する味方の拘束を解除。: Release the corresponding ally's restraint next turn.
messages.囚人側で早めに倒して救出する。: Have Sinners destroy it early to rescue the ally.
messages.最も少ないE.G.O資源+3と、ランダムな資源+3。: The least abundant E.G.O resource +3 and a random resource +3.
messages.救出と資源補充を同時に進める。: Rescue the ally while replenishing resources.
messages.生成された次のターンまで倒されない: Survives through the turn after being created
messages.そのターン終了時に消え、捕らえた味方へ最大HP30%の固定ダメージ、出血10・回: Disappears at that Turn End, dealing fixed damage equal to 30% max HP to its captive and inflicting 10 Bleed and 5 Count.
messages.自然解除を待たず処理する。: Destroy it rather than waiting for automatic release.
messages.ボスに任せて救出することはできない。味方がとどめを刺す。: The boss cannot rescue your ally. Have allies land the kill.
messages.虚しく安逸だった夢のかけら: Broken Fragment of a Futile, Naive Dream
messages.血餐+30。囚人が倒した場合は夢見る冒険の記憶を生成。: Bloodfeast +30. If a Sinner lands the kill, create Memories of the Dreaming Adventure.
messages.夢4体を味方で倒して必要な支援を得る。: Have allies defeat all 4 Dreams to gain the support needed.
messages.家族に背を向けた利己的な願い: A Selfish Wish at the Expense of the Family
messages.ボスが衝動5。全囚人へ色欲ダメージ30、出血8・回数8。: The boss gains 5 Bloodlust. Deal 30 Lust damage and inflict 8 Bleed and 8 Count on all Sinners.
messages.敵に倒される前に処理する。: Clear it before the enemy kills it.
messages.抱いてはならぬ無責任な夢だったのだ: I never should've dreamed this irresponsible dream
messages.倒しても冒険の記憶が生成されない。: Defeating it does not create Memories of the Dreaming Adventure.
messages.奥義-球まで夢を残さず、先に支援へ変えておく。: Do not leave Dreams until The Sphere; convert them to support first.
messages.本体を削る前に夢を処理する理由。: A reason to handle Dreams before damaging the main body.
messages.毎ターン開始時・奥義-球のターン: Every Turn Start / The Sphere turn
messages.全囚人の精神力5回復。味方ドンキホーテを強化し、奥義-球のターンには味方へのバリ: Heal 5 SP for all Sinners. Buff allied Don Quixote; on The Sphere turn, changes to an effect granting allied Shields. The Manager Identity receives a different special effect.
messages.長期戦の支援と大技への防御を兼ねる。夢を囚人で倒しておく。: Provides both long-fight support and defense against the big attack. Have Sinners defeat Dreams first.
messages.boss-copy:don-quixote:passives.26.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.血染めの鋏の刃が1以上なら、鋏の刃が強化される: If at 1 Blood-tinged Scissorblades or more, strengthen the Scissorblades.
messages.被ダメージに自分の出血回数が1増加。\n体力が20%減少するたびに硬化血液1を得: On taking damage, increase own Bleed Count by 1. Each 20% HP lost grants 1 Coagulated Blood. On death, if an ally or enemy is a Bloodfiend, increase Bloodfeast by 30.
messages.登場ターン終了時に生存: Alive at the end of the arrival turn
messages.次のターンに自爆スキルを使い、そのターン終了時には死亡する。: Uses its self-destruct skill next turn and dies at that turn's end.
messages.自爆はマッチ不可。先に混乱させるか倒す。: Self-destruction is Unclashable. Stagger or kill it first.

messages.boss-copy:don-quixote:passives.41.name: Starved and Withered

messages.血染めの鋏の刃が2以上なら、鋏の刃が強化される: If at 2 Blood-tinged Scissorblades or more, strengthen the Scissorblades.
