messages.7から開始し、ゴンドラが倒れるたびに1減る。0になり次の生成予定もなくなると人型: Starts at 7; decreases by 1 per Gondola defeated. At 0 with no pending summons, changes to the humanoid form.
messages.観覧車のHPではなく、ゴンドラの残りを進行の目安にする。: Use remaining Gondolas rather than Ferris Wheel HP to track progression.
messages.血餐消耗で獲得。10以上でⅡ、20以上でⅢ。段階Ⅱは攻撃・防御レベル増加とマッチ: Gained by consuming Bloodfeast. Reaches II at 10 or more and III at 20 or more. Stage II grants Offense and Defense Level Up and +1 Clash Power; III adds effects including +1 Coin Power. Bleed and Rupture application also increases.
messages.勝利で減らせるマント・楔などを止め、次の広域の被害を抑える。: Stop Mantle, Wedge, and other skills that reduce Bloodlust on your clash win, limiting later area-attack damage.
messages.2ターン行動不能になり、対応する槍が生成される。: Incapacitated for 2 turns; creates a corresponding Spear.
messages.槍を倒す役を決め、放置の追加被害とボスによる撃破を防ぐ。: Assign a Spear clearer to prevent timeout damage and boss kills.
messages.囚人が倒した夢から生まれ、精神力回復や味方ドンキホーテの強化を行う。奥義-球には: Created from Dreams defeated by Sinners. Restores SP and buffs allied Don Quixote; supplies Shields to everyone for The Sphere.
messages.夢はボスではなく囚人が倒し、強い大技の前に支援へ変える。: Have Sinners, not the boss, defeat Dreams and turn them into support before the big attack.
messages.ほかの囚人が生存している間はHP1未満にならない。初期E.G.Oは通常戦闘中使用: HP cannot fall below 1 while another Sinner is alive. Base E.G.O cannot be used during normal combat. Gains Offense Level and SP-related buffs as turns pass and under other conditions. The Manager Identity's special effects differ.
messages.単体の受け役にも使えるが、全員の広域被害までは防げない。別の生存者を残す。: Can receive attacks alone, but cannot protect the whole team from area damage. Keep another Sinner alive.
messages.同名の「貫かれよ」は憤怒の割合ダメージ技と、怠惰の拘束技がある。属性と効果で見分: Be Impaled has a Wrath version with percentage-based damage and a Sloth version with restraints. Distinguish them by affinity and effects.
messages.鏡ダンジョン限定のマッチ敗北時80%軽減を、本編の大技へ当てはめない。: Do not apply the Mirror Dungeon-only 80% damage reduction on Clash Lose to the story version's big attacks.
messages.HP境界でターンが終わる。全スキルを使える前提で資源・火力を計算しない。: HP boundaries can end the turn. Do not calculate resources and damage assuming every skill will act.
messages.夢の支援バリアは大技への重要な準備。資料には境界付近の混乱で発動タイミングがずれ: Dream support Shields are important preparation for the big attack. Stagger near a boundary can shift activation timing; check actual Shields and the displayed big attack.
messages.終了演出の退場と資源0は仕組みの一部。案内されたE.G.Oと操作で進める。: Departing Sinners and 0 resources in the ending sequence are part of the mechanic. Proceed with the prompted E.G.O and controls.
messages.推奨Lv50を目安に、主力と控えを育てる。出撃6名・控え6名の連続戦闘で、ドンキ: Aim for the recommended Lv.50 on main combatants and reserves. A Chain Battle with 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves; Don Quixote is mandatory.
Prepare SP and HP recovery, Protection, and Shields. Check E.G.O resources gathered in the dungeon too.
messages.貫通・打撃の広域と出血に備える。マッチ力だけでなく、残るコインへの耐性・HPも必: Prepare for Pierce and Blunt area attacks and Bleed. Clash strength alone is insufficient; remaining Coins also require resistances and HP.
messages.控えの開始精神力補正は加算人格と減算人格で向きが異なる。倒れた後に誰が出るかまで: Starting SP modifiers for reserves have opposite signs for positive- and negative-Coin Identities. Decide who enters after a casualty.
messages.出血を管理しながらマッチする主力: Main combatants who clash while managing Bleed
messages.広域とマントへ勝ち、衝動を削る。攻撃順と副対象まで確認する。: Beat area attacks and Mantle to reduce Bloodlust. Check attack order and additional targets too.
messages.本体だけを狙わず、救出とバリア供給停止・支援生成を担当する。: Handle rescues, stop Shield generation, and create support rather than focusing only on the main body.
messages.被弾を完全には消せない長期戦。人型の厳しい序盤を越え、後半の仕組みへつなぐ。: A long encounter where not every hit can be prevented. Survive the difficult humanoid opening and advance to the later mechanics.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-36「サンチョ（7章）」の攻略。HP: Sancho (Canto VII) guide for Limbus Company 7-36. Behavior changes at 80%, 60%, and 40% HP. Prepare for the Speed 10 Unbreakable attack, and win Clashes to limit damage and lifesteal through each phase.
messages.7章ダンジョンのサンチョ。7.5章LCB定期検診や鏡の個体とは別。基礎Lv85に: Sancho in the Canto VII dungeon, separate from the Canto VII.5 LCB Regular Checkup and Mirror Dungeon versions. Dreamy Hesitation lowers Offense Level by 35 from base Lv.85. Its description says Defense Level −35, but the actual reduction is 34; displayed Defense Level uses −34. Additional buffs from Hardblood and lost HP vary separately.
messages.表示威力は条件強化前。血餐・硬血・出血で威力と加重値が変わる。資料の硬血と血甲の: Listed Power is before conditional bonuses. Bloodfeast, Hardblood, and Bleed alter Power and Attack Weight. Check each skill's Hardblood consumption conditions against the actual status display. Unbreakable Coins still attack and apply On Hit effects after you win a clash.
messages.出撃6名＋控え5名。ドンキホーテは使えないので、ほかの囚人で主力・回復・高威力マ: 6 deployed Sinners plus 5 reserves. Don Quixote is unavailable; prepare your main attackers, recovery, and high-Power clashers using other Sinners.
messages.HP境界の次ターンは速度10の大技。先に回復と耐性を整え、マッチに勝って破壊不能: The turn after an HP boundary brings a big attack at 10 Speed. Prepare healing and resistances first, then win the clash to reduce Unbreakable damage and suppress HP drain.
messages.開幕は敵の精神力−15以下での回復に注意。終盤には精神力45のテルミナードへ勝て: Watch for the enemy's recovery at −15 SP or below in the opening. Save E.G.O that can beat “La Aventura Ha Terminado” at 45 SP in the final phase.
messages.序盤に勝ったのに敵の精神力が急に回復した: Enemy SP suddenly recovered despite early clash wins
messages.開始時に敵の精神力が−15以下なら、血餐を使って20へ回復しマッチ威力増加2を得: If at −15 SP or below at Turn Start, she consumes Bloodfeast to recover to 20 SP and gains 2 Clash Power Up. “Sanguine Joy” also restores SP On Use. Recheck next turn's predictions.
messages.マッチに勝っても出血を大量に受ける: Heavy Bleed despite winning the clash
messages.段階移行の攻撃には破壊不能コインがある。勝利で吸血や一部の被害は抑えられるが、残: Phase-transition attacks have Unbreakable Coins. Winning suppresses HP drain and some damage, but remaining hits still inflict Bleed. Heal before big attacks and check Bleed damage from subsequent actions.
messages.混乱させた直後に復帰して大技を使われた: She recovered from Stagger and immediately used a big attack
messages.HP80%・60%・40%で混乱を解除して段階移行する。混乱中でも境界を越えた後: At 80%, 60%, and 40% HP, she clears Stagger and changes phase. Prepare for crossing a boundary even while she is Staggered, and for 10 Speed next turn.
messages.終盤の1枚攻撃へ勝てない: Unable to beat the late single-Coin attack
messages.ラ・サングレは麻痺を使用時に付け、テルミナードは精神力を45へ回復する。基本威力: La Sangre inflicts Paralyze On Use, while “La Aventura Ha Terminado” restores SP to 45. Prepare high-Base-Power E.G.O or earlier debuffs; do not assign a clasher by listed Power alone.
messages.1〜2／硬血で増加／段階移行の次ターン10: 1–2 / increases with Hardblood / 10 next turn after a phase change
messages.HP80%・60%・40%（2104・1578・1052）でHP減少が止まり、混: HP stops decreasing at 80%, 60%, and 40% (2104 / 1578 / 1052), clearing Stagger and advancing to the next pattern. These boundaries are separate from Stagger Thresholds.
messages.最初の血餐400、硬血1から開始。血餐・硬血・本人の出血・失ったHPで強化される: Starts with 400 Bloodfeast and 1 Hardblood. Strengthened by Bloodfeast, Hardblood, her own Bleed, and lost HP.
messages.7.5章のように10ターン経過や特殊攻撃使用だけで終わる戦闘ではない。最後までH: Unlike Canto VII.5, the encounter does not end simply after 10 turns or a special attack. Deplete her HP to finish.
messages.ドンキホーテ抜きで、主力と回復・控えをそろえる: Prepare main attackers, recovery, and reserves without Don Quixote
messages.主力Lv50・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、HP・精神力回復と高威力E.G.Oを用意。ドン: Aim for Lv.50 and Uptie III or higher, with HP and SP recovery and high-Power E.G.O. Don Quixote is unavailable; do not rely on her healing or team effects.
messages.6名に加え控え5名まで入れられる。破壊不能の出血で主力が消耗しても、次ターンに交: Bring 6 Sinners and up to 5 reserves. Check reserve development and order so replacements can enter next turn if Unbreakable Bleed wears down the main team.
messages.貫通・色欲が通りやすい。怠惰・憂鬱の火力だけでは通りにくいので、育成済みの中から: Pierce and Lust are effective. Sloth and Gloom damage face resistance; consider attack affinities when choosing from your developed roster.
messages.精神力回復の条件を意識して序盤を作る: Plan the opening around the SP-recovery condition
messages.敵は開始時に精神力−15以下だと回復し、マッチ威力増加2も得る。初期精神力0なら: At Turn Start, the enemy recovers if at −15 SP or below and gains 2 Clash Power Up. From an initial 0 SP, making her lose 4 or more opening clashes can easily meet that condition. Judge by current SP.
messages.HPに余裕がある場合は、初ターンの弱い攻撃を一部守備で受け、マッチを3本程度に抑: With sufficient HP, you can receive some weaker first-turn attacks with Defense Skills and limit clashes to around 3. Do not force low-HP allies to take hits.
messages.血喜の使用時回復も含めてマッチ予測を確認し、味方の精神力を整える。HP85%の混: Include “Sanguine Joy”'s On Use recovery in predictions and build allied SP. The Stagger at 85% HP is cleared by the phase change at 80%.
messages.回復を先に済ませて破壊不能攻撃へ備える: Heal beforehand and prepare for Unbreakable attacks
messages.HP2104付近で本体HPの減少が止まり、次のターンに速度10で血の歓喜。戦闘開: HP stops falling near 2104; next turn she uses “Ecstasy of Blood” at 10 Speed. Allied Bleed activates at Combat Start, so winning the clash alone cannot prevent that HP loss.
messages.3枚すべて破壊不能。マッチには勝って吸血を抑え、残る的中と出血付与は耐性・事前回: All 3 Coins are Unbreakable. Win to suppress HP drain, and withstand remaining hits and Bleed with resistances and prior healing. The turn ends after the attack, so slower healing scheduled that turn cannot act.
messages.通常行動に戻ったら出血の少ない囚人で抉り抜き・掘り穿つへ対応する。後者の出血まと: When regular actions resume, assign Sinners with little Bleed to Sundering and Impaling. Prevent Impaling's repeated Bleed activation.
messages.広域へ勝ち、バリアを削る: Beat the area attack and deplete the Shield
messages.HP1578付近の次ターンに、速度10のドンキホーテ流硬血2式-血甲。加重値6、: The turn after reaching around 1578 HP brings “Don Quixote Hardblood Arts 2 - Hardblood” at 10 Speed. Attack Weight 6 and all 4 Coins are Unbreakable; prepare the whole team's HP beforehand.
messages.このマッチに勝つと技のダメージが50%減り、そのダメージでは混乱しなくなる。ただ: Winning halves the skill's damage and prevents Stagger from that damage. It does not make Bleed or other effects harmless.
messages.サンチョは戦闘開始時にバリア500と第2眷属の揺らぎを得る。バリアはターン終了で: At Combat Start, Sancho gains 500 Shield and Shimmering【Bloodfiend】. The Shield does not expire at Turn End, and attackers receive Bleed. Deplete it while checking their Bleed Count and HP.
messages.通常行動では追跡・奇襲が増える。出血最多の囚人を主対象にすると広域化・威力強化さ: Regular patterns add Track and Ambush. Targeting the Sinner with the most Bleed increases range and Power; redirect to someone with less Bleed when possible.
messages.麻痺を考え、基本威力の高い技で受ける: Account for Paralyze and use high Base Power
messages.HP1052付近の次ターンはラ・サングレ。速度に関係なくマッチできるが、使用時に: The turn after reaching around 1052 HP brings La Sangre. It can be clashed with regardless of Speed, but a condition inflicts 1 Paralyze on both participants On Use.
messages.コイン威力だけが高い1枚技より、基本威力も高いE.G.Oなどを合わせる。血餐また: Prefer E.G.O with high Base Power over single-Coin skills relying only on Coin Power. Check its +5 Clash Power from Bloodfeast or self-damage too.
messages.破壊不能の的中と、攻撃後のターン終了にも備える。回復や守備を間に合うタイミングで: Prepare for the Unbreakable hit and the turn ending after the attack. Time healing and defenses to act soon enough, and protect Sinners with heavy Bleed.
messages.テルミナードを止め、追撃を集中する: Stop “La Aventura Ha Terminado” and focus follow-up damage
messages.終盤の周期では3ターンに1度、ラ・アベントゥラ・ア・テルミナードを使う。戦闘開始: The final cycle uses “La Aventura Ha Terminado” once every 3 turns. It restores SP to 45 at Combat Start; low prior SP does not mean a weak attack.
messages.強いE.G.Oでマッチ勝利を狙う。破壊不能なので的中の出血は残るが、勝つことでこ: Aim to win with strong E.G.O. Its Unbreakable hit still inflicts Bleed, but winning prevents this passive's HP drain and the additional Bleed on enemy Clash Win.
messages.この技は段階移行の大技と違い、速度10固定・攻撃後のターン終了がない。先に弱体化: Unlike phase-transition attacks, this skill has neither fixed 10 Speed nor an After Attack turn ending. Use earlier debuffs or focus follow-up attacks to finish her.
messages.[使用時]血餐を10消耗して硬血を1得る: [On Use] Consume 10 Bloodfeast and gain 1 Hardblood.
messages.[使用時]自分の出血15につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 15 Bleed on self (max 3).
messages.基本は最大11だが、硬血と本人の出血でコイン威力が上がる。開幕のマッチ回数を決め: Base maximum is 11, but Hardblood and her own Bleed raise Coin Power. Check current buffs and allied HP when deciding how many opening clashes to take.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大20消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき硬血を1得る: [On Use] Consume up to 20 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Hardblood per 10 consumed.
messages.出血回数が増える攻撃。後の出血発動と大技の威力条件へつながるので、出血の多い主力: Increases Bleed Count, enabling later Bleed activation and big-attack Power conditions. Protect main combatants with heavy Bleed.
messages.[使用時]硬血を4消耗し、精神力を10回復: [On Use] Consume 4 Hardblood and heal 10 SP.
messages.[使用時]血餐を10消耗し、硬血1を得る、精神力が10回復: [On Use] Consume 10 Bloodfeast, gain 1 Hardblood, and heal 10 SP.
messages.-血餐を消耗できなければ、出血3を得る: - If unable to consume Bloodfeast, gain 3 Bleed.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の出血1につきダメージ量+10%(最大100%): Ⅰ[On Hit] Damage +10% per 1 Bleed on the target (max 100%).
messages.[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.使用時の精神力回復はマッチに勝つだけでは防げない。敵の精神力が低いと思って弱いス: Winning a clash cannot prevent On Use SP recovery. Do not assign a weak skill solely because enemy SP was low; include her recovered Heads chance in the prediction.
messages.速度に関係なくこのスキルとマッチできる: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed.
messages.[戦闘開始時]敵の中で出血を持つ敵がいれば、全ての敵の出血を発動。出血回数が2減: [Combat Start] If any enemy has Bleed, activate all enemies' Bleed and reduce Bleed Count by 2.
messages.[使用時]戦闘開始時に効果が発動しなかったら、出血30を得る: [On Use] If the Combat Start effect did not activate, gain 30 Bleed.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]血餐を最大40消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき、硬血1を得てダメー: [Clash Win] Consume up to 40 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Hardblood and +25% damage per 10 consumed (max 100%).
messages.-血餐を消耗できなかったら、出血5を得て発動させる。出血回数が2減少: - If unable to consume Bloodfeast, gain and activate 5 Bleed, then reduce Bleed Count by 2.
messages.[的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.
messages.戦闘開始時に味方の出血が発動する。マッチには勝ってよいが、3枚とも破壊不能なので: Activates allied Bleed at Combat Start. You should still win the clash, but all 3 Coins are Unbreakable; prepare for hits and additional Bleed. Healing after this attack is too late because it ends the turn.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]硬血段階によって、このスキルのダメージ量+20%(最大60%): [Clash Win] This skill's damage +20% per Hardblood stage (max 60%).
messages.[マッチ敗北]血甲を4消耗し、バリア体力を20得る: [Clash Lose] Consume 4 Hardblood and gain 20 Shield HP.
messages.出血6以上の味方にはコインが強くなる。マッチ勝利で敵の血甲を削れる一方、敵は小さ: Gains Coin Power against allies with at least 6 Bleed. Winning consumes the enemy's Hardblood, but she gains a small Shield; account for the follow-up damage needed.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血3につき、基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 3).
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の出血を回数分発動させる。対象の出血回数を1まで消耗させる: Ⅲ[On Hit] Activate the target's Bleed as many times as its Count; consume Bleed Count down to 1.
messages.出血が多い対象ほど基本威力が上がり、最後の的中で出血をまとめて発動する。出血の少: More target Bleed means higher Base Power, and the final hit activates Bleed repeatedly. Intercept with a Sinner who has little Bleed and prevent the hit.
messages.[戦闘開始時]血餐を200消耗し、500のバリア体力を得て硬血5,第2眷属の揺ら: [Combat Start] Consume 200 Bloodfeast; gain 500 Shield HP, 5 Hardblood, and 1 Shimmering【Bloodfiend】.
messages.-血餐が足りない場合、出血50を得て発動させる。出血回数が2減少。500だけバリ: - If Bloodfeast is insufficient, gain and activate 50 Bleed, then reduce Bleed Count by 2. Gain 500 Shield HP, 5 Hardblood, and 1 Shimmering【Bloodfiend】. This damage cannot reduce HP below 1.
messages.[マッチ敗北]このスキルで得たバリアがある間脆弱を3得る: [Clash Lose] Gain 3 Fragile while the Shield gained by this skill remains.
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が50%分減少し、このスキルのダメージで対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Damage −50%; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.
messages.[的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が3増加: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 3.
messages.加重値6、4枚すべて破壊不能。勝つとダメージが半減し、この技のダメージで混乱しな: Attack Weight 6, with all 4 Coins Unbreakable. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. It does not prevent death from Bleed; prepare healing and resistances beforehand.
messages.ドンキホーテ亜流サンチョ4式-追跡: Variant Don Quixote Style: Sancho Arts 4 - Track
messages.出血が最も多い対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritizes the target with the most Bleed.
messages.[使用時]出血が最も多い対象なら、攻撃加重値+2,マッチ威力+3: [On Use] If targeting the unit with the most Bleed, Attack Weight +2 and Clash Power +3.
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大30消耗し、消耗した血餐15につき硬血を1得る。コイン威力+: [On Use] Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Hardblood and +1 Coin Power per 15 consumed (max 2).
messages.-血餐を消耗できなければ、出血を10得て発動させる。出血回数が1減少: - If unable to consume Bloodfeast, gain and activate 10 Bleed, then reduce Bleed Count by 1.
messages.[攻撃後]このスキルの与ダメージだけ血餐が増加: [After Attack] Increase Bloodfeast by this skill's damage dealt.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに束縛を1付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.
messages.-このスキルで血餐を30消耗したなら、束縛2を追加で付与: - If this skill consumed 30 Bloodfeast, inflict 2 additional Bind.
messages.出血が最も多い対象には加重値+2・マッチ威力+3。速い味方で出血の少ない担当へ変: Against the target with the most Bleed, Attack Weight +2 and Clash Power +3. Check whether a fast ally can redirect it to someone with less Bleed. Bloodfeast consumption also boosts Coin Power.
messages.ドンキホーテ亜流サンチョ3式-奇襲: Variant Don Quixote Style: Sancho Arts 3 - Ambush
messages.[使用時]血餐を最大50消耗し、消耗した血餐10につき血甲を1得る。基本威力+1: [On Use] Consume up to 50 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Hardblood and +1 Base Power per 10 consumed (max 5).
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンに麻痺を1付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn.
messages.-このスキルで血餐を50消耗したなら、麻痺2を追加で付与: - If this skill consumed 50 Bloodfeast, inflict 2 additional Paralyze.
messages.出血最多の対象には広域化とマッチ強化が起こる。使用時の判定なので、マッチ中に出血: Gains range and Clash Power against the target with the most Bleed. The condition checks On Use, so Bleed expiring during the clash may not prevent the bonus.
messages.ドンキホーテ亜流サンチョ2式-ラ・サングレ: Variant Don Quixote Style: Sancho Arts 2 - La Sangre
messages.[使用時]血餐を50消耗し、対象と自分へ麻痺を1付与: [On Use] Consume 50 Bloodfeast; inflict 1 Paralyze on the target and self.
messages.血餐が足りない場合、自分の体力を100消耗してマッチ威力+5: If Bloodfeast is insufficient, consume 100 own HP for +5 Clash Power.
messages.[表面的中時]ダメージ量だけ体力を回復: [Heads Hit] Heal HP equal to damage dealt.
messages.血餐があると使用時に双方へ麻痺1。基本威力が高いスキル・E.G.Oを使い、コイン: With Bloodfeast, inflicts 1 Paralyze on both sides On Use. Choose high-Base-Power skills or E.G.O over single-Coin attacks relying on Coin Power. Prepare for the remaining Unbreakable hit too.
messages.[戦闘開始時]血餐を(45-現在の精神力)だけ消耗して精神力を45まで回復(この: [Combat Start] Consume Bloodfeast equal to (45 − current SP) to heal SP to 45. This damage cannot reduce HP below 1.
messages.-血餐が足りない場合、自分の体力を(45-現在の精神力)だけ消耗して精神力を45: - If Bloodfeast is insufficient, consume own HP equal to (45 − current SP) to heal SP to 45. This damage cannot reduce HP below 1.
messages.残った血餐だけバリア体力を得る(最大100): Gain Shield HP equal to remaining Bloodfeast (max 100).
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象へ出血10を付与: [Clash Win] Inflict 10 Bleed on the target.
messages.[攻撃後]ダメージ量だけ血餐が増加: [After Attack] Increase Bloodfeast by damage dealt.
messages.[的中時]対象の出血1につきダメージ量+10%(最大200%): [On Hit] Damage +10% per 1 Bleed on the target (max 200%).
messages.戦闘開始時に精神力45へ回復し、最大26の破壊不能攻撃を使う。勝てる高威力E.G: Restores SP to 45 at Combat Start, then uses an Unbreakable attack with a maximum of 26. Save high-Power E.G.O that can win. Unlike phase-transition attacks, it has no fixed 10 Speed or turn ending, allowing earlier Paralyze or focused follow-up damage.
messages.耳を傾けて聞いてしまった物語と胸の高鳴り: The Enthralling Tales, the Beating Passion
messages.80%,60%,40%になったとき、体力がそれ以上下がらずにパターンが変更\nパ: At 80%, 60%, and 40% HP, HP stops falling and the pattern changes. On the change, clear Stagger and set next turn's Speed to 10.
messages.境界でHPの減少が止まり、混乱も解除される。次ターン速度10の大技へ備え、境界に: HP loss stops at the boundary and Stagger is cleared. Prepare for next turn's big attack at 10 Speed; do not waste every strong attack on the boundary.
messages.戦闘開始時、夢心地の中のためらいを得る。\n戦闘開始時、戦場にまき散らされた伏在: At Combat Start, gain Dreamy Hesitation. Reveal latent blood scattered across the battlefield and gain 400 Bloodfeast.
messages.基礎Lv85のまま殴ってくる敵ではない。開始時のレベル低下と、戦闘中に硬血などで: She does not attack at unmodified base Lv.85. Distinguish initial level reductions from later Hardblood and other buffs.
messages.しかし父母様がいらっしゃって、家族がいて、目を背けられない: But I have my Father and my Family whom I cannot abandon
messages.ターン終了時、パニックならパニックを解除して血餐を100消耗し、攻撃威力増加3を: At Turn End, if Panicked, recover from Panic, consume 100 Bloodfeast, and gain 3 Attack Power Up. If unable to consume Bloodfeast, gain 30 Bleed, 3 Attack Power Up, and 2 Damage Up.
messages.パニック解除後に攻撃強化を得る。精神力を下げ続けるだけで長く無力化できるとは考え: Gains attack buffs after recovering from Panic. SP reduction alone cannot keep her disabled for long.
messages.この忌々しい病から逃れられるなら: If we can be freed from this excruciating sickness
messages.攻撃的中時、対象に出血があれば、与えた体力ダメージ量の40%だけの部位と本体の体:
On attack hit against a target with Bleed, heal overall and part HP by 40% of HP damage dealt. Own Bleed Potency adds 1% to this passive's healing per 1 Potency (max 20%). Does not activate on Unbreakable hits after losing a clash.
At Turn Start, heal own HP by Bloodfeast ÷ 10 (max 50). If at −15 SP or below, consume Bloodfeast equal to (20 − own SP) to recover SP and gain 2 Clash Power Up.
On defeating an enemy, gain 5 Hardblood.
messages.的中・ターン開始・囚人討伐: On Hit / Turn Start / Sinner kill
messages.開始時の精神力−15以下の回復に注意。マッチに勝てば、破壊不能の残存攻撃ではこの: Watch for Turn Start recovery at −15 SP or below. Winning prevents this passive's HP drain from remaining Unbreakable hits.
messages.私も冒険をしても良いのだろうか: Can I go on an adventure, too?
messages.ターン終了時、(体力最大値-現在の体力)10%につき、攻撃レベル増加1を得る(最: At Turn End, gain 1 Offense Level Up per 10% max HP lost (max 5). At Turn End, minimum and maximum Speed +1 next turn per 300 Bloodfeast.
messages.ターン終了時の失ったHP・血餐: HP lost and Bloodfeast at Turn End
messages.終盤は攻撃レベルと速度も変わる。開始時の数値だけで固定せず、現在の予測を確認する: Offense Level and Speed also change late in the fight. Check current predictions rather than relying on initial values.
messages.敵味方の出血ダメージが共通の血餐になる。出血を付けるだけで一方的に有利になるわけ: Enemy and allied Bleed damage feeds the shared Bloodfeast. Inflicting Bleed is not an entirely one-sided advantage.
messages.戦闘開始時、硬血を1得る\n-硬血が1未満に減少しない。\n-硬血が10以上なら:
At Combat Start, gain 1 Hardblood.
- Cannot fall below 1.
- At 10 or more, changes to Hardblood II.
- At 20 or more, changes to Hardblood III.
Minimum and maximum Speed increase by 1 per stage (max 2). Consumption below a threshold returns it to the previous stage.
messages.開始時と硬血の蓄積・消費: At the start / Hardblood accumulation and consumption
messages.硬血の段階が上がると速度や攻防が増す。マッチ予測と使用スキルの条件を見直す。: Higher Hardblood stages increase Speed and combat levels. Recheck clash predictions and skill conditions.
messages.パニックを変更する効果: Receives an effect that changes Panic Type
messages.パニックの種類の上書きはできない。マッチや弱体化・回復を組み合わせて対処する。: Panic Type cannot be replaced. Combine clashes, debuffs, and recovery to handle the fight.
messages.攻撃・防御レベル低下の開始時効果。表記は各35低下だが、資料脚注では防御は実際3: Initial Offense and Defense Level reduction. The description states −35 each, but the actual Defense reduction is 34.
messages.基礎Lv85と現在の攻撃・防御Lvを区別する。硬血による追加強化はさらに変動する: Distinguish base Lv.85 from current Offense and Defense Levels. Additional Hardblood buffs vary further.
messages.戦場で発生する出血ダメージを蓄積し、敵味方で共有する。サンチョは最初に400を得: Accumulates battlefield Bleed damage and is shared by both sides. Sancho starts with 400 and consumes it for recovery, Hardblood, and big attacks.
messages.味方への出血的中を減らす。血餐を消費できる味方も選択肢だが、特定の血鬼編成を必須: Reduce Bleed-inflicting hits on allies. Allies that consume Bloodfeast are an option, but a specific Bloodfiend team is not required.
messages.初期1、10以上でⅡ、20以上でⅢ。段階で速度が上がり、上位段階は数値に応じて攻: Starts at 1; reaches II at 10 or more and III at 20 or more. Stages increase Speed, and higher stages also increase Offense and Defense Levels based on value. Gained and consumed through skills.
messages.常に同じ威力ではない。使用時の硬血・本人の出血による強化も含めて担当を選ぶ。: Power is not constant. Include On Use bonuses from Hardblood and her own Bleed when assigning a clasher.
messages.boss-copy:sancho:mechanics.3.name: Shimmering【Bloodfiend】
messages.この効果がある間はバリアがターン終了で消えず、攻撃でダメージを与えた対象へ攻撃終: While active, Shield does not expire at Turn End. When a target damages the user with an attack, inflict 5 Bleed on that attacker at Attack End. Removed when its conditions are met, then grants 3 Fragile until the next phase change.
messages.殴る側にも出血が返る。バリアを割る火力と、攻撃後の出血ダメージを受けるHPを両方: Attackers receive Bleed too. Prepare both enough damage to break the Shield and enough HP to survive Bleed after attacking.
messages.マッチ勝利で破壊不能コインがすべて消えるわけではない。出血の的中効果と、勝利で抑: Winning does not remove every Unbreakable Coin. Distinguish On Hit Bleed from HP drain that winning can prevent.
messages.血甲のマッチ勝利時の混乱防止は、その技のダメージに対するもの。出血での死亡や他の: Winning against Hardblood prevents Stagger only from that skill's damage. It does not prevent death from Bleed or other damage.
messages.HP80%・60%・40%では段階移行が優先される。混乱の攻撃機会がそのまま次タ: Phase changes take priority at 80%, 60%, and 40% HP. Do not assume a Stagger opening will last unchanged into the next turn.
messages.段階移行の大技は攻撃後にターンを終える。サンチョより後の回復・追撃を頼りにしない: Phase-transition attacks end the turn After Attack. Do not rely on healing or follow-ups scheduled after Sancho. “La Aventura Ha Terminado” is the exception.
messages.7.5章のサンチョとは終了条件もスキル性能も異なる。このページは7章の回転木馬が: Ending conditions and skill performance differ from Canto VII.5 Sancho. This page covers the Canto VII carousel encounter.
messages.主力Lv50・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、高威力のマッチ担当とHP・精神力回復を用意。回: Aim for Lv.50 and Uptie III or higher, with high-Power clashers and HP and SP recovery. Secure healing resources before big attacks.
messages.ドンキホーテ以外の11囚人から主力と控えを選ぶ。控えを含めて戦力を用意し、序盤に: Choose main combatants and reserves from the 11 Sinners other than Don Quixote. Develop reserves too and avoid spending everyone's big skills in the opening.
messages.出血編成は血餐供給と敵自身の出血による強化にも注意。沈潜は開始時の精神力回復を踏: Bleed teams must account for Bloodfeast generation and bonuses from the enemy's own Bleed. Use Sinking with Turn Start SP recovery in mind; no single keyword guarantees victory.
messages.血甲や麻痺を伴うラ・サングレ、精神力45のテルミナードを止める。: Stop Hardblood, La Sangre with Paralyze, and “La Aventura Ha Terminado” at 45 SP.
messages.破壊不能による被弾と出血を受け切る。速度10の大技とターン終了に間に合うよう先に: Survive Unbreakable hits and Bleed. Act before big attacks at 10 Speed and their turn ending.
messages.段階移行を越えて本体とバリアを削り、消耗した主力から次へつなぐ。: Damage the main body and Shield across phase changes, replacing worn-down main combatants as needed.
messages.【リンバス】8-17 酔手夜客（8-17）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 8-17 Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm (8-17) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-17「酔手夜客（8-17）」の攻略。: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm (8-17) guide for Limbus Company 8-17. Clear the adds first and win against “Waterfall” to limit Swig. Hong Lu takes focused attacks, but his death does not immediately cause defeat here. Bring reserves to recover the fight.
messages.8-17 酔手夜客（8-17）: 8-17 Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm (8-17)
messages.酔手夜客の外見: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm appearance
messages.酔手夜客のスキル: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm skills
messages.Night Drifter of the Drunken Palmの外見: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm appearance
messages.Night Drifter of the Drunken Palmのスキル: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm skills
messages.酔手夜客（8-17）: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm (8-17)
messages.酔手夜客: Night Drifter of the Drunken Palm
messages.8-17の通常ストーリー。ホンル初期出撃必須、7名＋控え5名。首領の混乱欄は60: The regular 8-17 story encounter. Hong Lu must deploy initially; bring 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. The boss's Stagger entry lists both 60% and 588, which do not agree at 969 HP; neither is treated as a measured threshold. Two boss passives have footnotes restricting them to the Canto VIII dungeon; their uncertain applicability is retained in the responses.
messages.首領7技・取り巻き5技。取の破壊不能はひとくち3以上の条件付き。真鎮終斬は使用時: 7 boss skills and 5 add skills. “Drunklaim” gains Unbreakable Coins only at 3+ Swig. True Decapitation Deathblow gains further Offense Level and Power on use. Ordinary Counters and Clashable Counters are distinguished. The listed ending conditions are Hong Lu's death with the boss at 50% HP or lower, or another HP condition whose percentage is unspecified.
messages.推奨Lv53を目安に7名＋控え5名。ホンルのレンタル人格も使い、斬撃耐性・回避・: Aim for the recommended Level 53 with 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Consider a borrowed Hong Lu Identity, and bring Slash resistance, Evade, and healing.
messages.取り巻き3体を先に減らす。落酒に勝ってひとくちを3減らし、回復と破壊不能の強化を: Remove the 3 adds first. Win against “Waterfall” to consume 3 Swig, limiting healing and Unbreakable Coin upgrades.
messages.ホンルが倒れても続行できる。首領HP50%未満でターン終了・速度10の大技がある: The fight can continue if Hong Lu falls. Below 50% boss HP, the turn ends and a Speed 10 finisher follows; keep healing and powerful skills ready.
messages.ホンルに攻撃が集中して守り切れない: Hong Lu cannot survive the focused attacks
messages.取り巻き3体がホンルを優先する。回避や斬撃耐性、速い囚人の引き受けで守るが、倒れ: The 3 adds prioritize Hong Lu. Protect him with Evade, Slash resistance, and redirection by faster Sinners, but his death does not immediately end this fight. Bring reserves and avoid ruining the entire team by trying to intercept everything.
messages.勝っているのに首領のHPが戻る: The boss keeps healing despite winning clashes
messages.ひとくちは使用時にも増え、3以上で終了時にHP3%回復。落酒へのマッチ勝利で3消: Swig can increase on use and heals 3% HP at Turn End with 3+ stacks. Winning a clash against “Waterfall” consumes 3. Resolving it after other Swig-generating skills is effective.
messages.取に勝ったのに出血で倒れる: “Drunklaim” kills a Sinner with Bleed despite a clash win
messages.ひとくち3以上では全コインが破壊不能。出血が多い対象では威力も上がる。ひとくちを: At 3+ Swig, all its Coins become Unbreakable. It also gains Power against targets with substantial Bleed. Reduce Swig, or prepare resistance and healing beforehand to survive the remaining hits.
messages.混乱させたのにターンが終わった: The turn ended immediately after Staggering the boss
messages.HP50%未満で混乱を解除してターン終了、次ターンは速度10。後続の回復や追撃は: Below 50% HP, the boss recovers from Stagger and ends the turn, then has Speed 10 next turn. Later healing and follow-up attacks will not resolve; prepare before crossing the threshold.
messages.3〜5／HP境界の次ターン10: 3–5 / 10 on the turn after the HP threshold
messages.斬撃が有効。ひとくち3以上で回復、5で次ターンの攻撃強化と脆弱。: Weak to Slash. Heals at 3+ Swig; at 5, gains offensive buffs and Fragile next turn.
messages.HPが減るほど与ダメージが増える。50%未満の大技前に準備する。: Deals more damage as HP falls. Prepare before the finisher below 50% HP.
messages.ホンルを優先して攻撃する。斬撃で混乱させ、1体ずつ倒す。: Prioritize Hong Lu. Stagger them with Slash and defeat them one at a time.
messages.波斬り・馬出劫洗の2枚目は破壊不能。低HPでも放置しない。: The second Coins of “Waveslash” and “Becalming of a Bewildered Steed” are Unbreakable. Do not leave low-HP adds unattended.
messages.ホンルと控えを含めて戦力をそろえる: Prepare Hong Lu and a full reserve team
messages.推奨Lv53・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名と控え5名。ホンルは初期出撃必須で、この戦闘: Aim for the recommended Level 53 and Uptie III or higher, with 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Hong Lu must deploy initially; this fight also offers borrowed Identities with suitable levels and Uptie.
messages.斬撃耐性や回避を持つホンルを選び、HP・精神力の回復を用意する。火力は斬撃が通り: Choose a Hong Lu Identity with Slash resistance or Evade, and bring HP and SP recovery. Slash damage works well offensively.
messages.ホンル死亡で即敗北になる次の家主審査とは別の戦闘。ここでは倒れた後も控えで立て直: This is a separate encounter from the next family-head examination, where Hong Lu's death causes immediate defeat. Here, reserves can recover the fight after he falls.
messages.首領へ分散せず、取り巻きを減らす: Remove the adds before focusing the boss
messages.ホンルへ向く攻撃を確認し、回避・守備・速い引き受けで被害を抑える。出血の多い囚人: Check attacks targeting Hong Lu and limit damage with Evade, defense skills, and faster Sinners redirecting them. For Sinners with high Bleed, also check their remaining HP and how many Coins they will use.
messages.取り巻きは各HP207・斬撃1.5。1体へ集中し、混乱から倒し切って敵の手数を減: Each add has 207 HP and a 1.5 Slash resistance multiplier. Focus one at a time, Stagger it, and finish it to reduce enemy actions.
messages.首領が酔靠を構えたら、不必要に全員で本体を狙わない。狙っている人数によるひとくち: When the boss readies “Intoxicated Leaning”, avoid targeting it with everyone unnecessarily. Limit the Swig gained from the number of attackers, and spend actions on adds or defense instead.
messages.前旋斬・咽頭酒は使用時にひとくちを増やす。勝っても獲得は取り消せないため、その後: “Frontal Swirl” and “Way of the Open-throat Chugging” gain Swig on use. A clash win does not undo that gain; retain someone who can beat “Waterfall” afterward.
messages.落酒へ勝つと3消費。処理順を調整できる場合は獲得技の後に置き、終了時に3以上残さ: Winning against “Waterfall” consumes 3 Swig. If action order can be adjusted, resolve it after Swig-generating skills and aim to leave fewer than 3 stacks at Turn End.
messages.取はひとくち3以上で破壊不能化する。間に合わない場合は、勝った後の被弾も含めて耐: “Drunklaim” becomes Unbreakable at 3+ Swig. If it cannot be reduced in time, prepare resistance and HP for the hits that remain after a clash win.
messages.ターン終了と速度10を見越して備える: Prepare for the turn ending and Speed 10
messages.HP50%未満で混乱を解除し、ターンが終了する。境界を越える前に回復し、後ろの行: Below 50% HP, the boss clears Stagger and ends the turn. Heal before crossing the threshold; do not rely on later actions to recover.
messages.次ターンの真鎮終斬は速度10、使用時の強化も大きい。高威力E.G.Oや耐性のある: Next turn's True Decapitation Deathblow has Speed 10 and substantial on-use buffs. Prepare a powerful E.G.O or suitable defensive resistance, and check the current clash prediction.
messages.資料ではホンル死亡かつ首領HP50%以下なら終了、別のHP条件でも終了するとされ: The listed ending conditions include Hong Lu's death with the boss at 50% HP or lower, plus another HP condition with no specified percentage. If Hong Lu is alive, continue preparing for the finisher; crossing 50% does not necessarily end the encounter immediately.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が5以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Bleed, Base Power +1
messages.使用時にひとくち1。勝っても獲得自体は防げないが、出血5の的中を防ぐ。出血の多い: Gains 1 Swig on use. Winning does not prevent that gain, but prevents the hit that inflicts 5 Bleed. Base Power increases against targets with high Bleed.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血5につき、基本威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 5 Bleed on the target (max 2)
messages.使用時にひとくち1。出血回数を増やす2枚の的中を防ぎ、後の落酒へ勝つ担当を残す。: Gains 1 Swig on use. Stop both Bleed Count-increasing hits, and retain someone to beat “Waterfall” afterward.
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中]出血回数が3増加: [On Hit After Clash Win] Bleed Count +3
messages.こちらのマッチ勝利でひとくちを3消費させる重要な技。ほかの使用時獲得より後に処理: An important skill: winning against it consumes 3 Swig. Resolving it after other on-use Swig gains helps suppress Turn End healing and buffs.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血5につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Bleed on the target (max 2)
messages.[使用時]ひとくちが3以上なら、このスキルの全コインが破壊不能コインに変更される: [On Use] At 3+ Swig, all Coins of this skill become Unbreakable Coins
messages.Ⅲ対象の(出血+出血回数)1につきダメージ量+1%(最大20%): ⅢDeal +1% damage for every 1 (Bleed + Bleed Count) on the target (max 20%)
messages.[的中時]自分のひとくちが3以上なら、このコインを1回再使用(スキルごとに1回): [On Hit] At 3+ Swig on self, reuse this Coin once (once per skill)
messages.ひとくち3以上で3枚すべて破壊不能になり、最後のコインも再使用する。勝っても被弾: At 3+ Swig, all 3 Coins become Unbreakable and the last Coin is reused. Hits remain after a clash win; prepare Slash and Wrath resistance and sufficient HP, and check whether “Waterfall” can reduce Swig first.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル減少、防御レベル減少5を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict Offense Level Down and 5 Defense Level Down next turn
messages.マッチ可能な反撃。出血の多い対象で基本威力が上がる。勝って次ターンの麻痺4と攻防: A Clashable Counter. Base Power increases against targets with high Bleed. Win to prevent next turn's 4 Paralyze and Offense/Defense Level debuffs.
messages.[戦闘開始時]このスキルが終了するまで体力が0未満にならない: [Combat Start] HP cannot fall below 0 until this skill ends
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の(出血+出血回数)1につきダメージ量+1%(最大100%): Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal +1% damage for every 1 (Bleed + Bleed Count) on the target (max 100%)
messages.基本10+20に、使用時の攻撃レベル増加10・攻撃威力増加5が加わる。素の最大3: The base 10 + 20 also gains 10 Offense Level Up and 5 Attack Power Up on use. Do not choose a clash based only on its unmodified maximum of 30; prepare high-Base-Power E.G.O, healing beforehand, and resistance.
messages.[使用時]自分のひとくち1につきバリア5を得る(最大25): [On Use] Gain 5 Shield for every 1 Swig on self (max 25)
messages.[使用時]自分をターゲティングしている敵の数だけひとくちを得る: [On Use] Gain Swig equal to the number of enemies targeting self
messages.狙っている敵の人数だけひとくちを増やす守備。必要のない攻撃を本体へ集中させず、取: A defense skill that gains Swig for each enemy targeting the boss. Avoid unnecessary focused attacks on it; handle adds or defend instead. Offset it when possible to prevent its use altogether.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が8以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 8+ Bleed, Clash Power +1
messages.出血が多い対象では強くなる。勝てる通常技で止め、ホンルへの出血を減らす。: Stronger against high-Bleed targets. Stop it with a winning regular skill and limit Bleed on Hong Lu.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が5以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Bleed, Clash Power +1
messages.出血回数を増やす2枚技。HPが少ない・出血が多い囚人へ通さず、速い担当で引き受け: A 2-Coin skill that increases Bleed Count. Use a faster Sinner to redirect it away from low-HP or high-Bleed allies.
messages.対象の(出血+出血回数)1につきダメージ量+1%(最大20%): Deal +1% damage for every 1 (Bleed + Bleed Count) on the target (max 20%)
messages.4枚中2枚目が破壊不能。マッチに勝っても被弾は残る。出血でコインが強化されるため: The second of 4 Coins is Unbreakable, so a clash win still leaves a hit. Bleed also strengthens its Coins; choose the defender based on current statuses and resistance.
messages.効[使用時]対象の出血5につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Bleed on the target (max 3)
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血5を付与、出血回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 3
messages.対象の(出血+出血回数)2につきダメージ量+1%(最大50%): Deal +1% damage for every 2 (Bleed + Bleed Count) on the target (max 50%)
messages.2枚目が破壊不能で、対象の出血による強化も大きい。先に混乱させるか、強い担当で勝: The second Coin is Unbreakable, with substantial bonuses from the target's Bleed. Stagger the user first, or win with a strong skill and survive the remaining hit through resistance and healing.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃レベル減少、防御レベル減少3を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict Offense Level Down and 3 Defense Level Down next turn
messages.こちらは通常の反撃。弱い攻撃で触ると出血と次ターンの束縛・攻防低下を受ける。倒し: An ordinary Counter. Weak attacks into it invite Bleed and next-turn Bind and offensive/defensive debuffs. Commit enough damage to finish the enemy; avoid careless attacks by low-HP Sinners.
messages.こりゃこりゃ…ひっく、これはいかん: Well, well... Hic. This won't do
messages.自分の体力が50%を切ったとき、混乱状態を解除してこのターンを終了する。\n次の:
When HP falls below 50%, recover from Stagger and end the turn.
Speed is fixed at 10 next turn.
messages.混乱が解除されターンが終了し、次ターンは速度10。後ろに置いた回復や追撃が使える: Stagger clears, the turn ends, and next turn's Speed is 10. Do not assume later healing or follow-up attacks will resolve.
messages.次のターンまでパニックのままにできるとは考えず、予測を見直す。: Recheck predictions rather than assuming the enemy remains Panicked next turn.
messages.パニック上書きに頼らず、勝てるマッチとHP回復を使う。: Use winning clashes and HP recovery rather than relying on replacing its Panic type.
messages.ホンルへの優先指定（首領は資料脚注の適用範囲に注意）: Priority targeting of Hong Lu (check the boss passive's stated scope)
messages.取り巻きの攻撃がホンルへ集中する。首領側の同名パッシブには資料脚注で8章ダンジョ: The adds focus Hong Lu. The boss's same-named passive has a footnote restricting it to the Canto VIII dungeon; check the actual targeting lines in 8-17.
messages.戦闘中にダメージを受けたとき、そのターンの間与ダメージ量+20%\n戦闘中にマッ:
When taking damage during combat, deal +20% damage for the rest of the turn.
On Clash Lose during combat, take +15% damage from that skill.
messages.殴った敵はそのターンの与ダメージが増える。先行する攻撃で混乱まで届くかを確認し、: An enemy hit earlier deals more damage that turn. Check whether an early attack can Stagger it, and avoid spreading damage without a purpose.
messages.自分の失った体力1%につき、与ダメージ量+2%(最大100%): Deal +2% damage for every 1% HP lost (max 100%)
messages.削るほど与ダメージが増える。取り巻きを減らしてから首領へ火力を集中する。: Its damage rises as HP falls. Clear the adds before concentrating damage on the boss.
messages.自分の体力が70％以上のとき、ターン終了時にホンルにスキルが的中しなければ、次の:
At Turn End, if at 70%+ HP and no skill hit Hong Lu, gain 3 Offense Level Down next turn.
At Turn End, if below 70% HP and no skill hit Hong Lu, gain 6 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.資料脚注：8章ダンジョンのみ。8-17の適用は要確認: Source footnote: Canto VIII dungeon only; applicability to 8-17 unconfirmed
messages.HP70%とホンルへの的中で次ターンの攻撃Lvが変わる効果。8-17での適用を固: Next-turn Offense Level changes based on 70% HP and whether Hong Lu was hit. Do not assume it applies when calculating 8-17 clashes; check actual buff displays.
messages.戦闘中にダメージを受けたとき、そのターンの間与ダメージ量+10%\n戦闘中にマッ:
When taking damage during combat, deal +10% damage for the rest of the turn.
On Clash Lose during combat, take +20% damage from that skill.
messages.自分の失った体力1%につき、与ダメージ量+0.5%(最大50%): Deal +0.5% damage for every 1% HP lost (max 50%)
messages.低HPになると与ダメージが増える。混乱後に倒し切り、複数を中途半端に残さない。: Damage rises at low HP. Finish adds after Staggering them rather than leaving several partly damaged.
messages.自分の体力が70％以上のとき、ターン終了時にホンルにスキルが的中しなければ、次の:
At Turn End, if at 70%+ HP and no skill hit Hong Lu, gain 1 Attack Power Down next turn.
At Turn End, if below 70% HP and no skill hit Hong Lu, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
- Inflict +1 Bleed and Bleed Count next turn.
messages.HP70%・そのターンのホンルへの的中: 70% HP / hitting Hong Lu that turn
messages.HP70%未満では攻撃威力と出血付与が強化され得る。ホンルを守れば常に敵が弱まる: Below 70% HP, Attack Power and Bleed application can increase. Protecting Hong Lu does not always weaken the enemy.
messages.最大5。3以上ならターン終了にHP3%回復、5以上なら次ターンに攻撃威力増加3・: Max 5. At 3+, heal 3% HP at Turn End; at 5+, gain 3 Attack Power Up and 2 Fragile next turn. Losing a clash with “Waterfall” consumes 3.
messages.使用時の獲得をマッチ勝利で消せると考えず、落酒への勝利と処理順で減らす。: Clash wins do not cancel on-use gains; reduce stacks through “Waterfall” and action order.
messages.ホンルは必須だが、この戦闘では倒れても即敗北ではない。8-20の条件と混同しない: Hong Lu is required, but his death does not immediately cause defeat in this encounter. Do not confuse this with 8-20.
messages.ひとくち3以上の取はマッチ勝利後も被弾が残る。: At 3+ Swig, “Drunklaim” still hits after a clash win.
messages.HP50%未満でターン終了。後続の回復は使えないことがある。: The turn ends below 50% HP. Later healing may not resolve.
messages.首領の2パッシブの適用範囲と、ホンル生存時の別の終了HP割合は資料が明確でない。: The scope of 2 boss passives and the alternative ending HP percentage while Hong Lu lives are unclear in the source. Check actual statuses and targeting lines.
messages.Lv53を目安に7名＋控え5名。斬撃耐性・回避・HPと精神力の回復を用意する。: Aim for Level 53 with 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Bring Slash resistance, Evade, and HP/SP recovery.
messages.斬撃火力で取り巻きを減らし、首領の大技へ高威力技を残す。: Use Slash damage to remove adds and retain powerful skills for the boss's finisher.
messages.集中攻撃を抑え、取り巻きを倒す時間を作る。: Limit focused damage and buy time to remove the adds.
messages.各HP207の取り巻きを先に減らし、敵の手数を落とす。: Remove the 207-HP adds first to reduce enemy actions.
messages.ひとくちの蓄積を抑え、速度10の攻撃へ備える。: Limit Swig buildup and prepare for the Speed 10 attack.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-20「ジア・チォウ（8-20）」の攻: Jia Qiu (8-20) guide for Limbus Company 8-20. Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on Zilu. In the second half, win 3 Dialogues with Hong Lu himself to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.
messages.8-20「Second Hierarch Trial: What Hongyua: 8-20 · Second Hierarch Trial: What Hongyuan Needs Most
messages.ホンルを最後まで生かし、ズールゥへの無用な攻撃を避ける。後半はホンル本人で問答を: Keep Hong Lu alive throughout and avoid unnecessary attacks on Zilu. In the second half, win 3 Dialogues with Hong Lu himself to stop the Shield, then beat the finisher to create an opening.
messages.8-20ダンジョン最終戦。ホンル必須、死亡時は前座を含め即敗北。チォウは一抹の期: The final 8-20 dungeon encounter. Hong Lu is required; his death causes immediate defeat, including during the opening wave. Displayed Offense/Defense Levels account for 35 A Sliver of Anticipation on Qiu, 20 Bloodthirst Suppressed on Zilu, and 5 Concealed Bloodthirst on the Heishou. First- and second-half HP values are 2439 and 3403 respectively; both phases progress at half HP.
messages.34技を使用者・形態別に掲載。天罡星 - 格の表示は問答によるコイン低下前で、問: 34 skills listed by user and form. Tiangang Star - Form displays values before the Dialogues Coin Power reduction; with 3 Dialogues, its maximum is 13. The first-half “I Must Push You Further” has no confirmed Offense Level; the repeated Unbreakable Coin I label is provisionally treated as II. Dialogues appears as Uncompromising Imposition for Hong Lu's Lord Identity.
messages.ホンル死亡で即敗北。7名＋控え5名でHP・精神力回復と、ホンルの高威力技を用意す: Hong Lu's death causes immediate defeat. Bring 7 Sinners and 5 reserves, HP/SP recovery, and powerful skills for Hong Lu.
messages.ズールゥをHP85%以下へ削らない。援護防御があるターンは、チォウへの弱い一方攻: Do not reduce Zilu to 85% HP or lower. Avoid weak one-sided attacks on Qiu while Assist Defense is active.
messages.後半はホンルで答えろ、ジア・バオユに3回勝つ。その後の全体攻撃と一騎打ちへ、先に: In the second half, Hong Lu must win 3 clashes against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu”. Heal beforehand for the following mass attack and duel.
messages.ホンルが倒れると即敗北する。8-17のように犠牲にして続けられない。問答に必要な: Hong Lu's death immediately ends the fight. Unlike 8-17, sacrificing him does not allow the fight to continue. Prioritize his HP and the resources he needs for Dialogues.
messages.瞬歩を使うターンは援護防御がある。チォウへの一方攻撃が横取りされ、2以上なら破壊: Assist Defense is active on turns with Blinkstep. It intercepts one-sided attacks on Qiu; at 2+, it becomes a powerful Unbreakable Counter. Avoid weak follow-ups and prioritize regular clashes.
messages.後半のバリアが毎ターン戻る: The second-half Shield returns every turn
messages.ホンルで答えろ、ジア・バオユへマッチ勝利し、問答を3まで進める。バリアは900→: Have Hong Lu win against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” to reach 3 Dialogues. The Shield falls from 900 to 600 to 300 to none; there is no need to keep breaking it through raw damage alone.
messages.問答3なのにホンル以外が動けなくなった: At 3 Dialogues, everyone except Hong Lu stopped acting
messages.予定された全体攻撃で、次ターンはホンルとの一騎打ち。天罡星 - 格へ本人が勝つと: This is the scheduled mass attack, followed next turn by a duel with Hong Lu. If he wins against Tiangang Star - Form, the enemy loses 24 Defense Level. Heal everyone and prepare Hong Lu's strong skills beforehand.
messages.HP50%で即ターン終了し、後半へ移る。前半の混乱区間より先に移行する。: At 50% HP, immediately ends the turn and enters the second half, before reaching the first-half Stagger threshold.
messages.一抹の期待による攻防低下を表示へ反映。基礎Lv90のまま戦う敵ではない。: Displayed levels include A Sliver of Anticipation's reductions. This is not a fight against an unmodified Level 90 enemy.
messages.HP85%以下で強化、60%以下で開始時バリア500と死亡防止。討伐を目標にしな: Strengthens at 85% HP or lower. At 60% or lower, gains 500 Shield at Turn Start and death prevention. Defeating him is not the objective.
messages.チォウの前半終了で撤退。後半は一時的に再出現する。: Withdraws when Qiu's first half ends. Reappears temporarily in the second half.
messages.3〜5／問答後の全体攻撃10: 3–5 / 10 for the mass attack after Dialogues
messages.移行時にHP全快・精神力30。毎ターンのバリアは問答で減る。: Restores full HP and reaches 30 SP on transition. Dialogues reduces the Shield gained each turn.
messages.後半もHP半分まで削ると終了。0まで削る前提で資源配分しない。: The second half also ends at half HP. Do not budget resources around reducing him to 0.
messages.前座では2体。暗撃2体と合わせて精神力・資源を整える。: 2 appear in the opening wave. Build SP and resources against them and the 2 Umbrastrikers.
messages.後半に召喚される黒獣は1ターンで撤退。前座と同じ討伐目標にしない。: Heishou summoned in the second half withdraw after 1 turn. They are not elimination targets like the opening wave.
messages.前座では2体。斬撃は通りにくく、打撃が有効。: 2 appear in the opening wave. Resist Slash; weak to Blunt.
messages.ホンルを守り、勝てるマッチで精神力を上げる。: Protect Hong Lu and raise SP through winning clashes.
messages.ホンルと回復を軸に7名＋控え5名: 7 Sinners and 5 reserves, centered on Hong Lu and healing
messages.Lv55・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に育成し、ホンルの強いスキルや虚幻境を使える資源を確保: Aim for Level 55 and Uptie III or higher. Stock resources for Hong Lu's strong skills and Land of Illusion. His death causes immediate defeat.
messages.ダンジョンの回復地点と資源持ち越しを使い、前座で全ての大技を使い切らない。前座へ: Use dungeon healing points and carried-over resources; do not exhaust every powerful skill in the opening wave. Blunt works well against the opening enemies; Gluttony, Lust, and Pride work well against Qiu.
messages.ホンルの専用支援で全スキル最終威力+1、マッチ勝利で低精神力の味方を回復できる。: Hong Lu's exclusive support grants +1 Final Power to all skills and lets clash wins heal low-SP allies' SP. His Lord Identity uses different names for the support and Dialogues effects.
messages.打撃で減らし、精神力を整える: Use Blunt damage and build SP
messages.快撃2体・暗撃2体が相手。勝てる通常技を当て、ホンルを含む全員の精神力を上げる。: Face 2 Featherstrikers and 2 Umbrastrikers. Win clashes with regular skills to raise everyone's SP, including Hong Lu's.
messages.打撃火力を1体ずつ集中して混乱・撃破し、前座での消耗を抑える。後半の問答用E.G: Focus Blunt damage on one enemy at a time to Stagger and defeat it, limiting opening-wave attrition. Save E.G.O resources for the later Dialogues and healing.
messages.ズールゥを削らず、チォウへマッチで攻める: Clash against Qiu and avoid damaging Zilu
messages.チォウのHP50%までを目標にする。ズールゥは倒せず、HP85%以下へ削ると両者: Aim to reduce Qiu to 50% HP. Zilu cannot be killed, and reducing him to 85% HP or lower strengthens both enemies. Watch for accidental damage from area attacks.
messages.ズールゥへは必要なマッチに勝ち、見極めるで束縛を得させる。無用な追撃を集めず、チ: Win necessary clashes against Zilu so Estimation gives him Bind. Avoid unnecessary follow-ups; spend actions reducing Qiu's HP.
messages.瞬歩があるターンは援護防御を確認。チォウへ弱い一方攻撃を置くと横取りされる。特に: Check Assist Defense on turns with Blinkstep. Weak one-sided attacks on Qiu are intercepted. At 2+ Assist Defense, this becomes a strong Unbreakable Counter; using fewer attacks and more defense or healing is reasonable.
messages.HP50%で即ターン終了。境界を越す前に回復し、次の後半を迎える。: At 50% HP, the turn ends immediately. Heal before crossing the threshold to prepare for the second half.
messages.ホンル本人で答えろ、ジア・バオユへ3回勝つ: Hong Lu must win against “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” 3 times
messages.チォウはHP3403・精神力30へ戻り、最初は毎ターンバリア900。まず回復・マ: Qiu returns with 3403 HP and 30 SP, initially gaining 900 Shield every turn. Survive through healing and clashes while progressing Dialogues.
messages.後半の2ターン目から、黒獣が一時出現するターンに答えろ、ジア・バオユが来る。対象: From the second turn of this half, “Answer Me, Jia Baoyu” appears on turns when Heishou temporarily join. It cannot be redirected; Hong Lu must win the clash with his own powerful skill.
messages.勝つたび問答1。3回で以後のバリアがなくなる。君主ホンルは貫徹の名称で表示される: Each win grants 1 Dialogues. After 3 wins, future Shield gains stop. Hong Lu's Lord Identity displays this as Uncompromising Imposition; check the number on Hong Lu himself.
messages.再出現した黒獣は1ターンで撤退するので、討伐に火力を浪費しない。ズールゥの援護防: The returning Heishou withdraw after 1 turn; do not waste damage trying to kill them. Prioritize Zilu's Assist Defense and Hong Lu's Dialogue clash.
messages.全体攻撃の前に回復し、ホンルで一騎打ちへ勝つ: Heal before the mass attack, then win Hong Lu's duel
messages.次のターンは速度10のマッチ不可・対象変更不可攻撃。ホンル以外へ向かうため守備を: Next turn brings a Speed 10 Unclashable, unredirectable attack. It targets everyone except Hong Lu; equip defense skills and prepare for the turn to end after the attack.
messages.その次はホンルとの天罡星 - 格。問答3ならコイン威力が2まで下がり、最大13。: The following turn brings Tiangang Star - Form against Hong Lu. At 3 Dialogues, Coin Power drops to 2 and its maximum becomes 13. Use his strong skills or E.G.O for a reliable win.
messages.勝つと敵の防御Lv−24、ダメージ半減となり、その攻撃では混乱しなくなる。4枚の: Winning inflicts 24 Defense Level Down on the enemy and halves its damage; that attack cannot Stagger its targets. With 4 Unbreakable Coins and 7 Attack Weight, heal secondary targets beforehand too, and defend against the remaining hits.
messages.バリアがなく防御も下がった本体へ攻撃をまとめ、後半HP50%まで削る。: Focus the boss once its Shield is gone and Defense Level is reduced, bringing its second-half HP down to 50%.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂が5以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Rupture, Coin Power +1
messages.破裂5以上の対象にはコイン威力+1。勝って回数の追加を防ぎ、破裂の多い囚人へ攻撃: Gains +1 Coin Power against targets with 5+ Rupture. Win to prevent additional Count, and avoid concentrating attacks on Sinners with high Rupture.
messages.破裂を増やす1枚技。使用者の攻撃Lv低下を反映した今の予測で、勝てる通常技を合わ: A single-Coin skill that adds Rupture. Use a winning regular skill based on the current prediction, including the user's Offense Level reduction.
messages.非礼勿動: Act Not With Impropriety (非禮勿動)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂4につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 4 Rupture on the target (max 2)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂回数2につき、マッチ威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Clash Power +1 for every 2 Rupture Count on the target (max 3)
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中時]次のターンに束縛1を付与: [On Hit After Clash Win] Inflict 1 Bind next turn
messages.2枚目は破壊不能で呪殺【勿動】を付ける。破裂威力・回数の多い対象では強くなるため: The second Coin is Unbreakable and inflicts Deathrite 【Halt】. High Rupture Potency and Count strengthen it; choose someone who can survive the remaining hit after winning.
messages.このスキルを使用できなければ、次のターンに束縛1を得る: If this skill is not used, gain 1 Bind next turn
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂2につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 2 Rupture on the target (max 3)
messages.対象の破裂で回避威力が上がる。相殺するか、指定された囚人から攻撃を向けず不発にす: Evade Power increases with the target's Rupture. Offset it, or prevent its activation by not attacking with the targeted Sinner. If unused, the enemy gains 1 Bind next turn.
messages.呪殺【即減】を付ける。破裂の多い対象で強くなるので、勝てる担当へ引き取って的中を: Inflicts Deathrite 【Wane】. Stronger against high-Rupture targets; redirect to someone who can win and prevent the hit.
messages.2枚目は破壊不能で呪殺【掣肘】が残り得る。使用時の精神力10回復も予測に含め、ま: The second Coin is Unbreakable and may leave Deathrite 【Impede】 after a win. Account for the on-use 10 SP recovery, and avoid spreading new Deathrites to damage dealers who lack them.
messages.[マッチ勝利時]破裂2を付与、破裂回数が2増加: [On Clash Win] Inflict 2 Rupture and increase Rupture Count by 2
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]破裂回数が4増加: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Rupture Count +4
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]破裂3を付与: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Rupture
messages.対象の(破裂威力+破裂回数)1につきダメージ量+5%(最大20%): Deal +5% damage for every 1 (Rupture Potency + Rupture Count) on the target (max 20%)
messages.[的中時]対象の全呪殺を0にする: [On Hit] Set all Deathrites on the target to 0
messages.資料はⅠの番号が重複。2つ目をⅡとして整理している（番号の誤記と推定）。: The source repeats Coin I. The second instance is provisionally labeled II as an apparent numbering error.
messages.4枚の破壊不能攻撃。資料はⅠが重複しており2つ目をⅡと推定して整理。破裂が多いほ: An attack with 4 Unbreakable Coins. The source repeats Coin I; the second instance is provisionally treated as II. Rupture strengthens it, and its Offense Level is unconfirmed, so the displayed maximum of 25 alone does not establish safety.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.7.name: Do Not Meddle
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂回数4につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 4 Rupture Count on the target (max 3)
messages.マッチ可能反撃。破裂回数でコインが強化される。勝てる担当で処理し、弱い一方攻撃を: A Clashable Counter strengthened by Rupture Count. Handle it with a winning skill; do not trigger it first with a weak one-sided attack.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂が5以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Rupture, Clash Power +1
messages.破裂が多い対象へは強化。勝って的中を防ぐが、ズールゥを削る目的で追撃を集める必要: Stronger against high-Rupture targets. Win to prevent hits, but there is no need to pile on follow-ups to damage Zilu.
messages.[的中時]対象に呪殺【迅速】があれば、次のターンにクイック1を得る: [On Hit] If the target has Deathrite【Haste】, gain 1 Haste next turn
messages.使用時に脚力【卯】を得て次ターンの速度へつながる。マッチに勝つと見極めるの束縛も: Gains Strider【Mao】 on use for next-turn Speed. Winning clashes also makes Estimation inflict Bind on him, helping control his Speed.
messages.呪殺【迅速】を付ける技。次の瞬歩の優先対象と強化につながるため、できるだけ的中を: Inflicts Deathrite【Haste】, enabling the next Blinkstep's targeting priority and bonuses. Prevent the hit when possible.
messages.自分と対象の速度差2につきダメージ量+15%(最大60%): Deal +15% damage for every 2 Speed difference between self and target (max 60%)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂5につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Rupture on the target (max 2)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂回数2につき、基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Base Power +1 for every 2 Rupture Count on the target (max 3)
messages.[的中時]対象に呪殺【迅速】があれば、ダメージ量+50%: [On Hit] If the target has Deathrite【Haste】, deal +50% damage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]このコインを1回再使用(スキルごとに最大1回): [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Reuse this Coin once (max once per skill)
messages.3枚すべて破壊不能。勝っても破裂は増える。開始時に援護防御1を得るターンなので、: All 3 Coins are Unbreakable, so Rupture increases even after a clash win. This turn also grants 1 Assist Defense at Combat Start; avoid weak one-sided attacks on Qiu and prioritize strong clashes and healing.
messages.[使用時]自分の速度が対象よりも3以上高ければ、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If self is at least 3 Speed faster than the target, Clash Power +1
messages.[使用時]対象に呪殺【迅速】があるなら、このスキルで付与する破裂回数が1追加で増: [On Use] If the target has Deathrite【Haste】, inflict +1 Rupture Count with this skill
messages.マッチ可能反撃。速度差と呪殺【迅速】で強化される。勝てる技で処理し、破裂回数を増: A Clashable Counter strengthened by Speed difference and Deathrite【Haste】. Win with a suitable skill to prevent extra Rupture Count.
messages.自分と対象の速度差2につきダメージ量+20%(最大60%): Deal +20% damage for every 2 Speed difference between self and target (max 60%)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂5につき、コイン威力+1: [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 5 Rupture on the target
messages.3枚破壊不能で呪殺【破】を付ける。破裂と速度差で強くなるので、状態の少ない担当と: 3 Unbreakable Coins inflict Deathrite 【Fissure】. Rupture and Speed difference strengthen it; choose a Sinner with fewer statuses and prepare healing.
messages.[使用前]援護防御が2以上なら、黒獣 卯 奥義 - 雲海顕現として発動: [Before Use] At 2+ Assist Defense, activate as “Ascendant Heishou - Mao Technique: Cloudsplitting Manifestation”
messages.[使用時]自分がこの戦闘にて失った累計体力5%につき、このスキルの防御レベルが増: [On Use] This skill's Defense Level increases for every 5% cumulative HP lost in this encounter (max 10)
messages.[使用時]このスキルが終了するまでダメージによって混乱状態にならない: [On Use] Cannot be Staggered by damage until this skill ends
messages.援護防御1で発動するマッチ可能ガード。チォウへの一方攻撃が横取りされる。弱い技で: A Clashable Guard activated at 1 Assist Defense. Intercepts one-sided attacks on Qiu. Avoid accidentally triggering it with weak skills; prioritize clashes against Qiu.
messages.黒獣 卯 奥義 - 雲海顕現: Ascendant Heishou - Mao Technique: Cloudsplitting Manifestation
messages.(《超速護衛》から当スキルの効果で変化する。): (Transforms from “Swiftfeet Protection” through that skill's effect.)
messages.援護防御2以上で変わる破壊不能の反撃。瞬歩が2本あるターンは特に危険。チォウへの: An Unbreakable Counter replacing the Guard at 2+ Assist Defense. Especially dangerous on turns with 2 Blinksteps. Do not trigger it with weak one-sided attacks on Qiu.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.16.name: I Ask Again
messages.1枚が破壊不能。破裂付与は勝っても残るため、低HPの囚人を守りながら問答を待つ。: Its single Coin is Unbreakable, so Rupture can remain after a win. Protect low-HP Sinners while waiting for Dialogues.
messages.呪殺【勿動】の追加を防ぐ。破裂5以上で強化されるので、現在の状態込みの予測で担当: Prevent additional Deathrite 【Halt】. Strengthened at 5+ Rupture; assign the clash using predictions that include current statuses.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.18.name: You Will Not Meddle
messages.呪殺【掣肘】の追加を防ぐ。まだ呪殺のない主力へ分散させず、勝てるマッチを取る。: Prevent additional Deathrite 【Impede】. Win the clash rather than spreading it to damage dealers who do not yet have Deathrites.
messages.保有している呪殺の種類が1番多い対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritizes the target with the most distinct Deathrite types
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの破裂2につき、コイン威力+1(最大4): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for every 2 Rupture on the main target (max 4)
messages.[的中時]呪殺が2種類以上ある対象なら、呪殺【即滅】を付与: [On Hit] If the target has 2+ Deathrite types, inflict Deathrite【Extinguish】
messages.加重値3で、破裂威力に応じてコインが強化される。呪殺の多い対象が優先されるため、: 3 Attack Weight, with Coins strengthened by Rupture Potency. Prioritizes targets with more Deathrites; check secondary targets' HP and healing too.
messages.4枚すべて破壊不能。勝っても呪殺【迅速】や破裂が残り得る。事前回復を済ませ、次の: All 4 Coins are Unbreakable, so Deathrite【Haste】 and Rupture may remain after winning. Heal beforehand and rotate clash handlers according to their statuses.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.21.name: Heed Me, Zilu
messages.4枚すべて破壊不能で、最後に呪殺【破】。使用時の精神力回復を考慮し、被弾後の破裂: All 4 Coins are Unbreakable, with Deathrite 【Fissure】 on the last. Account for on-use SP recovery and Rupture damage after the hits.
messages.呪殺の種類を1番多く保有している対象を優先して攻撃: Prioritizes the target with the most Deathrite types
messages.[使用時]対象の呪殺の種類1につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Coin Power +1 for each Deathrite type on the target (max 3)
messages.対象の(破裂威力+破裂回数+保有する呪殺の種類)1につきダメージ量+5%(最大2: Deal +5% damage for every 1 (Rupture Potency + Rupture Count + number of Deathrite types) on the target (max 200%)
messages.対象変更不可。呪殺が最も多い本人の強い技を合わせる。破裂と呪殺による被害が大きく: Cannot be redirected. The Sinner with the most Deathrites needs a strong skill. Rupture and Deathrites make it dangerous; 1 Coin remains after winning, so heal beforehand.
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象がホンルなら、問答1を付与: [On Clash Lose] If the target is Hong Lu, inflict 1 Dialogues
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]破裂2を付与: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Rupture
messages.ホンル本人でマッチ勝利すると問答1。ほかの囚人では代われない。虚幻境など余裕を持: Hong Lu gains 1 Dialogues by personally winning the clash; another Sinner cannot substitute. Prepare Land of Illusion or another skill that wins comfortably, and succeed 3 times.
messages.対象の問答1につき、コイン威力-2: Coin Power -2 for every 1 Dialogues on the target
messages.[マッチ敗北]この攻撃で混乱状態にならない。この戦闘の間、防御レベル減少24を得: [On Clash Lose] This attack cannot Stagger targets. Gain 24 Defense Level Down for the rest of the encounter
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の(破裂威力+破裂回数+保有している呪殺の数)1につき: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Deal +5% damage for every 1 (Rupture Potency + Rupture Count + number of Deathrites) on the target (max 100%)
messages.問答3ならコイン威力が8−6＝2になり、基礎の表示最大37から実際の条件下では最: At 3 Dialogues, Coin Power becomes 8 − 6 = 2, reducing the base displayed maximum of 37 to 13 under those conditions. If Hong Lu wins, the enemy loses 24 Defense Level and deals half damage. Prepare everyone for 4 Unbreakable Coins and 7 Attack Weight.
messages.このスキルはホンルを除く人員を攻撃する: This skill attacks everyone except Hong Lu
messages.次のターンに、ホンルを除く他の人格たちを黒獣-卯を利用して混乱状態にする、自分の: Next turn, use Heishou - Mao to Stagger the other Identities except Hong Lu, and recover from Stagger
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可でホンル以外を狙い、攻撃後ターン終了。回避や防御で被害を: Unclashable and unredirectable; targets everyone except Hong Lu and ends the turn afterward. Limit damage with Evade or Guard and prepare Hong Lu to win next turn's finisher alone.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂が3以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 3+ Rupture, Clash Power +1
messages.前半Waveで精神力を整える相手。勝てる通常技で止め、打撃を集中して1体ずつ倒す: An opening-wave enemy for building SP. Stop its attacks with winning regular skills and focus Blunt damage to defeat enemies one at a time.
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂が4以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Rupture, Base Power +1
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]自分の(速度÷3)だけ、このコインを再使用する(最大2回): [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Reuse this Coin (self Speed ÷ 3) times (max 2)
messages.破裂回数を増やす。勝って後続の破裂被害を防ぎ、ホンルのHPを守る。: Increases Rupture Count. Win to prevent later Rupture damage and protect Hong Lu's HP.
messages.自分の速度が、対象より高いほどコイン威力+1(速度差2につきコイン威力+1,最大: Coin Power +1 for every 2 Speed faster than the target (max 3)
messages.[使用時]対象の破裂が4以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Rupture, Coin Power +1
messages.対象に呪殺【迅速】があれば、ダメージ量+50%: If the target has Deathrite【Haste】, deal +50% damage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]脚力【卯】3を得る: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Gain 3 Strider【Mao】
messages.[マッチ勝利後的中時]このコインを1回再使用(スキルごとに最大1回): [On Hit After Clash Win] Reuse this Coin once (max once per skill)
messages.3枚攻撃で破裂や呪殺を付ける。速度差による強化も見て、強い担当で止める。: A 3-Coin attack that inflicts Rupture and Deathrites. Account for Speed-difference bonuses and stop it with a strong clash handler.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.29.name: Windup
messages.守備を使う相手より、倒せる個体へ火力を集中する。後半に1ターンだけ出る場合は無理: Focus damage on enemies that can be killed rather than those using defense skills. When summoned for only 1 turn in the second half, there is no need to kill them.
messages.破裂の少ない担当で勝ち、ホンルへ的中を通さない。打撃火力をまとめて倒す。: Win with a low-Rupture Sinner and prevent hits on Hong Lu. Focus Blunt damage to finish the enemy.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.31.name: Overwhelm
messages.破裂を増やす2枚技。次の強化条件を作らせないよう、勝てる通常技を合わせる。: A 2-Coin skill that adds Rupture. Use a winning regular skill to prevent it from enabling further bonuses.
messages.多コインの攻撃。速度差や対象の破裂で強くなるため、弱い担当に無理なマッチをさせな: A multi-Coin attack strengthened by Speed difference and the target's Rupture. Avoid forcing weak Sinners into losing clashes.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:skills.33.name: Windup
messages.守備へ無駄に手数を割かず、前半は倒せる個体を優先。後半の一時召喚は危険な攻撃を止: Avoid wasting actions on defense skills; prioritize killable enemies in the opening wave. For temporary second-half summons, stopping dangerous attacks is enough.
messages.最初のターン開始時、精神力を30回復して一抹の期待を得る: At the start of the first turn, heal 30 SP and gain A Sliver of Anticipation
messages.一抹の期待で攻撃・防御Lvが35下がる。表は反映済みで、基礎Lv90だけから必要: A Sliver of Anticipation reduces Offense and Defense Levels by 35. The table already includes this; do not assess required leveling from base Level 90 alone.
messages.その道の果てはここまでか: This is where your path ends
messages.ホンル死亡時、戦闘終了: When Hong Lu dies, end the encounter
messages.即座に敗北する。8-17と違い、ホンルを犠牲にした立て直しはできない。: Causes immediate defeat. Unlike 8-17, sacrificing Hong Lu cannot be used to recover the fight.
messages.攻撃終了時、対象の呪殺の数1つにつき精神力を5回復\n的中時、対象の呪殺が発動し:
After attacking, heal 5 SP for each Deathrite on the target.
On Hit, if Deathrites on the target activated, heal 3 SP for each activated Deathrite.
messages.敵の精神力が回復する。呪殺を全員へ広げず、勝てる担当と回復を確保する。: Restores the enemy's SP. Avoid spreading Deathrites across the whole team; maintain winning clash handlers and healing.
messages.パニック上書きを主軸にせず、マッチと問答・回復で進める。: Progress through clashes, Dialogues, and healing rather than relying on changing its Panic type.
messages.対象のマイナス効果が4以上なら、マッチ威力+1: If the target has 4+ negative effects, Clash Power +1
messages.弱体化が重なる囚人にはマッチ威力+1。現在の効果数も見て担当を選ぶ。: Gains +1 Clash Power against heavily debuffed Sinners. Check current status counts when choosing the clash handler.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:passives.5.name: Deathrite [Halt (勿動)]
messages.呪殺【勿動】がある対象への与ダメージ量+10%: Deal +10% damage to targets with Deathrite 【Halt】
messages.同じ呪殺を持つ対象へ攻撃: Attacking a target with the matching Deathrite
messages.同名状態は束縛と破裂で発動し、このパッシブは敵の与ダメージを増やす。状態とパッシ: The same-named status activates through Bind and Rupture; this passive increases the enemy's damage. Distinguish the status from the passive.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:passives.6.name: Deathrite [Impede (掣肘)]
messages.呪殺【掣肘】がある対象からの被ダメージ量-20%: Take 20% less damage from targets with Deathrite 【Impede】
messages.同じ呪殺を持つ囚人から攻撃: Being attacked by a Sinner with the matching Deathrite
messages.その囚人のチォウへの与ダメージが20%減る。高火力の主力へ不用意に付けさせない。: That Sinner deals 20% less damage to Qiu. Avoid allowing it onto key damage dealers unnecessarily.
messages.次ターンも低精神力のままと考えず、現在の予測を確認する。: Check current predictions rather than assuming low SP persists next turn.
messages.最初のターン開始時、精神力を30回復\n体力が85%以下のとき、パターン変更\n:
At the start of the first turn, heal 30 SP.
At 85% HP or lower, change attack patterns.
At 60% HP or lower, gain 500 Shield at Turn Start.
Afterward, HP cannot fall below 0.
messages.85%以下で敵の行動が強化。倒せない相手を削り過ぎず、チォウを攻撃する。: Enemy actions strengthen at 85% HP or lower. Do not excessively damage an unkillable target; attack Qiu instead.
messages.呪殺【迅速】を持つ敵に的中時、対象の破裂回数が2増加(1ターンにつき最大6): On Hit against an enemy with Deathrite【Haste】, increase the target's Rupture Count by 2 (max 6 per turn)
messages.呪殺【迅速】の的中・速度差: Hits on Deathrite【Haste】 targets / Speed difference
messages.使用者で効果が異なる。各技の状態と速度差を確認し、破裂の多い囚人を守る。: Effects vary by user. Check each skill's statuses and Speed difference, and protect high-Rupture Sinners.
messages.自分より速度が低い対象を攻撃時、付与する破裂もしくは破裂回数+2,ダメージ量+1: When attacking a slower target, inflict +2 Rupture or Rupture Count and deal +10% damage
messages.速度差・呪殺【迅速】の的中: Speed difference / hits on Deathrite【Haste】 targets
messages.使用者ごとの効果を確認。ズールゥは脚力【卯】のクイックもあるので、マッチ勝利で束: Check each user's effects. Zilu also gains Haste through Strider【Mao】; make him gain Bind by winning clashes.
messages.スキル使用時、自分の速度が対象より2以上高いならコイン威力+1: On Skill Use, if self is at least 2 Speed faster than the target, Coin Power +1
messages.遅い囚人が受けるとコインが強くなる。速い担当や束縛を使う。: Coins strengthen against slower Sinners. Use a faster clash handler or Bind.
messages.ターン終了時、マッチで敗北した回数だけ次のターンに束縛1を得る(最大6): At Turn End, gain 1 Bind next turn for each clash lost (max 6)
messages.敗北回数分、次ターンに束縛。無用に削らず、マッチ勝利で速度を抑える。: Each lost clash adds next-turn Bind. Control his Speed by winning clashes rather than inflicting unnecessary damage.
messages.最初のターン開始時、一抹の期待を得る: At the start of the first turn, gain A Sliver of Anticipation
messages.フェーズ開始時に保有していた破裂、火傷、沈潜、振動、出血威力と破裂、火傷、沈潜、: Begin the phase retaining half the Rupture, Burn, Sinking, Tremor, and Bleed Potency and Count held at phase transition.
messages.一部の状態は半分持ち越す。前半の蓄積が全て残る前提で大技を使い切らない。: Some statuses carry over at half strength. Do not exhaust powerful skills assuming all first-half buildup remains.
messages.毎ターン開始時、本体と部位にバリアを900得る。\n-ホンルに問答があるなら、数:
At the start of each turn, gain 900 Shield on the body and parts.
- Gain 300 less for every 1 Dialogues on Hong Lu.
At 3+ Dialogues on Hong Lu, gain no further Shield for the rest of the encounter.
messages.バリア900から問答1につき300減り、3で以後なし。まずホンル本人で問答を進め: The 900 Shield falls by 300 per Dialogues and stops at 3. First progress Dialogues with Hong Lu himself.
messages.対象の持つ呪殺の数が3つ以上なら、コイン威力+1: If the target has 3+ Deathrite types, Coin Power +1
messages.敵のコイン威力+1。まだ持っていない呪殺を増やさないようにする。: The enemy gains +1 Coin Power. Avoid adding Deathrites the target does not yet have.
messages.最初のターン開始時、押し殺された殺気を得る\nホンル死亡時、戦闘が終了:
At the start of the first turn, gain Concealed Bloodthirst.
When Hong Lu dies, end the encounter.
messages.レベル低下5を反映している。前座の段階でもホンルの死亡は敗北。: Displayed levels include the reduction of 5. Hong Lu's death causes defeat even during the opening wave.
messages.呪殺【迅速】を持つ敵に的中時、対象の破裂回数が1増加(1ターンにつき最大3回): On Hit against an enemy with Deathrite【Haste】, increase the target's Rupture Count by 1 (max 3 times per turn)
messages.自分より速度が低い対象を攻撃時、付与する破裂もしくは破裂回数+1: When attacking a slower target, inflict +1 Rupture or Rupture Count
messages.自分の速度が対象より3以上高ければ、コイン威力+1: If self is at least 3 Speed faster than the target, Coin Power +1
messages.ターン終了時、このターンにてマッチで敗北したなら次のターンに束縛2を得る: At Turn End, if a clash was lost this turn, gain 2 Bind next turn
messages.次ターンに束縛2。前座は勝って精神力を整え、手数を減らす。: Gain 2 Bind next turn. Win opening-wave clashes to build SP and reduce enemy actions.
messages.チォウの基本攻撃・防御Lv−35。一方攻撃ではダメージ+30%。: Qiu's base Offense and Defense Levels -35. Deal +30% damage with one-sided attacks.
messages.低下を表示へ反映。こちらからマッチを取らず攻撃を通すと被害が大きい。: Displayed levels include the reduction. Letting attacks through without clashing causes greater damage.
messages.ズールゥの基本攻撃・防御Lv−20。: Zilu's base Offense and Defense Levels -20.
messages.基礎Lv75と現在のLvを区別する。: Distinguish base Level 75 from his current levels.
messages.黒獣の基本攻撃・防御Lv−5。: Heishou base Offense and Defense Levels -5.
messages.前座の現在の予測で勝てる通常技を使う。: Use regular skills that win according to current opening-wave predictions.
messages.味方が一方攻撃されると対象を自分へ変更し、専用ガード・反撃を使う。ズールゥは1な: Redirects one-sided attacks on allies to self and uses a special Guard or Counter. Zilu uses “Swiftfeet Protection” at 1 stack and Cloudsplitting Manifestation at 2+.
messages.チォウへの弱い一方攻撃を避ける。: Avoid weak one-sided attacks on Qiu.
messages.終了時に次ターンのクイック5を得て、数値が1減る。: At Turn End, gain 5 Haste next turn and reduce this status by 1.
messages.ズールゥの速度差による強化を、マッチ勝利での束縛や別の担当で抑える。: Control Zilu's Speed-difference bonuses with Bind from winning clashes or a different clash handler.
messages.ホンルが問いへのマッチに勝って得る進行効果。問答は終了時に精神力5回復、HP0時: A progression effect Hong Lu gains by winning clashes against the questions. Dialogues heals 5 SP at Turn End and allows full HP recovery at 0 HP as many times as its value. His Lord Identity displays Uncompromising Imposition, which also grants 1 Final Power Up next turn after recovery.
messages.3まで進めてバリアと大技を攻略する。復活効果をあてにして本人のHPを放置しない。: Reach 3 to handle the Shield and finisher. Do not neglect Hong Lu's HP by relying on revival.
messages.束縛3以上で破裂が発動すると数値が減り、混乱区間が前進する。: When Rupture activates at 3+ Bind, reduce this status and raise the Stagger Threshold.
messages.破裂の被弾と束縛が重なった囚人のHPを守る。: Protect the HP of Sinners with both Bind and incoming Rupture damage.
messages.ほかの呪殺が減ると数値が減り、0で次ターン攻撃Lv−6。同名パッシブにより所持者: When another Deathrite decreases, this status decreases; at 0, gain 6 Offense Level Down next turn. The same-named passive also makes its holder deal 20% less damage to Qiu.
messages.高火力担当への付与を避け、複数人へ広げない。: Keep it off key damage dealers and avoid spreading it across the team.
messages.速度10以上の対象から受けた攻撃で破裂が発動すると数値が減り、自分の破裂回数が増: When Rupture activates from an attack by a target with 10+ Speed, reduce this status and increase own Rupture Count.
messages.速いズールゥへ被弾を重ねず、マッチと回復で対応する。: Avoid repeated hits from a fast Zilu; use clashes and healing.
messages.付与者による破裂発動で数値が減り、ほかの呪殺も減少させる。: When its inflicter activates Rupture, reduce this status and other Deathrites.
messages.呪殺の種類と破裂の数値を確認する。: Check Deathrite types and Rupture values.
messages.boss-copy:jia-qiu:mechanics.10.name: Deathrite【Extinguish】
messages.後半の雷霆万鈞 - 波に記載された名称。専用状態欄は即減と表記され、即滅の個別効: A provisional rendering of the name used in the guide's second-half “Thunderstrike” - Ripple entry. Its dedicated status section instead lists Wane; the source does not establish a separate effect for Extinguish.
messages.即減と同一だと断定した計算はせず、実際の状態表示を確認する。: Do not calculate on the assumption that it is identical to Wane; check the actual status display.
messages.呪殺がある状態で破裂が発動すると数値が減り、次ターンの束縛へつながる。: When Rupture activates while Deathrites are present, reduce this status, leading to next-turn Bind.
messages.同じ囚人へ破裂と呪殺が重なった場合は、次ターンの担当を見直す。: When Rupture and Deathrites accumulate on one Sinner, reconsider next turn's clash assignments.
messages.ホンルの死亡は即敗北。控えがいても救済されない。: Hong Lu's death causes immediate defeat even with reserves available.
messages.援護防御があるターンのチォウへの弱い一方攻撃は、ズールゥの強い反撃を誘発する。: Weak one-sided attacks on Qiu while Assist Defense is active trigger Zilu's powerful counterattack.
messages.ズールゥを85%以下に削らない。倒す必要はなく、後半へ進めば撤退する。: Do not reduce Zilu to 85% HP or lower. He does not need to be defeated and withdraws on entering the second half.
messages.前半HP50%で即ターン終了。後ろに回復を置いていても使えない。: The first-half turn ends immediately at 50% HP. Later healing will not resolve.
messages.問答はホンル本人のマッチ勝利で進む。大技後の防御低下も、そのマッチに勝つことが条: Dialogues progresses only through Hong Lu's own clash wins. The finisher's Defense Level reduction also requires winning that clash.
messages.大技へ勝っても破壊不能の被弾が残る。混乱防止はその技のダメージに対するもので、破: Unbreakable hits remain after winning against the finisher. Stagger prevention applies to that skill's damage; it does not prevent death from Rupture.
messages.ホンルと回復、7名＋控え5名。前座用の打撃と、チォウへ通る暴食・色欲・傲慢を用意: Bring Hong Lu, healing, 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Prepare Blunt for the opening wave, and Gluttony, Lust, and Pride for Qiu.
messages.問答と一騎打ちに使うホンルのE.G.O資源を確保。破裂が重なった本人のHPを常に: Save Hong Lu's E.G.O resources for Dialogues and the duel. Keep checking his HP when Rupture accumulates.
messages.問答を3回進め、一騎打ちへ勝つ必須の担当。: The mandatory clash handler for progressing Dialogues 3 times and winning the duel.
messages.破壊不能と破裂の消耗を抑え、本人の即敗北を防ぐ。: Limit attrition from Unbreakable Coins and Rupture, preventing defeat through Hong Lu's death.
messages.援護防御の誘発を避け、呪殺を全員へ広げない。: Avoid triggering Assist Defense and spreading Deathrites across the whole team.
messages.【リンバス】8-32 ジア・ファン＆クボの攻略｜Limbus Assistant: 8-32 Jia Huan & Gubo Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-32「ジア・ファン＆クボ」の攻略。取: Jia Huan & Gubo guide for Limbus Company 8-32. Defeat the adds, then Huan, then Gubo. Avoid excessive focus on Huan, and use ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo to limit repeated low-SP area attacks.
messages.N社E.G.O::軽蔑、畏敬 ジア・ファンの外見: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan appearance
messages.N社E.G.O::軽蔑、畏敬 ジア・ファンのスキル: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan skills
messages.N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huanの外見: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan appearance
messages.N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huanのスキ: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan skills
messages.N社E.G.O::凶弾 クボの外見: N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet Gubo appearance
messages.N社E.G.O::凶弾 クボのスキル: N Corp. E.G.O::Fell Bullet Gubo skills
