messages.取り巻き→ファン→クボの順に倒す戦闘。ファンへ攻撃を集めすぎず、クボには通常防御: Defeat the adds, then Huan, then Gubo. Avoid excessive focus on Huan, and use ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo to limit repeated low-SP area attacks.
messages.8-32通常戦。ホンル必須・レンタル可。表示レベルは基礎Lv、攻撃・防御欄は不安: The regular 8-32 encounter. Hong Lu is required; a borrowed Identity is available. Displayed Levels are base values, while Offense/Defense entries include initial Volatile E.G.O Attunement reductions (7 for Huan, 2 for Gubo). Further stacks change these levels. Huan's 60% Stagger threshold is listed as 1098, which does not match 60% of 1824 HP. Exact HP thresholds for the bosses' incapacitation are unspecified.
messages.ねばつきを混乱させたら、クボの射撃前に倒し切る。: After Staggering Sticking enemies, finish them before Gubo shoots.
messages.ファンへ向ける攻撃は基本4つ以内。掌持ちで3ターン目の反撃へ勝つ。: Generally target Huan with no more than 4 attacks. Have the Grasp holder beat the turn 3 Counter.
messages.クボの精神力−20以下を警戒。後回しの間は通常防御・回避で受ける。: Watch for Gubo reaching -20 SP or lower. While leaving him for later, use ordinary Guard or Evade.
messages.勝っているのにクボの広域が増える: Gubo uses more area attacks after your clash wins
messages.クボはマッチ敗北で精神力が下がり、−20以下で特殊行動へ変わる。必要なマッチだけ: Gubo loses SP when losing clashes and switches to a special pattern at -20 or lower. Take only necessary clashes and use ordinary Guard or Evade. E.G.O Corrosion also lowers SP, so this cannot prevent the pattern forever.
messages.ファンを殴るだけでHPと精神力が下がる: Attacking Huan drains HP and SP
messages.仲間が残っている間の集中攻撃への反応がある。攻撃は基本4つ以内にし、残りをねばつ: While allies remain, he reacts to focused attacks. Generally limit attacks to 4 and spend the rest on Sticking enemies or defense.
messages.掌持ちへの集中とファンの低精神力時の行動が重なっている。前のターンに掌持ちが反撃: Grasp targeting overlaps with Huan's low-SP pattern. On the previous turn, have the Grasp holder beat the Counter to skip that action. Unredirectable skills cannot be intercepted by another Sinner.
messages.N社E.G.O::軽蔑、畏敬 ジア・ファン: N Corp. E.G.O::Contempt, Awe Jia Huan
messages.不安定E.G.O感応 - 軽蔑で初期攻防Lv−7。蓄積ごとに攻撃Lvは下がり、防: Volatile E.G.O Attunement - Contempt initially gives -7 Offense/Defense Levels. Each stack lowers Offense Level and raises Defense Level.
messages.掌持ちがいると全耐性+0.1。表示はこの変化前。: If a Grasp holder is present, all resistance multipliers +0.1. Displayed values are before this change.
messages.一定HP以下のターン終了に戦闘不能。正確な境界は不明。: Becomes incapacitated at Turn End below a certain HP threshold. The exact threshold is unknown.
messages.不安定E.G.O感応 - 凶弾で初期攻防Lv−2。マッチ敗北で蓄積し、攻防Lvが: Volatile E.G.O Attunement - Fell Bullet initially gives -2 Offense/Defense Levels. Losing clashes adds stacks, raising both levels.
messages.仲間が倒れると行動枠が増える。ねばつきの処理後も毎ターンの攻撃数を確認する。: Gains action slots when allies fall. Check attack counts every turn even after removing Sticking enemies.
messages.ファンとクボが両方戦闘不能になると死亡。通常は先に倒して手数と呼吸支援を減らす。: Die when both Huan and Gubo are incapacitated. Usually defeat these first to reduce enemy actions and Poise support.
messages.ホンルと、クボの単体技を受ける守備を用意: Prepare Hong Lu and defense against Gubo's single-target skills
messages.推奨Lv55を目安に主力を育てる。ホンルは初期出撃必須で、レンタルも利用できる。: Aim for the recommended Level 55 on the main team. Hong Lu must deploy initially; a borrowed Identity is available. Check healing and Pierce, Lust, and Pride resistance.
messages.ホンルにはファンへのマッチ威力+2、イサンにはクボへの+2の支援がある。君主ホン: Support gives Hong Lu +2 Clash Power against Huan and Yi Sang +2 against Gubo. Hong Lu's Lord Identity replaces this with exclusive support; do not assume both effects stack.
messages.クボの受けは通常防御か回避。マッチ可能ガードではマッチが発生するので、精神力を下: Use ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo. Clashable Guard causes a clash, so it does not serve the same purpose when trying to avoid lowering his SP.
messages.ねばつきを先に減らし、クボの指定射撃を止める: Clear Sticking enemies first and stop Gubo's designated shot
messages.ファンの必要なマッチを確保しながら、ねばつきへ斬撃・憤怒・暴食・嫉妬の火力を向け: Maintain necessary clashes against Huan while directing Slash, Wrath, Gluttony, and Envy damage at Sticking enemies. Avoid aiming 5+ attacks at Huan alone.
messages.ねばつきがHP半分未満になると、クボが戦友の血を被った弾丸を選ぶことがある。指定: When a Sticking enemy falls below half HP, Gubo may use “Bullet Drenched with the Blood of a Comrade”. Killing the designated Sticking enemy before Gubo fires cancels the shot.
messages.混乱だけで放置せず、倒し切れるコインと行動順を確認。クボの精神力が−20以下なら: Do not leave it merely Staggered; check Coins and action order to finish it. At -20 SP or lower, watch for Gubo's other special pattern too.
messages.掌持ちが反撃へ勝ち、潜在解放のターンを飛ばす: Win the Counter with the Grasp holder to skip the Unleashed turn
messages.ファンの掌は次のターンに束縛10を付け、攻撃を集中させる。付与された囚人のHP・: Huan's Grasp inflicts 10 Bind next turn and attracts focused attacks. Heal the affected Sinner's HP/SP and retain a strong attack.
messages.基本周期の3ターン目に来る受け止めねばならぬであろうへ、掌を持つ囚人でマッチ勝利: On turn 3 of the basic cycle, have the Grasp holder win against “You Must Confront This”. Reducing Grasp and Gaze can skip the next Unleashed pattern. Check that the actual skill is present before acting.
messages.飛ばせない場合、対象変更不可の潜在解放は指定された囚人で対処。敵側の仲間が倒れ、: If it cannot be skipped, the designated Sinner must handle the unredirectable Unleashed skill. When enemy allies have fallen and Huan is at -20 SP or lower, 2 copies may appear. Prepare Lust resistance, defense, and healing; Staggering him beforehand is another option.
messages.残ったクボへ集中し、長期化させない: Focus the remaining Gubo and finish promptly
messages.嫉妬・怠惰が通りやすい。精神力と予測を見て勝てるマッチを取り、強い技をまとめる。: Envy and Sloth work well. Check SP and predictions, take winning clashes, and concentrate strong skills.
messages.低精神力の減算広域と、4枚破壊不能の追憶を砕く弾丸を区別する。広域の副対象も事前: Distinguish low-SP negative-Coin area attacks from the 4-Unbreakable-Coin “Reminiscence Shattering Bullet”. Heal secondary targets beforehand too.
messages.E.G.O侵蝕による自傷を待つだけでは敵の攻撃も強くなる。控えめに受ける段階を終: Waiting only for E.G.O Corrosion's self-damage also strengthens enemy attacks. Finish the cautious defensive stage and concentrate damage until incapacitation.
messages.対象の視線が3以上なら、このスキルで付与するマイナス効果が2倍になる: If the target has 3+ Gaze, double negative effects inflicted by this skill
messages.視線3以上では付与されるマイナス効果が2倍。出血をためた囚人で受け続けず、勝てる: At 3+ Gaze, inflicted negative effects double. Do not keep taking it on a Sinner with accumulated Bleed; assign a winning clash handler.
messages.[表面的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少3を付与: [On Heads Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn
messages.[的中時]次のターンにダメージ量減少1を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Damage Down next turn
messages.2枚とも破壊不能。勝っても出血と弱体化は残るので、HPと出血回数を確認する。視線: Both Coins are Unbreakable, leaving Bleed and debuffs after a win. Check HP and Bleed Count; especially dangerous against targets with 3+ Gaze.
messages.[的中時](対象の視線×5)だけ混乱区間を前進させる: [On Hit] Raise the Stagger Threshold by (target's Gaze × 5)
messages.[攻撃後]対象の全ての視線を除去: [After Attack] Remove all Gaze from the target
messages.対象変更不可で最後の1枚が破壊不能。前のターンに掌持ちが受け止めねばならぬであろ: Unredirectable, with the last Coin Unbreakable. Have the Grasp holder beat “You Must Confront This” on the previous turn to skip it. Otherwise, the designated target must prepare their own clash or defense.
messages.[使用時]対象へ掌4を付与: [On Use] Inflict 4 Grasp on the target
messages.[使用時]次のターンにダメージ量増加2を得る: [On Use] Gain 2 Damage Up next turn
messages.ホンル優先。使用時に掌が付くため、マッチに勝っても掌の付与は防げない。以後の集中: Prioritizes Hong Lu. Grasp is inflicted on use; winning the clash does not prevent it. Check the HP of whoever will take the subsequent focused attacks.
messages.基本14からコイン1枚につき4を引く減算技。敵の低精神力では高威力が出やすい。予: A negative-Coin skill starting at 14 and subtracting 4 per Coin. Low enemy SP makes high rolls more likely. If predictions are poor, consider defending with a resistant Sinner.
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の視線が2減少: [On Clash Lose] Reduce the target's Gaze by 2
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の掌が1減少: [On Clash Lose] Reduce the target's Grasp by 1
messages.マッチ可能反撃。掌を持つ囚人で勝つと視線2・掌1を減らし、次の危険な行動を飛ばせ: A Clashable Counter. Winning with the Grasp holder reduces Gaze by 2 and Grasp by 1, skipping the next dangerous pattern. Win with an attack rather than trying to Offset it with a defense skill.
messages.[攻撃前]視線が4以上の囚人の数だけ攻撃加重値が増加: [Before Attack] Increase Attack Weight by the number of Sinners with 4+ Gaze
messages.[的中時]対象の視線が4以上なら、視線1を付与: [On Hit] If the target has 4+ Gaze, inflict 1 Gaze
messages.名前の順が逆の別技。視線4以上の囚人が増えると追加され、加重値も増える。1枚が破: A distinct skill with its name in reverse order. Added when more Sinners have 4+ Gaze, which also increases Attack Weight. 1 Coin is Unbreakable, so winning does not guarantee no damage.
messages.[戦闘開始時]ジア・ファンとクボがバリア30を得る: [Combat Start] Jia Huan and Gubo gain 30 Shield
messages.[マッチ勝利時]ジア・ファンとクボがバリア30を得る: [On Clash Win] Jia Huan and Gubo gain 30 Shield
messages.マッチ可能ガード。戦闘開始時のバリア30はマッチ勝利だけでは取り消せない。敵に勝: A Clashable Guard. Winning does not undo the 30 Shield gained at Combat Start. If the enemy wins, both bosses gain more Shield.
messages.前方を優先する単体技。クボの精神力を急に下げないよう、通常防御・回避で受ける選択: A single-target skill prioritizing the front line. Ordinary Guard or Evade can avoid rapidly lowering Gubo's SP. Avoid handlers with substantial Bleed.
messages.後方優先の単体技。前方射撃とは対象が違う。通常防御・回避でしのぐ場合も、呼吸によ: A single-target skill prioritizing the rear, unlike “Front Line Fire”. Even with ordinary Guard or Evade, watch for Poise critical hits and Bleed Count.
messages.[使用時]呼吸3、呼吸回数2を得る: [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and 2 Poise Count
messages.Ⅰこのコインはメインターゲットにのみダメージを与える。: ⅠThis Coin only damages the main target.
messages.Ⅱこのコインはサブターゲットにのみダメージを与える。: ⅡThis Coin only damages secondary targets.
messages.[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.加重値2の減算技。1枚目は主対象、2枚目は副対象に当たる。主対象の守備だけで全員: A negative-Coin skill with 2 Attack Weight. Coin 1 hits the main target; Coin 2 hits the secondary target. The main target's defense does not protect everyone; check secondary targets' HP too.
messages.戦友の血を被った弾丸: Bullet Drenched with the Blood of a Comrade
messages.- 指定対象を攻撃できなければ、スキルがキャンセルされる: - If unable to attack the designated target, cancel the skill
messages.[的中時](対象の的中時現体力)だけ、最終コインに傲慢ダメージを追加: [On Hit] Add Pride damage to the final Coin equal to the target's current HP at the moment of the hit
messages.[的中時]沈潜4を付与、沈潜回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 2
messages.対象変更不可・加重値5。指定されたN社職員を先に倒せば技がキャンセルされる。味方: Unredirectable, with 5 Attack Weight. Killing the designated N Corp. employee first cancels it. Focus that Sticking enemy before Gubo fires, rather than waiting for him to shoot his ally.
messages.自分の引き裂かれた追憶1につき、ダメージ量+10%: Deal +10% damage for every 1 Torn Memory on self
messages.4枚すべて破壊不能の加重値5。クボの精神力−20以下で現れる危険な行動。マッチ勝: A dangerous 5-Attack-Weight skill with 4 Unbreakable Coins, appearing at -20 SP or lower. Avoid continuously lowering Gubo's SP through clash wins; if it appears, use a strong clash and healing beforehand.
messages.マッチ可能反撃。これに勝っても凶弾コストで敵の精神力が下がる。クボを後回しにする: A Clashable Counter. Winning still lowers the enemy's SP through The Cost of Fell Bullets. While postponing Gubo, avoid unnecessary attacks that trigger it.
messages.ねばつきの出血付与。通常技で勝ちつつ、混乱させた後は倒し切る手数も残す。: Sticking enemies inflict Bleed. Win with regular skills and retain enough actions to finish them after Staggering them.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が2以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 2+ Bleed, Coin Power +1
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.出血2以上でコイン威力が上がる。出血を持つ囚人へ回数を重ねさせない。: Coin Power increases at 2+ Bleed. Avoid adding more Count to Sinners already carrying Bleed.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が3以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 3+ Bleed, Clash Power +1
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]次のターンにクイック1を得る: Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn
messages.出血3以上ではマッチが強化される3枚技。取り巻きを残さず、混乱から撃破まで集中す: A 3-Coin skill strengthened at 3+ Bleed. Focus adds from Stagger through defeat rather than leaving them alive.
messages.通常の防御。資料は使用時の麻痺付与とだけ記載し、対象の詳細は不明。防御越しに削れ: An ordinary Guard. Only on-use Paralyze application is listed; the target is unspecified. Prepare enough damage to cut through Guard.
messages.出血回数を増やす。威力が既に高い囚人を受け役にせず、通常マッチで止める。: Increases Bleed Count. Avoid a handler already carrying high Bleed Potency; stop it through a regular clash.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:skills.19.name: Skim Wounds
messages.出血2以上で威力が上がり、出血と回数を重ねる。低HPの囚人で連続して受けない。: Strengthens at 2+ Bleed and adds both Bleed and Count. Avoid repeated hits on low-HP Sinners.
messages.出血に応じて強くなる3枚技。敵の次ターンのクイックも防げるよう、勝てるマッチを割: A 3-Coin skill strengthened by Bleed. Assign winning clashes to prevent next-turn Haste too.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:passives.0.name: E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.このキャラクターが登場してから1ターンが経過する度に、ターン終了時にE.G.O侵:
At the end of every turn after this character appears, gain 1 E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
- At Turn End, if below 50% maximum HP or at -20 SP or lower, gain 1 additional E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.各ターン終了時・HP50%未満／精神力−20以下: Each Turn End / below 50% HP or at -20 SP or lower
messages.待つほど精神力が下がり攻撃が強くなる。自傷するからと全員で守備を続けない。: Waiting lowers SP and strengthens attacks. Do not keep the whole team defending simply because the enemy takes self-damage.
messages.逃した弟弟の手: My Little Brother's Hand I Let Slip
messages.敵へ自分の攻撃的中時、視線1を付与(人格ごとに1ターンにつき1回)\n敵へ自分が:
On Hit against an enemy, inflict 1 Gaze (once per Identity per turn).
When attacked by an enemy, inflict 1 Gaze on the attacker (once per Identity per turn).
At Turn Start, if Hong Lu is present in combat, inflict 1 Gaze on Hong Lu.
messages.ファンの的中・被攻撃・ホンル出現時: Huan hitting / being attacked / Hong Lu present
messages.視線は与ダメージも被ダメージも増やす。高い視線の囚人は削れる反面、被弾も危険にな: Gaze increases both damage dealt and taken. High-Gaze Sinners can deal more damage but are also at greater risk from hits.
messages.掌が付与された対象を優先して攻撃\n掌が付与された対象がいるならパターンが変更さ:
Prioritize targets with Grasp.
While a Grasp holder is present, change patterns and increase all resistance multipliers by 0.1.
messages.掌持ちがいる間: While a Grasp holder is present
messages.攻撃が集中する対象を見て、3ターン目の反撃へその囚人で勝つ。: Check who receives focused attacks and have that Sinner beat the turn 3 Counter.
messages.視線が4以上の囚人が4名以上なら、「畏敬、軽蔑【潜在解放】」スキルを使用: If 4+ Sinners have 4+ Gaze, use “Awe, Contempt【Unleashed】”
messages.別の潜在解放が追加される。全員でファンへ触れ続けると行動も強化される。: Adds another Unleashed skill. Repeatedly having everyone attack Huan also strengthens his actions.
messages.味方がいるとき、敵5名以上をメインターゲットに指定していると、該当する敵の体力・: While allies are present, if targeting 5+ enemies as main targets, those enemies lose 10 HP and SP
messages.敵側に仲間が残り、ファンへの集中条件を満たすとき: Enemy allies remain and Huan's focus condition is met
messages.原文はターゲットの主語が曖昧だが、攻略欄はファンへ5つ以上のスキルを向けないよう: The original targeting subject is ambiguous, but the walkthrough advises against aiming 5+ skills at Huan. Generally stay within 4 and spend remaining actions on adds.
messages.パニックの置き換えでギミックを止める編成にはしない。: Do not build around stopping the mechanics by replacing Panic type.
messages.精神力0へ戻る。低精神力に固定できるとは考えない。: SP resets to 0. Do not assume the enemy can be held at low SP indefinitely.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:passives.7.name: E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.攻撃的中時、精神力が5回復\nマッチ敗北時、精神力が5減少:
On Hit, heal 5 SP.
On Clash Lose, lose 5 SP.
messages.クボに勝ち続けると精神力を下げて危険な広域を招く。通常防御・回避を使い、敵の精神: Repeatedly beating Gubo lowers his SP and invites dangerous area attacks. Use ordinary Guard or Evade and check enemy SP each turn.
messages.ねばつきをクボに撃たせると呼吸回数も増える。指定対象を先に倒す手順を優先する。: Letting Gubo shoot Sticking enemies also increases his Poise Count. Prioritize killing the designated target first.
messages.朋よ、新たな時代が来ているのだよ。: A new era is upon us, my dear fellow.
messages.精神力が-20以下なら、特殊パターンを使用: At -20 SP or lower, use a special pattern
messages.広域中心の特殊行動へ変わる境界。単にマイナスになった時点と区別する。: The threshold for switching to an area-attack-focused pattern; merely having negative SP is not enough.
messages.どうか新たな理想のため献身してくれたまえ。: Please, dedicate yourself for the new ideal.
messages.ジア・ファンを除くN社職員の体力が50%未満なら、特殊パターンを使用: If an N Corp. employee other than Jia Huan is below 50% HP, use a special pattern
messages.ファン以外のN社職員のHP50%未満: N Corp. employee other than Huan below 50% HP
messages.混乱したねばつきを放置せず、クボが撃つ前に倒す。: Do not leave Sticking enemies Staggered; kill them before Gubo fires.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:passives.14.name: E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:passives.15.name: E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.ターン開始時に呼吸5を獲得、呼吸回数が2増加\n戦闘開始段階で、呼吸状態の味方が:
At Turn Start, gain 5 Poise and increase Poise Count by 2.
During combat, if an ally with Poise uses a skill and deals critical damage to an enemy, grant a random ally 5 Poise Potency and 2 Poise Count at the next Turn Start (once per turn).
messages.取り巻きが呼吸を配るため、放置するとボスの被害も増える。先に数を減らす。: Adds distribute Poise; leaving them alive increases the bosses' damage too. Reduce their numbers first.
messages.体力が50%以下のとき、出血を持つ敵へ攻撃的中時、相手の出血1につき自分の全体力: At 50% HP or lower, on hitting an enemy with Bleed, heal 1% of maximum HP per 1 Bleed on the enemy (max 10%; once per encounter)
messages.HP50%以下で出血持ちへ的中・戦闘中1回: Hitting a Bleeding target at 50% HP or lower / once per encounter
messages.混乱後は倒し切り、回復させない。: Finish them after Staggering them to prevent healing.
messages.1につきファンからの被ダメージ・ファンへの与ダメージが各10%増加。最大7で軽蔑: For each 1, take +10% damage from Huan and deal +10% damage to him. At the maximum of 7, becomes Contempt.
messages.高い視線は火力と危険の両方を増やす。被弾を抑え、視線4以上が4人に広がるのも警戒: High Gaze increases both damage and risk. Limit incoming hits and watch for 4 Sinners reaching 4+ Gaze.
messages.視線7から変化する状態。ファンとの被・与ダメージが50%減り、視線を得られない。: Transforms from 7 Gaze. Deal and take 50% less damage against Huan and cannot gain Gaze. Expires at Turn End.
messages.状態名と同名の攻撃技を区別。与ダメージも減るため、火力予測を確認する。: Distinguish this status from the same-named attack skill. It also reduces outgoing damage; check predictions.
messages.最大4。終了時に次ターンの束縛10を得て数値が1減る。ファンが掌持ちを優先し、行: Max 4. At Turn End, gain 10 Bind next turn and reduce this status by 1. Huan prioritizes Grasp holders and changes patterns.
messages.付いた囚人の回復と反撃への勝利を準備する。: Prepare healing and a Counter clash win for the affected Sinner.
messages.boss-copy:jia-fang-kubo:mechanics.3.name: E.G.O Corrosion - N Corp.
messages.最大10。開始時に数値分の精神力減少、3につき攻撃威力増加1。最大なら終了時に最: Max 10. At Turn Start, lose SP equal to its value and gain 1 Attack Power Up per 3. At maximum, take 5% maximum HP self-damage at Turn End.
messages.低精神力と威力強化が同時に進む。減算技とクボの特殊行動を毎ターン確認する。: Low SP and Power buffs progress together. Check negative-Coin skills and Gubo's special pattern each turn.
messages.攻防Lv−7。マッチ勝利で蓄積し、1につき攻撃Lv−1・防御Lv+1。最大5で次: Offense/Defense Levels -7. Gain stacks on Clash Win; each gives -1 Offense Level and +1 Defense Level. At the maximum of 5, gain 2 Protection next turn and reset.
messages.表は初期低下だけを反映。戦闘中の実際のレベル・保護で判断する。: The table includes only the initial reduction. Use actual in-combat levels and Protection when assessing clashes.
messages.攻防Lv−2。マッチ敗北で蓄積し、1につき攻防Lv+1。最大5で次ターンにダメー: Offense/Defense Levels -2. Gain stacks on Clash Lose; each gives +1 Offense/Defense Levels. At the maximum of 5, gain 2 Damage Up next turn and reset.
messages.クボに勝つことには強化を進める面もある。不要なマッチを減らす。: Beating Gubo also advances his buffs. Reduce unnecessary clashes.
messages.最大7。クボの射撃で蓄積し、追憶を砕く弾丸が数値1につきダメージ10%増加、攻撃: Max 7. Builds through Gubo's shots; each stack gives “Reminiscence Shattering Bullet” +10% damage. Fully consumed after the attack.
messages.精神力だけでなく、破壊不能広域の被害を増やす蓄積も見る。: Watch both SP and the buildup that strengthens Unbreakable area damage.
messages.通常のホンル支援。ファンとのマッチ威力+2。専用効果欄には「意思」とする表記差が: Hong Lu's regular support: +2 Clash Power against Huan. The dedicated effect entry uses a spelling variant for Will.
messages.ホンルの反撃担当を助ける。君主人格は別の専用支援へ置き換わる。: Helps Hong Lu handle the Counter. His Lord Identity replaces it with separate exclusive support.
messages.イサンのクボとのマッチ威力+2。: Yi Sang gains +2 Clash Power against Gubo.
messages.クボを集中処理する段階で使えるが、序盤から不要なマッチを増やす理由にはしない。: Useful when focusing Gubo, but not a reason to take unnecessary clashes from the opening.
messages.クボの危険な特殊行動の境界は精神力−20以下。マッチ敗北だけでなくE.G.O侵蝕: Gubo's dangerous special-pattern threshold is -20 SP or lower. E.G.O Corrosion lowers SP as well as lost clashes.
messages.ファンへの集中ペナルティは資料の原文と攻略欄で主語の表現が異なる。ここでは攻略欄: The focus penalty's targeting subject differs between the original effect and the walkthrough. This guide follows the walkthrough's limit of generally 4 attacks.
messages.掌の付与は使用時。マッチに勝てば付かない効果ではない。: Grasp is applied on use; winning the clash does not prevent it.
messages.潜在解放は名前の順が異なる2技。色欲の対象変更不可と、憤怒の広域を区別する。: There are 2 Unleashed skills with reversed names. Distinguish the unredirectable Lust skill from the Wrath area attack.
messages.ファンの低精神力時の減算技と、クボの低精神力で追加される破壊不能広域を同じ対処に: Huan's low-SP negative-Coin skill and Gubo's additional low-SP Unbreakable area attack require different responses.
messages.推奨Lv55を目安に主力を育成。ホンル初期出撃必須・レンタル可。回復手段とクボ受: Aim for the recommended Level 55 on the main team. Hong Lu must deploy initially; a borrowed Identity is available. Prepare healing and ordinary Guard or Evade against Gubo.
messages.ねばつきには斬撃、ファンには色欲・憂鬱、クボには嫉妬・怠惰が有効。属性だけでなく: Slash works against Sticking enemies; Lust/Gloom against Huan; Envy/Sloth against Gubo. Prioritize clash predictions as well as affinities.
messages.通常防御・回避で不要なマッチを減らす。: Use ordinary Guard or Evade to reduce unnecessary clashes.
messages.クボが指定したN社職員を先に倒し、危険な射撃をキャンセルする。: Kill Gubo's designated N Corp. employee first to cancel the dangerous shot.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-30「レイホン（8-30）」の攻略。: Lei Heng (8-30) guide for Limbus Company 8-30. Resolve Blasting Shatterslash late and use defense skills on Prey holders. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after clash wins, and prepare healing and damage for buffs that progress with HP loss and elapsed turns.
messages.親指ソルダート（補給役）の外見: Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit) appearance
messages.親指ソルダート（補給役）のスキル: Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit) skills
messages.Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit)の外見: Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit) appearance
messages.Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit)のスキル: Soldato of the Thumb (supply unit) skills
messages.8-30の通常個体。表示Lv・スキルLv・防御Lvは平均化前の基礎値。2ターン目: The regular 8-30 encounter. Displayed Levels, Skill Levels, and Defense Levels are base values before averaging. On turn 2, Chesed's Mercy averages everyone's Offense/Defense Levels and adds allied bonuses; subsequent values depend on the team and in-combat displays, rather than a fixed reduction. Supply units use the individual entry's 226 HP, which differs from the overview's 221.
messages.通常の本体8技・補給役1技。鏡の隠しボスの追加効果は含めない。快刀亂麻・超絶猛虎: 8 regular boss skills and 1 supply skill. Mirror Dungeon hidden-boss additions are excluded. Tanglecleaver and Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades show minimum Attack Weight, which increases conditionally. Tiantui Star and Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] determine when regular skills become Unbreakable. Reload's listed type, effects, and timing differ across entries, with reported bugs.
messages.初手の消耗は2ターン目の全回復・混乱解除で立て直せる。平均化はHP最大値まで育成: Turn 2's full heal and Stagger recovery can undo opening-turn attrition. Averaging does not raise maximum HP to a fully leveled value; level the main team too.
messages.爆砕斬は後ろの担当でマッチし、先にほかの技で弾を減らす。勝っても3枚の破壊不能は: Have a later-acting Sinner clash against Blasting Shatterslash, after other skills have reduced ammunition. All 3 Unbreakable Coins remain after winning.
messages.獲物はマッチ威力−5だが、守備装着でレイホンからの被ダメージ75%減。大技前に回: Prey gives -5 Clash Power, but equipping a defense skill reduces damage taken from Lei Heng by 75%. Heal before finishers and equip defense skills on Sinners who are not clashing too.
messages.マッチに勝っているのに爆砕斬で削られる: Blasting Shatterslash still deals damage after a clash win
messages.3枚すべて破壊不能。最後の方に処理して先に弾を減らすと火傷を抑えられる。暴食・斬: All 3 Coins are Unbreakable. Resolve it late so earlier skills reduce ammunition and limit Burn. Combine Gluttony/Slash resistance, Prey's defensive reduction, and healing beforehand.
messages.火力担当が次のターンだけ勝てなくなる: A damage dealer suddenly cannot win next turn
messages.前ターンの最多ダメージで獲物が付き、マッチ威力が5下がる。無理に弱い技で挑まず、: Dealing the most damage last turn grants Prey, reducing Clash Power by 5. Use a stronger skill or defend rather than forcing a weak clash. Equipping a defense skill greatly reduces damage.
messages.HPをあまり削っていないのに強くなった: The boss strengthened despite little HP loss
messages.HP境界のほか、ターン経過でも装填・天退星・終盤行動へ進む。回復だけで長引かせず: Reloading, Tiantui Star, and late-fight patterns advance with elapsed turns as well as HP thresholds. Do not stall through healing alone; concentrate damage during openings.
messages.大技の後に回復しようとしたら動けなかった: Healing scheduled after the finisher never happened
messages.快刀亂麻・超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬は攻撃後にターンを終える。回復は前のターンまでに行い、: Tanglecleaver and Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades end the turn after attacking. Heal by the previous turn, and equip defense skills on Sinners who are not clashing.
messages.基礎Lv83。2ターン目以降はケセドの慈悲による平均化で変わるため、スキル欄の基: Base Level 83. From turn 2, Chesed's Mercy changes levels through averaging; do not treat the skill table's base values as current values.
messages.資料のHP下限は423。攻略本文は残り約800で終了イベントの目安とされ、0まで: The listed HP floor is 423. The walkthrough places the ending event at roughly 800 HP remaining; this guide does not assume a fight to 0.
messages.HP90%・80%・60%・40%とターン経過で行動が変わり、混乱を解除する。: Patterns change and Stagger clears at 90%, 80%, 60%, and 40% HP, or as turns pass.
messages.猛虎標弾を使い切ると補給のため登場。生存したまま終了時に弾を支給して離脱する。: Appear to resupply after Savage Tigermark Rounds run out. If alive at Turn End, supply ammunition and withdraw.
messages.本体の攻撃は止まらない。補給役の処理だけで手数を使い切らない。: The boss keeps attacking. Do not spend every action handling supply units.
messages.回復・斬撃耐性と、弾を減らす担当を用意: Bring healing, Slash resistance, and ammunition-reduction handlers
messages.推奨Lv55・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に7名＋控え5名。ホンル初期出撃必須でレンタルも選: Aim for the recommended Level 55 and Uptie III or higher, with 7 Sinners and 5 reserves. Hong Lu must deploy initially; a borrowed Identity is available. Averaging does not increase maximum HP, so avoid taking hits while underleveled.
messages.斬撃・暴食・憤怒・嫉妬の被弾に備え、HP・精神力回復と強いマッチを用意。火力は暴: Prepare HP/SP recovery and strong clash skills against Slash, Gluttony, Wrath, and Envy attacks. Gluttony and Envy work well offensively.
messages.ホンルは攻撃後に属性のE.G.O資源を追加獲得。君主人格では被弾後の斬撃強化も加: Hong Lu gains extra E.G.O resources matching his attack's affinity after attacking. His Lord Identity also gains Slash buffs after taking hits. Ryōshū's damage in this encounter increases as turns pass.
messages.初手の特殊な保護と、2ターン目の立て直しを使う: Use turn 1's special protection and turn 2's recovery
messages.1ターン目は味方のHPに下限があり、通常のマッチは不利。弱い手札の消化や資源獲得: Allies have an HP floor on turn 1, when regular clashes are unfavorable. Cycle weak skills and gain resources; do not judge the team's viability from this turn alone. The listed 20% floor includes an estimate, so avoid plans requiring that exact value.
messages.2ターン目開始に全回復・混乱解除・精神力0リセット。ケセドの慈悲で攻撃・防御Lv: At turn 2's start, fully heal, recover from Stagger, and reset SP to 0. Chesed's Mercy averages Offense/Defense Levels, then grants allies +3 Offense Level and +6 Defense Level.
messages.以後は平均化後の予測で通常技へ勝ち、精神力と資源を整える。: Afterward, use the averaged clash predictions to beat regular skills and build SP and resources.
messages.爆砕斬を後に処理して、弾を先に使わせる: Spend ammunition before resolving Blasting Shatterslash
messages.二連斬-【爆】・三連撃-【爆】・天退星刀 装填へのマッチに勝つと弾が減る。これら: Winning against “Double Slash” - Blast, “Triple Slash” - Blast, or “Reloading Tiantui Star's Blade” reduces ammunition. Resolve these before Blasting Shatterslash.
messages.爆砕斬は速度に関係なくマッチできる。遅く行動する囚人を担当にし、実際の処理順を確: Blasting Shatterslash can be clashed regardless of Speed. Assign a later-acting Sinner and check actual resolution order. If one Sinner has multiple slots, account for clashes within that Sinner resolving first.
messages.弾切れでも破壊不能の攻撃は止まらないが、火傷付与を抑えられる。獲物付きは守備装着: Empty ammunition does not stop Unbreakable attacks, but limits Burn application. Equipping a defense skill on Prey reduces damage by 75%. A clash win grants 3 E.G.O resources of the least-owned type; clash only when able to win.
messages.猛虎標弾と通常技の破壊不能化へ備える: Prepare for Savage Tigermark Rounds and Unbreakable regular skills
messages.天退星と猛虎標弾18で火傷・振動・威力が強くなる。三連撃-【爆】の最後も破壊不能: Tiantui Star and 18 Savage Tigermark Rounds strengthen Burn, Tremor, and Power. “Triple Slash” - Blast's final Coin becomes Unbreakable; winning regular clashes no longer guarantees avoiding damage.
messages.弾を減らす順番と回復を続け、強い大技を待つだけで長期化させない。束縛3以上を前タ: Keep controlling ammunition order and healing rather than prolonging the fight waiting for finishers. Applying 3+ Bind from the previous turn can suppress Chachihu's SP recovery and Slash buffs.
messages.快刀亂麻へは強い技で勝つ。被害80%減と混乱防止を得ても的中の火傷は残る。攻撃後: Beat Tanglecleaver with a strong skill. Even with 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention, on-hit Burn remains. It ends the turn after attacking; equip defense skills on the other Sinners.
messages.6枚の大技へ勝ち、次の隙に集中する: Beat the 6-Coin finisher and exploit the next opening
messages.小指 天退星雷横の段階では超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬へ変化。6枚破壊不能、加重値3〜7で大: During Lei Heng, The Pinky's Tiantui Star, the finisher becomes Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades. Its 6 Unbreakable Coins and 3–7 Attack Weight cause heavy attrition. Prepare healing and powerful skills before crossing the HP threshold.
messages.勝つと被害80%減・その技のダメージでは混乱しなくなる。出血・火傷など別のダメー: Winning reduces its damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage. This does not protect against separate damage such as Bleed or Burn. Use resistance and defense skills on Sinners who are not clashing to limit remaining hits.
messages.大技後のオーバーヒートでは敵に脆弱・マッチ威力減少が付く。その機会へ火力を集中し: After the finisher, Overheat gives the enemy Fragile and Clash Power Down. Concentrate damage during that opening to reach the ending event. Roughly 800 HP remaining is an estimate, not an exact ending threshold.
messages.対象の火傷と振動の合計4につき、最終威力+1(最大2): Final Power +1 for every 4 total Burn and Tremor on the target (max 2)
messages.火傷と振動で最終威力が上がる。勝てる通常技で止め、後の強化条件を作らせない。: Burn and Tremor increase Final Power. Stop it with a winning regular skill to avoid enabling later bonuses.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]振動1を付与、振動回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅲ[On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst. Reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.振動回数を増やし振動爆発する3枚攻撃。火傷・振動が多い担当を避け、次の混乱と強化: A 3-Coin attack that adds Tremor Count and triggers Tremor Burst. Avoid assigning a high-Burn/high-Tremor Sinner, limiting future Stagger and bonuses.
messages.対象の火傷と振動の合計4につき、最終威力+1(最大4): Final Power +1 for every 4 total Burn and Tremor on the target (max 4)
messages.[的中時]火傷3を付与、火傷回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2
messages.[的中時]振動3を付与、振動回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2
messages.こちらが勝つと弾を1減らせる。終盤のシン(心)-天退星では最後のコインが破壊不能: Winning reduces ammunition by 1. Late-fight Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] makes its last Coin Unbreakable; do not assume the base display guarantees no hits.
messages.[的中時]振動2を付与、振動回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]2回振動爆発。対象の振動回数が2減少: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Trigger Tremor Burst 2 times. Reduce the target's Tremor Count by 2
messages.こちらのマッチ勝利で弾を1減らす。中盤以降は最後が破壊不能。爆砕斬より先に処理し: Winning reduces ammunition by 1. From the middle phase, the last Coin is Unbreakable. Resolve this before Blasting Shatterslash to reduce ammunition and prepare for the remaining hit.
messages.速度と関係なく、このスキルとマッチできる: Can be clashed regardless of Speed
messages.対象の火傷と振動の合計6につき、コイン威力+1(最大3): Coin Power +1 for every 6 total Burn and Tremor on the target (max 3)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]振動4を付与、振動回数が4増加: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 4 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 4
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]振動-灼熱へ振幅変換: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Scorch
messages.このコイン効果で虎標弾を消耗したなら、ダメージ量+50%: If this Coin effect consumed a Tigermark Round, deal +50% damage
messages.[的中時]火傷3を付与、火傷回数が3増加: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Burn and increase Burn Count by 3
messages.3枚すべて破壊不能。速度に関係なくマッチできるため、後ろに行動する囚人で担当し、: All 3 Coins are Unbreakable. It can be clashed regardless of Speed; assign a later-acting Sinner so other skills reduce ammunition first. Empty ammunition does not cancel the attack, but limits Burn application.
messages.速度と関係なく、このスキルとマッチでき、このスキルを使用するまで混乱状態にならな: Can be clashed regardless of Speed; cannot be Staggered until this skill is used
messages.[使用時]底力を全て消耗。消耗した数値が: [On Use] Consume all Inner Strength. Depending on the amount consumed:
messages.-25の場合、メインターゲットの火傷と振動の合計4につき、最終威力+1(最大5): - At 25, Final Power +1 for every 4 total Burn and Tremor on the main target (max 5)
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージが80%だけ減少し、このスキルのダメージによって対象が混乱: [On Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger targets. Halve inflicted Burn Potency/Count and Tremor Potency/Count (excluding changes from other effects)
messages.-猛虎標弾を保有しているなら、かわりに再装填-残弾維持(1ターンにつき1回): - If holding Savage Tigermark Rounds, instead Reload while retaining remaining ammunition (once per turn)
messages.[的中時]消耗した虎標弾だけ火傷を付与、火傷回数が増加、振動を付与、振動回数が増: [On Hit] Inflict Burn and Tremor and increase their Counts by the number of Tigermark Rounds consumed
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]3回振動爆発。対象の振動回数が3減少: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Trigger Tremor Burst 3 times. Reduce the target's Tremor Count by 3
messages.勝つと威力減少・麻痺に加えダメージ80%減、その技では混乱しなくなる。1枚は破壊: Winning applies Power Down and Paralyze, reduces damage by 80%, and prevents Stagger from this skill. 1 Coin remains Unbreakable. It ends the turn after attacking, so healing scheduled afterward will not resolve.
messages.超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬: Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬]
messages.-25以上なら、メインターゲットの火傷と振動の合計4につき、最終威力+1(最大6: - At 25+, Final Power +1 for every 4 total Burn and Tremor on the main target (max 6)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]5回振動爆発。対象の振動回数が5減少: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Trigger Tremor Burst 5 times. Reduce the target's Tremor Count by 5
messages.6枚すべて破壊不能、基礎加重値3から最大7。勝つとダメージ80%減とその技の混乱: All 6 Coins are Unbreakable; base Attack Weight 3 rises to 7. Winning reduces damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from that skill. Heal everyone beforehand and equip defense skills on those not clashing. Offense Level is unconfirmed.
messages.表示の種別は斬撃だが、効果欄に従ってマッチ可能反撃として掲載。勝つと弾が1減るの: Its listed type is Slash, but it is presented as a Clashable Counter based on its effects. Winning reduces ammunition by 1; resolve it before Blasting Shatterslash. A footnote places Reload at Turn End, but reported bugs make its behavior uncertain.
messages.[ターン終了時]自分が生き残っているなら、レイホンに猛虎標弾6を付与: [Turn End] If alive, grant Lei Heng 6 Savage Tigermark Rounds
messages.1ターンだけ出る補給役。倒せば補給を止められるが、本体の攻撃は続く。倒すために必: A supply unit appearing for 1 turn. Killing it prevents resupply, but the boss keeps attacking. Do not sacrifice essential clashes or boss damage to kill it.
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、精神力が0になる\nパニック状態が解除されると次:
If Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 0.
When Panic ends, at the next Turn Start recover SP equal to the percentage of HP lost (max 30).
messages.次ターンに失ったHPに応じて精神力も戻る。沈潜だけで無力化し続けるとは考えない。: Recovers SP next turn based on lost HP. Do not assume Sinking can keep the boss disabled indefinitely.
messages.パニック上書きに頼らず、弾・獲物・守備と回復で対処する。: Handle ammunition and Prey with defense and healing rather than replacing its Panic type.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜による被ダメージ量-30%\n虎標弾を消耗するコイン:
Take 30% less damage from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking.
When tossing a Coin that consumes Tigermark Rounds without ammunition, do not cancel the attack; that Coin's on-hit Burn and Burn Count effects do not activate instead.
During a clash, increase the target's Tremor Count by (1 + clash exchanges ÷ 3).
(Max 3; applies at most 3 times per target per turn.)
messages.弾切れでも攻撃は中止されない。火傷付与が減る利点と、残る被弾を分けて考える。: Empty ammunition does not cancel attacks. Distinguish reduced Burn application from the hits that still remain.
messages.ステージ開始時とパターンが変更されるターン開始時、\n-切斬1を得る\n-自分の:
At encounter start and at Turn Start when patterns change:
- Gain 1 Slash Power Up.
- Heal 5 SP for every 10% HP lost (max 40).
messages.失ったHPに応じて敵の精神力が戻る。移行前の低精神力だけで次のマッチを判断しない: The enemy recovers SP based on lost HP. Do not judge the next clash only from its low SP before transition.
messages.ターン開始時、前ターンにて自分へ最もダメージを与えた対象へ獲物1を付与\nレイホ:
At Turn Start, inflict 1 Prey on the target that dealt the most damage to self last turn.
After Lei Heng attacks a target with Prey:
- If Staggered, all enemies lose 10 SP and gain 1 Clash Power Down this turn and next turn (once per turn).
- If killed, activate the above effect once more.
messages.前ターンに最多ダメージを与えた囚人: Sinner who dealt the most damage last turn
messages.次ターンの主力が獲物になる。マッチ威力低下を見て、強い技か守備へ切り替える。: A main damage dealer becomes next turn's Prey. Account for reduced Clash Power and use a strong skill or defend.
messages.一方攻撃的中時、ダメージ量が30%増加し、次のターンに脆弱1を付与\n虎標弾を消:
On Hit with a one-sided attack, deal +30% damage and inflict 1 Fragile next turn.
Coins that consume Tigermark Rounds and hit deal +20% damage and inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.
These effects do not apply if the target has equipped a defense skill.
messages.守備を装着した相手には一部の追加効果が適用されない。大技の非マッチ担当にも守備を: Some additional effects do not apply against targets with defense skills equipped. Prepare defense skills for Sinners not clashing against finishers too.
messages.強力な攻撃(「快刀乱麻」「超絶猛虎殺劇乱斬」)を使用したなら、この戦闘の間に強力: After using a powerful attack (Tanglecleaver or Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades), gain Overheat next turn equal to the number of powerful attacks used in this encounter (max 5).
messages.次ターンに敵が脆弱とマッチ威力減少を得る。回復を先に整え、その隙へ火力を集中する: Next turn, the enemy gains Fragile and Clash Power Down. Prepare healing first, then concentrate damage during the opening.
messages.boss-copy:lei-heng:passives.7.name: Chachihu [揷翅虎]
messages.戦闘開始時、自分の速度に比例して\n-数値だけ精神力を回復。精神力が0未満なら回:
At Combat Start, based on own Speed:
- Heal that much SP; double this recovery if below 0 SP.
- Gain (Speed ÷ 3) Slash Damage Up (max 5).
At Combat Start with 3+ Bind, these effects do not activate; instead gain Defense Level Down equal to own Bind (max 9).
messages.束縛3以上で精神力回復・斬撃強化が止まり、防御低下へ変わる。前ターンから束縛を用: At 3+ Bind, SP recovery and Slash buffs stop and become Defense Level Down. Use Bind from the previous turn when available.
messages.ターン終了時に体力が90%以下になるか、2ターン目終了時、虎標弾を装填して次のタ:
At Turn End at 90% HP or lower, or at the end of turn 2, load Tigermark Rounds and change patterns next turn.
- If Staggered, recover from Stagger.
messages.HP90%以下・2ターン目終了: 90% HP or lower / end of turn 2
messages.以後は弾を使う技になる。HPだけでなく経過ターンでも進む。: Subsequent skills consume ammunition. Progress depends on elapsed turns as well as HP.
messages.ターン終了時に体力が80%以下になるか、4ターン目終了時に次のターンにパターンが:
At Turn End at 80% HP or lower, or at the end of turn 4, change patterns next turn.
Use the powerful attack Tanglecleaver, repeating every 3 turns. On its turns, minimum and maximum Speed +10.
- At that Turn Start, gain 25 Inner Strength.
- If Staggered, recover from Stagger.
messages.HP80%以下・4ターン目終了: 80% HP or lower / end of turn 4
messages.次に快刀亂麻。速くなっても速度に関係なくマッチできるので、強い担当を選ぶ。: Tanglecleaver comes next. Despite increased Speed, it can be clashed regardless of Speed; choose a strong handler.
messages.ターン終了時点で体力が60%以下になるか、次のターンに強力な攻撃(「快刀乱麻」):
At Turn End at 60% HP or lower, or if next turn would be the second use of Tanglecleaver in this encounter, change patterns next turn.
- At that Turn Start, gain 1 Tiantui Star.
- At that Turn Start, gain 18 Savage Tigermark Rounds and load them immediately.
- After consuming all Savage Tigermark Rounds, replace this effect with Tigermark Rounds and summon 2 Rigid Soldati of the Thumb next turn to resupply Savage Tigermark Rounds.
- If Staggered, recover from Stagger.
messages.HP60%以下・2回目の強攻撃前: 60% HP or lower / before the second powerful attack
messages.猛虎標弾18と威力強化で被害が増える。弾を減らす順番と回復を優先する。: 18 Savage Tigermark Rounds and Power bonuses increase damage. Prioritize ammunition order and healing.
messages.小指 天退星雷横: Lei Heng, The Pinky's Tiantui Star
messages.ターン終了時点で体力が40%以下になるか、次のターンに強力な攻撃(「快刀乱麻」):
At Turn End at 40% HP or lower, or if next turn would be the third use of Tanglecleaver in this encounter, change patterns next turn.
Replace Tanglecleaver with Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades. On its turns, minimum and maximum Speed +15.
- Replace Inner Strength with Extreme Strength.
- Replace Tiantui Star with Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星].
- If Staggered, recover from Stagger.
messages.大技が6枚破壊不能へ変わり、通常技も強化。境界前からHPと強いマッチを準備する。: The finisher becomes 6 Unbreakable Coins, and regular skills strengthen too. Prepare HP and strong clashes before the threshold.
messages.ターン開始時、脆弱5を得る\nターン終了時、レイホンへ猛虎標弾を支給する\n\n:
At Turn Start, gain 5 Fragile.
At Turn End, supply Lei Heng with Savage Tigermark Rounds.

On Death, cannot resupply Lei Heng; he gains 1 Fragile and 1 Clash Power Down next turn.
messages.倒せれば補給を止めて本体を弱めるが、無理なら本体の削りを優先。1ターンで離脱する: Killing it stops resupply and weakens the boss; otherwise, prioritize boss damage. Do not overcommit to a unit that withdraws after 1 turn.
messages.2ターン目に全キャラクターの攻撃・防御Lvを平均化し、味方はさらに攻撃Lv+3・: On turn 2, average all characters' Offense/Defense Levels, then grant allies +3 Offense Level and +6 Defense Level. This first release lasts for the encounter.
messages.表の平均化前のLvと、戦闘中の実値を区別する。最大HPまで育成済みになるわけでは: Distinguish the table's pre-averaging Levels from current in-combat values. Maximum HP does not become that of a fully leveled Identity.
messages.マッチ威力−5。攻撃装着ならレイホンへの与ダメージ50%減、守備装着なら被ダメー: Clash Power -5. With an attack skill equipped, deal 50% less damage to Lei Heng; with a defense skill equipped, take 75% less damage. On Clash Win, gain 3 E.G.O resources of the least-owned type. Expires at Turn End and heals 10 SP.
messages.弱い技で負け続けず、守備の大幅軽減か勝てる強い技を選ぶ。: Choose the substantial defensive reduction or a strong winning skill rather than repeatedly losing with weak skills.
messages.技で消費する弾。弾なしでも攻撃は続くが、そのコインの火傷付与が発動しない。猛虎標: Ammunition consumed by skills. Attacks continue without it, but that Coin's Burn application does not activate. Savage Tigermark Rounds grant +30% damage to consuming Coins and double Burn application.
messages.爆砕斬より先に弾を消費させ、マッチ勝利後の被弾を抑える。: Spend ammunition before Blasting Shatterslash to limit hits after a clash win.
messages.マッチや一方攻撃で増え、大技に消費。敵のマッチ敗北でそのマッチで得た数値が失われ: Build through clashes and one-sided attacks, then are consumed by finishers. Losing a clash removes the amount gained during that clash. Inner Strength caps at 25; Extreme Strength at 50.
messages.一方攻撃を通さず勝つ。大技の加重値と強化を増やさせない。: Win clashes and stop one-sided attacks to limit the finisher's Attack Weight and bonuses.
messages.天退星・シン(心)-天退星: Tiantui Star / Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星]
messages.失ったHPや速度差で威力・被害が増え、通常技の最後を破壊不能にする。中盤は三連撃: Lost HP and Speed difference increase Power and damage, and make regular skills' final Coins Unbreakable. Applies to “Triple Slash” - Blast in the middle phase and “Double Slash” - Blast in the final phase too.
messages.同じ技でも後半は被弾が残る。現在の状態で担当と回復を選び直す。: The same skill can leave hits in later phases. Reassign handlers and healing based on current statuses.
messages.大技後に得る弱体化。開始時に数値分のマッチ威力減少・脆弱を得て、終了時に数値が減: A debuff gained after finishers. At Turn Start, gain Clash Power Down and Fragile equal to its value; at Turn End, reduce its value. Max 5.
messages.大技前に回復し、大技後の削る機会へ手数を残す。: Heal before the finisher and retain actions for the damage window afterward.
messages.振動爆発時に振動と火傷の合計の半分だけ憤怒ダメージを受け、振動回数を消費する。: On Tremor Burst, take Wrath damage equal to half the total Tremor and Burn, consuming Tremor Count.
messages.火傷と振動が多い囚人へ振動爆発を重ねられないようにする。: Avoid repeated Tremor Bursts against Sinners with high Burn and Tremor.
messages.ケセドの慈悲は攻防Lvの平均化。最大HPは低レベルのままなので、育成を全て省ける: Chesed's Mercy averages Offense/Defense Levels. Maximum HP remains at the Identity's current level; leveling cannot be skipped entirely.
messages.爆砕斬に勝っても3枚が残る。処理順で先に弾を減らし、耐性と守備・回復で受ける。: All 3 Blasting Shatterslash Coins remain after winning. Reduce ammunition beforehand through action order, then use resistance, defense, and healing.
messages.大技2種は攻撃後にターンを終える。回復・追撃を大技の後へ置かない。: Both finishers end the turn after attacking. Do not schedule healing or follow-ups after them.
messages.HPだけでなくターン経過でも強化される。回復だけで安全に待ち続ける戦法にはしない: The boss strengthens through elapsed turns as well as HP loss. Healing alone cannot safely stall indefinitely.
messages.マッチ勝利時の混乱防止は、その技のダメージに対するもの。火傷などでの死亡は防がれ: Stagger prevention after a clash win applies only to that skill's damage. It does not prevent death from Burn or other sources.
messages.鏡の隠しレイホンと通常ストーリーは技の効果が違う。鏡側の追加軽減を混ぜない。: The hidden Mirror Dungeon Lei Heng and regular story encounter have different skill effects. Do not add the Mirror version's extra damage reduction here.
messages.推奨Lv55・同期Ⅲ以上。7名＋控え5名、ホンル必須。回復と斬撃耐性、後半の火力: Recommended Level 55 and Uptie III or higher. Bring 7 Sinners and 5 reserves, including Hong Lu, with healing, Slash resistance, and late-fight damage.
messages.暴食・嫉妬の火力と、高威力のマッチ担当を確保。束縛や回避を使えるなら組み合わせる: Prepare Gluttony/Envy damage and powerful clash handlers. Add Bind or Evade when available.
messages.先に弾を減らし、火傷と破壊不能の被害を抑える。: Reduce ammunition first to limit Burn and Unbreakable damage.
messages.獲物の軽減や事前回復で大技を受け切る。: Survive finishers through Prey's reduction and healing beforehand.
messages.オーバーヒートの脆弱を使い、ターン経過で強くなる前に削る。: Exploit Overheat's Fragile before the boss strengthens further over time.
messages.【リンバス】8-33 ジア・ムー／混覚轀輬黒獣の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 8-33 Jia Mu / Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)8-33「ジア・ムー／混覚轀輬黒獣」の攻: Jia Mu / Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin guide for Limbus Company 8-33. A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; after the Distortion, handle the Precious Jade, Palanquin, and elders in that order. Once Happiness is active, use Hong Lu's clash wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.

messages.ジア・ムー／混覚轀輬黒獣: Jia Mu / Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin
messages.6段階の長期戦。序盤はホンルを守り、ねじれ後は宝玉→輿→ご老人の順で妨害源を処理: A 6-phase endurance fight. Protect Hong Lu early; after the Distortion, handle the Precious Jade, Palanquin, and elders in that order. Once Happiness is active, use Hong Lu's clash wins to replenish resources and sustain healing.
messages.8-33通常戦。ホンル必須、出撃7名＋控え5名。攻防欄は不感応（+2）・怪力乱神: The regular 8-33 encounter. Hong Lu is required; deploy 7 Sinners with 5 reserves. Offense/Defense entries show base values before Malattunement (+2), Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits (+4), and other buffs. The Distorted body's 4759 HP is separate from the Torso's 4333 and Palanquin's 474 part HP. Listed phase-transition HP values differ: roughly 4100 / 2850–2900 / 1900–2000 / 700–720. Do not treat them as exact thresholds.
messages.長い技名は全文で掲載し、攻略では瞳の力と特別さを／惨めに死ぬがよいなどと略記する: Full skill names appear in the skill list; the walkthrough shortens the long names to the eye's powers attack or the insect's death attack. Conditional Unbreakable Coins are listed in effects, separately from fixed Unbreakable Coins. The Palanquin and Torso share a defense skill name but have different Unbreakable Coin listings.
messages.喜びを得るまではホンルの死亡で敗北。速度を使って攻撃を引き取る。: Hong Lu's death causes defeat until Happiness is gained. Use faster Sinners to redirect attacks.
messages.宝玉は自爆前に破壊、輿は摘出、ご老人5体は全員HP1へ。: Destroy the Precious Jade before it explodes, extract the Palanquin, and reduce all 5 elders to 1 HP.
messages.瞳の力と特別さをの主対象をホンルから外し、回復の資源を確保する。: Redirect the eye's powers attack away from Hong Lu as main target, and secure resources for healing.
messages.序盤にホンルが倒れて終わる: Hong Lu dies early and the fight ends
messages.初めから不死身ではない。速い囚人や束縛で危険な攻撃を引き取り、精神力・HP回復を: He is not immortal from the start. Use faster Sinners or Bind to redirect dangerous attacks, and use SP/HP recovery early. Protect him until Happiness is gained.
messages.ねじれ後のHPが減らない: The Distorted form's HP will not decrease
messages.宝玉と輿、ご老人がバリアを供給する。いま出現している供給源へ火力を向ける。宝玉破: The Precious Jade, Palanquin, and elders supply Shield. Focus whichever source is currently present. Delaying the Jade's destruction does not extend the action cycle; it only shortens the time available to damage the boss.
messages.宝玉を壊しても広域の破壊不能が続く: Area attacks remain Unbreakable after destroying the Jade
messages.足掻くによって、瞳の力と特別さをは主対象がホンルでも破壊不能になる。ホンル以外へ: Last-ditch Struggle also makes the eye's powers attack Unbreakable when Hong Lu is its main target. Redirect it to someone else. While the Jade is alive, redirection alone does not stop the Unbreakable Coins; destroy the Jade first.
messages.ご老人を倒せない・広域で全滅する: The elders will not die, and the area attack wipes the team
messages.HP1まで削れば十分。不完全な不死に変わった個体は後回しにし、供養の前に5体すべ: Reducing them to 1 HP is enough. Leave elders with Imperfect Immortality and convert all 5 before the Offering. Even 1 remaining Sublime Immortality strengthens the finisher.
messages.不感応で基礎攻防Lv+2。さらに異なる技の使用で攻撃Lvが上がる。: Malattunement gives +2 base Offense/Defense Levels. Using different skills further raises Offense Level.
messages.HP693で次の段階へ移り、ターンが終わる。混乱直後に強い技を使い切らない。: At 693 HP, enters the next phase and ends the turn. Do not exhaust strong skills immediately after Staggering her.
messages.混覚轀輬黒獣: Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin [混覺轀輬黑獸]
messages.0%（0）／輿摘出・不完全な不死5で混乱: 0% (0) / Staggered by Palanquin extraction or 5 Imperfect Immortality
messages.フェーズ2から怪力乱神で基礎攻防Lv+4。部位表の防御+8と混同しない。: From phase 2, Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits gives +4 base Offense/Defense Levels. Do not confuse this with the part table's +8 Defense Level.
messages.1スロットの加重値3。広域の枠が本体に吸われやすいため、副対象を実際に確認する。: Each slot takes 3 Attack Weight. The body can draw area attacks' targeting capacity away from adds; check actual secondary targets.
messages.本体HPの境界で段階が変わる。胴体部位のHPを境界にしない。: Body HP determines phase transitions. Do not use Torso part HP as the threshold.
messages.混覚轀輬黒獣・輿: Muddled Heishou of the Corpse Palanquin · Palanquin
messages.フェーズ3開始時まで攻撃不可。楽の段階で動き、バリアと胴体強化を供給する。: Cannot be attacked until phase 3 begins. Becomes active in the Joy phase and supplies Shield and Torso buffs.
messages.HP0で摘出し、次ターンの胴体混乱と脆弱を狙う。技使用前に混乱しない例外もある。: Extract it at 0 HP to Stagger the Torso and inflict Fragile next turn. Some skills prevent Stagger until they are used.
messages.爆発遊戯1で生成。行動可能な仲間で自爆前に破壊する。: Created with 1 Explosive Amusement. Destroy it with the allies still able to act before it explodes.
messages.囚人による討伐で資源・回復・敵弱体化。ホンルは次ターンに復帰する。: A Sinner defeating it grants resources, healing, and enemy debuffs. Hong Lu returns next turn.
messages.HP1で至高なる不死が不完全な不死へ変わる。HP0にはならない。: At 1 HP, Sublime Immortality becomes Imperfect Immortality. HP does not reach 0.
messages.HP1になったら追加攻撃をやめ、まだ至高なる不死の個体へ移る。: Stop attacking at 1 HP and switch to elders that still have Sublime Immortality.
messages.使用時にムーの攻撃を強化するため優先して処理。: Prioritize this elder because its on-use effects strengthen Mu's attacks.
messages.長期戦の回復と、ホンルを守る速度を用意: Bring sustained healing and enough Speed to protect Hong Lu
messages.推奨Lv55、出撃7名＋控え5名。ホンルは初期出撃必須でレンタルも使える。回復E: Recommended Level 55; deploy 7 Sinners with 5 reserves. Hong Lu must deploy initially, and a borrowed Identity is available. Check healing E.G.O, required resource affinities, and reserve levels.
messages.色欲・暴食・傲慢・嫉妬が通りやすい。属性だけで編成を固めず、強いマッチ・広域・H: Lust, Gluttony, Pride, and Envy work well. Do not build solely around affinities; prepare strong clashes, area attacks, and HP/SP recovery.
messages.支援の組み合わせにも注意。蜘蛛の巣良秀と薬指ホンルでは、良秀の回避に伴う味方への: Check support combinations too. With Spiderweb Ryōshū and Ring Hong Lu, the allied effect associated with Ryōshū's Evade can endanger Hong Lu. Check its conditions before using both during the opening, when his protection is not yet active.
messages.ホンルへの攻撃を引き取り、HP693まで削る: Redirect attacks from Hong Lu and reduce Mu to 693 HP
messages.敵はホンルへ集中する。速い囚人で危険な攻撃を引き取り、束縛・回復でホンルを守る。: The enemy focuses Hong Lu. Use faster Sinners to redirect dangerous attacks, with Bind and healing to protect him. His death causes defeat.
messages.巳・混は広域、酉は3枚破壊不能。勝っても被弾が残るのでHPを戻す。全黒仙丸 -: Si and Hun are area attacks; You has 3 Unbreakable Coins. Heal because hits remain after clash wins. “Completed Heixian Bolus - You [酉] - Defense” is a Clashable Guard and cannot be Offset by defense skills.
messages.HP693で段階が変わりターン終了。混乱区間762からすぐなので、大きな技を過剰: At 693 HP, the phase changes and the turn ends. This is shortly after the 762 Stagger threshold; avoid committing excessive powerful skills and save damage for the next Precious Jade.
messages.宝玉を早く壊し、ホンルを戻す: Destroy the Jade quickly and bring Hong Lu back
messages.最初の宝玉揺籃は通常のホンルなら勝っても宝玉化を防げない。君主ホンルの専用支援で: For ordinary Hong Lu Identities, winning the first “Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃]” does not prevent imprisonment. His Lord Identity's exclusive support can prevent it from this stage. The old Assist Defense bug that skipped imprisonment has been fixed; do not rely on it.
messages.生成された宝玉HP171へ色欲・暴食の火力を集中。可能なら出現した最初、遅くとも: Focus Lust/Gluttony damage on the 171-HP Jade. Destroy it on its first action turn if possible, or its second at the latest. Its turn 3 explosion heavily buffs Mu.
messages.宝玉がある間は毎ターンのバリア200で本体が削りにくい。倒すと回復・全属性資源3: While the Jade is alive, 200 Shield every turn makes the boss hard to damage. Defeating it grants healing, 3 of every E.G.O resource, and enemy debuffs; Hong Lu returns next turn. The 5-turn cycle does not extend based on when it is destroyed, so earlier destruction creates more time to attack the boss.
messages.本体HP約4100で次へ。広域へ必要なマッチを確保し、宝玉の破壊を遅らせない。: The next phase begins around 4100 body HP. Maintain necessary clashes against area attacks and do not delay destroying the Jade.
messages.ホンルが宝玉揺籃へ勝ち、資源を補給する: Have Hong Lu beat Precious Jade's Cradle to replenish resources
messages.喜びを得たホンルは、ほかの味方が1人以上生きている間は致死ダメージでHP50%回: With Happiness, Hong Lu recovers 50% HP upon lethal damage while at least 1 other ally is alive. Clash wins against Mu grant a total of 3 resources of the least-owned affinities. Keep other allies alive too.
messages.宝玉揺籃へホンルで勝てば宝玉化を阻止。喜びにはこの段階で1回だけ無条件の阻止もあ: Hong Lu winning against “Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃]” prevents imprisonment. Happiness also prevents it unconditionally once in this phase; do not treat that as repeatable protection.
messages.瞳の力と特別さをは、足掻くがあるとホンルが主対象でも破壊不能になる。こちらは別の: With Last-ditch Struggle, the eye's powers attack becomes Unbreakable when Hong Lu is main target too. Redirect this one to another Sinner; use other skills for Hong Lu's resource generation.
messages.本体HP約2850〜2900で次の段階へ。資料の部位欄と攻略欄で境界が異なるため: The next phase begins around 2850–2900 body HP. The part table and walkthrough give different thresholds; check the actual phase display.
messages.輿を壊し、バリアと強化を止める: Destroy the Palanquin to stop Shield and buffs
messages.輿が動き、本体・胴体へ最大HP10%のバリアと次ターンの強化を供給する。胴体だけ: The Palanquin becomes active, supplying the body and Torso with Shield equal to 10% maximum HP and buffs for next turn. Focus and extract the 474-HP Palanquin rather than attacking only the Torso.
messages.謹んで拝謁するがよいは速度に関係なくマッチできる。勝って半減し、広域の被害を抑え: “Be honored to be in audience of such a great man” can be clashed regardless of Speed. Win to halve its damage and limit area damage; this does not cancel the on-use Torso buffs.
messages.惨めに死ぬがよいは本体HP50%未満で破壊不能。必ず勝てる担当を用意し、回復も行: The insect's death attack becomes Unbreakable below 50% body HP. Prepare a reliable clash winner and healing. Exploit Torso Stagger and Fragile after extracting the Palanquin, then progress around 1900–2000 HP.
messages.仙人様よ…！は次ターンにご老人5体を生成し、攻撃後にターン終了。召喚は戦闘開始時: “O Xianren...!” creates 5 elders next turn and ends the turn after attacking. The summon is a Combat Start effect and cannot be stopped by a clash win.
messages.生成後は3ターンを目安に全員をHP1へ落とす。攻撃強化を配る地を優先し、HP1に: Aim to reduce everyone to 1 HP within about 3 turns after spawning. Prioritize Earthly Elders, which provide attack buffs; stop spending actions on elders already at 1 HP. The body's slot weight of 3 can absorb area targeting capacity; check actual secondary targets.
messages.5体すべてが不完全な不死なら、極仙搾滴供養で味方にバリア200が付き、吸収後にム: If all 5 have Imperfect Immortality, the Offering grants allies 200 Shield, and Mu can be Staggered after absorbing 5 Imperfect Immortality. Even 1 remaining Sublime Immortality produces dangerous buffs.
messages.老人をHP1にすると精神力・資源を得られる。回復と残りの処理に使い、本体HP約7: Reducing elders to 1 HP grants SP and resources. Use these for healing and the remaining elders; enter the final phase around 700–720 body HP.
messages.最初の広域2本に備え、最後まで削る: Prepare for the opening 2 area attacks and finish the fight
messages.ホンルは最終威力+5と資源獲得、仲間生存条件付きの致死ダメージからの回復を得る。: Hong Lu gains +5 Final Power, resource generation, and recovery from lethal damage while another ally survives. Heal to avoid losing every other Sinner.
messages.初手の惨めに死ぬがよい2本は破壊不能・加重値3。マッチ勝利で半減と混乱防止を得て: The opening 2 insect's death attacks are Unbreakable with 3 Attack Weight. A clash win halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill, but does not prevent Bleed or Rupture damage.
messages.ご老人がいない極仙搾滴供養はバリア200を付けるため、強いマッチを取りつつ削る。: Without elders, the Offering grants 200 Shield. Keep winning strong clashes and damaging the boss; this phase ends by reducing body HP to 0.

messages.対象の体力が50%以上なら、コイン威力+2: If the target has 50%+ HP, Coin Power +2

messages.Ⅱ[的中時]体力を最大値の20%回復: Ⅱ[On Hit] Heal 20% of maximum HP
messages.的中すると自身を回復する2枚技。主対象HP50%以上でコイン威力が上がる。勝ちつ: A 2-Coin skill that heals the user on hit. Coin Power increases against a main target with 50%+ HP. Win and reduce the elder to 1 HP that turn.
messages.[使用時]次のターンにジア・ムーへ攻撃威力増加1,ダメージ量増加1を付与: [On Use] Grant Jia Mu 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn
messages.使用時に次ターンのムーの攻撃を強化する。地のご老人を先にHP1へ落とす理由になる: On use, strengthens Mu's attacks next turn. This is a reason to reduce Earthly Elders to 1 HP first. Clash wins alone do not cancel on-use support.
messages.不完全な不死になった後の防御。追加攻撃で倒そうとせず、別のご老人へ手数を向ける。: Defense after gaining Imperfect Immortality. Spend actions on other elders rather than trying to finish this one with extra attacks.
messages.的中時に自身を回復する。マッチ勝利と集中攻撃でHP1へ落とし、回復の対象からも外: Heals itself on hit. Win clashes and focus damage to reduce it to 1 HP, also excluding it from healing targets.
messages.[使用時]次のターンにジア・ムーへ守備威力増加1,保護1を付与: [On Use] Grant Jia Mu 1 Defense Power Up and 1 Protection next turn
messages.使用時に次ターンのムーへ守備威力増加・保護を付ける。手数のあるうちにHP1へ落と: Grants Mu Defense Power Up and Protection for next turn on use. Reduce it to 1 HP while actions are available.
messages.資料に追加効果なし。至高なる不死が残ったほかの個体を優先する。: No additional effects are listed. Prioritize other elders still holding Sublime Immortality.
messages.沈潜などを使う場合も、パニックの置き換えによる無力化を前提にしない。: Even with Sinking, do not assume replacing Panic type will disable her.
messages.基礎攻防Lvに2が加わる。表は効果適用前で、実際のマッチ予測を確認する。: Adds 2 to base Offense/Defense Levels. The table is before this effect; check actual clash predictions.
messages.古より鴻園は仙人たちの意のままに導かれてきた: Hongyuan has always been a putty in the hands of the revered Xianren
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、次のターンにパニック状態を解除して精神力を0に初:
If Panicked at Turn End, recover from Panic next turn and reset SP to 0.
When Panic ends, gain 2 Attack Power Up and 2 Defense Power Up at the next Turn Start; if Hong Lu has Hollow Obedience, heal 15 SP.
messages.解除後は精神力0と威力強化。パニックだけで無力化し続ける計画にはしない。: Panic recovery resets SP to 0 and adds Power buffs. Do not plan to keep her disabled through Panic alone.
messages.バオユや、ここで家主の代が途絶えてはならぬ…。: Little Baoyu, the lineage of Family Hierarchs cannot end here...
messages.ホンル死亡時に戦闘敗北。全スキルがホンルを優先ターゲットする。: Hong Lu's death causes defeat. All skills prioritize Hong Lu.
messages.ホンル死亡・攻撃対象決定: Hong Lu's death / choosing attack targets
messages.序盤はホンルの生存が必須。速い囚人で対象を引き取り、回復を優先する。: Hong Lu must survive the opening. Redirect attacks with faster Sinners and prioritize healing.
messages.誰がご老人方のお世話をし、仙皇蟲様の意を鴻園に広めるというのだ！！！: Who shall serve the elders, who shall convey the revered Xianhuang Worm's will to Hongyuan then?!!!
messages.ホンルにマッチ勝利後的中時、積み上がる従順1を付与(スキルごとに1回): On Hit After Clash Win against Hong Lu, inflict 1 Heaping Obedience (once per skill)
messages.ホンルへマッチ勝利後に的中: Hitting Hong Lu after winning a clash
messages.積み上がる従順から空虚な従順へ進めさせない。勝てない攻撃は別の囚人へ引き取る。: Prevent Heaping Obedience from progressing into Hollow Obedience. Redirect attacks Hong Lu cannot beat to another Sinner.
messages.鴻園禁断 - 全黒仙丸: Forbidden Pill of Hongyuan - Completed Heixian Bolus [全黑仙丸]
messages.互いにちがう種類のスキルを使用する度に攻撃レベル増加1,防御レベル減少1を得る(: Each time a different skill type is used, gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Down (3 times per turn)
messages.異なる種類のスキル使用・1ターン最大3回: Using different skill types / at most 3 times per turn
messages.敵の攻撃Lvが上がり防御Lvが下がる。開始時の数値だけで最後の攻撃まで判断しない: The enemy's Offense Level rises and Defense Level falls. Do not judge the final attack only from the starting values.
messages.ホンル死亡時に戦闘敗北。ターン開始時、自分の召喚したユニットがいれば精神力を10: Hong Lu's death causes defeat. At Turn Start, heal 10 SP if a unit summoned by self is present
messages.喜びの保護は仲間が1人以上生存していることが条件。ほかの囚人まで失わない。: Happiness protects Hong Lu only while at least 1 other ally survives. Keep the other Sinners alive too.
messages.フェーズ2開始時、怪力乱神を得る: At the start of phase 2, gain Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits
messages.怪力乱神による基礎攻防Lv+4を含めて予測を見る。表の強化前の値と区別する。: Include the +4 base Offense/Defense Levels from Supernatural, Strength, Chaos, and Spirits in predictions. Distinguish these from the table's pre-buff values.
messages.全ての家主は仙皇蟲さまに身を捧げ、その志を受け継いできたというのに: Every Family Hierarch has the duty to surrender their bodies to the Xianhuang Worm and his honored will
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、次のターンにパニック状態を解除して精神力を0に初:
If Panicked at Turn End, recover from Panic next turn and reset SP to 0.
When Panic ends:
- Gain 2 Attack Power Up, 2 Defense Power Up, and 1 Haste at the next Turn Start.
- Heal 15 SP if a summoned unit is present.
Heal 15 SP if Hong Lu has Hollow Obedience.
messages.召喚ユニットや空虚な従順による精神力回復もある。宝玉・ご老人の処理を優先する。: Summons and Hollow Obedience also restore SP. Prioritize the Precious Jade and elders.
messages.金玉其外 敗絮其中: Rot and Decay in the Husk of Gold and Jade [金玉其外 敗絮其中]
messages.破裂が10以上付与されているときの被ダメージ量+10%\n付与されたマイナス効果:
Take +10% damage while afflicted with 10+ Rupture.
Take +10% damage while afflicted with 5+ negative effects.
messages.被ダメージ増加を使えるが、ギミック担当を崩してまで状態異常をそろえない。: Exploit increased damage taken, but do not disrupt mechanic assignments just to stack statuses.
messages.仙皇蟲が宿らぬ当主は、鴻園のために動くはずもない: A Family Hierarch without the revered Xianhuang Worm will never serve Hongyuan
messages.体力が0になると、胴体部位が次のターンに混乱状態になる\n以降摘出された状態にな:
At 0 HP, the Torso part becomes Staggered next turn.
Afterward, this part is extracted and the Torso gains 2 Fragile.
messages.輿を破壊・摘出すると次ターンに胴体混乱と脆弱2を狙える。本体を0にしなくてもよい: Destroying and extracting the Palanquin can Stagger the Torso and inflict 2 Fragile next turn. This does not mean body HP need not reach 0.
messages.このユニットが生きている間、ターン開始時にジア・ムーの本体と全部位がバリア200: While this unit is alive, Jia Mu's body and all parts gain 200 Shield at Turn Start
messages.宝玉が生きているターン開始: Turn Start while the Jade is alive
messages.本体より宝玉へ集中し、バリアの供給源を断つ。: Focus the Jade instead of the body to cut off the Shield source.
messages.このユニットが生きている間、閉じ込められているキャラクターへ以下の効果が適用され:
While this unit is alive, apply the following effect to the imprisoned character:
- Cannot act.
messages.ホンルは行動できない。他の囚人でHP171を削る手数を確保する。: Hong Lu cannot act. Ensure other Sinners have enough actions to remove its 171 HP.
messages.このユニットが倒されると、閉じ込められているキャラクターが次のターンに戦闘へ復帰: When this unit is defeated, the imprisoned character returns to combat next turn.
messages.ホンルの復帰は次ターン。倒した同じターンに動ける前提で組まない。: Hong Lu returns next turn. Do not plan for him to act on the turn the Jade is defeated.
messages.破邪顕正: Refute the Evil; Restore Justice [破邪顯正]
messages.このユニットが囚人たちに倒されると下記の効果が発動する\n-全味方の精神力を10:
When Sinners defeat this unit:
- All allies heal 10 SP and gain 2 Damage Up next turn.
- Inflict 5 Bind, 3 Offense Level Down, and 5 Fragile on Jia Mu for 2 turns starting next turn.
- Restore the imprisoned character's SP to 45; on return, they gain 2 Attack Power Up.
- Gain 3 of every E.G.O resource.
messages.味方の回復と全属性資源3、ムーの弱体化を得る。自爆との違いが大きいので、討伐を優: Grants allied healing, 3 of every resource, and debuffs on Mu. This differs substantially from self-destruction; prioritize defeating it.
messages.至高なる不死の仙人様よ: O The Supreme Xianren of Immortality
messages.毎ターンのバリア供給。見かけの残りHPだけで本体へ集中しない。: Supplies Shield every turn. Do not focus the body solely based on its apparent remaining HP.
messages.不老不死は永遠に続かん: Let us be eternally free from aging and death
messages.体力が1未満にならない\n体力が1になるとき、至高なる不死効果が不完全な不死に変:
HP cannot fall below 1.
At 1 HP, replace Sublime Immortality with Imperfect Immortality.
messages.倒し切る必要はなくHP1で不完全な不死に変わる。5体すべてを確認する。: They do not need to die; at 1 HP they gain Imperfect Immortality. Check all 5.
messages.被ダメージ時に体力が1になると、自分を攻撃した囚人の精神力を10回復させて、数の: When damage reduces HP to 1, heal the attacking Sinner for 10 SP and grant 3 resources of a random affinity among the least-owned E.G.O resources (once while this unit is alive)
messages.被ダメージでHP1・個体ごと1回: Damage reducing HP to 1 / once per elder
messages.精神力回復と不足資源を得られる。得た資源を残りの老人処理・回復に回す。: Grants SP recovery and scarce resources. Spend them on the remaining elders and healing.
messages.基本攻撃Lv・基本防御Lv+2。: Base Offense Level and base Defense Level +2.
messages.初期形態の表は強化前。レベル差によるマッチ補正を予測で確認する。: The initial form's table is before buffs. Check level-difference clash bonuses in the prediction.
messages.基本攻撃Lv・基本防御Lv+4。: Base Offense Level and base Defense Level +4.
messages.ねじれ後の強化。部位表や技のレベル差とは別の効果として読む。: A post-Distortion buff, separate from the part table and skill-level differences.
messages.ムーとのマッチ威力−2。精神力45か数値0で解除、終了時に1減る。: Clash Power -2 against Mu. Removed at 45 SP or a value of 0; decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.序盤のホンルへ積ませず、精神力回復も用意する。: Avoid building this on Hong Lu early and bring SP recovery.
messages.終了時に3なら、次ターンに空虚な従順へ変わる。: At 3 at Turn End, becomes Hollow Obedience next turn.
messages.ホンルへの一方攻撃や、危険技の破壊されずに的中する効果を防ぐ。: Prevent one-sided hits on Hong Lu and dangerous skills' effects requiring hits without Coin destruction.
messages.boss-copy:jia-mu:mechanics.4.name: Precious Jade's Cradle
messages.閉じ込められた囚人はHP・精神力・バフが更新されない行動不能状態になり、対応する: The imprisoned Sinner cannot act, and their HP, SP, and buffs do not update. A corresponding Precious Jade is created.
messages.宝玉を囚人が壊し、次ターンの復帰と支援を得る。喜び獲得後はホンルのマッチ勝利で阻: Have Sinners destroy the Jade to gain its support and a next-turn return. After Happiness is gained, Hong Lu's clash wins can prevent imprisonment.
messages.1で生成。終了時に閉じ込めた囚人のHP25%回復・精神力20減少、数値増加。3に: Created at 1. At Turn End, heal the imprisoned Sinner for 25% HP, reduce their SP by 20, and increase this value. At 3, use the self-destruct skill; dying by self-destruction inflicts 3 Hollow Obedience on the imprisoned Sinner next turn.
messages.自爆前に壊す。自然消滅を待つのと、囚人の討伐で得る報酬は異なる。: Destroy it before it explodes. Waiting for self-destruction does not grant the rewards for a Sinner defeating it.
messages.瞳の力と特別さをの主対象がホンルなら、スキル効果と別に全コインを破壊不能にする。: If Hong Lu is main target of the eye's powers attack, make all Coins Unbreakable independently of that skill's own condition.
messages.何も出来はしないの使用後は特に確認。宝玉を壊すだけでは解除したことにならない。: Check especially after “Still, you can do nothing” is used. Destroying the Jade alone does not remove this condition.
messages.ホンルのマッチ威力+1。ほかの味方が生存していれば致死ダメージでHP50%回復。: Hong Lu gains +1 Clash Power. While another ally lives, lethal damage restores 50% HP. Prevents imprisonment once in the phase; +5 Clash Power against the imprisonment skill. Winning prevents imprisonment and clears Stagger; Mu loses 10 SP and gains 2 Fragile. Clash wins against Mu grant a total of 3 scarce E.G.O resources.
messages.第3段階からの支援。序盤の生存保証と混同せず、宝玉揺籃をホンルで担当する。: Support gained from phase 3. It does not guarantee opening survival; have Hong Lu handle “Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃]”.
messages.ホンルの最終威力+1。マッチ勝利で精神力最低の味方を5回復。仲間生存条件付きのH: Hong Lu gains +1 Final Power. On Clash Win, heal the lowest-SP ally for 5 SP. The 50% HP recovery while another ally lives and 3 resources from wins against Mu continue.
messages.楽からは最終威力の強化。回復・資源獲得を続け、輿の処理を進める。: From Joy, the buff increases Final Power. Continue healing and resource generation while handling the Palanquin.
messages.ホンルの最終威力+3。勝利時の味方精神力回復、仲間生存条件付きのHP50%回復、: Hong Lu gains +3 Final Power. Continues allied SP recovery on wins, 50% HP recovery while another ally lives, and 3 resources. When an ally dies, grant remaining allies 1 Attack Power Up next turn at Turn End (once per turn).
messages.老人処理で得る資源と併用し、ほかの仲間も生かす。: Combine this with resources from elders and keep the other allies alive.
messages.ホンルの最終威力+5。開始時に全味方の精神力5回復、仲間生存条件付きのHP50%: Hong Lu gains +5 Final Power. At Turn Start, heal all allies for 5 SP. Retains 50% HP recovery while another ally lives, 3 resources, and the buff on ally death. Damage increases by 30% of the cumulative percentage of HP lost (max 100%).
messages.最後のマッチと火力を支えるが、ほかの味方が全滅すると生存条件を失う。: Supports final clashes and damage, but the survival condition fails if every other ally dies.
messages.ご老人が保持。開始時にムーの本体と全部位へ各最大HP5%のバリア。: Held by elders. At Turn Start, give Mu's body and all parts Shield equal to 5% of their respective maximum HP.
messages.HP1へ落とし、不完全な不死に変える。供養の前に全5体を処理する。: Reduce them to 1 HP to convert to Imperfect Immortality. Handle all 5 before the Offering.
messages.老人をHP1にすると変化する状態。ムーの特定技で吸収され、ムーに付くと1につき脆: Gained when elders reach 1 HP. Absorbed by a specific Mu skill; on Mu, each stack gives 1 Fragile, and 5 stacks cause Stagger.
messages.HP1の老人を倒そうとせず、まだ至高なる不死の個体へ移る。: Do not try to kill 1-HP elders; switch to those still holding Sublime Immortality.
messages.ホンルの致死ダメージからの回復は喜びを得てから、ほかの味方1名以上の生存が条件。: Hong Lu's lethal-damage recovery starts only after Happiness is gained and requires at least 1 other living ally. It cannot be relied on during the opening or while he is the sole survivor.
messages.宝玉揺籃は攻撃後にターン終了。勝利だけで宝玉化を防げるのは支援の条件を満たす場合: “Precious Jade's Cradle [寶玉搖籃]” ends the turn after attacking. Winning alone prevents imprisonment only when the support conditions are met.
messages.瞳の力と特別さをは宝玉の有無と、足掻く・ホンルの主対象条件を別々に確認する。: For the eye's powers attack, separately check the Jade's presence and the Last-ditch Struggle / Hong Lu main-target condition.
messages.宝玉の自爆は討伐報酬にならない。囚人で壊すことを優先する。: The Jade's self-destruction does not grant defeat rewards. Prioritize destroying it with Sinners.
messages.輿と老人が供給するバリアはマッチ勝利だけで止まらない。供給源自体を処理する。: Winning clashes alone does not stop Shield from the Palanquin and elders. Handle the sources themselves.
messages.段階移行のHPは資料内で差がある。数字ぴったりの操作を前提にせず、敵の姿・行動・: Listed phase-transition HP values differ. Avoid plans requiring exact numbers; check the enemy's form, actions, and Hong Lu's support.
messages.供養などは攻撃後にターン終了。後から回復を置かず、前もって回復する。: The Offering and similar skills end the turn after attacking. Heal beforehand rather than scheduling healing afterward.
messages.推奨Lv55。ホンルを含む出撃7名＋控え5名を用意。HP・精神力の回復E.G.O: Recommended Level 55. Deploy 7 Sinners including Hong Lu, with 5 reserves. Bring HP/SP recovery E.G.O and skill affinities that supply their resources.
messages.速度・束縛、色欲・暴食の単体火力、老人用の広域を組み合わせる。特定人格や過去の不: Combine Speed, Bind, Lust/Gluttony single-target damage, and area attacks for elders. No specific Identity or old bug is required.
messages.喜び獲得前のホンルを守り、瞳の力と特別さをの主対象も外す。: Protect Hong Lu before Happiness is gained and redirect the eye's powers attack away from him as main target.
messages.宝玉・輿の集中火力: Focused damage for the Jade and Palanquin
messages.バリア供給を早く断ち、本体を削る時間を作る。: Cut off Shield sources early to create time to damage the body.
messages.ホンルの勝利・宝玉・老人の報酬を使い、長期戦の消耗を戻す。: Use rewards from Hong Lu's wins, the Jade, and elders to recover from long-fight attrition.
messages.5体をHP1へ落とす。ただし本体に吸われる加重値と副対象を確認する。: Reduce all 5 to 1 HP, checking the body's slot weight and actual secondary targets.
messages.【リンバス】5.5-22 黒雲会副組長 ジュン（5.5-22）の攻略｜Limbu: 5.5-22 Kurokumo Clan Captain Jun (5.5-22) Guide | Limbus Assistant
Kurokumo Clan Captain Jun (5.5-22) guide for Limbus Company 5.5-22. More surviving adds mean more Coins on his ordinary Counter. Protect the first Sinner to trigger it, clear the adds, then finish him after the 30% HP Stagger. “Sky-clearing Cut” retains its Combat Start buffs even after he is isolated; save strong clash skills.
messages.5.5-22「Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bon: 5.5-22 · Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones: Black Clouds
messages.取り巻きが残るほど通常反撃のコインが増える。反撃に触れる最初の囚人を守りながら取: More surviving adds mean more Coins on his ordinary Counter. Protect the first Sinner to trigger it, clear the adds, then finish him after the 30% HP Stagger. “Sky-clearing Cut” retains its Combat Start buffs even after he is isolated; save strong clash skills.
The Normal 5.5-22 boss: Level 40, 359 HP, and Defense Level 40. Slash multiplier 1.2, Pierce 0.5, Blunt neutral; all Sin resistances neutral. Hard, BokGak, and enhanced Mirror variants are excluded. Check the actual add types and numbers in combat. This is a regular encounter; do not assume the free targeting available in focused encounters.
messages.本体の全6技。裏路地の掟は基礎1枚に生存味方数で最大3枚を追加する。表示は追加前: All 6 boss skills. “Rules of the Backstreets” adds up to 3 Coins to its base 1 according to surviving allies; displayed values are before additions. Base ranges also exclude “Sky-clearing Cut”'s and “Sharp Edge”'s Combat Start buffs and Kokuuntō's constant +1.
messages.主力Lv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。斬撃の火力と、通常反撃を受ける囚人の斬撃耐: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on the main team. Bring Slash damage and Slash resistance for whoever takes the ordinary Counter.
messages.生存する取り巻きが多い間は反撃が最大4枚になる。取り巻きを減らし、最初に本体へ攻: With many surviving adds, the Counter reaches 4 Coins. Clear adds and avoid leaving the first Sinner attacking the boss at low HP.
messages.HP30%（108）の混乱を狙う。混乱前の快刀乱麻には高威力の手を残し、戦闘開始: Aim for the 30% HP (108) Stagger. Save a powerful skill for “Sky-clearing Cut” before Stagger, accounting for Combat Start buffs too.
messages.反撃で主力が一気に倒される: The Counter suddenly kills a main attacker
messages.裏路地の掟はほかの生存味方数で最大4枚になる通常反撃。守備で相殺できない。取り巻: “Rules of the Backstreets” is an ordinary Counter reaching 4 Coins based on other living allies. Defense skills cannot Offset it. Remove adds or prepare resistance and HP for the first attacker.
messages.有利表示だった快刀乱麻に負ける: “Sky-clearing Cut” wins despite a favorable prediction
messages.攻撃5つのターンの最終威力+5と鋭い刃の斬撃威力+2は戦闘開始時に発動する。黒雲: The +5 Final Power on turns with 5 attack skills and “Sharp Edge”'s +2 Slash Power activate at Combat Start. Kokuuntō adds another +1; its base maximum of 22 alone does not guarantee a win.
messages.取り巻きを倒したら行動が増えた: The boss gained actions after an add died
messages.後始末は味方死亡の翌ターンに最大1枠増えるが、その効果は翌々ターンまで持続しない: Clean Up adds at most 1 slot on the turn after an ally dies; that increase does not persist into the following turn. Save strong skills for the extra-action turn and exploit the reduced Counter Coins too.
messages.味方死亡時の追加スロットは1ターン1回、翌ターンのみ。最大5枠で永続増加ではない: The extra slot on ally death activates once per turn, only for next turn, up to 5 slots. It is not a permanent increase.
messages.通常反撃は生存味方に応じて最大4コイン。取り巻きが減ると追加枚数も減る。: The ordinary Counter reaches 4 Coins based on surviving allies. Fewer adds mean fewer added Coins.
messages.HP30%まで混乱しないため、残HPが多い間の反撃と大技に備える。: No Stagger until 30% HP. Prepare for Counters and finishers while his remaining HP is still high.
messages.反撃の枚数を抑え、触れる順番を確認する: Limit Counter Coins and check attack order
messages.取り巻きを減らして裏路地の掟の追加コインを抑える。本体への一方攻撃を全員に並べず: Remove adds to reduce “Rules of the Backstreets”' added Coins. Avoid lining up unnecessary one-sided attacks on the boss; check Slash/Envy resistance and HP on the first Sinner whose attack reaches him.
messages.出血を受けると相手のコイン威力やダメージ条件を満たす。勝てるマッチを取り、斬撃脆: Taking Bleed enables enemy Coin Power and damage bonuses. Take winning clashes and prevent stacked Slash Fragility or Paralyze too.
messages.取り巻き死亡の翌ターンは本体の行動が1枠増える。複数倒しても追加は1ターン1回で: An add's death grants the boss 1 extra action next turn. Even multiple deaths trigger this only once per turn; previous increases do not permanently accumulate.
messages.戦闘開始時の強化込みで止める: Account for Combat Start buffs when stopping it
messages.通常の行動では第3ターンに快刀乱麻が来る。基礎最大22へ、黒雲道や鋭い刃、攻撃5: The normal pattern uses “Sky-clearing Cut” on turn 3. Its base maximum of 22 gains Kokuuntō, “Sharp Edge”, and +5 on turns with 5 attack skills; retain powerful E.G.O or equivalent skills.
messages.対象の出血10以上では加重値+1、出血7以上ではダメージも増える。出血の多い主力: At 10+ Bleed on the target, Attack Weight +1; at 7+ Bleed, damage also increases. Keep it off high-Bleed damage dealers.
messages.鋭い刃の強化は戦闘開始時。そこへマッチに勝つだけで、同ターンのほかの攻撃まで無強: “Sharp Edge”'s buffs activate at Combat Start. Winning its clash does not remove buffs from the other attacks that turn.
messages.斬撃でHP108の混乱を狙い、混乱中に強い攻撃を集める。貫通半減へ火力を偏らせな: Use Slash to reach the 108-HP Stagger and commit strong attacks while Staggered. Avoid relying heavily on Pierce against its halved damage.
messages.取り巻きがいなくなっても反撃の基礎1枚と快刀乱麻は残る。最後まで耐性・出血・マッ: Even without adds, the base 1-Coin Counter and “Sky-clearing Cut” remain. Keep checking resistance, Bleed, and clashes to the end.
messages.出血が重い囚人は、コインを振るたびにHPを失う。複数行動を無理に攻撃へ回さず、守: Heavy Bleed costs HP whenever Coins are tossed. Do not force every extra action into attacks; use defense or healing too.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が5以上なら、ダメージ量+10%: [On Use] If the target has 5+ Bleed, damage +10%
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血4を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.出血威力と回数を同時に増やす。出血5以上では使用時にダメージ+10%となるため、: Adds both Bleed Potency and Count. At 5+ Bleed, gains +10% damage on use; take winning clashes before repeated hits accumulate.
messages.対象の出血が5以上なら、コイン威力+1: If the target has 5+ Bleed, Coin Power +1
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターンに斬撃脆弱1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Slash Fragility next turn
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに斬撃脆弱1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Slash Fragility next turn
messages.出血5以上の相手にはコイン威力+1。的中で翌ターンの斬撃脆弱も付くため、次の反撃: Gains +1 Coin Power against targets with 5+ Bleed. Hits also inflict next-turn Slash Fragility; prevent it from reaching whoever will take the next Counter.
messages.boss-copy:jun:skills.2.name: Lenticular Slash
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]次のターン麻痺1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn
messages.出血5以上ではコイン威力+1で基礎範囲より強まる。翌ターンの麻痺と出血回数増加を: At 5+ Bleed, +1 Coin Power strengthens it beyond the base range. Prevent next-turn Paralyze and added Bleed Count to preserve your main clash winners.
messages.boss-copy:jun:skills.3.name: Sharp Edge
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を含めた全味方へ斬撃ダメージ量増加2を付与: [Combat Start] Grant all allies, including self, 2 Slash Damage Up
messages.全体の斬撃ダメージ増加2と自身の斬撃威力増加2は戦闘開始時に付く。マッチに勝って: The team's 2 Slash Damage Up and the user's 2 Slash Power Up activate at Combat Start. Winning does not prevent these buffs, which also affect other Slash attacks.
messages.boss-copy:jun:skills.4.name: Sky-clearing Cut
messages.[戦闘開始時]メインターゲットの出血が10以上なら、攻撃加重値+1: [Combat Start] If the main target has 10+ Bleed, Attack Weight +1
messages.[戦闘開始時]このターンに使用する攻撃スキルが5つなら、最終威力+5: [Combat Start] If using 5 attack skills this turn, Final Power +5
messages.[マッチ勝利時]全味方の精神力が10回復: [On Clash Win] All allies heal 10 SP
messages.対象の出血が7以上なら、ダメージ量+30%: If the target has 7+ Bleed, damage +30%
messages.Ⅲ対象の出血が7以上なら、ダメージ量+50%: ⅢIf the target has 7+ Bleed, damage +50%
messages.基礎最大22に加え、攻撃5つのターンは戦闘開始時に最終威力+5。鋭い刃と黒雲道の: Beyond its base maximum of 22, gains +5 Final Power at Combat Start on turns with 5 attacks. Check “Sharp Edge” and Kokuuntō too, rather than assigning solely from the win prediction. At 10+ Bleed, Attack Weight also increases.
messages.[使用時]自分を除いた生存している味方の数だけ、コインを1つ追加(最大3): [On Use] Add 1 Coin per surviving ally other than self (max 3)
messages.通常反撃で、ほかの生存味方数に応じてコインを最大3枚追加する。最大4枚の返しを守: An ordinary Counter adding up to 3 Coins based on other living allies. Defense cannot Offset its maximum 4-Coin retaliation; check Slash/Envy resistance and HP on the first attacker.
messages.的中時・1ターン3回まで: On Hit / at most 3 times per turn
