messages.スキル効果以外の出血も増えるため、的中自体を抑える。: Adds Bleed beyond skill effects; prevent hits themselves.
messages.boss-copy:jun:passives.1.name: Brutal Stab
messages.出血条件を満たされる前にマッチで止める。: Stop it through clashes before Bleed bonuses activate.
messages.boss-copy:jun:passives.2.name: Kokuuntō
messages.基礎の威力範囲だけを基準にしない。: Do not judge solely from the base Power range.
messages.次のターンに行動スロットが1増加し、最大5枠となる。増加効果はターンをまたいで持: Gain 1 action slot next turn, up to 5 slots. The increase does not persist across turns.
messages.増加する翌ターンに備える。永続でスロットが蓄積する効果とは扱わない。: Prepare for the additional action next turn. Do not treat slots as permanently accumulating.
messages.裏路地の掟は基礎1枚に、ほかの生存味方数だけコインを追加する。追加は最大3枚。: “Rules of the Backstreets” adds a Coin per other living ally to its base 1 Coin, up to 3 added Coins.
messages.取り巻きを減らし、最初に攻撃する囚人の被害を抑える。: Clear adds to limit damage to the first attacker.
messages.鋭い刃は自身に斬撃威力増加2。快刀乱麻は使用攻撃スキル5つのターンに最終威力+5: “Sharp Edge” gives self 2 Slash Power Up. “Sky-clearing Cut” gains +5 Final Power on turns with 5 attack skills.
messages.勝率表示だけを信じず、発動後の強化も想定して高威力の手を残す。: Retain powerful skills accounting for these buffs rather than relying only on the win prediction.
messages.通常反撃は守備で相殺できない。: Defense skills cannot Offset ordinary Counters.
messages.取り巻きを倒した後も、快刀乱麻の戦闘開始時強化は残る。: “Sky-clearing Cut” retains its Combat Start buffs after the adds are gone.
messages.本体の技とパッシブを中心に掲載している。取り巻きの配置・出血・攻撃先も画面で確認: This page focuses on the boss's skills and passives. Also check add positions, Bleed, and targets in combat.
messages.Hard・鏡の個体には別の強化がある。本ページは通常ストーリーが対象。: Hard and Mirror variants have different buffs. This page covers the Normal story encounter.
messages.主力Lv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。斬撃への耐性、HP回復、高威力マッチをそろ: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher on the main team. Prepare Slash resistance, HP recovery, and powerful clash skills.
messages.本体には斬撃が通りやすい。快刀乱麻の前に高威力E.G.Oの資源を確保する。: Slash works well against the boss. Secure resources for powerful E.G.O before “Sky-clearing Cut”.
messages.出血の多い囚人へ反撃を受けさせず、コインを振る回数も確認する。: Keep high-Bleed Sinners from taking the Counter and check how many Coins they will toss.
messages.反撃の追加コインを減らす。翌ターンの追加行動にも備える。: Reduce added Counter Coins and prepare for next turn's extra action.
messages.本体の混乱を取り、混乱中に削り切る。: Stagger the boss and finish him during Stagger.
messages.最初の攻撃者の耐性とHPを整える。: Prepare resistance and HP for the first attacker.
messages.【リンバス】5.5-24 キムサッガッ（ねじれゆく・ねじれた）の攻略｜Limbu: 5.5-24 Bamboo-hatted Kim (Distorting / Distorted) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)5.5-24「キムサッガッ（ねじれゆく・: Bamboo-hatted Kim (Distorting / Distorted) guide for Limbus Company 5.5-24. Lowering a Minus Coin enemy's SP can make it more dangerous. Use Slash and Pride damage to Stagger it, and arrange attacks to break the Shield before “To Claim Their Bones”.
messages.5.5-24「Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bon: 5.5-24 · “Yield My Flesh” to Claim Their Bones: 5.5-23 and the Final Battle of the Sword Demon's Mind
messages.通常難易度の5.5-23と5.5-24ダンジョン最終戦を分けて掲載。先頭はダンジ: Separately covers Normal 5.5-23 and the 5.5-24 dungeon final battle. The dungeon version appears first. Hard, BokGak, and Mirror Dungeon HP values and extra buffs are excluded.
messages.攻撃・回避・反撃はすべて減算コイン。表示威力はコインだけの範囲で、骨断のバリア残: Attacks, Evade, and Counters all use Minus Coins. Displayed Power ranges reflect Coins alone; see effects for To Claim Their Bones' Shield-dependent Clash Power buffs. Its area version and single-target version at 20% HP or lower are distinct skills.
messages.主力Lv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、斬撃と傲慢を優先。沈潜中心の編成は敵の減算スキ: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher, prioritizing Slash and Pride. Sinking-focused teams can strengthen the enemy's Minus Coin skills.
messages.回避を相殺し、骨断より先に攻撃してバリアを割る。必要量は5.5-23で50、最終: Offset Evade and attack before “To Claim Their Bones” to break its Shield: 50 in 5.5-23, 200 in the final battle.
messages.最終戦はHP20%付近から削り切る準備。強いスキルとE.G.Oを、混乱中と終盤に: Prepare to finish the final battle from around 20% HP. Concentrate strong skills and E.G.O during Stagger and the closing phase.
messages.精神力を下げたら相手が強くなった: Lowering the enemy's SP made it stronger
messages.減算コインは裏面が強い。敵はマッチに勝つと精神力が下がる特殊な増減条件もある。沈: Minus Coins are stronger on Tails. The enemy also has unusual SP rules: winning clashes lowers his SP. Recover by removing Sinking, choosing winning clashes for your team, or Staggering him before he acts.
messages.骨断の威力が高すぎて勝てない: “To Claim Their Bones” is too powerful to beat
messages.戦闘開始時のバリアが使用時まで残ると威力が上がる。先に攻撃する行動で割り、5.5: Power rises if the Combat Start Shield remains until use. Break it with earlier attacks, then clash against the base maximum of 25 in 5.5-23 or 28 in the final battle.
messages.バリアを削る予定の攻撃が回避された: The attacks meant to break the Shield were Evaded
messages.敵の回避を守備で相殺する。混乱させる役や骨断のマッチ担当だけを用意しても、先行攻: Offset the enemy's Evade with a defense skill. Preparing only a Stagger handler and a finisher clash handler is insufficient if the earlier attacks are Evaded.
messages.あと少しで回復されて負けた: The enemy healed just before defeat
messages.最終戦はHP20%以下で行動が変わり、対象変更不可の骨断や反撃が来る。20%手前: At 20% HP or lower in the final battle, patterns change to include an unredirectable “To Claim Their Bones” and a Counter. Assemble strong skills before 20% and finish him during Stagger.
messages.通常難易度のダンジョン最終戦。Lv50・HP2647のHard個体とは別。: The Normal dungeon final battle, distinct from the Level 50, 2647-HP Hard version.
messages.HP20%（約309）以下で行動が変わる。骨断には加重値6の広域と対象変更不可の: Patterns change at 20% HP (about 309) or lower. “To Claim Their Bones” has a 6-Attack-Weight area version and an unredirectable single-target version.
messages.道中で精神力とE.G.O資源を整えてから挑める。混乱の周期だけでなく実際のスキル: Build SP and E.G.O resources in the dungeon before entering. Check actual skills as well as the Stagger cycle.
messages.ダンジョンに入る前の通常ステージ。精神力と資源を戦闘中に整える必要がある。: The regular stage before the dungeon. SP and resources must be built during the encounter.
messages.毎ターン5つの攻撃に加え、回避や反撃を使う。骨断のバリアは50。最終戦の200と: Uses 5 attacks each turn plus Evade or Counter. “To Claim Their Bones” has 50 Shield here; do not confuse it with the final battle's 200.
messages.斬撃・傲慢の主力を動かしやすくする: Enable your main Slash/Pride damage dealers
messages.主力Lv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。初戦も最終戦も打撃・色欲・憂鬱は通りにくい: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher. Both encounters resist Blunt, Lust, and Gloom; prioritize leveled Slash/Pride attackers.
messages.上限6名に対し、5名出撃で編成1番目の主力へスロットを増やす方法もある。人数を減: Deploying 5 Sinners under the limit of 6 can give extra slots to the first deployed damage dealer. If reducing the team size, check that enough actions remain to Offset Evade and handle dangerous clashes.
messages.骨断の前にバリアを割る役と、割った後にマッチする役を用意する。速い囚人を並べるだ: Prepare both an early Shield breaker and a later clash handler for “To Claim Their Bones”. Check actual attack order rather than only choosing fast Sinners.
messages.抜剣など勝てるマッチを主力へ配る。負けるたび敵の精神力が下がり減算コインが強くな: Assign winning clashes such as “Draw of the Sword” to main attackers. Each clash your team loses lowers enemy SP and strengthens Minus Coins; avoid multiple clashes with little chance of winning.
messages.高威力の攻撃は守備や耐性でしのぎ、回避を相殺して本体へ火力を通す。主力の精神力が: Use defense or resistance against powerful attacks, Offset Evade, and damage the boss. Once the main team's SP rises, focus damage toward Stagger.
messages.肉斬の反撃に最初に触れる囚人は斬撃耐性と残HPを見る。攻めるための一撃で主力が混: Check Slash resistance and remaining HP on the first Sinner to trigger “Yield My Flesh”. Avoid having the initiating attack leave your main attacker Staggered by the Counter.
messages.骨断は戦闘開始時にバリア50を張る。使用時に残っているとマッチ威力+5なので、骨: “To Claim Their Bones” gains 50 Shield at Combat Start. If any remains on use, Clash Power +5; break it with clashes or one-sided attacks that resolve before the skill.
messages.敵の回避が先行攻撃を止めないよう相殺する。骨断の担当は、バリアを割った後の最大2: Offset Evade so it does not stop earlier attacks. Prepare E.G.O or another skill that can beat the maximum of 25 after the Shield breaks.
messages.骨断が動く前に混乱させる方法もある。混乱後は火力を集めて倒し、ダンジョンへ進む。: Staggering him before “To Claim Their Bones” acts is another option. Concentrate damage during Stagger, defeat him, and enter the dungeon.
messages.資源を持ち込み、バリア200に備える: Carry resources in and prepare for 200 Shield
messages.最終戦へ入る前にHP・精神力・E.G.O資源を整える。前のステージと同じ敵だと思: Prepare HP, SP, and E.G.O resources before the final battle. Recheck resistance and “To Claim Their Bones” rather than treating it as the same enemy from the previous stage.
messages.広域の骨断は加重値6、バリア200、残存時にマッチ威力+10で最大38。バリアを: The area “To Claim Their Bones” has 6 Attack Weight and 200 Shield; remaining Shield gives +10 Clash Power for a maximum of 38. Resolve several Shield-breaking attacks first, then stop it with the later clash.
messages.傲慢×2と斬撃の通りやすさを使い、HP60%の混乱を狙う。低威力の攻撃へ大技を全: Exploit the ×2 Pride multiplier and Slash weakness to reach the 60% HP Stagger. Do not exhaust every finisher against weak attacks; save damage for Stagger too.
messages.危険な単体版へ移る前に削り切る: Finish before the dangerous single-target version
messages.HP20%以下ではしこりが毎ターン増え、ターン終了でも消えなくなる。単体版の骨断: At 20% HP or lower, Growing Resentment increases every turn and no longer expires at Turn End. The single-target “To Claim Their Bones” prioritizes low-HP Sinners and cannot be redirected.
messages.混乱中や、強いスキルがそろったターンに20%付近から削り切る。追撃が足りない場合: Finish from around 20% during Stagger or a turn with strong skills available. If follow-up damage is insufficient, also prepare healing for low-HP Sinners and Counter protection.
messages.撃破を許すとしこりの倍化・回復につながる。残りわずかでも、弱い攻撃で危険なマッチ: Allowing a kill doubles Growing Resentment and enables healing. Do not take dangerous clashes with weak attacks even when little enemy HP remains.
messages.boss-copy:kim-satgat:skills.0.name: Draw of the Sword
messages.基本威力8の減算2枚。序盤はほかの攻撃より勝ちやすいので、精神力を上げたい主力の: 2 Minus Coins with Base Power 8. Easier to beat than other opening attacks; use it to raise your main attackers' SP. Its on-use Poise is gained even if you win.
messages.[的中時]次のターンにダメージ量増加1を得る: [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn
messages.出血と次ターン麻痺を重ねる3枚攻撃。負けると敵の精神力も下がってさらに強くなるの: A 3-Coin attack stacking Bleed and next-turn Paralyze. If your team loses, enemy SP falls and the enemy strengthens further; consider defense or Staggering him first when unable to win.
messages.boss-copy:kim-satgat:skills.2.name: Slay
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]呼吸1を得る、呼吸回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise and 1 Poise Count
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに斬撃ダメージ量増加1を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Slash Damage Up next turn
messages.[的中時]次のターンに斬撃耐性弱化2を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Slash Resist Down next turn
messages.的中を許すと斬撃耐性が弱まり、後の攻撃が重くなる。敵の呼吸と強化を含めた予測を見: Hits weaken Slash resistance, making later attacks more dangerous. Choose the handler from predictions including enemy Poise and buffs.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]呼吸3を得る、呼吸回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 3 Poise and 1 Poise Count
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに斬撃ダメージ量増加2を得る: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Slash Damage Up next turn
messages.出血と麻痺が重い減算3枚。低精神力になると高い威力を出しやすいため、勝率表示だけ: 3 Minus Coins with heavy Bleed and Paralyze. Low SP favors high rolls; do not assign weak attacks based only on the win prediction.
messages.[使用時]バリアが全て消耗されなかったら、マッチ威力+5: [On Use] If any Shield remains, Clash Power +5
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]斬撃耐性弱化3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Slash Resist Down
messages.[的中時]出血10を付与、出血回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 10 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]バリアが全て消耗されなかったら、結ばれゆくしこりを攻撃加重値で割った: Ⅲ[On Hit] If any Shield remains, deal fixed damage to each target equal to Growing Resentment divided by Attack Weight
messages.5.5-23の広域。バリア50が残るとマッチ威力+5で最大30になる。ほかのマッ: The 5.5-23 area attack. With 50 Shield remaining, +5 Clash Power raises its maximum to 30. Resolve other clashes or one-sided attacks first to break the Shield, or stop it by Staggering him.
messages.減算のため表示範囲は4〜12でも基本威力は12。守備スキルで相殺し、バリアを割る: Despite the displayed range of 4–12, this Minus Coin skill has Base Power 12. Offset it with a defense skill so Shield-breaking attacks are not Evaded.
messages.反撃スキルを発動させたスキルで受けたダメージだけ結ばれゆくしこりを得る: Gain Growing Resentment equal to the damage taken from the skill that triggered this Counter
messages.通常反撃なので、攻撃を受けた後に一方的に返してくる。最初に攻撃する囚人は斬撃耐性: An ordinary Counter that retaliates one-sidedly after being hit. Check Slash resistance and Stagger thresholds on the first attacker; do not lead with an ally near death.
messages.boss-copy:kim-satgat:skills.7.name: Draw of the Sword
messages.boss-copy:kim-satgat:skills.9.name: Slay
messages.[使用時]バリアが全て消耗されなかったら、マッチ威力+10: [On Use] If any Shield remains, Clash Power +10
messages.ダンジョン最終戦の広域。バリア200が残ると最大38になり、加重値も6ある。バリ: The dungeon finale's area attack has 6 Attack Weight and reaches a maximum of 38 with its 200 Shield remaining. Break the Shield with earlier attacks, remove the bonus, then clash with a powerful skill.
messages.[敵討伐時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加3,防御レベル増加3を得る: [On Kill] Gain 3 Offense Level Up and 3 Defense Level Up next turn
messages.HP20%以下で使う反撃。倒された味方が出ると攻撃・防御レベルも上がるので、削り: A Counter used at 20% HP or lower. Killing an ally also raises the enemy's Offense/Defense Levels; concentrate damage on a turn when you can finish him.
messages.骨断（HP20%以下）: To Claim Their Bones (20% HP or lower)
messages.[敵討伐時]結ばれゆくしこりだけ体力を回復: [On Kill] Heal HP equal to Growing Resentment
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]結ばれゆくしこり数値だけ固定ダメージ: Ⅲ[On Hit] Deal fixed damage equal to Growing Resentment
messages.低HPの囚人へ向く対象変更不可の単体攻撃。固定ダメージと撃破時回復で立て直される: An unredirectable single-target attack prioritizing low-HP Sinners. Fixed damage and on-kill healing can restore the fight in his favor; aim to Stagger and finish him from just above 20% HP.
messages.骨断が攻撃スロットにあるとき、ターン開始時に結ばれゆくしこりを得る。ターン終了時: At Turn Start, gain Growing Resentment if “To Claim Their Bones” is in an attack slot. Remove Growing Resentment at Turn End
messages.骨断が攻撃スロットにあるターン: Turns with “To Claim Their Bones” in an attack slot
messages.攻撃で蓄積させたしこりが骨断の固定ダメージに使われる。バリアを残したまま大技を通: Damage taken builds Growing Resentment for “To Claim Their Bones”' fixed damage. Do not let the finisher hit with Shield remaining.
messages.パニックの種類を上書きする作戦は使えない。精神力を下げれば弱くなるという通常の感: Replacing Panic type is unavailable. Remember that lowering SP does not weaken this enemy in the usual way.
messages.体力が20%残っているとき、パターンが変更。\n体力が20%以下になるとき、次の:
At 20% HP remaining, change patterns.
At 20% HP or lower, gain 20 Growing Resentment each turn starting next turn. Growing Resentment is no longer removed.
messages.以降はしこりが毎ターン増え、消えなくなる。混乱中に削り切るか、高威力攻撃を同じタ: Growing Resentment now increases every turn and no longer expires. Finish during Stagger or concentrate powerful attacks on the same turn.
messages.沈潜ダメージを受ける場合、次のターンに防御レベル減少1を得る(1ターンにつき5回: When taking Sinking damage, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn (5 times per turn)
messages.防御低下はあるが、精神力低下で減算攻撃を強める不利もある。沈潜を積むだけで有利に: The Defense Level reduction comes with the downside of strengthening Minus Coin attacks through lower SP. Stacking Sinking alone does not make this encounter favorable.
messages.パニックタイプを変更するバフ獲得時、パニックタイプが変更されない。その代わり、精: When gaining a buff that changes Panic type, the Panic type stays unchanged. Apply the effects intended for targets without SP instead
messages.効果がある間、受けたダメージを蓄積し骨断の固定ダメージに使う。通常は終了時に消え: While active, stores damage taken for “To Claim Their Bones”' fixed damage. Normally expires at Turn End; at 20% HP or lower in the finale, gains 20 every turn and stops expiring.
messages.バリアを残した大技の的中を避け、終盤は火力をまとめて長引かせない。: Prevent the finisher from hitting with Shield remaining, then focus damage to avoid a prolonged closing phase.
messages.マッチ敗北で精神力が上がり、マッチ勝利で下がる特殊な精神力条件。減算コインは精神: Unusual SP rules: losing clashes raises the enemy's SP; winning clashes lowers it. Minus Coins tend to roll higher at lower SP.
messages.沈潜や負けマッチで低精神力へ押し込むのを避ける。: Avoid pushing the enemy to low SP through Sinking or clashes your team loses.
messages.戦闘開始時に獲得し、使用時に残っているとマッチが強化される。初戦50／+5、最終: Gained at Combat Start; strengthens clashes if still present on use. First encounter: 50 / +5. Final battle's area version: 200 / +10.
messages.骨断とのマッチが始まる前に、別の攻撃で削る順番を作る。: Arrange other attacks to remove it before the “To Claim Their Bones” clash begins.
messages.沈潜を1人入れただけで攻略不能になるわけではないが、沈潜だけで固めると減算コイン: A single Sinking user does not make the fight impossible, but an entire Sinking team amplifies the disadvantage against Minus Coins.
messages.回避も減算。低い側の表示威力だけで簡単に突破できると判断しない。: Evade also uses Minus Coins. Do not assume its low displayed minimum means it is easy to beat.
messages.骨断の担当だけを速くしすぎると、バリアを割る前にマッチが始まる。攻撃順を必ず見る: Making only the finisher clash handler too fast can start the clash before the Shield breaks. Always check attack order.
messages.5.5-23と最終戦、NormalとHard、鏡の個体では数値が違う。このページ: 5.5-23, the finale, Normal, Hard, and Mirror variants have different values. This page covers the Normal story encounters.
messages.斬撃・傲慢の主力を中心にLv40・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。打撃中心の編成でダメー: Aim for Level 40 and Uptie III or higher with Slash/Pride damage dealers. If a Blunt-focused team lacks damage, review attack types too.
messages.バリアを割る火力、回避の相殺、骨断へマッチする高威力スキル・E.G.Oを用意する: Prepare Shield-breaking damage, an Evade Offset, and powerful skills or E.G.O to clash against “To Claim Their Bones”.
messages.最終戦は道中の資源とギフトを活用する。特殊な単騎攻略や特定ギフトの取得を必須には: Use dungeon resources and Gifts in the finale. No solo strategy or specific Gift is required; start with a team that can Stagger the boss using your available main attackers.
messages.本体とバリアを削り、混乱から撃破までつなぐ。人数を減らす場合は編成順も調整する。: Damage the boss and Shield, then progress from Stagger to defeat. Adjust deployment order if using fewer Sinners.
messages.バリア破壊役の攻撃を通し、予定した攻撃順を成立させる。: Enable Shield-breaking attacks and preserve the intended attack order.
messages.バリア破壊後の骨断を止める。終盤の反撃と対象変更不可にも備える。: Stop “To Claim Their Bones” after breaking the Shield; also prepare for late Counters and unredirectable attacks.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6.5-28「カセッティ・サーシャ」の攻: Cassetti & Sasha guide for Limbus Company 6.5-28. Prepare against the Bloodbags and Sasha, then reduce Cassetti's Stored Blood through clash wins and HP damage. Use Evade against the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood to limit his massive lifesteal recovery.
messages.6.5-28「Murder on the WARP Express: The O: 6.5-28 · Murder on the WARP Express: The One Who Commands
messages.血袋とサーシャで準備を整え、カセッティの宿した血をマッチ勝利とHP削りで減らす。: Prepare against the Bloodbags and Sasha, then reduce Cassetti's Stored Blood through clash wins and HP damage. Use Evade against the Unclashable area attack at 0 blood to limit his massive lifesteal recovery.
messages.6.5-28の通常難易度。Wave1の血袋・サーシャとWave2のカセッティを扱: Normal 6.5-28. Covers Wave 1's Bloodbags and Sasha, then Wave 2's Cassetti. Bloodbags list both maximum HP and halved HP on entry. Separate from Hard's extra passives and values.
messages.カセッティの広域にはマッチできる技とできない技がある。同名の義体稼働・反撃も使用: Cassetti has both Clashable and Unclashable area attacks. “Activate Prosthesis” and Counter also differ by user; check who is using them. Cassetti's Evade Defense Level is unlisted.
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、打撃・嫉妬などの火力と回復を用意。前半で精神力: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher, with Blunt/Envy damage and healing. Build SP and E.G.O resources in the first wave.
messages.宿した血を減らすマッチを優先。出血中の味方への的中は、敵の回復と強化につながる。: Prioritize clashes that reduce Stored Blood. Hits on Bleeding allies enable enemy healing and buffs.
messages.血0の広域はマッチ不可。回避で回復量を抑え、その後のマッチ可能な広域は強いスキル: The area attack at 0 blood is Unclashable. Use Evade to limit healing; stop the later Clashable area attack with powerful skills.
messages.カセッティが何度も全快近くまで回復する: Cassetti repeatedly heals nearly to full
messages.出血中の囚人へ的中すると吸血する。特に速度10の特殊広域は吸血が強く、全員に通す: Hits on Bleeding Sinners trigger lifesteal. The Speed 10 special area attack greatly strengthens it; letting everyone be hit causes massive recovery. Use Evade against the Unclashable version and win clashes against other area attacks.
messages.最大HP5%分を失うごとに1減るほか、パレードの王子や血···血···血···！: It drops by 1 per 5% maximum HP lost, and winning against “The Parade's Prince” or Blood... Blood... Blood...! reduces it too. Some hits increase it instead; combine damage and clash wins.
messages.出血編成で押し切れない: A Bleed team cannot finish the fight
messages.カセッティ自身の出血で攻防・マッチが強化され、出血ダメージも軽減される。出血の蓄: Bleed on Cassetti himself strengthens Offense/Defense Levels and clashes, and he resists Bleed damage. Try direct Blunt/Envy damage rather than relying on Bleed buildup alone.
messages.Wave1の敵が減るとサーシャのスロットが最大5まで増える仕様。増えた攻撃線を確: As Wave 1 enemies disappear, Sasha gains slots up to 5. Check the additional attack lines and use her 50% HP Stagger to stop attacks.
messages.宿した血5から登場。初めて0になると行動が変わり、速度10・マッチ不可の広域を使: Enters with 5 Stored Blood. The first drop to 0 changes patterns and brings a Speed 10 Unclashable area attack.
messages.HP30%（約513）で血紅色の渇求を得る。出血の多い囚人への的中で回復するため: Gains Bloodtinged Craving at 30% HP (about 513). Hits on high-Bleed Sinners heal him; prevent hits as well as dealing damage.
messages.Wave1で累計5体の敵が倒れると増援。基本3スロットで、ほかの敵が減るほど最大: Reinforces Wave 1 after 5 cumulative enemy deaths. Starts with 3 slots and gains up to 5 as other enemies disappear.
messages.HP50%以下で充電技が変わる。自傷だけでは倒れないので、囚人の攻撃で仕留める。: Charge skills change at 50% HP or lower. Self-damage cannot kill her; finish with Sinner attacks.
messages.爆ぜた血袋によりHP半分で登場するWave1の個体。通常ステージやHardの値は: The Wave 1 version enters at half HP due to Burst Bloodbag. Does not use regular-stage or Hard values.
messages.全種とも打撃・嫉妬が通りやすい。増援を含めて処理し、主力の精神力とE.G.O資源: All types are vulnerable to Blunt and Envy. Handle reinforcements while building the main team's SP and E.G.O resources.
messages.打撃の主力と、回避できる囚人を用意する: Prepare main Blunt attackers and Sinners with Evade
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安に、打撃×1.5と嫉妬を使える育成済みの人格を選ぶ: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher, choosing leveled Identities that exploit ×1.5 Blunt and Envy. This chain encounter allows 6 Sinners plus 6 reserves; check reserve order and levels too.
messages.カセッティへ出血を大量に付けると強化される。出血中心で詰まった場合は手持ちの直接: Heavy Bleed on Cassetti buffs him. If a Bleed team stalls, switch to available direct damage and bring HP/SP recovery.
messages.マッチ不可の広域へ回避を使える囚人がいると回復を抑えやすい。回避がない囚人は耐性: Evade users can limit healing from the Unclashable area attack. Prepare resistance and remaining HP on Sinners without Evade.
messages.弱いマッチで主力の精神力を上げる: Raise main attackers' SP through easy clashes
messages.最初はHP半分の乗客5体。倒すと整理要員・義体フィクサーなどが増援で出るため、最: Begins with 5 half-HP passengers. Cleanup Agents and Prosthetic Fixers reinforce after kills; the wave does not end with the initial 5.
messages.勝てるマッチを主力へ配って精神力と資源を稼ぐ。出血中の味方へ攻撃を通すと血袋も回: Assign winning clashes to main attackers for SP and resources. Bloodbags also heal by hitting Bleeding allies; do not leave weak enemies alive to cause attrition.
messages.サーシャが出たら残る敵と攻撃線を確認。取り巻きが減ると彼女のスロットも増えるため: When Sasha appears, check remaining enemies and attack lines. Her slots increase as adds disappear; use Blunt to reach the 50% HP Stagger and follow up.
messages.サーシャは自傷で充電を増やす。自傷だけで倒れるのを待たず、次Waveへ持ち込む資: Sasha increases Charge through self-damage. Do not wait for that alone to defeat her; finish while saving resources for the next wave.
messages.的中を防ぎ、宿した血とHPを削る: Prevent hits and reduce Stored Blood and HP
messages.宿した血は最大10で、HPを最大値5%分失うごとに1減る。パレードの王子などへ勝: Stored Blood caps at 10 and drops by 1 per 5% maximum HP lost. Wins against “The Parade's Prince” and certain other skills reduce it further. Stop dangerous clashes while dealing direct damage.
messages.出血の多い囚人は狙われやすく、敵の的中回復やスキル強化にもつながる。出血の少ない: High-Bleed Sinners attract attacks and enable healing and skill bonuses. Redirect to lower-Bleed Sinners, and Offset Evade with defense.
messages.出血がある囚人の人数でパレードの王子が広域化する。4枚の的中を通すと回復量も大き: “The Parade's Prince” gains area coverage based on the number of Bleeding Sinners. Its 4 hits can heal substantially; stop it with a strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.速度10のマッチ不可広域を回避で受け流す: Evade the Speed 10 Unclashable area attack
messages.我は···この行進の···王子である···！はマッチ不可で、使用ターンに混乱もし: “I Am... The Prince... of the Parade...!” is Unclashable and prevents Stagger that turn. A powerful E.G.O clash cannot stop it.
messages.出血中の対象へ当たると強化された吸血で大回復する。回避できる囚人は回避し、的中数: Hits on Bleeding targets trigger enhanced lifesteal and massive healing. Evade where possible to reduce hits; prioritize endangered Sinners.
messages.攻撃後に宿した血が10へ戻り、ターンも終了する。その後の攻撃で倒す前提ではなく、: After attacking, Stored Blood returns to 10 and the turn ends. Do not plan to finish him with later attacks; prepare to reduce blood again next turn.
messages.行動変化後〜HP30%以下: After the pattern change / at 30% HP or lower
messages.マッチ可能な大技を止めて削り切る: Stop the Clashable finisher and finish the fight
messages.行動変化後に血が少ないと、絶対に···戻らぬぞ···！へ変わる。こちらはマッチ可: After the pattern change, low blood brings “I'm... Never... Going Back...!” This one is Clashable; retain a strong handler or E.G.O to prevent hits.
messages.この技も攻撃後には血10を得る。勝っただけで血の回復まで止まるとは考えず、次の強: This skill also gains 10 blood after attacking. Winning does not stop that gain; prepare for the next buffs and further HP damage.
messages.HP30%以下では血紅色の渇求を得て、的中するたび血が増える。終盤ほど回復させず: At 30% HP or lower, Bloodtinged Craving adds blood on each hit. Prevent healing in the closing phase and combine clash wins with follow-up damage on the same turn.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が4以上なら、マッチ威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Bleed, Clash Power +1
messages.出血4以上の対象にはマッチが強くなる。出血が少なくHPのある囚人へ引き受け、的中: Clash Power increases against 4+ Bleed. Redirect to a healthy, lower-Bleed Sinner to prevent healing and further Bleed.
messages.出血回数を増やす攻撃。すでに出血の多い囚人へ通すと、後の広域や回復条件まで悪化す: Increases Bleed Count. Letting it hit a high-Bleed Sinner worsens later area attacks and healing conditions.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血回数1につき、ダメージ量+5%(最大20%): [On Use] Damage +5% per 1 Bleed Count on the target (max 20%)
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血8を付与、出血回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 8 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.出血の威力・回数が増えるうえ、出血回数に応じたダメージ強化もある。回復で受け続け: Adds Bleed Potency and Count, with extra damage from the target's Count. Stop it by clashing rather than repeatedly healing through hits.
messages.[戦闘開始時]出血を持つ対象だけ攻撃加重値が増加(最大5): [Combat Start] Increase Attack Weight by the number of targets with Bleed (max 5)
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が4以上なら、基本威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Bleed, Base Power +1
messages.[使用時]対象の出血回数が3以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 3+ Bleed Count, Coin Power +1
messages.出血している囚人が多いほど広域化する。4枚の的中と吸血を防ぐ優先マッチ。勝つと宿: More Bleeding Sinners mean greater area coverage. A priority clash to stop 4 hits and lifesteal; winning also reduces Stored Blood by 1.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が8以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 8+ Bleed, Coin Power +1
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血を5付与、出血回数が3増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 3
messages.[的中時]対象の出血が10以上なら、次のコインダメージ量+20%: [On Hit] If the target has 10+ Bleed, next Coin damage +20%
messages.勝つと宿した血−1、2枚目を通すと敵が血を1得る。出血を重ねられた主力を守りなが: Winning reduces Stored Blood by 1; letting Coin 2 hit gives the enemy 1 blood. Assign a blood-reduction handler while protecting high-Bleed main attackers.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血回数1につき、基本威力+1(最大4): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 1 Bleed Count on the target (max 4)
messages.対象の出血回数で基本威力が上がる回避。守備で相殺し、本体を削る攻撃を通す。守備L: Evade gains Base Power from the target's Bleed Count. Offset it with defense to enable boss damage. Defense Level is unlisted.
messages.我は···この行進の···王子である···！: I Am... The Prince... of the Parade...!
messages.[使用時]硬血式グレイブの回復効果が2倍になる: [On Use] Double Hardblood Glaive's healing effect
messages.このターンの間、混乱状態にならない。このスキルを使用後にターンを終了する: Cannot be Staggered this turn. End the turn after using this skill
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.マッチ不可、速度10、使用ターンは混乱しない。通常のマッチで止めようとせず、回避: Unclashable, Speed 10, and immune to Stagger that turn. Use Evade where possible rather than trying to clash; limit the massive healing from hits on Bleeding allies. Blood returns to 10 after the attack.
messages.[使用時]対象の出血5につき、マッチ威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 3)
messages.[使用時]対象の出血回数が4以上なら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has 4+ Bleed Count, Coin Power +1
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]出血3を付与、出血回数が1増加: Ⅳ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.こちらはマッチ可能な強い広域。使用時に吸血を強化し、攻撃後に血10を得る。勝って: This powerful area attack is Clashable. Enhances lifesteal on use and gains 10 blood after attacking. Win to prevent hits and massive healing, then prepare to reduce blood again.
messages.[使用時]充電回数が10以上なら、充電回数を3消耗してコイン威力+1: [On Use] At 10+ Charge Count, consume 3 for +1 Coin Power
messages.[使用時]充電回数が15以上なら、充電回数を3を追加で消耗してダメージ量+20%: [On Use] At 15+ Charge Count, consume 3 additional Count for +20% damage
messages.[使用時]充電回数が5未満なら、体力が最大値の10％分減少して充電回数が5増加: [On Use] Below 5 Charge Count, lose 10% maximum HP and gain 5 Charge Count
messages.充電と出血を利用する攻撃。同名でもサーシャと義体フィクサーで属性・威力・条件が異: Uses Charge and Bleed. Despite the shared name, Sasha and the Prosthetic Fixer have different affinities, Power, and conditions; check the user when assigning clashes.
messages.3枚の的中で出血と麻痺を重ねる。使用時の自傷・充電は勝っても起こるので、的中だけ: 3 hits stack Bleed and Paralyze. On-use self-damage and Charge occur even after winning; assign someone to prevent the hits themselves.
messages.[使用時]自分の体力最大値の10％分消耗し、充電回数が15増加: [On Use] Consume 10% own maximum HP and gain 15 Charge Count
messages.HP10%を消費して充電15を得る。自傷を待つだけで倒そうとせず、マッチを止めて: Consumes 10% HP for 15 Charge. Do not wait for self-damage alone; stop its attack and follow with Blunt damage to Stagger and kill.
messages.[使用時]自分の出血回数3につき、基本威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 3 own Bleed Count (max 2)
messages.守備で相殺するか、火力をまとめて削る。バリアへ攻撃を吸われ、次の危険なマッチへ使: Offset with defense or focus enough damage to break through. Avoid losing skills needed for the next dangerous clash to a Shield.
messages.充電でコイン威力が上がる。低い基本値だけで判断せず、現在の充電とマッチ予測を確認: Charge raises Coin Power. Check current Charge and clash predictions rather than relying on low Base Power.
messages.サーシャのHP50%以下で使う強い充電技。出血と攻撃レベル低下を止め、混乱後の火: A powerful Charge skill Sasha uses at 50% HP or lower. Prevent Bleed and Offense Level Down, then concentrate damage after Stagger to defeat her.
messages.出血回数が増える。弱い敵のマッチを主力へ配って精神力を上げ、次の敵へ備える。: Increases Bleed Count. Give main attackers easy clashes to build SP for later enemies.
messages.低威力でも出血回数を重ねる。勝てるマッチと打撃の追撃で血袋を減らし、消耗を抑える: Adds Bleed Count despite low Power. Clear Bloodbags with winning clashes and Blunt follow-ups to limit attrition.
messages.対象の出血が10以上なら、ダメージ量+20%: If the target has 10+ Bleed, damage +20%
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]対象の出血威力を最大10まで吸収し、体力最大値の(吸収した出血威力×: Ⅲ[On Hit] Absorb up to 10 Bleed Potency from the target and heal (absorbed Potency × 2)% of maximum HP
messages.出血の多い対象へ強くなり、最後のコインで吸収・回復する。低HPの血袋でも放置せず: Stronger against high-Bleed targets; the last Coin absorbs Bleed and heals. Do not ignore low-HP Bloodbags; kill before they hit or win the clash.
messages.通常反撃。先に攻撃する囚人の耐性と混乱区間を見て、無理な一撃で倒れないようにする: An ordinary Counter. Check resistance and Stagger thresholds on the first attacker to avoid a fatal initiating hit. Attack type also varies by user.
messages.使用時・的中時に充電が増える。的中を防ぎ、増援を長く場に残さないようにする。: Charge rises on use and on hit. Prevent hits and avoid leaving reinforcements alive for long.
messages.充電と出血を重ねる。通常の乗客よりHPも高いので、打撃などで集中し、回復される前: Builds Charge and Bleed. Has more HP than regular passengers; focus Blunt or other effective damage before it heals.
messages.[使用時]保有した充電回数を全て消耗し、体力最大値の2×(15-消耗した充電回数: [On Use] Consume all Charge Count, lose 2 × (15 − consumed Charge Count)% of maximum HP, and gain +2 Coin Power
messages.[的中時]対象の出血威力を最大10まで吸収し、体力最大値の(吸収した出血威力×: [On Hit] Absorb up to 10 Bleed Potency from the target and heal (absorbed Potency × 2)% of maximum HP
messages.充電とHPを消耗してコインが強化され、最後に出血を吸収して回復する。基本の表示よ: Consumes Charge and HP for stronger Coins, then absorbs Bleed and heals on the last Coin. Its maximum exceeds the base display; check buffed predictions.
messages.[使用時]充電回数が10以上なら、充電回数を5消耗して攻撃レベル増加3を得る: [On Use] At 10+ Charge Count, consume 5 for 3 Offense Level Up
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分の充電回数が5未満なら、自分の充電回数を5,出血回数を3増加さ: [Combat Start] Below 5 own Charge Count, gain 5 Charge Count, 3 Bleed Count, and 1 Fragile
messages.戦闘開始時の充電などはマッチ勝利だけでは防げない。的中の出血・束縛を防ぎ、主力の: Winning does not prevent Combat Start Charge and other gains. Stop on-hit Bleed and Bind to protect the main team's next actions.
messages.[使用時]自分の体力最大値の10%分消耗し、充電回数が10増加: [On Use] Consume 10% own maximum HP and gain 10 Charge Count
messages.使用時に自傷と充電、的中では出血・麻痺。自傷でHPが減った敵へ火力を集めるが、充: Self-damage and Charge occur on use; hits inflict Bleed and Paralyze. Focus the enemy after self-damage without allowing its charged attacks through.
messages.ターン終了時に宿した血が\n- 5以下ならターンごとに、減少した数値だけ次のター:
At Turn End, depending on Stored Blood:
- At 5 or lower, gain 1 Bind, 1 Fragile, and 1 Offense Level Down next turn per stack below 5.
- Above 5, gain 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up next turn per excess stack.
messages.血が少ないほど弱体化し、5を超えると攻撃・防御が強化される。マッチ勝利とHP削り: Low blood weakens him; above 5, Offense/Defense Levels rise. Reduce it through clash wins and HP damage.
messages.宿した血が初めて0になったときにパターン変更\n我は···この行進の···王子な:
Change patterns the first time Stored Blood reaches 0.
When using “I Am... The Prince... of the Parade...!”, Speed is fixed at 10.
messages.次の速度10・マッチ不可広域に回避を用意する。血0になればすべて安全という戦闘で: Prepare Evade for the next Speed 10 Unclashable area attack. Reaching 0 blood does not make everything safe.
messages.現体力が最大値の30%になったとき、血紅色の渇求を得る: At 30% maximum HP remaining, gain Bloodtinged Craving
messages.以後は的中で血が増える。削り切りたい終盤ほど、危険なマッチを勝てる担当へ回す。: Hits now increase blood. Assign winning handlers to dangerous clashes, especially when trying to finish.
messages.出血威力と回数の合計が最も高い対象を優先して攻撃\n攻撃的中時、対象に出血があれ:
Prioritize the target with the highest total Bleed Potency and Count.
On Hit against a target with Bleed, heal 2% maximum HP.
messages.出血の多い囚人が狙われ、大回復の起点になる。マッチか回避で的中を防ぐ。: High-Bleed Sinners attract attacks and enable major healing. Prevent hits through clashes or Evade.
messages.自分に出血があるとき、\n- 出血5につき攻撃レベル増加1,防御レベル増加1を得:
While self has Bleed:
- Gain 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up per 5 Bleed (max 10).
- Gain 1 Clash Power Up per 10 Bleed (max 5).
- Take 50% less Bleed damage (rounded down).
messages.出血で敵自身の攻防とマッチが強くなる。出血中心で止まった場合は、打撃・嫉妬などの: Bleed strengthens the enemy's Offense/Defense Levels and clashes. If a Bleed team stalls, switch to direct Blunt/Envy damage.
messages.種類の上書きを前提にしない。通常の精神力低下とマッチ勝利は別に活用できる。: Do not rely on replacing its Panic type. Normal SP reduction and clash wins can still be useful separately.
messages.長くパニックのままにはできない。回復する前の隙に火力を集める。: Panic does not last indefinitely. Concentrate damage before recovery.
messages.自分が攻撃でダメージを受ける度に出血回数1を得る\nターン終了時、自分の出血回数:
Whenever taking attack damage, gain 1 Bleed Count.
At Turn End, consume 3 own Bleed Count for 1 Coagulated Blood.
messages.攻撃を受けると出血回数が増え、終了時に硬化血液へ変わる。長引くほど攻防が上がるの: Hits add Bleed Count, converted to Coagulated Blood at Turn End. Longer fights raise Offense/Defense Levels; defeat enemies one at a time.
messages.boss-copy:cassetti-sasha:passives.9.name: Thirst for Blood
messages.出血が付与された対象を優先して攻撃\nこのターンにダメージを与えられなかったら次:
Prioritize Bleeding targets.
If no damage was dealt this turn, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Offense Level Up next turn.
messages.的中を防ぐと脆弱を得る一方、攻撃レベルも上がる。次の攻撃予測を見直しながら弱点へ: Preventing damage gives the enemy Fragile but also Offense Level Up. Recheck predictions and focus its weaknesses.
messages.被ダメージ時、攻撃者が充電を得るスキルを使用したなら充電回数1を攻撃者に移す\n:
When taking damage, if the attacker used a skill that gains Charge, transfer 1 Charge Count to the attacker.
(Once per skill; does not activate if the damaged target has no Charge.)
messages.敵に充電が残っていれば、該当スキルの攻撃者へ充電回数を移す。手持ちの充電人格の補: If the enemy has Charge left, transfers Charge Count to that skill's attacker. Can support available Charge Identities but is not required.
messages.自分のスキルによって受けるダメージで体力が1未満に減少しない: Damage from own skills cannot reduce HP below 1
messages.自傷だけではHP1未満にならない。待つだけでなく囚人の攻撃で倒す。: Self-damage cannot reduce HP below 1. Finish with Sinner attacks rather than waiting.
messages.ターン開始時に充電回数が5未満なら自分へ攻撃威力減少1を付与\nターン開始時に充:
At Turn Start below 5 Charge Count, gain 1 Attack Power Down.
At Turn Start with 5+ Charge Count, gain 2 Clash Power Up.
messages.充電5以上ではマッチが強くなる。初動の低い威力のままだと決めつけない。: Clashes strengthen at 5+ Charge. Do not assume its low opening Power persists.
messages.自分が受ける出血ダメージを30%減少(小数点切り捨て)\n攻撃的中時に対象に出血:
Take 30% less Bleed damage (rounded down).
On Hit against a Bleeding target, heal 25% of damage dealt.
messages.出血ダメージ・出血対象への的中: Bleed damage / hits on Bleeding targets
messages.出血軽減と吸血がある。打撃などで直接倒し、的中を通し続けない。: Resists Bleed and has lifesteal. Kill through direct Blunt or other damage rather than allowing repeated hits.
messages.自分が受ける出血ダメージを10%減少(小数点切り捨て)\n攻撃的中時に対象に出血:
Take 10% less Bleed damage (rounded down).
On Hit against a Bleeding target, heal 10% of damage dealt.
messages.乗客も出血相手から回復する。弱いマッチで精神力を上げたら、回復される前に倒す。: Passengers also heal from Bleeding targets. Build SP through easy clashes, then kill before they recover.
messages.血袋は最大HPの半分から登場する。最大値と初期の残HPを区別して攻撃を分配する。: Bloodbags enter at half maximum HP. Distinguish maximum from starting HP when distributing attacks.
messages.自分が受ける出血ダメージを20%減少(小数点切り捨て)\n攻撃的中時に対象に出血:
Take 20% less Bleed damage (rounded down).
On Hit against a Bleeding target, heal 15% of damage dealt.
messages.吸血前にマッチや混乱で止め、残HPの少ない敵を手早く減らす。: Stop lifesteal through clashes or Stagger and quickly remove low-HP enemies.
messages.自分が受ける出血ダメージを30%減少(小数点切り捨て)\n攻撃的中時に対象に出血:
Take 30% less Bleed damage (rounded down).
On Hit against a Bleeding target, heal 15% of damage dealt.
messages.義体フィクサーの出血軽減と回復。出血だけで削るより、弱点の打撃を使う。: The Prosthetic Fixer's Bleed resistance and healing. Use its Blunt weakness rather than relying only on Bleed.
messages.最大10、Wave2開始時5。最大HP5%分を失うごとに−1。特定技のマッチ敗北: Max 10; starts Wave 2 at 5. Lose 1 per 5% maximum HP lost. Also decreases on certain clash losses, and increases on hits or after special area attacks. High blood raises Offense/Defense Levels; low blood weakens them.
messages.マッチに勝つだけでも、攻撃するだけでも足りない。両方を組み合わせて減らす。: Neither clash wins nor damage alone is enough; combine both to reduce it.
messages.HP30%到達後の効果。毎ターンのマッチ・ダメージ強化と、的中による宿した血+1: Gained at 30% HP. Provides clash/damage buffs each turn and +1 Stored Blood on hit. Failing to gain blood also triggers different next-turn buffs and debuffs.
messages.終盤の予測を見直し、的中を防いで回復の循環を断つ。: Recheck closing-phase predictions and prevent hits to break the healing cycle.
messages.数値分の攻撃・防御レベル増加（最大5）。血袋たちは攻撃を受けて増えた出血回数から: Gain Offense/Defense Levels equal to its value (max 5). Bloodbags gain it from Bleed Count accumulated when attacked.
messages.多数を少しずつ削るより、倒せる相手へ集中して数を減らす。: Focus killable targets to reduce numbers rather than slightly damaging many enemies.
messages.マッチ不可の広域と、後のマッチ可能な広域を混同しない。前者は回避、後者はマッチ勝: Distinguish the Unclashable area attack from the later Clashable one. Evade is the main response to the former; clash wins to the latter.
messages.普通の防御はダメージを軽減しても、的中そのものは防げない。吸血を抑える回避と同じ: Ordinary Guard reduces damage but does not prevent the hit itself. It does not suppress lifesteal like Evade.
messages.宿した血を初めて0にした直後は大回復の危険がある。血0を見て攻撃だけを選ばず、表: The first drop to 0 Stored Blood risks massive healing. Check the displayed skill instead of choosing only attacks at 0 blood.
messages.Hard限定のラ・マンチャランドの悪夢や精神力回復条件は、この通常個体へ適用しな: Do not apply Hard-only Nightmare of La Manchaland or its SP recovery conditions to this Normal version.
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上。打撃・嫉妬の火力と、強い広域へ勝てるE.G.Oを用意す: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher. Bring Blunt/Envy damage and E.G.O strong enough to win dangerous area clashes.
messages.HPと精神力を戻せる役を用意し、前半で資源を整える。回復は出血をすべて取り除く効: Prepare HP/SP recovery and build resources in the opening. Healing does not necessarily remove all Bleed; check the target's Bleed Count too.
messages.回避役が少ない場合は耐性と火力を見直す。少人数で広域の被弾人数を減らす方法もある: With few Evade users, review resistance and damage. A smaller team can reduce area targets, but first check that enough actions remain for regular clashes.
messages.前半の血袋からカセッティまで弱点を突き、血を減らすHP削りを担当する。: Exploit weaknesses from the opening Bloodbags through Cassetti, dealing HP damage to reduce blood.
messages.マッチ不可の回は回避、マッチ可能な広域は高威力で止める。両方を1人だけへ任せず分: Evade the Unclashable attack and beat Clashable area attacks with high Power. Divide these jobs instead of leaving both to one Sinner.
messages.長い2Waveの消耗を支え、主力が倒れた場合も次のターンへつなげる。: Sustain the long 2-wave fight and keep going next turn if a main attacker falls.
messages.【リンバス】6.5-14 時間殺人鬼（6.5-14）の攻略｜Limbus Ass: 6.5-14 The Time Ripper (6.5-14) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6.5-14「時間殺人鬼（6.5-14）: The Time Ripper (6.5-14) guide for Limbus Company 6.5-14. Stolen Time raises Offense/Defense Levels early. Avoid repeated losing clashes; endure with resistance and defense while time is consumed. On “Time to be Saved” turns, limit attackers to control who is targeted during next turn's acceleration.
messages.6.5-14「Timekilling Time: The Dread Clock: 6.5-14 · Timekilling Time: The Dread Clock Tower
messages.序盤は奪った時間で攻撃・防御レベルが高い。勝てないマッチを重ねず、耐性と守備でし: Stolen Time raises Offense/Defense Levels early. Avoid repeated losing clashes; endure with resistance and defense while time is consumed. On “Time to be Saved” turns, limit attackers to control who is targeted during next turn's acceleration.
messages.通常難易度6.5-14の集中戦闘、単体の初戦を掲載。Lv45・HP1279・基礎: The Normal 6.5-14 focused encounter: the first fight against a single enemy. Level 45, 1279 HP, base Defense Level 48. Base tables exclude Stolen Time's Turn Start modifiers, Time Acceleration, and Panic changes. Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion start with 1 T Corp. Special Investigator Badge, but 6 Sinners may deploy. Final-battle and Hard parts and values are excluded.
messages.通常の全8技。表示は時間加速と残り時間による強化前。回避は残り時間で基本威力が増: All 8 regular skills, before Time Acceleration and remaining-time bonuses. Evade gains Base Power from remaining time. “Time to be Saved” is Unclashable. After time runs out, Normal uses 3 attacks.
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にする。貫通・怠惰・暴食の火力と、斬撃・貫通を受け: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher. Bring Pierce, Sloth, and Gluttony damage, plus defense against Slash and Pierce.
messages.第3ターンの救済する時間で本体へ攻撃した囚人が、翌ターンの加速中に狙われる。守り: Sinners who attack the boss on turn 3's “Time to be Saved” are targeted during next turn's acceleration. Keep vulnerable Sinners from attacking and prepare HP, resistance, and defense on the handlers.
messages.奪った時間は初期1000で補充されない。消耗するほどレベル補正が弱まり、0になる: Stolen Time starts at 1000 and is not replenished. Level bonuses weaken as it is spent; at 0, weaker patterns replace them. Avoid collapsing to unwinnable opening clashes.
messages.表示範囲より強く、序盤のマッチに勝てない: Opening clashes are stronger than the displayed range
messages.初期の奪った時間1000により攻撃・防御レベルが上がる。時間加速やHP条件も加わ: The initial 1000 Stolen Time raises Offense/Defense Levels. Time Acceleration and HP conditions add further bonuses; the base range alone does not ensure a win. Endure with resistant defense skills while time is spent.
messages.加速した敵が弱い囚人へ集中する: The accelerated enemy focuses vulnerable Sinners
messages.救済する時間のターンに敵へ攻撃した囚人が翌ターンの時間救済対象になる。全員で攻め: Sinners attacking during “Time to be Saved” gain Time Relief Entitlement next turn. Attack only with those able to survive accelerated attacks rather than with the whole team.
messages.回避へ弱い攻撃を当て続けてしまう: Weak attacks keep failing against Evade
messages.回避は残り時間100につき基本威力+1。守備で相殺し、加速中に狙われたくない囚人: Evade gains +1 Base Power per 100 remaining time. Offset it with defense, and avoid attacking with Sinners you do not want targeted during acceleration.
messages.初期の奪った時間は1000。ターン開始時の保有量で攻撃・防御レベルが変化する。: Starts with 1000 Stolen Time. The amount held at Turn Start changes Offense/Defense Levels.
messages.時間加速で速度+5、脆弱1と技の強化が付く。: Time Acceleration grants +5 Speed, 1 Fragile, and skill bonuses.
messages.HP75%で複数部位へ移る最終戦とは別。初戦の混乱は60%・30%。: Distinct from the finale, which splits into multiple parts at 75% HP. This first fight Staggers at 60% and 30%.
messages.勝てるマッチと守備で初動をしのぐ: Survive the opening with winning clashes and defense
messages.序盤は奪った時間のレベル補正が大きい。勝てないマッチを連発して敵の精神力を上げず: Stolen Time's opening level bonus is substantial. Avoid raising enemy SP through repeated losing clashes; defend with Sinners resistant to Slash and Pierce.
messages.勝てるマッチを主力へ配り、精神力と回復・高威力E.G.Oの資源を整える。攻めると: Assign winning clashes to main attackers and build SP and resources for healing and powerful E.G.O. Avoid halved Slash damage; use Pierce, Sloth, and Gluttony offensively.
messages.出血を受けた囚人のHPと回数も確認する。多コインの連続攻撃で自ら倒れないよう、守: Check HP and Bleed Count on afflicted Sinners. Retain defensive options to avoid self-inflicted deaths from consecutive multi-Coin attacks.
messages.翌ターンに狙われる担当を選ぶ: Choose who will be targeted next turn
messages.救済する時間はマッチ不可で、戦闘開始時に時間200を消耗し翌ターンの時間加速を準: “Time to be Saved” is Unclashable. At Combat Start, consumes 200 time and prepares Time Acceleration next turn. A powerful attack cannot stop it through a clash.
messages.このターンに本体へ攻撃した囚人へ、翌ターンの時間救済対象が付く。攻撃を受けられる: Sinners who attack the boss this turn gain Time Relief Entitlement next turn. Attack with those able to survive the incoming hits; switch vulnerable Sinners to defense or other actions.
messages.回避を守備で相殺する。残り時間で強化されるため、弱い攻撃を無理に通そうとしない。: Offset Evade with defense. Remaining time strengthens it; do not force weak attacks through it.
messages.速くなった敵の強化を受け止める: Prepare for the faster enemy's buffs
messages.速度+5で攻撃先を引き受けにくくなる。時間救済対象の囚人の守備・HP・耐性を確認: +5 Speed makes redirection harder. Check entitled Sinners' defense, HP, and resistance so they can personally survive attacks that cannot be redirected.
messages.摘出は加速でコイン威力+1、HP75%未満では使用時にマッチ威力+2。滅多切りは: “Extraction” gains +1 Coin Power during acceleration and +2 Clash Power on use below 75% HP. “Mutilate” also gains Attack Weight; do not rely only on base Power or target counts.
messages.以後も同様の予告と加速を繰り返す。HP条件による時間消耗も進むため、残り時間と次: The warning and acceleration cycle repeats. HP conditions also consume time; check remaining time and the next warning when recovering.
messages.弱体化したマッチから混乱・撃破へ: Use weaker clashes to Stagger and finish
messages.残り時間が減るほどレベル補正が下がる。勝てるマッチを増やして精神力を上げ、HP6: Level bonuses fall with remaining time. Win more clashes to raise SP and concentrate damage at the 60% and 30% HP Staggers.
messages.時間0ではそんな･･･。2つと時間が足りない1つの3行動になる。マッチで勝つと敵: At 0 time, uses 2 “My...” and 1 “Running Out of Time” for 3 actions. Clash wins inflict 1 Fragile on the enemy; exploit the opening to finish.
messages.出血の的中とパニックからの復帰は残る。時間が切れただけで全攻撃が消えるわけではな: Bleed-inflicting hits and Panic recovery remain. Running out of time does not remove every attack; keep checking HP.
messages.[マッチ敗北]自分の体力が75%未満なら、奪った時間を50消耗し、保護1を得る(: [On Clash Lose] Below 75% HP, consume 50 Stolen Time and gain 1 Protection (once per turn)
messages.時間加速中はマッチ威力+1。HP75%未満でマッチに負けると奪った時間50を消耗: Gains +1 Clash Power during acceleration. Below 75% HP, losing the clash consumes 50 Stolen Time and grants 1 Protection; win to reduce time. Protection also affects follow-ups that turn.
messages.[使用時]奪った時間が500以上なら、対象の出血回数が1増加: [On Use] At 500+ Stolen Time, increase the target's Bleed Count by 1
messages.[使用時]奪った時間が300以上なら奪った時間を25消耗し、このスキルで付与する: [On Use] At 300+ Stolen Time, consume 25 Stolen Time and inflict +1 Bleed Potency and Count with this skill
messages.時間加速でマッチ威力+2。残り時間500以上・300以上の使用時効果で出血回数や: Acceleration grants +2 Clash Power. On-use conditions at 500+ and 300+ time also increase Bleed Count and application; include remaining time and acceleration in predictions.
messages.[使用時]自分の体力が75%未満なら、奪った時間を50消耗してマッチ威力+2: [On Use] Below 75% HP, consume 50 Stolen Time for +2 Clash Power
messages.時間加速中はコイン威力+1、HP75%未満では使用時に時間50を消耗してマッチ威: During acceleration, +1 Coin Power; below 75% HP, consumes 50 time on use for +2 Clash Power. Account for the buffed maximum of 21 and Offense Level difference rather than only the base maximum of 15.
messages.[使用時]自分の体力が75%未満なら、奪った時間を75消耗してマッチ威力+2: [On Use] Below 75% HP, consume 75 Stolen Time for +2 Clash Power
messages.[攻撃前]時間加速状態なら、攻撃加重値が1増加: [Before Attack] During Time Acceleration, Attack Weight +1
messages.時間加速中は攻撃前に加重値+1。HP75%未満では時間75消耗でマッチ威力+2。: Acceleration adds +1 Attack Weight before attacking. Below 75% HP, consuming 75 time grants +2 Clash Power. Check targets and Bleed rather than treating it as a weak single-target attack.
messages.自分に攻撃スキルを使用した対象へ、次のターンに時間救済対象を付与: Inflict Time Relief Entitlement next turn on targets that used attack skills against self
messages.[戦闘開始時]奪った時間を200消耗。次のターンに時間加速を得る: [Combat Start] Consume 200 Stolen Time. Gain Time Acceleration next turn
messages.マッチ不可。使用ターンに敵へ攻撃した囚人は翌ターンの時間救済対象になる。加速中に: Unclashable. Sinners attacking this turn gain Time Relief Entitlement next turn. Attack only with those able to survive accelerated hits; keep vulnerable Sinners from attacking the boss.
messages.[使用時]奪った時間100につき、基本威力+1: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 100 Stolen Time
messages.残り時間100につき基本威力+1。初期1000から高い威力を出すため、基礎最大8: Base Power +1 per 100 remaining time. Starting from 1000, it can roll high; do not challenge it with weak attacks based on the base maximum of 8. Offset with defense.
messages.時間切れ後の攻撃。敵をマッチで負かすと脆弱1を得るため、勝てる手で止めて追撃する: An attack after time runs out. Winning against it gives the enemy 1 Fragile; use winning skills and follow up.
messages.時間切れ後の4枚攻撃。こちらのマッチ勝利で敵に脆弱1が付く。時間が切れても出血の: A 4-Coin attack after time runs out. Winning gives the enemy 1 Fragile. Bleed hits still remain a risk at 0 time; take winning clashes to the end.
messages.パニックで長く止まるとは考えず、攻撃と守りを続ける。: Do not assume Panic will disable it for long; maintain offense and defense.
messages.パニックタイプを変更せず、精神力のない対象に付与される効果を受ける。: Panic type does not change; effects for targets without SP apply instead.
messages.パニックを別種類へ変える戦法は前提にしない。: Do not rely on replacing Panic with a different type.
messages.序盤の高いレベル補正を守備でしのぎ、消耗を待つ。: Endure the opening level bonuses with defense and wait for time consumption.
messages.ターン終了時に部位破壊状態: Part remains broken at Turn End
messages.保有時間100を消耗し、次のターンに部位破壊を解除する。本個体は本体と部位のHP: Consume 100 time and restore the broken part next turn. Body and part HP are equal in this encounter, so regeneration normally does not become relevant.
messages.部位再生で時間を削る手順を必須にしない。: Part regeneration is not a required time-reduction step.
messages.開始時の数値が200以上なら（数値−200）÷50分の攻撃・防御レベル増加。20: At Turn Start with 200+ stacks, gain (value − 200) ÷ 50 Offense/Defense Levels. Below 200, lose (200 − value) ÷ 50 Offense/Defense Levels.
messages.表示の基礎レベルへ固定補正として埋め込まず、毎ターンの残り時間で判断する。端数の: Do not bake a fixed modifier into the base table; assess remaining time each turn. No rounding rule is assumed.
messages.速度+5、スキル強化、脆弱1を得る。振動爆発・スキル・コイン効果で受ける混乱区間: Gain +5 Speed, skill bonuses, and 1 Fragile. Stagger Threshold increases received from Tremor Burst, skill effects, and Coin effects are 50% greater.
messages.危険な攻撃を受ける担当を予告ターンに準備する。攻められる場合は脆弱も利用する。: Prepare handlers for dangerous attacks on the warning turn. Exploit Fragile when able to attack.
messages.時間加速中の攻撃対象になる。救済する時間のターンに本体へ攻撃した囚人へ、次のター: Becomes a target during Time Acceleration. Applied next turn to Sinners who attacked the boss on “Time to be Saved”'s turn.
messages.全員で攻めず、受ける担当を絞る。: Limit attackers to selected handlers rather than the whole team.
messages.6.5-15最終戦の部位・分担時間・イベントを本戦へ持ち込まない。: Do not import the 6.5-15 finale's parts, divided time, or events into this fight.
messages.奪った時間はスキルで消耗する。通常は毎ターン一定量ずつ減る数値ではない。: Skills consume Stolen Time. It does not normally decrease by a fixed amount every turn.
messages.Hard限定の定刻・残された時間を含めない。時間切れ後の4行動もHardのもの。: Excludes Hard-only 'O Clock and Remaining Time effects. The 4-action pattern after time runs out also belongs to Hard.
messages.斬撃・色欲は半減。育成済みでも火力が通りにくい場合は属性を見直す。: Slash and Lust are halved. Review affinities if even leveled attackers deal little damage.
messages.主力Lv45・同期Ⅲ以上を目安にし、序盤を受ける斬撃・貫通耐性と守備を確認する。: Aim for Level 45 and Uptie III or higher; check opening defense and Slash/Pierce resistance.
messages.貫通・怠惰・暴食の火力、HP回復、強化後の技へ使う高威力E.G.Oを用意する。: Bring Pierce, Sloth, and Gluttony damage, HP recovery, and powerful E.G.O for buffed skills.
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャはバッジを得るが、3名限定戦ではない。育成済みの6名で挑め: Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion gain badges, but deployment is not limited to those 3. Bring a leveled team of 6.
messages.予告ターンに攻撃して対象を引き受け、耐性・守備でしのぐ。: Attack on the warning turn to accept targeting, then endure through resistance and defense.
messages.時間消耗後の混乱と撃破へつなぐ。: Turn depleted time into Stagger and defeat.
messages.序盤の被弾と出血から立て直し、勝てるマッチを増やす。: Recover from opening hits and Bleed to secure more winning clashes.
messages.【リンバス】6.5-10 20区ユロージヴィ隊長（6.5-10）の攻略｜Limb: 6.5-10 District 20 Yurodiviye Captain (6.5-10) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)6.5-10「20区ユロージヴィ隊長（6: District 20 Yurodiviye Captain (6.5-10) guide for Limbus Company 6.5-10. Start with Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion, each with 2 slots. Build SP and resources in Wave 1, then focus Pierce damage on the Captain in Wave 2. Once Staggered, concentrate damage and defeat him before the Unclashable “For the Greater Good”.
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャの3名で、各2スロットから始まる戦闘。第1Waveで精神力: Start with Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion, each with 2 slots. Build SP and resources in Wave 1, then focus Pierce damage on the Captain in Wave 2. Once Staggered, concentrate damage and defeat him before the Unclashable “For the Greater Good”.
messages.6.5-10の集中戦闘・2Wave。本体Lv44・HP582・防御Lv44。出撃: The 2-wave focused encounter in 6.5-10. Boss Level 44, 582 HP, Defense Level 44. Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion can deploy; each starts with 2 slots and 1 T Corp. Special Investigator Badge. Stagger percentages and HP thresholds are unconfirmed. Lists all 7 boss skills; does not substitute the dungeon's Level 45, 633-HP version.
messages.振動回数を増やす使用時効果と、囚人への的中効果を分ける。大義のための収集はマッチ: Distinguishes on-use increases to the enemy's Tremor Count from on-hit effects on Sinners. “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable; Guard gains Shield at Combat Start. Check actual add types, numbers, and actions in combat.
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャの3名をLv44・同期Ⅲ以上の目安で育てる。ほかの囚人を出: Aim for Level 44 and Uptie III or higher on Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion. Do not build a plan requiring other Sinners to deploy.
messages.第1Waveで精神力と資源を整える。本体は貫通2倍、斬撃半減のため、育成済みの貫: Build SP and resources in Wave 1. The boss takes double Pierce and half Slash damage; prioritize leveled Pierce attackers.
messages.本体の混乱後は火力を集中し、復帰前の撃破を狙う。大義のための収集はマッチで止まら: Concentrate damage after Stagger and aim to kill before recovery. “For the Greater Good” cannot be stopped by clashing; prepare Evade or resistance if the fight lasts longer.
messages.普段の主力を出撃できない: The usual main team cannot deploy
messages.この戦闘は良秀・ホンル・ロージャのみ。3名の人格と装備E.G.Oを確認する。初期: Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion are available. Check their Identities and equipped E.G.O. Each starts with 2 slots, providing 6 actions despite the small team.
messages.混乱させた後の大技をマッチで止められない: The post-Stagger finisher cannot be stopped by a clash
messages.大義のための収集はマッチ不可。高威力攻撃を当てるだけでは止まらない。混乱中の撃破: “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable. A powerful attack alone cannot stop it. Aim to kill during Stagger; otherwise, limit damage with Evade, resistance, and sufficient HP.
messages.急に混乱しやすく、追加ダメージも増える: Suddenly easier to Stagger, with more additional damage
messages.振動-崩壊で防御レベルが下がり、反響が絡縺すると爆発時に怠惰ダメージも受ける。振: Tremor - Decay lowers Defense Level, while entangled Reverb adds Sloth damage on Tremor Burst. Stop Tremor-inflicting attacks through clashes and check the target's Tremor and Stagger Threshold.
messages.未確定（割合・HP値の記載なし）: Unconfirmed (no percentage or HP value listed)
messages.第2Waveに出現する集中戦闘の個体。: The focused-encounter version appearing in Wave 2.
messages.取り巻きが倒れると本体のスキルスロットが増える。固定の増加上限は補わない。: Gains skill slots when adds die. No unconfirmed fixed slot cap is supplied.
messages.混乱復帰後の大義のための収集に備え、混乱中の追撃を用意する。: Prepare follow-up damage during Stagger for “For the Greater Good” after recovery.
messages.3名の精神力と資源を整える: Build the 3 Sinners' SP and resources
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャが各2スロットで始まる。勝てるマッチを配り、精神力と高威力: Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion start with 2 slots each. Assign winning clashes and gather SP and resources for powerful E.G.O.
messages.貫通攻撃を優先し、不要な被弾と振動を抑える。第2Waveへ低精神力・低HPのまま: Prioritize Pierce and limit unnecessary hits and Tremor. Avoid entering Wave 2 with low SP or HP.
messages.人数制限を踏まえ、攻撃だけで埋めず守備と回復も使う。出撃していない囚人のスキルを: With only 3 Sinners, use defense and healing as well as attacks. Do not make an undeployed Sinner's skill part of the required sequence.
messages.貫通で本体の混乱を狙う: Use Pierce to Stagger the boss
messages.本体は貫通2倍。斬撃半減へ火力を偏らせず、手持ちの貫通で混乱へ近づける。混乱区間: The boss takes double Pierce damage. Avoid concentrating damage into halved Slash; use available Pierce attacks to reach Stagger. Check the exact threshold in combat.
messages.敵の振動回数は使用時にも増えるため、マッチに勝つだけで全ての蓄積が止まるわけでは: Enemy Tremor Count also increases on use; winning clashes does not stop all buildup. Check Sinners' Tremor and Tremor Burst conditions too.
messages.取り巻きを倒すと本体のスロットが増える。必要な処理をしつつ、本体への火力と増えた: Defeating adds increases boss slots. Handle necessary adds while retaining boss damage and answers to the additional attacks.
messages.復帰前の撃破へ火力をまとめる: Concentrate damage to kill before recovery
messages.混乱を取ったら強い攻撃を本体へ集め、復帰前に倒す。次のターンへ火力を温存しすぎな: Once Staggered, focus strong attacks and defeat the boss before recovery. Avoid saving too much damage for the following turn.
messages.大義のための収集は戦闘開始時に味方の振動回数を集めて攻撃レベルを上げ、使用時にも: “For the Greater Good” collects allies' Tremor Count at Combat Start to raise Offense Level, then adds 9 to own Count on use. It is Unclashable; ordinary clash-winning E.G.O cannot stop it.
messages.使われる場合は回避・耐性・残HPを確認する。連続爆発で混乱すると敵全体が精神力を: If it is used, check Evade, resistance, and remaining HP. Repeated Bursts that Stagger a Sinner restore the enemy team's SP; avoid that chain of damage.
messages.自分の振動回数増加は使用時で、マッチ勝利でも止まらない。的中による囚人側の振動2: Its own Tremor Count rises on use, even if you win the clash. Prevent the 2 Tremor inflicted on Sinners to limit later Burst conditions.
messages.良心無いんだな: I See, You Have No Shame
messages.使用時に敵の振動回数が増え、各的中で振動3を付ける。序盤から勝てるマッチで振動の: Own Tremor Count rises on use; each hit inflicts 3 Tremor. Win clashes from the opening to limit buildup.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]自分の振動回数が10以上なら、振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] At 10+ own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.[的中時]対象の振動威力が15以上なら、振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: [On Hit] At 15+ Tremor Potency on the target, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce its Tremor Count by 1
messages.敵自身の振動回数10以上、または対象の振動威力15以上で2枚目の振動爆発が起こる: Coin 2 can trigger Tremor Burst at 10+ own Tremor Count or 15+ Tremor Potency on the target. Check Stagger Thresholds as well as Power when stopping it.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]振動-崩壊で振幅変換: Ⅲ[On Hit] Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Decay
messages.3枚目で囚人の振動を崩壊へ変える。防御レベル低下につながるため、振動の多い囚人へ: Coin 3 converts the Sinner's Tremor into Decay, lowering Defense Level. Keep it off high-Tremor Sinners.
messages.[使用時]自分を除いた全味方へ自分の振動回数だけ振動回数を付与: [On Use] Grant all other allies Tremor Count equal to own Tremor Count
messages.[使用時]自分を含めた全味方の振動を振動-分配へ振幅変換: [On Use] Convert all allies' Tremor, including self, into Tremor - Distribution
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]振動-反響へ振幅絡縺: Ⅳ[On Hit] Amplitude Entanglement with Tremor - Reverb
messages.振動-崩壊のある相手を優先する。使用時の敵全体への分配と、的中時の振動・反響の絡: Prioritizes Tremor - Decay targets. Distinguish on-use enemy-team distribution from on-hit Tremor and Reverb Entanglement. Stop the 4 hits to limit Burst damage.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分の振動回数の3倍だけバリアを得る(最大30): [Combat Start] Gain Shield equal to 3 times own Tremor Count (max 30)
messages.戦闘開始時に自身の振動回数×3のバリアを得る。上限30。相殺するか、割り切れる火: Gains Shield equal to own Tremor Count × 3 at Combat Start, capped at 30. Offset it or use enough damage to break through and reach Stagger.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分を除いた全味方の振動回数を自分が得て、全味方の振動を除去: [Combat Start] Gain all other allies' Tremor Count, then remove Tremor from all allies
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分の振動回数3につき、攻撃レベル増加1を得る: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Offense Level Up per 3 own Tremor Count
messages.[的中時]自分の振動回数につき10%分の追加怠惰ダメージを与える: [On Hit] Deal additional Sloth damage of 10% per own Tremor Count
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]自分の振動回数を3消耗し、振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅲ[On Hit] Consume 3 own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst, and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.[的中時]自分の振動回数を3消耗し、振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: [On Hit] Consume 3 own Tremor Count, trigger Tremor Burst, and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.マッチ不可。高威力E.G.Oを当ててもマッチで止まらない。混乱中に倒すか、使われ: Unclashable, even against powerful E.G.O. Kill during Stagger or use Evade, resistance, and sufficient HP if it occurs. Repeated Bursts and additional Sloth damage are dangerous.
messages.パニックにしただけで長く停止する前提にはしない。: Do not assume Panic alone will disable the enemy for long.
messages.自身の攻撃または振動爆発で対象を混乱させる: Staggering a target with own attacks or Tremor Burst
messages.味方の混乱から敵が立て直す連鎖を防ぐ。: Prevent a chain where your Sinners' Stagger lets the enemy team recover.
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャのみ出撃可能。各2スロットとT社特別捜査官バッジ1を持って: Only Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion may deploy. Each starts with 2 slots and 1 T Corp. Special Investigator Badge.
messages.3名の育成とE.G.Oをそろえ、合計6行動を攻撃・守備へ配分する。: Prepare all 3 Sinners and their E.G.O, dividing the total 6 actions between offense and defense.
messages.振動威力4につき防御レベルが1減少する。振動爆発では振動威力分の混乱区間前進を受: Defense Level -1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Tremor Burst raises the Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency.
messages.対象の防御低下と混乱区間を確認し、振動の多い囚人へ爆発を通さない。: Check Defense Level reduction and Stagger Thresholds; prevent Bursts on high-Tremor Sinners.
messages.振動爆発時、振動威力分の怠惰ダメージを受ける。混乱区間前進も起こる。: On Tremor Burst, take Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency, in addition to the Stagger Threshold increase.
messages.爆発を繰り返す大義のための収集を受ける時間を短くする。: Limit how long the team must endure “For the Greater Good”'s repeated Bursts.
messages.ターン終了時、味方全体の振動回数合計÷生存味方数に応じ、次のターンに攻撃レベル増: At Turn End, gain up to 5 Offense Level Up next turn based on total allied Tremor Count divided by living allies.
messages.隊長が使用時に敵全体へ変換する強化。長期戦では次ターンの攻撃レベルも確認する。: The Captain converts the enemy team into this buff on use. In a long fight, check next-turn Offense Level too.
messages.変換は振動の種類を替え、絡縺は振動-重畳として効果を組み合わせる。威力・回数を維: Conversion changes Tremor type; Entanglement combines effects as Tremor - Superposition. Potency and Count are retained. Superposition reverts to Tremor at Turn End.
messages.見た目の名称変更だけではなく、防御低下と爆発時ダメージが併存する点を見る。: This combines Defense Level reduction with Burst damage; it is more than a name change.
messages.6.5-15道中のLv45・HP633の隊長とは別個体。: Distinct from the Level 45, 633-HP Captain in the 6.5-15 dungeon.
messages.混乱区間・取り巻きの固定配置・行動周期は未確定。推定の数値で手順を固定しない。: Stagger thresholds, fixed add formations, and action cycles are unconfirmed. Do not lock a sequence to estimated values.
messages.大義のための収集はマッチ不可。回避の成功も保証されないため、予測と残HPを確認す: “For the Greater Good” is Unclashable. Evade success is not guaranteed either; check predictions and remaining HP.
messages.良秀・ホンル・ロージャをLv44・同期Ⅲ以上の目安でそろえる。貫通が使える育成済: Aim for Level 44 and Uptie III or higher on Ryōshū, Hong Lu, and Rodion. Prioritize leveled Identities with Pierce attacks.
messages.第1Waveで精神力と資源を整え、混乱後へ高火力を残す。: Build SP and resources in Wave 1 and save high damage for Stagger.
messages.長引く場合に備え、3名の守備と回復手段を確認する。: Check defense and healing options for all 3 Sinners in case the fight lasts longer.
messages.本体の弱点を突き、混乱から撃破へつなぐ。: Exploit the boss's weakness and progress from Stagger to defeat.
messages.振動の蓄積を抑え、マッチ不可攻撃が残った場合の被害を軽減する。: Limit Tremor buildup and damage if the Unclashable attack occurs.
messages.3名のうち誰かが崩れたまま第2Waveへ進まないようにする。: Avoid entering Wave 2 with any of the 3 Sinners unable to contribute.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-18「レン・アルビナ」の攻略。4人で: Ren & Albina guide for Limbus Company 9-18. A 4-Sinner fight against 2 enemies. Reduce Ren's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken Albina's finisher with 3 separate attacks beforehand. Avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain” turns.
messages.4人で挑む2人戦。レンの呼吸と月下青刀を減らし、アルビナの大技は先に別々の攻撃3: A 4-Sinner fight against 2 enemies. Reduce Ren's Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade; weaken Albina's finisher with 3 separate attacks beforehand. Avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain” turns.
messages.9-18通常戦。イサン・良秀・ムルソー・グレゴールのみ出撃でき、良秀は必須。敵の: Normal 9-18. Only Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor may deploy; Ryōshū is required. No initial enemy Level reduction. Ren triggers reinforcements at 760 HP and withdraws below 490; Albina withdraws below 680. Neither must be reduced to 0 HP.
messages.良秀以外でレンのマッチを受け持ち、月下青刀を減らす。: Have Sinners other than Ryōshū handle Ren's clashes and reduce Moonlit Azure Blade.
messages.抑圧された肉体には、先に別々の攻撃3本を通す。: Hit “Repressed Flesh” with 3 separate attacks before its clash.
messages.鉄のとばりへは攻撃しない。相殺しても反射強化は残る。: Do not attack into “Iron Curtain”. Offsetting does not remove the enhanced reflection.
messages.アルビナの大技にまったく勝てない: Albina's finisher seems impossible to beat
messages.抑圧された肉体は正面から高威力で競う技ではない。使用前に3スキルでダメージを与え: “Repressed Flesh” is not a raw-Power contest. Damage her with 3 skills before use to reach 3 Impact-rattled Armor and reduce Final Power by 30, then clash.
messages.攻撃した味方が突然大きく削られる: An attacking ally suddenly takes massive damage
messages.アルビナの鉄のとばり中は棘の反射が20倍。守備の相殺では解除されないので、攻撃を: “Iron Curtain” multiplies Albina's Spikes reflection by 20. Offsetting the defense skill does not remove it; stop attacking and use defense or healing.
messages.月下青刀は被ダメージごとに1減るが、呼吸25を超えた獲得で補充される。多コインで: Moonlit Azure Blade drops by 1 each time he takes damage, but Poise gained beyond 25 replenishes it. Use multiple Coins and target Swerve/Defend slots to limit Poise gains too.
messages.月下青刀50で開始。開始時に数値×5のバリアを得る。: Starts with 50 Moonlit Azure Blade. At Turn Start, gains Shield equal to its value × 5.
messages.アルビナ出現前はHP760に下限があり、到達すると即ターン終了。6ターン目開始で: Before Albina appears, HP cannot fall below 760; reaching it immediately ends the turn. Reinforcements also arrive at the start of turn 6.
messages.HP490未満で離脱。アルビナだけ先に離脱させるとレンの行動枠が2つ増える。: Withdraws below 490 HP. If Albina withdraws first, Ren gains 2 action slots.
messages.精神力30で参戦し、良秀以外の味方の行動枠が1つ増える。: Joins at 30 SP; allies other than Ryōshū gain 1 action slot.
messages.HP60%付近で混乱解除・即ターン終了は1回のみ。その後の鉄のとばりを確認する。: At roughly 60% HP, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn once. Check the following “Iron Curtain”.
messages.保護・防御Lv増加・バリアは変動する効果。表の防御65に固定で含めない。: Protection, Defense Level Up, and Shield vary. Do not permanently include them in the table's Defense Level 65.
messages.出撃できる4人を育て、斬撃への守備を用意: Level the 4 available Sinners and prepare Slash defense
messages.推奨Lv58を目安に、イサン・良秀・ムルソー・グレゴールを育てる。敵はLv65で: Aim for the recommended Level 58 on Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor. Enemies are Level 65 with no reduction support. If clashes are unwinnable, consider leveling closer to 60 or using a Sapling of Light ability.
messages.良秀はほかの味方が生きていれば死亡しない。良秀以外の3人のHPを確保し、回復と高: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally survives. Maintain the other 3 Sinners' HP and prepare healing and powerful clash handlers.
messages.レンには斬撃、アルビナには打撃・怠惰・暴食が通りやすい。属性だけでなく、大技用の: Slash works against Ren; Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony against Albina. Prepare finisher clashes and healing as well as suitable affinities.
messages.多コインで月下青刀を減らす: Reduce Moonlit Azure Blade with multiple Coins
messages.最初は回・守・反が並ぶ。回と守へ攻撃を向けると、開始時の呼吸・回数獲得を減らせる: The opening uses Swerve, Defend, and Reflect. Targeting Swerve and Defend reduces their Combat Start Poise/Count gains. Clashable Guard cannot be Offset by defense skills.
messages.月下青刀は被ダメージで1ずつ減る。多コインの攻撃で削りつつ、呼吸25を超えた獲得: Moonlit Azure Blade falls by 1 per instance of damage. Reduce it with multi-Coin attacks while preventing replenishment from Poise gains beyond 25.
messages.良秀以外とのマッチではレンの威力が2下がる。危険な攻撃を3人で受け持ち、良秀には: Ren loses 2 Clash Power against Sinners other than Ryōshū. Have the other 3 handle dangerous attacks and use Ryōshū for damage or healing. Reaching 760 HP ends the turn; avoid excessive follow-ups.
messages.硬いアルビナよりレンを先に削る: Focus Ren before the heavily defended Albina
messages.6ターン目開始、またはレンHP760到達の次ターンにアルビナが参戦。良秀以外の枠: Albina joins at turn 6's start or the turn after Ren reaches 760 HP. Other Sinners gain slots; reorganize necessary clashes and one-sided attacks.
messages.アルビナは最初、保護・防御Lv増加・バリアで硬い。必要な攻撃を止めながら、レンへ: Albina initially has Protection, Defense Level Up, and Shield. Stop necessary attacks while focusing Ren below 490 HP to make him withdraw.
messages.落星一殺は加重値8・破壊不能。速度に関係なく強い技で勝つと被害80%減・その技で: Fallstar Slayer has 8 Attack Weight and Unbreakable Coins. Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to reduce damage by 80% and prevent Stagger from this skill. Account for Moonlit Azure Blade's bonuses; use Paralyze to limit Coin Power if available.
messages.3本の先行攻撃の後にマッチする: Resolve 3 attacks before the final clash
messages.生体材料2から作品名:ファシアを得ると、抑圧された肉体を使う。装着されたターンは: At 2 Corpus Ingredient, Albina gains Artwork: Fascia and uses “Repressed Flesh”. Spikes is inactive on the turn the skill is equipped.
messages.この大技より先に、別々の攻撃スキル3本でアルビナへダメージを与える。E.G.Oも: Before the finisher, damage Albina with 3 separate attack skills. Each skill, including E.G.O, grants 1 Impact-rattled Armor. A single 3-Coin skill counts only once.
messages.甲冑3なら大技の最終威力−30。先行する3本と、最後にマッチする1本を行動順で確: At 3 Armor, the finisher loses 30 Final Power. Check action order for 3 early attacks and 1 final clash. After attacking, she is Staggered through next turn and supplies less Protection/Shield; exploit the opening.
messages.鉄のとばりをしのぎ、離脱まで削る: Survive “Iron Curtain” and damage her until withdrawal
messages.HP約811で一度だけ混乱解除・即ターン終了。次に鉄のとばりが出たら、アルビナへ: At roughly 811 HP, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn once. If “Iron Curtain” follows, avoid attacking Albina. Offsetting does not remove the ×20 Spikes reflection.
messages.反射の強いターンは回復・守備に使い、弱体化・混乱した機会へ火力をまとめる。HP6: Use strong-reflection turns for healing and defense, then concentrate damage during debuffs or Stagger. Albina withdraws below 680 HP; the encounter ends if Ren has withdrawn too.
messages.大技に勝った時の混乱防止は、その技のダメージへの効果。出血や別の被弾による死亡ま: Stagger prevention after winning a finisher clash applies to that skill's damage. It does not prevent death from Bleed or other hits.

messages.加重値3の斬撃。呼吸によるクリティカルと攻撃終了時の追加ダメージが危険。勝てる通: A Slash attack with 3 Attack Weight. Poise critical hits and post-attack additional damage are dangerous. Stop it with a winning regular skill and maintain secondary targets' HP.
messages.加重値3で次ターンの斬撃脆弱を付ける。低HPの囚人へ通さず、後の落星一殺まで回復: 3 Attack Weight, inflicting next-turn Slash Fragility. Keep it off low-HP Sinners and save healing for the later Fallstar Slayer.

messages.使用前に別々の攻撃スキル3本でダメージを与え、酷く鳴り響く甲冑3にして最終威力を: Damage her with 3 separate attack skills before use to reach 3 Impact-rattled Armor, reducing Final Power by 30 before clashing. A single 3-Coin skill does not grant 3 stacks. Spikes is inactive this turn.

messages.開始時に、攻撃を受けると攻撃者の出血回数を増やす状態になる。棘の反射もあるため、: At Combat Start, gains an effect that increases attackers' Bleed Count when hit. Spikes also reflects damage; avoid unnecessary attacks and prioritize Ren.
messages.このターンに「アイアンメイデン - 棘」効果で敵への与ダメージ量が20倍に増加(: This turn, Iron Maiden - Spikes deals 20 times its normal damage to enemies (this effect is not removed by Offset)

messages.攻撃スキル終了時、各対象へ(クリティカル的中した斬撃コイン個数×10)だけ斬撃ダ: After an attack skill ends, deal Slash damage to each target equal to (number of Slash Coins that critically hit × 10). This damage cannot Stagger

messages.良秀以外の対象とマッチを進行するとき、マッチ威力-2,良秀以外の対象から受けるダ: When clashing against someone other than Ryōshū, Clash Power -2. Take 20% less damage from targets other than Ryōshū

Poise Potency caps at 25.
Poise Potency gained beyond 25 becomes Moonlit Azure Blade.

Take 50% less Bleed damage.
messages.出血は50%、その他の対象効果は30%軽減。状態異常だけで無理に突破せず、強攻撃: Bleed is reduced by 50%; the other listed effects by 30%. Use the opening after the finisher rather than forcing through with statuses alone.

For each use of “Repressed Flesh” this encounter, reduce these gains by 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and 5 percentage points of Shield.

While not Staggered, when damaged by an attacker's final Coin:

messages.反射と出血が返る。鉄のとばり中は特に攻撃しない。抑圧された肉体の準備ターンは例外: Returns reflected damage and Bleed. Especially avoid attacking during “Iron Curtain”; “Repressed Flesh”'s preparation turn is the exception.

messages.良秀のスロット+1、蜘蛛の巣へのダメージ+10%。混乱すると次ターンに解除して攻: Ryōshū gains +1 slot and +10% damage against Spiderweb. On Stagger, recover next turn and gain 1 Attack Power Up (once per encounter). Cannot retreat.
messages.ほかの味方生存中は良秀が死亡しない。仲間のHPを残しながら役割を分担する。: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. Divide roles while preserving allied HP.
messages.最大50。開始時に数値×5のバリア、数値1につきクリティカルダメージ+1%。被ダ: Max 50. At Turn Start, gain Shield equal to value × 5; critical damage +1% per stack. Decreases by 1 when taking damage.

messages.表示の基礎値だけで大技の威力を判断しない。: Do not judge the finisher's Power solely from base values.
messages.最大3。抑圧された肉体の最終威力を1につき10下げる。攻撃終了後、3なら消滅して: Max 3. Each stack reduces “Repressed Flesh”'s Final Power by 10. After attacking at 3 stacks, expires and causes Stagger through next turn.
messages.別々の攻撃3本でため、最後の1本でマッチする。: Build stacks with 3 separate attacks, then clash with the final skill.
messages.抑圧された肉体の弱体化はスキル数で数える。3コインの1技を当てても甲冑3にはなら: “Repressed Flesh” counts skills for its debuff. One 3-Coin skill does not grant 3 Armor.
messages.鉄のとばりの反射強化は相殺で消えない。抑圧された肉体の準備ターンと取り違えない。: “Iron Curtain”'s enhanced reflection survives Offset. Do not confuse it with the “Repressed Flesh” preparation turn.
messages.アルビナのHP60%でターンが終わる。混乱させた後の追撃が最後まで動くとは限らな: The turn ends at 60% Albina HP. Follow-up attacks after Stagger may not all resolve.
messages.良秀の保護は仲間の生存が条件。ほかの3人を失わない。: Ryōshū's protection requires another living ally. Keep the other 3 alive.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-30「ソラ（9-30）」の攻略。前半: Sora (9-30) guide for Limbus Company 9-30. Prevent hits on the Prescript's target early; later, survive with Vespa's support. Prioritize more than damage: use Ryōshū's resources and healing while preserving Assist Defense's conditions.
messages.前半は指令対象への的中を防ぎ、後半はベスパの援護を使って生き残る戦闘。火力だけを: Prevent hits on the Prescript's target early; later, survive with Vespa's support. Prioritize more than damage: use Ryōshū's resources and healing while preserving Assist Defense's conditions.
messages.9-30通常戦。イサン・良秀・ムルソー・グレゴールのみ出撃可能、良秀必須。通常と: Normal 9-30. Only Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor may deploy; Ryōshū is required. Normal and Effloresced forms are states of the same enemy, not separate 1500-HP fights. Offense/Defense entries are before Grace of the Prescript, Unlock, Faith Beyond Question, Shin (心) - Sora, and other buffs. Gains 750 Shield at encounter start and another 750 when Vespa joins.
messages.通常状態・開花状態の技を分けて掲載。大人しく潰されてくださいは9-30の通常パタ: Lists normal and Effloresced skills separately. “Please Don't Resist and just be Crushed to Death” is outside 9-30's normal pattern. Check effects for conditional Unbreakable Coins.
messages.指令対象は怠惰技を担当し、ほかの攻撃を別の囚人が引き取る。: Have the Prescript's target handle Sloth skills; redirect other attacks to different Sinners.
messages.良秀の資源獲得を回復・弱体化へ回し、イベントまで生存する。: Use Ryōshū's resources for healing/debuffs and survive until the event.
messages.ベスパの援護防御に任せる攻撃は、一方攻撃と守備未装着の条件を守る。: For attacks left to Vespa's Assist Defense, preserve the one-sided-attack and no-defense-equipped conditions.
messages.序盤から精神力と威力がどんどん上がる: Enemy SP and Power keep rising early
messages.指令対象へ的中すると指令を達成されやすい。指令対象自身は怠惰技を担当し、ほかの技: Hits on the Prescript's target make completion easier. That target should clash against Sloth skills while others redirect remaining attacks. Failed Prescripts still add Grace and Onus; progression cannot be halted forever.
messages.ベスパが来たのに囚人が倒れる: Sinners die even after Vespa arrives
messages.NPCがすべての攻撃を自動で防ぐわけではない。残った2本を囚人で止める。援護防御: The NPC does not automatically block everything. Stop the remaining 2 attacks with Sinners. Equipping defense on a target intended for Assist Defense invalidates its condition.
messages.回避を付けたのに発動しない: Evade is equipped but never activates
messages.は、はやく指令を遂行しなきゃ…。は守備を発動させない。圧迫感2なら対象変更もでき: “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” prevents defense-skill activation. At 2 Onus, it also cannot be redirected; prepare a winning attack on the designated Sinner.
messages.1〜2／強攻撃時+10など: 1–2 / +10 on powerful-attack turns and other bonuses
messages.解禁は加護3／6／9、またはHP90%／75%／60%でも進む。進むと精神力45: Unlock progresses at 3/6/9 Grace or at 90%/75%/60% HP. Progress restores SP to 45 and clears Stagger.
messages.指令未達成でも、解禁前は指令の加護1を得る。前半の固定したターン数だけで状態を決: Before Unlock, even failed Prescripts grant 1 Grace. Do not infer the opening state only from a fixed turn count.
messages.1〜2に当然の信心・シン(心)などを加算: 1–2 plus Faith Beyond Question, Shin (心) - Sora, and other bonuses
messages.通常区間なし／特定効果による混乱: No regular thresholds / Stagger from specific effects
messages.解禁があり、開始時の精神力25以上なら15を消費して開花。開始時0以下で解除する: With Unlock and 25+ SP at Turn Start, spend 15 SP to Effloresce. Ends at Turn Start with 0 SP or lower.
messages.ベスパ登場後は抹殺体勢で精神力0未満にならない。バリアと強化が追加される。: After Vespa joins, Annihilation Form prevents SP falling below 0 and adds Shield and buffs.
messages.HP300で終盤行動へ移り、ベスパの攻撃による決着を迎える。HP0まで囚人で削る: At 300 HP, enters the closing pattern and Vespa delivers the finish. Sinners do not need to reduce HP to 0.
messages.4人の生存と回復を優先する: Prioritize survival and healing for all 4 Sinners
messages.推奨Lv60。イサン・良秀・ムルソー・グレゴールを育てる。良秀以外も生きていない: Recommended Level 60. Level Yi Sang, Ryōshū, Meursault, and Gregor. If no other ally lives, Ryōshū loses protection from lethal damage.
messages.HP・精神力回復と攻撃威力低下を用意する。良秀はスキル使用で資源を得られるため、: Bring HP/SP recovery and Attack Power Down. Ryōshū generates resources by using skills; use options such as Meursault's Chains of Others to weaken strong attacks.
messages.通常状態は貫通が通るが、開花すると物理3種とも耐性になる。開花後は憂鬱・傲慢が通: Normal form is vulnerable to Pierce; Efflorescence resists all 3 physical types. Gloom and Pride work well afterward. Prioritize necessary clashes and healing over raw damage.
messages.指令対象に複数の的中を通さない: Prevent repeated hits on the Prescript's target
messages.毎ターンの人差し指の指令対象を確認。指令Ⅰは対象への的中、Ⅱは最初の枠の的中など: Check The Prescript's Target - The Index each turn. Conditions change by stage: Prescript I requires a hit on the target, II a hit from the first slot, and so on.
messages.指令対象は怠惰の頭を潰すなどを担当し、ほかの技を別の囚人で引き取る。は、はやく指: The designated target should handle Sloth skills such as “Skull Crushing” while other Sinners redirect remaining attacks. “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” disables defense; do not rely on Evade against it.
messages.未達成なら精神力15回復を防げる反面、圧迫感とカルマが増える。解禁前の加護も1増: Preventing completion stops the 15 SP recovery but increases Onus and Karmic Consequence. Before Unlock, Grace also rises by 1; repeated failure does not prevent Efflorescence forever.
messages.回復と弱体化で8ターン目またはHP900まで耐える: Endure with healing/debuffs until turn 8 or 900 HP
messages.解禁・精神力の条件を満たすと開花し、通常技も斬撃へ変わる。当然の信心や呼吸で基礎: Meeting Unlock/SP conditions causes Efflorescence; regular skills become Slash too. Faith Beyond Question and Poise strengthen attacks beyond base values, so use current predictions each turn.
messages.良秀は混乱するダメージでも混乱区間を取り除き、次ターンの攻撃強化と資源獲得で戦え: Ryōshū removes Stagger Thresholds even from damage that would Stagger her, and can fight with next-turn attack buffs and resource gains. Preserve allied HP and choose which attacks she redirects.
messages.8ターン目開始、またはHP900到達でイベントが起き、ベスパが参戦する。無理にH: An event at turn 8's start or 900 HP brings Vespa. Reach it through healing and debuffs rather than forcing a kill. Before he joins, lowering SP to end Efflorescence is another option.
messages.援護防御に任せる枠と、囚人が止める枠を分ける: Separate Assist Defense assignments from Sinner clashes
messages.基本の6本のうち、右側3本はベスパがマッチする。最左の1本は援護防御に任せ、中央: Of the basic 6 attacks, Vespa clashes against the rightmost 3. Leave the far-left attack to Assist Defense; stop the middle 2 with Ryōshū or other Sinners. Check that the NPC actually has the intended targets.
