messages.援護防御は、守備を装着していない味方への一方攻撃に発動する。任せる枠へマッチを付: Assist Defense intercepts one-sided attacks on allies without defense skills equipped. Do not clash against that attack or equip defense on its target. Defense in another slot of that same Sinner also affects eligibility.
messages.ベスパにもマッチ敗北はあり、囚人が全滅すると敗北。解禁Ⅲの大技は速度に関係なくマ: Vespa can lose clashes, and losing all Sinners causes defeat. Unlock III's finisher can be clashed regardless of Speed, but avoid needlessly redirecting NPC assignments.
messages.代行: 抹殺 - 本望はベスパ優先の行動。5枚破壊不能で、通常の代行: 抹殺にあ: Procuration's Immanent Yearning variant prioritizes Vespa. It has 5 Unbreakable Coins and lacks the 90% clash-loss damage reduction of ordinary “Procuration: Annihilate”. Confirm it remains assigned to Vespa.
messages.攻撃後にターンが終わるため、後からの回復を当てにせず事前に整える。HP300で終: It ends the turn after attacking; heal beforehand rather than relying on later actions. At 300 HP, the closing sequence ends with Vespa's “Harpoon Impalement - There It Is.”
messages.自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計6につき、最終威力+1(最大2): Final Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 2)
messages.呼吸と対象の沈潜で表示より強くなる。指令対象以外が引き取って的中を防ぎ、敵の指令: Poise and target Sinking raise Power above the display. Redirect away from the Prescript's target to prevent hits and completion.
messages.[戦闘開始時]圧迫感があるか、人差し指の指令対象なら、最終コインが破壊不能コイン: [Combat Start] With Onus or against The Prescript's Target - The Index, the final Coin becomes Unbreakable
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-50%,的中時に対象を混乱させず、沈潜効果も発動しない: [On Clash Lose] Damage -50%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking
messages.Ⅲ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜2を付与、沈潜回数が1増加: Ⅲ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Sinking and increase Sinking Count by 1
messages.圧迫感または指令対象の条件で最後のコインが破壊不能になる。勝つと被害半減・その的: Onus or the Prescript's target makes the final Coin Unbreakable. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger/Sinking activation from those hits, but on-use Poise remains.
messages.は、はやく指令を遂行しなきゃ…。: I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!
messages.自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計6につき、最終威力+1(最大3): Final Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 3)
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-80%,的中時に対象を混乱させず、沈潜効果も発動しない: [On Clash Lose] Damage -80%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking
messages.[使用時]呼吸2を得る、自分の呼吸回数が2増加: [On Use] Gain 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count
messages.Ⅰ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking
messages.Ⅱ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +2
messages.守備を発動させないため、回避・防御で受ける計画にしない。圧迫感2では対象変更もで: Disables defense activation; do not plan to Evade or Guard. At 2 Onus, cannot be redirected either. Use the designated Sinner's powerful attack and secure the 80% damage reduction by winning.
messages.大人しく潰されてください: Please Don't Resist and just be Crushed to Death
messages.速度と関係なく、このスキルとマッチができる: Can be clashed regardless of Speed
messages.[マッチ敗北]威力減少3,麻痺4を得る: [On Clash Lose] Gain 3 Power Down and 4 Paralyze
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-90%,的中時に対象を混乱させず、沈潜効果も発動しない: [On Clash Lose] Damage -90%; hits cannot Stagger targets or trigger Sinking
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]呼吸を1得る: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Gain 1 Poise
messages.9-30の通常の行動では使わない技。4枚破壊不能で、勝利すると威力減少・麻痺と9: Not used in 9-30's normal pattern. 4 Unbreakable Coins; winning applies Power Down, Paralyze, and 90% damage reduction. Do not import another encounter's action cycle into 9-30.
messages.boss-copy:sora:skills.4.name: Let These Hands be the Proxy...
messages.開花後の怠惰技。指令対象自身がこの枠とマッチし、ほかの攻撃を別の囚人で引き取る。: The Effloresced Sloth skill. Have the Prescript's target clash here while others redirect remaining attacks. Enemy SP falls by 3 after attacking.
messages.Ⅲ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜回数が2増加: Ⅲ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +2
messages.最後のコインは条件付き破壊不能。呼吸・対象の沈潜や開花の強化を含めて予測を確認す: The last Coin is conditionally Unbreakable. Include Poise, target Sinking, and Efflorescence buffs in predictions. Use the clash-loss damage halving and Sinking prevention.
messages.自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計6につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): Coin Power +1 per 6 total own Poise and target Sinking (max 2)
messages.[使用時]人差し指の指令対象なら、ダメージ量+50%: [On Use] Against The Prescript's Target - The Index, damage +50%
messages.[使用時]呼吸3を得る、自分の呼吸回数が3増加: [On Use] Gain 3 Poise and 3 Poise Count
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-80%,的中時に対象を混乱させず沈潜効果も発動しない: [On Clash Lose] Damage -80%; hits cannot Stagger targets or activate Sinking
messages.Ⅰ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜3を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 3 Sinking
messages.Ⅱ[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜回数が3増加: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Sinking Count +3
messages.指令対象へダメージ+50%、呼吸と沈潜でコイン威力も増える。勝てば80%軽減とそ: Deals +50% damage to the Prescript's target; Poise and Sinking also raise Coin Power. Winning grants 80% reduction and prevents Stagger/Sinking from those hits. Do not ignore dangerous attacks left after Vespa joins.
messages.[使用時]人差し指の指令対象なら、ダメージ量+100%: [On Use] Against The Prescript's Target - The Index, damage +100%
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]沈潜1を付与: [On Hit Without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Sinking
messages.4枚破壊不能。速度に関係なくマッチできるので、高威力技で勝って90%軽減・麻痺4: 4 Unbreakable Coins, clashable regardless of Speed. Win with high Power for 90% damage reduction and 4 Paralyze. Unlike Immanent Yearning, this skill has substantial clash-loss mitigation.
messages.代行: 抹殺 - 本望: Procuration: Annihilation - Mang of Immanent Yearning [本望]
messages.[使用時]精神力が0以上なら、望1つを生成: [On Use] At 0 SP or higher, generate 1 Mang
messages.-ダメージ量+20%,最終威力とコイン威力がそれぞれ+2: - Damage +20%; Final Power and Coin Power +2 each
messages.[攻撃後]望を生成したなら、精神力を20消耗: [After Attack] If a Mang was generated, consume 20 SP
messages.[攻撃後]圧迫感を全て消耗、このターンが終了: [After Attack] Consume all Onus and end the turn
messages.5枚破壊不能。精神力0以上なら望を生成し、最終威力・コイン威力が各2増える。ほか: 5 Unbreakable Coins. At 0 SP or higher, generates Mang and gains +2 Final Power and Coin Power. Unlike other Annihilate skills, it has no clash-loss damage reduction. Avoid redirecting it away from Vespa; also account for the turn ending afterward.
messages.ステージ開始時、体力最大値の50%だけバリアを得る(この戦闘の間維持される)\n:
At encounter start, gain Shield equal to 50% maximum HP (persists for this encounter).

At Turn Start:
- Gain a Prescript based on Unlock stage.
- Mark a random enemy with The Prescript's Target - The Index and prioritize them, except for specific patterns.

Damage to that target +2.5% per Grace of the Prescript (max 20%).
- At 9 Grace, instead deal +30% damage to all targets.
messages.開始時・毎ターンの指令対象決定: Encounter start / choosing each turn's Prescript target
messages.開始時のバリア750を突破しようと火力だけに寄せない。対象の印と指令条件を読み、: Do not focus only on damage to break the initial 750 Shield. Read the mark and Prescript conditions to prevent hits.
messages.このターンに指令を遂行したなら、\nターン終了時に精神力を15回復、(解禁段階+:
If the Prescript was completed this turn, at Turn End heal 15 SP and gain (Unlock stage + 1) Grace of the Prescript (once per turn).

If not completed, at Turn End gain 1 Onus and 5 Karmic Consequence.
- Without Unlock, also gain 1 Grace of the Prescript.
- At 9 Grace, do not gain Karmic Consequence.
- While Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration is active, double Karmic Consequence gained.
messages.阻止すると精神力回復を防げるが、圧迫感とカルマが増える。未達成なら敵が一切強くな: Preventing completion stops SP recovery but adds Onus and Karmic Consequence. Failure does not prevent every enemy buff.
messages.ターン終了時、指令の加護が3/6/9か体力が90%/75%/60%以下なら、\n:
At Turn End with 3/6/9 Grace of the Prescript or HP at 90%/75%/60% or lower:
- Gain Unlock - I / II / III.
- Restore SP to 45.
- Consume all Onus and recover from Stagger.

When gaining Unlock through HP:
- Gain Karmic Consequence equal to (SP recovered ÷ 15).
- If Grace is below 3/6/9, raise it to that value. Per stack gained, gain 1 Defense Level Down and 2 Karmic Consequence at the next Turn Start.

Minimum/maximum Speed +10 on powerful-attack turns.
“The sword and cloth bestowed by the Prescript unlock and manifest their powers only when the Prescript is fulfilled.”
messages.指令の加護3／6／9、またはHP90%／75%／60%以下: 3/6/9 Grace of the Prescript or 90%/75%/60% HP or lower
messages.HPを急に削っても段階が進み、精神力45回復と混乱解除がある。解禁が加護だけで進: Rapid HP damage also advances stages, restores SP to 45, and clears Stagger. Unlock does not progress through Grace alone.
messages.ターン開始時に解禁があるかつ、精神力が25以上なら\n精神力を15消耗して開花E:
At Turn Start with Unlock and 25+ SP, consume 15 SP to enter Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration and clear Stagger.
- Resistances change and gain Faith Beyond Question while active.
- Ends at Turn Start with 0 SP or lower.
messages.解禁あり・開始時精神力25以上: Unlock present / 25+ SP at Turn Start
messages.精神力15消費で開花し耐性とスキルが変わる。開始時0以下なら解除できるが、参戦後: Spend 15 SP to Effloresce, changing resistances and skills. Can end at Turn Start with 0 SP or lower, but distinguish this from the SP floor after Vespa joins.
messages.戦場にベスパ登場時、\n- 解禁段階が2未満なら、解禁 - Ⅱを得て指令の加護が:
When Vespa enters:
- If below Unlock stage II, gain Unlock - II and set Grace of the Prescript to 6. Per added Grace, gain 1 Defense Level Down and 2 Karmic Consequence at Turn Start.
- Gain Shin (心) - Sora and Shield equal to 50% maximum HP, lasting for the encounter.
- Disable Unlock's Onus consumption.
- Replace Onus with Extreme Onus at maximum stacks; gain 1 Extreme Onus at Turn Start.
- Raise SP up to 30; gain (SP recovered ÷ 10) Karmic Consequence.
- SP can no longer fall below 0.

At 20% HP or lower, maximize Extreme Onus.
“D-dangerous... I might not be able to execute the P-Prescript.”
messages.解禁Ⅱ以上・バリア追加・激しい圧迫感へ移行。以後は精神力が0未満にならないため、: Moves to Unlock II or higher, extra Shield, and Extreme Onus. SP no longer falls below 0; do not persist with the same SP-control plan as before reinforcements.
messages.精神力0へ戻る。パニックの継続だけで耐え切る前提にはしない。: SP resets to 0. Do not assume sustained Panic alone will keep the team alive.
messages.パニックの置き換えによる無力化を前提にしない。: Do not rely on replacing Panic type to disable her.
messages.良秀のスロット+1、蜘蛛の巣へのダメージ+10%。混乱するダメージで混乱区間を除: Ryōshū gains +1 slot and +10% damage against Spiderweb. Damage that would Stagger removes her Stagger Thresholds and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn). Skill use grants 1 resource matching the skill and 1 of a scarce affinity (twice per turn). Cannot retreat.
messages.ほかの味方生存中は良秀が死亡しない。資源を回復・敵弱体化に回し、仲間も守る。: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. Spend resources on healing and enemy debuffs while protecting allies too.
messages.人差し指へ使うスキル威力−2・被ダメージ+20%。ソラの優先対象になる。: Skill Power -2 against the Index; damage taken +20%. Becomes Sora's priority target.
messages.印を持つ囚人へ攻撃が集中しないよう、ほかの囚人で引き取る。: Redirect attacks with other Sinners to avoid concentrating hits on the marked Sinner.
messages.指令対象へ的中すると達成。解禁なしで付与され、この指令での加護は最大3。: Completed by hitting the Prescript's target. Granted without Unlock; Grace gained through this Prescript caps at 3.
messages.指令対象以外へ引き取って的中を防ぐ。: Redirect to other Sinners and prevent hits.
messages.最初のスロットの技を指令対象へ的中、または対象を倒すと達成。解禁Ⅰで付与、加護は: Completed by hitting the Prescript's target with the first slot's skill or killing the target. Granted at Unlock I; Grace caps at 6.
messages.最初の枠と指令対象の組み合わせを確認し、必要なマッチを優先する。: Check the first slot and designated target together; prioritize necessary clashes.
messages.対象を混乱させるか倒すと達成。解禁Ⅱで付与、加護は最大9。: Completed by Staggering or killing the target. Granted at Unlock II; Grace caps at 9.
messages.低HP・混乱区間に近い囚人を回復し、強い攻撃を止める。: Heal low-HP Sinners or those near Stagger, and stop strong attacks.
messages.全ての障害物を排除する指令。解禁Ⅲで付与。: A Prescript to eliminate every obstacle. Granted at Unlock III.
messages.後半は指令阻止だけを目的にせず、NPCの援護と生存を優先する。: Later, prioritize NPC support and survival rather than only preventing Prescript completion.
messages.最大9。3につき攻撃Lv+1。3／6／9で解禁が進む。: Max 9. Offense Level +1 per 3. Unlock progresses at 3/6/9.
messages.HP条件でも進むため、加護だけで段階を判断しない。: HP conditions also advance stages; do not assess progression from Grace alone.
messages.攻防Lv+1、戦闘終了時に精神力15回復。Ⅱは+2・30回復、Ⅲは+3・45回復: Offense/Defense Levels +1; heal 15 SP at Combat End. II grants +2 and 30 SP; III grants +3 and 45 SP.
messages.現在の解禁段階と基礎値の差を確認する。: Check the current Unlock stage against base values.
messages.最大2。1につきダメージ+25%。開花中は数値1で最終威力+1、2で代わりに+3: Max 2. Damage +25% per stack. While Effloresced, Final Power +1 at 1 stack, or +3 at 2 instead.
messages.指令を阻止しても敵は強くなる。高い時は対象変更不能の技にも備える。: Preventing Prescripts still strengthens the enemy. At high Onus, prepare for skills that cannot be redirected.
messages.最大2。1につきダメージ+50%。開花中は1で最終威力+2、2で加算コイン威力+: Max 2. Damage +50% per stack. While Effloresced, 1 stack grants +2 Final Power; 2 grant +1 Plus Coin Power and +3 Final Power. Certain skills consume this as Onus.
messages.ベスパ登場後の大幅な強化。残った囚人担当の技を軽く見ない。: Substantial buffs after Vespa joins. Do not underestimate the skills left to Sinners.
messages.最大100。開始時に10につき防御Lv減少1、20につき脆弱1。: Max 100. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10 and 1 Fragile per 20.
messages.指令未達成などで増える敵側の弱体化。ただし耐える準備を崩してまでためない。: Enemy debuffs gained through failed Prescripts and other effects. Do not disrupt survival preparations just to build stacks.
messages.速度範囲+1、攻防Lv+3、スキルで得る呼吸威力+1。: Speed range +1, Offense/Defense Levels +3, and +1 Poise Potency gained from skills.
messages.開花時の強化。通常状態の威力・耐性と区別する。: An Efflorescence buff; distinguish it from normal-form Power and resistances.
messages.速度範囲+1、攻防Lv+2、スキルで得る呼吸威力・回数+1。与ダメージは25%＋: Speed range +1, Offense/Defense Levels +2, and +1 Poise Potency/Count gained from skills. Damage increases by 25% plus the percentage of HP lost (max 100%).
messages.後半はNPCの援護を使い、囚人が残りの攻撃を止める。: Use NPC support later while Sinners stop remaining attacks.
messages.ベスパが守備未装着の味方への一方攻撃を引き受ける支援。: Vespa's support intercepts one-sided attacks on allies with no defense skills equipped.
messages.任せる攻撃にはマッチを付けず、狙われた囚人には守備を装着しない。NPCの援護効果: Do not clash against attacks left to Assist Defense or equip defense on the targeted Sinner. Also check that the NPC support effect is active that turn.
messages.良秀が死亡しないのは、ほかの味方が生存している間。NPCが来れば囚人全滅でも勝て: Ryōshū cannot die only while another ally survives. NPC arrival does not permit victory after all Sinners die.
messages.指令阻止には圧迫感という反動がある。阻止だけで敵の全強化を止められない。: Preventing Prescripts adds Onus; it does not stop all buffs.
messages.援護防御の条件は守備未装着。一方攻撃へ回避や防御を付けると、かえって援護を受けら: Assist Defense requires no defense skill equipped. Adding Evade or Guard against the one-sided attack can prevent support from activating.
messages.は、はやく指令を遂行しなきゃ…。は守備を発動させない。対象変更も圧迫感次第で不能: “I-I Have to Execute the Prescript Soon...!” disables defense activation. Onus can also make it unredirectable.
messages.代行: 抹殺 - 本望に、通常の抹殺の勝利時軽減はない。NPCが受ける攻撃を不用: The Immanent Yearning variant lacks ordinary Annihilate's clash-loss mitigation. Avoid needlessly redirecting attacks meant for the NPC.
messages.推奨Lv60。出撃できる4人を育て、HP・精神力回復と攻撃威力低下を用意。良秀の: Recommended Level 60. Level the 4 available Sinners, bringing HP/SP recovery and Attack Power Down. Use Ryōshū's resource generation to recover.
messages.沈潜などによる精神力低下は参戦前の開花解除を助けるが、後半は敵の精神力下限とNP: SP reduction such as Sinking can help end Efflorescence before Vespa joins. Later, prioritize the SP floor and NPC support conditions.
messages.指令対象以外のマッチ担当: Clash handlers other than the Prescript's target
messages.指令対象への的中を減らし、精神力回復を抑える。: Limit hits on the designated target and prevent SP recovery.
messages.生存支援を使いつつ、回復と弱体化を継続する。: Use survival support to sustain healing and debuffs.
messages.援護の条件を維持し、囚人へ残った攻撃だけを受け持つ。: Maintain support conditions and handle only attacks left to Sinners.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-33「塩見ヨル（9-33）」の攻略。: Shiomi Yoru (9-33) guide for Limbus Company 9-33. You do not need to reduce HP to 0. Deplete the Disjunction Shield or survive through the end of Turn 11 to progress. Have fast Sinners beat Silent Regard and Phantom Step first to make later major attacks safer.
messages.小指の親方 - 塩見ヨルの外見: The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoru appearance
messages.小指の親方 - 塩見ヨルのスキル: The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoru skills
messages.The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoruの外見: The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoru appearance
messages.The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoruのスキル: The Pinky Nursefather - Shiomi Yoru skills
messages.9-33通常戦。出撃7名＋控え5名、良秀必須。前の4人編成から人数を戻す。Lv7: The normal 9-33 battle. Deploy 7 Sinners with 5 backups; Ryōshū is required. Restore the team size after the preceding four-Sinner battle. The enemy starts at Lv. 77 with 45 SP and 1,600 Disjunction, with no fixed level reduction. Dealing damage that would reduce the Shield to 0, or reaching the end of Turn 11, triggers the event. Treat this separately from the battles at 9-41 and 9-48.
messages.残像歩と観望は威力の表記が整合しないため、基本威力・表示威力を未確定としている。: Phantom Step and Silent Regard have inconsistent Power listings, so their Base Power and displayed Power are marked unconfirmed. Check the actual clash prediction. Rend Space - String Connection is shown with 20 Base Power and +6 Coin Power; its +5 Final Power at 10 or more SP is listed separately in the effects.
messages.出撃7名＋控え5名に戻す。良秀以外も生存させる。: Restore the team to 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups. Keep Sinners other than Ryōshū alive too.
messages.観望で敵を弱め、残像歩で剣痕を減らしてから大技を受ける。: Weaken the enemy through Silent Regard and reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step before taking the major attacks.
messages.乖離1600を削るか11ターン耐える。HP0撃破に固執しない。: Deplete 1,600 Disjunction or survive 11 turns. There is no need to reduce the enemy's HP to 0.
messages.敵はLv77・精神力45で開始する。速い囚人で観望へ先に勝ち、攻撃威力減少を付け: The enemy starts at Lv. 77 with 45 SP. Have a fast Sinner beat Silent Regard first to inflict Attack Power Down, then handle the remaining skills. Use leveling, healing, and the Sapling of Light as needed.
messages.大技に勝っても味方が倒れる: Allies die even after winning against a major attack
messages.破壊不能と剣痕由来の最大HP割合ダメージが残る。大技前に残像歩へ勝って剣痕を半減: Unbreakable Coins and max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail remain. Before the major attack, win against Phantom Step to halve Bladetrail and heal in advance. The 80% damage reduction does not erase every source of damage.
messages.前の戦闘のまま4人で挑んでいる: The team still has only four Sinners from the previous battle
messages.この戦闘は7名出撃・5名控えに戻る。出撃画面で人数を増やし、育った控えも置く。良: This battle returns to 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups. Increase the deployment count and bring leveled backups. Ryōshū loses her protection if no other ally remains alive.
messages.低HPの囚人が回避もせず倒れる: A low-HP Sinner dies without even evading
messages.絶命は守備を発動させず、良秀以外の低HPを狙う。攻撃で止めるか、出現前にHP50: Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating and prioritizes low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū. Stop it with an attack, or heal everyone to at least 50% HP before it appears to remove the condition for the extra action.
messages.3〜5／四重残像もつれで範囲−2／大技20・30: 3–5 / Range −2 from Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement / Major attacks: 20 and 30
messages.50%（959）／乖離を失うと段階に応じた混乱: 50% (959) / Losing Disjunction causes Stagger at the relevant stages
messages.精神力45・シン(心) - 地慧星1・四重残像もつれ・乖離1600で出現。: Starts with 45 SP, 1 Shin (心) - Dihui Star, Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement, and 1,600 Disjunction.
messages.攻撃1スロットが広域枠を2消費する。通常の敵と同じ枠数で副対象を数えない。: One attack slot consumes 2 points of Atk Weight. Do not count secondary targets as though this enemy used ordinary slot sizes.
messages.終了条件はバリアを0にするダメージか、11ターン目終了。バリアを割る最後のダメー: The battle ends when damage would reduce the Shield to 0, or at the end of Turn 11. The final damage that would break the Shield becomes 0.
messages.7名と控えを用意し、斬撃耐性・回復をそろえる: Bring seven Sinners and backups, Slash resistance, and healing
messages.推奨Lv60、出撃7名＋控え5名。良秀は必須。前の4人戦の編成をそのまま使わず、: Recommended Lv. 60. Deploy 7 Sinners with 5 backups; Ryōshū is required. Expand the preceding four-Sinner team with additional leveled Sinners.
messages.敵はLv77・精神力45。斬撃耐性、HP・精神力回復、高威力のマッチ担当を用意す: The enemy is Lv. 77 with 45 SP. Bring Slash resistance, HP and SP recovery, and strong clashers. If the level gap makes clashes unwinnable, consider MOROSITAS from the Sapling of Light.
messages.良秀はほかの味方生存中なら死亡しないが、ほかの囚人全員の生存を保証する効果ではな: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally is alive, but this does not keep the other Sinners alive. Spend healing on them too.
messages.速い囚人から先に観望へ勝つ: Have a fast Sinner beat Silent Regard first
messages.観望は勝つと敵に攻撃威力減少2、担当へ精神力5回復。速い囚人に割り当て、後の攻撃: Winning against Silent Regard gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restores 5 SP to the Sinner who clashes with it. Assign a fast Sinner so the debuff lands before the later attacks.
messages.弱体化後の予測も含めて残りのマッチを組む。良秀が勝つと敵の精神力も5下がるため、: Plan the remaining clashes with the weakened enemy in mind. A clash win by Ryōshū also lowers the enemy's SP by 5, letting her contribute both strong clashes and resource generation.
messages.快閃はマッチ勝利で加重値3から1へ減る。放置すると副対象も被弾するので優先して止: Winning against Swift Glimmer reduces its Atk Weight from 3 to 1. Prioritize clashing with it to protect secondary targets.
messages.剣痕が多い囚人に半減の機会を回す: Let Sinners with high Bladetrail halve their stacks
messages.剣痕[残像]は数値10につき次ターン脆弱1。さらに大技の最大HP割合ダメージへ変: Every 10 Bladetrail [Afterimage] grants 1 Fragile next turn. Major attacks also convert it into max-HP-based damage, so win against Phantom Step to reduce it.
messages.剣痕の多い速い囚人から担当させる。全員の合計が50以上になると、地慧星刀によって: Assign fast Sinners with high Bladetrail. Once the total across all Sinners reaches 50, Dihui Star's Blade also strengthens the next major attack.
messages.良秀以外がHP50%未満になると絶命が追加されやすい。回復で条件を外すか、追加さ: Deathedge is more likely to be added when a Sinner other than Ryōshū falls below 50% HP. Heal to remove the condition, or clash with the added skill using an attack. Defense alone cannot handle it.
messages.無形斬・4ターン周期の大技: Formless Cut and the four-turn major attack cycle
messages.強いマッチと事前回復で破壊不能をしのぐ: Use strong clashes and advance healing to survive Unbreakable Coins
messages.無形斬と空間斬は速度に関係なくマッチ可能。勝つと被害80%減とその技による混乱防: Formless Cut and Rend Space can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Winning reduces their damage by 80% and prevents their targets from being Staggered by the skill. Even a slow Sinner can intercept them with a strong skill.
messages.地慧星刀50以上なら空間斬 - 縁へ変化し、精神力10以上なら最終威力がさらに5: At 50 or more Dihui Star's Blade, the attack changes to Rend Space - String Connection. At 10 or more SP, it gains another +5 Final Power. Do not choose the clasher based on Base Power alone.
messages.空間斬は剣痕を全消費して最大HP割合の追加ダメージを与える。先に剣痕を減らし、H: Rend Space consumes all Bladetrail to deal additional max-HP-based damage. Reduce Bladetrail and restore HP beforehand. The turn ends after the attack, so do not leave healing until afterward.
messages.バリアを割るか11ターン目まで生存する: Break the Shield or survive through Turn 11
messages.憤怒・憂鬱・斬撃の火力を使い、乖離1600のバリアを減らす。割る条件を満たせばイ: Use Wrath, Gloom, and Slash damage to deplete the 1,600 Disjunction Shield. Meeting the Shield-breaking condition triggers the event; you do not need to deplete the remaining 1,918 HP.
messages.火力が足りなければ回復とマッチ勝利を優先し、11ターン目終了を目指す。守備を使っ: If damage is insufficient, prioritize healing and clash wins to reach the end of Turn 11. Skills deal half damage to targets that use Defense Skills, but Deathedge is an exception because it prevents Defense Skills from activating.
messages.4ターンごとの終了時には敵へ脆弱とダメージ量増加が付く。こちらの火力も通りやすく: At the end of every fourth turn, the enemy gains Fragile and Damage Up. Your attacks become more effective, but incoming damage also rises. Manage remaining HP and healing resources.
messages.使用時に呼吸回数、的中で呼吸威力が増える。観望への勝利で敵を弱めてから、残りの囚: Gains Poise Count on use and Poise Potency on hit. Weaken the enemy by beating Silent Regard, then win the remaining clashes with the other Sinners.
messages.3枚で呼吸を得る通常技。基礎表示だけでなくLv差と現在の敵精神力を含めて判断する: A regular three-Coin skill that gains Poise. Account for the level gap and the enemy's current SP as well as the listed Power.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]剣痕[残像]1を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Bladetrail [Afterimage]
messages.破壊不能・加重値3だが、勝つと加重値が2減り単体になる。一方攻撃では呼吸5を得る: An Unbreakable attack with 3 Atk Weight. Winning the clash reduces its Atk Weight by 2, making it single-target. Prioritize clashing with it, as an unopposed attack grants it 5 Poise.
messages.速度に関係なくこのスキルとマッチができ、このスキルが終了するまで混乱状態にならな: This skill can be clashed with regardless of Speed. The user cannot be Staggered until the skill ends.
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が80%だけ減少し、このスキルダメージ対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; targets taking damage from this skill cannot be Staggered
messages.広域乱射・破壊不能1枚を最大4回再使用。速度に関係なくマッチでき、勝つと被害80: An Indiscriminate attack that reuses its single Unbreakable Coin up to four times. Clash with it regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction and protection from Stagger caused by the skill. Bladetrail and additional damage still require care.
messages.[的中時]対象の剣痕[残像]を全て消耗し、各対象の体力最大値の(消耗値)%だけ体: [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of each target's max HP
messages.加重値7・破壊不能。速度に関係なく強い技で勝って80%軽減を得る。剣痕を全消費し: An Unbreakable attack with 7 Atk Weight. Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction. Heal beforehand to prepare for max-HP-based damage from consuming all Bladetrail and for the turn ending after the attack.
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の剣痕[残像]が半減(小数点切り捨て): [Clash Lose] Halve the target's Bladetrail [Afterimage] (rounded down)
messages.勝つと担当囚人の剣痕が半減する。剣痕を持つ速い囚人で、大技より前に処理する。威力: Winning halves Bladetrail on the Sinner who clashes with it. Have a fast Sinner with Bladetrail handle it before the major attack. Its Power is unconfirmed, so also check the actual clash prediction.
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の精神力を5回復: [Clash Lose] Heal the target for 5 SP
messages.勝つと敵へ攻撃威力減少2、担当の精神力5回復。速い囚人から先に勝ち、後の通常技や: Winning gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restores 5 SP to the Sinner handling it. Win early with a fast Sinner to improve later clashes against regular and area attacks. Its Power is unconfirmed.
messages.このスキルは対象の守備スキルを発動させない: This skill prevents the target's Defense Skill from activating
messages.現体力の比率が最も低い対象を攻撃: Targets the unit with the lowest current HP percentage
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の失った体力1%につき、剣痕[残像]1を付与: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 1 Bladetrail [Afterimage] for every 1% HP the target has lost
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の剣痕[残像]を全て消耗し、対象の体力最大値の(消耗値)%だけ体: Ⅱ [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of the target's max HP
messages.良秀以外の低HPを狙い、守備を発動させない。回避任せにせず攻撃でマッチする。低H: Targets low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Clash with an attack instead of relying on Evade. Lower HP means more Bladetrail, followed by max-HP-based damage on the next Coin.
messages.空間斬 - 縁: Rend Space - String Connection [空間斬-緣]
messages.[使用時]自分の精神力が10以上なら、望を1つ生成。最終威力+5: [On Use] If the user's SP is 10 or higher, generate 1 Mang. Final Power +5
messages.[攻撃後]このスキルで望を生成したなら、精神力-10: [After Attack] If this skill generated Mang, lose 10 SP
messages.[的中時]対象の剣痕[残像]を全て消耗し、対象の体力最大値の(消耗値)%だけ体力: [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of the target's max HP
messages.空間を斬る技術。空間斬。空間を斬ることは剣士たちの宿念であり、様々な方法でその境: A technique that cuts space: Rend Space. Cutting space is a long-held ambition of swordsmen, who have reached that realm through various methods.
messages.地慧星刀50以上で強い空間斬へ変わる。精神力10以上なら最終威力+5も加わる。勝: At 50 or more Dihui Star's Blade, this becomes a stronger Rend Space. At 10 or more SP, it also gains +5 Final Power. Win the clash for 80% damage reduction, but remember that this does not erase max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail. The turn ends after the attack.
messages.ターン開始時、四重残像もつれを得る\nパターンの最初のターン開始時、乖離を(残像:
At Turn Start, gain Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement.
At the start of the first turn of a pattern, gain (Afterimage Entanglement stage × 400) Disjunction.
(Once per Afterimage Entanglement stage)

Losing all Disjunction at Afterimage Entanglement stages 3 and 4 changes the pattern and Staggers the user throughout the next turn.

HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement caused by Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
messages.開始時・乖離の消失: Battle start and loss of Disjunction
messages.まずは乖離1600のバリアを削る。剣痕を減らして耐える方法もあり、11ターン目終: Start by depleting the 1,600 Disjunction Shield. Alternatively, reduce Bladetrail and survive; the event also triggers at the end of Turn 11.
messages.4ターンごとに強力なスキルを使用\n- 自分の地慧星刀が50以上なら、使用スキル:
Uses a powerful skill every 4 turns.
- If Dihui Star's Blade is 50 or higher, the skill is enhanced.
“...A loathsome blade, like a brand.”
messages.4ターン周期の大技・地慧星刀50以上: Four-turn major attack cycle; Dihui Star's Blade at 50 or higher
messages.全囚人の剣痕合計で大技が強化される。残像歩で減らし、大技前に回復と高威力技を残す: The total Bladetrail across all Sinners strengthens the major attack. Reduce it with Phantom Step and save healing and high-Power skills for the major attack.
messages.守備スキルを使用した対象へ与える自分のスキルの最終ダメージ量-50%\n\n4タ:
The user's skills deal 50% less final damage to targets that use Defense Skills.

At Turn End every 4 turns, gain 2 Fragile and 2 Damage Up for the rest of the encounter (stacks up to twice per encounter).
messages.守備使用・4ターンごとの終了時: Use of Defense Skills; end of every fourth turn
messages.守備を使う相手への技の最終ダメージは半減。ただし絶命は守備が発動しないので、すべ: Final skill damage is halved against targets using Defense Skills. However, Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating, so do not rely on Defense for every attack.
messages.ターン終了時、パニック状態なら精神力が30になる: At Turn End, if Panicked, set SP to 30
messages.精神力30へ戻る。精神力を下げれば長く無力化できるとは考えない。: SP returns to 30. Lowering SP does not disable the enemy for long.
messages.パニックの置き換えに頼らず、弱い技から先に勝つ手順を使う。: Instead of relying on replacing the Panic effect, win against weaker skills first.
messages.自分のコイン的中時、(当該コインの最終ダメージ量÷10)だけ斬撃ダメージ(自分の: On Coin hit, deal Slash damage equal to (that Coin's final damage ÷ 10). Trigger this once per Afterimage Entanglement stage. This damage cannot Stagger.
messages.残像段階の数だけ追加の斬撃ダメージ。混乱しない追加ダメージでもHPは減るため、回: Deals additional Slash damage once per Afterimage stage. Damage that cannot Stagger still reduces HP, so bring healing and resistance.
messages.攻撃スキル終了時、各対象へ(クリティカル的中した斬撃コインの個数×10)だけ斬撃:
At the end of an Attack Skill, deal Slash damage to each target equal to (number of Slash Coins that critically hit × 10). This damage cannot Stagger.

At the end of an Attack Skill, consume all Poise above 20 and inflict Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target equal to the amount consumed.
messages.攻撃後の追加ダメージと剣痕が増える。低HPを放置せず、残像歩で剣痕を減らす。: Adds damage and Bladetrail after attacks. Do not leave Sinners at low HP; reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step.
messages.絡まり、歪んでしまった記憶と思い出: Twisted and Disjointed Memory and Recollection
messages.良秀のスロット+1。小指の親方との与・被ダメージ+20%、勝利で敵精神力−5。混: Ryōshū gains 1 skill slot. She deals and takes 20% more damage against the Pinky Nursefather; her clash wins lower his SP by 5. Damage that would Stagger her removes her Stagger Thresholds and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn (once per turn). Using a skill generates 1 resource of its affinity and 1 of a missing affinity (twice per turn). She cannot retreat.
messages.資源を回復・弱体化へ回す。良秀の被ダメージも増えるため、条件付きの生存保護だけを: Spend the resources on healing and debuffs. Ryōshū also takes more damage, so do not rely solely on her conditional protection from death.
messages.開始時に数値分のバリアを付け、バリアが減ると数値も減る。初期値1600。: At battle start, grants a Shield equal to its value; the value decreases as the Shield is depleted. Starts at 1,600.
messages.この戦闘はバリアを0にするダメージで終了条件を満たす。HP0撃破を狙わなくてよい: Damage that would reduce the Shield to 0 meets this battle's ending condition. There is no need to reduce HP to 0.
messages.最大99。開始時に10につき脆弱1（最大5）。大技では全消費して最大HP割合ダメ: Maximum 99. At Turn Start, every 10 grants 1 Fragile (max 5). Major attacks consume all of it to deal max-HP-based damage.
messages.残像歩への勝利で半減し、大技の前に回復する。: Halve it by winning against Phantom Step, then heal before the major attack.
messages.速度範囲−2。的中時に毒1・出血2・次ターン束縛1・火傷2を付与。: Speed range −2. On hit, inflicts 1 Poison, 2 Bleed, 1 Bind next turn, and 2 Burn.
messages.マッチ勝利後にも的中が残る技を確認し、状態異常の消耗を回復する。: Check which skills still hit after a clash win and heal the damage caused by status effects.
messages.このステージにある囚人たちの剣痕の合計。50以上で周期の大技が強化される。: The combined Bladetrail on all Sinners on the field. At 50 or higher, it strengthens the periodic major attack.
messages.1人だけでなく全員の剣痕を見て、残像歩の担当を選ぶ。: Check everyone's Bladetrail when assigning Phantom Step, rather than watching only one Sinner.
messages.最大3。開始時に数値1につき呼吸威力5・回数1。失ったHP15%につき斬撃ダメー: Maximum 3. At Turn Start, gain 5 Poise Potency and 1 Poise Count per stack. Gain 1 Slash Damage Up for every 15% HP lost (max 5).
messages.敵の呼吸と現在の状態を含めて予測を見る。開始時の威力が最後まで同じとは考えない。: Check predictions with the enemy's Poise and current status in mind. Its Power does not stay at its starting value throughout the battle.
messages.残像歩・観望の威力は未確定。弱体化・剣痕半減の用途は使えるが、数値だけで確実な勝: Phantom Step and Silent Regard have unconfirmed Power. Their debuff and Bladetrail-halving effects remain useful, but the listed numbers alone cannot guarantee a clash win.
messages.混乱しない追加ダメージでもHPは減る。破壊不能の軽減と剣痕の割合ダメージは別。: Additional damage that cannot Stagger still reduces HP. Unbreakable Coin damage reduction and max-HP-based Bladetrail damage are separate effects.
messages.絶命は守備を発動させない。低HPの囚人へ回避を付けるだけで済ませない。: Deathedge prevents Defense Skills from activating. Simply assigning Evade to a low-HP Sinner is insufficient.
messages.空間斬の後には行動できない。回復と弱体化は先に済ませる。: No actions occur after Rend Space. Complete healing and debuffing beforehand.
messages.9-33は耐えて進める戦闘。9-41や9-48の同名・関連するボスの終了条件を混: 9-33 allows progression through survival. Do not apply the ending conditions of the related or similarly named bosses at 9-41 and 9-48.
messages.推奨Lv60。7名＋控え5名をそろえ、斬撃耐性と回復資源を確保。速い囚人には観望: Recommended Lv. 60. Bring 7 deployed Sinners and 5 backups, Slash resistance, and healing resources. Assign fast Sinners to Silent Regard and Phantom Step.
messages.強い単体マッチ、攻撃威力低下、HP・精神力回復を組み合わせる。短期の高火力だけに: Combine strong single-target clashes, Attack Power Down, and HP/SP recovery. Surviving through Turn 11 allows progression, so a short burst of damage is not the only approach.
messages.観望へ速く勝ち、ほかの囚人のマッチを助ける。: Beat Silent Regard early to help the other Sinners win their clashes.
messages.残像歩で半減し、大技の割合ダメージを抑える。: Halve Bladetrail through Phantom Step to reduce max-HP-based damage from the major attack.
messages.速度に関係なく強い技で勝ち、80%軽減を得る。: Win with a strong skill regardless of Speed to gain 80% damage reduction.
messages.破壊不能と追加ダメージをしのぎ、終了条件まで生存する。: Survive Unbreakable Coins and additional damage until the ending condition is met.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-37「アルビナ・カリスト（9-37）: Albina & Callisto (9-37) guide for Limbus Company 9-37. Fight alongside Hohenheim and Alisa. Weaken major attacks with Sinner attacks before the NPCs clash with them. In the second half, incapacitate Albina first to reduce Callisto's Protection and Assist Defense.
messages.薬指身体派自動人形 - 研究員の外見: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Researcher appearance
messages.薬指身体派自動人形 - 研究員のスキル: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Researcher skills
messages.The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Researc: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Researcher appearance
The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Researcher skills
messages.薬指身体派自動人形 - 戦闘員の外見: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Combatant appearance
messages.薬指身体派自動人形 - 戦闘員のスキル: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Combatant skills
messages.The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Combata: The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Combatant appearance
The Ring Corporist Automanikin - Combatant skills
messages.ホーエンハイム・アリサとの共闘。大技は囚人の先行攻撃で弱めてからNPCに受けても: Fight alongside Hohenheim and Alisa. Weaken major attacks with Sinner attacks before the NPCs clash with them. In the second half, incapacitate Albina first to reduce Callisto's Protection and Assist Defense.
messages.ファウスト・シンクレア・イシュメールの3名固定。非常用K社アンプルはNPCを含む: Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael are the three required Sinners. Everyone, including the NPCs, shares the remaining K Corp. Emergency Ampules. Albina carries her current HP into the second half. Viewing the Tableau lowers Callisto's Offense and Defense Levels by 20; she gains 7 Protection while Albina can fight. Corpus Theater is listed at 74 HP, but use the individual unit's display. Unconfirmed resistances are marked unknown.
messages.自動人形2種の骨の解放は威力範囲とコインの表記が整合しないため、基本・表示威力を: Both Automanikins' Liberation of Bones have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin listings, so Base Power and displayed Power are marked unconfirmed. “Liberation of the Repressed Flesh” after the armor is removed is treated as having 1 Atk Weight. Check the actual predictions and targets before skills resolve.
messages.大技の前に別々の攻撃3本。幻惑のNPCマッチは奪わない。: Land three separate attacks before the major attack. Do not take over the NPC's clash enabled by Dazzle.
messages.大技を使わない側へ最速の囚人がマッチし、援護防御を減らす。: Have the fastest Sinner clash with the enemy not using the major attack to reduce Assist Defense.
messages.捕まった味方を救出し、NPC2人を同時に失わない。: Rescue captured allies and keep both NPCs from dying.
messages.NPCが大技に負ける: The NPC loses the clash against a major attack
messages.ホーエンハイムがマッチする前に、大技の使用者へ別々の攻撃3本を通す。敵の援護防御: Land three separate attacks on the major attack's user before Hohenheim clashes with it. If Assist Defense intercepts them, clash with the assisting enemy directly first.
messages.アルビナが戦闘可能だとカリストへ保護7が付く。後半はアルビナを先に戦闘不能にし、: Callisto gains 7 Protection while Albina can fight. Incapacitate Albina first in the second half to stop both the Protection and assistance.
messages.囚人が消えて操作できない: A Sinner disappears and cannot be controlled
messages.身体観劇で拘束されている。対応する敵ユニットをカリスト以外が倒せば次ターンに復帰: They are trapped in Corpus Theater. If anyone other than Callisto defeats the corresponding enemy unit, the ally returns next turn. Coordinate the rescue with Alisa's targets.
messages.混乱すると1回だけ解除・即ターン終了。鉄のとばりの後に後半へ進む。: Once per encounter, clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn when Staggered. “Iron Curtain” precedes the second half.
messages.9-18のHP60%条件とは異なる。混乱からの進行を確認する。: Unlike 9-18, progression does not use the 60% HP condition. Watch for the transition triggered by Stagger.
messages.後半への移行時に撤退するが、先に倒すと精神力を稼ぎ、出血と強化を減らせる。: Withdraws when the second half begins. Defeating them earlier earns SP and reduces incoming Bleed and buffs.
messages.眺望で攻防Lv−20。アルビナが戦闘可能なら開始時に保護7。鏡の最終ダメージ70: Viewing the Tableau lowers Offense and Defense Levels by 20. At Turn Start, gains 7 Protection if Albina can fight. This differs from the Mirror Dungeon version's 70% final damage reduction.
messages.HP半分付近で閉場のイベントへ進む。HP0まで削る戦闘ではない。: The Closing Time event begins around half HP. You do not need to reduce HP to 0.
messages.1352（前半の現在HPを引き継ぐ）: 1,352 (carries over current HP from the first half)
messages.新しく満タンのHPを削る相手ではない。後半はカリストより先に戦闘不能へ追い込む。: This is not a fresh, full HP bar. Incapacitate her before focusing on Callisto in the second half.
messages.同名技でも前半とは攻撃Lv差や生体材料の獲得条件が変わる。: Even skills with the same names have different Offense Level differences and Corpus Ingredient gain conditions from the first half.
messages.拘束した味方に対応するユニット: A unit corresponding to a captured ally
messages.憤怒・打撃以外にも火傷が有効。未確定の耐性を等倍として扱わない。: Burn is effective alongside Wrath and Blunt damage. Do not assume unconfirmed resistances are neutral.
messages.カリスト以外が倒すと次ターンに味方復帰。カリストが倒すと捕まった味方が戦闘不能に: If anyone other than Callisto defeats it, the ally returns next turn. If Callisto defeats it, the captured ally is incapacitated.
messages.固定3人とNPCを守る回復を準備: Prepare healing for the three required Sinners and the NPCs
messages.推奨Lv60。ファウスト・シンクレア・イシュメールを育て、HP・精神力回復と強い: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael, and bring HP/SP recovery and strong clashers.
messages.ホーエンハイムは大技、アリサは取り巻き・救出を助ける。2人とも死亡すると敗北。ア: Hohenheim handles major attacks; Alisa helps clear adds and rescue allies. You lose if both die. The five Ampules are shared by everyone, so do not spend them all on the Sinners.
messages.人形を減らし、甲冑の大技を弱める: Clear the Automanikins and weaken the armored major attack
messages.人形を早めに混乱・撃破して手数と精神力を稼ぐ。筋肉収縮の次ターンは筋繊維の強化で: Stagger and defeat the Automanikins early to gain actions and SP. The turn after “Muscular Contraction”, Automated Myofiber Activity makes Coins Unbreakable. Avoid assigning Sinners with high Bleed to take those hits.
messages.骨の解放より先に怠惰の攻撃を処理すると、その攻撃終了時に筋繊維の強化が消える。破: Resolving a Sloth attack before Liberation of Bones consumes Automated Myofiber Activity at the end of that attack. However, Unbreakable conversion is determined at Combat Start; do not assume all Coins revert.
messages.抑圧された肉体が出たら別々の攻撃3本を先に通す。甲冑3で最終威力−30。幻惑が付: When “Repressed Flesh” appears, land three separate attacks first. Three Impact-rattled Armor lowers Final Power by 30. Dazzle makes it target Hohenheim without redirection, letting the NPC handle the clash.
messages.アルビナが混乱すると解除・即ターン終了。鉄のとばり中は反射が20倍なので攻撃を控: Staggering Albina clears her Stagger and immediately ends the turn. During “Iron Curtain”, reflected damage is multiplied by 20. Hold back attacks and prepare for the second half.
messages.アルビナへ集中し、支援技は必ず止める: Focus on Albina and stop the support skill
messages.人形は撤退し、アルビナは甲冑を外す。カリストはアルビナ生存中に保護7を得るので、: The Automanikins withdraw and Albina removes her armor. Callisto gains 7 Protection while Albina is active, so focus on Albina first.
messages.カリストの私たちは血と肉を愛していますへマッチ勝利し、アルビナへの攻撃Lv増加6: Win the clash against Callisto's “Oh, How We Love the Flesh and the Blood” to prevent 6 Offense Level Up on Albina. Do not ignore it because its Base Power is low.
messages.通常攻撃は現在の出血と予測を見て止める。NPCの担当と救出に余裕があれば、アルビ: Handle regular attacks based on current Bleed and clash predictions. If NPC assignments and rescues allow, evading Albina's feeding skill can also limit Corpus Ingredient gains.
messages.広域を装着したターン: Turns when an area attack is equipped
messages.援護側へのマッチを先に行い、大技側へ3本当てる: Clash with the assisting enemy first, then land three attacks on the major attack's user
messages.広域を使わない側は援護防御で一方攻撃を吸う。最速の囚人でその相手本人とマッチし、: The enemy not using the area attack intercepts unopposed attacks through Assist Defense. Have the fastest Sinner clash with that enemy directly to reduce its value by 1. Check the remaining stacks and add clashes as needed.
messages.援護が減ったら、大技の使用者へ別々の攻撃を先に当てる。甲冑解除後は1本ごとに加算: Once assistance is reduced, land separate attacks on the major attack's user before it acts. After the armor is removed, each attack applies 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down, up to three times. This differs from the first half's −30 Final Power.
messages.ホーエンハイムの確定表面の攻撃へつなぐ。3本が理想だが、足りない場合もできるだけ: Then let Hohenheim attack with guaranteed Heads. Three attacks are ideal; if that is impossible, aim for at least two and prepare healing for the damage taken.
messages.捕まった味方をカリストより先に救出する: Rescue captured allies before Callisto reaches them
messages.簡易肋骨はマッチ不可・対象変更不可・守備発動不可。本人で防ぐのではなく、生成され: Improvised Ribcage is Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Destroy the Corpus Theater it creates instead of trying to defend with the captured Sinner.
messages.アリサは救出を助ける。どのユニットへ攻撃するかを見て、足りない分を囚人で補う。カ: Alisa helps with rescues. Check her target and have Sinners supply any missing damage. Do not leave a rescue unattended: Callisto defeating the unit incapacitates the ally.
messages.救出は次ターン復帰と全属性資源2。回復・大技への準備に使い、NPC2人を失わない: A rescued ally returns next turn, and you gain 2 resources of every affinity. Use them for healing and preparation for major attacks, and keep both NPCs from dying.
messages.閉場からアリサの最後の手段へ進む: Proceed from Closing Time to Alisa's last resort
messages.アルビナを戦闘不能にした後、カリストを削る。HP半分付近で混乱解除・即ターン終了: After incapacitating Albina, damage Callisto. Around half HP, she clears Stagger and immediately ends the turn. Closing Time turns everyone except Alisa into Corpus Theater.
messages.マッチ不可・守備発動不可のイベント技を囚人で止めようとしない。アリサの最後の手段: Do not try to stop the Unclashable event skill that prevents Defense Skills from activating. Alisa's last resort rescues everyone and ends the battle.
messages.出血6以上で威力が増える。出血が多い囚人へ連続して当てさせず、勝てる通常技で止め: Gains Power at 6 or more Bleed. Avoid repeated hits on a Sinner with high Bleed; clash with a regular skill that can win.
messages.出血回数・束縛を付ける2枚技。次のターンも担当を替えられるよう、速度とHPを確保: A two-Coin skill that inflicts Bleed Count and Bind. Maintain Speed and HP so another Sinner can take over next turn.
messages.出血4ごとに強くなる3枚技。混乱・回復を崩されないよう、出血をためた囚人から引き: A three-Coin skill that gains Power per 4 Bleed. Redirect it away from Sinners with high Bleed to avoid disrupting Stagger and healing plans.
messages.3枚破壊不能。勝利で被害80%減と混乱防止を得るが、的中時の生体材料は残る。次の: Three Unbreakable Coins. Winning grants 80% damage reduction and prevents Stagger, but on-hit Corpus Ingredient gains remain. Prepare early attacks for the next major skill.
messages.別々の攻撃3本を先に当て、酷く鳴り響く甲冑3で最終威力を30下げる。幻惑が付けば: Land three separate attacks first to gain 3 Impact-rattled Armor and lower Final Power by 30. With Dazzle active, Hohenheim handles the clash while Sinners supply the early attacks.
messages.攻撃者の出血回数が増え、棘の反射もある。必要以上に殴らず、自動人形の処理や回復へ: Increases the attacker's Bleed Count and reflects damage through Spikes. Avoid unnecessary attacks; spend actions on Automanikins and healing instead.
messages.棘の反射が20倍になり、守備相殺でも解除できない。このターンは攻撃を控え、次の形: Spikes reflects 20 times its normal damage and cannot be removed by Defense Skill Offset. Hold back attacks this turn and heal and prepare for the next form.
messages.出血回数を増やす単体技。後の骨の解放より先に処理すると、攻撃終了時に敵の強化を消: A single-target skill that increases Bleed Count. Resolve it before Liberation of Bones to consume the enemy's buff at the end of this attack.
messages.対象の出血が5以上なら、基本威力+1: If the target has 5 or more Bleed, Base Power +1
messages.対象の保有するマイナス効果が3種以上なら、追加で1増加: If the target has 3 or more types of negative effects, increase it by another 1
messages.[表面的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少2を付与: [On Heads Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn
messages.出血とマイナス効果が多い相手へ回数を重ねる。通常技で勝ちながら、早く混乱させる。: Adds more Count against targets with Bleed and several negative effects. Win with regular skills and Stagger the enemy early.
messages.[戦闘開始時]次のターンに筋繊維の機械的収縮と弛緩1を得る。被ダメージ時に追加で: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Automated Myofiber Activity next turn. Gain 1 more when damaged (once per turn).
messages.戦闘開始時に次ターンの強化を予約する。ここへ攻撃しても強化が追加されるため、次の: Schedules next-turn buffs at Combat Start. Attacking it adds another stack, so plan for the next turn's Unbreakable conversion.
messages.作品名:心周期に伴う骨の解放: Artwork: Liberation of Bones Contingent on Cardiac Rhythm
messages.自分が失った本体の体力20%につき、基本威力+1(最大4): Base Power +1 for every 20% HP the main body has lost (max 4)
messages.対象の出血3につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): Coin Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 2)
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象の振動回数が2増加: [Clash Win] Increase the target's Tremor Count by 2
messages.[コイントス開始時]現本体の体力の30%だけ体力が減少(この効果で混乱状態になら: [Before Coin Toss] Lose 30% of the main body's current HP (cannot Stagger from this effect; rounded down)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]振動-大量出血へ振幅変換: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Hemorrhage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.3枚目が固定で破壊不能。筋繊維の強化があると他のコインも破壊不能になる。先に怠惰: The third Coin is always Unbreakable. Automated Myofiber Activity makes the others Unbreakable too. Resolve the Sloth attack first to consume the buff, then stop the enemy through Stagger and focused attacks.
messages.boss-copy:albina-callisto:skills.11.name: Jab
messages.出血威力を付ける単体技。骨の解放より先にマッチして、敵の強化を消費させる手段にな: A single-target skill that inflicts Bleed Potency. Clashing with it before Liberation of Bones can consume the enemy's buff.
messages.対象の保有するマイナス効果が3種以上なら、ダメージ量+30%: If the target has 3 or more types of negative effects, damage +30%
messages.出血5以上やマイナス効果3種以上で強くなる。弱い囚人へ集中させず、早期の混乱・撃: Gains strength against targets with at least 5 Bleed or three types of negative effects. Protect weaker Sinners and aim for an early Stagger or kill.
messages.次ターンの強化を予約するマッチ可能ガード。通常防御の相殺と混同しない。: A Clashable Guard that schedules a buff for next turn. Do not confuse it with Offset against an ordinary Defense Skill.
messages.研究員と同じ3枚技。低HPほど基本威力が上がるので、削って放置せず混乱・撃破まで: The same three-Coin skill as the Researcher's. Its Base Power increases at lower HP, so follow through to Stagger or defeat it rather than leaving it injured.
messages.このスキルは守備スキルを発動させない: This skill prevents Defense Skills from activating
messages.[使用時]対象の出血8につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 8 Bleed on the target (max 2)
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]体力ダメージの代わりに、精神力ダメージを与える: Ⅰ [On Hit] Deal SP damage instead of HP damage
messages.[的中時]自分の精神力を15回復: [On Hit] Heal the user for 15 SP
messages.[的中時]混乱状態にして、次のターンに身体観劇にする: [On Hit] Stagger the target and turn them into Corpus Theater next turn
messages.対象変更不可・マッチ不可・守備発動不可: Cannot be redirected; Unclashable; prevents Defense Skills from activating
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可・守備発動不可。捕まった囚人に対応する身体観劇を壊せば次: Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Destroy the Corpus Theater corresponding to the captured Sinner to bring them back next turn. Check Alisa's rescue target too.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血4を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 4 Bleed
messages.2枚破壊不能。勝利で被害80%減とその技の混乱防止を得る。出血が多い相手ではコイ: Two Unbreakable Coins. Win for 80% damage reduction and protection from Stagger caused by this skill. High Bleed on the target also raises Coin Power.
messages.身体観劇をターゲットに優先指定する: Prioritizes Corpus Theater as a target
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血回数が1増加: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Increase Bleed Count by 1
messages.[的中時]次のターンに威力減少1を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Power Down next turn
messages.身体観劇を優先して攻撃する。カリストに身体観劇を壊されると捕まった味方が戦闘不能: Prioritizes Corpus Theater. If Callisto destroys it, the captured ally is incapacitated, so rescue the ally first.
messages.ティビアのメロディー - 解体されたものが解体されていないものを解体すること: Tibia's Melody - Anatomization of the Unanatomized by the Anatomized
messages.このスキルを装着したターンに攻撃スキルで被ダメージ時、加算コイン弱化1,威力減少: On the turn this skill is equipped, when damaged by an Attack Skill, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (once per skill, up to 3 times per turn)
messages.このスキルを使用するまで混乱状態にならない: Cannot be Staggered until this skill is used
messages.このスキルで倒した対象1体につき、精神力を15回復: Heal 15 SP for each target defeated by this skill
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットとサブターゲットの出血の合計6につき、ダメージ量+3%: [On Use] Damage +3% per 6 total Bleed across the main and secondary targets (max 30%)
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が60%減少し、このスキルのダメージで対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Deal 60% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger its targets
messages.[的中時]自分の精神力を5回復(スキルごとに1回): [On Hit] Heal the user for 5 SP (once per skill)
messages.[的中時]次のターンに保護1を得る(スキルごとに1回): [On Hit] Gain 1 Protection next turn (once per skill)
messages.[的中時]次のターンにダメージ量増加1を得る(スキルごとに1回): [On Hit] Gain 1 Damage Up next turn (once per skill)
messages.4枚破壊不能・加重値6。先行する別々の攻撃3本で加算コイン弱化3と威力減少3を付: Four Unbreakable Coins and 6 Atk Weight. Land three separate early attacks to apply 3 Plus Coin Drop and 3 Power Down, then let Hohenheim clash through Dazzle. Exhaust the other enemy's Assist Defense first.
messages.私たちは血と肉を愛しています: Oh, How We Love the Flesh and the Blood
messages.薬指の子方 - アルビナをターゲットに優先指定する: Prioritizes The Ring Apprentice - Albina as a target
messages.このコインは体力ダメージを与えない: This Coin deals no HP damage
messages.-対象が味方なら、この効果の代わりに次のターンまで攻撃レベル増加6を付与: - If the target is an ally, instead grant 6 Offense Level Up through the next turn
messages.アルビナへの攻撃Lv強化を渡す技。マッチに勝って支援を防ぐ。威力は低めでも放置し: A support skill that grants Albina Offense Level Up. Win the clash to stop it. Do not ignore it because of its low Power.
messages.[使用時]攻撃者の攻撃終了まで、攻撃者が保有した出血回数が減少しない: [On Use] The attacker's Bleed Count cannot decrease until their attack ends
messages.開始時に援護防御2を得る。カリスト自身へマッチを進行すると数値が1減るので、大技: Gains 2 Assist Defense at Combat Start. Each clash against Callisto herself reduces it by 1. Resolve these before the unopposed attacks meant for the major skill's user.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに威力減少1を付与: Ⅱ [On Hit] Inflict 1 Power Down next turn
messages.援護防御専用のマッチ可能反撃。カリストへのマッチで援護回数を減らし、別の敵への先: A Clashable Counter used only for Assist Defense. Clash with Callisto to reduce her assistance count and let early attacks reach the other enemy.
messages.閉場 - 設置美術第1号「あなた方がまき散らした肉と骨が客席となり」: Closing Time - Installation Art no. 1: Your Flesh and Bones as the Gallery's Seats
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]自分の体力が最大値の60%未満なら、体力ダメージの代わりに精神力ダメ: Ⅰ [On Hit] If the user's HP is below 60% of max HP, deal SP damage instead of HP damage
messages.マッチ不可・守備発動不可: Unclashable; prevents Defense Skills from activating
messages.マッチ不可・守備発動不可の終盤イベント技。囚人で止めようとせず、アリサの最後の手: An Unclashable late-battle event skill that prevents Defense Skills from activating. Proceed to Alisa's last resort instead of trying to stop it with Sinners. The turn ends after the attack.
messages.甲冑を外した後は攻撃Lv差も変わる。出血条件の威力増加を確認し、アルビナへ集中す: Removing the armor also changes the Offense Level difference. Check Bleed-based Power increases and focus on Albina.
messages.出血回数・束縛を付ける。先にアルビナを戦闘不能にし、カリストの保護と援護の供給を: Inflicts Bleed Count and Bind. Incapacitate Albina first to cut off Callisto's Protection and assistance.
messages.出血でコイン威力が増える3枚技。出血の多い囚人で受け続けない。: A three-Coin skill whose Coin Power increases with Bleed. Avoid repeatedly taking it with a Sinner who has high Bleed.
messages.[的中時]自分の精神力を10回復: [On Hit] Heal the user for 10 SP
messages.3枚破壊不能、的中で生体材料を得る。回避で的中を避けられれば次の大技の準備を遅ら: Three Unbreakable Coins; gains Corpus Ingredient on hit. Evading the hits can delay preparation for the next major attack, but this is not a guaranteed way to stop it.
messages.甲冑版の最終威力−30とは別の弱体化。攻撃3本で加算コイン弱化3・威力減少3を付: This weakening differs from the armored version's −30 Final Power. Land three attacks to apply 3 Plus Coin Drop and 3 Power Down before Hohenheim's clash.
messages.開始時に援護防御1。アルビナへ直接マッチを取って消費させ、カリストの大技へ先行攻: Starts with 1 Assist Defense. Consume it by clashing with Albina directly, allowing early attacks to reach Callisto's major skill.
messages.援護防御専用のマッチ可能反撃。援護を持つ相手本人へのマッチを先に行い、妨害を減ら: A Clashable Counter used only for Assist Defense. Clash with the assisting enemy directly first to reduce interception.
messages.生体材料2・強攻撃準備: 2 Corpus Ingredient; preparing a powerful attack
messages.甲冑の有無で大技への弱体化が変わる。現在のアルビナの形態を確認する。: The weakening method changes depending on whether Albina is armored. Check her current form.
messages.出血などの軽減がある。状態異常だけで待たず、強攻撃の弱体化と集中攻撃を使う。: Reduces damage from Bleed and other statuses. Do not simply wait for statuses to work; weaken major skills and focus your attacks.
messages.精神力0へ戻る。パニックを維持するだけの攻略にはしない。: SP returns to 0. Maintaining Panic alone is not a complete strategy.
messages.パニックの変更で危険技を封じる前提にはしない。: Do not assume changing Panic Type will disable dangerous skills.
messages.序盤の硬さを見て、まず人形を減らす。抑圧された肉体を使わせると支援が弱まる。: Work around the early defenses by clearing Automanikins first. Using “Repressed Flesh” weakens the defensive buffs.
messages.混乱中以外、最終コインで被ダメージ: Taking damage from a final Coin while not Staggered
messages.鉄のとばり中の反射を避け、抑圧された肉体の準備ターンに攻撃をまとめる。: Avoid “Iron Curtain”'s reflection and concentrate attacks on turns preparing “Repressed Flesh”.
messages.混乱状態になると、混乱状態を解除してこのターンを終了する(戦闘ごとに1回): When Staggered, clear Stagger and end the turn (once per encounter)
messages.9-18と異なり混乱自体が進行条件。混乱解除・即ターン終了後の鉄のとばりへ追撃を: Unlike 9-18, Stagger itself triggers progression. After Stagger is cleared and the turn ends, do not keep attacking into “Iron Curtain”.
messages.メインターゲットのマイナス効果が3種以上なら、最終威力+1: If the main target has 3 or more types of negative effects, Final Power +1
messages.主対象のマイナス効果3種以上: Main target has at least three types of negative effects
messages.敵の威力が増える。出血や弱体化をためた囚人へ攻撃を集めない。: The enemy gains Power. Avoid concentrating attacks on Sinners with accumulated Bleed and debuffs.
messages.ターン終了時、生体材料が2なら、次のターンに生体材料消滅後、作品名:ファシアを得:
At Turn End, if Corpus Ingredient is at 2, remove it next turn and gain Artwork: Fascia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Fascia, use a powerful attack this turn.

Before using that attack, when damaged by an Attack Skill, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (once per skill, up to 3 times per turn).
messages.ギャラリーにはギャラリーならではの鑑賞ルールがあるものよ: Visitors Must Respect the Rules of the Gallery
messages.自分に援護防御があるなら、マッチ開始時に援護防御が1減少(スキルごとに1回): With Assist Defense active, reduce it by 1 at Clash Start (once per skill)
messages.援護防御あり・マッチ開始: Clash Start with Assist Defense active
messages.最速の囚人でアルビナ本人とマッチし、援護を使い切らせてからカリストへ攻撃する。: Have the fastest Sinner clash with Albina directly and exhaust her assistance before attacking Callisto.
messages.攻撃スキル的中時、マイナス効果を付与して同時にプラス効果を得たなら、精神力が4回:
On an Attack Skill hit, if the user inflicts a negative effect and gains a positive effect simultaneously, heal 4 SP.
- If this recovery occurs at max SP, gain 1 Haste next turn (up to twice per turn).
messages.マイナス効果付与と自分の強化を同時に行う的中: Hits that both inflict a negative effect and grant a buff
messages.的中を許すと精神力も戻る。勝利後にも残るコインは耐性・回復で受ける。: Allowing hits also restores SP. Use resistance and healing to handle Coins that remain after a clash win.
messages.材料になった肉体の脈動: The Pulse and Beat of Corpus-turned-Ingredient
messages.火傷・振動・破裂・沈潜による体力・精神力・混乱区間の前進量-30%\n出血による:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
Bleed damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At Turn End, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4 Burn on self (max 15).

Fascia, made from Albina's blood and flesh.
Albina has only her brain left, while Fascia lacks only a brain.
This poses the question of which one truly possesses the body.
messages.火傷はNPCとも相性がよく防御低下につながるが、必要なマッチや援護解除を優先する: Burn works well with the NPCs and lowers Defense Level, but prioritize required clashes and removing assistance.
messages.マエストロ様の前で、作品で証明してみせるわ: With this Artwork, I will Prove Myself before the Maestro
messages.薬指の親方出現時、自分の精神力が20未満なら精神力が20になる: When the Ring Nursefather appears, if the user's SP is below 20, set it to 20
messages.アルビナの精神力が20未満なら20へ戻る。前半の精神力のまま予測しない。: Albina's SP returns to 20 if it is lower. Do not use her first-half SP for predictions.
messages.ターン終了時、生体材料(骨)が206かつ生体材料(血)が5なら、それぞれ数値だけ:
At Turn End, with 206 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 5 Corpus Ingredient (Blood), consume both amounts and gain 1 Artwork: Tibia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Tibia, use a powerful attack this turn.

When damaged by an Attack Skill while preparing to use the powerful attack, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (once per skill, up to 3 times per turn).

Tibia: a masterpiece carved and completed by pouring in every part of her own body.
messages.骨206・血5と強攻撃準備: 206 Bones, 5 Blood, and preparation for a powerful attack
messages.ティビアのメロディーが出たら、別々の先行攻撃3本とNPCのマッチを準備する。: When Tibia's Melody appears, prepare three separate early attacks and the NPC's clash.
messages.弟子の展示をしばらく観察してみましょうか: Allow Me to Briefly Enjoy My Pupil's Exhibition
messages.カリスト本人へのマッチで援護防御を減らし、アルビナの大技への先行攻撃を通す。: Clash with Callisto directly to reduce Assist Defense and let early attacks reach Albina's major skill.
messages.材料はいつであれ、現場で調達して加工することが美学: The Aesthetics of Harvesting and Trimming the Ingredient On-site
messages.スキル終了時、自分のスキルでダメージを与えたなら、対象1つにつき生体材料(骨)3: At Skill End, if the skill dealt damage, gain 30 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 1 Corpus Ingredient (Blood) per target
messages.ダメージを与えたスキル終了: End of a skill that dealt damage
messages.的中が材料になる。危険な技を止め、大技の準備状態を毎ターン確認する。: Hits supply ingredients. Stop dangerous skills and check preparation for major attacks every turn.
messages.走り回る観客は椅子に座って鑑賞なさってくださいね: Please, Do Stop Running and Be Seated
messages.ターン終了時、速度が最も高い囚人および助力者へ、次のターンに材料がこぼれ落ちる傷: At Turn End, inflict Ingredient-shedding Wound next turn on the fastest Sinner and assistant
messages.速い囚人に攻撃Lv低下が付く。先行攻撃役でも、必要なマッチに勝てるか確認する。: Fast Sinners receive Offense Level Down. Check whether early attackers can still win required clashes.
messages.出現時、精神力が30回復\n\n攻撃スキル的中時、マイナス効果を付与して同時にプ:
On entry, heal 30 SP.

On an Attack Skill hit, if the user inflicts a negative effect and gains a positive effect simultaneously, heal 4 SP at Attack End.
- If this recovery occurs at max SP, gain 1 Power Up next turn (once per turn).

An art that shapes combat using the opponent's bones and muscles as on-site materials. As the process continues, even small bone fragments become increasingly intricate weapons.
messages.参戦・的中時の強化: On entry and buffs from hits
messages.精神力30から始まる。基礎値だけでなく現在の精神力を確認する。: Starts at 30 SP. Check current SP as well as the base values.
messages.私の全ての身体要素は既にティビアへ: All of My Corpus has been Given to Tibia
messages.火傷・振動・破裂・沈潜による体力・精神力ダメージ量-30%\n出血で受けるダメー:
HP and SP damage from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
Bleed damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At Turn Start, if Staggered, clear Stagger. Then gain 2 Wrath Fragility and disable “Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage” through the next turn (once per encounter).

At Turn End, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4 Burn on self (max 15).
messages.最初の混乱は解除される。火傷による防御低下を活用しつつ、解除後の行動も確認する。: The first Stagger is cleared. Use Burn to lower Defense Level, but check actions after Stagger is cleared too.
messages.作品名:ティビア消滅時、下記の対象の精神力を30回復して、次のターンに下記の対象:
When Artwork: Tibia expires, heal the following units for 30 SP and grant them 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up next turn:
- The Ring Nursefather - Callisto
- The Ring Apprentice - Albina
- Corpus Theater
messages.大技後に敵側の精神力と攻防Lvが強化される。次の通常技にも備える。: The major attack is followed by enemy SP recovery and Offense/Defense Level buffs. Prepare for the next regular skills too.
messages.自分の体力が50%未満なら、混乱状態を解除してこのターンを終了させる\n- この:
If HP falls below 50%, clear Stagger and end the turn.
- At the start of the next turn after this effect activates, equip “Closing Time - Installation Art no. 1: Your Flesh and Bones as the Gallery's Seats” in the last slot.
messages.混乱解除・即ターン終了から閉場へ進む。HP0まで倒そうとせずアリサの終了イベント: Clears Stagger, immediately ends the turn, and proceeds to Closing Time. Continue to Alisa's ending event instead of trying to reduce HP to 0.
messages.身体観劇が薬指の親方に倒されると、繋がったキャラクターは戦闘不能状態になる: If the Ring Nursefather defeats Corpus Theater, its linked character is incapacitated
messages.捕まった味方が戦闘不能になる。こちらかNPCが先に壊す。: The captured ally is incapacitated. Have a Sinner or NPC destroy it first.
messages.身体観劇が薬指の親方以外の他のキャラクターに倒されると、下記の効果が発動される\:
If anyone other than the Ring Nursefather defeats Corpus Theater, apply the following:
- Its linked character returns next turn; if their SP is below 10, set it to 10.
- Lower the Ring Nursefather's and Ring Apprentice's SP by 10.
- Gain 2 of every E.G.O resource.
messages.カリスト以外が身体観劇を討伐: Someone other than Callisto defeats Corpus Theater
messages.次ターンに味方が復帰し、全属性資源を2ずつ得る。アリサの救出と手数を重複させすぎ: The ally returns next turn, and you gain 2 resources of every affinity. Avoid wasting too many actions on the same rescue as Alisa.
messages.火傷による被ダメージ量が2倍になる: Take twice as much Burn damage
messages.火傷ダメージ2倍。アリサの救出を助ける。: Takes double Burn damage. Use it to help Alisa rescue allies.
messages.身体観劇と繋がったキャラクターへ以下の効果が適用される\n-行動不能状態になる\:
Apply the following to the character linked to Corpus Theater:
- Cannot act.
- Buffs, HP, and SP do not update.
messages.本人の行動は使えない。残った囚人とNPCで救出する。: The captured character cannot act. Rescue them with the remaining Sinners and NPCs.
messages.ほかの味方が生存中に致死ダメージを受けると混乱解除・HP全快。全味方の残数が同時: When taking lethal damage while another ally is alive, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining Ampule count decreases by 1 simultaneously.
messages.開始時5を全員共有。NPCの立て直しにも必要なので、囚人1人につき5回とは数えな: Everyone shares the initial five uses. They are also needed to revive NPCs; this is not five uses per Sinner.
messages.混乱していない場合、最後の攻撃枠が対象変更不能になりホーエンハイムを優先。発動し: While not Staggered, the final attack slot cannot be redirected and prioritizes Hohenheim. Expires at Turn End on the turn it activates.
messages.NPCのマッチを確認し、囚人は先行攻撃で弱体化させる。: Check the NPC's clash and have Sinners weaken the enemy with earlier attacks.
messages.最大2。1につきダメージ+15%。2なら戦闘開始時に攻撃の全コインを破壊不能へ変: Maximum 2. Damage +15% per stack. At 2, convert all attack Coins to Unbreakable at Combat Start. Expires at Attack End.
messages.骨の解放より先に怠惰技を処理し、追加ダメージの強化を消費させる。: Resolve the Sloth skill before Liberation of Bones to consume the damage buff.
messages.抑圧された肉体の使用前に攻撃スキルでダメージを受けると1、スキルごと1回・最大3: Before “Repressed Flesh” is used, taking damage from an Attack Skill grants 1 stack, once per skill, up to 3. Each stack lowers that skill's Final Power by 10.
messages.3コイン1技ではなく別々の攻撃3本でためる。: Build stacks with three separate attacks, rather than one three-Coin skill.
messages.最大2。アルビナが的中などで獲得し、次の作品名:ファシアの準備に使う。: Maximum 2. Albina gains it through hits and other effects, then uses it to prepare Artwork: Fascia.
messages.破壊不能による的中でも材料が増える。次の大技への先行攻撃を準備する。: Hits from Unbreakable Coins also add ingredients. Prepare early attacks for the next major skill.
messages.開始時に基本威力増加4。攻撃スキルで出血を付けると出血威力2を追加。大技の攻撃後: At Turn Start, gain 4 Base Power Up. Attack Skills that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency. Expires after the major attack.
messages.基礎表示に強化を足して考える。前半と後半では先行攻撃で得る弱体化が異なる。: Account for the buff on top of the listed base values. Early attacks apply different debuffs in the first and second halves.
messages.最大206。ダメージを与えたスキル終了時などに増える。血5と骨206で次の作品名: Maximum 206. Gained at the end of skills that deal damage and through other effects. With 5 Blood and 206 Bones, prepares the next Artwork: Tibia.
messages.カリストの通常技を止め、大技が出たら先行攻撃を入れる。: Stop Callisto's regular skills, then land early attacks when the major skill appears.
messages.最大5。ダメージを与えたスキル終了時などに増え、骨とともに大技の準備へ使う。: Maximum 5. Gained at the end of skills that deal damage and through other effects. Used with Bones to prepare the major attack.
messages.アルビナの最大2の生体材料とは別の蓄積。: This is separate from Albina's Corpus Ingredient, which caps at 2.
messages.開始時に威力増加4・斬撃威力増加2。攻撃スキルで出血を付けると出血威力2を追加。: At Turn Start, gain 4 Power Up and 2 Slash Power Up. Attack Skills that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency. Expires after the major attack.
messages.基礎威力だけで判断せず、囚人の先行攻撃で弱めてNPCへつなぐ。: Do not judge from Base Power alone. Weaken the skill with early Sinner attacks before the NPC clashes with it.
messages.基本攻撃・防御Lv−20。アルビナが戦闘可能なら開始時に保護7。: Base Offense and Defense Levels −20. At Turn Start, gain 7 Protection if Albina can fight.
messages.表は固定低下を反映。後半アルビナを先に倒し、保護を止める。: The table includes the fixed level reduction. Defeat Albina first in the second half to stop Protection.
messages.スキル使用時に攻撃Lv減少2を得る。1ターン最大3回。: On Skill Use, gain 2 Offense Level Down, up to three times per turn.
messages.速い担当のマッチ威力が下がる。援護を消す担当も予測を確認する。: Lowers the fast Sinner's clash Power. Check predictions for the Sinner removing assistance too.
messages.捕まった味方は行動不能・HPや精神力などの更新停止。対応する敵ユニットが生成され: The captured ally cannot act, and HP, SP, and other values stop updating. A corresponding enemy unit appears.
messages.カリスト以外が倒して救出し、次ターンの復帰を待つ。: Have someone other than Callisto defeat it to rescue the ally, then wait for their return next turn.
messages.全囚人・助力者が身体観劇になると敗北。: You lose if all Sinners and assistants become Corpus Theater.
messages.アリサによる救出を維持する。終盤の閉場はアリサを残して最後の手段へ進むイベント。: Keep Alisa able to rescue allies. The late Closing Time event leaves Alisa free and leads into her last resort.
messages.NPCが2人とも死亡すると敗北。アンプルの残数は全員共有で、本人専用の回数ではな: You lose if both NPCs die. Remaining Ampules are shared by everyone, rather than being individual use counts.
messages.前半と後半では大技の弱め方が異なる。甲冑3の最終威力−30と、後半の加算コイン弱: Major attacks are weakened differently in the first and second halves. Distinguish −30 Final Power from three Armor stacks from the later Plus Coin Drop and Power Down.
messages.援護防御のある相手へ直接マッチを先に行う。大技へ一方攻撃だけを並べると吸われる。: Clash directly with the enemy that has Assist Defense first. Simply assigning unopposed attacks to the major skill's user lets them be intercepted.
messages.身体観劇をカリストに倒させない。捕まった味方を失う。: Do not let Callisto defeat Corpus Theater; the captured ally will be lost.
messages.9-43のイベント戦や鏡の隠しボスとは、耐性・保護・行動が異なる。: Resistances, Protection, and actions differ from the 9-43 event battle and the hidden Mirror Dungeon boss.
messages.推奨Lv60、ファウスト・シンクレア・イシュメールの3人。回復・精神力回復と強い: Recommended Lv. 60 with Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael. Bring HP/SP recovery and strong regular skills or E.G.O.
messages.NPCの火傷を活用できるが、先行攻撃と援護解除を最優先にする。打撃・怠惰・暴食が: NPC Burn is useful, but prioritize early attacks and removing assistance. Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony damage are effective.
messages.援護防御を減らす先行マッチ: Early clashes to reduce Assist Defense
messages.大技への攻撃を別の敵に吸われないようにする。: Keep attacks meant for the major skill's user from being intercepted by the other enemy.
messages.大技の先行攻撃: Early attacks against the major skill's user
messages.別々の攻撃でNPCが勝てるまで弱める。: Use separate attacks to weaken the skill enough for the NPC to win.
messages.NPCと囚人の全滅・拘束を防ぎ、資源を回復へ回す。: Prevent the NPCs and Sinners from all dying or being trapped, and spend resources on healing.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-38「キラ・マティアス（9-38）」: Kira & Matthias (9-38) guide for Limbus Company 9-38. Leave Matthias to Moses, Ezra, and Vespa while the three Sinners focus on Kira. Do not assign Defense Skills or clashes to attacks meant for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.
messages.マティアスはモーゼス・エズラ・ベスパに任せ、囚人3人はキラへ集中する。援護防御に: Leave Matthias to Moses, Ezra, and Vespa while the three Sinners focus on Kira. Do not assign Defense Skills or clashes to attacks meant for Assist Defense, and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.
messages.イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルの3名のみ出撃し、全員のスロットは2になる。敵の表は: Only Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu deploy; each has two skill slots. Enemy tables show base values, with NPC debuffs handled separately. Matthias triggers the ending event below a certain HP threshold, whose exact value is unconfirmed. Do not apply 9-44's final escort conditions or 701 HP threshold here. Check the initial shared Ampule count on screen.
messages.キラへ集中し、マティアスはNPCへ任せる。: Focus on Kira and leave Matthias to the NPCs.
messages.援護に任せる一方攻撃の対象には守備を付けない。: Do not equip Defense Skills on targets of unopposed attacks left to assistance.
messages.キラ撃破後も反撃・刺青を確認し、不必要な攻撃を控える。: After defeating Kira, keep checking Counters and tattoos; avoid unnecessary attacks.
messages.通常反撃と長兄の刺青による再使用が危険。囚人はキラだけを攻撃し、マティアスの削り: His ordinary Counter and its Great Brother tattoo reuse are dangerous. Have Sinners attack only Kira and leave damage against Matthias to the NPCs.
messages.援護が来ず囚人が大きく削られる: Assistance fails to activate and Sinners take heavy damage
messages.エズラ・ベスパの援護防御は、守備未装着の味方への一方攻撃に発動する。任せる攻撃へ: Ezra and Vespa's Assist Defense intercepts unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped. Do not clash with an attack left to them or equip Defense Skills in any other slot of its target. Also check that the NPC has Assist Defense equipped.
messages.キラの初手でアンプルを消費する: Kira's opening attack consumes an Ampule
messages.ガチ殴りへのマッチ敗北が特に危険。初手は強い通常技かE.G.Oで勝つ。2ターン目: Losing to “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” is especially dangerous. Win the opening clash with a strong regular skill or E.G.O. Moses's Plus Coin Drop makes clashes easier from Turn 2 onward.
messages.封印された剣を保有。段階が変わると同名技でも威力・効果が変わる。: Has Sealed Sword. Even skills with the same name change Power and effects as its stage changes.
messages.NPCが主に受け持つ。一定HP以下でイベントへ進むので、囚人でHP0まで倒そうと: Mainly handled by the NPCs. Progresses to an event below a certain HP threshold; Sinners do not need to reduce HP to 0.
messages.未解明のパッシブ1枠は効果を断定せず省略している。: One unidentified passive is omitted rather than assigning it an unconfirmed effect.
messages.モーゼスの紫の息で、2ターン目から5ターン続く加算コイン弱化3を得る。表にはこの: Moses's Purple Breath applies 3 Plus Coin Drop from Turn 2 for five turns. This temporary effect is not included in the table.
messages.褒められた！・熱線・刺青で強化される。現在の予測と反撃を確認して集中する。: Gains strength through I Got Praised!, Thermal Blades, and tattoos. Check current clash predictions and Counters while focusing attacks.
messages.固定3名とNPCを守る回復を用意: Bring healing to protect the three required Sinners and the NPCs
messages.推奨Lv60。イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルを育てる。全員2枠なので、キラへ合わせ: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu. Each has two slots, so divide attacks against Kira and healing duties.
messages.モーゼス・エズラ・ベスパが共闘する。NPCの誰かが死亡すると敗北になるため、共有: Moses, Ezra, and Vespa fight alongside you. You lose if any NPC dies, so do not spend all shared Ampules on Sinners.
messages.キラには貫通が通りやすい。属性だけでなく、初手のガチ殴りに勝つ手段を残す。: Kira is vulnerable to Pierce. Consider affinity, but also save a way to beat the opening “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”.
messages.囚人3人はキラへ集中。マティアスへ余った攻撃を向けると通常反撃を起動するため、余: All three Sinners focus on Kira. Spare attacks against Matthias trigger his ordinary Counter; use spare actions for healing or necessary defense instead.
messages.初手のガチ殴りは強い技で止める。褒められた！4以上のコイン再使用と追加ダメージを: Stop the opening “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” with a strong skill. Watch for Coin reuse at 4 or more I Got Praised! and for additional damage.
messages.2ターン目の紫の息でキラへ加算コイン弱化3が入る。効果と残りターンを確認し、予測: Purple Breath applies 3 Plus Coin Drop to Kira on Turn 2. Check the effect and remaining duration, then use improved clash predictions to Stagger and defeat her.
messages.NPCの援護条件を維持する: Maintain the conditions for NPC assistance
messages.エズラ・ベスパが援護防御を装着しているかを確認。任せる攻撃には囚人のマッチを付け: Check that Ezra or Vespa has Assist Defense equipped. Do not assign a Sinner to clash with an attack left to them; keep it unopposed.
messages.狙われた囚人には守備を装着しない。同じ囚人の別枠の守備でも条件を崩すため、キラへ: Do not equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Defense in another slot of the same Sinner also breaks the condition, so use attacks against Kira or healing instead.
messages.囚人が勝てる表示でも、マッチを奪えば援護と反撃の管理が変わる。基本はNPCへ任せ: Even if a Sinner is predicted to win, taking over the clash changes assistance and Counter management. Generally leave it to the NPCs and focus on Kira.
messages.囚人のイベント攻撃は追加の手札として数えない: Do not count event attacks as extra selectable skills
messages.2ターン目はドンキホーテ、5ターン目はイサンの自動追撃がある。自分で手札から選ん: Don Quixote performs an automatic follow-up on Turn 2, and Yi Sang on Turn 5. These are separate from skills selected from your hand; there is no need to prepare resources as for an ordinary E.G.O use.
messages.ドンキホーテの自動追撃はマティアスの反撃を受けない。これを見て通常の攻撃も安全だ: Don Quixote's automatic follow-up does not trigger Matthias's Counter. This does not mean regular attacks are safe too.
messages.反撃を増やさずNPCの決着を待つ: Wait for the NPCs to finish without adding Counters
messages.キラを倒したら、マティアスへ全員で攻撃する必要はない。反撃がなく安全に攻撃できる: Once Kira is defeated, everyone does not need to attack Matthias. Hold attacks unless he has no Counter and can be attacked safely. Having no tattoos does not remove the Counter itself.
messages.NPCが援護防御を使っているターンは、守備を付けて支援を消さない。狙われる対象と: On turns when NPCs use Assist Defense, do not cancel their assistance by equipping Defense Skills. Check targets and available assistance, then choose healing or withholding attacks as appropriate.
messages.一定HP以下でイベントへ進んで終了する。9-44のモーゼスを3ターン守る手順は、: The battle ends through an event below a certain HP threshold. Guarding Moses for three turns in 9-44 is not this battle's ending condition.
messages.対象の出血が4以上なら、コイン威力+1: If the target has 4 or more Bleed, Coin Power +1
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があれば、麻痺2を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], inflict 2 Paralyze
messages.基本はLCD組に任せる攻撃。援護を受ける囚人には守備を装着せず、マッチを付けない: Generally leave this attack to the LCD team. Do not equip Defense Skills or assign a clash on a Sinner relying on assistance. Do not take over carelessly even if the prediction is favorable.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]混乱区画を5前進: Ⅰ [On Hit] Raise Stagger Threshold by 5
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]混乱区画を5前進: Ⅱ [On Hit] Raise Stagger Threshold by 5
messages.混乱区間を進める2枚技。NPCの担当を確認し、囚人はキラへの攻撃を続ける。: A two-Coin skill that raises Stagger Thresholds. Check the NPC's assignment and keep Sinner attacks focused on Kira.
messages.対象の出血3につき、基本威力+1(最大3): Base Power +1 per 3 Bleed on the target (max 3)
messages.[攻撃後]自分の中指 - 怨恨を全て消費し、よく見とけ娘ちゃん！1を得る: [After Attack] Consume all The Middle - Grudge and gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo!
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血回数が2増加: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.4枚破壊不能の強攻撃。囚人の攻撃を増やすと怨恨が増えるため、マティアスはNPCに: A powerful attack with four Unbreakable Coins. Extra Sinner attacks add Grudge, so leave Matthias to the NPCs.
messages.たかがこれしきで壊れんなよ！: Don't Let Somethin' Like This Break Ya!
messages.[使用時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に追加打撃ダ: [On Use] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], deal 5 additional Blunt damage on Coin hit
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]麻痺2を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Paralyze
messages.3枚破壊不能で束縛・追加ダメージ。囚人へ向いた場合も、援護防御を装着したNPCが: Three Unbreakable Coins with Bind and additional damage. If it targets a Sinner, check for an NPC with Assist Defense equipped and leave it to them.
messages.被ダメージ時、自分の中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]1につき、このスキルを1回再使用: When damaged, reuse this skill once per The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother] on self (max 1 reuse)
messages.[使用時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に対象の出血: [On Use] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], increase the target's Bleed Count by 1 on Coin hit
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]混乱区画を10後退: Ⅱ [On Hit] Lower Stagger Threshold by 10
messages.通常反撃。長兄の刺青があると1回再使用する。マッチ可能反撃とは違い、不要な攻撃で: An ordinary Counter. Reuses once with the Great Brother tattoo. Unlike a Clashable Counter, it is best handled by avoiding unnecessary attacks that trigger it.
messages.ラッピング1つ破るぞ！: Gonna Unbox a Layer of Packaging!
messages.[使用時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に追加打撃ダ: [On Use] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], deal 10 additional Blunt damage on Coin hit

messages.対象変更不可・3枚破壊不能の段階移行技。攻撃後に封印が1段階解ける。NPCの担当: A transition skill with three Unbreakable Coins that cannot be redirected. Removes one stage of the seal after attacking. Keep the NPC's assignment intact.
messages.[使用時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に出血1を追: [On Use] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], inflict 1 additional Bleed on Coin hit
messages.[マッチ敗北]次のターンにマッチ威力増加1を得る(1ターンにつき最大2回): [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Clash Power Up next turn (up to twice per turn)
messages.封印解除後の同名技。出血と次ターンのマッチ強化が追加されるため、前半と同じ数値だ: The same-named skill after unsealing. Adds Bleed and next-turn clash buffs; do not assume its values are unchanged. Use NPC support.
messages.[マッチ敗北]次のターンに嫉妬ダメージ量増加1を得る(1ターンにつき最大2回): [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Envy Damage Up next turn (up to twice per turn)

messages.Ⅱ[的中時]混乱区画を10前進: Ⅱ [On Hit] Raise Stagger Threshold by 10
messages.前半より混乱区間が大きく進む。囚人がマッチを奪わず、NPCに任せて回復とキラの処: Raises Stagger Thresholds more than in the first half. Leave the clash to the NPCs while Sinners heal and handle Kira.
messages.後半の怨念スタンピング。4枚破壊不能・基本威力16。怨恨と出血の条件もあるので、: The later “Stamp of Vengeance”. Four Unbreakable Coins and 16 Base Power. Grudge and Bleed conditions also matter; do not assign a Sinner based on base values alone.
messages.[使用時]中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に追加打撃ダメージ: [On Use] With The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], deal 10 additional Blunt damage on Coin hit

messages.3枚破壊不能、低HP時はダメージ+40%。NPCに任せ、囚人へ残る攻撃は援護条件: Three Unbreakable Coins, with +40% damage at low HP. Leave it to the NPCs; maintain assistance conditions for any remaining attacks aimed at Sinners.
messages.boss-copy:kira-matthias:skills.10.name: Rule Violation

messages.強化後の通常反撃。長兄の刺青や低HPでさらに危険になるため、無用な一方攻撃をしな: The enhanced ordinary Counter. Great Brother tattoos and low HP make it more dangerous, so avoid unnecessary unopposed attacks.
messages.2つ目のラッピングまで剥がすことになったか。: Looks Like I Gotta Unbox the Second Layer, too.
messages.[攻撃後]1段階 封印解除状態が2段階 封印解除状態になる: [After Attack] Unsealed Stage 1 becomes Unsealed Stage 2
messages.対象変更不可・4枚破壊不能。攻撃後に2段階の封印解除へ進む。任されているNPCの: Four Unbreakable Coins; cannot be redirected. Advances to Unsealed Stage 2 after attacking. Preserve NPC assignments and prioritize Sinner survival.

messages.[マッチ敗北]このスキルダメージで対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] This skill's damage cannot Stagger the target

messages.3枚目が破壊不能。出血5以上で基本威力が2増える。勝っても残る被弾を回復し、出血: The third Coin is Unbreakable. Gains 2 Base Power against targets with at least 5 Bleed. Heal damage that remains after a clash win and prevent Bleed from accumulating.
