messages.褒められた！4以上で最後のコインを3回再使用する。特に初手のマッチ敗北が危険なの: At 4 or more I Got Praised!, reuses the last Coin three times. Losing the opening clash is especially dangerous, so assign a strong attack.
messages.このスキルは熱線ON状態のとき、熱線効果が適用される: While Thermal Blades ON is active, apply Thermal Blades effects to this skill

messages.[攻撃後]自分の褒められた！が2以上なら、次のターンに嫉妬ダメージ量増加1を得る: [After Attack] If the user has at least 2 I Got Praised!, gain 1 Envy Damage Up next turn
messages.出血4以上でコイン威力増加。熱線ONでは火傷も付く。モーゼスの弱体化を確認し、勝: Gains Coin Power against targets with at least 4 Bleed. Also inflicts Burn with Thermal Blades ON. Check Moses's debuff and stop it with a regular skill that can win.

messages.4枚すべて破壊不能。勝利すればその技で混乱しなくなるが、出血と追加ダメージは残る: All four Coins are Unbreakable. A clash win prevents Stagger from this skill, but Bleed and additional damage remain. Check HP and Bleed Count.
messages.[使用時]自分の体力が40%以下のとき、ダメージ量+60%: [On Use] If the user's HP is at 40% or less, damage +60%

messages.[攻撃後]自分の中指 - 怨恨を全て消耗し、褒められた！1を得る: [After Attack] Consume all The Middle - Grudge and gain 1 I Got Praised!

messages.5枚破壊不能の強攻撃。低HPと褒められた！で被害が増える。モーゼスの加算コイン弱: A powerful attack with five Unbreakable Coins. Low HP and I Got Praised! increase its damage. Check for Moses's Plus Coin Drop and survive with healing and strong clashes.
messages.ただじゃ置かないかんね: I'll Get You Back for This...!

messages.通常反撃。強化刺青1につき再使用、最大2回。マッチに勝った後も反撃・出血で削られ: An ordinary Counter. Reuses once per Augmentation Tattoo, up to twice. Counters and Bleed can still drain HP after clash wins, so do not concentrate attacks on the same low-HP Sinner.
messages.マッチ勝利時、よく見とけ娘ちゃん！1を得る\n\nスキル的中時、よく見とけ娘ちゃ:
On Clash Win, gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo!

On skill hit, gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo! (once per skill; destroyed Coins do not grant it).

If the first skill used this turn wins a clash, gain 1 additional Check This Out, Kiddo! and give that skill +1 Coin Power.
messages.マッチ勝利・破壊されていないコインの的中: Clash wins and hits with undestroyed Coins
messages.マティアスの強化はNPCも対処する。囚人は不用意な攻撃でさらに反撃を誘わない。: The NPCs handle Matthias's buffs too. Do not provoke extra Counters with careless Sinner attacks.

messages.攻撃を足すと怨恨が増え、強攻撃につながる。NPCの火力へ任せる。: Additional attacks add Grudge and lead to powerful skills. Leave the damage to the NPCs.
messages.ステージ開始時、全囚人とLCDキャラクターへ仕返し帳簿を付与する\n\nこのター:

messages.ステージ開始・的中したスキル数3超過: Stage Start; more than three skills hit
messages.超過した攻撃で長兄の刺青が付く。NPCの攻撃もあるので、囚人が3本までなら必ず安: Extra attacks grant Great Brother tattoos. NPC attacks also count, so three or fewer Sinner attacks are not necessarily safe.

messages.中指は絶対にお返しするって言ったよね: I'm pretty sure the Middle never forgets

At maximum The Middle - Grudge, use a powerful attack.

At Turn End, if HP is below 80%, 60%, or 40%, gain The Middle - Grudge up to its maximum.
messages.キラの怨恨が最大になると大技へ移る。削りの途中も手札と回復を残す。: Kira uses her major attack at maximum Grudge. Save skills and healing while lowering her HP.
messages.このターンに的中したスキル数が2つを超過したなら、超過したスキル数だけ次のターン:
If more than two skills hit this turn, gain The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos next turn equal to the number of skills above two.

“Will the Middle accept me as family someday too, so I can live with all the Big Sisters and Brothers forever?”
messages.攻撃をまとめるほど次ターンの刺青が増える。反撃再使用に備え、集中攻撃する囚人のH: More attacks mean more tattoos next turn. Restore the HP of Sinners focusing their attacks to prepare for Counter reuses.
messages.こうすればいいんだよね、パパ！: Am I doing this right, Papa?!
messages.ステージ開始時、熱線OFFを持って始める\n\nターン開始時、自分が保有した褒め:
Starts the stage with Thermal Blades OFF.

At Turn Start with at least 3 I Got Praised!, change to Thermal Blades ON for the turn and additionally inflict Burn with skills that inflict Bleed.

At Turn End with fewer than 3 I Got Praised!, change Thermal Blades ON to Thermal Blades OFF.

“Papa's the best. He always praises me and buys me comics.”
messages.熱線ONで出血技に火傷が加わる。マッチ勝利で的中条件を抑える。: Thermal Blades ON adds Burn to Bleed skills. Win clashes to limit on-hit effects.
messages.ほかの味方が生存中に致死ダメージを受けると、混乱解除・HP全快。全味方の残数が同: When taking lethal damage while another ally is alive, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining Ampule count decreases by 1 simultaneously.
messages.NPCと囚人で共有する残数を画面で確認。1人ごとに独立した復活回数ではない。: Check the remaining count shared by NPCs and Sinners on screen. These are not separate revival counts per character.
messages.エズラ・ベスパが、守備未装着の味方への一方攻撃を引き受ける支援。: Ezra and Vespa intercept unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped.
messages.任せる攻撃へマッチを付けず、対象囚人には守備を装着しない。NPCが援護を使うター: Do not assign clashes to attacks left to assistance, or equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Check whether the NPC is using assistance that turn too.
messages.最大10。1につき攻撃Lv+1・防御Lv−2・反撃ダメージ+5%。最大なら被ダメ: Maximum 10. Per stack: Offense Level +1, Defense Level −2, Counter damage +5%. At maximum, damage taken +20%. Consumed by specific skills.
messages.囚人がマティアスを不用意に殴るほど危険技を誘発する。: Careless Sinner attacks against Matthias trigger more dangerous skills.
messages.最大2、終了時に消滅。打撃・嫉妬ダメージ+10%。反撃などの追加効果条件になる。: Maximum 2; expires at Turn End. Blunt and Envy damage +10%. Enables additional effects on Counters and other skills.
messages.ある間はマティアスへの攻撃を控え、NPCへ任せる。: While active, hold back attacks against Matthias and leave him to the NPCs.
messages.最大3、終了時に消滅。打撃・嫉妬ダメージ+5%。反撃の再使用などの条件になる。: Maximum 3; expires at Turn End. Blunt and Envy damage +5%. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.
messages.キラへ集中する間も、反撃される囚人のHPを残す。: While focusing on Kira, maintain HP on Sinners exposed to Counters.
messages.最大10。2につき基本威力+1、1につき斬撃・打撃ダメージ+5%。スキルで2回ダ: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +5% per stack. Lose 1 after taking damage from skills twice.
messages.数値を減らす目的で囚人の攻撃を増やさず、反撃との兼ね合いを優先する。: Do not add Sinner attacks solely to lower this value; consider the resulting Counters first.
messages.最大10。2につき基本威力+1、1につき斬撃・打撃ダメージ+8%。スキルで2回ダ: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +8% per stack. Lose 1 after taking damage from skills twice.
messages.キラへのマッチ勝利と集中攻撃を続け、再使用条件を満たさせない。: Keep winning clashes and focusing on Kira to prevent her reuse condition from being met.
messages.褒められた！3以上で移行。出血を付与するスキルに追加の火傷が付く。: Activates at 3 or more I Got Praised!. Skills that inflict Bleed also inflict Burn.
messages.マッチを止め、火傷と出血の両方の消耗へ回復を用意する。: Win clashes to stop the attacks and prepare healing for both Burn and Bleed damage.
messages.中指の2人のスキルが的中すると、スキルごと1回精神力7回復。: When either Middle enemy lands a skill hit, heal 7 SP once per skill.
messages.的中が敵の精神力維持にもつながる。囚人はキラへ勝ち、マティアスはNPCに任せる。: Hits also help maintain enemy SP. Sinners should win against Kira while the NPCs handle Matthias.
messages.モーゼスがキラへ与える支援。2ターン目から5ターンの加算コイン弱化3。: Moses's support against Kira: 3 Plus Coin Drop from Turn 2 for five turns.
messages.敵の基礎値へ固定で差し引かず、実際の効果と残りターンを確認する。: Do not permanently subtract it from enemy base values. Check the active effect and its remaining duration.
messages.マティアスの反撃は通常反撃。マッチに勝って止める技ではなく、攻撃を控えて起動を避: Matthias uses an ordinary Counter. Avoid triggering it by withholding attacks; it cannot be stopped through a clash win.
messages.マティアスへ攻撃を追加すると、NPC分も含めた的中スキル数で刺青が増える。囚人3: Additional attacks against Matthias add tattoos based on all skills that hit, including NPC skills. This does not mean three Sinner attacks are safe.
messages.援護防御に任せる対象へ守備を付けない。キラ撃破後も毎ターンの支援条件を確認する。: Do not equip Defense Skills on targets left to Assist Defense. Check support conditions every turn even after Kira is defeated.
messages.9-44の再戦とはスキル・支援・終了条件が異なる。最後の護衛手順を混ぜない。: Skills, support, and ending conditions differ from the 9-44 rematch. Do not apply its final escort procedure here.
messages.推奨Lv60。イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルの固定3名。初手の強いマッチ、HP・精: Recommended Lv. 60. Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu are the three required Sinners. Prepare a strong opening clash and HP/SP recovery.
messages.キラへの貫通火力が有効。NPCの援護を維持し、親方へ無理に火力を足す編成にしない: Pierce damage is effective against Kira. Maintain NPC assistance rather than forcing extra damage against the Nursefather.
messages.キラへのマッチと集中火力: Clashes and focused damage against Kira
messages.NPCが親方を担当する間に手数を減らす。: Reduce enemy actions while the NPCs handle the Nursefather.
messages.破壊不能と通常反撃による消耗を戻す。: Recover damage from Unbreakable Coins and ordinary Counters.
messages.一方攻撃・守備未装着の条件を崩さない。: Preserve the conditions: an unopposed attack and no Defense Skills equipped on its target.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-43「アルビナ・カリスト（9-43）: Albina & Callisto (9-43) guide for Limbus Company 9-43. You control Faust and Ishmael. Leave Callisto to the NPC A Certain Sinclair while the two Sinners focus on Albina. The NPC's Abate the Smoke clears partywide Stagger, so the animation is no reason to stop attacking.
messages.操作するのはファウストとイシュメール。カリストはNPCのとあるシンクレアへ任せ、: You control Faust and Ishmael. Leave Callisto to the NPC A Certain Sinclair while the two Sinners focus on Albina. The NPC's Abate the Smoke clears partywide Stagger, so the animation is no reason to stop attacking.
messages.ファウスト・シンクレア・イシュメール固定。編成した人格に関係なくシンクレアは助力: Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael are required. Regardless of the chosen Identity, Sinclair is replaced by an assistant, leaving two controllable Sinners. There are no K Corp. Ampules. Callisto cannot fall below 1 HP while Albina lives, so handle Albina first. Tables show base values for normal 9-43.
messages.カリストはNPCへ任せ、2人はアルビナへ集中する。: Leave Callisto to the NPC and focus both Sinners on Albina.
messages.アンプルがないため、2人のHPと出血を管理する。: With no Ampules, manage both Sinners' HP and Bleed.
messages.身体観劇・全体混乱は煙払いの救出を確認して攻撃を続ける。: Confirm the rescue by Abate the Smoke after Corpus Theater or partywide Stagger, then keep attacking.
messages.編成人格にかかわらずNPCのとあるシンクレアへ置き換わる戦闘。操作するファウスト: This battle replaces any selected Sinclair Identity with the NPC A Certain Sinclair. Level the controllable Faust and Ishmael and assign them clashes and attacks against Albina.
messages.カリストの閉場で身体観劇にされても、NPCの煙払いが救出する。9-37と同じ手動: Even when Callisto's Closing Time turns allies into Corpus Theater, the NPC rescues them with Abate the Smoke. Manual rescue need not take the same priority as in 9-37. Check HP and Bleed after the rescue.
messages.カリストを先に攻撃しても倒れない: Callisto will not die when attacked first
messages.アルビナ生存中はカリストがHP1未満にならない。カリストへのマッチはNPCへ任せ: Callisto cannot fall below 1 HP while Albina is alive. Leave her clashes to the NPC and focus the two controllable Sinners on Albina.
messages.操作する2名の育成と回復を整える: Prepare levels and healing for the two controllable Sinners
messages.推奨Lv60。ファウスト・シンクレア・イシュメールの固定3名だが、シンクレアはN: Recommended Lv. 60. Faust, Sinclair, and Ishmael are required, but Sinclair becomes an NPC. Prepare Faust and Ishmael's Identities and E.G.O.
messages.敵には打撃・怠惰・暴食が通りやすい。属性だけでなく、アルビナの通常技へ勝つマッチ: Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony work well against the enemies. Prioritize winning clashes against Albina's regular skills and restoring HP, rather than affinity alone.
messages.この戦闘にはK社アンプルがない。ほかの親方戦と同じ感覚で致死ダメージを受けず、出: There are no K Corp. Ampules here. Do not take lethal damage expecting another Nursefather battle's revival; avoid concentrating attacks on a Sinner with high Bleed.
messages.カリストをNPCへ任せ、アルビナを先に倒す: Leave Callisto to the NPC and defeat Albina first
messages.カリストの強い技はとあるシンクレアへ任せ、2名の攻撃はアルビナへ集中する。アルビ: Leave Callisto's powerful skills to A Certain Sinclair and focus both Sinners' attacks on Albina. Do not try to finish the Nursefather while Albina remains alive.
messages.アルビナの出血技へ勝ち、混乱区間80%・40%を使って攻撃する。最低Lvを狙う材: Beat Albina's Bleed skills and use her 80% and 40% Stagger Thresholds to attack. Ingredient Selection prioritizes the lowest-level unit, so manage both Sinners' HP evenly.
messages.始まった展示会・展示会の主催で敵が援護防御を得る場面は、敵の装着技とマッチ線も確: When “The Exhibition Begins” or “Curating the Exhibition” grants Assist Defense, check equipped enemy skills and clash lines too. Sinner attacks do not always reach their intended target unchanged.
messages.自動E.G.Oの弱体化とNPCの摘出を利用する: Use automatic E.G.O debuffs and the NPC's Excision
messages.2ターン目の開始時、ファウストとイシュメールの初期E.G.Oが自動で発動する。ダ: At the start of Turn 2, Faust and Ishmael's base E.G.O activate automatically. Unlike ordinary manual uses that deal damage, these alone do not reduce enemy HP.
messages.この演出でも敵の大技にある被ダメージ時の弱体化は発動する。自分の手札の攻撃も組み: The animation still triggers the major enemy skills' debuffs on taking damage. Add attacks from your own hand and check whether Albina's clash predictions become favorable.
messages.抑圧された肉体の解放は対象変更不可。先に別々の攻撃を当てると加算コイン弱化・威力: “Liberation of the Repressed Flesh” cannot be redirected. Earlier separate attacks apply Plus Coin Drop and Power Down, weakening it up to three times.
messages.カリストの大技にはNPCの真鎮終斬が持つ摘出コインが有効。破壊不能も破壊できるの: The Excision Coin on the NPC's True Decapitation Deathblow works against Callisto's major skill. It can destroy Unbreakable Coins too, so do not force a Sinner to take over that clash.
messages.煙払いによる救出後も攻撃を続ける: Keep attacking after Abate the Smoke rescues allies
Closing Time is Unclashable and prevents Defense Skills from activating, inflicting Stagger and Corpus Theater across the party. A high-Power Sinner E.G.O cannot clash with it to stop it.
messages.外部効果で味方が行動不能になると、とあるシンクレアがターン終了前に煙払いを使う。: When an external effect prevents allies from acting, A Certain Sinclair uses Abate the Smoke before Turn End. It also removes the generated Corpus Theater, so you need not divert every attack to manual rescue as in 9-37.
messages.救出・撃破による精神力回復もあるが、アンプルによる復活はない。救出後のHP・出血: Rescues and kills can restore SP, but there are no Ampule revivals. Check HP and Bleed after the rescue and keep clashing with and attacking Albina.
messages.NPCの親方戦を支え、終了イベントへ進める: Support the NPC against the Nursefather and reach the ending event
messages.アルビナを先に処理した後、カリストへのNPCの攻撃で決着へ進む。自分の2名はHP: After handling Albina first, the NPC's attacks against Callisto lead toward the finish. Use your two Sinners for HP recovery and safe attacks rather than forcing them to take over strong skills.
messages.とあるシンクレアが死亡すると敗北。通常は強い支援を任せられるが、絶対にマッチで負: You lose if A Certain Sinclair dies. His support is usually strong, but do not assume he can never lose a clash; check targets and applied effects.
messages.カリストを一定HPまで削るとイベントで終了する。HP2819を必ず0まで削る戦闘: Reducing Callisto to a certain HP triggers the ending event. Do not treat this as a battle requiring all 2,819 HP to be depleted; watch the event progression.
messages.編成したシンクレアに代わって参戦する助力者。カリストのマッチ・火力、煙払いによる: An assistant who replaces your selected Sinclair. Handles clashes and damage against Callisto and rescues allies through Abate the Smoke. You lose if he dies.
messages.2名はアルビナを担当し、NPCの強いマッチを不用意に奪わない。: Have the two Sinners handle Albina; avoid needlessly taking over the NPC's strong clashes.
messages.外部効果で味方が行動不能になったとき、NPCがターン終了前に使う救出用の攻撃。身: A rescue attack used by the NPC before Turn End when an external effect prevents allies from acting. Removes Corpus Theater.
messages.全体混乱の演出を見て攻撃を諦めず、救出後のHPを確認する。: Do not give up attacking after the partywide Stagger animation; check HP after the rescue.
messages.NPCの強攻撃。摘出コインを持ち、破壊不能コインも破壊できる。: A powerful NPC attack with an Excision Coin that can destroy Unbreakable Coins too.
messages.カリストの強い技へのNPCの対処を任せる。: Leave the response to Callisto's powerful skills to the NPC.
messages.マッチで破壊不能コインも破壊でき、自分はマッチ敗北でも破壊されず攻撃する特殊コイ: A special Coin that can destroy Unbreakable Coins in clashes, remains intact after a clash loss, and still attacks.
messages.通常の破壊不能のまま攻撃が残る場合と区別する。: Distinguish this from ordinary Unbreakable Coins remaining to attack.
messages.HP・精神力・バフが更新されない行動不能状態になり、対応する身体観劇が生成される: Prevents action and freezes HP, SP, and buffs while generating a corresponding Corpus Theater. In 9-43, the NPC's Abate the Smoke removes it.
messages.9-37の捕縛救出の手順をそのまま持ち込まない。: Do not directly import 9-37's capture-and-rescue procedure.
messages.敵の味方への一方攻撃を引き受け、専用反撃を使う。マッチ開始時にも数値が減る。守備: Intercepts unopposed attacks against the enemy's allies and uses a special Counter. Its stacks also decrease at Clash Start. Does not activate for allies with Defense Skills equipped.
messages.敵側の支援効果。NPCや囚人のマッチ線を確認してアルビナへ集中する。: An enemy support effect. Check NPC and Sinner clash lines while focusing on Albina.
messages.最大2の特殊充電。開始時2。ターン終了時に2なら消費し、作品名:ファシアを得る。: A special Charge with a maximum of 2; starts at 2. At Turn End with 2, consume it to gain Artwork: Fascia.
messages.次ターンの対象変更不可大技へ備える。: Prepare for the next turn's major attack, which cannot be redirected.
messages.ターン開始時に基本威力増加4。出血を付与する攻撃に出血威力2を追加する。大技使用: At Turn Start, gain 4 Base Power Up. Attacks that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency. Removed after using the major skill or losing its clash.
messages.先行攻撃で大技を弱め、対象囚人のHPと出血を管理する。: Weaken the major attack with early hits and manage its targeted Sinner's HP and Bleed.
messages.最大206。カリストが血とともに消費して作品名:ティビアを得る特殊充電。: A special Charge with a maximum of 206. Callisto consumes it with Blood to gain Artwork: Tibia.
messages.親方の大技はNPCへ任せる。: Leave the Nursefather's major attack to the NPC.
messages.最大5。骨206・血5を消費して作品名:ティビアを得る。: Maximum 5. Consume 206 Bones and 5 Blood to gain Artwork: Tibia.
messages.自分の2名の役割はアルビナへの集中を優先する。: Prioritize focusing your two Sinners on Albina.
messages.ターン開始時に威力増加4・斬撃威力増加2。出血を付与する攻撃に出血威力2を追加す: At Turn Start, gain 4 Power Up and 2 Slash Power Up. Attacks that inflict Bleed inflict 2 additional Bleed Potency.
messages.NPCの摘出による対処を確認する。: Check the NPC's use of Excision to handle it.
messages.作品名:ティビアと同じ専用効果。大技へつながる。: The same special effect as Artwork: Tibia. Leads into a major attack.
messages.NPCの担当を崩さず、アルビナを先に処理する。: Keep NPC assignments intact and handle Albina first.
messages.スキル使用時に攻撃Lv減少2を得る（1ターン最大3回）。: On Skill Use, gain 2 Offense Level Down (up to three times per turn).
messages.速い囚人へ付くことがある。使用前のLv・マッチ予測を確認する。: May affect fast Sinners. Check levels and clash predictions before use.
messages.K社アンプルはない。ほかの親方戦の復活を前提にしない。: There are no K Corp. Ampules. Do not assume revivals from other Nursefather battles apply.
messages.シンクレアは編成人格の性能で操作する枠ではなく、NPCへ置き換わる。: Sinclair is replaced by an NPC rather than being controlled with your selected Identity's abilities.
messages.2ターン目の自動E.G.O演出はダメージや通常使用のパッシブ発動を見込んで手札に: Do not count Turn 2's automatic E.G.O animation as a hand skill that deals damage or triggers ordinary on-use passives. Distinguish this from the debuffs on major enemy skills.
messages.身体観劇はNPCが即座に処理するため、別個体として不明なステータスを作って掲載し: The NPC immediately removes Corpus Theater, so no separate unit with invented or unknown stats is listed.
messages.推奨Lv60。ファウスト・イシュメールのマッチ、HP回復、出血対策を整える。: Recommended Lv. 60. Prepare Faust and Ishmael's clashes, HP recovery, and Bleed management.
messages.打撃・怠惰・暴食が通りやすい。弱点だけへ寄せず、各囚人の通常技で勝てるかを見る。: Blunt, Sloth, and Gluttony work well. Check whether each Sinner can win with regular skills rather than focusing solely on weaknesses.
messages.NPCがカリストを受け持つ間に敵を減らす。: Reduce the enemy count while the NPC handles Callisto.
messages.復活のない2人戦で、破壊不能と出血の消耗を戻す。: Recover damage from Unbreakable Coins and Bleed in this two-Sinner battle without revivals.
messages.親方の強い技と救出を助力者へ任せる。: Leave the Nursefather's powerful skills and ally rescues to the assistant.
messages.生体材料2で開始。2ターン目から大技へつながる。: Starts with 2 Corpus Ingredient, leading into a major attack from Turn 2.
messages.最低Lvの囚人・助力者を優先して狙う。片方だけ育成が遅れると集中被弾しやすい。: Prioritizes the lowest-level Sinner or assistant. If one Sinner is underleveled, they are more likely to take concentrated hits.
messages.9-37の甲冑形態・取り巻き戦を流用せず、この戦闘は最初から本人を処理する。: Do not import 9-37's armored form and add phase. This battle starts with Albina herself as the target.
messages.生体材料(骨)206・生体材料(血)5で開始。: Starts with 206 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 5 Corpus Ingredient (Blood).
messages.最高Lvの囚人・助力者を優先して狙い、その対象へのダメージ+150%。基本はNP: Prioritizes the highest-level Sinner or assistant and deals 150% more damage to that target. Generally leave her to the NPC.
messages.アルビナ生存中はHP1未満にならない。混乱もターン開始時に1回解除し、憤怒脆弱2: Cannot fall below 1 HP while Albina lives. Also clears Stagger once at Turn Start and gains 2 Wrath Fragility.
messages.出血6以上でコイン威力+1。2人のうち勝てる技を合わせ、出血をためさせない。: At 6 or more Bleed, Coin Power +1. Assign a winning skill from either Sinner and prevent Bleed from building up.
messages.出血4につきコイン威力+1、最大2。3枚の的中から次ターンの威力減少につながるた: Coin Power +1 per 4 Bleed, up to +2. Three Coins can lead to Power Down next turn, so stop it early.
messages.3枚破壊不能。勝てば80%軽減と混乱防止。HPを戻しつつ、生体材料獲得につながる: Three Unbreakable Coins. Win for 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention. Restore HP and limit hits that generate Corpus Ingredient.
messages.対象変更不可・4枚破壊不能。別々の先行攻撃で最大3回弱め、対象囚人が勝つ。自動E: Four Unbreakable Coins; cannot be redirected. Weaken it up to three times with separate early attacks, then win with the targeted Sinner. Check actual predictions rather than relying solely on automatic E.G.O debuffs.
messages.回避と同時に援護防御1を得る。自分の攻撃とNPCのマッチ線を確認し、専用反撃への: Evades while gaining 1 Assist Defense. Check your attacks and the NPC's clash lines; watch for the switch to a special Counter.
messages.援護防御専用のマッチ可能反撃。通常反撃とは区別し、出血条件の強化と実際の担当を確: A Clashable Counter used only for Assist Defense. Distinguish it from an ordinary Counter and check Bleed-based buffs and the actual clasher.
messages.[マッチ敗北]このスキルのダメージによって対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] This skill's damage cannot Stagger its target
messages.2枚破壊不能。NPCへ任せ、2名はアルビナへ集中する。: Two Unbreakable Coins. Leave it to the NPC while the two Sinners focus on Albina.
messages.出血回数と次ターンの威力減少が付く2枚破壊不能。NPCの対処を確認する。: Two Unbreakable Coins that inflict Bleed Count and next-turn Power Down. Check the NPC's response.
messages.対象変更不可・加重値6・4枚破壊不能。NPCの真鎮終斬の摘出が有効なので、囚人で: Four Unbreakable Coins, 6 Atk Weight, and no redirection. Excision on the NPC's True Decapitation Deathblow is effective, so do not force a Sinner to take over.
messages.回避・援護防御2。攻撃者の出血回数を減らさない効果もある。出血の多い囚人で不用意: Evade with 2 Assist Defense. Also prevents the attacker's Bleed Count from decreasing. Avoid careless repeated attacks from Sinners with high Bleed.
messages.援護防御専用のマッチ可能反撃。囚人の攻撃がこちらへ回る場合も、NPCと自分の対処: A Clashable Counter used only for Assist Defense. If Sinner attacks are redirected here, check both your response and the NPC's.
messages.[的中時]混乱状態にして、身体観劇にする: [On Hit] Stagger the target and turn them into Corpus Theater
messages.マッチ不可・守備発動不可。混乱と身体観劇はNPCの煙払いで救出される。強いE.G: Unclashable and prevents Defense Skills from activating. The NPC's Abate the Smoke rescues allies from Stagger and Corpus Theater. Keep attacking Albina instead of trying to clash with a powerful E.G.O.
messages.先行する別々の攻撃で大技を弱め、対象囚人へ勝てる手札を残す。: Weaken the major skill with separate early attacks and save a winning skill for its targeted Sinner.
messages.敵の援護残数と実際のマッチ先を確認する。: Check remaining enemy assistance and the actual clash target.
messages.状態異常・ターン終了時の火傷: Status effects; Burn at Turn End
messages.火傷による防御低下も使えるが、操作する2名のマッチとHPを優先する。: Burn-based Defense Level reduction is useful, but prioritize the two controllable Sinners' clashes and HP.
messages.攻撃でマイナス付与・同時にプラス獲得: Attacks that inflict a negative effect and gain a positive effect simultaneously
messages.的中が敵の精神力と次ターンの強化へつながる。アルビナへ勝つ。: Hits restore enemy SP and grant next-turn buffs. Win against Albina.
messages.このキャラクターは、レベルが最も低い囚人および助力者を優先して攻撃する\n\n「:
This character prioritizes the lowest-level Sinner or assistant.

“We should start by taking the weakest one's muscles and bones.”
“The materials may be insignificant, but if we keep creating and exhibiting pieces one by one, better materials should follow.”
“Aren't you excited, Fascia?”
messages.育成の遅い囚人へ被害が寄るため、2名とも育てる。: Damage concentrates on underleveled Sinners, so level both of them.
messages.精神力が戻る。パニックによる弱体化を永続効果として扱わない。: SP recovers. Do not treat Panic-based weakening as permanent.
messages.別のパニックへの変更に頼らず、各技の担当と弱体化を使う。: Use skill assignments and debuffs rather than relying on a different Panic Type.
messages.ターン終了時、生体材料(骨)が206かつ生体材料(血)が5なら、それぞれ数値だけ:
At Turn End, with 206 Corpus Ingredient (Bones) and 5 Corpus Ingredient (Blood), consume both amounts and gain 1 Artwork: Tibia.

At Turn Start with Artwork: Tibia, use a powerful attack this turn.

When damaged by an Attack Skill while preparing to use that attack, gain 1 Plus Coin Drop and 1 Power Down (up to three times per turn).

Tibia: a masterpiece carved and completed by pouring in every part of her own body.
messages.親方の大技はNPCの対処へ任せる。: Leave the Nursefather's major attack to the NPC.
messages.援護残数とマッチ線を確認してアルビナへ攻撃する。: Check assistance stacks and clash lines while attacking Albina.
messages.親方を囚人で受けず、NPCへ任せる。: Leave the Nursefather to the NPC rather than taking her attacks with Sinners.
messages.材料がこぼれ落ちる傷による攻撃Lv低下を確認する。: Check Offense Level Down from Ingredient-shedding Wound.
messages.火傷・振動・破裂・沈潜による体力・精神力・混乱区間の前進量-30%\n出血で受け:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
Bleed damage taken is reduced by 50%.

At Turn Start, if Staggered, clear Stagger and gain 2 Wrath Fragility (once per encounter).

At Turn End, gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4 Burn on self (max 15).

The masterpiece the Fingers have awaited so eagerly—the very reason for the Spiderweb's existence—seems close to completion. The Golden Bough is intriguing, but it was never actually necessary to complete the piece. I still cannot understand why it was taken at the cost of making an enemy of Limbus Company... Yet with the result assured, this disorderly process must be accepted. These circumstances were desired by Lian... no, by the god that man worships. Is receiving all the love of a being called a god a blessing, or a curse? Hehe.
messages.混乱は1回解除される。混乱だけを頼りに囚人で親方へ集中しない。: Stagger is cleared once. Do not focus Sinner attacks on the Nursefather relying solely on Stagger.
messages.攻撃スキル的中時、マイナス効果を付与して同時にプラス効果を得たなら、攻撃終了時に:
On an Attack Skill hit, if the user inflicts a negative effect and gains a positive effect simultaneously, heal 4 SP at Attack End.
- If this recovery occurs at max SP, gain 1 Power Up next turn (once per turn).
messages.敵の精神力と次ターン強化が戻るため、基礎値だけでマッチを判断しない。: Enemy SP and next-turn buffs return, so do not judge clashes from base values alone.
messages.良い素材は良い肉体から: Healthy Corpus Leads to Healthy Ingredient
messages.このキャラクターは、レベルが最も高い囚人および助力者への与ダメージ量が150%増:
This character prioritizes the highest-level Sinner or assistant and deals 150% more damage to them.

“But once your artistic senses have matured enough, you should first seek out the finest body.”
“Flesh and bone fragments cut from a quality body provide the foundation for a work on a grander scale.”
“Aren't you excited, Albina?”
messages.その対象へのダメージ+150%。親方のマッチはNPCへ任せる。: Damage +150% against that target. Leave the Nursefather's clashes to the NPC.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-42「ルチオ・ヴァレンチーナ（9-4: Lucio & Valencina (9-42) guide for Limbus Company 9-42. Lower Lucio to half HP in the opening battle to bring Vergilius in. In the second half, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before defeating Lucio. Adjust NPC targets to weaken “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected.
messages.前哨戦のルチオを半分まで削るとヴェルギリウスが参戦する。後半は親方の予知眼を先に: Lower Lucio to half HP in the opening battle to bring Vergilius in. In the second half, reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition before defeating Lucio. Adjust NPC targets to weaken “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected.
messages.ヒースクリフ・ロージャ・グレゴールの3名固定。ルチオは最大HP1588の20%を: Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor are required. Lucio starts missing 20% of his 1,588 max HP. Reinforcements arrive at 794 HP; Valencina enters with 3,204 HP, 30 SP, 30 Eye of Precognition, and 10 Acceleration Round. Her ending event triggers at 320 HP. Treat Eye-based evasion and acceleration, and NPC Shields, as changing battle effects.
messages.ルチオの大技より先に他の攻撃へ勝ち、威力と加重値を下げる。: Win other clashes before Lucio's major attack to lower its Power and Atk Weight.
messages.増援後はヴェルギリウスを親方へ回し、予知眼を減らす。: After reinforcements arrive, direct Vergilius toward the Nursefather to reduce Eye of Precognition.
messages.予知眼を残したままルチオを倒して処分へ進めない。: Do not defeat Lucio and trigger “Disposal” while Eye of Precognition remains high.
messages.ルチオをすぐ倒したら全滅する: Defeating Lucio immediately leads to a wipe
messages.ルチオ戦闘不能で狩りの時間へ進み、予知眼依存の処分が来る。先にNPCで予知眼を減: Incapacitating Lucio activates Time to Hunt and brings “Disposal”, which scales with Eye of Precognition. Have the NPC reduce the Eye before making this transition.
messages.ルチオの優先マッチと援護防御に引かれている。囚人がそのマッチを引き取り、NPCの: Lucio draws him in through priority clashes and Assist Defense. Have Sinners take over those clashes, then check that the NPC has switched to the Nursefather's dangerous skills.
messages.バリアがあるのに一撃で崩される: A single hit breaks through the Shield
messages.火傷と加速弾でバリアへのダメージが大きく増える。600のバリアは無敵ではない。強: Burn and Acceleration Round greatly increase damage against Shields. A 600 Shield is not invincibility. Leave strong skills to the NPC and use healing and clashes.
messages.予知眼が高いと回避の基礎威力も増える。NPCの多いマッチ判定で過負荷を進め、弱い: High Eye of Precognition raises Evade Base Power. Use the NPC's many clash rolls to trigger Overloaded; do not invite retaliation by feeding it weak attacks it can evade entirely.
messages.胴体・前半から継続: Body · Continues from the first half
messages.3ターンの威力減少2。9-3と同じ開始状態ではない。: Has 2 Power Down for three turns. This differs from the starting state in 9-3.
messages.HP794の次の段階で親方と助力者が参戦し、混乱から即復帰する。: At the next phase after reaching 794 HP, the Nursefather and assistant enter, and Lucio immediately recovers from Stagger.
messages.親方参戦後は援護防御3とNPC優先マッチで妨害。戦闘不能になると処分の段階へ進む: After the Nursefather enters, interferes with 3 Assist Defense and priority clashes against the NPC. Incapacitating him starts the “Disposal” phase.
messages.予知眼30・加速弾10・精神力30で参戦。予知眼は開始時に10回復し、過負荷で減: Enters with 30 Eye of Precognition, 10 Acceleration Round, and 30 SP. The Eye recovers 10 at Turn Start and decreases through Overloaded.
messages.ルチオ戦闘不能後は狩りの標的へ集中し、処分を使う。: After Lucio is incapacitated, focuses on the Game Target and uses “Disposal”.
messages.HP320で終了イベント。HP0まで削る戦闘ではない。: The ending event triggers at 320 HP. You do not need to reduce HP to 0.
messages.固定3人と共有アンプルを守る準備: Protect the three required Sinners and shared Ampules
messages.推奨Lv60。ヒースクリフ・ロージャ・グレゴールを育て、斬撃・火傷・振動への耐性: Recommended Lv. 60. Level Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor, and bring resistance to Slash, Burn, and Tremor, plus HP/SP recovery.
messages.非常用K社アンプル4は囚人全員で共有。前哨戦で消費しすぎず、後半の事故への余裕を: The Sinners share four K Corp. Emergency Ampule uses. Avoid spending too many in the opening battle; save a buffer for later accidents.
messages.ヴェルギリウスは途中参戦し、死亡すると敗北。LCD組とは異なり援護防御で全員を庇: Vergilius joins mid-battle; you lose if he dies. Unlike the LCD team, he does not use Assist Defense to cover everyone.
messages.他のマッチを先に勝って大技を弱める: Win the other clashes first to weaken the major attack
messages.初手からセッチォナトゥラ・デル・チェルヴォがある。対象変更不可なので、狙われた囚: “Sezionatura di Cervo” appears from the opening turn. It cannot be redirected, so the targeted Sinner must handle it.
messages.他の攻撃へ先にマッチ勝利するたび、大技の最終威力−2・加重値−1、最低1まで減る: Each earlier clash win against another attack lowers the major skill's Final Power by 2 and Atk Weight by 1, to a minimum of 1. Check action order so other slots resolve before its clasher acts.
messages.同じ囚人でルチオと連続してマッチすると決闘高潮が増える。担当を替えながらHP79: Repeated clashes between Lucio and the same Sinner build The Duel Escalates. Rotate clashers while lowering him to 794 HP to bring in reinforcements.
messages.NPCを親方へ向け、予知眼を先に減らす: Direct the NPC toward the Nursefather and reduce the Eye first
messages.ルチオはNPCとの優先マッチと援護防御で妨害する。囚人がルチオや弱い技のマッチを: Lucio interferes through priority clashes with the NPC and Assist Defense. When Sinners take over clashes against Lucio or weaker skills, The Guide changes the NPC's targets. Check that he actually handles the Nursefather's dangerous skills.
messages.この段階でルチオを倒し切ることだけを優先しない。親方の予知眼をNPCで削り、処分: Do not focus only on finishing Lucio at this stage. Have the NPC reduce the Nursefather's Eye of Precognition so you can handle “Disposal” when it appears.
messages.ヴェルギリウスのバリア600は保険。火傷・加速弾のバリア特効で抜かれることがある: Vergilius's 600 Shield is insurance. Burn and Acceleration Round can break through it, so have Sinners stop remaining regular skills and keep healing.
messages.予知眼が高い間: While Eye of Precognition is high
messages.過負荷で削り、回避の強化を下げる: Reduce it through Overloaded to weaken Evade
messages.予知眼は1につき処分の基本威力とダメージを増やす。高いままの30で受けると、勝っ: Each Eye stack raises “Disposal”'s Base Power and damage. Taking it with all 30 remaining is dangerous even after a clash win.
messages.マッチで加速する未来が上限に達すると、その後のマッチ判定ごとに予知眼が1減る。一: Once clashes fill Accelerating Future to its cap, each further clash roll reduces the Eye by 1. It also loses 1 when attacked unopposed and 3 on a clash loss. Use the NPC's many clashes.
messages.予知眼があると回避を追加発動する。全コインを避けられると一方攻撃が返るため、弱い: With the Eye active, an additional Evade triggers. Evading every Coin leads to an unopposed retaliation, so do not pile on weak attacks. If possible, help reduce it with high-Power skills or Counters.
messages.0になると過熱状態へ変わるが、開始時に数値が増え、30で予知眼へ戻る。永続的に回: At 0, it changes to Overheat. However, it gains stacks at Turn Start and returns to Eye of Precognition at 30. Evade is not permanently removed.
messages.狩りの標的が速度1になり、対象変更不可の処分が向かう。別の囚人で強引に引き取るこ: The Game Target has Speed 1 and is targeted by “Disposal”, which cannot be redirected. Another Sinner cannot forcibly take it over.
messages.処分ターンの親方も速度1。ほかの技とのマッチを先に進め、予知眼をできるだけ減らし: The Nursefather also has Speed 1 on “Disposal” turns. Resolve clashes against her other skills first to reduce the Eye as much as possible, then have the target use a strong skill. Heal the target beforehand.
messages.勝利時の半減とクリティカル禁止があっても、5枚破壊不能・火傷・振動爆発は残る。標: Even a clash win's halved damage and disabled critical hits leave five Unbreakable Coins, Burn, and Tremor Bursts. If the target dies, another Game Target appears next turn; avoid a chain of casualties.
messages.NPCの火力と支援を維持し、親方HP320の終了イベントまで進める。: Maintain NPC damage and support until the Nursefather's ending event at 320 HP.
messages.対象の振動が6以上なら、マッチ威力+1: If the target has 6 or more Tremor, Clash Power +1
messages.振動6以上でマッチが強くなる。決闘高潮を同じ囚人にためないよう担当を替え、先に勝: Gains Clash Power against targets with at least 6 Tremor. Rotate clashers to avoid building The Duel Escalates on one Sinner, and win early to weaken the major attack.

messages.対象の火傷と振動の合計4につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): Coin Power +1 per 4 combined Burn and Tremor on the target (max 2)

messages.火傷・振動・呼吸で強化される3枚技。予知眼を減らす過程でも、こちらのHPと振動を: A three-Coin skill strengthened by Burn, Tremor, and Poise. While reducing the Eye, still check your HP and Tremor when assigning its clasher.
messages.[マッチ敗北]最終ダメージ量が50%だけ減少し、クリティカルが発動しない: [Clash Lose] Final damage −50%; cannot trigger critical hits
messages.このスキルのダメージにより、対象が混乱しない: This skill's damage cannot Stagger its target
messages.[的中時]2回振動爆発。対象の振動回数が2減少: [On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst twice; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 2
messages.[クリティカル的中時]2回振動爆発。対象の振動回数が2減少: [On Crit] Trigger Tremor Burst twice; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 2
messages.4枚破壊不能。勝利で最終ダメージ半減・クリティカル禁止を得るが、火傷・振動爆発は: Four Unbreakable Coins. Winning halves final damage and prevents critical hits, but Burn and Tremor Bursts remain. Use advance healing and NPC assignments.
messages.予知眼数値1につき、基本威力+1,ダメージ量+10%: Base Power +1 and damage +10% per Eye of Precognition stack
messages.[使用時]対象の現体力が50%以下なら、ダメージ量+100%: [On Use] If the target's current HP is at 50% or less, damage +100%
messages.このスキルのダメージによって対象が混乱しない: The target cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage
messages.[敵討伐時]次のターン開始時ランダムな囚人1名へ狩りの標的を付与: [On Kill] At the start of the next turn, apply Game Target to one random Sinner
messages.対象変更不可・5枚破壊不能。予知眼1につき基本威力+1・ダメージ+10%。ルチオ: Five Unbreakable Coins; cannot be redirected. Each Eye stack grants +1 Base Power and +10% damage. Start reducing the Eye before defeating Lucio, then resolve the other skills first on this turn too. Heal the target beforehand.
messages.スキルの全コインに回避成功したとき、攻撃した対象へ「セッチォナトゥラ・デル・コニ: After successfully evading every Coin of a skill, use “Sezionatura di Coniglio” for an unopposed attack against the attacker
messages.[使用時]予知眼数値2につき、基本威力+1: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 2 Eye of Precognition stacks
messages.[回避成功時]精神力を2回復(1ターンにつき5回): [On Evade] Heal 2 SP (up to 5 times per turn)
messages.予知眼30なら基本+15で最大28、さらに強化条件もある。全コインを避けられると: At 30 Eye stacks, gains +15 Base Power for a maximum of 28, with further conditional buffs possible. Evading every Coin leads to an unopposed retaliation, so use the NPC rather than piling on weak attacks.
messages.体力最大値の20%が減少した状態で戦闘を開始\nステージ開始時、3ターンの間威力:
Starts the battle missing 20% of max HP.
At Stage Start, gain 2 Power Down for three turns.
Fighting a Color will surely have made him stronger—if he survives to learn from the experience.
messages.ルチオは最大HPの20%を失い、3ターン威力減少2。前哨戦で共有アンプルを使いす: Lucio starts missing 20% of max HP and has 2 Power Down for three turns. Avoid spending too many shared Ampules in the opening battle.
messages.決闘高潮数値によって下記の効果を得る(重複して適用)\n- 数値1につき、付与さ:
Gain the following effects according to The Duel Escalates (effects stack):
- Deal and take 10% more damage against its target per stack.
- At 3 or more, gain +1 Clash Power against that target.
- At 5 or more, gain +1 Base Power when clashing with that target.
- At 7 or more, gain +1 Coin Power when clashing with that target.
- At 10 or more, gain +1 Final Power when clashing with that target.
messages.同じ担当とマッチを続けるほど危険になる。担当を交代し、1ターン対戦しないと消える: Repeated clashes against the same Sinner become increasingly dangerous. Rotate assignments and use its expiry at the end of a turn without a clash against him.
messages.ランダムな的1名を指定し、速度を1にして全スキルのターゲットに指定する\n以降、:
Choose one random target, set their Speed to 1, and target them with every skill.
Activates again every four turns afterward.
messages.標的指定・以後4ターンごと: Target selection; every four turns thereafter
messages.速度1の囚人へ集中する。強攻撃の対象変更不可と、ほかの技を引き取れる場面を区別す: Focuses on a Speed 1 Sinner. Distinguish the major attack that cannot be redirected from other skills whose targets can be changed.
messages.マッチ終了時、マッチを進行した対象へ決闘高潮1を付与\n決闘高潮を持つ対象とマッ:
At Clash End, inflict 1 The Duel Escalates on the clasher.
When clashing with a target with The Duel Escalates, heal 2 SP per stack on the target (max 10).
messages.ルチオとのマッチ終了: End of a clash with Lucio
messages.決闘高潮が増え、敵の精神力回復にもつながる。同じ囚人の連続担当を避ける。: Builds The Duel Escalates and restores enemy SP. Avoid assigning the same Sinner repeatedly.
messages.自分のスキル効果で振動爆発が発動したなら、次のターンに攻撃レベル増加2を得る(1: When the user's skill effects trigger Tremor Burst, gain 2 Offense Level Up next turn (up to three times per turn)
messages.次ターンの攻撃Lvが上がる。火傷・振動をためた味方を回復し、必要なマッチを取る。: Raises next-turn Offense Level. Heal allies with accumulated Burn and Tremor and take the necessary clashes.
messages.親指の親方が出現してからパッシブ「狩りの印」を使用せず、下記の効果が追加される\:
After the Thumb Nursefather appears, stop using Hunter's Mark and add the following effects:
- If SP is below 30, restore it to 30.
- At Turn Start, gain 3 Assist Defense.
- Can clash regardless of Speed.
- Prioritize clashes with Vergilius.
- When the Thumb Nursefather wins a clash, use “Colpi Sottani” for an unopposed attack at the end of that attack (twice per turn).
“Could I kill her now?”

Watching his sleeping teacher, Lucio always returned to that thought. Fear ingrained in him, and gratitude toward the person who had taken him out of the Backstreets, kept him from acting. Yet his resentment ran deep. Even as he promised heartfelt obedience, he swore to kill her after this battle—to cut and stab even her remaining eye. For the first time, life began to return to the eyes of the bruised boy.
messages.ルチオは援護防御3とNPC優先マッチで妨害する。囚人が引き取り、NPCを親方へ回: Lucio interferes with 3 Assist Defense and priority clashes against the NPC. Have Sinners take over so the NPC can handle the Nursefather. Do not prioritize an immediate kill.
messages.精神力0へ戻る。パニック継続だけで止める前提にはしない。: SP returns to 0. Do not assume sustained Panic alone will stop the enemy.
messages.パニックの置き換えで敵の強い行動を止める戦法にはしない。: Do not rely on replacing Panic Type to disable powerful actions.
messages.ステージに登場時、予知眼30を得る\n予知眼数値が0になると、予知眼が予知眼 加:
On entering the stage, gain 30 Eye of Precognition.
At 0 stacks, Eye of Precognition changes to Eye of Precognition - Overheat.
The relic called Odin's Eye is actually one fragment of another relic split into three.
messages.30から減らし、0で過熱状態へ変える。処分前に減らすことが重要。: Reduce it from 30 to 0 to enter Overheat. Lowering it before “Disposal” is essential.
messages.マッチ進行時、マッチごとに自分へ加速する未来1を付与\n加速する未来はターンごと:
Gain 1 Accelerating Future per clash.
Each turn, it can be gained up to (Eye of Precognition at Turn Start ÷ 3).
With Eye of Precognition active, being attacked unopposed or losing a clash activates “Precognition”.
“With every exchange this blade will heat up and keep accelerating until I reach the future I saw.”
messages.マッチごと・一方攻撃やマッチ敗北時の回避: Each clash; Evade on unopposed attacks or clash losses
messages.マッチを進めるほど敵も加速する。上限後はさらにマッチを重ねることで予知眼を削れる: The enemy accelerates as clashes continue. After reaching the cap, further clash rolls reduce the Eye.
messages.下記の条件によって予知眼が減少\n- 加速する未来を得られなければ、マッチ一発ご:
Reduce Eye of Precognition under these conditions:
- If Accelerating Future cannot be gained, lose 1 Eye per clash roll.
- When attacked unopposed, lose 1 Eye.
- On Clash Lose, lose 3 Eye.
“My eye throbs with pain and heat, and my vision turns red.”
messages.加速上限後のマッチ・一方攻撃・マッチ敗北: Clashes after the acceleration cap; unopposed attacks; clash losses
messages.予知眼を減らす本体の仕組み。NPCの多数のマッチを活用し、囚人の弱い攻撃だけを連: The main mechanism for reducing the Eye. Use the NPC's many clashes rather than repeatedly using only weak Sinner attacks.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜による体力・精神力・混乱区間の前進量-30%\n加速:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
With at least 1 Acceleration Round, skills that consume rounds deal 30% more damage and 150% more damage to Shields.
Gain 4 Poise per 4 rounds consumed.
Coins that consume rounds still attack when no rounds remain.
“You were taught Palermo and even inherited a family heirloom, yet you disgrace yourself like this.”
“We will not reclaim your inherited relic and sword; your dishonor has already stained them.”
“Valencina, surely no one else has been dismissed just three days after becoming Underboss.”
“You are a disgrace to the famiglia. Bognatelli withdraws its love from you.”
messages.弾があるとバリアへのダメージが大きく増える。弾切れでも攻撃そのものは続く。: Rounds greatly increase damage against Shields. Running out does not cancel the attack itself.
messages.メインターゲットの火傷1につき、バリアへの与ダメージ量が15%増加(最大300%:
Damage to Shields +15% per Burn on the main target (max 300%).
On Skill Use, if the target's Attack Skill is Slash or Pierce, Clash Power +1.
When the user's skill effects trigger Tremor Burst, gain 2 Damage Up next turn (up to three times per turn).
When the user's skill effects trigger a critical hit, heal 5 SP.
messages.対象の火傷・斬撃／貫通とのマッチ: Target's Burn; clashes against Slash or Pierce
messages.火傷でバリアへの被害が増える。こちらの攻撃タイプでも敵のマッチが強くなるため予測: Burn increases damage against Shields. Your attack type can also improve the enemy's clashes, so check predictions.
messages.被ダメージ時、もしくは「親指の子方 - ルチオ」が戦闘不能になったなら、次のター:
When damaged, or when The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio is incapacitated, gain Shin (心) - Valencina next turn.
“Phew... So I just slip in and raise hell like that fanatic planned... Will that really get my ticket back?”
messages.次ターンの強化を見込む。ルチオを倒した後も同じ行動・威力のままではない。: Expect buffs next turn. Actions and Power do not remain unchanged after Lucio falls.
messages.「親指の子方 - ルチオ」が戦闘不能になったなら、パッシブ「狩りの時間」が発動: When The Thumb Apprentice - Lucio is incapacitated, activate Time to Hunt
messages.狩りの時間へ進む。予知眼を十分減らしてから移行する。: Starts Time to Hunt. Reduce the Eye sufficiently before making this transition.
messages.ターン開始時、混乱状態なら混乱を解除\n\nランダムな囚人1名を指定し、狩りの標:
At Turn Start, clear Stagger if Staggered.

Choose one random Sinner and apply Game Target.
- Activates once every four turns afterward.
- Activates again next turn if “Disposal” kills its target.
Palermo swordsmanship embodies Famiglia Bognatelli's temperament: relentlessly pursue, hunt, and dismember a single quarry. It rejects stealth, killing openly before witnesses with honor and dignity. Its elegant swordsmanship brought many honors and raised Bognatelli into the Seven Great Famiglie of the Backstreets. Valencina mastered Palermo, beheaded many officers and veteran soldiers in the Smoke War, and became one of its heroes. Yet who could have foreseen that this fame would become her shackle?
messages.発動時・4ターンごと・処分による討伐後: On activation; every four turns; after a “Disposal” kill
messages.対象が倒れると次ターンも標的を作る。予知眼を残したまま連続処分へ入らせない。: A target's death creates another target next turn. Do not allow repeated “Disposal” attacks while the Eye remains high.
messages.この戦闘の囚人は4を共有。本人ごとの独立した回数として数えない。: The Sinners share four uses in this battle. These are not separate counts per Sinner.
messages.最大20。ルチオとのマッチ終了で増え、対象への威力・与被ダメージを強化する。対戦: Maximum 20. Increases after clashes with Lucio and strengthens Power and damage dealt/taken against its target. Expires at the end of a turn without a clash against him.
messages.同じ囚人に蓄積を集中させず、担当を替える。: Rotate assignments instead of concentrating stacks on one Sinner.
messages.最大30、マッチ威力+2。開始時に10増え、数値÷4の精神力を回復。回避や処分の: Maximum 30; Clash Power +2. At Turn Start, gain 10 stacks and heal SP equal to stacks ÷ 4. Strengthens Evade and “Disposal”.
messages.ルチオを倒す前に減らし、処分直前にも他のマッチを先に処理する。: Reduce it before defeating Lucio, and resolve other clashes first immediately before “Disposal” too.
messages.予知眼0で移行する過熱状態。攻撃ダメージ−20%。加速弾を消費する技の全コインを: The Overheat state entered at 0 Eye. Attack damage −20%. Converts all Coins of skills that consume Acceleration Round to Unbreakable Coins. Gains 10 stacks at Turn Start and returns to Eye of Precognition at 30.
messages.弱まる面と破壊不能化の両方がある。状態名の加熱・過熱の表記差より、実際の効果を確: Both weakening and Unbreakable conversion apply. Check the actual effects rather than focusing on variations in the translated Overheat label.
messages.最大10。1につきマッチ威力+1、5につきコイン威力+1。ターンの獲得上限は開始: Maximum 10. Clash Power +1 per stack; Coin Power +1 per 5 stacks. The gain cap each turn is Eye of Precognition at Turn Start ÷ 3.
messages.上限後のマッチ判定で過負荷が進む。序盤の予測だけで最後まで判断しない。: After the cap, clash rolls trigger Overloaded. Do not use an opening prediction to judge the entire turn.
messages.最大10。特定コインで消費する弾。弾があれば対象技のダメージ+30%、バリアへの: Maximum 10. Rounds consumed by specific Coins. While available, affected skills deal 30% more damage and 150% more damage to Shields.
messages.弾切れでも攻撃自体は続く。バリアだけで防ごうとしない。: Running out does not stop attacks. Do not rely solely on Shields.
messages.速度1固定でヴァレンチーナの全攻撃から狙われる。: Speed fixed at 1; targeted by all of Valencina's attacks.
messages.対象変更不可の処分は標的本人の技と事前回復を用意する。: “Disposal” cannot be redirected. Prepare the marked Sinner's own skill and heal them beforehand.
messages.囚人の指定に応じてヴェルギリウスの攻撃対象が変わる。: Vergilius's attack targets change according to Sinner assignments.
messages.NPCが受け持つ弱い技を囚人で引き取り、親方の危険技へNPCが回ったかを確認する: Have Sinners take over weaker skills assigned to the NPC, then check that he switches to the Nursefather's dangerous skills.
messages.ルチオを早く倒すほどよい戦闘ではない。予知眼を十分減らしてから処分の段階へ進む。: Defeating Lucio sooner is not always better. Reduce the Eye sufficiently before entering the “Disposal” phase.
messages.ヴェルギリウスはLCD組のような援護防御担当ではない。バリアと攻撃先の調整を使う: Vergilius does not provide Assist Defense like the LCD team. Use his Shields and adjust his attack targets.
messages.処分は対象変更不可。予知眼が高いまま受ければ、マッチ勝利でも危険。: “Disposal” cannot be redirected. With high Eye stacks, it is dangerous even after a clash win.
messages.予知で全コインを避けられると反撃が返る。弱い攻撃だけを連打しない。: If “Precognition” evades every Coin, it retaliates. Do not repeatedly feed it only weak attacks.
messages.過熱状態では加速弾の技が条件付きで破壊不能になる。弾切れも攻撃中止ではない。: Overheat conditionally makes round-consuming skills Unbreakable. Running out of rounds does not cancel attacks either.
messages.鏡の隠しボスの耐性・火力・ルチオ処理順を通常9-42へ混ぜない。: Do not apply the hidden Mirror Dungeon boss's resistances, damage, or Lucio kill order to normal 9-42.
messages.推奨Lv60、ヒースクリフ・ロージャ・グレゴール固定。斬撃への耐性、HP・精神力: Recommended Lv. 60 with Heathcliff, Rodion, and Gregor. Bring Slash resistance, HP/SP recovery, and high-Power skills.
messages.ルチオには斬撃、親方にも斬撃が通りやすい。属性より先にNPCの担当と予知眼の処理: Slash works well against both Lucio and the Nursefather. Prioritize NPC assignments and Eye management before affinity.
messages.前半の大技を弱め、後半はNPCを親方へ回す。: Weaken his opening major attack, then direct the NPC toward the Nursefather in the second half.
messages.NPCのマッチと過負荷を使い、処分を弱める。: Use NPC clashes and Overloaded to weaken “Disposal”.
messages.標的の回復と強いマッチ: Heal the target and prepare a strong clash
messages.対象変更不可の処分を受け切り、連続する標的生成を防ぐ。: Survive “Disposal” without redirection and prevent repeated target generation.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-41「塩見ヨル（9-41）」の攻略。: Shiomi Yoru (9-41) guide for Limbus Company 9-41. Have the fastest Sinner beat Silent Regard to weaken the enemy, while each marked Sinner stops “Destinated Opponent”. Reduce Meursault and Outis's Bladetrail, deplete each stage's Shield, and finish by reaching half HP.
messages.良秀・ムルソー・ウーティス固定。ムルソー・ウーティスはアンプル3回分を共有し、良: Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis are required. Meursault and Outis share three Ampule uses; Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. The enemy starts with 30 SP, 2 Shin (心) - Dihui Star, 1,600 Disjunction, and Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement. Base Speed is 2–5, before the Fourfold modifier. The battle ends at 959 HP.
messages.観望を先に処理し、後のマッチを弱める。: Handle Silent Regard first to weaken later clashes.
messages.確定された相手は印の付いた本人が攻撃で止める。: The marked Sinner must stop “Destinated Opponent” with an Attack Skill.
messages.ムルソー・ウーティスの剣痕とHPを守り、バリアを順に削る。: Protect Meursault and Outis's HP, reduce their Bladetrail, and deplete each Shield in turn.
messages.指定された攻撃へ別の囚人でマッチできない: Another Sinner cannot clash with the designated attack
messages.確定された相手は、対応する鶏鳴・日入・黄昏を持つ囚人だけがマッチできる。守備も発: Only the Sinner with the corresponding Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow can clash with “Destinated Opponent”. Defense Skills cannot activate either, so prepare an Attack Skill for the marked Sinner.
messages.3ターン周期の広域で大きく削られる: The area attack every three turns deals heavy damage
messages.残痕斬の前に確定された相手へ勝って印を消す。印が残った囚人はコイン最終威力×5の: Win against “Destinated Opponent” to remove marks before Scartrail Slash. Marked Sinners take additional damage equal to five times the Coin's Final Power. Have a slow Sinner handle the area attack so marks and Silent Regard resolve first.
messages.バリアを割っても終わらない: Breaking the Shield does not end the battle
messages.9-33と異なり、バリア1600を1回割るだけでは終わらない。残像もつれの段階ご: Unlike 9-33, breaking the initial 1,600 Shield is not enough. Deplete the Shield at each Afterimage Entanglement stage, then lower HP to 959. Surviving 11 turns is not an ending condition here.
messages.固定3名を育て、序盤のマッチを安定させる: Level the three required Sinners and stabilize early clashes
messages.推奨Lv60。良秀・ムルソー・ウーティスの3名。援護するNPCはいないため、斬撃: Recommended Lv. 60 with Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis. No NPCs provide assistance, so bring Slash resistance, healing, and strong clashes for each Sinner.
messages.良秀はほかの味方生存中なら死亡しない。快閃・無形斬など残る被害が重い技を、勝てる: Ryōshū cannot die while another ally lives. Where she can win, assign her Swift Glimmer, Formless Cut, and other skills with heavy damage remaining after a clash.
messages.序盤が安定しないなら初手のMOROSITASを検討する。ムルソー・ウーティスの共: If the opening is unstable, consider MOROSITAS on the first turn. Avoid spending all three Ampule uses shared by Meursault and Outis in the opening turns.
messages.速い囚人から観望へ勝ち、残りを弱める: Win against Silent Regard early with a fast Sinner
messages.観望への勝利で敵へ攻撃威力減少2、担当囚人の精神力5回復。速い囚人の先行マッチで: Winning against Silent Regard gives the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restores 5 SP to its clasher. Use a fast Sinner to apply the debuff before later powerful attacks.
messages.印の付いた囚人は確定された相手の担当も必要。観望へ枠を使い切らず、指定攻撃と広域: Marked Sinners also need to handle “Destinated Opponent”. Do not spend all their slots on Silent Regard; save skills for designated attacks and area attacks.
messages.快閃は勝つと加重値3から1へ減る。無形斬は勝つと80%軽減とその技の混乱防止。良: Winning against Swift Glimmer reduces its Atk Weight from 3 to 1. Winning against Formless Cut grants 80% damage reduction and prevents Stagger from that skill. Use Ryōshū's winning skills to limit damage.
messages.本人が印を消してから広域を受ける: Have each marked Sinner remove their mark before the area attack
messages.鶏鳴・日入・黄昏を確認し、対応する本人の攻撃で確定された相手へ勝つ。守備では発動: Check Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, and Eventide Glow, then have the corresponding Sinner beat “Destinated Opponent” with an attack. Defense Skills cannot activate; leaving it unopposed also gives the enemy +10 Final Power.
messages.勝利で印が消え、敵へ固定ダメージも入る。複数の指定技があるターンは、良秀以外の印: A clash win removes the mark and deals fixed damage to the enemy. When several designated attacks appear, remove the marks on Sinners other than Ryōshū too.
messages.3ターン周期の残痕斬は印持ちへ大きな追加ダメージ。遅い囚人が広域のマッチを取り、: Scartrail Slash appears every three turns and deals heavy extra damage to marked targets. Have a slow Sinner clash with it so Silent Regard and mark removal resolve first.
messages.広域へ勝てなさそうなら守備を用意し、守備を使った相手への最終ダメージ半減や、残痕: If winning against the area attack looks unlikely, prepare Defense Skills. Use the passive that halves final damage against targets using defense and Scartrail Slash's reduction based on equipped Defense Skills. “Destinated Opponent” and Deathedge preventing defense are separate exceptions.
messages.バリアを削り、残像歩で剣痕を減らす: Deplete Shields and reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step
messages.乖離のバリアを削ると残像段階が1つ下がり、次の段階で新しいバリアを得る。残像4・: Depleting the Disjunction Shield lowers the Afterimage stage by one and grants a new Shield at the next stage. After breaking it at stages 4 and 3, use the next turn's Stagger to attack.
messages.残像3から残像歩が加わる。ムルソー・ウーティスへ勝利を回し、剣痕を半減させる。ア: Phantom Step joins the pattern at stage 3. Let Meursault and Outis win against it to halve Bladetrail. Even with Ampule revivals available, do not neglect Bladetrail damage.
messages.敵は状態異常のHP・精神力・混乱区間前進を30%軽減する。憤怒・憂鬱・斬撃の直接: The enemy reduces HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from statuses by 30%. Combine direct Wrath, Gloom, and Slash damage with early Silent Regard debuffs.
messages.絶縁の前に剣痕を減らし、自動E.G.Oを利用する: Reduce Bladetrail before String Severance and use automatic E.G.O attacks
messages.極空間斬撃 - 絶縁は精神力20以上で最終威力+10。初期E.G.Oでも厳しい場: Uttermost Rend Space - String Severance gains +10 Final Power at 20 or more SP. Even base E.G.O may struggle, so reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step first and prepare healing and defense.
messages.残像1へ進んだターンにムルソーの他人の鎖、次ターンにウーティスのト・パソス・マソ: On reaching stage 1, Meursault automatically uses Chains of Others at maximum Speed; Outis uses To Páthos Máthos the next turn. These are separate from manual uses that spend your SP and resources.
messages.絶命は良秀以外の低HPを狙い、守備が発動しない。攻撃でマッチを取り、可能なら良秀: Deathedge prioritizes low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Clash with an Attack Skill and redirect it to Ryōshū if possible. Concentrating too many hits on her can cause Bind to complicate next-turn assignments.
messages.残りのバリアを削った後、HP959まで進める。良秀だけの生存で十分とは考えず、ほ: After depleting the remaining Shields, lower HP to 959. Ryōshū surviving alone is not enough; manage the other two Sinners' HP and shared Ampules too.
messages.良秀の効果。親方への与・被ダメージ+20%、マッチ勝利で親方の精神力−5。混乱を: Ryōshū's effect. Deals and takes 20% more damage against the Nursefather; clash wins lower his SP by 5. Prevents Stagger, removes Stagger Thresholds, and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Cannot retreat.
messages.良秀で危険技へ勝つ。ほかの囚人が生存している間の死亡防止も使う。: Have Ryōshū beat dangerous skills. Use her protection from death while other Sinners remain alive.
messages.ムルソー・ウーティスで3回分を共有。ほかの味方生存中の致死ダメージで、混乱解除・: Meursault and Outis share three uses. On lethal damage while another ally lives, clear Stagger and fully restore HP, reducing every ally's remaining count by 1.
messages.2人それぞれ3回ではない。良秀以外のHPと剣痕を管理する。: This is not three uses each. Manage HP and Bladetrail on Sinners other than Ryōshū.
messages.数値分のバリアをターン開始時に得て、バリアが減ると数値も減る。各残像段階の最初に: At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to its value; the value falls as the Shield is depleted. Gain (stage × 400) once at the start of each Afterimage stage.
messages.1600を1回割るだけで終了せず、段階ごとのバリアを削る。: Breaking 1,600 once does not end the battle. Deplete the Shield at every stage.
messages.4から段階が変化する専用状態。追加ダメージと行動パターンが段階で変わる。: A special status progressing from stage 4. Additional damage and action patterns change with its stage.
messages.同じ3ターン周期でも段階が変われば技構成を確認する。: Even within the same three-turn cycle, check the skill pattern after a stage change.
messages.残像4段階。速度範囲−2。的中で毒1・出血2・次ターン束縛1・火傷2を与える。: Afterimage stage 4. Speed range −2. On hit, inflict 1 Poison, 2 Bleed, 1 Bind next turn, and 2 Burn.
messages.序盤から状態異常と束縛が増える。アンプルだけへ頼らず弱体化とマッチを使う。: Statuses and Bind build up from the opening. Use debuffs and clashes rather than relying solely on Ampules.
messages.最大99。10につき次ターン脆弱1（最大5）。絶縁では全消費され、最大HP割合の: Maximum 99. Every 10 grants 1 Fragile next turn (max 5). String Severance consumes it all to deal additional max-HP-based damage.
messages.ムルソー・ウーティスを残像歩へ勝たせて半減する。: Have Meursault and Outis win against Phantom Step to halve it.
messages.ステージ内の剣痕[残像]の合計。: The combined Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the field.
messages.剣痕をためず、残像歩への勝利を回す。: Avoid accumulating Bladetrail; rotate clash wins against Phantom Step.
messages.開始時2。ターン開始時、数値1につき呼吸威力5・回数1を得る。失ったHP15%に: Starts at 2. At Turn Start, gain 5 Poise Potency and 1 Poise Count per stack. Gain 1 Slash Damage Up per 15% HP lost (max 5).
messages.後半はHPが減るほど火力も増す。残る被弾へ回復を残す。: Lower HP means more damage in the later stages. Save healing for hits that still get through.
messages.対応する確定された相手とマッチできる印。残痕斬の的中時に残っていると追加ダメージ: Marks allowing a clash with the corresponding “Destinated Opponent”. If still present when Scartrail Slash hits, take additional damage.
messages.印のある本人で確定された相手へ勝ち、広域より先に消す。: Have the marked Sinner win against “Destinated Opponent” to remove the mark before the area attack.
messages.ムルソーの基本E.G.O。残像1へ進んだターンには最速で自動使用され、資源・精神: Meursault's base E.G.O. Automatically used at maximum Speed on the turn stage 1 begins, without spending resources or SP.
messages.通常の手動使用とは分けて考え、敵の技と順番を確認する。: Treat it separately from a normal manual use and check the enemy skills and action order.
messages.ウーティスの基本E.G.O。ムルソーの自動攻撃の次ターンに最速で自動使用され、資: Outis's base E.G.O. Automatically used at maximum Speed the turn after Meursault's automatic attack, without spending resources or SP.
messages.自動支援の後も、残像歩と回復を使って残りを削る。: After the automatic support, continue depleting the enemy with Phantom Step and healing.
messages.9-33の「バリアを割るか11ターン耐久」とは終了条件が異なる。今回は段階を進め: The ending differs from 9-33's Shield break or 11-turn survival. Progress through the stages and lower HP to 959 here.
messages.良秀の死亡防止はほかの味方生存が条件。ムルソー・ウーティスが倒れても安全とは考え: Ryōshū's protection from death requires another living ally. She is not safe if Meursault and Outis both fall.
messages.確定された相手は守備発動不可。大技用の守備を用意することと、この技を守備で止める: “Destinated Opponent” prevents Defense Skills from activating. Preparing defense against major attacks does not mean defense can stop this skill.
messages.観望・残像歩の威力は9-41の表で確認できる値を掲載。別戦闘の未確定表示や天殺星: Silent Regard and Phantom Step use the Power values available in the 9-41 tables. Do not import another battle's unconfirmed values or Tiansha Star's Bladewound.
messages.固定3名を推奨Lv60まで育て、斬撃耐性とHP・精神力回復を用意する。: Level the three required Sinners to the recommended Lv. 60 and bring Slash resistance and HP/SP recovery.
messages.各人が指定技へ勝つ手段と、良秀が広域を受け持つ高威力技を残す。: Save a way for each Sinner to win their designated clash, plus strong skills for Ryōshū to handle area attacks.
messages.ほかの味方生存中の死亡防止を使い、広域や残る被弾を引き受ける。: Use her protection from death while another ally lives to take area attacks and remaining hits.
messages.先に弱体化し、後続のマッチを通す。: Apply the debuff first to help later clashes succeed.
messages.本人による印の解除: Each marked Sinner removes their own mark
messages.確定された相手へ勝ち、広域の追加ダメージを防ぐ。: Beat “Destinated Opponent” to prevent the area attack's additional damage.
messages.ムルソー・ウーティスの消耗を抑える。: Limit damage to Meursault and Outis.
messages.2〜5／四重残像もつれで範囲−2: 2–5 / Speed range −2 from Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement
messages.20%（383）／残像3・4のバリア消失後は次ターン混乱: 20% (383) / Staggered next turn after losing the Shield at stages 3 and 4
messages.初期精神力30。9-33の精神力45・出撃7名・終了条件と区別する。: Starts at 30 SP. Distinguish this from 9-33's 45 SP, seven-Sinner deployment, and ending conditions.
messages.残像段階×400の乖離を、各段階の最初に1回得る。1600・1200・800・4: Gains (Afterimage stage × 400) Disjunction once at the start of each stage. Deplete the 1,600, 1,200, 800, and 400 Shields in order.
messages.残像3・4で乖離を全て失うと、次ターン混乱する。残像2から1への移行でも同じ混乱: Losing all Disjunction at stages 3 and 4 Staggers the enemy next turn. Do not assume the transition from stage 2 to 1 causes the same Stagger.
messages.他の囚人が生存している間、良秀は死亡しない。ムルソー・ウーティスを残すことも重要: Ryōshū cannot die while another Sinner is alive. Keeping Meursault and Outis alive also matters.
messages.呼吸を増やす2枚技。先に観望へ勝って弱め、指定攻撃への手札も残す。: A two-Coin skill that gains Poise. Beat Silent Regard first to weaken it, while saving skills for designated attacks.
messages.呼吸を増やす3枚技。弱体化後の予測で通常技を合わせ、不要な集中被弾を避ける。: A three-Coin skill that gains Poise. Choose regular skills using predictions after debuffs and avoid unnecessary concentrated hits.
messages.破壊不能だが、勝つと加重値−2。良秀で勝てれば残る被害を引き受けやすい。: Unbreakable, but a clash win reduces Atk Weight by 2. If Ryōshū can win, she can take the remaining damage more safely.
messages.広域乱射・破壊不能。速度に関係なく勝って80%軽減と混乱防止を得る。可能なら良秀: An Unfocused Volley with Unbreakable Coins. Clash regardless of Speed and win for 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention. Assign Ryōshū if possible.
messages.勝つと担当囚人の剣痕が半減する。ムルソー・ウーティスを優先し、絶縁の前に処理する: Winning halves Bladetrail on its clasher. Prioritize Meursault and Outis, and resolve it before String Severance.
messages.速い囚人が先に勝ち、敵へ攻撃威力減少2、担当へ精神力5回復。後続を弱める最優先の: Have a fast Sinner win first to give the enemy 2 Attack Power Down and restore 5 SP to the clasher. The highest-priority clash for weakening later attacks.
messages.良秀以外の低HPを優先し、守備が発動しない。攻撃でマッチを取り、剣痕からの最大H: Prioritizes low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū and prevents Defense Skills from activating. Clash with an Attack Skill to prevent max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail.
messages.極空間斬撃 - 絶縁: Uttermost Rend Space - String Severance [空間斬 - 絕緣]
messages.[使用時]自分の精神力が20以上なら、望を3つ生成。最終威力+10: [On Use] If the user's SP is 20 or higher, generate 3 Mang. Final Power +10
messages.[攻撃後]このスキルで望を生成したなら、精神力-20: [After Attack] If this skill generated Mang, lose 20 SP
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が80%だけ減少し、このスキルダメージで対象が混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger its targets
messages.[的中時]対象の剣痕[残像]を全て消耗し、各被ダメージ者の体力最大値の(消耗値): [On Hit] Consume all Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the target; deal HP damage equal to (amount consumed)% of each damaged unit's max HP
messages.精神力20以上で最終威力+10。先に残像歩で剣痕を減らし、遅い担当で受ける。勝て: At 20 or more SP, gains +10 Final Power. Reduce Bladetrail through Phantom Step first and assign a slow Sinner. If winning is impossible, use defense-based reduction and advance healing.
messages.鶏鳴・日入・黄昏のうち、対応するバフを保有した対象のみマッチ可能: Only a target with the corresponding Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow buff can clash with this skill
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の鶏鳴・日入・黄昏は消滅: [Clash Lose] Remove the target's Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow
messages.対応する印のある本人だけがマッチ可能。守備では発動できないため攻撃で勝ち、残痕斬: Only the Sinner with the matching mark can clash with it. Defense Skills cannot activate; win with an attack to remove the mark before Scartrail Slash.
messages.未来を止められなかったな - 残痕斬: You Have Failed to Stop the Future - Scartrail Slash [殘痕斬]
messages.[戦闘開始時]このターンに守備スキルを装着した敵1名ごとにダメージ量減少1を得る: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Damage Down for each enemy with a Defense Skill equipped this turn (max 5)
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象に鶏鳴・日入・黄昏があるなら、(このコインの最終威力)×5の傲慢: Ⅰ [On Hit] If the target has Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow, deal Pride damage equal to (this Coin's Final Power) × 5
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。先に指定技へ勝って印を消す。印が残ると最終威力×5の追: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Beat the designated skills first to remove marks; a remaining mark causes additional damage equal to five times Final Power. Equipped Defense Skills also reduce damage without changing Power.
messages.ステージ開始時、四重残像もつれを得る\nパターンの最初のターン開始時、乖離を(残:
At Stage Start, gain Fourfold Afterimage Entanglement.
At the start of the first turn of a pattern, gain (Afterimage Entanglement stage × 400) Disjunction.
(Once per stage)

Losing all Disjunction at stages 3 and 4 changes the pattern and Staggers the user throughout the next turn.

HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 30%.
messages.段階の開始・乖離の消失: Start of a stage; loss of Disjunction
messages.バリアを順に削る。残像4・3では次ターンの混乱を使って攻撃する。: Deplete the Shields in order. At stages 4 and 3, use the following turn's Stagger to attack.
messages.特定ターンごとに、「確定された相手」スキルを使用\n攻撃対象に指定された対象のみ:
Uses “Destinated Opponent” at specific turn intervals.
Only the designated attack target can clash with the skill.

When “Destinated Opponent” loses a clash, take 36–60 fixed damage.

At Combat End, if every “Destinated Opponent” used this turn lost its clash, gain 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.印の本人で勝ち、固定ダメージと印の消失を得る。: Win with the marked Sinner to deal fixed damage and remove the mark.
messages.守備使用・4ターンごとの終了: Use of Defense Skills; end of every fourth turn
messages.勝てない広域には守備の軽減も使う。指定技の守備発動不可には適用しない。: Use defensive damage reduction against area attacks you cannot beat. It cannot solve the designated skill's prevention of Defense Skills.
messages.残像段階分の追加ダメージがある。混乱しない被害でもHPは減るため、回復する。: Deals additional damage according to the Afterimage stage. Damage that cannot Stagger still reduces HP, so heal it.
messages.追加ダメージと剣痕へ注意し、残像歩に勝って減らす。: Watch for additional damage and Bladetrail; win against Phantom Step to reduce it.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-44「キラ・マティアス（9-44）」: Kira & Matthias (9-44) guide for Limbus Company 9-44. Have the three Sinners defeat Kira and leave Matthias to the LCD team. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect Moses from every attack for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets her charge.
messages.囚人3人でキラを倒し、マティアスはLCD組へ任せる。終盤は火力勝負をやめ、モーゼ: Have the three Sinners defeat Kira and leave Matthias to the LCD team. In the final phase, stop racing for damage and protect Moses from every attack for three turns. Even with plenty of HP, a hit resets her charge.
messages.イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルのみ出撃可能。開始時の精神力は全キャラクター20、非: Only Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu can deploy. All characters start at 20 SP; every Sinner and assistant shares six K Corp. Emergency Ampule uses. Damage from 9-38 does not carry over. Tables show normal 9-44 base values, excluding NPC debuffs and enemy buffs.
messages.封印の段階で技が変わる。即決処刑スタンピング！とルール違反！は威力範囲とコイン値: Skills change with the seal stage. “Stamp of Complete and Total Extermination!” and “Rule Violation!” have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin values, so their Power is marked unconfirmed; use actual predictions. Atk Weight on ... Complete and Total Extermination varies.
messages.キラへ集中し、親方の反撃を不用意に起動しない。: Focus on Kira and avoid needlessly triggering the Nursefather's Counter.
messages.共有アンプルを温存し、LCD組の致死ダメージへ残す。: Save shared Ampules for lethal hits against the LCD team.
messages.終盤は腹をかっ開いてやるを囚人で止め、モーゼスを3ターン守る。: In the final phase, stop “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish” with a Sinner and protect Moses for three turns.
messages.終盤にいくら攻撃しても倒せない: Attacks cannot finish the final phase
messages.レーヴァテイン解放後は超根性で受けるダメージが1になる。削り続けず、モーゼスへ向: After Lævateinn is released, Ridiculous Grit reduces damage taken to 1. Stop attacking for damage and switch to intercepting attacks aimed at Moses.
messages.3ターンたっても終わらない: Three turns pass without ending the battle
messages.モーゼスの深い息 - 赤色を確認する。攻撃を通すと蓄積が戻るため、HPが十分でも: Check Moses's Deep Breath - Red. Hits reset its stacks, so do not ignore attacks even if her HP is high. If Kira remains alive, her attacks must also be intercepted.
messages.エズラかベスパが倒れて敗北する: Ezra or Vespa dies and the battle is lost
messages.NPCの死亡も敗北条件。囚人が通常反撃を無駄に受けて共有アンプルを消費していない: NPC deaths also cause defeat. Check whether unnecessary ordinary Counters against Sinners are consuming shared Ampules. Aim to save about two uses for the final phase, limiting consumption through healing and enemy debuffs.
messages.固定3名と共有アンプルの使い道を決める: Prepare the three required Sinners and plan shared Ampule use
messages.推奨Lv60。イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルの強いマッチ、HP・精神力回復を用意す: Recommended Lv. 60. Prepare strong clashes and HP/SP recovery for Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.
messages.アンプルは全員で6回分を共有する。囚人で反撃を受けて消費するより、終盤のエズラ・: Everyone shares six Ampule uses. Save them for Ezra and Vespa in the final phase rather than spending them on Sinners taking Counters. Aim to keep about two uses.
messages.腹をかっ開いてやるへ勝つE.G.Oの資源を確保する。表示の基礎威力だけでなく、敵: Save E.G.O resources to beat “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish”. Check predictions with enemy SP and buffs included, rather than judging from listed Base Power alone.
messages.LCD組に親方を任せ、キラへ集中する: Leave the Nursefather to the LCD team and focus on Kira
messages.マティアスはエズラ・ベスパへ任せる。モーゼスの支援も使い、囚人はキラのマッチと撃: Leave Matthias to Ezra and Vespa. Use Moses's support while the Sinners handle Kira's clashes and defeat her.
messages.ガチ殴りは褒められた！4以上でコインを再使用する。強い技で勝ち、通常反撃と破壊不: “Totally Badass Ass-kicking” reuses a Coin at 4 or more I Got Praised!. Win with a strong skill and heal damage left by ordinary Counters and Unbreakable Coins.
messages.NPCが援護防御を使う場面では、任せる一方攻撃へ囚人のマッチを付けず、対象囚人へ: When NPCs use Assist Defense, do not clash with the unopposed attacks left to them or equip Defense Skills on the targeted Sinner. Do not assume the same assistance is available every turn.
messages.反撃を増やさず封印解除まで進める: Progress to unsealing without adding unnecessary Counters
messages.マティアスの反撃と長兄の刺青を確認する。NPCの攻撃で削れるため、囚人の余った攻: Check Matthias's Counter and Great Brother tattoos. NPC attacks can lower his HP, so Sinners do not need to add every spare attack.
messages.封印解除の対象変更不可技はNPCの対処を確認して任せる。回復と資源を残し、囚人の: Check and preserve NPC responses to unsealing skills that cannot be redirected. Save healing and resources, and avoid spending Ampules on lethal damage to Sinners.
messages.レーヴァテイン - ここまで破んのも久々だな！の後はモーゼスがチャージを始める。: After “Lævateinn - Been a While Since I Had to Unbox the Whole Thing!”, Moses begins charging. Switch the purpose of your attacks to protecting her.
messages.モーゼスへ一発も通さず3ターン守る: Protect Moses from every hit for three turns
messages.深い息 - 赤色を3まで蓄積させる。モーゼスへの攻撃が通るとチャージが戻り、守り: Build Deep Breath - Red to 3. Any attack that reaches Moses resets the charge and forces another protection attempt. Do not ignore attacks because her HP is high.
messages.大技はエズラ・ベスパの対処を確認し、腹をかっ開いてやるを囚人の高威力E.G.Oで: Check Ezra and Vespa's responses to major skills, and assign a high-Power Sinner E.G.O to “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish”. Check targets, equipped NPC skills, and clash lines before starting combat.
messages.キラが残っているならキラのモーゼス狙いも止める。解放後1ターンたつとホンルの自動: If Kira is still alive, stop her attacks aimed at Moses too. One turn after the release, Hong Lu's automatic Land of Illusion removes Burn from all allies, but it does not replace protecting Moses.
messages.3ターン守り切るとイベントで終了。超根性を火力で突破しようとしない。: Protect her for three turns to trigger the ending event. Do not try to overpower Ridiculous Grit with damage.
messages.ほかの味方が生存中に致死ダメージを受けると、混乱解除・HP全快。全味方の残数が同: When taking lethal damage while another ally lives, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. Every ally's remaining count decreases by 1 simultaneously. Starts at 6.
messages.囚人とLCD組で共有する。終盤に必要な復活を無駄な反撃で使わない。: Shared by the Sinners and LCD team. Do not waste revivals needed later on unnecessary Counters.
messages.エズラ・ベスパが装着する支援。守備未装着の味方への一方攻撃を引き受ける。: Support equipped by Ezra and Vespa. Intercepts unopposed attacks against allies with no Defense Skills equipped.
messages.そのターンの装着を確認し、任せる攻撃へマッチや守備を付けない。: Check what is equipped that turn; do not assign clashes or Defense Skills to attacks left to assistance.
messages.モーゼスが終盤に蓄積するチャージ。3までためると決着へ進むが、攻撃を通すと蓄積が: Moses's final-phase charge. Reaching 3 leads to the finish, but attacks that hit her reset the stacks.
messages.残りHPで判断せず、毎ターンの被弾を防ぐ。: Prevent hits every turn instead of judging safety from remaining HP.
messages.ターン開始時、全キャラクターへ火傷5・火傷回数2を付与する。解放後のマティアスは: At Turn Start, inflict 5 Burn and 2 Burn Count on all characters. After the release, Matthias also gains Ridiculous Grit.
messages.味方だけでなく敵も火傷を得るが、これで親方を倒そうとせず護衛を続ける。: Enemies gain Burn as well as allies, but keep protecting Moses instead of trying to kill the Nursefather through it.
messages.状態異常も含め、受けるダメージが1に固定される。マッチ勝利で精神力回復、自分のス: Damage taken, including status damage, is fixed at 1. Clash wins restore SP; after losing SP through his own skills, he gains damage buffs next turn.
messages.通常のHP削りをやめ、モーゼスのチャージ成立を目指す。: Stop trying to deplete HP normally and complete Moses's charge.
messages.最大10。1につき攻撃Lv+1・防御Lv−2・反撃ダメージ+5%。最大時は被ダメ: Maximum 10. Per stack: Offense Level +1, Defense Level −2, Counter damage +5%. At maximum, damage taken +20%. Consumed by specific skills.
messages.被ダメージとHP境界で大技が早まる。必要なマッチと回復を残す。: Taking damage and crossing HP thresholds can bring major skills sooner. Save necessary clashes and healing.
messages.最大2。打撃・嫉妬ダメージ+10%、終了時に消滅。反撃の再使用などの条件。: Maximum 2. Blunt and Envy damage +10%; expires at Turn End. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.
messages.刺青と反撃がある親方へ不用意に攻撃しない。: Avoid careless attacks against the Nursefather while he has tattoos and a Counter.
messages.最大10。2につき基本威力+1、1につき斬撃・打撃ダメージ+5%。スキル被ダメー: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; Slash and Blunt damage +5% per stack. Lose 1 after taking skill damage twice.
messages.減らすためだけに囚人の攻撃を増やさず、NPCへ任せる。: Do not add Sinner attacks solely to lower it; leave him to the NPCs.
messages.最大10。2につき基本威力+1、1につきダメージ+8%。スキル被ダメージ2回で1: Maximum 10. Base Power +1 per 2 stacks; damage +8% per stack. Lose 1 after taking skill damage twice.
messages.ガチ殴りの再使用条件を警戒し、強いマッチで勝つ。: Watch for “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”'s reuse condition and win with strong clashes.
messages.最大3。打撃・嫉妬ダメージ+5%、終了時に消滅。反撃再使用などの条件。: Maximum 3. Blunt and Envy damage +5%; expires at Turn End. Enables effects such as Counter reuse.
messages.キラへ集中する間も担当囚人のHPを戻す。: Restore the clasher's HP while focusing on Kira.
messages.出血の威力・回数を付与する技に火傷の威力・回数が加わる。親方のレーヴァテイン解放: Skills that inflict Bleed Potency or Count also inflict Burn Potency or Count. Cannot return to OFF while the Nursefather has Lævateinn released.
messages.キラを序盤に倒し、終盤の護衛と火傷管理を軽くする。: Defeat Kira early to simplify final-phase protection and Burn management.
messages.熱線による追加の火傷がない状態。: A state without the additional Burn from Thermal Blades.
messages.褒められた！や終盤への移行でONになる。: Switches ON through I Got Praised! or the final-phase transition.
messages.キラへのマッチ勝利で的中を減らす。: Win clashes against Kira to limit hits.
messages.9-44の開始時の状態。2つ目のラッピングまで剥がすことになったか。の後は2段階: The starting state in 9-44. After “Looks Like I Gotta Unbox the Second Layer, too.”, advances to Second Seal Removed.
messages.9-38の開始時と使用技を混ぜない。: Do not mix this with 9-38's starting state or skills.
messages.レーヴァテイン解放前の段階。強化された踏み潰す！などを使用する。: The stage before Lævateinn's release. Uses enhanced skills such as “Stomping!”.
messages.解除技の後に護衛へ切り替える。: Switch to protection after the unsealing skill.
messages.NPCの死亡は敗北条件。アンプルがあっても無制限には復活できない。: NPC death causes defeat. Ampules do not provide unlimited revivals.
messages.刺青がないだけで反撃そのものが消えるわけではない。通常反撃を起動する攻撃は慎重に: The absence of tattoos does not remove the Counter itself. Carefully choose attacks that would trigger an ordinary Counter.
messages.終盤はモーゼスのHPではなく被弾の有無が重要。囚人のマッチで残った攻撃を止める。: In the final phase, preventing hits matters more than Moses's HP. Use Sinner clashes to stop remaining attacks.
messages.自動の虚幻境は手札から資源を払う通常使用とは別。自分で選べる切り札として数えない: Automatic Land of Illusion is separate from a normal manual use that spends resources. Do not count it as a selectable trump card.
messages.推奨Lv60。イサン・ドンキホーテ・ホンルの固定3名を育てる。: Recommended Lv. 60. Level the required Yi Sang, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.
messages.HP・精神力回復、キラへの貫通火力、終盤の高威力E.G.Oを用意する。: Bring HP/SP recovery, Pierce damage against Kira, and high-Power E.G.O for the final phase.
messages.キラへのマッチ・集中火力: Clashes and focused damage against Kira
messages.モーゼスを妨害する敵を終盤までに減らす。: Reduce the enemies that can interfere with Moses before the final phase.
messages.共有アンプルをエズラ・ベスパへ残す。: Save shared Ampules for Ezra and Vespa.
messages.腹をかっ開いてやるを処理し、チャージを守る。: Handle “I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish” and protect the charge.
messages.1段階 封印解除で開始。9-38の封印された剣からの開始とは異なる。: Starts with First Seal Removed, unlike the Sealed Sword opening in 9-38.
messages.HP701到達が終盤への目安。レーヴァテイン解放後は超根性を得て、モーゼスを狙う: Reaching 701 HP indicates the final-phase transition. After releasing Lævateinn, gains Ridiculous Grit and targets Moses.
messages.9-38の50%・30%ではなく、混乱区間は10%。混乱を待つより、強いマッチと: The Stagger Threshold is 10%, rather than 9-38's 50% and 30%. Defeat her through strong clashes and focused damage instead of waiting for Stagger.
messages.終盤まで残ると熱線OFFにならず、モーゼスの深い息を妨害する。: If she survives into the final phase, Thermal Blades stays ON and she interferes with Moses's Deep Breath.
messages.出血4以上でコイン威力増加。NPCの担当を確認し、囚人はキラへの攻撃と回復を続け: Coin Power increases against targets with at least 4 Bleed. Check NPC assignments while Sinners keep attacking Kira and healing.
messages.出血条件で強化され、混乱区間が進む。親方へ不用意にマッチを奪わず、LCD組へ任せ: Gains strength through Bleed conditions and raises Stagger Thresholds. Leave the Nursefather to the LCD team instead of carelessly taking over clashes.
messages.打撃の通常反撃。長兄の刺青で再使用する。囚人の余った攻撃で起動しない。: An ordinary Blunt Counter. Reuses with Great Brother tattoos. Do not trigger it with spare Sinner attacks.
messages.対象変更不可・4枚破壊不能。攻撃後は2段階 封印解除へ移る。NPCの対処を確認す: Four Unbreakable Coins; cannot be redirected. Advances to Second Seal Removed after attacking. Check the NPC response.
messages.[マッチ敗北]次のターンに基本威力増加1を得る(1ターンにつき2回): [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Base Power Up next turn (twice per turn)
messages.強化後の踏み潰す。出血と次ターンの基本威力増加に注意し、NPCの支援を維持する。: Enhanced “Stomping”. Watch for Bleed and next-turn Base Power Up, and maintain NPC support.
messages.[マッチ敗北]次のターンに嫉妬ダメージ量増加1を得る(1ターンにつき2回): [Clash Lose] Gain 1 Envy Damage Up next turn (twice per turn)
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]混乱区間を15前進: Ⅰ [On Hit] Raise Stagger Threshold by 15
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]混乱区間を15前進: Ⅱ [On Hit] Raise Stagger Threshold by 15
messages.強化後は混乱区間を各15進める。囚人が不要な被弾をしてアンプルを使わないようにす: The enhanced version raises Stagger Thresholds by 15 on each Coin. Avoid unnecessary Sinner hits that consume Ampules.
messages.即決処刑スタンピング！: Stamp of Complete and Total Extermination!
messages.[攻撃後]自分の中指 - 怨恨を全て消耗し、よく見とけ娘ちゃん！1を得る: [After Attack] Consume all The Middle - Grudge and gain 1 Check This Out, Kiddo!
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血5を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 5 Bleed
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血回数が3増加: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Increase Bleed Count by 3
messages.4枚破壊不能の大技。威力範囲とコイン値の整合が取れず、威力は未確定。NPCの対処: A major attack with four Unbreakable Coins. Power is unconfirmed because the listed range and Coin values conflict. Check the NPC response and actual predictions.
messages.そろそろ融け死ぬ時間だ: Time to Melt Away and Die
messages.[使用時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があるなら、コイン的中時に追加斬撃ダ: [On Use] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], deal 10 additional Slash damage on Coin hit
messages.3枚破壊不能。火傷と束縛、低HP時の火力増加がある。回復を先に行い、NPCの担当: Three Unbreakable Coins, with Burn, Bind, and extra damage at low HP. Heal in advance and preserve NPC assignments.
messages.被ダメージで再使用する記述がある技。威力範囲と4枚のコイン値が整合せず未確定。基: A skill described as reusing when damaged. Its listed Power range conflicts with the four Coin values, so Power is unconfirmed. Check the NPC response rather than assuming safety from base values.
messages.レーヴァテイン - ここまで破んのも久々だな！: Lævateinn - Been a While Since I Had to Unbox the Whole Thing!
messages.[攻撃後]2段階 封印解除状態がレーヴァテインになる: [After Attack] Second Seal Removed becomes Lævateinn
