messages.対象変更不可・4枚破壊不能。攻撃後にレーヴァテインへ移り、モーゼスの護衛が始まる: Four Unbreakable Coins; cannot be redirected. Changes to Lævateinn after attacking and begins the Moses protection phase.
messages.腹をかっ開いてやる: I'll Gut Ya Like a Fish
messages.[攻撃前](このスキルのコイン数×2)だけ火傷を得る: [Before Attack] Gain Burn equal to (this skill's Coin count × 2)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]混乱区間を10前進: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Raise Stagger Threshold by 10
messages.[的中時]火傷を10付与、火傷回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 10 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2
messages.終盤に囚人が受け持つ技。高威力E.G.Oでマッチ勝利する。破壊不能の火傷は残るが: A final-phase skill for Sinners to handle. Win with a high-Power E.G.O. Burn from Unbreakable Coins remains, but winning prevents Stagger from this skill.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]追加打撃ダメージ10: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Deal 10 additional Blunt damage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]火傷10を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 10 Burn
messages.5枚破壊不能の貫通技。LCD組の対処と共有アンプル残数を確認する。親方へ削り目的: A Pierce skill with five Unbreakable Coins. Check the LCD team's response and remaining shared Ampules. Do not add attacks just to damage the Nursefather.
messages.[攻撃前]自分の体力が50%以下のとき、ダメージ量+60%: [Before Attack] If the user's HP is at 50% or less, damage +60%
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]追加斬撃ダメージ10: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Deal 10 additional Slash damage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]追加貫通ダメージ10: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Deal 10 additional Pierce damage
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]自分に中指 - 怨恨の刺青[長兄]があれば、麻痺5を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] If the user has The Middle - Vengeance Tattoo [Great Brother], inflict 5 Paralyze
messages.加重値が可変の5枚破壊不能技。NPCの対応を確認し、囚人は残るモーゼス狙いを止め: Five Unbreakable Coins with variable Atk Weight. Check the NPC response while Sinners stop remaining attacks aimed at Moses.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]火傷回数が2増加: Ⅱ [On Hit] Increase Burn Count by 2
messages.解放後の斬撃通常反撃。親方を倒す目的で起動せず、護衛に必要な攻撃だけを選ぶ。: An ordinary Slash Counter after the release. Do not trigger it to try to kill the Nursefather; choose only attacks needed for protection.
messages.3枚目が破壊不能。出血5以上で基本威力+2。マッチ勝利と回復を両立する。: The third Coin is Unbreakable. Gains +2 Base Power against targets with at least 5 Bleed. Combine clash wins with healing.
messages.褒められた！4以上で最後のコインを3回再使用する。強い技を合わせて勝ち、アンプル: At 4 or more I Got Praised!, reuses the final Coin three times. Win with a strong skill to limit Ampule consumption.
messages.出血4以上でコイン威力増加。熱線ONでは火傷も増えるため、通常技で止めて早めに倒: Gains Coin Power against targets with at least 4 Bleed. Thermal Blades ON adds Burn too; stop her with regular skills and defeat her early.
messages.4枚すべて破壊不能。勝てばその技の混乱を防げるが、出血と追加ダメージは残る。: All four Coins are Unbreakable. Winning prevents Stagger from this skill, but Bleed and additional damage remain.
messages.5枚破壊不能、HP40%以下でダメージ+60%。強いマッチと回復を残して倒し切る: Five Unbreakable Coins, with +60% damage at 40% HP or less. Save strong clashes and healing to finish her.
messages.斬撃の通常反撃。強化刺青で最大2回再使用。集中攻撃する囚人のHPと出血を確認する: An ordinary Slash Counter. Augmentation Tattoos allow up to two reuses. Check HP and Bleed on Sinners concentrating their attacks.
messages.状態異常の軽減を無理に突破せず、NPCへ任せる。: Leave him to the NPCs instead of forcing damage through status resistance.
messages.開始時・的中スキル数3超過: At battle start; more than three skills hit
messages.囚人が追加で殴るほど次ターンの刺青が増える。不要な攻撃を控える。: Extra Sinner attacks add more tattoos next turn. Hold back unnecessary attacks.
messages.強化されたマティアスの対処はLCD組へ任せる。: Leave the enhanced Matthias to the LCD team.
messages.スキル被ダメージ2回・HP境界: Two instances of skill damage; HP thresholds
messages.大技への移行を見落とさず、アンプルと回復を残す。: Watch for the transition to major skills and save Ampules and healing.
messages.怨恨の刺青最高出力…レーヴァテインの封印解除だ！: Vengeance Tattoos Max Output... Unseal Lævateinn!
messages.レーヴァテイン解放時、超根性を得る\n\n深い息 - 赤色を保有したキャラクター:
When Lævateinn is released, gain Ridiculous Grit.

Target the character with Deep Breath - Red.
messages.超根性を得てモーゼスを狙う。削りから護衛へ切り替える。: Gains Ridiculous Grit and targets Moses. Switch from damage to protection.
messages.精神力0へ戻る。継続して無力化できるとは考えない。: SP returns to 0. Do not expect permanent incapacitation.
messages.パニック変更へ頼らず、マッチとNPC支援を使う。: Use clashes and NPC support rather than relying on changing Panic Type.
messages.ステージ開始時、熱線OFFを持って始める\n\nターン開始時、自分が保有した褒め:
Starts the stage with Thermal Blades OFF.

At Turn Start with at least 3 I Got Praised!, switch to Thermal Blades ON for the turn and additionally inflict Burn with skills that inflict Bleed.

At Turn End with fewer than 3 I Got Praised!, switch Thermal Blades ON to Thermal Blades OFF.
messages.熱線ONの火傷に備え、キラを先に倒す。: Prepare for Thermal Blades ON's Burn and defeat Kira first.
messages.中指の親方がレーヴァテイン保有時、熱線OFF状態にならない\n\n深い息 - 赤:
While the Middle Nursefather has Lævateinn, cannot enter Thermal Blades OFF.

Target the character with Deep Breath - Red.

Her animal instincts and innate combat sense tell her: whatever that is, if it hits, she will die.
messages.キラもモーゼスを狙う。残っているなら攻撃を通さない。: Kira targets Moses too. If she remains alive, stop her attacks.
messages.集中火力を出す間も、反撃される囚人のHPを戻す。: Restore the HP of Sinners exposed to Counters while dealing focused damage.
messages.ガチ殴りの再使用条件を満たさせないよう勝つ。: Win clashes to prevent “Totally Badass Ass-kicking”'s reuse condition.
messages.キラの大技へ強いマッチと回復を残す。: Save strong clashes and healing for Kira's major attack.
messages.【リンバス】9-48 小指の親方 - ???（9-48）の攻略｜Limbus A: 9-48 The Pinky Nursefather - ??? (9-48) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-48「小指の親方 - ???（9-4: The Pinky Nursefather - ??? (9-48) guide for Limbus Company 9-48. The second half becomes a solo duel with Ryōshū. Beat Dismay first to weaken enemy attacks, and also target Resentment and Futility. All enemy Coins become Unbreakable, so prepare to survive hits even after clash wins.
messages.良秀・ムルソー・ウーティス固定、最初は全員2スロット。敵は天殺星傷で基本攻撃・防: Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis are required; each starts with two skill slots. Tiansha Star's Bladewound lowers the enemy's base Offense and Defense Levels by 15. Tables list base Lv. 77 and Defense Level 77, with adjusted levels shown separately. In the second half, HP cannot fall below 210 until the end of its third turn; afterward, reaching 122 HP or less ends the battle.
messages.表は赤い糸を得る前のコイン。後半は敵の赤い糸で全コインが破壊不能・最終威力+4と: Tables show Coins before Red String is gained. In the second half, the enemy's Red String makes all Coins Unbreakable and grants +4 Final Power. Phantom Step has inconsistent Power ranges and Coin values, so its Power is marked unconfirmed.
messages.良秀の斬撃耐性・HPと、勝ち続けられるマッチを優先する。: Prioritize Ryōshū's Slash resistance, HP, and ability to keep winning clashes.
messages.落望へ先に勝ち、怨望・非望にも攻撃を向けて弱体化する。: Beat Dismay first; also target Resentment and Futility to apply their debuffs.
messages.後半の全コイン破壊不能と序盤3ターンのHP下限を踏まえて耐える。: Survive with the second half's fully Unbreakable Coins and its three-turn HP floor in mind.
messages.敵のHP0、または良秀以外の囚人1名以上の死亡で後半へ進む。移行時にほかの囚人が: The second half begins when the enemy reaches 0 HP or at least one Sinner other than Ryōshū dies. The other Sinners dying during the transition is part of the battle; from then on, fight with Ryōshū's skills alone.
messages.マッチに勝っても良秀が削られる: Ryōshū loses HP even after clash wins
messages.後半は敵の全コインが破壊不能になる。落望の攻撃威力減少、怨望の呼吸減少、非望の精: In the second half, every enemy Coin is Unbreakable. Use Dismay's Attack Power Down, Resentment's Poise reduction, and Futility's SP reduction, alongside Slash resistance and defense, to limit remaining damage.
messages.敵のHPが少しだけ残って減らない: The enemy stays at a sliver of HP
messages.後半3ターン目終了まではHP210の下限がある。手札を使い切らず生存し、その後に: The second half has a 210 HP floor through the end of its third turn. Survive without spending every skill, then lower the remaining HP. Reaching 122 HP or less triggers the final event.
messages.良秀が1人で受け切れる人格を選ぶ: Choose a Ryōshū Identity that can survive alone
messages.推奨Lv60。良秀・ムルソー・ウーティスの固定3名。後半は良秀だけになるため、良: Recommended Lv. 60 with the required Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis. Only Ryōshū remains in the second half, so prioritize her levels and Slash resistance.
messages.自分の被ダメージを増やす効果は一騎打ちで負担になる。火力だけでなくHPと耐性、通: Effects that increase her damage taken are costly in a solo duel. Compare HP, resistances, and regular-skill clash strength as well as damage output.
messages.敵には憤怒・憂鬱・斬撃が通りやすい。ただし弱点へ一方攻撃を重ねるより、弱体化する: Wrath, Gloom, and Slash work well against the enemy. Prioritize clashes against debuffing skills over piling on unopposed attacks against weaknesses.
messages.良秀のHPを守りながら移行する: Protect Ryōshū's HP through the transition
messages.良秀の断ち切れない時間で、マッチ勝利時に敵の精神力が5下がる。勝てるマッチを良秀: Ryōshū's Unseverable Time lowers the Nursefather's SP by 5 on clash wins. Assign winning clashes to her and generate resources too.
messages.確定された相手は、対応する鶏鳴・日入・黄昏を持つ対象だけがマッチできる。速い別人: Only the target with the corresponding Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow can clash with “Destinated Opponent”. Use the marked Sinner's skill rather than trying to take over with someone faster.
messages.敵のHP0、または良秀以外の囚人1名以上の死亡でイベントへ移る。ムルソー・ウーテ: The event triggers at 0 enemy HP or when at least one Sinner other than Ryōshū dies. Do not spend all resources keeping Meursault and Outis alive; save Ryōshū's skills for the second half.
messages.落望を先に処理して残りの攻撃を弱める: Handle Dismay first to weaken the remaining attacks
messages.良秀は赤い糸でスロット数+3、親方へのダメージ+50%。敵も同名の赤い糸を得るが: Ryōshū's Red String grants three extra skill slots and +50% damage against the Nursefather. The enemy gains the same-named Red String, but its effects differ: all Coins become Unbreakable and Final Power increases by 4.
messages.落望へ先にマッチ勝利し、攻撃威力減少3と精神力−5を入れる。怨望はそのスロットへ: Beat Dismay first to apply 3 Attack Power Down and −5 SP. Targeting Resentment's slot lowers Poise by 10; targeting Futility's lowers SP by 5.
messages.弱体化を入れてから残りの通常技や快閃へ対処する。勝った後も破壊不能の攻撃は残るた: Apply debuffs before handling the remaining regular skills and Swift Glimmer. Unbreakable attacks remain after clash wins, so check HP and Slash resistance.
messages.危険技を見て強い手札を残す: Watch for dangerous skills and save strong options
messages.1巡目は落望・怨望・残像歩・三連、2巡目は落望・非望・二連・快閃。快閃は勝つと加: Cycle turn 1 uses Dismay, Resentment, Phantom Step, and Tripleslash; turn 2 uses Dismay, Futility, Twinslash, and Swift Glimmer. Winning against Swift Glimmer reduces its Atk Weight.
messages.3巡目は落望・非望・残像歩・二連 - 残、4巡目は落望・あなたが憎い、でも…・三: Cycle turn 3 uses Dismay, Futility, Phantom Step, and Twinslash - Echoshear; turn 4 uses Dismay, “I resent you so. But...”, Tripleslash, and Inevitable Termination. The cycle then repeats.
messages.残像歩へ勝てば剣痕が半減する。必然殺は死亡・混乱で再使用するので、4巡目に強いマ: Winning against Phantom Step halves Bladetrail. Inevitable Termination reuses on a kill or Stagger, so save a strong clash for cycle turn 4.
messages.後半3ターン目終了まではHP210の下限がある。急いで火力を使い切らず、解除後に: The second half has a 210 HP floor through the end of its third turn. Do not rush to spend all your damage; once the floor is lifted, lower HP to 122 or less to finish.
messages.前半の良秀の効果。親方への与・被ダメージ+20%、マッチ勝利で親方の精神力−5。: Ryōshū's first-half effect. Deals and takes 20% more damage against the Nursefather; clash wins lower his SP by 5. Prevents Stagger, removes Stagger Thresholds, and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Using skills generates resources.
messages.前半のマッチと資源獲得に使う。後半は赤い糸へ変わる。: Use it for first-half clashes and resource generation. It changes to Red String in the second half.
messages.後半の親方の効果。全コインが破壊不能となり、最終威力+4。良秀の同名効果はスロッ: The Nursefather's second-half effect: all Coins become Unbreakable and Final Power +4. Ryōshū's same-named effect instead grants three extra slots, +50% damage against the Nursefather, and resource generation.
messages.誰が持つ効果かを確認する。良秀も同じ威力強化を得るわけではない。: Check who has the effect. Ryōshū does not receive the same Power buff.
messages.基礎Lvと補正後を区別し、実際のマッチ予測で担当を決める。: Distinguish base and adjusted levels, and use actual clash predictions to assign skills.
messages.最大10。的中時、コイン最終ダメージ÷10の斬撃追加ダメージが数値回発生。2以上: Maximum 10. On hit, deal additional Slash damage equal to Coin final damage ÷ 10 once per stack. At 2 or more, also inflict Burn; at 3, Bleed; at 4, Bind next turn; at 5, Poison.
messages.マッチ勝利だけで無傷にならない。残る被弾を減らす弱体化と耐性を重視する。: A clash win does not guarantee no damage. Prioritize debuffs and resistance to limit remaining hits.
messages.最大20。1につき与・被ダメージ−2%。精神力が0以上のときに得る。: Maximum 20. Damage dealt and taken −2% per stack. Gained while SP is 0 or higher.
messages.敵の火力が落ちる一方、こちらの攻撃も通りにくくなる。: Enemy damage falls, but your attacks become less effective too.
messages.最大20。1につき与・被ダメージ+2%。精神力が0未満のときに得る。: Maximum 20. Damage dealt and taken +2% per stack. Gained while SP is below 0.
messages.敵の精神力を下げた後も、追加ダメージと被弾へ注意する。: Watch for additional damage and remaining hits even after lowering enemy SP.
messages.敵の技で増える印。絶命や極空間斬撃 - 絶縁では、消費量に応じて最大HP割合ダメ: A mark added by enemy skills. Deathedge and Uttermost Rend Space - String Severance consume it to deal max-HP-based damage according to the amount consumed.
messages.残像歩への勝利で半減させ、低HPを放置しない。: Halve it through a clash win against Phantom Step, and avoid remaining at low HP.
messages.ステージ内の剣痕[残像]の数値合計。: The total Bladetrail [Afterimage] on the field.
messages.親方が段階3で開始する専用強化。: The Nursefather's special buff, starting at stage 3.
messages.通常の基礎値以外にも強化があるため、現在の予測を優先する。: Buffs apply beyond regular base values, so prioritize current predictions.
messages.確定された相手の対応するスロットとマッチできる印。: Marks allowing a clash with the corresponding “Destinated Opponent” slot.
messages.同じ印を持つ囚人で指定された技を受け持つ。: Assign the marked Sinner to the matching designated skill.
messages.後半の良秀には、前半の断ち切れない時間による混乱防止をそのまま当てはめない。: Do not assume Ryōshū retains first-half Stagger prevention from Unseverable Time in the second half.
messages.怨望・非望の弱体化は、その使用スロットへ攻撃を向ける戦闘開始時の条件。落望のマッ: Resentment and Futility apply debuffs at Combat Start if an attack targets their slot. This timing differs from Dismay's Clash Lose effect.
messages.後半の最終威力+4と全コイン破壊不能は、表の基礎値へ固定で含めていない。: The second half's +4 Final Power and fully Unbreakable Coins are not permanently included in the table's base values.
messages.良秀の赤い糸による資源獲得は1ターン2回まで。全スロットで無制限に増えるわけでは: Ryōshū's Red String generates resources at most twice per turn, rather than without limit in every slot.
messages.推奨Lv60。良秀の育成、斬撃耐性、強いマッチを優先する。: Recommended Lv. 60. Prioritize Ryōshū's levels, Slash resistance, and strong clashes.
messages.前半の2名も敵を弱められる技を用意するが、後半の生存を良秀以外の回復役へ依存しな: Prepare enemy-debuffing skills for the other two Sinners in the first half, but do not make second-half survival depend on another Sinner's healing.
messages.後半は良秀だけで破壊不能の被害を受ける。: Ryōshū alone takes the Unbreakable damage in the second half.
messages.確定された相手を指定された囚人で止める。: Stop “Destinated Opponent” with the designated Sinner.
messages.落望・怨望・非望を使い、残りの攻撃をしのぐ。: Use Dismay, Resentment, and Futility to survive the remaining attacks.
messages.天殺星傷、シン(心) - 地慧星3、暴走 - 残像もつれ4で開始。: Starts with Tiansha Star's Bladewound, 3 Shin (心) - Dihui Star, and 4 Paroxysm - Afterimage Entanglement.
messages.HP0となるダメージを受けたとき、1回だけ全快し、解除可能なマイナス効果を解除す: Once, when damage would reduce HP to 0, fully heal and remove all removable negative effects.
messages.後半は赤い糸で全コインが破壊不能・最終威力+4。良秀の同名効果とは内容が異なる。: In the second half, Red String makes all Coins Unbreakable and grants +4 Final Power. Its effects differ from Ryōshū's same-named status.
messages.2枚の斬撃。落望で弱めてから対処し、後半は全コイン破壊不能になることを忘れない。: Two Slash Coins. Weaken through Dismay first, and remember that all Coins become Unbreakable in the second half.
messages.3枚の斬撃。使用時と的中時の呼吸を増やさせず、弱体化後の強いマッチで勝つ。: Three Slash Coins. Use strong clashes after debuffing to stop Poise gains from use and hits.
messages.勝てば加重値が2減る破壊不能技。一方攻撃では呼吸5が増えるので放置しない。: An Unbreakable skill whose Atk Weight falls by 2 on a clash win. Do not leave it unopposed, as that grants 5 Poise.
messages.広域乱射・破壊不能。速度に関係なくマッチし、勝ってダメージ80%減と混乱防止を得: An Unfocused Volley with Unbreakable Coins. Clash regardless of Speed and win for 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention.
messages.勝てば担当の剣痕が半減する。威力は未確定なので現在の予測を確認する。: A clash win halves the clasher's Bladetrail. Power is unconfirmed, so check current predictions.
messages.良秀以外の低HPを優先する。守備が発動しないため攻撃でマッチする。剣痕から最大H: Prioritizes low-HP Sinners other than Ryōshū. Defense Skills cannot activate, so clash with an attack. Leads to max-HP-based damage from Bladetrail.
messages.精神力20以上で最終威力+10。強い技で勝って80%軽減を得るが、剣痕消費の割合: At 20 or more SP, Final Power +10. Win with a strong skill for 80% damage reduction, but also watch for max-HP-based damage from consuming Bladetrail.
messages.対応する鶏鳴・日入・黄昏を持つ囚人だけがマッチ可能。守備では受けず、指定された囚: Only a Sinner with the corresponding Dawn's First Crow, The Sun's Descent, or Eventide Glow can clash. Use the designated Sinner's attack to win rather than relying on defense.
messages.[クリティカル表面的中時]このコインを再使用(スキルごとに最大1回): [On Crit Heads Hit] Reuse this Coin (once per skill)
messages.破壊不能、クリティカル表で最大1回再使用。勝って被害80%減とその技の混乱防止を: Unbreakable; reuses once on a critical Heads hit. Win for 80% damage reduction and prevention of Stagger from this skill.
messages.[攻撃後]対象が死亡するか混乱したなら、このスキルを再使用(1ターンにつき3回): [After Attack] If the target died or was Staggered, reuse this skill (up to three times per turn)
messages.対象の死亡・混乱で最大3回再使用。4巡目へ強いマッチを残し、連鎖を防ぐ。: Reuses up to three times on a target's death or Stagger. Save a strong clash for cycle turn 4 to prevent a chain.
messages.[戦闘開始時]このスキルを使用スロットをメインターゲットにする攻撃スキルがあるな: [Combat Start] If an Attack Skill has this skill's slot as its main target, lose 10 Poise Potency
messages.このスロットへ攻撃を向けると戦闘開始時に呼吸−10。落望と併せ、残りの被害を抑え: Target this slot with an attack to lower Poise by 10 at Combat Start. Combine it with Dismay to reduce remaining damage.
messages.[戦闘開始時]このスキルを使用スロットをメインターゲットにする攻撃スキルがあるな: [Combat Start] If an Attack Skill has this skill's slot as its main target, lose 5 SP
messages.このスロットへ攻撃を向けると戦闘開始時に精神力−5。弱体化の条件を満たしてから残: Target this slot with an attack to lower SP by 5 at Combat Start. Meet the debuff condition before handling the remaining skills.
messages.先に勝つと敵の精神力−5・攻撃威力減少3。後半の最優先マッチにする。: Win early to lower enemy SP by 5 and apply 3 Attack Power Down. Make this the highest-priority clash in the second half.
messages.勝てば敵へ脆弱2。落望を先に処理し、強い手札は同じターンの必然殺にも残す。: Winning gives the enemy 2 Fragile. Handle Dismay first and save strong skills for Inevitable Termination on the same turn.
messages.ステージ開始時に天殺星傷、暴走 - 残像もつれ4を得る: At Stage Start, gain Tiansha Star's Bladewound and 4 Paroxysm - Afterimage Entanglement
messages.攻撃・防御の基礎Lvから15下がる。補正後の表示も確認する。: Offense and Defense Levels fall by 15 from their base values. Check the adjusted display too.
messages.この戦闘にて体力が0になるダメージを受けたとき、当該ダメージを受けずに下記の効果:
When damage would reduce HP to 0, negate that damage and apply the following (once per encounter):
- Fully heal and remove all removable negative effects.
- Gain 1 Fragile for the encounter and fix Paroxysm - Afterimage Entanglement at 1.
- At every Turn End, take fixed damage equal to (current turn number × 10).
- End the turn and enhance the pattern from then on.

“You forgot, and I was left to remember everything.”
messages.HP0になるダメージ・1回: Damage that would reduce HP to 0; once
messages.全快後はパターンが強化される。最初のHP0で決着だと思わず、良秀のHPを残す。: The pattern strengthens after the full heal. The first reduction to 0 HP does not finish the battle; preserve Ryōshū's HP.
messages.ターン開始時、精神力が0以上なら巡行 - 憐憫1を得る\n0より高い精神力2につ:
At Turn Start, if SP is 0 or higher, gain 1 Forward Flow - Compassion, plus 1 per 2 SP above 0.

At Turn Start, if SP is below 0, gain 1 Backward Flow - Bitterness, plus 1 per 2 SP below 0.

Past, present, and future overlap until their distinctions lose meaning. Childhood and every later moment are summoned into one place.
messages.精神力の正負で与・被ダメージが変わる。勝ちやすさだけで被害を判断しない。: Positive and negative SP change damage dealt and taken. Do not judge incoming damage solely by clash favorability.
messages.ターン終了時、このターン開始時の精神力との差5につき暴走 - 残像もつれが1増加:
At Turn End, gain 1 Paroxysm - Afterimage Entanglement per 5 difference from SP at Turn Start (max 5 gained per turn).
Lose 1 Paroxysm - Afterimage Entanglement per 100 cumulative damage taken, including Shield damage.

“As each layer of afterimages falls away, loss and liberation wash over me together.”
messages.残像の数値が上がると追加被害が増える。マッチと集中火力で増加を抑える。: Higher Afterimage stacks mean more additional damage. Use clashes and focused damage to limit the increase.
messages.指定された印の囚人で勝ち、固定ダメージと次ターンの脆弱を狙う。: Win with the marked Sinner to deal fixed damage and gain next-turn Fragile on the enemy.
messages.精神力30へ戻る。精神力を下げ続ければ安全とは考えない。: SP returns to 30. Repeated SP reduction alone does not guarantee safety.
messages.別のパニックへ変える戦法へ依存しない。: Do not depend on changing the enemy to another Panic Type.
messages.攻撃後の追加ダメージと剣痕を警戒し、残像歩へ勝って剣痕を減らす。: Watch for post-attack damage and Bladetrail; win against Phantom Step to reduce it.
messages.【リンバス】9-45 蜚蠊の皇帝（9-45）の攻略｜Limbus Assista: 9-45 The Roach Emperor (9-45) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-45「蜚蠊の皇帝（9-45）」の攻略: The Roach Emperor (9-45) guide for Limbus Company 9-45. Have Heathcliff and Rodion handle Gluttony skills and pests while Vergilius supplies major damage and dangerous clashes. Using Unbreakable Coins against Gluttony skills strengthens the enemy, so check the NPC's clash targets before starting.
messages.ヒースクリフ・ロージャは暴食技と害虫を処理し、大きな火力と危険なマッチはヴェルギ: Have Heathcliff and Rodion handle Gluttony skills and pests while Vergilius supplies major damage and dangerous clashes. Using Unbreakable Coins against Gluttony skills strengthens the enemy, so check the NPC's clash targets before starting.
messages.ヒースクリフ・ロージャの固定2名とヴェルギリウスの共闘。囚人は精神力30、全基本: Heathcliff and Rodion are the two required Sinners, fighting alongside Vergilius. Sinners start at 30 SP, or −30 for Identities whose basic attacks all use negative Coins, and share three Ampule uses. Tables show base values without Low Morale, Panic, or HP-loss debuffs. The ending event triggers at 30 HP.
messages.摘出コインは、破壊不能コインも破壊できる特殊なコイン。通常の破壊不能と区別して技: Excision Coins are special Coins that can destroy Unbreakable Coins. They are distinguished from ordinary Unbreakable Coins in skill labels and effects. The enemy's Heads chance is fixed at 50% regardless of SP, so do not choose clashers from favorable predictions alone.
messages.暴食技は破壊不能のない囚人の技で引き受ける。: Assign Sinner skills without Unbreakable Coins to Gluttony attacks.
messages.攻撃害虫は捕食で半減、防御害虫は状態異常の付与で削る。: Halve Hurting Pest through Devouring; reduce Protecting Pest by inflicting statuses.
messages.終盤の心臓狙いはNPCに任せ、摘出・晩餐を囚人で処理する。: Leave the final heart-targeting skill to the NPC; have Sinners handle Excision and Feast.
messages.NPCがマッチすると暴食技が急に強くなる: A Gluttony skill suddenly gains Power when the NPC clashes with it
messages.捕食は相手の破壊不能1枚につき基本威力+10、摘出・晩餐は+20。E.G.O発現: Devouring gains +10 Base Power per opposing Unbreakable Coin; Excision and Feast gain +20. After Vergilius manifests E.G.O, redirect these clashes to Sinner skills with ordinary Coins. Check for skills that become Unbreakable conditionally too.
messages.バリアがあるのに囚人が倒れる: Sinners die despite having a Shield
messages.攻撃害虫は最大HPを減らし、戦闘開始時に数値×12の固定ダメージを与える。50な: Hurting Pest reduces max HP and deals fixed damage equal to stacks × 12 at Combat Start. At 50, that is 600 damage, consuming the support Shield. Let Devouring hit to halve stacks before they build up, and avoid concentrating several strong attacks on one Sinner.
messages.後半の大技で一気に全滅する: The later major attack wipes the party
messages.皇帝の摘出にヴェルギリウスがマッチしていないか確認する。暴食の摘出は囚人へ回す一: Check whether Vergilius is clashing with “The Emperor's Excision”. Redirect that Gluttony skill to a Sinner, but preserve the NPC's Funeral clash against “'Son, don't forget to go for the heart.'”. Do not swap these assignments.
messages.打撃に耐える2名と通常コインの技を用意する: Bring two Sinners who can take Blunt hits and use ordinary Coins
messages.推奨Lv60。ヒースクリフとロージャだけを操作する。打撃への耐性、HP・精神力回: Recommended Lv. 60. Only Heathcliff and Rodion are controllable. Prioritize Blunt resistance and HP/SP recovery.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜の付与で防御害虫を削れる。状態異常のダメージだけで倒: Inflicting Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking reduces Protecting Pest. Your role is to supply status amounts rather than defeat the enemy through status damage alone.
messages.暴食技へ合わせる通常コインの攻撃を確保する。強い技でも、条件達成で破壊不能へ変わ: Save ordinary-Coin attacks for Gluttony skills. Even a strong skill is unsuitable if its Coins become Unbreakable when conditions are met.
messages.囚人が弱い技と暴食を受け、NPCへ危険技を回す: Sinners handle weaker skills and Gluttony; the NPC handles dangerous skills
messages.案内人により、ヴェルギリウスが受け持つ技へ囚人の攻撃を向けると、NPCは別の未担: Through The Guide, assigning a Sinner attack to the skill Vergilius is handling moves him to another unassigned skill. Removing the attack moves him back, so check the final clash lines before starting.
messages.色欲の拳など比較的受けやすい技と暴食を囚人へ回し、笞罪・鳴動などをNPCへ任せる: Assign relatively manageable skills such as the Lust Fist and Gluttony attacks to Sinners; leave Flogging and Quaking to the NPC. Do not pile several strong attacks onto one Sinner.
messages.囚人がマッチに負けると皇帝の精神力が5下がり、囚人へのダメージも減る。勝てない攻: When a Sinner loses a clash, the Emperor loses 5 SP and deals less damage to Sinners. Even an unwinnable clash can help, but only if HP, pests, and Shields allow survival.
messages.士気低下はマッチ威力減少8・威力減少3、パニックは10・5で大幅に弱まる。表面確: Low Morale applies 8 Clash Power Down and 3 Power Down; Panic applies 10 and 5, greatly weakening the enemy. Heads chance stays at 50%, so use strong regular skills or E.G.O even at low enemy SP.
messages.捕食を受ける囚人を選んで害虫を半減させる: Choose who takes Devouring to halve their pests
messages.攻撃害虫が多い囚人を皇帝の捕食へ回す。的中で害虫が半減し、減った数値に応じて資源: Assign “The Emperor's Devouring” to a Sinner with high Hurting Pest. On hit, it halves pests and grants resources according to the reduction. Around 35 is a warning sign; do not leave stacks to reach the cap of 50.
messages.捕食は対象のマイナス効果も吸収する。吸収された火傷などが防御害虫を減らすため、害: Devouring also absorbs the target's negative effects. Absorbed Burn and similar statuses reduce Protecting Pest, combining pest management with preparation to break the enemy Shield.
messages.破壊されずに的中するとプラス効果も吸収される。不要な強化を重ねた囚人を無条件に差: A hit without Coin destruction also absorbs positive effects. Do not automatically offer a heavily buffed Sinner; check incoming damage and what the enemy will gain.
messages.攻撃の隙を作り、盾は囚人が引き受ける: Create an opening and have a Sinner handle the Shield
messages.5種の状態異常の威力・回数を付与して防御害虫を減らす。0にすると次ターンは防御害: Inflict Potency and Count of the five statuses to reduce Protecting Pest. At 0, the enemy gains 10 Defense Level Down instead of Protecting Pest next turn, creating an opening.
messages.皇帝の盾がNPCを指定すると、NPCからの攻撃ダメージを50%減らす。囚人が担当: If “The Emperor's Shield” designates the NPC, it reduces damage from his attacks by 50%. Have a Sinner take over to preserve NPC damage.
messages.この隙は永続ではない。ターン終了にマイナス効果が除去され、防御害虫を得るため、再: This opening is temporary. At Turn End, negative effects are removed and Protecting Pest returns; inflict statuses again to reduce it.
messages.摘出・晩餐は囚人、心臓狙いはNPCへ分担する: Sinners handle Excision and Feast; the NPC handles the heart-targeting skill
messages.HP50%または混乱で行動が変わり、攻撃害虫の付与量が増える。精神力0・防御害虫: At 50% HP or when Staggered, the pattern changes and Hurting Pest application increases. SP resets to 0 and Protecting Pest to 50, so the first half's debuffs do not simply carry on.
messages.暴食の皇帝の摘出・皇帝の晩餐は必ず破壊不能のない囚人の技へ回す。特に広域の摘出へ: Always assign the Gluttony skills “The Emperor's Excision” and “The Emperor's Feast” to Sinner skills without Unbreakable Coins. In particular, letting the NPC clash with the area Excision greatly increases its Power.
messages.晩餐の破壊されていない2枚目が当たると敵HPが25%回復する。士気低下・パニック: An undestroyed second Coin from Feast restores 25% of enemy HP on hit. During Low Morale or Panic, use a high-Power E.G.O if needed to win and prevent that healing.
messages.「…坊や、心臓を狙わないと。」はNPCの死んだ血鬼が為の葬儀へ任せる。そのマッチ: Leave “'Son, don't forget to go for the heart.'” to the NPC's Funeral for a Dead Bloodfiend. Adding a Sinner attack to that target moves the NPC to another skill, so preserve the clash line.
messages.NPCの大技も味方の弱体化などで失敗する可能性はある。勝利確定とは決めつけず、予: NPC debuffs and other effects can still cause his major skill to fail. Check predictions and applied effects rather than assuming victory, and progress to the event at 30 HP.
messages.9-45の助力者。主な火力と強いマッチを担当し、案内人で攻撃先を変更する。死亡す: The assistant in 9-45. Supplies most damage and strong clashes; The Guide changes his attack targets. You lose if he dies.
messages.暴食技は囚人へ回し、後半の心臓狙いのマッチを任せる。: Redirect Gluttony skills to Sinners and leave the later heart-targeting clash to him.
messages.最大50。1につき最大HP−1%、戦闘開始時に数値×12の固定ダメージ。減少時に: Maximum 50. Max HP −1% per stack; at Combat Start, take fixed damage equal to stacks × 12. When reduced, gain random resources equal to the stacks removed (max 15).
messages.捕食の的中で半減する。上限になる前に受け持つ囚人を選ぶ。: Halved on a hit from Devouring. Choose the Sinner who takes it before stacks reach the cap.
messages.最大50。火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜の威力や回数の付与を防ぎ、同じ数値だけ減る: Maximum 50. Prevents application of Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking Potency or Count, losing an equal number of stacks instead. At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to stacks × 40.
messages.状態異常を付与して減らし、0にした次ターンの隙へつなぐ。: Reduce it by inflicting statuses, creating an opening on the turn after it reaches 0.
messages.マッチで破壊不能コインも破壊でき、自分はマッチに負けても破壊されず攻撃する。敗北: Can destroy Unbreakable Coins in clashes and still attacks intact after a clash loss. Coin Power becomes 1 after losing.
messages.摘出というコイン自体の効果と、暴食技が相手の破壊不能で強化される条件を区別する。: Distinguish Excision Coin's own effect from Gluttony skills gaining Power against opposing Unbreakable Coins.
messages.ほかの味方生存中、致死ダメージを受けると混乱解除・HP全快。味方全員の残数が同時: On lethal damage while another ally lives, clear Stagger and fully restore HP. All allies' remaining counts decrease by 1 simultaneously. The two Sinners share three uses.
messages.1人に3回ずつの復活ではない。害虫と集中被弾で使い切らない。: This is not three revivals each. Do not spend them all on pests and concentrated hits.
messages.囚人がNPCのマッチ先へ攻撃を向けると、NPCがほかの未担当技へ対象を変更する。: Assigning a Sinner attack to the NPC's clash target moves him to another unassigned skill.
messages.暴食と盾は囚人へ、後半の心臓狙いはNPCへ残す。: Leave Gluttony and Shield to Sinners, and the later heart-targeting skill to the NPC.
messages.ヴェルギリウスが毎ターン全味方へバリアを展開し、最大600になるよう補う。: Each turn, Vergilius replenishes Shields on all allies up to 600.
messages.上限50の攻撃害虫は開始時600ダメージ。支援があっても害虫を放置しない。: At 50 Hurting Pest, start-of-combat damage is 600. Do not neglect pests even with support available.
messages.NPCがE.G.O発現後の技群を使う状態。4ターン目から全技が破壊不能となる。: The state in which the NPC uses his manifested E.G.O skills. All his skills become Unbreakable from Turn 4.
messages.発現後は暴食技の担当を必ず囚人へ戻す。: After manifestation, always reassign Gluttony skills to Sinners.
messages.ヴェルギリウスが終盤の心臓狙いへ合わせる大技。: Vergilius's major skill against the late heart-targeting attack.
messages.囚人が同じ相手へマッチを重ね、NPCの担当を変えてしまわない。: Do not add a Sinner clash against the same target and accidentally change the NPC's assignment.
messages.強いE.G.Oでも破壊不能コインがあれば暴食技を強化する。通常コインかを確認する: Even a strong E.G.O strengthens Gluttony skills if it has Unbreakable Coins. Check for ordinary Coins.
messages.捕食の害虫半減は的中時。マッチに勝って被弾をなくせば、同じ害虫処理にはならない。: Devouring halves pests on hit. Winning the clash and preventing every hit does not provide the same pest removal.
messages.士気低下やパニックでも皇帝の表面確率は50%。マッチ勝率の表示だけで安全と判断し: The Emperor's Heads chance remains 50% during Low Morale or Panic. Clash-win probability alone does not guarantee safety.
messages.NPCも死亡すると敗北。危険な暴食を任せず、心臓狙いのマッチは崩さない。: NPC death also causes defeat. Do not leave dangerous Gluttony skills to him, and preserve his heart-targeting clash.
messages.推奨Lv60。固定2名は打撃耐性・回復・精神力管理を重視する。: Recommended Lv. 60. Prioritize Blunt resistance, healing, and SP management for the two required Sinners.
messages.5種の状態異常を付与できる技と、破壊不能のない高威力攻撃をそろえる。: Bring skills that inflict the five statuses and high-Power attacks without Unbreakable Coins.
messages.暴食技の強化条件を避け、NPCを危険技へ回す。: Avoid strengthening Gluttony skills and direct the NPC toward dangerous attacks.
messages.防御害虫を削ってNPCの火力を通す。: Reduce Protecting Pest to let NPC damage through.
messages.共有アンプルを守り、開始時ダメージを抑える。: Preserve shared Ampules and limit start-of-combat damage.
messages.50%（1520）／到達・混乱で行動変更: 50% (1,520) / Pattern changes on reaching this threshold or being Staggered
messages.コイン表面確率は精神力によらず50%。低精神力でも表が出ることを前提に組む。: Heads chance is 50% regardless of SP. Plan for Heads even at low SP.
messages.防御害虫の数値×40のバリアをターン開始時に得る。50なら2000。: At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to Protecting Pest × 40. At 50 stacks, this is 2,000.
messages.HP50%または混乱で皇帝の震怒が発動し、精神力0・防御害虫50へ戻る。: At 50% HP or when Staggered, The Emperor's Wrath activates, resetting SP to 0 and Protecting Pest to 50.
messages.HP30未満にならず、30でイベントへ進む。: Cannot fall below 30 HP; the event triggers at 30.
messages.対象のマイナス効果1種につき、ダメージ量+20%(最大100%): Damage +20% per type of negative effect on the target (max 100%)
messages.対象の攻撃害虫[蜚蠊]2につき、ダメージ量+10%: Damage +10% per 2 Hurting Pest [Roaches] on the target
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]火傷,出血,振動,破裂,沈潜のうちランダムな1つの効果を2付与、回数: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 2 Potency and 2 Count of one random effect among Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]火傷,出血,振動,破裂,沈潜のうちランダムな1つの効果を2付与、回数: Ⅱ [On Hit] Inflict 2 Potency and 2 Count of one random effect among Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking
messages.2枚の打撃。比較的囚人が受け持ちやすいが、害虫と状態異常の種類で被害が増える。耐: Two Blunt Coins. Relatively manageable for Sinners, but pests and negative-effect types increase damage. Check resistance and Shields.
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が80%減少、該当ダメージで混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; this damage cannot Stagger
messages.[的中時]火傷,出血,振動,破裂,沈潜のうちランダムな1つの効果を3付与、回数が: [On Hit] Inflict 3 Potency and 3 Count of one random effect among Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]呼吸5を得る、自分の呼吸回数が3増加: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Gain 5 Poise and 3 Poise Count
messages.3枚破壊不能の打撃。勝てばダメージ80%減と混乱防止。拳より重く、同じ囚人へ何本: Three Unbreakable Blunt Coins. Winning grants 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention. Heavier than Fist; avoid concentrating several on the same Sinner.
messages.[使用時]マッチを進行したスキルの破壊不能コイン1個につき、基本威力+10: [On Use] Base Power +10 per Unbreakable Coin in the opposing skill
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象のプラス効果を全て吸収: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Absorb all positive effects on the target
messages.[的中時]対象の攻撃害虫[蜚蠊]が半減: [On Hit] Halve the target's Hurting Pest [Roaches]
messages.[的中時]対象のマイナス効果をすべて吸収: [On Hit] Absorb all negative effects on the target
messages.- 当該効果を発動後、自分に防御害虫[蜚蠊]がないなら次のターンに威力減少2を得: - After this effect, if the user has no Protecting Pest [Roaches], gain 2 Power Down next turn
messages.破壊不能1枚につき基本威力+10。通常コインの囚人が担当する。害虫が多い囚人へ的: Base Power +10 per opposing Unbreakable Coin. Assign a Sinner with ordinary Coins. Letting it hit a Sinner with many pests can halve them, but check HP and absorbed effects.
messages.[的中時]自分の充電回数を全て消耗し、ダメージ量+(消耗した充電回数×20)%: [On Hit] Consume all Charge Count; damage +(Charge Count consumed × 20)%
messages.加重値7・2枚破壊不能。NPCへ任せる主な危険技。勝って80%軽減し、充電を使う: Two Unbreakable Coins and 7 Atk Weight. A key dangerous skill to leave to the NPC. Win for 80% damage reduction to limit the large Charge-based damage.
messages.3枚で攻撃害虫を合計7付与。害虫の少ない囚人でも放置し続けず、NPCの空き担当も: Three Coins inflicting seven Hurting Pest in total. Do not keep ignoring it even on Sinners with few pests; check the NPC's available assignments too.
messages.Ⅲ[的中時]振動回数が3増加: Ⅲ [On Hit] Increase Tremor Count by 3
messages.[的中時]ランダムな振動へ振幅変換: [On Hit] Inflict Amplitude Conversion into a random Tremor type
messages.Ⅳ[的中時]振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅳ [On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.加重値7・4枚の高威力技。NPCへ担当を回し、囚人は色欲・暴食などの処理へ回る。: A high-Power four-Coin skill with 7 Atk Weight. Assign it to the NPC while Sinners handle Lust, Gluttony, and other manageable skills.
messages.[使用時]マッチを進行したスキルの破壊不能コイン1個につき、基本威力+20: [On Use] Base Power +20 per Unbreakable Coin in the opposing skill
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]攻撃レベル減少を5付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 5 Offense Level Down
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]防御レベル減少を5付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 5 Defense Level Down
messages.相手の破壊不能1枚につき基本威力+20。NPCから通常コインの囚人へマッチを奪う: Base Power +20 per opposing Unbreakable Coin. Take the clash from the NPC with a Sinner using ordinary Coins. Win for 80% damage reduction and Stagger prevention. This is the highest-priority check in the second half.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象のバリアを除去: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Remove the target's Shield
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]本体と部位の体力を、最大値の25%回復: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Heal the main body and part for 25% of their max HP
messages.相手の破壊不能1枚につき基本威力+20。2枚目が破壊されずに当たると敵HP25%: Base Power +20 per opposing Unbreakable Coin. An undestroyed second Coin heals 25% of enemy HP on hit. Win with a high-Power ordinary-Coin skill or E.G.O.
messages.「…坊や、心臓を狙わないと。」: 'Son, don't forget to go for the heart.'
messages.[使用時]呼吸10を得る、自分の呼吸回数が4増加: [On Use] Gain 10 Poise and 4 Poise Count
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が80%減少し、クリティカルが発生しない: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage and cannot trigger critical hits
messages.[的中時]火傷,出血,振動,破裂,沈潜のうちランダムな1つの効果を5付与、回数が: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Potency and 2 Count of one random effect among Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking
messages.[クリティカル的中時]対象の体力最大値の25%だけ傲慢ダメージ: [On Crit] Deal Pride damage equal to 25% of the target's max HP
messages.対象変更不可・加重値7。NPCの葬儀へ任せ、そのマッチ先に囚人の攻撃を重ねない。: Cannot be redirected; 7 Atk Weight. Leave it to the NPC's Funeral and do not add Sinner attacks to that clash target. Winning grants 80% damage reduction and prevents critical hits, so check the NPC's prediction too.
messages.指定した対象からの、このターンの間の攻撃スキルによる被ダメージ量が50%減少: Take 50% less damage from the designated target's Attack Skills this turn
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の精神力が15回復: [Clash Lose] Heal the target for 15 SP
messages.指定対象からの攻撃をそのターン50%軽減する。囚人で担当し、NPCの火力を削らせ: Reduces damage from the designated target's attacks by 50% that turn. Have a Sinner handle it to preserve NPC damage. Treat its conditions separately from a Guard handled simply with unopposed attacks.
messages.精神力と関係なしに、コイン確率が50%に固定\n\n囚人とのマッチに勝利するとき:
Heads chance is fixed at 50% regardless of SP.

On winning a clash against a Sinner, lose 5 SP and deal 40% less damage to Sinners.

In Low Morale or Panic, gain Clash Power Down and Power Down.
On recovering from Panic, gain 2 Power Down.
“But has it really all been unwrapped?”
messages.表面50%固定・囚人へのマッチ勝利: Fixed 50% Heads chance; clash wins against Sinners
messages.囚人が受け持つマッチにも精神力低下とダメージ軽減の意味がある。ただし集中被弾は避: Assigning Sinners also helps lower SP and reduce damage. Still avoid concentrated hits.
messages.ターン開始時に防御害虫[蜚蠊]を50得る(1ターンごとに得る数値が3減少,最大で:
At Turn Start, gain 50 Protecting Pest [Roaches] (the amount gained decreases by 3 each turn, up to a reduction of 20).
- If the user has Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking, randomly reduce their Potency and lose Protecting Pest equal to the amount reduced.
- If the effect has 1 Potency and at least 2 Count, reduce Count instead.

If all Protecting Pest is depleted during combat, apply the following next turn:
- Gain 10 Defense Level Down instead of Protecting Pest.
- Generate 2 resources of each of the enemy's three least-abundant E.G.O affinities.
- At Turn End, remove all negative effects and gain Protecting Pest.
Wherever and whenever it may be, they crawl out from the lines where surfaces meet.
messages.5種の付与で防御害虫を減らし、次ターンの攻撃の隙を作る。: Use the five statuses to reduce Protecting Pest and create an opening next turn.
messages.ターン開始時、(防御害虫[蜚蠊]×40)だけバリアを得る\nゴキブリの群れは、た:
At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to (Protecting Pest [Roaches] × 40).
The swarm moves for one emperor alone.
messages.防御害虫50ならバリア2000。HPへの火力より、まず害虫を減らす。: At 50 Protecting Pest, the Shield is 2,000. Reduce pests before focusing on HP damage.
messages.- マッチ勝利時、対象へ攻撃害虫[蜚蠊]3を付与\n- スキル的中時、対象へ攻撃:
- On Clash Win, inflict 3 Hurting Pest [Roaches] on the target.
- On skill hit, inflict 1 Hurting Pest [Roaches] on the target.
Burrow, seep, permeate, gnaw, tear, and devour.
messages.害虫をためさせず、捕食で半減させる担当を回す。: Avoid building up pests; rotate who takes Devouring to halve them.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜による体力・精神力・混乱区間の前進量-50%\n当該:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold advancement from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 50%.
This damage cannot cause Stagger.
At Turn Start, gain 2 Power Down per 25% HP the main body has lost.
Adapt to everything, and grow dull.
messages.直接ダメージだけでなく状態異常の付与量を使って害虫を剥がす。: Use status application amounts, as well as direct damage, to strip pests.
messages.体力が50%になるか混乱状態になると、自分に掛かったマイナス効果の混乱状態を解除:
At 50% HP or when Staggered, clear Stagger among the user's negative effects and change the pattern.
Then apply the following:
- Set SP to 0.
- Gain 50 Protecting Pest [Roaches].
- Double the Hurting Pest [Roaches] inflicted by The Emperor's Legion.
messages.精神力0と防御害虫50へ戻り、害虫付与も増える。後半の技へ担当を組み直す。: Returns to 0 SP and 50 Protecting Pest, with increased pest application. Reassign clashes for the second-half skills.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 フォーレグ（10章A）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 10-04 Four-legs (Canto X A) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「フォーレグ（10章A）」の攻: Four-legs (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Break the Shield and attack before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against the powerful Unfocused Volley for halved damage and Stagger prevention. Defeating Four-legs leads directly into One-leg.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store A, 4F: S: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store A, 4F: Shoes Floor, First Battle
messages.保存威力が上がり切る前にバリアを崩して攻める。広域乱射が出たら強い技でマッチに勝: Break the Shield and attack before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against the powerful Unfocused Volley for halved damage and Stagger prevention. Defeating Four-legs leads directly into One-leg.
messages.AルートのLv23・HP814。防御レベル25は生地などの追加補正前。Bルートの: Route A: Lv. 23 and 814 HP. Defense Level 25 excludes additional Fabric modifiers. Separate from Route B's Lv. 48 version starting with Preservation 3/15 and a 1,000 Shield. Covers normal Route A “Nail” progression. In this dungeon, Customer Level replaces outside Identity levels. Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Form a team of up to 12 including each floor's three required Sinners. SP and E.G.O resources carry over after battles. The 4F required Sinners are Meursault, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.
messages.保存威力3以上で変わるコインは条件付きのため、常時の破壊不能アイコンには含めない: Coins that change at 3 or more Preservation Potency are conditional and are not shown as permanently Unbreakable. Unfocused Volley selects a target for each Coin; its three Coins do not hit everyone simultaneously.
messages.バリアを残し続けず、保存威力3になる前にHPを削る。: Break the Shield instead of leaving it up, and damage HP before Preservation Potency reaches 3.
messages.強力な広域乱射はマッチ勝利で半減し、混乱を防ぐ。: Win against the powerful Unfocused Volley to halve damage and prevent Stagger.
messages.ワンレグとの連戦へHPとE.G.O資源を残す。: Save HP and E.G.O resources for the consecutive One-leg battle.
messages.同じ通常技なのに次第に強くなる: The same regular skills keep getting stronger
messages.保存回数8以上で通常技のコイン威力が上がる。対象の振動でも最終威力が増える。素の: At 8 or more Preservation Count, regular skills gain Coin Power. Tremor on the target also raises Final Power. Check current Preservation and clash predictions rather than base maximum Power alone.
messages.追加の広域が出て立て直せない: An added area skill prevents recovery
messages.ターン開始時に保存威力3・回数10以上だと追加スロットに広域乱射を使う。マッチに: At Turn Start with 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count, uses Unfocused Volley in an extra slot. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill, so prioritize a strong E.G.O against it.
messages.倒したのに次の敵で負ける: The next enemy wins after Four-legs falls
messages.フォーレグの後はワンレグと連戦。2戦目で敗北するとフォーレグからやり直しになる。: One-leg follows Four-legs immediately. Losing the second battle restarts from Four-legs. Avoid wasting E.G.O at the end; save healing and resources for major skills.
messages.買い物と連戦の準備を済ませる: Finish shopping and prepare for consecutive battles
Meursault, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu are required. Bring your main attackers and HP recovery, using carried-over SP and E.G.O resources.
messages.買い物で顧客Lv25を目安にする。外での人格レベルを上げ直す必要はない。ムルソー: Aim for Customer Lv. 25 through shopping. You do not need to raise outside Identity levels. An official RENTAL Identity is available for Meursault too.
messages.打撃への耐性と、強いマッチに使うE.G.Oを確認する。解析段階は補助されないため: Check Blunt resistance and E.G.O for strong clashes. Threadspin is not raised, so choose according to required effects and resource costs.
messages.廊下からシューズフロアへ入ると戦闘が始まる。フォーレグの後にワンレグが続くため、: Entering the Shoes Floor from the corridor starts combat. One-leg follows Four-legs, so prepare healing and high-Power skills for both battles.
messages.バリアを削り切り、長期化を避ける: Break the Shield and avoid a prolonged fight
messages.初期の保存は威力1・回数0、生地は3。バリアが残ったままターンを終えると、次ター: Starts with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count and 3 Fabric. Ending a turn with a Shield remaining increases next-turn Preservation Count and Defense Level.
messages.バリア中に被撃すると敵の保存回数も増える。小さな攻撃でバリアだけを残し続けず、火: Taking hits while Shielded also adds Preservation Count. Do not leave the Shield intact through small attacks; concentrate damage to reach HP.
messages.怠惰1.5・色欲1.25で攻める。物理は斬・貫・打の全て1.2なので、特定の物理: Use Sloth ×1.5 and Lust ×1.25. All physical resistances are ×1.2, so there is no need to focus on one physical type.
messages.切ってください！お願いです！: Please, cut them off! I beg you!
messages.速度を問わず強い担当でマッチする: Assign a strong clasher regardless of Speed
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。保存回数10以上なら消耗して基本威力とコイン威力が各1: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed. At 10 or more Preservation Count, consumes it for +1 Base Power and +1 Coin Power, so do not judge only from the base maximum of 14.
messages.保存威力3以上では全コインが破壊不能へ変わる。マッチ勝利後の振動爆発に備え、担当: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, all Coins become Unbreakable. Heal the clasher beforehand to prepare for Tremor Bursts remaining after a clash win.
messages.混乱で敵の行動パターンはスキップされない。混乱明けに何を使うかを再確認する。: Stagger does not skip the enemy's action pattern. Recheck the skills it will use after recovery.
messages.保存威力3・回数10以上: 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count
messages.広域乱射へ勝ち、消耗を抑えて次戦へ進む: Win against Unfocused Volley and limit damage before the next battle
messages.追加スロットの「カタカタいうこの音、おぞましい･･･。」は3枚全て破壊不能。使用: The extra-slot “Clippety-clop, what an awful sound...” has three Unbreakable Coins. On use, inflicts 3 Tremor and 3 Count on all targets.
messages.マッチに勝つとダメージ−50%に加え、このスキルのダメージと効果では対象が混乱し: Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage and effects. It does not evade everything, but controls damage better than leaving it unopposed.
messages.広域乱射は初撃がメインターゲット、以後は対象のうちランダム1名へコインが飛ぶ。副: Unfocused Volley's first Coin hits the main target; later Coins choose a random target among those attacked. Heal secondary targets too.
messages.撃破後のワンレグへ資源と精神力を引き継ぐ。勝ちが確定した場面で強いE.G.Oを重: Resources and SP carry into the One-leg battle. Once victory is assured, do not add unnecessary powerful E.G.O; save them for the next major attack.
messages.百貨店で目玉を消費して買い物すると上がる、ダンジョン内のレベル。影界での人格レベ: The dungeon level raised by spending eyeballs in department-store shops. Determines Identity levels inside the dungeon.
messages.マッチで押し負けるなら、外での経験値稼ぎより、未購入の店や自販機を確認する。: If clashes are too weak, check unvisited shops and vending machines instead of farming outside EXP.
messages.特殊充電。充電威力・回数を増減させる効果を同様に受け、通常の回数上限は20。ター: A special Charge affected by effects that change Charge Potency and Count. The usual Count cap is 20; lose 1 Count at Turn End. Enemy passives increase Preservation Potency and other effects through cumulative Count consumption.
messages.威力と回数を分けて見る。保存回数を使わせた直後も、累計消耗による強化が進んでいる: Check Potency and Count separately. Spending Count may still advance buffs based on cumulative consumption.
messages.精神力−20以下で速度最大値−1・防御レベル+1、−45以下で速度最大値−5・防: At −20 SP or lower, maximum Speed −1 and Defense Level +1; at −45 or lower, maximum Speed −5 and Defense Level +3. Clash wins and losses also change SP.
messages.敵の精神力を下げる戦術も使えるが、速度低下だけで倒したと判断せず、残りHPとバリ: Lowering enemy SP is useful, but reduced Speed does not finish the fight. Check remaining HP and Shields.
messages.最大15。数値5につき速度最大値−1、攻撃・防御レベル+1。ターン終了時に1減る: Maximum 15. Per 5 stacks, maximum Speed −1 and Offense/Defense Levels +1. Lose 1 at Turn End. Some passives also grant Shields according to Fabric stacks.
messages.生地によるレベル変化とバリアを確認し、バリアだけを削る小さな攻撃を続けない。: Check Fabric's level changes and Shields; avoid repeated small attacks that only chip at the Shield.
messages.コインごとに攻撃対象からランダムに1名を選ぶ。1枚目は必ずメインターゲットに的中: Each Coin chooses one random attack target. The first always hits the main target; each Coin's damage and on-hit effects apply only to its chosen target.
messages.主対象だけを回復して安心せず、副対象のHPも見る。使用時の全対象への振動付与とは: Check secondary targets' HP too. Distinguish this from the on-use Tremor applied to every target.
messages.保存威力と保存回数は別。通常技の8以上の条件は回数、破壊不能化の3以上の条件は威: Preservation Potency and Count are separate. The regular skill's threshold of 8 uses Count; the Unbreakable threshold of 3 uses Potency.
messages.Aルートは保存1／0から始まる。Bルートの初手から強化された状態と混ぜない。: Route A starts at Preservation 1/0. Do not mix it with Route B's enhanced opening state.
messages.広域へのマッチ勝利でも使用時効果と破壊不能攻撃は残る。HP回復を省かない。: Winning against the area skill leaves on-use effects and Unbreakable attacks. Do not skip HP recovery.
messages.ワンレグ戦で敗北するとフォーレグからやり直し。1戦目だけの勝利へ資源を使い切らな: Losing to One-leg restarts from Four-legs. Do not spend all resources on winning only the first battle.
messages.バリアを削り切り、保存の強化前に進める。: Break the Shield and progress before Preservation buffs build up.
messages.追加広域への高威力マッチ: High-Power clash against the extra area skill
messages.マッチ勝利時の半減と混乱しない効果を発動させる。: Trigger the clash-win damage reduction and Stagger prevention.
messages.連戦用の回復と資源: Healing and resources for consecutive battles
messages.次のワンレグ戦まで戦力を維持する。: Maintain fighting strength through the following One-leg battle.
messages.出現時、保存威力1,回数0を得る。: On entry, gain 1 Preservation Potency and 0 Count.
messages.Aルート通常進行。Bルートの強化個体とは別。: Normal Route A progression, separate from Route B's enhanced version.
messages.-対象の振動4につき、最終威力+1(最大3): - Final Power +1 per 4 Tremor on the target (max 3)
messages.-自分の保存回数が8以上なら、コイン威力+1: - At 8 or more Preservation Count, Coin Power +1
messages.[使用時]自分の保存回数が15未満なら、保存回数が2増加: [On Use] If Preservation Count is below 15, gain 2 Preservation Count
messages.保存回数8以上でコイン威力+1。対象の振動でも強くなるため、低い素の威力だけで放: At 8 or more Preservation Count, Coin Power +1. Tremor on the target also strengthens it; do not ignore it because base Power is low.
messages.-自分の保存が3以上なら、最後のコインが破壊不能コインに変更される: - At 3 or more Preservation, convert the last Coin to an Unbreakable Coin
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]振動3を付与、振動回数が2増加: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 3 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2
messages.[的中時]自分の保存回数が15以上なら、保存回数3を消耗して振動爆発。対象の振動: [On Hit] At 15 or more Preservation Count, consume 3 to trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.保存威力3以上で最後のコインが破壊不能へ変わる。的中で回数を増やされないよう通常: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, the last Coin becomes Unbreakable. Stop it with a regular skill to prevent Count gains on hit.
messages.速度に関係なく、このスキルとマッチ可能: Can clash with this skill regardless of Speed
messages.-自分の保存回数が10以上なら、保存回数10を消耗して基本威力+1,コイン威力+: - At 10 or more Preservation Count, consume 10 for +1 Base Power and +1 Coin Power
messages.-自分の保存回数が10未満なら、保存回数が5増加: - With fewer than 10 Preservation Count, gain 5 Count
messages.-自分の保存が3以上なら、このスキルの全コインが破壊不能コインに変更される: - At 3 or more Preservation, convert every Coin of this skill to an Unbreakable Coin
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]振動回数が3増加: Ⅱ [On Hit] Increase Tremor Count by 3
messages.[的中時]このスキルで保存回数を消耗したなら、振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: [On Hit] If this skill consumed Preservation Count, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.速度を問わずマッチ可能。保存回数10以上で強化、保存威力3以上で全コイン破壊不能: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Gains strength at 10 or more Count and fully Unbreakable Coins at 3 or more Potency. Maintain the clasher's HP too.
messages.このスキルが的中するたび、対象に振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Whenever this skill hits, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.-全ターゲットに振動3を付与、振動回数が3増加: - Inflict 3 Tremor and 3 Tremor Count on all targets
messages.-自分の保存回数が10以上なら、保存回数10を消耗して基本威力+2,コイン威力+: - At 10 or more Preservation Count, consume 10 for +2 Base Power and +2 Coin Power
messages.-このスキルのダメージと効果では対象が混乱しない: - This skill's damage and effects cannot Stagger its targets
messages.3枚破壊不能の広域乱射。マッチに勝つとダメージ−50%・この技で混乱しない。強い: An Unfocused Volley with three Unbreakable Coins. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill. Assign a strong skill and heal secondary targets too.
messages.ステージ開始時、ル・ノワール ウーステッド生地3を得る\nターン開始時、自分の体:
At Stage Start, gain 3 Le Noir: Worsted.
At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to (Le Noir: Worsted stacks)% of max HP, unless Staggered.

Le Noir fabric shapes the customer's figure with an armor-like, sturdy silhouette that holds its form.
messages.開始時・ターン開始: At battle start and Turn Start
messages.生地3から始まり、混乱中以外は数値%分のバリアを得る。バリアを残し続けずHPを削: Starts with 3 Fabric, granting a Shield equal to its stacks as a percentage of max HP while not Staggered. Break the Shield and damage HP instead of leaving it up.
messages.戦闘中、自分の保存回数を累計で\n- 3消耗するたびにル・ノワール ウーステッド:
For cumulative Preservation Count consumed during battle:
- Gain 1 Le Noir: Worsted per 3 consumed.
- Gain 1 Preservation per 10 consumed.

At 3 or more Preservation Potency, maximum Preservation Count +5.

Condense, gather power, and hold it in place. Keeping something unchanged can require more force than changing it.
messages.累計10消耗ごとに威力が増す。回数を使わせた直後も強化の進行を見る。: Every 10 Count consumed adds Potency. Check buff progression even immediately after Count is spent.
messages.ターン開始時、自分の保存威力が3,保存回数が10以上なら、強力なスキルを使用\n:
At Turn Start with 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count, use a powerful skill.

Power gathered in one place to hold something still will eventually burst out.
messages.ターン開始時の保存威力3・回数10以上: At Turn Start: 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count
messages.追加スロットの広域用に高いマッチ威力を残す。: Save high Clash Power for the extra-slot area skill.
messages.バリアを保有する状態で囚人から被撃時、自分の保存回数が1増加\n- 自分の保存威:
When hit by a Sinner while Shielded, gain 1 Preservation Count.
- At 3/5 Preservation Potency, gain 2/3 Count instead.

If a Shield remains at Turn End, gain 1 Preservation Count and 1 Defense Level Up next turn per Preservation Potency (max 3 each).

Convert outside forces that would cause change into a force for self-preservation.

A world where, however much one wishes to remain unchanged and still, something must always change.
messages.バリア中の被撃・ターン終了: Taking hits while Shielded; Turn End
messages.バリアが残るほど回数と防御を強化する。小さな攻撃だけで長引かせない。: A remaining Shield strengthens Count and defense. Do not prolong the fight using only small attacks.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「ル・ノワール店員 ギュスター: Le Noir Sales Associate Gustave (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Customer-service skills cannot be redirected. The targeted Sinner must equip the correct action: defense against the refusal to allow a fitting, and an attack against the invitation to try something on. Read each instruction and switch accordingly.

messages.ル・ノワール店員 ギュスターヴ（10章A）: Le Noir Sales Associate Gustave (Canto X A)
messages.イベントから入るLv10・HP590の戦闘。イベント前にマップで攻撃して入るLv: Covers the event-triggered battle at Lv. 10 and 590 HP, not the Lv. 13, 641 HP encounter started by attacking on the map beforehand. Defense Level 15 excludes additional Fabric modifiers. This is the normal Route A “Nail” progression. In this dungeon, Customer Level replaces each Identity's outside level. Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Form a team of up to 12, including each floor's three required Sinners. SP and E.G.O resources carry over after battles. The 1F required Sinners are Meursault, Rodion, and Ishmael.
messages.条件付きの破壊不能は効果欄に記載。接客技の「攻撃スキル」は基本攻撃とE.G.Oで: Conditional Unbreakable conversion is listed in effects. For customer-service skills, “Attack Skill” means basic attacks and E.G.O, excluding Counters and Clashable Counters. These skills cannot be redirected, so check the targeted Sinner's equipped skill.
messages.接客技ごとに、狙われた囚人の攻撃・守備を切り替える。: Switch the targeted Sinner between attack and defense according to each customer-service skill.
messages.案内不履行を増やさず、広域前は守備で被害と印を減らす。: Avoid accumulating Instruction Incompliance; use defense before area attacks to reduce damage and stacks.
messages.防御スロットへ攻撃3本で生地を減らす場合は、次ターンの敵強化も見込む。: Targeting the Defense slot with three attacks reduces Fabric, but also prepare for next-turn enemy buffs.
messages.「何でもお気軽に」は守備を装着すると破壊不能になり最終威力+5。逆に「ご試着いた: If the target equips defense, “Please, feel free to try something on, Dear Customer.” turns its Coins Unbreakable and gains +5 Final Power. Conversely, “I'm afraid this item cannot be tried on, Dear Customer.” is canceled by defense. Do not handle these similarly named skills with the same action.
messages.途中から広域で大きく削られる: Area attacks start dealing heavy damage
messages.案内不履行は最大3。広域は守備未装着の対象へ、この数値×100%のダメージ増加が: Instruction Incompliance caps at 3. The area skill gains +100% damage per stack against targets without Defense Skills equipped. Equip defense on the target and use the on-hit reduction of 1 Instruction Incompliance too.
messages.本社に在庫を確認する防御スロットをメインターゲットに3本以上指定すると、生地が3: Target the head-office stock-check Defense slot with at least three skills as their main target to reduce Fabric by 3. The enemy gains 2 Attack Power Up next turn, so prepare defense afterward too.
messages.店を回り、通常のイベントから戦闘へ入る: Visit shops and enter through the normal event
messages.固定出撃はムルソー・ロージャ・イシュメール。主力とHP回復を組み、精神力とE.G: Meursault, Rodion, and Ishmael are required. Bring your main attackers and HP recovery, using carried-over SP and E.G.O resources.
messages.買い物で顧客Lv11を目安にする。外での人格レベルを上げ直す必要はない。ムルソー: Aim for Customer Lv. 11 through shopping. You do not need to raise outside Identity levels. An official RENTAL Identity is also available for Meursault.
messages.1Fのル・ノワールの売り場を調べると戦闘へ進む。ストーリー前にNPCを攻撃して倒: Inspecting the Le Noir sales floor on 1F starts the battle. Attacking and killing the NPC before the story event causes FATELOST; follow dialogue and events to progress normally.
messages.狙われた本人の装着スキルを変える: Change the targeted Sinner's equipped skill
messages.「ご試着いただけない商品でございます、お客様。」は対象が守備スキルを装着するとキ: “I'm afraid this item cannot be tried on, Dear Customer.” is canceled when its target equips a Defense Skill. It cannot be redirected, so do not try to have another Sinner take over.
messages.「何でもお気軽にご試着くださいませ、お客様。」は守備を選ぶと破壊不能化・最終威力: “Please, feel free to try something on, Dear Customer.” becomes Unbreakable and gains +5 Final Power against defense. Equip a basic attack or E.G.O on the target and win the clash to prevent hits.
messages.「商品に傷がつかないようお願いいたします。」は基本攻撃・E.G.Oを装着すると破: “Please take care not to damage the merchandise.” becomes Unbreakable and gains +5 Final Power against a basic attack or E.G.O. Switch to defense to avoid additional Instruction Incompliance.
messages.お客様！商品にシワが寄らないようお願いいたします！: Excuse me! Please try not to wrinkle the clothes!
messages.広域へ勝っても、守備と案内不履行を確認する: Check defense and Instruction Incompliance even after winning against the area skill
messages.攻撃加重値7・1枚の破壊不能コイン。素の威力は7〜12で、マッチに勝っても攻撃自: One Unbreakable Coin with 7 Atk Weight. Base Power range is 7–12, and the attack remains after a clash win.
messages.守備を装着していない対象は、案内不履行の数だけ広域のダメージが増える。副対象も含: Targets without Defense Skills equipped take more area damage according to Instruction Incompliance. Check defense on secondary targets too.
messages.守備装着中に的中すると案内不履行が1減る。HPを回復しつつ、次の接客技まで印を溜: A hit while defense is equipped reduces Instruction Incompliance by 1. Heal HP and avoid carrying too many stacks into the next customer-service skill.
messages.通常技を止め、混乱へ攻撃を集める: Stop regular skills and concentrate attacks during Stagger
messages.シャツとスラックスは嫉妬・打撃。束縛や攻撃威力減少を受けないよう通常技で止める。: The shirt and slacks skills are Envy and Blunt. Stop them with regular skills to avoid Bind and Attack Power Down.
messages.防御スロットへ3本指定する操作は、生地を減らす代わりに次ターンの敵の威力を上げる: Assigning three skills to the Defense slot lowers Fabric but raises enemy Power next turn. Do not meet the condition only to become unable to survive the following attacks.
messages.怠惰1.5・打撃1.2を生かし、HP40%の混乱へ押し込む。精神力と資源は次戦へ: Use Sloth ×1.5 and Blunt ×1.2 to reach the 40% HP Stagger. SP and resources carry into the next battle, so avoid spending every E.G.O once the fight is stable.
messages.最大3。数値1につき被ダメージ量+5%。さらに顧客案内で相互のダメージ量が数値×: Maximum 3. Damage taken +5% per stack. Ushering Customers also raises damage dealt and taken between the units by 10% per stack, with +200% enemy damage against targets at 3. The area skill has a separate multiplier against targets without defense.
messages.受ける接客技の条件を守り、広域では守備を装着して的中時に1減らす。: Follow each customer-service skill's condition; equip defense against the area skill to remove 1 stack on hit.
messages.守備を選ぶべき接客技と、攻撃を選ぶべき接客技が混在する。全員へ同じ操作をしない。: Some customer-service skills require defense and others require attacks. Do not give everyone the same action.
messages.反撃・マッチ可能反撃は、接客技の「攻撃スキル」条件では基本攻撃・E.G.Oと同じ: Counters and Clashable Counters do not count like basic attacks or E.G.O for customer-service skills' “Attack Skill” conditions.
messages.案内不履行の被ダメージ増加、顧客案内、広域の増幅は別の効果。数値3を放置しない。: Instruction Incompliance's damage-taken increase, Ushering Customers, and the area multiplier are separate effects. Do not leave 3 stacks unattended.
messages.Aルートのイベント戦を掲載。先制攻撃やBルートの取り巻き付き個体とは数値が異なる: Covers the Route A event battle. Values differ from the preemptive encounter and Route B version with adds.
messages.接客対象の攻撃・守備: Attack or defense on the customer-service target
messages.対象変更不可の条件を本人のスキルで満たす。: Meet the unredirectable skill's condition with the target's own skill.
messages.バリアとHPを削り、40%混乱まで押し込む。: Deplete Shield and HP to reach the 40% Stagger.
messages.破壊不能の広域による持ち越しダメージを戻す。: Heal damage from Unbreakable area attacks before it carries into the next battle.
messages.シャツはこちらにございます。: Right this way for the shirts.

messages.Ⅱ[的中時]振動回数が2増加: Ⅱ [On Hit] Increase Tremor Count by 2
messages.嫉妬・打撃。束縛2と保存回数の追加を防ぐため通常技で止める。: Envy and Blunt. Stop it with a regular skill to prevent 2 Bind and additional Preservation Count.
messages.スラックスはこちらに陳列しております。: The slacks display is right here.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力減少2を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn

messages.ご試着いただけない商品でございます、お客様。: I'm afraid this item cannot be tried on, Dear Customer.

messages.狙われた本人に守備スキルを装着するとキャンセル。対象変更不可なので、別の囚人の速: Equip a Defense Skill on the targeted Sinner to cancel it. It cannot be redirected, so another Sinner's Speed cannot solve it.

messages.守備装着で破壊不能化・最終威力+5。対象の本人へ基本攻撃かE.G.Oを装着し、マ: Against equipped defense, becomes Unbreakable and gains +5 Final Power. Equip a basic attack or E.G.O on the target and stop it through a clash.
messages.商品に傷がつかないようお願いいたします。: Please take care not to damage the merchandise.

messages.[的中時]保存回数5を消耗して振動爆発。: [On Hit] Consume 5 Preservation Count to trigger Tremor Burst
messages.対象の本人へ守備を装着する。基本攻撃・E.G.Oを選ぶと破壊不能化・最終威力+5: Equip defense on the targeted Sinner. A basic attack or E.G.O makes the skill Unbreakable with +5 Final Power and adds Instruction Incompliance.
messages.[戦闘開始時]守備スキルを装着していない対象への与ダメージ量+(各対象の案内不履: [Combat Start] Damage against targets without Defense Skills equipped +(each target's Instruction Incompliance × 100)%
messages.[的中時]対象が守備スキルを装着しているなら、対象の案内不履行が1減少: [On Hit] If the target has a Defense Skill equipped, reduce their Instruction Incompliance by 1
messages.加重値7の破壊不能広域。守備を装着しない対象は案内不履行でダメージが増える。副対: An Unbreakable area skill with 7 Atk Weight. Instruction Incompliance raises damage against targets without defense. Check secondary targets' defense too and remove 1 stack.
messages.こちらの商品はサイズのご用意がないため、別途本社に在庫を確認いたします。: We don't have that item in your size. Allow me to check the stocks with the head office.
messages.[戦闘開始時]このスキルを使用するスロットをメインターゲットとするスキルが3個以: [Combat Start] If at least three skills have this skill's slot as their main target, lose 3 Le Noir: Worsted and gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn
messages.この防御スロットへメインターゲットとして3本指定すると生地−3。ただし次ターンに: Assign three skills with this Defense slot as their main target to reduce Fabric by 3. However, the enemy gains 2 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.ステージ開始時、ル・ノワール ウーステッド生地5を得る\nターン開始時、自分の体:
At Stage Start, gain 5 Le Noir: Worsted.
At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to (Le Noir: Worsted stacks)% of max HP.

Le Noir fabric shapes the customer's figure with an armor-like, sturdy silhouette that holds its form.
messages.初期の生地5に応じてバリアが付く。防御スロットへの3本指定と、怠惰・打撃の火力で: Initial Fabric 5 grants a corresponding Shield. Use three skills targeting the Defense slot, plus Sloth and Blunt damage, to deplete it.
messages.対象の案内不履行1につき、対象へ与えるダメージ量と対象から受けるダメージ量+10:
Per Instruction Incompliance on the target, damage dealt to and taken from that target +10%.
Damage against targets at 3 Instruction Incompliance +200%.

Le Noir serves customers according to the head office's strict manual.
messages.数値3では特に危険。案内を守り、広域の守備で印を減らす。: Especially dangerous at 3. Follow instructions and use defense against the area skill to reduce stacks.
messages.戦闘中、自分の保存回数を累計で\n- 3消耗するたびにル・ノワール ウーステッド:
For cumulative Preservation Count consumed during battle:
- Gain 1 Le Noir: Worsted per 3 consumed.
- Gain 1 Preservation per 10 consumed.

Condense, gather power, and hold it in place. Keeping something unchanged can require more force than changing it.
messages.回数を使わせるだけでは生地と威力の強化を止められない。長引かせず混乱へ進める。: Making it spend Count alone does not stop Fabric and Potency buffs. Avoid a long fight and reach Stagger.
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)9-50「リアン（9-50）」の攻略。指: Rien (9-50) guide for Limbus Company 9-50. Protect the Prescript's Target to deny fulfillment and build Karmic Consequence on the enemy. Assign the major skill to Ryōshū, and match physical types against the 3 Gloom skills later. Limit the Unbreakable hits that remain after Clash Wins.
messages.人差し指の親方 - リアン［前半］の外見: The Index Nursefather - Rien [First Half] appearance
messages.人差し指の親方 - リアン［前半］のスキル: The Index Nursefather - Rien [First Half] skills

The Index Nursefather - Rien [First Half] skills

messages.親方リアン［後半・仮面解除］のスキル: Nursefather Rien [Second Half · Mask Removed] skills
