messages.良秀必須・グレゴール出撃不可。良秀は精神力45、ほかの囚人は30から開始し、基本: Ryōshū is required; Gregor cannot deploy. Ryōshū starts at 45 SP and other Sinners at 30; Identities whose basic attacks all use negative Coins start at −25. The second half begins at 55% HP or less without a full heal. Both form tables refer to the same carried-over HP pool. The −5 Offense and Defense Levels from Rien's Mask and Sizzling Wound are shown separately.
messages.各コインの実際のダメージ属性はランダムな武器で変わる。表の属性はスキルの分類で、: Actual damage types vary with the random weapon used for each Coin. The table's type is the skill classification; use it when matching attack types against second-half Gloom skills. The three first-half Pride skills have inconsistent Power ranges and Coin values, so Power is marked unconfirmed. Conditional Unbreakable conversion from Unlock and Prescript targeting is described in the text.
messages.序盤は指令対象以外がマッチし、指令を妨害してカルマをためる。: Early on, have Sinners other than the Prescript's target clash to disrupt Prescripts and build Karmic Consequence.
messages.Furioso系は良秀でマッチし、ほかの味方を回復・弱体化で守る。: Have Ryōshū clash with Furioso skills; protect other allies with healing and advance debuffs.
messages.後半の怠惰は良秀、憂鬱は同じ斬撃・貫通・打撃で勝つ。: In the second half, assign Sloth to Ryōshū and beat Gloom skills with matching Slash, Pierce, or Blunt attacks.
messages.指令対象への全コイン破壊不能と、Furiosoの連続被弾を確認する。大技はほかの: Check for fully Unbreakable Coins against the Prescript's target and repeated Furioso hits. Assign major attacks to Ryōshū, who survives lethal damage while another ally lives; heal and apply debuffs in advance to protect the others.
messages.後半の憂鬱技で一度に崩れる: Second-half Gloom skills overwhelm the team
messages.指令耽溺中は同じ物理属性、または良秀でマッチ勝利すると弱体化する。打撃へ打撃、貫: During Indulgence in Prescripts, a clash loss against the same physical type or Ryōshū weakens them. Match Blunt with Blunt, Pierce with Pierce, and Slash with Slash. Assign the Sloth skill that only Ryōshū can clash with first.
messages.終盤のFuriosoに勝てない: The final Furioso clash is unwinnable
messages.Furioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo]は良秀の基本E.G.Oと: Furioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo] loses 20 Power when clashing with Ryōshū's base E.G.O. Save resources for Forest for the Flames. Keep other allies alive to maintain Ketsuen and Renketsuen's conditions.
messages.良秀と斬撃・貫通・打撃の強いマッチをそろえる: Bring Ryōshū and strong Slash, Pierce, and Blunt clashes
messages.推奨Lv60。良秀を含む出撃7名、控え4名。グレゴールは出撃できない。: Recommended Lv. 60. Deploy seven Sinners including Ryōshū, with four backups. Gregor cannot deploy.
messages.後半の憂鬱3種へ合わせる、高威力の斬撃・貫通・打撃を準備する。通常技で足りない属: Prepare high-Power Slash, Pierce, and Blunt skills for the three second-half Gloom skills. Fill missing types with E.G.O. Save Ryōshū's Forest for the Flames for the final major attack.
messages.HP・精神力回復と敵の威力を下げる手段を用意する。他人の鎖は次ターンの弱体化なの: Bring HP/SP recovery and ways to lower enemy Power. Chains of Others weakens enemies next turn, so use it before a major attack or Indulgence in Prescripts.
messages.良秀はゲブラーの刃を得る。この戦闘ではほかの囚人生存中に持続するため、一般的な1: Ryōshū gains Gebura's Blade. Here it persists while another Sinner is alive, unlike its usual one-turn duration.
messages.指令対象をマッチから外し、指令を失敗させる: Keep the Prescript's target out of clashes and make Prescripts fail
messages.毎ターンの人差し指の指令対象を確認する。良秀以外が選ばれ、リアンはその囚人を優先: Check The Prescript's Target - The Index every turn. A Sinner other than Ryōshū is chosen and prioritized by Rien. Take over clashes with other Sinners to limit hits.
messages.端末機IIでは指令対象への的中だけでなく、ターン内4回以上の的中でも指令を達成す: Device II succeeds through hits on its target or at least four hits in one turn. Do not protect only the designated target while leaving other attacks unopposed.
messages.指令を失敗させるとカルマが増え、防御・マッチ威力が下がる。解禁はHPやターンでも: Failed Prescripts add Karmic Consequence, lowering Defense Level and Clash Power. Unlock also advances through HP and turn conditions, so its activation alone does not mean disruption failed.
messages.HP75%以下へ進むと解禁III・加護9につながり、前半でも全体への与ダメージが: At 75% HP or less, Unlock III and 9 Grace can activate, raising damage against everyone by 30% even in the first half. Avoid pushing HP too far before a major attack without healing and debuffs ready.
messages.代行9・前半5ターン目からの大技: 9 Procuration · Major attacks from Turn 5 of the first half
messages.Furiosoは良秀が勝ち、残る広域被害へ備える: Have Ryōshū beat Furioso and prepare for remaining area damage
messages.代行[ヘルメス]9でFuriosoを使用する。前半は5ターン目、以降4ターンごと: Uses Furioso at 9 Procuration [Hermes]. In the first half, missing stacks are filled to 9 on Turn 5 and every four turns afterward. Check the count and use Chains of Others or similar debuffs the turn before.
messages.Furioso-Replicaは広域乱射・破壊不能で、マッチ担当が複数回被弾しや: Furioso-Replica is an Unfocused Volley with Unbreakable Coins, often hitting the clasher repeatedly. Have Ryōshū win, using her survival against lethal damage while another ally lives.
messages.良秀が生き残っても味方全員が安全になるわけではない。副対象のHP、憤怒耐性、弱体: Ryōshū surviving does not keep everyone safe. Check secondary targets' HP, Wrath resistance, and debuffs beforehand. The turn ends after the attack, so do not postpone healing.
messages.指令対象を生かし、加護とカルマを管理する: Keep the Prescript's target alive and manage Grace and Karmic Consequence
messages.仮面が外れるとHPを引き継いで後半へ移る。代行は0へ戻り、カルマがカルマ[フォル: Removing the mask starts the second half with HP carried over. Procuration resets to 0 and Karmic Consequence becomes Karmic Consequence [Fortuna]. Do not simply extend the first half's counters.
messages.後半の指令は指令対象の撃破。対象を生存させて失敗させると、カルマ増加と加護減少を: Second-half Prescripts demand the target's death. Keeping them alive makes the Prescript fail, increasing Karmic Consequence and reducing Grace. At 9 Grace, damage against everyone rises by 50%; beware of damage immediately after the transition.
messages.後半開始を起点に指令耽溺は2ターンごと、代行の不足分補充は4ターンごと。特殊パタ: From the second-half transition, Indulgence in Prescripts occurs every two turns and missing Procuration is replenished every four. Check equipped skills to see whether the special pattern or major attack is active.
messages.光の苗木MOROSITASを使うなら、後半序盤の通常技と指令耽溺を安定させる場面: If using MOROSITAS from the Sapling of Light, consider stabilizing early second-half regular skills and Indulgence in Prescripts. Prepare healing and debuffs together.
messages.怠惰は良秀、憂鬱3種は同じ物理属性で勝つ: Ryōshū handles Sloth; beat the three Gloom skills with matching physical types
messages.娘、覚えているか？これはきっとお前にしか受け止められないだろうは良秀以外マッチ不: Only Ryōshū can clash with “Remember This, Sweetheart? Only You Can Clash Against This Move.” Assign her first.
messages.憂鬱の3種は、打撃へ打撃・貫通へ貫通・斬撃へ斬撃を合わせて勝つ。良秀による勝利も: Beat the three Gloom skills by matching Blunt with Blunt, Pierce with Pierce, and Slash with Slash. Ryōshū winning also meets the weakening condition, but check her available slots first.
messages.属性が違うまま勝っても、破壊不能のダメージを十分に抑えられない。足りない属性は強: Winning with the wrong type does not sufficiently reduce Unbreakable damage. Use strong E.G.O for missing types and check both win probability and remaining damage.
messages.良秀が怠惰技へ勝つとじりじりと焼ける傷が増える。憂鬱3種も全て勝てればさらに増や: Ryōshū beating the Sloth skill adds Sizzling Wound. Beating all three Gloom skills adds more. Wounds also strengthen her base E.G.O's damage.
messages.最終Furiosoへ森羅炎象を合わせて決着させる: Match Forest for the Flames against the final Furioso to finish
messages.終盤のFurioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo]は良秀の基本E.G: The final Furioso[Lacrimosa-Crescendo] loses 20 Power when clashing with Ryōshū's base E.G.O. Assign Forest for the Flames to weaken the remaining Unbreakable damage.
messages.れんけつえんは敵のじりじりと焼ける傷に応じて基本E.G.Oのダメージを大きく増や: Renketsuen greatly increases base E.G.O damage according to the enemy's Sizzling Wound. Keep allies other than Ryōshū alive to maintain her protection from lethal damage.
messages.一方攻撃や振動・破裂・沈潜のダメージは大きく軽減される。マッチを取って殴り、強化: Unopposed damage and damage from Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are greatly reduced. Clash while attacking and finish without allowing more enhanced major attacks.
messages.人差し指の敵へ使うスキル威力−2・与ダメージ+20%。リアンは優先して狙い、その: Skill Power −2 and damage +20% against Index enemies. Rien prioritizes the target and makes every Coin of skills used against them Unbreakable.
messages.基本は別の囚人でマッチを奪い、指令対象を守る。: Generally take over clashes with another Sinner to protect the Prescript's target.
messages.最大9。3につき攻撃Lv+1。加護9の全対象ダメージ増加は前半30%、後半50%: Maximum 9. Offense Level +1 per 3 stacks. At 9 Grace, damage against all targets increases by 30% in the first half and 50% in the second. In the second half, also grants Protection according to Grace.
messages.同じ加護9でも形態で危険度が変わる。後半は指令失敗で減らす。: The same 9 Grace is more dangerous in the second form. Reduce it through failed Prescripts in the second half.
messages.最大100。ターン開始時、10につき防御Lv減少1、20につき脆弱1、40につき: Maximum 100. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10, 1 Fragile per 20, and 1 Clash Power Down per 40 stacks.
messages.序盤の指令を妨害して増やす。: Build it by disrupting early Prescripts.
messages.最大200。ターン開始時、10につき防御Lv減少1、20につき脆弱1、40につき: Maximum 200. At Turn Start, gain 1 Defense Level Down per 10, 1 Fragile per 20, and 1 Clash Power Down per 40 stacks. Second-half Protection also falls by 1 per 20 stacks.
messages.後半も指令対象を生かして増やし、大技のマッチも弱める。: Keep the target alive in the second half too, building stacks to weaken major clashes.
messages.攻撃・防御Lv−5。火傷または出血を付与する技からの被ダメージ+5%、両方を付与: Offense and Defense Levels −5. Take 5% more damage from skills that inflict Burn or Bleed, or 7.5% more from skills that inflict both.
messages.状態異常の技も火力に使えるが、一方攻撃には別の軽減がある。: Status-inflicting skills can contribute damage, but unopposed attacks face a separate reduction.
messages.最大5。攻撃・防御Lv−5。数値に応じて火傷・出血回数が増え、それらを付与する技: Maximum 5. Offense and Defense Levels −5. Stacks increase Burn/Bleed Count and damage taken from skills that inflict them. Strengthens Ryōshū's Renketsuen.
messages.特殊パターンを正しく処理して増やし、基本E.G.Oの火力へつなげる。: Resolve the special pattern correctly to add stacks and improve base E.G.O damage.
messages.付与する沈潜威力・回数+2。特殊パターンの憂鬱技が全コイン破壊不能となる。終了時: Inflicted Sinking Potency and Count +2. Makes every Coin of the special-pattern Gloom skills Unbreakable. Expires at Turn End and grants Karmic Consequence according to the number of skills that lost clashes.
messages.同じ物理属性で勝って残る被害も弱める。怠惰技は良秀が担当する。: Win with matching physical types to weaken remaining damage too. Assign the Sloth skill to Ryōshū.
messages.攻撃スキル使用で増え、ターン開始時9ならFurioso系を使用する。大技後に技別: Increases through Attack Skill use; at 9 at Turn Start, uses a Furioso skill. After the major attack, per-skill gain tracking resets.
messages.周期だけでなく現在の数値と装着技を確認し、前のターンに弱体化する。: Check current stacks and equipped skills as well as the cycle; apply debuffs the turn before.
messages.前半の良秀。ほかの味方1名以上生存中はHP1未満にならない。マッチ威力+1、的中: First-half Ryōshū. Cannot fall below 1 HP while at least one other ally lives. Clash Power +1 and hit damage +10%. Clash wins generate three resources; prevents Stagger and removes Stagger Thresholds.
messages.大技の担当にするが、良秀以外の味方も生存させる。: Assign her major attacks, but keep other allies alive too.
messages.後半の良秀。ほかの味方生存中のHP保護に加え、マッチ威力+2、的中ダメージ+25: Second-half Ryōshū. Retains HP protection while another ally lives, plus Clash Power +2 and hit damage +25%. Also gains buffs including +50% base E.G.O damage per enemy Wound stack (max 250%).
messages.森羅炎象を終盤の大技へ合わせ、傷による火力も生かす。: Match Forest for the Flames against the final major skill and use Wound-based damage buffs.
messages.全コイン破壊不能・ダメージ+100%などの強化と、基本攻撃・反撃の的中ダメージ1: Buffs include fully Unbreakable Coins and +100% damage. Basic attacks and Counters heal 10% of hit damage as HP (max 100 per skill). In 9-50, persists while a Sinner other than Ryōshū lives.
messages.一般的なターン終了消滅とは持続条件が異なる。ほかの味方を守る。: Its duration differs from the usual Turn End expiry. Protect other allies.
messages.良秀・ムルソー・ウーティス以外の囚人が戦闘開始時に得る支援。: Support gained at Combat Start by Sinners other than Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis.
messages.良秀の専用効果と混ぜず、実際の付与状況を確認する。: Distinguish it from Ryōshū's special effects and check which buffs are actually applied.
messages.攻撃・防御Lv+1、戦闘終了時に精神力10回復。段階に応じて指令と技の効果が変わ: Offense and Defense Levels +1; heal 10 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.
messages.精神力の低下を長く維持できるとは考えず、指令失敗で弱める。: Do not expect SP reduction to last indefinitely; weaken through failed Prescripts.
messages.攻撃・防御Lv+2、戦闘終了時に精神力20回復。段階に応じて指令と技の効果が変わ: Offense and Defense Levels +2; heal 20 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.
messages.攻撃・防御Lv+3、戦闘終了時に精神力30回復。段階に応じて指令と技の効果が変わ: Offense and Defense Levels +3; heal 30 SP at Combat End. Prescripts and skill effects change with the stage.
messages.最初のターンまでに指令対象へ的中する指令。達成による加護は最大3。: A Prescript to hit the designated target by the first turn. Grace from completion caps at 3.
messages.指令対象以外がマッチを奪う。: Have a Sinner other than the target take over the clash.
messages.4ターン目までに指令対象へ的中、または1ターンに攻撃が4回以上的中する指令。達成: A Prescript to hit the designated target by Turn 4, or land at least four attacks in one turn. Grace from completion caps at 6.
messages.対象だけでなく、ほかの的中も減らす。: Limit other hits as well as hits on the target.
messages.9種の武器を使う強力な技を使用する指令。達成による加護は最大9。: A Prescript to use a powerful skill with nine weapon types. Grace from completion caps at 9.
messages.代行の蓄積を確認し、大技へ備える。: Check Procuration stacks and prepare for the major attack.
messages.次の指令までに全ての障害物を排除する指令。: A Prescript to eliminate every obstacle before the next Prescript.
messages.後半は指令対象を優先して倒す。: In the second half, prioritizes killing the Prescript's target.
messages.指令対象を生かして指令を失敗させる。: Keep the target alive to make the Prescript fail.
messages.失ったHPに比例してダメージ量増加・攻撃威力増加を得る。技で得る呼吸威力・回数+: Gains Damage Up and Attack Power Up in proportion to lost HP. Poise Potency and Count gained through skills +1. SP difference with the target also increases damage.
messages.終盤はカルマが増えていても敵火力が高い。回復と弱体化を続ける。: Enemy damage stays high in the final phase even with Karmic Consequence accumulated. Continue healing and debuffing.
messages.手斧で肋骨を叩き割るときは…: When hacking through the ribs with a hatchet...
messages.打撃。破壊されずに的中すると呼吸2。: Blunt. Gain 2 Poise on a hit without Coin destruction.
messages.ランダムな武器による実際の被害も見込み、マッチと回復を優先する。: Account for actual damage from random weapons and prioritize clashes and healing.
messages.打撃。破壊されずに的中すると呼吸2・回数2。: Blunt. Gain 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count on a hit without Coin destruction.
messages.スティレットで肺を貫き刺すときは…: When penetrating the lungs with a stiletto...
messages.貫通。破壊されずに的中すると沈潜2。: Pierce. Inflict 2 Sinking on a hit without Coin destruction.
messages.貫通。破壊されずに的中すると沈潜2・回数2。: Pierce. Inflict 2 Sinking and 2 Sinking Count on a hit without Coin destruction.
messages.バスタードソードで肩と頭を叩き潰すときは…: When cleaving through the shoulder and the skull with a bastard sword...
messages.斬撃・コインダメージ+5%。破壊されずに的中すると次ターン攻撃Lv増加1（2回ま: Slash; Coin damage +5%. On a hit without Coin destruction, gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn (up to twice).
messages.斬撃・コインダメージ+7.5%。破壊されずに的中すると次ターンまで攻撃Lv増加1: Slash; Coin damage +7.5%. On a hit without Coin destruction, gain 1 Offense Level Up through the next turn (up to twice).
messages.レイピアで体に10個以上の穴を開けるべきときは…: When punching 10 or more holes in the torso with a rapier...
messages.貫通・コインダメージ+5%。破壊されずに的中すると次ターン防御Lv減少1（2回ま: Pierce; Coin damage +5%. On a hit without Coin destruction, inflict 1 Defense Level Down next turn (up to twice).
messages.貫通・コインダメージ+7.5%。破壊されずに的中すると次ターンまで防御Lv減少1: Pierce; Coin damage +7.5%. On a hit without Coin destruction, inflict 1 Defense Level Down through the next turn (up to twice).
messages.ハンマーで後頭部を潰すべきときは…: When caving in the back of the skull with a hammer...

messages.ターン開始時、\n- 解禁段階によって指令を得る\n- 良秀を除いたランダムな囚:
At Turn Start:
- Gain a Prescript according to Unlock stage.
- Apply The Prescript's Target - The Index to a random Sinner other than Ryōshū and prioritize them.
- All Coins of skills used against the Prescript's target become Unbreakable.
· If the target dies or cannot be attacked, use remaining skills against a random Sinner other than Ryōshū, prioritizing the lowest current HP.
· If all other Sinners are dead, apply the target status to Ryōshū.

Damage against the Prescript's target +2.5% per Grace of the Prescript (max 20%).
- At 9 Grace, instead deal 30% more damage to all targets.
Do you wish for me to build a family?

“How did fate bring me a husband like you?”

messages.このターンに指令を遂行したなら、\nターン終了時に精神力を10回復、指令の加護3:
If the Prescript was completed this turn, at Turn End heal 10 SP and gain 3 Grace of the Prescript (once per turn).

If it was not completed, at Turn End gain 8 Karmic Consequence; its target gains 1 Clash Power Up next turn.
- Without Unlock, gain 1 Grace at Turn End.
- At 9 Grace, cannot gain Karmic Consequence.
Do you wish for me to lose a family?

messages.ターン開始時にアルミュール・エヴェイエがあるなら、「ワンキック」が「ワンキック:
At Turn Start with Armure Éveillée, “Single Kick” becomes “Single Kick - Couture Multiple”.

Tremor Bursts raise Stagger Thresholds by 20% more.
- At 12 or more Preservation Count, instead consume 1 Count on Tremor Burst for 40% more Stagger Threshold advancement (applied per target).

If the target has no Stagger Threshold when Tremor Burst triggers, deal fixed damage equal to Defense Level Up on self (max 20).

Le Noir believes strong tremors can shake an opponent until their worth collapses. The more violently a target trembles, the more it changes from moment to moment. Le Noir's combat techniques are built on that belief.
messages.ワンキックの強化版と、振動爆発による混乱前進の増加を見込む。: Account for the enhanced “Single Kick” and increased Stagger Threshold advancement from Tremor Burst.
messages.バリアを保有する状態で囚人から被撃時、\n-対象の囚人に振動1を付与(スキルごと:
When hit by a Sinner while Shielded:
- Inflict 1 Tremor on that Sinner (once per skill).
Gain 1 Preservation Count (once per skill, up to three times per turn).
- At 3/5 Preservation Potency, gain 2/3 Count instead.

If a Shield remains at Turn End, gain 1 Preservation Count and 2 Defense Level Up next turn per Preservation Potency (max 3 Count and 6 Defense Level Up).

The harder one tries not to change, the closer one's existence moves toward change. Everything that exists is always heading somewhere; movement inevitably brings change.
messages.バリアを残すと保存回数・防御も増える。小さな攻撃を続けるより削り切る火力をまとめ: Leaving the Shield up adds Preservation Count and defense. Concentrate enough damage to break it rather than repeating small attacks.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 裁縫の王（10章A）の攻略｜Limbus Assista: 10-04 King of Needleworks (Canto X A) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「裁縫の王（10章A）」の攻略: King of Needleworks (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Equip Defense Skills on Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle each turn to prevent Naildle buildup. Defeat Needlekin quickly in the first half to limit body buffs and area attacks. After the transition at 1,087 HP, finish without relying on Stagger.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store A, B2F:: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store A, B2F: Yarn Nest Corridor
messages.10章Aルートの個体が対象。本体はLv43・HP1812、針っ子はLv35・HP: Covers the Canto X Route A version. Main body: Lv. 43, 1,812 HP; Needlekin: Lv. 35, 85 HP. Distinct from Route B's enhanced version and regular-battle Needlekin at Lv. 38 with 99 HP. Defense Levels exclude additional effects. Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis are required in a team of up to 12. Customer Level determines dungeon Identity levels; Uptie below III is raised to III. E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged.
messages.表示威力は針っ子の数と繭の泣き声による最終威力増加を含まない。破壊不能アイコンは: Listed Power excludes Final Power from Needlekin count and Cry of the Cocoon. Icons show permanently Unbreakable Coins only. Needlekin Running Stitch becomes Unbreakable against targets with at least 6 Bleed. The Naildle amount on Tacking Stitch is unknown. The Hand-stitch skill grants 1 Offense Level Up.
messages.毎ターン、舌に刺さった針を受けた2名に守備スキルを装着する。: Each turn, equip Defense Skills on the two Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle.
messages.針っ子を倒し切り、3ターン周期の「脇線の外側に…」をキャンセルする。: Defeat every Needlekin to cancel the side-seam skill in the three-turn cycle.
messages.「針数！針数！針数！」には80%軽減がない。受け役の耐性か回避で被害を抑える。: “Stitch! Per! Inch!” has no 80% reduction. Use the clasher's resistance or Evade to limit damage.
messages.囚人が行動不能になって倒される: Sinners become unable to act and are killed
messages.針釘がたまると、マッチ不可のピックステッチから剥製状態にされ、追撃で最大HP99: High Naildle lets the Unclashable Pick-stitch skill inflict Taxidermized, followed by fixed damage equal to 99% max HP. Start recovery by equipping defense every turn on Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle.
messages.広域の威力が高くて勝てない: Area skills have too much Power to beat
messages.針っ子1体につき本体の最終威力が1増す。3の倍数ターンは繭の泣き声でさらに+2、: Each Needlekin adds 1 Final Power to the body. Cry of the Cocoon adds another 2 on turns divisible by three; in the second half, it adds 3 every turn. Check beyond base maximum Power and prioritize Needlekin kills early. Shopping toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby also helps.
messages.マッチに勝っても針数で大きく削られる: “Stitch! Per! Inch!” deals heavy damage despite a clash win
messages.「針数！針数！針数！」は4枚破壊不能で、勝利してもダメージ−80%にはならない。: “Stitch! Per! Inch!” has four Unbreakable Coins but no 80% damage reduction on a clash loss. Assign a Sinner who is not weak to Pierce and Gluttony, or use sufficiently strong Evade. It differs from “Yap Yap Weft Yap” and “20 stitches an inch, minimum!!!”.
messages.混乱させた針っ子が動く・本体が混乱しない: Staggered Needlekin act, or the body cannot be Staggered
messages.ハンドステッチングは針っ子へ混乱を無視した追加攻撃をさせる。本体も泣き声のあるタ: The Hand-stitch support skill makes Needlekin perform extra attacks ignoring Stagger. The body is also immune to inability to act on turns with the Cry. Defeat Needlekin outright and do not abandon clashes expecting to Stagger the body.
messages.顧客Lv45と固定出撃を確認する: Check Customer Lv. 45 and required deployment
messages.買い物を進め、顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安にする。外で育てた人格レベルでは影界のレ: Shop toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Outside Identity levels do not raise dungeon levels.
messages.良秀・ムルソー・ウーティスが固定出撃。針っ子を倒す貫通火力、広域への高威力マッチ: Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis are required. Fill remaining slots with Pierce damage to kill Needlekin, high-Power area-skill clashes, Evade, and HP recovery.
messages.ムルソーの釘刺す者は、スキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る効果を: Meursault's He Who Nails adds two E.G.O resources of his skill's affinity on use, twice per turn. Its survival effect requires another ally alive at Turn Start.
messages.舌に刺さった針を守備装着で消す: Remove Tongue-pinning Needle by equipping defense
messages.剥製開始でランダムな囚人2名へ舌に刺さった針が付く。攻撃を並べる前に、この2名を: The Sewing Commences applies Tongue-pinning Needle to two random Sinners. Check those two before arranging attacks.
messages.対象の囚人に守備スキルを装着すると、針釘が1減り、舌に刺さった針が消える。守備を: Equipping a Defense Skill on an affected Sinner removes Tongue-pinning Needle and reduces Naildle by 1. The condition is equipping defense, rather than activating it.
messages.放置するとターン終了時に針釘3が増える。針釘は貫通被弾で減るが出血回数も増やすた: Leaving it through Turn End adds 3 Naildle. Pierce hits reduce Naildle but also add Bleed Count, so do not rely on taking hits to remove it.
messages.回避を使える囚人なら「針数！針数！針数！」への対処と兼ねられる。回避の威力と、現: Sinners with Evade can also use it against “Stitch! Per! Inch!”. Check Evade Power and the body's current buffs.
messages.召喚された針っ子を倒して広域を止める: Defeat summoned Needlekin to stop the area attack
messages.1ターン目の集合は次ターンに針っ子3体を召喚する。2ターン目は本体の広域へマッチ: The Turn 1 Assemble skill summons three Needlekin next turn. On Turn 2, clash with the body's area attack while concentrating spare fast attacks on Needlekin.
messages.針っ子はHP85・貫通耐性1.5。混乱させただけではハンドステッチングで攻撃して: Needlekin have 85 HP and Pierce resistance ×1.5. Stagger alone leaves them able to attack through Hand-stitch support, so focus damage to finish individual targets.
messages.3ターン目の「脇線の外側に縫い目が2本見えたらダブルニードル。失格！」は、使用時: On Turn 3, “Double stitching past the side seam? Double-needle! Rejected!” is canceled if no Needlekin remain when used. Aim to eliminate them before the body acts.
messages.針っ子を残すと1体につき大技のダメージが50%増し、攻撃後の処分で次ターンの攻撃: Each surviving Needlekin adds 50% major-skill damage, then grants next-turn Attack Power when disposed of after the attack. If you cannot kill them all, prepare for area damage; do not expect body Stagger to stop it.
messages.本体の通常攻撃・広域: Regular and area attacks from the body
messages.80%軽減のある技と、ない技を見分ける: Distinguish skills with and without 80% reduction
messages.「緯糸がこうだの」と「1インチあたりの針数は20以上で！！！」は破壊不能だが、マ: “Yap Yap Weft Yap” and “20 stitches an inch, minimum!!!” are Unbreakable, but winning reduces damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage. Assign strong skills to area clashes.
messages.「緯糸がこうだの」は広域乱射で、各コインが対象のうち1名を攻撃する。対象全員へ3: “Yap Yap Weft Yap” is an Unfocused Volley: each Coin attacks one of its targets. It does not hit every target three times.
messages.「針数！針数！針数！」には同じ80%軽減がない。マッチに勝っても的中時の針釘は付: “Stitch! Per! Inch!” lacks the same 80% reduction. On-hit Naildle remains after winning, so use a resistant Sinner or Evade.
messages.「ボタンをX字に縫いつけていなければ失格！」へ勝つと、受け手の針釘が2減る。勝て: Winning against “No cross-stitch buttons? Rejected!” reduces the clasher's Naildle by 2. Use it to lower stacks when a Sinner with Naildle can win.
messages.強制ターン終了に備え、混乱を当てにせず削る: Prepare for an immediate turn end and fight without relying on Stagger
messages.本体HP1087で即座にターンが終わり、第2段階へ移る。残りの行動が全て通る前提: At 1,087 body HP, the turn ends immediately and Phase 2 begins. Do not postpone healing or Needlekin kills assuming every remaining action will resolve.
messages.後半は2ターン周期の攻撃へ変わり、繭の泣き声 - 悪性で毎ターン最終威力+3。行: The second half uses a two-turn attack cycle and Cry of the Cocoon - Vicious grants +3 Final Power every turn. Immunity to inability to act means you cannot plan around safely damaging a Staggered body.
messages.マッチを取り、破壊不能の被害を回復しながら貫通火力で攻める。混乱区間を通過した際: Clash, heal remaining Unbreakable damage, and attack with Pierce. The 2 Fragile gained next turn after crossing a Stagger Threshold also creates an opening.
messages.針釘5以上でマッチ不可のピックステッチが追加され、剥製状態の囚人がいると「いいか: At 5 or more Naildle, an Unclashable Pick-stitch skill is added; a Taxidermized Sinner brings “Just... Eat!!”. Keep checking equipped defense in the second half and finish before dangerous stacks accumulate.
messages.毎ターン、剥製開始でランダムな囚人2名へ付く。守備スキル装着時に自分の針釘を1減: The Sewing Commences applies it to two random Sinners each turn. Equipping defense removes it and lowers Naildle by 1. If left through Turn End, gain 3 Naildle and remove it.
messages.攻撃を並べる前に対象を確認し、守備スキルを装着する。: Check affected Sinners before arranging attacks, then equip Defense Skills.
messages.特殊出血。貫通ダメージを受けると出血回数が1増え、数値が1減る。ターン終了時に出: A special Bleed. Taking Pierce damage adds 1 Bleed Count and removes 1 stack. At Turn End, gain 1 Bleed and lose 1 stack. At 5 or more, enables extra body skills and redirection restrictions.
messages.舌に刺さった針を消し、ボタンへのマッチ勝利も利用して蓄積を抑える。: Remove Tongue-pinning Needle and use clash wins against the button skill to limit buildup.
messages.最大2で、保有中は行動不能。被攻撃時に出血回数が1増える（1ターン3回）。終了時: Maximum 2; cannot act while active. When attacked, Bleed Count +1 (three times per turn). At Turn End, take 15 HP damage, lose 5 Naildle, and reduce this effect by 1. A hit from “Just... Eat!!” deals fixed damage equal to 99% max HP.
messages.追撃は破壊不能なので、通常のマッチ勝利だけに頼れない。針釘の管理で剥製状態になる: The follow-up is Unbreakable, so ordinary clash wins alone cannot protect you. Manage Naildle to prevent Taxidermized in the first place.
messages.第1段階の3の倍数ターンに得る。スキル最終威力+2。耳を塞いでも見えるクレームに: Gained on Phase 1 turns divisible by three. Skill Final Power +2. Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints grants immunity to inability to act on turns with the Cry.
messages.3ターン周期の大技は、混乱ではなく針っ子の全滅で止める。: Stop the three-turn major attack by defeating every Needlekin, rather than through Stagger.
messages.第2段階では毎ターン続き、スキル最終威力+3。泣き声が続く間は行動不能に免疫があ: Persists every turn in Phase 2 and grants +3 Skill Final Power. Immune to inability to act while the Cry persists.
messages.後半は混乱を当てにせず、マッチと回復を維持して削る。: Maintain clashes and healing while damaging the second half, without relying on Stagger.
messages.精神力−20以下のターン開始時に攻撃威力減少1、−45以下ではさらにダメージ量減: At Turn Start with −20 SP or lower, gain 1 Attack Power Down; at −45 or lower, also gain 1 Damage Down.
messages.マッチ勝利で本体の精神力を下げる。ただし、裏面が出ても破壊不能の攻撃は残る。: Lower body SP through clash wins. Unbreakable attacks still remain even on Tails.
messages.ムルソーがスキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る（1ターン2回）。: Meursault gains two extra E.G.O resources of the skill's affinity on use (twice per turn). If another ally lives at Turn Start, cannot die from damage that turn. Cannot retreat.
messages.資源補充と受け役に使いつつ、ほかの味方も生存させる。: Use him for resources and taking hits, while keeping other allies alive too.
messages.百貨店で目玉を使った買い物によって上がり、影界の人格レベルへ反映される。: Raised through department-store shopping with eyeballs; determines dungeon Identity levels.
messages.難しい場合は未購入の店を確認し、顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安にする。: If struggling, check unvisited shops and aim for Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby.
messages.舌に刺さった針は守備スキルの装着で消す。放置すると終了時に針釘3が増える。: Remove Tongue-pinning Needle by equipping defense. Leaving it adds 3 Naildle at Turn End.
messages.針っ子は混乱中でも本体の支援技で攻撃する。倒し切ってハンドメイドと大技も抑える。: The body's support makes Needlekin attack even while Staggered. Defeat them to limit Handmade and major skills too.
messages.針数！針数！針数！には、ほかの広域にあるマッチ敗北時のダメージ−80%がない。: “Stitch! Per! Inch!” lacks the 80% reduction on a clash loss found on the other area skills.
messages.HP1087で即座にターン終了。後半は毎ターン泣き声が続き、行動不能に免疫がある: At 1,087 HP, the turn ends immediately. In the second half, the Cry persists every turn and grants immunity to inability to act.
messages.ピックステッチの剥製判定は貫通被弾による針釘−1の後。被弾直前が針釘5なら必ず剥: The Pick-stitch Taxidermized check occurs after the −1 Naildle from taking Pierce damage. Having exactly 5 before the hit does not always mean being Taxidermized.
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安に買い物を進める。固定出撃の良秀・ムルソー・ウーティス: Shop toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Check Defense Skills and resistances on the required Ryōshū, Meursault, and Outis too.
messages.本体は貫通1.2、色欲・怠惰・暴食1.2。針っ子も貫通1.5なので、貫通火力をそ: The body takes ×1.2 Pierce, Lust, Sloth, and Gluttony damage. Needlekin take ×1.5 Pierce, so Pierce works well against both. Beware the body's Blunt ×0.5 and Pride ×0.75.
messages.強いマッチと回復に加え、針数を受ける貫通・暴食耐性や回避を用意する。E.G.O使: Alongside strong clashes and healing, prepare Pierce/Gluttony resistance or Evade for “Stitch! Per! Inch!”. Check sin resistances after E.G.O use too. Needlekin inflict extra Naildle on targets with Pierce or Envy resistance of at least ×1.5.
messages.針っ子を倒す速い貫通火力: Fast Pierce damage to kill Needlekin
messages.本体が動く前に針っ子を全滅させ、大技のキャンセルと最終威力低下を狙う。: Eliminate Needlekin before the body acts to cancel its major skill and lower Final Power.
messages.緯糸がこうだの・1インチあたりの針数への勝利で、破壊不能の被害を80%減らす。: Win against “Yap Yap Weft Yap” and “20 stitches an inch, minimum!!!” for 80% less Unbreakable damage.
messages.80%軽減のない針数と、後半の連続攻撃に備える。舌に刺さった針の解除には全員の守: Prepare for “Stitch! Per! Inch!” without 80% reduction and repeated second-half attacks. Check defense on every affected Sinner to remove Tongue-pinning Needle.
messages.HP1087で即座にターン終了し、第2段階へ移る。: At 1,087 HP, immediately end the turn and enter Phase 2.
messages.泣き声のあるターンは行動不能に免疫。混乱区間通過時は次ターンに脆弱2を得る。: Immune to inability to act on turns with the Cry. Crossing a Stagger Threshold grants 2 Fragile next turn.
messages.Aルートの召喚個体。通常戦闘の陽射しパッシブは持たない。: The Route A summoned unit. Lacks the sunlight passive of regular-battle versions.
messages.混乱中もハンドステッチングによる追加攻撃は発動する。: Extra attacks from Hand-stitch support activate even while Staggered.
messages.通常の2枚貫通。出血回数と威力を増やされないよう、マッチを取る。針っ子がいると最: A regular two-Coin Pierce skill. Clash to prevent Bleed Count and Potency gains. Surviving Needlekin also raise Final Power.
messages.対象の針釘1につき、ダメージ量+5%(最大25%): Damage +5% per Naildle on the target (max 25%)
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-80%、このスキルのダメージでは混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Damage −80%; this skill's damage cannot Stagger
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]針釘1を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Naildle
messages.3枚破壊不能の広域乱射。マッチに勝てばダメージ−80%・この技のダメージによる混: An Unfocused Volley with three Unbreakable Coins. Winning grants 80% damage reduction and prevention of Stagger from its damage, and stops Naildle applied on hits without Coin destruction.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血2を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Bleed
messages.4枚破壊不能。マッチ敗北による80%軽減はなく、勝っても的中時の針釘は残る。貫通: Four Unbreakable Coins without 80% reduction on a clash loss. On-hit Naildle remains after winning. Use a Sinner not weak to Pierce and Gluttony, or sufficiently strong Evade.
messages.加重値7の破壊不能広域。強い技で勝ち、ダメージ−80%と、この技のダメージで混乱: An Unbreakable area skill with 7 Atk Weight. Win with a strong skill for 80% damage reduction and prevention of Stagger from this skill's damage.
messages.ステッチが均一すぎるだと？手縫いのピックステッチじゃないだと？集合！！！: Too even, you say? Not pick-stitching, you say? Assemble!!!
messages.[戦闘開始時]次のターンに針っ子を3体召喚: [Combat Start] Summon three Needlekin next turn
messages.戦闘開始時の効果で次ターンに針っ子3体を召喚する。守備を削るだけで召喚を止められ: Its Combat Start effect summons three Needlekin next turn. Merely reducing defense does not stop the summons; save attackers to handle them next turn.
messages.ハンドステッチングしろ！！！: You want me to hand-stitch this?! HAND-STITCH???!!!
messages.混乱していない味方を優先して指定し、ダメージ量が常に0に固定される: Prioritizes allies that are not Staggered; damage is always fixed at 0
messages.[攻撃後]対象の針っ子がランダムな攻撃スキルを発動(混乱を無視): [After Attack] The targeted Needlekin uses a random Attack Skill, ignoring Stagger
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]このターンと次のターンに攻撃レベル増加1を付与: Ⅰ [On Hit] Grant 1 Offense Level Up this turn and next turn
messages.針っ子へ使う支援技。直接ダメージは0だが、混乱を無視した追加攻撃を誘発する。針っ: Support used on Needlekin. Deals 0 direct damage but triggers extra attacks that ignore Stagger. Defeat Needlekin instead of leaving them Staggered.
messages.脇線の外側に縫い目が2本見えたらダブルニードル。失格！: Double stitching past the side seam? Double-needle! Rejected!
messages.[使用時]戦場の針っ子1体につき、ダメージ量+50%: [On Use] Damage +50% per Needlekin on the field
messages.・戦場に針っ子がいないならスキルがキャンセルされる: · If no Needlekin are on the field, cancel the skill
messages.・この効果で倒した針っ子1体につき、次のターンに攻撃威力増加1を得る: · Per Needlekin killed by this effect, gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn
messages.加重値7・破壊不能。発動前に針っ子を全滅させればキャンセルできる。残すと1体につ: Unbreakable, with 7 Atk Weight. Defeat every Needlekin before activation to cancel it. Each survivor adds 50% damage and grants next-turn Power when disposed of after the attack.
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の針釘が2減少: [Clash Lose] Reduce the target's Naildle by 2
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の針釘1を消耗して固定ダメージ5: Ⅰ [On Hit] Consume 1 Naildle on the target to deal 5 fixed damage
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の針釘1を消耗して固定ダメージ5: Ⅱ [On Hit] Consume 1 Naildle on the target to deal 5 fixed damage
messages.マッチに勝てば、相手のマッチ敗北効果で受け手の針釘を2減らせる。針釘持ちの囚人が: Winning triggers the enemy's Clash Lose effect, reducing the clasher's Naildle by 2. Use this opportunity when a Sinner with Naildle can win.
messages.ピックステッチをわざと目立つように縫ったのかって！？同じように縫い潰してやる！: Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]針釘を5以上保有する対象に剥製状態2を付与: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 2 Taxidermized on targets with at least 5 Naildle
messages.マッチ不可。針釘5以上の対象へ剥製状態を付けるが、貫通被弾時の針釘−1が先に処理: Unclashable. Inflicts Taxidermized at 5 or more Naildle, but the −1 Naildle from Pierce damage resolves first. Equip defense to prevent buildup and consider Evade too.
messages.-針釘の数値が最も高い対象を優先して攻撃: - Prioritizes the target with the most Naildle
messages.針釘を5以上保有する対象は、この攻撃の対象を変更できない: Targets with at least 5 Naildle cannot redirect this attack
messages.対象の針釘1につき、ダメージ量+10%(最大50%): Damage +10% per Naildle on the target (max 50%)
messages.[的中時]対象が剥製状態なら、体力最大値の99%だけ固定ダメージ: [On Hit] If the target is Taxidermized, deal fixed damage equal to 99% of max HP
messages.[敵討伐時]自分の体力最大値の5%だけ体力を回復: [On Kill] Heal 5% of the user's max HP
messages.剥製状態の相手を優先し、的中時に最大HP99%の固定ダメージを与える破壊不能技。: An Unbreakable skill prioritizing Taxidermized targets and dealing fixed damage equal to 99% max HP on hit. Cannot be redirected from a designated target with at least 5 Naildle, so preventing Taxidermized is the top priority.
messages.対象の出血が4以上なら、最終威力+1: At 4 or more Bleed on the target, Final Power +1
messages.[使用時]対象の出血が6以上なら、全コインが破壊不能コインになる: [On Use] At 6 or more Bleed on the target, convert every Coin to an Unbreakable Coin
messages.[的中時]次のターンに貫通脆弱1を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Pierce Fragility next turn
messages.出血6以上の対象には使用時に破壊不能化する。振動と次ターンの貫通脆弱を避けるため: Becomes Unbreakable on use against targets with at least 6 Bleed. Avoid assigning Sinners with high Bleed to prevent Tremor and next-turn Pierce Fragility.
messages.出血回数・針釘・次ターンの束縛を付ける。通常コインなのでマッチで防ぐ。針釘の基本: Inflicts Bleed Count, Naildle, and next-turn Bind. Ordinary Coins can be stopped through a clash. The base Naildle amount is unknown.
messages.対象の出血4につき、最終威力+1(最大2): Final Power +1 per 4 Bleed on the target (max 2)
messages.[使用時]対象の出血1につき、ダメージ量+1%(最大20%): [On Use] Damage +1% per Bleed on the target (max 20%)
messages.[的中時]出血2を付与、出血回数が2増加: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]このコインを1回再使用(スキルにつき1回): [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Reuse this Coin once (once per skill)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の出血威力だけ貫通ダメージ(最大30): [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Deal Pierce damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency (max 30)
messages.1枚破壊不能で、破壊されずに的中すると再使用・追加貫通ダメージがある。マッチに勝: One Unbreakable Coin with reuse and additional Pierce damage on a hit without Coin destruction. Win to prevent extra effects, and prepare for the remaining hit. The reused Coin inflicts 2 Naildle.
messages.[戦闘開始時]次のターンに貫通威力増加1を得る: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Pierce Power Up next turn
messages.戦闘開始時に次ターンの貫通威力増加1を得る。守備中でも放置せず、倒して本体の強化: Gains 1 Pierce Power Up next turn at Combat Start. Do not ignore it while defending; kill the Needlekin to weaken the body and its major skill.
messages.[的中時]次のターンに貫通耐性弱化1を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 1 Pierce Resistance Down next turn
messages.出血6以上の対象には使用時に破壊不能化する。出血と次ターンの貫通耐性弱化を付ける: Becomes Unbreakable on use against targets with at least 6 Bleed. Inflicts Bleed and next-turn Pierce Resistance Down, so avoid consecutive Pierce hits.
messages.出血威力・針釘・次ターンの束縛を付ける。緯糸の出血回数増加とは効果が異なる。針釘: Inflicts Bleed Potency, Naildle, and next-turn Bind, unlike Weft's Bleed Count increase. The base Naildle amount is unknown.
messages.破壊されずに当たると再使用し、対象の出血威力に応じた追加ダメージも与える。マッチ: Reuses on a hit without Coin destruction and deals extra damage based on the target's Bleed Potency. Win the clash to prevent it. Reuse inflicts 1 Naildle, unlike Weft.
messages.次ターンの貫通威力増加を戦闘開始時に得る。針っ子は混乱させるだけで終わらせず、倒: Gains next-turn Pierce Power Up at Combat Start. Concentrate enough damage to kill Needlekin instead of merely Staggering them.
messages.戦場の針っ子1体につき、スキル最終威力+1: Skill Final Power +1 per Needlekin on the field
messages.針っ子を倒すと本体のマッチ威力も下がる。本体だけを狙い続けない。: Killing Needlekin also lowers the body's clash strength. Do not focus only on the body.
messages.耳を塞いでも見えるクレーム※Aルート: Unending, Unavoidable Stream of Customer Complaints [Route A]
messages.3の倍数ターンごとに繭の泣き声が聞こえる\n2フェーズ突入時、繭の泣き声が毎ター:
Hear Cry of the Cocoon on turns divisible by three.
After entering Phase 2, the Cry persists every turn.

Immune to inability to act on turns with the Cry.

After crossing a Stagger Threshold, gain 2 Fragile next turn.
messages.泣き声のあるターンは混乱を当てにしない。第2段階は毎ターン最終威力+3で、混乱区: Do not rely on Stagger on turns with the Cry. Phase 2 grants +3 Final Power every turn; attack during Fragile after a Stagger Threshold is crossed.
messages.ターン開始時、ランダムな敵2名に舌に刺さった針を付与: At Turn Start, apply Tongue-pinning Needle to two random enemies
messages.舌に刺さった針を受けた2名を確認し、守備スキルを装着して消す。放置すると終了時に: Check the two Sinners with Tongue-pinning Needle and equip Defense Skills to remove it. Leaving it adds 3 Naildle at Turn End.
messages.貫通耐性または嫉妬耐性が1.5以上の対象に付与する針釘の数値+1: Naildle inflicted on targets with Pierce or Envy resistance of at least ×1.5 +1
messages.貫通または嫉妬耐性が1.5以上の対象: Targets with Pierce or Envy resistance of at least ×1.5
messages.針っ子の針釘付与量が増える。受け役の物理耐性とE.G.Oによる罪悪耐性を確認する: Needlekin inflict more Naildle. Check the clasher's physical resistance and E.G.O sin resistance. Distinguish this from the Route A body's passive.
messages.針釘を保有する敵にスキルで出血威力を付与するとき、付与量が(対象の針釘の数値)だ: When a skill inflicts Bleed Potency on an enemy with Naildle, increase the amount by the target's Naildle stacks (max 3)
messages.針釘持ちへスキルで出血威力を付与: Inflicting Bleed Potency through a skill on a target with Naildle
messages.針っ子の出血付与量が最大3増える。針釘と出血を同じ囚人へためない。: Needlekin inflict up to 3 extra Bleed. Avoid accumulating Naildle and Bleed on the same Sinner.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 スーシェフ（10章A）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 10-04 Sous Chef (Canto X A) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「スーシェフ（10章A）」の攻: Sous Chef (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Defeat the Leather Wallet being prepared as food before the Sous Chef acts to limit healing and buffs from meals. However, repeatedly preventing meals triggers a different major attack through hunger. Track cooking outcomes and both Unbreakable area skills while lowering the main body's HP below 30%.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store A, B1F:: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store A, B1F: Food Court, First Battle
messages.スーシェフが調理しようとしている革の財布を先に倒し、食事による回復と強化を抑える: Defeat the Leather Wallet being prepared as food before the Sous Chef acts to limit healing and buffs from meals. However, repeatedly preventing meals triggers a different major attack through hunger. Track cooking outcomes and both Unbreakable area skills while lowering the main body's HP below 30%.
messages.Aルートのストーリー必須戦が対象。本体はLv35・HP1523、革の財布はLv3: Covers the mandatory Route A story battle. Main body: Lv. 35, 1,523 HP; Leather Wallet: Lv. 35, 93 HP. The battle ends below 30% main-body HP. Excludes Route B's enhanced version and Route A's optional rematch. Defense Levels are base values without added effects. Customer Level determines Identity levels inside the dungeon; outside levels do not carry in. Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Faust, Meursault, and Gregor are required in a team of up to 12.
messages.破壊不能アイコンは常時のものを表示する。革の財布「げえええっぷ」の条件付き破壊不: Unbreakable icons show permanent Coins only. Check effects for conditional Unbreakable conversion and Atk Weight increases on Leather Wallet's “Buuuurp”. “Aah! I'm on lunch break, you hear?” is a healing and buffing skill that deals no direct damage.
messages.「材料を得るんですよ」の対象の財布を、スーシェフが動く前に倒す。: Defeat the Wallet targeted by “I'm collecting ingredients, you hear?” before the Sous Chef acts.
messages.空腹3・元気5と大技の周期を確認し、食事を止め続ける場合も大技へ備える。: Check hunger at 3, energy at 5, and the major-skill cycle. Prepare for a major attack even when repeatedly preventing meals.
messages.シグネチャーはソースのない囚人でマッチに勝ち、被害を80%減らす。: Win against the signature skill with a Sinner without Sauce to reduce damage by 80%.
messages.材料を得るんですよにマッチできない: Cannot clash with the ingredient-gathering skill
messages.スーシェフが敵陣の財布へ使う、マッチ不可・対象変更不可の技。技そのものを止めるの: An Unclashable skill used on an allied Wallet that cannot be redirected. Rather than stopping the skill itself, have a fast Sinner defeat the Wallet at the end of its targeting line first.
messages.財布を倒しているのに料理される: Cooking still occurs despite defeating Wallets
messages.食べて･･･を持つ財布が、スーシェフへの一方攻撃を援護防御している可能性がある。: A Wallet with Please, eat me... may be intercepting unopposed attacks against the Sous Chef through Assist Defense. If it survives the assistance, extra cooking follows. Start with clashes against the Sous Chef and send spare attacks to Wallets.
messages.食事を止めたら強い広域が来た: Stopping meals triggered a powerful area attack
messages.食事できないとお腹が空いたんですよが増え、ターン終了時に3以上で次ターンに憤怒の: Failing to eat adds Got an appetite, you hear?. At 3 or more at Turn End, a Wrath area skill follows next turn. Instead of insisting on complete prevention, allow cooking once when hunger is high or save strong clashes and healing to survive the major attack.
messages.広域へ勝ったのに全員が削られる: The whole team takes damage despite a clash win
messages.大技は破壊不能なので勝っても攻撃は残る。暴食のシグネチャーは勝利でダメージ−80: Unbreakable major skills still attack after losing clashes. Winning against the Gluttony signature skill gives 80% damage reduction and prevents Stagger from its damage. The Wrath skill “Cooking!! Lemme get cooking, you hear?!” lacks that reduction, so check the skill name.
messages.B1Fの右側廊下へ入る前: Before entering the right-hand B1F corridor
messages.フードコートには右側の廊下から入るとすぐ戦闘が始まる。未購入の店や自販機を確認し: Entering the Food Court from the right-hand corridor immediately starts battle. Check unvisited shops and vending machines; aim for Customer Lv. 35 and Emerald.
messages.固定出撃はファウスト・ムルソー・グレゴール。残りは強いマッチ、財布を先に倒す速度: Faust, Meursault, and Gregor are required. Add strong clashes, Speed and Slash damage to defeat Wallets first, and HP recovery. SP and E.G.O resources carry over from the previous battle.
messages.ムルソーには釘刺す者が付く。自分のスキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2: Meursault gains He Who Nails. On Skill Use, it grants two extra E.G.O resources of that affinity, up to twice per turn. Use him to replenish resources.
messages.調理対象を先に倒し、本体にはマッチを組む: Defeat the cooking target first and clash with the main body
messages.最初に「材料を得るんですよ」の対象を確認する。保有効果が多い敵陣の財布が優先され: First check the target of “I'm collecting ingredients, you hear?”. It prioritizes an allied Wallet with many effects, so the target is not necessarily in the same position every turn.
messages.速い囚人から十分な火力を集め、スーシェフの調理より先にその財布を倒す。調理技に囚: Concentrate enough damage from fast Sinners to defeat that Wallet before cooking. Do not try to assign a Sinner clash against the cooking skill.
messages.本体の通常攻撃にはマッチを取る。食べて･･･を持つ財布がいる間、本体への余分な一: Clash with the main body's regular attacks. While a Wallet has Please, eat me..., spare unopposed attacks against the body invite Assist Defense and extra cooking; send spare actions to Wallets instead.
messages.斬撃と色欲・暴食が通りやすい。本体は打撃0.5・憂鬱0.75なので、その組み合わ: Slash, Lust, and Gluttony are effective. The body resists Blunt at ×0.5 and Gloom at ×0.75; do not rely solely on that combination to damage it.
messages.食事の成否が決まるたび: Whenever a meal succeeds or fails
messages.元気と空腹を見て、妨害の続け方を決める: Check energy and hunger before choosing further disruption
messages.スーシェフが対象を倒すとぶつ切りの料理材料を得る。対象の保有効果が多いほど追加材: Defeating a target grants Chopped Ingredients, with extras for targets holding more effects. The meal at the end of the turn converts them into healing and energy.
messages.食事は材料1につき本体HPを最大値の1%、ほかの敵を20%回復し、元気も与える。: Each ingredient heals the body for 1% max HP, heals other enemies for 20%, and grants energy. Too many meals strengthen Wallet attacks as well as the body.
messages.一方、食事を止めると空腹が増える。空腹3をためる前に、2～3ターンごとに一度は調: Preventing meals instead builds hunger. You can allow cooking once every two or three turns before hunger reaches 3. If doing so, also watch for 5 energy bringing the major attack forward.
messages.食事を許さず押し切る場合は、次に来る憤怒の広域を見込んで高威力技とHPを残す。元: If pushing through without allowing meals, save high-Power skills and HP for the next Wrath area attack. If both energy and hunger conditions are met, the Wrath skill takes priority.
messages.シグネチャーへ勝ち、破壊不能の被害を抑える: Beat the signature skill to limit Unbreakable damage
messages.「私のシグネチャーなんですよ」は4枚破壊不能・暴食の斬撃・加重値5。元気2につき: “My signature knife work, you hear?” has four Unbreakable Coins, Gluttony/Slash, and 5 Atk Weight. Gains 1 Coin Power per 2 energy and +3 Final Power if the main target has Sauce.
Sauce also lowers Sinner Offense Level. Assign a Sinner without Sauce to the major clash and win with a strong E.G.O or similar skill. Do not judge from the base maximum of 16 alone.
messages.勝利で敵のダメージ量が80%減り、この技のダメージでは混乱しなくなる。攻撃自体は: Winning reduces enemy damage by 80% and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. Attacks remain, so restore HP and watch for additional Bleed Count.
messages.使用後は元気を全て消耗する。混乱で発動を逃した場合は次ターンへ持ち越すため、混乱: Consumes all energy afterward. If Stagger prevents use, it is carried into the next turn; taking a Stagger does not remove the major attack.
messages.空腹3の次ターン・終盤: The turn after 3 hunger; final push
messages.別の大技を見分け、HP30%未満まで押し込む: Recognize the other major attack and push below 30% HP
messages.「料理！！！料理させてほしいんですよ！」は3枚破壊不能・憤怒の斬撃・加重値5で、: “Cooking!! Lemme get cooking, you hear?!” has three Unbreakable Coins, Wrath/Slash, 5 Atk Weight, and cannot distinguish friend from foe. Unlike the signature skill, it has no 80% reduction on a clash loss.
messages.強いマッチで破壊不能コインの威力を抑え、被弾する囚人のHPを確保する。使用後は空: Use a strong clash to lower Unbreakable Coin Power and maintain HP on Sinners taking hits. Consumes all hunger afterward and replenishes Wallets next turn.
messages.どちらの大技を使っても、シグネチャーまでのターン数カウントはリセットされる。固定: Either major skill resets the turn count until the signature skill. Check current skills and effects rather than only fixed Turns 4 and 8.
messages.必須の初戦は本体HP30%未満で終了する。財布の全滅を目指し続けず、十分に本体を: The mandatory first battle ends below 30% body HP. Do not keep trying to eliminate every Wallet; focus body damage to finish when an opening allows it.
messages.百貨店で目玉を使って買い物すると上がり、影界での人格レベルへ反映される。: Raised by spending eyeballs at department-store shops; determines Identity levels inside the dungeon.
messages.この戦闘は顧客Lv35を目安に、未購入の店を確認する。: Aim for Customer Lv. 35 for this battle and check unvisited shops.
messages.ムルソーがこの戦闘で得る。自分のスキル使用時、同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個: Meursault gains this in the battle. On Skill Use, gain two extra E.G.O resources of the same affinity (twice per turn). If another ally is alive at Turn Start, cannot die from damage that turn. Cannot retreat.
messages.資源の補充と受け役に使える。生存効果にはターン開始時の味方の条件があるため、ほか: Useful for resources and taking hits. Survival depends on another ally at Turn Start, so protect the other Sinners too.
messages.最大3。数値1につき攻撃レベルが1減る。スーシェフの複数の技には、対象がソースを: Maximum 3. Offense Level −1 per stack. Several Sous Chef skills gain Power against targets with Sauce.
messages.特にシグネチャーのメインターゲットには、ソースのない囚人を選ぶ。: Especially for the signature skill, choose a main-target clasher without Sauce.
messages.スーシェフが攻撃で対象を倒すと得る。対象の保有効果3種につき追加で1、追加分は最: Gained when the Sous Chef defeats a target with an attack. Gain one extra per three types of effects on the target, up to two extras. Consumed by meals for enemy healing and energy. Maximum 5; expires at Turn End.
messages.調理対象を先に倒す。食事そのものは直接ダメージ0なので、広域攻撃と取り違えない。: Defeat the cooking target first. The meal itself deals 0 direct damage; do not confuse it with an area attack.
messages.美味しいものを食べて元気が出るんですよ: Eat yummies and perk up, you hear?
messages.最大5。数値1につき攻撃レベルが1増える。本体はターン開始時に数値1につき精神力: Maximum 5. Offense Level +1 per stack. The main body heals 3 SP per stack at Turn Start. At 5, brings the signature skill forward. Wallets gain Unbreakable “Buuuurp” Coins at 3 or more and +2 Atk Weight at 5.
messages.食事を許した次ターンは、本体と財布の両方の強化を確認する。: After allowing a meal, check buffs on both the body and Wallets next turn.
messages.食事できないターンの終了時に本体と財布が得る。本体がターン終了時に3以上持つと、: The body and Wallets gain it at the end of turns without a meal. If the body has at least 3 at Turn End, it uses “Cooking!! Lemme get cooking, you hear?!” next turn.
messages.食事の完全阻止だけを目標にせず、空腹がたまったら次の広域への準備を優先する。: Do not aim only to prevent every meal; when hunger builds, prioritize preparation for the next area attack.
messages.フードコート待機の戦闘開始時に財布が得る。スーシェフへの一方攻撃を自分へ引き受け: Gained by Wallets at Combat Start of “Standby at the Food Court”. Intercepts unopposed attacks against the Sous Chef and uses the Assist Defense-only “I don't want to be cooked.” Expires at Turn End.
messages.援護後も財布が生き残り、本体が混乱していなければ追加の調理が発動する。本体への不: If the Wallet survives assistance and the body is not Staggered, extra cooking activates. Avoid unnecessary unopposed attacks against the body.
messages.材料を得るんですよはマッチ不可・対象変更不可。調理対象の財布を先に倒して止める。: “I'm collecting ingredients, you hear?” is Unclashable and cannot be redirected. Stop it by defeating its Wallet target first.
messages.食事を止め続けると空腹3から別の広域が来る。毎ターンの完全妨害だけに固執しない。: Repeatedly stopping meals brings another area attack at 3 hunger. Do not insist only on perfect disruption every turn.
messages.シグネチャーへのマッチ勝利はダメージ−80%。憤怒の大技に同じ軽減はない。: Winning against the signature skill reduces damage by 80%. The Wrath major skill has no equivalent reduction.
messages.食べて･･･の援護防御が追加調理を誘う。本体への一方攻撃の線も確認する。: Assist Defense from Please, eat me... invites extra cooking. Check unopposed targeting lines against the body too.
messages.HP30%未満で終了するのはストーリー必須の初戦。任意再戦・Bルートへ条件を流用: The below-30% ending applies to the mandatory first story battle. Do not apply it to optional rematches or Route B.
messages.顧客Lv35・エメラルドを目安に買い物を進める。外での人格レベル育成では影界のレ: Shop toward Customer Lv. 35 and Emerald. Raising outside Identity levels does not raise levels inside this dungeon.
messages.固定出撃はファウスト・ムルソー・グレゴール。ムルソーは公式RENTAL人格も利用: Faust, Meursault, and Gregor are required. An official RENTAL Identity is available for Meursault. Check Speed and damage to defeat Wallets first, plus Slash resistance.
messages.広域への高威力マッチとHP回復を用意する。E.G.Oは解析段階が補助されないため: Prepare high-Power area-skill clashes and HP recovery. E.G.O Threadspin is not raised, so check available effects and resource costs.
messages.速い斬撃・色欲・暴食の火力: Fast Slash, Lust, and Gluttony damage
messages.指定された財布を先に倒し、料理材料の獲得を抑える。本体への火力にも使いやすい。: Defeat the designated Wallet first to limit ingredient gains. Also useful for damaging the body.
messages.シグネチャーの威力強化を避け、勝利による80%軽減を取る。: Avoid the signature skill's Power buff and win for 80% damage reduction.
messages.HP回復と斬撃を受ける役: HP recovery and taking Slash hits
messages.破壊不能広域の被害を立て直す。釘刺す者のあるムルソーも、ほかの味方の生存と合わせ: Recover from Unbreakable area damage. Use Meursault's He Who Nails while keeping other allies alive too.
messages.ストーリー必須の初戦はHP30%未満で終了。: The mandatory first story battle ends below 30% HP.
messages.調理対象になる取り巻き。召喚による補充がある。: An add used as a cooking target. Summons replenish them.
messages.切るんですよ: Cutting up the meat, you hear?
messages.[使用時]対象にピリカラソースがあるなら、最終威力+1: [On Use] If the target has Fiery, Tongue-scorching Sauce, Final Power +1
messages.ピリカラソース持ちには最終威力+1。出血を増やされないよう、通常技でマッチを取る: Final Power +1 against targets with Sauce. Clash with a regular skill to prevent Bleed buildup.
messages.大きく切るんですよ: Cutting up big chunks, you hear?
messages.[使用時]対象のピリカラソース1につき、最終威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Final Power +1 per Fiery, Tongue-scorching Sauce on the target (max 2)
messages.対象のソースで最終威力が最大2増す。出血回数も増えるため、出血の多い囚人に受けさ: Sauce on the target adds up to 2 Final Power. Also adds Bleed Count, so avoid assigning a Sinner with high Bleed.
messages.[使用時]対象にピリカラソースがあるなら、コイン威力+1: [On Use] If the target has Fiery, Tongue-scorching Sauce, Coin Power +1

- Gain one extra per three effects the target had on Skill Use (max 2 extra).

A chef by title, but never acknowledged by the fifth-floor restaurant.

messages.料理材料は財布だけでなく、倒した対象から得る。被害を抑え、調理対象の財布を先に倒: Ingredients come from any defeated target, not only Wallets. Limit damage taken and defeat the cooking-target Wallet first.

messages.4ターンごとに強力な暴食スキルを使用(混乱により発動できなかった場合、次のターン:

- At Turn End with at least 5 Eat yummies and perk up, you hear?, use the powerful Gluttony skill next turn.

Making something edible and cooking are different. You merely... make it possible to eat.
messages.元気5で暴食技が早まり、空腹3で憤怒技が来る。両方を満たす場合は憤怒技を優先する: At 5 energy, the Gluttony skill comes sooner; at 3 hunger, the Wrath skill appears. Wrath takes priority if both conditions are met.

There is no wish to die.

With at least five types of effects on self, Offense and Defense Levels +3.

This does not even qualify as an ingredient.

Softening tough wallet leather can only achieve so much.

If the Sous Chef could not use “Aah! I'm on lunch break, you hear?” by Turn End, gain 1 Got an appetite, you hear?.

Though not made as an ingredient, the Wallet is raised as one; naturally it gets hungry too.
messages.食事が行われないターン終了時: End of a turn without a meal

These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted, using renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus damage on one target to reduce actions. Distinguish Flannel gaining Preservation when hit while Shielded from the Maison reflecting damage during defense.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store B, 3F: L: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store B, 3F: Le Noir Maison
messages.保存とウーステッド生地を育て、毎ターンのバリアと条件付き破壊不能で戦う敵。攻撃を: These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted, using renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus damage on one target to reduce actions. Distinguish Flannel gaining Preservation when hit while Shielded from the Maison reflecting damage during defense.
messages.10章Bルート3Fの個体が対象。フランネルLv46・HP541・基礎防御Lv48: Covers Canto X Route B 3F. Flannel: Lv. 46, 541 HP, base Defense Level 48; Maison du Noir: Lv. 45, 266 HP, base Defense Level 47. Both start with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count. Excludes B2F versions and regular-enemy stats. Customer Level determines dungeon Identity levels; Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Team size is up to 12.
messages.表示威力は保存・振動・防御レベル差による補正前。破壊不能はいずれも条件付きなので: Listed Power excludes Preservation, Tremor, and Defense Level differences. All Unbreakable conversion is conditional, so no fixed icons are shown. The Base Power increase from a Defense Level advantage of at least 5 in Fabric Density Disparity is unknown. Unfilled skill slots are omitted; changes between regular patterns and Count-based skills are not presented as a fixed sequence.
messages.攻撃を散らさず、メゾンなど倒し切れる敵へ集中して行動を減らす。: Focus attacks on an enemy you can finish, such as the Maison, to reduce actions.
messages.保存の威力と回数を分けて確認する。威力3以上の条件付き破壊不能に備える。: Check Preservation Potency and Count separately. Prepare for conditional Unbreakable conversion at 3 Potency.
messages.メゾンのスタンピング[反響]中は、バリアへの細かい攻撃による反射に注意する。: During the Maison's “Stamping [Reverb]”, watch for reflection from small attacks against its Shield.
messages.少しずつ殴っているのにバリアが戻る: The Shield keeps returning despite repeated chip damage
messages.ウーステッド生地の数値に応じて、毎ターン新しいバリアを得る。さらにフランネルはバ: Le Noir: Worsted grants a fresh Shield every turn according to its stacks. Flannel also gains Preservation Count when hit while Shielded. Focus one enemy at a time, or break the Shield and deal substantial HP damage that turn.
messages.マッチに勝ったのに振動や被害が残る: Tremor and damage remain after a clash win
messages.購入資格は？・欠陥だらけだなは保存威力3以上で最後のコインが破壊不能。フランネル: “Your purchasing rights, please?” and “Disqualifying defects, all over” make the last Coin Unbreakable at 3 or more Preservation Potency. Flannel's Stamping also makes every Coin Unbreakable when consuming at least 10 Count. Winning does not stop everything; check the clasher's HP and Tremor.
messages.メゾンを攻撃したらこちらが削られた: Attacking the Maison damages my Sinner
messages.スタンピング[反響]中、バリアがある相手へ攻撃すると保存威力×生地の数値だけダメ: During “Stamping [Reverb]”, attacking while its Shield remains returns damage equal to Preservation Potency × Fabric stacks. Avoid careless repeated low-damage multi-hit attacks; concentrate enough damage to finish through the Shield or handle another enemy first.
messages.加重値4の保存のためにがどこへ飛んでいるか分からない: Where does the 4 Atk Weight “For Conservation” skill go?
messages.敵陣の味方へ使う、直接ダメージ0の支援技。囚人全体への広域と取り違えない。敵の保: It is support used on enemy allies, dealing 0 direct damage. Do not confuse it with an area attack against Sinners. It strengthens Preservation, defense, and Fabric, so check buffs afterward before assigning clashes.
messages.顧客レベルと、倒す敵を決める火力を用意する: Prepare Customer Level and enough damage to finish a chosen enemy
messages.買い物を進め、顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安にする。この時点では顧客Lv51: Shop toward Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire. Lv. 51 is reachable at this point. Raising only outside Identity levels does not change dungeon levels.
messages.敵は怠惰が1.5。フランネルは色欲も1.25、メゾンは打撃1.2なので、通しやす: Enemies take ×1.5 Sloth damage. Flannel also takes ×1.25 Lust; the Maison takes ×1.2 Blunt. Bring effective attacks and strong clashes. Both resist Slash at ×0.8.
messages.初期保存は威力1・回数0、生地は5。威力と回数は増える経路が違うため、現在の数字: Starts with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count and 5 Fabric. Potency and Count grow through different effects, so check both numbers separately.
messages.通常技へマッチし、倒し切れる敵へ集中する: Clash with regular skills and focus on enemies you can finish
messages.購入履歴は？・あなたの値段は？などにマッチを取り、的中による保存の追加獲得や振動: Clash with “Your purchase history, please?”, “Your price range, please?”, and similar skills to prevent extra on-hit Preservation and Tremor. On-use Count gains remain after winning.
messages.余った攻撃は、HPの少ないメゾンなど倒し切れる敵へ集める。全員へ小さく攻撃してバ: Send spare attacks to a target you can finish, such as the lower-HP Maison. Avoid small attacks spread across everyone that only chip at Shields.
messages.フランネルはバリアがある間、被撃で保存回数1を得る。攻めるなら火力をまとめて早く: Flannel gains 1 Preservation Count when hit while Shielded. Concentrate damage to remove the Shield quickly and continue into HP.
messages.両者の通常の混乱区間はHP0。HPを少し削って混乱を取る計画には頼らず、マッチと: Both enemies normally have Stagger Thresholds at 0 HP. Do not plan around an early Stagger from chip damage; use clashes and kills to stop actions.
messages.敵への支援先と、消耗後の強化を確認する: Check support targets and buffs after consumption
messages.生地強化と保存のためには敵陣の味方へ使う技で、味方への直接ダメージは0。フランネ: “Reinforce Fabric” and “For Conservation” support enemy allies and deal 0 damage to them. They raise Flannel's own Defense Level and the target's Charge Count. Preservation, as a special Charge, is affected too.
messages.対象の充電回数が最大なら、次ターンに防御レベル増加3とウーステッド生地5が付く。: If the target's Charge Count is capped, it gains 3 Defense Level Up and 5 Le Noir: Worsted next turn. Decide where to focus attacks before that target grows stronger.
messages.保存のためには、回数が10未満なら10まで補充し、その量に応じて自分に脆弱を得る: “For Conservation” refills Count to 10 if lower and gives the user Fragile according to the amount added. It consumes all Count after attacking, so a low remaining Count afterward does not guarantee safety.
messages.保存は累計3消耗ごとに生地1、累計10消耗ごとに保存威力1を得る。使った回数は防: Every 3 Preservation Count consumed cumulatively grants 1 Fabric; every 10 grants 1 Potency. Consumption strengthens defense and later skills, so avoid letting support repeat through a long battle.
messages.保存威力3以上・保存回数が高いとき: At least 3 Preservation Potency or high Count
messages.破壊不能になる条件を見て、強いマッチを合わせる: Check Unbreakable conditions and assign strong clashes
messages.購入資格は？と欠陥だらけだなは、保存回数と受け手の振動の合計6につきコイン威力+: “Your purchasing rights, please?” and “Disqualifying defects, all over” gain +1 Coin Power per 6 combined Preservation Count and target Tremor (max 2). At 3 or more Preservation Potency, the last Coin also becomes Unbreakable.
messages.スタンピング[フランネル]は保存回数を最大15消耗し、最大HPの消耗回数×2%分: “Stamping [Flannel]” consumes up to 15 Preservation Count for a Shield equal to (Count consumed × 2)% max HP, lasting through next turn. Consuming at least 10 grants +2 Coin Power and makes all three Coins Unbreakable.
messages.スタンピングは振動-崩壊への変換と振動爆発も行う。強いマッチでコインの威力を抑え: Stamping also converts to Tremor - Decay and triggers Tremor Burst. Use a strong clash to lower Coin Power; avoid low-HP or high-Tremor targets. It has no 80% damage reduction on a clash win.
messages.保存威力3以上なら振動付与量も増える。敵より防御レベルが低い受け手には、防御差に: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, more Tremor is inflicted. A target with lower Defense Level also takes extra damage from the level gap. Check actual Power predictions and target HP.
messages.反射を見分け、最後まで集中して倒す: Recognize reflection and focus damage to the finish
messages.メゾンのスタンピング[反響]は防御技。バリア中に攻撃されると保存威力×ウーステッ: The Maison's “Stamping [Reverb]” is a Defense Skill. When attacked while Shielded, it returns damage equal to Preservation Potency × Le Noir: Worsted stacks. Avoid repeatedly chipping at a Shield that remains intact.
messages.倒し切れる火力があるならバリアごと削る。反射で危険な囚人は別の敵へのマッチへ回し: If enough damage is available, finish through the Shield. Redirect Sinners endangered by reflection to clashes against another enemy and limit unnecessary damage.
messages.バリアと生地の強化を繰り返させないよう、残った敵にも火力をまとめる。保存回数が下: Focus damage on remaining enemies to stop repeated Shield and Fabric buffs. Even when Count falls, keep checking accumulated Potency and conditional Unbreakable conversion.
messages.特殊充電。初期は威力1・回数0で、回数の基本最大値20。終了時に回数が1減る。充: A special Charge starting at 1 Potency / 0 Count, with a base Count cap of 20. Lose 1 Count at Turn End; effects changing Charge Potency or Count also apply. Every 3 Count cumulatively consumed grants 1 Fabric, and every 10 grants 1 Preservation Potency. At 3 or more Potency, Count cap +5.
messages.回数を使わせても威力は育つ。両方を確認し、長期戦を避けて1体ずつ倒す。: Spending Count still builds Potency. Check both and defeat enemies one at a time before the fight drags on.
messages.最大15。数値5につき速度最大値−1・攻撃レベル+1・防御レベル+1。終了時に数: Maximum 15. Per 5 stacks, maximum Speed −1, Offense Level +1, and Defense Level +1. Lose 1 at Turn End. Gain 5 at Stage Start, then a Shield equal to stacks% of max HP each Turn Start.
messages.毎ターンのバリアと防御上昇を見越して集中攻撃する。メゾンの反射ダメージにもこの数: Focus damage with renewed Shields and defense buffs in mind. The Maison's reflection uses these stacks too.
messages.振動威力4につき防御レベルが1減る。振動爆発で混乱区間が威力分前進し、終了時に回: Defense Level −1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Tremor Burst raises Stagger Threshold by Potency; lose 1 Count at Turn End.
messages.通常の振動が変換されると防御も落ちる。振動の少ない囚人を強い技の受け手にし、混乱: Conversion from regular Tremor also lowers defense. Assign strong skills to Sinners with less Tremor to avoid Stagger and increased damage taken.
messages.敵の防御レベルが対象より高いと、差1につき与ダメージ+3%（最大30%）。差5以: If enemy Defense Level exceeds the target's, damage +3% per level of difference (max 30%). At a gap of at least 5, Base Power also rises by an unknown amount. At 3/5 or more Preservation Potency, inflicted Tremor Potency +1/+2.

messages.百貨店で目玉を使って買い物すると上がり、影界の人格レベルへ反映される。: Raised by department-store shopping with eyeballs; determines dungeon Identity levels.
messages.顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安に準備する。: Prepare for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire.
messages.フランネルの品質保存と、メゾンの検品保存は別。バリア中の被撃による保存回数増加は: Flannel's Quality Preservation and the Maison's Inspection Preservation are distinct. Preservation Count gained from taking hits while Shielded belongs to Flannel.
messages.生地強化・保存のためには敵陣への支援技。加重値だけを見て囚人への広域攻撃と判断し: “Reinforce Fabric” and “For Conservation” support the enemy team. Atk Weight alone does not make them area attacks against Sinners.
messages.メゾンのスタンピング[反響]は防御中のバリアへの攻撃にダメージを返す。フランネル: The Maison's “Stamping [Reverb]” reflects damage from attacks against its Shield while defending. It differs from Flannel's Attack Skill.
messages.破壊不能はいずれも条件付き。保存威力3と、スタンピングの保存回数10以上消耗を混: All Unbreakable conversion is conditional. Distinguish the 3 Potency condition from Stamping consuming at least 10 Count.
messages.生地密度の格差の追加基本威力と、正確な行動の切り替え順は未確定。実際の技と予測威: Extra Base Power from Fabric Density Disparity and the exact action-switching order are unconfirmed. Check actual skills and predicted Power.
messages.顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安にする。影界では外で育てた人格レベルを持ち込ま: Aim for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire. Outside Identity levels do not carry into the dungeon.
messages.怠惰の高火力と強いマッチをそろえる。フランネルには色欲、メゾンには打撃も通しやす: Bring high Sloth damage and strong clashes. Lust works well against Flannel and Blunt against the Maison.
messages.振動と破壊不能の被害に備えてHP回復を用意する。受け手の打撃・嫉妬・怠惰耐性も確: Prepare HP recovery for Tremor and Unbreakable damage. Check the target's Blunt, Envy, and Sloth resistances too.

messages.保存・振動で強くなる技へ勝ち、振動と保存の追加獲得を抑える。: Beat skills strengthened by Preservation and Tremor to limit extra Tremor and Preservation gains.
messages.HP回復と打撃を受ける役: HP recovery and taking Blunt hits
messages.条件付き破壊不能と、メゾンの反射による被害を戻す。: Recover damage from conditional Unbreakable Coins and Maison reflection.

messages.初期保存は威力1・回数0。スタンピング[反響]の反射に注意。: Starts with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count. Watch for “Stamping [Reverb]” reflection.
messages.使用時の保存回数+2は勝っても残るが、的中時の追加獲得と振動は防げる。バリアがあ: The on-use +2 Count remains after winning, but additional on-hit gains and Tremor can be prevented. A Shield also raises damage, so take the clash.

messages.加重値4だが敵陣への支援で、味方への直接ダメージは0。保存回数を補充して支援に使: Despite 4 Atk Weight, it supports enemy allies and deals 0 direct damage to them. Refills Count, uses it for support, then consumes it all. Consumption builds Fabric and Potency; avoid a prolonged fight.

messages.バリア中に殴ると、保存威力×ウーステッド生地の数値だけダメージを返す防御技。小さ: A Defense Skill reflecting Preservation Potency × Fabric stacks when attacked while Shielded. Choose focused damage that can finish the enemy, or handle another target instead of repeated small attacks.
