messages.【リンバス】10-04 リナモヴィブル（10章A）の攻略｜Limbus Assi: 10-04 L'Inamovible (Canto X A) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「リナモヴィブル（10章A）」: L'Inamovible (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. A Blunt-heavy fight alternating between the normal pattern and Changing Room. Its 500 Shield need not be broken immediately; waiting with defense is an option. In the normal pattern, recognize the skill reduced when unopposed and prepare for Unbreakable attacks below half HP.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store A, 3F: L: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store A, 3F: Le Rouge Boutique
messages.10章Aルート3Fの個体が対象。本体Lv43・HP1740・基礎防御Lv48。固: Covers the Canto X Route A 3F version: Lv. 43, 1,740 HP, base Defense Level 48. Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis are required in a team of up to 12. Customer Level determines dungeon Identity levels; Uptie below III is raised to III. E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Base values exclude SP-based Offense/Defense Level changes and skill-based Defense Level reductions.
messages.全て減算コイン。基本威力は減算前の高い側を表示し、脈動・新作服・使用時の最終威力: All Coins are negative. Base Power shows the higher value before subtraction; listed ranges exclude Pulsation, New Releases, and on-use Final Power buffs. “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” becomes Unbreakable conditionally below 50% HP, so its icons do not show permanent conversion. The Changing Room skill is displayed as a Clashable Counter.
messages.試着室では全員守備で待つ方法がある。バリア500へ無理に攻撃を重ねない。: In the Changing Room, everyone can wait with defense. Do not force repeated attacks into the 500 Shield.
messages.「確かに私と共にいてくださる！」は一方攻撃時に80%軽減。マッチ時とは被害が異な: “The Voice is with me, this I know!” deals 80% less damage when unopposed. Clashing changes the damage taken.
messages.HP50%未満の「搔き取れ！」は破壊不能化する。色欲・打撃を受けられる囚人に任せ: Below 50% HP, “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” becomes Unbreakable. Assign a Sinner who can take Lust and Blunt damage.
messages.試着室に入ったらHPを減らせない: HP cannot be damaged in the Changing Room
messages.試着室中は体力ダメージを受けず、信仰によるバリア500を持つ。攻撃して削る方法の: The Changing Room prevents HP damage and grants a 500 Devotion Shield. You can attack to deplete it, or generally wait two turns with everyone defending. Avoid unnecessary attacks that add Counters and Persecution.
messages.毎ターンの単体技へ勝っても被害と回復が大きい: The single-target skill deals heavy damage and heals the enemy even after clash wins
messages.「確かに私と共にいてくださる！」は一方攻撃時にダメージ−80%、マッチ敗北後に的: “The Voice is with me, this I know!” deals 80% less damage when unopposed; hits after a clash loss heal the enemy for the damage dealt. One option is to take the reduced unopposed attack with a Blunt/Gluttony-resistant Sinner and save strong clashes for other dangerous skills.
messages.HP半分を切ったあたりから急に倒される: Sinners suddenly die after the enemy falls below half HP
messages.戦闘開始時のHPが50%未満だと「搔き取れ！」の全コインが破壊不能になる。さらに: If below 50% HP at Combat Start, “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” makes both Coins Unbreakable. Pulsation Potency and Count can add up to 110% damage. Check Lust/Blunt resistance and healing rather than trusting the listed maximum of 13.
messages.倒せるはずの攻撃で回復され、ターンが終わった: A finishing attack instead heals the enemy and ends the turn
messages.通常パターン中にHP10未満になるダメージを初めて受けると、そのダメージを受けず: In the normal pattern, the first damage that would lower HP below 10 is negated, heals 30% max HP, and enters the Changing Room. This happens once per encounter; resolve the room, then deplete HP again.
messages.顧客Lv45と打撃耐性を確認する: Check Customer Lv. 45 and Blunt resistance
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安に買い物を進める。リナモヴィブルとB2F針っ子の期間限: Shop toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Missing both L'Inamovible's and the B2F Needlekin's limited-time shops leaves the level at 44, so check shopping opportunities as you progress.
messages.固定出撃はムルソー・シンクレア・ウーティス。残りの枠に強いマッチ、打撃を受ける耐: Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis are required. Fill remaining slots with strong clashes, Blunt resistance, and HP recovery. Lust and Sloth are effective for offense.
messages.ムルソーの釘刺す者は、スキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る効果を: Meursault's He Who Nails adds two resources of his skill's affinity on use, twice per turn. With another ally alive at Turn Start, he cannot die from damage that turn. Use him for resources and taking hits.
messages.通常パターン・1～2ターン周期: Normal pattern · One- and two-turn cycles
messages.危険なマッチを取り、一方攻撃で軽減される技を分ける: Clash with dangerous skills and distinguish the skill reduced when unopposed
messages.通常時は7行動。2ターン周期で「この世界に意味はあったんだ！」と「搔き取れ！引き: Normally takes seven actions. “So this world wasn't meaningless after all!” and “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” join every two turns. Negative Coins favor high Power at lower SP; lowering enemy SP is not a debuff by itself.
messages.通常攻撃と色欲の強い技にはマッチを取る。特に私の信仰は無意味じゃなかったんだ！は: Clash with regular attacks and strong Lust skills. In particular, “My faith wasn't in vain!” gains +2 Final Power when consuming 5 Pulsation Count on use.
messages.毎ターンの「確かに私と共にいてくださる！」は、一方攻撃で通した場合にダメージが8: Each turn's “The Voice is with me, this I know!” deals 80% less damage when left unopposed. Choose a Blunt/Gluttony-resistant target and use clashes elsewhere. Account for additional Bleed damage and avoid assigning a low-HP Sinner.
messages.本体は物理3種とも耐性0.9だが、色欲・怠惰は1.5。憂鬱は0.5なので、憂鬱だ: All physical resistances are ×0.9, but Lust and Sloth are ×1.5. Gloom is ×0.5; do not rely only on Gloom damage.
messages.広域の対象と、破壊不能になる色欲技を確認する: Check area targets and the Lust skill's Unbreakable conversion
messages.「この世界に意味はあったんだ！」は加重値7・1枚破壊不能。対象のうち守備スキル装: “So this world wasn't meaningless after all!” has 7 Atk Weight and one Unbreakable Coin. Damage falls by 10% per target with defense equipped, so switch to defense when HP is strained.
messages.攻撃スキルを装着した対象1名につき、敵は次ターンに防御レベル減少1を得る。攻める: For each target with an Attack Skill equipped, the enemy gains 1 Defense Level Down next turn. If attacking, still ensure a winning area clash and healing afterward, then use that defense reduction.
messages.「搔き取れ！」は戦闘開始時に本体HP50%未満なら2枚とも破壊不能化する。脈動1: “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” makes both Coins Unbreakable if below 50% body HP at Combat Start. Damage rises by 10% per Pulsation Potency (max 50%) and 3% per Count (max 60%), making later hits heavier.
messages.色欲・打撃に強い囚人でマッチし、残る攻撃に耐えられるHPを確保する。破壊されたコ: Clash with a Lust/Blunt-resistant Sinner and maintain HP for remaining attacks. Destroyed Coins lower Base Power, but a win does not guarantee no damage.
messages.試着室では守備で待つか、バリアを削る: Wait with defense or deplete the Shield in the Changing Room
messages.通常時は被撃でブティークの新作服が増え、ターン終了時に20なら次ターンに試着室へ: In the normal pattern, hits add Boutique: New Releases; at 20 at Turn End, enter the Changing Room next turn. Also, the first normal-pattern damage that would lower HP below 10 is negated, heals 30% max HP, immediately ends the turn, and enters the room.
messages.試着室へ入ると新作服を除去し、試着室1・信仰500を得る。体力ダメージを受けず、: Entering removes New Releases and grants 1 Changing Room and 500 Devotion. HP damage is prevented and all seven slots become Unbreakable Clashable Counters.
messages.安全に進めるなら全員守備にして通常2ターン待つ。信仰を急いで壊さなくても、試着室: For a safer approach, have everyone defend and generally wait two turns. Changing Room at 3 ends the pattern even without breaking Devotion. Avoid triggering Counters and prepare healing and skills for the next normal pattern.
messages.早く戻したい場合は信仰500のバリアを削り切る。ただし被撃で迫害が増え、10・2: To end it sooner, deplete the 500 Devotion Shield. Hits add Persecution, enabling extra Counter reuses at 10 and 20. If attacking, win against each Counter for 80% reduction and prepare for Unbreakable damage.
messages.解除時の強化を確認し、通常パターンをもう一度削る: Check exit buffs and deplete the normal pattern again
messages.信仰0または試着室3で精神力が20減り、そのターンが終わる。次ターンから通常パタ: At 0 Devotion or 3 Changing Room, lose 20 SP and end the turn. Return to the normal pattern next turn and gain 1 Damage Up for the encounter. This happens whether you break the Shield or wait.
messages.HP下限による試着室への移行は戦闘につき1回で、その際に戦闘中攻撃威力増加2も得: The HP-floor room transition happens once per encounter and also grants 2 Attack Power Up for the encounter. After the first apparent finishing point, reassess clashes with buffs included.
messages.本体の混乱区間はHP20%・348。試着室の解除時には混乱も解除されるため、混乱: The body's Stagger Threshold is 20% HP, or 348. Leaving the Changing Room also clears Stagger, so do not assume it remains afterward.
messages.後半も色欲の破壊不能技と広域の受け手を確認し、HP回復を挟んで削り切る。新作服2: Keep checking later Lust Unbreakable and area targets, healing between attacks to finish. The 20 New Releases transition is repeatable; use the same approach if the room returns.
messages.最大20。スキル使用時に自分の最大HP1%を消耗し、スキルダメージ量が消耗した体: Maximum 20. On Skill Use, consume 1% of max HP and increase skill damage by a percentage corresponding to HP consumed. Normal-pattern hits add 1 stack; at 20 at Turn End, enter the Changing Room next turn.
messages.敵の自傷だけを当てにせず、強いマッチと回復を維持する。20到達時は次の試着室に備: Do not rely solely on enemy self-damage; maintain strong clashes and healing. Prepare for the room at 20 stacks.
messages.最大3。保有中は体力ダメージを受けない。被攻撃時、脈動回数1・ダメージ量増加1・: Maximum 3. Prevents HP damage while active. When attacked, gain 1 Pulsation Count, 1 Damage Up, and 1 Defense Level Down next turn (up to 20 times per turn). At 3 Changing Room or 0 Devotion, end the pattern.
messages.反撃へ無理に攻撃せず、守備で待つ方法も取れる。攻める場合はバリア削りと反撃への備: Waiting with defense avoids forcing attacks into Counters. If attacking, prepare Shield damage and Counter responses together.
messages.ターン開始時に数値分のバリアを得る。バリアが減ると数値も減る。試着室への移行で5: At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to its value; losing Shield also lowers the value. Gain 500 on entering the Changing Room.
messages.削った分は信仰の数値からも減る。0にして早く解除するか、試着室3まで待つかを決め: Shield damage also reduces Devotion. Decide whether to reach 0 sooner or wait for 3 Changing Room.
messages.最大20。試着室パターン中に被撃で得る。反撃は迫害10以上でコインを1回再使用し: Maximum 20. Gained when hit during the Changing Room pattern. At 10, the Counter reuses a Coin once; at 20, reuses it once more after a reuse hit (each condition once per skill).
messages.攻撃回数を増やすほど反撃も増え得る。守備で待つ場合は不要な攻撃を入れない。: More attacks can mean more Counters. Do not add unnecessary attacks when waiting with defense.
messages.特殊充電で、回数の最大値は20。充電威力・回数を増減させる効果を同様に受け、終了: A special Charge with a Count cap of 20, affected by effects changing Charge Potency and Count. Lose 1 Count at Turn End. Gain 10 Count on first entry and 1 Potency per 10 Count cumulatively consumed.
messages.脈動威力と回数は別々に攻撃の強化へ使われる。マッチ勝利後も使用時の獲得は残るため: Pulsation Potency and Count strengthen attacks separately. On-use gains remain after clash wins, so check both values.
messages.精神力−20以下で防御レベル−3・攻撃レベル+1、−45以下では防御レベル−5・: At −20 SP or lower, Defense Level −3 and Offense Level +1; at −45 or lower, Defense Level −5 and Offense Level +2.
messages.全技が減算コインなので、精神力低下は高威力を出しやすくする。防御低下を攻めに使い: All skills use negative Coins, so lower SP favors high Power. Use reduced defense to attack, but also check opposing Power.
messages.E.G.O資源の補充に使い、受け役にする場合もほかの味方を守る。: Use it for E.G.O resources and protect other allies even when using him to take hits.
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安に進める。期間限定の店は利用可能なうちに買い物する。: Aim for Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Use limited-time shops while available.
messages.試着室のバリア500は急いで壊さなくてもよい。守備で待てば、攻撃で反撃・迫害を増: There is no need to rush the 500 Changing Room Shield. Waiting with defense avoids adding Counters and Persecution through attacks until the room ends.
messages.確かに私と共にいてくださる！の80%軽減は一方攻撃時。マッチ時に同じ軽減を当てに: The 80% reduction on “The Voice is with me, this I know!” applies when unopposed. Do not expect the same reduction when clashing.
messages.通常パターンの初回HP10未満ではダメージ無効・最大HP30%回復・強制ターン終: The first normal-pattern damage taking HP below 10 is negated, heals 30% max HP, and immediately ends the turn. It is not limited to self-damage.
messages.搔き取れ！の破壊不能化は戦闘開始時の敵HP50%未満が条件。コインが残る後半は色: “Scrape! Flay! Peel!” becomes Unbreakable only if enemy HP is below 50% at Combat Start. Check Lust/Blunt resistance for remaining Coins later in the battle.
messages.試着室退出時のダメージ量増加1は、バリア破壊・時間経過の両方で得る。待つ方法だけ: Both breaking the Shield and waiting grant 1 Damage Up on leaving the room. It is not an extra penalty exclusive to waiting.
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安にする。リナモヴィブルとB2F針っ子の期間限定店を逃し: Aim for Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. If you missed L'Inamovible's and the B2F Needlekin's limited-time shops, check your current Customer Level.
messages.固定3名はムルソー・シンクレア・ウーティス。全技が打撃なので打撃耐性を優先し、後: Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis are required. Every skill is Blunt, so prioritize Blunt resistance; also check sin resistance for later Lust and single-target Gluttony skills, including changes after E.G.O use.
messages.高威力マッチとHP回復、色欲・怠惰の攻撃を用意する。試着室を守備で待つ場合も、解: Bring high-Power clashes, HP recovery, and Lust/Sloth attacks. Even when defending through the room, save strong skills and E.G.O resources for afterward.
messages.本体の弱点となる罪悪属性。物理は3種とも0.9なので、罪悪とマッチ性能を合わせて: The body's weak sin affinities. All physical resistances are ×0.9, so consider sin affinity alongside clash performance.
messages.打撃と色欲・暴食を受ける役: Taking Blunt, Lust, and Gluttony hits
messages.後半の色欲破壊不能と、一方攻撃で軽減される暴食技を担当する。: Handles later Lust Unbreakable attacks and the Gluttony skill reduced when unopposed.
messages.減算コインの高威力へ勝ち、破壊不能で残る被害を戻す。試着室を攻める場合は反撃にも: Beat high-Power negative Coins and heal remaining Unbreakable damage. Prepare for Counters too if attacking the room.
messages.通常パターン中、初回のHP10未満となるダメージを無効にして最大HP30%を回復: In the normal pattern, the first damage that would take HP below 10 is negated, heals 30% max HP, and enters the Changing Room.
messages.試着室中は体力ダメージを受けない。信仰500のバリアを得る。: In the Changing Room, prevents HP damage and gains a 500 Devotion Shield.
messages.精神力による攻撃・防御レベルの変化は基礎値に含まない。: Base values exclude SP-based Offense and Defense Level changes.
messages.聞こえる！聞こえるんだ！: I hear it... I can hear it!
messages.使用時の脈動回数5はマッチに勝っても防げない。的中時の追加獲得と出血を防ぐため、: Winning cannot prevent the 5 Pulsation Count gained on use. Clash to prevent extra on-hit gains and Bleed. Its two negative Coins favor high Power at low enemy SP.
messages.もう一度服を着替えられたんだ！: I have been granted another chance to change my clothes!
messages.的中させると脈動回数と出血回数が増える。出血をためた囚人へ一方攻撃を通さず、マッ: Hits add Pulsation Count and Bleed Count. Clash to stop unopposed attacks on Sinners with high Bleed. On-use Pulsation Count gains remain.
messages.[使用時]自分の脈動1につき、ダメージ量+10%(最大50%): [On Use] Damage +10% per Pulsation on self (max 50%)
messages.[使用時]脈動回数5を消耗して最終威力+2: [On Use] Consume 5 Pulsation Count for +2 Final Power
messages.脈動回数5を使うと最終威力+2。素の最大12だけで判断しない。脈動によるダメージ: Consuming 5 Pulsation Count grants +2 Final Power; check beyond the base maximum of 12. Pulsation also raises damage, so avoid a Lust/Blunt-weak target.
messages.[戦闘開始時]自分の現体力が最大値の50%未満なら、このスキルの全コインが破壊不: [Combat Start] If current HP is below 50% max HP, convert all Coins to Unbreakable Coins
messages.[使用時]自分の脈動回数1につき、ダメージ量+3%(最大60%): [On Use] Damage +3% per Pulsation Count on self (max 60%)
messages.[攻撃前]破壊されたコインの数につき、基本威力-2: [Before Attack] Base Power −2 per destroyed Coin
messages.戦闘開始時に敵HP50%未満なら2枚とも破壊不能化する。脈動と回数によりダメージ: Both Coins become Unbreakable if enemy HP is below 50% at Combat Start. Pulsation Potency and Count add up to 110% damage; prepare a Lust/Blunt-resistant target and healing later in the fight.
messages.この世界に意味はあったんだ！: So this world wasn't meaningless after all!
messages.[戦闘開始時]守備スキルを装着した対象1名につき、このスキルのダメージ量-10%: [Combat Start] Skill damage −10% per target with a Defense Skill equipped
messages.[戦闘開始時]攻撃スキルを装着した対象1名につき、次のターンに防御レベル減少1を: [Combat Start] Gain 1 Defense Level Down next turn per target with an Attack Skill equipped
messages.[攻撃前]破壊されたコインの数につき、基本威力-1: [Before Attack] Base Power −1 per destroyed Coin
messages.加重値7の破壊不能。対象に守備装着者が多いほどダメージが下がる。被害が厳しいとき: Unbreakable, with 7 Atk Weight. More targets with defense equipped means less damage. Defend when incoming damage is too high; if attacking, ensure winning clashes and healing.
messages.確かに私と共にいてくださる！: The Voice is with me, this I know!
messages.[一方攻撃時]このスキルのダメージ量-80%: [On Unopposed Attack] This skill deals 80% less damage
messages.[マッチ敗北後的中]このスキルの最終ダメージ量だけ体力を回復: [On Hit after Clash Lose] Heal HP equal to this skill's final damage
messages.一方攻撃時にダメージ−80%。この技へマッチを取らず、耐性のよい囚人で軽減された: Deals 80% less damage when unopposed. One option is to avoid clashing and take the reduced attack with a resistant Sinner. Hits after a clash loss heal the enemy for damage dealt; avoid careless clashes that enable healing.
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量が80%減少し、このスキルのダメージでは混乱状態にならな: [Clash Lose] Deal 80% less damage; this skill's damage cannot Stagger
messages.[的中時]自分の迫害が10以上なら、このコインを再使用(スキルにつき1回): [On Hit] At 10 or more Persecution, reuse this Coin (once per skill)
messages.[再使用的中時]自分の迫害が20以上なら、このコインを再使用(スキルにつき1回): [On Reuse Hit] At 20 or more Persecution, reuse this Coin (once per skill)
messages.試着室専用の破壊不能・マッチ可能反撃。守備で待てば反撃を誘発せずに済む。バリアを: An Unbreakable Clashable Counter used only in the Changing Room. Waiting with defense avoids triggering it. If attacking the Shield, win for 80% reduction and prepare for extra reuses at 10 and 20 Persecution.
messages.ル・ルージュ ブティーク 新作ルックブック: Boutique du Rouge: New Arrivals Lookbook
messages.ブティークの新作服パターン\n\n保有する試着室,信仰を除去し、ブティークの新作:
Boutique: New Releases pattern

Remove Changing Room and Devotion; gain Boutique: New Releases.
When hit, gain 1 New Releases.
At Turn End with 20 New Releases, switch to the Changing Room pattern next turn.

During this pattern, the first damage that would lower HP below 10 is negated: heal 30% max HP and end the turn, then change to the Changing Room and gain 2 Attack Power Up for the encounter (once per encounter).
messages.通常パターン・新作服20・初回のHP下限: Normal pattern; 20 New Releases; first HP floor
messages.新作服20で次ターンに試着室へ入る。通常パターン中の初回の致死圏ではHP30%回: At 20 New Releases, enter the room next turn. The first near-lethal normal-pattern hit also heals 30% HP and ends the turn, so the first HP depletion does not necessarily finish the battle.
messages.試着室パターン\n\n保有するブティークの新作服を除去し、試着室1,信仰500を:
Changing Room pattern

Remove Boutique: New Releases and gain 1 Changing Room and 500 Devotion.

When hit, gain Persecution.
At 0 Devotion or 3 Changing Room, lose 20 SP and end the turn. Return to the New Releases pattern next turn and gain 1 Damage Up for the encounter. Clear Stagger if Staggered.
messages.試着室パターンへの移行と解除: Entering and leaving the Changing Room pattern
messages.信仰500を削り切るか、試着室3まで待つ。退出時には精神力が20下がり、以後のダ: Deplete 500 Devotion or wait for 3 Changing Room. Leaving lowers SP by 20 and grants 1 Damage Up afterward. Waiting does not carry an exclusive extra penalty.
messages.戦闘に初めて登場すると、脈動回数10を得る\n\n戦闘中、自分の脈動回数を累計で:
On first entering battle, gain 10 Pulsation Count.

Gain 1 Pulsation per 10 Pulsation Count cumulatively consumed during battle.
messages.初登場・脈動回数の累計消耗10ごと: First entry; every 10 Pulsation Count cumulatively consumed
messages.使用時獲得で脈動回数をため、消耗によって脈動も増える。マッチ勝利だけで全ての強化: On-use gains build Count, and consumption adds Potency. Clash wins alone do not stop every buff; prepare for increasing damage in a long fight.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 赤き神［未生］（10章A）の攻略｜Limbus Assi: 10-04 The Crimson God [Inchoate Life] (Canto X A) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「赤き神［未生］（10章A）」: The Crimson God [Inchoate Life] (Canto X A) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Reduce Baptism [Crimson] with defense and E.G.O instead of repeatedly using basic attacks while Bleeding. Destroy the Lifecord during Rampage, when its Protection and Assist Defense are inactive, then attack the Body. Win low-HP-targeting Unbreakable area clashes with healthy Sinners to limit damage.

messages.赤き神［未生］（10章A）: The Crimson God [Inchoate Life] (Canto X A)
messages.10章Aルートの赤き神［未生］が対象。Cルートの［完熟］とは別の戦闘。本体HP4: Covers Route A's Crimson God [Inchoate Life], a separate battle from Route C's later form. Recorded HP: main body 4,494, Body part 2,439, Lifecord 2,023. Do not recalculate main-body HP by adding part HP. Enemy Lv. 50, base Defense Level 52. Meursault, Faust, and Heathcliff are required in a team of up to 12. Customer Level determines dungeon Identity levels; Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged.
messages.スキルを胴体・命綱・肉片に分けた。表示威力は出血・HP・脈動・精神力などの補正を: Skills are divided among Body, Lifecord, and Flesh. Listed Power excludes Bleed, HP, Pulsation, SP, and other modifiers. The three Lust skills gain 80% damage reduction and Unbreakable conversion against targets without Bleed, so their icons do not show permanent Unbreakable Coins. “Don't... do that...” is an Assist Defense skill, separate from regular attacks. Parts of the post-Lifecord action order are unconfirmed; check actual skills as well as turn numbers.
messages.洗礼[赤]が3以上なら守備・E.G.Oで減らす。基本攻撃による出血回数増加を抑え: At 3 or more Baptism [Crimson], use defense or E.G.O to reduce it and limit Bleed Count gains from basic attacks.
messages.暴走中に命綱へ火力を集めて破壊する。命綱が残るとHP半分未満で暴走が続く。: Focus damage on the Lifecord during Rampage. If it remains, Rampage persists below half HP.
messages.低HPを狙う強攻撃は健康な囚人でマッチする。最後の大技は勝利で95%軽減。: Redirect low-HP-targeting major attacks to a healthy Sinner. Winning against the final major skill grants 95% damage reduction.
messages.攻撃を選ぶたびに出血で削られる: Bleed drains HP whenever an attack is selected
messages.洗礼[赤]は基本攻撃スキル使用時に数値の2倍だけ出血回数を増やす。3以上を目安に: Baptism [Crimson] adds twice its stacks as Bleed Count on basic Attack Skill use. At around 3 or more, switch to defense or E.G.O to remove 3 stacks. Existing Bleed remains, so check HP and remaining Bleed too.
messages.命綱への攻撃が胴体へ吸われる: Attacks on the Lifecord are intercepted by the Body
messages.非暴走時の自己保護で一方攻撃を胴体が受け、援護防御専用のガードを使う。命綱には保: Outside Rampage, Self-preservation makes the Body intercept unopposed attacks with an Assist Defense-only Guard. The Lifecord also has 5 Protection. This support does not activate during Rampage; concentrate Lifecord-breaking damage then.
messages.本体を半分まで削ったら暴走が終わらない: Rampage continues after lowering the body below half HP
messages.命綱未破壊のまま、ターン終了時に本体HP50%未満だと、命綱を壊すまで暴走の数値: If main-body HP is below 50% at Turn End while the Lifecord remains, Rampage stops losing stacks until the Lifecord is destroyed. Parts can still be broken during Rampage; aim to destroy the Lifecord rather than Stagger it.
messages.弱った囚人が大技で倒される: A major attack kills an injured Sinner
messages.命綱の憤怒・暴食技は低HPを優先し、失ったHPや出血で威力・ダメージが増える。速: The Lifecord's Wrath and Gluttony skills prioritize low HP and gain Power or damage from lost HP and Bleed. Redirect clashes to a healthy Sinner with enough Speed and heal in advance. Disparity adds further damage against targets slower than the enemy.
messages.HP1の肉片を何度殴っても倒せない: Repeated attacks cannot kill the Flesh at 1 HP
messages.肉片は生の本能がある間、HP1未満にならない。被攻撃で1減少（スキルごとに2回ま: Flesh cannot fall below 1 HP while Instinctive Cling to Life remains. Attacks remove 1 stack, up to twice per skill; Turn End removes another, and expiry kills it. Prioritize remaining stacks and the body rather than piling on large damage.
messages.顧客Lv45と固定出撃、回復を確認する: Check Customer Lv. 45, required deployment, and healing
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安に買い物を進める。敵Lv50とのレベル差があるが、ルビ: Shop toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. The Lv. 50 enemy has a level advantage, but Ruby's +1 Clash Power and +1 Final Power help. If limited-time shops were missed, check current Customer Rank and available strong skills.
messages.固定出撃はムルソー・ファウスト・ヒースクリフ。全攻撃が打撃なので打撃耐性とHP回: Meursault, Faust, and Heathcliff are required. All attacks are Blunt; bring Blunt resistance and HP recovery, saving high-Power skills for the Lifecord's Wrath and Gluttony area attacks.
messages.ムルソーの釘刺す者はスキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る（1ター: Meursault's He Who Nails grants two extra resources of his skill's affinity on use, twice per turn. Survival requires another ally at Turn Start. Replenish resources while protecting the other Sinners too.
messages.洗礼と出血を確認し、守備・E.G.Oを挟む: Check Baptism and Bleed; mix in defense and E.G.O
messages.洗礼[赤]の多い囚人を先に確認する。基本攻撃を使うと数値の2倍だけ出血回数が増え: Check Sinners with high Baptism [Crimson] first. Basic attacks add twice its stacks as Bleed Count; at 3 or more, use defense or E.G.O to remove 3 stacks.
messages.洗礼[赤]5では出血ダメージが2倍になる一方、出血だけでは死亡しない。HP1で安: At 5 Baptism, Bleed damage doubles but Bleed alone cannot kill. Being at 1 HP is still unsafe: an immediate enemy attack can kill, so check healing and incoming targets too.
messages.色欲のひっく…・ううっ…・ビュ…ッフェ…は、対象またはメインターゲットに出血がな: The Lust skills “Hrgh...”, “Nngh...”, and “Pw... ffeh...” gain 80% damage reduction and Unbreakable conversion if their target or main target has no Bleed. Choosing a Bleed-free Sinner helps, but on-hit Baptism remains after clash wins.
messages.強い憤怒・暴食技のマッチは、出血と失ったHPが少ない囚人へ任せる。弱った囚人のま: Assign strong Wrath and Gluttony clashes to Sinners with little Bleed and lost HP. Injured targets more easily meet enemy bonus conditions.
messages.非暴走・通常は最初の3ターン: Outside Rampage · Usually the first three turns
messages.マッチを取りながら、暴走への火力を残す: Win clashes while saving damage for Rampage
messages.胴体の通常技へ勝って、敵のマッチ勝利時の脈動回数増加を防ぐ。囚人の出血がマッチ中: Beat the Body's regular skills to prevent Pulsation Count gained on enemy clash wins. Sinner Bleed triggering during clashes also adds Pulsation, so keep managing Baptism.
messages.非暴走時の命綱には保護5があり、自己保護1による胴体の援護防御もある。命綱への一: Outside Rampage, the Lifecord has 5 Protection plus Body Assist Defense through 1 Self-preservation. Avoid adding too many unopposed Lifecord attacks and save strong skills for Rampage.
messages.「声が…聞こえる…」へは勝って80%軽減を取る。ただし使用時に脈動回数を15まで: Beat “I hear... the Voice...” for 80% reduction. Its on-use refill to 15 Pulsation Count remains, usually bringing Rampage next turn.
messages.出血やマッチ結果で脈動回数15へ早く届く場合もある。4ターン目だけに固定せず、毎: Bleed and clash results can bring Count to 15 earlier. Do not assume Rampage always starts on Turn 4; check its state each turn and prepare to attack the Lifecord.
messages.命綱を破壊し、苦痛の袋もためる: Destroy the Lifecord and build Sac of Suffering
messages.ターン開始時に暴走がなく脈動回数15以上なら、回数を全消耗して暴走を得る。暴走中: At Turn Start without Rampage and with at least 15 Pulsation Count, consume all Count to gain Rampage. No parts can be Staggered during it, but the Lifecord can be destroyed. Focus attacks there while Protection and Self-preservation support are inactive.
messages.命綱はHP2023、物理3種とも耐性1.2で、色欲・怠惰・暴食も1.2。健康な囚: The Lifecord has 2,023 HP and ×1.2 resistance to all physical types, Lust, Sloth, and Gluttony. Have healthy Sinners clash with dangerous skills and direct spare damage to the Lifecord.
messages.暴走中は被撃で苦痛の袋1、マッチ敗北で3を得る。暴走終了時に総和30以上なら次タ: During Rampage, hits add 1 Sac of Suffering and clash losses add 3. At a combined total of at least 30 when Rampage ends, next turn's pattern weakens and Flesh is Staggered. Each 5 Sac also grants 1 Fragile after Rampage ends, creating an opening.
messages.命綱が残ったまま終了時に本体HP50%未満だと、命綱を壊すまで暴走の数値が減らな: If main-body HP is below 50% at Turn End with the Lifecord intact, Rampage stacks stop decreasing until it is destroyed. Prioritize breaking the Lifecord instead of damaging only the Body.
messages.健康な囚人で勝ち、80%・95%軽減を取る: Win with healthy Sinners for 80% or 95% reduction
messages.「さ…むい…」「痛い…身体が…勝手に…！！！」は低HPを狙い、受け手の失ったHP: “It's... cold...” and “It hurts...! My body... won't listen...” target low HP and gain damage from the target's lost HP. Base Power also rises if the main target is below 50% HP, so assign a healthy Sinner with enough Speed.
messages.この2技は勝利でダメージ−80%、その技のダメージによる混乱なし。洗礼の的中時付: Winning against these two skills gives 80% reduction and prevents Stagger from their damage. On-hit Baptism remains, but extra application on hits without Coin destruction can be prevented.
messages.「お腹が空いた…寒い…痛い…！」は4枚破壊不能・加重値5。脈動回数10以上ならコ: “Hungry... cold... hurts...!” has four Unbreakable Coins and 5 Atk Weight. At 10 or more Pulsation Count, Coin Power +2 and Atk Weight +2. Bleed also raises Coin Power, so do not judge from the base maximum of 16.
messages.最後の大技へ勝つとダメージ−95%となり、破壊されずに的中する出血発動なども防げ: Winning against the final major skill gives 95% damage reduction and prevents extras such as Bleed activation on hits without Coin destruction. Assign your strongest clash and check HP and Bleed on every area target.
messages.胴体の脆弱を利用して削り切る: Use Fragile on the Body to finish
messages.命綱は破壊すると行動とスロットが消え、追撃できなくなる。以後は胴体へ攻撃を集める: Destroying the Lifecord removes its actions and slots and prevents follow-up attacks on it. Focus the Body afterward. Severed Lifecord grants the Body 3 Fragile next turn at Turn End.
messages.命綱を壊しても現在の暴走が即座に消えるとは限らない。数値と実際の技を確認し、解除: Destroying the Lifecord does not necessarily remove current Rampage immediately. Check stacks and actual skills, and clash without relying on Stagger until it ends. Prepare for Pulsation to trigger Rampage again too.
messages.暴走中に洗礼[赤]3以上の囚人を倒されると、次ターンに肉片が生まれる（最大3体）: During Rampage, killing a Sinner with at least 3 Baptism [Crimson] creates Flesh next turn, up to three units. Flesh adds Baptism; use spare attacks to reduce Instinctive Cling to Life or wait for it to expire.
messages.出血と洗礼を抱えた囚人へ基本攻撃を連打させず、守備・E.G.OとHP回復を続ける: Do not repeatedly use basic attacks on Sinners carrying Bleed and Baptism; keep using defense, E.G.O, and HP recovery. The full post-Lifecord order is unconfirmed, so choose winning clashes against the Body's actual equipped skills.
messages.最大5。基本攻撃スキル使用時、自分の出血回数が数値×2増える。E.G.O・守備ス: Maximum 5. On basic Attack Skill use, gain Bleed Count equal to stacks ×2. E.G.O or Defense Skill use removes 3 stacks. Offense Level +1 per 3 Bleed Potency (max 3). At 5, take double Bleed damage but cannot die from Bleed.
messages.3以上を目安に守備・E.G.Oへ切り替える。既にある出血は消えないため、HPと出: Switch to defense or E.G.O at around 3 stacks. Existing Bleed is not removed, so check HP and Bleed Count too.
messages.特殊充電で回数最大20。未熟な赤き神により終了時に回数が減らず、マッチ中に相手の: A special Charge with a Count cap of 20. The Preterm Crimson God prevents Turn End Count loss. Each opposing Bleed trigger during a clash adds 1 Count; kills add the target's Bleed Potency plus Count. At Turn Start, heal 3 SP per Count. At 15 or more Count without Rampage, consume all to enter Rampage.
messages.囚人の出血を放置しない。［完熟］の脈動威力による段階強化とは混同しない。: Do not neglect Sinner Bleed. Distinguish this from the later form's stages based on Pulsation Potency.
messages.基本値3。敵の出血3につき与ダメージ+5%（最大30%）、全ての部位が混乱しなく: Base value 3. Damage +5% per 3 enemy Bleed (max 30%); all parts cannot be Staggered; Bleed damage taken −75%. Normally lose 1 at Turn End and consume all Pulsation Count on expiry. With the Lifecord intact and main-body HP below 50%, stacks stop decreasing until the Lifecord is destroyed.
messages.暴走中は保護と自己保護の補助が発動しないため、混乱ではなく命綱の破壊を狙う。: Protection and Self-preservation support do not activate during Rampage. Aim for Lifecord destruction rather than Stagger.
messages.最大30。暴走中、部位の被撃で1、マッチ敗北で3を得る。暴走消滅時に消え、次ター: Maximum 30. During Rampage, gain 1 when a part is hit and 3 on a clash loss. Removed when Rampage expires, granting 1 Fragile next turn per 5 stacks. At a combined total of 30 or more on expiry, also weaken next turn's pattern and Stagger Flesh.
messages.暴走中にマッチへ勝ち、命綱へ攻撃してためる。弱化は暴走が消滅する条件と合わせて考: Build it through clash wins and Lifecord attacks during Rampage. The weakening also requires Rampage to expire.
messages.命綱への一方攻撃時に1消耗し、対象を胴体へ変えて援護防御専用技を使う。非暴走・非: Consumes 1 on an unopposed attack against the Lifecord, redirecting it to the Body and using an Assist Defense-only skill. Survival Instinct grants 1 at Turn Start outside Rampage and Stagger, also giving the Lifecord 5 Protection. Expires at Turn End.
messages.非暴走時の一方攻撃は吸われ得る。命綱へ本格的に攻めるのは暴走中を狙う。: Unopposed Lifecord attacks may be intercepted outside Rampage. Commit serious damage during Rampage.
messages.最大5。終了時に消えて、翌ターンに数値×2の脈動回数を得る。5で消滅した場合、翌: Maximum 5. Expires at Turn End, granting Pulsation Count equal to stacks ×2 next turn. If expiring at 5, all parts also gain a Shield equal to 3% main-body max HP next turn. That Shield does not expire at Turn End.
messages.命綱の技へ勝ち、プラス効果を奪われる条件を抑える。攻撃ごとにマッチ勝利時か的中時: Beat Lifecord skills to limit positive-effect theft. Check whether each attack steals on clash win or on hit.
messages.最大5。肉片のHPが1未満に減らなくなる。被攻撃で1減少（スキルごとに2回まで）: Maximum 5. Prevents Flesh HP falling below 1. When attacked, lose 1 (up to twice per skill); lose 1 at Turn End and die on expiry. Starts with stacks equal to the dead Sinner's Baptism [Crimson].
messages.肉片はHP1への大火力ではなく、残数を減らして倒す。本体の生存本能とは別の効果。: Defeat Flesh by removing stacks rather than dealing large damage at 1 HP. Distinct from the main body's Survival Instinct passive.
messages.最大3。数値1につき速度最小・最大が1減る。開始時に脆弱1を得て、終了時に1減る: Maximum 3. Minimum and maximum Speed −1 per stack. Gain 1 Fragile at Turn Start and lose 1 stack at Turn End. Gained next turn according to the Pulsation replenished by “I hear... the Voice...”.
messages.速度が下がる機会に命綱への先行攻撃を狙う。暴走による混乱免疫は残る。: Use reduced Speed to land early Lifecord attacks. Rampage's Stagger immunity remains.
messages.精神力−20以下で防御レベル−3・攻撃レベル+3、洗礼[赤]5の相手とのマッチ威: At −20 SP or lower, Defense Level −3, Offense Level +3, and +2 Clash Power against targets with 5 Baptism [Crimson]. At −45 or lower, Defense Level −5, Offense Level +3, damage +10%, and +3 Clash Power against those targets.
messages.精神力が低くても単純な無力化にはならない。洗礼5の囚人を危険なマッチへ出し続けな: Low SP does not simply disable the enemy. Avoid repeatedly assigning a Sinner with 5 Baptism to dangerous clashes.
messages.ムルソーがスキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る（1ターン2回）。: Meursault gains two extra resources of his skill's affinity on use, twice per turn. With another ally alive at Turn Start, cannot die from damage that turn. Cannot retreat.
messages.資源補充と受け役に使い、ほかの味方も生存させる。: Use him for resources and taking hits while keeping other allies alive.
messages.百貨店で目玉を使った買い物に応じて上がり、影界の人格レベルへ反映される。: Raised through department-store shopping with eyeballs; determines dungeon Identity levels.
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安にする。外での人格レベルとは分けて確認する。: Aim for Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Check this separately from outside Identity levels.
messages.洗礼[赤]は基本攻撃で出血回数を増やす。守備・E.G.Oで洗礼を減らしても、既に: Baptism [Crimson] adds Bleed Count through basic attacks. Reducing Baptism with defense or E.G.O does not remove existing Bleed.
messages.命綱未破壊のまま本体HP50%未満でターンを終えると、命綱破壊まで暴走が減らなく: Ending a turn below 50% main-body HP with the Lifecord intact prevents Rampage from decreasing until the Lifecord is destroyed.
messages.暴走中は混乱しないが部位破壊は可能。命綱は破壊後に追撃できず、行動とスロットも消: Rampage prevents Stagger but not part destruction. A destroyed Lifecord loses actions and slots and cannot be attacked further.
messages.低HPの囚人を狙う大技は、受け手のHPと出血で強くなる。マッチの表示だけでなく、: Low-HP-targeting major skills gain strength from the target's HP and Bleed. Check the target's condition as well as clash predictions.
messages.苦痛の袋30による弱化は、暴走が消えるときの条件。ためた瞬間に弱化するわけではな: The weakening at 30 Sac of Suffering checks when Rampage expires. Reaching 30 does not immediately weaken the pattern.
messages.命綱破壊後の完全な行動順は未確定。特定ターンを無条件の安全ターンとして扱わない。: The full post-Lifecord action order is unconfirmed. No particular turn is unconditionally safe.
messages.顧客Lv45・ルビーを目安に買い物を進める。敵Lv50とのレベル差があるため、強: Shop toward Customer Lv. 45 and Ruby. Prepare strong clashes and E.G.O resources for the Lv. 50 enemy's level advantage.
messages.ムルソー・ファウスト・ヒースクリフが固定。打撃耐性、憤怒・暴食の大技を受ける罪悪: Meursault, Faust, and Heathcliff are required. Check Blunt resistance, sin resistance for Wrath/Gluttony major skills, and HP recovery. Injured Sinners are targeted, so do not wait until the brink of death to heal.
messages.命綱へ通しやすい色欲・怠惰・暴食の火力を用意する。胴体の憤怒・憂鬱は0.75。生: Bring Lust, Sloth, and Gluttony damage for the Lifecord. The Body's Wrath and Gloom resistances are ×0.75. Check team resources so defense and E.G.O can prioritize survival.
messages.暴走中の隙に命綱を壊し、破壊後の胴体の脆弱3につなげる。: Break it during Rampage to enable 3 Fragile on the Body afterward.
messages.低HP狙いの大技を引き受け、80%・95%軽減を取る。出血と速度の両方を見て担当: Intercept low-HP-targeting major attacks for 80%/95% reduction. Check both Bleed and Speed when assigning.
messages.HP回復と洗礼管理のためのE.G.O: HP recovery and E.G.O for Baptism management
messages.洗礼の多い囚人の基本攻撃を減らし、出血と破壊不能の被害を立て直す。: Use fewer basic attacks on Sinners with high Baptism and recover Bleed and Unbreakable damage.
messages.本体HPと部位HPは別の値。: Main-body HP and part HP are separate values.
messages.暴走中は混乱しない。命綱破壊後は次ターンに脆弱3を得る。: Cannot be Staggered during Rampage. Gains 3 Fragile next turn after Lifecord destruction.
messages.摘出可能。破壊時に行動キャンセル・スロット破壊、破壊後追撃不可。: Excisable. Destruction cancels actions and destroys slots; cannot be attacked further afterward.
messages.非暴走・非混乱の開始時に保護5と胴体の自己保護による援護がある。: At Turn Start outside Rampage and Stagger, has 5 Protection and support through the Body's Self-preservation.
messages.暴走中も破壊できる。HP半分未満の永続暴走を解くために優先する。: Can be destroyed during Rampage. Prioritize it to end persistent Rampage below half HP.
messages.赤き神の引きちぎられた肉片: Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God
messages.生の本能が残る間はHP1未満にならず、効果が消えると死亡する。: Cannot fall below 1 HP while Instinctive Cling to Life remains; dies when the effect expires.
messages.暴走中に洗礼[赤]3以上の囚人を倒すと次ターンに生成。最大3体。: Created next turn after killing a Sinner with at least 3 Baptism [Crimson] during Rampage. Maximum three units.
messages.[使用時]対象に出血がないなら、ダメージ量-80%,このスキルの全コインが破壊不: [On Use] If the target has no Bleed, damage −80% and convert all Coins to Unbreakable Coins
messages.[マッチ勝利時]メインターゲットのプラス効果をランダムに1つ除去(充電、呼吸を除: [Clash Win] Remove one random positive effect from the main target, excluding Charge and Poise; gain 1 A Seized Something.
messages.出血のない対象なら使用時に80%軽減・破壊不能化する。受け手の出血を見て判断し、: Against a Bleed-free target, gains 80% damage reduction and Unbreakable conversion on use. Check the target's Bleed and remaining hits and Baptism after a clash win.
messages.[的中時]対象のプラス効果をランダムに1つ除去(充電、呼吸を除く)、自分が奪い取: [On Hit] Remove one random positive effect from the target, excluding Charge and Poise; gain 1 A Seized Something.
messages.出血のない対象には80%軽減・破壊不能化。的中で洗礼[赤]が増え、1枚目はプラス: Gains 80% damage reduction and Unbreakable conversion against targets without Bleed. Hits add Baptism, and Coin 1 also steals a positive effect. Prevent unopposed attacks against Sinners with Bleed.
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの出血4につき、最終威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Final Power +1 per 4 Bleed on the main target (max 3)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットに出血がないなら、ダメージ量-80%,このスキルの全コ: [On Use] If the main target has no Bleed, damage −80% and convert all Coins to Unbreakable Coins
messages.加重値3。メインターゲットに出血がなければ80%軽減・破壊不能化する。広域の受け: 3 Atk Weight. A Bleed-free main target gives 80% damage reduction and Unbreakable conversion. Check Baptism on every area target after the attack too.
messages.体力が最も低い対象を優先して指定: Prioritizes the target with the lowest HP
messages.対象の失った体力1%につき、ダメージ量+5%(最大250%): Damage +5% per 1% HP the target has lost (max 250%)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの出血4につき、最終威力+2(最大4): [On Use] Final Power +2 per 4 Bleed on the main target (max 4)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの現体力が50%未満なら、基本威力+3: [On Use] If the main target's HP is below 50%, Base Power +3
messages.[マッチ勝利時]メインターゲットのプラス効果をランダムに1つ除去(充電、呼吸を除: [Clash Win] Remove one random positive effect from the main target, excluding Charge and Poise; gain 2 A Seized Something.
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-80%、このスキルのダメージでは対象は混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Damage −80%; this skill's damage cannot Stagger its targets
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]洗礼[赤]2を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 2 Baptism [Crimson]
messages.低HPを狙い、失ったHPに応じてダメージが最大250%増す。HPと出血が軽い囚人: Targets low HP and gains up to 250% damage from lost HP. Redirect to a Sinner with high HP and little Bleed, then win for 80% reduction.
messages.痛い…身体が…勝手に…！！！: It hurts...! My body... won't listen...
messages.体力が最も低い対象をメインターゲットとして優先して指定: Prioritizes the lowest-HP target as main target
messages.対象の失った体力3%につき、ダメージ量+5%(最大50%): Damage +5% per 3% HP the target has lost (max 50%)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの現体力が50%未満なら、基本威力+2: [On Use] If the main target's HP is below 50%, Base Power +2
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]洗礼[赤]1を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 1 Baptism [Crimson]
messages.低HPを狙う加重値3の破壊不能。メインターゲットがHP50%未満だと基本威力も上: An Unbreakable skill with 3 Atk Weight targeting low HP. Gains Base Power if the main target is below 50% HP. Win with a healthy Sinner for 80% reduction and Stagger prevention.
messages.対象の失った体力1%につき、ダメージ量+1%(最大30%): Damage +1% per 1% HP the target has lost (max 30%)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの出血6につき、コイン威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 6 Bleed on the main target (max 2)
messages.[使用時]自分の脈動回数が10以上なら、脈動回数を全て消耗し、コイン威力+2,加: [On Use] At 10 or more Pulsation Count, consume all Count for +2 Coin Power and +2 Atk Weight
messages.[マッチ敗北]ダメージ量-95%、このスキルのダメージでは対象は混乱しない: [Clash Lose] Damage −95%; this skill's damage cannot Stagger its targets
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]出血6を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 6 Bleed
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の出血が1回発動。対象の出血回数が1減少: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Trigger the target's Bleed once; reduce Bleed Count by 1
messages.4枚破壊不能・加重値5で、脈動回数10以上ならコイン威力+2・加重値+2。最優先: Four Unbreakable Coins and 5 Atk Weight; at 10 or more Pulsation Count, Coin Power +2 and Atk Weight +2. Prioritize your strongest clash for 95% reduction and prevention of extra effects on hits without Coin destruction.
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの出血4につき、最終威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Final Power +1 per 4 Bleed on the main target (max 2)
messages.通常の怠惰技。敵がマッチに勝つと脈動回数3を得るため、出血と束縛を防ぐ意味でも勝: A regular Sloth skill. Enemy clash wins grant 3 Pulsation Count; win to prevent that, Bleed, and Bind.
messages.2枚の怠惰打撃。マッチ敗北による脈動増加と、出血・翌ターンの束縛を防ぐ。出血の多: Two Sloth/Blunt Coins. Win to prevent enemy Pulsation gains, Bleed, and next-turn Bind. A target with high Bleed also raises its Power.
messages.加重値3の怠惰打撃。敵のマッチ勝利で脈動回数が増える。通常コインなので勝って攻撃: A Sloth/Blunt skill with 3 Atk Weight. Enemy clash wins add Pulsation Count. Ordinary Coins can be stopped by winning.
messages.[使用時]自分の脈動回数が15未満なら、15まで増加し、増加した数値5につき次の: [On Use] If Pulsation Count is below 15, raise it to 15 and gain 1 Exhausted next turn per 5 Count added
messages.3枚破壊不能。勝てば80%軽減できるが、使用時の脈動回数15への補充は防げない。: Three Unbreakable Coins. Winning grants 80% reduction, but cannot prevent the on-use refill to 15 Pulsation Count. Expect next-turn Rampage and Exhausted, and save Lifecord damage.
messages.[使用時]自分の(脈動回数x10)だけバリアを得る: [On Use] Gain a Shield equal to (Pulsation Count × 10)
messages.自己保護で誘発される援護防御専用のマッチ可能ガード。命綱への一方攻撃が胴体へ吸わ: An Assist Defense-only Clashable Guard triggered by Self-preservation. Unopposed Lifecord attacks are intercepted by the Body. Avoid forcing them outside Rampage; target the Lifecord during Rampage instead.
messages.自分の出血が6以上なら、コイン威力+1: At 6 or more Bleed on self, Coin Power +1
messages.敵の出血6以上でコイン威力が増す。勝てば80%軽減に加えて脈動回数を2減らせる。: Gains Coin Power at 6 or more enemy Bleed. Winning grants 80% reduction and removes 2 Pulsation Count. Also check Final Power from Bleed on your target Sinner.
messages.[使用時]自分の脈動回数が10以上なら、脈動回数10を消耗し、コイン威力+2: [On Use] At 10 or more Pulsation Count, consume 10 for +2 Coin Power
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]次のターンに束縛4を付与: [On Hit without Coin Destruction] Inflict 4 Bind next turn
messages.脈動回数10を消耗するとコイン威力+2。素の最大17で判断せず、高威力で勝って8: Consuming 10 Pulsation Count grants +2 Coin Power. Check beyond the base maximum of 17 and win with high Power for 80% reduction. An undestroyed third Coin inflicts 4 Bind next turn.
messages.破壊不能なので勝っても洗礼[赤]1は残る。肉片はHPを削るだけでは死なない。生の: Unbreakable means 1 Baptism [Crimson] remains even after winning. Flesh cannot be killed through HP damage alone. Reduce Instinctive Cling to Life through attacks and time.
messages.ターン終了時に脈動回数が減少しない\nマッチ進行時、対象の出血が発動するたびに自:
Pulsation Count does not decrease at Turn End.
During a clash, gain 1 Count whenever the target's Bleed triggers.
On defeating a target, gain Count equal to their Bleed Potency + Count.
At Turn Start, heal 3 SP per Pulsation Count.
messages.出血発動・対象撃破・ターン開始: Bleed triggers; target kills; Turn Start
messages.脈動回数は通常の終了時減少がない。出血持ちで基本攻撃を連打すると、囚人の消耗と敵: Pulsation lacks the normal Turn End Count reduction. Repeated basic attacks with Bleeding Sinners drain allies and strengthen the enemy together.
messages.ターン開始時、自分に暴走がなく、自分の脈動回数が15以上なら、脈動回数を全て消耗:
At Turn Start without Uncontrollable Rampage and with at least 15 Pulsation Count, consume all Count to gain Rampage.

While Rampaging:
- On Skill Use, gain 3 Bleed Count.
- On skill hit, gain 1 Bleed.
- When a part is attacked, gain 1 Sac of Suffering.
- On Clash Lose, gain 3 Sac of Suffering.
- Killing a target with at least 3 Baptism [Crimson] creates Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God next turn.
- At Combat End, heal 3 SP per enemy with Baptism [Crimson].

When Rampage expires at Turn End, if the combined Sac of Suffering is at least 30, weaken next turn's pattern and Stagger all Ripped Flesh on the field.

※ E.G.O and Defense Skills reduce Baptism [Crimson].
※ Ripped Flesh gains Instinctive Cling to Life equal to the dead target's Baptism.
※ Ripped Flesh with that effect cannot die.
※ At most three Ripped Flesh can be created on the field.
messages.脈動回数15以上・暴走中・暴走終了時: At least 15 Pulsation Count; during Rampage; Rampage expiry
messages.暴走中は命綱を狙い、マッチ勝利と被撃で苦痛の袋もためる。暴走終了時に総和30以上: Attack the Lifecord during Rampage, building Sac of Suffering through clash wins and hits. At a combined total of at least 30 when Rampage expires, next turn's pattern weakens.
messages.自分より遅い対象への与ダメージ量+50%: Damage against targets slower than the user +50%
messages.遅い囚人への与ダメージが50%増える。速度も含めて受け役を決め、束縛を受けた囚人: Deals 50% more damage to slower Sinners. Consider Speed when assigning targets and avoid concentrating dangerous skills on a Bound Sinner.
messages.暴力的な誕生の暴走: Rampage of a Violent, Traumatic Birth
messages.命綱の部位が破壊されていない状態で、ターン終了時に本体の体力が50%未満なら暴走:
At Turn End with the Lifecord intact and main-body HP below 50%, gain Uncontrollable Rampage.
Afterward, Rampage stacks do not decrease until the Lifecord is destroyed.
messages.命綱未破壊・終了時の本体HP50%未満: Lifecord intact; main body below 50% HP at Turn End
messages.命綱を壊すまで暴走の数値が減らなくなる。胴体だけを削らず、暴走中に命綱を壊して長: Rampage stacks stop decreasing until the Lifecord is destroyed. Break it during Rampage rather than damaging only the Body and prolonging the battle.
messages.精神力は0へ戻る。低精神力のまま固定できるとは考えず、毎ターン威力を確認する。: SP returns to 0. Do not assume it stays low; check Power every turn.
messages.パニックタイプは変わらず、精神力のない対象への代替効果が適用される。専用パニック: Panic Type stays unchanged and applies the alternative effects for targets without SP. Do not rely on a special Panic to disable the enemy.
messages.命綱の部位が破壊された状態なら、ターン終了時、次のターンに胴体の部位が脆弱3を得: With the Lifecord destroyed, at Turn End grant the Body part 3 Fragile next turn
messages.次ターンの胴体に脆弱3を付ける。破壊した命綱への追撃はできないため、残りの攻撃を: Grants the Body 3 Fragile next turn. The destroyed Lifecord cannot take follow-up attacks, so focus remaining damage on the Body.
messages.ターン開始時に自己保護1を得て、命綱の部位に保護5を付与\n暴走を保有しているか:
At Turn Start, gain 1 Self-preservation and grant the Lifecord 5 Protection.
Does not activate while Rampaging or Staggered.
messages.非暴走・非混乱のターン開始時: Turn Start outside Rampage and Stagger
messages.自己保護1と命綱の保護5が付く。暴走中は発動しないため、命綱を壊す火力をそこへ集: Grants 1 Self-preservation and 5 Protection to the Lifecord. Inactive during Rampage, so concentrate Lifecord-breaking damage then. Distinct from Flesh's Instinctive Cling to Life.
messages.-生存時、死亡した対象の洗礼[赤]の数値だけ生の本能を得る\n\n生の本能消滅時:

Die when Instinctive Cling to Life expires.
messages.洗礼[赤]持ちの死亡から肉片を生成: Flesh created from a dead target with Baptism [Crimson]
messages.死亡した囚人の洗礼[赤]の数だけ生の本能を持つ。攻撃で残数を減らすか、寿命を待つ: Starts with Instinctive Cling to Life equal to the dead Sinner's Baptism. Remove stacks through attacks or wait for expiry; large damage against 1 HP is unnecessary.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 アルリウネ（10章B）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 10-04 Alriune (Canto X, Route B) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「アルリウネ（10章B）」の攻: Alriune (Canto X, Route B) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Give the first Laurel Wreath of Atonement to a strong Sinner and let them clash with major skills and attack the body. The others handle adds and normal skills while restoring SP. Prevent lethal attacks triggered by Panic or Corrosion, protect the Assist Unit Pwie, and aim for a quick finish.

messages.最初の贖罪の月桂冠を強い囚人へ渡し、その囚人に大技のマッチと本体への攻撃を任せる: Give the first Laurel Wreath of Atonement to a strong Sinner and let them clash with major skills and attack the body. The others handle adds and normal skills while restoring SP. Prevent lethal attacks triggered by Panic or Corrosion, protect the Assist Unit Pwie, and aim for a quick finish.
messages.10章Bルート4Fの影界戦。本体Lv55・HP2183・基礎防御Lv57、土から: Covers the Route B, 4F dungeon battle in Canto X. The body is Lv. 55 with 2,183 HP and base Defense Level 57; One Who Emerged from the Earth is Lv. 50 with 254 HP and base Defense Level 52. HP lost in the preceding encounter does not carry over: the body fully heals when this dungeon battle begins. Identity levels follow Customer Level; aim for Customer Lv. 55 or higher and Onyx rank. Identities below Uptie III are raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Up to 12 Sinners can deploy. The death of Assist Unit Pwie causes defeat.
messages.直接ダメージ0の技も、精神力ダメージや状態付与まで無効とは限らない。攻撃後の精神: A skill dealing 0 direct damage can still deal SP damage or apply statuses. Distinguish After Attack SP loss from On Hit and On Hit Without Breaking effects. Only the third Coin of the area-random attack “A Human Who Yearned to be a Doll” hits every attack target. A fixed turn sequence is unconfirmed; check Petals and skill names.
messages.良い香りのする月桂冠の受け手を強い囚人へ変更し、大技の担当を作る。: Redirect “Fragrant Laurel Wreath” to a strong Sinner to establish a major-clash specialist.
messages.パニック・侵蝕を精神力回復で防ぐ。助力者プイが倒されないよう攻撃を引き受ける。: Restore SP to prevent Panic and Corrosion. Intercept attacks to keep Assist Unit Pwie alive.
messages.花びら3の大技は月桂冠持ちでマッチに勝ち、80%軽減を取る。: At 3 Petals, win the major clash with the Wreath holder for 80% reduction.
messages.月桂冠のない囚人からのスキル被ダメージは50%減り、月桂冠持ちからは150%増え: The body takes 50% less skill damage from Sinners without the Wreath, but 150% more from its holder. Give it to a strong Sinner and have them attack the body. Burn and Bleed damage are also nullified; do not rely solely on their ongoing damage.
messages.精神力が減って、急に囚人が倒された: SP dropped and a Sinner suddenly died
messages.パニック・侵蝕の囚人には、マッチも守備もできない最大HP120%の固定ダメージ技: Panicked or Corroded Sinners face an Unclashable attack dealing fixed damage equal to 120% max HP; it does not activate defense. The attack is canceled if the target is no longer Panicked or Corroded, so restore SP first. Also watch for the additional 20 SP lost on Stagger.
messages.広域へ勝てず全体が混乱する: Ⅰcannot win the area clash and everyone gets Staggered
messages.土へ還ろうとする願いを抱いては、月桂冠がない相手に最終威力+5。振動・沈潜でも威: “Bearing the hope to return to dust...” gains +5 Final Power against a target without the Wreath. Tremor and Sinking further increase its Power. Use the Wreath holder's strongest skill for 80% reduction and immunity to Stagger from that skill's damage.
messages.ダメージ0の技を放置したら精神力が崩れた: Ⅰignored a 0-damage skill and lost too much SP
messages.取り巻きは直接ダメージ0でも残香・沈潜・振動を付ける。本体の皆の心の中の欲望が…: Adds apply Faint Aroma, Sinking, and Tremor even with 0 direct damage. The body's When flowers substitute... also removes 25 SP After Attack from targets without the Wreath. Check statuses and SP effects rather than prioritizing by displayed damage alone.
messages.助力者プイの死亡が敗北条件。プイへの攻撃を引き受け、月桂冠持ちのマッチ勝利による: Assist Unit Pwie's death causes defeat. Intercept attacks aimed at Pwie and use the Wreath holder's clash wins to restore SP to all allies.
messages.精神力回復と月桂冠を渡す囚人を決める: Prepare SP recovery and choose the Wreath recipient
messages.顧客Lv55以上・オニキスを目安に買い物を進める。外での人格レベルとは別に、現在: Shop toward Customer Lv. 55 or higher and Onyx rank. Check current Customer Level separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon. Even after reducing the body to half HP in the preceding encounter, it fully heals in the dungeon battle.
messages.最も強いマッチと通常火力を持つ囚人を、月桂冠の受け手に決める。火傷・出血の継続ダ: Choose the Sinner with the strongest clashes and direct damage to receive the Wreath. Both the body and adds nullify ongoing Burn and Bleed damage; prioritize skill damage and SP recovery.
messages.ほかの囚人には通常技・取り巻きへのマッチと精神力回復を任せる。プイを守るために速: Assign the others to normal skills, adds, and SP recovery. Check Speed to protect Pwie, and avoid repeatedly using E.G.O at SP levels that risk Corrosion.
messages.強い囚人で月桂冠を受け取る: Let a strong Sinner receive the Wreath
messages.贖罪の月桂冠持ちがいない場合、本体は良い香りのする月桂冠をセットする。大技のある: If nobody has Laurel Wreath of Atonement, the body equips “Fragrant Laurel Wreath”. On a major-attack turn, it is deferred to next turn. Check the equipped skills and assign your planned strong Sinner as recipient.
messages.この技は速度に関係なくマッチ可能で、直接ダメージ0・沈潜を発動しない。攻撃後に月: This skill is clashable regardless of Speed, deals 0 direct damage, and does not trigger Sinking. It applies the Wreath After Attack and heals 20 SP On Hit. You do not have to use only a fast Sinner.
messages.月桂冠持ちは混乱区間が全て消え、マッチ威力+2、沈潜の精神力ダメージ−50%。終: The Wreath removes all Stagger Thresholds, gives +2 Clash Power, and halves Sinking SP damage. It also heals 10 SP at Turn End, grants 5 Haste next turn, and restores 5 SP to all allies including Pwie on a clash win.
messages.本体は月桂冠持ちからのスキル被ダメージが150%増える。大技に勝ったうえで、余っ: The body takes 150% more skill damage from the Wreath holder. After covering the major clash, direct their spare strong attacks at the body. Deploying fewer Sinners can give the holder more actions, but first secure recovery and Pwie's survival.
messages.月桂冠持ちに危険な技、ほかの囚人に通常技と取り巻き: Wreath holder takes dangerous skills; others handle normal skills and adds
messages.人になりたかった人形や、皆の心の中の欲望が…は月桂冠持ちに任せる。月桂冠があれば: Assign “A Doll Who Yearned to be Human” and When flowers substitute... to the Wreath holder. The Wreath prevents their After Attack SP loss, and clash wins restore SP to all allies.
messages.月桂冠のない囚人は弱い通常技や土から生まれた者へマッチする。攻撃後の精神力低下は: Sinners without the Wreath clash with weaker normal skills or One Who Emerged from the Earth. After Attack SP loss is separate from On Hit effects; check SP even on Sinners who won their clashes.
messages.人形になりたかった人は加重値3の広域乱射だが、最後のコインだけ全攻撃対象に当たる: “A Human Who Yearned to be a Doll” has 3 Atk Weight and randomly distributed attacks, but only the last Coin hits all attack targets. Others besides the clash recipient may suffer Faint Aroma and Tremor Burst; check everyone.
messages.取り巻きは直接ダメージ0でも状態を増やす。残香・沈潜・振動がたまる前にマッチと攻: Adds build statuses even with 0 direct damage. Clash and eliminate them before Faint Aroma, Sinking, and Tremor accumulate. With Tremor, you can raise their Stagger Thresholds and exploit their death on Stagger.
messages.月桂冠持ちで広域に勝つ: Win the area clash with the Wreath holder
messages.花びらは戦闘開始時1、ターン終了時に1増え、3になると土へ還ろうとする願いを抱い: Petals starts at 1 at Combat Start and increases by 1 at Turn End. At 3, the body uses “Bearing the hope to return to dust...” This usually gives a three-turn cycle, but the body's Stagger resets it; check the Stack too.
messages.大技は加重値7・1枚破壊不能、素の最大21。メインターゲットの振動・沈潜威力の合: The major skill has 7 Atk Weight, one Unbreakable Coin, and a base maximum of 21. It gains +1 Final Power per combined 3 Tremor and Sinking Potency on the main target, up to +8, plus another +5 without the Wreath. Use the Wreath holder's strong skill or E.G.O.
messages.マッチに勝てばダメージ−80%・この技のダメージによる混乱なし・対象の沈潜を発動: Winning grants 80% damage reduction, prevents Stagger from this skill's damage, and stops it triggering the target's Sinking. It also prevents the Faint Aroma-based extra inflictions and Tremor Burst from On Hit Without Breaking.
messages.使い終わると花びらは0へ戻る。残る破壊不能の被害を回復し、次の大技までに本体を混: Petals resets to 0 after the skill. Heal the remaining Unbreakable damage, then Stagger and damage the body before the next major attack.
messages.毎ターンの開始・精神力が低いとき: Each Turn Start and whenever SP is low
messages.パニック・侵蝕とプイへの攻撃を先に確認する: Check Panic, Corrosion, and attacks on Pwie first
messages.パニック・侵蝕の囚人がいると、開始時に生きようとするすべてのものと共に墓へと帰ら: If a Sinner is Panicked or Corroded, the body uses “... It shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live” at Turn Start. It targets the slowest first, up to twice per turn; Assist Units are excluded.
messages.この技はマッチ不可・対象変更不可で守備も発動させない。対象がパニック・侵蝕でなく: This skill is Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and does not activate Defense Skills. It is canceled if the target is no longer Panicked or Corroded; restore SP before it acts. Do not plan to survive by simply taking it.
messages.的中すると最大HP120%の固定ダメージ。死亡すると次ターンに取り巻きが増える（: On Hit, it deals fixed damage equal to 120% max HP. A kill creates an add next turn unless four already exist. Heal early to account for Faint Aroma's Turn End SP damage and the 20 SP lost on Stagger.
messages.プイは即死技の対象外でも、ほかの攻撃で死亡すれば敗北する。囚人の精神力だけでなく: Pwie is excluded from the lethal attack, but still causes defeat if killed by another attack. Check and intercept attacks aimed at Pwie as well as managing Sinners' SP.
messages.本体HP40%・混乱後: Body at 40% HP and after Stagger
messages.全体精神力回復と脆弱を使って仕留める: Finish with party SP recovery and Fragile
messages.本体の混乱区間はHP40%・873。混乱すると囚人と助力者の精神力が20回復し、: The body's Stagger Threshold is at 40% HP (873). Stagger restores 20 SP to Sinners and Assist Units and gives the body 2 Fragile next turn. Concentrate the Wreath holder's damage to finish during this opening.
messages.混乱から回復したターンの開始時には花びらが1へ戻る。単純な3・6・9ターン固定で: At Turn Start after recovering from Stagger, Petals resets to 1. Recheck Petals and skills instead of predicting major attacks strictly on turns 3, 6, and 9.
messages.取り巻きの攻撃と残香を放置した長期戦は精神力が厳しくなる。月桂冠持ちの強い攻撃を: A long battle with unchecked add attacks and Faint Aroma strains SP. Send the Wreath holder's strong attacks at the body while the others cover necessary clashes and healing; protect Pwie and finish.
messages.混乱区間を全て除去し、マッチ威力+2、沈潜の精神力ダメージ−50%（小数点切り捨: Removes all Stagger Thresholds, gives +2 Clash Power, and reduces Sinking SP damage by 50% (rounded down). At Turn End, heal 10 SP and gain 5 Haste next turn. Clash wins heal 5 SP to all allies, including Assist Units. Also excludes the holder from several of the body's After Attack SP losses.
messages.最初の受け手を強い囚人にし、大技へのマッチと本体への攻撃を任せる。: Give the first Wreath to a strong Sinner and assign them major clashes and attacks on the body.
messages.最大30。終了時に数値分の精神力ダメージ。沈潜ダメージを受けると1増え、振動爆発: Maximum 30. At Turn End, take SP damage equal to Stack. Gain 1 after taking Sinking damage. On Tremor Burst, apply 1–2 to 3 other random allies. At 30, gain 2 Tremor, trigger Tremor Burst, take Gloom damage equal to Sinking on self, then remove this effect and cannot regain it that turn. On death, randomly distribute half the Stack, rounded down, among allies.
messages.終了時の精神力低下を見越して回復し、残香を増やす取り巻きにもマッチを取る。: Heal for the expected Turn End SP loss and clash with adds that increase Faint Aroma.
messages.最大3。3のターンに強い技を使い、混乱した対象への与ダメージが数値×10%増す。: Maximum 3. Uses a powerful skill on a turn at 3; deals +(Stack ×10)% damage to Staggered targets. Gains 1 at Turn End and resets to 0 at the end of the major skill. At Turn Start after the body recovers from Stagger, resets to 1.
messages.3の大技へ月桂冠持ちの強いマッチを残す。囚人が混乱したまま攻撃を受けないよう守る: Save a strong clash from the Wreath holder for the major attack at 3. Protect Staggered Sinners from further attacks.
messages.本体・部位・土から生まれた者は、火傷と出血によるダメージを受けない。: The body, its parts, and One Who Emerged from the Earth take no Burn or Bleed damage.
messages.火傷・出血の継続ダメージを主軸にせず、月桂冠持ちのスキル火力で削る。: Use the Wreath holder's skill damage rather than centering the strategy on ongoing Burn or Bleed damage.
messages.助力者プイも戦い、死亡すると敗北する。立春のパニック・侵蝕対象の技からは除外され: Assist Unit Pwie also fights, and their death causes defeat. Excluded from Spring's Advent's skill targeting Panic or Corrosion, but can still die to normal damage.
messages.向かっている攻撃を引き受け、月桂冠持ちのマッチ勝利で精神力も回復する。: Intercept incoming attacks and restore SP through the Wreath holder's clash wins.
messages.顧客Lv55以上・オニキスを目安に準備する。外での人格レベルとは分けて確認する。: Prepare for Customer Lv. 55 or higher and Onyx rank. Check separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.
messages.月桂冠のない囚人からのスキル被ダメージは50%減、ある囚人からは150%増。受け: The body takes 50% less skill damage from Sinners without the Wreath and 150% more from its holder. Choosing the recipient is central to the fight.
messages.パニック・侵蝕への即死級技はマッチ・対象変更・守備発動不可。精神力を回復して条件: The lethal attack on Panic or Corrosion is Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and does not activate defense. Remove its condition by restoring SP.
messages.助力者プイが死亡すると敗北する。即死技の対象外でも、通常の攻撃から守る。: Assist Unit Pwie's death causes defeat. Protect them from normal attacks even though the lethal skill excludes them.
messages.本体・取り巻きは火傷・出血ダメージ無効。取り巻きは混乱すると死亡する。: The body and adds nullify Burn and Bleed damage. Adds die when Staggered.
messages.直接ダメージ0でも、状態付与や精神力低下は残る。勝利後も精神力を確認する。: Even at 0 direct damage, statuses and SP loss remain. Check SP after winning too.
messages.大技は花びら3が目印。本体の混乱と大技の終了で数値が変わるため、固定ターンだけで: 3 Petals signals the major attack. The body's Stagger and the skill's end change its Stack; do not rely only on fixed turn numbers.
messages.顧客Lv55以上・オニキスを目安にする。強い囚人1名へ月桂冠を渡し、その囚人が大: Aim for Customer Lv. 55 or higher and Onyx rank. Give the Wreath to one strong Sinner and save their skills and resources to win major clashes.
messages.精神力回復を優先し、HP回復とプイを守る速度も用意する。精神力が低いときのE.G: Prioritize SP recovery, with HP healing and enough Speed to protect Pwie. When using E.G.O at low SP, check SP after its cost and the risk of Corrosion.
messages.敵は打撃1.2・憤怒と色欲1.2。憂鬱・嫉妬0.5、暴食0.75なので、使う罪悪: The enemy has Blunt 1.2 and Wrath and Lust 1.2. Gloom and Envy are 0.5, Gluttony 0.75; choose sin affinities too. Ongoing Burn and Bleed damage do not work, but the skills' own damage is not nullified.
messages.大技へのマッチ、味方全体の精神力回復、本体への大きなダメージを担う。: Handles major clashes, restores SP to all allies, and deals heavy damage to the body.
messages.残香・攻撃後の精神力低下・混乱時の追加低下を戻し、パニックや侵蝕からの即死攻撃を: Restores SP lost to Faint Aroma, After Attack effects, and additional loss on Stagger, preventing lethal attacks triggered by Panic or Corrosion.
messages.状態付与を防ぎ、プイへ向かう攻撃を引き受ける。振動による取り巻きの混乱も処理手段: Prevents status application and intercepts attacks aimed at Pwie. Staggering adds with Tremor is another way to eliminate them.
messages.影界開始時にHPを全回復。火傷・出血ダメージ無効。: Fully heals at the start of this dungeon battle. Immune to Burn and Bleed damage.
messages.混乱時に囚人・助力者の精神力20回復、次ターンの自身に脆弱2。: On Stagger, heals Sinners and Assist Units for 20 SP and gains 2 Fragile next turn.
messages.土から生まれた者: One Who Emerged from the Earth
messages.火傷・出血ダメージ無効。混乱すると死亡。: Immune to Burn and Bleed damage. Dies when Staggered.
messages.振動による混乱区間前進量+100%。直接ダメージ0の技でも状態を付与する。: Stagger Threshold rise from Tremor +100%. Applies statuses even with 0 direct damage.
messages.- 贖罪の月桂冠を保有する対象は除く: - Excludes targets with Laurel Wreath of Atonement
messages.2枚破壊不能。攻撃後の精神力−5は贖罪の月桂冠持ちを除く。マッチ勝利後も残る沈潜: Two Unbreakable Coins. The After Attack loss of 5 SP excludes Laurel Wreath of Atonement holders. Check remaining Sinking, Tremor Count, and SP even after a clash win.
messages.通常の2枚貫通。月桂冠を持たない囚人はこの技や取り巻きへマッチし、大技担当を月桂: Two normal Pierce Coins. Sinners without the Wreath should clash with this or the adds while the holder handles major skills. Also watch the After Attack loss of 5 SP.
messages.人になりたかった人形: A Doll Who Yearned to be Human
messages.[使用時]対象の振動威力と沈潜威力の合計3につき、最終威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Final Power +1 per combined 3 Tremor and Sinking Potency on the target (max 2)
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅰ[On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]対象の沈潜威力だけ精神力ダメージ: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal SP damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency
messages.振動・沈潜威力の合計で最終威力が最大2増す。月桂冠持ちで精神力−10を避け、振動: Combined Tremor and Sinking Potency grants up to +2 Final Power. Use the Wreath holder to avoid the 10 SP loss, and prevent Tremor Burst and SP damage equal to Sinking Potency.

messages.このコインは全攻撃対象に命中する: This Coin hits every attack target
messages.3枚破壊不能の広域乱射だが、3枚目は全攻撃対象に当たる。残香と振動爆発を広げるた: Three Unbreakable Coins with randomly distributed area attacks; the third Coin hits every attack target. It spreads Faint Aroma and Tremor Burst, so check all recipients even after winning.
messages.このスキルはダメージを与えず、対象の沈潜を発動させない: This skill deals no damage and does not trigger the target's Sinking
messages.[攻撃後]対象に贖罪の月桂冠を付与(1ターンにつき1回): [After Attack] Apply Laurel Wreath of Atonement to the target (once per turn)
messages.[的中時]対象の精神力を20回復: [On Hit] Heal the target for 20 SP
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。ダメージ0・沈潜発動なしで、攻撃後に受け手へ月桂冠を付: Clashable regardless of Speed, with 0 damage and no Sinking activation. Applies the Wreath to the recipient After Attack. Choose a strong Sinner to receive it and handle later major clashes and attacks.
messages.土へ還ろうとする願いを抱いて: Bearing the hope to return to dust...
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの振動威力と沈潜威力の合計3につき、最終威力+1(最大: [On Use] Final Power +1 per combined 3 Tremor and Sinking Potency on the main target (max 8)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットに贖罪の月桂冠がなければ、最終威力+5: [On Use] If the main target lacks Laurel Wreath of Atonement, Final Power +5

messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の残香だけ沈潜威力を付与(個別に適用): [On Hit Without Breaking] Inflict Sinking Potency equal to the target's Faint Aroma (applied separately)
messages.加重値7の破壊不能。月桂冠がない相手には最終威力+5、振動・沈潜でも最大+8。月: Unbreakable with 7 Atk Weight. Gains +5 Final Power against a target without the Wreath and up to +8 from Tremor and Sinking. Win with the Wreath holder's strong skill for 80% reduction, Stagger prevention, and no Sinking activation.
messages.生きようとするすべてのものと共に墓へと帰らん: ... It shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live
messages.対象がパニックまたは侵蝕状態でなければ、攻撃がキャンセルされる: If the target is neither Panicked nor Corroded, this attack is canceled
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象の最大体力の120%だけ固定ダメージ: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal fixed damage equal to 120% of the target's max HP
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可・守備発動不可: Unclashable; cannot be redirected; does not activate defense
messages.マッチ不可・対象変更不可・守備発動不可。対象がパニック・侵蝕でなければキャンセル: Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and does not activate defense. Canceled if the target is no longer Panicked or Corroded; restore SP before it acts to remove the condition. On Hit, deals fixed damage equal to 120% max HP.
messages.皆の心の中の欲望が花に置き換わるときが来るのなら…: When flowers substitute all the desire in everyone's hearts...
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能で、直接ダメージは0。攻撃後の精神力−25を避けるため月: Clashable regardless of Speed and deals 0 direct damage. Assign the Wreath holder to avoid losing 25 SP After Attack; win to also prevent 10 Sinking.
messages.このスキルのダメージは0に固定される: This skill's damage is fixed at 0
messages.直接ダメージ0でも、2枚の的中で残香を付ける。余力のある囚人でマッチし、精神力の: Even at 0 direct damage, both Coins apply Faint Aroma On Hit. Clash with an available Sinner to prevent sustained SP loss.
messages.[使用時]対象のマイナス効果の威力の合計3につき、最終威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Final Power +1 per combined 3 negative effect Potency on the target (max 2)
messages.直接ダメージ0だが、沈潜・振動と次ターンの脆弱を付ける。対象のマイナス効果の威力: Deals 0 direct damage but applies Sinking, Tremor, and Fragile next turn. The target's combined negative effect Potency increases its Power; avoid letting a weakened Sinner take it.
messages.[使用時]対象のマイナス効果の威力の合計3につき、最終威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Final Power +1 per combined 3 negative effect Potency on the target (max 3)

messages.破壊不能でも、マッチに勝てば沈潜発動と破壊されずに的中する追加効果を防げる。直接: Despite the Unbreakable Coin, winning prevents Sinking activation and the On Hit Without Breaking extra effects. Do not ignore it just because direct damage is 0.
messages.ステージ開始時、体力を全快する\n本体と部位が、火傷、出血によるダメージを受けな:
At Stage Start, fully recover HP.
