messages.影界開始時・継続中: Start of the dungeon battle and throughout combat
messages.象徴界で半分まで削っても影界では全快する。火傷・出血ダメージを主な削りにせず、通: Even if reduced to half HP in the preceding encounter, fully heals for the dungeon battle. Use direct skill damage rather than relying mainly on Burn or Bleed damage.
messages.戦闘開始時、花びら1を得る\n自分が混乱すると、\n- 次のターンに脆弱2を得る:
At Combat Start, gain 1 Petals.
When Staggered:
- Gain 2 Fragile next turn.
- Heal Sinners and Assist Units for 20 SP.
- At Turn Start after recovering from Stagger, reset Petals to 1.
At Turn Start, if no enemy has Laurel Wreath of Atonement, equip “Fragrant Laurel Wreath”.
- If “Bearing the hope to return to dust...” is equipped, equip it next turn instead.
Take 50% less skill damage from enemies without Laurel Wreath of Atonement.
Take 150% more skill damage from enemies with Laurel Wreath of Atonement.
messages.戦闘開始・花びら・本体混乱: Combat Start, Petals, and the body's Stagger
messages.月桂冠持ちの与ダメージが大きく増す。本体の混乱で全員の精神力を20回復でき、翌タ: The Wreath holder's damage increases greatly. Staggering the body restores 20 SP to everyone, and its 2 Fragile next turn creates another damage opening.
messages.敵が混乱した場合、対象に精神力ダメージ20\nターン開始時、パニックまたは侵蝕状:
When an enemy becomes Staggered, deal 20 SP damage to them.
At Turn Start, use “... It shall go back to the grave with all that desires to live” on Panicked or Corroded enemies (up to twice per turn, slowest first; excludes Assist Units).
If that skill kills its target, create one One Who Emerged from the Earth next turn.
- Do not create another if four already exist in battle.
messages.混乱でさらに精神力20を失う。パニック・侵蝕のまま開始すると即死級技を受けるため: Stagger costs another 20 SP. Starting a turn Panicked or Corroded invites a lethal attack; restore SP and protect Sinners at risk of Stagger too.
messages.火傷、出血によるダメージを受けない\n振動による混乱区間前進量+100%\n自分:
Takes no Burn or Bleed damage.
Stagger Threshold rise from Tremor +100%.
Dies when Staggered.
messages.火傷・出血は無効だが、振動による混乱区間前進量が100%増す。混乱すると死亡する: Burn and Bleed do not work, but Tremor raises Stagger Thresholds by 100% more. Since adds die on Stagger, Tremor Burst can eliminate them.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 お直し職人アネット（10章B）の攻略｜Limbus As: 10-04 Annette the Alterationist (Canto X, Route B) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「お直し職人アネット（10章B: Annette the Alterationist (Canto X, Route B) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Each turn, have the Alteration Target defend while the other Sinners attack to Stagger Annette. Attacks from the target greatly increase her Power. Stagger removes her Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors; exploit the opening with 3 Fragile to deal heavy damage.
messages.10-04 お直し職人アネット（10章B）: 10-04 Annette the Alterationist (Canto X, Route B)
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store B, 3F: A: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store B, 3F: Alteration Room
messages.お直し職人アネット（10章B）: Annette the Alterationist (Canto X, Route B)
messages.毎ターン、お直し対象になった囚人を守備に回し、ほかの囚人で攻撃して混乱を取る戦闘: Each turn, have the Alteration Target defend while the other Sinners attack to Stagger Annette. Attacks from the target greatly increase her Power. Stagger removes her Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors; exploit the opening with 3 Fragile to deal heavy damage.
messages.10章Bルート3Fの個体が対象。敵Lv48・HP3093・基礎防御Lv56、精神: Covers the Route B, 3F encounter in Canto X. Annette starts at Lv. 48 with 3,093 HP, base Defense Level 56, 30 SP, and Inertia of Drifting at 1 Potency and 0 Count. Her initial Stagger Threshold is 50% HP (1,546) and rises when hit. On Stagger, she creates a new threshold at 0 HP. Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis are required; up to 12 Sinners can deploy. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level, and Identities below Uptie III are raised to III; E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged.
messages.表示威力は漂流慣性・花ばさみ・HP・お直し対象の攻撃による強化を含まない。カッテ: Displayed Power excludes bonuses from Inertia of Drifting, Blossom Scissors, HP, and attacks by the Alteration Target. “Cutting”'s third Coin is always Unbreakable. The effects and tips explain how “Trimming”'s last Coin and “Cutting”'s second Coin become Unbreakable at 60% HP or less. Some action sequences remain unconfirmed; check the current skills and Alteration Target rather than relying on a fixed turn table.
messages.お直し対象の囚人は守備にする。追撃・自動発動攻撃で殴ってしまう場合も警戒する。: Have the Alteration Target defend. Watch for follow-up and automatically triggered attacks that may still hit her.
messages.対象以外の囚人でマッチと攻撃を行い、混乱区間を前進させてバリアを崩す。: Use the other Sinners to clash and attack, raising her Stagger Threshold to break through the Shield.
messages.固定、そして…には75%、クーペ・ダン・ル・ビエには90%軽減がある。強いマッチ: Win strong clashes for 75% reduction against “Pin and Trim Along the Patterns” and 90% against “Coupez dans le Biais”.
messages.急に敵のマッチ威力と被害が大きくなった: Her Clash Power and damage suddenly increased
messages.お直し対象の囚人が攻撃を当てるたび、敵が威力増加3を得る（1ターン最大9）。その: Each hit from the Alteration Target gives Annette 3 Power Up, up to 9 per turn. Have that Sinner defend. Beware of Identities that still trigger follow-up or automatic attacks after manually selecting defense, and attack with the other Sinners.
messages.毎ターンのバリアが厚く、HPを減らせない: The Shield refreshes every turn and I cannot damage her HP
messages.生地30なら開始時に最大HP30%分のバリアを得る。ただし囚人から被撃するたび混: At 30 Fabric, she gains a Shield equal to 30% max HP at Turn Start. However, every hit from a Sinner also raises her Stagger Threshold. Focus attacks from Sinners other than the target to Stagger her, then exploit the loss of Shield and Fabric.
messages.お直し対象の技へ別の囚人でマッチできない: Another Sinner cannot clash with the attack on the Alteration Target
messages.パターン起こしとスュルフィル・ア・ラ・シェンは対象変更不可。お直し対象自身に守備: “Patterning” and “Surfile à la Chaîne” cannot be redirected. Equip defense on the Alteration Target for 80% damage reduction; let the other Sinners clash with normal skills and attack to Stagger her.
messages.広域へ勝っても攻撃が残る: The area attack continues after I win the clash
messages.大技は破壊不能なのでマッチ勝利後も攻撃する。クーペ・ダン・ル・ビエは勝利で90%: Her major skills have Unbreakable Coins and still attack after a clash win. Winning against “Coupez dans le Biais” grants 90% reduction, gives her 4 Paralyze, and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage. Keep checking HP recovery and Tremor even after winning.
messages.守備を選んだはずなのに敵を強化した: Ⅰselected defense but still strengthened her
messages.自動発動する攻撃や追撃が原因になり得る。守備スキルが攻撃スキルへ変化する場合も、: Automatic attacks and follow-ups can cause this. If a Defense Skill changes into an Attack Skill, check what actually activates. If its interaction is unclear, use an Identity with an ordinary Guard or Evade as the Alteration Target.
messages.守備と追撃を確認し、役割を交代できるようにする: Check defense and follow-ups so roles can rotate
messages.顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安に買い物を進める。この時点では顧客Lv51まで: Shop toward Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire rank. Customer Lv. 51 is reachable at this point. Check this separately from Identity levels raised outside the dungeon.
messages.固定出撃はムルソー・シンクレア・ウーティス。全員の守備を確認し、攻撃を止めたいタ: Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis are required. Check everyone's defense and whether follow-ups or automatic attacks may activate on turns when you need them to stop attacking.
messages.相手は斬撃中心。斬撃を受ける耐性とHP回復、対象以外が大技へ勝つための強いマッチ: The enemy mainly uses Slash. Prepare Slash resistance, HP recovery, and strong clashes from Sinners other than the target. Blunt, Sloth, Pride, and Envy work well offensively.
messages.通常技へ勝ち、次のお直し対象を意識する: Win against normal skills and plan the next Alteration Target
messages.トリミング・カッティングへマッチを取り、印と振動の付与を抑える。使用時の漂流慣性: Clash with “Trimming” and “Cutting” to limit Mark and Tremor application. Their On Use Inertia of Drifting Count gains still occur even if you win.
messages.カッティングの3枚目は最初から破壊不能。勝っても裁断の印が付くため、受け手のHP: “Cutting”'s third Coin is Unbreakable from the start. It can apply Mark of Shearing even after a clash win; check the recipient's HP and Mark.
messages.次ターンのお直し対象は、直前のターンにアネットへ最も多くのダメージを与えた囚人。: Next turn's Alteration Target is the Sinner who dealt the most damage to Annette this turn. Avoid concentrating damage on someone whose follow-ups are hard to stop; aim to mark a Sinner who can switch to defense.
messages.最初にお直し対象の囚人を確認する。その囚人の行動を守備にし、攻撃スキルを混ぜない: Identify the Alteration Target first. Set that Sinner to defense without mixing in Attack Skills. Equipping defense at Combat Start reduces damage taken from Annette by 80%.
messages.対象は速度+5・最初のスキルのマッチ威力+3を得るが、攻撃してよい合図ではない。: The target gains +5 Speed and +3 Clash Power on their first skill, but these are not a reason to attack. Hitting Annette first grants her Power Up and worsens later allies' clashes.
messages.攻撃が当たるたびに敵へ威力増加3、1ターン最大9。追撃や自動発動攻撃にも反応する: Each hit gives her 3 Power Up, up to 9 per turn. Follow-ups and automatic attacks also trigger this. After choosing defense, make sure the setup will actually prevent attacks.
messages.マッチ可能反撃で受ける方法もある。ただし通常の攻撃への変化や自動発動攻撃の扱いま: A Clashable Counter can also handle the attack. However, do not assume attacks converted from defense or automatically triggered attacks behave identically. Start with Guard or Evade until familiar with the interaction.
messages.固定、そして…・広域が出たとき: When Pin and Trim or an area attack appears
messages.対象以外の強い技で勝ち、被害を減らす: Win with a strong skill from someone other than the target
messages.固定、そしてパターンに沿って裁断とクーペ・ダン・ル・ビエは、速度に関係なくマッチ: “Pin and Trim Along the Patterns” and “Coupez dans le Biais” can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Assign a strong Sinner other than the Alteration Target.
messages.漂流慣性回数10以上なら10を使ってコイン威力+2となるため、固定の最大15・ク: At 10 or more Inertia of Drifting Count, she consumes 10 for +2 Coin Power. Do not judge Pin and Trim only by its base maximum of 15, or Coupez by 16. Remaining Count consumption and Fabric also increase damage.
messages.固定、そして…へ勝つと75%軽減、クーペへ勝つと90%軽減。どちらも敵に麻痺4を: Winning against Pin and Trim gives 75% reduction; Coupez gives 90%. Both give her 4 Paralyze, reduce Fabric by 3, and prevent Sinners from being Staggered by that skill's damage.
messages.クーペは花ばさみの数だけ加重値が増え、最大7。勝利後も振動や印は残り得るので、広: Coupez gains Atk Weight equal to Blossom Scissors, reaching 7. Tremor and Marks may remain after winning; check HP and statuses on everyone hit by the area attack.
messages.お直し対象の裁断の印が9: The Alteration Target has 9 Mark of Shearing
messages.強化されたお直し技も守備で受ける: Defend against the enhanced alteration skill too
messages.パターン起こしは対象変更不可で、お直し対象へ使う。2枚破壊不能の最後の的中で印9: “Patterning” targets the Alteration Target and cannot be redirected. Both Coins are Unbreakable, and the final hit applies 9 Mark. Prioritize the target's defense and healing instead of trying to redirect it.
messages.開始時のお直し対象が印9なら、スュルフィル・ア・ラ・シェンへ変わる。4枚破壊不能: If the Alteration Target has 9 Mark at Turn Start, the skill changes to “Surfile à la Chaîne”. It has four Unbreakable Coins and scales with Blossom Scissors and Inertia of Drifting Potency.
messages.対象が守備を装着していれば、使用時に敵が麻痺4を得て、その技のダメージでは混乱し: If the target has defense equipped, Annette gains 4 Paralyze On Use, and the skill's damage cannot Stagger the target. Combine this with the Alteration Target's 80% reduction.
messages.対象が守備を装着していないと、敵は次ターンに生地10を得る。マッチを行った場合は: If the target has no defense equipped, Annette gains 10 Fabric next turn. Clashing also inflicts Sheared Apart equal to half the Sinner's Final Clash Power, so do not insist on countering with a strong attack. After use, all Marks are consumed and she also gains Blossom Scissors next turn.
messages.対象以外の攻撃・本体混乱: Other Sinners' attacks and the body's Stagger
messages.混乱で強化を消し、脆弱3の間に攻める: Clear her buffs with Stagger and exploit 3 Fragile
messages.アネットは囚人から攻撃を受けるたび、混乱区間が最大HP0.8%分前進する。お直し: Every hit from a Sinner raises Annette's Stagger Threshold by 0.8% of her max HP. Keep attacking with Sinners other than the target to seek Stagger even while her Shield remains.
messages.混乱するとバリア・裁断された生地・花ばさみを全て失い、脆弱3を得る。この混乱中は: Stagger removes all Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors and gives her 3 Fragile. The Alteration Target can also attack during this Stagger; concentrate strong skills to deal heavy damage.
messages.漂流慣性は混乱で消える効果に含まれない。復帰後の開始時には生地30も戻るので、混: Inertia of Drifting is not among the effects removed by Stagger. She regains 30 Fabric at Turn Start after recovering, so use the entire opening, then identify the next Alteration Target and rotate defense and attack roles.
messages.HP60%以下の開始時からは、失ったHPに応じて威力・斬撃ダメージが増す。トリミ: From a Turn Start at 60% HP or less, lost HP increases her Power and Slash damage. “Trimming”'s last Coin and “Cutting”'s second Coin also become Unbreakable. Watch post-clash damage and healing while seeking another Stagger to finish her.
messages.開始時に前ターン最大与ダメージの囚人へ付く。速度の最小・最大+5、最初に使うスキ: Applied at Turn Start to the Sinner who dealt the most damage last turn. +5 minimum and maximum Speed; +3 Clash Power on the first skill used. If defense is equipped at Combat Start, take 80% less damage from Annette. Loses 1 at Turn End. Each Attack Skill hit from the target gives Annette 3 Power Up, up to 9 per turn.
messages.対象を守備にし、追撃・自動発動攻撃も止める。ほかの囚人が攻め、対象を毎ターン交代: Have the target defend and stop follow-up and automatic attacks. The other Sinners attack; rotate the target each turn.
messages.最大9。数値だけ防御レベルが下がる。アネットを攻撃した囚人にも1付く（囚人ごとに: Maximum 9. Lowers Defense Level by Stack. Sinners attacking Annette also gain 1, up to 5 per Sinner per turn. If the Alteration Target has 9 at Turn Start, “Patterning” becomes “Surfile à la Chaîne”.
messages.印9でも攻撃で無理にマッチせず、対象の守備による軽減を使う。: Even at 9 Mark, use the target's defensive reduction rather than forcing an attack clash.
messages.最大30。充電回数・特殊充電を得るか消耗する技のダメージが数値%増える。終了時に: Maximum 30. Skills that gain or consume Charge Count or special Charge deal Stack% more damage. Loses 5 at Turn End, or 10 if the Shield broke that turn. At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to Stack% max HP and heal SP equal to Stack. Gains 30 at Stage Start and after recovering from Stagger.
messages.混乱でバリアごと消し、復帰後に生地が戻る前に攻める。: Remove it together with the Shield by Staggering her, then attack before Fabric returns after recovery.
messages.最大3。囚人への与ダメージ+(5＋数値×5)%（最大20%）。お直し対象への技の: Maximum 3. Deal +(5 + Stack ×5)% damage to Sinners, up to 20%. Skills against the Alteration Target gain Clash Power equal to Stack. Also enhances “Cutting” and Coupez's Atk Weight, and Surfile's Power and damage.
messages.混乱させれば全て消せる。増えた状態で対象に攻撃させ、さらに敵の威力を上げない。: Stagger removes all of it. Do not let the target attack while it is stacked and further increase her Power.
messages.特殊充電。初期威力1・回数0、回数の基本最大値20で終了時に1減る。累計回数10: Special Charge. Starts at 1 Potency and 0 Count, with a base maximum of 20 Count; loses 1 Count at Turn End. Gain 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. At 3 or more / 5 or more Potency, maximum Count increases by 5 / 10. Charge gain and loss effects also apply.
messages.回数10以上で強化される技が多い。混乱で消えない威力と回数も確認してマッチを選ぶ: Many skills are enhanced at 10 or more Count. Check both Potency and Count, which remain through Stagger, before choosing clashes.
messages.最大30。開始時に数値6につき体力回復減少1を得る（最大5）。パターン起こし・ス: Maximum 30. At Turn Start, gain 1 HP Healing Down per 6 Stack, up to 5. Clash Power against “Patterning” and “Surfile à la Chaîne” is reduced by Stack.
messages.対象への強化技は守備で受け、攻撃でマッチして効果を重ねない。: Defend against the enhanced skill on the target; avoid stacking this by clashing with an attack.
messages.精神力−20以下で被ダメージ+7.5%、被撃時に振動回数1を得る。−45以下では: At −20 SP or lower, take +7.5% damage and gain 1 Tremor Count when hit. At −45 SP or lower, take +15% damage and gain 1 Tremor Potency and Count when hit, once per skill and up to 5 times per turn. If Panicked at Turn End, SP returns to 30.
messages.弱った間に攻撃して混乱を狙う。ただし低精神力が固定されるとは考えない。: Attack during her weakened state to seek Stagger, but do not assume her low SP can be maintained indefinitely.
messages.顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安に、手持ちの強い技と回復をそろえる。: Aim for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire rank, with your strongest available clashes and healing.
messages.お直し対象が攻撃すると敵へ威力増加が付く。速度+5やマッチ威力+3を見て攻撃を選: Attacks from the Alteration Target grant her Power Up. Do not choose attacks just because the target gains +5 Speed or +3 Clash Power.
messages.守備を選んでも、追撃・自動発動攻撃が出る人格には注意する。守備が攻撃へ変わる場合: Beware of Identities with follow-up or automatic attacks even after choosing defense. Interactions when defense changes into an attack remain unconfirmed.
messages.パターン起こし・スュルフィルは対象変更不可。対象自身の守備で80%軽減を使う。: “Patterning” and Surfile cannot be redirected. Use the target's own defense for 80% reduction.
messages.カッティングの3枚目は常時破壊不能。HP60%以下では2枚目も加わり、トリミング: “Cutting”'s third Coin is always Unbreakable. At 60% HP or less, its second Coin and “Trimming”'s last Coin also become Unbreakable.
messages.混乱でバリア・生地・花ばさみは消えるが、漂流慣性は残る。復帰後は生地30を再獲得: Stagger removes Shield, Fabric, and Blossom Scissors, but Inertia of Drifting remains. She regains 30 Fabric after recovery.
messages.正確な技の順番には未確定部分がある。お直し対象・印・現在の技を確認して行動を選ぶ: The exact skill sequence is partly unconfirmed. Check the Alteration Target, Marks, and current skills before acting.
messages.顧客Lv50以上・サファイアを目安にし、固定のムルソー・シンクレア・ウーティスも: Aim for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire rank. Check defense and automatic attacks on the required Meursault, Sinclair, and Outis too.
messages.打撃1.2、怠惰・傲慢・嫉妬1.25が通りやすい。貫通・憤怒・色欲・憂鬱は0.7: Blunt 1.2 and Sloth, Pride, and Envy 1.25 are favorable. Pierce, Wrath, Lust, and Gloom are 0.75; check your main damage types.
messages.斬撃を受ける役とHP回復、速度に関係なく合わせられる大技へ勝つ高威力技を用意する: Prepare Slash-resistant recipients, HP recovery, and high-Power skills to win against major attacks clashable regardless of Speed. Ensure the other Sinners can handle clashes while the Alteration Target defends.
messages.前ターンの最大与ダメージに応じて交代する。防御・回避で攻撃を止め、80%軽減を使: Rotates according to the previous turn's top damage dealer. Stops attacks with Guard or Evade to use the 80% reduction.
messages.対象以外のマッチと手数: Clashes and repeated hits from other Sinners
messages.敵の威力を上げずに攻撃し、被撃時の混乱区間前進でバリアと強化を崩す。: Attack without increasing her Power, raising her Stagger Threshold on hit to break her Shield and buffs.
messages.大技への勝利で75%・90%軽減を取り、残る破壊不能の被害を戻す。: Win major clashes for 75% / 90% reduction and heal the remaining Unbreakable damage.
messages.精神力30、漂流慣性威力1・回数0で出現。: Starts at 30 SP with Inertia of Drifting at 1 Potency and 0 Count.
messages.混乱時、HP0の位置に新しい混乱区間を生成。: On Stagger, creates a new Stagger Threshold at 0 HP.
messages.混乱でバリア・生地・花ばさみを失い、脆弱3を得る。: Stagger removes Shield, Fabric, and Blossom Scissors and gives her 3 Fragile.

messages.Ⅱ[的中時]自分の漂流慣性回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Inertia of Drifting Count
messages.漂流慣性回数10以上でコイン威力+1。HP60%以下の開始時以降は最後のコインも: At 10 or more Inertia of Drifting Count, Coin Power +1. From a Turn Start at 60% HP or less, the last Coin also becomes Unbreakable. Clash with someone other than the Alteration Target to limit Marks and Tremor.

messages.固定、そしてパターンに沿って裁断: Pin and Trim Along the Patterns
messages.-自分の漂流慣性回数が10以上なら、漂流慣性回数10を消耗し、コイン威力+2: - At 10 or more Inertia of Drifting Count, consume 10 Count for +2 Coin Power
messages.・自分の残りの漂流慣性回数を最大20まで消耗し、消耗した数値1につきダメージ量+: · Consume up to 20 remaining Inertia of Drifting Count; damage +1% per Count consumed (max 20%)
messages.-このスキルのダメージでは対象が混乱しない: - The target cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage

messages.[破壊されずに的中時]次のターンに裁断された生地3を得る: [On Hit Without Breaking] Gain 3 Cut Fabric next turn
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。4枚破壊不能だが、勝てば75%軽減・敵に麻痺4・この技: Clashable regardless of Speed, with four Unbreakable Coins. Winning gives 75% reduction, gives the enemy 4 Paralyze, and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. Use a strong skill from someone other than the Alteration Target.
messages.-花ばさみの数値だけ攻撃加重値が増加(最大3): - Increase Atk Weight by Blossom Scissors Stack (max 3)

messages.[的中時]メインターゲットなら、裁断の印5を付与: [On Hit] If the target is the main target, inflict 5 Mark of Shearing
messages.[的中時]振動爆発1回。対象の振動回数が1減少: [On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst once; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]メインターゲットなら振動爆発2回。対象の振動回数が2減少: [On Hit Without Breaking] On the main target, trigger Tremor Burst twice; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 2
messages.加重値4に花ばさみの数だけ加算（最大7）。速度に関係なくマッチでき、勝利で90%: Base 4 Atk Weight increases by Blossom Scissors, up to 7. Clashable regardless of Speed; winning gives 90% reduction, gives the enemy 4 Paralyze, and prevents Stagger. Prioritize a strong clash.
messages.対象変更不可・お直し対象へ使用: Cannot be redirected; used on the Alteration Target
messages.お直し対象への対象変更不可の技。2枚とも破壊不能で、的中すると印9が付く。対象は: An attack on the Alteration Target that cannot be redirected. Both Coins are Unbreakable, and a hit inflicts 9 Mark. Equip defense on the target for 80% reduction while the others attack to Stagger her.
messages.自分の花ばさみ1につき、最終威力+1,ダメージ量+20%(それぞれ最大3,60%: For each Blossom Scissors on self, Final Power +1 and damage +20% (max 3 and 60%, respectively)
messages.自分の漂流慣性威力1につき、ダメージ量+4%(最大20%): Damage +4% per Inertia of Drifting Potency on self (max 20%)

messages.-装着しているなら麻痺4を得て、このスキルのダメージでは対象が混乱しない: - Equipped: gain 4 Paralyze; this skill's damage cannot Stagger the target
messages.-装着していないなら、次のターンに裁断された生地10を得る: - Not equipped: gain 10 Cut Fabric next turn

messages.-対象の裁断の印を全て消耗: - Consume all Mark of Shearing on the target

messages.印9のお直し対象へ使う4枚破壊不能。対象は守備をセットし、80%軽減に加えて敵の: Four Unbreakable Coins against an Alteration Target with 9 Mark. Equip defense for 80% reduction, 4 Paralyze on the enemy, and immunity to Stagger from this skill's damage. Clashing with an attack strengthens her and also inflicts Sheared Apart.
messages.敵Lv48が今回の基準。顧客レベルを上げ、使える強いマッチと回復を準備する。: The reference encounter is enemy Lv. 48. Raise Customer Level and prepare your available strong clashes and healing.
messages.ターン開始時、直前のターンに自分へ最も多くのダメージを与えた囚人にお直し対象1を:
At Turn Start, inflict 1 Alteration Target on the Sinner who dealt the most damage to this unit last turn, then use “Patterning”.
- If that Sinner has 9 Mark of Shearing, “Patterning” activates as “Surfile à la Chaîne”.

Whenever hit by a Sinner:
- Inflict 1 Mark of Shearing on that Sinner (max 5 per Sinner per turn).
- Gain 1 Inertia of Drifting Count.

Whenever hit by an Attack Skill from a Sinner with Alteration Target, gain 3 Power Up (max 9 per turn).
messages.開始時の前ターン最大与ダメージ囚人・被撃時: Turn Start: previous turn's top damage dealer; when hit
messages.お直し対象は守備に回す。対象の攻撃は敵へ威力増加3を与え、最大9まで強化する。ほ: Have the Alteration Target defend. Their attacks give her 3 Power Up, up to 9. Let the other Sinners attack to seek Stagger.
messages.ステージ開始時、または混乱状態から脱した後のターン開始時、裁断された生地30を得:
At Stage Start, or at Turn Start after recovering from Stagger, gain 30 Cut Fabric.

Fixed Panic applies; if Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 30.

At Turn Start:
- Gain a Shield equal to (Cut Fabric Stack)% max HP (max 30%).
- Heal SP equal to Cut Fabric Stack.
messages.開始時・混乱から復帰後・毎ターン: Stage Start, after Stagger recovery, and each turn
messages.生地30によるバリアと精神力回復がある。混乱で生地を消し、バリアが戻る前にHPを: 30 Fabric supplies Shield and SP recovery. Remove Fabric through Stagger and deal heavy HP damage before the Shield returns. Panic also resets SP to 30 at Turn End, so do not rely on keeping her SP low.
messages.お直し職人アネットが、\n-囚人から攻撃を受けるたびに、自分の混乱区間が最大体力:
Whenever Annette the Alterationist is hit by a Sinner, raise her Stagger Threshold by 0.8% max HP.

On becoming Staggered, lose all Shield, Cut Fabric, and Blossom Scissors and gain 3 Fragile.

At Turn Start, if at 60% HP or less:
- Gain 1 Power Up and 1 Slash DMG Up per 20% HP lost (max 3 each).
- “Trimming”'s last Coin and “Cutting”'s second Coin become Unbreakable.
messages.囚人から被撃・混乱・開始時HP60%以下: When hit by Sinners, on Stagger, and Turn Start at 60% HP or less
messages.被撃で混乱区間が前進するため、バリアが厚くても攻撃に意味がある。混乱でバリア・生: Hits raise her Stagger Threshold, so attacks matter even against a thick Shield. Stagger removes Shield, Fabric, and Blossom Scissors; attack during 3 Fragile.
messages.戦闘中、累計で自分の漂流慣性回数を10消耗するたびに、漂流慣性威力1を得る\n\:
During this battle, gain 1 Inertia of Drifting Potency for every cumulative 10 Inertia of Drifting Count consumed.

At 3 or more / 5 or more Potency, maximum Inertia of Drifting Count +5 / +10.
messages.回数を使うほど威力が育つ。威力3・5で回数上限も増すため、混乱で消えないこの成長: Consuming Count builds Potency, with higher Count caps at 3 and 5 Potency. This growth survives Stagger; avoid a prolonged fight.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 統制者（10章B）の攻略｜Limbus Assistan: 10-04 The Overseer (Canto X, Route B) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「統制者（10章B）」の攻略。: The Overseer (Canto X, Route B) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. From Turn 2, obey the rules applied to three Sinners each turn. Eliminate Tanned Prisoners to weaken the body’s Unbreakable area attacks. Punishment is Unclashable and does not activate defense: plan targets and skill types first. Clear adds while damaging the body, and prepare for a forced turn end around half HP.
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store B, B3F:: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store B, B3F: Leather Room
messages.10章BルートB3Fの個体が対象。本体Lv65・最大HP5000だが、HP450: Covers the Route B, B3F encounter in Canto X. The body is Lv. 65 with 5,000 max HP, but starts at 4,500 HP and 45 SP. Base Defense Level is 70. Prisoners are Lv. 60 with 74 HP and base Defense Level 59. Base values exclude Rule Collapse and Defense Level loss from killing Prisoners. Yi Sang, Meursault, and Ishmael are required; up to 12 Sinners can deploy. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level, and Identities below Uptie III are raised to III; E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. The exact transition boundary around 50% HP remains unconfirmed.
messages.表示威力は精神力・罪人数・規則の崩壊・開始時の強化を含まない。召喚を攻撃2つで止: Displayed Power excludes SP, Prisoner count, Rule Collapse, and start-of-combat buffs. Only normal “Splitting”'s summon can be stopped with two assigned attacks; “Massive Splitting” has no such condition. Rule violations are checked at Combat Start based on assigned targets and equipped skills. After a violation, the follow-up comes at the end of that Sinner's attack.
messages.毎ターン、規則の付いた3名の禁止内容を確認してからスキルをセットする。: Each turn, check the restrictions on the three marked Sinners before equipping skills.
messages.規則を守れる囚人で罪人を倒し、本体の広域ダメージと回復を抑える。: Kill Prisoners with Sinners who can obey their rules to limit the body's area damage and healing.
messages.本体の肉面除去・原罪的脳油タンブリングへ勝ち、80%軽減を取る。: Win against the body's “Fleshing” and “Leather Tumbling in Brain Fat: Original Sin Style” for 80% reduction.
messages.行動後に強烈な追撃を受けた: A powerful follow-up hit after my action
messages.タンナリー規則に違反すると、その囚人の攻撃終了時に罰の技が来る。マッチ不可・守備: Violating a Tannery Rule triggers punishment at the end of that Sinner's attack. It is Unclashable and does not activate defense, so revise the actions of Sinners with rules. Distinguish the two targeting restrictions from the two restrictions on attack or defense.
messages.攻撃禁止なのにマッチを取らないと危ない: Attacks are prohibited, but I need to clash
messages.攻撃的態度禁止はE.G.Oを例外としているため、守備へ回すか、精神力と資源に余裕: Offensive Behavior Prohibited exempts E.G.O. Defend, or clash with E.G.O if SP and resources allow. Do not extend this exemption to rules prohibiting attacks on the Overseer or Prisoners.
messages.罪人を倒しても次々に出てくる: Prisoners keep appearing after I kill them
messages.通常のスプリッティングは、そのスロットをメインターゲットにする攻撃を2つ以上指定: For normal “Splitting”, assigning at least two attacks with that slot as their main target stops its summoning effect. Use Sinners who can obey their rules. “Massive Splitting” summons up to four without that cancellation condition; eliminate the new Prisoners quickly.
messages.肉面除去とタンブリングは破壊不能で、罪人1体ごとにダメージが10%増す。勝利で8: “Fleshing” and Tumbling have Unbreakable Coins and gain 10% damage per Prisoner. Winning gives 80% reduction, but the attacks remain. Kill Prisoners first if possible and prepare HP recovery. In the second half, Prisoner count also increases Tumbling's Final Power.
messages.削った罪人が消えて本体が回復した: A wounded Prisoner disappeared and healed the body
messages.ブレイン・タンニングは敵陣の低HPの味方を回収する技。対象を先に倒せばキャンセル: “Brain Tanning” consumes a low-HP ally on the enemy side. Killing the target first cancels the skill; finish Prisoners rather than chipping them down. Their “Expiatory Embossing” also heals the body On Hit.
messages.顧客Lv65と、規則に合わせられる手札を用意する: Prepare Customer Lv. 65 and flexible actions for the rules
messages.買い物を進め、顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安にする。B3Fへ入る前に到達可能な: Shop toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Both are reachable before B3F, so check unpurchased shops. Check Customer Rank separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.
messages.固定出撃はイサン・ムルソー・イシュメール。攻撃を禁止される場合に備えて、使いやす: Yi Sang, Meursault, and Ishmael are required. Bring Identities with usable defense for turns when attacks are prohibited. Save E.G.O resources, SP, and HP recovery for Unbreakable area damage.
messages.打撃1.5、嫉妬1.25・怠惰1.2が通りやすい。プイの出血付与も活用し、本体へ: Blunt 1.5, Envy 1.25, and Sloth 1.2 are favorable. Use Pwie's Bleed application to maintain damage on the body while eliminating Prisoners promptly.
messages.4種類の禁止規則で行動を振り分ける: Assign actions according to the four prohibitions
messages.まず規則の付いた3名を確認する。原皮損傷禁止なら罪人へ攻撃を指定せず、本体への攻: First identify the three Sinners with rules. Raw Hide Damage Prohibited means no attacks targeting Prisoners: attack the body or defend. Tanning Rush Prohibited means no attacks on the body: attack Prisoners or defend.
messages.攻撃的態度禁止なら通常の攻撃をセットせず守備へ回す。E.G.Oはこの規則の例外な: With Offensive Behavior Prohibited, do not equip a normal attack; defend instead. E.G.O is exempt from this rule, so it can be used to clash if resources and SP allow.
messages.防御的態度禁止なら守備をセットしない。ほかの規則に抵触しない攻撃先を選び、マッチ: With Defensive Behavior Prohibited, do not equip defense. Pick a legal attack target and clash. E.G.O is exempt from Offensive Behavior Prohibited, not automatically from targeting restrictions.
messages.判定は攻撃先の指定やスキルのセットをして戦闘開始する時点。自動追撃・援護防御の発: Checks occur at Combat Start based on assigned targets and equipped skills. Do not confuse an automatic follow-up or defensive assist activating with manually equipping that skill. Rules are reapplied each turn; do not blindly repeat the previous turn's actions.
messages.前半・召喚と回収: First half: summoning and consuming allies
messages.罪人を倒し切り、止められる召喚を止める: Finish Prisoners and stop the summons you can
messages.罪人はHP74だが、召喚後は皺のついていない皮でバリア20・保護2を得る。打撃や: Prisoners have 74 HP, but Uncreased Hide gives them 20 Shield and 2 Protection after summoning. Focus attacks from Sinners who can obey their rules, using Blunt or favorable sin affinities to finish them.
messages.罪人を残すと本体の肉面除去・タンブリングのダメージが1体につき10%増え、終了時: Each surviving Prisoner increases “Fleshing” and Tumbling damage by 10%. Their Turn End survivor count also grants DMG Up next turn. Each death lowers the body's Defense Level by 1 for the battle, giving another reason to kill them.
messages.通常のスプリッティングが出たら、その技のスロットをメインターゲットにする攻撃を2: When normal “Splitting” appears, assign at least two Attack Skills with that exact slot as their main target to stop its Turn End summoning effect. Use Sinners who will not violate rules, and ensure both attacks target the same slot.
messages.マッシブ・スプリッティングは最大4体を召喚し、同じ攻撃2つでの停止条件はない。罪: “Massive Splitting” summons up to four and has no equivalent two-attack cancellation condition. Prisoners cannot exceed six alive. If the consumption skill appears, kill its low-HP Prisoner target first to prevent the Overseer's healing and buffs.
messages.罪人を減らしてから、強いマッチで軽減を取る: Reduce Prisoner numbers, then win strong clashes for mitigation
messages.肉面除去は3枚破壊不能、タンブリングは加重値7の3枚破壊不能。どちらも勝利でダメ: “Fleshing” has three Unbreakable Coins; Tumbling has three Unbreakable Coins and 7 Atk Weight. Winning either gives 80% damage reduction and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage.
messages.速い囚人が先に罪人を倒し、その後に本体へマッチする順を作れると被害が下がる。無理: Damage drops if fast Sinners kill Prisoners before the body clashes. Do not violate a rule to force that order; prioritize legal actions and winnable clashes.
messages.タンブリングは戦闘開始時に敵陣へ攻撃威力増加2を与える。マッチで勝ってもこの強化: Tumbling grants 2 Attack Power Up to the enemy side at Combat Start. A clash win does not prevent this buff; check the other enemies' skills too.
messages.勝利後も出血・破裂と破壊不能の被害は残る。罪人から翌ターンの威力減少・防御低下・: Bleed, Rupture, and Unbreakable damage remain after a clash win. Clash with Prisoners you cannot kill to prevent next-turn Power Down, Defense Level loss, and Paralyze.
messages.強制ターン終了と罪人の補充へ備える: Prepare for a forced turn end and Prisoner replenishment
messages.最大HPの半分付近でターンが強制終了して後半へ移る。残った回復や罪人処理が必ず行: Around half max HP, the turn forcibly ends and the second half begins. Do not assume queued healing or Prisoner cleanup will still resolve; heal early. The exact boundary check remains unconfirmed, so expect the transition around 2,500 HP.
messages.移行時には罪人が6体になるまで補充され、敵陣は規則の崩壊を得る。攻撃レベル+3・: At transition, Prisoners are replenished to six and the enemy side gains Rule Collapse. Attack Level +3 and Defense Level −3 make them easier to damage but strengthen incoming attacks.
messages.後半の原罪的脳油タンブリングは、本体HP50%未満の使用時に罪人1体につき最終威: In the second half, “Leather Tumbling in Brain Fat: Original Sin Style” gains +1 Final Power per Prisoner On Use while the body's HP is below 50%. Do not judge the clash by its base maximum of 18 with many Prisoners alive.
messages.前半のパッシブによる追加スロット生成は後半に止まるが、技による召喚と禁止規則は続: First-half passives stop generating extra slots in the second half, but skill-based summons and prohibitions continue. Keep stopping “Splitting” and eliminating Prisoners while finishing the body with Blunt or Bleed.
messages.なめされた罪人へ攻撃スキルを指定して戦闘開始すると、規則が消えてタンナリー規則違: If an Attack Skill targets a Tanned Prisoner at Combat Start, remove this rule and gain 1 Tannery Rule Violation. The rule also expires at Turn End.
messages.本体への攻撃か守備を選ぶ。罪人処理はほかの囚人へ任せる。: Attack the body or defend. Let other Sinners handle Prisoners.
messages.統制者へ攻撃スキルを指定して戦闘開始すると、規則が消えてタンナリー規則違反1を得: If an Attack Skill targets the Overseer at Combat Start, remove this rule and gain 1 Tannery Rule Violation. The rule also expires at Turn End.
messages.罪人への攻撃か守備を選ぶ。本体のマッチはほかの囚人へ任せる。: Attack Prisoners or defend. Let other Sinners handle the body's clashes.
messages.攻撃スキルをセットして戦闘開始するとタンナリー規則違反1を得る。E.G.Oスキル: Equipping an Attack Skill at Combat Start gives 1 Tannery Rule Violation. E.G.O skills are exempt. This rule expires at Turn End.
messages.守備にするか、資源と精神力を確認してE.G.Oを使う。: Defend, or use E.G.O after checking resources and SP.
messages.守備スキルをセットして戦闘開始するとタンナリー規則違反1を得る。規則は終了時に消: Equipping a Defense Skill at Combat Start gives 1 Tannery Rule Violation. This rule expires at Turn End.
messages.守備をセットせず、攻撃可能な相手へマッチや攻撃を行う。: Do not equip defense; clash or attack a legal target.
messages.最大1。統制者からの被ダメージ+30%。その囚人の攻撃終了時にパニッシング・バー: Maximum 1. Take 30% more damage from the Overseer. At the end of the Sinner's attack, receive “Punishing Burnishing Finishing”, then remove this effect. The follow-up is Unclashable, does not activate defense, and triggers extra attacks from three Prisoners.
messages.耐えることを基本にせず、開始前のスキル指定で違反を防ぐ。: Prevent violations through pre-combat skill assignments rather than planning to tank the punishment.
messages.最大1。開始時にバリア20・保護2を得て、終了時に消える。スプリッティング系の召: Maximum 1. At Turn Start, gain 20 Shield and 2 Protection; expires at Turn End. Applied to Prisoners summoned by “Splitting” skills.
messages.HP74だけで必要火力を判断せず、召喚直後のバリアと保護を含めて倒し切る。: Do not estimate required damage from 74 HP alone. Include the Shield and Protection just after summoning and finish them.
messages.攻撃レベル+3・防御レベル−3。後半への移行時に統制者を含む敵陣が得る。: Attack Level +3 and Defense Level −3. The enemy side, including the Overseer, gains it at the second-half transition.
messages.後半の火力増加に備え、罪人の処理と大技へのマッチを続ける。: Prepare for higher damage in the second half while continuing Prisoner cleanup and major clashes.
messages.精神力−20以下で最終威力+1、開始時にほかの味方へ攻撃威力減少1を付与。−45: At −20 SP or lower, Final Power +1 and inflict 1 Attack Power Down on other allies at Turn Start. At −45 SP or lower, also inflict 1 DMG Down. If Panicked at Turn End, SP returns to 30.
messages.低精神力でも本体の威力が下がるとは限らない。予測威力と罪人数を見てマッチを組む。: Low SP does not necessarily lower the body's Power. Plan clashes using predicted Power and Prisoner count.
messages.B3Fへ入る前に顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドへ到達できる。未購入の店を確認する。: Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank are reachable before B3F. Check unpurchased shops.
messages.規則は2ターン目以降、毎ターン3名へ付く。攻撃先の禁止と、攻撃・守備の種類の禁止: From Turn 2, three Sinners receive rules each turn. Distinguish restrictions on targets from restrictions on attack or defense.
messages.E.G.Oが例外なのは攻撃的態度禁止。統制者・罪人への攻撃指定禁止にも例外がある: E.G.O is exempt from Offensive Behavior Prohibited. Do not assume it is also exempt from prohibitions on targeting the Overseer or Prisoners.
messages.違反への追撃はマッチも守備もできない。自分の攻撃終了後の追撃を受ける前に、指定し: The violation follow-up cannot be clashed with and does not activate defense. Check assigned actions before receiving it after your attack.
messages.通常スプリッティングの召喚停止は、同じスロットへのメインターゲット指定2つ以上。: Normal “Splitting”'s summon is stopped by at least two attacks with the same slot as their main target. This does not apply to “Massive Splitting”.
messages.本体最大HPは5000、開始は4500。HP2500付近で強制ターン終了と罪人の: The body has 5,000 max HP and starts at 4,500. Expect a forced turn end and Prisoner replenishment around 2,500 HP.
messages.罪人の数は本体のダメージと後半の威力にも影響する。召喚後に本体だけを殴り続けない: Prisoner count affects the body's damage and later Power. Do not keep attacking only the body after summons.
messages.顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に買い物を済ませる。固定のイサン・ムルソー・イシ: Finish shopping toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Check usable defense on the required Yi Sang, Meursault, and Ishmael too.
messages.打撃・嫉妬・怠惰の火力と罪人を先に倒す速度を用意する。プイの出血付与を生かし、出: Prepare Blunt, Envy, and Sloth damage and enough Speed to kill Prisoners first. You can also exploit Pwie's Bleed application, maintaining Bleed Potency and Count to damage the body.
messages.本体の全攻撃は打撃。打撃耐性とHP回復、大技に勝つ高威力技をそろえる。攻撃的態度: All of the body's attacks are Blunt. Bring Blunt resistance, HP healing, and high-Power skills for major clashes. Check SP and resources when using E.G.O under Offensive Behavior Prohibited.
messages.規則に合わせて行動するマッチ役: Clash roles that adapt to the rules
messages.毎ターン使える囚人が変わる。1名だけに大技担当を固定せず、守備やE.G.Oも使っ: Available Sinners change each turn. Avoid relying on only one major-clash specialist; use defense and E.G.O to avoid violations.
messages.速い罪人処理と本体への火力: Fast Prisoner cleanup and body damage
messages.取り巻きを倒して広域ダメージ・回復を抑え、防御低下から本体を削る。: Kill adds to reduce area damage and healing, then exploit the body's lowered defense.
messages.マッチ勝利後も残る破壊不能の被害を戻し、後半の強化にも備える。: Heal Unbreakable damage remaining after clash wins and prepare for second-half buffs.
messages.後半の規則の崩壊・罪人死亡による防御低下を含まない基礎防御値。: Base defense excludes second-half Rule Collapse and reductions from Prisoner deaths.
messages.HP半分付近でターン終了・罪人補充・パターン変更。: Around half HP, ends the turn, replenishes Prisoners, and changes patterns.
messages.召喚後は皺のついていない皮によるバリア20・保護2に注意。: After summoning, watch for Uncreased Hide's 20 Shield and 2 Protection.
messages.死亡時、統制者の防御レベルが戦闘中1減る。: On death, lowers the Overseer's Defense Level by 1 for the battle.
messages.生存6体を超えない範囲で召喚される。: Summons cannot exceed six living Prisoners.
messages.通常の2枚打撃。出血と破裂の威力・回数を増やすため、規則を守れる囚人でマッチを取: Two normal Blunt Coins. Adds Bleed and Rupture Potency and Count; clash with a Sinner who can obey their rules.
messages.戦場で生存しているなめされた罪人1体につきダメージ量+10%: Damage +10% per living Tanned Prisoner on the field
messages.[マッチ敗北]このスキルのダメージ量-80%。このスキルのダメージでは混乱しない: [Clash Lose] This skill deals 80% less damage and cannot Stagger targets with its damage
messages.3枚破壊不能。罪人1体につきダメージ+10%。勝利で80%軽減と、この技のダメー: Three Unbreakable Coins. Damage +10% per Prisoner. Winning gives 80% reduction and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. Killing Prisoners first also reduces damage.
messages.このスキルは体力が最も低い味方を優先して指定する: This skill prioritizes the ally with the lowest HP
messages.指定した対象を攻撃できなければ、スキルがキャンセルされる: If the selected target cannot be attacked, this skill is canceled
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]対象が味方なら下記の効果を適用: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target is an ally, apply the following effects
messages.- 今回のターンと次のターンにダメージ量増加2を得る: - Gain 2 DMG Up this turn and next turn
messages.敵陣の味方へ使用・対象変更不可: Used on an enemy-side ally; cannot be redirected
messages.低HPの敵陣の味方を回収し、本体のHP・精神力を回復する技。対象を先に倒して攻撃: Consumes a low-HP ally on the enemy side to restore the body's HP and SP. Killing the target first prevents the attack and cancels it. Do not mistake this for an attack aimed at a Sinner.
messages.[ターン終了時]次のターンになめされた罪人を最大2体召喚し皺のついていない皮を付: [Turn End] Summon up to 2 Tanned Prisoners next turn and apply Uncreased Hide
messages.・このスキルを使用するスロットをメインターゲットに指定した攻撃スキルが2つ以上: · At least two Attack Skills have the slot using this skill assigned as their main target
messages.・戦場で生存しているなめされた罪人が6体以上: · At least six Tanned Prisoners are alive on the field
messages.このスロットをメインターゲットにする攻撃スキルを2つ以上セットすると、次ターンの: Equip at least two Attack Skills with this slot as their main target to stop the next-turn summon. A clash win alone is not the cancellation condition. Check each Sinner's restrictions first.
messages.[ターン終了時]次のターンになめされた罪人を最大4体召喚し皺のついていない皮を付: [Turn End] Summon up to 4 Tanned Prisoners next turn and apply Uncreased Hide
messages.[戦闘開始時]すべての味方に次のターンにダメージ量増加1を付与: [Combat Start] Apply 1 DMG Up to all allies next turn
messages.加重値7・破壊不能で、次ターンに最大4体を召喚する。通常のスプリッティングにある: Unbreakable with 7 Atk Weight; summons up to four next turn. It lacks normal “Splitting”'s two-attack cancellation condition, so do not try to stop it the same way.
messages.原罪的脳油タンブリング: Leather Tumbling in Brain Fat: Original Sin Style
messages.[戦闘開始時]すべての味方に攻撃威力増加2を付与: [Combat Start] Apply 2 Attack Power Up to all allies
messages.[使用時]自分の現体力が最大値の50%未満なら、戦場に存在するなめされた罪人1体: [On Use] If current HP is below 50% max HP, Final Power +1 per Tanned Prisoner on the field
messages.加重値7・3枚破壊不能。罪人の数でダメージが増し、本体HP50%未満では最終威力: 7 Atk Weight and three Unbreakable Coins. Prisoner count increases damage and, below 50% body HP, Final Power too. Win a strong clash for 80% reduction. Account separately for the enemy side's 2 Attack Power Up at Combat Start.
messages.このスキルは守備スキルを発動させない(マッチ可能守備スキルを含む): This skill does not activate Defense Skills, including Clashable Defense Skills
messages.[攻撃後]ランダムななめされた罪人3体に、対象へランダムなスキルを使用するよう命: [After Attack] Order 3 random Tanned Prisoners to use a random skill on the target, prioritizing allies that are not Staggered
messages.規則違反への追撃・マッチ不可・守備発動不可: Rule-violation follow-up; Unclashable; does not activate defense
messages.規則違反への追撃。マッチ不可・守備発動不可で、攻撃後には罪人3体の追加攻撃も誘発: Punishes rule violations. Unclashable and does not activate defense; After Attack, also triggers extra attacks from three Prisoners. Prevent violations when choosing actions rather than planning to take it.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに攻撃威力減少2を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn
messages.破裂と次ターンの攻撃威力減少を付ける。倒し切れない罪人にはマッチし、次ターンの本: Applies Rupture and Attack Power Down next turn. Clash with Prisoners you cannot finish to avoid weakening next turn's response to the body.
messages.Ⅱ[的中時]次のターンに防御レベル減少5を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Defense Level Down next turn
messages.破裂回数・次ターンの防御レベル減少5と麻痺2。通常コインなので、規則を守れる囚人: Applies Rupture Count, 5 Defense Level Down next turn, and 2 Paralyze. Normal Coins: win with a Sinner who can obey their rules to prevent the effects.
messages.Ⅰ[的中時]統制者の最大体力の1%だけ、統制者の部位および本体の体力を回復: Ⅰ[On Hit] Heal the Overseer's body and parts for 1% of the Overseer's max HP
messages.[的中時]統制者の最大体力の1%だけ、統制者の部位および本体の体力を回復: [On Hit] Heal the Overseer's body and parts for 1% of the Overseer's max HP
messages.的中ごとに本体を最大HP1%ずつ回復する。2枚目は破壊不能なので、勝利だけで回復: Each hit heals the body for 1% max HP. The second Coin is Unbreakable, so a clash win may not fully stop the healing. Kill the Prisoner first if possible.
messages.原罪的原皮調達: Reaping Raw Hide: Original Sin Style
messages.ターン開始時、戦場に存在するなめされた罪人が2体以下なら、追加スロットを生成\n:
At Turn Start, if two or fewer Tanned Prisoners exist on the field, generate an extra slot.
At Turn End, gain 1 DMG Up next turn per Tanned Prisoner on the field.
messages.前半の罪人2体以下・終了時の生存数: First half: two or fewer Prisoners; Turn End survivor count
messages.罪人を残すと翌ターンのダメージ量が増す。減らすと追加召喚も来るが、規則を守りなが: Leaving Prisoners alive increases next-turn damage. Reducing their numbers also brings extra summons, but keep eliminating them while obeying the rules to limit damage from the body.
messages.戦場に自分以外の、現体力が最大値の80%未満の味方がいれば、追加スロットを生成: If another ally on the field is below 80% max HP, generate an extra slot.
messages.前半・HP80%未満のほかの敵がいる: First half: another enemy below 80% HP
messages.削った罪人を回収される前に倒し切る。後半は追加スロットの生成が止まる。: Finish wounded Prisoners before they are consumed. Extra slot generation stops in the second half.
messages.原罪革タンナリー フル稼働: Tannery of the Original Sin: Full Operation
messages.自分の本体の体力が最大値の50％未満になると、ターンが終了してパターンが変更され: When the body's HP falls below 50% max HP, end the turn, change patterns, and grant Rule Collapse to all allies, including self, for this battle.
messages.強制ターン終了と罪人の補充に備える。規則の崩壊で敵陣の攻撃レベルが3増し、防御が: Prepare for the forced turn end and Prisoner replenishment. Rule Collapse raises the enemy side's Attack Level by 3 and lowers Defense Level by 3.
messages.2ターン目から毎ターン開始時、ランダムな敵3名に以下の効果の中から1つをランダム:
From Turn 2, at each Turn Start, apply one randomly selected effect below to 3 random enemies:
- Rule: Raw Hide Damage Prohibited
- Rule: Tanning Rush Prohibited
- Rule: Offensive Behavior Prohibited
- Rule: Defensive Behavior Prohibited

Violating a rule inflicts 1 Tannery Rule Violation.
messages.規則の付いた3名を確認してから行動をセットする。攻撃先と攻撃・守備の種類を間違え: Check the three Sinners with rules before equipping actions. Distinguish attack targets from attack and defense skill types.
messages.ステージ開始時、体力が90%,精神力が45の状態で開始: At Stage Start, begin at 90% HP and 45 SP.
messages.最大HP5000に対して開始HPは4500。移行の半分は開始HP4500の半分と: Maximum HP is 5,000, but starting HP is 4,500. Do not calculate the halfway transition from the starting 4,500 HP.
messages.専用パニックへの変更で行動を止める前提を置かず、通常のマッチと規則管理を続ける。: Do not assume changing its special Panic will stop its actions. Continue normal clashes and rule management.
messages.ターン終了時にパニック状態なら、精神力が30になる。: If Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 30.
messages.精神力は30へ戻る。低精神力のまま固定できるとは考えない。: SP returns to 30. Do not assume it can be kept at low SP indefinitely.
messages.死亡時、この戦闘のあいだ統制者の防御レベルが永続的に1減少: On death, permanently lower the Overseer's Defense Level by 1 for this battle.
messages.倒すたび本体の防御レベルが戦闘中1下がる。回収されるだけでは死亡時の効果を得たと: Each kill lowers the body's Defense Level by 1 for the battle. Do not assume merely being consumed grants the on-death effect.
messages.麻痺・攻撃レベル減少・攻撃威力減少で敵の攻撃を弱めるデバッファー。: A debuffer that weakens enemy attacks with Paralyze, Offense Level Down, and Attack Power Down.
messages.麻痺: S1「縦斬り」のⅠコインで麻痺1を付与。: **Paralyze**: Coin Ⅰ of S1 Downward Slash inflicts 1 Paralyze.
messages.攻撃レベル減少: S2「斬り上げ」のⅡコインで、次のターンに攻撃レベル減少1/3: **Offense Level Down**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 Upward Slash inflicts 1/3 Offense Level Down next turn.
messages.攻撃威力減少: S3「抉り刺し」のⅠ・Ⅱコインで、次のターンに攻撃威力減少1ずつ: **Attack Power Down**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ of S3 Drilling Stab each inflict 1 Attack Power Down next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「分析」(傲慢×2・共鳴): マイナス効果に掛かっている対象への与: **Combat passive — Analytic Eye (2 Pride Resonance)**: +10% damage against targets afflicted with a negative effect.
messages.S1の麻痺でそのターンのコイン威力を封じ、S2・S3で次のターンの敵の攻撃を弱め: Use S1's Paralyze to lock down Coin Power that turn, weaken the enemy's attacks next turn with S2 and S3, and make use of the passive's damage bonus. The passive requires Resonance, so line up 2 Pride skills.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「エネルギー循環」・S2「跳躍」の使用時と的中時に自分の充電回: **Gaining Charge**: S1 Energy Cycle and S2 Leap increase her Charge Count on use and on hit.
messages.S2: Ⅱコイン的中時に充電回数を3消耗し、次のターンに束縛4を付与。: **S2**: On hit, Coin Ⅱ spends 3 Charge Count to inflict 4 Bind next turn.
messages.S3「過充電」: 充電回数5以上ならマッチ威力+2。Ⅲコイン的中時に充電回数を5: **S3 — Overcharge**: +2 Clash Power with at least 5 Charge Count. On hit, Coin Ⅲ spends 5 Charge Count to inflict 2 Attack Power Down and 3 Paralyze next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「自家発電」(嫉妬×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 攻撃終了時、自分: **Combat passive — Self-charging (4 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the end of an attack, increases the Charge Count of herself and a random ally by 1 each.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を貯め、S2・S3の消耗効果で束縛・攻撃威力減少・麻痺を入れ: Build Charge Count with S1 and S2, then use the spending effects on S2 and S3 to inflict Bind, Attack Power Down, and Paralyze. The passive also raises allies' Charge Count, so she likely pairs well with Identities that use Charge.
messages.S3「機会狙い」: 基本威力4、コイン威力+8の2コイン。前のターンにダメージを: **S3 — Opportunistic Slash**: 2 Coins with 4 Base Power and +8 Coin Power. If she took no damage on the previous turn, Coin Power becomes +11, for a maximum Clash Power of 26 (4+11×2). Coin Ⅱ inflicts 5 Rupture on Heads Hit. Its minimum roll is only 4, so with low SP both Coins risk landing Tails.
messages.S2「深斬り」: 3コインの主力。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで次のターンに呼吸1、Ⅲコインで次: **S2 — Deep Cuts**: Her main 3-Coin skill. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ give 1 Poise next turn, and Coin Ⅲ gives 2/4 Haste next turn.
messages.S1「単撃」: マッチ威力2~8/3~9/3~11と低く、一方攻撃向き。使用時に: **S1 — Sole Strike**: Low Clash Power of 2–8/3–9/3–11, so it is better suited to one-sided attacks. On use, increases Poise Count by 2 and inflicts 1/2 Rupture.
messages.低い耐久: 体力71~224、防御レベルは人格Lv-4。被弾が重なると崩れやすい: **Low durability**: 71–224 HP and Defense Level of Identity Lv -4. She falls apart quickly when hits stack up.
messages.バトルパッシブ「覚悟」(色欲×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開始時に呼: **Combat passive — Resolution (2 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the start of the next turn, gains 2 Haste if she has at least 4 Poise Count. None of her skills scale with Speed, so the benefit is small.
messages.主力はS2。S3はここぞという場面の切り札にする。被弾しなかったターンの次にS3: S2 is her main skill, and S3 is a trump card for key moments. After a turn in which she took no damage, S3 reaches up to 26 power, so throw it at the enemy's strongest skill to take the Clash. It has enough Clash power to beat attacks that would otherwise require an E.G.O. S1 tends to lose Clashes, so use it for one-sided attacks or swap it for a Defense skill. Her durability is low, so play around avoiding unfavorable Clashes and incoming hits.

messages.1ターン目はS1(または守備)で振動回数を貯め、次のターンにS2を広域で撃つ。S: On the first turn, build Tremor Count with S1 or her Defense skill, then fire S2 as a multi-target attack the next turn. messages.S1「40Y-3稼働」: 使用時に充電回数を5消耗してコイン威力+1/2、Ⅱコイ: **S1 — 40Y-3 Activation**: On use, spends 5 Charge Count for +1/2 Coin Power, and Coin Ⅱ adds +2/3 Count. It is a net loss of Count, so hold it back when you want to save Count for S2.
messages.序盤はS3(または守備「充電」)で充電回数を貯め、S3の嫉妬脆弱が入った次のター: Early on, build Charge Count with S3 or the Defense skill Charge, and on the turn after S3's Envy Fragility lands, use S2 at 3 or more Envy Resonance. messages.S2「E.G.O紅炎殺 展開」(始動): 使用時に自分の火傷回数+4。S1・S3: **S2 — E.G.O - A.B.S Activation (opener)**: On use, +4 to her own Burn Count. S1 and S3 only add +1 Count, so start with S2 to grow her own Burn.
messages.S1「着火」・S3「火に思い焦がれて」: S1は使用時に火傷7、S3は戦闘開始時: **S1 Ignition and S3 Drawn by Flame**: S1 gains 7 Burn on use, and S3 gains 7 Burn at Combat Start. The more Burn she has, the more damage she deals. If she has at least 30 Burn, S3 becomes Max Attunement, checked before use.

messages.バトルパッシブ「火取蛾」(憤怒×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時、失った: **Combat passive — Flame Moth (3 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, if she has lost at least 80% of her HP and has less than 30 Burn, she gains Burn up to 30, once per stage. messages.バトルパッシブ「耐火」: 火傷ダメージでは混乱せず、体力も1未満にならない。体力: **Combat passive — Fireproof**: Burn damage does not stagger her and cannot reduce her HP below 1. Even if she holds at 1 HP, other damage kills her normally.
messages.S2 → S1・S3の順で自分の火傷を伸ばし、体力が十分減ったところで「最大感応: Grow her own Burn with S2, then S1 and S3, and once her HP is low enough, fire Max Attunement to self-destruct. The more HP she has lost before using it, the higher its Attack Weight and damage. The basic flow is to hand Offense Level Up to the next unit and swap out. If she wins a Clash against a boss's big Unbreakable Coin attack and then self-destructs, that attack fizzles. The biggest risk is dying to something other than Max Attunement. Watch out for Unbreakable Coins and attacks she cannot Clash while her HP is low. Reducing Burn with her Defense skill can prolong her life, but it delays the self-destruction, so do not use it when aiming to self-destruct.
messages.「雲解顕現」: S3「目でも耳でも追えぬように。」と援護防御専用スキル「超速護衛: **Cloudsplitting Manifestation**: S3 Traceless to Sight and Sound Alike. and the Assist Defense-only skill Swiftfeet Protection turn into it if she has at least 10 Tianjiu Star's Blade before use. It spends 10 Tianjiu Star's Blade after the attack. On hit, Coin Ⅰ inflicts Deathrite【Haste】 and Deathrite 【Fissure】, and at 10 or more Speed, Coin Ⅲ's reuse inflicts them once more on hit.
messages.天究星刀の収支: 最大20。バトルパッシブ「黒獣化【卯】/卯 筆頭」(暴食×5・: **Tianjiu Star's Blade economy**: Maximum 20. Through the combat passive Heishou Mutation [Mao] / Mao Branch Adept (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), she gains 1 each time an ally triggers Deathrite, +1 if she triggered it herself, up to 5 times per turn, for at most 10. The 5-trigger limit appears to be shared with allies' Deathrite triggers, so the amount she recovers may drop if other Identities trigger Deathrite first. She also gains 5 when Assist Defense triggers. At 10 or more Speed, firing it with 10 lets the Deathrite triggers during the attack bring her back up to 20, leaving 10 even after spending 10. This economy is the foundation of the Technique Loop. Both triggering Deathrite【Haste】 and Coin Ⅲ's reuse require at least 10 Speed, so below 10 Speed she cannot recover enough and the loop breaks.
messages.援護防御: S3・守備「尊命。」の戦闘開始時に得る(各1ターン1回)。守備スキル: **Assist Defense**: Gained at Combat Start from S3 and the Defense skill It Shall Be Done., once per turn each. When an ally without a Defense skill equipped is attacked one-sidedly, she redirects the attack to herself and receives it with Swiftfeet Protection. It does not trigger for attacks on Faust herself or attacks marked [Cannot be redirected].
messages.速度: S3・守備・「雲解顕現」で脚力【卯】を得て、次のターンの速度が上がる。速: **Speed**: S3, her Defense skill, and Cloudsplitting Manifestation grant Strider【Mao】, raising her Speed next turn. At 10 or more Speed, triggering Deathrite【Haste】 and Coin reuse become active. With at least 10 Tianjiu Star's Blade, she also gains 1 Haste for the next turn at Turn End.
messages.序盤は守備「尊命。」で暴食を集めてパッシブを発動させ、援護防御の発動(+5)や呪: Early on, gather Gluttony with the Defense skill It Shall Be Done. to activate the passive, and bring Tianjiu Star's Blade to 10 through Assist Defense triggers (+5) and Deathrite triggers. From then on, equip the Defense skill every turn and fire Cloudsplitting Manifestation from Assist Defense to restore Tianjiu Star's Blade to 10. As long as there are one-sided attacks that trigger Assist Defense, the loop is worth continuing even if it means turning S1 and S2 into Defense skills. If you fire an S3 in hand as Cloudsplitting Manifestation in the same turn, the Deathrite recovery runs into the 5-per-turn limit, Tianjiu Star's Blade drops below 10, and the loop breaks. During the loop, save S3 for moments such as when the enemy is staggered. Before entering the loop, S3 can be used early. At 10 or more Speed, hitting an enemy with Rupture triggers Deathrite【Haste】 three times — Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ plus the reuse — for up to 6 Tianjiu Star's Blade. Adding Assist Defense's +5 pushes her past 10 and speeds up the start. She is not good at regular battles where Assist Defense goes unused, and Tianjiu Star's Blade takes time to accumulate, so she shines in reasonably long Focused Encounters.
