messages.黒獣-卯(ウーティス): 同じく呪殺を扱う人格。立ち上げ時の天究星刀の回収に使え: **[Heishou Pack - Mao Branch](persona:1112)** (Outis): Another Identity that uses Deathrite. Useful for recovering Tianjiu Star's Blade during the start-up.
messages.呼吸と出血による強化: S1「刈り取る」は自分の呼吸と対象の出血の合計4以上でコ: **Poise and Bleed bonuses**: S1 Cleave gains +1 Coin Power if her Poise plus the target's Bleed totals at least 4. S2 Positioning Maneuver and S3 Glimmering Bow gain Clash Power/Coin Power for every 4 of that total, and +11% damage for every 4 Poise she has, up to 44%. The Poise-based bonuses do not activate without Poise.
messages.乏しい呼吸: 自前で得られる呼吸はS1で1/2、S2・S3のコインで1/2程度に: **Scarce Poise**: Her own Poise gain is only about 1/2 from S1 and 1/2 from the Coins of S2 and S3. Her main stage is the Mirror Dungeon, where E.G.O Gifts can make up for Poise. Yi Sang's Blade Lineage Salsu support passive Bestow (the 1 ally with the highest SP gains +1 whenever they gain Poise Count from a skill effect) and the E.G.O Thoracalgia can also help.
messages.出血: S3のⅢコインで出血4、S2・S3で出血回数も増やす。: **Bleed**: Coin Ⅲ of S3 inflicts 4 Bleed, and S2 and S3 also increase Bleed Count.
messages.「閃弓」: 守備「弓刀展開」のターン終了時、矢-死が1以上なら狙撃姿勢と目標照準: **Bow's Glimmer**: At Turn End after using the Defense skill Unfold Bowblade, if she has at least 1 Arrow - Shi, she gains Ready to Loose and 1 Target Aim. From then on, her leftmost basic attack skill becomes Bow's Glimmer, an unclashable shot fired at Combat Start. Each turn she uses no attack skill grants +1 Target Aim, up to 4. Each Target Aim raises damage and Critical damage, and at 4 she gains +444% Critical damage. While in Ready to Loose, damage does not stagger her. It is cancelled if she starts combat with an E.G.O skill equipped.
messages.基本はS1〜S3でマッチし、呼吸と出血で威力を伸ばす。呼吸は外部の補助で維持する: By default, Clash with S1–S3 and raise their power with Poise and Bleed. Maintain Poise with external support. Bow's Glimmer means giving up Clashes while charging, and the damage rarely justifies that. Do not use it routinely; limit it to situations where she cannot attack anyway, such as bosses whose powerful skills force the turn to end, and charge Target Aim then fire.
messages.指令: ターン開始時、基本攻撃スキルに指令の印が付く(最大2つ)。遂行すると精神: **Prescript**: At Turn Start, Mark of the Prescript is placed on basic attack skills, up to 2. Fulfilling it restores SP and grants 1 Grace of the Prescript, or 3 if the main target has The Prescript's Target. Failing it grants 5 Karmic Consequence, except at 9 Grace.
messages.指令の加護: 3につき攻撃レベル+1(最大9)。加護6以上ならS3「指令に従い貴: **Grace of the Prescript**: +1 Offense Level for every 3, up to 9. At 6 or more Grace, all Coins of S3 As the Prescript Demands, You Will Be Eliminated. become Unbreakable, and it deals +30% damage.
messages.呼吸と沈潜: 各攻撃スキルは自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計が6以上でコイン威力が上: **Poise and Sinking**: Each attack skill gains Coin Power when her Poise plus the target's Sinking totals at least 6.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遂行者の剣」(怠惰×1・傲慢×1・憂鬱×1・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Combat passive — Proselyte's Blade (1 Sloth, 1 Pride, and 1 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Raises the damage of skills with Mark of the Prescript based on Grace. At 9 Grace, basic attack skills deal +20% damage.
messages.毎ターン指令の印が付いたスキルを優先して当て、カルマを避けながら指令の加護を9ま: Each turn, prioritize landing the skills with Mark of the Prescript, avoid Karmic Consequence, and build Grace of the Prescript up to 9. At 6–8 Grace, fulfilling the Prescript requires landing a marked S3 or an Awakening E.G.O. At 6 or more Grace, all Coins of S3 become Unbreakable, so the attack continues even if she loses the Clash.
messages.生体材料: 特殊充電(回数最大20)。登場時に(戦場にいる薬指所属の味方数×2): **Corpus Ingredient**: A special Charge with up to 20 Count. When she first appears, its Count increases by (number of Ring allies on the field×2), up to 10. At the end of a skill that dealt damage to HP or Shield, +5 Count, plus +3 more if it defeated the target. Each time she spends a cumulative 10 Count, she gains 1 Corpus Ingredient Potency.
messages.作品名:ファシア: 生体材料の威力2以上で得る。威力1で基本威力+1、2で出血の: **Artwork: Fascia**: Gained at 2 or more Corpus Ingredient Potency. At Potency 1, +1 Base Power; at 2, +10% damage against enemies with Bleed; at 3, +1 to the Bleed Potency and Count she inflicts; at 4, +1 Base Power.
messages.アイアンメイデン(序盤): 最も左のスロットの挑発値+4。ターン開始時に保護1・: **Iron Maiden (early phase)**: +4 Aggro on her leftmost slot. At Turn Start, she gains 1 Protection, 5 Defense Level Up, and Shield. When she takes damage from an attacker's final Coin, she returns 20% of it as Pierce damage and increases the attacker's Bleed Count by 2, once per skill and up to 3 times per turn. At Turn End on the turn she gains Fascia, she switches to The Self Unbound - Flow State, gaining +2 to her minimum and maximum Speed and swapping her skills.
messages.S3「抑圧された肉体」/「抑圧された肉体の解放」: 回数10以上なら最大20まで: **S3 Repressed Flesh / Liberation of the Repressed Flesh**: With at least 10 Count, spends up to 20 for +2 Final Power and more damage. After The Self Unbound, the skill gains +1/+2 Attack Weight at 3/5 or more Corpus Ingredient, and all of its Coins become Unbreakable Coins.
messages.解除後の守備「始まった展示会」: 戦闘開始時に援護防御1を得て、一方攻撃される味: **Defense skill after The Self Unbound — The Exhibition Begins**: At Combat Start, gains 1 Assist Defense, then covers an ally who is attacked one-sidedly and counters with No Acts of Vandalism Allowed., a clashable counter that spends and gains Corpus Ingredient.
messages.サポートパッシブ「アイアンメイデン-棘」(色欲×1・嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅲで取: **Support passive — Iron Maiden - Spikes (1 Lust and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When an ally with a Defense skill equipped takes damage, inflicts 4 Bleed on the attacker. If the attacker already has Bleed, increases Bleed Count by 2 instead, twice per turn.
messages.序盤はアイアンメイデンの耐久と挑発値で攻撃を受け、出血回数を伸ばしながら生体材料: Early on, absorb attacks with Iron Maiden's durability and Aggro, extending Bleed Count while building Corpus Ingredient Count. Use S3 only after checking whether its spending will reach 3 Potency; do not throw it away early. After The Self Unbound, attack with her basic skills, which now inflict more Bleed, and her multi-target S3, and use her Defense skill's Assist Defense to cover allies and counterattack. This counter is strong against enemies with Unbreakable Coins. Her support passive is powerful, so leaving her in backup is also an option. She has strong synergy with Hong Lu's The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather.
messages.炎蝶の棺: 最大30(1ターンに得られるのは最大20)。基本スキルの的中で2、各: **Fire Butterfly Coffin**: Maximum 30, with at most 20 gained per turn. Landing a basic skill grants 2, and each skill also adds more on use. Every 10 increases Clash Power and reuse Coins. If it exceeds 20 at Turn End, she gains half of the excess as Burn next turn (5 Burn and +2 Burn Count at 30).
messages.「正午の解体」(守備「烙印」から): 棺30以上で変化する広域乱射(1ターン1回: **Dismemberment at High Noon (from the Defense skill Stigmatize)**: An Unfocused Volley that it turns into at 30 or more Coffin, once per turn. After the attack, she spends up to 30 of her own Burn and recovers (5/20 + Burn spent)% of her max HP, up to 35/50%. She then spends all Coffin and gains 3 Battle Instinct. It does not transform while she has Overheated Coffin.
messages.戦闘感覚: 最大3。速度の最小・最大値+2、基本スキルで付与する火傷の威力・回数: **Battle Instinct**: Maximum 3. +2 to minimum and maximum Speed, +1 to the Burn Potency and Count inflicted by basic skills, and more damage for skills such as Eject and Eject - High Noon.
messages.バトルパッシブ「フォイヤファルター[スティグマ工房]」(憤怒×3・保有・同期化Ⅱ: **Combat passive — Feuerfalter [Stigma Workshop] (3 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: With Battle Instinct, gains (value×3) Coffin at Combat Start, or 9 at 3 Battle Instinct. She follows up with Seconded Offensive after certain skills from Sinclair's Dawn Office Fixer and Gregor's Dawn Office Rep, or when their basic skills stagger an enemy.
messages.「射出-正午」(S3「射出」から): 棺30で変化する広域乱射(1ターン1回)。: **Eject - High Noon (from S3 Eject)**: An Unfocused Volley that it turns into at 30 Coffin, once per turn. All Coins are Unbreakable Coins. It performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst, then grants 1 Battle Instinct and 1 Overheated Coffin after the attack. It does not spend Coffin.
messages.断熱コート: 火傷ダメージでは混乱せず、体力も1未満にならない。火傷による被ダメ: **Heatproof Coat**: Burn damage does not stagger her and cannot reduce her HP below 1. Damage taken from Burn is reduced by 50%, or 75% below 50% HP.
messages.序盤は棺10未満のスキルが弱いので、慎重に動きながら棺を溜める。S3「射出」と守: Her skills are weak below 10 Coffin early on, so build Coffin while playing carefully. S3 Eject and the Defense skill Stigmatize gain Coffin and Wrath, so they are fine to use from the start. Once she reaches 30 Coffin, fire Eject - High Noon first if S3 is in hand. Then fire Dismemberment at High Noon from her Defense skill to gain 3 Battle Instinct and recover HP. However, on the turn she fires Eject - High Noon, Overheated Coffin prevents her Defense skill from transforming, so be careful when acting with multiple slots. After gaining 3 Battle Instinct, she gains 9 Coffin every turn and can fire the enhanced S3 repeatedly. Above 20 Coffin she starts damaging herself, so if her HP is under pressure, recover early with Dismemberment at High Noon. Pairing her with the other two Dawn Office members adds Seconded Offensive follow-ups.
messages.軽い資源で戦闘序盤に撃ち、精神力が低い味方4人を回復して立ち上がりを安定させる、: A Pride Blunt E.G.O that hits 3 targets, costs few resources, and can be used early in a fight to restore SP to the 4 allies with the lowest SP and stabilize the opening.
messages.精神力の回復: 攻撃終了時に、精神力が最も低い味方4人の精神力を回復する(解析Ⅲ: **SP recovery**: At the end of the attack, restores SP to the 4 allies with the lowest SP, increased to 10 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 12 at Ⅳ.
messages.軽い必要資源: 暴食2・傲慢4、精神消耗は20。ZAYIN なので重いE.G.O: **Light requirements**: 2 Gluttony and 4 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 20. As a ZAYIN E.G.O, it can be used earlier than heavier E.G.O.
messages.広域攻撃: 攻撃加重値3で、マッチ威力は15~19(解析Ⅲで19~23)。傲慢抵: **Multi-target attack**: 3 Attack Weight, with Clash Power of 15–19, or 19–23 at Threadspin Ⅲ. Note that her resistances change to Endured against Pride and Fatal to Lust and Gluttony.
messages.パッシブ「倦怠」: 攻撃中に敵が混乱すると、精神力が最も低い味方1名の次のターン: **Passive — Ennui**: If an enemy is staggered during the attack, the 1 ally with the lowest SP gains +2 SP Heal Efficiency next turn, up to 3 times per turn. The condition is strict, so treat it as a minor extra.
messages.侵蝕なし: 初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無い。: **No Corrosion**: As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.精神力が下がる序盤に撃ち、味方のマッチを安定させる。: Use it early, when SP is dropping, to stabilize allies' Clashes.
messages.打撃や傲慢に弱い敵なら、攻撃目的で撃ってもよい。: Against enemies weak to Blunt or Pride, it can also be used for damage.
messages.回復はスキル単発で完結するので、パッシブの発動は期待しすぎない。: The healing is complete with a single use, so do not count on the passive triggering.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブ「倦怠」が解放されるだけで、実質的な変化は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks the passive Ennui, so the practical change is small.
messages.Ⅲ: マッチ威力が上がり、回復量が10になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Clash Power and increases the heal to 10.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量が12になるだけで、優先度は低いと考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: Only increases the heal to 12, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.LCB囚人: スキルが傲慢・怠惰・暴食で、必要資源の傲慢と暴食を自分で出せる。: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0201)**: Her skills are Pride, Sloth, and Gluttony, so she can supply the required Pride and Gluttony herself.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::後悔: S2が傲慢で、重い傲慢4の資源を補える。: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Regret](persona:0207)**: Her Pride S2 helps cover the heavy 4 Pride requirement.
messages.5枠広域の攻撃と同時に、味方全員の体力と精神力をまとめて回復する、資源が重い憂鬱: A Gloom Blunt healing E.G.O with heavy requirements that attacks 5 targets while restoring HP and SP to all allies at once.
messages.全体回復: 攻撃後に全味方の精神力と体力(最大値の割合)を回復する。解析Ⅲで回復: **Team-wide healing**: After the attack, restores SP and HP (as a percentage of max HP) to all allies. Threadspin Ⅲ raises the amount from 10 to 15.
messages.解析Ⅳの追加回復: 表面の攻撃終了時に、全味方の精神力をさらに10回復する。: **Extra healing at Threadspin Ⅳ**: At the end of a Heads attack, restores another 10 SP to all allies.
messages.重い資源: 色欲2・憂鬱4・嫉妬3の9個が必要。編成で賄えないと撃てない。: **Heavy requirements**: Needs 9 resources: 2 Lust, 4 Gloom, and 3 Envy. It cannot be used unless the team can supply them.
messages.低めのマッチ威力: 14~22(解析Ⅲで16~24)で、回復系としては低めと考え: **Modest Clash Power**: 14–22, or 16–24 at Threadspin Ⅲ, which is likely low for a healing E.G.O. Aim it at skills it can reliably beat.
messages.パッシブ「包み込む液体」: ターン開始時に、体力が最も低い味方1人に保護2を付与: **Passive — Liquid Veil**: At Turn Start, gives 2 Protection to the 1 ally with the lowest HP.
messages.資源を出せる人格を編成して撃てる状態を作り、精神力と体力が落ちた場面で撃つ。: Include Identities who can supply its affinities so it is ready, then use it when SP and HP have fallen.
messages.精神力が低いとコインの裏が出やすいので、マッチ負けを避けられる相手に当てる。: With low SP, Coins tend to land Tails, so target opponents against whom it can avoid losing the Clash.
messages.侵蝕スキルは、敵への精神力ダメージと攻撃威力減少を付ける攻撃的な内容で、回復は付: The Corrosion skill is offensive, dealing SP damage and Attack Power Down to enemies, and does not heal. It cannot distinguish friend from foe, and its targets are random, so it can hit allies.
messages.Ⅲ: マッチ威力と回復量が増え、侵蝕の精神力ダメージも増える。: **Ⅲ**: Increases Clash Power and healing, and raises the Corrosion skill's SP damage.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒に精神力回復、侵蝕に精神力ダメージが加わる。優先して進める価値は高いと: **Ⅳ**: Adds SP recovery to Awakening and SP damage to Corrosion. It is likely well worth prioritizing.
messages.生き残ったロボトミー職員: S1が色欲、S2が憂鬱、S3が嫉妬で、必要資源の3属: **[Lobotomy Corp. Remnant](persona:0203)**: Lust S1, Gloom S2, and Envy S3 supply all three required affinities.
messages.マルチクラック事務所 代表: S1が色欲、S2が嫉妬、S3が憂鬱で、必要資源の3: **[MultiCrack Office Rep](persona:0210)**: Lust S1, Envy S2, and Gloom S3 supply all three required affinities.
messages.味方の攻撃より先に撃って貫通脆弱・嫉妬脆弱を付け、後続の貫通・嫉妬スキルのダメー: A single-target Envy Pierce E.G.O used before allies attack to inflict Pierce Fragility and Envy Fragility, raising the damage of the Pierce and Envy skills that follow.
messages.脆弱の付与: 的中時に貫通脆弱(解析Ⅲで3)と嫉妬脆弱1を付与する。脆弱は1ター: **Inflicting Fragility**: On hit, inflicts Pierce Fragility (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and 1 Envy Fragility. Fragility only lasts for 1 turn, so it must land before allies attack.
messages.呪い(解析Ⅲ): 表面的中時に呪い3を付与する。ターン終了時に、次のターンの攻撃: **Curse (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Inflicts 3 Curse on Heads Hit. At Turn End, it applies one random effect such as Attack Power Down for the next turn, so you cannot choose the result.
messages.釘と追加ダメージ(解析Ⅳ): 表面的中時に釘3(特殊出血)を付与し、呪いのある対: **Nails and extra damage (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Inflicts 3 Nails (a special Bleed) on Heads Hit and deals +50% damage to targets with Curse.
messages.高めのマッチ威力: 14~24(解析Ⅲで16~26)と高めで、嫉妬6の資源が賄え: **High Clash Power**: A fairly high 14–24, or 16–26 at Threadspin Ⅲ. If the team can cover 6 Envy, it also works for Clashing.
messages.パッシブ「いたい！」: 自分のマイナス効果1つにつき与ダメージ量+10%(最大5: **Passive — It Hurts!**: +10% damage dealt for each negative effect on herself, up to 50%.
messages.速度の高い人格で先に撃ち、脆弱を付けてから味方の攻撃を通す。: Fire it first with a fast Identity, apply Fragility, and then let allies attack.
messages.後続が貫通中心なら覚醒、嫉妬中心なら侵蝕(貫通脆弱1・嫉妬脆弱1、解析Ⅲで嫉妬脆: Use Awakening if the follow-up attackers mainly use Pierce, and Corrosion if they mainly use Envy. Corrosion inflicts 1 Pierce Fragility and 1 Envy Fragility, or 3 Envy Fragility at Threadspin Ⅲ. Corrosion cannot distinguish friend from foe, and its targets are random, so it can hit allies.
messages.嫉妬6のみが必要資源なので、嫉妬を多く出せる編成と合わせる。: It only requires 6 Envy, so pair it with a team that can produce plenty of Envy.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と貫通脆弱量が増え、呪いが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and Pierce Fragility, and adds Curse.
messages.Ⅳ: 釘の付与と、呪い対象へのダメージ量+50%が加わる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds Nails and +50% damage against Cursed targets.
messages.握る者: S1が嫉妬で資源を出せ、S1・S2・S3が釘を付与するので、解析Ⅳの釘: **[The One Who Grips](persona:0204)**: Her Envy S1 supplies resources, and S1, S2, and S3 all inflict Nails, which fits the Threadspin Ⅳ Nails.
messages.W社2級整理要員: S1と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬6の資源を集めやすく、パッシブも嫉妬: **[W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent](persona:0202)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Envy, making the 6 Envy easy to gather, and her passive also triggers with Envy Owned.
messages.充電を補充しつつパッシブでダメージ量を底上げし、充電人格の火力を引き上げる、嫉妬: A high-power Envy Pierce E.G.O that refills Charge while raising damage through its passive, boosting the damage of Charge Identities.
messages.高いマッチ威力: 20~26(解析Ⅲで22~28)と高めで、的中時に麻痺3を付与: **High Clash Power**: A high 20–26, or 22–28 at Threadspin Ⅲ, and inflicts 3 Paralyze on hit.
messages.充電の獲得: 的中時(解析Ⅳは攻撃後)に自分の充電回数が増える(解析Ⅲで7)。解: **Gaining Charge**: On hit (after the attack at Threadspin Ⅳ), increases her own Charge Count, to 7 at Threadspin Ⅲ. At Threadspin Ⅳ, it increases by another 3 at the end of a Heads attack.
messages.味方への支援(解析Ⅲ。解析Ⅳは表面攻撃終了時): 表面的中時に、次のターンにラン: **Support for allies (Threadspin Ⅲ; at the end of a Heads attack at Threadspin Ⅳ)**: On Heads Hit, gives 1 Envy Power Up and 1 Haste next turn to 2 random allies. The targets cannot be chosen.
messages.広域化(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が1から3になり、複数の敵を同時に攻撃できる。: **Multi-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight rises from 1 to 3, letting it hit several enemies at once.
messages.パッシブ「適応型放出」: 充電回数1つにつきダメージ量+2%。スキル効果で消耗す: **Passive — Adaptive Release**: +2% damage per Charge Count. Reduces the Charge Count spent by skill effects by 2.
messages.充電を使う人格と組み、立ち上がりで不足しがちな充電をこのE.G.Oで補う。: Pair it with Identities that use Charge, and use this E.G.O to cover the Charge that tends to be lacking at the start.
messages.麻痺は撃ったターンだけ効くので、速度が高い人格で撃つ。: Paralyze only works on the turn it is used, so fire it with a fast Identity.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と充電獲得量が増え、覚醒に味方への嫉妬威力増加・クイックが付く。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and Charge gain, and adds Envy Power Up and Haste for allies to Awakening.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、充電獲得が攻撃後に変わる。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and the Charge gain moves to after the attack.
messages.マルチクラック事務所 代表: S1・S3が充電を消耗または獲得するスキルで、S1: **[MultiCrack Office Rep](persona:0210)**: S1 and S3 spend or gain Charge, and her Lust S1 and Envy S2 supply resources.
messages.W社2級整理要員: S1・S2が充電を増やし、S1の嫉妬と S3の憤怒でも必要資: **[W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent](persona:0202)**: S1 and S2 increase Charge, and her Envy S1 and Wrath S3 also supply the required affinities.
A multi-target Lust Slash E.G.O used on enemies with built-up Burn to inflict Defense Level Down and raise physical damage (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ).
messages.防御レベル減少: 的中時に防御レベル減少5を付与し、さらに対象の火傷2を防御レベ: **Defense Level Down**: On hit, inflicts 5 Defense Level Down and converts every 2 Burn on the target into 1 Defense Level Down, up to 5. The total reaches up to 10 (5+5). The conversion cannot reduce the target's Burn below 1.
messages.火傷によるダメージ増: 攻撃前に、全攻撃対象と自分の火傷威力の合計1につきダメー: **Damage from Burn**: Before attacking, +5% damage for every 1 total Burn Potency on all targets and herself, up to 100%. It also inflicts 3 Burn on hit.
messages.広域化: 最大共鳴数が4以上で加重値+1、6以上でさらに+1。解析Ⅴでは色欲に限: **Multi-target**: +1 Attack Weight at a highest Resonance of 4 or more, and +1 more at 6 or more. At Threadspin Ⅴ, it checks the highest Resonance of any affinity, not just Lust.
messages.パッシブ「炎の剣」: 憤怒または色欲スキルの表面的中時に火傷1を付与する(1ター: **Passive — Flamebrand**: Inflicts 1 Burn on Heads Hit with a Wrath or Lust skill, up to 6 times per turn. If the target's Burn is at maximum, it becomes 1 Defense Level Down instead. Using a Gluttony basic skill also adds 1 Gluttony resource.
messages.軽い資源: 色欲1・暴食2・傲慢1で、使用時に必要な暴食の資源が1減る。: **Light requirements**: 1 Lust, 2 Gluttony, and 1 Pride, and the Gluttony required on use is reduced by 1.
messages.火傷編成で火傷が十分に溜まった敵に撃つ。溜まる前に撃つと、後続の火傷依存の火力を: In Burn teams, use it on an enemy with plenty of Burn. Using it before Burn builds up likely lowers the damage of the Burn-dependent attacks that follow.
messages.防御レベル減少は撃ったターンの味方の攻撃にだけ効くと考えられるため、味方より先に: Defense Level Down likely only affects allies' attacks on the turn it is used, so fire it before allies attack.
messages.威力が18~26と高めなので、火傷を気にせずマッチ用に撃つこともできる。: Its power is a fairly high 18–26, so it can also be used for Clashing without regard to Burn.
messages.Ⅲ: 最大色欲完全共鳴4以上で加重値+1。覚醒に火傷付与、侵蝕に束縛が付く。: **Ⅲ**: +1 Attack Weight at a highest Lust Absolute Resonance of 4 or more. Adds Burn infliction to Awakening and Bind to Corrosion.
messages.Ⅳ: 色欲完全共鳴6以上で加重値がさらに+1。火傷付与が表面限定でなくなる。: **Ⅳ**: Another +1 Attack Weight at 6 or more Lust Absolute Resonance. Burn infliction no longer requires Heads.
messages.Ⅴ: 暴食の必要数が減り、共鳴の色欲条件が外れ、火傷の消耗が緩む。防御レベル減少: **Ⅴ**: Reduces the Gluttony requirement, removes the Lust condition from the Resonance check, and eases the Burn consumption. The passive also inflicts Defense Level Down. Threadspin Ⅴ is likely essential to use its effects.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S1が火傷を付与する傲慢スキルで、S3は憤怒なので「炎の: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:0216)**: Her Pride S1 inflicts Burn, and her Wrath S3 triggers Flamebrand, while also supplying the required Pride.
messages.LCE E.G.O:: 紅炎殺: 火傷を扱う人格で、S3が憤怒、S2が傲慢なので: **[LCE E.G.O:: Ardor Blossom Star](persona:0211)**: A Burn Identity with Wrath S3 and Pride S2, so she triggers Flamebrand and supplies Pride.
messages.怠惰の共鳴を作って撃ち、大量の振動を付与して連続で振動爆発を起こし、敵を一気に混: A 4-Coin E.G.O used after building Sloth Resonance that inflicts heavy Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst repeatedly to push enemies into Stagger at once.
messages.振動の付与と絡縺: Ⅰコインが振動と振動回数を付与し、振動-永続へ振幅絡縺を行う: **Tremor and Entanglement**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Tremor and Tremor Count and performs Amplitude Entanglement into Tremor - Everlasting. If Coin Ⅰ is broken, this chain stops. Threadspin Ⅳ raises the amount from 5 to 10.
messages.連続の振動爆発: Ⅱ〜Ⅳコインが的中時に振動爆発を起こす(解析ⅣはⅠコインも爆発: **Repeated Tremor Burst**: Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ trigger Tremor Burst on hit; at Threadspin Ⅳ, Coin Ⅰ also bursts, for 4 in total. Tremor - Everlasting has a chance to add 1 more burst when bursting, up to 50% each for Potency and Count.
messages.共鳴で伸びる振動付与: 攻撃前に最大共鳴数が3以上なら振動威力を付与する(解析Ⅳ: **Resonance-scaling Tremor**: Before attacking, inflicts Tremor Potency if the highest Resonance is 3 or more (Resonance×2 at Threadspin Ⅳ, up to 10). With Sloth Absolute Resonance, it also inflicts the same amount of Tremor Count (Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.速度差ダメージ: 対象の速度が自分より低いほどダメージ量が増える(解析Ⅳで最大5: **Speed-difference damage**: Deals more damage the lower the target's Speed is compared to hers, up to 50% at Threadspin Ⅳ. Coin Ⅳ halves the target's maximum Speed next turn.
messages.自傷: 攻撃後の3ターンは、ターン終了時に精神力が10ずつ減る。パッシブ「走る時: **Self-damage**: For 3 turns after the attack, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End. The passive Running Time grants 1 Haste next turn when she triggers Tremor Burst, up to 4 times.
messages.怠惰を並べて怠惰完全共鳴を作り、決めたい場面で撃つ。振動爆発を起こす味方が続けば: Line up Sloth skills to build Sloth Absolute Resonance and fire it at the decisive moment. If allies who trigger Tremor Burst follow up, it likely gains more value, including from the extra bursts.
messages.マッチ威力は4~24と低いので、1コイン目を割られない相手か、一方攻撃になる場面: Its Clash Power is a low 4–24, so use it against opponents who will not break the first Coin, or when it will be a one-sided attack.
messages.振動爆発ごとに追加ダメージを出す振動効果と組み合わせると伸びると考えられる。必要: It likely scales well with Tremor effects that deal extra damage on each Tremor Burst. Its 11 required resources are heavy.
messages.侵蝕スキルは1コインの3枠広域で、同じ振動付与と爆発を1コインにまとめた形。敵味: The Corrosion skill hits 3 targets with 1 Coin, compressing the same Tremor infliction and bursts into a single Coin. It cannot distinguish friend from foe, and its targets are random, so it can hit allies.
messages.Ⅲ: 速度差ダメージの倍率が上がり、怠惰完全共鳴での振動回数付与が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the speed-difference damage multiplier and adds Tremor Count infliction with Sloth Absolute Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 付与量・爆発回数・速度差ダメージがさらに増える。本領が出る段階。: **Ⅳ**: Further increases the infliction amount, number of bursts, and speed-difference damage. This is where it reaches its full strength.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::後悔: S1が怠惰、S2が傲慢で資源を出せ、振動回数を増: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Regret](persona:0207)**: Her Sloth S1 and Pride S2 supply resources, and she has skills that increase Tremor Count and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S2が怠惰、S1が傲慢で資源を出せ、振動を付与して振動爆: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:0216)**: Her Sloth S2 and Pride S1 supply resources, and she can inflict Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.暴食共鳴で3枠広域にして敵へ破裂を配る、破裂編成向けの暴食斬撃E.G.O。: A Gluttony Slash E.G.O for Rupture teams that becomes a 3-target attack with Gluttony Resonance and spreads Rupture to enemies.
messages.コイン威力の強化: 対象の破裂7につきコイン威力+1(最大2)。解析Ⅲから、自分: **Coin Power bonus**: +1 Coin Power for every 7 Rupture on the target, up to 2. From Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 more if her Speed and the target's Speed total at least 6. Its base power is a low 4–10, so meet these conditions before using it.
messages.広域化: 最大共鳴が4以上で加重値+1(解析Ⅲ)。それが暴食共鳴ならさらに+1で: **Multi-target**: +1 Attack Weight at a highest Resonance of 4 or more (Threadspin Ⅲ). If that is Gluttony Resonance, +1 more for 3 targets (Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.破裂の付与: 3コインとも破裂を付与するか、破裂回数を増やす(解析Ⅲで量が増える: **Inflicting Rupture**: All 3 Coins inflict Rupture or increase Rupture Count, with larger amounts at Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.パッシブ「広がりゆく投げ縄」: 攻撃終了時に対象が混乱・死亡していると、ランダム: **Passive — Sprawling Lasso**: If the target is staggered or dead at the end of the attack, increases the Rupture Count of 2 random enemies by 1, once per turn.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 最初から3枠広域で、Ⅲコインが対象に特殊効果「投げ縄」を付与する(: **Corrosion skill**: Hits 3 targets from the start, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts the special effect Lasso on the target, with larger amounts at Threadspin Ⅳ. It also deals more damage to targets with Poise.
messages.破裂編成で、速度の高い人格と組んで速度条件を満たす。: In Rupture teams, pair it with fast Identities to meet the Speed condition.
messages.暴食スキルを4つ以上並べて加重値を伸ばし、複数の敵に破裂を撒く。: Line up 4 or more Gluttony skills to raise its Attack Weight and spread Rupture across several enemies.
messages.解析Ⅲから攻撃前に次のターンのクイック2を得るので、続くターンの速度も確保しやす: From Threadspin Ⅲ, it grants 2 Haste for the next turn before attacking, making it easier to keep her Speed up on the following turn.
messages.Ⅲ: 速度条件、クイック獲得、共鳴による加重値、破裂付与量が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds the Speed condition, Haste gain, Resonance-based Attack Weight, and more Rupture infliction.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力+1、暴食共鳴での加重値+1が加わる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds +1 Coin Power and +1 Attack Weight with Gluttony Resonance.
messages.南部セブン協会4課: S1が嫉妬、S3が暴食、守備が色欲で必要資源を出せ、破裂を: **[Seven Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0206)**: Envy S1, Gluttony S3, and a Lust Defense skill supply the required affinities, and she has skills that inflict Rupture.
messages.黒獣-卯 筆頭: 暴食のS3を持ち、破裂を付与するスキルがあり、クイックを得られ: **[Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212)**: Has a Gluttony S3 and skills that inflict Rupture, and gains Haste, making the Speed condition easy to meet.
messages.全味方へ呼吸を配り、使用後は毎ターンの自動回復も得られる、攻撃より支援向けの傲慢: A Pride Pierce E.G.O geared more toward support than offense: it hands out Poise to all allies and grants automatic healing every turn after use.
messages.呼吸の配布: 攻撃前に全味方へ呼吸威力を最大共鳴数だけ付与する(最大4、解析Ⅲで: **Distributing Poise**: Before attacking, gives all allies Poise Potency equal to the highest Resonance, up to 4, or 6 at Threadspin Ⅲ. With 3 or more Pride Resonance, it also grants Poise Count and Shallow Exhale.
messages.パッシブ「息」: 使用の次のターンからネブライザーαが増える(最大5)。ターン終: **Passive — Breath**: From the turn after use, Nebulizer α increases, up to 5. At Turn End, it heals a number of allies equal to the highest Resonance, in order of lowest HP ratio, by α% of their max HP each.
messages.呼吸が多い味方: 回復対象の呼吸威力が20以上なら回復がもう1回発動する。荒い呼: **Allies with plenty of Poise**: If a healed target has at least 20 Poise Potency, the heal triggers once more. Shallow Exhale increases the Count by 1 when an Identity with at least 20 Poise Potency gains Poise.
messages.自身の強化: 解析Ⅲで的中時に自分の呼吸回数が増え、クリティカルダメージ量が上が: **Self-buffs**: At Threadspin Ⅲ, it increases her own Poise Count on hit and raises Critical damage, up to 40% at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 呼吸威力が20未満のとき20まで得て、得た分×2%の最大体力を消耗: **Corrosion skill**: If her Poise Potency is below 20, she gains Poise up to 20 and spends max HP equal to 2% per Poise gained, without being staggered or killed. The Awakening effects still apply.
messages.危なくなってから撃つより、戦闘の早い段階で撃って自動回復を溜める。: Rather than waiting until things get dangerous, use it early in the fight to start accumulating the automatic healing.
messages.傲慢共鳴を3以上にして撃ち、呼吸回数も配る。: Use it with 3 or more Pride Resonance to hand out Poise Count as well.
messages.攻撃は控えめ(加重値3で2コイン)なので、呼吸と回復が目的。味方が少ないほど回復: Its attack is modest (2 Coins with 3 Attack Weight), so Poise and healing are the goal. The fewer allies there are, the slower the healing likely is.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放され、呼吸配布と回復の中核が揃う。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive, completing the core of Poise distribution and healing.
messages.Ⅲ: 呼吸配布の上限と自分の呼吸獲得、クリティカル強化が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds a higher Poise distribution cap, her own Poise gain, and the Critical buff.
messages.Ⅳ: 威力とクリティカル強化が伸びるが、優先度は低いと考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: Increases power and the Critical buff, but is likely a low priority.
messages.人差し指遂行者：【紙片】: S1が怠惰、S2が傲慢、S3が憂鬱で必要資源の3属性: **[The Index Proselyte: 【Paper Slip】](persona:0214)**: A Poise Identity with Sloth S1, Pride S2, and Gloom S3, covering all three required affinities.
messages.剣契殺手: S1が怠惰、S2が傲慢、S3が憂鬱で必要資源の3属性を出せ、呼吸を使: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:0208)**: A Poise Identity with Sloth S1, Pride S2, and Gloom S3, covering all three required affinities.
messages.硬化バリアを維持して毎ターン味方を自動回復させる、暴食偏重の回復E.G.O(コラ: A Gluttony-heavy healing E.G.O that keeps up Hardened Shell-Barrier to heal allies automatically every turn (collaboration-limited).
messages.体力回復: 攻撃後に、自分と体力の割合が最も低い味方1名を自分の最大体力の割合で: **HP recovery**: After the attack, heals herself and the 1 ally with the lowest HP ratio by a percentage of her own max HP, 30% at Threadspin Ⅳ. If her own HP is full, it heals 2 allies.
messages.硬化バリア: 攻撃後に硬化バリアを得る(解析Ⅳで10、最大10)。被ダメージ直前: **Hardened Shell-Barrier**: Gains Hardened Shell-Barrier after the attack, 10 at Threadspin Ⅳ, up to 10. Right before taking damage, half of it is spent and turned into Protection, but the spent amount also lowers the healing.
messages.パッシブ「医師」: ターン開始時に、自分の最大体力の(バリア数値)%ぶん味方の体: **Passive — Doctor**: At Turn Start, heals allies by (Shield value)% of her max HP. ×1.5 if the target is at 25% HP or less or staggered. If this was the last E.G.O she used, the Shield's Turn End decrease drops from 3 to 1.
messages.精神力の回復: 精神力が最も低い味方2名(自分を含む)を回復する(解析Ⅳで15): **SP recovery**: Restores SP to the 2 allies with the lowest SP, including herself, 15 at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.攻撃面: 破裂か火傷のある対象への最終威力増加と、破裂量に応じたダメージ増加があ: **Offense**: Gains Final Power against targets with Rupture or Burn, and more damage based on Rupture. The latter is ×1.5 with Hardened Shell-Barrier, or ×2 at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.戦闘の早い段階で撃ち、バリアを維持して自動回復を回す。: Use it early in the fight, keep the Shield up, and keep the automatic healing running.
messages.他のE.G.Oを使うとバリアが毎ターン3ずつ減るので、使う順番に注意する。: Using another E.G.O makes the Shield drop by 3 every turn, so pay attention to the order of use.
messages.侵蝕スキルは敵味方識別不可で回復が無く、敵を混乱・死亡させられないと自分の体力を: The Corrosion skill cannot distinguish friend from foe and does not heal; if it fails to stagger or kill an enemy, she spends her own HP to gain a large Shield, making it defensive in nature.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力・回復量・バリア量が増え、バリア所持時の破裂ダメージ増加が1.5倍にな: **Ⅲ**: Increases power, healing, and Shield, and the Rupture damage bonus with Shield becomes ×1.5.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量・バリア量が最大になり、破裂ダメージ増加の上限が上がってバリア所持時: **Ⅳ**: Healing and Shield reach their maximum, the cap on the Rupture damage bonus rises, and it becomes ×2 with Shield.
messages.黒獣-卯 筆頭: S1が怠惰、S3が暴食、S2が傲慢で必要資源の3属性を出せ、破: **[Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212)**: Sloth S1, Gluttony S3, and Pride S2 supply all three required affinities, and she also inflicts Rupture.
messages.南部セブン協会4課: S3が暴食、S1〜S3が破裂を付与し、破裂量で伸びる攻撃と: **[Seven Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0206)**: Has a Gluttony S3, and S1–S3 inflict Rupture, which fits its Rupture-scaling attack.
messages.自分に火傷を溜めて紅炎殺人格の火傷付与量を伸ばす、専用寄りの憤怒打撃E.G.O。: A largely dedicated Wrath Blunt E.G.O that stacks Burn on herself to increase the Burn infliction of her Ardor Blossom Star Identity. Its effect for surviving the self-destruction only buys a little extra time.
messages.自分への火傷: 攻撃後に火傷10と火傷回数1を自分が得る。火傷を使う人格の強化向: **Burn on herself**: After the attack, she gains 10 Burn and 1 Burn Count. It is meant to strengthen Identities that use Burn; for others, it is just self-damage.
messages.火傷が多いほど強い: 攻撃前に、全攻撃対象と自分の火傷威力の合計10につき最終威: **Stronger with more Burn**: Before attacking, +1 Final Power for every 10 total Burn Potency on all targets and herself, up to 2. If she has at least 15 Burn, she gains 1 Wrath DMG Up next turn.
messages.残り火: 自分の火傷が15以上のとき、Ⅱコインの攻撃終了時に全攻撃対象へ残り火1: **Embers**: While she has at least 15 Burn, at the end of Coin Ⅱ's attack, inflicts 1 Embers on all targets.
messages.パッシブ「消えない火種」: 自分の火傷10につき、基本攻撃スキルが敵へ付与する火: **Passive — Unsnuffed Embers**: For every 10 Burn on herself, the Burn Potency her basic attack skills inflict on enemies increases by 1, up to 2. In addition, after using A.B.S Max Attunement 【Degraded Corrosion】, she does not die and instead recovers 40% HP, once per battle.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 覚醒より広い加重値5の3コインで、失った体力が50%以上なら火傷に: **Corrosion skill**: 3 Coins with 5 Attack Weight, wider than Awakening. If she has lost at least 50% of her HP, it restores SP based on Burn. It can also inflict plenty of Embers.
messages.紅炎殺人格の火傷が溜まった状態で撃ち、基本スキルの火傷付与を増やす。: Use it while her Ardor Blossom Star Identity has plenty of Burn to increase her basic skills' Burn infliction.
messages.自爆を生き延びる効果は戦闘中1回だけで、スキルが増えるわけではない。自爆で攻撃を: The survival effect only works once per battle and does not add any skills. It likely makes it harder to use the self-destruction to stop an attack.
messages.資源は憤怒3・怠惰2・傲慢2。資源に余裕のある場面向けで、撃たなくても紅炎殺人格: It requires 3 Wrath, 2 Sloth, and 2 Pride. It is for situations with spare resources, and the Ardor Blossom Star Identity likely works fine without it.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放される。自爆を活かす運用なら、パッシブの無い解析Ⅰの方が噛み: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive. If you rely on the self-destruction, Threadspin Ⅰ without the passive is likely a better fit.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、憤怒共鳴に応じた火傷付与が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power and adds Burn infliction based on Wrath Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 憤怒共鳴に応じた火傷回数の増加が加わり、侵蝕の精神力回復上限が上がる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds more Burn Count based on Wrath Resonance and raises the cap on the Corrosion skill's SP recovery.
messages.LCE E.G.O:: 紅炎殺: パッシブが「紅炎殺 最大感応【劣化侵蝕】」を直: **[LCE E.G.O:: Ardor Blossom Star](persona:0211)**: The passive directly references A.B.S Max Attunement 【Degraded Corrosion】, and her Wrath S3, Sloth S1, and Pride S2 supply the required affinities.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S1が火傷を付与する傲慢スキルで、このE.G.Oで自分の: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:0216)**: Her Pride S1 inflicts Burn, and gaining Burn on herself through this E.G.O increases that amount. Her passive also reduces damage taken from Burn.
messages.1ターン目に「穴」で準備し、次のターンに7枠広域の「ブーシェ」を資源なしで撃って: A Pierce E.G.O that prepares with Le Trou on the first turn, then on the next turn fires Boucher un trou, a 7-target attack, without resources to gain large amounts of Poise and Charge.
messages.穴(le trou): 戦闘で初めて使うと、精神消耗と必要資源が軽くなる(憂鬱2: **Le Trou**: The first time it is used in a battle, its Sanity cost and requirements are reduced (2 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy less). It cannot Clash and does not hit enemies; she gains 5 Ashen Bullet, Poise, Charge, and Black Wings.
messages.ブーシェ: 弾丸があると発動する広域攻撃。攻撃前に弾丸を全消耗して呼吸と充電を得: **Boucher un trou**: A multi-target attack that activates while she has Bullets. Before attacking, she spends all Bullets to gain Poise and Charge, with +8% damage per Bullet. It reuses an Unbreakable Coin (Bullets spent − 1) times, up to 4.

messages.序盤は勝てそうな相手にだけS1・S2をぶつけてマッチ勝利の強化を取る。分の悪いマ: Early on, only throw S1 and S2 at opponents she can likely beat to collect the Clash Win buffs. Avoid unfavorable Clashes, use one-sided attacks instead, and build up her SP. Once her SP is high, take Clashes with S3 and, at Uptie Ⅳ, stack Bleed. In teams with Pierce attackers, leaving her in backup to use Support is also an option.

On turns with 10 or more Speed, hold S3 and throw it at the enemy's strong skill to stop it. With few Coins, her total damage is limited, so use her to stop enemy attacks through Clashes. messages.耐久とサポート: 守備「ガード」はマッチ威力10〜15。サポートパッシブ「盲目の: **Durability and support**: Her Guard has Clash Power 10–15. The support passive Hammer of Zealotry (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +10% damage to the 1 ally with Fanatic who has the lowest SP.
messages.自分だけで釘を5本以上に保つのは難しいので、釘や狂信を扱うN社の味方と組む。S1: Keeping 5 or more Nails up by herself is difficult, so pair her with N Corp. allies who handle Nails and Fanatic. Stack Nails and Tremor with S1 and S3, then trigger Tremor Burst with S2. Against targets with at least 5 Nails, she can also aim for S3's debuffs. She inflicts plenty of Tremor Count, so she also works as a helper for Tremor attackers who spend Tremor Count.

messages.S2→S1の速度管理: S2「フレッシュ」は使用時に次のターンのクイック1/2を: **Speed management from S2 to S1**: S2 Flèche grants 1/2 Haste next turn on use. S1 Remise gains +1/2 Coin Power at 7 or more Speed and grants 1 Haste next turn on Clash Win. Her Speed range is 4–7, so the Haste from S2 makes it easier to meet the S1 bonus (7+ Speed) on the next turn. It is not guaranteed, though: even with 2 Haste, a base roll of 4 only reaches 6 (it works on a roll of 5–7).
messages.束縛: S1はⅡコインのマッチ勝利後の(表面)的中時、S2はⅡコインの(表面)的: **Bind**: S1 inflicts 1 Bind next turn on (Heads) hit with Coin Ⅱ after a Clash Win, and S2 does so on Coin Ⅱ (Heads) hit.

messages.バトルパッシブ「高貴な決闘」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 全味方の速度が: **Combat passive — A Noble Duel (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Only while all allies are faster than every enemy, +6% damage per point of Speed difference against the slowest enemy, up to 30%.
messages.速度の低いターンはS2でクイックを取り、次のターンにS1を強化してマッチ勝利と束: On low-Speed turns, collect Haste with S2, then empower S1 the next turn to aim for Clash Wins and Bind. Against a single boss, apply Declared Duel early with S3 to tilt Clashes in her favor. S3's 10 Speed and the passive's condition are hard to meet, so treat them as a bonus when they happen rather than something to set up. Her Defense skill Défensive reduces the target's SP by 3 on a successful Evade, so it suits opponents with SP.
messages.反撃「倍返し」: 2コインの反撃(打撃、スキルレベル人格Lv+5)。Ⅰ・Ⅱコイン: **Counter — Multifold Retribution**: A 2-Coin counter (Blunt, Skill Level Identity Lv +5). On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each push her own Stagger Threshold back by 3/5. If total Envy Absolute Resonance is 6 or more at Combat Start, she uses A Just Vengeance as an Envy skill when countering, up to 2 times per turn. This change is added at Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.攻撃レベルの増加: S3「正義の仕返し」は(最も多い完全共鳴数÷2)だけ攻撃レベ: **Offense Level increase**: S3 A Just Vengeance gains Offense Level equal to (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 2), up to 4/6. S2 Proof of Loyalty gains (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 3/2) at Combat Start, up to 4/6. With Envy Absolute Resonance, both gain an extra 50%, and in Focused Encounters with a deployment limit of 7 or fewer, the increase is doubled. Counters count as Defense skills, so the level-difference adjustment carries straight into the counter's power.
messages.S2「義理証明」: 2コイン(マッチ威力4〜14/4〜16)のマッチ用スキル。Ⅱ: **S2 — Proof of Loyalty**: A 2-Coin Clash skill (Clash Power 4–14/4–16). Coin Ⅱ inflicts 3 Bleed and 1 Damage Down.

messages.バトルパッシブ「怨恨の刺青」(嫉妬×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分を含む味方: **Combat passive — Vengeance Tattoo (4 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time allies, including herself, take damage 3 times, she gains 1 Envy DMG Up next turn, up to 5. messages.中指所属など、嫉妬を多く持つ味方で編成し、嫉妬の完全共鳴を作る。条件を満たしたタ: Build the team with allies who have many Envy skills, such as Middle members, to form Envy Absolute Resonance. On turns that meet the condition, set up Multifold Retribution and answer attacking enemies with a high-level A Just Vengeance. The counter only triggers when enemies attack her, so staggering enemies first with Resonance-building attacks can make it fizzle. Take Clashes with S2, and recover with S1 when SP is short.
messages.破裂回数の維持: 破裂は被ダメージのたびに回数が1減る。S1「噛み砕いてやろう！: **Maintaining Rupture Count**: Rupture loses 1 Count each time the bearer takes damage.
