S3 Whirlwind Om-Nom-Nom! adds +3 with Coin Ⅰ and loses 3 from its 3 Coin hits, so she can attack without reducing Count (reusing Coin Ⅲ below 50% HP costs 1 more).
messages.S2「発光擬餌」で破裂を始動: 3コインで破裂1・1・2を付与する。Ⅲコインの的: **Starting Rupture with S2 Flashing Lure**: 3 Coins inflicting 1, 1, and 2 Rupture. On hit, Coin Ⅲ increases the target's Rupture Count by 2/3 if it is 2 or less. It serves as the starter against targets without Rupture or with little Count left.
messages.破裂6以上で強化: S2・S3は対象の破裂が6以上でコイン威力+1。守備「カチカ: **Bonuses at 6+ Rupture**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Rupture. Her Defense skill Chattering Teeth gains +3 Final Power.
messages.回復: S3のⅢコインの的中時に体力を10/15回復し、さらに対象の破裂1につき: **Healing**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 heals 10/15 HP plus 1/2 per Rupture on the target, up to 20/40. Below 50% HP, Coin Ⅲ is reused once, healing 50% more on reuse. Her Defense skill heals HP equal to the remaining Shield at Turn End, once per turn, up to 10% of her max HP.
messages.挑発とバトルパッシブ「ガツガツむしゃむしゃ」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得):: **Aggro and the combat passive Om Nom Nom (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On use, S1–S3 give that slot Aggro next turn, which matters in Focused Encounters. Through the passive, she gains +1 Clash Power while she has Aggro and heals 4/6 HP each time she hits an enemy that targets her attack skills.
messages.破裂編成に入れ、S2で破裂を付け、S1で回数を足し、S3で回数を保ったまま攻撃し: Put her in a Rupture team: apply Rupture with S2, add Count with S1, and attack with S3 while keeping Count, so allies' Rupture never runs out. In Focused Encounters, draw enemy attacks with Aggro and endure by hitting the enemies that target her while healing. Her Clash Power is modest and weak in opening Clashes, so early on she mainly uses her Defense skill and one-sided attacks. The support passive Illumilantern (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives the same kind of healing to the ally with the highest Aggro.
messages.配布先の優先順位: S2・S3の配布も、パッシブ「共に吸う息」も、「呼吸がない」: **Distribution priority**: Both the distribution from S2 and S3 and the passive Collective Breathing prioritize allies with no Poise. If the team includes Identities that do not use Poise, the Poise tends to go to them and be wasted.
messages.バトルパッシブ「共に吸う息」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分のスキル・: **Combat passive — Collective Breathing (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time she gains Poise Potency from her own skill or Coin effect, gives 1 Poise to an ally with no Poise or the lowest Poise Potency, up to 3/5 times per turn. S1 Draw of the Sword gains 1 Poise each on Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, so one use gives two chances to trigger it.
messages.S2「剣軌」: Ⅱコインのクリティカル的中時、呼吸がないか呼吸威力が最も少ない味: **S2 — Blade Arc**: On Critical Hit, Coin Ⅱ gives 2 Poise to the 1 ally with no Poise or the lowest Poise Potency, plus 2 more if they are a Blade Lineage member.
messages.S3「さらば！」: 使用時に呼吸5を得る。Ⅲコインのクリティカル的中時、呼吸がな: **S3 — Fare Thee Well!**: Gains 5 Poise on use. On Critical Hit, Coin Ⅲ increases the Poise Count of the 2 allies with no Poise or the lowest Poise Count by 2, plus 2 more for Blade Lineage members. Defeating the target gives herself and 1 random ally 1 Slash DMG Up next turn.
messages.呼吸による自己強化: 自分の呼吸がS1は5以上、S2は7以上、S3は10以上でコ: **Self-buffs from Poise**: +1 Coin Power when her Poise is at least 5 for S1, 7 for S2, and 10 for S3.
messages.呼吸を扱う人格(剣契組織員ならなおよい)で編成を固める。S1・S2を使うたびに自: Fill the team with Identities that use Poise, ideally Blade Lineage members. Build her own Poise each time she uses S1 and S2 while the passive shares it with allies. Once Poise is built up, use S3's Critical Hits to top up allies' Poise Count. The support passive Nightly Stroll (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +1/2 to the Poise Potency gained by the ally with the least Poise, up to 2 times; it does not apply to targets without Poise.
messages.時間貸与: 守備「時間を引き寄せようぞ」を構えると、時間貸与状態でなければ、戦闘: **Borrowed Time**: When she sets up the Defense skill I Shall Summon the Time while not in Borrowed Time, its Combat Start effect grants 4 Borrowed Time at Turn End, once per turn; it cannot be regained while active. If she ends a turn with 2 or more Count, she gains Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile equal to (Count − 1) next turn. If she ends a turn with 1 Count, she gains (Potency − 1)×2 Bind next turn. If the Bind she would gain next turn exceeds her Haste, Borrowed Time ends and she is staggered. For the 3 turns after using her Defense skill, Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile decrease 3→2→1, and on the turn after that she receives 6 Bind.
messages.守備で振動付与: 守備を使ったターンは、敵からダメージを受けると次のターンに振動: **Tremor from her Defense skill**: On the turn she uses her Defense skill, taking damage from enemies inflicts 2/3 Tremor next turn, 2/6 times per turn.
messages.振動で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の振動が6以上なら/につき、マッチ威力+1(最大: **Tremor bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Clash Power if/for every 6 Tremor on the target, up to 2. S2 T Corp. Accelerated Amputator spends up to 3 of the target's Tremor with Coin Ⅰ to inflict (Tremor spent − 1) Bind next turn. Coin Ⅲ triggers Tremor Burst if this skill's Coin effects spent Tremor.
messages.S3「そこ、停まりたまえ！」の時間猶予: Ⅳコインの的中時、対象の振動が10以上: **S3 I Command Thee, Halt!'s Time Moratorium**: On Coin Ⅳ hit, if the target has at least 10 Tremor, spends 10 Tremor to inflict 2 Time Moratorium; it does not spend Tremor while she is in Borrowed Time. During Time Moratorium, the target takes no damage and stores it instead. At Combat End at Count 1, it takes (100 + Potency×15)% of the stored amount as Sloth damage. Because the damage becomes Sloth, the enemy's Sloth resistance changes the effect greatly.
messages.振動-鎖: S3のⅣコインの的中時、対象の速度が自分より低ければ振動-鎖へ振幅変: **Tremor - Chain**: On Coin Ⅳ hit of S3, if the target is slower than her, it performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Chain. −1 Clash Power on the target for every 10 Tremor Potency, up to 3.
messages.バトルパッシブ「ゴールデンタイム-領収」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): タ: **Combat passive — Golden Time - Extracting (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If her HP is between 10% and 20% at Turn End, she recovers 80% HP and recovers from Stagger, once per battle. When Borrowed Time ends, one of her skill slots gains 8 Aggro next turn.
messages.強い敵には初手で守備を構えて時間貸与を得て、強化されている間にマッチを取る。安定: Against strong enemies, open with her Defense skill to gain Borrowed Time, and take Clashes while she is buffed. Against opponents she can beat reliably, she can skip the Defense skill, which spends a turn without dealing damage. Once Tremor is stacked, apply Time Moratorium with S3, but not against enemies she can finish off or enemies that resist Sloth, because damage stops landing during Time Moratorium. Against enemies slower than her, use Coin Ⅳ of S3 to convert into Tremor - Chain and lower their Clash Power. She tends to spend Tremor Count, so have allies who handle Tremor maintain it.
messages.血餐と硬血: この人格がいると、全キャラクターが受けた出血ダメージだけ血餐が増え: **Bloodfeast and Hardblood**: While this Identity is present, Bloodfeast increases by the Bleed damage taken by all characters, shared by everyone, up to 999. Her un-enhanced S1–S3 spend up to 50 Bloodfeast on use, and her un-enhanced Defense skill does so at Combat Start, to gain Hardblood; enhanced skills do not spend Bloodfeast. S1 Enough is Enough gives 1 Hardblood per 5 Bloodfeast, and the others give 1 per 10. **If she cannot spend Bloodfeast, she gains Bleed herself.**
messages.「サンチョ流硬血奥義-ラ・サングレ」: ターン開始時に硬血15以上なら、最も左の: **Ascendant Sancho Hardblood Arts - La Sangre**: If she has at least 15 Hardblood at Turn Start, her leftmost S3 is enhanced into this skill. All 4 Coins are Unbreakable. +1 Coin Power if/for every 5 Bleed when the target has at least 10, up to 2. It also gains +5% damage per Bleed on the target, up to 50%, and +20% per 100 Bloodfeast Consumed (shared), up to 100%. After the attack, it spends 10 per 10 Hardblood. If the target dies, Bloodfeast increases by 50/100 and half of the Hardblood spent is returned, once per turn.
messages.S3で敵を倒して補給: 強化前のS3「貫かせていただきましょう」も、対象が死亡す: **Resupply by defeating enemies with S3**: When the target of her un-enhanced S3 I Shall Impale dies, Bloodfeast increases by 30/60 and she gains 10 Hardblood, once per turn.
messages.血鬼の味方で硬血が貯まる: 常時発動パッシブ「亜流サンチョ硬血式」により、自分以: **Bloodfiend allies build Hardblood**: Through the passive Variant Sancho Hardblood Arts, which is always active, she gains 2 Hardblood each time an ally other than herself takes Bleed damage or spends Bloodfeast, 3 times per turn. While Gregor's The Priest of La Manchaland, Outis's The Barber of La Manchaland, or Rodion's The Princess of La Manchaland is participating or has died, her S1, S2, or Defense skill respectively is also enhanced at 15 or more Hardblood.
messages.吸血: 各スキルは的中時、与ダメージ量の一部だけ体力を回復する(S1・S2は30: **Lifesteal**: Each skill heals HP on hit equal to part of the damage dealt (S1 and S2: 30%, up to 10; S3: 50%, up to 10; La Sangre: 50%, up to 20).
messages.出血を付ける味方、特にラ・マンチャランドの血鬼と組んで血餐を貯める。S1で効率よ: Pair her with allies who inflict Bleed, especially the Bloodfiends of La Manchaland, to build Bloodfeast. Use S1 to efficiently build Hardblood to 15. Fire La Sangre at enemies with at least 10 Bleed to trigger as many damage bonuses as possible. It spends a lot of Hardblood, so aim to defeat enemies and recover Bloodfeast and Hardblood. If Bloodfeast is 0 early on, she gains Bleed herself, so watch the remaining amount. Hardblood also raises Offense and Defense Levels and Speed based on its amount, but this cannot be confirmed from the Identity data.
messages.速度差で強化: 各スキルは、自分の速度が対象より高いほどコイン威力が上がる(速度: **Speed-difference bonuses**: Each skill gains Coin Power the faster she is than the target (+1 per 2 Speed difference, up to 2). Her Defense skill gains the same bonus when she is faster than the attacker.
messages.呼吸→クイックのループ: バトルパッシブ「草炎玉球」(憤怒×2・傲慢×2・保有・: **Poise→Haste loop**: Through the combat passive Virescent Pyrojade (2 Wrath and 2 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), she gains 1 Haste next turn at Turn End for every 5/3 Poise Potency she has, up to 2. She gains Poise Potency on Clash Win with S2 Virescent Flame Palm (3 Poise) and S3 (5 Poise).
messages.点穴-ドンキホーテ: 同じパッシブにより、基本攻撃スキルで最後に的中した対象に、: **Nerve Strike - Don Quixote**: Through the same passive, the last target hit by her basic attack skills receives Nerve Strike next turn, once per turn, up to 3. Her Clash Power and Base Power against that target rise with the number of stacks. Applying it to a different target removes the previous stacks.
messages.S3「一手頼み申す」: 4コイン。対象の点穴1につきダメージ量+10/15%(最: **S3 — Prithee, let this be an enlightening bout**: 4 Coins. +10/15% damage per Nerve Strike on the target, up to 30/45%. On Clash Win, she gains 5 Poise, plus 3 more if the target has Nerve Strike. Coin Ⅳ inflicts 3 Defense Level Down if the target has Nerve Strike.
messages.呼吸回数はS1で確保: S1「発勁」は使用時に呼吸回数が2/3増える。S3は呼吸: **Secure Poise Count with S1**: S1 Fa Jin increases Poise Count by 2/3 on use. S3 cannot increase Poise Count, so its many Coins tend to use up her Count.
messages.火傷: 各スキルで火傷を付与する。S2はⅢコインで火傷6につき防御レベル減少(最: **Burn**: Each skill inflicts Burn. Coin Ⅲ of S2 inflicts Defense Level Down for every 6 Burn, up to 2/3/5, and the passive raises Critical damage based on Burn Potency. However, she can barely increase Burn Count.
messages.序盤はS1で呼吸回数を確保し、S2のマッチ勝利で呼吸威力を貯めて、パッシブのクイ: Early on, secure Poise Count with S1, build Poise Potency by winning Clashes with S2, and collect the passive's Haste. Keep hitting the same enemy to stack Nerve Strike to 3, then unleash the S3 you have been saving. Treat Burn as a bonus rather than her core. She can fight on Speed difference and Nerve Strike alone, even outside Burn teams.
messages.形態の循環: ターン開始時、精神力0以上なら「魔法少女、参上！」(加算コイン)、: **Form cycle**: At Turn Start, she is in Here Comes Magical Girl! (Plus Coins) if her SP is 0 or higher, or Regressive Transformation - Reversed (Minus Coins) if it is below 0. If she ends a turn with 3 Magical Arcana and SP at −25% or higher, her SP becomes −25 and she switches to Reversed form. Reversed form's S3 restores SP at Turn End if her SP is below 0 (but not −45); the lower her SP, the more it restores. It does not restore SP at −45, so she does not always return to Magical Girl form.
messages.逆転形態のS3「リバースド･ビート / リバースド･アルカナ･スレイブ」: 攻撃: **Reversed form's S3 — Reversed Beats / Reversed Arcana Slave**: Before attacking, spends all Magical Arcana for +1 Attack Weight each, up to 3. If the Hysteria consumed is 3, +1 more Attack Weight. +15/30% damage per Love/Hate, up to 60/150%. Damage dealt to sub-targets is −50%. Even so, hitting as many enemies as possible is ideal.
messages.マジカル・アルカナの獲得: 魔法少女形態のS3「アルカナ･ビート! / マイナー: **Gaining Magical Arcana**: She gains 1 after the attack of Magical Girl form's S3, Arcana Beats!! / Minor Arcana Slave!!!. The combat passive Magical Girl of Love / Queen of Hatred (4 Envy Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) also grants 1 at Combat Start, up to 3. However, this Arcana gain is added at Uptie Ⅲ.
messages.ヒステリー: ターン終了時に精神力が0未満なら1増え、0以上なら1減る(最大3): **Hysteria**: At Turn End, it increases by 1 if her SP is below 0 and decreases by 1 if it is 0 or higher, up to 3. Reversed form's S2 gains Base Power from Hysteria. At 3 Hysteria, S2 gains +1 Attack Weight.
messages.愛/憎悪: 特殊充電(回数最大20)。各スキルで回数を増やし、消耗して威力を上げ: **Love/Hate**: A special Charge with up to 20 Count. Each skill increases its Count and spends it to raise power. Each time she spends a cumulative 10 Count, she gains 1 Love/Hate. Skills in Reversed form lower her SP on use, but a skill's SP cost cannot bring her below −40.
messages.嫉妬を持つ味方を多く入れて嫉妬共鳴4を作り、パッシブでマジカル・アルカナを貯める: Include many allies with Envy skills to form 4 Envy Resonance and build Magical Arcana through the passive. In Magical Girl form, raise Love/Hate with S1 and S2, and use S3 for extra Arcana. Once she enters Reversed form at 3 Arcana, mainly use S1 Where are... the villains...? while building Hysteria to 3. When everything is ready, fire Reversed form's S3 at multiple enemies, restore SP, and return to Magical Girl form (at −45 SP she does not recover, so she does not return).
messages.「鴻園の君主」ホンルとの連携: 常時発動パッシブ「亡羊之嘆」により、待機解除また: **Coordination with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan**: Through the passive Lament of the Lost Sheep [亡羊之嘆], which is always active, she gains 3 Burgeoning of Horns [發角] on the turn she appears from backup or returns. The Lord Hong Lu's passive makes Heishou allies who step in from backup or return perform a one-sided attack with basic skill 3 at Combat Start, 2 times per battle per Identity. In other words, an S3 carrying 3 Burgeoning of Horns is fired immediately. Also, triggering Exalted Command with the Lord Hong Lu grants him an enhancement that inflicts 1 Sinking each time his skills inflict Rupture, 3 times per turn.
messages.S3「破砕角」: 使用時に発角3を得る。戦闘開始時に発角があれば全コインが破壊不: **S3 — Crushing Horns [破碎角]**: Gains 3 Burgeoning of Horns on use. If she has Burgeoning of Horns at Combat Start, all Coins become Unbreakable, with +10% damage per stack, up to 30%. Coin Ⅳ deals more damage if the target has a Panic Type change effect and inflicts 3 Shattermark next turn. It grows stronger the more it is used in succession.
messages.破裂・沈潜の合計で強化: 攻撃スキルは対象の破裂と沈潜の合計が6以上なら/につき: **Bonuses from total Rupture and Sinking**: Attack skills gain +1 Coin Power if/for every 6 combined Rupture and Sinking on the target, up to 2. The combat passive Explosive Battering Ram (3 Gluttony and 3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +1% damage for every 2 of that total, up to 15%, doubled against targets without SP. With Burgeoning of Horns, her final Coin's damage also rises.
messages.発角: 最大3、ターン終了時に1減少。基本スキルで付与する破裂・沈潜の威力+1。: **Burgeoning of Horns**: Maximum 3; decreases by 1 at Turn End. +1 to the Rupture and Sinking Potency inflicted by basic skills. Her Defense skill grants 3 next turn. S2 Seize the Momentum, Shatter the Wall also makes its final Coin Unbreakable if she has Burgeoning of Horns at Combat Start.
messages.破砕痕: 暴食・憂鬱スキルでの被ダメージ量+10%。精神力のある対象はパニックタ: **Shattermark**: +10% damage taken from Gluttony and Gloom skills. It changes the Panic Type of targets with SP and gives −1 Clash Power to targets without SP. S1 Breakthrough deals +25% damage to targets with Shattermark.
messages.自分では破裂・沈潜を多く積めないので、破裂や沈潜を維持する味方と組んで蓄積を任せ: She cannot stack much Rupture or Sinking herself, so pair her with allies who maintain Rupture or Sinking and leave the buildup to them. In regular battles, the efficient approach is to pair her with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan, place her in a backup slot that will step in, and have her fire S3 with 3 Burgeoning of Horns. When fighting on her own, gain Burgeoning of Horns with S3 or her Defense skill first, then fire S2 and S3 with Unbreakable Coins.
messages.解禁と開花E.G.O::代行: 指令の加護が3/6/9でターンを終えると、解禁-: **Unlock and Effloresced E.G.O::Procuration**: Ending a turn with 3/6/9 Grace of the Prescript grants Unlock - Ⅰ/Ⅱ/Ⅲ. On gaining Unlock - Ⅰ, she spends 15 SP to enter the Procuration state, and her skills are swapped. In the Procuration state, she gains Faith Beyond Question: +1 to minimum and maximum Speed, +2 Offense Level and +2 Defense Level, and +1 Poise Potency gained from basic skills. At Unlock - Ⅲ, she also gains Shin (心) - Procuration. If her SP is 0 or lower at Turn Start, the Procuration state ends, and re-entering requires at least 25 SP at Turn Start.
messages.守備で解禁を進める: 通常の守備は、ターン終了時に解禁が無ければ解禁-Ⅰを得る(: **Advancing Unlock with her Defense skill**: Her normal Defense skill grants Unlock - Ⅰ at Turn End if she has no Unlock, bringing Grace of the Prescript to 3. During Procuration, the Defense skill Compulsory Unlock raises the Unlock stage by 1 if she has Unlock, bringing Grace to 6/9. In exchange, she gains 5 Karmic Consequence at the next Turn Start for each Grace gained (1 Defense Level Down per 10 Karmic Consequence, and 1 Fragile per 20).
messages.指令: ターン開始時、基本攻撃スキルに指令の印が付く。遂行すると指令の加護1と精: **Prescript**: At Turn Start, Mark of the Prescript is placed on basic attack skills. Fulfilling it grants 1 Grace of the Prescript and restores 4 SP, or 3 Grace and 8 SP if the main target has The Prescript's Target. Failing it grants 5 Karmic Consequence, except at Unlock - Ⅲ. At Unlock - Ⅱ, the Prescript becomes "land a marked S3 in the Procuration state, or land an E.G.O Awakening skill."
messages.精神力の収支: 代行中のスキルは攻撃後に精神力が減る(S1は3、S2は6、S3は: **SP balance**: During Procuration, her skills lower her SP after attacking (S1: 3, S2: 6, S3: 15; each up to 2 times per turn). However, at Unlock - Ⅰ/Ⅱ/Ⅲ she recovers 5/10/15 at Combat End, and she also recovers through fulfilling the Prescript and the passive The Great Magicked Beeper Knoweth My Desire!.
messages.呼吸とS1: 各スキルは自分の呼吸と対象の沈潜の合計で強化される。代行状態のS1: **Poise and S1**: Each skill is strengthened by her Poise plus the target's Sinking. In the Procuration state, S1 Let These Hands be the Proxy with Which... increases Poise Count by 1/2 on use and by 1 more on Critical Hit.
messages.1ターン目に指令を遂行できそうにないときは、守備を構えて解禁-Ⅰへ進め、早めに代: When she is unlikely to fulfill the Prescript on turn 1, set up her Defense skill to advance to Unlock - Ⅰ and enter the Procuration state early. She gains Karmic Consequence, but reaching Unlock - Ⅰ on turn 1 is the premise. In the Procuration state, take Clashes with S2 and S3, and Compulsory Unlock is an option for skipping the often troublesome Unlock - Ⅱ Prescript. If her Poise Count is about to run out, use S1 to maintain it. Against enemies that lower SP, watch out for the Procuration state ending.
messages.保存神域: S3「誕生を断たん！」と守備「黙示」は、戦闘開始時に保存神域3を得る: **Sanctum of Conservation**: S3 I Sever Thine Advent! and the Defense skill Witness Ye in Silence grant 3 Sanctum of Conservation at Combat Start, up to 5, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. While the Sanctum is active, the following apply. All allies gain Shield equal to (Preservation Potency×2)% of their max HP when using a skill, once per turn, up to 10%. All enemies get −1 to minimum and maximum Speed and take +10% damage from skills that spend Charge Count or special Charge, doubled for skills from Le Noir allies. Le Noir allies gain Offense and Defense Level.
messages.黒き神の加護: ステージ初登場時に25を得る。保存回数を消耗するか最大値を超えて: **Blessing of the Obsidian God**: Gains 25 on first appearing in a stage. It increases by (value×5) when she spends Preservation Count or gains it beyond the maximum, up to 30 per turn, and also when an ally with Shield is hit, up to 100. At Turn Start, she gains Shield equal to (value÷5)% of her max HP. At 25 or more, all Coins of her basic attack skills become Unbreakable, and at 40 or more she cannot be staggered, except by forced Stagger.
messages.「幾度も振り下ろし、誕生を断たん！」: 戦闘開始時に加護が100なら、守備がこの: **With Each Smite, I Sever Thine Advent!**: If Blessing is 100 at Combat Start, her Defense skill activates as this skill (3 Attack Weight; it triggers even against one-sided attacks). It adds Sloth damage based on the number of Promised Nails, up to 45%/90%. After the attack, it spends all Blessing of the Obsidian God and all of the target's Nails, so the Shield and Stagger immunity weaken the next turn. This skill's effect text does not include gaining Sanctum of Conservation. So while Blessing is 100, setting up the Defense skill may not renew the Sanctum, and she has to rely on S3 to maintain it during that time.
messages.保存と約束された釘: 釘を付与するたびに保存回数を2消耗する(12以上なら4消耗: **Preservation and Promised Nails**: Each Nail infliction spends 2 Preservation Count; at 12 or more, it spends 4 to inflict +1, and if there is not enough, no Nails are inflicted. Each cumulative 10 spent grants 1 Preservation Potency, and at 3 or more Potency each skill is strengthened. All attack skills except S1 Cometh the Nail, plus her Defense skill, inflict Nails, and each skill also replenishes Preservation Count. The Count balance is always positive, so there is little need to manage it closely.
messages.ル・ノワールの味方と追撃: 自分以外のル・ノワール所属の味方が攻撃する前に、「審: **Le Noir allies and follow-ups**: Before a Le Noir ally other than herself attacks, she makes a one-sided attack with Judgment!, once per turn. This attack inflicts 1 Promised Nail and 3/4 Tremor, so Preservation Potency builds quickly.
messages.振動-保存: S3のⅢコインで振幅変換する。振動爆発時に振動威力の(60+攻撃者: **Tremor - Conservation**: Coin Ⅲ of S3 performs Amplitude Conversion. On Tremor Burst, it deals Sloth damage equal to (60 + attacker's Charge Potency or special Charge ×8)% of Tremor Potency, up to 120%.
messages.初手はS3か守備で保存神域を張り、切れる前にS3や守備を挟んで維持する(加護10: Open with S3 or her Defense skill to set up Sanctum of Conservation, and maintain it by slipping in S3 or the Defense skill before it runs out (at 100 Blessing, the Defense skill turns into the enhanced skill, so maintain it with S3). Grow Preservation Potency to 3 or more while driving in Nails, and once Blessing reaches 100, hit several enemies at once with the enhanced Defense skill. However, if you know a strong attack is coming the turn after using it, consider holding it. Follow-ups speed up Preservation Potency, so pairing her with Le Noir allies is ideal.
messages.出血を付けつつ、解析Ⅲから与ダメージの半分を回復できる、出血編成向けの色欲貫通・: A single-target Lust Pierce E.G.O for Bleed teams that inflicts Bleed and, from Threadspin Ⅲ, heals for half of the damage dealt.
messages.出血付与: Ⅰコインの的中時に出血を付与する。付与量は解析で増え、Ⅱ以前は表面的: **Inflicting Bleed**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Bleed on hit. The amount grows with Threadspin: 4 on Heads Hit at Ⅱ or below, 6 on hit at Ⅲ, and 8 on hit at Ⅳ.
messages.与ダメージの回復(解析Ⅲで追加): 与ダメージ量の50%分体力を回復する(解析Ⅲ: **Healing from damage dealt (added at Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Heals HP equal to 50% of the damage dealt (on Heads Hit at Threadspin Ⅲ, on hit at Ⅳ). Using it on enemies weak to Pierce or staggered enemies likely increases the healing as well.
messages.パッシブ「過度な熱情」: 攻撃が的中したとき、対象に出血があれば体力を3回復する: **Passive — Immoderate Passion**: When an attack lands, heals 3 HP if the target has Bleed. Attacks from Identities with more Coins likely trigger it more often.
messages.軽さ: 必要資源は色欲2・傲慢2、精神消耗は10。ただしマッチ威力は12〜23と: **Lightweight**: Requires 2 Lust and 2 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 10. However, its Clash Power is a lowish 12–23 (12–26 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.出血を扱う人格と組み、出血の上乗せと回復で体力を保つ。: Pair it with Identities that use Bleed to add Bleed and keep HP up through healing.
messages.マッチ威力が低いので、精神力が高いときに使うか、一方攻撃で通す場面に使うと考えら: Its Clash Power is low, so it is likely best used when her SP is high, or where it can go through as a one-sided attack.
messages.解析Ⅳで威力・出血量・回復条件がそろうため、ドンキホーテを使うなら優先して解析す: Threadspin Ⅳ brings together power, Bleed amount, and the healing condition, so it is likely well worth prioritizing if you use Don Quixote.
messages.Ⅲ: 出血が的中時に6へ増え、表面的中時の体力回復が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Bleed rises to 6 on hit, and HP recovery on Heads Hit is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 威力が12〜26に上がり、出血8、回復も的中時になる。恩恵が大きく、優先度: **Ⅳ**: Power rises to 12–26, Bleed becomes 8, and healing also applies on hit. The benefit is large, so it is likely a high priority.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長: 出血を扱う人格で、色欲のスキルを複数持ち、必要資源の色: **[The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310)**: A Bleed Identity with several Lust skills who can supply the required Lust.
messages.南部センク協会5課部長: ルミーズ(色欲)とサリュー!(傲慢)で、必要資源の色欲: **[Cinq Assoc. South Section 5 Director](persona:0305)**: Remise (Lust) and Salut! (Pride) supply both required Lust and Pride.
messages.高威力の1コイン打撃で敵の精神力を削り、精神力のある敵を押し込む憂鬱E.G.O。: A Gloom E.G.O that drains enemy SP with a high-power 1-Coin Blunt attack and pushes enemies that have SP.
messages.高威力と精神力ダメージ: 表面で最大33(解析Ⅲは38)の1コイン打撃。表面的中: **High power and SP damage**: A 1-Coin Blunt attack reaching up to 33 on Heads (38 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Triggers Tremor Burst on Heads Hit and deals 15 SP damage on hit (25 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.追加ダメージ(解析Ⅲ): 対象が混乱・士気低下・パニックのとき、与ダメージ量の3: **Extra damage (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Deals an additional 30% of the damage dealt when the target is staggered, in Low Morale, or panicking.
messages.広域化と沈潜(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が3になり、的中時に沈潜2を付与する。複数部: **Multi-target and Sinking (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and it inflicts 2 Sinking on hit. Used against multi-part enemies, it can likely drain SP all at once.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 的中時に振動と沈潜を付与する(付与量は解析で5から7、10へ)。精: **Corrosion skill**: Inflicts Tremor and Sinking on hit, with the amount growing from 5 to 7 to 10 through Threadspin. Even against enemies without SP, Sinking turns into Gloom damage.
messages.パッシブ「押し寄せる憂鬱」: パネル最右のスキルで攻撃した対象に、終了時(憂鬱完: **Passive — Wave of Depression**: Targets attacked by the rightmost skill on the panel take (Gloom Absolute Resonance×2) SP damage at the end. A minor bonus.
messages.精神力のある敵に撃って精神力を削り、士気低下やパニックへ追い込む。敵の精神力が下: Use it on enemies with SP to drain it and push them into Low Morale or Panic. Lower enemy SP makes Heads less likely for them, likely tilting Clashes in your favor too.
messages.最大威力が高く、表が出れば多くの攻撃にマッチ勝利しやすい。: Its maximum power is high, so on Heads it can win Clashes against many attacks.
messages.精神力のない敵には侵蝕スキルの沈潜が主な手段になるが、E.G.O侵蝕で使われると: Against enemies without SP, the Corrosion skill's Sinking is the main tool, but when used through E.G.O Corrosion it attacks friend and foe alike.
messages.必要資源は憂鬱4・傲慢2・色欲1。憂鬱が重いので、使いどころを絞る。: It requires 4 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 1 Lust. The Gloom cost is heavy, so pick its moments carefully.
messages.Ⅱ: 「押し寄せる憂鬱」が解放されるが、効果は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Wave of Depression, but the effect is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力と精神力ダメージが上がり、混乱中などの追加ダメージが付く。単体の敵: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and SP damage, and adds extra damage against staggered targets and similar. Against a single enemy, this is likely enough.
messages.Ⅳ: 広域化と沈潜付与が入る。複数部位の敵に当てるなら価値が高い。: **Ⅳ**: Adds multi-target attacks and Sinking infliction. Valuable when hitting multi-part enemies.
messages.人差し指代行者-開花E.G.O::代行: 沈潜を付与し、色欲・傲慢・憂鬱のスキル: **[The Index Proxy - Effloresced E.G.O:: Procuration](persona:0314)**: Inflicts Sinking, and her Lust, Pride, and Gloom skills supply all of the required affinities.
messages.黒獣-未: 破砕角(憂鬱)と突破(色欲)で必要資源の一部を出せ、突破と破砕角が沈: **[Heishou Pack - Wei Branch](persona:0313)**: Crushing Horns (Gloom) and Breakthrough (Lust) supply some of the required affinities, and both also inflict Sinking.
messages.軽いコストで自分と味方全体に充電回数を配り、充電編成の下準備を一度で済ませる嫉妬: A low-cost Envy Pierce E.G.O that hands out Charge Count to herself and all allies, completing a Charge team's setup in one go.
messages.充電の獲得: Ⅰコインの的中時に、自分が充電回数10を得る。: **Gaining Charge**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, she gains 10 Charge Count.
messages.味方への配布: 嫉妬共鳴の数に比例して全味方に充電回数を付与する。解析Ⅲは表面的: **Distribution to allies**: Gives all allies Charge Count in proportion to Envy Resonance. At Threadspin Ⅲ it happens on Heads Hit, and at Ⅳ after the attack, so it no longer depends on the Coin result.
messages.広域化(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が3になる。複数の敵に当てるほど的中が増え、自分の: **Multi-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight becomes 3. The more enemies it hits, the more hits land, likely making it easier to fill her own Charge to the cap (20).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 自分が充電回数10と破裂10を得る。解析Ⅲからは全味方に脆弱5・破: **Corrosion skill**: She gains 10 Charge Count and 10 Rupture. From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also gives all allies 5 Fragile, 10 Rupture, and 10 Charge Count (12 at Ⅳ), greatly increasing the risk when allies are hit. There is no mention of being unable to distinguish friend from foe, so targets can likely be chosen.
messages.パッシブ「無作為放出」: 戦闘開始時、充電を持つ味方1名に(嫉妬完全共鳴数÷2): **Passive — Haphazard Discharge**: At Combat Start, gives 1 ally with Charge (Envy Absolute Resonance ÷ 2) Charge Count. The condition is demanding and the effect small.
messages.充電を条件にするスキルが多い編成の序盤に撃ち、充電の準備をまとめて済ませる。: Fire it early in a team with many skills that require Charge to finish preparing Charge all at once.
messages.嫉妬共鳴を作れるほど配布量が増える。: The more Envy Resonance you can build, the larger the distribution.
messages.侵蝕スキルは味方に脆弱と破裂が乗るので、被弾しにくい場面で使う。: The Corrosion skill puts Fragile and Rupture on allies, so use it when they are unlikely to be hit.
messages.必要資源は憤怒1・憂鬱2・嫉妬2、精神消耗は覚醒20。充電以外の強みは少なく、汎: It requires 1 Wrath, 2 Gloom, and 2 Envy, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20. It has few strengths beyond Charge, so its versatility is likely low.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、味方への充電配布(表面的中時)と侵蝕の全味方配布が加わる: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and adds Charge distribution to allies (on Heads Hit) and the Corrosion skill's team-wide distribution.
messages.Ⅳ: 広域化し、配布が攻撃後になる。侵蝕の充電配布は12へ。OCで使う機会が多い: **Ⅳ**: Becomes multi-target, and the distribution moves to after the attack. The Corrosion skill's Charge distribution rises to 12. It is likely worthwhile if you often use it with Overclock.
messages.W社3級整理要員: 切断・跳躍が充電を条件や獲得源にし、空間切断が充電10を消耗: **[W Corp. L3 Cleanup Agent](persona:0302)**: Rip and Leap use Charge as a condition or source, and Rip Space spends 10 Charge. Her Gloom and Envy skills also supply resources.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::愛と憎悪の名の下に: 憤怒・嫉妬のスキルが多く、必要資源: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: In the Name of Love and Hate](persona:0312)**: Has many Wrath and Envy skills, supplies the required Wrath and Envy, and makes Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.色欲資源を溜めるほどダメージ量が伸び、火傷と出血の回数を増やす色欲打撃の3枠広域: A 3-target Lust Blunt E.G.O whose damage grows with stored Lust resources and that increases Burn and Bleed Count. In practice, it is for Bleed teams (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ).
messages.資源でダメージ量: 攻撃前、保有する色欲E.G.O資源1つにつきダメージ量+6%: **Damage from resources**: Before attacking, +6% damage per Lust E.G.O resource held, up to 120% at 20 resources.
messages.回数の上乗せ: 的中時に火傷回数と出血回数が各3増える。付与ではなく回数の増加な: **Adding Count**: On hit, increases Burn Count and Bleed Count by 3 each. It increases Count rather than inflicting, so Burn or Bleed likely needs to be applied first. It also gains +1 Final Power for every 4 combined Burn and Bleed, up to 3.
messages.色欲威力増加の配布: 色欲資源6つにつき、編成順に味方1名へ次のターンに色欲威力: **Distributing Lust Power Up**: For every 6 Lust resources, gives 1 ally, in team order, 1 Lust Power Up next turn, up to 5 allies.
messages.パッシブ「暴食のるつぼ」: ターン開始時に色欲以外の資源1つを色欲資源1つへ変換: **Passive — Cauldron of Gorging**: At Turn Start, converts 1 non-Lust resource into 1 Lust resource. With 20 or more Lust resources, it does not convert, and she gains 1 Lust Power Up instead. Note that other resources decrease while below 20.
messages.色欲資源を20個近く貯めてから撃つ。色欲のスキルが多い出血編成が前提で、資源を引: Fire it after storing close to 20 Lust resources. It assumes a Bleed team with many Lust skills and likely shines on battlefields where resources carry over.
Early on, when resources are short, the passive turns scarce resources such as Gloom into Lust, making other E.G.O harder to use.
messages.侵蝕スキルは破壊不能コインで、色欲共鳴数×2(最大8)の資源を消費し、消費1つに: The Corrosion skill uses Unbreakable Coins, consumes (Lust Resonance×2) resources, up to 8, and gains +20% damage per resource consumed. Its resource consumption is heavy.
messages.必要資源は色欲5、精神消耗は覚醒20。: It requires 5 Lust, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放される。資源が減る副作用だけが先に来るため、Ⅱで止めるならⅠ: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive. Only the resource-draining side effect arrives first, so if you stop at Ⅱ, staying at Ⅰ is likely better.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力、ダメージ量の上限、火傷回数の付与が伸びる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, the damage cap, and Burn Count infliction.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒・侵蝕とも攻撃加重値が3になる。: **Ⅳ**: Both Awakening and Corrosion reach 3 Attack Weight.
messages.Ⅴ: 出血回数の増加と最終威力強化、色欲威力増加の配布が加わり、ダメージ量の上限: **Ⅴ**: Adds Bleed Count increase, Final Power Up, and Lust Power Up distribution, and raises the damage cap from 50% to 120%. The passive improves from converting 2 resources to 1.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長: 出血を扱い、色欲のスキルを複数持つので資源を出しやすい: **[The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310)**: Uses Bleed and has several Lust skills, making resources easy to supply.
messages.LCB囚人: 刺す(色欲)で色欲資源を出せ、束ね刺しと正義のため!が出血を付与す: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0301)**: Joust (Lust) supplies Lust resources, and Galloping Tilt and For Justice! inflict Bleed.
messages.出血回数・振動・麻痺をまとめて付ける打撃E.G.Oで、他のTETHが噛み合わない: A Blunt E.G.O that applies Bleed Count, Tremor, and Paralyze together, likely filling gaps in teams where other TETH E.G.O do not fit.
messages.出血と振動の付与: Ⅰコインの的中時に、出血回数を3(解析Ⅲは4)増やし、振動4: **Bleed and Tremor**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, increases Bleed Count by 3 (4 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and inflicts 4 Tremor (5 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.麻痺(解析Ⅲ): 表面的中時に麻痺2を付与する。: **Paralyze (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Inflicts 2 Paralyze on Heads Hit.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 基本威力24・コイン威力-10の減算コインで、的中時に振動爆発(振: **Corrosion skill**: A Minus Coin with 24 Base Power and −10 Coin Power that triggers Tremor Burst on hit (Tremor Count decreases by 2). On Critical Hit or Tails Hit, it triggers an additional Tremor Burst. On Critical Hit, it also inflicts Bleed.
messages.パッシブ「崩れた石塔」: 出血が付いた敵を討伐すると呼吸2と呼吸回数2を得る(1: **Passive — Fallen Stone Pagoda**: Defeating an enemy with Bleed grants 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count, up to 3 times per turn. It works when you are defeating enemies one after another.
messages.突出した効果はないので、出血・振動・呼吸のどれかを軸にした編成で、足りない部分を: It has no standout effect, so use it to cover what is missing in a team built around Bleed, Tremor, or Poise.
messages.出血回数を即座に足したい人格と相性がよい。: It pairs well with Identities that want Bleed Count added immediately.
messages.マッチ威力は18〜27で、軽いコストのマッチ用としては決め手に欠けると考えられる: Its Clash Power is 18–27, likely lacking punch as a low-cost Clash option.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・怠惰2・傲慢1、精神消耗は覚醒20。: It requires 2 Wrath, 2 Sloth, and 1 Pride, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20.
messages.Ⅲ: 出血回数と振動の付与量が増え、麻痺が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases Bleed Count and Tremor infliction, and adds Paralyze.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒が広域化し、侵蝕スキルの出血付与量が増える。: **Ⅳ**: Awakening becomes multi-target, and the Corrosion skill's Bleed infliction increases.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長: 出血を扱い、怠惰・憤怒のスキルで必要資源も出せる。: **[The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310)**: Uses Bleed, and her Sloth and Wrath skills supply the required affinities.
messages.剣契殺手: 呼吸を扱う人格で、傲慢・怠惰のスキルから必要資源を出せ、パッシブの呼: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:0308)**: A Poise Identity whose Pride and Sloth skills supply the required affinities, and who meshes with the passive's Poise gain.
A multi-target Pierce E.G.O for Envy teams whose Attack Weight and damage grow with higher Envy Resonance.
messages.加重値の増加: 攻撃前に(嫉妬共鳴数-2)だけ攻撃加重値が増える(上限は解析Ⅳで: **Attack Weight increase**: Before attacking, Attack Weight increases by (Envy Resonance − 2), capped at +3 at Threadspin Ⅳ. The base is 2, for a maximum of 5.
messages.ダメージ量の増加(解析Ⅲ): 攻撃前に(嫉妬共鳴数-3)×5%(上限15%)が加: **Damage increase (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Before attacking, adds (Envy Resonance − 3)×5% damage, up to 15%; at Threadspin Ⅳ, it becomes ×10%, up to 30%.
messages.充電の消費: 攻撃前に自分の充電回数が20以上なら最大20を消耗し、ダメージ量+: **Spending Charge**: Before attacking, if she has at least 20 Charge Count, spends up to 20 for +30% damage (35% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 40% at Ⅳ). Defeating an enemy increases Charge Count by 2.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 加重値の強化は覚醒と共通で、共鳴によるダメージ量の値は別(解析Ⅳは: **Corrosion skill**: The Attack Weight bonus is shared with Awakening, but the Resonance-based damage value differs (×12% at Threadspin Ⅳ, up to 36%). If her Charge Count is short of 20, she spends HP to make up the difference. Spending that 20 gives up to +100% damage (Threadspin Ⅳ), making it a damage skill paid for with HP.
messages.パッシブ「嵐が如き悲鳴」: 斬撃か嫉妬のスキルで対象を倒すと、次のターンに攻撃威: **Passive — Tempestuous Screaming**: Defeating a target with a Slash or Envy skill grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.嫉妬スキルを多く並べて共鳴を高めたうえで撃つ。覚醒の解析Ⅳなら、嫉妬共鳴5で加重: Line up many Envy skills to raise Resonance before using it. At Threadspin Ⅳ, Awakening's Attack Weight caps out at 5 Envy Resonance and the damage bonus at 6.
messages.充電を消耗する効果は、充電を持たない編成では発動しにくく、おまけと考えられる。: The Charge-spending effect rarely triggers in teams without Charge, so it is likely just a bonus.
messages.侵蝕スキルは減算コイン(コイン威力-12)で、表が出るほど威力が下がる。: The Corrosion skill uses Minus Coins (−12 Coin Power), so its power drops the more Heads land.
messages.必要資源は傲慢2・嫉妬4、精神消耗は覚醒20(侵蝕25)。: It requires 2 Pride and 4 Envy, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20 (25 for Corrosion).
messages.Ⅲ: 共鳴によるダメージ量増加が加わり、加重値の上限が2に、充電消耗の強化が35: **Ⅲ**: Adds the Resonance-based damage increase, raises the Attack Weight cap to 2, and raises the Charge-spending bonus to 35%.
messages.Ⅳ: 加重値の上限が3、共鳴によるダメージ量がさらに伸び、侵蝕の体力消耗も軽くな: **Ⅳ**: Raises the Attack Weight cap to 3, increases the Resonance-based damage further, and lightens the Corrosion skill's HP cost.
messages.中指末妹: 義理証明・倍返し(嫉妬)と正義の仕返し(傲慢)で必要資源を出せ、嫉妬: **[The Middle Little Sister](persona:0306)**: Proof of Loyalty and Multifold Retribution (Envy) plus A Just Vengeance (Pride) supply the required affinities and make Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::愛と憎悪の名の下に: 嫉妬のスキルが多く、嫉妬共鳴を作り: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: In the Name of Love and Hate](persona:0312)**: Has many Envy skills, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.全コイン破壊不能の7枠広域(解析Ⅳ)で、出血と血餐を溜めた血鬼編成が一気に大ダメ: A Lust Pierce E.G.O that hits up to 7 targets with all-Unbreakable Coins (Threadspin Ⅳ), letting a Bloodfiend team that has built up Bleed and Bloodfeast go for massive damage at once.
messages.4コインの破壊不能コイン: 基本威力3・コイン威力+3の4コインで、使用中は体力: **4 Unbreakable Coins**: 4 Coins with 3 Base Power and +3 Coin Power, and her HP cannot drop below 1 during use. Its Clash Power is low, but its Coins cannot be broken.
messages.血餐による強化: 共用累積消耗血餐が増えるほど各コインのダメージ量が上がる。2枚: **Bloodfeast bonuses**: The more Bloodfeast Consumed (shared) increases, the more damage each Coin deals. From the second Coin on, the bonuses kick in at 100, 200, and 300 or more Bloodfeast, and Threadspin raises the caps. +1 Clash Power per 100 of her own Bloodfeast Consumed, up to 5 at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.出血の活用: 対象の出血が10以上で、コイン威力が上がる(解析Ⅲ以降)。血餐が少: **Using Bleed**: Coin Power rises when the target has at least 10 Bleed (Threadspin Ⅲ and up). While Bloodfeast is low, each hit inflicts 1 Bleed.
messages.渇望する薔薇: 4枚目のコインでマッチ勝利後に的中すると、最大色欲完全共鳴数に応: **Polydipsic Rose**: Inflicted when the fourth Coin hits after a Clash Win, based on the highest Lust Absolute Resonance, up to 3 (4 at Threadspin Ⅳ). With 10 or more Bleed Potency, the target takes Lust damage at Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「高くそびえる紅い花」: 出血のダメージが10以上出るたび精神力が1回復: **Passive — Spiring Crimson Blossom**: Restores 1 SP each time Bleed deals 10 or more damage, up to 10 per turn.
messages.血餐と出血を溜めてから撃つ。条件は重いが、鏡ダンジョンなど強化が乗りやすい場面で: Use it after building Bloodfeast and Bleed. The requirements are steep, but it likely produces the most output where buffs stack easily, such as in Mirror Dungeons.
messages.攻撃後の3ターン、毎ターン終了時に精神力が10減るので、精神力を確認して使う。: For 3 turns after the attack, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End, so check her SP before using it.
messages.侵蝕スキルは自分が出血20を得て発動し、血餐によるダメージ量の強化が主体。: The Corrosion skill activates with her gaining 20 Bleed, and its main strength is the Bloodfeast-based damage bonus.
messages.必要資源は色欲5・暴食3・傲慢2・嫉妬2の計12で重い。精神消耗は覚醒15。: It requires a heavy 12 resources: 5 Lust, 3 Gluttony, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy. Awakening Sanity cost is 15.
messages.Ⅲ: 血餐と出血による強化の上限が引き上げられる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the caps on the Bloodfeast and Bleed bonuses.
messages.Ⅳ: 上限がさらに上がり、加重値が7になる。単体相手なら加重値5のⅢで足りる場面: **Ⅳ**: Raises the caps further, and Attack Weight becomes 7. Against a single enemy, Ⅲ with 5 Attack Weight is likely enough in some cases.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド室長: 血餐を扱う人格で、出血を付与し、色欲のスキルで必要資源: **[The Manager of La Manchaland](persona:0310)**: A Bloodfeast Identity who inflicts Bleed and supplies the required Lust with her Lust skills.
messages.LCB囚人: 刺す(色欲)・正義のため!(暴食)・束ね刺し(嫉妬)で必要資源を出: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0301)**: Joust (Lust), For Justice! (Gluttony), and Galloping Tilt (Envy) supply the required affinities, and the latter two also inflict Bleed.
messages.1コイン目で呪いの札を溜め、2コイン目の大ダメージと破裂付与につなげる、暴食共鳴: A 3-target Slash E.G.O suited to Gluttony Resonance that stacks curse talismans with the first Coin and turns them into heavy damage and Rupture with the second.
messages.呪いの札の付与: 1コイン目の的中時に、対象へ(4+暴食共鳴数)の札を付与する(: **Inflicting talismans**: On first Coin hit, inflicts (4 + Gluttony Resonance) talismans on the target, up to 10. 6 Gluttony Resonance reaches the cap. The talismans disappear at Turn End.
messages.札によるダメージ増加(解析Ⅲ): 2コイン目のダメージ量が札1つにつき+3%(上: **Damage from talismans (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: The second Coin deals +3% damage per talisman, up to 30%, or +5% per talisman, up to 50%, at Threadspin Ⅳ. If the first Coin is broken, the bonus does not apply.
messages.破裂の付与: 2コイン目の的中時に、札÷2の破裂(最大3、解析Ⅳは4)を付与し、: **Inflicting Rupture**: On second Coin hit, inflicts Rupture equal to talismans÷2, up to 3 (4 at Threadspin Ⅳ), and increases Rupture Count by talismans÷4, up to 2.
messages.札10の追加効果: 札が10のとき、30以上のダメージを受けると破裂回数+1と破: **Extra effect at 10 talismans**: At 10 talismans, taking 30 or more damage adds +1 Rupture Count and deals Gluttony damage equal to Rupture Potency, once per turn.
messages.パッシブ「衰弱符」: 対象の破裂が15以上、またはクリティカルを与えたときに防御: **Passive — Enfeebling Talisman**: Inflicts 1 Defense Level Down when the target has at least 15 Rupture or when she lands a Critical Hit, up to 6.
messages.暴食共鳴を作って札を10に近づけ、2コイン目の破裂付与につなげる。: Build Gluttony Resonance to bring talismans close to 10, then follow up with the second Coin's Rupture.
messages.1コイン目を落とさないよう、マッチ相手を選ぶ。: Choose Clash opponents so the first Coin is not broken.
messages.侵蝕スキルは札の強化が大きい反面、コイン威力が減算でマッチが不安定。OCには向か: The Corrosion skill has a larger talisman bonus, but its Minus Coin Power makes Clashes unstable. It is likely not suited to Overclock.
messages.必要資源は色欲1・暴食5・憂鬱2・傲慢1の計9、精神消耗は覚醒25。: It requires 9 resources: 1 Lust, 5 Gluttony, 2 Gloom, and 1 Pride. Awakening Sanity cost is 25.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放されるだけで、ここで止める意味は薄いと考えられる。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks the passive, so there is likely little point in stopping here.
messages.Ⅲ: 札に応じて2コイン目のダメージが伸びる。: **Ⅲ**: The second Coin's damage grows with talismans.
messages.Ⅳ: ダメージ増加がさらに伸び、破裂の付与量が少し増える。: **Ⅳ**: The damage bonus grows further, and Rupture infliction increases slightly.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::提灯: 破裂を扱い、暴食・色欲・憂鬱のスキルで必要資源を: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Lantern](persona:0307)**: Uses Rupture, and her Gluttony, Lust, and Gloom skills supply three of the required affinities.
messages.黒獣-未: 暴食のスキルを2つ持ち、各スキルが破裂を付与する。: **[Heishou Pack - Wei Branch](persona:0313)**: Has 2 Gluttony skills, and each skill inflicts Rupture.
messages.充電で加重値を伸ばし、味方に詠唱と回復を配る嫉妬打撃の大型広域で、愛と憎悪の人格: A large multi-target Envy Blunt E.G.O that extends Attack Weight with Charge and hands out Chant and healing to allies. It meshes especially well with the In the Name of Love and Hate Identity.
messages.魔法少女の詠唱: 攻撃前に、自分以外のランダムな味方へ魔法少女の詠唱を付与する(: **Magical Girl's Chant**: Before attacking, gives Magical Girl's Chant to random allies other than herself, with the number of allies growing with Envy Resonance. It raises the Final Power and damage of attack skills that use Charge.
messages.充電で広域化: 攻撃前に(充電-1)だけ攻撃加重値が増える(最大3、解析Ⅲは5): **Multi-target through Charge**: Before attacking, Attack Weight increases by (Charge − 1), up to 3 (5 at Threadspin Ⅲ). The base Attack Weight is 5.
messages.味方の回復: 攻撃後に充電回数をすべて消耗し、体力割合の低い味方を消耗した充電回: **Healing allies**: After the attack, spends all Charge Count and heals allies with low HP ratios by a percentage equal to the Charge Count spent, up to 5% (8% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10% at Ⅳ).
messages.破壊不能コイン: 1枚目の的中で充電を増やし、2枚目の表面的中時(解析Ⅳは的中時: **Unbreakable Coins**: The first Coin increases Charge on hit, and the second applies Mark of Villainy for the next turn on Heads Hit (on hit at Threadspin Ⅳ). The second Coin also inflicts Rupture based on Charge.
messages.パッシブ「アルカナ適性回路」: 充電回数の消耗が累計10になるごとに充電1を得る: **Passive — Arcana Aptitude Circuit**: Gains 1 Charge for every cumulative 10 Charge Count spent. Raises the damage of basic attack skills that spend Charge. When used by the In the Name of Love and Hate Identity, it adds 1 more Skill 3.
messages.嫉妬共鳴を高めて撃ち、味方への詠唱付与と回復も同時に取る。: Raise Envy Resonance before using it to also collect the Chant and healing for allies.
messages.愛と憎悪の人格で使うと、マジカル・アルカナの獲得など専用の効果が働く。: When used by the In the Name of Love and Hate Identity, dedicated effects such as gaining Magical Arcana apply.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・憂鬱2・傲慢2・嫉妬6の計12で、早い段階での使用は資源面が厳: It requires 12 resources: 2 Wrath, 2 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 6 Envy, so using it early is hard on resources.
messages.侵蝕スキルは充電を全消耗するダメージ量の強化が大きい火力型。精神消耗は覚醒30で: The Corrosion skill is a damage type with a big bonus from spending all Charge. Sanity cost is 30 for Awakening, or 45 with Overclock.
messages.Ⅲ: 充電による加重値の上限と回復量が増える。魔法少女、参上！がある間は詠唱が2: **Ⅲ**: Raises the Charge-based Attack Weight cap and the healing. While Here Comes Magical Girl! is active, Chant becomes 2 (the In the Name of Love and Hate Identity gains it at 0 or more SP).
messages.Ⅳ: 詠唱の対象人数が増え、充電の獲得量と回復量がさらに増える。: **Ⅳ**: Increases the number of Chant targets and further raises Charge gain and healing.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::愛と憎悪の名の下に: このE.G.Oの専用効果の対象にな: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: In the Name of Love and Hate](persona:0312)**: The Identity this E.G.O's dedicated effects target. Her Wrath and Envy skills also supply the required affinities.
messages.W社3級整理要員: 充電を獲得・消耗するスキルを持ち、詠唱の恩恵を受けやすく、憂: **[W Corp. L3 Cleanup Agent](persona:0302)**: Has skills that gain and spend Charge, benefits easily from Chant, and supplies Gloom and Envy resources.
messages.マッチ勝利で体力の低い味方を回復し、敗北してもバリアと与ダメージ増加で受ける、嫉: A multi-target ZAYIN E.G.O for Envy teams that heals low-HP allies on Clash Win and, even on Clash Lose, takes the hit with Shield and a damage bonus.
messages.勝利時の回復: マッチ勝利後の攻撃終了時に、体力割合の低い味方(2+嫉妬共鳴数÷: **Healing on win**: At the end of the attack after a Clash Win, heals the (2 + Envy Resonance ÷ 2) allies with the lowest HP ratios by 2% of their max HP (4% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 6% at Ⅳ) and restores 5 SP. Up to 3 targets (4 from Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.敗北時の保険: マッチ敗北時に(嫉妬共鳴数×5)のバリアを得て、メインターゲット: **Insurance on loss**: On Clash Lose, gains Shield of (Envy Resonance×5), and damage against the main target becomes +100% (150% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 200% at Ⅳ).
messages.破壊不能コイン: マッチ勝利後の的中時に次のターンの威力減少1を付与し、的中時に: **Unbreakable Coin**: On hit after a Clash Win, inflicts 1 Power Down next turn, and inflicts 4 Bleed on hit.
messages.パッシブ「此度はそなたが針を呑む番である…！」: 嫉妬スキルのダメージ量+10%: **Passive — 'Tis Thy Turn to Swallow the Needle!**: Envy skills deal +10% damage, plus +1% per Envy Resonance, up to 7%. Offense Level also rises based on accumulated HP damage, up to 3.
messages.嫉妬共鳴を最低でも4は作れる編成で使う。共鳴が低いと回復と人数が伸びない。: Use it in teams that can build at least 4 Envy Resonance. With low Resonance, the healing and number of targets stay small.
messages.回復は小さいが気軽に撃てるので、数を重ねて体力を維持する。: The healing is small, but it is easy to use, so use it repeatedly to keep HP up.
messages.憤怒の耐性が普通なので、憤怒攻撃が多い戦闘ではZAYINのラ・サングレ・デ・サン: Its Wrath resistance is Normal, so in fights with many Wrath attacks, equipping it instead of the ZAYIN La Sangre de Sancho (Fatal to Wrath) is an option.
messages.必要資源は嫉妬5、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: It requires 5 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20 for both Awakening and Corrosion.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放されるが、回復量は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive, but the healing is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量が2倍になり、精神力の回復対象も増える。バリアと与ダメージ量も上がり: **Ⅲ**: Doubles the healing and increases the SP recovery targets. Shield and damage dealt also rise, so it is likely worth taking at least this far.
messages.Ⅳ: バリア、与ダメージ量、回復量がさらに増える。: **Ⅳ**: Further increases Shield, damage dealt, and healing.
messages.中指末妹: 嫉妬スキルで資源と共鳴を作れ、パッシブ「怨恨の刺青」は味方が被ダメー: **[The Middle Little Sister](persona:0306)**: Her Envy skills build resources and Resonance, and her passive Vengeance Tattoo grows stronger the more damage allies take.
messages.ラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョ: 出血を扱う人格で、色欲のスキルを複数持ち、必要資源: **[La Sangre de Sancho](ego:0301)**: A Bleed Identity with several Lust skills who can supply the required Lust.
messages.ラ・サングレ・デ・サンチョ: ルミーズ(色欲)とサリュー!(傲慢)で、必要資源の: **[La Sangre de Sancho](ego:0301)**: Remise (Lust) and Salut! (Pride) supply both required Lust and Pride.
messages.水袋: 沈潜を付与し、色欲・傲慢・憂鬱のスキルで必要資源をすべて出せる。: **[Fluid Sac](ego:0302)**: Inflicts Sinking, and her Lust, Pride, and Gloom skills supply all of the required affinities.
messages.水袋: 破砕角(憂鬱)と突破(色欲)で必要資源の一部を出せ、突破と破砕角が沈潜も: **[Fluid Sac](ego:0302)**: Crushing Horns (Gloom) and Breakthrough (Lust) supply some of the required affinities, and both also inflict Sinking.
messages.電信柱: 切断・跳躍が充電を条件や獲得源にし、空間切断が充電10を消耗する。憂鬱: **[Telepole](ego:0303)**: Rip and Leap use Charge as a condition or source, and Rip Space spends 10 Charge. Her Gloom and Envy skills also supply resources.
messages.電信柱: 憤怒・嫉妬のスキルが多く、必要資源の憤怒・嫉妬を出せて嫉妬共鳴も組みや: **[Telepole](ego:0303)**: Has many Wrath and Envy skills, supplies the required Wrath and Envy, and makes Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.一生シチュー: 出血を扱い、色欲のスキルを複数持つので資源を出しやすい。: **[Lifetime Stew](ego:0304)**: Uses Bleed and has several Lust skills, making resources easy to supply.
messages.一生シチュー: 刺す(色欲)で色欲資源を出せ、束ね刺しと正義のため!が出血を付与: **[Lifetime Stew](ego:0304)**: Joust (Lust) supplies Lust resources, and Galloping Tilt and For Justice! inflict Bleed.
messages.願いの石: 出血を扱い、怠惰・憤怒のスキルで必要資源も出せる。: **[Wishing Cairn](ego:0305)**: Uses Bleed, and her Sloth and Wrath skills supply the required affinities.
messages.願いの石: 呼吸を扱う人格で、傲慢・怠惰のスキルから必要資源を出せ、パッシブの呼: **[Wishing Cairn](ego:0305)**: A Poise Identity whose Pride and Sloth skills supply the required affinities, and who meshes with the passive's Poise gain.
messages.電気哀鳴: 義理証明・倍返し(嫉妬)と正義の仕返し(傲慢)で必要資源を出せ、嫉妬: **[Electric Screaming](ego:0306)**: Proof of Loyalty and Multifold Retribution (Envy) plus A Just Vengeance (Pride) supply the required affinities and make Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.電気哀鳴: 嫉妬のスキルが多く、嫉妬共鳴を作りやすい。: **[Electric Screaming](ego:0306)**: Has many Envy skills, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.渇望-ミルカラ: 血餐を扱う人格で、出血を付与し、色欲のスキルで必要資源も出せる: **[Yearning-Mircalla](ego:0307)**: A Bloodfeast Identity who inflicts Bleed and supplies the required Lust with her Lust skills.
messages.渇望-ミルカラ: 刺す(色欲)・正義のため!(暴食)・束ね刺し(嫉妬)で必要資源: **[Yearning-Mircalla](ego:0307)**: Joust (Lust), For Justice! (Gluttony), and Galloping Tilt (Envy) supply the required affinities, and the latter two also inflict Bleed.
messages.紅籍: 破裂を扱い、暴食・色欲・憂鬱のスキルで必要資源を3種出せる。: **[Red Sheet](ego:0308)**: Uses Rupture, and her Gluttony, Lust, and Gloom skills supply three of the required affinities.
messages.紅籍: 暴食のスキルを2つ持ち、各スキルが破裂を付与する。: **[Red Sheet](ego:0308)**: Has 2 Gluttony skills, and each skill inflicts Rupture.
messages.愛と憎悪の名の下に: このE.G.Oの専用効果の対象になる人格。憤怒・嫉妬のスキ: **[In the Name of Love and Hate](ego:0309)**: The Identity this E.G.O's dedicated effects target. Her Wrath and Envy skills also supply the required affinities.
messages.愛と憎悪の名の下に: 充電を獲得・消耗するスキルを持ち、詠唱の恩恵を受けやすく、: **[In the Name of Love and Hate](ego:0309)**: Has skills that gain and spend Charge, benefits easily from Chant, and supplies Gloom and Envy resources.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「古き海の黒い糸（10章B）」: Blackthread of the Elden Sea (Canto X, Route B) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Reduce Tangling through defense and “Cleansing” to prevent “Abyssal Maw”'s reuse. Staggering a part ends the turn, after which the enemy hides in a Pool of Black Water. Remove the pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks concentrated on Pwie.
