messages.絡まりを守備や洗い流すで減らし、奈落の顎門の再使用を防ぐ戦闘。部位を混乱させると: Reduce Tangling through defense and “Cleansing” to prevent “Abyssal Maw”'s reuse. Staggering a part ends the turn, after which the enemy hides in a Pool of Black Water. Remove the pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks concentrated on Pwie.
messages.10章Bルート5Fの個体が対象。Lv65・基礎防御Lv67・速度1～2。HPは本: Covers the Route B, 5F encounter in Canto X. Lv. 65, base Defense Level 67, Speed 1–2. Listed HP is body 6,022 (6,691), each arm 1,989 (2,209), and torso 2,650 (2,944); whether the parenthesized values represent starting or maximum HP is unconfirmed. Stagger percentages and some threshold positions are also unconfirmed; do not reverse-calculate percentages. Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor are required; up to 12 Sinners can deploy. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level, and Identities below Uptie III are raised to III; E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged.
messages.全て減算コイン。パニック中は全コインが破壊不能になるため、マッチ勝利だけでは被弾: All Coins are negative. During Panic, every Coin becomes Unbreakable, so winning a clash cannot fully prevent hits. “Cleansing” is a Counter used by each part. Clumped Black Threads increases Clash Power on arm skills, but lowers it on the torso's “Thrashing of an Elden Being” and Tangling.
messages.初手とパニック中はプイへの攻撃を引き受ける。プイを狙ったままの追加威力に注意する: Intercept attacks on Pwie at the opening and during Panic. Watch for extra Power if Pwie remains the main target.
messages.絡まりは守備の使用や洗い流すで減らす。奈落は混乱中・絡まり20以上の囚人に受けさ: Reduce Tangling by using defense or “Cleansing”. Do not let Staggered Sinners or those with 20 or more Tangling receive “Abyssal Maw”.
messages.混乱後の黒い水たまりは、コイン数ではなく攻撃スキルの本数で解除を狙う。: Remove the post-Stagger Pool of Black Water with the number of Attack Skills, not Coin count.
messages.マッチに勝ったのに即死級の追撃が来た: A lethal follow-up occurred despite winning the clash
messages.奈落の顎門は、的中時に対象が混乱中か絡まり20以上なら再使用し、最大HP150%: On Hit, “Abyssal Maw” reuses its Coin if the target is Staggered or has at least 20 Tangling, dealing fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. During Panic, Unbreakable Coins remain after a clash win; choose a healthy recipient with little Tangling.
messages.プイへ攻撃が集中し、敵の威力も高い: Attacks focus on Pwie and the enemy's Power is high
messages.敵はパニックで開始し、パニック中は全ての対象をプイにする。プイがメインターゲット: The enemy starts Panicked and targets Pwie with every attack during Panic. Leaving Pwie as the main target increases Base and Clash Power. Intercept with Sinners, using clashes available regardless of Speed too.
messages.守備を選んだのに絡まりがすぐ減らない: Tangling did not immediately decrease after selecting defense
messages.絡まりは守備スキルの使用時に、現在数値の半分だけ減る（減少量切り捨て）。セットだ: Tangling decreases when a Defense Skill is used, removing half the current Stack, rounded down. Merely equipping defense does not instantly remove it. Ensure an opportunity to use defense, and use a clash with “Cleansing” to remove it all.
messages.混乱させたらターンが終わり、攻撃が通らなくなった: Stagger ended the turn and my attacks stopped dealing damage
messages.部位混乱で強制ターン終了し、次ターンに全部位が黒い水たまりを得る。被ダメージ−1: Staggering a part forcibly ends the turn, and all parts gain Pool of Black Water next turn. Its 100% damage reduction changes the usual approach of focusing damage during Stagger. Hit each part with Attack Skills to reduce pool Potency.
messages.多段攻撃を当てても水たまりがあまり減らない: A multi-hit attack barely reduced the pool
messages.水たまりの威力減少は被撃時にスキルごと1回。コイン数の多い1技より、当てるスキル: The pool loses Potency only once per skill when hit. Use multiple skills rather than one with many Coins. It also expires over time, but that grants Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn; prepare for the buff.
messages.貫通火力と絡まりを減らす守備を用意する: Prepare Pierce damage and defense to reduce Tangling
messages.顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に買い物を済ませる。固定出撃はイサン・ムルソー・: Finish shopping toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor are required. Prepare opportunities to use defense and HP recovery; do not rely on only one Sinner to receive “Abyssal Maw”.
messages.敵の全攻撃は打撃。打撃を受ける耐性を見て、攻める側は貫通1.2と、憤怒・色欲・暴: All enemy attacks are Blunt. Check Blunt resistance; offensively, use Pierce 1.2 and Wrath, Lust, Gluttony, and Pride 1.2. Slash and Blunt are 0.8; Gloom and Envy are 0.75.
messages.ムルソーは釘刺す者で、スキル使用時に同属性のE.G.O資源を追加で2個得る（1タ: He Who Nails lets Meursault gain 2 extra E.G.O resources matching a used skill's affinity, twice per turn. Its survival effect requires another ally alive at Turn Start, so protect the other Sinners too.
messages.プイへの攻撃を囚人へ引き受ける: Intercept attacks on Pwie with Sinners
messages.敵はパニックで戦闘開始し、その状態では全対象をプイに指定、全コインが破壊不能にな: The enemy starts Panicked. In that state, all targets are Pwie and all Coins become Unbreakable. Check each slot's target and clash with Sinners.
messages.メインターゲットがプイなら、パニック中はマッチ威力+6・基本威力+4。士気低下中: If Pwie is the main target during Panic, Clash Power +6 and Base Power +4. Low Morale also grants +3 and +2. Distinguish the prediction while Pwie is targeted from the values after redirecting to a Sinner.
messages.多くの技は速度に関係なくマッチ可能。奈落の顎門と、絡まり15以上を強制混乱させる: Many skills are clashable regardless of Speed. Assign recipients with few statuses to “Abyssal Maw” and attacks that forcibly Stagger targets with at least 15 Tangling.
messages.終了時にパニックなら精神力0へ戻るが、マッチ敗北で再び低下する。精神力を下げれば: Panic resets SP to 0 at Turn End, but clash losses can lower it again. Do not assume low SP means safety; check current Unbreakable Coins and targets every turn.
messages.毎ターン・絡まりが増えたとき: Each turn and when Tangling rises
messages.絡まりを減らし、危険な技の担当を替える: Reduce Tangling and rotate dangerous clashes
messages.絡まりは被ダメージを増やし、10ごとに基本威力−1、終了時の3ごとに翌ターンの束: Tangling increases damage taken, lowers Base Power by 1 per 10 Stack, and applies Bind next turn per 3 Stack at Turn End. Do not keep assigning strong clashes to a heavily affected Sinner.
messages.守備スキルを使用すると、その時点の絡まりの半分だけ減る（減少量切り捨て）。左腕の: Using a Defense Skill removes half the current Tangling, rounded down. The left arm's “Give It Back...” deals 90% less damage if the recipient has defense equipped, making it a useful opportunity to defend.
messages.洗い流すが出たら、絡まりを持つ囚人で勝てるマッチを取る。勝敗にかかわらず対象の絡: When “Cleansing” appears, take a winnable clash with a Sinner carrying Tangling. Their Tangling is fully removed regardless of the result. If you win, half that part's Blackstitch remains, rounded up.
messages.奈落は的中時に混乱中・絡まり20以上だと再使用し、再使用的中で最大HP150%の: “Abyssal Maw” reuses its Coin On Hit against Staggered targets or those with at least 20 Tangling; the reused hit deals fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. Do not rely solely on the post-clash removal of 10 Tangling; rotate to a less affected Sinner.
messages.一つの部位へ火力を集め、糸くずをためる: Focus one part and build Blackstitch
messages.本体の複数部位へ攻撃を散らさず、混乱を狙う部位へ火力を集める。腕は破壊後も追撃で: Focus damage on the part you want to Stagger rather than spreading attacks across parts. Arms can still be attacked after destruction. Some Stagger positions are unconfirmed; check the actual gauge too.
messages.被撃で敵のほつれ落ちる黒い糸くずが1増え、斬撃ならさらに1増える。数値分だけ被ダ: Each hit gives the enemy 1 Bursting Blackstitch, plus 1 more for Slash. It increases damage taken by Stack%, and grants 1 Fragile per 25 Stack at Turn Start. Slash is resisted at 0.8, so weigh Blackstitch buildup against direct damage.
messages.加重値5以上の技で攻撃すると、翌ターンに黒く固まった糸が増える（1ターン1回）。: A hit from a skill with at least 5 Atk Weight grants Clumped Black Threads next turn, once per turn. It increases damage taken but also raises part slot weight. Area attacks may not reach every part; check the target display.
messages.黒く固まった糸は腕のマッチ威力を上げ、胴体の古きものの身悶え・絡まりのマッチ威力: Clumped Black Threads raises arm Clash Power but lowers it on the torso's “Thrashing of an Elden Being” and Tangling. Check each part's modifier, and finish necessary healing before triggering Stagger.
messages.部位混乱・次ターン: Part Stagger and the next turn
messages.水たまりは攻撃スキルの本数で解除する: Clear pools with multiple Attack Skills
messages.どれかの部位が混乱すると、ほかの部位の混乱区間が1つずつ消え、即座にターンが終わ: When any part is Staggered, each other part loses one Stagger Threshold and the turn ends immediately. Do not plan on all remaining attacks or healing resolving.
messages.次ターンは全部位が黒い水たまりを得る。被ダメージ−100%・混乱しない状態で、一: All parts gain Pool of Black Water next turn. They take 100% less damage, cannot be Staggered, and deal 100% more unopposed damage. Keep clashing instead of ignoring attacks, and use spare skills to reduce pool Potency.
messages.水たまりは被撃で威力1減少、ただしスキルごと1回。各部位の残数を見て複数の攻撃ス: The pool loses 1 Potency when hit, once per skill. Check each part's remaining value and hit it with multiple Attack Skills. It also loses 1 Count at Turn End and expires when either Potency or Count reaches 0.
messages.被撃で解除した部位は糸くず10を得る。糸くずが上限を超えて増える場合は、このター: A part whose pool is removed by hits gains 10 Blackstitch. If the gain exceeds the Blackstitch cap, it also gains 3 Fragile this turn and next turn. If the pool expires over time, it gains Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn; check how it was removed.
messages.奈落の連打に備え、柔らかくなった部位を削る: Prepare for repeated Maws and damage the weakened parts
messages.水たまり解除後は捕食パターンに備える。胴体が奈落の顎門を4つ使うため、複数の囚人: Prepare for the predation pattern after pools expire. The torso uses four Abyssal Maws; divide clashes among multiple Sinners and avoid assigning Staggered recipients or those with at least 20 Tangling.
messages.古き捕食者の本能を持つ部位があると、1部位につき全部位のマッチ威力+2。さらに受: Each part with Instinct of the Predator of Eld grants +2 Clash Power to all parts. Damage also increases with the recipient's Tangling. After pools expire over time, prioritize strong clashes and Tangling control.
messages.糸くずの増えた部位は攻撃が通りやすい。水たまりが消えた後に強い技を集め、反撃の洗: Parts with more Blackstitch take more damage. Focus strong attacks after the pools disappear; when the “Cleansing” Counter appears, also use it to remove Tangling.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜によるダメージや混乱区間前進は50%減る。状態異常だ: Damage and Stagger Threshold rise from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 50%. Do not rely on statuses alone; finish with direct skill damage too.
messages.最大30。数値1につき被ダメージ+1%、10につき基本威力−1。終了時に数値3に: Maximum 30. Take +1% damage per Stack and lose 1 Base Power per 10 Stack. At Turn End, gain 1 Bind next turn per 3 Stack, up to 10. Using defense removes half the current Stack, with the amount removed rounded down.
messages.守備と洗い流すで減らし、強制混乱や奈落の再使用条件を避ける。: Reduce it with defense and “Cleansing” to avoid forced Stagger and “Abyssal Maw”'s reuse condition.
messages.威力最大6・回数最大2。被撃で威力1減少（スキルごと1回）、終了時に回数1減少。: Maximum 6 Potency and 2 Count. On Hit, lose 1 Potency, once per skill; at Turn End, lose 1 Count. Expires when either reaches 0. Cannot be Staggered, takes 100% less damage, and deals 100% more unopposed damage.
messages.コイン枚数ではなく、当てる攻撃スキルの本数で威力を削る。マッチも継続する。: Reduce Potency with multiple Attack Skills rather than Coin count. Keep clashing too.
messages.最大50。数値1につき被ダメージ+1%、開始時に25につき脆弱1。被撃や水たまり: Maximum 50. Damage taken +1% per Stack; gain 1 Fragile per 25 Stack at Turn Start. Increases from hits and pool removal. At 25 or more, the arms may replace Gloom skills with “Cleansing”; the torso uses “Cleansing” at 50 on certain actions.
messages.高い部位へ火力を集める。洗い流すへのマッチで囚人の絡まりも解除する。: Focus damage on parts with high Stack. Clashing with “Cleansing” also removes Sinners' Tangling.
messages.最大5。数値分だけ各部位のスロット加重値が増え、1につき被ダメージ+10%。腕の: Maximum 5. Increases each part's slot weight by Stack and damage taken by 10% per Stack. Raises Clash Power on several arm skills by Stack, but lowers it on the torso's “Thrashing of an Elden Being” and Tangling.
messages.加重値5以上の攻撃で増えるため、火力の利点と、広域の届く範囲・腕のマッチ威力を合: Gained from attacks with at least 5 Atk Weight. Weigh the damage benefit against area targeting coverage and increased arm Clash Power.
messages.古き捕食者の本能: Instinct of the Predator of Eld
messages.保有する部位1つにつき全部位のマッチ威力+2。受け手の絡まり3につき与ダメージ+: Each part with this effect grants all parts +2 Clash Power. Damage +5% per 3 Tangling on the recipient, up to 50%. Expires at Turn End. Gained next turn when a pool expires at Turn End.
messages.時間経過で解除した後は、絡まりの軽い囚人と強いマッチで捕食に対処する。: After pools expire over time, handle predation with strong clashes and Sinners carrying little Tangling.
messages.精神力−20以下では、プイへの技のマッチ威力+3・基本威力+2、被撃時に絡まり1: At −20 SP or lower, skills against Pwie gain +3 Clash Power and +2 Base Power; inflict 1 Tangling when hit, up to 3 times per skill. At −45 or lower, target Pwie with everything, make all Coins Unbreakable, increase those bonuses to +6 and +4, and inflict Tangling up to 6 times per skill.
messages.初手からパニックのためプイを狙う。囚人で攻撃を引き受け、低精神力を単なる弱体化と: Starts Panicked and targets Pwie. Intercept with Sinners; do not treat low SP as a simple debuff.
messages.資源補充と受け役に使い、ほかの囚人も生存させる。: Use him for resources and receiving attacks while keeping other Sinners alive.
messages.顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に準備する。: Prepare for Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank.
messages.パニック中はプイ狙い・全コイン破壊不能。マッチに勝っても攻撃が残ることを見込む。: During Panic, all attacks target Pwie and all Coins are Unbreakable. Expect attacks to remain after a clash win.
messages.奈落は混乱中または絡まり20以上への的中で再使用し、最大HP150%固定ダメージ: “Abyssal Maw” reuses On Hit against a Staggered target or one with at least 20 Tangling, dealing fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. Check the recipient's condition first.
messages.絡まりは守備の使用時に減る。セットしただけで即座に消えるわけではない。: Tangling decreases when defense is used, not immediately on equipping it.
messages.部位混乱で即座にターン終了。翌ターンの水たまりは通常の混乱中の火力集中とは分けて: Part Stagger immediately ends the turn. Handle next turn's pools differently from a normal Stagger damage opening.
messages.水たまりの威力減少はスキルごと1回。時間経過で消すと翌ターンに捕食者の強化が付く: Pool Potency decreases once per skill. Letting it expire over time grants the predator buff next turn.
messages.本体・部位HPの括弧値の対応と、混乱割合・一部位置は未確定。ゲージを確認し、数値: The meanings of parenthesized body and part HP, Stagger percentages, and some threshold positions remain unconfirmed. Check the gauge; do not build a fixed sequence from reverse-calculated numbers.
messages.顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に、固定のイサン・ムルソー・グレゴールも守備とH: Aim for Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Check defense and HP recovery on the required Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor too.
messages.貫通火力を中心に、憤怒・色欲・暴食・傲慢の攻撃を用意する。状態異常の効果は半減す: Build mainly around Pierce with Wrath, Lust, Gluttony, and Pride attacks. Status effects are halved, so value direct skill damage too.
messages.打撃耐性と、絡まりの軽い囚人へ役割を交代できる複数のマッチ役をそろえる。奈落に勝: Prepare Blunt resistance and multiple clash recipients who can rotate to Sinners with less Tangling. Avoid Maw's reuse condition as well as winning its clash.
messages.プイへの攻撃を引き受け、絡まりの多い囚人を休ませながら捕食の奈落4つへ対処する。: Intercept attacks on Pwie and handle four predation Maws while resting Sinners with high Tangling.
messages.部位へ集中する貫通火力と手数: Focused Pierce damage and repeated skills on parts
messages.糸くずをためて部位を削り、水たまり中は攻撃スキルの本数で解除を狙う。: Build Blackstitch to damage parts; use multiple Attack Skills to remove pools.
messages.絡まりを減らし、破壊不能で残る被害を戻す。混乱を取る前に必要な回復を行う。: Reduce Tangling and heal remaining Unbreakable damage. Finish necessary healing before triggering Stagger.
messages.HP括弧値の開始／最大との対応は未確認。: Whether parenthesized HP is starting or maximum HP is unconfirmed.
messages.部位混乱でターン終了し、翌ターンに全部位が水たまりを得る。: Part Stagger ends the turn; all parts gain pools next turn.
messages.古き海の黒い糸［左腕］: Blackthread of the Elden Sea [Left Arm]
messages.破壊後も追撃可能。HP括弧値の対応は未確認。: Can still be attacked after destruction. The meaning of parenthesized HP is unconfirmed.
messages.混乱割合・一部位置は未確定。実際のゲージも確認する。: Stagger percentages and some positions are unconfirmed. Check the actual gauge too.
messages.古き海の黒い糸［右腕］: Blackthread of the Elden Sea [Right Arm]
messages.対象が守備スキルを装着しているなら、ダメージ量-90%: If the target has a Defense Skill equipped, damage −90%
messages.自分の黒く固まった糸の数値1につき、マッチ威力+1: Clash Power +1 per Clumped Black Threads Stack on self
messages.[使用時]対象の絡まり5につき、基本威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 5 Tangling on the target (max 2)
messages.パニック時は全コイン破壊不能: All Coins become Unbreakable during Panic
messages.受け手が守備を装着していればダメージ−90%。絡まりが高い囚人は守備で受け、使用: Deals 90% less damage if the recipient has defense equipped. Have a Sinner with high Tangling defend to also reduce it when defense is used. Becomes Unbreakable during Panic.
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの絡まり3につき、マッチ威力+1(最大8): [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 3 Tangling on the main target (max 8)
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の絡まりが15以上なら、対象を混乱状態にする: [On Hit Without Breaking] If the target has at least 15 Tangling, Stagger them
messages.パニック時は全コイン破壊不能・速度に関係なくマッチ可能: During Panic, all Coins are Unbreakable; clashable regardless of Speed
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。受け手の絡まりでマッチ威力が最大8増す。絡まり15以上: Clashable regardless of Speed. The recipient's Tangling grants up to +8 Clash Power. At 15 or more Tangling, an unbroken second-Coin hit forcibly Staggers them; use a Sinner with little Tangling.
messages.奪わないで…。: Don't Take It Away From Me...
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの絡まり5につき、基本威力+1(最大2): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 5 Tangling on the main target (max 2)
messages.加重値3。メインターゲットの絡まりで基本威力が上がる。破裂回数と絡まりを増やされ: 3 Atk Weight. Base Power rises with the main target's Tangling. Clash with a less affected Sinner to prevent more Rupture Count and Tangling.
messages.[使用時]対象の絡まり3につき、マッチ威力+1(最大8): [On Use] Clash Power +1 per 3 Tangling on the target (max 8)
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。絡まり15以上への破壊されずに3枚目が的中すると強制混: Clashable regardless of Speed. An unbroken third-Coin hit forcibly Staggers a target with at least 15 Tangling. Coins subtract from Base Power 14; use 14 as the base maximum and check additional buffs.
messages.自分の黒く固まった糸の数値1につき、マッチ威力-1: Clash Power −1 per Clumped Black Threads Stack on self
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの絡まり3につき、基本威力+1(最大3): [On Use] Base Power +1 per 3 Tangling on the main target (max 3)
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの絡まりが15以上なら、基本威力+3: [On Use] If the main target has at least 15 Tangling, Base Power +3
messages.メインターゲットの絡まりで基本威力が増し、15以上ならさらに+3。黒く固まった糸: Base Power rises with the main target's Tangling, with another +3 at 15 or more. Clumped Black Threads lowers this skill's Clash Power. Win with a low-Tangling Sinner to also prevent forced Stagger.
messages.加重値3で、的中ごとに絡まり5を付ける。連続被弾で奈落の再使用条件へ近づくため、: 3 Atk Weight; each hit inflicts 5 Tangling. Repeated hits approach Maw's reuse threshold, so limit buildup through clashes and defense.
messages.[戦闘開始時]対象の絡まり2につき、基本威力+1、ダメージ量+10%: [Combat Start] Base Power +1 and damage +10% per 2 Tangling on the target
messages.Ⅰ[破壊されずに的中時]絡まり5を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Breaking] Inflict 5 Tangling
messages.[マッチ敗北後的中]対象の絡まり10を除去: [On Hit After Clash Lose] Remove 10 Tangling from the target
messages.[的中時]対象が混乱状態または対象の絡まりが20以上なら、このコインを再使用(ス: [On Hit] If the target is Staggered or has at least 20 Tangling, reuse this Coin (once per skill)
messages.[再使用的中時]対象の最大体力の150%だけ固定ダメージ: [On Reused Coin Hit] Deal fixed damage equal to 150% of the target's max HP
messages.最優先で受け手を選ぶ技。混乱中または絡まり20以上の対象へ的中すると再使用し、最: Prioritize choosing the recipient. On Hit against a Staggered target or one with at least 20 Tangling, reuses for fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. When Unbreakable Coins remain after winning, choose someone who does not meet the reuse condition.
messages.[使用時]対象の絡まり2につき、基本威力+1: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 2 Tangling on the target
messages.[マッチ勝利時]対象の絡まりを全て除去し、このスキルを使用した部位のほつれ落ちる: [Clash Win] Remove all Tangling from the target and all Bursting Blackstitch from the part using this skill
messages.[マッチ敗北]対象の絡まりを全て除去し、このスキルを使用した部位のほつれ落ちる黒: [Clash Lose] Remove all Tangling from the target and halve Bursting Blackstitch on the part using this skill (rounded up)
messages.パニック時は全コイン破壊不能・マッチ可能反撃: During Panic, all Coins are Unbreakable; Clashable Counter
messages.マッチ可能反撃。勝っても負けても受け手の絡まりが全て消える。こちらが勝つと、この: Clashable Counter. The recipient loses all Tangling whether you win or lose. If you win, that part's Blackstitch is halved, rounded up. Take a winnable clash with a Sinner carrying Tangling to cleanse it while limiting damage.
messages.ステージ開始時、パニック状態で戦闘を開始\n\nパニック状態のとき、以下の効果を:
At Stage Start, begin Panicked.

During Panic:
- Set all attack targets to Pwie.
- On Skill Use, gain Clash Power and Base Power if Pwie is the main target.
- At Combat Start, change all skill Coins to Unbreakable Coins.
messages.初手はプイを狙い、全技が破壊不能になる。囚人で攻撃を引き受け、プイをメインターゲ: Initially targets Pwie and makes all skills Unbreakable. Intercept with Sinners to avoid the extra Power from keeping Pwie as the main target.
messages.スキルと士気低下・パニック効果で敵に絡まりを付与\n※絡まりは守備スキルの使用、:
Skills, Low Morale, and Panic inflict Tangling on enemies.
Tangling can be reduced by using Defense Skills or specific skills.

When hit:
- Gain 1 Bursting Blackstitch.
- If hit by a Slash skill, gain 1 additional Bursting Blackstitch.
- If hit by a skill with at least 5 Atk Weight, gain 1 Clumped Black Threads next turn (once per turn).
messages.被撃・斬撃被撃・加重値5以上の被撃: When hit, hit by Slash, or hit by at least 5 Atk Weight
messages.攻撃して糸くずをためると敵が柔らかくなる。加重値5以上の技では黒く固まった糸も増: Attacks build Blackstitch and make the enemy easier to damage. Skills with at least 5 Atk Weight also build Clumped Black Threads, changing arm Clash Power and slot weight.
messages.部位が\n混乱状態になると、他の部位の混乱区間を1つずつ除去し、ターンを終了\n:
When a part becomes Staggered, remove one Stagger Threshold from each other part and end the turn. All parts then gain Pool of Black Water next turn.

If a pool is removed by a hit:
- Gain 10 Bursting Blackstitch.
- If Blackstitch is gained beyond its maximum, gain 3 Fragile this turn and next turn.

If a pool expires at Turn End:
- Gain Bursting Blackstitch equal to (7 − remaining Potency).
- Gain 1 Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn.
messages.混乱で即座にターンが終わるため、残った攻撃や回復を当てにしない。翌ターンの水たま: Stagger ends the turn immediately; do not count on remaining attacks or healing. Reduce next turn's pools with multiple skills and prepare for predation after removal.
messages.火傷、出血、振動、破裂、沈潜による体力・精神力・混乱区間前進量-50%\n\nパ:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold rise from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −50%.

Panic type cannot change. If Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 0.
messages.継続中・終了時にパニック: Throughout combat; Panicked at Turn End
messages.主要な状態異常のダメージ・混乱区間前進が半減する。スキル自体の火力を用意し、パニ: Major status damage and Stagger Threshold rise are halved. Bring direct skill damage and check the all-Unbreakable Coins during Panic.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 赤き神［完熟］（10章C）の攻略｜Limbus Assi: 10-04 The Crimson God [Adulthood] (Canto X, Route C) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「赤き神［完熟］（10章C）」: The Crimson God [Adulthood] (Canto X, Route C) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. Besides reducing HP to zero, you can finish by winning clashes against specific major skills and building Pwie's Memories to 5. This guide focuses on that route. Check Bleed and L'Abject when assigning clashes each turn, and preserve Sinners with Shared with Pwie for the final phase.
messages.10-04 赤き神［完熟］（10章C）: 10-04 The Crimson God [Adulthood] (Canto X, Route C)
messages.赤き神［完熟］（10章C）: The Crimson God [Adulthood] (Canto X, Route C)
messages.HPを削り切るほか、特定の大技へマッチで勝ち、プイの記憶を5までためて終える方法: Besides reducing HP to zero, you can finish by winning clashes against specific major skills and building Pwie's Memories to 5. This guide focuses on that route. Check Bleed and L'Abject when assigning clashes each turn, and preserve Sinners with Shared with Pwie for the final phase.
messages.Cルートの影界戦。本体の最大HPは6000だが、HP3000から開始する。敵Lv: A Route C dungeon battle. The body has 6,000 max HP but starts at 3,000 HP. Enemy Lv. 90 is separate from the recommended Customer Lv. 65. Body Defense Level 92 and staff Defense Level 69 exclude Memories, Pulsation, and other modifiers. The body's Stagger Thresholds are unconfirmed; staff have a threshold listed at 74 HP, but its percentage is unconfirmed. Identity levels follow Customer Level; outside Identity levels do not carry in. Identities below Uptie III are raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. This is a different battle from Route A's Crimson God [Inchoate Life].
messages.ラ・ジュイサンスは第1・第2段階で効果が異なるため別タブにした。破壊不能アイコン: La Jouissance has different effects in Phases 1 and 2, so it has separate tabs. Coin icons show only always-Unbreakable Coins; check effects for conversion based on Bleed, Rampage, Memories, or HP. The staff skill “With sickles mine I answer your calling!” lists one Coin but has unconfirmed effect Coin numbering; no extra Coins have been invented to fill the gap.
messages.毎ターン、出血持ちで色欲技を受け、ラブジェクトを付ける怠惰技には強いマッチを当て: Each turn, use Sinners with Bleed against Lust skills and strong clashes against Sloth skills that apply L'Abject.
messages.第2段階はスタッフを先に処理。本体を削りすぎず、プイの記憶3で終盤へ進む。: In Phase 2, eliminate staff first. Avoid excessive body damage and enter the final phase at 3 Pwie's Memories.
messages.終盤用の経験持ちを残し、ラ・カストラシオンへ勝つ。記憶5の後も、もう一度マッチに: Preserve a Shared with Pwie holder for the end and win against La Castration. After reaching 5 Memories, win one more clash.
messages.デガジェとル・ポワン・ドゥ・キャピトンは、対象に出血がないと破壊不能になる。出血: “Dégagé” and “Le Point de Capiton” become Unbreakable if the target lacks Bleed. Win with a Sinner carrying Bleed to stop the attack. Sinners with L'Abject gain Bleed Count simply by using basic attacks; choose E.G.O or defense instead.
messages.一度の被弾から広域が続いて壊滅する: One hit starts repeated area attacks and wipes the team
messages.第2段階以降は攻撃終了時、主対象のラブジェクトが5以上だと追撃が来る。終盤の傲慢: From Phase 2, a follow-up triggers After Attack if the main target has at least 5 L'Abject. The final phase's Pride skill applies 2 L'Abject even after a clash win, so switch its main target to a Sinner with 2 or less. The follow-up itself is Unclashable, cannot be redirected, and does not activate defense.
messages.スタッフが予測より強く、倒し切れない: Staff are stronger than predicted and I cannot finish them
messages.本体の支援がスタッフのHPを半減させ、攻撃レベル+5と暴走を与える。HPが減った: The body's support halves staff HP and gives them +5 Offense Level and Rampage. Even at low HP they take 50% less damage and can strengthen beyond the initial clash prediction. Focus area damage on their arrival turn and kill them before their Wrath skills.
messages.後半の大技に勝てない: I cannot win the late major clashes
messages.プイとの経験を失った囚人では、大技のコイン威力−3を使えない。序盤のラ・ジュイサ: Sinners who lost Shared with Pwie cannot trigger −3 Coin Power on the major skill. Early La Jouissance converts the recipient's Shared with Pwie into Decision, and the Pride skill also removes it from the main target. Do not rotate everyone through these attacks; preserve holders for the end.
messages.記憶が5になったのに終わらない: Memories reached 5 but the fight did not end
messages.5になると敵が暴食技1つの行動へ変わる。その技にも経験持ちでマッチ勝利する。さら: At 5, the enemy changes to a single Gluttony skill. Win that clash with a Shared with Pwie holder too. The following turn, it stops resisting; victory occurs at that turn's end. Do not simply defend and wait immediately upon reaching 5.
messages.顧客Lv65と、大技に使う資源をそろえる: Prepare Customer Lv. 65 and resources for major clashes
messages.買い物を進め、顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安にする。外での経験値稼ぎより、店や: Shop toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Check missed shops and vending machines rather than farming experience outside. Use the available deployment slots and keep survivors alive until the end.
messages.高威力E.G.O、攻撃レベルや威力を下げる手段、スタッフをまとめて削る広域、HP: Prepare high-Power E.G.O, Offense Level or Power debuffs, area damage for staff, HP recovery, and Shields. Do not assume a clash is winnable based only on its maximum before modifiers.
messages.象徴界ではダッシュ・回避で攻撃を避け、つかまれたら攻撃を連打して抜ける。HPが厳: In the preceding encounter, dash or evade attacks and repeatedly attack to escape grabs. If HP is low, retreat and kill replenishing minor enemies to heal. Reducing the body to 3,000 HP starts the dungeon battle.
messages.ムルソーの釘刺す者は速度補助と、使用スキルと同属性のE.G.O資源+2（1ターン: Meursault's He Who Nails provides Speed support and +2 E.G.O resources matching a used skill's affinity, twice per turn. This battle also grants him +3 Final Power. Use him for resources and early Memory-gaining clashes.
messages.出血・ラブジェクト・残す経験持ちを確認する: Check Bleed, L'Abject, and the Shared with Pwie holders to preserve
messages.最初に囚人の出血とラブジェクト、プイとの経験を確認する。ラブジェクト持ちで通常攻: First check Sinners' Bleed, L'Abject, and Shared with Pwie. Avoid repeated basic attacks with L'Abject; switch to E.G.O or defense. This prevents basic attacks from increasing Bleed Count, but does not remove existing Bleed.
messages.次に、ラブジェクトを付ける怠惰技へ強いマッチを割り当てる。デガジェとル・ポワン・: Next, assign strong clashes to Sloth skills that apply L'Abject. Win against “Dégagé” and “Le Point de Capiton” with Sinners carrying Bleed.
messages.3枠の色欲技ジュ・メクスピュルスは出血を付けるが、ラブジェクトは付けない。強い技: The three Lust slots using “Je m'expulse” apply Bleed but not L'Abject. If strong skills are limited, prioritize L'Abject-building attacks and Memory-gaining clashes first.
messages.最後に余った攻撃をスタッフへ集める。反撃があるときは追加攻撃・追撃で先に触れない: Finally, focus spare attacks on staff. When a Counter is present, check whether extra attacks or follow-ups might trigger it early. Do not resolve everything through repeated basic attacks or auto-selection.
messages.第1段階・開始から最初の記憶獲得まで: Phase 1: opening through the first Memory
messages.怠惰技を止め、最初の記憶を取る: Stop Sloth skills and gain the first Memory
messages.開始直後は敵Lv90との差が大きい。まず怠惰技への勝利を優先し、厳しいマッチには: The opening level gap to enemy Lv. 90 is large. Prioritize winning Sloth clashes and use E.G.O for difficult ones. In Phases 1 and 2, using a skill against a Shared with Pwie holder lowers the enemy's SP by 10, so later attacks face different conditions.
messages.通常進行では2ターン目にマッチ可能反撃を構える。勝てる担当で受け、3枚目の効果で: In the normal sequence, it prepares a Clashable Counter on turn 2. Use a recipient who can win; the third Coin consumes everyone's L'Abject. The Counter is Unbreakable, so expect hits after winning too.
messages.通常進行の3ターン目はラ・ジュイサンス。経験持ちなら敵の精神力−20・コイン威力: Turn 3 in the normal sequence brings La Jouissance. Shared with Pwie lowers enemy SP by 20 and Coin Power by 3. Clashable regardless of Speed; winning increases Pwie's Memories.
messages.担当の経験は攻撃後に決断へ変わり、被ダメージ75%減少を失う。ムルソーなど序盤の: After the attack, the recipient's Shared with Pwie becomes Decision, losing 75% damage reduction. Assign an early recipient such as Meursault and preserve other holders for the end. The next Gluttony skill heals the body and staff join the battle.
messages.取り巻きを先に倒し、記憶3まで進める: Eliminate adds first and reach 3 Memories
messages.スタッフを登場ターンに広域で削り切る。翌ターン以降の憤怒技は、脈動・出血・攻撃レ: Finish staff with area damage on their arrival turn. From the following turn, their Wrath skill becomes extremely strong through Pulsation, Bleed, and increased Offense Level. Clear them while still covering the body's Sloth and Lust clashes.
messages.本体は混乱したスタッフを回復して起こす。スタッフの混乱だけを見て放置せず、そのタ: The body heals Staggered staff and removes their Stagger. Do not leave them merely because they are Staggered; prioritize killing them that turn. Dead staff become flesh with Voice of the Crimson God and later return, so prepare for reappearance.
messages.第2段階のラ・ジュイサンスは、スタッフ1人につき精神力+15・マッチ威力+2。全: Phase 2 La Jouissance heals 15 SP and gains +2 Clash Power per staff member. If all are dead, Clash Power −3. Kill staff with fast attackers before winning this major clash with a slower recipient.
messages.本体HP25%未満、または記憶3で第3段階へ移る。記憶をためる方針ではスタッフへ: Below 25% body HP or at 3 Memories, Phase 3 begins. When pursuing Memories, direct damage at staff and avoid reducing the body too far before gaining enough Memories. At transition, the body heals and removes negative effects.
messages.傲慢技の担当を選び、暴食技で記憶を増やす: Choose Pride recipients and gain Memories through Gluttony
messages.本体だけとの戦いになり、マッチ可能反撃を使うターンとラ・カストラシオンを使うター: Only the body remains, alternating between Clashable Counter turns and La Castration turns. The early SP loss from targeting Shared with Pwie holders no longer applies.
messages.終盤の傲慢技ル・ノン・デュペールは暴走中に全コイン破壊不能。主対象はラブジェクト: The final Pride skill Le Nom-du-Père has all-Unbreakable Coins during Rampage. Choose a main target with 2 or less L'Abject and win with a strong skill. The remaining On Hit +2 must not reach the follow-up threshold of 5. Losing adds more, so 2 or less is not permission to ignore the clash.
messages.経験持ちが傲慢技を受けると加重値を5から3へ減らせるが、その経験を失う。次のラ・: A Shared with Pwie main target lowers Atk Weight from 5 to 3, but loses that effect afterward. Check surviving holders before sacrificing one so you retain a La Castration recipient.
messages.反撃は全員のラブジェクトを消す機会。傲慢技の後に処理できれば蓄積を落とせるが、追: The Counter can remove everyone's L'Abject. Resolving it after the Pride skill can clear buildup, but check action order so an extra attack does not trigger it early. Clash with a high-Power skill and win for 80% reduction.
messages.ラ・カストラシオンは経験持ちが担当するとコイン威力−3。4枚なので素の最大27か: A Shared with Pwie recipient gives La Castration −3 Coin Power. Across four Coins, its base maximum falls from 27 to 15, but Bleed, Pulsation, and level-gap modifiers still apply. Clash regardless of Speed and win for +1 Memory and 95% reduction. It does not convert Shared with Pwie into Decision, so the same holder can handle it repeatedly.
messages.変化後の大技へもう一度勝ち、次ターンの終了を待つ: Win the changed major clash once more, then wait until next Turn End
messages.記憶5ではまだ戦闘終了にならない。次は敵が暴食技1つだけを構えるので、残した経験: 5 Memories does not immediately end combat. The enemy next prepares only one Gluttony skill; win with a preserved Shared with Pwie holder. The all-Unbreakable conversion that applies below 5 Memories also stops.
messages.その次のターンは抵抗をやめる。HPを0へ削る必要はなく、そのターンの終了で勝利と: On the following turn, it stops resisting. You do not need to reduce HP to 0; victory comes at Turn End. Losing every Shared with Pwie holder just before this makes the final clash harder, so protect them until the end.
messages.全体が崩れた場合はコンティニューも選べ、使用してもEXクリアは可能。再挑戦するな: If the team collapses, Continue is an option and still allows an EX clear. When retrying, identify which attack brought a Sinner to 5 L'Abject.
messages.開始時、控えを含む囚人が得る。速度最小・最大+3、赤き神［完熟］からの最終被ダメ: Granted at Stage Start to Sinners, including reserves. Minimum and maximum Speed +3, final damage taken from the Crimson God [Adulthood] −75%, and heal 15 SP at Turn Start. Also weakens certain major skills.
messages.傲慢技で消され、ラ・ジュイサンスでは決断へ変わる。終盤用の所持者を複数残す。: Removed by the Pride skill and converted to Decision by La Jouissance. Preserve multiple holders for the end.
messages.最大5。本体が持ち、数値1につき基本攻撃・防御レベル−5、マッチ威力−1。ターン: Maximum 5. Held by the body. Base Offense and Defense Levels −5 and Clash Power −1 per Stack. At Turn Start, heal SP equal to Stack ×8. Gained by winning clashes against specific major skills.
messages.記憶3で第3段階へ進み、5の後に変化した大技へ勝って決着する。精神力回復もあるた: 3 Memories advances to Phase 3. After 5, win the changed major clash to finish. Its SP recovery means level reductions alone do not render it harmless.
messages.経験から変わる効果。赤き神［完熟］への与ダメージ+30%、ターン開始時に精神力1: Replaces Shared with Pwie. Damage to the Crimson God [Adulthood] +30%; heal 15 SP at Turn Start. Does not retain Shared with Pwie's 75% damage reduction or Speed support.
messages.火力は上がるが生存力は下がる。序盤の担当を固定し、全員の経験を順番に失わせない。: Damage rises, but survival falls. Fix early recipients rather than having everyone lose Shared with Pwie in turn.
messages.最大5。数値1につき速度−1・出血による被ダメージ+20%。基本攻撃スキルを使う: Maximum 5. Speed −1 and Bleed damage taken +20% per Stack. Using a basic Attack Skill increases own Bleed Count by Stack. From Phase 2, if the main target has at least 5 After Attack, a powerful follow-up triggers once per turn.
messages.通常攻撃の代わりにE.G.O・守備を使う。破壊不能の的中で増える分も数え、追撃の: Use E.G.O or defense instead of basic attacks. Count application from remaining Unbreakable hits too, and manage it before the follow-up.
messages.本体は出血ダメージが発生すると回数を得て、回数の累計10消耗ごとに威力が増す。威: The body gains Count whenever Bleed damage occurs and gains Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. At 2 Potency, Final Power +1; at 3, Bleed Potency inflicted +1; at 4, Coin Power +1; at 5, Rampage no longer decreases.
messages.バリアで囚人の出血によるHPダメージを防ぐことは、敵の成長を抑える助けにもなる。: Shields preventing HP damage from Sinners' Bleed also help limit enemy growth. Applying Bleed to the body likewise increases its Pulsation.
messages.暴走［ル・デジール］は最大3。速度最小・最大+1、出血被ダメージ−50%、出血ダ: Uncontrollable Rampage [Le Désir] has a maximum of 3. Minimum and maximum Speed +1, Bleed damage taken −50%, and cannot die from Bleed damage. Normally loses 1 at Turn End, but the body's 5 Pulsation Potency stops this. Also affects the Pride skill's all-Unbreakable conversion and staff damage reduction.
messages.自然解除を待つだけでは終わらない。本体の記憶獲得とスタッフの先制処理を進める。: Waiting for natural expiry is not enough. Keep gaining the body's Memories and eliminating staff before they act.
messages.死亡したスタッフは、声3を持つHP150の赤き神の引きちぎられた肉片として戻る。: Dead staff return as Ripped Flesh of the Crimson God with 150 HP and 3 Voice. Voice loses 1 each turn and prevents death while present. On expiry, returns to staff form and gains SP recovery and Pulsation Count based on remaining HP.
messages.肉片を何度も攻撃して完全に消そうとせず、スタッフへ戻るタイミングに広域火力を用意: Do not repeatedly attack flesh expecting to erase it permanently. Prepare area damage for its return to staff form.
In this battle, Meursault gains +3 minimum and maximum Speed, +3 Final Power, and +2 matching-affinity E.G.O resources on skill use, twice per turn; cannot retreat. If another ally is alive at Turn Start, he also cannot die that turn.
messages.序盤の記憶獲得技と資源補充に使う。ほかの囚人がいなくなっても無条件で生存できるわ: Use him for early Memory-gaining clashes and resources. Survival is not unconditional when no other Sinners remain.
messages.第1・2段階で記憶を増やす憤怒の大技。3枚破壊不能。第1段階は経験で弱体化し、第: A Wrath major skill that gains Memories in Phases 1 and 2. Three Unbreakable Coins. Shared with Pwie weakens it in Phase 1; surviving staff strengthen it in Phase 2. Converts the main target's Shared with Pwie into Decision.
messages.段階ごとの別タブを確認し、スタッフ処理と終盤用の経験の温存を両立する。: Check the separate phase tabs and balance staff cleanup with preserving Shared with Pwie holders for the end.
messages.第3段階の記憶獲得技。経験持ちでコイン威力−3、マッチ勝利で記憶+1・ダメージ9: Phase 3 Memory-gaining skill. Shared with Pwie gives −3 Coin Power; a clash win grants +1 Memory and 95% damage reduction. Its damage cannot Stagger the target.
messages.残した経験持ちで繰り返し勝つ。記憶5になった後の、最後の1回も忘れない。: Win repeatedly with a preserved holder. Do not forget the final extra clash after reaching 5 Memories.
messages.傲慢の広域。経験持ちを主対象にすると加重値−2だが、攻撃後にその経験を失う。暴走: Pride area skill. A Shared with Pwie main target gives Atk Weight −2, but loses the effect After Attack. All Coins become Unbreakable during Rampage; 2 L'Abject can remain after winning.
messages.ラブジェクト2以下の囚人で受け、経験持ちの残数も管理する。: Receive with a Sinner at 2 or less L'Abject and track remaining Shared with Pwie holders too.
messages.全3枚破壊不能のマッチ可能反撃。全員のラブジェクトを消耗するが、その量に応じて追: Clashable Counter with three Unbreakable Coins. Consumes everyone's L'Abject, but its amount increases extra damage and Bleed Count.
messages.高威力担当で勝って80%軽減を取る。弱い追撃で先に反撃を発動させない。: Win with a high-Power recipient for 80% reduction. Do not trigger it early with a weak follow-up.
messages.プイの記憶5で即勝利ではない。変化後の大技への勝利と、さらに次ターンの終了が必要: 5 Pwie's Memories is not immediate victory. Win the changed major clash, then reach the following Turn End.
messages.プイとの経験とプイの記憶は別。前者は囚人の防御・大技弱体化、後者は本体の蓄積と勝: Shared with Pwie and Pwie's Memories are different. The former protects Sinners and weakens major skills; the latter accumulates on the body and affects victory conditions.
messages.ラブジェクトによる追撃は攻撃終了時の判定で、1ターン1回。マッチ開始時の数値だけ: L'Abject's follow-up is checked After Attack and triggers once per turn. The value at clash start alone does not guarantee safety.
messages.経験を失うと被ダメージ75%減少も失う。精神力回復が残る決断を、経験と同じ防御効: Losing Shared with Pwie also loses 75% damage reduction. Decision retains SP recovery but does not provide the same defense.
messages.スタッフは本体の支援で混乱解除・強化され、死亡後も復帰する。混乱だけで放置しない: The body removes staff Stagger and strengthens them, and they return after death. Do not leave them merely Staggered.
messages.ムルソーの生存効果はほかの味方がいる条件付き。最後の1人で全て受け切る前提にしな: Meursault's survival requires another ally. Do not plan to take every attack with him as the last survivor.
messages.顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に買い物を進める。外の人格レベルや、Aルートの顧: Shop toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Do not reuse outside Identity levels or Route A's Customer Lv. 35 as the benchmark.
messages.ムルソーを含め、経験持ちの生存者を多く残せる編成にする。大技に勝つE.G.Oと、: Bring Meursault and enough survivors to preserve several Shared with Pwie holders. Prepare E.G.O for major clashes and area attacks to focus damage on three staff.
messages.HP回復・バリアと敵への攻撃レベル低下を組み合わせる。出血の蓄積と高い攻撃レベル: Combine HP recovery and Shields with enemy Offense Level debuffs. Bleed buildup and the large Offense Level gap make an Evade-only approach unreliable.
messages.不足しやすいE.G.O資源は直前の影界戦で補充できる。コンティニューを使ってもE: Replenish scarce E.G.O resources in the preceding dungeon battle. Continue still allows an EX clear, so consider it if clearing is the priority.
messages.終盤まで経験を残す高威力マッチ役: High-Power clash recipients who retain Shared with Pwie until the end
messages.ラ・カストラシオンのコイン威力−3を使い、記憶をためる。傲慢技と序盤の決断役を全: Use La Castration's −3 Coin Power condition to gain Memories. Do not assign every Pride skill and early Decision conversion to those same recipients.
messages.広域火力でスタッフを先に倒す役: Area damage to eliminate staff before they act
messages.本体の保護と大技の強化を減らし、危険な憤怒技を使わせる前に処理する。: Reduce the body's Protection and major-skill buffs, killing staff before their dangerous Wrath attacks.
messages.敵Lv90と脈動強化を見込み、高威力技へ勝つ確率を上げる。: Account for enemy Lv. 90 and Pulsation buffs to improve the chance of winning high-Power clashes.
messages.HP回復・バリアと資源補充: HP recovery, Shields, and resource generation
messages.破壊不能の被弾と出血から立て直し、重要なマッチへE.G.Oを回す。ムルソーの追加: Recover from Unbreakable hits and Bleed and use E.G.O for key clashes. Exploit Meursault's extra resources too.

messages.戦場に赤き神［完熟］がいれば、ターン終了時に自分の脈動回数が減少しない\n\n被:
While the Crimson God [Adulthood] is on the field, Pulsation Count does not decrease at Turn End.

If Staggered by a hit and then relieved of Stagger by the Crimson God's skill, attack the attacker unopposed with “With sickles mine I answer your calling!”

Breath and pulse do not stop. Even wanting them to stop cannot stop them.
messages.全段階／本体生存中・混乱解除後: All phases: body alive and after Stagger removal
messages.本体の救援で混乱が解けると一方攻撃が来る。スタッフの混乱を安全な休止と考えない。: When the body's rescue removes Stagger, an unopposed attack follows. Do not treat staff Stagger as a safe pause.
messages.【リンバス】10-04 看守・司祭（10章C）の攻略｜Limbus Assist: 10-04 The Warden and the Chaplain (Canto X, Route C) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)10-04「看守・司祭（10章C）」の攻: The Warden and the Chaplain (Canto X, Route C) guide for Limbus Company 10-04. A long battle progressing from the Warden to the Chaplain. Destroy the candles first, then assign major clashes according to each turn's Stillness and Thumping Pulse. Against the Chaplain, avoid selecting Attack Skills pierced by nails. Let Meursault handle the final Shift + Delete while keeping other survivors alive.
messages.10-04 看守・司祭（10章C）: 10-04 The Warden and the Chaplain (Canto X, Route C)
messages.10-04「Sisyphus Department Store C: FATE: 10-04 · Sisyphus Department Store C: FATE LOST
messages.看守・司祭（10章C）: The Warden and the Chaplain (Canto X, Route C)
messages.看守から司祭へ続く長期戦。序盤は燭台を先に壊し、その後は毎ターン付く停止と鼓動に: A long battle progressing from the Warden to the Chaplain. Destroy the candles first, then assign major clashes according to each turn's Stillness and Thumping Pulse. Against the Chaplain, avoid selecting Attack Skills pierced by nails. Let Meursault handle the final Shift + Delete while keeping other survivors alive.
messages.Cルートの専用戦闘。本体は全段階Lv90・最大HP3660、基礎防御80。第1段: A special Route C battle. The body is Lv. 90 in every phase, with 3,660 max HP and base Defense Level 80. Phase 1 starts at 1,830 HP and 30 SP; transition to Phase 2 fully heals it. At 1 HP in Phase 2, it becomes the Chaplain and fully heals again. Phase 2 Stagger positions are unconfirmed. Candles are Lv. 1 with 59 HP and Defense Level 1. Each body slot has 2 slot weight. Aim for Customer Lv. 65, separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.
messages.同名の技も段階ごとに数値・効果が違う。第1段階「悔い改めよ」と第2段階「刑罰を受: Skills sharing a name have different values and effects across phases. Displayed Power for Phase 1 “Atone.” and Phase 2 “Receive thy punishment.” is unconfirmed. Unbreakable conversion from Divinity of the Obsidian God is conditional and is not added to fixed Coin icons. Excision Coins are shown through labels and effects. The Chaplain's collective nail notation “~” is shown alongside Implements of Confession.
messages.第1段階は速い囚人で燭台を全破壊。看守には速度2以上の担当でマッチを取る。: In Phase 1, destroy all candles with fast Sinners. Assign a Sinner with at least 2 Speed to clash with the Warden.
messages.大広域は停止、次の死刑執行・強制退場は鼓動持ちでマッチに勝つ。: Win the major area clash with Stillness, then “Death Unto the Condemned” or “Systemwide Ban” with Thumping Pulse.
messages.司祭には手動でスキルを選ぶ。終盤はムルソーでShift + Deleteを受け、: Choose skills manually against the Chaplain. Have Meursault take Shift + Delete at the end and keep other allies alive.
messages.序盤から全員の速度が1になった: Everyone's Speed fell to 1 early on
messages.燭台を残すと、1つごとに次ターンの全員へ束縛2が付く。速い囚人で燭台を全て先に壊: Each surviving candle applies 2 Bind to everyone next turn. Use fast Sinners to destroy all candles before clashing with the Warden. A main target at 1 Speed greatly strengthens him; do not simply choose your slowest Sinner.
messages.大技の要求威力が高すぎる: The major clash requires far too much Power
messages.停止持ちなら第2・3段階の大広域の最終威力−5・マッチ威力−5が働く。まず担当を: Stillness gives the Phase 2 and 3 major area skills −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power. Change the recipient first. You can also make Voice B's Sloth skill act after the normal skills to consume all Preservation Count, but this does not work if Count is replenished at the next Turn Start.
messages.死刑執行・強制退場に勝ったのに死亡する: I won against “Death Unto the Condemned” or “Systemwide Ban” but still died
messages.どちらも勝ってもコインが残り、最大HP200%の固定ダメージを与える。鼓動持ちで: Both retain a Coin after losing the clash and deal fixed damage equal to 200% max HP. Winning with Thumping Pulse grants a temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP to absorb it. An ordinary Sinner winning through high Power alone is insufficient.
messages.スキルを選んだだけでダメージと釘が付く: Selecting a skill caused damage and nails
messages.第3段階では、パネル上で釘が刺さった攻撃スキルを装着するとペナルティがある。勝率: In Phase 3, equipping an Attack Skill pierced by a nail on the panel incurs a penalty. Avoid Win Rate and Damage auto-selection; choose an unpierced skill, or change it to defense or E.G.O before equipping it. Changing an equipped skill back to its original attack triggers the penalty again.
messages.HPを半分削ったのに全回復した: I removed half his HP but he fully healed
messages.司祭は最初にHP50%未満へ落とすと全快・弱体解除する。もう一度半分まで削った際: The first time the Chaplain falls below 50% HP, he fully heals and removes negative effects. After reducing him to half again, the battle continues without another heal. Treat dramatic turn-display changes as an effect rather than normal turn progression.
messages.終盤の即死技を避けられない: I cannot avoid the final lethal skill
messages.HP33%以下でバリアを得るとShift + Deleteが来る。ムルソーでマッ: After gaining a Shield at 33% HP or less, he uses Shift + Delete. Clash with Meursault and use The Stranger's 1 HP protection. It requires at least one other ally alive, so do not leave Meursault alone.
messages.FATE LOSTの専用戦闘へ入る前: Before entering the special FATE LOST battle
messages.顧客Lv65と精神・資源を準備する: Prepare Customer Lv. 65, SP, and resources
messages.Cルートの顧客Lv65・ダイヤモンドを目安に買い物を進める。影界の人格レベルは顧: Shop toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank on Route C. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level; experience levels gained outside it do not carry in.
messages.ムルソーと、HP・精神力回復、高威力のE.G.Oを組む。突入時にE.G.O資源は: Bring Meursault, HP and SP recovery, and high-Power E.G.O. E.G.O resources are halved on entry, but candle destruction in Phase 1 and phase transitions replenish them. If needed, gather SP and resources in the earlier 1F dungeon battle with Le Khaki.
messages.象徴界の看守戦では、光る蝋燭を攻撃してから看守の攻撃を誘導し、スタンを取る。危な: In the preceding Warden encounter, attack glowing candles, then lure his attack into them to stun him. Retreat when in danger and break candles to heal. Reducing him to 1,830 HP starts the dungeon battle.
messages.影界開始時は囚人の精神力が30になるまで回復する。高い精神力を下げる効果と取り違: At the start of the dungeon battle, Sinners' SP recovers up to 30. Do not mistake this for an effect that lowers higher SP.
messages.燭台を全て壊し、速度2以上で看守とマッチする: Destroy every candle and clash at 2 Speed or higher
messages.燭台は最初に2体、次のターン以降は召喚数が増え、最大4体が並ぶ。HP59・全耐性: Two candles appear initially, with more summoned on later turns, up to four at once. Each has 59 HP and all resistances at ×2; split fast Sinners' attacks to kill them first. Candles targeted secondarily by area skills take 50% less damage, so check for survivors.
messages.燭台が残るほど看守の技が強くなり、終了時には全員へ次ターンの束縛を付ける。看守へ: Surviving candles strengthen the Warden's skills and apply Bind to everyone next turn at Turn End. Destroy all of them every turn before focusing damage on him.
messages.燭台処理より遅く動く、速度2以上の囚人で看守とマッチする。主対象の速度1は全コイ: Assign a Sinner with at least 2 Speed who acts after candle cleanup to clash with the Warden. A main target at 1 Speed can trigger all-Unbreakable Coins, +2 Final Power, and +100% damage.
messages.3ターン目は懲罰へ高威力技を当てる。このターンは囚人から被撃するたびに看守へマッ: On turn 3, use a high-Power skill against “Divine Retribution”. That turn, Sinner hits inflict Clash Power Down on the Warden, so landing other attacks first helps. Phase 2 begins at 1 HP or less, or at the end of turn 3.
messages.停止・鼓動と釘を確認し、次の大技へ備える: Check Stillness, Thumping Pulse, and nails before major attacks
messages.看守はHP・精神力を全快し、弱体効果を除去する。保存威力と回数は引き継ぐ。以後は: The Warden fully restores HP and SP and removes negative effects. Preservation Potency and Count carry over. The normal cycle then repeats Voice A → Voice B → Divinity A → Divinity B.
messages.ターン開始時に停止と鼓動を持つ囚人を確認する。声Aは通常攻撃を処理し、停止持ちは: At Turn Start, identify Sinners with Stillness and Thumping Pulse. Handle normal attacks in Voice A; the Stillness holder can increase damage by assigning the Defense Skill slot as their main target.
messages.声Bの怠惰技「審判」は釘が少ない囚人で受ける。釘が多い囚人には比較的弱い傲慢技を: Assign Voice B's Sloth skill “Judgment” to a Sinner with few nails. Give relatively weak Pride skills to those with many nails, and heal SP lost to Sinking.
messages.余裕があれば審判をほかの通常技より後に使わせる。憂鬱・傲慢技で増えた保存回数を審: If possible, make “Judgment” act after the other normal skills. It consumes all Preservation Count gained by the Gloom and Pride skills, helping prevent the next major skill's Coin Power buff. However, automatic Count replenishment next turn can prevent this weakening.
messages.停止で審判の大広域、鼓動で死刑執行へ勝つ: Use Stillness for the major “Judgment” clash and Thumping Pulse for execution
messages.権能Aでは「審判…！宣告…！断罪…！」が来る。速度に関係なくマッチ可能なので、停: Divinity A brings “Judgment... Sentencing... Condemnation!” It is clashable regardless of Speed; assign a high-Power skill from the Stillness holder for −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power on the enemy.
messages.勝利するとダメージ75%減少・この技のダメージによる混乱を防げるが、残るコインで: Winning reduces damage by 75% and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage, but remaining Coins still activate nail effects. Other Sinners with Hammernail [Judgment] can equip defense to halve the nail's fixed damage and prevent death or Stagger from that effect. The major skill itself does not activate Defense Skills.
messages.次ターンの死刑執行は鼓動持ちが担当する。対象変更不可だが、鼓動持ちは速度不問でマ: Next turn, assign “Death Unto the Condemned” to the Thumping Pulse holder. It cannot be redirected normally, but that holder can clash regardless of Speed. Thumping Pulse gives the enemy −15 Clash Power; win to gain the temporary Shield.
messages.死刑執行は破壊不能1枚で、的中時に最大HP200%の固定ダメージを与える。鼓動で: “Death Unto the Condemned” has one Unbreakable Coin that deals fixed damage equal to 200% max HP On Hit. The 250% max HP Shield from a Thumping Pulse clash win is needed; an ordinary recipient merely winning is insufficient.
messages.ほかの憂鬱・傲慢技も権能中は破壊不能になる。受けた囚人の釘を次の周回へ持ち越すこ: Other Gloom and Pride skills also become Unbreakable during Divinity. Account for nails remaining into the next cycle, and prepare high-Power E.G.O for whoever receives Stillness. The turn may end at 50% body HP or less; at 1 HP or less, Phase 3 begins.
messages.パネルの釘を避け、同じ二役を続ける: Avoid panel nails and keep the same two roles
messages.HP・精神力の全快と弱体解除が入り、保存は引き継ぐ。司祭になっても、停止で大広域: HP and SP fully recover and negative effects are removed; Preservation carries over. The Chaplain keeps the same plan: Stillness for the major area clash, Thumping Pulse for the following Gluttony skill.
messages.毎ターン、パネルで釘が刺さった攻撃スキルを確認する。そのスキルを装着せず、勝率・: Every turn, check Attack Skills pierced by nails on the panel. Do not equip them or use Win Rate or Damage auto-selection. Change a skill to defense or E.G.O before equipping it to avoid the selection penalty. Beware of changing it back to the original attack while still equipped.
messages.第3段階の釘は告解道具と呼ぶ。Console、Breakpoint、Except: Phase 3 nails are called Implements of Confession. Console, Breakpoint, and Exception have different effects. Stacked Console causes self-damage when landing attacks; check nails on Sinners too.
messages.停止持ちで「シーシュポスシステムを本当に壊す気か？」へ勝つ。停止による威力低下に: Win against “Do you seriously mean to break the Sisyphe System?” with Stillness. Alongside its Power reduction, all targets gain a temporary Shield and winning gives 90% reduction. Do not reuse Phase 2's 75% value.
messages.次の強制退場は鼓動持ちでマッチに勝つ。摘出コインは勝っても残るが、最大HP250: Win the following “Systemwide Ban” with Thumping Pulse. The Excision Coin remains after winning, but the temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP absorbs the 200% fixed damage.
messages.保存威力と回数が10未満だと、ターン開始時に回数5を補充する。移行直後は、声Bで: If both Preservation Potency and Count are below 10, replenish 5 Count at Turn Start. Just after transition, emptying Preservation during Voice B may not prevent the next major skill's buff.
messages.司祭の最初のHP50%未満→再度半分: Chaplain below 50% HP for the first time, then half again
messages.一度目の全快を越え、演出後も攻撃を続ける: Push through the first full heal and keep attacking after the effects
messages.最初にHP50%未満へ落とすと、司祭は全快し、弱体を除去する。移行の失敗ではない: The first time the Chaplain falls below 50% HP, he fully heals and removes negative effects. This is not a failed transition; repeat the Stillness and Thumping Pulse plan to damage him again.
messages.途中のターン表示が大きく変わる演出は、通常のターン経過として数えない。バフやデバ: Do not count the dramatic turn-display change as ordinary turn progression. Buffs and debuffs do not suddenly stack by the displayed number of turns.
messages.もう一度半分まで削ると、光の苗木LUXURIAの演出後は全快せずに続行する。専用: When reduced to half again, the battle continues without a full heal after the Sapling of Light LUXURIA effect. Keep damaging him rather than waiting for a special buff.
messages.ムルソーでShift + Deleteを受け、バリアごと押し切る: Take Shift + Delete with Meursault and push through the Shield
messages.司祭はシーシュポスシステム保存を消耗し、最大HPの（25+消耗数値）%の不揮発性: The Chaplain consumes Sisyphe System Preservation to gain a non-decaying Shield equal to (25 + consumed Stack)% max HP. Defense Level permanently decreases by the consumed amount.
messages.声Aの行動にShift + Deleteが加わる。ムルソー以外を優先して狙うが、: Shift + Delete joins the Voice A actions. It prioritizes Sinners other than Meursault, but clash with Meursault for −20 enemy Clash Power. Check this recipient separately from the Stillness and Thumping Pulse assignments.
messages.摘出3枚は勝っても残る。現在HPの50%固定ダメージ2回と、最大HP200%の固: All three Excision Coins remain after winning. They deal fixed damage equal to 50% current HP twice and 200% max HP, so use Meursault, whose The Stranger preserves 1 HP. Keep at least one other ally alive.
messages.勝利できれば司祭の現在バリアが半減し、このターンと次ターンに脆弱10が付く。残る: Winning halves the Chaplain's current Shield and gives him 10 Fragile this turn and next turn. Focus remaining damage. Continue assigning Stillness to the major area skill and Thumping Pulse to “Systemwide Ban” until the end.
messages.毎ターン、ランダムな囚人が得る。第1段階は最終威力+1・与ダメージ+15%。第2: A random Sinner gains it each turn. Phase 1: Final Power +1 and damage +15%. Phases 2 and 3: +2 and +25%. Phase 3 also inflicts 1 Defense Level Down On Hit, up to 9.
messages.第2・3段階の大広域を担当する。主対象にすると敵の最終威力−5・マッチ威力−5と: Handles major area skills in Phases 2 and 3. Being the main target gives the enemy −5 Final Power and −5 Clash Power.
messages.毎ターン、ランダムな囚人が得る。マッチ威力は第1・2・3段階で+1・+2・+3、: A random Sinner gains it each turn. Clash Power +1 / +2 / +3 in Phases 1 / 2 / 3; damage taken −25% / −25% / −50%. Winning against Phase 2 “Death Unto the Condemned” or Phase 3 “Systemwide Ban” grants a temporary Shield equal to 250% max HP, removed after the attack. Phase 3 also inflicts 1 Offense Level Down On Hit, up to 9.
messages.対象変更不可でも、対応する暴食技に速度不問でマッチできる。鼓動を持つだけでなく、: Can clash with the corresponding Gluttony skill regardless of Speed even when it cannot be redirected normally. Having Thumping Pulse is not enough: you must win.
messages.ムルソーが得る。ほかの味方が1人以上生存中はHP1未満にならず、混乱するダメージ: Granted to Meursault. While at least one other ally is alive, HP cannot fall below 1; damage that would Stagger him removes the threshold instead. Strengthens across phases. In Phase 3, Speed +3, Final Power +3, damage +30%; winning a clash against the Chaplain heals 8 SP and grants 5 total E.G.O resources of affinities with low reserves. Cannot retreat.
messages.終盤のShift + Deleteを担当する。味方の生存条件は戦闘中に必要で、ム: Handles Shift + Delete at the end. Another ally must remain alive during the fight; do not treat Meursault as immortal when alone.
messages.第1段階で2から開始。ターン開始時に数値×4のマッチ威力減少と脆弱を得る。終了時: Starts at 2 in Phase 1. At Turn Start, gain Clash Power Down and Fragile equal to Stack ×4. At Turn End, heal SP and lose 1 Stack.
messages.序盤の弱さを、後の看守・司祭の威力へ当てはめない。: Do not apply his opening weakness to the Power of later Warden or Chaplain phases.
messages.特殊充電。回数を累計10消耗するたびに威力が1増える。この戦闘では回数の自然減少: Special Charge. Gain 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Count does not naturally decrease in this battle. In Phase 3, replenish 5 Count at Turn Start if both Potency and Count are below 10; maximum Count rises to 25 / 30 at 5 or more / 10 or more Potency.
messages.威力と回数を分けて見る。前ターンに回数を使い切っても、自動補充があれば大技の強化: Distinguish Potency from Count. Emptying Count last turn does not prevent the major attack's buff if it is automatically replenished.
messages.最大100。保存回数の獲得・消耗に応じて増え、ターン終了時にも10増える。100: Maximum 100. Increases with Preservation Count gained or consumed, and by 10 at Turn End. At 100, changes to Divinity of the Obsidian God next turn.
messages.声Bの守備技で100まで増えるため、次の停止担当を確認して大技に備える。: Voice B's Defense Skill raises it to 100. Identify the next Stillness holder and prepare for the major attack.
messages.数値に応じて攻撃・防御レベルを増やし、全スキルのコインを破壊不能へ変える（摘出コ: Increases Offense and Defense Levels based on Stack and makes all skill Coins Unbreakable, excluding Excision Coins. At 0, returns to Voice of the Obsidian God next turn.
messages.マッチ勝利後の被弾も見込み、停止・鼓動で大技の軽減とバリアを取る。: Expect hits after clash wins; use Stillness and Thumping Pulse for major-skill mitigation and Shields.
messages.第2段階の釘の総称。金鎚の釘[断罪]・金鎚の釘[審判]・釘[刑罰]・釘[贖罪]を: Collective term for Phase 2 nails: Hammernail [Condemnation], Hammernail [Judgment], Nail [Punishment], and Nail [Penance]. Changes to the last applied type and combines Stack, but Hammernails do not revert to ordinary Nails.
messages.数値が多い担当ほど敵が強化される。声Bの怠惰技は釘が少ない囚人へ回す。: More nails on the recipient strengthen the enemy. Assign Voice B's Sloth skill to a Sinner with few nails.
messages.大広域で発動すると、最大HPの数値×5%の固定ダメージ（最小10）。戦闘開始時に: When activated by the major area skill, deals fixed damage equal to Stack ×5% max HP, minimum 10. Equipping defense at Combat Start halves it and prevents death or Stagger from this effect.
messages.大技を受ける停止担当以外に釘があるなら、守備装着で釘の被害を減らす。守備の発動そ: If other Sinners besides the Stillness clash recipient have these nails, equip defense to reduce nail damage. The Defense Skill does not need to activate.
messages.開始時に保有していると混乱する。鼓動持ちはこの効果で混乱せず、そのターンの終了時: Staggers the holder at Turn Start. Thumping Pulse prevents Stagger from this effect; expires at that turn's end.
messages.翌ターンの鼓動持ちで死刑執行にマッチする。: Clash with “Death Unto the Condemned” using next turn's Thumping Pulse holder.
messages.大広域で発動すると、数値分の沈潜を得る。最大9。: When activated by the major area skill, gain Sinking equal to Stack. Maximum 9.
messages.大技の後は精神力も確認し、次の周回のマッチを立て直す。: Check SP after the major skill and restore clashes for the next cycle.
messages.大広域で発動すると、数値×2だけ混乱区間が前進する。最大9。: When activated by the major area skill, raise the holder's Stagger Threshold by Stack ×2. Maximum 9.
messages.マッチ勝利による混乱防止と、釘の別効果を混同せずにHPを確保する。: Keep enough HP and distinguish protection from the skill's Stagger damage from separate nail effects.
messages.司祭の効果名「～」の総称。釘[Exception]・釘[Breakpoint]・: Collective term for the Chaplain's “~” effects: Nail [Exception], Nail [Breakpoint], and Nail [Console]. Changes to the last applied type and combines Stack, but Exception and Breakpoint do not revert to Console.
messages.釘の多い囚人では敵の威力・ダメージが増す。パネルに刺さった釘とは別に管理する。: More nails on the Sinner increase enemy Power and damage. Manage these separately from nails on the skill panel.
messages.最大9。戦闘開始時に9なら、そのターンに司祭へ攻撃的中するたび最大HP2%の固定: Maximum 9. If at 9 at Combat Start, each attack hit on the Chaplain deals fixed self-damage equal to 2% max HP that cannot Stagger the holder. When activated by the major area skill, gain Sinking equal to Stack and raise the Stagger Threshold by Stack ×2.
messages.パネルの釘付きスキルを避け、不要な追加蓄積を防ぐ。: Avoid panel skills pierced by nails to prevent unnecessary extra buildup.
messages.大広域で発動すると最大HPの数値×10%の固定ダメージ（最小10）。戦闘開始時に: When activated by the major area skill, deals fixed damage equal to Stack ×10% max HP, minimum 10. Equipping defense at Combat Start halves it and prevents death or Stagger from this effect. Maximum 9.
messages.停止のマッチ担当以外は、守備装着による釘の軽減も検討する。: For Sinners other than the Stillness clash recipient, also consider equipping defense to reduce nail damage.
messages.ターン開始時に現在HP50%の固定ダメージを受けて混乱する。鼓動持ちなら混乱せず: At Turn Start, take fixed damage equal to 50% current HP and become Staggered. Thumping Pulse prevents that Stagger and halves the damage. Expires at Turn End after activation.
messages.鼓動持ちで強制退場を担当する。回復だけで混乱条件を無視しない。: Assign “Systemwide Ban” to the Thumping Pulse holder. Healing alone does not remove the Stagger condition.
messages.最大25。数値%だけ与ダメージ増加・被ダメージ減少。司祭の保存威力10超過分から: Maximum 25. Damage dealt increases and damage taken decreases by Stack%. Gained from the Chaplain's Preservation Potency above 10. messages.S3「描き出す」: 戦闘開始時に斬撃ダメージ量増加2(1ターンの間、スキルの与ダ: **S3 — Brushstroke**: Gains 2 Slash DMG Up at Combat Start (more skill damage for 1 turn). Because it is applied before her skills are used, it also boosts her other Slash skills that turn, including Slash E.G.O.
messages.S2「ばら撒く」: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインとも、対象がこのターンにダメージを受けていればダ: **S2 — Splatter**: Both Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ deal +10%/+30% damage (depending on Uptie) if the target has already taken damage this turn. Landing it after S3 or an ally's attack meets the condition.
messages.呼吸: S1「塗る」のⅠコイン[表面的中時/的中時](同期化段階で変化)で次のタ: **Poise**: Coin Ⅰ of S1 Paint grants 1/2 Poise next turn [on Heads Hit/on hit] (depending on Uptie), and Coin Ⅱ of S3 grants 2 Poise next turn on hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「無差別的芸術」(暴食×3・共鳴): 自分の被ダメージ量と与ダメー: **Combat passive — Indiscriminate Art (3 Gluttony Resonance)**: She takes +25% damage and deals +25% damage. Her only Gluttony skills are S1 and the Defense skill Evade.
messages.サポートパッシブ「背中を押す」(暴食×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 最大体力が最: **Support passive — Hustle (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the lowest max HP deals and takes +20% damage.
messages.S3を引いたターンは、S3を当ててから同じターンにS2を続け、斬撃ダメージ量増加: On turns when she draws S3, land S3 and then follow with S2 in the same turn to stack both the Slash DMG Up and S2's condition (damage taken this turn). S2 meets its condition more easily from her second slot onward, so she tends to shine in regular battles where she gets more actions. Her HP is low and her passive increases damage taken, so watch out for hits when she is likely to be targeted.

messages.S3の斬撃脆弱: Ⅰコイン的中時に次のターンに斬撃脆弱3を付与し、マッチ勝利時は: **S3's Slash Fragility**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, inflicts 3 Slash Fragility next turn, plus 2 more on Clash Win (5 total). It cannot be inflicted if Coin Ⅰ is broken in the Clash.
messages.S2「アッパースラッシュ」: 対象に斬撃脆弱があればスキル威力+2。マッチ勝利時: **S2 — Upper Slash**: +2 Skill Power if the target has Slash Fragility. Grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn on Clash Win. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 2 Defense Level Down.
messages.バトルパッシブ「はん・われ」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): このターンの斬: **Combat passive — C. I. H. (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% Slash damage this turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「アイスブレイク」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 最大体力: **Support passive — Ice Breaker (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Rupture inflicted by the 1 ally with the lowest max HP.
messages.精神力が高いうちはS2・S3で積極的にマッチを取る。S3は勝てる相手に当てて斬撃: While her SP is high, actively take Clashes with S2 and S3. S1 and S2 are 1-Coin skills, so her Clashes are unstable early on when SP is low, and her low HP makes her crumble easily. She only inflicts a little Rupture with S1 Slash, so in Rupture teams she can also sit in backup for her support passive.
messages.出血回数の付与: S2「後始末」のⅡコインで出血回数1/3増加、S3「雲の撹乱」: **Inflicting Bleed Count**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 Clean Up increases Bleed Count by 1/3, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 Lenticular Swirl increases it by 3 on hit. She inflicts 2 Bleed Potency on Coin Ⅰ hit of S2 and on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit of S3.
messages.低めの速度: 速度2~5/2~6/3~6。先に動く味方の後から一方攻撃を入れやす: **Lowish Speed**: Speed 2–5/2–6/3–6. It is easy for her to land one-sided attacks after faster allies act.
messages.敵のスキルを弱めるデバフ: S1「発勁」のⅠコインで麻痺1/3(1ターンの間、数: **Debuffs that weaken enemy skills**: Coin Ⅰ of S1 Focus Strike inflicts 1/3 Paralyze (fixes the Coin Power of that many Coins to 0 for 1 turn), Coin Ⅱ of S2 inflicts 2 Damage Down on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 inflicts 5 Offense Level Down on hit. messages.出血回数で強化: 対象の出血回数がS1は2以上でダメージ量+20%、S2は5以上: **Bonuses from Bleed Count**: +20% damage for S1 if the target has at least 2 Bleed Count, +20% for S2 at 5 or more, and +40% for S3 at 9 or more. S1's condition is easy to meet. The S2 and S3 bonuses demand high Count and are hard to reach outside the Mirror Dungeon.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「黒雲刀」(色欲×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)は出血の敵: **Passives**: The combat passive Kokuuntō (3 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +10% damage against enemies with Bleed. messages.出血編成に入れ、味方が出血を入れたりマッチを取ったりした敵に、S2・S3を一方攻: Put her in a Bleed team and land S2 and S3 as one-sided attacks on enemies that allies have already bled or Clashed with, extending Bleed Count. Her own damage is modest, so use her as a role that raises the whole team's Bleed damage rather than one who wears enemies down herself.

messages.S2「しょ・が」: 3コインでマッチ威力2~17/3~18。Ⅰコインで次のターン: **S2 — I.H.**: 3 Coins with Clash Power 2–17/3–18. messages.バトルパッシブ「即席料理」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵討伐時、体力が: **Combat passive — Rustle Up (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On defeating an enemy, heals 15 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP, once per turn. If she has Appetite, she spends all of it to increase the healing.

messages.サポートパッシブ「芸術的な味」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 誰が倒しても: **Support passive — Artistic Flavor (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When an enemy dies, no matter who defeated it, heals 15 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP, once per turn.
messages.序盤はS1・S2で削りながらマッチを取り、体力の減った敵にS3を当てて仕留める。: Early on, chip away with S1 and S2 while taking Clashes, then finish weakened enemies with S3. The passive requires 5 Lust Owned, but her only Lust skills are S3 and her Defense skill, so pairing her with Lust allies makes it easier to activate.
messages.S2「跳躍」: 使用時に充電回数が5/6/7増加。充電回数10以上でコイン威力+: **S2 — Leap**: Increases Charge Count by 5/6/7 on use. +1 Coin Power at 10 or more Charge Count, and +1 more at 15 or more. messages.S3「次・魔・空・切」: 充電回数15以上なら15を消耗してコイン威力+3/5。: **S3 — D.D.E.D.R.**: With 15 or more Charge Count, spends 15 for +3/5 Coin Power. With 7–14, spends all of it and pays HP equal to 3×(15 − Charge Count spent)% of max HP for +3/5 Coin Power. At 6 or less, there is neither a bonus nor an HP cost. Only when 15 was spent, Coin Ⅳ grants 5/7 Charge Barrier to herself and 1 ally on defeating an enemy.
messages.S1「エ・循」: 3コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に充電回数が2ずつ増加。充電10: **S1 — E.C.**: 3 Coins. On hit, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each increase Charge Count by 2. +10% damage each at 10 or more and 15 or more Charge.
messages.充電: 最大20、ターン終了時に1減少。: **Charge**: Maximum 20; decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「次元魔剣」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵討伐時に充電回: **Combat passive — Dimensional Demon Edge (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Increases Charge Count by 2/3 on defeating an enemy, up to 3 times per turn.
messages.S1は充電をⅠ・Ⅱコインの的中時に得るので、コインが当たらないと稼げない。マッチ: S1 gains Charge on hit with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, so it gains nothing if the Coins do not land. It is better suited to landing one-sided attacks for Charge than to Clashing. Build Clashes and damage around S2. Using it when slightly short of a threshold is efficient, since its on-use increase pushes Charge over the line. S3 reaches full output at 15 Charge, but can still be fired at 7–14 by paying HP. That HP cost can be treated as a resource. Her HP is low, so use it when she has HP to spare.
messages.呼吸で強化: S1「押しのける」・S2「夕・む」は自分の呼吸7以上でコイン威力+: **Poise bonuses**: S1 Shove and S2 T.N. gain +1 Coin Power with at least 7 Poise. S3 O.O.F. gains +1 Coin Power with at least 10 Poise (+1 per 7 Poise, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.クリティカル時のデバフ: S1はクリティカル時に対象の精神力を減らし、S2は攻撃: **Debuffs on Critical Hit**: On Critical Hit, S1 reduces the target's SP, and S2 inflicts Offense Level Down.
messages.S3: Ⅲコインで弾丸1を消耗し、振動・破裂の付与と振動爆発。クリティカル時は振: **S3**: Coin Ⅲ spends 1 Ammo to inflict Tremor and Rupture and trigger Tremor Burst. On Critical Hit, the Tremor and Rupture Potency and Count are doubled.
messages.バトルパッシブ「ヤ・切」(暴食×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 弾丸7を保有。ター: **Combat passive — A S.B. (2 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Holds 7 Ammo. Restores 8 SP at Turn End if she has at least 7 Poise.
messages.S2・S3で呼吸を貯め(S1は呼吸回数を補う)、S3のⅢコインでクリティカルを狙: Build Poise with S2 and S3 (S1 tops up Poise Count), then aim for a Critical Hit with Coin Ⅲ of S3 to inflict doubled Tremor and Rupture. Ammo comes from the passive A S.B., so Uptie Ⅱ or higher is a prerequisite. Keeping Poise at 7 or more also restores SP.
messages.火傷で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の火傷6以上でマッチ威力+1。コイン威力+1の条: **Burn bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Clash Power if the target has at least 6 Burn. The +1 Coin Power condition is 10 or more Burn for S1 All-out War, and 6 or more for S2 Fiery Knifehand and S3 Flame Cleave.
messages.追加ダメージ: S2のⅡコインは対象の火傷6以上で与ダメージ量+20/30/50: **Extra damage**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 deals +20/30/50% damage if the target has at least 6 Burn, and Coin Ⅳ of S3 deals +20/40% at 10 or more.
messages.自前の火傷付与: S1はⅠ・Ⅱコインで火傷1ずつ(Ⅱコイン表面的中時はさらに1): **Her own Burn infliction**: S1 inflicts 1 Burn each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ (plus 1 more on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit), S2 inflicts 2 Burn with Coin Ⅰ, and S3 inflicts 1 Burn each with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ. None of her skills increase Burn Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「火伝」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 火傷の敵を倒すと、火: **Combat passive — Flame Spread (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Defeating an enemy with Burn inflicts 4 Burn on 1/2 enemies with no Burn or the least Burn, 1/2 times per turn.
messages.サポートパッシブ「伝火」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も低い味方: **Support passive — Spread Flame (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 slowest ally defeats an enemy with Burn, inflicts 3 Burn on 1/2 random enemies, once per turn.
messages.火傷回数を伸ばせる味方と組み、味方が積んだ火傷が6以上の敵にS2を、10以上の敵: Pair her with allies who can extend Burn Count, and hit enemies with at least 6 Burn from allies with S2, and those with 10 or more with S3. Her own Coins also inflict Burn, so she can push targets up to the thresholds with S1 and S3. Defeating enemies spreads Burn to other enemies through Flame Spread. S1 is Gluttony, so supplying Gluttony resources to Burn teams is another reason to use her.
messages.S2の加重値増加: 戦闘開始時に呼吸回数6を消耗して加重値+2。Ⅰコイン的中時に: **S2's Attack Weight increase**: At Combat Start, spends 6 Poise Count for +2 Attack Weight. On Coin Ⅰ hit, gains 2/3 Poise and inflicts 1 B.M. on Critical Hit. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 B.M. on hit. If it hits multiple enemies, the effects apply to each one.
messages.呼吸回数の準備: S1「応接道一式 狩り」は使用時とⅠコイン的中時に呼吸回数が2: **Preparing Poise Count**: S1 Receiving Arts 1: The Hunt increases Poise Count by 2 on use and again on Coin Ⅰ hit, and Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 B.M. S3 Receiving Arts 2: S.Y.N.C. increases Poise Count by 7 on use and grants 5 Poise on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「家事の仕上げ」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): バ・目の対象: **Combat passive — Clearing Household Chores (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Hitting a target with B.M. grants 1 Poise Count and 1 Haste next turn, up to 3 times per turn. A Critical Hit against a target with B.M. removes B.M. and grants +5/10% Critical damage per point of Speed difference, up to 30/60%.
messages.速度差で強化: 対象の速度が自分より低いと、S1・S2はマッチ威力、S3はコイン: **Speed-difference bonuses**: If the target is slower than her, S1 and S2 gain Clash Power and S3 gains Coin Power. The base rule is +1 per 2 Speed difference (up to 3 for S2 and 2 for S3). For S1, it is +1 at a difference of 3 or more at lower Uptie, and +1 per 2 difference, up to 3, at higher Uptie.
messages.S3: Ⅰコインで次のターンに束縛1を付与し、ダメージ量の20/30%だけ混乱区: **S3**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Bind next turn and shifts the Stagger Threshold by 20/30% of the damage dealt. Coin Ⅱ gains +20/40% Critical damage against staggered targets. Defeating an enemy with Coin Ⅱ reuses the skill once on a random enemy with B.M. (this does not trigger on the reuse, and fizzles if no enemy has B.M.).
messages.序盤はS1・S3で呼吸回数と呼吸を貯める。S2を使うのは呼吸回数を8〜9ほど貯め: Early on, build Poise Count and Poise with S1 and S3. It is safest to use S2 after building about 8–9 Poise Count. Cut through multiple enemies with S2 and land Coin Ⅱ on the B.M. applied by Coin Ⅰ's Critical Hit to trigger the passive. Throw S3 at enemies she can likely defeat and chain into reuse against enemies with B.M. Her attacks are all Slash, so she struggles against enemies that resist Slash. Against single bosses, her multi-target attacks and reuse are hard to make use of.
messages.S2で敵へ移す: 使用時に自分の振動回数が2増加。Ⅱコインで対象の振動回数を1増: **Transferring to the enemy with S2**: Increases her Tremor Count by 2 on use. Coin Ⅱ increases the target's Tremor Count by 1, and on Coin Ⅲ hit she spends her own Tremor Count to increase the target's Tremor Count by the same amount, up to 5.
messages.S1で参照して得る: 使用時に自分の振動回数が2増加。Ⅰコイン的中時に、対象の振: **Gaining by reference with S1**: Increases her Tremor Count by 2 on use. On Coin Ⅰ hit, her Tremor Count increases by half of/the same as the target's Tremor Count, up to 2/3/4, without reducing the target's Count. Coin Ⅱ increases the target's Tremor Count by 1/2.
messages.自分の振動回数で強化: S1は5/4以上でマッチ威力+2。S2は4以上でマッチ威: **Bonuses from her own Tremor Count**: S1 gains +2 Clash Power at 5/4 or more. S2 gains +1 Clash Power at 4 or more and +1 Coin Power at 5/4 or more. Her Guard grants Shield equal to twice her Tremor Count, up to 5/10.
messages.S3「叩きゃ直る」: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10/8消耗してコイン威力+1。対: **S3 — Percussive Maintenance**: Spends 10/8 of her Tremor Count on use for +1 Coin Power. +1 more Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Tremor. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each inflict 2 Tremor, and Coin Ⅲ triggers Tremor Burst (the target's Tremor Count decreases by 2/1).
messages.バトルパッシブ「制・支」(怠惰×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 味方の攻撃で混乱し: **Combat passive — N.O. (3 Sloth Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Follows up with S1 against enemies staggered by allies' attacks, once per turn. On this follow-up, the Tremor Count she gains increases by 1, and her final Coin triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.振動回数のある敵にS1を当てて自分の回数を確保し、S2のⅢコインで敵に移し、増え: Land S1 on an enemy with Tremor Count to secure her own Count, transfer it to the enemy with Coin Ⅲ of S2, then gain it back with the next S1 by referencing the enemy's increased Count, and repeat. At lower Uptie, she only references half of the target's Count, so she gains little from enemies with low Count. She needs an initial source to draw from, so allies who can inflict Tremor Count speed up her start. S3 spends a large amount of her Tremor Count, which tends to cut off the S1 and S2 bonuses on later turns. Using it early, or turning it into a Defense skill, are options.
messages.通常のS3「ドタマを割る」: Ⅰコイン的中時に赤眼7と懺悔7を得る。Ⅱコイン表面: **Regular S3 — Skullbuster**: Gains 7 Red Eyes and 7 Penitence on Coin Ⅰ hit. Coin Ⅱ grants 2 Penitence on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅲ heals HP and SP for herself and allies (SP by the amount of Penitence above 10). At max SP, she gains +2 Clash Power and +1 Coin Power, and loses 15 SP after the attack.
messages.赤眼・懺悔による強化: S1「どっちも黙れ」は赤眼7以上でコイン威力+1、懺悔7: **Bonuses from Red Eyes and Penitence**: S1 Both of You, Shut Up gains +1 Coin Power with at least 7 Red Eyes and +1/2 Clash Power with at least 7 Penitence. S2 S.H. / S.F. gains +1 Coin Power when Red Eyes and Penitence total at least 20/15, and +1 more if the target has at least 6 Bleed.
messages.赤眼・懺悔の獲得: S1・S2・守備のコイン的中時に得る。充電回数を得る効果も代: **Gaining Red Eyes and Penitence**: Gained on Coin hits of S1, S2, and her Defense skill. Effects that would grant Charge Count grant these instead (E.G.O Assimilation). Through the combat passive Spiderhead/Skullface (3 Lust and 3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), Coins that grant Red Eyes or Penitence deal more damage based on each value, and she also gains Penitence when taking damage, up to 3.
messages.「ガチでドタマを割る」: 赤眼と懺悔がそれぞれ15以上のとき、S3がこれに変わる: **Serious Skullbuster**: S3 turns into this when Red Eyes and Penitence are each at 15 or more. It spends all of both, gaining +1 Coin Power per 5 Red Eyes and +1 Base Power per 5 Penitence, up to 4 each, and Coin Ⅲ gains +2.5/4% damage per point spent, up to 100/160%. It heals allies' HP and SP and inflicts 3 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down. She loses 15 SP after the attack.
messages.通常S3は序盤に使っても強い。Ⅰコインで赤眼7・懺悔7を得るので、これだけでS1: The regular S3 is strong even early on. Coin Ⅰ grants 7 Red Eyes and 7 Penitence, which alone meets S1's bonus conditions (7 or more each). S2's condition (20/15 total) cannot be reached with 14, and a single S3 meets it only at higher Uptie when Coin Ⅱ's Heads Hit adds 2 Penitence (16 total). Red Eyes and Penitence are gained on Coin hits, so choose opponents who will not break her Coins in Clashes. Once both reach 15, release them with the enhanced version. Spending everything means building up again, so it works well to aim for it with the second S3 cycle or save it for the finishing blow.
messages.脚力【卯】: S3と守備(マッチ可能反撃)の使用時に3を得る(最大3)。ターン終: **Strider【Mao】**: Gains 3 on using S3 and her Defense skill (a clashable counter), up to 3. At Turn End, she gains 5 Haste next turn and then loses 1, so gaining 3 provides 5 Haste three times. Her Defense skill is only used when it Clashes with an attack skill, and otherwise grants no Strider.
messages.速度10以上: S1・S3はコインを1回再使用(スキルごとに1回)。S2「刻まれ: **10 or more Speed**: S1 and S3 reuse a Coin once (once per skill). S2 As Written adds +1 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅰ and +10/20/30% damage with Coin Ⅱ, and S3 gains +30% damage with Coin Ⅲ. Her Speed range is 3–6/3–7/4–7, so even with 5 Haste her minimum is 8/8/9, and 10 or more Speed is not guaranteed.
messages.S2のクイック: 速度に関係なく、使用時に次のターンのクイック2を得る(1ターン: **S2's Haste**: Regardless of Speed, grants 2 Haste next turn on use, once per turn. Combined with Strider's 5 Haste, it raises her minimum Speed next turn.
messages.速度差と破裂で強化: S1・S2は速度が対象より3以上高ければコイン威力+1、対: **Bonuses from Speed difference and Rupture**: S1 and S2 gain +1 Coin Power if she is at least 3 Speed faster than the target, and +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6/4 Rupture. S2 and S3 gain (Speed difference × target's Rupture Potency)% damage, up to 50%.
messages.破裂回数の維持: S1はマッチ勝利時とⅡコインで破裂回数+1、S3はマッチ勝利時: **Maintaining Rupture Count**: S1 adds +1 Rupture Count on Clash Win and with Coin Ⅱ, S3 adds +2 on Clash Win and +1 with Coin Ⅰ, and her Defense skill adds +1 with Coin Ⅰ. The Rupture Potency she inflicts is small, around 1–3.
messages.呪殺【迅速】: S3のⅠコインと再使用コインで付与。速度10以上の相手の攻撃で破: **Deathrite【Haste】**: Inflicted by Coin Ⅰ and the reused Coin of S3. It decreases by 1 each time Rupture triggers from an attack by someone with 10 or more Speed, and each time the bearer's Rupture Count increases by 1. When it reaches 0, it deals Gluttony damage equal to Rupture Potency.
