messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「黒獣化[卯]」(暴食×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得)は、: **Passives**: The combat passive Heishou Mutation [Mao] (3 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +5% damage while she has Strider【Mao】, and +5% more if the target has Deathrite【Haste】. The support passive Partial Heishou Mutation Training (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives the 1 fastest ally 2 Haste next turn at Turn End.
messages.1ターン目は守備で敵の攻撃とマッチして脚力【卯】を得る。2ターン目以降、速度が1: On turn 1, Clash an enemy attack with her Defense skill to gain Strider【Mao】. From turn 2 on, if her Speed is 10 or more, prioritize S1, which becomes 3 attacks with reuse, and use S2 when you need Clash Power or when her Speed falls short of 10. S3 also grants Strider, so fire it while maintaining it. S3 is much weaker below 10 Speed. Pairing her with allies who can inflict Rupture Potency extends the Speed difference × Rupture Potency damage bonus.
messages.視線と軽蔑: 視線は最大7で、1につき良秀からの被・与ダメージ量+10%。ターン: **Gaze and Contempt**: Gaze has a maximum of 7, and each point gives +10% damage dealt to and taken from Ryōshū. At 7 at Turn End, it becomes Contempt next turn (−50% damage dealt to and taken from Ryōshū), and Contempt reverts to 7 Gaze the following turn. It is inflicted by S1–S3 and the combat passive @#$'s Hand I Let Slip (2 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ).
messages.出血と振動: 各スキルで出血と振動を付与し、合計に応じてコイン威力・ダメージ量が: **Bleed and Tremor**: Each skill inflicts Bleed and Tremor, and Coin Power and damage rise based on their total. S2 triggers Tremor Burst if the target has at least 3 Tremor Count, and S3 triggers Tremor Burst with Coin Ⅲ and converts into Tremor - Hemorrhage if it hits without being broken.
messages.「軽蔑の下に降り注ぐ畏敬の視線」: 全ての敵の視線の合計が7以上か軽蔑が1以上な: **Cascading Gaze of Awe Underneath Contempt**: S3 changes into this when the total Gaze across all enemies is 7 or more or Contempt is 1 or more. A 1-Coin big hit with +200% damage against a single target, and even more against targets with Contempt. It spends all Gaze and Contempt after the attack.
messages.視線の軽蔑: 守備の戦闘開始時、条件を満たすと得る。保護7・ダメージ量減少7を得: **Contempt of the Gaze**: Gained at Combat Start of her Defense skill when the condition is met. She gains 7 Protection and 7 Damage Down, and her Aggro increases by 20.
messages.S1・S2で視線・出血・振動を積み、視線の合計が7以上か軽蔑が付いたら強化S3で: Stack Gaze, Bleed, and Tremor with S1 and S2, and once total Gaze reaches 7 or Contempt is applied, blast through with the enhanced S3. Paired with Yi Sang's N Corp. E.G.O:: Fell Bullet, only on turns when Ryōshū has Contempt of the Gaze, Yi Sang's S3 Target Readjustment Fire turns into I Shall Fire / Anytime, which shoots Ryōshū, once per turn.
messages.追撃: 常時発動パッシブ「君・可・傍・良」により、自分以外の味方のスキルが敵に当: **Follow-up**: Through the passive I.L.T.L.T. (I would've Liked to walk The Lord's path Together), which is always active, when another ally's skill hits an enemy, she makes a one-sided attack with Hey, Back Off at the end of that attack, once per turn. It also supplies Gloom resources every turn.
messages.呼吸で強化: 各スキルは呼吸威力と破裂威力の合計が6以上ならコイン威力+1(上位: **Poise bonuses**: Each skill gains +1 Coin Power if Poise Potency plus Rupture Potency totals at least 6 (+1 per 6, up to 2, at higher Uptie). Per the effect text, S1 counts "her own Poise Potency and Rupture Potency," while S2 and S3 count "her own Poise Potency and the target's Rupture Potency." She has trouble maintaining Rupture Count herself, so the condition is mainly met with Poise.
messages.護衛態勢: S3の使用時と守備「護衛」の戦闘開始時に2を得る(最大2、ターン終了: **Protector's Stance**: Gains 2 on using S3 and at Combat Start of the Defense skill Sentinel, up to 2, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. Damage taken is reduced by value×10%, and she gains Shield equal to her Poise at Turn Start, up to 20. At Turn End, she gains 3 Poise Potency and 1 Poise Count, and her leftmost slot gains +5 Aggro next turn.
messages.S3「加斥我援」: 使用時に呼吸3と呼吸回数3を得る。Ⅳコインは呼吸威力と対象の: **S3 — Aiding Strike [加斥我援]**: Gains 3 Poise and 3 Poise Count on use. Coin Ⅳ gains Critical damage based on her Poise Potency plus the target's Rupture Potency.
messages.呼吸の獲得: S1は使用時に呼吸回数1、S2「銘肌鏤骨」は使用時に呼吸回数2とⅡ: **Gaining Poise**: S1 grants 1 Poise Count on use, and S2 Engraved in Flesh and Bone [銘肌鏤骨] grants 2 Poise Count on use and Poise with Coin Ⅱ. Her Defense skill grants Poise equal to the target's Rupture on Clash Win, up to 5.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊侠」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 味方が倒れるか体力2: **Combat passive — Loyal Warrior (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When an ally falls or drops below 25% HP, she makes a one-sided attack with Aiding Strike against the enemy that made that attack, once per battle. The follow-up Hey, Back Off gains +30% Critical damage, and the 1 ally with the lowest SP recovers 2–4 SP.
messages.序盤にS3を使い、護衛態勢と呼吸で呼吸威力を早く6以上に乗せて、全スキルのコイン: Use S3 early to quickly push Poise Potency to 6 or more through Protector's Stance and Poise, raising the Coin Power of every skill. After that, just using the skills in hand lets her follow up every turn alongside allies' attacks. When Protector's Stance is about to run out, renew it with her Defense skill and cover allies with Aggro. She adds Rupture Potency but tends to reduce Count, so pair her with allies who can increase Rupture Count.
messages.弾丸-孤独と「止まらない物語」: 弾丸-孤独を6保有し、S1「ばぁん。ばぁん。」: **Ammo - Solitude and Stories that Never Cease**: She holds 6 Ammo - Solitude, spending 1 each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ of S1 Bang. Bang. and 1 with Coin Ⅰ of S2 Blossoming Fragrance in the Void. If it is 0 at the end of her attack, she makes a one-sided attack with Stories that Never Cease (an Unfocused Volley with 3 Coins), then spends 10 SP to Reload. It inflicts Solitude, and enemies without SP or in Solitude Panic gain Sinking Count at Turn End.
messages.「ばぁん。ばぁん。」の追撃: 弾丸-孤独が1以上のときだけ、自分または味方の攻撃: **Bang. Bang. follow-up**: Only while she has at least 1 Ammo - Solitude, at the end of her or an ally's attack skill, if an enemy's SP is below −40 or it is staggered, she makes a one-sided attack with Bang. Bang., once per turn.
messages.花びらと「恍惚とした終末」: バトルパッシブ「枯れない花」(怠惰×1・憂鬱×2・: **Petals and Magnificent End**: Through the combat passive Unwithering Flower (1 Sloth and 2 Gloom Owned), she gains Petals: 1 from enemy Sinking damage, an amount equal to the enemy's Faint Aroma, and 2 from Tremor Burst, up to 15 per turn, with +1 Offense Level per 10. If she has at least 30 at the end of her attack, she triggers Magnificent End against the enemy with the most Faint Aroma.
messages.残香: S2・S3「満開」で付与(最大30)。沈潜ダメージを受けると増え、振動爆: **Faint Aroma**: Inflicted by S2 and S3 Full Bloom, up to 30. It increases when the bearer takes Sinking damage, and on Tremor Burst it spreads 1–2 Faint Aroma to 3 random enemies other than that one. S2 and S3 gain +1% damage per Faint Aroma.
messages.守備「芸・観・時」: ターン終了時に花びら10と、次のターンの脆弱2・攻撃威力増: **Defense skill — A.A.T.**: At Turn End, she gains 10 Petals, plus 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up for the next turn. Magnificent End checks at the end of her attack, so reaching 30 at Turn End does not trigger it right away.
messages.S1・S2で弾丸を減らしながら沈潜回数・振動・残香を積み、撃ち切ったら止まらない: Stack Sinking Count, Tremor, and Faint Aroma with S1 and S2 while spending Ammo, and chain into Stories that Never Cease once she runs dry. If an enemy is staggered, Bang. Bang. also follows allies' attacks. On the turn before Petals reach 30, use her Defense skill, then unleash Magnificent End next turn with 2 Attack Power Up active. Petals are capped at 15 per turn, so if she has already gained more than 5 that turn from attacks, part of the Defense skill's +10 is cut off by the cap. Each Reload costs SP, so manage SP while counting Unwithering Flower's recovery (3% HP and 10 SP on a turn she loses at least 10% of her max HP, once per turn).
messages.「天殺」: 守備「残像歩」を装着したターンの戦闘開始時に、出場中で編成順が最も遅: **Slay the Heavens - Tiansha [天殺]**: At Combat Start on a turn she equips the Defense skill Phantom Step [殘像步], she designates the deployed House of Spiders ally latest in team order (up to 2 times per turn, once per Identity; Sinclair's The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice has the lowest priority). When that ally finishes using their equipped skills, is staggered, or has no skill to use, she makes a one-sided attack with Tiansha. It deals fixed damage equal to 120% of max HP and can kill. She gains +1 Base Power for attacks (−1 Offense Level, 4 times per battle), inflicts 20 Bladetrail [Afterimage] on hit, and gains 20 SP and Entangled Life [羅生] on defeating the target.
messages.味方の死亡で得る強化: バトルパッシブ「再会」の効果。蜘蛛の巣所属の味方が死亡し: **Buffs gained from allies' deaths**: An effect of the combat passive Saikai [再会]. While a House of Spiders ally is dead, she gains 1 Entanglement, and each fallen Identity's unique effect lasts for the rest of that battle. For example, Outis's The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather gives −20% damage taken, and Yi Sang's The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather makes the final Coin of her basic attack skills Unbreakable. If no Identity steps in from backup or returns, she gains +1 slot for every 3 deaths, up to 3 times. The combat passive Spacetime Afterimage Collapse also increases the number of Phantom Traces inflicted for every 3 deaths.
messages.絶縁: 死亡した蜘蛛の巣の親方人格1名につき+1(最大4)。1につき被ダメージ-: **String Severance [絕緣]**: +1 for each dead House of Spiders Nursefather Identity, up to 4. Each point reduces damage taken by 7.5%, and at 1 or more, Phantom Step designates one more ally.
messages.残影と「必然殺」: ターン開始時に敵へ残影を付与する。残影の敵を基本攻撃スキルの: **Phantom Trace and Inevitable Termination**: At Turn Start, inflicts Phantom Trace on enemies. When an enemy with Phantom Trace is the main target of a basic attack skill, she makes a one-sided attack with Inevitable Termination before use, once per turn. Basic attack skills against enemies with Phantom Trace have all-Unbreakable Coins and +1 Final Power. However, Phantom Trace disappears after Inevitable Termination's attack, so this bonus basically only applies to Inevitable Termination itself (except in Focused Encounters, where Phantom Trace does not disappear).
messages.地慧星刀と空間斬: 自分が付与した剣痕の総計(最大70、1ターン最大25)。50: **Dihui Star's Blade and Rend Space**: The total Bladetrail she has inflicted, up to 70 and 25 per turn. At 50 or more, she triggers Rend Space - String Connection at the end of the turn, once per battle (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ). After that, if she has 50 or more at Turn End, one basic skill turns into Rend Space - Echoshear. Tiansha's 20 Bladetrail makes it easier to build, but the 25-per-turn cap means she reaches 50 on turn 2 at the earliest.
messages.蜘蛛の巣所属の人格を複数編成し、天殺の対象が編成順の遅い順に選ばれることを利用し: Deploy multiple House of Spiders Identities, and use the fact that Tiansha targets allies latest in team order by placing the allies you want to defeat first at the back. Defeating Nursefather Identities first increases String Severance and the number of designated allies, speeding up Tiansha. Early on, repeat Tiansha with Phantom Step, building Dihui Star's Blade while gaining buffs from the defeated allies. Once Rend Space is available, attack in combination with Inevitable Termination aimed at enemies with Phantom Trace. Note also that the damage redirection from Saikai does not work unless House of Spiders allies are deployed. There is no need to defeat every House of Spiders ally; in many situations it is better to fight normally after defeating 2–3. If you build around her, Burn teams fit better than Bleed teams.
messages.保存: 特殊充電。スキルで回数を増やし、消耗して威力を上げる。累計で回数10を消: **Preservation**: A special Charge. Skills increase its Count and spend it to raise power. Each time she spends a cumulative 10 Count, she gains 1 Preservation Potency. At 3 or more Preservation Potency, her basic attack skills gain +1 Coin Power.
messages.ル・ノワール ギャバジン生地のコート: 登場時に25を得る。保存回数の獲得・消耗: **Le Noir: Gabardine Overcoat**: Gains 25 when she appears. It increases when she gains or spends Preservation Count and when she is hit while having Shield, granting +1 Defense Level per 25. Her leftmost slot also gains +5 Aggro. When it reaches 100, or when she uses a Defense skill at 60 or more, it turns into Armure Éveillée next turn.
messages.アルミュール・エヴェイエ: 速度+2、25につき攻撃・防御レベル+1、基本攻撃ス: **Armure Éveillée**: +2 Speed, +1 Offense and Defense Level per 25, and all Coins of her basic attack skills become Unbreakable. During this time, S3 becomes Single Kick - Couture Multiple. When it reaches 0, she returns to the Overcoat.
messages.振動爆発: S1・S2・S3・守備で振動を付与。S2は保存威力3以上で振動爆発し: **Tremor Burst**: S1, S2, S3, and her Defense skill inflict Tremor. S2 triggers Tremor Burst at 3 or more Preservation Potency, and S3 triggers Tremor Burst on hit (more times at 3 or more Preservation Potency).
messages.序盤はコートとバリアで攻撃を受けながら保存回数を回し、保存威力を3まで育てる。コ: Early on, take attacks with the Overcoat and Shield while cycling Preservation Count and growing Preservation Potency to 3. Once the Overcoat reaches 60 or more, switch to Armure Éveillée with a Defense skill and attack with Unbreakable Coins and the enhanced S3. The enhanced S3 and the Defense skill's enhanced attack spend Armure Éveillée, so she returns to the Overcoat when it reaches 0.
messages.単体の敵に撃って火傷6と脆弱を残し、次のターンの味方の火力を底上げする、色欲斬撃: A starting Lust Slash E.G.O used on a single enemy to leave 6 Burn and Fragile behind, raising allies' damage on the next turn.
messages.脆弱の付与: 次のターンに脆弱1を付与する。解析Ⅲでは表面的中時のみ、解析Ⅳでは: **Inflicting Fragile**: Inflicts 1 Fragile next turn. At Threadspin Ⅲ it applies only on Heads Hit, and at Threadspin Ⅳ it also applies on hit, totaling 2 on Heads Hit. Higher SP makes Heads more likely, so use it when her SP is as high as possible.
messages.火傷の付与: 解析Ⅲから的中時に火傷6を付与する(解析Ⅱ以前は表面的中時に火傷4: **Inflicting Burn**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 6 Burn on hit (4 Burn on Heads Hit at Threadspin Ⅱ or below). It becomes an extra damage source for Burn teams.
messages.威力の伸び: マッチ威力は解析Ⅲで18~24、解析Ⅳで18~28。必要資源が憤怒: **Power growth**: Clash Power is 18–24 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 18–28 at Threadspin Ⅳ. Its requirements are a light 2 Wrath and 2 Lust, making it easy to use even on battlefields with limited resources.
messages.パッシブ「芸術」: 前のターンに倒した敵1体につき、被ダメージと与ダメージが5%: **Passive — Art**: For each enemy she defeated on the previous turn, damage taken and dealt increase by 5%. It suits regular battles where enemies fall easily, but damage taken also rises, so watch out for hits.
messages.単体ボスや混乱区間に入る直前の敵に撃ち、脆弱が乗る次のターンに味方全員で攻める。: Use it on a single boss or an enemy about to hit its Stagger Threshold, then have the whole team attack on the next turn while Fragile is active.
messages.自分の火力より、味方の攻勢を強める目的で使う。: Use it to strengthen allies' offense rather than for her own damage.
messages.初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無く。: As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.罪悪耐性は暴食と嫉妬が脆弱なので、弱点を突かれやすい点に注意。: Its Sin resistances are Fatal to Gluttony and Envy, so be aware that she is easy to hit for weakness damage.
messages.Ⅱ: 「芸術」が解放されるだけで、スキルは変わらない。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks Art; the skill does not change.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が14から18になり、的中時の火傷6と、表面的中時の脆弱1が加わる: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises from 14 to 18, and 6 Burn on hit and 1 Fragile on Heads Hit are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+6から+10になり、的中時にも脆弱1が付く。上げる価値が最も: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power rises from +6 to +10, and 1 Fragile is also applied on hit. This is likely the most worthwhile upgrade.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、「対象の火傷が6以上」で強化される効: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0407)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and she has effects that power up when the target has at least 6 Burn, which meshes with this E.G.O's 6 Burn. She also supplies Wrath and Lust resources.
messages.りょ・ミ・パ厨房長: S1(憤怒)とS3(色欲)で必要資源の憤怒・色欲を出せ、S: **[R.B. Chef de Cuisine](persona:0404)**: S1 (Wrath) and S3 (Lust) supply the required Wrath and Lust, and S3's damage grows with the HP the target has lost.
messages.火傷を溜めた敵ほどダメージが伸びる、攻撃加重値3の斬撃広域で、4つ目のスキルを強: A 3-Attack-Weight multi-target Slash E.G.O whose damage grows against enemies with more Burn, and whose passive, which boosts her fourth skill, keeps providing damage afterward (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ).
messages.火傷によるダメージ増加: 攻撃対象に火傷があれば威力+2。全攻撃対象の火傷の合計: **Damage from Burn**: +2 Power if a target has Burn. +5% damage per 1 total Burn on all targets, up to 100%. Its Clash Power is 21–37 from Threadspin Ⅲ, high for 6 resources.
messages.火傷付与と憤怒ダメージ: 的中時に火傷4を付与し、対象の火傷威力に応じて憤怒ダメ: **Burn and Wrath damage**: Inflicts 4 Burn on hit and adds Wrath damage based on the target's Burn Potency (Burn Potency×2% of final damage, up to 20%).
messages.敵討伐の見返り: 敵を倒すと次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る。広域で複数体を倒せ: **Reward for defeating enemies**: Defeating an enemy grants 2 Attack Power Up next turn. Defeating several with the multi-target attack likely stacks it accordingly.
messages.パッシブ「四本目のマッチの火」: 4つ目に使用するスキルの最終威力+4と的中ごと: **Passive — 4th Match Flame**: The fourth skill she uses gains +4 Final Power and 4 Burn per hit. If that skill is Wrath, it gains damage based on the Burn Potency of all targets, and if it is an E.G.O skill, it restores SP on the first Coin toss (for Plus Coins).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 覚醒より高威力の破壊不能コインで、減算型。敵を倒せないと火傷10を: **Corrosion skill**: A Minus Coin skill with Unbreakable Coins and higher power than Awakening. If it fails to defeat an enemy, she takes 10 Burn herself, so it is heavy to handle.
messages.火傷を溜めた複数の敵に撃つ。広域なので通常戦闘でも単体ボスでも使える。: Use it on multiple enemies with built-up Burn. Being multi-target, it works in both regular battles and against single bosses.
messages.使用後にパッシブが有効になるので、早めに一度撃っておく。: The passive becomes active after use, so fire it once early.
messages.スロット増加などで1ターンに動く回数が多いほど、4つ目のスキルを作りやすい。: The more actions she takes per turn, such as with extra slots, the easier it is to line up a fourth skill.
messages.4つ目に憤怒のE.G.O(三千大世界など)を当てると、パッシブの効果が重なる。: Landing a Wrath E.G.O (such as Great Trichiliocosm) as the fourth skill stacks the passive's effects.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、討伐時の攻撃威力増加も2に強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and strengthens the Attack Power Up on kills to 2.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、火傷に応じたダメージ増加が付く。多用するなら目標の段: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and the Burn-based damage increase is added. This is the target level if you use it often.
messages.Ⅴ: ダメージ増加の判定が全攻撃対象の火傷合計になり、憤怒ダメージが加わる。パッ: **Ⅴ**: The damage increase checks the total Burn on all targets, and Wrath damage is added. The passive gains extra effects for Wrath skills and E.G.O skills, and the Corrosion skill gains Unbreakable Coins.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 火傷・出血を付与するスキルを持ち、S2(傲慢)とS3(憤怒)で必: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Has skills that inflict Burn and Bleed, and S2 (Pride) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities. She can increase her number of actions, for example by gaining slots when allies die, so the passive is likely easy to cycle.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、憤怒のS2・ガードで必要資源の憤怒も: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0407)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and her Wrath S2 and Guard supply the required Wrath.
messages.当てた敵に束縛と加算コイン弱化を残して次のターンのマッチを有利にする、軽い資源の: A low-cost Lust Slash E.G.O that leaves Bind and Plus Coin Drop on the target, tilting the next turn's Clashes in your favor.
messages.束縛の付与: 的中時に次のターンに束縛3を付与する。敵の速度が下がり、マッチを取: **Inflicting Bind**: Inflicts 3 Bind next turn on hit. The enemy's Speed drops, making Clashes easier to win.
messages.加算コイン弱化: 対象にすでに束縛3以上があれば、次のターンに加算コイン弱化1も: **Plus Coin Drop**: If the target already has 3 or more Bind, also inflicts 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn. It assumes using it twice in a row or another source of Bind.
messages.斬撃脆弱: 解析Ⅲから、対象の速度が自分より遅いと次のターンに斬撃脆弱2を付与す: **Slash Fragility**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 2 Slash Fragility next turn if the target is slower than her.
messages.パッシブ「蜘蛛の糸」: マッチに勝つたび、次のターンに束縛1を付与する(1ターン: **Passive — Spider's Webs**: Each Clash Win inflicts 1 Bind next turn, up to 3 times per turn. Active from the turn after use until the end of the battle.
messages.広域化: 解析Ⅳで攻撃加重値が3になり、複数の敵や部位にまとめてデバフを撒ける。: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight becomes 3 at Threadspin Ⅳ, letting it spread debuffs across several enemies or parts.
messages.自分のダメージより、次のターンのマッチを楽にするために撃つ。: Use it to make the next turn's Clashes easier rather than for her own damage.
messages.強い敵のスキルが来る前のターンに撃っておき、束縛と加算コイン弱化で威力を下げさせ: Fire it on the turn before a strong enemy skill arrives so Bind and Plus Coin Drop lower its power.
messages.必要資源は色欲2・暴食2・嫉妬1。侵蝕スキルは敵味方を問わずランダムに攻撃するの: It requires 2 Lust, 2 Gluttony, and 1 Envy. The Corrosion skill attacks friend and foe at random, so just keep in mind that allies can also receive Bind.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、速度の遅い敵への斬撃脆弱が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and adds Slash Fragility against slower enemies.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、広域化する。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, making it multi-target.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::赤眼･懺悔: 赤眼・懺悔が15以上でS3が「ガチでドタマ: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Red Eyes & Penitence](persona:0410)**: When Red Eyes and Penitence reach 15 or more and S3 becomes Serious Skullbuster, it inflicts 3 Bind next turn, meeting the Plus Coin Drop condition. She also supplies Lust and Envy resources.
messages.りょ・ミ・パ厨房長: S2が的中時に次のターンへ束縛を付与し、S3(色欲)で必要: **[R.B. Chef de Cuisine](persona:0404)**: S2 inflicts Bind next turn on hit, and S3 (Lust) supplies the required affinity. Reaching 3 Bind likely requires combining it with other sources.
messages.自分より遅い敵をまとめて斬り、混乱させるか倒すと回復も得られる、嫉妬の斬撃広域E: A multi-target Envy Slash E.G.O that cuts down enemies slower than her and heals when it staggers or defeats them.
messages.速度差のボーナス: メインターゲットの速度が自分より3以上遅いと、コイン威力+4: **Speed-difference bonus**: +4 Coin Power (+7 at Threadspin Ⅳ) if the main target is at least 3 Speed slower than her. Little benefit against fast enemies.
messages.束縛によるダメージ増加: 的中時、対象に束縛が3以上あればダメージ量+20%(解: **Damage from Bind**: On hit, +20% damage (40% at Threadspin Ⅳ) if the target has at least 3 Bind. Another source is needed to inflict 3 Bind.
messages.回復(解析Ⅲ): このスキルで対象を混乱させるか倒すと、体力が最も低い味方1名と: **Healing (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Staggering or defeating a target with this skill heals the 1 ally with the lowest HP and herself by 10% of max HP.
messages.パッシブ「捕食」: そのターンに体力最大値の10%より多く回復していれば、次のタ: **Passive — Predator**: If she healed more than 10% of her max HP that turn, she gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.嫉妬の確保: 良秀の嫉妬属性のE.G.Oはこれだけで、嫉妬共鳴に参加する手段にも: **Securing Envy**: This is Ryōshū's only Envy E.G.O, so it also gives her a way to take part in Envy Resonance.
messages.速度で勝てる敵が複数いる場面で撃ち、混乱区間に入った敵を巻き込んで回復を狙う。: Use it when there are several enemies she can outspeed, catching enemies at their Stagger Threshold to aim for the healing.
messages.束縛の条件は、束縛を付ける人格を先に使ったうえで満たせれば加点程度に考える。: Treat the Bind condition as a bonus if it can be met by using Bind Identities first.
messages.「赤眼」で束縛3を付けてからこれを撃つ流れは、資源も精神力も2ターン分かかるため: Applying 3 Bind with Red Eyes and then firing this costs two turns' worth of resources and SP, which is likely not worth it.
messages.侵蝕スキルは減算型でダメージ増加が覚醒より大きいが、扱いは覚醒中心でよい。: The Corrosion skill is a Minus Coin skill with a bigger damage increase than Awakening, but Awakening should be the main choice.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、攻撃加重値が2から3になる。混乱・撃破時の回復が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and Attack Weight from 2 to 3. Adds healing on Stagger and kills.
messages.Ⅳ: 速度差のコイン威力が+7、束縛によるダメージ増加が40%になる。: **Ⅳ**: The speed-difference Coin Power becomes +7, and the Bind-based damage increase becomes 40%.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::赤眼･懺悔: 赤眼・懺悔が15以上でS3が「ガチでドタマ: **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Red Eyes & Penitence](persona:0410)**: When Red Eyes and Penitence reach 15 or more and S3 becomes Serious Skullbuster, it inflicts 3 Bind and heals HP. She also supplies Lust and Envy resources.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: 速度差でマッチ威力が伸びるスキルが多く、S1(色欲: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: Many of her skills gain Clash Power from Speed difference, and S1 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities. Her S3 also inflicts 1 Bind on hit.
messages.沈潜6と振動4を広域に付与しつつ、味方へ資源獲得量+を配って資源を回す、憂鬱貫通: A Gloom Pierce E.G.O that spreads 6 Sinking and 4 Tremor across targets while handing E.G.O Resource Amp to allies to keep resources flowing (assumes Threadspin Ⅴ).
messages.状態異常の付与: 的中時に振動4と沈潜6を付与する。威力そのものは低めで、沈潜・: **Inflicting status effects**: Inflicts 4 Tremor and 6 Sinking on hit. Its own power is lowish, so use it as support for Sinking and Tremor teams.
messages.資源獲得量+の配布: 攻撃後、次のターンに自分を含むランダムな味方2名+最大共鳴: **Distributing Resource Amp**: After the attack, gives 1 E.G.O Resource Amp next turn to 2 random allies including herself plus a number of allies equal to the highest Resonance, up to 7. +1 Attack Weight at a Resonance of 4 or more.
**Reaction to Stagger**: If any target is staggered or panicking, she gains 1 of the E.G.O resource she holds the least of and recovers 3 SP. +40% damage against enemies below 25% HP.
messages.討伐時の見返り: 敵を倒すと保有中の資源のうちランダムな1属性を3つ得て、全味方: **Reward for defeating enemies**: Defeating an enemy grants 3 of one random affinity among the resources she holds and restores 3 SP to all allies.
messages.パッシブ「蓋の開いた飲料」: 沈潜5以上の敵への的中で守備威力減少1(1ターン最: **Passive — Opened Can**: Hitting an enemy with at least 5 Sinking inflicts 1 Defense Power Down, up to 5 times per turn. Hitting a staggered or panicking enemy grants 1 Offense Level Up next turn, up to 3 times per turn.
messages.資源に余裕のない場面で、先に撃って味方の資源獲得を増やす。: When resources are tight, fire it first to increase allies' resource gain.
messages.必要資源は暴食2・傲慢2・嫉妬2。沈潜編成では暴食が足りにくいと考えられるので、: It requires 2 Gluttony, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy. Sinking teams likely run short on Gluttony, so pair it with Identities who can supply Gluttony.
messages.侵蝕スキルは破壊不能コインで、全味方に資源獲得量+1と次のターンのクイック1を付: The Corrosion skill has Unbreakable Coins and gives all allies 1 Resource Amp and 1 Haste next turn.
messages.Ⅲ: 沈潜が5になり、討伐時に全味方の精神力が回復する。: **Ⅲ**: Sinking becomes 5, and defeating enemies restores SP to all allies.
messages.Ⅳ: 沈潜が6になり、攻撃加重値が2で広域化する。侵蝕スキルにクイック付与が加わ: **Ⅳ**: Sinking becomes 6, and Attack Weight becomes 2 for multi-target attacks. The Corrosion skill gains Haste infliction.
messages.Ⅴ: 振動付与、資源獲得量+の配布、混乱時の資源・精神力回復、体力25%未満への: **Ⅴ**: Adds Tremor infliction, Resource Amp distribution, resource and SP recovery on Stagger, the damage increase against enemies below 25% HP, and the passive's Offense Level Up.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::残香・寂しさ: 沈潜と振動を軸にした人格で、S2(嫉妬): **[Lobotomy E.G.O:: Faint Aroma & Solitude](persona:0414)**: An Identity built around Sinking and Tremor whose S2 (Envy) also supplies the required Envy.
messages.20区ユロージヴィ: S3(暴食)で不足しやすい暴食を出せ、振動を付与して振動爆: **[District 20 Yurodivy](persona:0409)**: Her S3 (Gluttony) supplies the often-lacking Gluttony, and she inflicts Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.傲慢スキルのクリティカル的中で呼吸を伸ばしつつ、呼吸と充電を相互に稼ぐ、傲慢斬撃: A multi-target Pride Slash E.G.O that extends Poise through Critical Hits with Pride skills while earning Poise and Charge from each other.
messages.呼吸の獲得: 攻撃前に呼吸4を得る。解析Ⅲから、的中した対象のうち死亡した数だけ: **Gaining Poise**: Gains 4 Poise before attacking. From Threadspin Ⅲ, gains 2 more Poise for each target hit that died.
messages.充電の獲得: 的中時に充電回数が2増え、クリティカル的中時にさらに自分の充電回数: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases by 2 on hit, and her own Charge Count increases by 2 more on Critical Hit.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 充電回数を2ずつ消耗して呼吸1を得る(最大10)。解析Ⅳでは呼吸1: **Corrosion skill**: Spends 2 Charge Count at a time to gain 1 Poise, up to 10. At Threadspin Ⅳ, a Critical Hit with 10 or more Poise gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.パッシブ「夢を貪る」: 傲慢属性のスキルでクリティカル的中するたび、呼吸回数が1: **Passive — Dream Devouring**: Each Critical Hit with a Pride skill increases Poise Count by 1, up to 3 times per turn. Active from the turn after use until the end of the battle.
messages.広域化: 攻撃加重値が解析Ⅲで2、解析Ⅳで3になり、複数の敵に当てて呼吸を稼ぎや: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight becomes 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 3 at Ⅳ, making it easier to hit several enemies and earn Poise.
messages.呼吸を主軸にする人格の編成で、呼吸の補充と、傲慢スキルのクリティカルを狙う手段と: In teams built around Poise Identities, slot it in to top up Poise and to aim for Critical Hits with Pride skills.
messages.撃破が絡むと呼吸の伸びが大きいので、複数体に当てられる場面で使う。: Poise grows a lot when kills are involved, so use it when it can hit multiple enemies.
messages.火力・充電・呼吸のどれも控えめなので、呼吸と充電の両方を扱う編成でないと持ち味が: Its damage, Charge, and Poise are all modest, so it likely struggles to shine outside teams that use both Poise and Charge.
messages.必要資源は憂鬱2・傲慢2・嫉妬2。: It requires 2 Gloom, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy.
messages.Ⅲ: 攻撃加重値が2になり、撃破時の呼吸が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Attack Weight becomes 2, and Poise on kills is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、侵蝕スキルにクリティカルダメージ増加が付く。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and the Corrosion skill gains the Critical damage increase.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: 傲慢のS2は戦闘開始時に呼吸回数を消耗して攻撃加重: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: Her Pride S2 spends Poise Count at Combat Start to increase Attack Weight, and Critical Hits with Pride skills make the passive easy to trigger.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: S2(傲慢)が的中時に呼吸を得て、パッシブ「残像反響」でクリティ: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Her S2 (Pride) gains Poise on hit, and the passive Afterimage Reverberation boosts Critical Hits. She also supplies Pride resources.
messages.最大共鳴数に応じて攻撃加重値と与ダメージが伸びる、出血を撒く色欲斬撃の広域E.G: A multi-target Lust Slash E.G.O that spreads Bleed and whose Attack Weight and damage grow with the highest Resonance (requires 14 resources in total).
messages.共鳴で広域化: 攻撃加重値が最大共鳴数だけ増える(上限は解析Ⅱで2、Ⅲで4、Ⅳで: **Multi-target through Resonance**: Attack Weight increases by the highest Resonance, capped at 2 at Threadspin Ⅱ, 4 at Ⅲ, and 6 at Ⅳ. The more Resonance the team can build, the wider it hits.
messages.軽蔑の視線: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+1)だけ得て、1につき与ダメージ+7%(最大: **Gaze of Contempt**: Before attacking, she gains (highest Resonance + 1), with +7% damage dealt per point, up to 7. At Threadspin Ⅳ, she gains it across this turn and the next.
messages.出血の付与: 攻撃後に、攻撃対象へ出血10(解析Ⅲは15)を均等に分けて付与する: **Inflicting Bleed**: After the attack, inflicts 10 Bleed (15 at Threadspin Ⅲ) divided evenly among the targets.
messages.代償: 使用後の2ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10ずつ減る。マッチ威力も低めな: **Cost**: For 2 turns after use, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End. Its Clash Power is also lowish, so push it through as a one-sided attack or pick Clashes it can win.
messages.パッシブ「視線の痕跡」: 敵への基本攻撃スキルを使うたび、そのスキル以外の属性で: **Passive — Mark of the Gaze**: Each time she uses a basic attack skill on an enemy, she gains 1 of the resource she holds the least of, excluding that skill's affinity, 2 times per turn.
messages.先に共鳴を作れる編成にし、広い範囲へ一気に撃つ。: Set up a team that can build Resonance first, then fire it across a wide area at once.
messages.解析Ⅳでは、色欲共鳴を作ると保有する基本攻撃スキルと同じ属性の資源が増える。: At Threadspin Ⅳ, building Lust Resonance increases resources of the same affinities as the basic attack skills she holds.
messages.軽蔑の視線が7になると、次のターンは視線の軽蔑(保護7など)に変わる。混乱が避け: When Gaze of Contempt reaches 7, it becomes Contempt of the Gaze (7 Protection and more) next turn. It can shore up her durability when Stagger is unavoidable.
messages.侵蝕スキルは単体向けの単コインで、軽蔑の視線7を確定で得る。: The Corrosion skill is a single-target, single-Coin attack that guarantees 7 Gaze of Contempt.
messages.Ⅲ: 攻撃加重値の上限と出血量が増え、侵蝕スキルの出血ダメージ増加が強まる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the Attack Weight cap and Bleed amount, and strengthens the Corrosion skill's Bleed damage increase.
messages.Ⅳ: 威力と加重値の上限(6)が上がり、軽蔑の視線が2ターンにまたがり、色欲共鳴: **Ⅳ**: Raises power and the Attack Weight cap (6), spreads Gaze of Contempt across 2 turns, and adds resource gain with Lust Resonance. Every upgrade is useful, so it is likely a high priority.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: S1(色欲)・S2(傲慢)・S3(憤怒)が必要資源: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Wrath) match the required affinities, and her Pride S2 increases Attack Weight to become multi-target.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルを持ち、出血・火傷を付与するので、このE: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Has Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills and inflicts Bleed and Burn, making her easy to use alongside this E.G.O's Bleed.
messages.呼吸を溜めてから撃つほど火力が跳ね上がる、傲慢斬撃の広域E.G.Oで、侵蝕では味: A multi-target Pride Slash E.G.O whose damage soars the more Poise she builds before using it; its Corrosion skill benefits from killing allies.
messages.呼吸の置き換え強化: 攻撃前に呼吸と呼吸回数を得るが、呼吸が15以上なら呼吸の代: **Replacement bonuses from Poise**: Before attacking, she gains Poise and Poise Count, but at 15 or more Poise, Final Power rises instead of Poise, and at 5 or more Poise Count, Coin Power rises instead of Count (Final Power scales with the highest Resonance, and the Count side with half of it).
messages.クリティカル強化: Ⅱコインは、呼吸威力と呼吸回数の合計に応じてクリティカルダメ: **Critical bonus**: Coin Ⅱ gains Critical damage based on combined Poise Potency and Count, up to 20% at Threadspin Ⅲ and 40% at Ⅳ. It also grants Deep Inhale on hit.
messages.討伐時: 対象を倒すと次のターンに深い吸気を得る。深い吸気はクリティカル時に呼吸: **On kills**: Defeating a target grants Deep Inhale next turn. Deep Inhale spends Poise Potency on Critical Hits to add Critical damage.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も低い対象を、味方を優先して攻撃する。味方を含むとダメージ: **Corrosion skill**: Attacks the target with the lowest HP, prioritizing allies. +30% damage if allies are included, and from Threadspin Ⅲ, killing an ally restores SP.
messages.パッシブ「息」: 使用の次のターン開始時にネブライザーβ1を得て、敵を倒せばその: **Passive — Breath**: At the start of the turn after use, she gains 1 Nebulizer β, plus 1 for each enemy defeated and 2 for each ally defeated (accumulates during battle, up to 5). At Combat Start on a turn with Pride Absolute Resonance, she and a random ally gain Poise and Poise Count.
messages.呼吸を溜めた状態で、複数の敵に向けて撃つ。2ターン目以降が目安と考えられる。: Fire it at multiple enemies once Poise has built up. Turn 2 or later is likely a good guideline.
messages.共鳴を多く作るほど、強化が最大まで乗りやすい。: The more Resonance you build, the more easily the bonuses reach their maximum.
messages.侵蝕スキルは呼吸が15未満のとき自分の体力を消耗して呼吸を補う。味方を倒す性質上: The Corrosion skill spends her own HP to make up Poise when it is below 15. Because it kills allies, handle it with care outside specific teams.
messages.必要資源は憤怒1・色欲1・傲慢5で、傲慢に偏る。: It requires 1 Wrath, 1 Lust, and 5 Pride, heavily skewed toward Pride.
messages.Ⅲ: 共鳴数による上限が6に、クリティカルダメージ増加と侵蝕スキルの呼吸付与が加: **Ⅲ**: The Resonance-based cap becomes 6, and the Critical damage increase and the Corrosion skill's Poise infliction are added.
messages.Ⅳ: 基本威力が上がり、回数による強化の上限が3になり、クリティカルダメージ増加: **Ⅳ**: Raises Base Power, raises the Count-based bonus cap to 3, and raises the Critical damage increase to up to 40%. The Corrosion skill gains an effect that returns resources.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: S1(色欲)・S2(傲慢)・S3(憤怒)が必要資源: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Wrath) match the required affinities, and she has many skills that build Poise.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルを持ち、呼吸を稼ぐスキルも多い。傲慢の資: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Has Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills and many skills that earn Poise. She supplies Pride resources.
messages.攻撃加重値7・3コインすべて破壊不能の憤怒斬撃で、羅生と火傷・出血・呼吸を乗せて: A heavy-cost multi-target Wrath Slash E.G.O with 7 Attack Weight and 3 all-Unbreakable Coins that stacks Entangled Life with Burn, Bleed, and Poise to wipe out enemies at once.
messages.羅生: 攻撃後に羅生1を得て、与えたスキルダメージ1につき増える(最大999)。: **Entangled Life [羅生]**: She gains 1 Entangled Life after the attack, plus more per skill damage dealt, up to 999. At the start of Coin Ⅲ, she spends all of it for +1% damage per 5, up to 100% (198% at Threadspin Ⅳ). With a single target, the effect is ×1.5 (×2 at Threadspin Ⅳ). In other words, it is stronger from the second use on.
messages.火傷・出血の参照(解析Ⅲ): 全対象の火傷+出血の威力10につきダメージ量+1%: **Using Burn and Bleed (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: +1% damage per 10 combined Burn and Bleed Potency on all targets, up to 30% (50% at Threadspin Ⅳ), and +1 Coin Power per 10 Count, up to 3 (5 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.呼吸の獲得: 攻撃前に最大共鳴数だけ呼吸を得る(最大7)。解析Ⅲから呼吸回数も増: **Gaining Poise**: Before attacking, gains Poise equal to the highest Resonance, up to 7. From Threadspin Ⅲ, Poise Count also increases.
messages.多様な付与: Ⅰコインは火傷、Ⅱコインは出血を付与し、Ⅲコインはクリティカルダメ: **Varied infliction**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Burn, Coin Ⅱ inflicts Bleed, and Coin Ⅲ gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.パッシブ「三途」: 攻撃スキル終了時に敵が混乱か死亡していれば、次のターンにクリ: **Passive — Sanzu [三途]**: If an enemy is staggered or dead at the end of an attack skill, she gains 1 Crit DMG Up next turn, 3 times per turn.
messages.必要資源は憤怒4・色欲4・傲慢4の計12個。通常戦闘の殲滅や、鏡ダンジョンなどの: It requires 12 resources: 4 Wrath, 4 Lust, and 4 Pride. Use it to clear regular battles or in deep runs such as the Mirror Dungeon.
messages.羅生を自力で稼げる人格と組み、1回目から羅生を乗せる。: Pair it with Identities who can earn Entangled Life themselves so it carries Entangled Life from the first use.
messages.使用後の3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10ずつ減るので、精神力の管理が要る。: For 3 turns after use, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End, so SP management is required.
messages.「4本目のマッチの火」を使用済みで、これが4つ目のスキルに当たるなら、そのパッシ: If 4th Match Flame has already been used and this lands as the fourth skill, that passive's extra effects for Wrath skills and E.G.O skills likely apply.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が上がり、束縛1、火傷・出血に応じた強化、攻撃対象が1名のときの羅: **Ⅲ**: Raises Base Power and adds 1 Bind, the Burn- and Bleed-based bonuses, and the Entangled Life amplification for a single target.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力+5になり、羅生を含む各強化の上限が伸びる。: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +5, and the caps on each bonus, including Entangled Life, rise.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀: 天殺で対象を倒すと与えたダメージ分の羅生を得られ、火傷・出血・呼: **[Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415)**: Defeating a target with Tiansha grants Entangled Life equal to the damage dealt; she uses Burn, Bleed, and Poise and supplies Wrath, Pride, and Lust resources.
messages.エドガー家 チーフバトラー: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルで資源を賄え、呼吸を溜める: **[Edgar Family Chief Butler](persona:0408)**: Her Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills cover the resources, and she has many skills that build Poise.
messages.森羅炎象: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、「対象の火傷が6以上」で強化される効果を持つ: **[Forest for the Flames](ego:0401)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and she has effects that power up when the target has at least 6 Burn, which meshes with this E.G.O's 6 Burn. She also supplies Wrath and Lust resources.
messages.森羅炎象: S1(憤怒)とS3(色欲)で必要資源の憤怒・色欲を出せ、S3は対象の: **[Forest for the Flames](ego:0401)**: S1 (Wrath) and S3 (Lust) supply the required Wrath and Lust, and S3's damage grows with the HP the target has lost.
messages.4本目のマッチの火: 火傷・出血を付与するスキルを持ち、S2(傲慢)とS3(憤怒: **[4th Match Flame](ego:0402)**: Has skills that inflict Burn and Bleed, and S2 (Pride) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities. She can increase her number of actions, for example by gaining slots when allies die, so the passive is likely easy to cycle.
messages.4本目のマッチの火: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、憤怒のS2・ガードで必要資源の憤怒: **[4th Match Flame](ego:0402)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and her Wrath S2 and Guard supply the required Wrath.
messages.赤眼: 赤眼・懺悔が15以上でS3が「ガチでドタマを割る」に変化したとき、次のタ: **[Red Eyes](ego:0403)**: When Red Eyes and Penitence reach 15 or more and S3 becomes Serious Skullbuster, it inflicts 3 Bind next turn, meeting the Plus Coin Drop condition. She also supplies Lust and Envy resources.
messages.赤眼: S2が的中時に次のターンへ束縛を付与し、S3(色欲)で必要資源も出せる。: **[Red Eyes](ego:0403)**: S2 inflicts Bind next turn on hit, and S3 (Lust) supplies the required affinity. Reaching 3 Bind likely requires combining it with other sources.
messages.赤眼(開): 赤眼・懺悔が15以上でS3が「ガチでドタマを割る」に変化したとき、: **[Red Eyes (Open)](ego:0404)**: When Red Eyes and Penitence reach 15 or more and S3 becomes Serious Skullbuster, it inflicts 3 Bind and heals HP. She also supplies Lust and Envy resources.
messages.赤眼(開): 速度差でマッチ威力が伸びるスキルが多く、S1(色欲)とS3(憤怒): **[Red Eyes (Open)](ego:0404)**: Many of her skills gain Clash Power from Speed difference, and S1 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities. Her S3 also inflicts 1 Bind on hit.
messages.ソーダ: 沈潜と振動を軸にした人格で、S2(嫉妬)で必要資源の嫉妬も出せる。: **[Soda](ego:0405)**: An Identity built around Sinking and Tremor whose S2 (Envy) also supplies the required Envy.
messages.ソーダ: S3(暴食)で不足しやすい暴食を出せ、振動を付与して振動爆発も起こせる: **[Soda](ego:0405)**: Her S3 (Gluttony) supplies the often-lacking Gluttony, and she inflicts Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.盲目: 傲慢のS2は戦闘開始時に呼吸回数を消耗して攻撃加重値を増やせ、傲慢スキル: **[Blind Obsession](ego:0406)**: Her Pride S2 spends Poise Count at Combat Start to increase Attack Weight, and Critical Hits with Pride skills make the passive easy to trigger.
messages.盲目: S2(傲慢)が的中時に呼吸を得て、パッシブ「残像反響」でクリティカルを伸: **[Blind Obsession](ego:0406)**: Her S2 (Pride) gains Poise on hit, and the passive Afterimage Reverberation boosts Critical Hits. She also supplies Pride resources.
messages.軽蔑、畏敬: S1(色欲)・S2(傲慢)・S3(憤怒)が必要資源の属性と重なり、: **[Contempt, Awe](ego:0407)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Wrath) match the required affinities, and her Pride S2 increases Attack Weight to become multi-target.
**[Contempt, Awe](ego:0407)**: Has Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills and inflicts Bleed and Burn, making her easy to use alongside this E.G.O's Bleed.
messages.胸痛: S1(色欲)・S2(傲慢)・S3(憤怒)が必要資源と重なり、呼吸を溜める: **[Thoracalgia](ego:0408)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Wrath) match the required affinities, and she has many skills that build Poise.
messages.胸痛: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルを持ち、呼吸を稼ぐスキルも多い。傲慢の資源を出せ: **[Thoracalgia](ego:0408)**: Has Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills and many skills that earn Poise. She supplies Pride resources.
messages.三千大世界: 天殺で対象を倒すと与えたダメージ分の羅生を得られ、火傷・出血・呼吸: **[Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0409)**: Defeating a target with Tiansha grants Entangled Life equal to the damage dealt; she uses Burn, Bleed, and Poise and supplies Wrath, Pride, and Lust resources.
messages.三千大世界: 色欲・傲慢・憤怒のスキルで資源を賄え、呼吸を溜めるスキルが多い。: **[Great Trichiliocosm [三千大世界]](ego:0409)**: Her Lust, Pride, and Wrath skills cover the resources, and she has many skills that build Poise.
messages.硬さと遅さ: 防御レベルは人格Lv+3、速度は1〜3と遅い。S2「突き立てる拳」: **Sturdy and slow**: His Defense Level is Identity Lv +3, and his Speed is a slow 1–3. S2 Nailing Fist grants 3 Defense Power Up next turn on use, and S3 Des Coups grants 3 Protection next turn on use, shoring up his own defense.
messages.振動: S1「ワン、ツー」とS3の表面的中で振動を付与し、S3のⅣコインで振動回: **Tremor**: S1 Un, Deux and S3 inflict Tremor on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅳ of S3 increases Tremor Count by 2. S2 triggers Tremor Burst on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「覚悟」(怠惰×2・保有): 戦闘開始時、自分の体力が50%未満な: **Combat passive — Staunchness (2 Sloth Owned)**: At Combat Start, gains 1 Protection if his HP is below 50%.
messages.サポートパッシブ「背中を支える」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる: **Support passive — Backup (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, the 1 ally with the highest max HP takes −10% damage from attack skills.
messages.硬さを活かして攻撃を受け持ち、S2・S3の「次のターン」の守りで被害を抑える。振: Use his durability to take attacks, and limit damage with the next-turn defenses from S2 and S3. He can stack Tremor with S1 and S3 and burst it with S2, but to make the most of Tremor Burst, pair him with allies who inflict plenty of Tremor (such as Ishmael's LCCB Assistant Manager). In backup, his support passive can support the team's tank.
messages.火傷の維持: 火傷はターン終了後に回数が1減る。S3のⅢコインは的中時に火傷回数: **Maintaining Burn**: Burn loses 1 Count after each turn. Coin Ⅲ of S3 increases Burn Count by 3 on hit, extending Burn that is about to run out.
messages.火傷の拡散: S2「震脚」のⅠコインとS3のⅢコインは、対象の火傷が6以上ならラ: **Spreading Burn**: Coin Ⅰ of S2 Stalwart Stance and Coin Ⅲ of S3 also inflict Burn on 2 random enemies if the target has at least 6 Burn. S3 gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Burn Potency.
messages.自力の付与量: S1「突破」の付与は火傷1+1/2と少なく、「火傷6以上」の条件: **His own infliction**: S1 Assault inflicts only 1 + 1/2 Burn, so meeting the 6-Burn condition alone is difficult.
messages.バトルパッシブ「泰山」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメージ時、ランダ: **Combat passive — Great Mountain (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When taking damage, inflicts 1 Burn on a random target, up to 4 times.
messages.サポートパッシブ「摩擦打撃点」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間: **Support passive — Friction Point (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, +1 to the Burn inflicted by the 1 slowest ally.
messages.火傷を付与する味方(同じリウ協会の人格など)と組み、敵の火傷を6以上にしてからS: Pair him with allies who inflict Burn (such as other Liu Association Identities), bring enemy Burn to 6 or more, then spread it with S2 and S3. Hit enemies whose Burn is about to expire with S3 to top up Count, so the team's Burn never lapses.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「切断」の使用時・的中時、守備の戦闘開始時に充電回数が増える。: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases on use and on hit of S1 Rip, and at Combat Start of his Defense skill. S1 also grants Slash Protection on use.
messages.S2「エネルギー循環」: 破裂を付与。Ⅲコイン的中時に充電回数3を消耗して斬撃脆: **S2 — Energy Cycle**: Inflicts Rupture. On Coin Ⅲ hit, spends 3 Charge Count to inflict 2 Slash Fragility.
messages.S3「エネルギー交流」: 各コイン的中時に充電回数2を消耗して防御レベル減少2を: **S3 — Energy Current**: On each Coin hit, spends 2 Charge Count to inflict 2 Defense Level Down (4 Coins).
messages.充電で強化: 充電回数5以上でS2・S3のコイン威力+1。: **Charge bonuses**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power at 5 or more Charge Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「耐え抜く」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメージ時とマ: **Combat passive — Enduring Spirit (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Charge Count increases by 1 when taking damage and on Clash Lose, up to 6 times each.
messages.S1や被弾で充電回数を貯め、S2で斬撃脆弱、S3で防御レベル減少を入れて味方の攻: Build Charge Count through S1 and taking hits, then inflict Slash Fragility with S2 and Defense Level Down with S3 to help allies' attacks land. S3 spends 2 Charge Count per Coin, so spending on all 4 Coins likely requires 8 Charge Count (the behavior when short is unconfirmed).
messages.S3→S2の順で釘5: S2はⅠコインで釘3を付与し、Ⅱコインで次のターンの束縛: **5 Nails via S3 then S2**: S2's Coin Ⅰ inflicts 3 Nails, and Coin Ⅱ inflicts 3 Bind next turn. If the target has at least 5 Nails, it additionally inflicts 2 Bind and 1/2 Attack Power Down. S2 alone cannot reach 5 Nails, so apply "2 Nails next turn" with Coin Ⅰ of S3 on the previous turn.
messages.挑発: S1〜S3は使用時に、次のターンにそのスロットの挑発値が増える(集中戦闘: **Aggro**: On use, S1–S3 increase that slot's Aggro next turn, making him more likely to be targeted in Focused Encounters. His Defense Level is a sturdy Identity Lv +5.
messages.体力50%未満で強化: S1「貫く」はコイン威力+2、守備「愚かなり･･･！」は: **Bonuses below 50% HP**: S1 Drive gains +2 Coin Power, and the Defense skill Foolishness…! gains +2 Final Power.
messages.S3の回復: S3のⅡコインは、的中時に与ダメージの50%分の体力を回復する(対: **S3's healing**: Coin Ⅱ of S3 heals HP equal to 50% of the damage dealt on hit, +3% per Nail on the target.
messages.バトルパッシブ「執念の金槌」(憤怒×4・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時、体: **Combat passive — Obsessive Hammer (4 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, if his HP is below 50%, removes 1 negative effect and grants 1 Fanatic, 1 Attack Power Up, and 3 Protection. It requires both 4 Wrath Resonance and HP below 50%, so it is hard to trigger on purpose.
messages.サポートパッシブ「至上の栄光」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間: **Support passive — Highest Honor (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, the 1 ally below 50% HP with the lowest current HP gains 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Protection (plus 1 Fanatic for N Corp. Fanatics).
messages.初動でS3を当てて釘を仕込み、次のターンにS2で釘5以上の強化デバフを入れる。釘: Open with S3 to plant Nails, then on the next turn use S2 to land the enhanced debuffs at 5 or more Nails. Pairing him with allies who inflict Nails (such as N Corp. Identities) makes S2's condition easier to meet even without S3. In Focused Encounters, draw attacks with Aggro and hold out with his durability and S3's healing.
messages.振動威力の付与: S1「引き受けた業務処理」・S2「強制休憩」・S3「仕上げの加: **Inflicting Tremor Potency**: S1 Saddled Tasks, S2 Forced Break, and S3 Finishing Runup all inflict Tremor. However, none increase Tremor Count, and S3's Coin Ⅳ Tremor Burst actually reduces Tremor Count by 3.
messages.振動回数で強化: 対象の振動回数がS1は5以上でコイン威力+2、S2は7以上で最: **Bonuses from Tremor Count**: S1 gains +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Tremor Count, S2 gains +1 Final Power at 7 or more, and S3 gains +1 Coin Power at 10 or more. These are hard to meet on his own.
messages.S3の充電: Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインの的中で自分の充電回数を増やし、Ⅳコインの振動爆発でそ: **S3's Charge**: Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ increase his own Charge Count on hit, and Coin Ⅳ's Tremor Burst spends all of it to increase the Tremor Burst's Stagger Threshold shift (5% per Charge spent, up to 50%). It builds and spends within a single skill, and he can gain only 5 Charge from Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ himself, so about 25% is a realistic increase.
messages.S2: Ⅱコインで、対象に振動が5以上あれば次のターンに攻撃威力減少1を付与。: **S2**: Coin Ⅱ inflicts 1 Attack Power Down next turn if the target has at least 5 Tremor.
messages.バトルパッシブ「慢性疲労」(憂鬱×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の振動が5以: **Combat passive — Chronic Fatigue (5 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: −1 Clash Power for the target if it has at least 5 Tremor. Heals 5% of his max HP when he recovers from Stagger.
messages.サポートパッシブ「休職勧告」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間、: **Support passive — Leave by Suggestion (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, when the 1 fastest ally Clashes with an enemy that has Tremor, the enemy gets −1 Clash Power.
messages.振動回数を付与できる味方と組み、その振動にこの人格で威力を上乗せしてS3の振動爆: Pair him with allies who can inflict Tremor Count, add Potency on top of that Tremor with this Identity, and aim for Stagger with S3's Tremor Burst. Tremor loses 1 Count after each turn, so he is not suited to building it up across turns by himself.
messages.S3で出血回数を大量付与: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインはそれぞれ的中時に出血回数+1。さらに充: **Mass Bleed Count with S3**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each add +1 Bleed Count on hit. They also spend 2 Charge Count for +1 and 3 Charge Count for +1, so using up 10 Charge gives +6 Bleed Count in total. Coin Power also rises at 10 or more Charge Count.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「重い衝突」は使用時と的中時に計4、S2「壊す」は使用時と的中: **Gaining Charge**: S1 Weighty Bash grants 4 Charge Count in total on use and on hit, and S2 Demolish grants 8 in total on use and on hit. The Defense skill Bioelectricity Induction grants Charge Count when he takes damage while he has Shield.
messages.硬さと挑発: 防御レベルは人格Lv+5。バトルパッシブ「rrR-#4スーツ加圧稼: **Durability and Aggro**: His Defense Level is Identity Lv +5. Through the combat passive Activate rrR-#4 Suit Pressurization (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), his rightmost slot gains +3 Aggro if he has at least 5 Charge Count at Turn Start.
messages.速度強化(おまけ): 同じパッシブで、ターン終了時に充電回数5につき次のターンの: **Speed boost (minor)**: The same passive grants +2 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Charge Count at Turn End, up to 6. At 7 or more Speed, S1 deals +25% damage and S2 adds +1 Bleed Count. However, his base Speed is a slow 2–5, so it is hard to achieve on purpose.
messages.サポートパッシブ「機動訓練」(嫉妬×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間、: **Support passive — Maneuver Training (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, at Turn End, the 1 ally with the highest Charge Count gains +1 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Charge Count, up to 3.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を10以上貯め、S3で出血回数を一気に増やして、出血を扱う味: Build 10 or more Charge Count with S1 and S2, then use S3 to raise Bleed Count all at once, laying the groundwork for Bleed allies' damage. His high Defense Level and Aggro let him take attacks while building Charge.
messages.両隣の強化: S2「義理の鎖」は戦闘開始時、操作パネルの両隣の味方へ嫉妬威力増加: **Buffing both neighbors**: At Combat Start, S2 Chains of Loyalty gives 1 Envy Power Up to the allies on both sides of him on the dashboard (plus 1 Envy DMG Up if that slot's skill is Envy). Placing him where he has allies on both sides makes the most of it.
messages.精神力の回復: バトルパッシブ「義理」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得)により、: **SP recovery**: Through the combat passive Loyalty (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), while another Middle Identity is alive, he restores 6 SP to himself and the 1 Middle Identity with the lowest SP at Turn End.
messages.サポートパッシブ「一家」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間、精神: **Support passive — One Family (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, if the 1 ally with the lowest SP has a living character from the same affiliation, that ally recovers 10 SP at Turn End.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で強化: S3「刻む」と守備「倍返し」は嫉妬共鳴4以上でコイン威力+1。: **Envy Resonance bonuses**: S3 Recording and the Defense skill Multifold Retribution gain +1 Coin Power at 4 or more Envy Resonance. S3 gains +1 more at a highest Envy Absolute Resonance of 6 or more. However, S3 itself is Wrath, so it does not count toward Envy Resonance.
messages.仕返し対象: 「義理」により、ターン終了時、そのターンに味方へスキルで最も多くダ: **Vengeance Mark**: Through Loyalty, at Turn End, it is applied to the 1 enemy that dealt the most skill damage to allies that turn. +1 Final Power if the main target has Vengeance Mark. S3 inflicts Plus Coin Drop (Coin Ⅰ) and Envy Fragility (Coin Ⅲ) for the next turn on targets with Vengeance Mark.
messages.中指所属の味方と組み、S2で両隣の味方を強化しながら、パッシブで味方の精神力を支: Pair him with Middle allies, buffing both neighbors with S2 while his passive supports allies' SP. Even when he is not deployed, his support passive restores SP for teams built around a shared affiliation.
messages.肉斬骨断: S3「肉斬」はマッチに負けると、被ダメージ後に特殊反撃「骨断」を使う: **Yield My Flesh, To Claim Their Bones**: When S3 Yield My Flesh loses its Clash, he uses the special counter To Claim Their Bones after taking damage (on a win, he only gains 5 Poise). He cannot be staggered during use. To Claim Their Bones is a 4-Coin counter whose Attack Weight grows with Poise (depending on Uptie, +1 at 10 or more Poise, or +1 per 7 Poise, up to 2). +100% damage against a single target. Coin Ⅳ inflicts 3 Bleed and 5 Paralyze next turn on hit.
messages.呼吸の獲得: S1「抜剣」・S2「刺法」は使用時に呼吸回数を増やし、コインの的中: **Gaining Poise**: S1 Draw of the Sword and S2 Acupuncture increase Poise Count on use and grant Poise on Coin hits. The higher his Poise Potency, the more Critical damage Yield My Flesh and To Claim Their Bones deal.
messages.バトルパッシブ「本国剣術」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時、自分: **Combat passive — Swordplay of the Homeland (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, gives Swordplay of the Homeland (skill bonuses based on Poise) to Blade Lineage members other than himself. Each time he gains Poise, the 2 Blade Lineage Identities with no Poise or the least Poise also gain 1 Poise Potency and Count. He survives one hit that would bring his HP to 0, once per battle.
messages.伝授: S1・S2は戦闘開始時、自分以外の剣契組織員(最大完全共鳴数の人数)へ、: **Instruction**: At Combat Start, S1 and S2 give Blade Lineage members other than himself (as many as the highest Absolute Resonance) an Instruction effect that raises the Final Power of their S1 and S2 that turn.
messages.剣契所属の味方と組み、毎ターン傲慢の共鳴3を作ってパッシブを維持する。S1・S2: Pair him with Blade Lineage allies and build 3 Pride Resonance every turn to keep the passive active. Build Poise with S1 and S2, and throw S3 into Clashes he can afford to lose to chain into To Claim Their Bones. Against a single strong enemy, To Claim Their Bones gains +100% damage.
messages.攻撃レベル減少: S2「打ち落とす」のⅡコイン的中時(対象の破裂6/4以上)、S: **Offense Level Down**: Inflicts 2 Offense Level Down on Coin Ⅱ hit of S2 Smackdown (if the target has at least 6/4 Rupture) and on Clash Win with S3 Relentless. Coin Ⅳ of S3 also inflicts 2 Offense Level Down next turn if the target has at least 6 Rupture, helping allies' Clashes as well.
messages.破裂で強化: S1「バットで殴る」は対象の破裂5以上、S2・S3は6以上でコイン: **Rupture bonuses**: S1 Bat Strike gains Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Rupture, and S2 and S3 at 6 or more. S3 gains +1 Clash Power at 3 or more Rupture.
messages.破裂回数は他頼み: 破裂回数を増やせるのはS2のマッチ勝利時(+2)だけで、破裂: **Relies on others for Rupture Count**: His only way to increase Rupture Count is S2's Clash Win (+2), and Rupture loses 1 Count each time the bearer is attacked.
messages.バトルパッシブ「時間稼ぎ」(暴食×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 破裂を持つ対象と: **Combat passive — Buy Time (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 Clash Power in Clashes against targets with Rupture, or +2 if the target has at least 5 Rupture Count.
messages.サポートパッシブ「俺が責任を取る」(暴食×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにい: **Support passive — My Responsibility (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, when the 1 fastest ally lands an attack on an enemy with at least 6/3 Rupture, inflicts 1 Offense Level Down, up to 3 per enemy per turn.
messages.破裂の威力・回数を付与する味方と組み、破裂のある敵とのマッチをパッシブで勝ちにい: Pair him with allies who inflict Rupture Potency and Count, and use his passive to win Clashes against enemies with Rupture. Stack Offense Level Down with S2 and S3 to weaken enemy attacks.
messages.知識鍛錬の配布: S2「学びの時間」は戦闘開始時、ランダムな味方1/2名と自分へ: **Distributing Erudition**: At Combat Start, S2 Moment of Erudition gives Erudition equal to his Insight to 1/2 random allies and himself, prioritizing allies with Discard skills who have low Erudition. Identities with Erudition gain Shield equal to (Erudition×1.5)% of max HP when they discard a skill, once per turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「自律学習指示」(憂鬱×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分以外の味: **Combat passive — Study Hall (2 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time an ally other than himself discards a skill, gives 1 Erudition to that ally and himself, once per skill and 3 times per turn. At Turn End, he gains Pierce and Blunt DMG Up next turn equal to the number of allies who discarded skills, up to 3.
messages.スキルを捨てる: S1「学業精進」は最もランクの低いスキル1つ、S2は2つ、守備: **Discarding skills**: On use, S1 Studious Dedication discards the lowest-rank skill, S2 discards 2 such skills, and the Defense skill Fixated Study discards the highest-rank skill. Insight becomes the rank of the last discarded skill. He also gains Shield when S1 itself is discarded. He gains his own Erudition on S1 Clash Win (once per turn) and at Combat Start of S2.
messages.S3「知識全焼」: 攻撃前に知識鍛錬を全て消耗して探求した知識を増やし、Ⅲコイン: **S3 — Scorch Knowledge**: Before attacking, spends all Erudition to increase Insight, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts a random split of Sinking Potency and Sinking Count totaling his Insight. After the attack, if Insight is 4 or more, it returns to 1 (or 3 if this skill defeated an enemy).
messages.サポートパッシブ「誠実な学び」(憂鬱×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいる間: **Support passive — Diligent Learning (5 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, when the 1 ally with the highest max HP discards a skill, they gain Shield based on the discarded skill's rank, once per turn.
messages.スキルを捨てる味方(ディエーチ協会の人格など)と組み、S2とパッシブで知識鍛錬を: Pair him with allies who discard skills (such as Dieci Association Identities), cycling Erudition through S2 and his passive to limit allies' damage taken with Shield. He discards S1 to gain Shield while building Erudition through S1 Clash Wins and S2, then converts it into Sinking and damage with S3.
messages.呼吸→クイック→速度差: バトルパッシブ「決闘生放送」(傲慢×2・暴食×2・保有: **Poise→Haste→Speed difference**: Through the combat passive Duel Livestream (2 Pride and 2 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Haste next turn at Turn End for every 3 Poise Potency, up to 2. He gains Poise from Coin Ⅱ of S2 Fente (2 Poise) and on Clash Win with S3 Salut (5 Poise).
messages.速度差で強化: S1「アレ」は速度差3につきコイン威力+1(最大2)、S2・守備: **Speed-difference bonuses**: S1 Allez gains +1 Coin Power per 3 Speed difference, up to 2, and S2 and the Defense skill Défensive gain Coin Power at a difference of 3 or more. S3 gains +1 Coin Power per 2 Speed difference, up to 3.
messages.破裂の維持: S1〜S3は、対象の破裂が15かつ破裂回数が3以上なら、的中時に破: **Maintaining Rupture**: If the target has 15 Rupture and at least 3 Rupture Count, S1–S3 do not consume Rupture Count on hit (S1 and S2 instead inflict no Rupture). In that case, S2 gains Critical damage equal to the amount it did not inflict.
messages.集中攻撃-ムルソー(おまけ): 基本攻撃スキルが当たると次のターンに付与する。S: **Focused Attack - Meursault (minor)**: Applied next turn when his basic attack skills hit. Coin Ⅲ of S3 deals more damage per Focused Attack, and defeating an enemy with that Coin reuses S3 once. However, it requires attacking the same slot repeatedly, so it is hard to pull off on purpose.
messages.サポートパッシブ「もう1歩素早く」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにい: **Support passive — One Step Ahead (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, the 1 fastest ally gains 1 Haste next turn on Clash Win, twice per turn.
messages.S3はマッチ勝利で呼吸5を得られるので、マッチで勝てる相手に当てる。呼吸を貯めて: S3 grants 5 Poise on Clash Win, so throw it at opponents it can beat. Build Poise, create Speed differences with Haste, and fight with enhanced S1–S3. In Rupture teams, he also serves to maintain the Rupture applied by allies.
messages.猛虎標弾への切り替え: 最初は虎標弾12発を持つ。戦闘で初めて守備スキルを装着す: **Switching to Savage Tigermark Rounds**: He starts with 12 Tigermark Rounds. The first time in a battle he equips a Defense skill, runs out of Tigermark Rounds, or is staggered, he loads 8 Savage Tigermark Rounds at the end of that turn and gains Tiantui Star [天退星] (once per battle; any remaining Tigermark Rounds disappear). Equipping a Defense skill lets him switch without waiting to fire off all Tigermark Rounds.
messages.猛虎標弾の間の強さ: バトルパッシブ「天退星刀」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Strength while on Savage Tigermark Rounds**: Through the combat passive Tiantui Star's Blade [天退星刀] (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), all Coins of his basic attack skills become Unbreakable while he has at least 1 Savage Tigermark Round. Coins that spend Savage Tigermark Rounds gain +2 Coin Power, +30% damage, and +2 Burn inflicted. S3 becomes the 5-Coin Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades [超絕猛虎殺擊亂斬], which uses 3 Savage Tigermark Rounds per use.
messages.弾数の管理: 猛虎標弾の最後の1発を撃つ基本攻撃スキルは、攻撃加重値+2になる。: **Ammo management**: The basic attack skill that fires the last Savage Tigermark Round gains +2 Attack Weight. The Defense skill I'm Burning Up. uses no ammo. Adjust the ammo spent by other skills so the enhanced S3 fires the last rounds.
messages.オーバーヒート(避けたい状態): 猛虎標弾を撃ち切った次のターンに得る。速度は上: **Overheat (a state to avoid)**: Gained on the turn after firing off all Savage Tigermark Rounds. His Speed rises, but his basic attack skills lose Clash Power equal to (total rounds spent ÷ 2), up to 10. It is a major weakening, so keep it from overlapping with a boss's critical phase.
messages.振動と火傷: 各スキルで振動と火傷を付与し、S3は振動-灼熱へ変換して振動爆発す: **Tremor and Burn**: Each skill inflicts Tremor and Burn, and S3 converts into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst. If ammo was spent, an additional Tremor Burst is triggered.
messages.序盤に守備を装着して猛虎標弾に切り替え、破壊不能コインと強化S3で一気に攻める。: Equip a Defense skill early to switch to Savage Tigermark Rounds, then attack hard with Unbreakable Coins and the enhanced S3. There are only 8 Savage Tigermark Rounds, so allocate them so the enhanced S3 uses up the last rounds, and time Overheat to match the flow of battle.
messages.硬血甲冑を5に保つ: 硬血甲冑(最大5)は、攻撃終了時に体力ダメージを受けると1: **Keeping Hardblood Armor at 5**: Hardblood Armor (maximum 5) decreases by 1 when he takes HP damage at the end of an attack. With Lust Resonance, it does not decrease (but healing is halved instead). The counter Coagulation grants 1 Hardblood Armor on Clash Win, twice per turn. If his Hardblood Armor is 5, S3 activates as Ouvertüre.
messages.「ウヴェルテューレ」: 攻撃加重値3。自分以外の味方(最大共鳴数の人数)へ硬血甲: **Ouvertüre**: 3 Attack Weight. Gives 2 Hardblood Armor (+1 with Lust Resonance) to allies other than himself, as many as the highest Resonance, and applies La Mancha Parade. After the attack, he spends all of his Hardblood Armor.
messages.演技集中: 常時パッシブ「王子であった者がすべきこと」により、ターン開始時、硬血: **Focused Performance**: Through the always-active passive Responsibility of a Former Prince, at Turn Start, La Manchaland Identities with maximum Hardblood Armor gain 1 Focused Performance. When such an Identity is staggered by damage, it spends all Hardblood Armor to recover from Stagger, once per stage per Identity.
messages.硬血甲冑の配布: S1「行進指揮」・S2「再建の義務」は、血餐を最大10消耗して: **Distributing Hardblood Armor**: S1 March Conductor and S2 Responsibility to Rebuild spend up to 10 Bloodfeast to give Hardblood Armor to himself and 1 ally (+1 for La Manchaland members). Bloodfeast accumulates from the Bleed damage taken by all characters.
messages.バトルパッシブ「「血をまとい、仮面を被り、血を命ずるがままに」」(色欲×3・傲慢: **Combat passive — 'Bloodied, Masked, and as Blood Commands' (3 Lust and 3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, he gains Offense and Defense Level Up with 3 or more Hardblood Armor, and Haste for the next turn with 4 or more. With Focused Performance, landing attacks applies La Mancha Parade.
messages.色欲の共鳴を作って自分の硬血甲冑を減らさないようにし、S1・S2・反撃で5まで育: Build Lust Resonance so his Hardblood Armor does not decrease, grow it to 5 with S1, S2, and his counter, then fire Ouvertüre. Hand out Armor to La Manchaland allies so they gain Focused Performance. Paired with Rodion's The Princess of La Manchaland, both of their S3s deal +15% damage.
messages.胞子で火傷回数を供給: 胞子弾を消耗するコインの的中時に胞子を付与する([基本]: **Supplying Burn Count with Spore**: Coins that spend Spore Rounds inflict Spore on hit ([Basic] 2, [Buckshot] 3). Spore (maximum 15) increases Burn Count by 1 per 5 at Turn End. S2 E.G.O Alteration - Buckshot and Coin Ⅳ of S3 also directly increase Burn Count on hit.
messages.S2は広域の始動役: 攻撃加重値2で、[散弾]のコインで胞子3ずつを撒く(サブタ: **S2 is the multi-target starter**: 2 Attack Weight, and its [Buckshot] Coins spread 3 Spore each (damage to sub-targets is −50%).
messages.S3は単体で強い: 攻撃加重値より攻撃対象が少ないと、1名につきダメージ量+50: **S3 is strong against single targets**: +50% damage for each target fewer than its Attack Weight. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ only hit 1 target. Coin Ⅳ is Unbreakable; if it hits without being broken and the target's Spore is at maximum, it deals (Burn Potency × Spore ÷ 10) Wrath damage and removes the Spore.
messages.弾の再装填: S2は攻撃後に基本弾が1以下なら再装填し、S3は攻撃後に必ず再装填: **Reloading ammo**: S2 reloads after the attack if he has 1 or fewer Basic Rounds, and S3 always reloads after the attack. The Defense skill Spore Germination reloads at Combat Start. Reloading costs SP based on the number of missing rounds. If he has 2 or fewer Basic Rounds before using S3, he spends 6 SP to refill 3 Basic Rounds.
messages.忠誠フェロモン: 胞子を持つ敵が死亡すると得る(最大3)。S2・S3のマッチ威力: **Loyalty Pheromone**: Gained when an enemy with Spore dies, up to 3. S2 and S3 gain +1 Clash Power and more Unbreakable Coins.
messages.S2で複数の敵に胞子を撒いて火傷回数を供給し、火傷を付与する味方の火傷を長持ちさ: Spread Spore across multiple enemies with S2 to supply Burn Count, keeping the Burn from allies who inflict it going longer. Against a single enemy that has built up 15 Spore, aim for extra Wrath damage with Coin Ⅳ of S3.
messages.S3の強化条件: 自分の体力が50%未満か、対象の引き裂かれた色彩が5以上なら、: **S3's enhancement condition**: If his HP is below 50% or the target has at least 5 Mauled Color, it gains 1 extra Coin and all Coins become Unbreakable. The extra Coin inflicts Bleed or Sinking Potency equal to the target's Color ÷ 3. Rodion also inflicts [Rouge] and [Bleu], but whether the two colors are counted together cannot be determined from the data.
messages.引き裂かれた色彩[ルージュ]: 常時パッシブにより、基本スキル的中時に付与する(: **Mauled Color [Rouge]**: Through an always-active passive, inflicted when his basic skills hit, up to 9, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. When the bearer takes damage, it gains 1 Bleed Potency per 3, once per turn, and at Turn End it receives 1 Defense Level Down next turn per 4, up to 2.
messages.野獣派-マスク・ドゥ・シヤン: この戦闘で自分が[ルージュ]を10以上付与すると: **Le Fauvisme - Masque de Chien**: Gained at Turn End once he has inflicted 10 or more [Rouge] in this battle. +1 to the Bleed and Sinking Potency he inflicts, and +2 Base Power for the Defense skill Coloring Preparations.
messages.バトルパッシブ「満ちゆく着想」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マスクがあれ: **Combat passive — Welling Inspiration (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: With the Mask, +1 to the Color he inflicts. Restores 5 SP for every 4 Color inflicted, twice per turn, and at max SP grants 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn.
messages.マイナス効果の数で強化: 各スキルは対象のマイナス効果の種類に応じてダメージ量が: **Bonuses from the number of negative effects**: Each skill deals more damage based on the number of different negative effects on the target (up to 60% for S3). Coin Power and Final Power also rise with combined Bleed and Sinking.
messages.S1・S2で出血・沈潜と色彩を積み、マスクを得て付与量を伸ばしてから、色彩が5以: Stack Bleed, Sinking, and Color with S1 and S2, gain the Mask to increase the amounts inflicted, then land the enhanced S3 on enemies with at least 5 Color. When deployed together with Rodion, he also gains Imperfections Addressed at the start of the Coin toss of her Critique.
A starting E.G.O for single strong enemies that cripples the enemy with heavy Bind and Attack Power Down.
messages.敵への弱体: 的中時、次のターンに束縛と攻撃威力減少を敵へ付与する。敵の攻撃が弱: **Weakening the enemy**: On hit, inflicts Bind and Attack Power Down on the enemy next turn. The enemy's attacks weaken, making it easier for allies to win Clashes.
messages.自分への反動: 同じ弱体を自分も次のターンに得る。付与量は解析Ⅲで増え、Ⅳで軽く: **Recoil on himself**: He also receives the same debuffs next turn. The amounts rise at Threadspin Ⅲ and lighten at Ⅳ.
messages.保護: 解析Ⅲの表面的中時(Ⅳは的中時)に、次のターンの保護2を得て反動を受け止: **Protection**: On Heads Hit at Threadspin Ⅲ (on hit at Ⅳ), he gains 2 Protection next turn, making the recoil easier to absorb.
messages.パッシブ「判断拒否」: 戦闘開始時に3つ以上のスキルの標的なら保護3。標的が散る: **Passive — Refusal to Judge**: Gains 3 Protection if he is targeted by 3 or more skills at Combat Start. This is likely easy to meet in regular battles where targeting is spread out, and hard to meet in Focused Encounters.
messages.資源の変換: 必要資源4つ(怠惰1・憂鬱1・嫉妬2)を、傲慢資源1に変える。: **Resource conversion**: Converts its 4 required resources (1 Sloth, 1 Gloom, 2 Envy) into 1 Pride resource.
messages.単体の強敵に撃つ。弱体できるのは1体だけで自分にも弱体が入るため、通常戦闘には向: Use it on a single strong enemy. It only weakens 1 enemy and also weakens himself, so it is not suited to regular battles.
messages.撃った次のターンは自分が遅く弱くなる。ガードや保護を持つ耐久型のムルソー人格で受: On the turn after using it, he becomes slower and weaker. Play defensively with a durable Meursault Identity that has Guard or Protection.
messages.弱体を受けていない味方がマッチを担当し、弱った敵を集中して削る。: Let allies without the debuffs handle Clashes and focus down the weakened enemy.
messages.罪悪耐性は色欲・暴食が脆弱(×2)。この属性の攻撃が多い戦闘では他のE.G.Oの: Its Sin resistances are Fatal (×2) to Lust and Gluttony. In fights with many attacks of those affinities, consider switching to another E.G.O's resistances. It has no Corrosion skill.
messages.Ⅲ: 束縛5・攻撃威力減少4に倍増し(自分への反動も倍)、基本威力が19になり、: **Ⅲ**: Doubles to 5 Bind and 4 Attack Power Down (the recoil on himself also doubles), Base Power becomes 19, and 2 Protection is added.
messages.Ⅳ: 自分への反動が束縛3・攻撃威力減少3に軽くなり、保護が的中時に得られる。敵: **Ⅳ**: The recoil on himself lightens to 3 Bind and 3 Attack Power Down, and Protection is gained on hit. The amounts inflicted on enemies stay the same as Ⅲ. Stopping at Ⅲ likely makes little difference.
messages.LCB囚人: 怠惰(S1・ガード)と憂鬱(S3)で必要資源を出せ、S3は次のター: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0501)**: Sloth (S1, Guard) and Gloom (S3) supply the required affinities, and his S3 grants 3 Protection next turn, making it easy to play defensively.
messages.W社2級整理要員: 嫉妬(S1・ガード)と憂鬱(S2)で必要資源を出せ、被ダメー: **[W Corp. L2 Cleanup Agent](persona:0503)**: Envy (S1, Guard) and Gloom (S2) supply the required affinities, and his passive, which gains Charge when taking damage or losing Clashes, meshes with a defensive playstyle.
messages.施術を積んで与ダメージとクイックを得る代わりに最大体力を削る、ハイリスクな嫉妬打: A high-risk Envy Blunt E.G.O that stacks Surgery to gain damage and Haste in exchange for cutting max HP.
messages.施術: 数値1につき与ダメージ量+20%、最大体力-20%で、毎ターン数値だけク: **Surgery**: Each point gives +20% damage dealt and −20% max HP, and grants Haste equal to its value every turn. He dies when it reaches 5.
messages.施術の付与: 覚醒は攻撃後に次のターンの施術1(解析Ⅲ)、侵蝕は施術2を得る。使: **Inflicting Surgery**: Awakening grants 1 Surgery next turn after the attack (Threadspin Ⅲ), and Corrosion grants 2. It stacks with every use.
messages.パッシブ「最後の改造」: 体力25%未満でこのE.G.Oを使うと、毎ターン攻撃威: **Passive — Final Augment**: Using this E.G.O below 25% HP grants Attack Power Up, Defense Power Up, and 3 Haste every turn, and he dies 3 turns later.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可の記載がない。: **Corrosion skill**: There is no mention of being unable to distinguish friend from foe.
messages.麻痺: 表面的中時に麻痺3を付与する。体力を削るリスクに見合わないので、おまけ程: **Paralyze**: Inflicts 3 Paralyze on Heads Hit. It is not worth the risk of cutting HP, so treat it as a minor extra.
messages.施術は1〜2に抑え、体力に気を付ける。最大体力が減るので、不利なマッチは守備で処: Keep Surgery at 1–2 and watch his HP. His max HP drops, so handle unfavorable Clashes with Defense skills and avoid taking hits.
messages.連戦では序盤に施術を積んでおくと、後のウェーブを高い与ダメージで始められる。: In consecutive battles, stacking Surgery early lets later waves start with high damage.
messages.「最後の改造」は使い捨ての終盤火力。発動前の体力調整が前提になる。: Final Augment is single-use late-game damage. It assumes adjusting his HP before triggering it.
messages.必要資源は怠惰2・傲慢1・嫉妬2、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: It requires 2 Sloth, 1 Pride, and 2 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20 for both Awakening and Corrosion.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が23になり、覚醒に施術の付与が加わる。侵蝕には混乱区間の前進が付: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 23, and Awakening gains Surgery infliction. Corrosion gains a Stagger Threshold shift.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒・侵蝕の攻撃加重値が2になり、広域化する。: **Ⅳ**: Awakening and Corrosion reach 2 Attack Weight, becoming multi-target.
messages.剣契頭目: 失った体力に応じてダメージ量が伸びる肉斬・骨断を持ち、パッシブで致死: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508)**: Has Yield My Flesh and To Claim Their Bones, whose damage grows with HP lost, and his passive survives lethal damage once.
messages.N社大鎚: 体力50%未満でコイン威力が上がる「貫く」や、体力50%未満で保護3: **[N Corp. Großhammer](persona:0504)**: Has Drive, which gains Coin Power below 50% HP, and a passive that grants 3 Protection and more below 50% HP, so he makes good use of a lowered-HP state.
messages.高いマッチ威力で攻撃を受け止めつつ、体力の低い味方2名を回復して立て直す、汎用の: A versatile Sloth Blunt E.G.O that absorbs attacks with high Clash Power while healing the 2 allies with the lowest HP to stabilize the team.
messages.高いマッチ威力: 基本威力20(解析Ⅲで26)にコイン威力+8で、敵の大技へのマ: **High Clash Power**: 20 Base Power (26 at Threadspin Ⅲ) with +8 Coin Power, strong in Clashes against enemy big attacks.
messages.味方2名の回復: 攻撃後、自分を除く現在体力が最も低い味方2名を最大体力の15%: **Healing 2 allies**: After the attack, heals the 2 allies with the lowest current HP, excluding himself, by 15% of max HP (30% at Threadspin Ⅲ). He cannot heal himself.
messages.保護: 解析Ⅲで、次のターンの保護2も付与する。: **Protection**: At Threadspin Ⅲ, also gives 2 Protection next turn.
messages.パッシブ「天の啓示」: 操作パネルの一番左のスキルでマッチに勝つと、次のターンに: **Passive — Revelation from Above**: Winning a Clash with the leftmost skill on the dashboard gives a random ally 1 Attack Power Up or Defense Power Up next turn. Both the effect and the target are random.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 回復の代わりに、体力が最も低い味方2名へ脆弱とダメージ量増加を付与: **Corrosion skill**: Instead of healing, it inflicts Fragile and Damage Up on the 2 allies with the lowest HP. 3 Attack Weight, attacking friend and foe at random.
messages.被弾が重なった場面で、敵の強いスキルにマッチを当てて受け止め、回復で態勢を立て直: When hits have piled up, throw it into a Clash against the enemy's strong skill to absorb it, and stabilize with the healing.
messages.回復量はⅢで伸びるので、回復目的ならⅢまで解析する。: The healing grows at Ⅲ, so take it to Threadspin Ⅲ if you use it for healing.
messages.必要資源は怠惰4・憂鬱1・傲慢2で怠惰が重い。: It requires 4 Sloth, 1 Gloom, and 2 Pride; the Sloth cost is heavy.
messages.人格との噛み合わせに依存しない汎用枠と考えられる。罪悪耐性は色欲・暴食が脆弱(×: It is likely a versatile slot that does not depend on synergy with Identities. Its Sin resistances are Fatal (×2) to Lust and Gluttony.
messages.Ⅲ: マッチ威力が26~34になり、回復が30%に増え、保護2が付く。性能が出そ: **Ⅲ**: Clash Power becomes 26–34, healing rises to 30%, and 2 Protection is added. Its performance is complete here.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒の攻撃加重値が3になるだけで、回復は強化されない。優先度は低いと考えら: **Ⅳ**: Only raises Awakening's Attack Weight to 3; the healing is not improved. Likely a low priority.
messages.LCB囚人: 怠惰(S1・ガード)・傲慢(S2)・憂鬱(S3)で必要資源の3色を: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0501)**: Sloth (S1, Guard), Pride (S2), and Gloom (S3) supply all three required affinities, making this E.G.O easy to activate with his own skills.
messages.バラのスパナ工房フィクサー: 憂鬱(S1)・傲慢(S2)・怠惰(S3・ガード)で: **[Rosespanner Workshop Fixer](persona:0505)**: Gloom (S1), Pride (S2), and Sloth (S3, Guard) supply all three required affinities.
messages.高威力の1コインで火傷と振動を押し付け、振動爆発による混乱を起点に火傷を他の敵へ: A Wrath Blunt E.G.O that forces Burn and Tremor onto the target with a high-power single Coin, then spreads Burn to other enemies starting from a Tremor Burst Stagger.
messages.火傷の付与: 的中時に対象へ火傷4(解析Ⅲで7、Ⅳで10)を付与する。さらに解析: **Inflicting Burn**: On hit, inflicts 4 Burn on the target (7 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10 at Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also inflicts Burn on 5 random enemies.
messages.振動と振動爆発: 対象の火傷の数値と同じだけ振動を付与し、そのまま振動爆発させる: **Tremor and Tremor Burst**: Inflicts Tremor equal to the target's Burn value and triggers Tremor Burst right away (the burst reduces Tremor Count, from 3 to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.混乱で火傷を拡散: 振動爆発で対象が混乱すると、ランダムな敵5名の火傷回数が増え: **Spreading Burn through Stagger**: If the Tremor Burst staggers the target, 5 random enemies gain Burn Count (1, 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 3 at Ⅳ).
messages.次ターンの強化: 攻撃後、次のターンにクイック、憤怒威力増加1、打撃威力増加1を: **Next-turn buffs**: After the attack, he gains Haste, 1 Wrath Power Up, and 1 Blunt Power Up next turn.
messages.パッシブ「冷ませぬ興奮」: 戦闘開始時に2つ以上のスキルの標的なら基本威力+1。: **Passive — Untempered Agitation**: +1 Base Power if he is targeted by 2 or more skills at Combat Start. When taking damage, inflicts 1 Burn on the attacker, up to 5 times per turn.
messages.火傷と振動は威力に偏って回数が少ない。回数は他の人格で補う火傷編成で使う。: Its Burn and Tremor lean toward Potency with little Count. Use it in Burn teams where other Identities cover the Count.
messages.必要資源が5つと軽く、威力も高いのでマッチにも使える。バフは憤怒・打撃スキルに効: It requires only 5 resources and has high power, so it also works for Clashing. Its buffs apply to Wrath and Blunt skills, so leave the next turn to Identities with those skills.
messages.侵蝕スキルは解析Ⅳで広域(加重値3)になる。敵味方識別不可で、火傷の拡散先もラン: The Corrosion skill becomes multi-target (3 Attack Weight) at Threadspin Ⅳ. It cannot distinguish friend from foe, and the Burn spread also goes to random characters, so it can hit allies.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が20に上がり、火傷7、5名への火傷拡散、クイック2が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises to 20, and 7 Burn, Burn spread to 5 enemies, and 2 Haste are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+25になり(最大威力45)、火傷10・拡散3など付与量が増え: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +25 (max power 45), and amounts such as 10 Burn and a spread of 3 increase. Corrosion becomes multi-target.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 怠惰(S1)・色欲(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Sloth (S1), Lust (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and he inflicts both Burn and Tremor.
messages.南部リウ協会6課: 色欲(S1)・怠惰(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色を出: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 6](persona:0502)**: Lust (S1), Sloth (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and S1–S3 inflict Burn to cover the lack of Count.
A Wrath Blunt E.G.O whose real value is a passive that boosts the Coin Power of the leftmost skill on the dashboard.
messages.パッシブ「縛られた怒り」: 操作パネルの一番左に置いた自分のスキルは、基本威力が: **Passive — Bound Wrath**: His skill placed at the far left of the dashboard loses 1 Base Power and gains 2 Coin Power. The more Coins it has, the better: +3 power with 2 Coins and +5 with 3 Coins.
messages.速度4以下の強化: ターン開始時に速度が4以下なら打撃威力増加1を得る。条件を満: **Bonus at 4 or less Speed**: Gains 1 Blunt Power Up if his Speed is 4 or less at Turn Start. The condition is hard to meet, so it is only a footnote.
messages.デバフ除去: 覚醒の攻撃前に、自分の解除可能なマイナス効果を1つ(解析Ⅳで2つ): **Removing debuffs**: Before Awakening's attack, removes 1 removable negative effect from himself (2 at Threadspin Ⅳ). The removal happens before the attack, so it cannot clear Paralyze or Power Down before the Clash.
messages.振動: 的中時に振動回数が増え(憤怒完全共鳴数÷3も加算)、振動爆発する。おまけ: **Tremor**: Increases Tremor Count on hit (adding Wrath Absolute Resonance ÷ 3) and triggers Tremor Burst. A minor extra.
messages.解析Ⅱでパッシブが解放された時点で、性能の大半は出る。: Most of its performance is available once Threadspin Ⅱ unlocks the passive.
messages.効果は戦闘終了まで続くため、長期戦が見込まれる場面で早めに撃つ。: The effect lasts until the end of the battle, so fire it early when a long fight is expected.
messages.多コインの人格を左端に置いて、威力を伸ばす。: Place a multi-Coin Identity at the far left to boost its power.
messages.侵蝕スキルは、自分にマイナス効果があると広域になり、次のターンに束縛と打撃威力増: The Corrosion skill becomes multi-target if he has negative effects, and he gains Bind and Blunt Power Up next turn.
messages.Ⅱ: 「縛られた怒り」が解放される。ここまででほぼ完成。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Bound Wrath. It is nearly complete at this point.
messages.Ⅲ: 振動爆発時、混乱区間のない対象に憤怒ダメージを与える追加効果が付く。おまけ: **Ⅲ**: Adds an extra effect that deals Wrath damage to targets without a Stagger Threshold on Tremor Burst. A minor extra.
messages.Ⅳ: デバフ除去が2つになり、振動回数の増加と追加ダメージが強化される。優先度は: **Ⅳ**: Removes 2 debuffs and strengthens the Tremor Count increase and extra damage. Low priority.
messages.剣契頭目: 傲慢のスキルが多く、肉斬(憤怒)で必要資源の憤怒も出せる。: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508)**: Has many Pride skills, and Yield My Flesh (Wrath) supplies the required Wrath.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 3コインの憤怒スキル(S3)を持ち、左端に置くとコイン威: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Has a 3-Coin Wrath skill (S3) that benefits greatly from +2 Coin Power at the far left. He also handles Tremor Burst.
