messages.嫉妬共鳴を高めて自分と味方に充電と嫉妬ダメージ量増加を配る、サポート特化の嫉妬貫: A support-focused Envy Pierce E.G.O that raises Envy Resonance to hand out Charge and Envy DMG Up to himself and allies.
messages.充電の配布: 攻撃前に自分の充電が8(解析Ⅳで12)増え、攻撃後に充電が最も低い: **Distributing Charge**: Before attacking, his Charge increases by 8 (12 at Threadspin Ⅳ), and after attacking, the ally with the lowest Charge also gains 8.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で対象が増える: 最大嫉妬共鳴数が高いほど配る対象が増える(最大3、解析: **More targets with Envy Resonance**: The higher the highest Envy Resonance, the more allies receive it (up to 3, 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 5 at Ⅳ).
messages.嫉妬ダメージ量増加: 解析Ⅲから、最大嫉妬共鳴数が4以上(Ⅳは6以上)なら、自分: **Envy DMG Up**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, if the highest Envy Resonance is 4 or more (6 or more at Ⅳ), gives 1 Envy DMG Up to himself and the targets. The effect lasts only that turn.
messages.パッシブ「過負荷ケーブル」: 戦闘開始時に共鳴が4以上発動していれば攻撃レベル増: **Passive — Overloading Cables**: Gains 2 Offense Level Up and 2 Defense Level Up if a Resonance of 4 or more is active at Combat Start. With Envy Resonance, the allies on both sides of him on the dashboard also receive them.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 嫉妬共鳴数に応じて広域化し、充電を消耗してダメージ量を増やす。: **Corrosion skill**: Becomes multi-target based on Envy Resonance and spends Charge to increase damage.
messages.嫉妬スキルを並べて共鳴を作ってから撃つ。共鳴が低いと配る対象が少ない。: Line up Envy skills to build Resonance before using it. With low Resonance, few allies receive the distribution.
messages.充電人格や嫉妬スキルが多い編成で撃つ。充電人格とそれ以外の混成だと、充電人格以外: Use it in teams with many Charge Identities or Envy skills. In teams that mix Charge Identities with others, non-Charge Identities may end up as targets.
messages.必要資源は憤怒1・嫉妬4で、嫉妬の多い編成なら賄える。: It requires 1 Wrath and 4 Envy, which an Envy-heavy team can cover.
messages.Ⅱ: 「過負荷ケーブル」が解放される。この編成で使うなら最低限ここまで。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Overloading Cables. If you use it in this kind of team, take it at least this far.
messages.Ⅲ: 配る対象が最大4に増え、嫉妬ダメージ量増加が付く。侵蝕の広域も強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the number of targets to up to 4 and adds Envy DMG Up. Corrosion's multi-target range also improves.
messages.Ⅳ: 自分の充電が12、対象が最大5に増える。嫉妬ダメージ量増加の条件が共鳴6以: **Ⅳ**: His own Charge becomes 12, and targets rise to up to 5. The Envy DMG Up condition changes to 6 or more Resonance.
messages.中指末弟: 嫉妬のS2・守備や嫉妬共鳴を条件とするスキルを持ち、嫉妬共鳴を作りや: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:0507)**: Has an Envy S2 and Defense skill plus skills conditioned on Envy Resonance, makes Envy Resonance easy to build, and also restores SP.
messages.R社第4群サイチーム: 嫉妬(S1・守備)で資源と共鳴に参加でき、S1・S2が充: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Rhino](persona:0506)**: Envy (S1, Defense skill) lets him join in resources and Resonance, and S1 and S2 increase Charge, so he can be both distributor and recipient.
messages.出血を付けた単体の敵の出血を、薔薇のとげを育てながら強制的に発動させる、色欲貫通: A Bleed-specialized Lust Pierce E.G.O that forcibly triggers the Bleed of a single bleeding enemy while growing Rose Wedge.
messages.出血の強制発動: 破壊不能の4コイン目が、マッチに勝った後に的中すると対象の出血: **Forced Bleed triggers**: When the Unbreakable fourth Coin hits after a Clash Win, it triggers the target's Bleed (at Threadspin Ⅲ, the number of triggers grows with the highest Resonance, up to 3). Bleed Count decreases by the number of triggers.
messages.出血の付与: 1・2コイン目が出血2を付与する。解析Ⅲでは最大共鳴4以上で、出血: **Inflicting Bleed**: The first and second Coins inflict 2 Bleed. At Threadspin Ⅲ, with a highest Resonance of 4 or more, they trigger Bleed once.
messages.薔薇のとげ: 破壊不能の3コイン目で回数が増える。出血ダメージ10ごとに威力が1: **Rose Wedge**: Its Count increases with the Unbreakable third Coin. Its Potency rises by 1 per 10 Bleed damage (up to 10, with a maximum Count of 4). Each time the bearer is inflicted with Bleed, it gains 2 additional Bleed, and the inflicter receives 1 Bleed in return, up to 5 times per turn. At Combat End, if Potency is 10 or Count is 1, it disappears and deals (Potency×10) Lust damage.
messages.コイン威力強化: 解析Ⅲで対象の出血が6以上ならコイン威力+1、Ⅳでは出血6につ: **Coin Power bonus**: At Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Bleed; at Ⅳ, +1 per 6 Bleed, up to 2.
messages.パッシブ「残酷な晩餐」: 出血ダメージを受ける、または与えると、同量だけ体力を回: **Passive — Bloodthirsty Banquet**: Taking or dealing Bleed damage heals the same amount of HP, up to 10 per turn.
messages.出血を扱う編成で、単体の敵に撃つ。出血回数を消耗するので、回数は他の人格で確保す: Use it on a single enemy in a Bleed team. It consumes Bleed Count, so have other Identities secure the Count.
messages.解析Ⅲからは、最大共鳴数が高いほど発動回数が増える。戦闘後半は出血ダメージの累計: From Threadspin Ⅲ, the higher the highest Resonance, the more triggers. Later in battle, Rose Wedge grows from accumulated Bleed damage.
messages.必要資源は色欲4・傲慢3・嫉妬4の計11で重い。精神消耗は覚醒10(使用後3ター: It requires a heavy 11 resources: 4 Lust, 3 Pride, and 4 Envy. Its Awakening Sanity cost is 10 (−10 SP at each Turn End for 3 turns after use).
messages.侵蝕スキルは使用時に体力を消耗し、自分と対象の両方に出血を与える。: The Corrosion skill spends HP on use and inflicts Bleed on both himself and the target.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、出血の強制発動が共鳴数で増える。1・2コイン目の追加発動とコ: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, and forced Bleed triggers increase with Resonance. Adds extra triggers on the first and second Coins and the Coin Power bonus.
messages.Ⅳ: 薔薇のとげの回数増加が1から2になり、コイン威力強化が出血6につきに変わる: **Ⅳ**: Rose Wedge's Count increase goes from 1 to 2, and the Coin Power bonus becomes per 6 Bleed.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの王子: 色欲(S3)・傲慢(S2)・嫉妬(S1)で必要資源の: **[The Prince of La Manchaland](persona:0513)**: Lust (S3), Pride (S2), and Envy (S1) supply all three required affinities, and he can also inflict Bleed.
messages.中指末弟: 嫉妬のS2・守備で嫉妬共鳴に参加でき、S1・S2・守備が出血を付与す: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:0507)**: His Envy S2 and Defense skill join Envy Resonance, and S1, S2, and his Defense skill inflict Bleed.
messages.メインターゲットに振動を溜めるほど火力が伸びる、高加重値の怠惰打撃広域E.G.O: A multi-target Sloth Blunt E.G.O with high Attack Weight whose damage grows the more Tremor is built on the main target.
messages.広域の高加重値: 攻撃加重値が6と高い。解析Ⅲでメインターゲットの振動(威力+回: **High multi-target Attack Weight**: A high 6 Attack Weight. At Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 if the main target's Tremor (Potency + Count) is 30 or more; at Ⅳ, +3 at 100 or more.
messages.振動の付与: 1コイン目が振動回数を増やし、2コイン目が振動を付与する。メインタ: **Inflicting Tremor**: The first Coin increases Tremor Count, and the second Coin inflicts Tremor. Concentrating it on the main target is efficient.
messages.振動によるダメージ強化: メインターゲットの振動に応じて、コインごとのダメージ量: **Tremor-based damage**: Each Coin deals more damage based on the main target's Tremor. The third Coin gains +1% per Tremor, up to 50%, and the fourth gains +1% per point of (Potency + Count), up to 100%; at 100% or more, it triggers Tremor Burst twice.
messages.怠惰共鳴の偶奇: 奇数ターンは怠惰共鳴数が奇数、偶数ターンは偶数だと、攻撃後に精: **Odd and even Sloth Resonance**: If Sloth Resonance is odd on odd turns or even on even turns, he recovers 10 SP after the attack. For 3 turns after the attack, he loses 10 SP at each Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「メトロノーム」: 奇数ターンはダメージ量増加、偶数ターンは保護を得る。: **Passive — Metronome**: Grants Damage Up on odd turns and Protection on even turns. Accumulated Past builds with each turn after use, raising Clash Power and Offense Level.
messages.無条件でも威力が高いので、序盤に雑魚をまとめて削る使い方ができる。: Its power is high even without conditions, so it can be used early to chip down groups of weak enemies.
messages.振動を溜めてからフィニッシャーとして撃つ使い方もできる。長期戦ほど伸びる。: It can also be used as a finisher after building Tremor. It grows stronger in longer fights.
messages.怠惰共鳴の偶奇を合わせて、精神力の消耗を相殺する。: Match the parity of Sloth Resonance to offset the SP cost.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・色欲2・怠惰6・嫉妬1で怠惰が重い。: It requires 2 Wrath, 2 Lust, 6 Sloth, and 1 Envy; the Sloth cost is heavy.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が4になり、振動による加重値+1が付く。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 4, and +1 Attack Weight from Tremor is added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+4になり、50%以上での振動爆発の追加、最大共鳴数に応じた振: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +4, and an extra Tremor Burst at 50% or more, Tremor infliction based on the highest Resonance, and HP recovery are added. The Coin Power gain is large, so take it if you can afford it.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 怠惰(S1・守備)の資源を出せ、S1〜S3が振動を付与す: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Supplies Sloth resources (S1, Defense skill), and S1–S3 inflict Tremor.
messages.バラのスパナ工房フィクサー: S1〜S3が振動を付与し、怠惰(S3・ガード)で資: **[Rosespanner Workshop Fixer](persona:0505)**: S1–S3 inflict Tremor, and Sloth (S3, Guard) supplies resources.
messages.剣契頭目に持たせて追慕酒と呼吸で強化し、2回目以降の使用で高い与ダメージを出す、: A Pride Slash E.G.O to give to Blade Lineage Mentor, strengthened by Drink to the Fallen and Poise, that deals high damage from its second use onward.
messages.剣契頭目への優遇: 剣契頭目なら必要資源が憤怒・傲慢・嫉妬それぞれ1減り(傲慢3: **Preferential treatment for Blade Lineage Mentor**: For Blade Lineage Mentor, the Wrath, Pride, and Envy requirements each drop by 1 (leaving only 3 Pride), and the damage increase from Drink to the Fallen applies doubled.
messages.追慕酒: 使用の次のターンに追慕酒4を得る(初回の使用は精神消耗が15減る)。タ: **Drink to the Fallen**: He gains 4 Drink to the Fallen on the turn after use (the first use costs 15 less Sanity). At Turn Start he gains Poise (doubled for Blade Lineage Mentor), his Critical damage grows, and if he takes damage that would bring his HP to 0, he recovers based on the Drink to the Fallen value (once per battle).
messages.2回目以降の火力: 追慕酒を得た戦闘では、メインターゲットへの与ダメージ量が増え: **Damage from the second use onward**: In a battle where he has gained Drink to the Fallen, damage against the main target increases (+60%, 80% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 100% at Ⅳ). Doubled for Blade Lineage Mentor.
messages.味方の支援: 攻撃前に編成順の早い味方へ呼吸回数4を配り、攻撃後は精神力の低い剣: **Supporting allies**: Before attacking, gives 4 Poise Count to the allies earliest in team order, and after attacking, restores 10 SP to the 4 Blade Lineage allies with the lowest SP.
messages.剣契頭目専用効果: 追慕酒があると恨の宿った鞘を得る。肉斬の使用中は体力が10未: **Blade Lineage Mentor-only effects**: With Drink to the Fallen, he gains Resentful Scabbard. While using Yield My Flesh, his HP cannot drop below 10, but his Clash Power decreases. With Pride Resonance, Blade Lineage allies receive Sword of the Homeland - The True Essence.
messages.剣契編成で、序盤に撃って呼吸と精神力を配り、追慕酒を得る。: In Blade Lineage teams, fire it early to hand out Poise and SP and gain Drink to the Fallen.
messages.追慕酒が残るうちに肉斬・骨断で攻め、2回目に撃つと与ダメージ増加が乗る。: Attack with Yield My Flesh and To Claim Their Bones while Drink to the Fallen lasts, and the second use carries the damage increase.
messages.侵蝕スキルは敵味方全員に呼吸4・斬撃ダメージ量増加1・斬撃脆弱1を与える。味方の: The Corrosion skill gives every ally and enemy 4 Poise, 1 Slash DMG Up, and 1 Slash Fragility. It raises allies' Slash damage, but also increases the damage they take.
messages.Ⅱ: 「剣先にしたたる酒滴」が解放され、主要な効果は出そろう。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Beads of Liquor at Bladepoint, completing its main effects.
messages.Ⅲ: 呼吸によるマッチ威力・ダメージ量の上限と、追慕酒後のダメージ増加が強化され: **Ⅲ**: Raises the caps on Poise-based Clash Power and damage, and strengthens the damage increase after Drink to the Fallen.
messages.Ⅳ: Ⅲと同じ系統の強化で、優先度は低いと考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: The same kind of improvement as Ⅲ, likely a low priority.
messages.剣契頭目: 専用効果が全て働き、呼吸と出血を扱う人格として強化される。: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508)**: All of the dedicated effects apply, strengthening him as a Poise and Bleed Identity.
messages.西部センク協会3課: 傲慢(S1)で必要資源を出せ、スキルで呼吸を得るので追慕酒: **[Cinq Assoc. West Section 3](persona:0511)**: Pride (S1) supplies the required affinity, and his skills gain Poise, so he benefits from Drink to the Fallen's effects.
messages.灰色の弾丸5で資源を払わずに撃ち、充電・呼吸・沈潜を積んで貫通火力を出す、7枠広: A 7-target WAW Pride E.G.O that fires without paying resources at 5 Ashen Bullet and stacks Charge, Poise, and Sinking to deal Pierce damage.
messages.灰色の弾丸: パッシブにより、弾丸が5なら資源を消費せずに撃てる。ターン開始時に: **Ashen Bullet**: Through the passive, it can be fired without spending resources at 5 Bullets. Bullets increase by 1 at Turn Start. If short, he can pay SP before attacking to top them up to the maximum.
messages.再使用される1コイン目: 破壊不能で、メインターゲットにだけ的中する。弾丸を消耗: **Reused first Coin**: Unbreakable and only hits the main target. It spends Bullets and is reused as long as Bullets remain, up to 4 times per skill. In practice, it can be treated as a single-target attack.
messages.充電・呼吸・黒い翼: 攻撃前に呼吸威力と充電を得て、(呼吸威力+充電)と弾丸でマ: **Charge, Poise, and Black Wings**: Before attacking, he gains Poise Potency and Charge, and (Poise Potency + Charge) and Bullets raise Clash Power. Black Wings increase Charge and Offense Level at Turn Start.
messages.沈潜と貫通脆弱: 1コイン目の的中時に貫通脆弱と沈潜を付与し、2コイン目で沈潜回: **Sinking and Pierce Fragility**: The first Coin inflicts Pierce Fragility and Sinking on hit, and the second Coin increases Sinking Count.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 2コイン目の裏面確率は弾丸×20%で、弾丸が5なら確実に裏面。表面: **Corrosion skill**: The second Coin's chance of Tails is Bullets×20%, guaranteeing Tails at 5 Bullets. On Heads, the attack does not hit.
messages.弾丸を5にして撃ち、資源の負担なしで高火力を出す。弾丸が足りないときは精神力を払: Fire it at 5 Bullets to deal heavy damage with no resource burden. When short on Bullets, pay SP to make up the difference.
messages.呼吸と充電を事前に積んでから撃つと、威力とクリティカルがさらに伸びる。: Building Poise and Charge before firing further raises its power and Critical Hits.
messages.1コイン目が単体向けなので、狙う敵を決めて撃つ。広域部分は巻き込み分の火力になる: The first Coin is single-target, so decide which enemy to aim at. The multi-target part is extra damage on the enemies caught in it.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が12になり、クリティカル強化と、攻撃対象1名のときのダメージ量増: **Ⅲ**: Base Power becomes 12, and the Critical bonus and the damage increase against a single target are added.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+2になり、対象1名時の増加が100%に、充電によるコイン威力: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +2, the single-target increase becomes 100%, and Charge-based Coin Power is added.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課部長: 沈潜を付与するスキルを持ち、このE.G.Oの沈潜付: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:0510)**: Has skills that inflict Sinking, so a Sinking-centered team can stack it with this E.G.O's Sinking.
messages.西部センク協会3課: 貫通スキルで呼吸を得て、呼吸威力が積みやすい。: **[Cinq Assoc. West Section 3](persona:0511)**: Gains Poise with his Pierce skills, making Poise Potency easy to build.
messages.他人の鎖: 怠惰(S1・ガード)と憂鬱(S3)で必要資源を出せ、S3は次のターン: **[Chains of Others](ego:0501)**: Sloth (S1, Guard) and Gloom (S3) supply the required affinities, and his S3 grants 3 Protection next turn, making it easy to play defensively.
messages.他人の鎖: 嫉妬(S1・ガード)と憂鬱(S2)で必要資源を出せ、被ダメージやマッ: **[Chains of Others](ego:0501)**: Envy (S1, Guard) and Gloom (S2) supply the required affinities, and his passive, which gains Charge when taking damage or losing Clashes, meshes with a defensive playstyle.
messages.ネジの外れた一撃: 失った体力に応じてダメージ量が伸びる肉斬・骨断を持ち、パッシ: **[Screwloose Wallop](ego:0502)**: Has Yield My Flesh and To Claim Their Bones, whose damage grows with HP lost, and his passive survives lethal damage once.
messages.ネジの外れた一撃: 体力50%未満でコイン威力が上がる「貫く」や、体力50%未満: **[Screwloose Wallop](ego:0502)**: Has Drive, which gains Coin Power below 50% HP, and a passive that grants 3 Protection and more below 50% HP, so he makes good use of a lowered-HP state.
messages.執行: 怠惰(S1・ガード)・傲慢(S2)・憂鬱(S3)で必要資源の3色を出せ、: **[Pursuance](ego:0503)**: Sloth (S1, Guard), Pride (S2), and Gloom (S3) supply all three required affinities, making this E.G.O easy to activate with his own skills.
messages.執行: 憂鬱(S1)・傲慢(S2)・怠惰(S3・ガード)で必要資源の3色を出せる: **[Pursuance](ego:0503)**: Gloom (S1), Pride (S2), and Sloth (S3, Guard) supply all three required affinities.
messages.カポーテ: 怠惰(S1)・色欲(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色を出せ、火傷: **[Capote](ego:0504)**: Sloth (S1), Lust (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and he inflicts both Burn and Tremor.
messages.カポーテ: 色欲(S1)・怠惰(S2)・憤怒(S3)で必要資源の3色を出せ、S1: **[Capote](ego:0504)**: Lust (S1), Sloth (S2), and Wrath (S3) supply all three required affinities, and S1–S3 inflict Burn to cover the lack of Count.
messages.後悔: 傲慢のスキルが多く、肉斬(憤怒)で必要資源の憤怒も出せる。: **[Regret](ego:0505)**: Has many Pride skills, and Yield My Flesh (Wrath) supplies the required Wrath.
messages.後悔: 3コインの憤怒スキル(S3)を持ち、左端に置くとコイン威力+2の恩恵が大: **[Regret](ego:0505)**: Has a 3-Coin Wrath skill (S3) that benefits greatly from +2 Coin Power at the far left. He also handles Tremor Burst.
messages.電気哀鳴: 嫉妬のS2・守備や嫉妬共鳴を条件とするスキルを持ち、嫉妬共鳴を作りや: **[Electric Screaming](ego:0506)**: Has an Envy S2 and Defense skill plus skills conditioned on Envy Resonance, makes Envy Resonance easy to build, and also restores SP.

messages.穴: 沈潜を付与するスキルを持ち、このE.G.Oの沈潜付与と重ねて沈潜を軸に組め: **[Hollow](ego:0510)**: Has skills that inflict Sinking, so a Sinking-centered team can stack it with this E.G.O's Sinking.
messages.穴: 貫通スキルで呼吸を得て、呼吸威力が積みやすい。: **[Hollow](ego:0510)**: Gains Poise with his Pierce skills, making Poise Potency easy to build.
messages.沈潜と破裂: S1「縦斬り」で沈潜、S2「二連撃」で沈潜と破裂、S3「旋風」のⅡ: **Sinking and Rupture**: S1 Downward Cleave inflicts Sinking, S2 Dual Strike inflicts Sinking and Rupture, and Coin Ⅱ of S3 Whirlwind inflicts Sinking and Rupture (plus 2 Attack Power Down on Heads Hit).
messages.ダメージを受けなかった次のターンに強化: 前のターンにダメージを受けていなければ: **Bonuses on the turn after taking no damage**: If he took no damage on the previous turn, S2 gains +1 Coin Power and S3 gains +2 Coin Power.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊戯」(怠惰×2・共鳴): 次のターン開始時に精神力を6回復。: **Combat passive — Entertainment (2 Sloth Resonance)**: Restores 6 SP at the start of the next turn.
messages.S1・S2で沈潜と破裂を入れる。前のターンにダメージを受けていなければS2・S3: Inflict Sinking and Rupture with S1 and S2. If he took no damage on the previous turn, S2 and S3 become stronger, so prioritize S3 if it is in hand that turn.
messages.S2のコイン倍増: 攻撃前に対象の出血回数が4未満なら、1・2枚目のコインが追加: **Doubling S2's Coins**: Before attacking, if the target has less than 4 Bleed Count, the first and second Coins are duplicated for 4 Coins. Enemies with no Bleed also meet the condition. The addition happens before attacking, so the Clash uses the original 2 Coins.
messages.出血回数との兼ね合い: S2の条件は「出血回数4未満」なので、出血回数を多く付与: **Balancing with Bleed Count**: S2's condition is less than 4 Bleed Count, so pairing him with allies who inflict a lot of Bleed Count makes it harder to meet.
messages.S3の麻痺: 戦闘開始時に、このスキルで付与する出血と麻痺が1増える。Ⅲコインの: **S3's Paralyze**: At Combat Start, the Bleed and Paralyze inflicted by this skill increase by 1. Coin Ⅲ inflicts Paralyze on hit, locking down the enemy's Coin Power that turn.
messages.出血: S1「切り払う」・S2・S3で出血を付与。バトルパッシブ「黒雲刀」(色欲: **Bleed**: S1 Cleave, S2, and S3 inflict Bleed. Through the combat passive Hēiyúndào (3 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), attacking with the final Coin of the last Sin in a chain inflicts 3 Bleed.
messages.サポートパッシブ「組織の報復」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も高: **Support passive — Syndicate Payback (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Bleed inflicted by the 1 fastest ally.
messages.S2を主力にして、出血回数が4未満の敵へ当てる。マッチ威力は高くないので、弱いス: Use S2 as his main skill and land it on enemies with less than 4 Bleed Count. His Clash Power is not high, so the basic approach is to Clash against weak skills or use one-sided attacks. Land S3 while the enemy still has actions left to make use of Paralyze. Note that S2 rarely doubles in teams that inflict a lot of Bleed Count.
messages.出血: S1「首を切る」の表面的中時に出血を付与。S2「抉る」は対象の出血が7以: **Bleed**: S1 Throat Slit inflicts Bleed on Heads Hit. S2 Shank deals +20% damage if the target has at least 7 Bleed.
messages.S2のⅢコイン: 敵の体力が25%未満のとき、表面的中で対象が生きていればコイン: **S2's Coin Ⅲ**: When the enemy is below 25% HP, if the target is still alive after a Heads Hit, the Coin is reused once.
messages.S3「滅多切り」: 1コインの大技(威力5〜30)。敵を倒すとスキルを1回再使用: **S3 — Mutilate**: A 1-Coin big hit (power 5–30). Defeating an enemy reuses the skill once, and a Heads Hit on the reuse greatly increases damage (more if the target has at least 10 Bleed).
messages.バトルパッシブ「愉悦」(暴食×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開始時に(: **Combat passive — Gaiety (2 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Restores (Gluttony Resonance×2) SP at the start of the next turn.
messages.精神力が高いほどコインの表面が出やすい(ゲームの一般仕様)ので精神力を高く保ち、: Higher SP makes Heads more likely (a general game rule), so keep his SP high and stack Bleed with S1. Finish weakened enemies with S2 and S3 to chain into reuse.
messages.サポートパッシブ「暖かいですよね？」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力: **Support passive — Isn’t It Warm? (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Burn Count inflicted by the skill and Coin effects of attack skills of the 1 ally with the highest SP. It works when he is not deployed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「沸き立ちますね～」(憤怒×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の精: **Combat passive — Flaring Up~ (4 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: While his SP is 30 or more, +1 Burn Count inflicted by his attack skills. His only Wrath skill is S3 Crimson Blaze Fist, so allies need to supply the Wrath.
messages.S2「流れる炎」: Ⅱコインで火傷回数を増やし、自分の精神力が30以上・45以上: **S2 — Flowing Flame**: Coin Ⅱ increases Burn Count, more at 30 or more and 45 or more of his own SP. +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Burn Count.
messages.精神力の確保: S1「身体をほぐす」は使用時に精神力3回復、S3はⅡコインの表面: **Securing SP**: S1 Warm Up restores 3 SP on use, and S3 restores 6 SP on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit.
messages.S3: 対象の火傷回数が6以上なら、Ⅱコインでダメージ量の30%分混乱区間を前進: **S3**: If the target has at least 6 Burn Count, Coin Ⅱ shifts the Stagger Threshold by 30% of the damage dealt.
messages.火傷編成では、控えに置いて「暖かいですよね？」で味方の火傷回数付与を増やす。出撃: In Burn teams, place him in backup to increase allies' Burn Count infliction with Isn’t It Warm?. When deploying him, keep his SP at 30 or more with S1 and S3, and stack Burn Count with S2. Both passives require 4 Wrath Owned, so include allies with Wrath skills in the team.
messages.K社アンプル: ターン開始時に4未満なら(数値×5)%の体力を回復する。4以上に: **K Corp Ampule**: At Turn Start, if it is below 4, he heals (value×5)% of his HP. **He dies when it reaches 4 or more.**
messages.守備「アンプル注入」: 使用時に次のターンにK社アンプル1を得る(バリアも高め): **Defense skill — Ampule Injection**: Grants 1 K Corp Ampule next turn on use (with a fairly large Shield).
messages.バトルパッシブ「再生アンプル活性化」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 被ダメ: **Combat passive — Regeneration Ampule Activation (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When he takes damage below 20% HP, he heals 90% of his max HP and gains 1 K Corp Ampule. After it triggers, he gains 1 Fragile every turn. The data says "once per battle," but whether this applies to the whole passive cannot be determined from the data. Triggering it multiple times does not increase the Fragile gained, so it is likely fine to use it as if it can trigger multiple times.
messages.アンプルの配分: 守備とパッシブはどちらもアンプルを増やす。守備を多く使ってアン: **Allocating Ampules**: Both the Defense skill and the passive increase Ampules. If the passive triggers while Ampules are at 3 from heavy Defense skill use, it reaches 4 and he dies.
messages.挑発値: S1「侵入者遮断」・S2「崩壊刃」・守備は使用時に次のターンの挑発値+: **Aggro**: S1 Impede the Intruder, S2 Decay Blade, and his Defense skill grant +5 Aggro next turn on use. The Aggro is added from Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.S2「崩壊刃」: マッチ威力が高めの主力スキル。破裂を付与する。: **S2 — Decay Blade**: His main skill with fairly high Clash Power. Inflicts Rupture.
messages.集中戦闘ではS2と守備で挑発値を上げて攻撃を引き受ける。守備を早めに使えば毎ター: In Focused Encounters, raise Aggro with S2 and his Defense skill to take attacks. Using the Defense skill early increases the percentage healing every turn, while not using it leaves Ampule room for the passive's large heal. Decide the allocation based on whether he needs to take big hits or endure many small ones, and manage Defense skill use so Ampules never reach 4.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「エネルギー循環」・S2「整理支援」の使用時と的中時に充電回数: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases on use and on hit of S1 Energy Cycle and S2 Cleanup Support.
messages.充電力場: S2のⅡコインは充電回数に応じて次のターンに充電力場を得る。S3「充: **Charge Barrier**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 grants Charge Barrier next turn based on Charge Count. S3 Deploy Charge Barrier spends all Charge Count if it is 10 or more and gives (amount spent ÷ 2) Charge Barrier to the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio, including himself. His Defense skill also grants Charge Barrier.
messages.S2: 自分にバリアがあるときマッチ威力が上がる。: **S2**: Clash Power rises while he has Shield.
messages.バトルパッシブ「慣れた整理業務」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時: **Combat passive — Cleanup Mastery (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, grants 2 Haste next turn if he has at least 5 Charge Count, and 1 more at 10 or more.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を10以上貯め、S3で体力の低い味方に充電力場を配る。充電回: Build 10 or more Charge Count with S1 and S2, then hand out Charge Barrier to low-HP allies with S3. Keeping Charge Count up also raises his Speed through the passive, but spending all Charge Count with S3 makes the passive's Haste unlikely on the next turn.
messages.速度で強化: S1「追跡」は自分のクイック2以上で最終威力+1。S2「お先」は速: **Speed bonuses**: S1 Track gains +1 Final Power with at least 2 Haste on himself. S2 Goin' First gains +1 Coin Power at 6 or more Speed, and S3 Rampage at 8/6 or more.
messages.クイック: S2の使用時と守備「素早い」の回避成功時に次のターンのクイックを得る: **Haste**: Gains Haste next turn on using S2 and on a successful Evade with the Defense skill Quickness.
messages.出血: 各スキルで出血を付与。S2のⅢコインは、速度が対象より高ければ速度差だけ: **Bleed**: Each skill inflicts Bleed. Coin Ⅲ of S2 increases Bleed Count by the Speed difference if he is faster than the target.
messages.S3: 対象の失った体力に応じてダメージ量が増加。Ⅰコインの表面的中で対象の出血: **S3**: Deals more damage based on the HP the target has lost. On Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit, restores SP based on the target's Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「鈎」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵討伐時、次のターンに: **Combat passive — Hook (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On defeating an enemy, grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn, once per turn.
messages.S2と守備でクイックを重ねて速度を上げ、出血を積む。体力の減った敵をS3で仕留め: Stack Haste with S2 and his Defense skill to raise Speed, and build Bleed. Finish weakened enemies with S3 to chain into Attack Power Up for the next turn.
messages.探求した知識: 最後に捨てたスキルのランク(基本値1)。S3を捨てれば3、S2な: **Insight**: The rank of the last discarded skill (default 1). Discarding S3 makes it 3, S2 makes it 2, and S1 makes it 1.
messages.S1「知識消耗」: 使用時にスロット内でランクが最も高いスキル1つを捨てる。スロ: **S1 — Expend Knowledge**: On use, discards the highest-rank skill in his slots. If there is no S3 in his slots but there is an S2, it discards S2, dropping Insight to 2. At 3 or more Insight, it reuses Coin Ⅰ and gains Clash Power (at Uptie Ⅳ, it reuses (Insight − 1) times and gains +(Insight − 1) Clash Power; at 3 Insight, 2 reuses and +2). Reuse happens when attacking, so the Clash uses 1 Coin.
messages.S2「開け放つ」・守備「導く歩み」: ランダムな2つのスキルをランクの低い順に捨: **S2 Unveil and the Defense skill Guiding Steps**: Discard 2 random skills in ascending order of rank. The rank of the last one discarded becomes Insight, so discarding only S1s drops it to 1. S2 gains Coin Power at 3 or more Insight (+(Insight − 1) at Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.S3「循環する知識」: 知識2以上なら知識の値だけコイン威力が上がり、対象の沈潜: **S3 — Cyclical Knowledge**: At 2 or more Insight, gains Coin Power equal to Insight and deals more damage based on the target's Sinking. It does not discard other skills itself.
messages.バトルパッシブ「鍵を覗き込む」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分がスキル: **Combat passive — Peering Through a Key (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When he discards a skill, gains Damage Up equal to its rank, up to 3 per turn. When an ally discards a skill of higher rank than his Insight, his Insight increases by 1.
messages.スロットにS3がある状態でS1(またはS2)を使い、S3を捨てて知識を3にする。: Use S1 (or S2) while S3 is in his slots to discard S3 and bring Insight to 3. After that, each use of S1 or S2 discards the remaining skills, and Insight drops if S2 or S1 is discarded last. Once Insight is 3, he can keep it there by replacing the lower-row skills with Defense skills and using only the upper row, leaving no discardable skills (Defense skills cannot be discarded). He also inflicts Sinking, but his core is sustained Slash damage.
messages.S3の消耗段階: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10消耗してコイン威力が上がる(同期化: **S3's spending tiers**: On use, spends 10 of his own Tremor Count to gain Coin Power (at higher Uptie, at 15 or more it spends 15 for even more). If spent, Coin Ⅰ performs Amplitude Entanglement into Tremor - Reverb, and Coins Ⅱ, Ⅲ, and Ⅳ trigger Tremor Burst 3 times in total. Without spending 10 or more, Coin Ⅲ's Tremor Burst does not occur (Coin Ⅳ's condition differs by Uptie).
messages.振動-反響: 振動爆発時に振動威力の分だけ怠惰ダメージを与える。S3の振動爆発と: **Tremor - Reverb**: On Tremor Burst, deals Sloth damage equal to Tremor Potency. Combined with S3's Tremor Bursts, it becomes a damage source.
messages.自分の振動回数の獲得: S1「推理開始」・S2「変形杖護身術」の使用時と的中時に: **Gaining his own Tremor Count**: Increases on use and on hit of S1 Deduction Start and S2 Morph Cane Technique, and above certain amounts, S1 and S2 also gain Coin Power.
messages.敵の振動回数は増やせない: どのスキルにも対象の振動回数を増やす効果はなく、S2: **He cannot increase the enemy's Tremor Count**: None of his skills increase the target's Tremor Count, and S2's and S3's Tremor Bursts actually reduce it by 1. Allies need to inflict the Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「振動癒着変形戦闘杖(未認可発明品)」(怠惰×6・保有・同期化Ⅱで: **Combat passive — Vibroweld Morph-combat Cane (Unauthorized Invention) (6 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Grants Damage Up next turn equal to the number of Tremor Bursts he triggered that turn, up to 3.
messages.自分への振動爆発: 振動回数を消耗できなかったとき(同期化段階が高いと、消耗が1: **Tremor Burst on himself**: If he could not spend Tremor Count (at higher Uptie, if he spent less than 15), he also triggers Tremor Burst on himself at the end of S3. Tremor Burst shifts the Stagger Threshold by Tremor Potency, so if he has no Tremor himself, the impact is likely small.
messages.敵の振動回数を増やせる味方と組み、S1・S2で自分の振動回数を貯める。回数が10: Pair him with allies who can increase the enemy's Tremor Count, and build his own Tremor Count with S1 and S2. Once it reaches 10 or more, use S3 to entangle into Tremor - Reverb and gain Stagger Threshold shift and Sloth damage from 3 Tremor Bursts. S2 itself also has high power, so attack with S2 while waiting for Tremor to be ready.
messages.破裂で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の破裂6以上でコイン威力+1。S2「骨を折る」・: **Rupture bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Rupture. If the target has at least 15 Rupture and 3 Rupture Count, S2 Bonecrusher and S3 A Cheerful Hunt's End **do not inflict Rupture or Rupture Count with that skill**, but gain +1 Coin Power instead (+1 more against Bloodfiends and Blood Sacs) (Uptie Ⅳ). This stop also covers the Rupture Count increase on S2's and S3's own Clash Wins.
messages.マッチ勝利で回数補充: S2・S3はマッチ勝利時に破裂回数を増やす。ただし上の強: **Topping up Count on Clash Win**: S2 and S3 increase Rupture Count on Clash Win. However, it is not replenished while the bonus above is active, so it only works when the condition is not met.
messages.S1「振り下ろす」: 付与停止の対象外で、強化中も破裂を4回に分けて付与し続ける: **S1 — Slam**: Not affected by the stop, so it keeps inflicting Rupture in 4 parts even during the bonus.
messages.バトルパッシブ「愉快な狩猟法」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象が血鬼・: **Combat passive — How to Hunt Cheerfully (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% damage if the target is a Bloodfiend or Blood Sac or has at least 10 Rupture. If he has Bleed on use, inflicts 3 Rupture on hit (once per turn at lower Uptie, twice at Uptie Ⅳ). This infliction is not affected by the skill-side stop.
messages.S3の再使用: Ⅲコインは対象の破裂15以上か体力比率30%未満で再使用(スキル: **S3's reuse**: Coin Ⅲ is reused if the target has at least 15 Rupture or is below 30% HP ratio, once per skill (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.S1・S2で破裂を積み、破裂15以上か弱った敵にS3を当てて強化と再使用を狙う。: Stack Rupture with S1 and S2, then land S3 on enemies with 15 or more Rupture or weakened enemies to aim for the bonus and reuse. During the bonus, S2 and S3 inflict neither Rupture nor Count, so Rupture Count decreases with every attack. Cover Rupture Count with allies who can inflict it, and add Rupture with S1 and the passive's 3 Rupture. He shines especially in the Mirror Dungeon, where E.G.O Gifts can supplement Rupture.
messages.ターゲット捕捉: 終止符事務所ヒースクリフが出場中なら、S3では確定で、S2では: **Target Spotted**: While Heathcliff's Full-Stop Office Fixer is deployed, it always triggers with S3, and with S2 has a 20% chance per point of the highest Resonance (25% at higher Uptie). After Hong Lu's attack, Heathcliff makes a one-sided attack on the same enemy with Skill 2.
messages.バトルパッシブ「戦術的射撃支援」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ヒースクリ: **Combat passive — Tactical Fire Support (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If Heathcliff is in Overwatch Assignment or in backup, S2 and S3 are enhanced into Combo: Target Marked and Combo: Full-Stop to Life with more Coins. 5 Pride is hard to gather on his own, so allies' Pride is also needed.
messages.弾丸: S2・S3は消耗した弾丸1つごとに基本威力+1、さらにダメージ量も上がる: **Ammo**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Base Power per Ammo spent, plus more damage. Without Ammo, the attack is not cancelled, but that Coin's on-hit effects do not activate (passive Concentration).
messages.再装填: ターン開始時に弾丸が0なら守備が「影の向こう」に変わり、使うとターン終: **Reload**: If he has 0 Ammo at Turn Start, his Defense skill becomes Beyond the Shadow, which reloads at Turn End when used (once per battle).
messages.S3: 混乱区間を前進させ、Ⅲコインは対象が混乱状態ならクリティカルダメージ量+: **S3**: Shifts the Stagger Threshold, and Coin Ⅲ gains +30% Critical damage against staggered targets and inflicts Bind and Pierce Fragility on hit.
messages.ヒースクリフと同時に出撃させ、S2・S3でターゲット捕捉の追撃を引き出す。ヒース: Deploy him together with Heathcliff and draw out Target Spotted follow-ups with S2 and S3. When Heathcliff steps back in Overwatch Assignment or is in backup, hold 5 Pride to switch to the combo versions of S2 and S3. Build Poise with S1, and reload with Beyond the Shadow once he runs out of Ammo.
messages.充電(威力)の育成: バトルパッシブ「脳波充電収束角」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱ: **Growing Charge Potency**: Through the combat passive Brainwave Charge-focusing Antlers (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Charge each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. At 2 or more Charge, his basic attack skills' Sinking infliction and damage increase.
messages.S3「集中」で回数確保: 使用時に充電回数+5(同期化Ⅳでは+7)、的中時に(充: **Securing Count with S3 Concentration**: +5 Charge Count on use (+7 at Uptie Ⅳ), and increases by (Charge + 1) on hit, up to 6 (Charge + 3, up to 8, at Uptie Ⅳ). Charge Count decreases by 1 at Turn End. At Uptie Ⅳ, 10 or more remains on the next turn so S2 can be used safely, but at Uptie Ⅲ the gain falls short, and using S2 right away lands in the misfire range below. +1 Base Power and Coin Power per Charge, up to 5 each, and damage rises greatly with power. Inflicts 4 Sinking and Sinking Count.
messages.S2「精神の鞭」で消耗: 使用時に充電回数10を消耗してコイン威力が上がり、攻撃: **Spending with S2 Mind Whip**: Spends 10 Charge Count on use for more Coin Power, and if 8 or more remain before attacking, spends 8 more for +40% damage.
messages.S2の暴発に注意: 充電回数が5以上10未満で使うと、自分が沈潜を得て回数を10: **Beware S2's misfire**: Using it with 5–9 Charge Count makes him gain Sinking to top Count up to 10 and turns it into an Unfocused Volley that cannot distinguish friend from foe. At 5 or more Charge Potency, the friend-or-foe restriction does not apply.
messages.その他の獲得手段: S1「エネルギー強打」と守備「エネルギー凝集」も充電回数を得: **Other sources**: S1 Energy Strike and the Defense skill Energy Condensation also grant Charge Count, but the Defense skill only grants +3.
messages.同期化Ⅳでは、序盤にS3を敵に当てて充電回数を確保し、次のターンにS2で10消耗: At Uptie Ⅳ, land S3 on an enemy early to secure Charge Count, then spend 10 with S2 on the next turn to grow Charge Potency (S3→S2). At Uptie Ⅲ, the same sequence falls short of 10 Charge Count and tends to misfire, so add Count with S1 and his Defense skill to reach 10 or more before using S2. Using S2 at 5–9 Charge Count risks hitting allies, so avoid it until Charge Potency reaches 5. The passive requires 3 Envy Owned, so secure Envy alongside spending Count with his Envy S2. He takes time to fully develop and his opening is unstable, so using him at Uptie Ⅳ is preferable.
messages.S3の3連撃: 「黒獣たちよ、応えろ」の攻撃後、行動可能で畳み掛けが最も低い黒獣: **S3's three-hit sequence**: After Answer Me, Heishou Packs's attack, he issues Exalted Command to the Heishou ally who can act and has the lowest Unrelenting Storm, and that ally makes a one-sided attack on the same enemy with basic skill 3, once per turn. He then uses I Carve the Path of a Lord. If Exalted Command does not trigger, or the coordinating Heishou ally is staggered or dies, he uses Lonesome Stand: Sacrifice to Claim The Garden [孑孑單身, 捨生取园] instead.
messages.常時パッシブ「黒獣君主」: 自分以外の味方が待機解除・復帰すると精神力を回復させ: **Always-active passive — The Heishou Lord**: When an ally other than himself steps in from backup or returns, he restores their SP and has them make a one-sided attack with Skill 1 at Combat Start. For Heishou or Jia Family members, it restores 20 SP and the one-sided attack uses Skill 3 (2 times per battle per Identity).
messages.守備「黒獣利爪」で入れ替え: マッチ可能反撃。待機人員がいれば、体力比率が最も低: **Swapping with the Defense skill Heishou Keenclaw [黑獣利爪]**: A clashable counter. If there are units in backup, the 1 Heishou ally with the lowest HP ratio follows up with Skill 1 and retreats at Turn End (recovering 10% of max HP). If there are none in backup, that Heishou ally receives 2 Attack Power Up.
messages.全ての黒獣の主: ステージ開始時、待機人員を含めて編成した黒獣人格1名につき1得: **Leash-holder of All Heishou**: At stage start, he gains 1 for each Heishou Identity in the team, including backup. Raises Speed, Defense Level, and Offense Level, and at 5 or more, all Heishou Identities gain 1 Offense Level Up.
messages.バトルパッシブ「汚れた血さえも受け入れ、誰かの血に濡れながら意を果たす。」(暴食: **Combat passive — Embrace the Tarnished Blood and Exsanguinate Others For the Cause. (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Survives damage that would bring his HP to 0 at 1 HP for 1 turn and gains Tarnished Blood, once per battle. Tarnished Blood increases by 1 at Turn End, and he takes HP damage equal to 20% of max HP per point.
messages.黒獣人格を出撃と待機人員の両方に入れて組む。S3で黒獣との3連撃を組み、尊命の相: Build the team with Heishou Identities both deployed and in backup. Set up the three-hit sequence with Heishou allies through S3; the Exalted Command target is the Heishou ally who can act and has the lowest Unrelenting Storm, and on a tie, the Identity earlier in team order. Check which Heishou ally's S3 will come out before using it. When there are units in backup, use his Defense skill to retreat worn-out Heishou allies, and have the incoming Heishou ally fire S3 through The Heishou Lord. The Heishou Bolus Contamination [黑獣丸染] and Life from Death [死中求活] enhancements build slowly, so there is little need to aim for them. His durability is very low, so watch out for Clash losses.
messages.生体材料と「作品名:ティビア」: 常時パッシブ「生涯の作品、ティビア」により、ダ: **Corpus Ingredient and Artwork: Tibia**: Through the always-active passive Magnum Opus: Tibia, Count increases by 5 at the end of a skill that dealt damage (+3 if the target dies). Each time he spends a cumulative 10 Count, he gains 1 Corpus Ingredient Potency. At Potency 2, he gains Artwork: Tibia, activating +1 Base Power (the Potency 1+ effect) and +10% damage against enemies with Bleed (the 2+ effect) at that point; at 3, +1 to Bleed Potency and Count inflicted is added. At Potency 1, Tibia has no effect yet.
messages.S3「ティビアのメロディー-解体されたものが解体されていないものを解体すること」: **S3 — Tibia's Melody - Anatomization of the Unanatomized by the Anatomized**: With at least 10 Corpus Ingredient Count, spends up to 20 to enhance itself, making all Coins Unbreakable Coins. Attack Weight also increases with Corpus Ingredient Potency. Because it spends a lot at once, it is a way to reach Potency 3.
messages.S2「材料獲得-血で沐浴するオブジェ」の追撃: 対象のマイナス効果の種類に応じて: **S2 Gather Ingredient - Blood-bathed Objet's follow-up**: Deals more damage based on the number of different negative effects on the target, and at 5 or more types, follows up with Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage on Coin Ⅲ hit, once per turn.
messages.守備「展示会の主催」: 戦闘開始時に援護防御1を得て、味方が一方攻撃されるとマッ: **Defense skill — Curating the Exhibition**: Gains 1 Assist Defense at Combat Start, and when an ally is attacked one-sidedly, covers them with the clashable counter Please. Vandalism is Prohibited. The counter also counts as a skill that gains Corpus Ingredient Count.
messages.「閉場」: パッシブ「身体克服」(同期化Ⅲで取得)により、眺望(登場時21。ター: **Closing Time**: Through the passive Transcend the Corpus (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ), when Viewing the Tableau (21 on appearing; decreases by 2 at Turn End and by 1 when a Ring ally uses a skill, the latter once per turn per Identity) reaches 0, one attack skill becomes a 5-Coin big hit on the next turn, once per battle. It takes time before it can be fired.
messages.S1「解体」・S2でマイナス効果を重ね、5種以上の敵にS2を当てて追撃を出す。生: Stack negative effects with S1 Anatomize and S2, and land S2 on enemies with 5 or more types to trigger the follow-up. Build Corpus Ingredient Count, and fire S3 at the moment its spending reaches Potency 3 to gain Tibia's Bleed infliction bonus early. Protect allies with his Defense skill's Assist Defense while cycling Count through counters. Treat Closing Time as a bonus trump card that comes sooner in long fights with more Ring allies.
messages.捕縛[ホンル]: S3「推刷執行」・守備「捕縄を掛ける」で付与。対象の速度が下が: **Trussed [Hong Lu]**: Inflicted by S3 Hunter's Scouring and the Defense skill Throwing the Ohra Bond. Lowers the target's Speed and increases Pride damage taken by 10%. It decreases each turn unless the bearer is attacked by the inflicter. While an enemy has Trussed, he gains Prisoner Transport Arrangements and gains Clash Power against that enemy.
messages.捕縛した敵への強化: S1「捕縄で締め上げる」・S2「裂き斬る」は最終威力+1。: **Bonuses against Trussed enemies**: S1 Constricting Ohra Bonds and S2 Avulsion Slash gain +1 Final Power. At 2 or more Trussed, S2 spends 1 to reuse a Coin and trigger Bleed. S3 gains all-Unbreakable Coins, and its final Coin inflicts Bleed Count and Attack Power Down.
messages.引き裂かれた傷: S3のⅣコインで付与(S2はクリティカル時のみ)。ターン開始時: **Avulsion Wound**: Inflicted by Coin Ⅳ of S3 (S2 only on Critical Hit). Deals 2 Bleed at Turn Start and inflicts 1 Bind next turn.
messages.呼吸と出血: S1〜S3は自分の呼吸と対象の出血の合計に応じてコイン威力が上がる: **Poise and Bleed**: S1–S3 gain Coin Power based on his Poise plus the target's Bleed, up to 2. His Defense skill gains +2 Clash Power.
messages.守備かS3で狙った敵に捕縛を掛け、その敵を攻撃し続けて出血と引き裂かれた傷を重ね: Apply Trussed to the target enemy with his Defense skill or S3, then keep attacking it to stack Bleed and Avulsion Wound. In Focused Encounters, he can take the Trussed enemy's attacks himself regardless of Speed.
messages.点穴 - ホンル: 常時パッシブ「立ち合いの下での決闘」により、基本攻撃スキルで: **Nerve Strike - Hong Lu**: Through the always-active passive A Duel Witnessed, inflicts 1 next turn on the last target hit by his basic attack skills (once per turn, up to 3; inflicted on parts in Focused Encounters). Clash Power and Base Power rise with the number of stacks. Applying it to another target removes the previous stacks.
messages.バトルパッシブ「草炎玉球」(憤怒×2・傲慢×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ: **Combat passive — Virescent Pyrojade (2 Wrath and 2 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Clash Win, inflicts 1 more Nerve Strike if the target has it, once per turn. Grants Haste next turn based on Poise Potency, up to 2, and raises Critical damage based on the target's Burn Potency. An important effect for stacking Nerve Strike quickly.
messages.点穴でコイン再使用: S1「発勁」は点穴3以上、S2「草炎掌」は2以上、S3「最: **Coin reuse from Nerve Strike**: S1 Fa Jin reuses a Coin at 3 or more Nerve Strike, S2 Virescent Flame Palm at 2 or more, and S3 Take the Hit to the Last Blow, Please? whenever the target has Nerve Strike (once per skill).
messages.速度差と呼吸・火傷: 各スキルは対象より速いほど、また自分の呼吸と対象の火傷の合: **Speed difference, Poise, and Burn**: Each skill gains power the faster he is than the target, and the more his Poise plus the target's Burn totals. S2 and S3 gain Poise on Clash Win.
messages.立合い - 東部センク: ステージ初登場時、待機・サポート人員のセンク協会所属人: **Witnessed - Eastern Cinq**: On first appearing in a stage, he gains 1 per Cinq Association Identity in backup or support, up to 3. Raises Offense Level and Poise gain.
messages.狙う敵(部位)を1つに決めて殴り続け、点穴を積む。傲慢・憤怒を味方からも集めて「: Pick one enemy (or part) to target and keep hitting it to stack Nerve Strike. Gathering Pride and Wrath from allies to activate Virescent Pyrojade early lets Clash Wins stack Nerve Strike too, reaching reuse sooner. Don Quixote's Cinq Assoc. East Section 3 also inflicts Nerve Strike - Don Quixote, and one character's Nerve Strike replaces the other's, so deploying them together means competing for Nerve Strike. There is little need to line up Cinq Association Identities in backup just to max out Witnessed.
messages.解析Ⅲ以降は精神力を実質消費せずに撃てる、沈潜を付ける憂鬱打撃の広域E.G.O。: A multi-target Gloom Blunt E.G.O that inflicts Sinking and, from Threadspin Ⅲ, can be used at effectively no SP cost.
messages.精神力の回復(解析Ⅲ): 攻撃後に精神力を15回復する。精神消耗は15なので、使: **SP recovery (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Restores 15 SP after the attack. Its Sanity cost is 15, so using it nets out to zero.
messages.広域と沈潜: 攻撃加重値3の広域で、Ⅰコインが的中時に沈潜を付与する(解析Ⅲで2: **Multi-target and Sinking**: A multi-target attack with 3 Attack Weight, and Coin Ⅰ inflicts Sinking on hit (from 2 to 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ). It is a single Coin with 11 Base Power and +10 Coin Power, so its power stays low on Tails.
messages.パッシブ「波紋」: ターン開始時、精神力が最も低い味方を、パネル上で最も多い自分: **Passive — Ripple**: At Turn Start, heals the ally with the lowest SP by his highest Absolute Resonance on the panel (except while panicking). Without Absolute Resonance, it heals nothing.
messages.必要資源: 憂鬱5・色欲1と憂鬱に偏る。侵蝕スキルは無い。: **Requirements**: 5 Gloom and 1 Lust, heavily skewed toward Gloom. It has no Corrosion skill.
messages.憂鬱の資源を出せる編成で、精神力を減らさずに沈潜を広く撒きたいときに使う。: Use it in teams that can supply Gloom when you want to spread Sinking widely without losing SP.
messages.完全共鳴を作りやすい編成なら、長期戦の序盤に撃って波紋を有効にしておく。: In teams that build Absolute Resonance easily, fire it early in a long fight to activate Ripple.
messages.マッチの切り札にするには威力が心もとないと考えられるので、通常スキルの補助として: Its power is likely too unreliable to be a Clash trump card, so use it to supplement regular skills.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が11から15、沈潜が2から5になり、攻撃後の精神力回復が付く。実: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 11 to 15, Sinking from 2 to 5, and SP recovery after the attack is added. Its practical performance is decided here.
messages.Ⅳ: 次のターンに味方全員の精神力減少効率-2とE.G.O使用時の精神力減少-2: **Ⅳ**: Only adds −2 SP Loss Efficiency for all allies next turn and −2 SP loss when using E.G.O. Likely a low priority.
messages.南部リウ協会5課: S1(憂鬱)とS2(色欲)で必要資源をそのまま出せ、S1は精: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0604)**: S1 (Gloom) and S2 (Lust) supply the required affinities directly, and S1 also restores SP.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課: S2(憂鬱)が沈潜を付与し、S3も沈潜回数を増やすので: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0608)**: S2 (Gloom) inflicts Sinking and S3 increases Sinking Count, so he comfortably covers a Sinking team's Gloom needs.
A Lust Pierce debuff E.G.O that inflicts Defense Level Down on enemies so allies' attacks land harder.
messages.防御レベル減少: Ⅰコインの的中時に防御レベル減少を付与する(解析Ⅲで2から4、: **Defense Level Down**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Defense Level Down on hit (from 2 to 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 5 at Ⅳ). It only lasts this turn, so it must be used before allies attack.
messages.守備威力減少: 的中時に守備威力減少2を付与する。敵が守備スキルを使うときにしか: **Defense Power Down**: Inflicts 2 Defense Power Down on hit. It only matters when the enemy uses a Defense skill, so it is a footnote.
messages.広域化(解析Ⅳ): 攻撃加重値が1から3になり、複数の敵にデバフを配れる。: **Multi-target (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Attack Weight goes from 1 to 3, spreading the debuff across several enemies.
messages.パッシブ「拘束するリボン」: パネル最左のスキルで攻撃した対象に、次のターン、色: **Passive — Binding Ribbons**: Targets attacked by the leftmost skill on the panel receive Lust Fragility equal to Lust Absolute Resonance ÷ 4 next turn. It does not apply without at least 4 Lust Absolute Resonance.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可で、速度が最も速い対象(味方に当たり得る)を攻撃し、: **Corrosion skill**: Cannot distinguish friend from foe, attacks the fastest target (which can be an ally), and inflicts 4 Bind (on hit from Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.デバフ役として、色欲・嫉妬の資源が溜まった時点で、味方の大技の直前に撃つ。: As a debuffer, fire it right before allies' big attacks once Lust and Envy resources are available.
messages.解析Ⅳまでは単体攻撃なので、広域のデバフが欲しいなら解析Ⅳを前提にする。: It is single-target until Threadspin Ⅳ, so if you want a multi-target debuff, assume Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.威力そのものは最低限と考えられるので、資源と属性を活かす用途に絞る。: Its power is likely minimal, so limit it to uses that make the most of its resources and affinity.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が17から19、防御レベル減少が2から4になる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 17 to 19, and Defense Level Down from 2 to 4.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、防御レベル減少が5になる。実用の水準に届くのはここか: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, and Defense Level Down becomes 5. This is where it reaches a practical level.
messages.ぽんぽん派ボス: S1(嫉妬)とS2(色欲)で必要資源をそのまま出せる。: **[Tingtang Gang Gangleader](persona:0603)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Lust) supply the required affinities directly.
messages.黒雲会若衆: S1が色欲で、パッシブ「黒雲刀」も色欲共鳴3で働くため、色欲の完全: **[Kurokumo Clan Wakashu](persona:0602)**: His S1 is Lust, and his passive Hēiyúndào also works at 3 Lust Resonance, making it easy to build Lust Absolute Resonance for Binding Ribbons.
messages.クイックと脆弱・次元の亀裂で場を整えつつ、充電を使った一度きりの復活を持つ傲慢斬: A Pride Slash E.G.O that sets up the field with Haste, Fragile, and Dimensional Rift, and has a one-time revival using Charge.
messages.充電とクイック: 攻撃前に充電回数が増え(解析Ⅲで3から5)、次のターンにクイッ: **Charge and Haste**: Increases Charge Count before attacking (from 3 to 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and grants 2 Haste next turn. Suited to combos where action order matters.
messages.脆弱と次元の亀裂: Ⅰコインの的中時に脆弱1と次元の亀裂(解析Ⅲで2から4)を付: **Fragile and Dimensional Rift**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Fragile and Dimensional Rift (from 2 to 4 at Threadspin Ⅲ) on hit. Dimensional Rift turns into Rupture Count and disappears at Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「もつれた現状復旧」: マイナス効果を持つ敵への的中で充電回数が1増える: **Passive — Entangled Phenomena Restoration**: Hitting an enemy with a negative effect increases Charge Count by 1, up to 4 per turn. When his HP would reach 0, he spends all Charge and recovers HP based on the amount (once per battle, up to 25% of HP).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 敵味方識別不可で現体力が最も高い対象を攻撃し、敵味方識別不可で現体: **Corrosion skill**: Cannot distinguish friend from foe, attacks the target with the highest current HP, and spends 10 Charge to increase the Fragile and Dimensional Rift inflicted. It assumes Charge is secured.
messages.充電を扱う人格と組み合わせ、充電を貯めた状態で撃つ。復活の回復量は充電の量次第。: Combine it with Identities that use Charge and fire it with Charge built up. The revival's healing depends on the amount of Charge.
messages.覚醒スキルは一般戦闘では最後方の対象を攻撃するので、狙いを決めたいときは注意する: In regular battles, the Awakening skill attacks the rearmost target, so be careful when you want to choose a target.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が20から22、充電獲得と次元の亀裂が増え、侵蝕スキルも強化される: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 20 to 22, Charge gain and Dimensional Rift increase, and the Corrosion skill is strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になり、広域になる。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3, making it multi-target.
messages.R社第4群トナカイチーム: S1(暴食)が充電回数を増やし、充電を消費するスキル: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Reindeer](persona:0612)**: S1 (Gluttony) increases Charge Count, and he has a full set of Charge-spending skills, helping with Charge management.
messages.K社3級摘出職職員: S1(傲慢)とS2(暴食)で必要資源を出せ、S2・S3で破: **[K Corp. Class 3 Excision Staff](persona:0605)**: S1 (Pride) and S2 (Gluttony) supply the required affinities, and S2 and S3 inflict Rupture, meshing with Dimensional Rift's conversion into Rupture Count.
messages.コインの表裏で味方の体力か精神力を、クリティカルなら両方を回復する、嫉妬打撃の回: An Envy Blunt healing E.G.O that heals allies' HP or SP depending on Heads or Tails, or both on a Critical Hit.
messages.表裏で回復先が変わる: 表面で攻撃を終えると体力比率の低い味方2名の体力を、裏面: **Heal target depends on Heads or Tails**: Ending the attack on Heads heals the HP of the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio, and on Tails heals the SP of the 2 allies with the lowest SP (10, 12 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 15 at Ⅳ).
messages.クリティカル回復(解析Ⅲ): クリティカルで攻撃を終えると、体力が最も低い味方1: **Critical healing (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Ending the attack with a Critical Hit heals 6 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP and 6 SP to the 1 ally with the lowest SP (8 at Threadspin Ⅳ). Being able to aim for Critical Hits with Poise improves efficiency.
messages.広域化: 攻撃加重値は解析Ⅲで2、Ⅳで3になる。攻撃レベルが人格Lv-5なので、: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight becomes 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 3 at Ⅳ. Its Offense Level is Identity Lv −5, so its actual Clash Power is lower than displayed.
messages.パッシブ「遠い海のカモメの鳴き声」: 敵が死ぬたびに、精神力が最も低い味方の精神: **Passive — Seagull Squawking Of The Distant Seas**: Each time an enemy dies, restores SP to the ally with the lowest SP. The amount grows with more kills (up to 9), but resets when a new wave starts.
messages.資源7個に対して回復量は小さいと考えられる。回復手段に困るときの補助として使う。: The healing is likely small for 7 resources. Use it as a supplement when healing is lacking.
messages.呼吸を持つ人格で使うと、クリティカルによる両方の回復を狙える。: Used by an Identity with Poise, it can aim for the Critical Hit that heals both.
messages.使用中の耐性は怠惰・嫉妬が脆弱なので、その属性の敵には注意する。侵蝕スキルは束縛: While in use, its resistances are Fatal to Sloth and Envy, so be careful against enemies of those affinities. The Corrosion skill inflicts Bind and Tremor, cannot distinguish friend from foe, and attacks the target with the lowest HP (possibly an ally).
messages.Ⅱ: カモメの鳴き声が解放される。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Seagull Squawking Of The Distant Seas.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量が10から12になり、クリティカル回復と広域化(加重値2)が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Healing goes from 10 to 12, and Critical healing and multi-target attacks (2 Attack Weight) are added.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量が15、クリティカル回復が8、加重値が3になる。: **Ⅳ**: Healing becomes 15, Critical healing 8, and Attack Weight 3.
messages.鴻園の君主: S1・S2が呼吸を得るのでクリティカルを狙いやすく、S1(憂鬱)・: **[The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613)**: S1 and S2 gain Poise, making Critical Hits easier to aim for, and S1 (Gloom) and S2 (Gluttony) also supply the required affinities.
messages.東部センク協会3課: S1が呼吸回数を3増やし、憂鬱の資源も出せる。: **[Cinq Assoc. East Section 3](persona:0616)**: S1 increases Poise Count by 3, and he also supplies Gloom resources.
messages.最大威力32の高いマッチ力と束縛で強敵を押さえ、侵蝕では与ダメージ分の体力も回復: A Gluttony Pierce E.G.O that holds down strong enemies with high Clash Power (up to 32) and Bind, and whose Corrosion skill heals HP based on damage dealt.
messages.高いマッチ威力: 基本威力17にコイン威力+15の1コインで、解析による威力の変: **High Clash Power**: A single Coin with 17 Base Power and +15 Coin Power; Threadspin does not change its power. It is stronger on Heads, so use it when SP is high.
messages.束縛: 的中時に次のターンの束縛2を付与し、次のターンのマッチを管理しやすくする: **Bind**: Inflicts 2 Bind next turn on hit, making the next turn's Clashes easier to manage.
messages.暴食脆弱(解析Ⅲ): 次のターンに暴食脆弱2を付ける。表面的中時が条件で、解析Ⅳ: **Gluttony Fragility (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: Inflicts 2 Gluttony Fragility next turn. It requires a Heads Hit, relaxed to on hit at Threadspin Ⅳ.

messages.低いなきごえ: S1(怠惰)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で必要資源の3属性を全て: **[Cavernous Wailing](ego:0606)**: S1 (Sloth), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply all three required affinities. Tremor needs to come from elsewhere.
messages.投げ縄: S2(暴食)が破裂を扱い、S1(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)と合わせて暴食・傲: **[Lasso](ego:0607)**: S2 (Gluttony) handles Rupture, and together with S1 (Gloom) and S3 (Pride) he supplies Gluttony and Pride resources.

messages.汚血泣涙: パッシブで終の死亡が起きず体力60%を回復し、以降ダメージ量増加も得: **[Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:0608)**: His passive prevents the death from The End and heals 60% HP, then grants Damage Up afterward. S2 (Gluttony) also supplies resources.
messages.汚血泣涙: S2(暴食)が資源を出し、S2・S3で破裂を付与するので、終の破裂条: **[Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:0608)**: S2 (Gluttony) supplies resources, and S2 and S3 inflict Rupture, making The End's Rupture condition easy to meet.
messages.寧ろ吾をなさん: S1(怠惰)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で必要資源の3属性を出: **[To Remain Oneself [宁作吾]](ego:0609)**: S1 (Sloth), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply all three required affinities, and S1 and S3 gain Poise.
messages.寧ろ吾をなさん: S1(憂鬱)が呼吸回数を3増やし、S3(傲慢)も呼吸を得るので: **[To Remain Oneself [宁作吾]](ego:0609)**: S1 (Gloom) increases Poise Count by 3, and S3 (Pride) also gains Poise, making it easy to avoid running out of Poise Count.
messages.拒絶宣布: 基本攻撃スキルが充電回数を得るスキルとして扱われ、S1(傲慢)・S2: **[Repudiation](ego:0610)**: His basic attack skills count as skills that gain Charge Count, and S1 (Pride), S2 (Envy), and his Defense skill (Lust) supply all three required affinities.
messages.拒絶宣布: 充電を溜めて消耗するスキルが揃い、S2(嫉妬)で資源も出せる。: **[Repudiation](ego:0610)**: Has a full set of skills that build and spend Charge, and S2 (Envy) also supplies resources.
messages.S2「撃ち落とす」の自己強化: 使用時に、次のターンの攻撃威力増加とダメージ量増: **S2 Smackdown's self-buff**: On use, grants Attack Power Up and 1 Damage Up next turn. Attack Power Up raises the Final Power of attack skills, so S2 and S3 become stronger in Clashes the next turn. Coin Ⅰ also inflicts 2 Tremor on Heads Hit (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.S3「腹いせ」: 2コインの大技。Ⅰコインが表面で的中すると次のコインの威力+2: **S3 — Upheaval**: A 2-Coin big hit. If Coin Ⅰ lands Heads, the next Coin gains +2 power, and Coin Ⅱ triggers Tremor Burst on hit. Most of its power comes from Coin Power, so it is a skill to use after raising SP.
messages.振動は補助: S1「バットで殴る」のⅠコイン(低い同期化段階では表面的中時、高い: **Tremor is supplementary**: Coin Ⅰ of S1 Bat Bash (on Heads Hit at lower Uptie, on hit at higher Uptie) inflicts 3 Tremor, and S2 inflicts 2 Tremor (Uptie Ⅳ). He has no effects that increase Tremor Count, so S3's Tremor Burst can be treated as a minor bonus that brings Stagger a little closer.
messages.守備「反撃」: 相手の攻撃を受けてから殴り返す反撃スキル。S2の攻撃威力増加は乗: **Defense skill — Counter**: A counter that strikes back after taking the opponent's attack. S2's Attack Power Up does not apply. It fizzles if he is staggered, so use it when he has HP to spare.
messages.パッシブ: バトル「ルサンチマン」(嫉妬×4・共鳴)は、最大体力が自分より高い敵: **Passives**: The combat passive Ressentiment (4 Envy Resonance) gives +10% damage against enemies with higher max HP than his. The support passive Spite-driven (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +10% Blunt skill damage to the 1 ally with the lowest max HP.
messages.S2は×2枚なので毎ターン来るとは限らないが、手元に来たら優先して使い、強化が乗: S2 has only 2 copies, so it will not come every turn, but prioritize it when it is in hand, then go for Clashes with S2 or S3 on the buffed next turn. All of his attacks are Blunt, so deploy him in fights where Blunt is effective. His Speed is a slow 1–4 (1–5 and 2–5 at higher Uptie), so he works well placed at the back where he is likely to be targeted. The combat passive needs 4 Envy Resonance for a small effect, so it is not worth forcing.
messages.体力が低いほど強化: S1「極剣」・S2「飛剣」は、体力が一定未満でスキル威力が: **Stronger at lower HP**: S1 Extreme Edge and S2 Flying Sword gain Skill Power below a certain HP (+1 below 25% at lower Uptie, +2 below 50% at higher Uptie). S3 gains +2 Skill Power below 25% HP at lower Uptie, and +1 Attack Weight (multi-target) below 50% HP at higher Uptie.
messages.S3「閃撃」の自傷とダメージ量: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの攻撃前にそれぞれ自分の体力を5減: **S3 Flashing Strike's self-damage and damage bonus**: Before the attacks of Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, he loses 5 HP each, and that Coin gains +50% damage. Its damage is high even without meeting the bonus conditions. However, he loses 10 HP in total, so using it at low HP can make him fall.
messages.反撃で体力を調整: 守備「反撃」は使用時に自分の体力を5減らし、呼吸回数3以上な: **Adjusting HP with Counter**: The Defense skill Counter costs him 5 HP on use and gains +50% damage with 3 or more Poise Count (both Uptie Ⅳ). It is a way to bring his HP down to the bonus threshold.
messages.呼吸(同期化Ⅳ): S1は使用時に呼吸回数3、S2は呼吸3を得る。S3は呼吸回数: **Poise (Uptie Ⅳ)**: S1 grants 3 Poise Count on use, and S2 grants 3 Poise. S3 gains +2 Skill Power at 10 or more Poise Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「呼吸」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): そのターンに攻撃でダ: **Combat passive — Respiration (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% damage if he took damage from an attack that turn. Pairs well with Counter.
messages.体力が多いうちはS1・S2で普通に戦って呼吸を貯める。並行して、被弾と反撃の自傷: While his HP is high, fight normally with S1 and S2 to build Poise. Meanwhile, bring his HP down to the bonus threshold (below 50% at higher Uptie) through hits and Counter's self-damage, then cut through with the multi-target S3. His Stagger Thresholds are front-loaded at 80%/60%, so he staggers easily early on, but past them there are no later thresholds, so he can hold out at high HP. Combined with Counter, he excels at holding the line in long fights and against stronger opponents. While lowering his HP, be careful not to get knocked out at once by attacks hitting his Sin weaknesses. Counter's self-damage, Poise, the 50% HP condition, and S3's multi-target were added or replaced at Uptie Ⅳ. At Uptie Ⅲ or below, the condition is below 25% HP and S3 is his only self-damage, so this playstyle hardly works.
messages.S3「迅速制圧」: 5コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時に脆弱2ずつ(1ターンの間有効: **S3 — Quick Suppression**: 5 Coins. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each inflict 2 Fragile on hit (lasting 1 turn), and Coins Ⅲ–Ⅴ inflict 1, 2, and 3 Rupture. Fragile takes effect the turn it is applied, so acting fast and letting following attacks benefit from it is strong.
messages.速度6以上で強化: 速度6以上のとき、S2「集中射撃」はコイン威力+1、S3はコ: **Bonuses at 6 or more Speed**: At 6 or more Speed, S2 Concentrated Fire gains +1 Coin Power and S3 gains +2 Coin Power. His Speed range is 3–5 (3–6 and 3–7 at higher Uptie), so at stages with a low cap, make up for it with the passive's Haste and similar.
messages.弾丸: 1回の使用で、S1「草食み」はⅠ・Ⅱコインで2、S2はⅠ〜Ⅲコインで3、: **Ammo**: Per use, S1 Graze the Grass spends 2 with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, S2 spends 3 with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ, and S3 spends 2 with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ. Cycling through his skills once (3× S1, 2× S2, 1× S3) uses 14 rounds in total. The only refill in the data is the passive Raring to Graze's "+3 Ammo at stage start." He starts with 13 (16 including the passive). When he runs out, Coins that spend Ammo are removed when attacking (Clashes still use all Coins).
messages.S2「集中射撃」: Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインの的中時に出血1ずつ付与する。: **S2 — Concentrated Fire**: Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ each inflict 1 Bleed on hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「草を食む準備」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開: **Combat passive — Raring to Graze (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the start of the next turn, Charge Count increases by Wrath Resonance. With 5 or more Charge Count, he gains 1 Haste and 1 Attack Power Up. Charge Count also increases on Coin Ⅲ hit of S1 and when using the Defense skill Evade.
messages.速度6以上を確保して、S3を味方より先に撃って脆弱を入れ、後続の攻撃でまとめて削: Secure 6 or more Speed, fire S3 before allies to inflict Fragile, and let following attacks wear the enemy down together. Even with the passive, his Ammo only covers a little over one cycle of skills, with no way to refill. So in long fights, or battles where Ammo carries over across waves, replace S1 and S2 with Evade or E.G.O to conserve Ammo. His damage drops when he runs dry, so he tends to perform best later in team order. In the current environment, spanning the three keywords Bleed, Rupture, and Charge is the reason he is used in the Mirror Dungeon.
messages.加算コイン弱化: S2のⅠコインが表面で的中すると、次のターンに加算コイン弱化(: **Plus Coin Drop**: If Coin Ⅰ of S2 lands Heads, it inflicts Plus Coin Drop next turn (1 at lower Uptie, 2 at higher Uptie). Plus Coin Drop lowers the power of Plus Coins by its value for 1 turn. The more Coins a skill has, the bigger the reduction. It is especially effective against story bosses with many Coins. S2 is 1 Coin, so keep his SP high so it lands Heads.
messages.S2のマッチ勝利で精神力回復: S2はマッチ勝利時に精神力を回復する(低い段階で: **SP recovery on S2 Clash Win**: S2 restores SP on Clash Win (3 at lower Uptie, 5 at higher Uptie).
messages.N社編成で強化: バトルパッシブ「クソッ…。」(嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): **Stronger in N Corp. teams**: The combat passive Bugger… (2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants +1 Coin Power while 4 or more N Corp. Fanatics, including himself, are alive (Uptie Ⅳ). Its other effect: when an ally dies, he loses 10 SP at the start of the next turn and gains 1 Blunt Power Up.
messages.釘と出血: S1「未熟な釘打ち」で釘と出血を付与する。釘は、ターン開始時に出血1: **Nails and Bleed**: S1 Gawky Nailing inflicts Nails and Bleed. Nails is a special Bleed that inflicts 1 Bleed at Turn Start and increases Bleed Count by the Nails value.
messages.S3「微弱な断罪」: 3コイン。各コインの表面的中で、ダメージ量の10%分の追加: **S3 — Infirm Retribution**: 3 Coins. Each Coin's Heads Hit deals additional damage equal to 10% of the damage dealt.
messages.サポートパッシブ「読経」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も高い味方: **Support passive — Cantillation (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Nails inflicted by the 1 fastest ally. Strong in combination with Faust's The One Who Grips.
messages.コインの多い敵スキルにS2を当てて加算コイン弱化を入れ、次のターンの味方のマッチ: His main job is to land S2 on enemy skills with many Coins to inflict Plus Coin Drop, making allies' Clashes easier the next turn. Apply Nails and Bleed with S1 while chipping away with S3. With 2 Envy Owned and at least 4 N Corp. Fanatics alive, the passive's +1 Coin Power applies. This is checked separately from the ally-death condition. Combined with the passive's SP loss, S2 is more likely to land Tails, so watch his SP after an ally dies.
messages.マッチ敗北で精神力が減る: この人格には特殊精神力増減「精神力減少」がある。マッ: **SP drops on Clash Lose**: This Identity has a special SP rule, SP Decrease. He loses SP on Clash Lose (10 by default, more for each Clash exchange after the first). S1 Umbrella Thwack has a low Clash Power of −1–5 (0–6 at higher Uptie) and grants 3 Sinking on [Clash Lose], making it a skill for losing to lower his SP.
messages.S2「泥濘踏み」が主力: 精神力-15未満で最終威力+2(低い同期化段階)/+3: **S2 Puddle Stomp is his main skill**: +2 Final Power below −15 SP (lower Uptie) or +3 (higher Uptie), and +2 more below −25. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict Rupture on Tails Hit, and Coin Ⅳ spends 5 of his own Sinking for +20% damage (triggers Tremor Burst on Tails Hit). Because it reduces Sinking, it also keeps his SP from dropping too far.
messages.バトルパッシブ「泪の雨」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に沈潜回: **Combat passive — Rain of Tears (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, spends 1 Sinking Count and lowers his own SP by his Sinking. Before taking damage, he gains Protection equal to his Sinking, up to 5 per turn. When taking damage, he gains 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn, up to 3 per turn. The effect is large with his Blunt S2.
messages.沈潜を自分に積む: S1は使用時に沈潜回数+1。S3「拡がれ！」は使用時に沈潜6: **Stacking Sinking on himself**: S1 adds +1 Sinking Count on use. S3 Spread Out! grants 6 Sinking and +3 Sinking Count on use. The Defense skill Warning grants 3/5 Sinking on use.
messages.減算コイン: 基本威力が高く、表面が出るたびに威力が下がる。裏面的中時の効果が多: **Minus Coins**: His Base Power is high, and power drops each time a Coin lands Heads. Many effects trigger on Tails Hit, and lower SP makes Tails more likely (a general game rule).
messages.序盤はS1でマッチに負けるか、S3で沈潜を得て精神力を下げる。精神力が十分下がっ: Early on, lose Clashes with S1 or gain Sinking with S3 to lower his SP. Once his SP is low enough, switch to attacking with S2. S2 consumes Sinking, so firing it just before E.G.O Corrosion prevents his SP from dropping too far. The design assumes the passive's Protection and Blunt DMG Up, so gather 3 Envy as early as possible (within 1–2 turns). The Defense skill Warning has low Coin Power and is worse than S1 for lowering SP. He is also easier to handle in Focused Encounters, where the opponent will attack him.
messages.S1「直感」の分割付与: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインそれぞれに破裂1の付与が2回ずつある。「[: **S1 Intuition's split infliction**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each have two separate 1-Rupture inflictions: "[Heads Hit/On Hit] 1 Rupture" (on Heads Hit at lower Uptie, on hit at higher Uptie) and "[Heads Hit] 1 Rupture" (Uptie Ⅳ). Because the infliction is split into instances, the passive's +1 below applies to each instance.
messages.バトルパッシブ「本能的看破」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 相手の脆弱属性: **Combat passive — Instinctive Read (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When attacking with an affinity the target is Fatal to (resistance above 1.5), +1 to the Rupture inflicted by skills. +1 more if 4 or more Seven Association Fixers, including himself, are alive at Combat Start.
messages.S2「事後収拾」で回数を維持: マッチ勝利時に破裂回数+1、Ⅰコインの的中時に破: **Maintaining Count with S2 The Wrap-up**: +1 Rupture Count on Clash Win and +2 Rupture Count on Coin Ⅰ hit. As a 1-Coin skill, it adds more Count than it consumes. It also inflicts 1/3 Defense Level Down next turn.
messages.S3「現場資料分析」: 4コインで対象の破裂を何度も発動させる。Ⅰコインで破裂回: **S3 — Forensics**: 4 Coins that trigger the target's Rupture repeatedly. Coin Ⅰ adds +3 Rupture Count, and Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ each inflict 1 Rupture on Heads Hit. Defeating an enemy with Coin Ⅳ increases the Rupture Count of the enemy with the least Rupture Count by 2.
messages.破裂6以上で強化(同期化Ⅳ): S1・S3は、対象の破裂が6以上ならコイン威力+: **Bonuses at 6+ Rupture (Uptie Ⅳ)**: S1 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Rupture.
messages.相手の脆弱属性を突けるときにパッシブを発動させ、S1で破裂威力を一気に積む。S2: Trigger the passive when he can hit the target's weak affinity, and stack Rupture Potency quickly with S1. Keep Count from running out with S2, then fire S3 once Rupture has built up to trigger it repeatedly. S3's Clash Power is a low 4–12, so pick its Clash opponents. He suits fights against high-HP Abnormalities where Rupture's fixed damage pays off, and in the Mirror Dungeon he pairs well with E.G.O Gifts that increase Rupture Potency and Count.
messages.挑発: S1「獲物追跡」・S2「銛穿ち」・守備「お返し」は使用時に次のターンの挑: **Aggro**: S1 Stalk Prey, S2 Snagharpoon, and the Defense skill Payback grant Aggro next turn on use.
messages.出血: S1は使用時に呼吸回数が増え、Ⅱコインで出血2を付与。S2は対象の出血3: **Bleed**: S1 increases Poise Count on use and inflicts 2 Bleed with Coin Ⅱ. S2 grants 1 Poise per 3 Bleed on the target and increases Bleed Count on Critical Hit. S3 Sever Knot inflicts more Bleed the lower his HP.
messages.S3: 嫉妬共鳴3以上でマッチ威力+1、嫉妬共鳴4以上・嫉妬完全共鳴6以上でコイ: **S3**: +1 Clash Power at 3 or more Envy Resonance, and Coin Power rises at 4 or more Envy Resonance and at 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance.
messages.バトルパッシブ「穿たれた刺青」(嫉妬×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分を含む味: **Combat passive — Mutilated Tattoos (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time an ally, including himself, takes damage, he gains 1 Offense Level Up and 1 Defense Level Up next turn (2 if the damaged ally is a Pequod member, up to 6/9). Damage rises with HP lost.
messages.集中戦闘では挑発値で攻撃を引き受け、被弾で攻撃・防御レベル増加を貯める。体力が減: In Focused Encounters, take attacks with Aggro and build Offense and Defense Level Up from hits. Bleed infliction and damage grow as his HP drops, so use S3 when his HP is low. Lining up Envy skills to build Resonance strengthens S3.
messages.敵の振動で強化: S1「履行勧告」は対象の振動3、S2「最終警告」・S3「執行宣: **Bonuses from enemy Tremor**: Coin Power rises based on the target's Tremor, with a threshold of 3 for S1 Execution Advised and 6 for S2 Final Warning and S3 Execution Sentencing (up to 2; +1 at or above the threshold at lower Uptie, +1 per threshold at higher Uptie).
messages.バトルパッシブ「厳重な立会い」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の振動威: **Combat passive — Grave Attendance (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +5%/10% damage per 6 Tremor Potency on the target, up to 15%/30%. When his own skill effect converts the target into Tremor - Decay, it triggers Tremor Burst on that target (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.自分で付ける振動は少なめ: S1はⅡコインで振動回数+2、S2は振動2×2、S3: **He inflicts little Tremor himself**: S1 adds +2 Tremor Count with Coin Ⅱ, S2 inflicts 2 Tremor ×2, and S3 inflicts 1 Tremor ×2. The Defense skill Do Not Obstruct adds +1 to the attacker's Tremor Count when he takes damage while he has Shield (does not stack).
messages.振動-崩壊: S3のⅢコインの的中時、対象の振動威力と回数の合計が20以上なら振: **Tremor - Decay**: On Coin Ⅲ hit of S3, if the target's combined Tremor Potency and Count is 20 or more, it performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Decay. The target's Defense Level drops by 1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Amplitude Conversion changes Tremor into another type, so it also overwrites any other amplitude already applied.
messages.サポートパッシブ「義務履行の確認」(傲慢×6・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最: **Support passive — Verify Obligation Fulfillment (6 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 Clash Power for skills that inflict Tremor Potency or Count used by the 1 fastest ally.
messages.振動を多く付与できる味方と組み、その振動を利用して高いマッチ威力とダメージ量で戦: Pair him with allies who can inflict plenty of Tremor, and use that Tremor to fight with high Clash Power and damage. Reaching 20 total Tremor alone is difficult, so use him to take on Clashes that protect the Tremor-applying allies. If an ally has applied a more useful amplitude (such as Tremor - Reverb), hold back S3 so it is not overwritten. His main stage is Focused Encounters, where Tremor is easier to maintain.
messages.充電を育てる: バトルパッシブ「モデルL37充電」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取: **Growing Charge**: Through the combat passive Charge Model L37 (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), he gains 1 Charge each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count during battle. At Turn End, he gains 1 Haste next turn with 2 or more Charge, and 1 more Haste plus 1 Clash Power Up with 3 or more.
messages.S2「光電標識」: 使用時に充電回数を10消耗し、コイン威力+1/+2。充電回数: **S2 — Photoelectric Mark**: Spends 10 Charge Count on use for +1/+2 Coin Power. With 5–9 Charge Count, he spends HP equal to 2×(10 − current Charge Count)% of max HP to make up the difference to 10. If it spent Charge, Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 2 Defense Level Down. Coin Ⅲ inflicts Photoelectricity equal to his Charge, up to 2/3.
messages.充電回数の補充: 主な補充源は4つ。S3「光電銛」はⅡコインの的中で5/7、Ⅲコ: **Replenishing Charge Count**: There are four main sources. S3 Photoelectric Harpoon adds 5/7 on Coin Ⅱ hit and Charge×3 (up to 9) on Coin Ⅲ hit. The Defense skill Charge adds 3 on use (once/twice per turn). The others are the increase from attacking enemies with Photoelectricity and S2's HP-paid top-up. S1 40S-2 Activation spends 5 on use for +1 Coin Power and only returns 2 each on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits, for a net of −1. It does not replenish Count, but it does add to the cumulative amount spent. S1's and S3's Coin effects trigger on hit, so they gain nothing if the Coins are broken.
messages.S3「光電銛」: 充電に応じてコイン威力が上がる(最大2)。Ⅳコインで光電(最大: **S3 — Photoelectric Harpoon**: Coin Power rises with Charge, up to 2. Coin Ⅳ inflicts Photoelectricity (up to 3) and 1 Blunt Fragility per 2 Charge, up to 2.

messages.終止符事務所代表ホンルとの連携: ホンルが出場していると、守備を使ったときに攻撃: **Coordination with Hong Lu's Full-Stop Office Rep**: While Hong Lu is deployed, using his Defense skill requests Melee Support against the attacker, once per turn.
messages.1ターン目は貫通威力増加3を活かしてS1・S2でマッチを取りに行き、呼吸回数を稼: On turn 1, use the 3 Pierce Power Up to take Clashes with S1 and S2 and build Poise Count. After that, create turns with no attacks by setting every slot to non-attacks such as Combat Poise. Build Poise Potency all at once through successful Evades and Precision Aim, then aim for big damage with S3's Critical Hit. If you do not want him to step back, the safe choice from turn 2 on is to turn S1 into his Defense skill or E.G.O to conserve Ammo. In consecutive battles, have a backup unit ready to fill the gap when he steps back. Deploying him with Hong Lu's Full-Stop Office Rep lets him keep attacking even while defending as he builds Poise, a good pairing.

messages.普段は攻撃スキルで出血とデバフを積み、S3を使ったら、次のターンは「裏路地の掟」: Normally stack Bleed and debuffs with his attack skills, and after using S3, counter with Rules of the Backstreets the next turn to aim for big damage including Coin reuse; that is the basic flow. However, the counter fizzles if he is staggered. Activate Dark Cloud Blade in a Lust-heavy team so his follow-ups when allies are attacked also add damage. While the passive is active at 3 Lust Resonance, he gains Dark Cloud Blade if one more Kurokumo Clan Identity is in battle. The combination with Ishmael's Kurokumo Clan Captain is especially strong.

messages.S2・S3を中心に戦い、弱いS1を守備に置き換えて過充電を挟み、充電を補ってから: Fight mainly with S2 and S3, replace the weak S1 with his Defense skill to slot in Overcharge, replenish Charge, then fire S3. messages.序盤は守備「獲物だな」で血炎を確保してS2の再使用を起こし、S1・S2で積極的に: Early on, secure Bloodflame with the Defense skill More Grub for Us to trigger S2's reuse, and actively Clash with S1 and S2 to raise Battleblood Instinct and his own Burn.
