messages.ジャンヌ（10章C最終戦）: Jeanne (Canto X, Route C Final Battle)
messages.第1段階は設計図を先に倒して捕捉を妨げ、第2段階はムルソーのスキル番号を合わせて: In Phase 1, kill blueprints before “Focusing” can consume them. In Phase 2, match Meursault's skill numbers to advance the waltz. In Phase 3, kill blueprints to reduce the body's HP instead of attacking it directly. Protect Meursault's HP and assignments; do not assume he can repeatedly survive lethal damage as in the preceding Chaplain battle.
messages.Cルートの最終戦。第1段階本体はLv90・HP2793・基礎防御94。第2段階は: Route C's final battle. The Phase 1 body is Lv. 90 with 2,793 HP and base Defense Level 94. Phase 2 is immune to damage; the Phase 3 body has no directly targetable part. Blueprints have 178 HP in Phase 1 and 730 HP at Lv. 65 in Phase 3. Phase 1 blueprint Stagger Thresholds are unconfirmed. Aim for Customer Lv. 65, separately from Identity levels outside the dungeon.
messages.Lvの記載がない技や、設計図へ付与された際の実際の攻撃レベルが未確認の技は、レベ: Skill levels are marked unknown where no level is listed or the actual Offense Level of a blueprint-granted skill is unconfirmed. Phase 2 Evade “We had our little quarrels, yes.” has unconfirmed displayed Power. The Le Rouge blueprint's “Pattern: "Don."” retains its listed one Coin, with the Bleed Count effect's Coin number marked unconfirmed.
messages.ムルソーを保護し、番号指定や名指しのマッチを他の囚人へ任せない。: Protect Meursault; do not assign skill-number or named-recipient clashes to another Sinner.
messages.第2段階はスキル1→スキル2→スキル3またはE.G.O。実際に構えた敵技の指定を: Phase 2 requires Skill 1 → Skill 2 → Skill 3 or E.G.O. Check the actual equipped enemy skill's requirement.
messages.第3段階は変化した設計図にムルソーで勝ち、脆弱を付けて設計図を倒す。: In Phase 3, win transformed blueprint clashes with Meursault, apply Fragile, then kill the blueprint.
messages.設計図が出てから急にマッチに勝てなくなった: Clashes became much harder after blueprints appeared
messages.ジャンヌが捕捉で設計図を倒すと釘付けが増え、3でアンガジュマンへ変わる。自分は表: If Jeanne kills a blueprint with “Focusing”, she gains Nailed; at 3, it becomes Engagement. Her Heads chance becomes 100%, while your Coins are fixed unfavorably. Do not try to clash with “Focusing”; kill its blueprint target first.
messages.第2段階でHPが全く減らない: HP does not decrease at all in Phase 2
messages.この段階はダメージ無効で、HPを削る必要はない。ムルソーで敵の指定したスキル番号: This phase is immune to damage and does not require HP reduction. Match Meursault's skill number to the enemy's requirement and advance Pathos to 100. Do not try to bypass it with area attacks or statuses.
messages.ムルソーのE.G.Oでもコインが全部不利になる: Even Meursault's E.G.O has unfavorable Coins
messages.第2段階のプルミエ・ステップはスキル1、ドゥジエム・マルシュはスキル2が必要。E: Phase 2 “First Step” requires Skill 1 and “Second Pace” requires Skill 2. Only “Third Movement” permits E.G.O. Increasing Power alone cannot counter the wrong-number punishment skill.
messages.第3段階でジャンヌ本人を攻撃できない: I cannot attack Jeanne herself in Phase 3
messages.本体を直接攻撃する段階ではない。ノワールとルージュの設計図が対象となり、設計図の: This phase does not involve direct attacks on the body. Target Le Noir and Le Rouge blueprints; their deaths lower body HP. Clash with transformed Sartorial Tailor blueprints using Meursault to inflict Fragile, then plan their elimination.
messages.設計図が回復し、戦闘が進まない: Blueprints heal and the battle does not progress
messages.変化した設計図の「この舞台だけは、全てが決まっているの。」へムルソーを合わせてい: Check that Meursault clashes with the transformed blueprint's “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.” Another Sinner or an unopposed attack changes it to a punishment skill that heals 50% max HP. Le Rouge's defense also heals, so concentrate damage on one blueprint you can finish.
messages.次のターンだけ主力のコインが不利になる: A key Sinner's Coins become unfavorable next turn
messages.デゼスポワールは加算コインを裏面、減算コインを表面100%へ固定する。権限:遮断: Désespoir fixes positive Coins to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Rights: Ban applies it After Attack, so a clash win alone does not prevent it. Do not keep that Sinner on an important clash next turn; use defense, healing, or another recipient.
messages.ムルソーを守る編成と、設計図用の火力を準備する: Protect Meursault and prepare damage for blueprints
messages.Cルートの顧客Lv65を目安に買い物を確認する。人格のレベルは影界の顧客レベルに: Check shopping toward Customer Lv. 65 on Route C. Identity levels follow Customer Level in the dungeon. E.G.O Threadspin is not boosted, so check available effects and resource costs too.
messages.ムルソーのHP回復・保護と、設計図に使うE.G.O火力を用意する。第1・第2段階: Prepare HP recovery and Protection for Meursault, plus E.G.O damage for blueprints. Meursault's death causes defeat in Phases 1 and 2; do not carry over The Stranger's 1 HP protection from the Warden battle.
messages.最終戦は象徴界で本体HPを削る操作を挟まない。各段階で必要な操作が変わるため、自: The final battle has no preceding action encounter where you reduce the body's HP. Each phase needs different actions; check skill conditions instead of relying only on auto-selection.
messages.設計図を捕捉より先に倒し、釘付けを妨げる: Kill blueprints before “Focusing” and prevent Nailed
messages.3ターンごとに設計図が3体召喚され、本体は最大HP分のバリアと、そのターンの混乱: Every three turns, three blueprints are summoned and the body gains a Shield equal to max HP, removes Stagger, and cannot be Staggered that turn. Clear blueprints before pouring everyone's damage into the Shield.
messages.捕捉は設計図を優先するマッチ不可・対象変更不可の技。対象線を確認し、速い囚人から: “Focusing” prioritizes blueprints, is Unclashable, and cannot be redirected. Check targeting lines and use fast Sinners to kill blueprints before Jeanne gains Nailed.
messages.設計図には基本攻撃の被ダメージ−50%、E.G.Oの被ダメージ+100%がある。: Blueprints take 50% less basic attack damage and 100% more E.G.O damage. However, they use defense before the first hit to greatly reduce that skill's damage. Do not assume one skill will kill them; check remaining HP.
messages.囚人が設計図を倒すと、少ない属性のE.G.O資源を計5個得る。次の設計図処理や回: Sinner kills on blueprints grant 5 total E.G.O resources of scarce affinities. Use them for the next cleanup and healing while advancing to 50% body HP. Win against Unbreakable skills such as “Fixed Viewpoint” for 80% reduction.
messages.釘付け・アンガジュマンがあるとき: When Nailed or Engagement is present
messages.確率固定を、精神力の低さと取り違えない: Do not confuse fixed Coin chances with low SP
messages.釘付けは表面確率95%、数値2では相手のマッチ威力−2。数値3で次ターンにアンガ: Nailed fixes Heads chance at 95% and gives the clash opponent −2 Clash Power at 2 Stack. At 3, it changes to Engagement next turn. Killing blueprints before she consumes them prevents this buildup.
messages.アンガジュマン中はジャンヌが表面100%、マッチや攻撃をする側は加算コインが裏面: During Engagement, Jeanne has 100% Heads. Units clashing with or attacking her have positive Coins fixed to 100% Tails, negative Coins to 100% Heads. SP recovery or high Power alone cannot remove these fixed chances.
messages.捕捉を装着するとき、または混乱時に解除される。状態が切れたかを確認し、無理なマッ: Removed when “Focusing” is equipped or on Stagger. Check whether the effect has ended rather than repeatedly forcing difficult clashes on the same key Sinner.
messages.敵技に合わせ、ムルソーのスキル番号を選ぶ: Choose Meursault's skill number to match the enemy skill
messages.ジャンヌはこの段階でダメージを受けない。HPを0にする段階ではなく、パトスを10: Jeanne takes no damage in this phase. Advance Pathos to 100 rather than reducing HP to 0. Check the skill generated in Meursault's upper slot and the enemy's requirement.
messages.プルミエ・ステップにはスキル1、ドゥジエム・マルシュにはスキル2、トロワジエム・: Use Skill 1 against “First Step”, Skill 2 against “Second Pace”, and Skill 3 or E.G.O against “Third Movement”. Numbers refer to Identity skill numbers, not Coin count.
messages.番号が違うと、コイン確率を不利に固定する「パターンどおりにしなきゃ。」へ変わる。: A wrong number changes the attack to “You've got to keep to the pattern.”, fixing Coins unfavorably. Do not substitute E.G.O for requirements 1 or 2. Keep taking the required clashes rather than simply defending and waiting.
messages.この段階でムルソーは弱体除去と精神力固定・混乱防止を得るが、ダメージ無効ではない: In this phase, Meursault clears negative effects and gains fixed SP and Stagger prevention, but not damage immunity. Positive-Coin Identities have 45 SP; negative-Coin Identities have −30. Do not confuse his effects with Jeanne's damage immunity.
messages.マッチの勝敗や回数、進行用の会話・回避技でパトスとロゴスが増える。パトス100で: Clash results and exchanges, dialogue skills, and Evade increase Pathos and Logos. At 100 Pathos, Phase 3 begins. Logos is a separate effect increasing Meursault's Offense Level and Clash Power.
messages.変化した設計図へムルソーを合わせ、脆弱を作る: Use Meursault against transformed blueprints to create Fragile
messages.本体は直接指定できず、HP50%の状態から始まる。ノワールとルージュの設計図がそ: The body cannot be targeted directly and starts at 50% HP. Le Noir and Le Rouge blueprints are replenished to two of each. Each blueprint death reduces body HP by 5%.
messages.第3段階の2ターン目以降、設計図1体が裁断士へ変わる。混乱中なら解除されるので、: From the second turn of Phase 3, one blueprint becomes the Sartorial Tailor. Stagger is removed on transformation; do not assume Stagger makes it safe to ignore.
messages.「この舞台だけは、全てが決まっているの。」には必ずムルソーでマッチして勝つ。別の: Always clash with “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.” using Meursault and win. Another Sinner or an unopposed attack changes it to the punishment skill and prompts major healing.
messages.勝った設計図は次ターンから毎ターン脆弱5を得る。その設計図を優先して倒す。ムルソ: After Meursault wins, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn onward. Prioritize killing it. Other Sinners handle blueprint normal clashes and damage.
messages.設計図撃破・権限技の追加: Blueprint deaths and added Rights skills
messages.不利な確率の担当を替え、設計図へ火力を集中する: Rotate recipients with unfavorable Coins and focus blueprint damage
messages.裁断士の姿が解除されるたび、ジャンヌの権限:遮断を持つ設計図が増える。これはマッ: Each time the Sartorial Tailor form ends, another blueprint starts using Jeanne's Rights: Ban. It applies Désespoir for next turn After Attack regardless of the clash result. Avoid fixing affected Sinners to important clashes.
messages.設計図を倒すと、ほかの設計図へデレスマンが付き、次ターンは権限:視線を装着する設: A blueprint death gives other blueprints Délaissement; next turn, one blueprint equips Rights: Gaze. Win against Gaze for 80% reduction and to prevent next-turn Désespoir.
messages.デレスマンはマッチ威力を上げる一方、被ダメージも増やす。4以上ではターン開始時に: Délaissement increases both Clash Power and damage taken. At 4 or more, Turn Start removes all Stagger Thresholds, clears Stagger, and increases slot weight by 1. Exploit increased damage taken to finish them rather than waiting for Stagger alone.
messages.ノワールはバリア、ルージュは自傷と回復を使う。全員で少しずつ削らず、脆弱がある、: Le Noir uses Shields; Le Rouge uses self-damage and healing. Do not chip everyone down: focus on a Fragile or low-HP blueprint while preserving Meursault's required clash.
messages.本体HP10%以下がこの段階の終了条件。本人を直接削ろうとせず、設計図撃破で進め: The phase ends at 10% body HP or less. Progress through blueprint kills instead of direct body attacks. Do not assume you can receive “Rights: Rebuild”'s death-on-hit effect through immortality as in the Chaplain fight.
messages.最大3。表面確率95%、数値2ではマッチ相手のマッチ威力−2。3になると全消耗し: Maximum 3. Heads chance 95%; at 2 Stack, the clash opponent has −2 Clash Power. At 3, consume all to gain Engagement next turn. Loses 1 at Turn End except on the turn gained.
messages.第1段階の捕捉より先に設計図を倒し、ためさせない。: Kill Phase 1 blueprints before “Focusing” to prevent buildup.
messages.本人の表面確率100%。本人とマッチ、または本人を攻撃する対象の加算コインは裏面: Own Heads chance 100%. Units clashing with or attacking this unit have positive Coins fixed to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Removed on equipping “Focusing” or becoming Staggered.
messages.高い精神力でも不利な確率を覆せない。設計図処理と状態の解除を確認する。: High SP cannot override fixed unfavorable chances. Clear blueprints and check effect removal.
messages.特殊充電。ジャンヌは回数を累計10消耗すると威力1を得て、回数の自然減少がない。: Special Charge. Jeanne gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed; Count does not naturally decrease. At Turn End, gain Poise Potency based on Count and Poise Count based on Potency.
messages.回避や広域技への強化もある。長く放置するほど有利になるとは考えない。: Also strengthens Evade and area skills. Do not assume prolonging the fight favors you.
messages.第2段階のジャンヌの精神力を45へ固定し、ダメージを受けなくする。段階変更時に除: Fixes Phase 2 Jeanne's SP to 45 and makes her immune to damage. Removed at phase transition.
messages.火力ではなくワルツの指定技でパトスを増やす。: Increase Pathos through the required waltz skills rather than damage.
messages.第2段階のムルソーは獲得時に弱体を除去し、精神力45固定（減算人格は−30）・混: On gaining it in Phase 2, Meursault removes negative effects and gains fixed 45 SP (−30 for negative-Coin Identities) and Stagger prevention. Removed at phase transition. Does not grant damage immunity.
messages.番号指定を守りつつHPを守る。混乱しないことと、死亡しないことを混同しない。: Follow skill-number requirements while protecting HP. Stagger immunity is not death immunity.
messages.第2段階の進行値。最大100。ジャンヌのマッチ勝利で3、敗北で5、さらにマッチ回: Phase 2 progression, maximum 100. Increases by 3 on Jeanne's clash win, by 5 on her loss, and additionally by clash exchanges. Certain skills also increase it. At 100, advance to the next phase.
messages.本体HPではなく、この数値の進みを見る。技の番号を守り、ワルツを続ける。: Track this value instead of body HP. Follow skill numbers and continue the waltz.
messages.ムルソー側の蓄積値。最大100。マッチ勝利で5、マッチ回数分増加し、数値10につ: Meursault's accumulating effect, maximum 100. Gains 5 on a clash win and increases by clash exchanges. Offense Level +1 per 10 Stack, Clash Power +1 per 20. Certain skills also increase it.
messages.パトスと別の効果。第3段階の指定マッチにムルソーを使う手順も意識する。: Separate from Pathos. Also keep Meursault's required Phase 3 clashes in mind.
messages.加算コインを裏面100%、減算コインを表面100%へ固定する。ターン終了時に1減: Fixes positive Coins to 100% Tails and negative Coins to 100% Heads. Loses 1 at Turn End. Rights: Ban applies it for next turn After Attack; Rights: Gaze applies it when the enemy wins the clash.
messages.付与条件が違う。受けた囚人を次の高威力マッチへ固定せず、別の担当や守備を選ぶ。: Their application conditions differ. Use another recipient or defense rather than forcing the affected Sinner into next turn's high-Power clash.
messages.最大5。数値1につきマッチ威力+1・スキル被ダメージ+10%。4以上ではターン開: Maximum 5. Clash Power +1 and skill damage taken +10% per Stack. At 4 or more, remove all Stagger Thresholds, clear Stagger, and gain +1 slot weight at Turn Start.
messages.敵の火力と被ダメージが両方増える。混乱を待つより、脆弱と合わせて倒し切る。: Both offense and damage taken increase. Combine with Fragile to finish them instead of waiting for Stagger.
messages.ノワール設計図の特殊充電。回数の累計10消耗ごとに威力1を得る。技によるバリアや: The Le Noir blueprint's special Charge. Gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Enables stronger Shields and damage from skills.
messages.守備のバリアを残し続けず、倒しやすい設計図を選んで集中する。: Do not leave its defensive Shield indefinitely; focus a blueprint that is easier to kill.
messages.ルージュ設計図の特殊充電。回数の累計10消耗ごとに威力1を得る。自分のスキルによ: The Le Rouge blueprint's special Charge. Gains 1 Potency per cumulative 10 Count consumed. Self-damage from its own skills cannot lower HP below 1.
messages.自傷後のHPを削る。自滅を待たず、回復する前に倒し切る。: Attack after self-damage. Do not wait for self-destruction; kill it before healing.
messages.設計図へ追加される技。最初のコインは破壊不能で、攻撃後に次ターンのデゼスポワール: A skill added to blueprints. Its first Coin is Unbreakable; applies Désespoir for next turn After Attack.
messages.勝っても付与を防げない。次ターンの担当を見直す。: Winning does not prevent application. Reconsider next turn's recipient.
messages.加重値3・2枚破壊不能。特殊充電や弱体効果で強化される。マッチ敗北時はダメージ8: 3 Atk Weight and two Unbreakable Coins. Strengthened by special Charge and negative effects. On a clash loss, deals 80% less damage and cannot Stagger targets with its damage.
messages.高威力担当で勝ち、次ターンのデゼスポワールも防ぐ。: Win with a high-Power recipient and prevent next-turn Désespoir too.
messages.第1・第2段階はムルソー死亡で敗北。看守・司祭戦のHP1保護をこの戦闘へ持ち込ま: Meursault's death causes defeat in Phases 1 and 2. Do not carry over 1 HP protection from the Warden / Chaplain battle.
messages.ワルツの番号指定はスキル1・2・3。コイン枚数や罪悪属性を合わせる条件ではない。: The waltz requires Skills 1, 2, and 3, not matching Coin counts or sin affinities.
messages.第2段階の本体はダメージ無効。ムルソーの混乱防止にもダメージ無効はない。: The Phase 2 body is immune to damage. Meursault's Stagger prevention does not grant that immunity.
messages.第3段階の本体を直接攻撃することはできない。変化した設計図の指定技にはムルソーで: The Phase 3 body cannot be attacked directly. Use Meursault to clash with transformed blueprints' required skills.
messages.デゼスポワールは確率固定。精神力45や高威力のE.G.Oだけでは解消しない。: Désespoir fixes Coin chances. Neither 45 SP nor high-Power E.G.O alone removes it.
messages.権限:再構築は的中時死亡。ムルソーへ致命傷を通せる前提で戦わず、設計図撃破を進め: “Rights: Rebuild” kills On Hit. Progress through blueprint kills rather than assuming Meursault can take lethal hits.
messages.顧客Lv65と手持ちE.G.Oの解析段階を確認する。最終戦はムルソーの番号指定と: Check Customer Lv. 65 and your E.G.O Threadspin. Skill-number requirements and blueprint cleanup make raw damage alone insufficient.
messages.ムルソーのHP回復・保護と、ほかの囚人のマッチ担当をそろえる。第1段階は貫通攻撃: Prepare Meursault's HP recovery and Protection and other clash recipients. Phase 1 mainly uses Pierce; Phase 3 Le Noir mainly uses Blunt and Le Rouge Pierce.
messages.第1段階の設計図にはE.G.Oが通りやすく、撃破で資源も得る。広域と回復の資源を: Phase 1 blueprints are vulnerable to E.G.O and grant resources on death. Save area-attack and healing resources for Phase 3 required clashes and finishing damage.
messages.ワルツの番号指定と、第3段階の変化した設計図へのマッチを担う。最優先でHPを守る: Handles the waltz's skill-number requirements and transformed blueprint clashes in Phase 3. Protect his HP first.
messages.第1段階の捕捉を妨げ、第3段階は脆弱が付いた設計図を倒して本体HPを減らす。: Prevents Phase 1 “Focusing”; in Phase 3, kills Fragile blueprints to lower body HP.
messages.破壊不能の被弾と確率固定中の不利を立て直し、ムルソーを失わないようにする。: Recovers from Unbreakable hits and fixed unfavorable chances to keep Meursault alive.
messages.視線へ勝って被害を減らし、デゼスポワールの付いた囚人へ無理なマッチをさせない。: Win Gaze to reduce damage and avoid forcing clashes on Sinners with Désespoir.
messages.開始精神力45。ムルソー死亡で敗北。: Starts at 45 SP. Meursault's death causes defeat.
messages.本体HP50%以下で次段階へ。設計図召喚時は最大HP分のバリアと混乱解除・混乱防: Next phase at 50% body HP or less. Blueprint summons give a max-HP Shield, remove Stagger, and prevent Stagger.
messages.基本攻撃の被ダメージ−50%、E.G.Oの被ダメージ+100%。: Basic attack damage taken −50%; E.G.O damage taken +100%.
messages.最初の被撃前に守備を使用し、その技への被ダメージを軽減する。: Uses defense before the first hit to reduce that skill's damage.
messages.最大2793／この段階はダメージ無効: Maximum 2,793 / immune to damage in this phase
messages.HP削りでは進行しない。パトス100で第3段階へ。: HP damage does not advance the phase. At 100 Pathos, Phase 3 begins.
messages.暴食・傲慢の基礎耐性は未確定。段階中のダメージ無効とは区別する。: Base Gluttony and Pride resistances are unconfirmed, separately from this phase's damage immunity.
messages.本体は直接攻撃の対象にならない。設計図を倒して本体のHPを減らす。設計図へ追加さ: The body cannot be attacked directly. Kill blueprints to lower body HP. Skills added to blueprints and the final special skill are grouped below.
messages.最大2793／50%から開始・10%以下で段階終了: Maximum 2,793 / starts at 50%; phase ends at 10% or less
messages.設計図へのマッチと撃破を優先し、本体への攻撃先を探さない。: Prioritize blueprint clashes and kills rather than looking for a direct body target.
messages.精神力45固定。設計図を倒すたび本体HPが5%減少する。: SP fixed at 45. Each blueprint kill reduces body HP by 5%.
messages.各種類が2体になるよう補充される。撃破で本体HPが5%減少し、ほかの設計図へデレ: Replenished to two of each type. Kills reduce body HP by 5% and give other blueprints Délaissement.

- Exclude the blueprint transformed last turn.
- Clear Stagger if present.

In Sartorial Tailor form, use “At least on this stage, everything's set and fixed.”
- If Meursault wins its clash, that blueprint gains 5 Fragile every turn from next turn.

On blueprint death:
- Jeanne loses 5% HP.
- Other blueprints gain 1 Délaissement.
messages.ムルソーのマッチ勝利で付く脆弱を生かして処理する。ほかの設計図のデレスマンも確認: Exploit Fragile from Meursault's clash win to finish it. Check Délaissement on other blueprints too.
messages.boss-copy:jeanne:passives.13.name: Conservation
messages.戦闘中、自分の保存回数を累計10消耗するたびに保存威力1を得る: Gain 1 Preservation Potency per cumulative 10 Preservation Count consumed during battle.
messages.保存威力が上がるほど守備のバリアなども強くなる。長期放置せず、倒せる設計図へ集中: Higher Preservation Potency strengthens defensive Shields and other effects. Focus a blueprint you can finish rather than leaving it indefinitely.
messages.同じ変化と死亡時効果を持つ。ノワールと同様に、指定技にはムルソーを合わせる。: Shares the same transformation and death effects. Assign Meursault to required skills as with Le Noir.
messages.戦闘中、自分の脈動回数を累計10消耗するたびに脈動威力1を得る\n\n自分のスキ:
Gain 1 Pulsation Potency per cumulative 10 Pulsation Count consumed during battle.

HP loss from own skills cannot lower HP below 1.
messages.脈動回数の累計消耗・自傷: Cumulative Pulsation Count consumption and self-damage
messages.自傷だけではHP1未満にならない。自滅を待たず、囚人の攻撃で倒す。: Self-damage alone cannot reduce HP below 1. Kill it with Sinner attacks instead of waiting for self-destruction.
messages.E.G.Oと使いどころ: E.G.O and when to use them
messages.目標は累計24ターン以内。配分は目安。敵のスキル、残りHP、主力の状態を見て調整: Aim for 24 cumulative turns or less. The budget is a guide; adjust to enemy skills, remaining HP, and your core's condition.
messages.反撃で受ける攻撃と、マッチ・回避で止める攻撃を分担する。共鳴を維持するために主力: Divide attacks between Counter recipients and clashes or Evade. Do not sacrifice key Sinners merely to maintain Resonance.
messages.【リンバス】射影 HARD リカルド（射影戦闘・HARD）の攻略｜Limbus: Reflectrial HARD Ricardo (Reflectrial, HARD) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)射影 HARD「リカルド（射影戦闘・HA: Ricardo (Reflectrial, HARD) guide for Limbus Company Reflectrial HARD. For 18 turns or less, maintain the Middle's Envy Absolute Resonance and carry unsealed Lævateinn damage into Phase 2. Protect key Sinners by choosing clash wins or Evade against attacks made dangerous by Book buildup.
messages.射影 HARD「Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR - Noctu: Reflectrial HARD · Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR - Nocturnal Sweeping BokGak
messages.18ターン以内を狙うなら、中指の嫉妬完全共鳴を保ち、レーヴァテイン解放後の火力を: For 18 turns or less, maintain the Middle's Envy Absolute Resonance and carry unsealed Lævateinn damage into Phase 2. Protect key Sinners by choosing clash wins or Evade against attacks made dangerous by Book buildup.
messages.射影戦闘専用個体の基礎値。攻撃レベル増加・怨恨の刺青による動的な強化は含まない。: Base values for the Reflectrial encounter. Excludes dynamic buffs from Offense Level Up and Vengeance Tattoo. Second-phase HP carries over from the first phase; it is not a separate HP bar.
messages.前半と後半で技を分けて掲載する。固定の行動順ではなく、実際に構えた技を確認する。: Skills are listed separately for each phase. Check actual equipped skills rather than a fixed sequence. Conditional Unbreakable conversion from the Book is not included in the always-visible Coin icons.
messages.中指6人＋回避・回復役で、後半まで続投する: Six Middle members plus Evade and healing, continuing into Phase 2
messages.中指4名以上で序盤パターンを変え、嫉妬完全共鳴で反撃を強化する型。反撃をS3へ変: Uses at least four Middle members to change the opening pattern and Envy Absolute Resonance to strengthen Counters. Converting Counter into S3 requires a combined total of at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, distinct from ordinary 6 Envy Resonance. The starting order is an example; check the actual skill panel. Use Faust's Evade, Envy skills, and Envy E.G.O to maintain Resonance. The four reserve LCB Sinners are flexible slots and can be replaced by trained Identities of the same Sinners. Borrowed Support Identities cannot be used.
messages.主力。嫉妬完全共鳴6またはS3で剣の封印解除を進め、レーヴァテインで後半を削る。: Main damage dealer. Progress sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or S3, then damage Phase 2 with Lævateinn. Use normal S2 or S3 to clash with dangerous skills.
messages.守備を装着した中指の耐久と精神力を支える。反撃を使い終わった後の被弾では混乱し得: Supports the durability and SP of Middle members with defense equipped. Hits after their Counter ends can still Stagger them; do not force several attacks onto one recipient.
messages.ウーティスと組ませる反撃アタッカー。嫉妬完全共鳴6を維持して守備からS3を使う。: Counter attacker paired with Outis. Maintain 6 Envy Absolute Resonance to use S3 from defense.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6で強化される打撃反撃役。受けられる通常攻撃を担当する。: Blunt Counter role enhanced by 6 Envy Absolute Resonance. Receives normal attacks they can survive.
messages.嫉妬共鳴をつなぎ、必要時に《他人の鎖》で翌ターンの通常攻撃を弱める。自身の反撃は: Maintains Envy Resonance and uses Chains of Others when needed to weaken next turn's normal attacks. His own Counter gains Coin Power from Resonance but does not become S3.
messages.嫉妬共鳴と反撃を担当する。強い広域攻撃のマッチ担当まで無理に兼ねさせない。: Provides Envy Resonance and Counters. Do not also force them to handle strong area clashes.
messages.嫉妬の回避で共鳴をつなぎ、《水袋》で回復する。打撃に弱いため回避失敗の被害が大き: Maintains Resonance with Envy Evade and heals with Fluid Sac. Blunt weakness makes failed Evades costly. Check SP and predictions; do not assign “Promised Suffering” while Evade Power is low.
messages.同期Ⅲで得るサポートパッシブ枠。嫉妬3共鳴で、体力比率が最低の味方1名の体力3、: Support passive unlocked at Uptie III. At 3 Envy Resonance, heals 3 HP to the ally with the lowest HP percentage and 3 SP to the ally with the lowest SP percentage.
messages.イサンの自由枠。控えまで回った際の戦力が不足するなら、育成済みの人格へ替える。: Flexible Yi Sang slot. If reserves lack combat strength when deployed, replace with a trained Identity.
messages.ホンルの自由枠。後半用の別編成に使う人格を、ここで使ってしまわないように配分する: Flexible Hong Lu slot. Allocate Identities so those needed for a separate Phase 2 team are not used here.
messages.ロージャの自由枠。中指の先発を支えるサポートパッシブや、脱落後に戦える人格へ変更: Flexible Rodion slot. Can switch to a support passive for the Middle starters or an Identity that can fight after casualties.
messages.グレゴールの自由枠。控えの火力に頼るより、先発の共鳴と回復を維持することを優先す: Flexible Gregor slot. Prioritize starting-team Resonance and recovery over relying on reserve damage.
messages.体力・精神力の回復役。色欲2・憂鬱4・嫉妬3を使う。開幕にSUPERBIAを使う: HP and SP recovery. Costs 2 Lust, 4 Gloom, and 3 Envy. Opening SUPERBIA is an option. Its Gloom affinity may interrupt Envy Absolute Resonance; check whether 6 remains that turn.
messages.怠惰1・憂鬱1・嫉妬2。的中時に翌ターンの束縛と攻撃威力減少を付与する。通常攻撃: Costs 1 Sloth, 1 Gloom, and 2 Envy. On Hit, inflicts Bind and Attack Power Down next turn. Reduces normal attack damage, but alone cannot neutralize fixed or extra damage or ordinary Counters. Pride affinity can also break Resonance.
messages.嫉妬属性のまま資源の偏りを補える。色欲1・嫉妬3を使い、マッチ勝利で資源を変換す: Balances resource reserves while keeping Envy affinity. Costs 1 Lust and 3 Envy; converts resources on a clash win. An unopposed attack on a Staggered enemy does not trigger conversion.
messages.憤怒1・嫉妬4で使う嫉妬属性のマッチ手段。《他人の鎖》を撃つ必要がないターンに、: Envy clash option costing 1 Wrath and 4 Envy. On turns not needing Chains of Others, can maintain Absolute Resonance while answering dangerous skills.
messages.最大3編成で挑む連続戦闘。1編成は先発7名＋控え5名。使った人格は進行度を初期化: A continuous battle with up to three team loadouts. Each has 7 starters and 5 reserves. Used Identities have reuse restrictions until progress is reset; borrowed Support Identities are unavailable.
messages.1編成の12ターン経過前でも、進行度を保存して次の編成へ移れる。フェーズ移行でも: You can save progress and switch loadouts before 12 turns with one team. Phase transitions also advance turns; manage the goal using the displayed cumulative count.
messages.フェーズ移行と編成交代は別。中指編成の主力と回復が残るなら、HP50%で自動的に: Phase transition and loadout replacement are separate. If the Middle core and healing remain, you do not have to replace the team automatically at 50% HP.
messages.光の苗木は通常戦闘と別枠で、難易度ごとに使用を判定する。同じ難易度の後半で再び使: Sapling of Light usage is separate from normal battles and checked per difficulty. Do not assume it can be reused in the second phase of the same difficulty.
messages.HARDは最大HP+25%、スキルによる与ダメージ+20%。後半は敵の精神力が0: HARD gives +25% max HP and +20% skill damage. In Phase 2, enemy SP cannot fall below 0 and Sinners who attacked the body last turn gain 2 additional Book.
messages.段階報酬はクリア・30・24・18ターン以下。18ターン以下の段階は狂気200と: Reward tiers are clear, 30 turns or less, 24 or less, and 18 or less. The 18-turn tier gives 200 Lunacy and 300 Burnt-in Lens. Record a clear first; check progress reset and Identity allocation when improving time.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴6かS3で、剣の封印解除を進める: Progress sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or S3
messages.回復・弱体化E.G.Oで共鳴が切れるターンは、ウーティスの手元のS3を使う案も考: If healing or debuff E.G.O breaks Resonance, consider using Outis's available S3. Prioritize progressing the unsealing condition each turn.
messages.剣の解放を火力に変え、HP50%の後半へ進む: Turn the unsealed sword into damage and reach Phase 2 at 50% HP
messages.9ターンで半分に届かない場合は、共鳴が途切れた回数、反撃を返せているか、主力の育: If not halfway by turn 9, review broken Resonance, whether Counters actually activate, and core levels or Stagger. This is an example allocation of 9 turns for each phase.
messages.同じ編成で倒せるか、次編成へ渡すか判断する: Decide whether this team can finish or must hand over to the next
messages.1編成の上限を見越す。交代が必要なら後半向けの破裂・暴食主体を用意し、使用済み人: Account for the per-loadout limit. If switching, prepare a Rupture / Gluttony team for Phase 2 without reusing spent Identities. If the Middle core remains alive, use its damage first.
messages.取り巻き全滅を目指さず、本体を撃破する: Kill the body rather than trying to eliminate every add
messages.HP30%の混乱で強い攻撃を集中する。本体へ与えるダメージが落ちてまで取り巻きを: Focus strong attacks during the 30% HP Stagger. Check whether excessive add cleanup is reducing damage on the body.
messages.中指6人の嫉妬完全共鳴を軸に、ウーティスの剣を解放する。後半まで続投する主力を守: Unseal Outis's sword through six Middle members' Envy Absolute Resonance. Protect the core through Phase 2 and plan around 18 cumulative turns.
messages.《全員、処刑だ！！！》《俺のヘアクーポォオオオン！！！》は強いスキルでマッチに勝: Win against “COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!!” and “MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!” with strong skills. Handle “Promised Suffering” separately through Evade or other suitable defense.
messages.HP50%で後半、30%で混乱。本体の撃破を優先し、取り巻き全滅に手数を割かない: Phase 2 at 50% HP; Stagger at 30%. Prioritize the body instead of spending actions killing every add.
messages.マッチには勝つのに主力が倒れる: My key Sinners die despite winning clashes
messages.帳簿による破壊不能化と《苦痛を刻む》の追加ダメージを確認する。守備の軽減・回避・: Check Book-based Unbreakable conversion and “Promised Suffering”'s extra damage. Divide defensive reduction, Evade, and healing roles; avoid assigning nearly dead key Sinners to area clashes.
messages.反撃がS3にならない・剣が解放されない: Counter does not become S3 or the sword stays sealed
messages.反撃の変更条件は嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6以上。孤立した嫉妬スキルは完全共鳴数に入ら: Counter conversion requires a combined total of at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance. Isolated Envy skills do not count toward Absolute Resonance. When another affinity or a Staggered Sinner interrupts the chain, check the remaining consecutive groups and their combined count. Meursault's Counter does not become S3.
messages.前半HP50%までを9ターン、後半を残り9ターンと置き、遅れた側を探す。剣の解放: Allocate 9 turns to reach 50% HP and 9 more for Phase 2, then identify the slower half. Review sword unsealing, unused Counters, core Stagger, and excess add damage. Judge current HP and skills rather than forcing a fixed turn-by-turn sequence.
messages.《水袋》《他人の鎖》の資源が足りない: Not enough resources for Fluid Sac or Chains of Others
messages.嫉妬だけでなく色欲・憂鬱・怠惰も必要になる。完全共鳴の追加資源とウーティスの《私: You need Lust, Gloom, and Sloth as well as Envy. Use Absolute Resonance's extra resources and Outis's I'll Go fer Scissors. How 'Bout You? to save costs for the next heal or debuff.
messages.HP50%以下でフェーズ2へ移る。5-30と違い、半分削っただけでは勝利にならな: At 50% HP or less, enters Phase 2. Unlike 5-30, halving HP does not win.
messages.物理耐性は全て等倍。ストーリー版の打撃弱点を持ち込まない。: All physical resistances are neutral. Do not apply the story version's Blunt weakness.
messages.ターンごとの攻撃レベル増加と怨恨の刺青は、表示した基礎レベルへ別途加わる。: Per-turn Offense Level Up and Vengeance Tattoo add separately to displayed base levels.
messages.HPを0にすれば勝利。取り巻きの全滅は必要ない。: Win by reducing HP to 0. Killing every add is unnecessary.
messages.フェーズ移行でリカルドの固有効果以外の効果が消える。前半にためた破裂などの持越し: Transition removes effects other than Ricardo's unique effects. Do not plan to carry over accumulated Rupture or other Phase 1 statuses.
messages.苦難により精神力は0未満に下がらない。沈潜による精神力低下を後半の勝ち筋にしない: Tribulation prevents SP from falling below 0. Do not make sustained Sinking SP loss the Phase 2 win condition.
messages.後半に召喚される取り巻き。勝利に必要なのはリカルドの撃破。: Add summoned in Phase 2. Victory requires Ricardo's defeat.
messages.取り巻きの全技の数値は未掲載。画面の予測を見て、主力へ通すと危険な攻撃だけ対処す: Full add skill values are not listed. Use battle predictions and answer only attacks that threaten key Sinners.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時]打撃追加ダメージ3: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal 3 extra Blunt damage
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]打撃追加ダメージ3: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal 3 extra Blunt damage
messages.守備装着で麻痺を防げる。反撃で受けるなら残りHPと、この後に受ける攻撃も確認する: Equipping defense prevents Paralyze. If receiving with Counter, check remaining HP and attacks still to come.
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時]打撃追加ダメージ5: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal 5 extra Blunt damage
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]打撃追加ダメージ5: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal 5 extra Blunt damage
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時]次のターンに麻痺3を付与: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Paralyze next turn
messages.次ターンの麻痺を避けたい囚人は守備を装着する。主力の反撃に回す場合も、追加ダメー: Equip defense on Sinners who need to avoid next-turn Paralyze. Even for key Counter users, check survival including extra damage.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]対象の精神力を5減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 5
messages.通常反撃なので攻撃を当てると打ち返される。減算コインのため、敵の精神力を下げるだ: A normal Counter retaliates when hit. Negative Coins mean lowering enemy SP alone does not make it safe. Avoid opening with a frail Sinner; use a Stagger-triggering attack or a Blunt-resistant recipient.
messages.対象の精神力0未満の場合、コイン威力+3: If the target's SP is below 0, Coin Power +3
messages.[的中時]次のターンに束縛2,攻撃威力減少2を付与: [On Hit] Inflict 2 Bind and 2 Attack Power Down next turn
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]対象の精神力を20減少: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce the target's SP by 20
messages.マッチで止めたい単体技。精神力が負の対象にはコインが強化される。的中で次ターンの: A single-target skill worth stopping with a clash. Negative-SP targets strengthen its Coins. Hits also inflict next-turn Bind and Attack Power Down; do not let it hit key Sinners.
messages.回避スロット。守備スキルでの相殺も使い、弱い攻撃を何本も外して時間を失わない。: Evade slot. Use defensive offsetting too; avoid wasting time with many weak attacks that miss.
messages.[マッチ敗北]最終ダメージ量が30%減少し、このスキルのダメージによって対象が混: [Clash Lose] Final damage −30%; this skill's damage cannot Stagger the target
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]混乱区間を30前進: [On Hit Without Breaking] Raise the Stagger Threshold by 30
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]次のターンに麻痺1を付与: [On Hit Without Breaking] Inflict 1 Paralyze next turn
messages.[的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済みが5減少: [On Hit] Remove 5 Written in the Book from the target
messages.強いE.G.Oなどでマッチ勝利を狙う。勝てば最終ダメージが30%減り、この技のダ: Aim to win with a strong E.G.O or similar skill. Winning reduces final damage by 30% and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage. The Unbreakable retaliation remains; do not assign a nearly dead Sinner.
messages.帳簿に記載済みの数値が最も高い対象を優先して指定: Prioritizes the target with the highest Written in the Book
messages.[使用時]対象の帳簿に記載済みが3以上なら、: [On Use] If the target has at least 3 Written in the Book:
messages.このスキルの全コインが破壊不能コインに変更される: All Coins of this skill become Unbreakable
messages.Ⅰ：[的中時]このターンと次のターンに脆弱1を付与: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile this turn and next turn
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]このターンと次のターンに脆弱1を付与: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Fragile this turn and next turn
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時](対象が保有する帳簿に記載済みの数値×3)だけ打撃追加ダメ―ジ: Ⅲ[On Hit] Deal extra Blunt damage equal to (Written in the Book on the target ×3)
messages.[的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済みが3減少: [On Hit] Remove 3 Written in the Book from the target
messages.帳簿3以上で全コインが破壊不能になるため、20未満でも危険。最後のコインに帳簿×: All Coins become Unbreakable at 3 Book, so it is dangerous even below 20. The last Coin deals extra Blunt damage equal to Book ×3. Assign an Evade or Clashable Defense user; a normal Attack Skill clash win alone does not ensure safety.
messages.[ターン終了時]次のターンに攻撃威力増加5を得る: [Turn End] Gain 5 Attack Power Up next turn
messages.次ターンの攻撃威力増加5に備える。回復や弱体化を先に使い、次の広域攻撃を止めるE: Prepare for 5 Attack Power Up next turn. Heal and debuff early, saving E.G.O resources to stop the next area attack.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済み1につき、体力最大値の3%ダメージ: [On Hit Without Breaking] Deal damage equal to 3% of the target's max HP per Written in the Book on them
messages.[的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済みが10減少: [On Hit] Remove 10 Written in the Book from the target
messages.マッチ勝利を最優先にする。勝てば30%のダメージ軽減と混乱防止が働き、破壊されず: Prioritize winning the clash. Winning gives 30% reduction, prevents Stagger from its damage, and prevents the On Hit Without Breaking max-HP damage. Do not rely only on Counter.
messages.俺らの家族だったか: Ah, You Were One of the Fam
messages.[戦闘開始時]全中指所属ユニットの精神力を10回復: [Combat Start] Heal all Middle-affiliated units for 10 SP
messages.中指4名以上で序盤パターンが変わるときの準備時間。精神力回復を利用し、共鳴と剣の: Preparation time when at least four Middle members change the opening pattern. Use SP recovery to build Resonance and progress sword unsealing.
messages.戦闘開始時の脆弱4で攻める機会が生まれる。広域の破壊不能コインは残るので、主力が: Its 4 Fragile at Combat Start creates a damage opening. Area Unbreakable Coins remain; concentrate attacks only while key Sinners can survive.
messages.[ターン終了時]次のターンに攻撃レベル増加3を得る: [Turn End] Gain 3 Offense Level Up next turn
messages.- このスキルを使用するスロットをメインターゲット指定した攻撃スキルがあるなら、: - If an Attack Skill has this skill's slot as its main target, reduce Offense Level Up gained by this effect by 1
messages.この回避枠をメインターゲットにする攻撃があれば、次ターンの攻撃レベル増加が3から: Assigning this Evade slot as an attack's main target lowers next-turn Offense Level Up from 3 to 2. Distinguish the targeting requirement from actually hitting through Evade.
messages.Ⅰ：[破壊されずに的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済み1につき、体力最大値の1%ダメージ: Ⅰ[On Hit Without Breaking] Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's max HP per Written in the Book on them
messages.Ⅱ：[破壊されずに的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済み1につき、体力最大値の1%ダメージ: Ⅱ[On Hit Without Breaking] Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's max HP per Written in the Book on them
messages.Ⅲ：[破壊されずに的中時]対象の帳簿に記載済み1につき、体力最大値の1%ダメージ: Ⅲ[On Hit Without Breaking] Deal damage equal to 1% of the target's max HP per Written in the Book on them
messages.帳簿30の囚人がいると追加される。各コインの最大HP割合ダメージは、コインを破壊: Added when a Sinner has 30 Book. Each Coin's max-HP damage requires an unbroken hit. Break Coins in the clash to prevent it, while keeping enough HP for the normal retaliation.
messages.[使用時]次のターンに打撃ダメージ量増加3を得る: [On Use] Gain 3 Blunt DMG Up next turn
messages.[使用時]メインターゲットの帳簿に記載済みが5以上なら、: [On Use] If the main target has at least 5 Written in the Book:
messages.メインターゲットの帳簿5以上で全コインが破壊不能になる。翌ターンの打撃強化も続く: At 5 or more Book on the main target, all Coins become Unbreakable. Next-turn Blunt buffs also remain; maintain healing and debuffs.
messages.[破壊されずに的中時]対象を混乱状態にする: [On Hit Without Breaking] Stagger the target
messages.マッチでコインを破壊して強制混乱を防ぐ。帳簿を減らせるからと、破壊されないまま当: Break Coins in the clash to prevent forced Stagger. Do not allow an unbroken hit merely to lower Book.
messages.召喚は戦闘開始時に次ターン分が決まる。マッチ勝利で取り消せるとは考えず、後半も本: The next-turn summon is set at Combat Start. Do not assume winning cancels it; keep prioritizing the body in Phase 2.
messages.同じ対象とのマッチが10発以上になると、マッチ発数÷10（小数点切り捨て）に応じ: At 10 or more clash exchanges against the same target, Clash Power increases or decreases according to exchanges ÷10, rounded down. Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count.
messages.通常戦闘の蓄積上限を前提にしない。威力30に達した後も付与だけに手数を使うより、: Do not assume normal stacking caps. After reaching 30 Potency, improve skill damage rather than spending all actions on further application.
messages.現在のターン数だけ攻撃レベル増加を得る。: Gain Offense Level Up equal to the current turn number.
messages.長引くほどマッチが厳しくなる。表示威力だけで判断せず、実際の予測と残りターンを見: Clashes grow harder over time. Check actual predictions and remaining turns rather than displayed Power alone.
messages.ターン開始・被ダメージ・攻撃的中時: Turn Start, taking damage, and attack hits
messages.ターン開始時、全ての敵へ帳簿に記載済み1を付与。被ダメージ時、攻撃者へ同効果2を: At Turn Start, inflict 1 Written in the Book on all enemies. On taking damage, inflict 2 on the attacker. On hitting, remove 1 from the target. During battle, gain Vengeance Tattoo equal to the amount removed.
messages.攻撃を集中した主力ほど帳簿も増える。蓄積とHPを毎ターン確認し、強い攻撃を全て同: Key attackers also build more Book. Check Stack and HP each turn; do not keep assigning every strong attack to the same Sinner.
messages.大人しく執行を受けろ: Don't Resist and Accept Your Punishments
messages.対象が守備スキルを装着: Target has a Defense Skill equipped
messages.戦闘開始時、当該対象への与ダメージ量-30%。: At Combat Start, deal 30% less damage to that target.
messages.中指の反撃と相性がよい。ただし《苦痛を刻む》の追加ダメージや、破壊されずに的中す: Works well with Middle Counters. However, do not assume this makes “Promised Suffering”'s extra damage or unbroken-hit percentage damage safe.
messages.スキル使用時など: On Skill Use and related triggers
messages.対象の帳簿に記載済みが20以上なら、そのスキルの全コインが破壊不能になる。帳簿に: At 20 or more Written in the Book on the target, all Coins of that skill become Unbreakable. If Ricardo selects the target with the highest Book, the attack cannot be redirected.
messages.帳簿20からは通常技も打ち返す。対象変更不能の表示がある攻撃は、別の味方で引き取: From 20 Book, even normal skills retaliate after a clash win. If an attack is marked unredirectable, handle it with the assigned recipient's clash, Evade, or durability rather than assuming another ally can intercept.
messages.中指の優先復讐対象だ: You're The Middle's Priority Revenge Target
messages.ターン開始時、帳簿に記載済み30の対象が存在: Turn Start with a target at 30 Written in the Book
messages.追加スキルスロットを作り、《即決処刑だ！》を使用する。: Create an extra skill slot and use “IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!”
messages.帳簿30は追加攻撃の目印。マッチに勝ち、破壊されずに的中する場合の割合ダメージを: 30 Book signals an extra attack. Win the clash to prevent its unbroken-hit percentage damage.
messages.2ターン目から自分を含む全味方の精神力を10回復する。火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈: From turn 2, heal all allies including self for 10 SP. Damage taken from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −20%.
messages.状態異常の定数ダメージだけに頼らず、強化された攻撃と混乱中の集中攻撃で削る。: Use strengthened attacks and focused Stagger damage rather than relying only on flat status damage.
messages.パニック変更不能。ターン終了時にパニック状態なら精神力が0になる。HP50%以下: Panic type cannot change. If Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 0. At 50% HP or less, change phases and remove effects other than unique effects.
messages.HP50%を越える前に、後半も続投するか編成を替えるか決める。: Before crossing 50% HP, decide whether the team will continue or be replaced for Phase 2.
messages.パニック変更不能。ターン終了時にパニック状態なら精神力が0になる。: Panic type cannot change. If Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 0.
messages.通常反撃が減算コインであることも踏まえ、精神力低下だけで安全と判断しない。: The normal Counter uses negative Coins; lowering SP alone does not guarantee safety.
messages.次のターンに加算コイン強化1を得る（最大2）。: Gain 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn (max 2).
messages.取り巻きを倒すと翌ターンの本体も強まる。撃破するなら、本体の危険技と重ならないか: Killing adds also strengthens the body next turn. Check whether the kill will overlap a dangerous body skill.
messages.中指のパターン変更を使い、共鳴と剣の解放を進める: Use the Middle pattern change to build Resonance and unseal the sword
messages.中指所属を4名以上先発させると最初の2パターンが変わり、全属性E.G.O資源を2: Starting at least four Middle members changes the first two patterns and grants 2 E.G.O resources of every affinity. Six Middle members can meet this condition while also aiming for 6 Envy Absolute Resonance.
messages.《俺らの家族だったか》は全中指の精神力回復、《俺を騙したのか！！！》は敵自身の脆: “Ah, You Were One of the Fam” heals SP for all Middle units; “TRICKED ME, DID YOU??!!” gives the enemy 4 Fragile. Use these openings to prepare and attack, but do not ignore the latter's area Unbreakable Coins.
messages.ウーティスは嫉妬完全共鳴6またはS3で封印解除を進める。共鳴を保てる安全な通常攻: Outis progresses unsealing through 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or S3. Counter safe normal attacks to preserve Resonance; clash with dangerous skills using normal S2, S3, or E.G.O.
messages.体力・精神力が不足するなら開幕のSUPERBIA《水袋》も候補。後半にもう一度使: Opening SUPERBIA Fluid Sac is an option if HP or SP is low. Do not assume another use in Phase 2; save later healing resources too.
messages.マッチで止める技と、回避でしのぐ技を分ける: Separate skills to stop through clashes from those handled by Evade
messages.《全員、処刑だ！！！》《俺のヘアクーポォオオオン！！！》はマッチに勝つとダメージ: Winning against “COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!!” or “MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!” reduces damage by 30% and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage. Unbreakable retaliation remains, so healing is also needed.
messages.《苦痛を刻む》は帳簿3から全コインが破壊不能になり、最後の的中で帳簿×3の打撃追: “Promised Suffering” makes all Coins Unbreakable from 3 Book and deals extra Blunt damage equal to Book ×3 on the final hit. Use a Sinner with Evade or Clashable Defense; winning with an ordinary attack alone is insufficient.
messages.帳簿20から他の通常技も破壊不能になる。対象変更不能の表示があれば、別の囚人へ引: At 20 Book, other normal skills also become Unbreakable. If marked unredirectable, use that recipient's defense, healing, or strong clash instead of planning to intercept with another Sinner.
messages.《他人の鎖》は翌ターンの通常攻撃を弱める用途。撃つターンの共鳴切れと、ムルソー自: Chains of Others weakens next turn's normal attacks. Assign roles while accounting for Resonance interruption that turn and Meursault's own next-turn debuffs.
messages.育った中指を続投させ、後半の本体へ集中する: Keep the strengthened Middle core and focus the Phase 2 body
messages.後半は射影効果が破裂・暴食中心へ変わるが、嫉妬弱点は残る。剣を解放した中指の主力: Phase 2's Shade shifts toward Rupture and Gluttony, but Envy weakness remains. If the Middle core with its unsealed sword is alive, a change in favored effects alone is no reason to switch.
messages.フェーズ移行で本体の固有効果以外が消える。前半の状態異常をそのまま引き継ぐ計算を: Transition removes all effects except the body's unique effects. Reapply needed debuffs instead of assuming Phase 1 statuses carry over.
messages.後半の苦難は、前ターンに本体を攻撃した囚人へ帳簿2を追加し、敵の精神力を0以上に: Phase 2 Tribulation adds 2 Book to Sinners who attacked the body last turn and keeps enemy SP at 0 or above. Do not switch to a strategy relying on indefinitely lowering SP through Sinking.
messages.《全員集合》で取り巻きが増える。主力を倒す攻撃だけ止め、強い攻撃のメインターゲッ: “Assemble” summons more adds. Stop only attacks threatening key Sinners and keep strong attacks' main targets on the body.
messages.混乱で火力を集中し、必要なら未使用の編成へ渡す: Focus damage during Stagger; switch to unused Identities if necessary
messages.HP30%の混乱に強いS2・S3を重ねる。後半は攻撃者が混乱中の本体より速い場合: Concentrate strong S2 and S3 attacks during the 30% HP Stagger. In Phase 2, if the attacker is faster than the Staggered body, it also takes +(Speed difference ×2)% damage, up to 20%.
messages.敵が攻撃してこない混乱中は、通常反撃を構えるだけではダメージを返せない。攻撃スキ: A normal Counter deals no damage when the Staggered enemy does not attack. Use Attack Skills and maintain Envy Absolute Resonance where possible.
messages.1編成12ターンで削り切れない見込みなら、未使用の破裂・暴食主体の編成を後半へ回: If one loadout cannot finish within 12 turns, use an unused Rupture / Gluttony team for Phase 2. H Corp. members also gain +15% damage dealt and −30% damage taken, but do not choose untrained Identities solely for affiliation.
messages.18ターン以内は累計で数える。残りHPを削る強い攻撃まで取り巻きへ向けず、本体撃: The 18-turn goal is cumulative. Keep finishing attacks on the body rather than diverting them to adds.
messages.5-30のイシュメール生存条件や、HP50%での勝利は適用されない。: 5-30's Ishmael survival condition and victory at 50% HP do not apply.
messages.帳簿の20は通常技の全コイン破壊不能化、30は追加の《即決処刑だ！》の条件。《苦: 20 Book enables all-Unbreakable normal skills; 30 adds “IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!” “Promised Suffering”'s conversion starts at 3, and “No More Tests” at 5.
messages.対象変更不能は実際のスキル表示を確認する。帳簿がまだ30未満だからと、引き取り可: Check the actual skill display for unredirectable attacks. Below 30 Book does not automatically mean it can be intercepted.
messages.《即決処刑だ！》の割合ダメージは破壊されずに的中した場合。マッチで破壊して防ぐが: “IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!”'s percentage damage requires an unbroken hit. Breaking Coins prevents it, but does not remove normal damage from Unbreakable Coins remaining at 20 or more Book.
messages.完全共鳴を作るためだけに、耐えられない広域攻撃へ全員反撃を構えない。反撃後の追加: Do not have everyone Counter an unsurvivable area attack just to create Absolute Resonance. Extra hits after a Counter can still Stagger them.
messages.出血・破裂などは威力30・回数10が上限。通常の上限までためる長期戦を前提にしな: Bleed, Rupture, and similar effects are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count. Do not plan a prolonged fight around normal caps.
messages.最大30。数値1につき被ダメージ量+3%。ターン開始と本体への攻撃で増え、本体の: Maximum 30. Damage taken +3% per Stack. Increases at Turn Start and when attacking the body; decreases from the body's hits and certain skills.
messages.数値だけでなく残りHPと敵の技を一緒に見る。減少を目的に、破壊されずに当たる割合: Check remaining HP and enemy skills alongside Stack. You do not need to take unbroken-hit percentage damage just to reduce it.
messages.最大300。数値10につきリカルドのスキル攻撃レベル+1。リカルドが帳簿を減らし: Maximum 300. Ricardo's skill Offense Level +1 per 10 Stack. Increases by the amount of Book Ricardo removes.
messages.長期化で敵の攻撃レベルも増える。基礎威力の表だけでマッチ勝率を判断しない。: Enemy Offense Level also rises over time. Base Power tables alone cannot determine clash chances.
messages.中指4名以上の出場で最初の2パターンが変化し、全属性資源+2。守備装着者には本体: Deploying at least four Middle members changes the first two patterns and grants +2 resources of every affinity. The body's skill effects do not apply Paralyze to units with defense equipped. Attacks that inflict Bleed or special Bleed, or have Envy affinity, deal +30% damage, or +100% for E.G.O. Absolute Resonance grants one resource of a lowest-reserve affinity four times.
messages.中指の守備と嫉妬共鳴を軸にする。『出血人格』という分類ではなく、対象となる攻撃ス: Build around Middle defense and Envy Resonance. The bonus checks individual Attack Skills, not a broad classification as a Bleed Identity.
messages.破裂付与または暴食の攻撃はダメージ+25%（E.G.Oは代わりに+100%）。H: Attacks inflicting Rupture or using Gluttony deal +25% damage, or +100% for E.G.O. H Corp. members deal +15% damage and take −30%. Absolute Resonance grants one resource of a lowest-reserve affinity four times. If the attacker is faster than the Staggered body, damage taken increases by Speed difference ×2%, up to 20%.
messages.育った中指を続投する案と、未使用の破裂・暴食編成へ替える案がある。速度差の効果は: Either continue with the trained Middle core or switch to an unused Rupture / Gluttony team. Exploit the Speed difference during focused attacks after Stagger.
messages.最大HP+25%、スキルによる与ダメージ+20%。後半はリカルドと末弟の精神力が: Max HP +25%, skill damage +20%. In Phase 2, Ricardo and Little Brothers cannot fall below 0 SP; at Turn Start, inflict 2 extra Book on units that attacked the body last turn.
messages.NORMALよりHPと蓄積が重い。中指の主力を守り、剣の解放後と混乱中にまとめて: HP and buildup are heavier than NORMAL. Protect the Middle core and concentrate damage after unsealing and during Stagger.
messages.18ターン以内を狙う主力はLv60以上を土台に、可能な範囲で上限まで育成する。中: For an 18-turn goal, build key Sinners from Lv. 60 upward toward the available cap. Bring the Middle core to Uptie IV and healing / clash E.G.O to the needed Threadspin.
messages.中指6人＋ファウストの先発が主案。ウーティス・ヒースクリフ・イシュメールを優先し: The main starting lineup is six Middle members plus Faust. Prioritize Outis, Heathcliff, and Ishmael while combining the Nursefather’s sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance.
Put Faust with Fluid Sac and Meursault with Chains of Others in the same team. Account for Resonance breaks from E.G.O affinities and resource costs.
messages.中指が揃わない場合は前半出血、後半破裂・黒獣が代替案。ただし主案と同じ手順・同じ: Without the Middle roster, Phase 1 Bleed and Phase 2 Rupture or Heishou are alternatives. They may not reproduce the main setup's procedure or turn count. Allocate each team's core in advance.
messages.危険な広域技のマッチ役: Clash recipient for dangerous area skills
messages.《全員、処刑だ！！！》《俺のヘアクーポォオオオン！！！》には、強いE.G.Oや主: Use strong E.G.O or a core S3 against “COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!!” and “MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!!” Envy options preserve Resonance more easily, but prioritize survival if the clash chance is insufficient.
messages.帳簿が高い対象へ向くため、回避・マッチ可能守備と回復を準備する。引き取り不能にな: Targets high Book, so prepare Evade, Clashable Defense, and healing. Ensure the target can respond even if redirection is locked; avoid forcing low-SP Evade or Blunt-weak Sinners into it.
messages.次の被弾より先にHPを戻す。完全共鳴の追加資源と資源変換を使い、嫉妬だけが余って: Restore HP before the next hit. Use Absolute Resonance's extra resources and conversion so excess Envy does not leave you unable to heal.
messages.【リンバス】射影 NORMAL リカルド（射影戦闘・NORMAL）の攻略｜Lim: Reflectrial NORMAL Ricardo (Reflectrial, NORMAL) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)射影 NORMAL「リカルド（射影戦闘・: Ricardo (Reflectrial, NORMAL) guide for Limbus Company Reflectrial NORMAL. Use the Middle's defense and Envy Resonance to learn Book buildup and Unbreakable Coin handling. Unlike 5-30, which ends at half HP, you must finish Ricardo's body in the second phase too.
messages.射影 NORMAL「Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR - Noc: Reflectrial NORMAL · Reflectrial][lairtcelfeR - Nocturnal Sweeping BokGak
messages.中指の守備と嫉妬共鳴を軸に、帳簿の蓄積と破壊不能コインへの対処を覚える。HP半分: Use the Middle's defense and Envy Resonance to learn Book buildup and Unbreakable Coin handling. Unlike 5-30, which ends at half HP, you must finish Ricardo's body in the second phase too.
messages.NORMALにHARDの苦難はない。ただし帳簿による破壊不能化と広域攻撃は共通な: NORMAL lacks HARD's Tribulation, but shares Book-based Unbreakable conversion and area attacks. A clash win does not guarantee no damage.
messages.段階報酬はクリア・32・28・24ターン以下。24ターン以下の段階は狂気150と: Reward tiers are clear, 32 turns or less, 28 or less, and 24 or less. The 24-turn tier gives 150 Lunacy and 100 Burnt-in Lens. Prioritize a first clear, then improve the time.
messages.HP65%の混乱を使い、HP50%へ進む: Use the Stagger at 65% HP and advance to 50%
messages.帳簿3・20・30で危険になる技を確認する。全員を攻撃にするより、受けられる相手: Check skills that become dangerous at 3, 20, and 30 Book. Use defense against manageable attacks rather than making everyone attack.
messages.主力の状態を見て続投・交代を決める: Decide whether to continue or switch based on the core's condition
messages.同じ人格を次の編成で再使用できる前提にしない。交代が必要なら未使用の人格を残して: Do not assume the same Identity can be reused in the next loadout. Preserve unused Identities if a switch is needed.
messages.回復を維持しつつ、本体HPを削り切る: Maintain healing and finish the body's HP
messages.間に合わなければ、まずクリアを優先する。次の挑戦では空振りの反撃、共鳴切れ、過剰: If too slow, prioritize clearing first. Next time, reduce unused Counters, broken Resonance, and excessive add cleanup.
messages.中指4名以上で序盤パターンを変え、守備と共鳴を利用する。借りたサポート人格は使え: Deploy at least four Middle members to change the opening pattern and use defense and Resonance. Borrowed Support Identities are unavailable.
messages.帳簿20で通常技も破壊不能化する。《苦痛を刻む》だけは帳簿3から全コインが破壊不: At 20 Book, normal skills also become Unbreakable. “Promised Suffering” alone makes all Coins Unbreakable from 3 Book.
messages.HP50%は後半への移行。本体を倒すまで終わらないので、回復と後半の戦力を残す。: 50% HP starts Phase 2. Keep healing and later combat strength because the fight ends only when the body dies.
messages.後半まで戦力が残らない: I cannot preserve combat strength into Phase 2
messages.回復前に主力が倒れるなら、攻撃を減らしてでもHPを戻す。後半用編成へ替える案もあ: If key Sinners die before healing, restore HP even at the cost of attacks. Switching to a Phase 2 team is another option, but the same Identities from Phase 1 cannot be reused.
messages.NORMALには後半の精神力下限・帳簿追加の苦難はない。ただし通常反撃は減算コイ: NORMAL lacks Phase 2 Tribulation's SP floor and extra Book. However, the normal Counter has negative Coins, so lower SP alone does not make it harmless.
messages.24ターン以内に固執して敗北するより、最初は回復を保って本体撃破を優先する。: For the first attempt, maintain healing and kill the body rather than losing by insisting on 24 turns or less.
messages.敵本体はLv60。主力のレベルと同期を整え、打撃の通常攻撃を受けられるHPと回復: The enemy body is Lv. 60. Prepare your core's levels and Uptie, enough HP for normal Blunt attacks, and recovery.
messages.次のターンの攻撃威力増加とクイックを稼ぎ、雑魚戦で他の味方の撃破によるバフも重ね: A starting Envy Blunt E.G.O that earns Attack Power Up and Haste for the next turn and, in fights against weak enemies, also stacks buffs from allies' kills.
messages.次ターンのバフ獲得: 的中時に次のターンの攻撃威力増加1とクイック3を得る(解析: **Next-turn buffs**: On hit, he gains 1 Attack Power Up and 3 Haste next turn (Threadspin Ⅲ and up).
messages.パッシブ「傲気」: 他の味方が敵を倒すと、次のターン開始時に攻撃威力増加1・クイ: **Passive — Vying Spirit**: When another ally defeats an enemy, he gains 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Haste at the start of the next turn, up to 3. It is strong against many easy-to-kill enemies, and it does not apply on the turn it is used.
messages.撃破ボーナス(解析Ⅳ): 敵を倒すと次のターンの攻撃威力増加がさらに2付く。: **Kill bonus (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: Defeating an enemy grants 2 more Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.長引きそうな雑魚戦では最初に使い、「傲気」を早く有効にする。: In fights against weak enemies that are likely to drag on, use it first to activate Vying Spirit early.
messages.強い攻撃の直前のターンに使うと、次のターンのバフを本命のスキルに乗せられる。: Using it on the turn before a strong attack lets the next turn's buffs ride on the skill that matters.
messages.耐性は色欲・暴食が脆弱、嫉妬が抵抗。嫉妬の攻撃には強いが、色欲・暴食の攻撃が多い: Its resistances are Fatal to Lust and Gluttony and Endured against Envy. It is strong against Envy attacks, but likely at a disadvantage in fights with many Lust or Gluttony attacks.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、バフ獲得が表面的中時から的中時に緩和され、クイックが2から3: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, relaxes the buff gain from Heads Hit to on hit, and raises Haste from 2 to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 敵討伐時の攻撃威力増加2が加わる。火力が特別高いわけではないので、優先度は: **Ⅳ**: Adds 2 Attack Power Up on defeating an enemy. Its damage is not especially high, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.R社第4群ウサギチーム: S3が嫉妬の資源を出せ、速度6以上でコイン威力が上がる: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Rabbit](persona:0703)**: His S3 supplies Envy, and many of his skills gain Coin Power at 6 or more Speed, making Haste easy to use.

Before Threadspin Ⅳ, it is Before the King at 50%. If a skill's original Attack Weight is 1, it likely triggers even if its Attack Weight increases during combat.
