messages.パッシブで3コインの火傷を大きく増やし、火傷でコイン威力を伸ばす、3コイン広域の: A 3-Coin multi-target Envy Blunt E.G.O whose passive greatly increases Burn from 3-Coin skills and whose Coin Power grows with Burn.
messages.パッシブ「回路接続」: 火傷を付与するスキルか嫉妬属性のスキルが的中したとき、そ: **Passive — Circuit Wiring**: When a skill that inflicts Burn or an Envy skill hits, it inflicts additional Burn Potency equal to half its Coin count (rounded up), 3 times per turn. Efficient with 3-Coin skills.
messages.火傷によるコイン威力(解析Ⅳ): メインターゲットの火傷6につき、コイン威力+1: **Coin Power from Burn (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: +1 Coin Power per 6 Burn on the main target, up to 3. This makes up for its low Base Power.
messages.充電のダメージ変換: 攻撃前に充電を得て全消費し、消費1につきダメージ量2%上が: **Converting Charge into damage**: Before attacking, he gains Charge and spends all of it, gaining 2% damage per point spent (3% at Threadspin Ⅲ, up to 45%). At 4 or more Envy Resonance, the Charge becomes 7.
messages.住民登録マイクロチップ: 3コイン目で付与。憤怒・嫉妬スキルの被ダメージが+10: **Resident Reg. Microchip**: Inflicted by the third Coin. Damage taken from Wrath and Envy skills becomes +10%, working as a damage-taken increase that lasts until the next turn.
messages.火傷を扱う編成で、3コインのスキルとして頻繁に振る。パッシブは使用した次のターン: In Burn teams, use it frequently as a 3-Coin skill. The passive is active from the turn after use.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・暴食1・嫉妬3で、嫉妬3が重いので、資源を出せる人格で組む。: It requires 2 Wrath, 1 Gluttony, and 3 Envy; the 3 Envy is heavy, so build with Identities that can supply it.
messages.火傷抜きの充電寄りは威力を出しにくく、工夫が要る。侵蝕スキルは充電が最大10まで: A Charge-leaning build without Burn struggles to deal damage and needs some ingenuity. The Corrosion skill raises Charge up to 10 with nearly the same power.
messages.Ⅱ: 「回路接続」が解放され、火傷の主力になる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Circuit Wiring, making it a key Burn source.
messages.Ⅲ: 充電のダメージ変換が強化されるが、効果は小さい。火傷目的ならⅡで止めるか、: **Ⅲ**: Strengthens the Charge-to-damage conversion, but the effect is small. For Burn purposes, it is likely best to stop at Ⅱ or go all the way to Ⅳ.
messages.Ⅳ: 火傷付与が2に増え、火傷によるコイン威力が加わり、マッチもしやすくなる。: **Ⅳ**: Burn infliction rises to 2, Burn-based Coin Power is added, and it becomes easier to Clash.
messages.黒獣-酉 筆頭: S1(嫉妬)・S2(暴食)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源をすべて出せ: **[Heishou Pack - You Branch Adept](persona:0714)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Gluttony), and S3 (Wrath) supply all required affinities, and his Coin Power rises with Burn.
messages.中指末兄: S1(憤怒)とS2・S3(嫉妬)で資源を出せ、火傷も付与できる。: **[The Middle Big Brother](persona:0715)**: S1 (Wrath) and S2 and S3 (Envy) supply resources, and he can also inflict Burn.
messages.死体袋: S3が嫉妬の資源を出せ、速度6以上でコイン威力が上がるスキルが多いので: **[Bodysack](ego:0701)**: His S3 supplies Envy, and many of his skills gain Coin Power at 6 or more Speed, making Haste easy to use.
messages.死体袋: S1が嫉妬、S3が色欲の資源を出せるので、必要資源(色欲2・嫉妬2)を: **[Bodysack](ego:0701)**: His S1 supplies Envy and S3 supplies Lust, covering the required resources (2 Lust, 2 Envy) by himself.
messages.電信柱: 充電を得るスキルがあり、S1(憤怒)とS2(嫉妬)でこのE.G.Oの資: **[Telepole](ego:0702)**: Has skills that gain Charge, and S1 (Wrath) and S2 (Envy) also supply this E.G.O's resources.
messages.電信柱: S1が色欲、S2が憤怒、S3が嫉妬で、必要資源の3種をすべてスキルで出: **[Telepole](ego:0702)**: S1 is Lust, S2 is Wrath, and S3 is Envy, supplying all three required affinities through skills.
messages.AEDD: S1(嫉妬)とS2(憂鬱)で資源を出せ、パッシブが沈潜分の保護と被ダ: **[AEDD](ego:0703)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Gloom) supply resources, and his passive grants Protection equal to Sinking and Blunt DMG Up after taking damage, suiting a playstyle built on taking hits.
messages.AEDD: S2(嫉妬)・S3(憂鬱)で資源を出せ、S2は体力を消費して充電を増: **[AEDD](ego:0703)**: S2 (Envy) and S3 (Gloom) supply resources, and his S2 spends HP to increase Charge, likely pairing well with the Charge-using passive.
messages.空即是色: S2(憂鬱)・S3(怠惰)と守備(憤怒)で色欲以外の資源を出せ、パッ: **[Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam](ego:0704)**: S2 (Gloom), S3 (Sloth), and his Defense skill (Wrath) supply everything except Lust, and his passive's Protection shores up durability (however, the passive lowers his SP by his Sinking at Combat Start, so it needs balancing with the 15-SP condition for multi-target).
messages.空即是色: S3が色欲の資源を出せ、S2はマッチ勝利時に精神力を回復するので、自: **[Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam](ego:0704)**: His S3 supplies Lust, and S2 restores SP on Clash Win, helping maintain his own SP.
messages.ホリデイ: S1(嫉妬)・S2(暴食)で必要資源を出せ、マッチ開始時に自分にも火: **[Holiday](ego:0705)**: S1 (Envy) and S2 (Gluttony) supply the required affinities, and he applies Burn to himself at the start of Clashes, easily meeting the passive's "status effect on himself" condition.
messages.ホリデイ: S1はマッチ敗北時に自分へ沈潜を付けるため、パッシブの条件を満たせる: **[Holiday](ego:0705)**: His S1 applies Sinking to himself on Clash Lose, likely meeting the passive's condition. However, he cannot supply Gluttony.
messages.拘束: S2(嫉妬)・S3(憂鬱)・守備(色欲)で資源を出せ、S2(追悼行進)は: **[Binds](ego:0706)**: S2 (Envy), S3 (Gloom), and his Defense skill (Lust) supply resources, and S2 (Memorial Procession) inflicts Sinking and has increasing Attack Weight, likely making it easy to rack up the next turn's effect damage.
messages.拘束: S1(嫉妬)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で資源を出せ、振動を付与するので: **[Binds](ego:0706)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply resources, and he inflicts Tremor, laying the groundwork for this E.G.O's Tremor Burst.
messages.凶弾: S2(嫉妬)・S3(傲慢)で資源を出せ、S1〜S3で呼吸を自前で稼ぎ、ク: **[Fell Bullet](ego:0707)**: S2 (Envy) and S3 (Pride) supply resources, S1–S3 earn Poise on their own, and he can make use of the Ammo from Critical kills.
messages.凶弾: S1(傲慢)・S2(嫉妬)・守備(憤怒)で必要資源の3種を出せ、S1・S: **[Fell Bullet](ego:0707)**: S1 (Pride), S2 (Envy), and his Defense skill (Wrath) supply all three required affinities, S1 and S2 earn Poise, and S1 also inflicts Bleed.
messages.偏った慣性: S1(嫉妬)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(傲慢)で資源を出せ、S2・S3が: **[Asymmetrical Inertia](ego:0708)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Pride) supply resources, S2 and S3 inflict Tremor, and S1 also increases Tremor Count.
messages.偏った慣性: S2が怠惰の資源を出せ、火傷と振動を付与する。: **[Asymmetrical Inertia](ego:0708)**: His S2 supplies Sloth, and he inflicts Burn and Tremor.
messages.転入届: S1(嫉妬)・S2(暴食)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源をすべて出せ、火傷で: **[Move-in Reg.](ego:0709)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Gluttony), and S3 (Wrath) supply all required affinities, and his Coin Power rises with Burn.
messages.転入届: S1(憤怒)とS2・S3(嫉妬)で資源を出せ、火傷も付与できる。: **[Move-in Reg.](ego:0709)**: S1 (Wrath) and S2 and S3 (Envy) supply resources, and he can also inflict Burn.
messages.速度と1コインスキル: 速度範囲値は5~6から、同期化で最大5~8まで伸びる。全: **Speed and 1-Coin skills**: Her Speed range starts at 5–6 and extends up to 5–8 through Uptie. All of her attack skills have 1 Coin, so higher SP makes it easier to roll her maximum, while low SP makes her crumble.
messages.S3「防御」: マッチ威力8~20の1コイン打撃スキル。的中時に振動爆発し、打撃: **S3 — Shield Bash**: A 1-Coin Blunt skill with Clash Power 8–20. Triggers Tremor Burst on hit and inflicts 1 Blunt Fragility.
messages.S2「スライディング」: マッチ勝利時に守備威力減少1/3を付与する。的中時に振: **S2 — Slide**: Inflicts 1/3 Defense Power Down on Clash Win. Inflicts 3 Tremor on hit.
messages.振動: S2で振動3を入れてからS3を当てれば、単独でも振動爆発を狙える。S1「: **Tremor**: Landing S3 after applying 3 Tremor with S2 lets her aim for Tremor Burst on her own. S1 Loggerhead only increases Tremor Count by 1, so to make real use of Tremor, pair her with allies who inflict it.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「足掻く」(憤怒×3・保有)は自分の体力が25%未満で: **Passives**: The combat passive Last-ditch Struggle (3 Wrath Owned) gives +1 Clash Power below 25% of her HP. The support passive Determination to Survive (6 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +1 Clash Power while the 1 ally with the lowest HP is below 50%.
messages.速度で先に行動できるので、敵の強いスキルや味方が不利なマッチを引き受け、S3の高: Her Speed lets her act first, so she takes on the enemy's strong skills and Clashes unfavorable for allies, stopping them with S3's high maximum. Early on, when SP is low, her single Coin's low rolls make her lose easily, so start up carefully. The Blunt Fragility from S3 pays off when paired with allies who hit with Blunt. Treat Tremor as a bonus, making use of S3's Tremor Burst when S2 lands before S3 or when allies inflict Tremor.
messages.S3「精神の鞭」の判定タイミング: 充電回数を全て(上位段階では8)消耗する。戦: **S3 Mind Whip's check timing**: Spends all Charge Count (8 at higher Uptie). If Charge Count is below 10/8 **at Combat Start**, it becomes a one-sided attack on a random target. The check happens at Combat Start, so Charge gained with S1 and S2 that same turn does not count.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「精神加撃」は使用時と各コインの的中時に2ずつ、S2「灼きつけ: **Gaining Charge**: S1 Mind Strike adds 2 on use and on each Coin hit, S2 Flaying Surge adds 5/7 on use, and the Defense skill Evade adds 1 on a successful Evade. The cap is 20, and it decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.S1「精神加撃」: マッチ威力は最大4~14の2コインスキル。マッチの主力になる: **S1 — Mind Strike**: A 2-Coin skill with Clash Power up to 4–14. Her main Clash skill. If it does not hit, her Charge gain drops.
messages.沈潜と混乱区間: S1で沈潜、S2で沈潜回数3を付与。S3は各コインで沈潜1を付: **Sinking and Stagger Threshold**: S1 inflicts Sinking, and S2 inflicts 3 Sinking Count. Each Coin of S3 inflicts 1 Sinking and shifts the Stagger Threshold by 40%→10% of the damage dealt.
messages.バトルパッシブ「脳波集束」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に精神: **Combat passive — Brainwave Focus (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: −15 SP at Combat Start. At the start of the next turn, she gains Attack Power Up equal to (Gloom Resonance ÷ 3).
messages.S1を中心にマッチを取りつつ、S1・S2で充電を貯める。戦闘開始時の充電回数が1: Take Clashes mainly with S1 while building Charge with S1 and S2. Only select S3 after confirming that Charge Count at Combat Start is 10 or more (8 at higher Uptie). Selecting S3 while short can produce a one-sided attack that hits allies even if the enemies are already defeated, so avoid letting auto select it. At higher Uptie (spend 8, cap 20), the numbers allow up to 2 uses per turn, but she only holds 1 copy of S3, and the check on a second use cannot be confirmed from the data.
messages.S2「閃撃」: 自分の体力が50%未満のとき、スキルの1・2枚目のコインが追加さ: **S2 — Flashing Strike**: While her HP is below 50%, the skill's first and second Coins are duplicated, effectively doubling its Coins. Each Coin hit increases Poise Count by 1/2.
messages.体力を減らす手段: 守備「反撃」は相手の攻撃を受けつつ殴り返せるため、わざと体力: **Ways to lower HP**: The Defense skill Counter lets her take the opponent's attack and strike back, so it works when you want to lower her HP on purpose. However, no counter occurs if she is staggered by the enemy's attack.
messages.S3「息を整える」: 呼吸回数5以上でクリティカルダメージ+50%。Ⅱコインのク: **S3 — Catch Breath**: +50% Critical damage with 5 or more Poise Count. On Coin Ⅱ Critical Hit, if her HP is below 25%, she heals HP equal to 100% of the damage dealt. Use it to recover when her HP has dropped too far.
messages.呼吸: S1「飛剣」とS3で呼吸を得て、S2・反撃で呼吸回数を増やす。S1は体力: **Poise**: S1 Flying Sword and S3 grant Poise, and S2 and Counter increase Poise Count. S1 grants +1/3 more Poise below 50% HP.
messages.バトルパッシブ「死線足掻き」(嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 体力50%未満: **Combat passive — Walking the Line of Death (2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Below 50% HP, +1 Poise gained from skill effects.
messages.序盤は反撃で被弾を受けるなどして、体力を50%未満まで下げる。条件を満たしたらS: Early on, lower her HP to below 50%, for example by taking hits with Counter. Once the condition is met, prioritize S2 and push through with the extra Coins' damage. If her HP drops below 25%, recover with S3's Critical Hit. In consecutive battles where HP carries over, you can also lower her HP beforehand and enter the next battle. In the Mirror Dungeon, the combination with the E.G.O Gift Resolution, which always treats her as below 50% HP, is especially strong.
messages.S2「振動弾」: Ⅱ・Ⅲコインでそれぞれ弾丸を1消耗し、振動4/8を付与して振動: **S2 — Quake Rounds**: Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ each spend 1 Ammo to inflict 4/8 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Attack Power Down without Ammo.
messages.S3「制圧」: Ⅰコインで振動爆発。Ⅱ〜Ⅳコインで弾丸を1ずつ消耗し、Ⅱ・Ⅲで破: **S3 — Suppress**: Coin Ⅰ triggers Tremor Burst. Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ each spend 1 Ammo; Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict 4 Rupture and 2 Rupture Count, and Ⅳ inflicts 5 Fragile. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Tremor Count.
messages.デバフは1ターン限り: 脆弱・攻撃威力減少は1ターンの間だけ効く。速度範囲値が最: **Debuffs last only 1 turn**: Fragile and Attack Power Down only last for 1 turn. Her Speed range is a slow 2–6 at most, so having later allies benefit requires adjusting action order.
messages.弾丸は有限: S2のⅡ・Ⅲ、S3のⅡ〜Ⅳが弾丸を消耗する。弾丸が尽きるとこれらの: **Ammo is limited**: Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ of S2 and Ⅱ–Ⅳ of S3 spend Ammo. Once Ammo runs out, those Coins can no longer attack. She has 13 rounds at stage start, which run out in about 8 turns if she keeps using S2 and S3.
messages.挑発値: S1「押し付ける」と守備「ガード」は使用時に次のターンの挑発値+4(守: **Aggro**: S1 Shove and the Defense skill Guard grant +4 Aggro next turn on use (+2 more for the Defense skill at 0 Ammo). Aggro only matters in Focused Encounters. S1 inflicts 1/3 Paralyze on Coin Ⅰ hit (Heads Hit/on hit) and gains +2 Skill Power if the target has at least 8 Tremor.
messages.振動を扱う味方と組み、S2で一気に振動を入れて味方の振動系スキルの条件を満たす。: Pair her with allies who use Tremor, and apply a burst of Tremor with S2 to meet allies' Tremor skill conditions. S3's Tremor Burst is a bonus; the real goal is inflicting Rupture and 5 Fragile to boost the follow-up attacks that same turn. Ammo is limited, so save S2 and S3 for moments when their effects matter, and once Ammo runs out, switch to drawing attacks with the Aggro from S1 and her Defense skill in Focused Encounters.
messages.挑発値: S1〜S3・守備は使用時に次のターンの挑発値+4。: **Aggro**: S1–S3 and her Defense skill grant +4 Aggro next turn on use.
messages.マッチ敗北時の付与: S1「重い…！」・S2「ゆらゆらする…！」・S3「腐食性粘: **Infliction on Clash Lose**: S1 It's Heavy...!, S2 It's Churning...!, and S3 Corrosive Splash inflict Tremor and Rupture when they lose a Clash (5 Tremor and 5 Rupture for S3).
messages.S3: 1コインの大技。的中時に振動爆発(振動回数-4)し、破裂5を付与。: **S3**: A 1-Coin big hit. Triggers Tremor Burst on hit (Tremor Count −4) and inflicts 5 Rupture.
messages.バトルパッシブ「満ちる液体」(憂鬱×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 攻撃スキルで対: **Combat passive — Filling Fluid (3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If an attack skill fails to deal damage to the target's HP, she gains Shield next turn, up to 30.
messages.集中戦闘では挑発値で攻撃を集める。マッチに負ければS1〜S3で振動と破裂を、勝て: In Focused Encounters, draw attacks with Aggro. If she loses a Clash, S1–S3 inflict Tremor and Rupture; if she wins, they inflict Tremor (S3 triggers Tremor Burst and inflicts 5 Rupture). When her attacks fail to damage HP, she gains Shield next turn.
messages.火傷で強化: S1「丹脚」は対象の火傷3以上、S2「正面突破」は火傷6以上でコイ: **Burn bonuses**: S1 Red Kick gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 3 Burn, and S2 Frontal Assault at 6 or more (+1 per 3 and per 6 Burn respectively at higher Uptie, up to 2). S3 Inner Gate Elbow Strike deals +30%/50% damage if the target's Burn and Burn Count are both 6 or more.
messages.遅い速度: 速度範囲値は最大3~6。より先に動く味方が火傷を入れておけば、最初の: **Slow Speed**: Her Speed range is 3–6 at most. If faster allies apply Burn first, she can meet S2's condition (6 Burn) from her very first action.
messages.火傷回数: S2はⅢコインで対象の火傷が6以上なら火傷回数2を付与。S3はⅢコイ: **Burn Count**: Coin Ⅲ of S2 inflicts 2 Burn Count if the target has at least 6 Burn. Coin Ⅲ of S3 increases Burn Count by 2 unconditionally, and the Defense skill Counter increases it by 1 on hit.
messages.バトルパッシブ「激火」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の火傷回数3につ: **Combat passive — Intense Blaze (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% Blunt damage per 3 Burn Count on the target, up to 30%. It grows with more allies who build Burn Count.
messages.S3のⅣコイン: 攻撃終了時に対象が混乱するか死亡していれば、次のターンに加算コ: **S3's Coin Ⅳ**: If the target is staggered or dead at the end of the attack, she gains 1 Plus Coin Boost next turn.
messages.火傷を付与できる味方と組み、その味方より後に動いてS2を当てる。S2のⅢコインで: Pair her with allies who can inflict Burn, and act after them to land S2. Add Burn Count with Coin Ⅲ of S2, increase it further with S3, and land S3 on enemies with 6 or more Burn and Burn Count to boost damage. Burn Count is hard to raise on her own, so build it across the whole team to aim for Intense Blaze's 30% cap.
messages.沈潜の大量付与: S1「破砕準備」はⅡコインで沈潜回数+2、S2「炸裂」はⅡコイ: **Mass Sinking infliction**: S1 Ready to Crush adds +2 Sinking Count with Coin Ⅱ, S2 Explosive Blast inflicts 6 Sinking with Coin Ⅱ, and S3 Risky Judgement adds +5 Sinking Count with Coin Ⅰ and 3 Sinking each with Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ. S3 deals +20%/40% damage if the target has at least 6 Sinking.
messages.バトルパッシブ「クラップ破砕」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 振動がある対: **Combat passive — Crushin' Crabs (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time an attack hits a target with Tremor, Sinking Count increases by 1. The more she keeps hitting enemies with Tremor, the more Sinking Count all of her skills effectively inflict (Coin Ⅰ of S2 also increases the target's Tremor Count by 2/3, but whether Tremor Count alone meets the condition cannot be determined from the data).
messages.自分の振動回数: S1は使用時と的中時に3ずつ、S2は的中時に2増える。S2・S: **Her own Tremor Count**: S1 adds 3 on use and 3 on hit, and S2 adds 2 on hit. S2 and S3 gain Coin Power with 5 or more of her own Tremor Count (S3: +1 per 5, up to 2).
messages.守備「迅速歩法」: マッチ威力10~14の回避。使用時に破裂保護2を得る(1ター: **Defense skill — Nimble Steps**: An Evade with Clash Power 10–14. Grants 2 Rupture Protection on use, up to 6 per turn.
messages.S3の脆弱(おまけ): Ⅱ・Ⅲコインで自分の振動回数を5ずつ消耗し、次のターンに: **S3's Fragile (minor)**: Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ each spend 5 of her own Tremor Count to inflict 1 and 2 Fragile next turn.
messages.沈潜を扱う味方と組み、S2・S3で沈潜の威力と回数を積み上げる。S1を当てると自: Pair her with allies who use Sinking, and stack Sinking Potency and Count with S2 and S3. Landing S1 builds her own Tremor Count, powering up S2 and S3 the next turn. S1 has low power, so it works well as a one-sided attack to start things off. That said, given S1's low power, simply cycling S2 and S3 without forcing Clashes inflicts plenty of Sinking. Evade with Nimble Steps in unfavorable Clashes or early on when SP is low. Treat S3's Fragile as a bonus when she has Tremor Count to spare.
messages.S2の援護攻撃: 使用時、最も多い共鳴の共鳴数1につき10/15/20%の確率で: **S2's Assist Attack**: On use, there is a 10/15/20% chance per point of the highest Resonance to order an Assist Attack from an ally to her right on the dashboard (that ally makes a one-sided attack with Skill 1 on the enemy she attacked). It references the count of the single largest Resonance; Resonances of different Sins are not added together. The dashboard order changes with Speed, so the ally who receives the order is not stable. If the highest Absolute Resonance is 4 or more, the target also receives 1/2 Damage Up, and with 4 or more Pride Absolute Resonance, 1/2 Pride Power Up as well.
messages.両隣への配布: 操作パネル上の両隣の味方に、S2は戦闘開始時に攻撃レベル増加3、: **Giving to both neighbors**: To the allies on both sides of her on the dashboard, S2 gives 3 Offense Level Up at Combat Start, and S1 To Me! gives 2 Defense Level Up. Her Defense skill restores 3/5 SP to both neighbors on use, up to 2 times.
messages.トドメを取る: バトルパッシブ「ピークォド号の船長」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで: **Taking the kill**: The combat passive Captain of the Pequod (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants Poise if the target is dead at the end of her attack; next turn she enters the Gas Harpoon state, restoring 7 SP to the 1/2 allies with the lowest SP other than herself and giving them 4 Poise. This Identity has special SP rules: her SP may rise when she defeats an enemy and fall when an ally does.
messages.S3「執着の銛」: 対象の失った体力と出血に応じて強化される4コイン。攻撃後に敵: **S3 — Harpoon of Obsession**: 4 Coins that grow stronger based on the target's lost HP and Bleed. If the enemy is staggered or dead after the attack, restores 10 SP to the 1 ally with the lowest SP plus (highest Absolute Resonance ÷ 2) more allies, and gives them 2 Poise and 4 Poise Count (up to 2/4 times, up to 4 allies healed).
messages.出血・火傷・呼吸: S1は出血、S2・S3は出血と火傷を付与し、S3とパッシブで: **Bleed, Burn, and Poise**: S1 inflicts Bleed, S2 and S3 inflict Bleed and Burn, and S3 and the passive handle Poise.
messages.S2を使って操作パネル上の両隣に攻撃レベル増加3を配る。両隣・右方の味方は速度順: Use S2 to give 3 Offense Level Up to both neighbors on the dashboard. Her neighbors and the ally to her right swap with Speed order, so check every turn who it will reach. The larger the Resonance of a single Sin (especially Pride), the more often Assist Attack triggers, and the more you can aim for Damage Up and Pride Power Up. Assist Attack hits with Skill 1, so the benefit is likely larger in teams with many Identities whose Skill 1 advances buffs or resources. Play support until the enemy weakens, then take the final blow yourself with S3 or similar to restore SP and trigger the passive.
messages.速度で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の速度が自分より低ければコイン威力+1。: **Speed bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Coin Power if the target is slower than her.
messages.呼吸と沈潜: S1「掃き払う」・S2「整理整頓」で呼吸を得て沈潜を付与。S3「胴: **Poise and Sinking**: S1 Sweeping Redirection and S2 Housekeeping grant Poise and inflict Sinking. S3 Restraining Technique grants 6 Poise on use.
messages.デバフ: S2で防御レベル減少2(クリティカル時は束縛も)、S3のⅢコインで次の: **Debuffs**: S2 inflicts 2 Defense Level Down (plus Bind on Critical Hit), and Coin Ⅲ of S3 inflicts Bind and 1 Slash Fragility next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「積もった埃を払う」(憂鬱×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 速度が自: **Combat passive — Deep Cleaning (5 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Critical Hit against a target slower than her, +1 Potency to the negative effects she inflicts, up to 3 times per turn.
messages.速度で敵を上回り、S1・S2で呼吸と沈潜を積む。S3で束縛と斬撃脆弱を入れて、次: Outspeed enemies and stack Poise and Sinking with S1 and S2. Apply Bind and Slash Fragility with S3 to help Slash attacks land on the next turn.
messages.振動回数→防御レベル増加: 各攻撃スキルは使用時に自分の振動回数に応じて防御レベ: **Tremor Count → Defense Level Up**: Each attack skill grants Defense Level Up on use based on her Tremor Count. The more Defense Level Up she has, the higher their power.
messages.挑発値: S1〜S3は使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る(S3は8/10)。: **Aggro**: S1–S3 grant Aggro next turn on use (8/10 for S3).
messages.防御態勢: 守備「あなたの盾」の戦闘開始時に得る。次のターン、速度が最低値に固定: **Defensive Stance**: Gained at Combat Start of the Defense skill Your Shield. On the next turn, her Speed is fixed at its minimum, but she gains 5 Defense Level Up, Aggro, Stagger immunity, Tremor Burst on Clash Win, and more. In Focused Encounters, she can redirect attack targets to herself regardless of Speed.
messages.S3「守護」: 防御態勢があればダメージ量+50/70%。Ⅲコインで自分の振動回: **S3 — Ward**: +50/70% damage with Defensive Stance. Coin Ⅲ spends all of her Tremor Count to inflict that much Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.パッシブ「衝撃相殺グレートソード」: 戦闘開始時、自分の振動回数だけ防御レベル増: **Passive — Shock-nullifying Greatsword**: At Combat Start, gains Defense Level Up equal to her Tremor Count (up to 5, doubled during Defensive Stance).
messages.守備で防御態勢と振動回数を得て攻撃を集め、防御レベル増加を高く保つ。S3で振動回: Gain Defensive Stance and Tremor Count with her Defense skill to draw attacks and keep Defense Level Up high. Convert Tremor Count into Tremor with S3 and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.出血とマイナス効果: 各攻撃スキルは対象の出血に応じてコイン威力、マイナス効果の: **Bleed and negative effects**: Each attack skill gains Coin Power based on the target's Bleed and damage based on the number of negative effects.
messages.S3「墨塗り」: Ⅲコインで対象の出血を3回発動させる(出血回数-3)。マイナス: **S3 — Ink Over**: Coin Ⅲ triggers the target's Bleed 3 times (Bleed Count −3). +10% damage per negative effect, up to 100%.
messages.黒雲会の強化: S2「鋭い刃」は戦闘開始時に速度の高い黒雲会の味方へダメージ量増: **Strengthening the Kurokumo Clan**: At Combat Start, S2 Sharpened Blade gives Damage Up to fast Kurokumo Clan allies. With 6 or more Kurokumo Clan members, S2 is upgraded to give 2/3/4 Damage Up to 5 allies. Her Defense skill gives 2 Defense Power Up to (2 + highest Resonance) Kurokumo Clan members, including herself.
messages.バトルパッシブ「押し寄せる黒い雲」(色欲×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘参加: **Combat passive — Gathering Dark Clouds (3 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains Dark Cloud Blade if 2 or more Kurokumo Clan members are in battle. Gives Dark Cloud (that turn's basic attack skills gain Unbreakable Coins, and more) to the Kurokumo Clan Identities on both sides of her (all other Kurokumo Clan members at 4 or more Lust Resonance).
messages.S1・S2で出血とマイナス効果を積み、S3で出血を連続発動させて削る。黒雲会所属: Stack Bleed and negative effects with S1 and S2, then wear enemies down by triggering Bleed repeatedly with S3. The more Kurokumo Clan allies in the team, the larger the ally buffs.
messages.攻撃レベルの優位: バトルパッシブ「破吸自桓」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): **Offense Level advantage**: The combat passive Rupture-breathing Resolve [破吸自桓] (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +1 Clash Power when her Offense Level is higher than her Clash opponent's, and +1 to the Rupture Potency or Count inflicted by basic skills (twice per turn). Defeating an enemy also grants Poise equal to that enemy's Rupture (up to 3, once per turn).
messages.S3「赤春」: 1コインの破壊不能コイン。ダメージ量+(20/50+自分の呼吸+: **S3 — Crimson Spring**: A single Unbreakable Coin. +(20/50 + her Poise + main target's Rupture)% damage (up to 40/75%), plus +(45/80 + her Poise + main target's Rupture)% Critical damage (up to 65/105%), plus +5% Critical damage per Launcher, up to 30%. +1 Attack Weight each if the target has 6/5 or more types of negative effects, or if she has 3 or more Launcher.
messages.呼吸の確保: S1「赤撃」はマッチ勝利時に呼吸を得る。S2「赤鳳」はⅢコインで対: **Securing Poise**: S1 Crimson Strike grants Poise on Clash Win. Coin Ⅲ of S2 Crimson Phoenix grants Poise equal to the target's Rupture, up to 5. Her own Poise alone likely cannot make Crimson Spring's Critical Hits reliable.
messages.黒獣-午 筆頭 イサンとの連携: イサン側のパッシブ「狗馬之心」により、同時に出: **Coordination with Yi Sang's Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept**: Through Yi Sang's passive The Steed's Houndlike Loyalty [狗馬之心], when deployed together, she gains 3 Poise Potency whenever her skill effects inflict Rupture or Rupture Count (twice per turn; not for E.G.O skills). At Turn Start, she also receives 1 Attack Power Up (+1 more at 10 or more Poise Potency), and after Yi Sang uses Obsidian Stormrider's Crescent Decapitator [黑風馬脚月斬], she makes an Assist Attack with Crimson Spring, once per turn.
messages.始と待: 始は戦闘に参加したターン数(最大6)。始が3以上なら、守備「秀回」の効: **Launcher and Ready**: Launcher [始] is the number of turns she has participated in battle, up to 6. At 3 or more Launcher, the Defense skill Adept Evasion makes her retreat at Turn End. Through the passive Launching Maneuver [始動], on retreat she gives allies (in team order) 1 Offense Level Up next turn per Launcher (2 for Jia Family members), and on the turn she steps in from backup or returns, she gains Ready [待] and fires Crimson Strike - Launcher [始] at a random target at Combat Start, first in skill order.
messages.攻撃レベルで勝てる相手を選び、S1・S2で破裂を入れつつ呼吸を貯める。対象のマイ: Pick opponents she can beat in Offense Level, and build Poise while inflicting Rupture with S1 and S2. Increase the target's negative effect types and Rupture before firing Crimson Spring to raise its Attack Weight and damage. On her own, she lacks Poise and Crimson Spring stalls, so fielding her together with Yi Sang's Heishou Pack - Wu Branch Adept to cover Poise and power is close to a requirement. In consecutive battles with backup units, she can also retreat with her Defense skill to hand out Offense Level Up, then strike again with Crimson Strike - Launcher on her return.
messages.組札は前のターンのスキルに変わる: パッシブ「こいこい」により、最も左のスロット: **The Hand changes to match the previous turn's skill**: Through the passive Koi-Koi [こいこい], from the next turn the Hand changes to the one matching the skill used in her leftmost slot (Pine Crane = S1, Wrath; Susuki Grass = S2, Sloth; Blue Sakura = S3, Gloom). Using a skill of the same Sin as the Hand gives +1 Bright【光】 Potency, and +1 more if it also matched on the previous turn. It triggers Tremor Burst on hit.
messages.捨てる: S1〜S3は使用時、同じスロットの装着していないスキルが異なるなら捨て: **Discard**: On use, S1–S3 discard the unequipped skill in the same slot if it is different. This makes identical skills line up in hand more easily, helping consecutive use.
messages.光札と制限時間: 光札は威力0〜5、回数3で、回数はターン開始時に1減る。威力1: **Bright and its time limit**: Bright has Potency 0–5 and Count 3, and Count decreases by 1 at Turn Start. +1 Offense Level Up at Turn Start per Potency. At the end of her leftmost slot's skill, if Potency is 5 or Count is 0, Kōzan [光斬] triggers.
messages.光札を足す手段: 「桜閃」かE.G.Oスキルを最も左のスロットで使うと、組札に関: **Ways to add Bright**: Using Sakura-sen [桜閃] or an E.G.O skill in the leftmost slot gives +1 Bright Potency regardless of the Hand. The Defense skill Shuffle Hands - Floral Deck has a 50% chance of +1 Bright Potency at Combat Start, once per turn.
messages.「光斬」: 光札威力3未満ならキャンセルされ、次のターンに攻撃威力増加2を得る。: **Kōzan [光斬]**: Cancelled if Bright Potency is below 3, granting 2 Attack Power Up next turn. At 3 or more, +10% damage per Potency, reusing a Coin (Bright Potency − 1) times. At 5, the last reused Coin triggers Tremor Burst twice on hit. After use, the Hand changes randomly.
messages.最も左のスロットで同じスキルを毎ターン使い、組札を合わせ続けて1回目+1、2回目: Use the same skill in her leftmost slot every turn to keep matching the Hand, building Bright at +1 the first time and +2 from the second time on, and fire Kōzan at Potency 5 before Count runs out. The basic pattern is spamming S1, her most-held skill, three times from the start (with the Pine Crane Hand, 1→2→2 reaches 5 Bright on turn 3). There is also a route starting from Sakura-sen or a Gloom E.G.O when the Hand is Blue Sakura, but it takes more turns to reach Kōzan, and Bright's 3 Count may run out so Kōzan triggers below Potency 5 (the order of decrease and trigger cannot be determined from the data), so limit it to when conditions line up. When her hand does not cooperate, equipping Shuffle Hands - Floral Deck in the leftmost slot randomly changes the next turn's Hand to one different from the current one.
messages.反撃でS3: 守備「ただじゃ置きませんからね」は戦闘開始時に嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計: **S3 from her counter**: If total Envy Absolute Resonance is 6 or more at Combat Start, the Defense skill I'll Get You Back for This, Man uses S3 when countering (activating from the left-side slots of the dashboard, up to 2 times per turn). She also gains Shield equal to 25% of HP lost at Combat Start. Using S3 as a counter grants 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn.
messages.中指-怨恨: バトルパッシブ「中指は忘れないんですよ」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱ: **The Middle - Grudge**: Through the combat passive The Middle Never Forgets, Y'know? (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), she gains 2 each time she is hit (twice per turn) and 1 when other Middle allies are hit (once per turn per Identity), up to 15. If the attacking enemy has Vengeance Mark, she gains 1 more. On turns with Envy Absolute Resonance, the gain is doubled. +20% damage against targets with Vengeance Mark.
messages.S3での消費: S3は中指-怨恨5以上で最終威力+1(上位段階では5につき+1、: **Spending with S3**: S3 gains +1 Final Power at 5 or more The Middle - Grudge (+1 per 5, up to 3, at higher Uptie). After the attack, it spends all Grudge, gaining 1 The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos per 5 spent (twice per turn).
messages.中指式強化刺青: 最大10。5につき基本スキルの最終威力+1(最大2)、1につき: **The Middle Styled Augmentation Tattoos**: Maximum 10. +1 Final Power for basic skills per 5 (up to 2), and +5% damage for Envy or Blunt skills per point (up to 50%). It only grows by up to 2 per turn, so it takes time to fully develop.
messages.熱線: 戦闘開始時に熱線がなく嫉妬共鳴数の合計が3以上なら、次のターンに熱線2を: **Thermal Blades**: If she has no Thermal Blades at Combat Start and total Envy Resonance is 3 or more, she gains 2 Thermal Blades next turn. While active, some Coins of S2 Crossing Dervish and S3 also inflict Burn equal to their base Bleed value.
messages.嫉妬持ちの人格を厚く入れ、嫉妬完全共鳴6以上を作れるターンに守備を置き、反撃のS: Pack in Identities with Envy skills, set her Defense skill on turns when you can build 6 or more Envy Absolute Resonance, and strike with the counter S3. Spend the The Middle - Grudge built from hits on the counter S3 to turn it into Tattoos, increasing her damage as turns go on. Grudge also builds when other Middle allies are hit, so pairing her with Middle Identities speeds up the Tattoos' growth. The S3 fired from her hand is weak, so on turns without Envy Absolute Resonance, bridge the gap by restoring SP with S1 and similar.
messages.バトルパッシブ「リンバス・カンパニー制作特殊義体試製品mk5-ドッケビの腕」(傲: **Combat passive — Limbus Company Specialized Custom Prosthetic Prototype mk5 - Dokkaebi Arms (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains Dokkaebi Arms at Combat Start (−15% damage taken; 1 Haste next turn on skill use). At the end of a skill, gains Dokkaebi Fire per 3 Poise Potency, up to 5, twice per turn. Her main source of Dokkaebi Fire.
messages.ドッケビの火(正式名「ムク工房 - イェ[鋭]二式抜刀 / 推力:ドッケビの火」: **Dokkaebi Fire** (official name: Mook Workshop - Ye [銳] Type II Bladedraw / Thrust Force: Dokkaebi Fire): Maximum 20, up to 10 per turn. At 15 or more at the end of a basic attack skill, Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame triggers, and all of it is spent after the attack. At Turn End, 1 Haste next turn per 5, up to 3. −1 Clash Power for Defense skills per 2.
messages.クイック3・5: S1「勢法」・S2「刺法」はドッケビの腕を持ちクイック3以上な: **3 and 5 Haste**: S1 Rending Arts and S2 Acupuncture reuse a Coin while she has Dokkaebi Arms and 3 or more Haste. Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame reuses Coin Ⅳ on Critical Hit at 5 or more Haste. S3 Lucent Rippling Flame and the Defense skill I'll Light the Path Forward grant 2 Haste next turn.
messages.「骨断」: 守備スキルのマッチに負けたとき、クイックが3以上なら、守備スキル終了: **To Claim Their Bones**: When her Defense skill loses a Clash, if she has 3 or more Haste, she does not stagger until the Defense skill ends, and the follow-up To Claim Their Bones triggers (twice per turn). It inflicts 1 Slash Fragility. Her Defense skill also grants Assist Defense, and if she has Haste at the end of the skill, she gains 2 Dokkaebi Fire.
messages.剣契との連携: パッシブ「帰るべき場所」により、ステージ初登場時に、戦場にいる剣: **Coordination with Blade Lineage**: Through the passive To Where I Must Return, on first appearing in a stage, she gains 1 Bearing of a Salsu (+1 Offense Level, up to 3) per Blade Lineage ally on the field. Meursault's Blade Lineage Mentor's passive Swordplay of the Homeland (3 Pride Resonance) grants her Swordplay of the Homeland, making him a near-essential partner.
messages.傲慢のスキルをそろえて毎ターン傲慢共鳴3を起こすのが大前提。序盤は呼吸と精神力を: Triggering 3 Pride Resonance every turn by lining up Pride skills is the core premise. Early on, build Poise and SP. Even the Balance spends all Fire after the attack, so every use means building up again. From the midgame on, once Poise has built up, she can aim for a two-turn cycle: bring Fire to 10 or more with her Defense skill or S3 while securing Haste for the next turn, then fire Even the Balance at 5 Haste the next turn. However, the Fire from a single S3 may fall short of 10 depending on Poise Potency and Critical Hits. Using skills multiple times per turn through Assist Defense or To Claim Their Bones, triggering the passive's Fire gain (twice per turn) both times, makes it easier to reach. If you can afford it, place her Defense skill instead of S1 and bring out To Claim Their Bones from Clash losses to earn Fire and extra actions. However, losing Clashes raises the enemy's SP, so do not overdo aiming for To Claim Their Bones.
messages.試着室への入り方: パッシブ「試着室の中へ…」により、体力が0になるダメージを受: **Entering the Changing Room**: Through the passive Into the Changing Room..., when she takes damage that would bring her HP to 0, she does not take it and gains 2 Changing Room instead (once per battle). However, HP-reducing effects from basic skills cannot drop her below 1 HP, so to enter the Changing Room she must take damage that would reduce her HP to 0 from something other than self-damage.
messages.自傷: S2・S3は使用時に脈動回数が足りなければ、新装の有無に関係なく不足分を: **Self-damage**: When using S2 or S3 without enough Pulsation Count, she pays the shortfall with HP regardless of Full Makeover (S2 up to 10, S3 up to 15; 3% of max HP per missing point). In addition, without Full Makeover, she spends 20% of her HP before attacking. The Defense skill Of Course... There was Meaning to this World After All also spends 20% of her HP at Combat Start without Full Makeover, and grants +10 Aggro next turn.
messages.試着室: 速度1固定、スキルによる被ダメージ-50%、体力最大値分のバリア、ター: **Changing Room**: Speed fixed at 1, −50% damage taken from skills, Shield equal to her max HP, and 10 Aggro at Turn Start. She can only use the dedicated Defense skill As the Voice Says, I Gladly Withdraw into Myself. If Changing Room is 0 at Turn End, she enters Full Makeover and gains 5 Pulsation Count.
messages.新装: 速度+1、体力最大値の25%分の体力増加、スキルによる被ダメージ-10%: **Full Makeover**: +1 Speed, HP increase equal to 25% of max HP, −10% damage taken from skills, and +1 Bleed Potency inflicted by basic skills. S2 and S3 gain damage, reuse a Coin once, and heal HP when the reuse hits. The combat passive Cradle of Change (1 Wrath, 1 Lust, and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) also heals 8% of her HP on basic skill hits during Full Makeover, 5 times per turn.
messages.S1は序盤に向かない: S1は現体力80%以上なら脈動回数5を得るため、S2・S: **S1 is poor early on**: S1 grants 5 Pulsation Count at 80% or more current HP, which reduces S2's and S3's self-damage and delays the Changing Room.
messages.序盤はS2・S3を優先し、S1は守備に入れ替えて自傷で体力を削る。体力が低くなっ: Early on, prioritize S2 and S3, swap S1 for her Defense skill, and wear down her HP with self-damage. Once her HP is low, take damage that would bring it to 0 (using enemy one-sided attacks or Unbreakable Coins) to enter the Changing Room (below 50% HP, all of S3's Coins become Unbreakable Coins, letting her strike back while taking hits). Equipping her Defense skill at 10% HP or less also lets her enter the Changing Room, but it throws away that turn's actions, and per the data, entering the Changing Room through damage taken no longer triggers in that battle. After Full Makeover, fight with healing and Coin reuse to balance damage and survivability.

messages.勝率が有利なマッチの威力を底上げするパッシブ「強迫」と、束縛でマッチを組みやすく: A starting E.G.O with the passive Compulsion, which boosts the power of Clashes with favorable odds, and Bind that makes Clashes easier to set up.
messages.強迫: 勝率が有利なマッチの進行時にマッチ威力+2、不利なら-2。条件が軽く、勝: **Compulsion**: +2 Clash Power while a Clash with favorable odds is in progress, and −2 if unfavorable. The condition is light, making Clashes she is likely to win more stable.
messages.束縛: 的中時に次のターンへ束縛4(解析Ⅲは6)を付与し、敵の速度を落として次の: **Bind**: Inflicts 4 Bind next turn on hit (6 at Threadspin Ⅲ), slowing the enemy so next turn's Clashes are easier to set up.
messages.最後方狙い: 一般戦闘では最後方の対象を攻撃する。後続のマッチ順が変わるので、使: **Targets the rearmost**: In regular battles, it attacks the rearmost target. This changes the order of subsequent Clashes, so check its target before using it.
messages.振動: 表面的中時に振動1(解析Ⅲは的中時に振動3)。解析Ⅳで振動爆発も付くが、: **Tremor**: 1 Tremor on Heads Hit (3 Tremor on hit at Threadspin Ⅲ). Threadspin Ⅳ adds Tremor Burst, but its value is small outside Tremor teams.
messages.軽さ: 精神消耗10、必要資源は憤怒2・憂鬱2。ZAYIN の初期E.G.Oで侵: **Lightweight**: Sanity cost 10, requiring 2 Wrath and 2 Gloom. A ZAYIN starting E.G.O with no Corrosion skill.
messages.勝てそうなマッチが多い編成や長期戦で、早めに「強迫」を発動させる。: In teams with many winnable Clashes or in long fights, activate Compulsion early.
messages.ボス戦では束縛が刺さる。次のターンに敵の速度が下がり、マッチを有利に組める。: In boss fights, Bind is effective. The enemy's Speed drops next turn, letting her set up favorable Clashes.
messages.格上の相手には「強迫」が不利判定で裏目に出る点に注意する。: Note that against stronger opponents, Compulsion backfires through unfavorable odds.
messages.Ⅱ: 「強迫」が解放される。これだけで価値が大きい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Compulsion. This alone adds a lot of value.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、束縛が4から6に、振動が1から3になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, Bind from 4 to 6, and Tremor from 1 to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 振動爆発が付く。振動編成でなければ優先度は低いと考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: Adds Tremor Burst. Likely a low priority outside Tremor teams.
messages.LCB囚人: S1(憤怒)・S3(憂鬱)で必要資源を出せ、各スキルが振動を扱い、: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0801)**: S1 (Wrath) and S3 (Gloom) supply the required affinities, each skill handles Tremor, and S3 triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.R社第4群トナカイチーム: S1(憂鬱)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せ、S1・S: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Reindeer](persona:0802)**: S1 (Gloom) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities, S1 and S3 inflict Sinking, and S2 also increases Sinking Count.
messages.桃色のリボンで束縛を積み、攻撃レベル減少・麻痺と合わせて勢いを削ぐ、色欲貫通のデ: A debuff-specialized Lust Pierce E.G.O that stacks Bind through Pink Ribbons and, together with Offense Level Down and Paralyze, saps the enemy's momentum.
messages.桃色のリボン: マッチ勝利時に付与される専用効果。付いた側はコインを使うたびに値: **Pink Ribbons**: A dedicated effect inflicted on Clash Win. Its value grows each time the bearer uses a Coin, and the bearer gains Bind equal to its value at Turn End.
messages.デバフの重ね掛け: 的中時に攻撃レベル減少2(解析Ⅲは7、Ⅳは10)と麻痺2(解: **Stacked debuffs**: On hit, inflicts 2 Offense Level Down (7 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10 at Ⅳ) and 2 Paralyze (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ). 10 Offense Level Down is a weakening roughly equal to −3 Clash Power, and works best when landed early in the turn.
messages.減算コイン: 覚醒はコイン威力-13の減算型で、マッチ威力は13〜26と低め。強: **Minus Coin**: Awakening is a Minus Coin type with −13 Coin Power and a lowish Clash Power of 13–26. It is unreliable in Clashes against strong enemies.
messages.束縛の追加: 解析Ⅳで覚醒にも、的中時に次のターンへ束縛3が付く。: **Extra Bind**: At Threadspin Ⅳ, Awakening also inflicts 3 Bind next turn on hit.
messages.速度が高い人格で、ターン序盤にボスへ当てて勢いを削ぐ。: Land it on a boss early in the turn with a fast Identity to sap its momentum.
messages.敗北しても攻撃できる破壊不能コインのスキルとの相性が良いと考えられる。: It likely pairs well with skills that have Unbreakable Coins, which can still attack after losing.
messages.麻痺は敵のコイン威力を下げるが、減算コインのスキルには逆効果になりうる。: Paralyze lowers the enemy's Coin Power, but can backfire against Minus Coin skills.
messages.侵蝕スキルは加算コインで束縛も付くが、敵味方識別不可で速度が最も速い対象(味方に: The Corrosion skill uses Plus Coins and also inflicts Bind, but it cannot distinguish friend from foe and attacks the fastest target (which can be an ally).
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が26から29に上がり、攻撃レベル減少・麻痺が増える。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power rises from 26 to 29, and Offense Level Down and Paralyze increase.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃レベル減少が10に増え、覚醒にも束縛が付く。デバフ目的なら優先度は高い: **Ⅳ**: Offense Level Down increases to 10, and Awakening also inflicts Bind. High priority if you use it for debuffs.
messages.黒雲会副組長: 色欲のS3で必要資源を出せ、対象のマイナス効果の数でダメージ量が: **[Kurokumo Clan Captain](persona:0811)**: Her Lust S3 supplies the required affinity, and her damage grows with the number of negative effects on the target, making this E.G.O's debuffs pay off.
messages.南部シ協会5課: S2(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せる。: **[Shi Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0803)**: S2 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities.
messages.最大威力41の高威力で火傷を撒き、解析Ⅳで加重値3の広域になる、憤怒貫通の火傷E: A Wrath Pierce Burn E.G.O that spreads Burn with high power up to 41 and becomes a 3-Attack-Weight multi-target attack at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.高威力: 1コインでマッチ威力14〜36(解析Ⅲは19〜41)。基本威力が低いの: **High power**: A single Coin with Clash Power 14–36 (19–41 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Its Base Power is low, so power drops sharply on Tails.
messages.火傷の付与: 的中時に憤怒共鳴数÷2(解析Ⅲは憤怒共鳴数)の火傷を付与。表面的中: **Inflicting Burn**: On hit, inflicts Burn equal to Wrath Resonance ÷ 2 (Wrath Resonance at Threadspin Ⅲ). On Heads Hit (at the end of a Heads attack at Threadspin Ⅳ), inflicts 3 Burn (5 at Threadspin Ⅳ) on 3 random enemies.
messages.混乱区間前進: 解析Ⅲから、表面的中時にダメージ量の40%分、混乱区間を進める。: **Stagger Threshold shift**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, shifts the Stagger Threshold by 40% of the damage dealt on Heads Hit.
messages.飛び散る火花: 火傷のある敵への攻撃的中時、ランダムな敵3名に火傷1を付与する。: **Passive — Shower of Fire**: When an attack hits an enemy with Burn, inflicts 1 Burn on 3 random enemies. It works well alongside multi-Coin Burn Identities.
messages.最後方狙い: 一般戦闘では最後方の対象を攻撃するため、味方のマッチ順が変わる。: **Targets the rearmost**: In regular battles, it attacks the rearmost target, changing allies' Clash order.
messages.憤怒共鳴を稼げる火傷編成で、精神力が高い状態で撃つ。精神力が低いと裏面が出やすく: Use it with high SP in a Burn team that can build Wrath Resonance. With low SP, Tails becomes more likely and its low Base Power hurts.
messages.解析Ⅲで威力が揃い、マッチ目的ならここで十分。広域で火傷を撒くなら解析Ⅳが必要。: Its power is complete at Threadspin Ⅲ, which is enough for Clashing. To spread Burn across multiple targets, Threadspin Ⅳ is required.
messages.侵蝕スキルは打撃で、使用時に体力を最大値の10%減らし、敵味方全員に火傷を付与す: The Corrosion skill is Blunt, costs 10% of her max HP on use, and inflicts Burn on every ally and enemy.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が14から19になり、混乱区間前進が付く。火傷が憤怒共鳴数ぶんに増: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 14 to 19, and the Stagger Threshold shift is added. Burn increases to Wrath Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が3になって広域化し、ランダム3名への火傷が5に増える。: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 3 for multi-target attacks, and the Burn on 3 random enemies increases to 5.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: S1(色欲)・S2(憤怒)・S3(嫉妬)で必要資源をすべて出: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0806)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Wrath), and S3 (Envy) supply all required affinities, and all of her skills inflict Burn.
messages.南部シ協会5課: S1(嫉妬)・S2(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せ、体力: **[Shi Assoc. South Section 5](persona:0803)**: S1 (Envy), S2 (Lust), and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities, and the Corrosion skill's HP cost helps power up her skills that strengthen below 50% HP.
messages.火傷と精神力ダメージを与えつつ、次のターンの味方全体に憤怒ダメージ量増加を配る、: A support-type Wrath E.G.O that inflicts Burn and SP damage while handing Wrath DMG Up to all allies for the next turn.
messages.憤怒ダメージ量増加: 攻撃後、次のターンに味方全体へ憤怒ダメージ量増加1を付与す: **Wrath DMG Up**: After the attack, gives 1 Wrath DMG Up to all allies next turn. It is an after-attack effect, so it does not depend on whether the attack hits.
messages.火傷と精神力ダメージ: 的中時に火傷3(解析Ⅲは4)と、対象への精神力ダメージ7: **Burn and SP damage**: On hit, inflicts 3 Burn (4 at Threadspin Ⅲ) and deals 7 SP damage to the target (15 at Threadspin Ⅲ). Effective against enemies with SP.
messages.喝采の中、息の根を断つ: 攻撃対象の体力が30%未満のとき、憤怒属性スキルのダメ: **Passive — Slaying Amid Cheers**: +20% damage for Wrath skills when the target is below 30% HP.
messages.低コスト: 必要資源は憤怒2・色欲2・怠惰1、精神消耗は覚醒20。: **Low cost**: Requires 2 Wrath, 2 Lust, and 1 Sloth, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 20.
messages.先に撃って、次のターンに憤怒スキルをまとめて使う。バフが次のターンに付くので、ダ: Fire it first, then use Wrath skills together on the next turn. The buff applies next turn, making it easy to time when to deal damage.
messages.火力目的なら紅炎殺(0803)の方が向く。このE.G.Oは場づくりが主役と考えら: For damage, Ardor Blossom Star (0803) is better suited. This E.G.O is likely mainly about setting up the field.
messages.侵蝕スキルは全キャラクターに憤怒脆弱と憤怒ダメージ量増加を付けるため、味方も被害: The Corrosion skill gives every character Wrath Fragility and Wrath DMG Up, so allies also suffer.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、火傷と精神力ダメージが増える。バフ役としての変化は無い。: **Ⅲ**: Raises power, and increases Burn and SP damage. No change in its buffing role.
messages.Ⅳ: 攻撃加重値が2になり広域化する。バフ役としての変化は無く、優先度は低いと考: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 2 for multi-target attacks. No change in its buffing role, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.南部リウ協会4課: 全スキルが火傷を付与し、憤怒のS2も持つので、憤怒ダメージ量: **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0806)**: All of her skills inflict Burn, and she has a Wrath S2, making Wrath DMG Up easy to use.
messages.定事務所代表: S1(憤怒)・S2(怠惰)で必要資源の一部を出せる。: **[Jeong's Office Rep](persona:0813)**: S1 (Wrath) and S2 (Sloth) supply some of the required affinities.
messages.精神力の低い味方4名を回復し、高い味方4名の貫通とダメージ量を強化する、広域の貫: A multi-target Pierce support E.G.O that restores SP to the 4 allies with the lowest SP and strengthens the Pierce attacks and damage of the 4 allies with the highest SP.
messages.精神力回復: 攻撃後、精神力が最も低い味方4名を15(解析Ⅲは20、Ⅳは25)回: **SP recovery**: After the attack, restores 15 SP (20 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 25 at Ⅳ) to the 4 allies with the lowest SP. Its Sanity cost is a heavy 35, so if she is among the targets, the net at Threadspin Ⅳ is likely −10.
messages.貫通・ダメージ量強化: 解析Ⅲから、精神力が最も高い味方4名へ貫通威力増加とダメ: **Pierce and damage buffs**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, gives Pierce Power Up and Damage Up (1 at Ⅲ, 2 at Ⅳ) to the 4 allies with the highest SP. It only lasts this turn, so firing it on a turn she acts early makes it count.
messages.充電と呼吸: 表面的中時に自分の充電回数が3(解析Ⅲは4)、解析Ⅳでは的中時に6: **Charge and Poise**: Her Charge Count increases by 3 on Heads Hit (4 at Threadspin Ⅲ), or by 6 on hit at Threadspin Ⅳ, and 1 random ally gains 1 Poise Count (2 at Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.無謀な航海: ターン終了時、自分以外で体力が最も低い味方に沈潜5、次のターンにク: **Passive — Temeritous Voyage**: At Turn End, inflicts 5 Sinking on the ally other than herself with the lowest HP, plus 1 Haste and 3 Offense Level Up (equal to about +1 Clash Power) next turn. If the same ally remains lowest in HP, Sinking keeps piling up.
messages.開幕に撃つと自分の精神力がマイナスに沈みやすい。精神力を回復できる味方と組む。: Firing it at the start tends to sink her own SP into negatives. Pair her with allies who can restore SP.
messages.貫通人格が多い編成ほど強化の恩恵が大きい。: The more Pierce Identities in the team, the larger the buff's benefit.
messages.長期戦では沈潜が累積するので、使うなら短期決着を狙う。: Sinking accumulates in long fights, so if you use it, aim for a quick finish.
messages.Ⅱ: 「無謀な航海」が解放されるが、沈潜のデメリットも加わる。強化するならⅢまで: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Temeritous Voyage, but also adds the Sinking downside. If you upgrade it, go at least to Ⅲ.
messages.Ⅲ: 貫通威力増加とダメージ量増加が解禁され、回復と充電が増える。: **Ⅲ**: Unlocks Pierce Power Up and Damage Up, and increases recovery and Charge.
messages.Ⅳ: 加重値が5から7、最大威力が35になり、強化の発動条件が緩み、収支が改善す: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight goes from 5 to 7, maximum power becomes 35, the buff conditions relax, and the net cost improves.
messages.R社第4群トナカイチーム: S1(憂鬱)・S2(嫉妬)・S3(憤怒)で憂鬱・嫉妬: **[R Corp. 4th Pack Reindeer](persona:0802)**: S1 (Gloom), S2 (Envy), and S3 (Wrath) supply Gloom, Envy, and Wrath resources, and her skills that use Charge Count mesh with the Charge gain.
messages.ピークォド号船長: スキルが貫通で、S1(嫉妬)・S2(傲慢)で嫉妬・傲慢の資源: **[The Pequod Captain](persona:0808)**: Her skills are Pierce, S1 (Envy) and S2 (Pride) supply Envy and Pride resources, and she has effects that give and gain Poise.
messages.2コイン目が表面的中するたびにコインを再使用し、表が続くほど火力が跳ね上がる暴食: A single-target Gluttony Slash E.G.O that reuses its second Coin each time it lands Heads, with damage soaring the longer the Heads streak lasts.
messages.コイン再使用: 2コイン目の表面的中で、そのコインを再使用する(最大5回、合計7: **Coin reuse**: On Heads Hit, the second Coin is reused (up to 5 times, 7 Coins total). Each reuse costs 1–2 SP. Base Power is a low 3, so whether it grows depends on luck.
messages.暴食脆弱と出血: 2コイン目の的中ごとに暴食脆弱1と出血を付与する。再使用で重な: **Gluttony Fragility and Bleed**: Each second-Coin hit inflicts 1 Gluttony Fragility and Bleed. The more it stacks through reuse, the harder later Coins hit.
messages.自己回復: 1コイン目の的中で体力最大値の15%(解析Ⅲは18、Ⅳは20)を回復: **Self-healing**: On first Coin hit, heals 15% of max HP (18 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 20 at Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, healing beyond her max HP goes to the ally with the lowest HP ratio.
messages.食い意地: スキル使用時にメインターゲットがそのターンにダメージを受けていれば、: **Passive — Gluttony**: On skill use, if the main target has taken damage that turn, on hit it deals 5–10% more damage if her HP is full, or heals 2–5 HP if it is not (up to 7 times per turn).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も低い対象を狙い、味方5名にも割合ダメージを与えて自分を回: **Corrosion skill**: Targets the lowest-HP target and also deals percentage damage to 5 allies to heal herself. Beware of catching allies.
messages.精神力が高い状態で撃つ。精神力が下がると裏面が増え、再使用が続かない。: Fire it with high SP. As SP drops, Tails increases and the reuse chain does not last.
messages.他の人格が先にダメージを入れてから撃つと、「食い意地」が発動する。: Firing it after other Identities have dealt damage activates Gluttony.
messages.暴食資源を出せる人格と組み、必要資源(色欲1・暴食3・傲慢2)を揃える。: Pair it with Identities who can supply Gluttony to gather the required resources (1 Lust, 3 Gluttony, 2 Pride).
messages.Ⅱ: 「食い意地」が解放される。火力の核は解析Ⅰから変わらない。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Gluttony. Its core damage is unchanged from Threadspin Ⅰ.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量が増え、余剰回復を味方へ回せる。侵蝕スキルも強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Increases healing, letting surplus healing go to allies. The Corrosion skill is also strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量がさらに増え、侵蝕スキルに敵討伐時の攻撃威力増加が付く。覚醒の火力の: **Ⅳ**: Further increases healing, and the Corrosion skill gains Attack Power Up on kills. Awakening's damage gains are limited to a higher Bleed cap and more healing, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.LCCB係長: S1(暴食)・S3(傲慢)で必要資源を出せる。: **[LCCB Assistant Manager](persona:0804)**: S1 (Gluttony) and S3 (Pride) supply the required affinities.
messages.エドガー家 バトラー: S2(暴食)で資源を出せ、パッシブが、速度が自分より低い: **[Edgar Family Butler](persona:0809)**: S2 (Gluttony) supplies resources, and her passive adds 1 Potency on Critical Hits against targets slower than her, likely making Gluttony Fragility easy to stack.
messages.敵の沈潜と憂鬱共鳴で回復量が伸びる、体力の低い味方2名を回復する沈潜編成向けの憂: A Gloom Slash E.G.O for Sinking teams that heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP, with healing that grows with the enemy's Sinking and Gloom Resonance.
messages.味方の回復: 攻撃後、体力比率が最も低い味方2名を、体力最大値の(5+メインター: **Healing allies**: After the attack, heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio by (5 + main target's combined Sinking and Sinking Count ÷ 3)% of their max HP, up to 15%. The base rises to 10% at Threadspin Ⅲ, and the cap to 20% at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.沈潜の上乗せ: 的中時に沈潜回数が2(解析Ⅳは3)増える。回復は攻撃後に計算され: **Adding Sinking**: Sinking Count increases by 2 on hit (3 at Threadspin Ⅳ). Healing is calculated after the attack, so her own hits also count toward it.
messages.共鳴で広域化: 最大共鳴が4以上なら加重値+1。解析Ⅲから、それが憂鬱共鳴ならさ: **Multi-target through Resonance**: +1 Attack Weight if the highest Resonance is 4 or more. From Threadspin Ⅲ, +1 more if that Resonance is Gloom. At Threadspin Ⅳ, 4 or more Gloom Resonance increases healing by 10% of max HP.
messages.招聘されざる者: 的中時に付与(最大2)。沈潜1につき被ダメージが0.5%増える: **The Uninvited**: Inflicted on hit, up to 2. The bearer takes 0.5% more damage per Sinking, up to 10%. It also inflicts Curse.
messages.招かざる客の出迎え: 対象に招聘されざる者かパニックタイプ変更効果があれば、マッ: **Passive — Interloper Reception**: +1 Clash Power if the target has The Uninvited or a Panic Type change effect. On hit, restores 5 SP to the ally with the lowest SP, once per turn.
messages.沈潜を付ける人格で敵に沈潜を積んでから撃つと、回復量が伸びる。: Firing it after Sinking Identities have stacked Sinking on the enemy increases the healing.
messages.憂鬱の資源と共鳴を揃え、解析Ⅲ以降の加重値と回復量の増加を狙う。: Gather Gloom resources and Resonance to aim for the Attack Weight and healing increases from Threadspin Ⅲ.
messages.侵蝕スキルは使用時に体力を最大値の10%減らし、解析Ⅲから、次のターンに解析Ⅲか: The Corrosion skill costs 10% of her max HP on use, and from Threadspin Ⅲ inflicts Echoes of the Manor next turn. Normally, use Awakening.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復の基礎値が上がり、憂鬱共鳴で加重値が増える。憂鬱共鳴4以上で憂鬱脆弱も: **Ⅲ**: Raises the healing base value, and Gloom Resonance increases Attack Weight. At 4 or more Gloom Resonance, it also inflicts Gloom Fragility.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復の最大値が20%に上がり、沈潜回数が3、呪いが2になる。: **Ⅳ**: Raises the healing cap to 20%, Sinking Count to 3, and Curse to 2.
messages.奥歯ボートセンターフィクサー: S2(怠惰)・S3(憂鬱)で必要資源を出せ、S2: **[Molar Boatworks Fixer](persona:0807)**: S2 (Sloth) and S3 (Gloom) supply the required affinities, S2 and S3 inflict Sinking, and S1 increases Sinking Count.
messages.エドガー家 バトラー: S1(怠惰)・S3(憂鬱)で必要資源を出せ、沈潜を付与す: **[Edgar Family Butler](persona:0809)**: S1 (Sloth) and S3 (Gloom) supply the required affinities, and she has many skills that inflict Sinking.
messages.自分に振動を積んで3枠の広域で振動爆発を重ね、敵を混乱させつつ精神力も回復する怠: A Sloth Blunt E.G.O that stacks Tremor on herself and layers Tremor Bursts across 3 targets, staggering enemies while also restoring SP.
messages.振動爆発: 2コイン目の的中で振動爆発(振動回数1減少)が起きる。解析Ⅲから、対: **Tremor Burst**: Triggers Tremor Burst (Tremor Count −1) on second Coin hit. From Threadspin Ⅲ, the first Coin also bursts if the target is not staggered, in Low Morale, or panicking, and at Threadspin Ⅳ it bursts twice.
messages.自己振動: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+5)だけ自分の振動回数が増え(最大10)、1コ: **Tremor on herself**: Before attacking, her Tremor Count increases by (highest Resonance + 5), up to 10, and by 5 more on first Coin hit. Useful for Identities that reference their own Tremor Count.
messages.精神力回復: 攻撃後、攻撃対象に混乱・士気低下・パニックの敵がいれば精神力を10: **SP recovery**: After the attack, restores 10 SP if any target is staggered, in Low Morale, or panicking. Against its Sanity cost of 20, this effectively makes it 10.
messages.精神力0未満へのダメージ増: 解析Ⅲから、対象の精神力が0未満なら、不足1につき: **More damage against SP below 0**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, if the target's SP is below 0, +1% damage per point below 0, up to 45%.
messages.暗闇の中の視線: 味方がスキル・コイン効果で得る振動回数を+1(1ターン2回)。: **Passive — A Gaze in the Shadows**: +1 to the Tremor Count allies gain from skill and Coin effects, twice per turn. +2 if the target is staggered or similar.

messages.沈潜の活用: 使用時、メインターゲットの沈潜が4以上でマッチ威力+1(解析Ⅳは4: **Using Sinking**: On use, +1 Clash Power if the main target has at least 4 Sinking (per 4 at Threadspin Ⅳ, up to 2). Inflicts Sinking and Tremor on hit.
