messages.S3「処断」: 4コイン。Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインの表面的中時に出血1ずつ、Ⅳコインは対象の: **S3 — Slay**: 4 Coins. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ each inflict 1 Bleed on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅳ deals +20% damage if the target has at least 6 Bleed. +1 Skill Power if her SP is below 0.
messages.出血の付与: S1「振り下ろす」はⅠコインで出血2、S2「連続斬り」はⅠ・Ⅱコイ: **Inflicting Bleed**: S1 Strike Down inflicts 2 Bleed with Coin Ⅰ, and S2 Axe Combo inflicts 2 Bleed each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ (Coin Ⅱ also adds +1 Bleed Count on Heads Hit).
messages.バトルパッシブ「断悪」(憤怒×5・保有): 攻撃的中時、50%の確率で出血1を付: **Combat passive — Split Evil (5 Wrath Owned)**: On hit, 50% chance to inflict 1 Bleed. The many Coins of S3 give it more attempts.
messages.サポートパッシブ「賭博師」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいるとき、: **Support passive — Gambler (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, Coins that land Heads deal +20% damage for the 1 ally with the highest current HP.
messages.自分だけで付与できる出血は1スキルあたり2〜4程度なので、出血を付与する人格と組: She can only inflict about 2–4 Bleed per skill on her own, so she shines when paired with Identities that inflict Bleed. Bring enemy Bleed to 6 or more with S1, S2, and allies' infliction, then land S3. Bleed damage ignores resistances, so she can be fielded even when the team lacks Identities that can hit weaknesses. Even when she is not deployed, if the team can hold 5 Wrath, she is worth keeping in backup for Gambler.
messages.S3「快刀乱麻」: 1コイン(7+16/18)。対象の出血が6以上ならクリティカ: **S3 — Sky-clearing Cut**: 1 Coin (7+16/18). Doubled Critical chance if the target has at least 6 Bleed, and +100% Critical damage if she has at least 10 Poise. Inflicts 10 Bleed on Critical Hit.
messages.呼吸の確保: S2「飛び散る剣撃」は使用時に呼吸回数+1/2、Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで呼吸: **Securing Poise**: S2 Scattering Slash adds +1/2 Poise Count on use, grants 1/2 and 2/3 Poise with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, and gains +2 Coin Power at 5 or more Poise. S1 Sharpened Blade grants 2/4 Poise on Heads Hit and gains +2 Coin Power at 4 or more Poise. The Defense skill Counter grants +2 Poise Count and 1 Protection on use.
messages.出血の付与: 自分で出血を付与できるのはS2(Ⅰコイン1/2・Ⅱコイン2/3)と: **Inflicting Bleed**: Her only sources of Bleed are S2 (Coin Ⅰ 1/2, Coin Ⅱ 2/3) and Sky-clearing Cut's Critical Hit. S1 does not inflict Bleed.
messages.バトルパッシブ「黒雲刀」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 反撃時、自分の呼吸: **Combat passive — Dark Cloud Blade (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When countering, if she has at least 5 Poise, the counter activates as Skill 3 (Sky-clearing Cut). In that case, she does not get the regular Counter's on-use effects (1 Protection, +2 Poise Count).
messages.サポートパッシブ「黒雲剣術」(憂鬱×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最も低い: **Support passive — Dark Cloud Swordsmanship (5 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +10% Slash skill damage for the 1 slowest ally.
messages.S2の付与量は最大でも出血5なので、出血6以上の条件は味方の出血付与で満たすのが: S2 inflicts at most 5 Bleed, so the 6-Bleed condition is basically met through allies' Bleed infliction (pair her with Bleed Identities or Poise supporters). Earn Poise and Poise Count with S2 to reach 5 or more Poise, then land S3 on a bleeding enemy. Her only ways to increase Poise Count are S2 and Counter, and once Dark Cloud Blade triggers, Counter no longer grants it, so expect Poise to run out within a few turns and rebuild by slotting in S2. Also, none of her skills grant Aggro, so the chances to deliberately bring out the Dark Cloud Blade counter are limited.
messages.麻痺と守備威力減少で敵の守備スキルと攻撃を崩す打撃デバッファー。ほかの打撃人格と: A Blunt debuffer that breaks down enemy Defense skills and attacks with Paralyze and Defense Power Down. Her core strength is lining up with other Blunt Identities to strengthen S1 and S2, and, against enemies with clashable Defense skills or counters, Clashing with their attack skills to land S2 and S3 and help allies' Clashes.
messages.連続打撃で強化: S1「打撃」・S2「刺す」は、操作パネルの次のスキルが打撃スキ: **Bonuses from consecutive Blunt hits**: S1 Bludgeon and S2 Thrust gain +2 Coin Power if the next skill on the dashboard is a Blunt skill (Uptie Ⅳ). Because it references the next skill, it does not trigger if she is last in line or there are no other Blunt Identities.
messages.守備威力減少: S2はⅡコインの的中時に守備威力減少2/4、S3「制圧」はⅠコイ: **Defense Power Down**: S2 inflicts 2/4 Defense Power Down on Coin Ⅱ hit, and S3 Suppress inflicts 4 on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit. For 1 turn, it lowers the Final Power of Defense skills.
messages.麻痺: S1は表面的中時に麻痺1/3、S3はⅡコインの表面的中時に麻痺3。S3は: **Paralyze**: S1 inflicts 1/3 Paralyze on Heads Hit, and S3 inflicts 3 Paralyze on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit. S3 also inflicts 4 Defense Level Down on Coin Ⅰ hit.
messages.S3の先制強化: 対象がこのターンにまだ攻撃でダメージを受けていなければコイン威: **S3's first-strike bonus**: +2/3 Coin Power if the target has not yet taken damage from an attack this turn.
messages.パッシブ: バトル「防御崩し」(嫉妬×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)は、このターンに: **Passives**: The combat passive Breach Defense (3 Envy Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +10% damage against enemies that used a Defense skill this turn. The support passive Breaching (5 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +20% damage under the same condition to the 1 ally with the highest HP.
messages.S1・S2の強化には後ろに打撃スキルが続く必要があるので、同じくらいの速度の打撃: Strengthening S1 and S2 requires a Blunt skill to follow, so field her with Blunt Identities of similar Speed (to use her properly, take her to Uptie Ⅳ and pair her with Blunt Identities in the same Speed range). Defense Power Down mainly matters against enemies with clashable Defense skills or counters: Clash those enemies' attack skills with S2 and S3 to land them, making it easier for following allies to break their defenses. Clashable Defense skills are triggered by the first one-sided attack they receive, so trying to push through with one-sided attacks hits the defense before it is weakened. S3's bonus requires landing before anyone else, which is hard in today's Focused Encounters with many fast Identities, so it mainly pays off in regular battles.
messages.釘と出血: S1「忠実な釘打ち」で出血を付与し、釘がある対象にはさらに釘を付与。: **Nails and Bleed**: S1 Devoted Hammering inflicts Bleed, plus more Nails on targets that already have Nails. S2 Zealous Purge inflicts 1 Nails and 1 Paralyze next turn. Her Defense skill's counter also inflicts Nails.
messages.狂信: S2のマッチ勝利時に次のターンの狂信1を得る。狂信は釘のある対象への攻撃: **Fanatic**: Grants 1 Fanatic next turn on S2 Clash Win. Fanatic raises Final Power when attacking targets with Nails.
messages.S3「鉄の断罪」: 自分に狂信があればダメージ量+15%、生存しているN社の狂信: **S3 — Ironclad Retribution**: +15% damage if she has Fanatic, and +5% damage per living N Corp. Fanatic.
messages.バトルパッシブ「処断の歓び」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵が死亡すると: **Combat passive — Joy of Execution (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When an enemy dies, she gains 1 Haste and 1 Damage Up next turn. If she defeated it, she also gains 1 Fanatic (once per turn).
messages.S2をマッチで勝たせて次のターンの釘と狂信を得て、次のターンにS1で釘を増やして: Win Clashes with S2 to gain next turn's Nails and Fanatic, then on the next turn increase Nails with S1 before landing S3. Fielding many N Corp. Fanatics increases S3's damage.
messages.S2「振動圧着」のコイン再使用: Ⅱコインは自分の充電回数が3以上なら、表面が出: **S2 Vibration Compression's Coin reuse**: Coin Ⅱ is reused each time it lands Heads while her Charge Count is 3 or more, up to 2 times. Each reuse adds +2 to the Tremor inflicted (2→4→6), and after 2 reuses it inflicts Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst. The reuse itself does not consume Charge Count (the passive spends it on Tremor Burst). +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 10 Tremor Count.
messages.充電回数の獲得: S1「エンジン始動」は使用時に+2、Ⅰコインの的中時に+4(同: **Gaining Charge Count**: S1 Rev Up adds +2 on use and +4 on Coin Ⅰ hit (Uptie Ⅳ; also inflicts 1 Tremor on Heads Hit). S3 Let’s Rack Up Some Scores adds +6 on use. The Defense skill Preheat adds +2 at Combat Start. Charge loses 1 Count at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「早上がりのために～」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 振動爆: **Combat passive — Here’s to Getting Off Early~ (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On Tremor Burst, spends 3 Charge Count for +40% Stagger Threshold shift from that burst. When Tremor Burst occurs, she gains 1 Haste and 1 Blunt DMG Up next turn.
messages.S3: 3コイン。Ⅱ・Ⅲコインで振動爆発(Ⅱコインは表面的中時に振動2も付与)。: **S3**: 3 Coins. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ trigger Tremor Burst (Coin Ⅱ also inflicts 2 Tremor on Heads Hit). If the target is staggered, Coin Ⅲ deals additional damage equal to 25% of the damage dealt.
messages.S2の再使用には「充電回数3以上」と「表面」の両方が要る。パッシブが発動している: S2's reuse requires both 3 or more Charge Count and Heads. With the passive active, each Tremor Burst spends 3 Charge Count, so after firing S3 (2 bursts, up to 6 spent) and similar, Count tends to run short. S1 only gains +2 Count if its first Coin misses, so land it as a one-sided attack whenever possible to earn Count and pass it to S2. In regular battles, her Defense skill can also add +2 at Combat Start. S2's Clash Power is lowish (up to 12), so raise her SP early. She suits the Mirror Dungeon, where Tremor and Charge Gifts are easy to gather.
messages.呼吸回数: S1「牽制」・S2「集中防御」の使用時・的中時やマッチ敗北時に呼吸回: **Poise Count**: Poise Count increases on use and on hit of S1 Careful Obstruction and S2 Focused Defense, and on Clash Lose. S2 increases it further on use if she has Shield of 15 or more.
messages.挑発値: S1・S2・守備は使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る。: **Aggro**: S1, S2, and her Defense skill grant Aggro next turn on use.
messages.S3「脅威対象制圧」: 自分のバリアが15以上ならコイン威力+1/2。Ⅲコインの: **S3 — Subdue Threat**: +1/2 Coin Power if she has Shield of 15 or more. On Coin Ⅲ Critical Hit, inflicts 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「防御呼吸」(憤怒×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時、呼吸: **Combat passive — Defensive Breathing (3 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, gains Shield of 2 per Poise Count, up to 20.
messages.S1・S2で呼吸回数を貯め、パッシブで次の戦闘開始時にバリアに変える。バリアが1: Build Poise Count with S1 and S2, and the passive converts it into Shield at the next Combat Start. Using S3 while the Shield is 15 or more raises its Coin Power.
messages.S2・S3で捨ててバリア: S2「知識の重さ」は使用時にランクが最も低いスキル1: **Discarding with S2 and S3 for Shield**: On use, S2 Weight of Knowledge discards the lowest-rank skill, and S3 Excruciating Study discards 2. Depending on the discarded skill, she gains Shield of "Insight × a set % of max HP" (S1: 3/5%, S2: 5/8/10%, S3: 15/20%). Insight is the rank of the last discarded skill (default 1).
messages.主力のS2・S3: どちらも4コインで、使用時に次のターンの挑発値を得る(S2は: **Main S2 and S3**: Both have 4 Coins and grant Aggro next turn on use (S2: 2/3/5, S3: 3/5). S2 inflicts 2/3/5 Sinking with Coin Ⅳ, and S3 adds +4 Sinking Count with Coin Ⅰ and +2 with Coin Ⅳ. S2 gains +2 Clash Power if the target has at least 5 Sinking, and S3 gains +1 Coin Power at 7 or more.
messages.バトルパッシブ「悟りの光」(憂鬱×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): そのターンに受け: **Combat passive — Incandescent Enlightenment (3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains Blunt DMG Up next turn in proportion to the damage taken that turn (including damage absorbed by Shield), up to 5 at 25% of her HP at Turn Start. At 3 Insight, removes 1 negative effect at Turn End.
messages.守備「探求没入」: 使用時にランクが最も高いスキル1つを捨て、次のターンの挑発値: **Defense skill — Fixated Study**: Discards the highest-rank skill on use and grants +2/5 Aggro next turn. When the panel holds only S1s, it discards an S1, keeping skills cycling even when S2 and S3 are unavailable. It is an on-use effect, so if the Defense skill is not used, the discard fizzles too.
messages.S1「無知を明かさん」: 探求した知識が2以上なら(知識-1)だけコイン威力が上: **S1 — Illuminate Thy Vacuity**: At 2 or more Insight, gains (Insight − 1) Coin Power, and on Coin Ⅲ hit pushes her own Stagger Threshold back by 5/8/10. Normally, its role is to be discarded into Shield.
messages.基本はS2とS3を振り続けるだけでよい。毎回S1が捨てられてバリアになり、パネル: Basically, just keep using S2 and S3. Each use discards S1 into Shield, and S2 and S3 tend to come around on the panel. In Focused Encounters, take attacks with Aggro and use the damage taken (including Shield damage) to raise next turn's Blunt damage. Deliberately taking one-sided attacks for Incandescent Enlightenment is also an option. When only S1s are lined up on the panel, use her Defense skill to discard an S1 (the highest rank at that point) and keep the rotation going. As a separate trick, discarding S2 or S3 with her Defense skill brings Insight to 3, granting S1's Coin Power bonus and Incandescent Enlightenment's negative effect removal. However, this reduces her main skills by the S2s and S3s discarded and also her chances to gain Shield. S2 and S3 have lowish Clash Power caps (S2 up to 15, S3 up to 16), so pick Clash targets early on when SP is low.
messages.S2「炎手撃-燃」(主力): 3コイン。Ⅰ・Ⅱコインの的中時と、Ⅲコインの表面的: **S2 Fiery Knifehand-Combust (main skill)**: 3 Coins. +1 Burn Count on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits and on Coin Ⅲ Heads Hit. On Coin Ⅲ hit, if the target has at least 6 Burn Count, inflicts 3 Burn on the 2 enemies with no Burn or the lowest Burn Count. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Burn (+1 per 6 Burn, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.S3「一点突破」: 4コイン。Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインで火傷1・1・2を付与し、Ⅳコインで対: **S3 — Pinpoint Blitz**: 4 Coins. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ inflict 1, 1, and 2 Burn, and Coin Ⅳ deals Wrath damage equal to half of the target's Burn Potency (all of it at higher Uptie), up to 20/30, and reduces Burn Count by 2. +30% damage if the target's Burn and Burn Count are both 6 or more.
messages.バトルパッシブ「アツい勢い」(憤怒×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の火傷威力: **Combat passive — Burning Passion (3 Wrath Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +5/10% damage per 6 Burn Potency on the target, up to 15/30%. At Combat Start, if all enemies have at least 6 Burn, gives 1 Wrath DMG Up to allies in team order (up to the number of Wrath Absolute Resonance), plus 1 Attack Power Up if the target is a Liu Association Fixer.
messages.S1「炎拳撃」: Ⅰ・Ⅱコインで火傷1ずつ。対象の火傷が3以上でコイン威力+1(: **S1 — Flaming Fists**: Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 1 Burn each. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 3 Burn (+1 per 3 Burn, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.サポートパッシブ「アツアツの激励」(憤怒×6・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が: **Support passive — Passionate Cheer (6 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: When the 1 ally with the lowest SP lands an attack, +5% Pierce damage per 6 Burn Potency on the target, up to 15%.
messages.自分で付与できる火傷威力はS1・S3の1〜2ずつと少ないので、火傷威力を付与する: She can only inflict 1–2 Burn Potency at a time with S1 and S3, so pair her with other Burn Identities who inflict Burn Potency while she covers Burn Count with S2. Fighting around S2 is the basic approach. Once the target's Burn Count reaches 6 or more, spread 3 Burn to surrounding enemies with S2's Coin Ⅲ. S3 has a damage cap (20/30) and also reduces Burn Count by 2, so firing it before Burn Potency has built up tends to be a loss. Fire it once Burn and Burn Count are both 6 or more. Burning Passion's ally buffs are determined by team order, so place the Wrath allies you want to buff at the front.
messages.振動で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の振動が多いほどマッチ威力が上がる。: **Tremor bonuses**: Each attack skill gains Clash Power the more Tremor the target has.
messages.束縛: S2「T社式制圧格闘」・S3「徴収執行」で次のターンに束縛を付与し、対象: **Bind**: S2 T Corp. Martial Suppression and S3 Execute Collections inflict Bind next turn, and damage rises with the target's Bind.
messages.S3: 自分の振動回数を8消耗してコイン威力+1。Ⅳコインで振動爆発し、次のター: **S3**: Spends 8 of her own Tremor Count for +1 Coin Power. Coin Ⅳ triggers Tremor Burst and inflicts 1 Bind next turn (2 more if Tremor Count was spent). If she is in Borrowed Time, it inflicts 2 Time Moratorium.
messages.時間貸与: 守備「時間貸与」で得る。回数2以上ならクイック・マッチ威力増加と引き: **Borrowed Time**: Gained through the Defense skill Borrow Time. At 2 or more Count, she gains Haste and Clash Power Up in exchange for Fragile, and is staggered if Bind exceeds Haste. At 1 Count, she gains Bind next turn.
messages.バトルパッシブ「ゴールデンタイム-対抗」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): タ: **Combat passive — Golden Time - Standoff (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If her HP is between 16% and 20% at Turn End, she immediately recovers 60% HP and recovers from Stagger (once per battle). +2 Clash Power in Clashes against enemies with Time Moratorium, and −10% damage taken from them.
messages.S1で振動を付与し、S1・S2で自分の振動回数を貯めて、S3で振動爆発と束縛を入: Inflict Tremor with S1, build her own Tremor Count with S1 and S2, then apply Tremor Burst and Bind with S3. Landing S3 on or after the turn following Borrowed Time from her Defense skill applies Time Moratorium, but Borrowed Time carries a risk of Stagger.
messages.デリバリーキャリア-ロージャ: S1・S2のⅠコインの的中時と守備の使用時に得る: **Courier Trunk - Rodion**: Gained on Coin Ⅰ hit of S1 and S2 and on using her Defense skill (extra below 15). All attack skills gain +1 Coin Power if Courier Trunk is 10 or more or the target has at least 6 Rupture (+1 per 10 Courier Trunk or 6 Rupture, up to 2, at higher Uptie). S2 gains +2% damage per Courier Trunk (up to 40%), and S3 gains +2/4% (up to 40/80%).
messages.S2「デリバリーキャリア-ガジェット射出」(主軸): 3コイン。キャリア獲得、Ⅱ: **S2 Courier Trunk - Gadget Reveal (core)**: 3 Coins. Gains Courier Trunk, grants 1 Haste next turn on Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit (+1 more at 15 or more Courier Trunk), and Coin Ⅲ inflicts Defense Level Down. If the target has 15 Rupture and at least 3 Rupture Count, it does not consume Rupture Count on hit.
messages.S3「ポルー！ちょっと頑張って！」: 対象の破裂が15・破裂回数が3以上なら、破: **S3 — I Trust Ya, Polu!**: If the target has 15 Rupture and at least 3 Rupture Count, it reuses its last Coin instead of inflicting Rupture Count. Otherwise, Coin Ⅱ adds +3 Rupture Count (+1 more per 10 Courier Trunk, up to 2). At 15 or more Courier Trunk, Coin Ⅲ deals +15/25% damage.
messages.バトルパッシブ「迅速配達」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン開始時に速: **Combat passive — Speedy Delivery (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn Start, if she has 6 or more Speed or Haste, she gains Shield of (Courier Trunk ÷ 2 / Courier Trunk)% of her max HP, up to 15/20%. On retreat, gives 1 Clash Power Up to 2 allies next turn (+1 turn of duration per 15 Courier Trunk, up to +2).
messages.退却: 戦闘開始時にキャリアが15以上なら、守備「配達補助および統制シーケンス」: **Retreat**: If Courier Trunk is 15 or more at Combat Start, the Defense skill Courier Support & Control Sequence activates as Just... a Strategic Time Off!, and she enters Strategic R&R Mode (retreat) at Turn End. When she rejoins in consecutive battles, Courier Trunk is halved (once per battle, rounded up).
messages.序盤はS1・S2・守備でキャリアを溜め(15までは多めに貯まる)、溜まるほど強く: Early on, build Courier Trunk with S1, S2, and her Defense skill (it builds faster up to 15), and attack mainly with S2, which grows stronger as it builds. Against enemies with 15 Rupture and 3 or more Rupture Count, S3's last Coin is reused, so setting up the condition in a Rupture team before firing it deals big damage. S2's Haste also makes Speedy Delivery's Shield condition easy to meet. Once Courier Trunk reaches 15 or more, placing her Defense skill makes her retreat at Turn End regardless of whether the counter was used, so from then on it is a choice between continuing to attack and retreating. Above 30 Courier Trunk, self-damage begins (not mentioned in the Identity's effect text), but most battles end without her retreating. Think of retreat as an option for long fights or for swapping with a backup unit in consecutive battles.
messages.S2のバフ(主力): 戦闘開始時、自分と最大体力が最も低い味方1名へ攻撃威力増加: **S2's buffs (main skill)**: At Combat Start, gives 1 Attack Power Up to herself and the 1 ally with the lowest max HP, and spends up to 30 Bloodfeast to give 1 Blooming Thorn per 10 Bloodfeast (up to 2 times per turn). If the recipient is a Bloodfiend, it adds 1 more Attack Power Up and 2 Blooming Thorn. This "ally" includes herself as a Bloodfiend, so she also receives the extra (how the extra is handled when Bloodfeast cannot be spent cannot be read from the effect text). +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Bleed (+1 per 6 Bleed, up to 2, at higher Uptie).
messages.血餐の消耗と自傷: S1「下がりなさい…」・S2は戦闘開始時に血餐を消耗して棘を: **Spending Bloodfeast and self-damage**: At Combat Start, S1 Begone... and S2 spend Bloodfeast to hand out Thorns (prioritizing Bloodfiend allies). If she cannot spend Bloodfeast, she gains 5 Bleed herself. If a higher-ranked kin ally spends Bloodfeast that same turn, she waits until that ally has spent it.
messages.咲き出す棘: 数値2につき防御レベル+1(最大5)。被ダメージ時に攻撃者へ出血1: **Blooming Thorn**: +1 Defense Level per 2, up to 5. When the bearer takes damage, it inflicts 1 Bleed on the attacker and decreases by 1. For this Identity, Thorn reaching its maximum raises its stage, increasing the Bleed and Rupture inflicted by basic skills by (current stage − 1).
messages.守備「ドンキホーテ流硬血15式日傘」: マッチ可能反撃。使用時に、自分以外で(出: **Defense skill — Don Quixote Hardblood Arts 15: Parasol**: A clashable counter. On use, reduces the Bleed Count of the 2 allies other than herself with the highest (Bleed × Bleed Count) by 3 (2 more for Bloodfiends), and increases Bloodfeast by (Bleed Potency before reduction × Bleed Count reduced). Bleed disappears when its Count reaches 0. Grants 4 Blooming Thorn on Clash Win.
messages.フィナーレ: S3「祝祭は終わるの」の使用前、自分の咲き出す棘が25以上なら派生: **The Finale**: Branches from S3 The Festival Will End before use if she has 25 or more Blooming Thorn. +1% damage per 5 Bloodfeast Consumed, up to 50%; gives Festive Fever and Blooming Thorn to herself and allies (up to the highest Resonance), and spends all of her Blooming Thorn after the attack.
messages.バトルパッシブ「硬血の棘」(色欲×3・嫉妬×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分以: **Combat passive — Hardblood Thorn (3 Lust and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains 1 Blooming Thorn each time an ally other than herself takes Bleed damage or spends Bloodfeast, up to 3/5 times per turn. Heals HP equal to 20% of basic skill damage dealt (up to 10 per skill; at full HP, the excess goes to the ally with the lowest HP ratio).
messages.序盤からS2を振り、自分と味方の攻撃威力増加でマッチを有利にするのが基本。出血を: The basic approach is to use S2 from the start, tilting Clashes in your favor with Attack Power Up for herself and allies. Paired with allies who inflict Bleed, Bloodfeast builds up, S1's and S2's Thorn distribution works, and she avoids self-damage (5 Bleed). Her Defense skill can Clash while turning allies' Bleed into Bloodfeast, and Lust covers its resources. The Finale requires 25 or more Thorns and takes time to trigger, so there is almost never a chance to use it twice or more in a battle. Treat it as a bonus if you get to fire it. Even in teams that do not involve Bleed, she can fight with S2's buffs and her high base power.
messages.巳腕(呼吸の供給源): 最大3。ターン終了時に、次のターンの呼吸3と呼吸回数+2: **Serpent Arm (Poise source)**: Maximum 3. At Turn End, grants 3 Poise and +2 Poise Count for the next turn. When using a basic attack skill, she gains 5 Poise if the target has Rupture. It decreases by 1 at Turn End. She gains 3 Serpent Arm on using S3 Serpent's Mortal Flurry, 3 Serpent Arm for the next turn at Combat Start of the Defense skill Reversal Kick, and 1 on Coin Ⅲ Critical Hit of S2 (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.呼吸と破裂で強化: 全攻撃スキルは、自分の呼吸威力と対象の破裂威力の合計が10以: **Poise and Rupture bonuses**: All attack skills gain +1 Coin Power if her Poise Potency plus the target's Rupture Potency is 10 or more (+1 per 10, up to 2, at higher Uptie; +2 at a total of 20 is Uptie Ⅳ). Each Poise gives 5% Critical chance, so 20 Poise guarantees Critical Hits.
messages.S2「巳の牙」: 3コイン。マッチ勝利時に対象の破裂回数+2・自分の呼吸回数+1: **S2 — Snake Fang**: 3 Coins. On Clash Win, +2 Rupture Count on the target and +1/2 Poise Count on herself. Coin Ⅲ inflicts Deathrite【Venom】, and at 30 or more Poise, spends 10 Poise to reuse the Coin once.
messages.S3「絶命巳乱」: 3コインの広域乱射(2枚目以降はランダムな対象)。巳腕の数だ: **S3 — Serpent's Mortal Flurry**: A 3-Coin Unfocused Volley (from the second Coin on, targets are random). Clash Power rises by her Serpent Arm. On Coin Ⅲ Critical Hit, the Coin is reused (up to 2 times per skill) and the target's Deathrite【Venom】 decreases by 1.
messages.バトルパッシブ「黒獣化【巳】」(暴食×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 巳腕があれば: **Combat passive — Heishou Mutation [Si] (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +5% damage while she has Serpent Arm, and +5% more if the target has Deathrite【Venom】.
messages.序盤はS3か守備で巳腕を確保する(守備は戦闘開始時に効果が出るので、敵の攻撃とマ: Early on, secure Serpent Arm with S3 or her Defense skill (the Defense skill takes effect at Combat Start, so it does not need to Clash with an enemy attack). Serpent Arm's 5 Poise is only gained when the target has Rupture, so pairing her with allies whose final Coin inflicts Rupture is important. Her ways to maintain Poise Count are Serpent Arm, S1 (+1/2 on use), S2's Clash Win (+1/2), and S3 (+2 on Coin Ⅰ hit; Coin Ⅱ also grants 2 Poise), so use S2 in Clashes it can win and send S1 to one-sided attacks. Firing S3 once Poise has built up reaches up to 5 Coins through Critical reuse. Deathrite【Venom】 is enough as a passive condition and is not the main thing to aim for. Her Defense skill has low Clash Power (up to 10/13). She is also fragile herself, so avoid relying on the Defense skill too much. She shows her true strength in long fights rather than short ones.
messages.2つの形態: ターン開始時、精神力が0以上なら加護、0未満なら絶望になる。加護は: **Two forms**: At Turn Start, she is in Blessing if her SP is 0 or higher, and Despair if it is below 0. In Blessing she gains Protecting Sword (Defense Level Up, leftmost slot Aggro + value×3, up to 15) per 8 SP, and in Despair she gains Piercing Sword (Offense Level Up) per −8 SP, each up to 5. In Despair, her attack skills lower her SP on use (S1 7, S2 10, S3 15).
messages.涙で研ぎ澄ます(守備で得る): 守備はターン終了時、研ぎ澄ますが3未満なら精神力: **Tear-sharpened (gained through her Defense skill)**: At Turn End, if Tear-sharpened is below 3, her Defense skill lowers her SP by 15 and grants 1 Tear-sharpened (once per turn; while she holds it, SP drops by an extra 15 per stack). While held, her SP drops by value×15 at each Turn End, and she gains 5 Deep Tears at Turn Start. Basic attack skills gain +value×10% damage (up to 30%), and she gains Clash Power Up in Blessing or Pierce Power Up in Despair equal to its value.
messages.研ぎ澄ます3での放出: 3あると、基本攻撃スキルの最終コイン的中前に全て消耗し、: **Release at 3 Tear-sharpened**: At 3, she spends all of it before her basic attack skill's final Coin hits, inflicting 3 Sinking and 3 Sinking Count and giving that Coin +50% damage. If her SP is below 0 at that Turn End, it returns to 0 and then recovers 30, so she returns to Blessing. Despair's S3 Arcana: Tear and Pierce reuses its final Coin once if it spends Tear-sharpened on this Coin.
messages.深い涙: 特殊充電(最大20)。S2は15以上で5消耗してダメージ量が上がり、S: **Deep Tears**: A special Charge (up to 20). S2 spends 5 at 15 or more for more damage, and S3 spends up to 20 at 10 or more, gaining damage and Base Power based on the amount spent.
messages.バトルパッシブ「正義の魔法少女 / 絶望の騎士」(憂鬱×3・傲慢×3・保有・同期: **Combat passive — Magical Girl of Justice / Knight of Despair (3 Gloom and 3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: In Blessing, damage taken is reduced by (SP ÷ 2)% (up to 20%), with 1 Protection at 3 or more Protecting Sword, or 2 Protection and 1 Clash Power Up at 5. In Despair, basic skills deal more damage (up to 20%), with 1 Damage Up at 3 or more Piercing Sword, or 2 Damage Up and 1 Power Up at 5.
messages.精神力の下限: 自分の基本スキル、研ぎ澄ます、味方のサポートパッシブなどによる精: **SP floor**: SP loss from her own basic skills, Tear-sharpened, allies' support passives, and similar cannot bring her below −40. If SP damage would bring her to −45, she holds at −44 that turn (once per battle). Costs such as E.G.O use are not covered.
messages.絶望で戦う場合: 1ターン目から守備を使い、研ぎ澄ますを貯めて精神力を下げる(守: **When fighting in Despair**: Use her Defense skill from turn 1 to build Tear-sharpened and lower her SP (two uses of the Defense skill reach −40 SP and 20 Deep Tears). Gather the passive's resources (3 Gloom and 3 Pride) during that time. Stopping Tear-sharpened at 2 makes even the per-turn SP loss a benefit in this form. At 3, the next attack releases it and returns her to Blessing, so only use the Defense skill a third time when you have decided to deal maximum damage with S3 and then move to Blessing. Be careful: losing a Clash at −40 SP risks immediate Corrosion. **When fighting in Blessing**: Seal away her Defense skill (using it grants Tear-sharpened and lowers her SP) and keep her SP high. As a tank who takes attacks with Protecting Sword 5's Aggro and damage reduction, she can be handled like a normal Plus Coin Identity.
messages.S3の放出: 使用時に充電回数が10以上なら全て消耗し、コイン威力+1/2、10: **S3's release**: On use, with 10 or more Charge Count, spends all of it for +1/2 Coin Power and +6/12% damage per Count spent beyond 10, up to 30/60%. +5/10% damage per Charge Potency, up to 20/40%. Coin Ⅰ adds +3 Sinking Count, Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ inflict 1 Sinking each, and each Coin shifts the Stagger Threshold by a set percentage of the damage dealt (20% for Coin Ⅰ at 3 or more Charge).
messages.充電回数5〜9でのS3: 自分が沈潜5を得て充電回数+5され、[敵味方識別不可]: **S3 at 5–9 Charge Count**: She gains 5 Sinking, Charge Count increases by 5, and it becomes an Unfocused Volley that [cannot distinguish friend from foe] (+1 Attack Weight). With 3 or more Charge before use, the friend-or-foe restriction does not apply, but she does not get the damage increase from firing it at 10 or more.
messages.充電回数の獲得: S1「エネルギー強打」はⅠ・Ⅱコインの的中時に+2/3・+2。: **Gaining Charge Count**: S1 Energy Strike adds +2/3 and +2 on Coin Ⅰ and Ⅱ hits. S2 Concentration adds +3/6 on Coin Ⅰ hit. Coin Ⅱ's check comes after that: if Count is below 8 at that point, she gains 5 Sinking and +4; if 8 or more, she spends 4 to inflict 1 Blunt Fragility next turn (once per turn each; the spending and Fragility effects are Uptie Ⅳ). On Clash Lose, S1 grants 4 Sinking and S2 grants 5 Sinking, and Charge Count also increases. Her Defense skill adds +3 on use (once per turn). Charge Count decreases by 1 at Turn End.
messages.バトルパッシブ「クリスマスデコレーションされた角」(憂鬱×2・嫉妬×2・保有・同: **Combat passive — Jolly Antlers (2 Gloom and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains 1 Charge each time she spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. When using a basic attack skill that inflicts Sinking, if the main target has no Sinking, she gains 5 Sinking and that skill's Sinking Potency is doubled (once per turn). +1 Final Power for basic attack skills below 35% HP.
messages.S1を積極的に振って充電回数を稼ぎ、同期化ⅣのS2は、使用時の回数が2以上ならⅠ: Actively use S1 to earn Charge Count. With S2 at Uptie Ⅳ, if Count is 2 or more on use, Coin Ⅰ's +6 brings it to 8 or more, and Coin Ⅱ spends 4 to inflict Fragility instead of adding +4 (net +2). Firing it at 0–1 Count also adds +4 on Coin Ⅱ for a large increase, but puts 5 Sinking on her. Release it with S3 once 15 or more Count has built up. Sinking on herself tends to stack through S2, Clash losses, and the passive, and taking Unbreakable Coins while it is built up causes heavy SP damage. With 1 slot, it takes time before she can fire S3 at full power, so use her in regular battles where slots can increase.
messages.果敢なタッチ(最大2): 数値1につき、出血・沈潜による体力・精神力の被ダメージ: **Touche Hardie (max 2)**: Per point, +10% HP and SP damage taken from Bleed and Sinking, up to 20%. It decreases by 1 at Turn End. Inflicted by S2 Expression of Primary Colors (target with 5/6 or more negative effect types; the condition differs by Uptie and is relaxed at Uptie Ⅳ), S3, and Critique's third Coin.
messages.S2「原色表現」(エンジン): 1スキルで出血2・沈潜回数+2・[ルージュ]1・: **S2 Expression of Primary Colors (engine)**: One skill inflicts 2 Bleed, +2 Sinking Count, 1 [Rouge], and 2/3 [Bleu], plus 1 Touche Hardie if the condition is met. +20% damage per negative effect type on the target (up to 60%), and +1 Coin Power per 2 types (up to 3; Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.「クリティーク」: 自分にレフレクスィヨンがなく、対象のマイナス効果が3種以上な: **Critique**: If she does not have Réflexion and the target has 3 or more negative effect types, the Defense skill Trimming the Medium transforms (a clashable counter). +2 Clash Power per 2 negative effect types (up to 6), +3 Final Power if Bleed and Sinking total 4 or more, and Coin reuse per 3 types (up to 2 times). After use, she gains 2 Réflexion and cannot use it during that time (restores 5 SP at Turn Start).
messages.野獣派 - マスク・ドゥ・ルー(永続バフ): 強烈な色彩を3付与する、クリティー: **Le Fauvisme - Masque de Loup (permanent buff)**: Gained at Turn End after inflicting 3 Palette Vibrante, using Critique twice, or using the enhanced S3 Burst Forth the Pulsing Crimson under Your Skin. +1 Speed, +1 Bleed and Sinking inflicted, and +1 Sinking Count and Bleed Count on hits against enemies with 3 or more [Bleu] or [Rouge] (once per turn each).
messages.強烈な色彩: 戦闘終了時、3種を全て持つ敵へ次のターンに付与する([ルージュ]・: **Palette Vibrante**: At Combat End, inflicted next turn on enemies that have all 3 types (2/3/4 if [Rouge] and [Bleu] are 3/6/9 or more). Increases damage taken from Ring members (even more from Fauvists). The enhanced S3 activates when the target has 6 or more negative effect types (once per turn; an Unfocused Volley whose fourth Coin hits all targets).
messages.バトルパッシブ「ここはもう少し荒く…！」(色欲×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): [: **Combat passive — Needs a Rougher Touch for this Part...! (2 Lust Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 to the [Rouge], [Bleu], and Touche Hardie inflicted.
messages.毎ターン色欲×2共鳴でパッシブを発動させながら、S2とS3で3種のマイナス効果を: Keep the passive active with 2 Lust Resonance every turn while maintaining the three negative effects with S2 and S3. On turn 1, when the enemy has no negative effects, the Defense skill Trimming the Medium inflicts more than S1. Once there are 3 or more negative effect types, replace S1 with the Defense skill and fire Critique (it is unavailable during Réflexion, so alternate). On turns when Critique is unavailable, S1 Vehement Overpainting reuses a Coin if the target has 4 or more negative effect types (Uptie Ⅳ). Gaining Masque de Loup through the enhanced S3, two Critiques, or 3 Palette Vibrante makes later Count infliction easier. Negative effects count by number of types, so pairing her with allies who inflict different types speeds up the bonuses (especially strong in Bleed teams against single bosses with a single part).
messages.予知眼: 登場時に30。マッチ1回ごとや「予知」発動時に減る。予知眼があると、一: **The Eye of Precognition**: 30 when she appears. It decreases with each Clash and when Precognition triggers. While she has it, taking a one-sided attack or Unbreakable Coin attack, or losing a Clash, triggers the Evade skill Precognition (once per turn). At 0, it turns into Eye of Precognition - Overheat (+3 Offense Level, −3 Defense Level).
messages.加速弾: 特殊弾丸。S2・S3のコインで消耗し、消耗1につき呼吸2・呼吸回数2を: **Acceleration Round**: Special ammo. Spent by S2 and S3 Coins, granting 2 Poise and 2 Poise Count per round. Her Defense skill loads up to 5 Acceleration Rounds at Turn End. If she has no Acceleration Rounds at Turn Start, S2 becomes Sezionatura di Cervo (with all-Unbreakable Coins and +2 Final Power during Overheat).
messages.「処分」: 予知眼が過熱に変わったターンの終了時に再装填し(戦闘ごとに1回)、次: **Disposal**: She reloads at the end of the turn her Eye of Precognition turns into Overheat (once per battle), and on the next turn one basic skill becomes Disposal. All 5 Coins are Unbreakable. Defeating an enemy marked as a Game Target adds Disposal on the next turn.
messages.火傷と振動: 各スキルで火傷と振動を付与し、合計に応じて威力が上がる。振動-灼熱: **Burn and Tremor**: Each skill inflicts Burn and Tremor, and power rises with their total. It converts into Tremor - Scorch and triggers Tremor Burst.
messages.序盤は予知眼で攻撃をいなしながら火傷と振動を積み、予知眼が尽きたら、過熱中(ター: Early on, parry attacks with The Eye of Precognition while stacking Burn and Tremor, and once it runs out, attack hard with Disposal during Overheat (which increases by 10 at each Turn Start and returns to The Eye of Precognition at 30). Paired with Heathcliff's The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice, Heathcliff follows up while she has The Eye of Precognition and provides Assist Defense during Overheat. Activate the combat passive La Spada di Palermo (3 Wrath and 2 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ; +1 Coin Power and +25% damage for Skill 3 while she has at least 1 Acceleration Round) before her first Disposal.
messages.S1(双極性): 味方を対象にでき、その場合は戦闘開始時に発動し、的中せず守備ス: **S1 (Duality)**: It can target allies; in that case, it activates at Combat Start, does not hit, and does not trigger Defense skills. With auto-targeting and in regular battles, the ally earliest in team order is prioritized. It gives the ally 3/4 Charge Count and 1 Offense Level Up, plus Shield (5/10% of her own max HP), 1 Second is Welcome-snipping, and 1/2 Attack Power Up for Charge Identities (the Shield, Welcome-snipping, and Attack Power Up set applies 1/2 times per turn). It cannot Clash, so it is weak when used on enemies.
messages.ドゥ、オー・ボン・スィゾー: 攻撃・防御レベル+3。充電人格はスキル使用時に精神: **Second is Welcome-snipping**: +3 Offense and Defense Level. Charge Identities recover 5 SP when using a skill (once per turn). Additional Slash damage on basic skill hits. At the end of an attack by an ally with this effect, she follows up with Patterning (once per turn). If the target has 2 or more Mark of Shearing, she follows up with Cutout instead and gains Blossom Scissors.
messages.バリア配布: S2「固定、そしてパターンに沿って裁断」は戦闘開始時に、自分・編成: **Distributing Shield**: At Combat Start, S2 Pin and Trim Along the Patterns gives 2 Offense Level Up and a 5% Shield to herself, the ally earliest in team order (prioritizing Charge Identities), and the ally with the lowest HP ratio (+1 and +5% more for Charge Identities). At Combat Start, S3 Coupez dans le Biais gives Welcome-snipping and a 5/10% Shield to the ally earliest in team order and the ally with the lowest HP ratio. At Combat Start, the Defense skill Trimming gives a 5/10% Shield to herself and the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio.
messages.バトルパッシブ「お直し室の花ばさみの音」(怠惰×2・嫉妬×1・保有・同期化Ⅱで取: **Combat passive — Snipping in the Alteration Shop are Blossom Scissors (2 Sloth and 1 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, she gains Shield for the next turn equal to her Inertia of Drifting Count. At 2/3/5 or more Inertia of Drifting Potency, basic skills gain +1/+2/+3 Final Power.
messages.漂流慣性: 特殊充電。累計で回数10を消耗するたびに威力1を得る。S2・S3は回: **Inertia of Drifting**: A special Charge. Each cumulative 10 Count spent grants 1 Potency. S2 and S3 spend 5 Count for +2 Final Power. S3 spends 5 more at 5 or more Count to trigger an additional Tremor Burst.
messages.支援の中心は編成順で決まるので、強い充電人格を編成順の1番に置く。毎ターン、支援: Her support is centered on team order, so put a strong Charge Identity first in team order. Every turn, use S1 on the ally you want to support (in Focused Encounters, you can target them directly), boosting their Clash Power and damage while Welcome-snipping's follow-ups stack Mark of Shearing and Tremor. When you want to Clash an enemy with S1, swapping it for her Defense skill fights better. S2 and S3 also hand out Shield to allies on their own. Her highly stable Clashes are another strength. Her own damage scales with Inertia of Drifting Potency, so it is low early on and she suits long fights.
messages.【リンバス】射影 HARD レイホン（射影戦闘・HARD）の攻略｜Limbus: Reflectrial HARD Lei Heng (Reflectrial, HARD) Guide | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)射影 HARD「レイホン（射影戦闘・HA: Lei Heng (Reflectrial, HARD) guide for Limbus Company Reflectrial HARD. For 18 turns or less, unseal Outis's sword while keeping Prey out of Attack Skill clashes. Suppress enemy buffs with at least 3 Bind and reduce ammunition before Blasting Shatterslash. After 66% HP, use the surviving core to finish rather than relying only on healing.
messages.厳格な親指 ソルダートの外見: Stern Soldato of the Thumb appearance
messages.厳格な親指 ソルダートのスキル: Stern Soldato of the Thumb skills

messages.18ターン以内を狙うなら、獲物の攻撃マッチを避けながらウーティスの剣を解放する。: For 18 turns or less, unseal Outis's sword while keeping Prey out of Attack Skill clashes. Suppress enemy buffs with at least 3 Bind and reduce ammunition before Blasting Shatterslash. After 66% HP, use the surviving core to finish rather than relying only on healing.
messages.射影版の基礎値。8-30の平均化や回復は前提にしない。前後半は同じHPを引き継ぎ: Base values for the Reflectrial version. Do not assume 8-30's level averaging or healing applies. HP carries over between phases and all base resistances are 0.9. Check extra effects from Severing Slash, Tiantui Star, and Tribulation separately. Images illustrate appearance; displayed current HP and SP are not fixed stats.
messages.本体8技と補給役1技。大技の加重値は下限を表示し、底力・極力で増える。超絶猛虎殺: Eight body skills and one support skill. Major skills show minimum Atk Weight; Inner Strength and Extreme Strength increase it. Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades has unknown Offense Level. Form-dependent conversion of normal skills' last Coins is separate from HARD's all-Unbreakable conversion against Prey.
messages.中指6人＋回避・回復役で、剣の解放後に削り切る: Six Middle members plus Evade and healing, finishing after sword unsealing
messages.中指の反撃と嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6以上を軸にする。ウーティスをレーヴァテイン解放: Build around Middle Counters and a combined total of at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance. Protect Outis until Lævateinn is unsealed; keep Sinners with Prey out of Attack Skill clashes. Even when choosing defensive Counters, receive only manageable normal skills. Faust handles Evade and healing. The four reserve LCB Sinners can be replaced by trained Identities of the same Sinners. Middle member count does not change Lei Heng's patterns.
messages.主力。嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6以上、またはS3で封印解除を進める。獲物が付いたター: Main damage dealer. Progress unsealing with at least 6 combined Envy Absolute Resonance or S3. On Prey turns, avoid Attack Skill clashes; use defense and healing to preserve the next damage opening.
messages.中指の守備と精神力を支え、獲物ではないターンに強いS3や特殊スキルで大技へマッチ: Supports Middle defense and SP. When not Prey, use strong S3 or special skills for major clashes. Extra hits after Counter can Stagger him; avoid concentrating too many attacks.
messages.ウーティスと組ませる反撃アタッカー。守備を装着し、耐えられる通常技へ反撃する。獲: Counter attacker paired with Outis. Equip defense and Counter survivable normal skills. Check Prey, Burn, and Tremor buildup every turn.
messages.嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6以上で反撃をS3へ変える。弱い通常技を受け、主力を大技の担: At least 6 combined Envy Absolute Resonance converts Counter into S3. Receive weak normal skills while stronger allies handle major attacks.
messages.嫉妬共鳴をつなぎ、《他人の鎖》で翌ターンの束縛と攻撃威力減少を用意する。自身の反: Maintains Envy Resonance and uses Chains of Others for next-turn Bind and Attack Power Down. His own Counter does not become S3.
messages.嫉妬共鳴と反撃を担当する。獲物を持つ場合は、爆砕斬の攻撃マッチを無理に受け持たな: Provides Envy Resonance and Counters. With Prey, do not force an Attack Skill clash against Blasting Shatterslash.
messages.嫉妬の回避で共鳴をつなぎ、《水袋》で体力と精神力を戻す。回避の威力は3〜13なの: Maintains Resonance with Envy Evade and restores HP and SP with Fluid Sac. Evade Power is 3–13, so it cannot be assumed to dodge enhanced Blasting Shatterslash. Assign based on predictions and support such as Bind or Paralyze.
messages.同期Ⅲ・嫉妬3共鳴で、体力比率が最低の味方1名の体力3、精神力比率が最低の味方1: At Uptie III and 3 Envy Resonance, heals 3 HP to the ally with the lowest HP percentage and 3 SP to the ally with the lowest SP percentage.
messages.イサンの自由枠。控えが出る展開に備え、育成済み人格へ替えてもよい。: Flexible Yi Sang slot. Can use a trained Identity in case reserves enter battle.
messages.ホンルの自由枠。次の編成に使う人格はここで使用せず、別人格を割り当てる。: Flexible Hong Lu slot. Allocate a different Identity here if one is needed for the next loadout.
messages.ロージャの自由枠。未使用の後半用編成と人格を重複させない。: Flexible Rodion slot. Avoid sharing an Identity with an unused Phase 2 loadout.
messages.グレゴールの自由枠。サポートパッシブか、主力脱落後の戦力を補える人格に変更する。: Flexible Gregor slot. Can switch to a support passive or combat strength after core casualties.
messages.怠惰1・憂鬱1・嫉妬2。的中時に翌ターンの束縛と攻撃威力減少を付与する。束縛3以: Costs 1 Sloth, 1 Gloom, and 2 Envy. On Hit, applies Bind and Attack Power Down next turn. At least 3 Bind stops the body's Speed-based buffs and also grants clash support in Phase 1. Account for Pride affinity breaking Resonance and Meursault's own debuffs.
messages.憤怒1・色欲4。解析Ⅳの覚醒スキルは的中時に攻撃レベル減少10・麻痺3、翌ターン: Costs 1 Wrath and 4 Lust. At Threadspin IV, the Awakening skill inflicts 10 Offense Level Down and 3 Paralyze On Hit, plus 3 Bind next turn. Separate current clash predictions from next-turn setup. Lust affinity also changes the Resonance total.
messages.色欲2・憂鬱4・嫉妬3。大技を使われる前のターンに体力と精神力を戻す。強制ターン: Costs 2 Lust, 4 Gloom, and 3 Envy. Restore HP and SP on the turn before a major attack. Do not schedule healing after a forced turn end. Check Resonance changes from Gloom affinity too.
messages.色欲1・嫉妬3。嫉妬属性のまま資源を補う候補で、マッチ勝利時に嫉妬資源を最少属性: Costs 1 Lust and 3 Envy. An Envy resource option that converts Envy resources into a lowest-reserve affinity on a clash win. Do not force it into an unwinnable clash under Prey's Power penalty.
messages.最大3編成・1編成は先発7名＋控え5名の連続戦闘。使用済み人格は進行度を初期化す: A continuous battle with up to three loadouts, each with 7 starters and 5 reserves. Used Identities have reuse restrictions until progress is reset; borrowed Support Identities are unavailable. You can save progress and switch before the 12-turn loadout limit.
messages.第1編成の開始時は敵と戦場の囚人の精神力30（減算コイン人格は-30）、全属性E: The first loadout starts enemies and fielded Sinners at 30 SP (−30 for negative-Coin Identities) and grants +3 E.G.O resources of every affinity. Do not assume this reset also applies to the second or third loadout.
messages.HP66%以下で次ターンから後半へ移る。移行も累計ターンに数え、状態効果は初期化: At 66% HP or less, Phase 2 starts next turn. Transitions count toward cumulative turns; statuses do not reset. At 50% HP or less, major and normal skills strengthen further during Phase 2.
messages.フェーズ移行と編成交代は別。主力と回復が残るなら続投できる。第2・第3編成の入場: Phase transition and loadout switching are separate. Continue if the core and healing remain. The second and third loadouts enter an already enhanced pattern based on the body's remaining HP.
messages.光の苗木は通常戦闘と別枠で、難易度ごとの判定。同じ難易度の前半と後半で使い直せる: Sapling of Light usage is separate from normal battles and checked per difficulty. Do not assume reuse between phases of one difficulty; save it for difficult transitions or major attacks.
messages.HARDの苦難は最大HP+80%、精神力の下限0。獲物への追加強化と、虎標弾3以: HARD Tribulation gives +80% max HP and an SP floor of 0. Adds buffs against Prey and +100% Blasting Shatterslash damage at 3 or more Tigermark Rounds. In Phase 2, skills against Prey gain further buffs and Unbreakable conversion.
messages.段階報酬はクリア・30・24・18ターン以下。18ターン以下の段階は狂気200と: Reward tiers are clear, 30 turns or less, 24 or less, and 18 or less. The 18-turn tier gives 200 Lunacy and 300 Burnt-in Lens. The HARD clear tier also includes a ticket decoration.
messages.封印解除と、最初の大技への準備を進める: Progress unsealing and prepare for the first major attack
messages.第1編成の初手は二連斬4本・三連撃2本。以後は弾を使う7行動へ変わる。HP85%: The first loadout opens with four Double Slashes and two Triple Slashes, then changes to seven ammunition-using actions. At 85% HP or less, or the end of turn 2, Tanglecleaver follows; do not postpone healing.
messages.HP66%へ進み、剣を解放した主力を後半へ残す: Reach 66% HP and preserve the unsealed core for Phase 2
messages.前半6・後半12と置いた配分例。前半を急いで獲物の主力を倒されるなら、守備・回復: Example budget: 6 turns for Phase 1, 12 for Phase 2. If rushing Phase 1 kills key Prey Sinners, reconsider defense, healing, and major-clash recipients.
messages.獲物を守備へ回し、本体HP50%以降を削る: Have Prey defend while damaging the body below 50% HP
messages.獲物以外の囚人で大技に勝ち、耐えられる通常技へ反撃する。1編成の上限までに倒せな: Win major clashes with non-Prey Sinners and Counter survivable normal skills. If one loadout cannot finish within its limit, preserve unused Burn / Wrath Identities for Phase 2.
messages.本体を撃破する。補給役を追い過ぎない: Kill the body; avoid overpursuing support units
messages.残りターンとHPで交代を判断する。前半の主力を再使用できる前提にせず、後半の射影: Judge switching by remaining turns and HP. Do not assume Phase 1's core can be reused; focus attacks with remaining Identities suited to Phase 2's Shade.
messages.獲物の囚人で攻撃マッチしない。特に後半は、守備の75%軽減と他の囚人のマッチで主: Do not take Attack Skill clashes with Prey. Especially in Phase 2, protect key Sinners through 75% defensive reduction and other clash recipients.
messages.束縛3以上を前ターンから用意する。爆砕斬は回避か守備でしのぐか、遅い担当へ回して: Prepare at least 3 Bind from last turn. Handle Blasting Shatterslash with Evade or defense, or a slow recipient so ammunition is reduced first.
messages.HP66%で後半、50%でさらに強化。剣の解放後は主力の火力を使い、累計18ター: Phase 2 at 66% HP, further buffs at 50%. After unsealing, use the core's damage to aim for body defeat within 18 cumulative turns.
messages.獲物の主力が、マッチに勝っても倒される: My key Prey Sinner dies despite winning
messages.後半の苦難で、獲物への技は基本威力+5と全コイン破壊不能化がある。攻撃マッチを他: Phase 2 Tribulation gives skills against Prey +5 Base Power and all-Unbreakable Coins. Assign Attack Skill clashes elsewhere and equip defense on Prey. Even with Counter, choose normal skills they can survive.
messages.爆砕斬で1人ずつ失う: Blasting Shatterslash kills Sinners one by one
messages.勝っても3枚の破壊不能は残る。先に他の技で弾を減らすか、回避・獲物の守備軽減で受: All three Unbreakable Coins remain after winning. Reduce ammunition through other skills first, or use Evade and Prey's defensive reduction. HARD adds buffs if at least 3 Tigermark Rounds remain On Use; check ammunition too.
messages.大技の後に回復できず、立て直せない: I cannot heal and recover after the major attack
messages.快刀亂麻・超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬の攻撃後はターンが終わる。回復・束縛は前ターンに用意し: Tanglecleaver and Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades end the turn After Attack. Prepare healing and Bind last turn and assign a strong non-Prey recipient. Do not assume the normal version's Overheat opening applies.
messages.HP66%までを6ターン、残りを12ターンと置き、どちらで遅れたかを見る。共鳴の: Budget 6 turns to reach 66% HP and 12 for the rest, then identify the slower section. Review Resonance totals, sword unsealing, forced Prey attacks, and excess damage on support units.
messages.射影版の基礎値。8-30の攻防レベル平均化や、2ターン目の全回復を前提にしない。: Reflectrial base values. Do not assume 8-30's offense/defense level averaging or turn-2 full heal.
messages.ターン終了時にHP66%以下なら後半へ移る。リカルドのHP50%移行とは異なる。: At Turn End with 66% HP or less, enter Phase 2 next turn. Different from Ricardo's 50% transition.
messages.物理・罪悪耐性は全て0.9。表は基礎耐性で、切斬による斬撃耐性の扱いの変更は別。: All physical and sin resistances are 0.9. These are base values; Severing Slash separately changes how Slash resistance is treated.
messages.70%区間は前半。強化パターン移行時は混乱解除あり: 70% threshold belongs to Phase 1; enhanced pattern transitions clear Stagger
messages.本体は同じHPゲージを使う。HP50%以下で小指 天退星雷横へ進み、後半の途中で: The body uses the same HP bar. At 50% HP or less, advances to Lei Heng, The Pinky's Tiantui Star and strengthens again within Phase 2.
messages.天退星で三連撃-【爆】、シン(心)-天退星では二連斬-【爆】も最後のコインが破壊: Tiantui Star makes “Triple Slash” - Blast's last Coin Unbreakable; Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] also converts “Double Slash” - Blast's last Coin.
messages.数値と技は前後半で共通のものを本体のスキル欄へまとめた。形態の強化とHARDの苦: Shared values and skills are grouped in the body's skill section. Form buffs and HARD Tribulation apply separately.
messages.猛虎標弾を補給する取り巻き。1ターンの支援後に離脱する。: Add supplying Savage Tigermark Rounds. Withdraws after one support turn.
messages.倒すと翌ターンにレイホンが脆弱1を得る。通常版のマッチ威力減少まで追加して考えな: Killing it gives Lei Heng 1 Fragile next turn. Do not also assume the normal version's Clash Power Down.
messages.初回の1ターン目に使う技。勝てる相手にはマッチし、以後の獲物を誰が受けるかも見て: Used on the first turn of the initial loadout. Take winnable clashes and allocate attacks with next turn's Prey recipient in mind.
messages.Ⅱ：[的中時]振動1を付与、振動回数が2増加: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Tremor and 2 Tremor Count
messages.Ⅲ：[的中時]振動爆発。対象の振動回数が1減少: Ⅲ[On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1
messages.通常の3コイン攻撃。反撃で受ける場合も、振動爆発による混乱を含めて耐えられるか確: A normal three-Coin attack. When receiving with Counter, check survival including Stagger from Tremor Burst.
messages.マッチに勝つと虎標弾を1減らせる。爆砕斬の前に処理し、残弾を減らす。ただしシン(: Winning removes 1 Tigermark Round. Resolve it before Blasting Shatterslash to reduce ammunition. Under Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星], however, its last Coin becomes Unbreakable.
messages.マッチ勝利で虎標弾を減らす。天退星以降は最後のコインが破壊不能になるため、勝利後: Win to reduce Tigermark Rounds. From Tiantui Star onward, the last Coin becomes Unbreakable; prepare for hits after winning. Prey Sinners can Counter it, but check HP, Burn, and Tremor buildup.
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能。攻撃で止めるなら遅い担当に任せ、先に他の技で虎標弾を減: Clashable regardless of Speed. If using an attack, assign a slow recipient so other skills reduce Tigermark Rounds first. All three Coins are Unbreakable; use Evade or Prey's defensive reduction too. HARD adds buffs at 3 or more Tigermark Rounds, especially dangerous in Phase 2. Do not force a Prey Sinner's Attack Skill into it.
messages.獲物ではない囚人の強いスキル・E.G.Oでマッチ勝利を狙う。勝てばダメージ80%: Win with a strong skill or E.G.O from a non-Prey Sinner for 80% reduction and protection from this skill's Stagger damage. The turn ends After Attack; prepare healing and debuffs last turn.
messages.速度に関係なくマッチ可能だが、獲物には任せない。6枚とも破壊不能。マッチに勝って: Clashable regardless of Speed, but do not assign Prey. All six Coins are Unbreakable. Even winning for 80% reduction leaves hits; prepare HP and equipped defense on every target. Save unused strong skills or Sapling of Light, and do not assume Stagger before use will stop it.
messages.マッチ可能反撃。勝つと虎標弾を1減らせるため、爆砕斬の前に処理する候補。相殺だけ: Clashable Counter. Winning removes 1 Tigermark Round, so it can be resolved before Blasting Shatterslash. Do not assume offsetting alone stops Reload; check ammunition after Turn End too.
messages.[ターン終了時]レイホンに猛虎標弾6を付与: [Turn End] Grant Lei Heng 6 Savage Tigermark Rounds
messages.生存してターンを終えると本体へ猛虎標弾6を渡し、自身は離脱する。倒せば翌ターンに: If alive at Turn End, grants the body 6 Savage Tigermark Rounds and withdraws. Killing it gives the body 1 Fragile next turn, but do not delay body damage by overpursuing it.
messages.常時・編成の入場時・フェーズ移行: Always, loadout entry, and phase transition
messages.同じ対象とのマッチが10発以上になると、マッチ発数÷10（小数点切り捨て）に応じ: At 10 or more clash exchanges against the same target, Power increases or decreases according to exchanges ÷10, rounded down. Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count. At the first loadout's start, set enemies and fielded Sinners to 30 SP (−30 for negative-Coin Identities) and gain +3 resources of every affinity. Tiantui Star activation ends the turn; Phase 2 starts next turn. Statuses do not reset at transition. Second and third loadouts start in an enhanced pattern based on remaining HP percentage.
messages.交代すると敵の強化まで初期化できるとは考えない。第1編成の初期精神力・資源を、第: Switching does not reset enemy buffs. Do not apply the first loadout's initial SP and resources to the second or third.
messages.常時・虎標弾消耗コイン・マッチ進行時: Always, ammunition-consuming Coins, and clash exchanges
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜による被ダメージ量-30%。虎標弾がなくても攻撃は止: Damage taken from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −30%. Running out of Tigermark Rounds does not stop attacks; the corresponding Coins stop inflicting Burn Potency and Count. During clashes, inflict Tremor Count equal to 1 + clash exchanges ÷3, up to 3, at most three times per target per turn.
messages.弾を減らすと火傷を抑えられるが、攻撃そのものは残る。状態異常を上限までためるだけ: Reducing ammunition limits Burn but leaves attacks intact. Do not rely on a long fight spent only stacking statuses to their caps.
messages.開始時・パターン変更ターン・パニック時: Stage Start, pattern-change turns, and Panic
messages.開始時とパターン変更ターンに切斬1を得て、失ったHP10%につき精神力5を回復す: At Stage Start and on pattern-change turns, gain 1 Severing Slash and heal 5 SP per 10% HP lost, up to 40. Panic type cannot change; if Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 45.
messages.パニックを繰り返して安全に止める戦い方を前提にしない。切斬のあるターンは斬撃を集: Do not rely on repeated Panic to stop actions safely. Severing Slash turns create a Slash damage opening.
messages.ターン開始時・獲物への攻撃後: Turn Start and after attacks on Prey
messages.前ターンに本体へ最もダメージを与えた対象へ獲物1を付与。獲物を混乱させると囚人側: Inflict 1 Prey on the target who dealt the most body damage last turn. Staggering Prey removes 10 SP from all Sinners and applies 1 Clash Power Down this turn and next turn, once per turn. Killing them triggers it once more.
messages.主力が獲物になったら守備も選び、味方全体の弱体化まで連鎖させない。獲物の担当は固: When a key Sinner becomes Prey, consider defense to avoid cascading party debuffs. Check the recipient each turn rather than fixing the role.
messages.一方攻撃的中・弾を消耗するコインの的中: Unopposed hits and ammunition-consuming Coin hits
messages.一方攻撃のダメージ+30%、次ターンに脆弱1を付与。虎標弾を消耗したコインのダメ: Unopposed damage +30% and inflict 1 Fragile next turn. Ammunition-consuming Coin damage +20% and inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn. These do not apply if the target has defense equipped.
messages.攻撃を引き受けない囚人にも、守備を装着する意味がある。攻撃一辺倒で広域の被害を増: Even Sinners not intercepting attacks benefit from equipping defense. Avoid an all-attack approach that increases area damage taken.
messages.戦闘開始時の速度・束縛: Speed and Bind at Combat Start
messages.速度分の精神力を回復し、速度÷3の斬撃ダメージ量増加を得る（最大5）。精神力が負: Heal SP equal to Speed and gain Slash DMG Up equal to Speed ÷3, up to 5. SP healing doubles if SP is negative. At 3 or more Bind, these Speed-based effects do not activate; gain Defense Level Down equal to Bind instead, up to 9.
messages.《他人の鎖》《桃色の欲望》などで前ターンから束縛3以上を用意する。前半は射影効果: Prepare at least 3 Bind from the preceding turn with Chains of Others or Roseate Desire. Phase 1 also grants clash support through its Shade.
messages.虎標弾を装填し、次ターンからパターンを変更する。混乱していれば混乱を解除する。: Reload Tigermark Rounds and change patterns next turn. Remove Stagger if present.
messages.初回の混乱だけで行動を止め続けられるとは考えない。最初の6行動から通常7行動へ変: The first Stagger cannot keep actions stopped indefinitely. The opening six actions become seven normal actions.
messages.ターン終了時HP85%以下、または2ターン目終了: Turn End at 85% HP or less, or end of turn 2
messages.次ターンにパターンを変更し、快刀亂麻を使用する。以後3ターンごとに繰り返す。大技: Change patterns next turn and use Tanglecleaver; repeat every three turns thereafter. On major-attack turns, minimum and maximum Speed +10, gain 25 Inner Strength at Turn Start, and remove Stagger.
messages.HPだけでなく経過ターンでも大技に進む。大技直前に回復と束縛を用意する。: Elapsed turns as well as HP trigger major attacks. Prepare healing and Bind just before them.
messages.ターン終了時HP66%以下: Turn End at 66% HP or less
messages.次ターンからフェーズ2へ移行し、天退星1と猛虎標弾18を得て即装填する。猛虎標弾: Enter Phase 2 next turn, gain 1 Tiantui Star and 18 Savage Tigermark Rounds, and load them immediately. After spending all Savage Rounds, return to Tigermark Rounds and summon two support units next turn. Remove Stagger at transition.
messages.HP66%の前に後半への準備を終える。リカルドと異なり、状態効果はフェーズ移行で: Finish Phase 2 preparation before 66% HP. Unlike Ricardo, statuses do not reset at phase transition.
messages.ターン終了時HP50%以下: Turn End at 50% HP or less
messages.次ターンに快刀亂麻が超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬へ変わる。大技ターンの速度の最小・最大+15: Next turn, Tanglecleaver becomes Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades. On major-attack turns, minimum and maximum Speed +15; Inner Strength becomes Extreme Strength, Tiantui Star becomes Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星], and Stagger is removed.
messages.後半に入った後もHP50%でさらに強まる。強制混乱解除と大技に備え、残り半分の削: Even after Phase 2 begins, 50% HP strengthens him again. Prepare for forced Stagger removal and the major skill, then focus damage on the remaining half.
messages.ターン開始時に脆弱3を得る。ターン終了時に本体へ猛虎標弾を渡す。死亡時、次ターン: At Turn Start, gain 3 Fragile. At Turn End, supply Savage Tigermark Rounds to the body. On death, give the body 1 Fragile next turn.
messages.1ターンで離脱する相手なので、撃破による補給阻止と本体への攻撃を比べて判断する。: Withdraws after one turn; weigh preventing its supply through a kill against attacking the body.
messages.第1編成の1ターン目〜初回の大技: First loadout: turn 1 through the first major attack
messages.精神力30と初期資源を使い、束縛を先に用意する: Use 30 SP and starting resources to prepare Bind early
messages.第1編成は精神力30と全属性資源+3で始まる。中指の嫉妬共鳴と反撃を軸に剣の封印: The first loadout starts with 30 SP and +3 resources of every affinity. Progress sword unsealing through Middle Envy Resonance and Counters; Faust handles Evade and healing as needed.
messages.《他人の鎖》などで束縛3以上を次ターンに用意すると、速度に応じた精神力回復・斬撃: Preparing at least 3 Bind next turn with Chains of Others stops Speed-based SP healing and Slash buffs. In Phase 1, also gain +1 Clash Power per 2 Bind, up to 2.
messages.HP85%以下、または2ターン目終了で快刀亂麻のパターンへ進む。敵がまだ高HPで: At 85% HP or less, or the end of turn 2, advance to the Tanglecleaver pattern. Major attacks come even at high HP; check equipped skills.
messages.獲物を守り、爆砕斬の前に弾を減らす: Protect Prey and reduce ammunition before Blasting Shatterslash
messages.毎ターン、獲物が付いた囚人を確認する。攻撃マッチは他へ分担し、本人の守備装着で7: Identify the Prey Sinner each turn. Assign Attack Skill clashes elsewhere and use their equipped defense for 75% damage reduction. Even with a Middle Counter, check the incoming skill and remaining HP.
messages.攻撃で爆砕斬に対処するときは、速度に関係なくマッチできる性質を使い、遅い担当へ回: If using an attack against Blasting Shatterslash, exploit its clashability regardless of Speed and choose a slow recipient. First reduce ammunition through clashes with “Double Slash” - Blast, “Triple Slash” - Blast, or “Reloading Tiantui Star's Blade”.
messages.爆砕斬は3枚とも破壊不能。HARDで虎標弾3以上ならさらに強まるため、回避できる: All three Blasting Shatterslash Coins are Unbreakable. HARD strengthens it further at 3 or more Tigermark Rounds. Evade if predictions support it; otherwise prepare Prey's defensive reduction and healing. Empty ammunition does not stop the attack itself.
messages.獲物以外の囚人も、広域の一方攻撃を受ける場合は守備を装着する選択がある。天退星刀: Non-Prey Sinners can also equip defense when receiving unopposed area hits, suppressing Tiantui Star's Blade's extra effects.
messages.HP66%以下〜HP50%以下: 66% HP or less through 50% HP or less
messages.後半への移行前に主力を回復し、解放した剣で攻める: Heal the core before Phase 2 and attack with the unsealed sword
messages.HP66%以下で次ターンから後半へ移る。猛虎標弾18と天退星を得て、通常技の最後: At 66% HP or less, Phase 2 begins next turn. Gains 18 Savage Tigermark Rounds and Tiantui Star, strengthening normal skills' last Coins. Heal before transition and retain the option of Sapling of Light for the difficult opening.
messages.後半の射影効果は火傷・特殊火傷付与、または憤怒の攻撃を強化する。剣を解放した中指: Phase 2's Shade boosts attacks that inflict Burn or special Burn, or use Wrath. Continue if the unsealed Middle core remains; Phase 1 statuses such as Rupture can also carry over where useful.
messages.後半の獲物への攻撃マッチは避ける。苦難の全コイン化・威力強化が重なるため、通常の: Avoid Phase 2 Attack Skill clashes with Prey. Tribulation combines all-Unbreakable conversion and Power buffs; ordinary clash predictions alone do not ensure safety.
messages.HP50%以下では超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬とシン(心)-天退星へ進む。混乱を解除して強化: At 50% HP or less, advances to Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades and Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星]. Clears Stagger and strengthens; do not assume Stagger lets you skip the major skill.
messages.大技に勝って被害を減らし、補給役より本体を優先する: Win major clashes for mitigation and prioritize the body over support units
messages.快刀亂麻と超絶猛虎殺撃乱斬は、獲物ではない囚人の強いスキル・E.G.Oでマッチ勝: Win Tanglecleaver and Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades with strong skills or E.G.O from non-Prey Sinners. Winning gives 80% reduction and prevents Stagger from that skill's damage, but Unbreakable hits remain.
messages.大技の攻撃後はターンが終わる。回復は前ターンに済ませ、使われる前の混乱や、攻撃後: Major skills end the turn After Attack. Heal last turn; do not rely on pre-use Stagger or post-attack Overheat.
messages.補給役は1ターンで離脱する。倒す余裕があれば補給を阻止し、翌ターンの本体への脆弱: Support units withdraw after one turn. If affordable, kill to stop supply and gain Fragile on the body next turn. Do not pursue every add at the cost of body damage or needed clashes.
messages.1編成12ターンで届かない見込みなら、残りHPと累計ターンを見て未使用の編成へ渡: If one loadout cannot finish within 12 turns, judge remaining HP and cumulative turns and hand over to an unused team. Preserve strong Burn, Tremor, and Wrath Identities for Phase 2.
messages.射影版には、通常版の天退星刀オーバーヒートのパッシブがない。大技の後に必ず脆弱・: The Reflectrial version lacks the normal version's Tiantui Star's Blade - Overheat passive. Do not assume a Fragile and Clash Power Down opening always follows major attacks.
messages.8-30のHP下限・勝利条件や、攻防レベル平均化・2ターン目の回復をこの戦闘へ持: Do not import 8-30's HP floor, victory conditions, level averaging, or turn-2 healing into this battle.
messages.HARDは両フェーズで精神力が0未満に下がらない。沈潜で精神力を下げ続ける戦い方: HARD SP cannot fall below 0 in either phase. Do not center the strategy on indefinitely lowering SP through Sinking.
messages.獲物の守備は軽減手段で、無傷や生存の保証ではない。火傷・振動の蓄積と複数の被弾も: Prey's defense is mitigation, not a guarantee of no damage or survival. Check Burn, Tremor, and multiple hits too.
messages.大技とパターン移行には混乱を解除する条件がある。HP70%の混乱だけで長く止めら: Major attacks and pattern transitions have Stagger-removal conditions. The 70% HP Stagger cannot keep him stopped for long.
messages.火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜は威力30・回数10が上限。射影効果の対象はスキルご: Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count. Shade bonuses check individual skills; Identity keyword classification alone does not determine damage.
messages.敵とのマッチ威力-5。戦闘開始時、攻撃装着なら本体への攻撃スキルダメージ-50%: Clash Power against the enemy −5. At Combat Start, equipping an attack halves Attack Skill damage to the body; equipping defense reduces damage taken from the body by 75%. Winning a body clash while holding this grants 3 E.G.O resources of a lowest-reserve affinity. Expires at Turn End and heals 10 SP.
messages.獲物になった主力は守備へ回す。特にHARD後半は、資源獲得を狙って攻撃マッチする: Have a key Prey Sinner defend. Especially in HARD Phase 2, prioritize survival over seeking resource gains through Attack Skill clashes.
messages.前半は全人格の混乱区間1つを除去し、基本攻撃・防御Lv+8（重複不可）。共鳴時、: Phase 1 removes one Stagger Threshold from every Identity and grants +8 base Offense and Defense Levels, non-stacking. On Resonance, gain one matching resource and one random lowest-reserve resource, twice per turn. E.G.O damage +50%. Attacks inflicting Rupture or using Gluttony deal +25% damage, or +100% for E.G.O instead. Clash Power +1 per 2 Bind on the enemy, up to 2.
messages.前半に破裂・暴食を使う案もあるが、中指の共鳴と回避・回復を軸に通すこともできる。: Phase 1 can use Rupture / Gluttony, but Middle Resonance with Evade and healing can continue too. Prepare Bind early.
messages.後半は全人格の混乱区間1つを除去し、基本攻撃・防御Lv+15（重複不可）。共鳴時: Phase 2 removes one Stagger Threshold from every Identity and grants +15 base Offense and Defense Levels, non-stacking. On Resonance, gain one matching resource and two random lowest-reserve resources, twice per turn. E.G.O damage +50%. Attacks inflicting Burn or special Burn, or using Wrath, deal +25% damage, or +100% for E.G.O instead.
messages.前半の+8と後半の+15を足して+23にはしない。育った主力を続投するか、未使用: Do not add Phase 1's +8 to Phase 2's +15 to get +23. Continue with the trained core or switch to an unused Burn / Wrath team.
messages.虎標弾は最大6。猛虎標弾は装填中と残弾を持ち、消耗コインのダメージ+30%、火傷: Tigermark Rounds have a maximum of 6. Savage Tigermark Rounds have loaded and reserve ammunition, grant +30% damage to consuming Coins, and double Burn Potency and Count inflicted. Return to Tigermark Rounds after exhausting loaded and reserve Savage ammunition.
messages.マッチ勝利などで弾を減らし、爆砕斬の時点の残量を確認する。装填技の再装填タイミン: Reduce ammunition through clash wins and check the amount when Blasting Shatterslash acts. Do not calculate guaranteed safety solely from the Reload skill's timing.
messages.再装填は保有する弾を捨てて最大数だけ再取得する。再装填-残弾維持は保有する弾を捨: Reload discards held ammunition and regains the maximum. Reload - Tactical retains held ammunition and regains the maximum amount that can be gained.
messages.大技と装填技で弾が戻る。今ターン減らした残量が次ターンにも残るとは考えず、表示を: Major attacks and reload skills restore ammunition. Do not assume this turn's reduced amount persists next turn; check the display.
messages.失ったHP20%につきダメージ量増加1・威力増加1（各最大3）。振動威力の付与量: Gain 1 DMG Up and 1 Power Up per 20% HP lost, up to 3 each. Tremor Potency inflicted +2. If the Speed difference is at least 3, damage +(Speed difference ×5)%, up to 20%. “Triple Slash” - Blast's last Coin becomes Unbreakable.
messages.後半の通常技も勝利後に被弾が残る。束縛と守備装着、回復を合わせる。: Normal Phase 2 skills can still hit after winning. Combine Bind, equipped defense, and healing.
messages.失ったHP15%につきダメージ量増加1・威力増加1（各最大5）。振動威力の付与量: Gain 1 DMG Up and 1 Power Up per 15% HP lost, up to 5 each. Tremor Potency inflicted +3 and Count +1. If the Speed difference is at least 3, damage +(Speed difference ×5)%, up to 40%. “Double Slash” - Blast and “Triple Slash” - Blast's last Coins become Unbreakable.

messages.前ターンの最多ダメージで獲物が付く。マッチ威力-5を見て、守備と他の担当を使い分: Prey marks last turn's top damage dealer. Account for −5 Clash Power and choose between defense and another clash recipient.

messages.大技は攻撃後にターンを終える。回復と弱体化は前のターンまでに用意する。: Major attacks end the turn After Attack. Prepare healing and debuffs by the preceding turn.
messages.獲物はマッチ威力-5で、攻撃装着時は本体への攻撃ダメージも半減する。守備装着なら: Prey gives −5 Clash Power and halves Attack Skill damage to the body while an attack is equipped. Equipping defense instead reduces damage taken from the body by 75%; use protection rather than attacking every turn.
messages.HP66%で天退星、50%でシン(心)-天退星と大技が強まる。境界前に回復し、最: At 66% HP, Tiantui Star activates; at 50%, Shin (心) - Tiantui Star [天退星] and the major skill strengthen. Heal before boundaries and prepare for last-Coin Unbreakable conversion.
messages.後半も獲物の守備軽減を利用する。NORMALでも破壊不能コインは消えないため、削: Keep using Prey's defensive reduction in Phase 2. Unbreakable Coins remain even in NORMAL; do not assign wounded key Sinners to clashes before healing.

messages.体力比率の低い味方2名を自分の最大体力基準で回復しつつ、敵に怠惰脆弱を付ける怠惰: A multi-target Sloth healing E.G.O that heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio based on her own max HP while inflicting Sloth Fragility on enemies.
messages.回復: 攻撃後、自分を除く現体力の比率が最も低い味方2名を、自分の体力最大値の1: **Healing**: After the attack, heals the 2 allies other than herself with the lowest current HP ratio by 15% of her max HP (25% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 30% at Ⅳ). She cannot heal herself.
messages.バリア: 解析Ⅲから、表面攻撃終了時に対象が混乱または死亡すると、回復した味方に: **Shield**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, if the target is staggered or dies at the end of a Heads attack, the healed allies gain Shield equal to 10% of her max HP (15% at Ⅳ).
messages.怠惰脆弱: 表面的中時(解析Ⅳは的中時)に、次のターンの怠惰脆弱1を付与する。: **Sloth Fragility**: On Heads Hit (on hit at Threadspin Ⅳ), inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility next turn.
messages.パッシブ「天の宣告」: 敵が混乱するたび、現体力の比率が最も低い味方1名の体力が: **Passive — Sentencing from Above**: Each time an enemy is staggered, the 1 ally with the lowest current HP ratio recovers 4% of max HP (once per turn). It triggers no matter who causes the Stagger.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 打撃になり、回復が無く、振動爆発と精神力ダメージを持つ。味方に当た: **Corrosion skill**: Becomes Blunt with no healing, and has Tremor Burst and SP damage. It does heavy damage if it hits allies.
messages.回復量は撃つ人格の最大体力で決まるので、体力の高いロージャで撃つ。: The healing is based on the max HP of the Identity firing it, so fire it with a high-HP Rodion.
messages.混乱を狙う場面では、使用の次のターン以降にバリアと「天の宣告」が重なる。: When aiming for Stagger, the Shield and Sentencing from Above stack from the turn after use onward.
messages.必要資源は怠惰4・傲慢3、精神消耗は25。: It requires 4 Sloth and 3 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 25.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量25%、加重値2、バリアが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: 25% healing, 2 Attack Weight, and the Shield are added.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量30%、加重値3、バリア15%、怠惰脆弱が的中時になる。: **Ⅳ**: 30% healing, 3 Attack Weight, 15% Shield, and Sloth Fragility on hit.
messages.蜘蛛の巣親指の親方: 怠惰(S2)・傲慢(S1)の資源を自給でき、振動爆発で混乱: **[The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916)**: Supplies her own Sloth (S2) and Pride (S1), and can aim for Stagger with Tremor Burst.
messages.バラのスパナ工房代表: パッシブが振動爆発の混乱前進量を増やし、「天の宣告」の発: **[Rosespanner Workshop Rep](persona:0905)**: Her passive increases Tremor Burst's Stagger Threshold shift, making it easy to create enemy Staggers, the trigger for Sentencing from Above. She also supplies Pride.
messages.メインターゲットの出血回数をそのターン減らさず、出血威力に応じた大ダメージを出す: A Lust Slash Bleed E.G.O that keeps the main target's Bleed Count from decreasing that turn and deals heavy damage based on Bleed Potency.
messages.出血回数の維持: メインターゲットは、そのターンの間出血回数が減少しない。出血が: **Maintaining Bleed Count**: The main target's Bleed Count does not decrease for that turn. Bleed triggers without reducing Count, so it can lead into big damage with Potency and Count kept high.
messages.出血依存のコイン威力: 対象の出血2につきコイン威力+1(最大6、解析Ⅲは9、Ⅳ: **Bleed-dependent Coin Power**: +1 Coin Power per 2 Bleed on the target (up to 6, 9 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 13 at Ⅳ). Combined with 21 Base Power, it reaches up to 46 at Threadspin Ⅳ.
messages.色欲属性ダメージ: 的中時に対象の出血威力に倍率をかけた色欲属性ダメージを与える: **Lust damage**: On hit, deals Lust damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency times a multiplier. The multiplier rises with Threadspin and further at 4 or more Lust Resonance. Bleed Potency counts up to 99.
messages.代償: このスキル自体は出血を付与しない。攻撃後3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が: **Cost**: The skill itself does not inflict Bleed. For 3 turns after the attack, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「執着」: 最左方のスキルの出血威力付与量が2倍になる(1ターン1回)。: **Passive — Obsession**: The Bleed Potency inflicted by her leftmost skill is doubled (once per turn).
messages.出血編成で出血を積ませた敵に撃つ。出血が多いボスほど向く。: Fire it at an enemy that a Bleed team has loaded with Bleed. The more Bleed a boss has, the better it fits.
messages.必要資源は計10と重く、精神力の減少も続くため、長期戦の前半に使う。: It requires 10 resources in total and the SP loss keeps going, so use it in the first half of long fights.
messages.侵蝕スキルは多数の敵へ出血を配るもので、覚醒とは役割が違う。敵味方識別不可で味方: The Corrosion skill spreads Bleed to many enemies, a different role from Awakening. It cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies.
messages.Ⅱ: 「執着」が解放される。核となる出血回数の維持はこの時点で使え、以降の強化は: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Obsession. The core Bleed Count maintenance is already usable at this point, and later upgrades are less important.
messages.Ⅲ: コイン威力の上限9、色欲属性ダメージの倍率上昇。侵蝕で出血回数も付与する。: **Ⅲ**: Coin Power cap 9 and a higher Lust damage multiplier. Corrosion also inflicts Bleed Count.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力の上限13、倍率がさらに上がる。コストに見合わず、Ⅲで運用しても: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power cap 13 and an even higher multiplier. Not worth the cost; using it at Ⅲ is likely fine.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの姫: 出血を付与するスキルを持ち、傲慢(S1)・嫉妬(S2): **[The Princess of La Manchaland](persona:0911)**: Has Bleed-inflicting skills and supplies all of the required Pride (S1), Envy (S2), and Lust (S3).
messages.薬指野獣派ドーセント: S2・S3が出血を付与し、嫉妬(S2)・色欲(S3)の資: **[The Ring Fauvist Docent](persona:0915)**: S2 and S3 inflict Bleed, and she supplies Envy (S2) and Lust (S3) resources.
messages.自分を含む味方を回復しつつ、敵に出血・呪い・釘を撒く、嫉妬斬撃の出血向け回復広域: A multi-target Envy Slash healing E.G.O for Bleed teams that heals allies, including herself, while spreading Bleed, Curse, and Nails on enemies.
**Healing**: After the attack, heals herself and the 2 allies with the lowest current HP ratio by 12.5% of her max HP (15% at Threadspin Ⅳ). She can heal herself. At Threadspin Ⅳ, with 4 or more Envy Resonance, one more ally is healed.
messages.回復量の上乗せ: 解析Ⅲから、回復対象のマイナス効果が多いほど回復量が増える(Ⅲ: **Healing bonus**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, healing increases the more negative effects the recipient has (2.5% per 2 types at Ⅲ, per 1 type at Ⅳ; up to 7.5% at Ⅲ and 10% at Ⅳ).
messages.出血・呪い・釘: 的中時に出血2(Ⅲは3、Ⅳは4)と呪い2(Ⅳは3)、表面的中時: **Bleed, Curse, and Nails**: Inflicts 2 Bleed (3 at Ⅲ, 4 at Ⅳ) and 2 Curse (3 at Ⅳ) on hit, and 2 Nails (3 at Ⅳ) on Heads Hit. Nails is a special Bleed that inflicts Bleed every turn.
messages.パッシブ「胸に突き刺さった鉄のくい」: 基本攻撃スキルで出血を付与すると防御レベ: **Passive — Iron Stake against the Heart**: When a basic attack skill inflicts Bleed, it also inflicts 1 Defense Level Down, plus 2 more Bleed if the target already has Bleed (once per turn each). When an ally takes HP damage from an enemy, it inflicts 1 Curse (twice per turn).
messages.出血編成で、出血を配りつつ味方を回復する場面に使う。パッシブは意識しなくても出血: Use it in Bleed teams when you want to spread Bleed while healing allies. The passive triggers in Bleed teams without any special effort.
messages.2コインで合計威力の幅が広く、精神力が高いほど表が出やすいので、精神消耗25を踏: With 2 Coins, its total power varies widely, and higher SP makes Heads more likely, so use it with the 25 Sanity cost in mind.
messages.必要資源は嫉妬4・色欲2・傲慢1。嫉妬に偏る。: It requires 4 Envy, 2 Lust, and 1 Pride, skewed toward Envy.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放される。効果が優秀なので早めに解放したい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive. Its effect is excellent, so unlock it early.
messages.Ⅲ: 出血3、回復量の上乗せが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds 3 Bleed and the healing bonus.
messages.Ⅳ: 基本威力6→8、回復15%、出血4・呪い3・釘3、嫉妬共鳴4で回復対象+1: **Ⅳ**: Base Power 6→8, 15% healing, 4 Bleed, 3 Curse, 3 Nails, and +1 healing target at 4 Envy Resonance.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの姫: 出血を付与するスキルを持ち、色欲(S3)・傲慢(S1): **[The Princess of La Manchaland](persona:0911)**: Has Bleed-inflicting skills and supplies all of the required Lust (S3), Pride (S1), and Envy (S2).
messages.憤怒を多用する火傷編成で、広域攻撃・火傷付与・味方3名の回復を同時にこなす、憤怒: A Wrath Pierce E.G.O for Wrath-heavy Burn teams that delivers multi-target attacks, Burn infliction, and healing for 3 allies all at once.
messages.広域と火傷: 攻撃加重値は4で、解析Ⅲから(最大共鳴数÷2)ぶん増え最大7になる: **Multi-target and Burn**: Attack Weight is 4, increasing by (highest Resonance ÷ 2) from Threadspin Ⅲ, up to 7. Inflicts 6 Burn on hit (8 at Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.回復: 攻撃後、現体力の比率が最も低い味方(1+最大共鳴数)名(最大3名)を、最: **Healing**: After the attack, heals (1 + highest Resonance) allies with the lowest current HP ratio, up to 3, by 15% of max HP (18% at Ⅲ, 20% at Ⅳ).
messages.熱せられた鳥籠: メインターゲットに、次のターンの鳥籠を(1+憤怒共鳴数÷3)付: **Searing Birdcage**: Inflicts (1 + Wrath Resonance ÷ 3) Birdcage for the next turn on the main target (up to 2, 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ). It raises the Wrath resistance of Burning enemies, and the bearer also gains Bind at Turn End.
messages.パッシブ「灼熱遊戯」: 火傷回数10以上の敵が死亡すると、全ての敵へ火傷回数を分: **Passive — Blazing Amusement**: When an enemy with 10 or more Burn Count dies, distributes Burn Count among all enemies and restores 8 SP (twice per turn). The condition is demanding.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 2枚とも元から破壊不能コインで、解析Ⅲから火傷・鳥籠が強化され、Ⅳ: **Corrosion skill**: Both Coins are Unbreakable from the start, with Burn and Birdcage strengthened from Threadspin Ⅲ and further at Ⅳ. It cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies, making it hard to handle.
messages.憤怒スキルをまとめて使い、共鳴数で加重値・回復人数・鳥籠を伸ばしてから撃つ。: Use Wrath skills together, raising Attack Weight, healing targets, and Birdcage through Resonance before firing it.
messages.攻撃後3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10減る。精神消耗15と合わせて重いので、: For 3 turns after the attack, she loses 10 SP at each Turn End. Together with its 15 Sanity cost, it is heavy, so pick its moments.
messages.必要資源は憤怒7・傲慢3と偏っており、火傷編成で憤怒が余る場面に向く。: It requires 7 Wrath and 3 Pride, a lopsided cost suited to Burn teams with Wrath to spare.
messages.Ⅱ: 「灼熱遊戯」が解放されるが、条件が重く活用しにくい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Blazing Amusement, but its condition is demanding and hard to use.
messages.Ⅲ: 覚醒が強化される(共鳴による加重値、回復18%、火傷8、鳥籠の上限3)。覚: **Ⅲ**: Strengthens Awakening (Resonance-based Attack Weight, 18% healing, 8 Burn, Birdcage cap 3). Enough if you only use Awakening.
messages.Ⅳ: 侵蝕が大きく強化され、覚醒の回復も20%になる。: **Ⅳ**: Greatly strengthens Corrosion, and Awakening's healing becomes 20%.
messages.南部リウ協会4課部長: 火傷を付与するスキルがそろい、憤怒(S2)・傲慢(S1): **[Liu Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:0908)**: Has a full set of Burn-inflicting skills and supplies Wrath (S2) and Pride (S1).
messages.蜘蛛の巣親指の親方: 基本スキルの多くが火傷を付与し、憤怒・傲慢の資源も出せる。: **[The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916)**: Many of her basic skills inflict Burn, and she supplies Wrath and Pride resources.
messages.少ない資源で味方を回復しつつ、火傷と出血も撒ける、色欲共鳴を活かす打撃広域の回復: A multi-target Blunt healing E.G.O that makes use of Lust Resonance, healing allies for few resources while also spreading Burn and Bleed.
messages.回復と緋色の蛾: 攻撃後、現体力の比率が最も低い味方2名を最大値の5%(解析Ⅲは: **Healing and Scarlet Moth**: After the attack, heals the 2 allies with the lowest current HP ratio by 5% of max HP (8% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10% at Ⅳ) and gives them 2 Scarlet Moth. The number of healing targets increases by (Lust Resonance − 1), up to 2 more. Moths restore HP and SP at Turn End.
messages.精神力回復: 解析Ⅲから、回復対象が色欲スキルを装着していれば精神力も回復する(: **SP recovery**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, if the healed ally has a Lust skill equipped, they also recover SP (3 at Ⅲ, 6 at Ⅳ).
messages.火傷・出血: 的中時に火傷2・出血2(解析Ⅲは3)を付与し、解析Ⅳでは次のターン: **Burn and Bleed**: Inflicts 2 Burn and 2 Bleed on hit (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ), and at Threadspin Ⅳ also 1 Wrath Fragility and 1 Lust Fragility next turn.
messages.パッシブ「蛾と蝶の違い」: 最左端の基本攻撃スキルが憤怒か色欲なら、与ダメージ量: **Passive — What Distinguishes Moths from Butterflies**: If her leftmost basic attack skill is Wrath or Lust, it deals additional Sin damage equal to 30% of the damage dealt (up to 30).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 覚醒のような直接回復は無く、火傷と出血の合計でダメージ量が伸びる攻: **Corrosion skill**: It has no direct healing like Awakening and leans offensive, with damage that grows with combined Burn and Bleed. It gives Scarlet Moth to random allies, cannot distinguish friend from foe, and can hit allies.
messages.色欲スキルを複数並べて回復人数を増やす。: Line up several Lust skills to increase the number of healing targets.
messages.最左端に憤怒か色欲の基本攻撃スキルを置き、パッシブを活かす。: Place a Wrath or Lust basic attack skill at the far left to make use of the passive.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・色欲3と軽く、精神消耗は20。火傷・出血編成の回復役として組み: It requires a light 2 Wrath and 3 Lust, with a Sanity cost of 20. Easy to work into Burn and Bleed teams as a healer.
messages.Ⅱ: 「蛾と蝶の違い」が解放される。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks What Distinguishes Moths from Butterflies.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が微増し、回復8%、火傷・出血3、色欲スキル持ちへの精神力回復が加わる: **Ⅲ**: Slightly raises power, with 8% healing, 3 Burn and Bleed, and SP recovery for allies with Lust skills. If healing is the goal, take it at least this far.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復10%、精神力回復6、侵蝕の火力増加、憤怒脆弱・色欲脆弱の付与が加わる: **Ⅳ**: Adds 10% healing, 6 SP recovery, more damage on Corrosion, and Wrath and Lust Fragility infliction.
