A Poise and Tremor E.G.O that builds Poise while inflicting and bursting Tremor across multiple targets, breaking enemies down with Fracturing of the Senses.
messages.呼吸の獲得: 攻撃前に呼吸を(2+最大共鳴数)得て、呼吸回数も2増える(解析Ⅲは: **Gaining Poise**: Before attacking, gains (2 + highest Resonance) Poise, and Poise Count increases by 2 (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 4 at Ⅳ). +1 Clash Power per 6 combined Poise Potency and target's Tremor Potency (up to 2, 3 at Ⅲ, 4 at Ⅳ).
messages.振動と振動爆発: Ⅰコインが振動2、Ⅱコインが振動回数を増やし、Ⅲコインが攻撃レ: **Tremor and Tremor Burst**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 2 Tremor, Coin Ⅱ increases Tremor Count, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 2 Offense Level Down and triggers Tremor Burst. A 3-Coin multi-target attack that spreads Tremor across several enemies.
messages.感覚亀裂: 攻撃後、ランダムな敵に合計(1+最大共鳴数)の感覚亀裂を付与する(最: **Fracturing of the Senses**: After the attack, inflicts a total of (1 + highest Resonance) Fracturing of the Senses on random enemies, up to 5. Per the effect text, enemies with it gain Tremor Count when their allies are attacked, and take more damage when hit by Critical Hits (a % equal to the attacker's own Tremor Potency, up to 15%). It likely meshes with Poise-based Critical Hits.
messages.パッシブ「分裂した触覚」: 呼吸を得るたびに呼吸回数が1増える(1ターン2回)。: **Passive — Schismatic Stereognosis**: Each time she gains Poise, Poise Count increases by 1 (twice per turn). messages.呼吸か振動を扱う人格で使い、使用後の次のターンからパッシブを活かす。: Use it with Identities that use Poise or Tremor, making use of the passive from the turn after use.
messages.共鳴数が呼吸量と感覚亀裂の量を決めるので、怠惰などの同属性スキルを並べてから撃つ: Resonance determines the amount of Poise and Fracturing of the Senses, so line up skills of the same Sin, such as Sloth, before firing it.

messages.血色の欲望: 出血を付与するスキルを持ち、傲慢(S1)・嫉妬(S2)・色欲(S3: **[Sanguine Desire](ego:0906)**: Has Bleed-inflicting skills and supplies all of the required Pride (S1), Envy (S2), and Lust (S3).
messages.血色の欲望: S2・S3が出血を付与し、嫉妬(S2)・色欲(S3)の資源も出せる: **[Sanguine Desire](ego:0906)**: S2 and S3 inflict Bleed, and she supplies Envy (S2) and Lust (S3) resources.
messages.呪いの釘: 出血を付与するスキルを持ち、色欲(S3)・傲慢(S1)・嫉妬(S2): **[Hex Nail](ego:0907)**: Has Bleed-inflicting skills and supplies all of the required Lust (S3), Pride (S1), and Envy (S2).
messages.呪いの釘: S2・S3が出血を付与し、嫉妬(S2)・色欲(S3)の資源も出せる。: **[Hex Nail](ego:0907)**: S2 and S3 inflict Bleed, and she supplies Envy (S2) and Lust (S3) resources.
messages.指定裁判: 火傷を付与するスキルがそろい、憤怒(S2)・傲慢(S1)の資源も出せ: **[Indicant's Trial](ego:0908)**: Has a full set of Burn-inflicting skills and supplies Wrath (S2) and Pride (S1).
messages.指定裁判: 基本スキルの多くが火傷を付与し、憤怒・傲慢の資源も出せる。: **[Indicant's Trial](ego:0908)**: Many of her basic skills inflict Burn, and she supplies Wrath and Pride resources.
messages.夕焼けの中へ: S2・S3が出血を付与し、色欲(S3)の資源も出せる。出血・色欲: **[Into the Sunset](ego:0909)**: S2 and S3 inflict Bleed, and she supplies Lust (S3) resources. She fits Bleed and Lust teams.
messages.夕焼けの中へ: 憤怒スキルで火傷を付与でき、このE.G.Oの憤怒脆弱の恩恵も受け: **[Into the Sunset](ego:0909)**: Her Wrath skills can inflict Burn, and she likely benefits from this E.G.O's Wrath Fragility.
messages.鏡触覚: 呼吸と振動の両方を扱い、傲慢・怠惰・憤怒の資源も出せる。: **[Mirror-touch](ego:0910)**: Uses both Poise and Tremor and supplies Pride, Sloth, and Wrath resources.
messages.鏡触覚: S1〜S3が振動を付与し、傲慢・憂鬱の資源も出せる。振動爆発で打撃ダメ: **[Mirror-touch](ego:0910)**: S1–S3 inflict Tremor, and she supplies Pride and Gloom resources. Her passive grants Blunt DMG Up on Tremor Burst, meshing with this Blunt E.G.O.
messages.破裂: S1「縦斬り」で破裂2、S3「掻き斬る」の表面的中で破裂1ずつを付与。: **Rupture**: S1 Downward Swing inflicts 2 Rupture, and S3 Ravaging Cut inflicts 1 Rupture on each Heads Hit.
messages.マッチ勝利で強化: S2「連続斬り」はマッチ勝利時にダメージ量+10%/+30%: **Bonuses on Clash Win**: S2 Halberd Combo deals +10%/+30% damage on Clash Win, and S3 grants 1 Attack Power Up on Clash Win.
messages.バトルパッシブ「覚悟」(傲慢×3・保有): このターンに味方が死亡すると、次のタ: **Combat passive — Pluckiness (3 Pride Owned)**: If an ally dies this turn, he gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.S1で破裂を入れ、S2・S3はマッチに勝てる相手に当ててダメージを伸ばす。: Inflict Rupture with S1, and throw S2 and S3 at opponents they can beat in Clashes to raise damage.
messages.剣契編成の補助: 補助の主役は「剣契頭目」(ムルソー)のバトルパッシブ「本国剣術: **Blade Lineage team support**: The main support comes from Meursault's Blade Lineage Mentor and his combat passive Swordplay of the Homeland (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ). At Combat Start, it gives Swordplay of the Homeland to Blade Lineage members other than the Mentor. Also, each time the Mentor gains Poise Potency or Count, the 2 Blade Lineage Identities with no Poise or the least Poise also gain 1 Potency and Count. At Combat Start on turns they are equipped, the Mentor's S1 and S2 give Sword of the Homeland - Rending and Sword of the Homeland - Penetrating to Blade Lineage members other than himself, in order of lowest Speed (up to the number of the highest Absolute Resonance). This Identity is a Blade Lineage member with low Speed, so he tends to be a priority target.
messages.呼吸威力はS2だけ: S2「連斬」の各コインで呼吸2・1・1を得る(同期化段階が: **Only S2 grants Poise Potency**: Each Coin of S2 Slash Series grants 2, 1, and 1 Poise (only on Heads Hit at lower Uptie). S2 is his only source of Poise Potency; S1 Slice then Stab and his Defense skill only increase Poise Count. On Clash Win, S2 does not consume Poise Count on this skill's Critical Hits.
messages.S3「骨断」: 1コイン。自分の呼吸回数が10以上ならクリティカルダメージ量+1: **S3 — To Claim Their Bones**: 1 Coin. +150% Critical damage if he has 10 or more Poise Count. Inflicts 5 Paralyze (5 Coins' worth of Coin Power fixed at 0 for 1 turn) and 3 Bleed on hit.
messages.呼吸回数の補充: 守備「反撃 - 初生」は使用時に次のターンのダメージ量増加1と: **Topping up Poise Count**: The Defense skill Newsprung Counter grants 1 Damage Up next turn and +3 Poise Count on use (Uptie Ⅳ). S1 adds 1/2 Poise Count on hit, and gains +1 Coin Power at 3 or more Poise Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「殺手」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分を除く味方のスキ: **Combat passive — Slayer (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When an ally other than himself increases Poise Count with a skill, there is a 50% chance his Poise Count also increases by 1. The final Coin of the last Sin in a chain deals +20% damage.
messages.剣契の味方と一緒に出撃し、補助を受けられる形にする。序盤はS2を積極的に振って呼: Deploy him with Blade Lineage allies so he can receive their support. Early on, actively use S2 for Poise, and build Poise Count to 10 or more with S1, his Defense skill, and Slayer before firing S3. His Speed is low (2–5), so note that S3's Paralyze tends to only affect enemy skills that act later the same turn.
messages.ダメージ量減少: S2のⅡコインが的中すると、次のターンに対象へダメージ量減少1: **Damage Down**: When Coin Ⅱ of S2 hits, it inflicts 1/2 Damage Down on the target next turn (the value changes with Uptie). On use, S2 also adds +4 Aggro to its slot next turn (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.保護と「あなたの盾」: S1「打撃」はマッチ敗北時に保護2を得る。S3「強打」は: **Protection and Your Shield**: S1 Baton grants 2 Protection on Clash Lose. On use, S3 Strong Strike gives 1 Protection to the ally with the lowest HP (that turn or the next, depending on Uptie). The combat passive Your Shield (2 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +2 Defense power and 1 Protection for 1 turn to the allies on both sides of him on the dashboard at Combat Start (not himself).
messages.低速・高耐久: 速度は1〜3/2〜3/2〜4、防御レベルは人格Lv+3。通常戦闘: **Slow and durable**: His Speed is 1–3/2–3/2–4, and his Defense Level is Identity Lv +3. In regular battles where enemies have many actions, the slowest ally tends to take one-sided attacks, and this Identity can take them on.
messages.挑発値(集中戦闘、同期化Ⅳ): S3は使用時に次のターンの挑発値+10、S2・守: **Aggro (Focused Encounters, Uptie Ⅳ)**: S3 grants +10 Aggro next turn on use, and S2 and his Defense skill grant +4.
messages.振動とS3: S1・S2で振動を付与できるが、振動回数を増やす効果は無い。そのま: **Tremor and S3**: S1 and S2 can inflict Tremor, but nothing increases Tremor Count, so it disappears at Turn End as is. S3 triggers Tremor Burst on hit and inflicts 2 Blunt Fragility. If the target has at least 5 Tremor at the time of the Tremor Burst, he also gains 2 Protection next turn.
messages.通常戦闘では最も遅い枠として敵の一方攻撃を受け持ち、S2を当てて次のターンの敵の: In regular battles, take enemy one-sided attacks as the slowest slot, and land S2 to lower the enemy's damage next turn. Placing allies you want to protect on both sides of him on the dashboard makes the most of Your Shield. In Focused Encounters, draw attacks with Aggro and absorb them with Protection. Burst Tremor with S3 the same turn, or combine it with allies who can inflict Tremor Count. He does not need to win every Clash; the playstyle is to limit damage with Protection and Damage Down and absorb hits with his HP.
messages.守備「回避」: マッチ威力5〜15、スキルレベル人格Lv+5。回避成功時に呼吸回: **Defense skill — Evade**: Clash Power 5–15, Skill Level Identity Lv +5. Poise Count increases by 1 on a successful Evade. His HP is 98–307, and his Defense Level is Identity Lv +3.
messages.S3「パニャータパーティー」: 1コイン、マッチ威力8〜19。この人格で唯一まと: **S3 — Pañata Party**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 8–19. His only skill that can Clash properly. On hit, pushes his own Stagger Threshold back by 50% of the damage dealt. If the target's SP is below 0, Critical chance increases in proportion to it, and with 5 or more Poise Count he gains +30% Critical damage.
messages.S1・S2は一方攻撃用: マッチ威力はS1「舞い」が3〜7/4〜8、S2「激情の: **S1 and S2 are for one-sided attacks**: Their Clash Power is low: S1 Baile y Rola at 3–7/4–8 and S2 Danza de Pasión at 4–7/5–8. S1 inflicts 2/4 Sinking and gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 4 Sinking. S2 inflicts Sinking with Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ (Coin Ⅱ also Sinking Count) and gains +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Sinking.
messages.バトルパッシブ「遊興」(憂鬱×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 回避成功時、(憂鬱共: **Combat passive — Júbilo Hedonista (3 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On a successful Evade, there is a (Gloom Resonance×5)% chance to push the Stagger Threshold back by the Evade skill's power. S3 and his Defense skill (the Defense skill at Uptie Ⅳ) are Gloom, making it easy to aim for.
messages.敵の攻撃は基本的に「回避」で処理する。S3が手元にあれば、勝てそうな敵スキルとの: Handle enemy attacks with Evade as a rule. If S3 is in hand, use it to Clash enemy skills it can likely beat. Land S1 and S2 as one-sided attacks to stack Sinking and drain enemy SP. His low Speed and lack of Aggro make covering allies difficult, so his role is to hold out without falling himself. In Sinking teams, the Coin Power conditions on S1 and S2 are also easy to meet.
messages.減算コイン: 基本威力が高く、コイン威力がマイナス(S1「追い立てられた審判」7: **Minus Coins**: High Base Power with negative Coin Power (S1 Coerced Judgement 7/8 and −2, S2 Amoral Enactment 12/16 and −3/−4, S3 30 and −12). Power drops the more Heads land, so he is stronger the lower his SP and the more likely Tails is (lower SP making Tails more likely is a general game rule).
messages.精神力の自己消耗: 使用時に精神力がS1で7、S2で10、S3で15減る。守備「: **Self-draining SP**: On use, he loses 7 SP with S1, 10 with S2, and 15 with S3. The Defense skill Enough… restores 5–10 SP at Combat Start.
messages.バトルパッシブ「狂炎」(憤怒×2・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ勝利・敵討伐時: **Combat passive — Mad Flame (2 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: SP recovered on Clash Win and on defeating enemies is reduced by 50%. If 5 or more N Corp. Fanatics, including himself, are alive, N Corp. Fanatics deal +10% damage.
messages.S3「自滅的浄化」: 狂信があればダメージ量+15%。Ⅱコインの的中で、与えたダ: **S3 — Self-destructive Purge**: +15% damage with Fanatic. On Coin Ⅱ hit, shifts the Stagger Threshold by 50% of the damage dealt. Coin Ⅲ inflicts 5/7 Burn if the target has at least 5 Bleed, and grants 1 Blunt Power Up next turn on defeating an enemy.
messages.狂信と火傷: S1はⅡコインの裏面的中時に次のターンの狂信1を得る。狂信があると: **Fanatic and Burn**: S1 grants 1 Fanatic next turn on Coin Ⅱ Tails Hit. With Fanatic, S2 deals +5/10% damage and S3 +15%. S1 and S2 also inflict Burn.
messages.まず憤怒×2を確保して「狂炎」を発動させる。憤怒スキルはS3だけなので、味方の憤: First, secure 2 Wrath to activate Mad Flame. His only Wrath skill is S3, so it is more efficient to have allies' Wrath skills supply the resources. Attack every turn to keep his SP on the negative side. At −45 SP, he panics or undergoes E.G.O Corrosion the next turn, so slip in his Defense skill or a Clash Win just before that to bring SP back. He is advantaged in battles that start at 0 SP (story stages and Refraction Railway), but pairs poorly with effects that heal the ally with the lowest SP.
messages.敵に貼ったお札: お札を持つ対象は、被ダメージ時に(お札÷2)の破裂を得て、お札: **Talismans on enemies**: A target with Talismans gains (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture when it takes damage, and Talisman decreases by 1 (minimum 1 gained, rounded down). It only decreases at Turn End when it is 6 or more, so at 5 or less it stays until the bearer is hit.
messages.S3「破裂符」: Ⅰコインの的中時に自分のお札を5消耗し、対象にお札5を付与する: **S3 — Rupturing Talisman**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, spends 5 of his own Talismans and gives the target 5 Talismans. It only works while he has 5 or more Talismans. On Coin Ⅱ hit, if the target has Talismans, Rupture Count increases by 1/3. The transfer is on the first Coin, so land it as a one-sided attack or with a sure Clash Win so it is not broken.
messages.お札の獲得: S2「増殖するお札」の各コイン、S1「傷口浮彫」(表面的中時、対象: **Gaining Talismans**: He gains 1 Talisman with each Coin of S2 Proliferating Talismans, with S1 Magnify Wound (on Heads Hit, if the target has at least 5 Rupture), and on using his Defense skill Guard. The combat passive Unfixing Talismans (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants 1 Talisman on hit if the target has Rupture.
messages.自分が持つお札: 最大6。攻撃的中時に対象の破裂回数を1消耗して(お札÷2)の破: **Talismans on himself**: Maximum 6. On hit, they consume 1 of the target's Rupture Count to inflict (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture (minimum 1 if Rupture Count was consumed, rounded down), and when he takes damage, he gains (Talisman ÷ 2) Rupture and Talisman decreases by 1. At 6 or more at Turn End, all of it is spent and he takes fixed damage equal to its value.
messages.S1・S2(とパッシブ)でお札を5まで溜め、6以上のままターンを終えないよう枚数: Build Talismans to 5 with S1 and S2 (and the passive), adjusting the count so he does not end a turn at 6 or more. Once at 5 or more, push them onto an enemy with S3 so allies' subsequent attacks trigger Rupture repeatedly. The Talisman effect consumes extra Rupture Count, so pair him with allies who can extend Rupture Count (Rupture teams) to maintain it.
messages.S2「落ち着いて…」: 1コイン、マッチ威力3〜15/4〜16。使用時に自分の振: **S2 — Steady...**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 3–15/4–16. On use, his own Tremor Count increases by 2/4/6, and on hit it inflicts 2/4/6 Tremor (values by Uptie).
messages.S3「ギャンブラー」: 自分の振動回数10につきコイン威力+1(最大2)。Ⅰコイ: **S3 — Gamble**: +1 Coin Power per 10 of his own Tremor Count, up to 2. On Coin Ⅰ hit, if his Tremor Count is 10 or more, he spends all of it and gives the target the same amount of Tremor Count. Below 10, he gains 6/10 Tremor himself and triggers Tremor Burst on himself, dealing that much Blunt damage to the target. This branch advances his own Stagger Threshold, so avoid it if possible.
messages.S1「猛襲」: 4コインだがマッチ威力2〜6と低く、一方攻撃向け。自分の振動回数: **S1 — Fierce Assault**: 4 Coins but with a low Clash Power of 2–6, suited to one-sided attacks. +1 Coin Power with 10 or more of his own Tremor Count. Coins Ⅱ and Ⅳ increase both his and the target's Tremor Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「不安定な出力」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の振動回: **Combat passive — Unstable Power Output (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: While his own Tremor Count is 10 or more, +1 to the Tremor and Tremor Count inflicted by Coin effects on Heads Hit.
messages.サポートパッシブ「出力改造」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 体力最大値が最: **Support passive — Modified Power Output (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Tremor that the 1 ally with the highest max HP inflicts with attack skills. In Tremor teams, keeping him in backup is also a strong option.
messages.序盤はS2で自分の振動回数を溜める(同期化Ⅳなら2回で10を超える)。10以上に: Early on, build his own Tremor Count with S2 (at Uptie Ⅳ, two uses exceed 10). Once at 10 or more, transfer it all to the enemy with S3 and let allies who are good at bursting trigger it. After the transfer, his own Tremor Count becomes 0, losing S1's and S3's bonuses and the passive's condition, so time it with allies' bursts. Avoid S3 below 10.
messages.速度差で強化: 速度範囲は4〜6/4〜7/4〜8。S1「ルミーズ」は対象より2以: **Speed-difference bonuses**: His Speed range is 4–6/4–7/4–8. S1 Remise gains +1 Coin Power if he is at least 2 faster than the target. S2 and S3 gain Coin Power based on Speed difference (+1 per 2 Speed difference at higher Uptie; up to 2 for S2 and 3 for S3).
messages.S2「アンガジェマン」: 3コイン、マッチ威力3〜15/4〜16。マッチ勝利時に: **S2 — Engagement**: 3 Coins with Clash Power 3–15/4–16. +2 Poise Count on Clash Win, and +1 each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ.
messages.クイック: S1は使用時に呼吸回数2増加、Ⅰ・Ⅱコインでそれぞれ次のターンのクイ: **Haste**: S1 increases Poise Count by 2 on use, and Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ each grant 1 Haste next turn, making it easier to keep a Speed difference.
messages.決闘宣布 - シンクレア: S3「コントラタック」のⅠコインで付与。付与した相手: **Declared Duel - Sinclair**: Inflicted with Coin Ⅰ of S3 Contre Attaque. In Clashes against the marked target, he gains +1 Clash Power, and landing attacks grants 1 Haste next turn (up to 4 times per turn). It disappears if applied to another target. On Clash Win, S3 spends 10 Poise Count to gain the same amount of Poise (doubled against the Declared Duel target). Also, on Clash Win, if he Clashed while being the only one targeting that slot (Single Combat), it inflicts 1 Fragile on hit (up to 2 per turn).
messages.バトルパッシブ「眠った殺気」(傲慢×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): ターン終了時、: **Combat passive — Slumbering Bloodthirst (5 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn End, +2 maximum Speed next turn per 5 Poise Count, up to 6. If all allies are faster than every enemy at Combat Start, he gains 1 Pierce DMG Up.
messages.速度差を保ったままS2を主力にマッチし、合間にS1でクイックを得る。単体ボスには: Clash mainly with S2 while keeping the Speed difference, gaining Haste with S1 in between. Against a single boss, applying Declared Duel early with S3 makes later Clashes and Haste gain easier. S3's Fragile is inflicted when he is the only one targeting that slot and wins the Single Combat Clash. Poise Potency offers little benefit and Poise Count builds naturally, so there is almost no need to play around Poise.
messages.変身(「不安定な自我の殻」): ターン開始時に精神力が40以上なら精神力を20消: **Transformation (Unstable Shell of Ego)**: If his SP is 40 or more at Turn Start, he spends 20 SP to transform. While transformed, he gains Volatile Passion, inflicts 1 Burn on hit, and gains +1 Final Power if the main target has Burn. At Turn End, he loses (turns transformed×5) SP, up to 40, and the transformation ends if his SP is 0 or below at Turn Start.
messages.初動はS3「烙印」: マッチ勝利時に精神力10回復、マッチ敗北時に10減少。Ⅰ・: **Open with S3 Stigmatize**: Restores 10 SP on Clash Win and loses 10 on Clash Lose. Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ inflict 3 Burn each. Throw it at opponents it can beat to raise SP.
messages.変身後のS2: 使用時と攻撃後に精神力が5ずつ減る代わりに攻撃加重値+1、精神力: **S2 after transforming**: On use and after the attack, he loses 5 SP each, but gains +1 Attack Weight, and +1 more at 45 SP. Each Coin increases Burn Count by 1.
messages.「燃えたぎる一撃」: 変身中にS3が変化する1コイン技。敵全体の火傷威力合計4ご: **Blazing Strike**: A 1-Coin technique that S3 turns into while transformed. Coin Power rises per 4 total Burn Potency across all enemies (with a cap). +5/10% damage per Wrath Resonance (up to 30/60%), with more if the highest Wrath Absolute Resonance is 4 or more. Inflicts 10 Burn. Restores 10 SP on Clash Win, loses 30 on Clash Lose, and loses 15 after the attack.
messages.バトルパッシブ「スティグマ工房武器/激情」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得):: **Combat passive — Stigma Workshop Weaponry / Passion (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 to the Burn Potency and Count inflicted (up to 6 times per turn). While transformed, Coin Power increases by (SP ÷ 20), or +3 at 45 SP.
messages.夜明事務所編成: グレゴールは精神力の回復・維持と耐久を、ファウストは火力を大き: **Dawn Office team**: Gregor greatly supports his SP recovery, upkeep, and durability, and Faust greatly supports his damage (see the other Identities' data for the buff details).
messages.夜明事務所の2人と出撃する。序盤はS3「烙印」などでマッチに勝って精神力を40ま: Deploy him with the other two Dawn Office members. Early on, win Clashes with S3 Stigmatize and similar to raise his SP to 40 and transform. With both Dawn Office members present (SP recovers every turn through Gregor's Dawn Office Rep's From Dawnbreak to Sunset and the Dawn Office 3-member effect), a Clash Win with S3 or a 3-Coin skill on turn 1 lets him transform on turn 2. He can hardly gather 5 Wrath on his own, so secure it with allies' Wrath skills to activate Passion. After transforming, spread Burn Count with the multi-target S2, and fire S3 with 4 or more Wrath chained. His SP keeps dropping, so make up for it with Clash Wins to keep the transformation.
messages.防御レベル増加: S1「制圧します。」は使用時に防御レベル増加を得る。S2「戦闘: **Defense Level Up**: S1 Suppressing. grants Defense Level Up on use. S2 Combat Preparation and S3 Fence grant Defense Level Up per 2 of his own Tremor Count; S2 gains +1 Coin Power at 4 or more Defense Level Up, and S3 gains +1 per 3.
messages.味方の支援: S2はマッチ勝利後の的中で体力の低い味方へ防御レベル増加、防御レベ: **Supporting allies**: On hit after a Clash Win, S2 gives Defense Level Up to a low-HP ally and Offense Level Up to allies with Defense Level Up. S3 gives 3/4 Defense Level Up to the ally with the lowest HP ratio.
messages.挑発値: S1・S2・守備は次のターンの挑発値を得る。: **Aggro**: S1, S2, and his Defense skill grant Aggro next turn.
messages.振動: S1・S2のマッチ勝利や守備で自分の振動回数を得る。S3のⅢコインで自分: **Tremor**: He gains his own Tremor Count on S1 and S2 Clash Wins and from his Defense skill. Coin Ⅲ of S3 spends up to 8 of his own Tremor Count to transfer it to the target and triggers Tremor Burst. His Defense skill triggers Tremor Burst on Clash Win.
messages.バトルパッシブ「保護任務開始」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時、: **Combat passive — Begin Protection Mission (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, gains Defense Level Up equal to his own Tremor Count, up to 5.
messages.S1・守備で振動回数を貯めて防御レベルを上げ、集中戦闘では挑発値で攻撃を受ける。: Build Tremor Count with S1 and his Defense skill to raise Defense Level, and take attacks with Aggro in Focused Encounters. Hand out Defense Level Up to allies with S2 and S3, and trigger Tremor Burst with S3.
messages.デリバリーキャリア-シンクレア: S1「デリバリーキャリア-崩壊ハンマー」のⅠコ: **Courier Trunk - Sinclair**: He gains 1 with Coin Ⅰ of S1 Courier Trunk - Decay Hammer (1 more below 15) and 1 with Coin Ⅰ of S2 Courier Trunk - Demolition Gadget (2 more below 15). All attack skills gain +1 Coin Power based on Courier Trunk or the target's Rupture (up to 2; the condition changes with Uptie).
messages.破裂15・回数3以上の敵: この状態の敵には、S1・S2の的中時効果で破裂(回数: **Enemies with 15 Rupture and 3+ Count**: Against enemies in this state, S1's and S2's on-hit effects do not inflict Rupture (or Count) and inflict 2 Defense Level Down instead (once per Coin). S3 does not inflict Rupture or Count, but gains +2/4 final Coin Power. If the target has 15 or more Rupture, the final Coin gains +3/4% damage per Courier Trunk, up to 90/120%. However, the loss from S1 and S2 no longer maintaining Rupture is larger.
messages.破裂回数: S1はⅡコインで破裂回数2(キャリア15以上ならさらに1)。S2はⅡ: **Rupture Count**: S1 inflicts 2 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅱ (1 more at 15 or more Courier Trunk). S2 inflicts 2 and 3 Rupture with Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ, increasing Rupture Count by 1/2 only at 15 or more Courier Trunk. S3 inflicts 1 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅰ plus 1 per 10 Courier Trunk, up to 2/3.
messages.整備(退却): キャリアが15以上なら、守備が戦闘開始時に「ちょ、ちょっと整備し: **Maintenance (retreat)**: With 15 or more Courier Trunk, his Defense skill activates as W-wait, I need to do some maintenance...! at Combat Start, granting Shield based on Courier Trunk, and he enters Strategic R&R Mode at Turn End. When returning from retreat in consecutive battles, Courier Trunk is halved (once per battle, rounded up).
messages.バトルパッシブ「ちょっとだけ待ってください…！」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得: **Combat passive — A moment, please... (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Turn Start, if he has 6 or more Speed or Haste, he gains Shield of (Courier Trunk)% of max HP, up to 20%. On retreat, gives 1 Clash Power Up to 2 allies next turn (+1 turn of duration per 15 Courier Trunk, up to +2).
messages.S1・S2でキャリアを溜めつつ破裂を積む。キャリア15以上からはS2でも破裂回数: Build Courier Trunk with S1 and S2 while stacking Rupture. From 15 Courier Trunk, S2 can also increase Rupture Count. Once the enemy reaches 15 Rupture and 3 or more Count, stop landing S1 and S2 on it and aim to finish with S3. In consecutive battles with backup units, use the retreat through his Defense skill once Courier Trunk has built up, buffing allies and keeping the fight going.
messages.守備の反撃変化(同期化Ⅳ): 守備「東部でひと暴れするとしますか」は戦闘開始時、: **Defense skill's counter changes (Uptie Ⅳ)**: At Combat Start, if total Envy Absolute Resonance is 4 or more, the Defense skill Warmup in the East uses S2 Payback with Interest when countering, or S3 at 6 or more (activating from the left-side slot skills on the dashboard, up to 2 times per turn). At Combat Start, he also gains Shield equal to 20/30% of HP lost (once per turn).
messages.バトルパッシブ「中指は忘れない」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分が被弾: **Combat passive — The Middle Never Forgets (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: When he is hit, inflicts 3/5 Vendetta Mark on the attacker (once per turn). When an ally is hit, it inflicts 2, plus 3 more if the ally is a Middle member (once per turn per Identity). At the end of a basic attack skill or counter skill's attack, it spends all of the target's Vendetta Mark (up to 10) and grants that much Book of Vengeance [Sinclair].
messages.仕返し帳簿[シンクレア]: 最大30。ダメージ量が(数値)%増加(最大30%)。: **Book of Vengeance [Sinclair]**: Maximum 30. Damage increases by (value)%, up to 30%. As next-turn effects, he gains 1 Blunt DMG Up at 10 or more, +1 maximum Speed and 1 Power Up at 20 or more, and 2 Blunt DMG Up at 30. S3's damage also rises further with Book of Vengeance.
messages.共鳴で攻撃レベル増加: S2・S3は戦闘開始時、最も高い共鳴数に応じて攻撃レベル: **Offense Level Up through Resonance**: At Combat Start, S2 and S3 gain Offense Level based on the highest Resonance (up to 2/3 for S2 and 3 for S3), doubled if that Resonance includes Absolute Resonance.
messages.中指編成: 中指所属の味方(「中指末妹」(ドンキホーテ)、「中指末弟」(ムルソー: **Middle teams**: When Middle allies (Don Quixote's The Middle Little Sister, Meursault's The Middle Little Brother, Heathcliff's The Middle Big Brother) are hit, more Vendetta Mark is inflicted.
messages.中指の味方と組んで嫉妬スキルを並べ、嫉妬完全共鳴数の合計6を作って守備をS3の反: Pair him with Middle allies, line up Envy skills, and build a total of 6 Envy Absolute Resonance to turn his Defense skill into an S3 counter. The counter collects Vendetta Mark right after it is applied by the hit, building Book of Vengeance most efficiently. The closer the Book gets to 30, the more damage all of his skills deal. S1 Is it You?! restores 5 SP on use (+1 Clash Power instead at max SP), and S1 and S2 also grant Aggro next turn on use. The bonuses on each attack skill for targets with 6 or more Bleed are hard to combine with the S3 counter, so there is no need to aim for them.
messages.灼熱推進弾(15): S3「推力集中」のコインで消耗する。消耗した数だけ次のター: **Scorch Propellant Ammo (15)**: Spent by the Coins of S3 Thruster Compression. Grants Damage Up next turn equal to the amount spent, up to 3. Without ammo, the attack is not cancelled, but that Coin's Burn infliction and Burn Count increase do not activate.
messages.火傷と振動: 各スキルは対象の火傷と振動の合計で威力が上がる。S2「親指へ尊重を: **Burn and Tremor**: Each skill gains power from the target's combined Burn and Tremor. S2 Respect the Thumb. triggers Tremor Burst if the target has at least 6 Tremor.
messages.S3: 灼熱推進弾を3つ以上持っていれば基本威力・ダメージ量が上がり、破壊不能コ: **S3**: With 3 or more Scorch Propellant Ammo, Base Power and damage rise and its Coins become Unbreakable. It converts into Tremor - Scorch, and Coin Ⅲ triggers Tremor Burst up to 3 times.
messages.弾丸の補給: バトルパッシブ「弾丸上納」(傲慢×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)により: **Resupplying ammo**: Through the combat passive Ammunition Tribute (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), the 1 ally earliest in team order among those who use ammo, if they have less than half their ammo after attacking, is resupplied by spending his Scorch Propellant Ammo (once per battle; 1 more is supplied to higher-ranking Thumb Identities).
messages.S1・S2で振動を積み(火傷は他の味方かS3で補う)、灼熱推進弾が3つ以上あるう: Stack Tremor with S1 and S2 (cover Burn with other allies or S3), and layer Tremor Bursts with S3 while he still has 3 or more Scorch Propellant Ammo. Paired with allies who use ammo (especially Thumb Identities), he also acts as a resupplier. The value of a single round differs by Identity, so place a high-value ammo Identity (such as Meursault's The Thumb East Capo IIII) earliest in team order among the ammo users.
messages.血炎: 最大3、ターン終了時に1減少。自分の基本スキルで敵へ付与する火傷・破裂威: **Bloodflame [血炎]**: Maximum 3, decreasing by 1 at Turn End. +1 to the Burn and Rupture Potency his basic skills inflict on enemies. He gains 3 Bloodflame next turn on using the Defense skill Rooster's Deathstrike [鷄窮則殺] and 1 Bloodflame on using S3 Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞]. Through the passive Gamefowl, he also gains 3 Bloodflame on a turn he enters by stepping in from backup or returning.
messages.S2のコイン再使用: S2「酔いつ暴れまわってみせましょう。」はⅢコインの表面的: **S2's Coin reuse**: On Coin Ⅲ Heads Hit, S2 ... Fuel My Rampage. reuses that Coin if he has Bloodflame or is below 50% HP (once per skill). The same Heads Hit also adds Wrath damage equal to 10% of the final damage. It does not reuse on Tails.
messages.S3「血炎亂舞」: 4コインの広域乱射。戦闘開始時に血炎があるか体力が50%未満: **S3 — Bloodflame Massacre [血炎亂舞]**: A 4-Coin Unfocused Volley. If he has Bloodflame or is below 50% HP at Combat Start, all Coins become Unbreakable. +1% damage per 2% of HP lost by the target and himself, up to 50%. On Clash Lose, inflicts 2 Burn on the target and himself.
messages.火傷と破裂の合計: 各攻撃スキルは、対象の火傷と破裂の合計が6以上でコイン威力が: **Combined Burn and Rupture**: Each attack skill gains Coin Power if the target's combined Burn and Rupture is 6 or more.
messages.鴻園の君主ホンルとの連携: 「闘鶏」は「鴻園の君主」ホンルと尊命を発動したとき、: **Coordination with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan**: When Exalted Command triggers with Hong Lu's The Lord of Hongyuan, Gamefowl activates an effect that inflicts 1 Burn when skills inflict Rupture (3 times per turn). However, the data's wording does not settle whether this Identity or Hong Lu gains the effect. There is also an effect that keeps Burn damage from staggering him or reducing his HP below 1, but whether that line falls inside the Exalted Command condition is likewise unclear.
messages.破裂回数の消耗: 破裂人格としては破裂回数の消耗が激しい。: **Rupture Count consumption**: As a Rupture Identity, he consumes Rupture Count heavily.
messages.初動は守備(マッチ可能反撃)で次のターンの血炎3を確保し、S2の再使用とS3の破: Open with his Defense skill (a clashable counter) to secure 3 Bloodflame for the next turn, bringing out S2's reuse and S3's Unbreakable Coins. The 1 Bloodflame from S3 also meets the reuse condition for an S2 used later that turn. In Lord Hong Lu teams, swap him with other Heishou Identities to gain 3 Bloodflame each time he steps in from backup. Field him after other Identities have built Rupture Count, or use him in a Burn-leaning way where Count does not matter. His only ways to gain Burn himself are S3 and his Defense skill's Clash losses, so there is no need to force the self-damage-based bonuses of the combat passive Let's Get Battle-drunk (3 Wrath and 3 Gluttony Owned).
messages.守備「守」と「回」: 「守」はマッチ可能ガードで、戦闘開始時に呼吸6/8と呼吸回: **Defense skills Defend [守] and Swerve [回]**: Defend is a Clashable Guard that grants 6/8 Poise and 1/2 Poise Count at Combat Start (once per turn). If Poise Potency is 25 or more at Turn Start, it turns into the Evade Swerve, which grants Shield equal to Moonlit Azure Blade and 4 Poise Count at Combat Start.
messages.「精神一到」: ターン終了時、25を超えた分の呼吸威力を最大15まで月下青刀に変: **Singular Focus of the Mind**: At Turn End, converts Poise Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade, up to 15. On turns he equips no attack skills (including E.G.O), he restores 5 SP at Combat Start and gains 1 Slash Power Up next turn, so spamming his Defense skill does not drop his SP.
messages.月下青刀: 最大20。ターン開始時に1につきバリア2、1につきクリティカルダメー: **Moonlit Azure Blade**: Maximum 20. At Turn Start, Shield of 2 per point, and +1% Critical damage per point.
messages.S2「無名斬」: 3枠の広域乱射。Ⅱコインはクリティカル表面的中時に再使用し、そ: **S2 — Nameless Slash [無名斬]**: A 3-target Unfocused Volley. Coin Ⅱ is reused on Critical Heads Hit, and if that reuse lands Heads with 10 or more Moonlit Azure Blade, it is reused once more (the second at Uptie Ⅳ; once per skill each). Base Power also rises with Poise, up to 2.
messages.S3「落星一殺」: 1コイン。呼吸と月下青刀に応じてコイン威力・基本威力が上がる: **S3 — Fallstar Slayer [落星一殺]**: 1 Coin. Coin Power and Base Power rise with Poise and Moonlit Azure Blade. Before attacking, +1 Attack Weight per 10 Moonlit Azure Blade (up to 2), and after attacking, spends 7/5 Moonlit Azure Blade per Attack Weight gained. If there are fewer targets than its Attack Weight, +30/50% damage per missing target. At 20 Moonlit Azure Blade, all Coins are Unbreakable.
messages.バトルパッシブ「整剣」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に(傲慢共: **Combat passive — The Orthodox Blade [整劍] (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, gains (Pride Resonance ÷ 2) + 1 Poise, up to 4. At Combat End, +1 Poise Count if Poise is 20 or more.
messages.最初の2〜3ターンは攻撃スキルを装着せずに「守」を使い、呼吸を溜める。呼吸が20: For the first 2–3 turns, use Defend without equipping attack skills to build Poise. Switching to attacks once Poise is around 20 works well. Build 2 Pride Resonance every turn to activate The Orthodox Blade too. Bringing Moonlit Azure Blade to 10 or more unlocks S2's second reuse and S3's Attack Weight increase, which is where he hits his stride. When Poise Count is about to run out, top it up with Swerve. His slow start makes him weak in short fights, and he shines in drawn-out battles and boss fights with Unbreakable Coins.
messages.双極性のS1・S2: 味方を対象にでき、S1「ラ・ピュルシオン」は味方の体力・精: **Duality S1 and S2**: They can target allies: S1 La Pulsion restores an ally's HP and SP, and S2 L'Appétit grants 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Desperate Hunger (plus 4 Charge Count for Charge Identities). If the target is a Le Rouge ally, S1's HP healing alone is replaced with "spend 20% HP and grant 2 Power Up" (the SP recovery still applies), and S2 spends 10% of their HP to additionally grant 2 Offense Level Up.
messages.絶え間ない飢えと高貴な品格: 脈動回数の消耗、味方の回復、味方の体力減少などで溜: **Relentless Hunger and Noble Dignity**: It builds through spending Pulsation Count, healing allies, reducing allies' HP, and more (up to 150, up to 50 per turn). If it is 100 or more at Turn End, the lower skill in his leftmost slot becomes La Voracité next turn, and at Combat Start the first time he equips it, he gains Noble Dignity (unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ). In Noble Dignity, his equipped basic skills change into dedicated skills and start inflicting the special Bleed L'Abject.
messages.脈動と暴走: 脈動は特殊充電(回数最大20)。戦闘終了時に暴走状態でなく脈動回数: **Pulsation and Uncontrollable Rampage**: Pulsation is a special Charge (up to 20 Count). At Combat End, if he is not in Uncontrollable Rampage and has 15 or more Pulsation Count, he spends all of it and gains 3 Uncontrollable Rampage next turn (raised Offense Level and Speed, no Stagger, and no death from Bleed, but he also gains Bleed). At Combat Start, the Defense skill La Fuite spends HP to raise Pulsation Count to 15 if he has no Rampage and less than 15 Count, so it likely serves as a way into Rampage.
messages.味方の体力消耗: 幼年期のS3「ル・バテーム・ルージュ」は戦闘開始時に味方2名の: **Draining allies' HP**: Childhood's S3 Le Baptême rouge spends 15% HP from 2 allies at Combat Start (prioritizing Le Rouge members, 25% for them). In Noble Dignity, Je m'abjecte spends 15% HP from 2 allies and La Voracité from 3 allies before attacking. La Castration (which it turns into at 150 Hunger) spends 50% of a Le Rouge ally's current HP to grant 3 Uncontrollable Rampage. Through the passive La Moisson, allies are never staggered or brought below 1 HP by the costs from this Identity's basic skill effects.
messages.序盤はS1・S2で味方を支援しつつ飢えを溜め、高貴な品格に移ってから出血とラブジ: Early on, support allies with S1 and S2 while building Hunger, then attack with Bleed and L'Abject after moving into Noble Dignity. He has many effects that drain allies' HP, and Le Rouge allies (currently Ishmael's Haute Couture:: Boutique du Rouge) take those costs first. If there are not 3 or more other Le Rouge allies, it is better to swap S3 (which drains 2 allies' HP) for his Defense skill (Evade). If he unintentionally changes into Noble Dignity in that state, also swap S2 for a counter along with S3. With a full set of Le Rouge allies, the usual flow of moving into Noble Dignity and attacking works fine.
messages.精神力を大きく払って1コインから大量の破裂を付与する、精神減少を苦にしない人格向: A starting Gluttony Slash E.G.O for Identities unbothered by SP loss, paying a lot of SP to inflict heavy Rupture from a single Coin.
messages.表裏で変わる1コイン: 表面的中時は破裂を付与して精神力が10減る。裏面的中時は: **A single Coin that changes with Heads or Tails**: On Heads Hit, it inflicts Rupture and he loses 10 SP. On Tails Hit, he recovers 10 SP. On Heads, combined with the 10 Sanity cost, he effectively pays 20.
messages.破裂の付与量: 破裂回数を与える他の攻撃と組み合わせると、破裂を一気に積める。: **Rupture amount**: Combined with other attacks that grant Rupture Count, it stacks Rupture quickly.
messages.パッシブ「不安定」: 1つのスキルで直前のコインと別の面が出ると、精神力-5とダ: **Passive — Unstable**: When a Coin lands on a different face from the previous Coin within one skill, he loses 5 SP and gains 1 Damage Up (up to 3 times per turn). This skill has 1 Coin, so it does not trigger it itself; it happens with other multi-Coin skills after use.
messages.耐性と侵蝕: 憤怒・傲慢が脆弱、暴食が抵抗。初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無い: **Resistances and Corrosion**: Fatal to Wrath and Pride, Endured against Gluttony. As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.破裂を積みたい相手に撃つ。破裂付与の別攻撃と合わせると効果が大きい。: Fire it at enemies you want to stack Rupture on. It is more effective combined with other Rupture-inflicting attacks.
messages.撃つと次ターン以降も精神力が下がるので、精神力に余裕のあるときに使う。: Using it lowers his SP on later turns too, so use it when he has SP to spare.
messages.精神減少が利点になる人格なら、長期戦では早めに使って低精神を保つ手もある。: For Identities who benefit from SP loss, using it early in long fights to keep SP low is also an option.
messages.Ⅱ: 「不安定」が解放される。精神力が減る効果が主なので、利点は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Unstable. Its main effect is reducing SP, so the benefit is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が10から14、破裂が6から12になる。本格的な性能はここから。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 10 to 14, and Rupture from 6 to 12. This is where it gets serious.
messages.Ⅳ: 表面的中時に次ターンの攻撃威力増加1、裏面的中時に保護1を得る。使う機会が: **Ⅳ**: Grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn on Heads Hit and 1 Protection on Tails Hit. It sees little use, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.握らんとする者: 3つの攻撃スキルが精神力を減らす(7・10・15)ので、精神減: **[The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005)**: His three attack skills reduce his SP (7, 10, 15), so the SP-loss downside barely affects him, and S3 (Wrath) supplies Wrath.
messages.剣契殺手: S1(暴食)とS2(憤怒)で必要資源の暴食・憤怒を自給できる。: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:1002)**: S1 (Gluttony) and S2 (Wrath) supply the required Gluttony and Wrath himself.
messages.敵を倒すと全員を回復し、パッシブで倒したスキル属性の資源を5つ得られる、資源回収: A Wrath Blunt E.G.O suited to resource gathering, healing everyone on kills and, through its passive, granting 5 resources of the killing skill's Sin.
messages.討伐で全員回復: 敵討伐時に全味方の体力を最大値の10%(解析Ⅲは15%)回復し: **Team heal on kills**: On defeating an enemy, heals all allies by 10% of max HP (15% at Threadspin Ⅲ) and grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
messages.止めを刺す設計: 対象の体力が25%未満のときダメージ量が上がる(10%、解析Ⅲ: **Built for finishing**: Deals more damage when the target is below 25% HP (10%, 20% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 40% at Ⅳ). Suited to finishing off enemies below 25% HP.
messages.パッシブ「生贄の儀式」: 攻撃・反撃スキルで敵を倒すと、倒したスキル属性の資源を: **Passive — Live Offering**: Defeating an enemy with an attack or counter skill grants 5 resources of the killing skill's Sin. Its main use is likely farming resources by defeating weak enemies, then funneling them into high-cost E.G.O later.
messages.減算コイン: コイン威力-8の1コインで、マッチ威力は低め。: **Minus Coin**: A single Coin with −8 Coin Power and lowish Clash Power.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 討伐に失敗すると次ターンに出血10を得る(覚醒と条件が逆)。解析Ⅲ: **Corrosion skill**: Gains 10 Bleed next turn if it fails to defeat an enemy (the opposite condition from Awakening). Threadspin Ⅲ also adds 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.雑魚戦で人格スキルや反撃で倒して資源を貯め、強敵に使うE.G.Oの原資にする。: In fights against weak enemies, defeat them with Identity skills or counters to build resources, funding the E.G.O you use against strong enemies.
messages.覚醒そのものの火力は期待しすぎず、止めと回復に使う。: Do not expect too much damage from Awakening itself; use it for finishing blows and healing.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2、精神消耗は覚醒20・OC30。: It requires 3 Wrath and 2 Lust, with a Sanity cost of 20 for Awakening and 30 for Overclock.
messages.Ⅱ: 「生贄の儀式」が解放される。パッシブ目的ならここまでで足りる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Live Offering. If the passive is the goal, this is enough.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が24から28、回復量とダメージ補正が増え、侵蝕に攻撃威力増加3が: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 24 to 28, healing and the damage bonus increase, and Corrosion gains 3 Attack Power Up.
messages.Ⅳ: 体力25%未満の補正だけが大きくなる(覚醒40%、侵蝕50%)。侵蝕は味方: **Ⅳ**: Only the bonus against targets below 25% HP grows (40% for Awakening, 50% for Corrosion). Corrosion also increases the risk to allies, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.握らんとする者: S2(色欲)とS3(憤怒)で倒せば、必要資源の色欲・憤怒を回収: **[The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005)**: Defeating enemies with S2 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) recovers the required Lust and Wrath.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S3が憤怒で、倒せば必要資源の憤怒を5つ得られる。: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:1009)**: His S3 is Wrath, so a kill with it grants 5 of the required Wrath.
messages.敵味方を問わず体力の低い順に当て、味方には回復・クイック・資源獲得量+1を配る、: A support-specialized E.G.O, assuming Threadspin Ⅴ, that hits targets in order of lowest HP regardless of side and hands allies healing, Haste, and +1 E.G.O Resource Amp.
messages.体力の低い順に攻撃: 現体力が最も低い対象を狙う広域(加重値7)。味方に当たると: **Attacks in order of lowest HP**: A multi-target attack (7 Attack Weight) aimed at the targets with the lowest current HP. Allies it hits take 0 damage, and their Defense skills do not trigger. It is basically a one-sided attack.
messages.味方への回復と補助: 的中した味方を、的中人数ぶん(1人5%、最大20%)だけシ: **Healing and support for allies**: Allies hit are healed based on Sinclair's max HP by an amount per number of allies hit (5% per ally, up to 20%), and receive +1 Resource Amp and 2 Haste next turn.
messages.資源の回収: 資源獲得量+1で味方が次ターンに得る資源が増え、人数と行動数しだい: **Recovering resources**: With +1 Resource Amp, allies gain more resources next turn, and depending on the number of allies and actions, it can recover the resources spent.
messages.裏面の火傷: 裏面的中時に火傷7を付与する。味方に当たると味方にも付く点に注意。: **Burn on Tails**: Inflicts 7 Burn on Tails Hit. Note that allies hit also receive it.
messages.パッシブ「シチュー噴出」: 火傷を付与する基本攻撃スキルでは、加算コインなら精神: **Passive — Stew Spewage**: For basic attack skills that inflict Burn: with Plus Coins, restores 4 SP below 40 SP, or +10% damage at 40 or more. With Minus Coins, loses 4 SP above −25, or +10% damage at −25 or below.
messages.味方を多く巻き込める場面で撃つ。低体力の敵が多いと味方に飛ばず、人数が少ないと回: Fire it when it can catch many allies. With many low-HP enemies, it does not reach allies, and with few allies hit, the healing also drops.
messages.次ターンは増えた資源でE.G.Oを撃つ流れが基本。: The basic flow is to use the increased resources next turn to fire E.G.O.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2、精神消耗は覚醒15。侵蝕は資源を追加で消費して火力を出: It requires 3 Wrath and 2 Lust, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 15. Corrosion spends extra resources for damage but tends to catch the lowest-HP ally, so manage SP to avoid Corrosion.
messages.Ⅱ: 裏面的中時の火傷1のみ。単独では弱い。: **Ⅱ**: Only 1 Burn on Tails Hit. Weak on its own.
messages.Ⅲ: 威力と回復量が増え、資源獲得量+1が付く。: **Ⅲ**: Increases power and healing, and adds +1 Resource Amp.
messages.Ⅴ: 全的中で回復・資源獲得量+1・クイック2が確定し、自分の精神力と体力も回復: **Ⅴ**: All hits guarantee healing, +1 Resource Amp, and 2 Haste, and he also recovers his own SP and HP. The passive gains SP changes, and Corrosion is strengthened. This is where it becomes practical.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S1・S3が火傷を付与し(S2は回数増加)、S3(憤怒): **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:1009)**: S1 and S3 inflict Burn (S2 increases Count), and S3 (Wrath) and his Defense skill (Lust) supply the required affinities.
messages.東部親指ソルダートII: S1(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で必要資源を出せ、火傷も付与: **[The Thumb East Soldato II](persona:1013)**: S1 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply the required affinities, and he also inflicts Burn.
messages.複数の敵を斬りながら、的中のたびに体力の低い味方2名を回復する、暴食の斬撃広域・: A multi-target Gluttony Slash healing E.G.O that cuts down multiple enemies while healing the 2 allies with the lowest HP on each hit.
messages.的中ごとの回復: 的中時に現体力の比率が最も低い味方2名を、最大値の10%(解析: **Healing per hit**: On hit, heals the 2 allies with the lowest current HP ratio by 10% of max HP (12% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 15% at Ⅳ). The more targets it hits, the more the healing stacks.
messages.広域: 攻撃加重値は3。自分の体力が50%未満なら、解析Ⅲで+1、解析Ⅳで+2に: **Multi-target**: Attack Weight is 3. If his HP is below 50%, +1 at Threadspin Ⅲ and +2 at Ⅳ.
messages.破裂: 的中時に破裂3を付与する(解析Ⅲまでは表面的中時のみ)。: **Rupture**: Inflicts 3 Rupture on hit (only on Heads Hit through Threadspin Ⅲ).
messages.威力は低め: マッチ威力18~24の1コインで、強敵の大技に合わせるには向かない: **Lowish power**: A single Coin with Clash Power 18–24, not suited to matching strong enemies' big attacks.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 体力が最も高い対象を狙い、与えたダメージの一部で自分を回復する。解: **Corrosion skill**: Targets the highest-HP target and heals himself with part of the damage dealt. From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also inflicts Defense Level Down.
messages.3体以上を巻き込める場面で、体力が減った味方をまとめて回復する。: In situations where it can catch 3 or more enemies, heal multiple damaged allies at once.
messages.資源は色欲1・暴食4・傲慢2と重いので、資源を自給できる人格で使う。精神消耗は覚: Its resources are a heavy 1 Lust, 4 Gluttony, and 2 Pride, so use it with Identities that can supply them. Sanity cost is 25 for Awakening and 30 for Corrosion.
messages.回復目当てなら、体力50%未満の強化は後回しでも使える。: If healing is the goal, the below-50%-HP bonus can wait.
messages.Ⅱ: 「好餌妖精」が解放される。効果は条件が厳しく、小さな補助にとどまる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Fairy Lure. Its condition is strict, so it is only a small supplement.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復が12%になり、体力50%未満で加重値+1。: **Ⅲ**: Healing becomes 12%, with +1 Attack Weight below 50% HP.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復が15%、体力50%未満で加重値+2になり、破裂が的中時に付く。強化は: **Ⅳ**: Healing becomes 15%, +2 Attack Weight below 50% HP, and Rupture applies on hit. The upgrades pay off when his HP is low.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::紅籍: S1(暴食)・S2(傲慢)・S3(色欲)で必要資: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Red Sheet](persona:1006)**: S1 (Gluttony), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Lust) cover all required affinities, and he also inflicts Rupture.
messages.南部センク協会4課部長: S1(暴食)・S2(傲慢)・S3(色欲)で必要資源を自: **[Cinq Assoc. South Section 4 Director](persona:1008)**: S1 (Gluttony), S2 (Pride), and S3 (Lust) supply the required affinities himself.
messages.色欲共鳴で攻撃対象を増やし、火傷のない敵へ大量の火傷を付ける、減算コインの色欲打: A multi-target Lust Blunt E.G.O with Minus Coins that adds targets through Lust Resonance and loads heavy Burn onto enemies without Burn.
messages.火傷の付与: 的中時に火傷4を付与し、対象に火傷がなければさらに火傷4(侵蝕は6: **Inflicting Burn**: Inflicts 4 Burn on hit, plus 4 more (6 for Corrosion) if the target has no Burn. It is most efficient against enemies without Burn.
messages.共鳴で広域化: 加重値は3。色欲共鳴が4以上で+1(解析Ⅲ)、最大色欲完全共鳴が: **Multi-target through Resonance**: Attack Weight is 3. +1 at 4 or more Lust Resonance (Threadspin Ⅲ), and +1 more at a highest Lust Absolute Resonance of 4 or more (Threadspin Ⅳ).
messages.火傷10以上のデバフ: 覚醒は裏面的中時に次ターンの攻撃・守備威力減少を付与(解: **Debuffs at 10+ Burn**: Awakening inflicts Attack and Defense Power Down next turn on Tails Hit (Threadspin Ⅳ). Corrosion inflicts Lust Fragility and meets the condition in one hit even on targets without Burn.
messages.減算コイン: 威力16~26で、HEとしては低め。強敵の大技にマッチを合わせる使: **Minus Coins**: Power 16–26, lowish for HE. It is likely not suited to matching strong enemies' big attacks in Clashes.
messages.パッシブ「破滅の予言」: 色欲スキルが表面的中時、自分と対象へ精神力ダメージ4。: **Passive — Prophecy of Ruin**: When a Lust skill lands Heads, deals 4 SP damage to himself and the target. Defeating an enemy with a Lust skill grants 5 Lust resources.
messages.他の人格で火傷を付けきる前に、火傷のない敵へ撃って一気に積む。: Before other Identities have fully applied Burn, fire it at enemies without Burn to stack it all at once.
messages.色欲スキルを並べて共鳴を作り、広域化させる。: Line up Lust skills to build Resonance and make it multi-target.
messages.精神力を高く保ちたい人格には向かない。精神減少を使う人格で、準備技として撃つ手も: It is not suited to Identities who want to keep SP high. With an Identity that uses SP loss, firing it as a setup move is an option.
messages.必要資源は憤怒2・色欲5・嫉妬1、精神消耗は覚醒25・侵蝕30。: It requires 2 Wrath, 5 Lust, and 1 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 25 for Awakening and 30 for Corrosion.
messages.Ⅲ: 色欲共鳴4以上で加重値+1。侵蝕の色欲脆弱は1。: **Ⅲ**: +1 Attack Weight at 4 or more Lust Resonance. Corrosion's Lust Fragility is 1.
messages.Ⅳ: 最大色欲完全共鳴4以上で加重値がさらに+1。覚醒に威力減少が付き、侵蝕の色: **Ⅳ**: +1 more Attack Weight at a highest Lust Absolute Resonance of 4 or more. Awakening gains Power Down, and Corrosion's Lust Fragility becomes 2. The activation conditions do not change, so it is team-dependent.
messages.握らんとする者: S1・S2が火傷を付与し、S2(色欲)・S3(憤怒)で憤怒・色: **[The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005)**: S1 and S2 inflict Burn, and S2 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) supply Wrath and Lust (Envy is needed separately). His SP-reducing skills also mesh with the passive's SP loss.
messages.東部親指ソルダートII: S1(色欲)で色欲の資源と共鳴を稼ぎ、S3(憤怒)が火: **[The Thumb East Soldato II](persona:1013)**: S1 (Lust) earns Lust resources and Resonance, and S3 (Wrath) inflicts Burn.
messages.攻撃後に自分と体力の低い味方へバリアと涙の雫を付け、割られると沈潜を返す、憂鬱打: A multi-target Gloom Blunt defensive E.G.O that gives Shield and Blubberbubble to himself and a low-HP ally after attacking, returning Sinking when the Shield is broken.
messages.バリアと涙の雫: 攻撃後、自分と現体力が最も低い味方1名に、自分の最大体力の10: **Shield and Blubberbubble**: After the attack, gives himself and the 1 ally with the lowest current HP Shield equal to 10% of his max HP (14% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 20% at Ⅳ) and 2 Blubberbubble. It is applied after the attack, so with a slow Identity it does not arrive in time to defend that same turn.
messages.涙の雫の効果: 付いている間はターン終了時にバリアが切れない。雫付きのバリアが破: **Blubberbubble's effect**: While it lasts, the Shield does not expire at Turn End. When Shield with Blubberbubble is broken, the attacker receives a total of 4 Sinking.
messages.共鳴で拡張: 最大共鳴数が4以上なら加重値+1(解析Ⅲは共鳴数-2、最大2。対象: **Expansion through Resonance**: +1 Attack Weight if the highest Resonance is 4 or more (at Threadspin Ⅲ, Resonance − 2, up to 2, with the number of target allies increasing by the same amount). With a highest Gloom Absolute Resonance of 4 or more, Blubberbubble becomes 3.
messages.パッシブ「涙液膜」: ターン開始時にバリアがあれば保護1、涙の雫もあればさらに保: **Passive — Tear Film**: At Turn Start, gains 1 Protection if he has Shield, plus 1 more if he also has Blubberbubble.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 付与対象が自分だけになり、次ターンの挑発値が上がる。的中時に沈潜も: **Corrosion skill**: Only he receives the buffs, and his Aggro increases next turn. It also inflicts Sinking on hit.
messages.先に使って味方を守りたいので、速度の高い人格で撃つ。: You want to use it first to protect allies, so fire it with a fast Identity.
messages.解析Ⅲ以降は、共鳴を作って対象を増やすと、バリアと沈潜が複数の味方に広がる。: From Threadspin Ⅲ, building Resonance increases the number of targets, spreading the Shield and Sinking to multiple allies.
messages.バリア量はシンクレアの最大体力が基準。: The Shield amount is based on Sinclair's max HP.
messages.必要資源は色欲1・怠惰2・憂鬱3。ZAYINなので、装備していると戦闘開始時の罪: It requires 1 Lust, 2 Sloth, and 3 Gloom. As a ZAYIN, equipping it sets his Sin resistances at Combat Start to this E.G.O's (Fatal to Gluttony and Envy).
messages.Ⅲ: バリアが14%になり、共鳴数に応じて対象と加重値が増える。侵蝕のバリアと挑: **Ⅲ**: The Shield becomes 14%, and targets and Attack Weight increase with Resonance. Corrosion's Shield and Aggro also increase.
messages.Ⅳ: バリアが20%になる。侵蝕の沈潜回数が3になり、憂鬱共鳴4以上でバリアが追: **Ⅳ**: The Shield becomes 20%. Corrosion's Sinking Count becomes 3, and at 4 or more Gloom Resonance, an extra Shield is added.
messages.西部ツヴァイ協会3課: S1(色欲)・S2(憂鬱)・S3(怠惰)で必要資源が揃い: **[Zwei Assoc. West Section 3](persona:1010)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Gloom), and S3 (Sloth) cover the required affinities, and he serves as a tank who takes hits with Guard.
messages.蜘蛛の巣小指の子方: 守備「回」が月下青刀の数値だけバリアを得るので、涙の雫で持: **[The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice](persona:1015)**: His Defense skill Swerve grants Shield equal to Moonlit Azure Blade, which Blubberbubble can likely carry over.
messages.呪いを付けて攻撃後に即2回発動させ、ターン終了時の1回を待たずにデバフを稼ぐ、嫉: A single-target Envy Pierce E.G.O that applies Curse and triggers it twice immediately after attacking, earning debuffs without waiting for the single Turn End trigger.
messages.呪いの前倒し発動: 攻撃後、対象に呪いがあれば該当効果を即2回発動し、呪いが2減: **Early Curse triggers**: After the attack, if the target has Curse, its effect triggers twice immediately and Curse decreases by 2. Curse normally triggers only once at Turn End, giving a random debuff next turn (Attack or Defense Power Down, Offense or Defense Level Down).
messages.呪いと釘の付与: 的中時に呪い2と釘2(解析Ⅲは3)を付与する。呪いと釘を除くマ: **Inflicting Curse and Nails**: Inflicts 2 Curse and 2 Nails (3 at Threadspin Ⅲ) on hit. Additional Curse is added per 3 negative effects other than Curse and Nails (2 at Threadspin Ⅳ), up to 2. Nails is a special Bleed that inflicts Bleed at Turn Start.
messages.嫉妬共鳴で広域化: 加重値は1。嫉妬共鳴が4以上で+1(解析Ⅲ)、解析Ⅳは共鳴3: **Multi-target through Envy Resonance**: Attack Weight is 1. +1 at 4 or more Envy Resonance (Threadspin Ⅲ), and at Threadspin Ⅳ, +1 per 3 Resonance (up to 2).
messages.マッチ威力減少: 呪いが4以上の対象へ的中時、そのターンのマッチ威力減少1(解析: **Clash Power Down**: On hit against a target with 4 or more Curse, inflicts 1 Clash Power Down that turn (Threadspin Ⅳ, once per turn).
messages.パッシブ「薄汚れた皮」: 戦闘開始時に自分へマイナス効果があれば、マッチ威力増加: **Passive — Grimy Hide**: If he has a negative effect at Combat Start, he gains 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up. 1 Protection per 3 negative effects, up to 2.
messages.先に呪いを積み、このE.G.Oで前倒し発動させて次ターンのデバフを重ねる。発動タ: Stack Curse first, then use this E.G.O to trigger it early, layering debuffs for the next turn. The debuffs do not apply on the turn they trigger.
messages.威力は低め(基本威力7、解析Ⅳは9)なので、ダメージ役ではなくデバフ役として使う: Its power is lowish (7 Base Power, 9 at Threadspin Ⅳ), so use it as a debuffer rather than a damage dealer.
messages.必要資源は色欲2・傲慢2・嫉妬2、精神消耗は覚醒20・侵蝕25。: It requires 2 Lust, 2 Pride, and 2 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20 for Awakening and 25 for Corrosion.
messages.Ⅲ: 釘が3になり、表面的中時に次ターンの束縛2(1ターン1回)。嫉妬共鳴4以上: **Ⅲ**: Nails becomes 3, and it inflicts 2 Bind next turn on Heads Hit (once per turn). +1 Attack Weight at 4 or more Envy Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 基本威力が9、加重値が共鳴3につき+1になり、マッチ威力減少が付く。: **Ⅳ**: Base Power becomes 9, Attack Weight becomes +1 per 3 Resonance, and Clash Power Down is added.
messages.西部ツヴァイ協会3課: 振動を扱うスキルがあり、「薄汚れた皮」のマイナス効果の条: **[Zwei Assoc. West Section 3](persona:1010)**: Has skills that handle Tremor, likely meshing with Grimy Hide's negative effect condition. His Defense skill is a Clashable Guard that can use the Clash and Defense Power Up.
messages.中指末弟: S2・S3と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬共鳴を作って加重値を伸ばしやすい。: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:1012)**: S2, S3, and his Defense skill are Envy, making it easy to build Envy Resonance and raise Attack Weight.
messages.埋花針を溜め、自分の体力と引き換えに広域の2コイン目を再使用して大ダメージを出す: A self-sacrificing Gluttony Pierce E.G.O that builds Flower-burying Pin and, at the cost of his own HP, reuses its multi-target second Coin for heavy damage.
messages.埋花針: 攻撃前に暴食共鳴の数だけ得る(最大5)。ターン終了時と被ダメージ時に1: **Flower-burying Pin**: Before attacking, he gains as many as his Gluttony Resonance (up to 5). It increases by 1 at Turn End and when taking damage (up to 20), with +1 Offense Level per 5. Without Gluttony Resonance, he gains none.
messages.自傷と不許: 攻撃前に(埋花針×2)の体力ダメージを受ける。混乱はせず、戦闘開始: **Self-damage and Denial**: Before attacking, he takes (Flower-burying Pin×2) HP damage. He is not staggered, and Denial [不許], gained at Combat Start, lets him survive damage that would bring his HP to 0, dying at Turn End instead.
messages.2コイン目の再使用: 的中時、自分の現体力が30%未満か埋花針が20なら、このコ: **Reusing the second Coin**: On hit, if his current HP is below 30% or Flower-burying Pin is 20, this Coin is reused. When the reuse hits, he spends all of his HP and it gains +20% damage. A strike that trades his life, and this is its core strength.
messages.強化: 埋花針が6以上でコイン威力+1(解析Ⅲ)。解析Ⅳは6につき+1(最大3): **Bonuses**: +1 Coin Power at 6 or more Flower-burying Pin (Threadspin Ⅲ). At Threadspin Ⅳ, +1 per 6 (up to 3), plus +1% damage per 2% HP lost (up to 40%).
messages.精神力の分割払い: 攻撃後3ターン、ターン終了時に精神力が10減る。パッシブ「泣: **SP paid in installments**: For 3 turns after the attack, he loses 10 SP at each Turn End. The passive Crying Tears offsets part of it by recovering 5 at Turn End when he has a negative effect or lost HP or SP.
messages.体力30%未満の瀕死時に使うか、一度使って被弾し埋花針を20まで溜めてから使う。: Use it when he is near death below 30% HP, or use it once, take hits to build Flower-burying Pin to 20, and then use it.
messages.暴食共鳴を作らないと埋花針が増えないので、暴食スキルを並べる。: Flower-burying Pin does not increase without Gluttony Resonance, so line up Gluttony skills.
messages.再使用を狙わない通常の使い方は、威力が控えめと考えられる。侵蝕スキルは敵味方識別: Used normally without aiming for the reuse, its power is likely modest. The Corrosion skill cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies, so there is little reason to use it actively.
messages.必要資源は色欲2・暴食6・傲慢2、精神消耗は覚醒10。: It requires 2 Lust, 6 Gluttony, and 2 Pride, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 10.
messages.Ⅲ: 破裂付与が2から3になり、埋花針6以上でコイン威力+1。: **Ⅲ**: Rupture infliction goes from 2 to 3, and +1 Coin Power at 6 or more Flower-burying Pin.
messages.Ⅳ: 埋花針による強化が6ごとに伸び、失った体力に応じたダメージ量増加が加わる。: **Ⅳ**: The Flower-burying Pin bonus grows per 6, and the damage increase based on lost HP is added.
messages.北部ヂェーヴィチ協会3課: S1(色欲)・S2(暴食)と守備(暴食)で色欲・暴食: **[Devyat' Assoc. North Section 3](persona:1011)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Gluttony), and his Defense skill (Gluttony) supply Lust and Gluttony resources and build Gluttony Resonance, and he also inflicts Rupture.
messages.中指末弟: 守備は失った体力に応じたバリアを得る反撃で、被弾を前提とする溜め方と: **[The Middle Little Brother](persona:1012)**: His Defense skill is a counter that grants Shield based on HP lost, likely meshing with a buildup that relies on taking hits.
messages.体力を削りながら3コインを再使用して火傷と出血を撒き、味方にリズムを配る、憤怒斬: A multi-target Wrath Slash attacker E.G.O that reuses its third Coin while cutting into its own HP, spreading Burn and Bleed and handing Rhythm to allies.
messages.コインの再使用: 3枚目のコインが表面的中すると、体力が10%以上なら4~8の自: **Coin reuse**: When the third Coin lands Heads, if his HP is 10% or more, he takes 4–8 self-damage and reuses the Coin (up to 4 times per skill; no Stagger or death). Each reuse adds 1 Burn and 1 Bleed.
messages.出血と火傷で強化: メインターゲットの出血と火傷の合計2につきマッチ威力+1(最: **Bonuses from Bleed and Burn**: +1 Clash Power per 2 combined Bleed and Burn on the main target (up to 6, 8 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 10 at Ⅳ). Damage also increases with the ratio of HP lost (up to 10%, 15% at Ⅲ, 20% at Ⅳ). Damage to sub-targets is −50%.
messages.リズムと精神力の配布: 的中時にランダムな味方へ次ターンのリズムを付け、討伐時は: **Distributing Rhythm and SP**: On hit, gives Rhythm next turn to a random ally, and on kills, 2 to all allies. After the attack, restores SP to the allies with low SP (1 + highest Resonance, up to 4).
messages.パッシブ「それは、リズムでした」: ターン開始時にリズム2を得る。討伐時に体力と: **Passive — That... was Indeed a Rhythm**: Gains 2 Rhythm at Turn Start. Recovers HP and SP on kills, doubled for kills with this E.G.O. It also recovers at the end of turns in which his SP decreased.
messages.精神力の分割払い: 攻撃後2ターン、戦闘終了時に精神力が8減る。: **SP paid in installments**: For 2 turns after the attack, he loses 8 SP at Combat End.
messages.精神力が高いほど表が出やすく再使用が伸びるので、精神力の高いうちに撃つ。: Higher SP makes Heads more likely and extends the reuse chain, so fire it while his SP is high.
messages.出血・火傷を付けた複数の敵に撃つ。敵が1体だと真価を出しにくい。: Fire it at multiple enemies with Bleed and Burn. Against a single enemy, it struggles to show its value.
messages.マッチ威力は低めなので、一方攻撃で当てる。自傷が重なるため体力の管理が要る。: Its Clash Power is lowish, so land it as a one-sided attack. The self-damage piles up, so HP management is required.
messages.必要資源は憤怒3・色欲2・怠惰1・傲慢1・嫉妬1、精神消耗は覚醒10。: It requires 3 Wrath, 2 Lust, 1 Sloth, 1 Pride, and 1 Envy, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 10.
messages.Ⅱ: 「それは、リズムでした」が解放される。優先度が高い。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks That... was Indeed a Rhythm. High priority.
messages.Ⅲ: マッチ威力・ダメージ量の上限、精神力の回復量、リズムの付与量が増える。: **Ⅲ**: Raises the caps on Clash Power and damage, SP recovery, and Rhythm infliction.
messages.Ⅳ: 同じ項目がさらに増える。強化幅は控えめ。: **Ⅳ**: The same items increase further. The upgrade is modest.
messages.夜明事務所フィクサー: S1〜S3が火傷を付与し、S3(憤怒)・S2(嫉妬)で必: **[Dawn Office Fixer](persona:1009)**: S1–S3 inflict Burn, and S3 (Wrath) and S2 (Envy) also supply the required affinities.
messages.黒獣-酉: S3が失った体力でダメージ量を上げ、自傷を重ねるこのE.G.Oと噛み: **[Heishou Pack - You Branch](persona:1014)**: His S3 gains damage from HP lost, meshing with this E.G.O's stacking self-damage. S1 (Lust) and S3 (Wrath) also supply resources.

messages.低いなきごえ: 守備「回」が月下青刀の数値だけバリアを得るので、涙の雫で持ち越せ: **[Cavernous Wailing](ego:1006)**: His Defense skill Swerve grants Shield equal to Moonlit Azure Blade, which Blubberbubble can likely carry over.

messages.汚血泣涙: S1(色欲)・S2(暴食)と守備(暴食)で色欲・暴食の資源と暴食共鳴: **[Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:1008)**: S1 (Lust), S2 (Gluttony), and his Defense skill (Gluttony) supply Lust and Gluttony resources and build Gluttony Resonance, and he also inflicts Rupture.
messages.汚血泣涙: 守備は失った体力に応じたバリアを得る反撃で、被弾を前提とする溜め方と: **[Tears of the Tarnished Blood [汚血泣淚]](ego:1008)**: His Defense skill is a counter that grants Shield based on HP lost, likely meshing with a buildup that relies on taking hits.

messages.S1「抜剣」: スキル1ながら3コインで、攻撃レベルは人格Lv+3。コインが多い: **S1 — Pulled Blade**: Despite being Skill 1, it has 3 Coins and an Offense Level of Identity Lv +3. With many Coins, a single Tails rarely loses her the Clash. Coin Ⅱ inflicts 2 Rupture on hit (only on Heads Hit at lower Uptie), and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 1 Rupture on Heads Hit.
messages.S2「背後斬り」: 2コイン。対象より速度が速ければ、各コインのダメージ量+20: **S2 — Backslash**: 2 Coins. If she is faster than the target, each Coin deals +20% damage (+10% at lower Uptie).
messages.S3「突き抜く」: 1コインでコイン威力+14。対象の体力が50%以上ならダメー: **S3 — Piercing Thrust**: 1 Coin with +14 Coin Power. +20% damage if the target has 50% or more HP, and Rupture Count increases by 1 on hit.
messages.耐久の低さ: 防御レベルは人格Lv-4。マッチに負けたときの被害が大きいので、ぶ: **Low durability**: Her Defense Level is Identity Lv −4. Losing Clashes hurts a lot, so she needs to pick who to throw her skills at.
messages.パッシブ: バトルパッシブ「処刑」(怠惰×4・保有)は精神力0未満の対象への与ダ: **Passives**: The combat passive Executor (4 Sloth Owned) gives +10% damage against targets below 0 SP. The support passive Military Mindset (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives +30% damage to the 1 ally with the highest current HP when attacking enemies below 0 SP.
messages.S1はコインが多くマッチが安定するので、主力として積極的に振る。ただしS1の威力: S1 has many Coins and stable Clashes, so use it actively as her main skill. However, S1's power range is narrow, so avoid Clashing strong skills with it and deflect those with S3's high Coin Power instead. Use S2 against opponents she can outspeed, and land S3 on high-HP enemies early in the fight for a big chunk of damage that leads into allies' follow-ups. S1 and S2 alone cover the resources for her starting E.G.O To Páthos Máthos, making her self-sufficient.
messages.S2→S3の連携: S2のⅡコインの表面的中時に、次のターンの斬撃ダメージ量増加: **S2 into S3**: On Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit of S2, she gains 2 Slash DMG Up next turn (1 at lower Uptie). S3 is Slash and gains +2 Final Power if the target is below 50% HP (below 25% at lower Uptie).
messages.止めの補正: バトルパッシブ「冷静」(傲慢×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得)で、体力2: **Finishing bonus**: The combat passive Levelheaded (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) gives +20% damage to attacks against enemies below 25% HP. When Coin Ⅱ of S3 lands a Critical Hit, it shifts the first Stagger Threshold by 20% of the damage dealt.
messages.サポートパッシブ「確殺」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も高い味: **Support passive — Double Tap (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the highest SP deals +30% damage when attacking enemies below 25% HP.
messages.呼吸: S1のⅠコインの的中時に呼吸4(低い同期化段階では表面的中時に2)を得て: **Poise**: She gains 4 Poise on Coin Ⅰ hit of S1 (2 on Heads Hit at lower Uptie), and S1 gains +1 Coin Power at 5 or more Poise. The Defense skill Evade gains +3 Coin Power at 6 or more Poise. Her only way to increase Poise Count is S2's Clash Win (+2 Count, +1 at lower Uptie).
messages.S1・S2でマッチを取りながら敵の体力を削り、S2を当てた次のターンに、体力の減: Wear enemies down while taking Clashes with S1 and S2, and on the turn after landing S2, finish weakened enemies with S3. Her Poise Count supply is small, making Poise hard to sustain on her own. Meursault's Blade Lineage Mentor's passive increases the Poise Potency and Count of the 2 Blade Lineage Identities other than the Mentor with no Poise or the least Poise by 1 each time the Mentor gains Poise from skill or Coin effects, so he serves as a Poise supplier. Her own performance falls behind later Identities, but Double Tap is easy to use and also helpful in backup.
messages.味方の支援: S1「指揮」は的中時に速度が最も低い味方へ保護を付与。S2「攻撃命: **Supporting allies**: S1 Order gives Protection to the slowest ally on hit. S2 Onslaught Command gives 1 Attack Power Up and Damage Up to the slowest ally.
messages.沈潜: S1は対象の沈潜5以上でスキル威力+2。S3「気合」は沈潜5(表面的中な: **Sinking**: S1 gains +2 Skill Power if the target has at least 5 Sinking. S3 Focus is a 1-Coin skill that inflicts 5 Sinking (plus 4 more on Heads Hit) and 2 Attack Power Down.
messages.バトルパッシブ「士気高揚」(怠惰×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 次のターン開始時: **Combat passive — Morale Boost (2 Sloth Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At the start of the next turn, gives 2 Haste to herself and the allies who were on both sides of her the previous turn.
messages.S1・S2の支援は速度が最も低い味方に自動で入るため受け手の速度を意識して編成し: S1's and S2's support automatically goes to the slowest ally, so build the team with the recipient's Speed in mind, and inflict Sinking and Attack Power Down with S3. The passive also hands Speed to the allies on both sides of her.
messages.マッチ威力減少: S1〜S3はマッチ進行時に対象のマッチ威力を下げる(S3は-2: **Clash Power Down**: S1–S3 lower the target's Clash Power during Clashes (−2 for S3).
messages.デバフ: S1「予測分析」で次のターンの麻痺1と、その場で破裂1、S2「現場指揮: **Debuffs**: S1 Predictive Analysis inflicts 1 Paralyze next turn and 1 Rupture immediately, S2 Field Command inflicts Rupture Count and 2 Defense Level Down next turn, and S3 Exploit the Gap inflicts 2 Offense Level Down and Weakness Analyzed next turn.
messages.S3: 対象の破裂7以上でコイン威力+2。Ⅲコインでダメージの15%分の斬撃追加: **S3**: +2 Coin Power if the target has at least 7 Rupture. Coin Ⅲ deals additional Slash damage equal to 15% of the damage.
messages.バトルパッシブ「弱点把握」(暴食×3・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 相手の弱点・脆弱: **Combat passive — Grasping Vulnerabilities (3 Gluttony Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +10% damage when attacking with an affinity the target is Fatal or Weak to.
messages.マッチ威力減少で競り勝ちながら破裂とデバフを重ね、S3で弱点分析を入れて次のター: Win Clashes through Clash Power Down while stacking Rupture and debuffs, then apply Weakness Analyzed with S3 to help allies' attacks land the next turn.
messages.スキルを捨てる: S2と守備「二日酔いの解消」は、使用時に自分の全スキルスロット: **Discarding skills**: On use, S2 and the Defense skill Hangover Cure discard the lowest-rank skill from all of her skill slots. On use, S3 discards all skills in descending order of rank (skills not used that turn). The Defense skill's discard happens on use, so it does not trigger unless she is attacked.
messages.S1「待て！」は捨てて得をする: 捨てられると自分の振動回数+4(低い同期化段階: **S1 Wait Up! pays off when discarded**: When discarded, her Tremor Count increases by 4 (+3 at lower Uptie). S2 only grants 1 Offense Level Up when discarded, so keep it as her main skill.
messages.自分の振動回数: S1の使用時に+2され、6以上でS1の最終威力+2(低い同期化: **Her own Tremor Count**: +2 on using S1, and at 6 or more, S1 gains +2 Final Power (+1 at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅲ of S2 triggers Tremor Burst on hit if her own Tremor Count is 6 or more.
messages.S3: 使用時に自分の振動回数を10消耗してコイン威力+2(低い同期化段階では+: **S3**: On use, spends 10 of her own Tremor Count for +2 Coin Power (+1 at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅰ inflicts 4 Tremor (+3 Tremor Count if she spent), and Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ trigger Tremor Burst 3 times (each followed by −1 target Tremor Count).
messages.バトルパッシブ「武勇伝」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 敵に振動爆発を起こ: **Combat passive — Drinking Boast (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Each time she triggers Tremor Burst on an enemy, deals Sloth damage equal to 30% of the Stagger Threshold shift (up to 20, rounded down).
messages.サポートパッシブ「横暴と応援」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 振動回数が最: **Support passive — Carrot & Stick (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 to the Tremor Count that the 1 ally with the most Tremor Count gains from skill effects. It speeds up preparation for Identities that power up by spending their own Tremor Count (for example, Yi Sang's Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush, whose S2 spends 6 of his own Tremor Count).
messages.S1がパネルに並んだら、S2や守備でS1を捨て、空いた枠にS2・S3を引き込んで: When S1s line up on the panel, discard them with S2 or her Defense skill, pulling S2 and S3 into the freed slots to use repeatedly. Each S1 discarded builds her own Tremor Count, making S2's Tremor Burst and S3's bonus conditions easier to meet. Tremor Burst's effect is determined by the target's Tremor Potency, and her own infliction is limited to S2 (2 Tremor each on Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ, 1 each at lower Uptie) and S3 (4 Tremor), so pair her with allies who can stack Tremor on enemies. Note that her play changes depending on how well she can discard S1.
messages.守備「ルトレット」: スキルレベル人格Lv+5、マッチ威力5~15。自分の速度が: **Defense skill — Retraite**: Skill Level Identity Lv +5, Clash Power 5–15. The faster she is than the attacker, the higher its Coin Power, +1 per point of Speed difference (up to 3; +1 if faster at lower Uptie). Grants 1 Poise on a successful Evade (up to 10, 5 at lower Uptie).
messages.挑発値とクイック: S1「マルシュ」は使用時に次のターンのクイック2と挑発値3(: **Aggro and Haste**: S1 Marche grants 2 Haste and 3 Aggro next turn on use (1 at lower Uptie). S2 also grants 4 Aggro next turn on use (2 at lower Uptie).
messages.バトルパッシブ「いなす」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 回避成功時、次のタ: **Combat passive — Redirect (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On a successful Evade, gains 1 Haste next turn and pushes her own Stagger Threshold back by 5 (up to 3 times; only Haste at lower Uptie).
messages.S2「ピュニスィオン」: 自分の速度が対象より高ければコイン威力+2(低い同期化: **S2 — Punition**: +2 Coin Power if she is faster than the target (+1 at lower Uptie). Grants +2 Poise Count on use, 2 Poise with Coin Ⅰ, and inflicts 2 Bind next turn on Coin Ⅱ hit (1 at lower Uptie).
messages.S3「バレストラフォント」: 1コイン(8~22)。呼吸7以上なら最終威力+4(: **S3 — Balestra Fente**: 1 Coin (8–22). +4 Final Power with 7 or more Poise (+2 at lower Uptie). On hit, inflicts Declared Duel - Outis (+1 Clash Power in Clashes against the marked target, 1 Haste next turn on hitting attacks, up to 4 times per turn) and gives 2 Haste next turn to the 2 slowest allies (1 at lower Uptie).
messages.集中戦闘ではS1・S2で挑発値を取り、次のターンに集まった攻撃を「ルトレット」で: In Focused Encounters, take Aggro with S1 and S2, then evade the gathered attacks all together with Retraite the next turn. The more she outspeeds them, the stronger the Evade, and each successful Evade grants Haste and pushes back her Stagger Threshold through Redirect, so the more she keeps evading, the easier it is to maintain Speed and durability. S2 is her main attack, and S3 is for dealing with high-rolling enemy skills or applying Declared Duel to a single boss. Evade is unreliable at low SP, so securing SP is a challenge. Her contribution to damage is small.
messages.黒炎: 特殊火傷(最大7)。数値だけ対象の防御レベルを下げ、ターン終了時に(数値: **Dark Flame**: A special Burn (up to 7). Lowers the target's Defense Level by its value, deals (value × target's Burn) Pride damage at Turn End, then disappears. S1 Ignition's Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Dark Flame next turn, and Coin Ⅱ of S1 and S2 inflicts Burn equal to the target's Dark Flame. She has no effects that increase Burn Count.
messages.S2「魔弾起爆」: Ⅰコインの的中時、魔弾が4未満なら魔弾が1増え、次のターンに: **S2 — Detonate Magic Bullet**: On Coin Ⅰ hit, if Magic Bullet is below 4, Magic Bullet increases by 1 and inflicts Dark Flame equal to Magic Bullet next turn. At 4 or more, this effect does not trigger.
messages.魔弾とS3: 魔弾は最大7。S3は攻撃前に魔弾が1増え、攻撃加重値が魔弾の値にな: **Magic Bullet and S3**: Magic Bullet has a maximum of 7. Before attacking, S3 increases Magic Bullet by 1, and its Attack Weight becomes the Magic Bullet value (multiple targets at 2 or more). The more Magic Bullet, the higher S3's Base Power and Coin Power, and on hit it inflicts Dark Flame equal to Magic Bullet next turn. At 7, it resets to 0 after the attack.
messages.精神力の代償: S3は攻撃前に(魔弾-1)×5だけ精神力が減り、精神力10以下な: **SP cost**: Before attacking, S3 lowers her SP by (Magic Bullet − 1)×5, and at 10 or less SP, there is a 50% chance it attacks without distinguishing friend from foe. The Defense skill The Price of a Bullet increases Magic Bullet by 1 (once per turn) and gains +2 Final Power per Magic Bullet, but lowers her SP by the Magic Bullet count when it ends.
messages.火傷で強化: S1は対象の火傷3につきコイン威力+1(最大3)、S2は対象の火傷: **Burn bonuses**: S1 gains +1 Coin Power per 3 Burn on the target (up to 3), S2 +1 per 6 Burn (up to 3), and S3 +1% damage per Burn on the target (up to 30%).
messages.バトルパッシブ「射手のパイプ」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): メインターゲ: **Combat passive — The Marksman's Smoking Pipe (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If the main target's Defense Level is lowered by 4 or more, she gains Poise equal to the main target's Burn before attacking (up to 20 per turn; Burn ÷ 2 at lower Uptie).
messages.火傷を付与・維持できる味方の多い編成に入れ、S1・S2で黒炎を重ねて、ターン終了: Put her in a team with many allies who can apply and maintain Burn, and stack Dark Flame with S1 and S2 to grow the Turn End Pride damage. S2 is the center of Dark Flame infliction, but it loses that effect at 4 or more Magic Bullet. S3 adds 1 Magic Bullet before attacking and only resets to 0 at 7, so landing S2 at 3 brings it to 4, and firing S3 afterward brings it to 5. From then on, S2's Dark Flame infliction stays stopped until it resets at 7, and it does not recover naturally. Aim to finish things around 3–4 Magic Bullets. The more Magic Bullet, the larger S3's SP cost and the higher the risk of friendly fire, so check her SP before firing. Building Magic Bullet all at once with the Magic Bullet E.G.O and then resetting with S3 keeps things cycling. Allies who can restore SP make her easier to handle.

messages.1ターン目は「先鋒隊」で目を得るため、憂鬱3共鳴を組む。自分の憂鬱スキルはS3と: On turn 1, build 3 Gloom Resonance to gain Udjat through Vanguard Team.
