messages.Ⅳ: 加重値が4になり、体力の消耗が10%に減って、ダメージ増加の上限が30%に: **Ⅳ**: Attack Weight becomes 4, the HP cost drops to 10%, and the damage increase cap becomes 30%.
messages.W社3級整理要員チーフ: 充電を増やして消費する人格で、S1と守備が傲慢、S2が: **[W Corp. L3 Cleanup Captain](persona:1110)**: An Identity who increases and spends Charge, whose S1 and Defense skill are Pride, S2 Envy, and S3 Gloom, also supplying the required affinities.
messages.魔弾の数で性質が変わる貫通攻撃で火傷と黒炎を大量に配り、魔弾人格の魔弾射撃へつな: A Pride E.G.O whose Pierce attack changes with the number of Magic Bullets, handing out heavy Burn and Dark Flame and chaining into the Magic Bullet Identity's Magic Bullet Fire.
messages.魔弾の消費: 攻撃前に魔弾が0なら1を得る。撃つ弾丸は魔弾の数値で決まり、1〜7: **Spending Magic Bullets**: If Magic Bullet is 0 before attacking, she gains 1. The bullet fired is determined by the Magic Bullet value, and the effect changes greatly from the 1st to the 7th (the 6th grants +6 Attack Weight; the 7th grants +200% damage but she dies at the end of the attack).
messages.魔弾の補充: 攻撃後に最大共鳴数(1〜4)だけ魔弾を得る。: **Replenishing Magic Bullets**: After the attack, she gains Magic Bullets equal to the highest Resonance (1–4).
messages.火傷と黒炎: Ⅰコインが的中時に魔弾の数だけ火傷と黒炎を付与する。黒炎は防御レベ: **Burn and Dark Flame**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts Burn and Dark Flame equal to the number of Magic Bullets on hit. Dark Flame lowers Defense Level and deals (value × target's Burn) Pride damage at Turn End.
messages.火傷によるダメージ増加: 対象の火傷3につきダメージ量+1%(最大10%)。解析: **Damage from Burn**: +1% damage per 3 Burn on the target, up to 10%. 2% (up to 20%) at Threadspin Ⅲ and 3% (up to 30%) at Ⅳ.
messages.パッシブ「7つの弾丸」: 基本攻撃スキルの的中時に(魔弾÷3)だけ火傷を付与する: **Passive — Seven Bullets**: Basic attack skills inflict (Magic Bullet ÷ 3) Burn on hit. For the Magic Bullet Identity, it inflicts Burn equal to the number of Magic Bullets (up to 3 times per turn). If the target's Burn Potency is 30 or more, it inflicts 1 Dark Flame instead (up to 2 times per turn).
messages.魔弾人格が主な使い手で、魔弾を上乗せしてから魔弾射撃で撃ち切る流れが基本と考えら: The Magic Bullet Identity is its main user, and the basic flow is likely adding Magic Bullets with this, then emptying them with Magic Bullet Fire.
messages.黒炎のダメージは敵の火傷に比例する(数値×対象の火傷)ので、火傷を先に積んでから: Dark Flame's damage scales with the enemy's Burn (value × target's Burn), so stack Burn first before firing.
messages.魔弾が少ないと、的中時に付与する火傷・黒炎の数も少ない。: With few Magic Bullets, it inflicts little Burn and Dark Flame on hit.
messages.魔弾7のときに撃ち切ると、魔弾射撃の人格では魔弾が初期化される。7つ目の弾丸は攻: Emptying them at 7 Magic Bullets resets Magic Bullets for the Magic Bullet Fire Identity. The 7th bullet kills her at the end of the attack.
messages.Ⅱ: 「7つの弾丸」が解放される。火傷編成の火力に関わる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Seven Bullets. It affects Burn teams' damage.
messages.Ⅲ: 火傷によるダメージ増加が2%になり、メインターゲット撃破時に火傷持ちの全敵: **Ⅲ**: The Burn-based damage increase becomes 2%, and the Dark Flame applied to all Burning enemies when the main target is defeated increases to 3.
messages.Ⅳ: 火傷によるダメージ増加が3%になり、撃破時の黒炎が4に増える。解析の費用に: **Ⅳ**: The Burn-based damage increase becomes 3%, and Dark Flame on kills increases to 4. Whether it is worth the Threadspin cost is doubtful, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::魔弾: パッシブの火傷付与が魔弾の数だけに強化される専用: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Magic Bullet](persona:1107)**: The dedicated Identity whose passive Burn infliction is strengthened to the number of Magic Bullets; her S2, S3, and Defense skill are Pride, supplying the required affinity, and her S3 Magic Bullet Fire resets Magic Bullets at 7.
messages.蜘蛛の巣中指の親方: 火傷と出血を付与する人格で、S1が色欲で必要資源の色欲を出: **[The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115)**: An Identity who inflicts Burn and Bleed, whose S1 is Lust, supplying the required Lust.
messages.マッチに勝つと余った嫉妬資源を足りない資源へ変換でき、パッシブで強敵に威力減少も: An Envy Resonance E.G.O with an Unbreakable Coin that, on Clash Win, converts spare Envy resources into missing resources, with a passive that also inflicts Power Down on strong enemies.
messages.資源の変換: マッチ勝利時、嫉妬共鳴の数だけ嫉妬資源を消耗し、最も少ない資源を1: **Resource conversion**: On Clash Win, spends Envy resources equal to Envy Resonance and gains the resources she has least of, 1 at a time (up to 4, 5 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 6 at Ⅳ).
messages.マッチ敗北時: 最終威力が4下がる代わりに、嫉妬共鳴数×5のバリアを得る(最大2: **On Clash Lose**: Final Power drops by 4, but she gains Shield of Envy Resonance×5 (up to 20, 25 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 30 at Ⅳ). The conversion only works on a win, so use it when she can win.
messages.一方攻撃に注意: 破壊不能コインで、一方攻撃では「破壊されずに的中時」の回復が発: **Beware one-sided attacks**: It has an Unbreakable Coin, and in one-sided attacks, the healing "on hit without being broken" does not trigger.
messages.デバフと回復: 的中時に針2・釘1(解析Ⅲから呪い1)を付与する。破壊されずに的: **Debuffs and healing**: Inflicts 2 Needles and 1 Nails on hit (plus 1 Curse from Threadspin Ⅲ). When it hits without being broken, heals the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio by 6% of max HP (8% at Ⅲ, 10% at Ⅳ) (allies other than herself must have an Envy basic attack).
messages.パッシブ「呪いの罰ゲーム」: マッチ勝利時に対象へ嫉妬ダメージ4。自分か対象の体: **Passive — Loser's Penalty: Voodoo**: Deals 4 Envy damage to the target on Clash Win. If her or the target's HP is below 33%, inflicts 1 Power Down next turn (once per turn).
messages.嫉妬共鳴を高く保てる編成で、スキル1の代わりに撃って嫉妬資源を他の資源に替える。: In teams that can keep Envy Resonance high, fire it in place of Skill 1 to trade Envy resources for other resources. It is good for securing resources that are hard to produce with Identity skills.
messages.嫉妬主体でない編成では、ほぼパッシブ目当てのE.G.Oになると考えられる。: In teams that are not Envy-centered, it is likely an E.G.O used mostly for its passive.
messages.必要資源は色欲1・嫉妬3、精神消耗は覚醒15。使用中の罪悪耐性は、怠惰・憂鬱が脆: It requires 1 Lust and 3 Envy, with an Awakening Sanity cost of 15. While in use, her Sin resistances switch to Fatal to Sloth and Gloom, Endured against Envy, and Normal for the rest.
messages.侵蝕スキルは1枠3コインで、嫉妬共鳴に応じた広域化とデバフが中心。詳細はスキル欄: The Corrosion skill is a single 3-Coin slot centered on multi-target attacks and debuffs based on Envy Resonance. See the skill section for details.
messages.Ⅲ: 変換量・回復量・バリア量が増え、呪い1が加わる。嫉妬編成でよく使うなら価値: **Ⅲ**: Increases the conversion amount, healing, and Shield, and adds 1 Curse. Valuable if you use it often in Envy teams.
messages.Ⅳ: Ⅲとほぼ同じ項目がさらに強化される。余裕があれば。: **Ⅳ**: Strengthens nearly the same items as Ⅲ further. If you can spare it.
messages.蜘蛛の巣中指の親方: 嫉妬のスキルが中心で、嫉妬完全共鳴6を前提にした効果を持ち: **[The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115)**: Centered on Envy skills, with effects that assume 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, boosting this E.G.O's conversion amount and Shield.
messages.ト・パソス・マソス: S1・守備が怠惰、S2が傲慢で必要資源を出せ、破裂付与のス: **[To Páthos Máthos](ego:1101)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Sloth and S2 is Pride, supplying the required affinities, and she has Rupture-inflicting skills.
messages.ト・パソス・マソス: S3と守備が傲慢で傲慢資源を賄える。: **[To Páthos Máthos](ego:1101)**: Her S3 and Defense skill are Pride, covering the Pride resources.
messages.黒い枝: S1〜S3と守備が破裂の付与か破裂回数の増加を持ち、S2・守備(暴食): **[Ebony Stem](ego:1102)**: S1–S3 and her Defense skill inflict Rupture or increase Rupture Count, and S2, her Defense skill (Gluttony), and S3 (Gloom) also supply the required affinities. She uses Speed difference, meshing with Bind.
messages.黒い枝: S1・守備が暴食、S3が色欲で資源を出せ、S1・S2は破裂を付与・増加: **[Ebony Stem](ego:1102)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Gluttony and S3 is Lust, supplying resources, and S1 and S2 inflict and increase Rupture.
messages.空即是色: 色欲のS2で出血を重ねる人格で、色欲脆弱の恩恵を受けられる。: **[Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam](ego:1103)**: An Identity who stacks Bleed with her Lust S2 and benefits from Lust Fragility.
messages.空即是色: S1と守備が色欲で、必要資源の色欲を出せ、出血を付与する。: **[Ya Śūnyatā Tad Rūpam](ego:1103)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Lust, supplying the required Lust, and she inflicts Bleed.
messages.狐雨: 呼吸を扱う人格で、S3はクリティカルダメージ増加を持ち、クリティカルの効: **[Sunshower](ego:1104)**: A Poise Identity whose S3 has a Critical damage increase, meshing with the Critical Hit effects.
messages.狐雨: S1・守備が怠惰、S2が暴食、S3が憂鬱で必要資源をすべて出せ、S3は沈: **[Sunshower](ego:1104)**: Her S1 and Defense skill are Sloth, S2 is Gluttony, and S3 is Gloom, supplying all required affinities, and S3 inflicts Sinking.
messages.ホリデイ: S1が傲慢、S3が色欲で資源を出せ、S1・S3でクイックを付与して速: **[Holiday](ego:1105)**: Her S1 is Pride and S3 is Lust, supplying resources, and S1 and S3 grant Haste, making it easy to secure Speed.
messages.ホリデイ: S1が傲慢、S2・守備が怠惰、S3が色欲で資源を賄え、振動を扱う人格: **[Holiday](ego:1105)**: Her S1 is Pride, S2 and Defense skill Sloth, and S3 Lust, covering the resources, and as a Tremor Identity she meshes with Tremor Burst.
messages.拘束: S1が憤怒、S2が色欲、S3と守備が怠惰で必要資源を3種出せ、振動爆発を: **[Binds](ego:1106)**: Her S1 is Wrath, S2 Lust, and S3 and Defense skill Sloth, supplying three of the required affinities, and she uses Tremor Burst.
messages.拘束: 振動を付与し、S2で振動-鎖への振幅変換と振動爆発を行う人格で、S1が傲: **[Binds](ego:1106)**: A Tremor-inflicting Identity whose S2 performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Chain and Tremor Burst; her S1 is Pride and S2 Sloth.
messages.次元裂き: 充電を増やして消費する人格で、S1と守備が傲慢、S2が嫉妬、S3が憂: **[Dimension Shredder](ego:1107)**: An Identity who increases and spends Charge, whose S1 and Defense skill are Pride, S2 Envy, and S3 Gloom, also supplying the required affinities.
messages.魔弾: パッシブの火傷付与が魔弾の数だけに強化される専用の人格で、S2・S3と守: **[Magic Bullet](ego:1108)**: The dedicated Identity whose passive Burn infliction is strengthened to the number of Magic Bullets; her S2, S3, and Defense skill are Pride, supplying the required affinity, and her S3 Magic Bullet Fire resets Magic Bullets at 7.
messages.魔弾: 火傷と出血を付与する人格で、S1が色欲で必要資源の色欲を出せる。: **[Magic Bullet](ego:1108)**: An Identity who inflicts Burn and Bleed, whose S1 is Lust, supplying the required Lust.
messages.私はチョキを出すね、そっちは？: 嫉妬のスキルが中心で、嫉妬完全共鳴6を前提にし: **[I'll Go fer Scissors. How 'Bout You?](ego:1109)**: Centered on Envy skills, with effects that assume 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, boosting this E.G.O's conversion amount and Shield.
messages.サポートパッシブ「因子コードG-0」(憂鬱×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 編成中: **Support passive — Gene Code G-0 (3 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in the team but not participating in battle, heals 5 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest current HP at Combat Start. It can trigger every turn without spending resources, so it works well in dungeons with many turns, and it is this Identity's centerpiece.
messages.バトルパッシブ「強制生存」(憂鬱×3・保有): 戦闘参加中、戦闘開始時に自分の体: **Combat passive — Forced Survival (3 Gloom Owned)**: While participating in battle, he heals 5 of his own HP at Combat Start.
messages.S3「切り刻む」: 対象に破裂があれば各コインのダメージ量+10%。Ⅱコインの表: **S3 — Chop Up**: Each Coin deals +10% damage if the target has Rupture. On Coin Ⅱ Heads Hit, he heals HP equal to 30% of the damage dealt.
messages.破裂と貫通脆弱: S1「斬る」は表面的中時に破裂2(同期化段階が上がると4)を付: **Rupture and Pierce Fragility**: S1 Swipe inflicts 2 Rupture on Heads Hit (4 at higher Uptie) but does not increase Rupture Count. S2 Jag adds +1 Rupture Count with Coin Ⅰ and inflicts 2 Rupture and 1 Pierce Fragility on Heads Hit. On his own, Rupture Count runs short and tends to disappear before S3.
messages.罪悪属性: S1が憂鬱、S2が暴食、S3が怠惰。S2・S3でE.G.O《まやかし: **Sin affinities**: S1 is Gloom, S2 Gluttony, and S3 Sloth. S2 and S3 cover the resources for the E.G.O Legerdemain.
messages.鏡ダンジョンなど長丁場では、編成に入れたまま戦闘不参加にして「因子コードG-0」: In long runs such as the Mirror Dungeon, keeping him in the team but out of battle as a healer through Gene Code G-0 is effective. It heals the lowest-HP ally first, so note that it can break the conditions of Identities that rely on "below X% HP." When deploying him, treat S1's and S2's Rupture as a bonus, deal damage with his Pierce S2 and S3, and hold out with S3's Coin Ⅱ healing and Forced Survival.
messages.火傷6以上で強化: S1「一点突き」・S2「一網打尽」は対象の火傷6以上でコイン: **Bonuses at 6+ Burn**: S1 Single-point Stab and S2 Rush Down gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Burn, and S3 Perfected Palm Strike deals +10% damage. On Coin Ⅲ hit, S2 grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn if the target has at least 6 Burn.
messages.火傷威力の付与: 各コインで火傷1を付与し、S2のⅢコイン・S3のⅣコインは的中: **Inflicting Burn Potency**: Each Coin inflicts 1 Burn, and Coin Ⅲ of S2 and Coin Ⅳ of S3 inflict 3 Burn on hit. The effect text has no mention of increasing Burn Count (whether S1's "inflict 1 Burn" is Potency or Count cannot be determined from the wording).
messages.バトルパッシブ「発火」(怠惰×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): スキルの3つ目以降の: **Combat passive — Ignition (3 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Inflicts 1 Burn on hits from the third and later Coins of a skill. With this, landing all of S2's Coins reaches 6 Burn (1+1+3+1).
messages.サポートパッシブ「ひた走る心」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 編成中かつ戦: **Support passive — Rushing Heart (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in the team but not participating in battle, Coins after the third of the 1 slowest ally deal +30% damage.
messages.マッチ威力が低い: S1は最大8、S2は最大11、S3は最大12。: **Low Clash Power**: S1 tops out at 8, S2 at 11, and S3 at 12.
messages.自分では火傷回数を足せないため、火傷回数を付与する人格と組んで火傷を保つ。S2・: He cannot add Burn Count himself, so pair him with Identities who inflict Burn Count to keep Burn going. Bring the target's Burn to 6 or more with S2 and S3, then attack with the bonuses on S1–S3. His Clash Power caps are low, so prepare for strong attacks with E.G.O. When he is not deployed, make use of Rushing Heart in teams with slow allies who have multi-Coin skills.
messages.吸血: S1「切り払う」はⅠコインで与ダメージの30%(同期化段階が上がると的中: **Lifesteal**: S1 Hack heals HP equal to 30% of damage dealt with Coin Ⅰ (50% on hit at higher Uptie), S2 heals 50% of damage, and S3 Eviscerate heals 100% with Coin Ⅳ. It scales with damage dealt, so hitting staggered enemies increases the healing.
messages.S2「四肢切断」(マッチの主力): 1コインでマッチ威力6〜16(同期化段階が低: **S2 Dismember (main Clash skill)**: 1 Coin with Clash Power 6–16 (5–15 at lower Uptie). Inflicts 5 Rupture on Coin Ⅰ hit. Used on a target that already has 5 or more Rupture, it deals +50% damage (the 5 Rupture he inflicts himself does not arrive in time for this skill's condition).
messages.S1: マッチ勝利時にダメージ量+40%(同期化段階が低いと+20%)。: **S1**: +40% damage on Clash Win (+20% at lower Uptie).
messages.破裂関連はおまけ: S1・S3は対象の破裂5以上でコイン威力+1。S3のⅠ〜Ⅲコ: **Rupture effects are a bonus**: S1 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Rupture. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ of S3 deal additional damage equal to 30% of the damage dealt if the target has Rupture. His own Rupture infliction is only S2's 5 Rupture, and he cannot increase Rupture Count.
messages.パッシブ: バトル「緊急食糧補給」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得)は、体力25: **Passives**: The combat passive Emergency Rations (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) heals 5% HP on Clash Win below 25% HP. The support passive Gene Code G-3 (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) heals 5 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP when they win a Clash.
messages.危険なマッチはS2で受け、マッチ威力の上限が12のS3は敵の隙(一方攻撃)に回し: Take dangerous Clashes with S2, and send S3, whose Clash Power caps at 12, into openings (one-sided attacks) to deal damage and heal. Treat Rupture's extra damage as a bonus if you can get it. His Sins are Gluttony for S1, Sloth for S2, and Lust for S3. He alone covers the resources for Legerdemain, and using them together greatly changes how easily he plays. When he is not deployed, Gene Code G-3 makes him a healer in regular battles with many actions.
messages.麻痺で味方のマッチを助ける: S1「鮮度維持」はⅠコインで麻痺1(対象に出血があ: **Helping allies' Clashes with Paralyze**: S1 Keep It Fresh inflicts 1 Paralyze with Coin Ⅰ (plus 1 Paralyze next turn if the target has Bleed), and S3 Butcher Viand inflicts 1 Paralyze each with Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ. Paralyze fixes the Coin Power of that many Coins to 0 for 1 turn.
messages.マッチ威力が低い: S1は4〜8、S3は5〜9。S2「新鮮な材料か？」は6〜14: **Low Clash Power**: S1 is 4–8 and S3 is 5–9. S2 You Fresh Enough? is 6–14 and gains +3 Coin Power if he is at least 3 faster than the target.
messages.出血と束縛: S2のⅠコインで出血回数+2・次のターンに束縛2(同期化段階が低い: **Bleed and Bind**: Coin Ⅰ of S2 adds +2 Bleed Count and 2 Bind next turn (1 each at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅱ of S1 and Coin Ⅰ of S3 inflict 1 Bleed. S1 deals +30% damage if the target has at least 4 Bind, S3 gains +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 10 Bleed Count, and Coin Ⅳ of S3 heals HP in proportion to the target's Bleed (up to 20%).
messages.サポートパッシブ「調理補助」(色欲×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 編成中かつ戦闘: **Support passive — Culinary Aid (5 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in the team but not participating in battle, heals 5 HP to the 1 ally with the lowest HP at Combat Start. It also adds +5 to the healing of Ryōshū's R.B. Chef de Cuisine passive Rustle Up.
messages.バトルパッシブ「パイ包み」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時に自分: **Combat passive — Packed Pies (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Heals 8 of his own HP at Combat Start.
messages.マッチは味方に任せ、空いた敵にS1・S3で一方攻撃して麻痺を入れ、次のマッチを有: Leave Clashes to allies, and land one-sided attacks with S1 and S3 on free enemies to apply Paralyze and tilt the next Clashes in your favor. When a Clash is unavoidable, use S2. Rather than Clashing with S1, it is better to hold out with Guard (Clash Power up to 16). S3's 10-Bleed-Count condition is hard to meet without support from allies who inflict Bleed Count. In long dungeons, keeping him out of battle as a healer through Culinary Aid is also a strong option.
messages.振動で破裂が増える: S1「エンジン始動」・S3「切り刻もうか」は、対象の振動回: **More Rupture from Tremor**: S1 Rev Up and S3 Let's Grind 'Em inflict 3 extra Rupture if the target has at least 5 Tremor Count (Coin Ⅰ of S3 triggers Tremor Burst and reduces Tremor Count by 2, so getting the extra on Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ calls for 7 or more before use). S3 gains +1 Coin Power at 5 or more Tremor Count.
messages.充電: S1・S2「チェーン潤滑」の使用時に充電回数が増える。S3のⅠコインで振: **Charge**: Charge Count increases on using S1 and S2 Grease Chains. Coin Ⅰ of S3 triggers Tremor Burst and spends up to 4 Charge Count to increase Rupture Count by that much.
messages.S2: 振動回数と破裂回数を増やす。: **S2**: Increases Tremor Count and Rupture Count.
messages.バトルパッシブ「鋸刃稼働」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 振動がある対象に: **Combat passive — Sawblade Fired Up (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +1 Rupture inflicted on targets with Tremor.
messages.振動は他の人格で付与しておき、S2で振動回数を伸ばしてから(単独で届くかは要検証: Have other Identities apply Tremor first, extend Tremor Count with S2 (whether it reaches the threshold on its own needs verification), then inflict heavy Rupture with S1 and S3. Against staggered enemies, Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ of S3 gain +10% damage.
messages.高めの速度と挑発値で敵の攻撃に割り込み、防御レベル増加で受け止めるタンク。S3「: A tank who cuts in on enemy attacks with fairly high Speed and Aggro and absorbs them with Defense Level Up. S3 Guardian hands Defense Power Up and Defense Level Up to all allies, also strengthening allies' Defense skills.

messages.S1・S2で自傷しながら挑発値を上げて攻撃を受け、血餐と手を貯める。体力が減り、: Take attacks while raising Aggro and harming himself with S1 and S2, building Bloodfeast and Hand. Once his HP is down and Hand has built up enough, fire S3 to gain healing and damage at the same time. Maximum output often requires a second cycle of skills. He has only a single Stagger Threshold at 80%, and after his self-damage drops him below 80%, a single enemy hit staggers him. If needed, deliberately get the Stagger out of the way early. More actions mean more self-damage, so a later position in team order is best.

messages.序盤はS1・S2で燃料を使って火傷と火傷回数を配り、50以下の過熱燃料状態になっ: Early on, use Fuel with S1 and S2 to spread Burn and Burn Count, and once in Overheated Fuel at 50 or less, attack hard with S3. messages.呪殺【毒】: S2のⅢコインとS3で付与する(基本値5)。バトルパッシブ「黒獣化: **Deathrite【Venom】**: Inflicted by Coin Ⅲ of S2 and by S3 (base value 5). messages.序盤は守備かS3で巳腕を得る。守備はマッチ威力3〜13のマッチ可能ガードで、混乱: Early on, gain Serpent Arm with his Defense skill or S3. His Defense skill is a Clashable Guard with Clash Power 3–13, and with 3 Stagger Thresholds he is fragile, so do not overuse it. Hit enemies with Rupture to stack Serpent Arm's 5 Poise, growing it to around 20. Prioritize S1 for one-sided attacks, keeping Count up with its on-use Poise Count increase. Once Poise has built up, aim for big damage with S3. Short battles tend to end before Poise builds, so he shows his true strength in longer fights.
messages.傷: S1「隙を突く」・S2「スティレット・ドッピオ」・S3「エクセキューション: **Open Wound**: Inflicted by S1 Gap Attack, S2 Stiletto Doppio, and S3 Execution (up to 2). At Turn End, it inflicts 1 Bind for the next turn, and at 2 it turns into Deep Wound.

messages.「メルチェ」: S2は敵(本体)の体力が20%以下か対象に致命的な傷があるとき、: **Mercé**: An execution technique that triggers from S2 when the enemy (main body) is at 20% HP or less or the target has Fatal Wound, and from Execution additionally when the target is staggered. messages.ランプから眩惑へ: ランプは最大8。ターン開始時に1を得るほか、「灯りのような眼: **From Lamp to Dazzle**: Lamp has a maximum of 8. Besides gaining 1 at Turn Start, he gains 1 per 2 Gloom Resonance through Eyes Bright Like Lamps (up to 3), and at Combat Start, the Defense skill The Wick of Burned Feathers fills it up to 8 (self-damage equal to 1% of max HP per point gained; HP does not drop below 1). messages.眩惑: 沈潜と火傷の合計1につき、基本攻撃スキルによる被ダメージ量+0.5%(最: **Dazzle**: +0.5% damage taken from basic attack skills per combined Sinking and Burn, up to 10%. Enemies with SP have their Panic Type changed to Dazzle, and enemies without SP get −2 Defense Level. It decreases by 1 at Turn End (it refreshes rather than stacks).
messages.スキルの強化条件: 各攻撃スキルは「対象の速度が自分より3以上高い」「自分の速度: **Skill bonus conditions**: Each attack skill is strengthened if any of these holds: "the target is at least 3 faster than him," "his Speed is 1 or less," or "the target has Dazzle," and also gains +1 Coin Power at 6 or more combined Sinking and Burn on the target. messages.速度の扱い: 常時発動の「眩惑のランプ」により、速度の最小・最大値は外部効果で変: **Handling Speed**: Through the always-active Dazzling Lamp, his minimum and maximum Speed are not changed by external effects. When he would gain Haste, he gains 1 Clash Power Up instead (once per turn). In Focused Encounters, when selecting skills, he can redirect an enemy attack skill's target to himself regardless of Speed. Even though he is slow, he can draw enemy attacks to himself and take the Clash.
messages.バトルパッシブ「灯りのような眼」(憂鬱×2・共鳴・同期化Ⅱで取得): 眩惑のある: **Combat passive — Eyes Bright Like Lamps (2 Gloom Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If an enemy has Dazzle, restores 5 SP at Combat Start (3 at lower Uptie). messages.集中戦闘では1ターン目に守備でランプを8にし、次のターンにボスへ眩惑3を付ける。: In Focused Encounters, fill Lamp to 8 with his Defense skill on turn 1, then apply 3 Dazzle to the boss next turn. Attack with S3 and S2 while Dazzle lasts. Paired with allies who inflict Burn and Sinking, he meets both Dazzle's damage-taken increase and each skill's 6-or-more total condition. In regular battles, targets tend to die soon after being Dazzled, so it is better to build Lamp gradually and aim for the Speed condition through Bind. On the turn after Lamp hits maximum, 10 Aggro is added, making it easier to gather attacks (the effect text applies it to the "leftmost slot"). Make use of his durability to absorb them.
messages.味方への充電供給: 「前へ出たまえ。サポートするとしよう。」(憂鬱×2・嫉妬×2: **Supplying Charge to allies**: Take the Lead. I'll Provide You Support. (2 Gloom and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) adds +10 to his Charge Count at Combat Start (+5 at lower Uptie; once per battle). At "Combat End" (per the data; it likely triggers at each Turn End in practice), if his Charge Count exceeds 12, he spends up to 8 of the excess and gives half of it to 1 ally earlier than him in team order (prioritizing allies with low Charge Count). messages.Ⅳ: 放出電流が15になり、侵蝕スキルの攻撃加重値が3になる。: **Ⅳ**: Spark Discharge becomes 15, and the Corrosion skill's Attack Weight becomes 3.
messages.バラのスパナ工房フィクサー: 充電と破裂を扱い、S2が嫉妬、S3が憂鬱で必要資源: **[Rosespanner Workshop Fixer](persona:1205)**: Uses Charge and Rupture, and his S2 is Envy and S3 Gloom, supplying the required affinities.
messages.LCE E.G.O::AEDD: 充電を軸にする人格で、S2が憂鬱、S3が嫉妬。: **[LCE E.G.O:: AEDD](persona:1215)**: A Charge-centered Identity whose S2 is Gloom and S3 Envy. He also inflicts Rupture.
messages.罪悪共鳴の数に応じて、複数の味方を回復しつつ、共鳴した属性のバフを配る回復・補助: A healing and support E.G.O that heals multiple allies based on the number of Sin Resonance while handing out buffs for the resonating Sin.
messages.共鳴数に比例する強化: 最も高い共鳴が3以上なら攻撃加重値が増える(解析Ⅲで最大: **Bonuses scaling with Resonance**: If the highest Resonance is 3 or more, Attack Weight increases (up to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ, up to 3 at Ⅳ). The number of buff and healing targets also increases with more Resonance.
messages.バフ: 最も高い共鳴の属性について、ダメージ量増加と威力増加を1ずつ味方に付与す: **Buffs**: Gives allies 1 Damage Up and 1 Power Up for the Sin of the highest Resonance. At 4 or more Resonance, extra Damage Up is added, and at Threadspin Ⅲ with 5 or more Resonance, extra Power Up is added too.
messages.次ターンへの持ち越し(解析Ⅳ): 完全共鳴6以上なら、同じバフが次のターンにも付: **Carrying over to the next turn (Threadspin Ⅳ)**: With 6 or more Absolute Resonance, the same buffs also apply next turn.
messages.回復: 体力比率が最も低い味方を最大値の15%(解析Ⅲで18%、Ⅳで22%)回復: **Healing**: Heals the ally with the lowest HP ratio by 15% of max HP (18% at Threadspin Ⅲ, 22% at Ⅳ).
messages.重い資源: 全属性2つずつの計14個が必要で、精神消耗は30。: **Heavy requirements**: Needs 14 resources, 2 of every Sin, with a Sanity cost of 30.
messages.特定の属性に偏った編成で、共鳴を作ったターンに撃つ。: Fire it on turns when a team skewed toward a specific Sin has built Resonance.
messages.資源が偏りやすい編成では、14個を揃えるのが前提になる。: In teams whose resources tend to be lopsided, gathering all 14 is the premise.
messages.パッシブ「薔薇の冠」は敵に破裂2を付与するが、数値が小さい。: The passive Crown of Roses inflicts 2 Rupture on enemies, but the value is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 回復とバフの対象が増え、共鳴5以上で威力増加が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases healing and buff targets, and adds Power Up at 5 or more Resonance.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量と対象が大きく増え、完全共鳴6でバフを持ち越せる。使うなら強化したい: **Ⅳ**: Greatly increases healing amount and targets, and buffs carry over at 6 Absolute Resonance. If you use it, upgrade it.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド 神父: S3と守備が色欲で、このE.G.Oの色欲共鳴に加わり: **[The Priest of La Manchaland](persona:1210)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Lust, making it easy to join this E.G.O's Lust Resonance. He also has plenty of self-healing.
messages.LCE E.G.O::AEDD: S3と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬共鳴を作りやすい。: **[LCE E.G.O:: AEDD](persona:1215)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Envy, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.沈潜を消費して精神力を回復する覚醒と、憂鬱脆弱を押し込む侵蝕を持つ、沈潜編成向け: A Pierce E.G.O for Sinking teams, with an Awakening that consumes Sinking to restore SP and a Corrosion skill that pushes in Gloom Fragility.
messages.精神力の回復: 攻撃後に自分と、精神力が最も低い味方2名の精神力を10回復する(: **SP recovery**: After the attack, restores 10 SP to himself and the 2 allies with the lowest SP (12 at Threadspin Ⅲ, 15 at Ⅳ).
messages.沈潜の消費で上乗せ: 対象が生き残った場合、対象の沈潜回数を5消耗し(解析Ⅳで3: **Bonus from consuming Sinking**: If the target survives, it spends 5 of the target's Sinking Count (3 at Threadspin Ⅳ) and adds healing equal to the target's Sinking Potency (total capped at 20).
messages.撃破時の拡散: 対象が死亡した場合は、ランダムな敵2名(解析Ⅳで3名)へ沈潜3を: **Spread on kills**: If the target dies, inflicts 3 Sinking on 2 random enemies (3 at Threadspin Ⅳ). From Threadspin Ⅲ, it also adds 1 Curse.
**Passive — If I Could Go Back...**: If the target is dead at the end of the attack, he gains 1 of the E.G.O resource he has least of. +1 more per 5 combined Sinking Potency and Count on the target (up to 3).
messages.侵蝕スキル: 憂鬱脆弱・沈潜回数・呪いを付与する攻め寄りの性能。解析Ⅳでは呪い持: **Corrosion skill**: An offense-leaning skill that inflicts Gloom Fragility, Sinking Count, and Curse. At Threadspin Ⅳ, damage against Cursed targets becomes +50%.
messages.沈潜が十分に乗った敵に撃ち、精神力を回復する。沈潜を削るので、使いどころを選ぶ。: Fire it at enemies with plenty of Sinking to restore SP. It reduces Sinking, so choose when to use it. Awakening is supplementary, and running it around the Corrosion skill that pushes in Gloom Fragility is likely also an option (Corrosion cannot distinguish friend from foe and can hit allies).
messages.敵を倒せる場面で撃つと、資源の補充にもなる。: Firing it when it can defeat an enemy also replenishes resources.
messages.Ⅱ: 「戻れるなら...」が解放される。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks If I Could Go Back...
messages.Ⅲ: 回復量と呪いが増え、侵蝕の憂鬱脆弱の追加条件が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Increases healing and Curse, and adds an extra Gloom Fragility condition to Corrosion.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量がさらに増え、沈潜の消耗が3に減る。侵蝕は呪い持ちに強くなる。: **Ⅳ**: Further increases healing, and Sinking consumption drops to 3. Corrosion becomes stronger against Cursed targets.
messages.エドガー家 継承者: 沈潜を付与する人格で、S2・守備が憂鬱、S3が色欲。必要資: **[Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)**: A Sinking-inflicting Identity whose S2 and Defense skill are Gloom and S3 Lust, supplying the required affinities.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::ランプ: S2が憂鬱で、沈潜を付与できる。: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Lamp](persona:1214)**: His S2 is Gloom, and he can inflict Sinking.
messages.精神力が高いうちに撃つと最大8コインを撃ち込み、蝶を大量に付与する、沈潜編成向け: A multi-Coin Blunt E.G.O for Sinking teams that, fired while his SP is high, unloads up to 8 Coins and inflicts heavy Butterfly.
messages.広域乱射: 攻撃加重値は3だが、コインごとに攻撃対象を1体選ぶ。1枚目はメインタ: **Unfocused Volley**: Attack Weight is 3, but each Coin picks one target. The first Coin hits the main target. Against a single enemy, all Coins hit that enemy.
messages.コイン再使用: 3枚目のコインは的中時に精神力を2~6減らし、自分の精神力が0以: **Coin reuse**: The third Coin lowers his SP by 2–6 on hit and is reused while his SP is 0 or higher (up to 5 times). The higher his SP, the more reuses.
messages.蝶: 的中ごとに蝶を付与する特殊な沈潜で、最大15。蝶1つごとに、表面が出る確率: **Butterfly**: A special Sinking inflicted on each hit, up to 15. Each Butterfly becomes a Dead Butterfly with the chance of landing Heads, or a Living Butterfly otherwise.
messages.パッシブ「哀悼」: ターン終了時にマイナス効果を持っていれば、次のターンに攻撃威: **Passive — Lament**: If he has a negative effect at Turn End, he gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn. +15% damage against targets in Panic or E.G.O Corrosion.
messages.重い資源: 色欲1・怠惰2・憂鬱2・嫉妬2の計7個で、精神消耗は25。: **Heavy requirements**: 7 resources in total: 1 Lust, 2 Sloth, 2 Gloom, and 2 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 25.
messages.精神力が満タンに近いときに撃つ。精神力が低いと再使用が伸びない。: Fire it when his SP is close to full. With low SP, the reuse chain does not last.
messages.事前に沈潜を乗せた単体の敵へ撃つと活きる。: It pays off when fired at a single enemy already loaded with Sinking.
messages.Ⅲ: 攻撃後に、的中したコイン3の数に応じて精神力を回復する。: **Ⅲ**: After the attack, restores SP based on the number of third-Coin hits.
messages.Ⅳ: コイン威力が+2になり、マッチ威力が8~14になる。精神力の回復量も増える: **Ⅳ**: Coin Power becomes +2 and Clash Power 8–14. SP recovery also increases.
messages.エドガー家 継承者: 沈潜を扱い、S1が嫉妬、S2が憂鬱、S3が色欲で必要資源を: **[Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)**: Uses Sinking, and his S1 is Envy, S2 Gloom, and S3 Lust, supplying the required affinities.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::ランプ: S1の使用時に束縛を得るので、マイナス効果を持: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Lamp](persona:1214)**: He gains Bind on using S1, making it easy to hold a negative effect and keep Lament going.
messages.攻撃加重値5で振動と沈潜をばらまく広域斬撃で、E.G.O。: A multi-target Slash E.G.O with 5 Attack Weight that spreads Tremor and Sinking.
messages.高火力の広域: 加重値5の2コインの広域。侵蝕スキルは敵味方を問わず狙うため、同: **High-damage multi-target**: A 2-Coin multi-target attack with 5 Attack Weight. The Corrosion skill targets friend and foe alike, so beware of friendly fire.
messages.振動と沈潜: Ⅰコインで振動5を付与して振動爆発、Ⅱコインで沈潜4を付与する。: **Tremor and Sinking**: Coin Ⅰ inflicts 5 Tremor and triggers Tremor Burst, and Coin Ⅱ inflicts 4 Sinking.
messages.精神力の回復: 攻撃後に自分の体力が最大値なら、ターン終了時に精神力が10回復し: **SP recovery**: If his HP is full after the attack, he recovers 10 SP at Turn End (15 at Threadspin Ⅳ) and gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn. It does not work once his HP drops.
messages.精神力が低い敵への追撃(解析Ⅲ): 対象の精神力が0未満なら、不足ぶん1につきダ: **Follow-up against low-SP enemies (Threadspin Ⅲ)**: If the target's SP is below 0, +1% damage per point below 0 (up to 45%). It grows when Sinking drains SP.
messages.パッシブ「眠れぬ夜」: 戦闘開始時に、混乱・士気低下・パニックの敵の数だけ、全敵: **Passive — Insomniac Night**: At Combat Start, inflicts Offense Level or Defense Level Down on all enemies equal to the number of staggered, Low Morale, or panicking enemies (up to 2 times per turn).
messages.体力を保ったまま、複数の敵へ撃つ。: Fire it at multiple enemies while keeping his HP up.
messages.必要資源は怠惰2・暴食2・憂鬱2・傲慢2の計8個、精神消耗は20。: It requires 8 resources in total: 2 Sloth, 2 Gluttony, 2 Gloom, and 2 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 20.
messages.Ⅲ: 精神力が低い敵への追撃と、的中時の体力回復が加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds the follow-up against low-SP enemies and HP recovery on hit.
messages.Ⅳ: 精神力の回復量が増え、混乱した敵などに属性脆弱が付く。: **Ⅳ**: Increases SP recovery, and staggered enemies and similar receive Sin Fragility.
messages.夜の錐カピターノ: 振動と出血を扱い、S1が怠惰、S3が傲慢で必要資源の一部を出: **[Night Awls Capitano](persona:1213)**: Uses Tremor and Bleed, and his S1 is Sloth and S3 Pride, supplying some of the required affinities.
messages.エドガー家 継承者: 沈潜を重ねて敵の精神力を下げられ、S2が憂鬱で資源も出せる: **[Edgar Family Heir](persona:1209)**: Can stack Sinking to lower enemy SP, and his Gloom S2 also supplies resources.
messages.「流水」で挑発値を得るタンクになりつつ鞘を溜め、鞘40で「光輝」を撃つ二段構えの: A two-stage multi-target E.G.O: as a tank, it gains Aggro with Flowing while building Man in Scabbard, then fires Incandescence at 40 Man in Scabbard.
messages.輝かざる栄光-流水: マッチ不可で攻撃は当たらず、鞘に納められた人を1得て精神力: **Unbrilliant Glory - Flowing**: Cannot Clash and does not hit; he gains 1 Man in Scabbard and recovers 25 SP. The first time, its requirements are reduced to 1 Wrath, 1 Sloth, and 1 Pride.
messages.鞘に納められた人: 最大40。ターン終了時に10増え、自分の被ダメージなどでも溜: **Man in Scabbard**: Maximum 40. It increases by 10 at Turn End and also builds when he takes damage and similar. He gains 1 Aggro per 8 and 1 Protection per 20.
messages.輝かざる栄光-光輝: 鞘が1以上あると、2回目から「光輝」として発動する。鞘を全: **Unbrilliant Glory - Incandescence**: With 1 or more Man in Scabbard, it activates as Incandescence from the second use. It spends all Man in Scabbard to raise Attack Weight and Defense Level, and if it spent 40, the fourth Coin's damage rises greatly and he gains 2 Protection. At 40 Man in Scabbard, it can Clash and he cannot be staggered.
messages.火傷と振動: 破壊不能の1コインで火傷と振動を付け、メインターゲットの火傷と振動: **Burn and Tremor**: Its single Unbreakable Coin inflicts Burn and Tremor, and damage increases with the main target's Burn and Tremor.
messages.パッシブ「遊侠」: 自分の体力・バリアダメージや、味方の混乱・死亡で鞘が溜まる。: **Passive — Wanderer**: Man in Scabbard builds from HP and Shield damage he takes and from allies being staggered or dying. At 40 Man in Scabbard, if he is staggered by damage, he can recover from Stagger once per battle.
messages.耐性が有利な人格に持たせ、敵の主要スキルに合わせて挑発で受け止める。: Give it to an Identity with favorable resistances, and absorb the enemy's key skills with Aggro.
messages.光輝は鞘40の状態で撃つ。撃たずに鞘を保ったまま戦うのも手。: Fire Incandescence at 40 Man in Scabbard. Fighting while holding Man in Scabbard without firing it is also an option.
messages.Ⅱ: 「遊侠」が解放される。鞘の溜まりが大きく速くなる。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Wanderer. Man in Scabbard builds much faster.
messages.Ⅲ: 流水の次ターンの攻撃レベル増加が2になり、光輝のダメージ量が強化される。: **Ⅲ**: Flowing's next-turn Offense Level Up becomes 2, and Incandescence's damage is strengthened.
messages.Ⅳ: 流水がダメージ量増加も得て、光輝がさらに強化される。: **Ⅳ**: Flowing also grants Damage Up, and Incandescence is strengthened further.
messages.ラ・マンチャランド 神父: 自分で出血を得て体力を削れるため鞘が溜まりやすく、挑: **[The Priest of La Manchaland](persona:1210)**: He gives himself Bleed to wear down his own HP, making Man in Scabbard build easily, and he makes use of the Aggro and Protection.
messages.夜明事務所代表: S1が怠惰、S2が傲慢、S3が憤怒で必要資源を出せ、火傷と振動: **[Dawn Office Rep](persona:1216)**: His S1 is Sloth, S2 Pride, and S3 Wrath, supplying the required affinities, and he can inflict Burn and Tremor.
messages.共鳴数に応じた充電を溜めて一気に消費して火力に変える、嫉妬編成と充電人格向けの低: A low-cost E.G.O for Envy teams and Charge Identities that builds Charge based on Resonance and spends it all at once for damage.
messages.充電の獲得と消費: 攻撃前に(最大共鳴数+1)だけ充電回数が増え(最大7)、続け: **Gaining and spending Charge**: Before attacking, Charge Count increases by (highest Resonance + 1), up to 7, then it spends up to 15, gaining damage per point spent.
messages.束縛と火傷: 的中時に火傷を付与し、住民登録マイクロチップと、次のターンの束縛1: **Bind and Burn**: On hit, inflicts Burn, Resident Reg. Microchip, and 1 Bind next turn. Enemies with the Microchip or Bind receive more Burn Count.
messages.パッシブ「転入届の処理」: 最大共鳴数が3以上なら、メインターゲットへ、スキル的: **Passive — Processing Transfer Reg**: If the highest Resonance is 3 or more, skill hits inflict 1 Bind next turn on the main target (once per turn).
messages.低コスト: 必要資源は憤怒1・嫉妬5、精神消耗は20。: **Low cost**: Requires 1 Wrath and 5 Envy, with a Sanity cost of 20.
messages.嫉妬の共鳴を作って撃ち、束縛を撒く。: Build Envy Resonance and fire it to spread Bind.
messages.充電人格では、解析Ⅲの充電返還(充電15消耗時)も活かせる。: With Charge Identities, the Charge refund at Threadspin Ⅲ (when spending 15 Charge) can also be used.
messages.侵蝕スキルは討伐時の充電獲得が目当てで、覚醒より使う機会は少ないと考えられる。: The Corrosion skill is mainly for gaining Charge on kills, and it likely sees less use than Awakening.
messages.Ⅲ: 火傷が2、ダメージ量の上限が30%になり、充電15消耗時に充電が5戻る。Ⅱ: **Ⅲ**: Burn becomes 2, the damage cap 30%, and 5 Charge is returned when spending 15. Coin Ⅱ also increases Charge.
messages.Ⅳ: 火傷が3、ダメージ量の上限が45%になり、チップの付与量が2になる。: **Ⅳ**: Burn becomes 3, the damage cap 45%, and Microchip infliction becomes 2.
messages.LCE E.G.O::AEDD: 充電を扱い、S3・守備が嫉妬で共鳴を作りやすい: **[LCE E.G.O:: AEDD](persona:1215)**: Uses Charge, and his S3 and Defense skill are Envy, making Resonance easy to build.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::ランプ: S1が憤怒で必要資源を出し、火傷を付与できる。: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Lamp](persona:1214)**: His S1 is Wrath, supplying the required affinity, and he can inflict Burn.
messages.ある日突然: S1が色欲で、必要資源の色欲を出せる。出血も付与できるため、ランダ: **[Suddenly, One Day](ego:1201)**: His S1 is Lust, supplying the required Lust. He also inflicts Bleed, meshing with randomly inflicted Bleed.
messages.ある日突然: S2が色欲、S3が憂鬱で、必要資源の両方を出せる。出血を軸にする人: **[Suddenly, One Day](ego:1201)**: His S2 is Lust and S3 Gloom, supplying both required affinities. A Bleed-centered Identity.
messages.まやかし: S1が暴食、S2が怠惰で、必要資源の両方を出せる。: **[Legerdemain](ego:1202)**: His S1 is Gluttony and S2 Sloth, supplying both required affinities.
messages.まやかし: S1が怠惰、S2が暴食で資源を出せ、速度4-8と高く先に麻痺を入れや: **[Legerdemain](ego:1202)**: His S1 is Sloth and S2 Gluttony, supplying resources, and his high Speed of 4–8 makes it easy to apply Paralyze first.
messages.提灯: 破裂を扱い、S1が暴食、S2が怠惰で必要資源を出せる。: **[Lantern](ego:1203)**: Uses Rupture, and his S1 is Gluttony and S2 Sloth, supplying the required affinities.
messages.提灯: 破裂を付与する人格で、S2が暴食、S3が怠惰で必要資源を出せる。: **[Lantern](ego:1203)**: An Identity who inflicts Rupture, whose S2 is Gluttony and S3 Sloth, supplying the required affinities.
messages.AEDD: 充電と破裂を扱い、S2が嫉妬、S3が憂鬱で必要資源を出せる。: **[AEDD](ego:1204)**: Uses Charge and Rupture, and his S2 is Envy and S3 Gloom, supplying the required affinities.
messages.AEDD: 充電を軸にする人格で、S2が憂鬱、S3が嫉妬。破裂も付与する。: **[AEDD](ego:1204)**: A Charge-centered Identity whose S2 is Gloom and S3 Envy. He also inflicts Rupture.
messages.茨の花園: S3と守備が色欲で、このE.G.Oの色欲共鳴に加わりやすい。自己回復: **[Garden of Thorns](ego:1205)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Lust, making it easy to join this E.G.O's Lust Resonance. He also has plenty of self-healing.
messages.茨の花園: S3と守備が嫉妬で、嫉妬共鳴を作りやすい。: **[Garden of Thorns](ego:1205)**: His S3 and Defense skill are Envy, making Envy Resonance easy to build.
messages.過ぎし日: 沈潜を付与する人格で、S2・守備が憂鬱、S3が色欲。必要資源を出せる: **[Bygone Days](ego:1206)**: A Sinking-inflicting Identity whose S2 and Defense skill are Gloom and S3 Lust, supplying the required affinities.
messages.過ぎし日: S2が憂鬱で、沈潜を付与できる。: **[Bygone Days](ego:1206)**: His S2 is Gloom, and he can inflict Sinking.
messages.厳粛な哀悼: 沈潜を扱い、S1が嫉妬、S2が憂鬱、S3が色欲で必要資源を出せる。: **[Solemn Lament](ego:1207)**: Uses Sinking, and his S1 is Envy, S2 Gloom, and S3 Lust, supplying the required affinities.
messages.厳粛な哀悼: S1の使用時に束縛を得るので、マイナス効果を持って「哀悼」を維持し: **[Solemn Lament](ego:1207)**: He gains Bind on using S1, making it easy to hold a negative effect and keep Lament going.
messages.クリスマスの悪夢: 振動と出血を扱い、S1が怠惰、S3が傲慢で必要資源の一部を出: **[Christmas Nightmare](ego:1208)**: Uses Tremor and Bleed, and his S1 is Sloth and S3 Pride, supplying some of the required affinities.

messages.守備「回避」: 戦闘開始時に時限漂流1・四色次元1を得る(充電威力3以上なら追加: **Defense skill — Sidestep**: At Combat Start, he gains 1 Dimensional Castaway and 1 Quadricolor Dimensions (1 more with 3 or more Charge Potency, once per turn). If his Charge Count is below 7, he spends HP to refill it to 7, and if it exceeds 15, he spends 10 of the excess to recover HP and gain Haste next turn. messages.追撃: 常時発動パッシブ「貫かれし路地」により、自分以外の味方のスキルが敵に的中: **Follow-ups**: Through the always-active passive Open Alley, when an ally other than himself hits an enemy with a skill, he spends 1 Dimensional Castaway to trigger Dimensional Slice on that target and gains 1 Quadricolor Dimensions.
messages.S1「次元斬り」: 使用時に充電回数を2消耗し、Ⅰコイン的中時に6増加(スキルご: **S1 — Dimensional Slice**: Spends 2 Charge Count on use and gains 6 on Coin Ⅰ hit (once per skill). With Dimensional Castaway, it spends 1 to reuse Coin Ⅰ (once per skill). The follow-up trigger also spends 1 Dimensional Castaway, so a follow-up S1 only reaches the reuse at 3 or more Charge Potency, when Sidestep grants 2 Dimensional Castaway.
messages.充電威力と四色次元: 戦闘中、累計で充電回数を10消耗するたびに充電威力1を得る: **Charge Potency and Quadricolor Dimensions**: During battle, he gains 1 Charge Potency each time he spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count. Quadricolor Dimensions (max 4, decreasing by 1 at Turn End) raises Offense Level, Defense Level, and Charge Count gain based on its value, and at 4 or more, his skills deal +(Charge Potency×4)% damage, up to 20%.
messages.S3「空間切断」: 充電回数が15以上なら「四次角歪曲時系列切断」(4コインの広: **S3 — Rip Space**: With 15 or more Charge Count, it activates as Four-dimensional Refraction Time Series Severance (a 4-Coin Unfocused Volley that spends 15 Charge Count), gaining 1 Quadricolor Dimensions on each hit with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ. Coin Ⅳ is reused at 5 or more Charge Potency (once per skill). With 7–14, it becomes the regular version that spends all Charge Count.
messages.手元のS1は基本的に守備(回避)へ回すとよい。回避で時限漂流を得て、味方の攻撃に: It works well to basically turn the S1s in hand into his Defense skill (Sidestep). Gain Dimensional Castaway with Sidestep and earn Charge Count through Dimensional Slice follow-ups timed with allies' attacks. Sidestep refills Charge Count to 7, so combined with the follow-ups, Charge builds quickly. Once Charge Count reaches 15, fire the enhanced S3, then return to Sidestep and follow-ups. As he keeps spending, Charge Potency grows and he meets the reuse conditions for the follow-ups and enhanced S3. S2 Consecutive Dimensional Slice spends 5 Charge Count but only gains 6, a poor return. Treat it as a Clash skill for raising SP. This Identity has no way to restore SP, so he needs to secure SP through Clashes against weak skills or rely on allies' support. Rupture infliction is only a side effect.

If you decide to use workshop gear that handles heat, be ready to pay what it costs. Unlike ordinary weapons, which only need to be sharper and sturdier, weapons that give off heat need all sorts of precautions so that their wielder is not caught in that heat.
Of course, weapons that simply spew fire at random and fabrics that resist burning are easy to come by. But a weapon that lets its user finely control exactly as much heat as they want, at the moment they want, and a fabric that blocks the heat itself usually cost a great deal, and you must not neglect the effort of learning to use them.

The reason for using this weapon, which looks like a suitcase or an instrument case, is clear. First, to blend into everyday life. A weapon that is complex and unwieldy in combat is, precisely because of that inefficiency, more likely not to be recognized as a weapon at all.
Second, the storage capacity that the suitcase shape itself provides. For that reason, weapons shaped to hold things inside are actively used by the Devyat' Association.
Despite these strengths, though, it is not well regarded among those who handle workshop gear. You often hear things like "they'd have gotten stronger if they had put the time spent on this weapon into another one," or "it's gear for modern Fixers who only care about looking cool."
When you meet someone wielding such difficult gear, the fact that they are a high-ranking Fixer or a senior syndicate member... paradoxically means something else. That is why, in the workshops, this gear is called not a suitcase but a coffin. And coffins always come with butterflies.

The Dawn Office of this Mirror World has not yet fully cooled compared to those of other Mirror Worlds. As such, the combat power of the two who support the office is observed to be at a level that would fall short in nothing even working as Grade 1 Fixers. However, the ranks of the office and its Fixers are no different from those in other Mirror Worlds. The ranks of an office and its Fixers are not determined by combat power alone. If they cannot properly handle jobs to the standard each request demands, or deliberately avoid high-risk requests that would meaningfully affect a rank-up, a Fixer's rank cannot rise no matter how much they want it to.

An A+ grade workshop weapon. From his days as a fledgling Fixer, through the Smoke War, and beyond, this sword was wielded by the hand of the Fixer at the Crack of Dawn. As the Fixer at the Crack of Dawn built his record on his journey, the Stigma Workshop's reputation rose, and in return the Stigma Workshop improved this sword for him many times. Select no reserves, put everyone on Defense, and sacrifice them with Tiansha. Tiansha proceeds from the latest deployment position, so put the Middle Nursefather in position 7 to sacrifice her first. Her String Severance lets each Phantom Step sacrifice two allies. Sacrifice the four Nursefathers first to reach String Severance 4. Sacrifice the remaining House members in the next normal Encounter. For Sinners without a House of Spiders Identity, such as Meursault and Gregor, use an unleveled Lv 1 Identity and let enemies defeat them by floor 3.
messages.編成1番。残像歩で天殺し、赤くもつれた蜘蛛の巣で1人になってから15層まで戦う中: Position 1. The core unit: sacrifices allies with Phantom Step, then fights alone to floor 15 once Spiderweb Entangled in Red keeps them down. Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.2番。6人目に天殺する。〈再会〉で防御レベル+2、基本攻撃スキルの火傷威力+1。: Position 2. Sacrificed sixth. Saikai grants +2 Defense Level and +1 Burn Potency from basic attack skills.
messages.3番。5人目に天殺する。〈再会〉で毎ターン体力最大値10%のバリア。: Position 3. Sacrificed fifth. Saikai grants Shield equal to 10% max HP each turn.
messages.4番。4人目に天殺する親方。〈再会〉で守備のコイン威力+1、バリアを持つ敵へのダ: Position 4. The fourth sacrifice, a Nursefather. Saikai grants +1 defense Coin Power and +10% damage against enemies with Shield.
messages.5番。3人目に天殺する親方。〈再会〉で基本攻撃スキルの最終コインが破壊不能になる: Position 5. The third sacrifice, a Nursefather. Saikai makes the final Coin of basic attack skills Unbreakable.
messages.6番。2人目に天殺する親方。〈再会〉でマッチ威力+1・ダメージ量+10%・速度+: Position 6. The second sacrifice, a Nursefather. Saikai grants +1 Clash Power, +10% damage, and +1 Speed.
messages.7番。最初に天殺する親方。絶縁が付き、〈再会〉で被ダメージ量-20%と被ダメージ: Position 7. The first sacrifice, a Nursefather. Grants String Severance; Saikai gives -20% damage taken and Offense Level Up when hit.
messages.次の通常戦闘で天殺する。〈再会〉でマッチ勝利時に振動爆発。: Sacrificed in the next normal Encounter. Saikai triggers Tremor Burst on Clash wins.
messages.次の通常戦闘で天殺する。〈再会〉で基本攻撃スキル使用時に呼吸2。: Sacrificed in the next normal Encounter. Saikai grants 2 Poise when using basic attack skills.
messages.次の通常戦闘で天殺する。天殺の優先順位が最も低く、編成順に関係なく最後に倒れる。: Sacrificed in the next normal Encounter. Has the lowest Tiansha priority, so she falls last regardless of position.
messages.解析Ⅱ以上なら付ける。〈残像反響〉で、天殺でもE.G.Oパッシブが発動する。: Equip it at Threadspin Ⅱ or higher. Afterimage Reverberation lets Tiansha trigger its E.G.O passive too.
messages.天殺で強化を集め、1人で15層まで戦う中核。同期化Ⅳが必須。: The core unit, gathering bonuses through Tiansha and fighting alone to floor 15. Requires Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.必須の親方。天殺すると、刀良秀の基本攻撃スキルの最終コインが破壊不能になり、その: A required Nursefather. When sacrificed, the final Coin of Blade Ryōshū's basic attack skills becomes Unbreakable and deals +10% damage.
messages.必須の親方。天殺すると、刀良秀が速度+1、基本攻撃スキルのマッチ威力+1・ダメー: A required Nursefather. When sacrificed, Blade Ryōshū gains +1 Speed, plus +1 Clash Power and +10% damage on basic attack skills.
messages.天殺の優先度が高い親方。被ダメージ量-20%と、被ダメージ時の攻撃レベル増加1(: A high-priority Nursefather sacrifice. Grants -20% damage taken and Offense Level Up 1 when hit (twice per turn). As a Nursefather, she also adds String Severance.
messages.親方なので絶縁が付く。守備のコイン威力+1と、バリアを持つ敵への基本スキルのダメ: As a Nursefather, adds String Severance. Grants +1 defense Coin Power and +10% basic skill damage against enemies with Shield, which helps against the 3000 Shield on floor 13 and later.
messages.天殺の優先度が高い子方。毎ターン体力最大値10%のバリアを得る。: A high-priority Apprentice sacrifice. Grants Shield equal to 10% max HP each turn.
messages.天殺の優先度が高い子方。防御レベル+2と、基本攻撃スキルで付与する火傷威力+1。: A high-priority Apprentice sacrifice. Grants +2 Defense Level and +1 Burn Potency from basic attack skills.
messages.子方。天殺すると、基本スキルでマッチに勝ったときに振動2を付与して振動爆発する。: An Apprentice. When sacrificed, Clash wins with basic skills apply 2 Tremor and trigger Tremor Burst.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の人格。天殺すると、基本攻撃スキル使用時に呼吸2を得て、クリティカル時に: A House of Spiders member. When sacrificed, basic attack skills grant 2 Poise, and critical hits apply 1 Sinking.
messages.子方。天殺の優先順位が最も低く、最後に倒れる。毎ターン呼吸回数1とクリティカルダ: An Apprentice with the lowest Tiansha priority, so she falls last. Grants 1 Poise Count and Crit Damage Up 1 each turn.
messages.必須ではない。解析Ⅱ以上なら付ける。刀良秀の〈残像反響〉で、天殺でもE.G.Oパ: Optional. Equip it at Threadspin Ⅱ or higher. Blade Ryōshū's Afterimage Reverberation lets Tiansha trigger its E.G.O passive too.
messages.侵蝕版は体力が最も低い味方を優先して狙うので、天殺できないLv1の囚人を倒すのに: Its Corrosion version prioritizes the ally with the lowest HP, so it can defeat Lv 1 Sinners that Tiansha cannot target.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の刀(良秀)が蜘蛛の巣の味方を「天殺」して強化を集め、ギフト「赤くもつれ: [Blade Ryōshū](persona:0415) sacrifices House of Spiders allies with Tiansha to gather bonuses, goes solo once the Gift Spiderweb Entangled in Red keeps them down, and clears Mirror Dungeon floor 15 at 60 Adversity.
messages.刀良秀の守備スキル「残像歩」を使ったターンは、出撃中の蜘蛛の巣の人格のうち、編成: On a turn when [Blade Ryōshū](persona:0415) uses her Defense skill Phantom Step, she designates the deployed House of Spiders member with the latest deployment position. After that ally finishes acting, she kills them with Tiansha (fixed damage equal to 120% of their max HP). [The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice](persona:1015) (Sinclair) is always designated last, regardless of position.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の親方が1人死ぬたびに「絶縁」が1増える(最大4)。絶縁1につき被ダメー: Each House of Spiders Nursefather death adds 1 String Severance (max 4). Each point gives -7.5% damage taken, and with 1 or more, each Phantom Step designates two allies.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の味方が死んでいると、〈再会〉で倒した人格ごとの効果を得る。蜘蛛の巣の人: While House of Spiders allies are dead, Saikai grants a bonus for each one. Every 3 dead House members give Blade Ryōshū one more slot (up to 3) and add more Phantom Traces on enemies. Slots do not increase while allies remain to enter from reserve.
messages.ギフト観測で持ち込む「Ⅲ赤くもつれた蜘蛛の巣」は、この攻略の要。刀良秀がいると、: Tier Ⅲ Spiderweb Entangled in Red, brought in through Gift Observation, is the heart of this strategy. With Blade Ryōshū in the team, other Identities do not revive after clearing floor bosses or hidden nodes. Each dead ally gives all allies +1 Offense and Defense Level (max 10), and every 2 dead House allies give Blade Ryōshū +1 Final Power, +1 Coin Power, and +10% damage (up to 3 times each).
messages.刀良秀を編成1番に置き、ほかの全員が死んでいると「裂かれ出づる蝶」(全スキルの最: With Blade Ryōshū in position 1 and everyone else dead, she gains Torn-out Butterfly (+2 Final Power on all skills; when damage Staggers her, she recovers at once and gains Shield equal to 100% max HP). While she is the only survivor, every event choice gets +12 to its check.
messages.序盤に味方を全員倒しておけば、以後は強化しきった刀良秀1人で戦える。: Defeat all allies early, and the fully enhanced Blade Ryōshū can fight alone for the rest of the run.
messages.必須: 刀良秀(同期化Ⅳ)、蜘蛛の巣 人差し指の親方(イサン)、蜘蛛の巣 薬指の: **Required**: [Blade Ryōshū](persona:0415) (Uptie Ⅳ), [The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather](persona:0115) (Yi Sang), [The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather](persona:0614) (Hong Lu), and at least one House of Spiders Apprentice. Apart from Blade Ryōshū, nobody needs Uptie or levels.
messages.残りの枠は自由: 蜘蛛の巣の人格が多いほど強化が増える。刀良秀以外の蜘蛛の巣の人: **Other slots are flexible**: More House of Spiders members mean more bonuses. Sacrificing 9 House members besides Blade Ryōshū maxes out the slot and Phantom Trace increases.
messages.蜘蛛の巣の人格がない囚人: 敵に倒させるので、育成していないLv1の人格を入れる: **Sinners without a House of Spiders Identity**: Enemies will defeat them, so use unleveled Lv 1 Identities.
messages.E.G.O: 必須ではない。《三千大世界》を解析Ⅱ以上で持っていれば付ける。刀良: **E.G.O**: Optional. If you have [Great Trichiliocosm](ego:0409) at Threadspin Ⅱ or higher, equip it. Blade Ryōshū's Afterimage Reverberation lets Tiansha trigger its E.G.O passive, Sanzu.
messages.開始ギフト: 呼吸。加護を強化すると3つとも取れる。呼吸のギフトを集めておくと、: **Starting Gifts**: Poise. Upgraded Blessings let you take all three. Collecting Poise Gifts makes it easier to aim for Gear Shrapnel through fusion. Bleed also works.
messages.Ⅲ赤くもつれた蜘蛛の巣: この攻略の要。効果は「仕組み」にまとめた。: **Tier Ⅲ Spiderweb Entangled in Red**: the heart of this strategy. Its effects are summarized in "How It Works".
messages.Ⅲプレステージカード: ショップでのギフトの購入額が30%下がる。: **Tier Ⅲ Prestige Card**: Gift purchases in shops cost 30% less.
messages.Ⅲ鋭い糸と針: 毎ターン、最初に敵へダメージを与えたスキルのダメージ量の半分だけ: **Tier Ⅲ Sharp Needle & Thread**: each turn, the first skill that damages an enemy deals extra fixed damage equal to half its damage.
messages.鋭い糸と針の代わりに、緊急付与型捜査官バッジを取る手もある。編成3番の人格が、体: You can take Emergency Investigator Badge instead of Sharp Needle & Thread. The Identity in position 3 survives damage that would bring HP to 0 once per Encounter and recovers to 80% max HP.
messages.++まで強化すると、編成1番の刀良秀にも効く。: At ++ it also covers Blade Ryōshū in position 1.
messages.ただし観測で取ると最初から編成3番に効くので、3番の蜘蛛の巣の人格は天殺に耐え、: However, an observed Badge covers position 3 from the start, so the House member in position 3 survives Tiansha and drops out of its targets for that Encounter. Sacrifice that Identity in the next Encounter.
messages.最初の天殺は親方にする。絶縁が付き、次のターンから1回で2人を倒せる。: Make the first sacrifice a Nursefather. She adds String Severance, so from the next turn each Phantom Step kills two allies.
messages.4人の親方を先に倒すと、絶縁4で被ダメージ量-30%になり、空間斬-残も最大まで: Sacrificing all four Nursefathers first gives String Severance 4 for -30% damage taken and fully enhances Rend Space - Echoshear.
messages.天殺は編成順の後ろから進む。最初の通常戦闘では、刀良秀を1番、蜘蛛の巣の人格を2: Tiansha proceeds from the latest position. In the first normal Encounter, put Blade Ryōshū in position 1 and House of Spiders members in positions 2–7, and select no reserves. With reserves, the entering ally is sacrificed first, and slots do not increase.
messages.天殺している間は全員守備にして、敵を倒しきらない。敵が先に全滅すると戦闘が終わっ: While sacrificing, keep everyone on Defense and do not finish off the enemies. If the enemies are wiped out first, the Encounter ends.
messages.1回目の通常戦闘(並び順と〈再会〉の効果): First normal Encounter (order and Saikai bonuses)
messages.7番 蜘蛛の巣 中指の親方(ウーティス): 被ダメージ量-20%、被ダメージ時に: Position 7, [The House of Spiders: The Middle Nursefather](persona:1115) (Outis): -20% damage taken and Offense Level Up 1 when hit (twice per turn). The strongest defensive bonus, and as a Nursefather she adds String Severance.
messages.6番 蜘蛛の巣 薬指の親方(ホンル): 「身体が響かす旋律」(速度+1、基本攻撃: Position 6, [The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather](persona:0614) (Hong Lu): Somatic Frisson-inspiring Melody (+1 Speed, +1 Clash Power and +10% damage on basic attack skills).
messages.5番 蜘蛛の巣 人差し指の親方(イサン): 基本攻撃スキルの最終コインが破壊不能: Position 5, [The House of Spiders: The Index Nursefather](persona:0115) (Yi Sang): the final Coin of basic attack skills becomes Unbreakable and deals +10% damage.
messages.4番 蜘蛛の巣 親指の親方(ロージャ): 守備スキルのコイン威力+1、バリアを持: Position 4, [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Nursefather](persona:0916) (Rodion): +1 defense Coin Power and +10% basic skill damage against enemies with Shield. Effective against the 3000 Shield that Adversity gives enemies from floor 13.
messages.3番 蜘蛛の巣 薬指の子方(ファウスト): 毎ターン、体力最大値10%のバリア。: Position 3, [The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice](persona:0215) (Faust): Shield equal to 10% max HP each turn.
messages.2番 蜘蛛の巣 中指の子方(イシュメール): 防御レベル+2、基本攻撃スキルで付: Position 2, [The House of Spiders: The Middle Apprentice](persona:0814) (Ishmael): +2 Defense Level and +1 Burn Potency from basic attack skills.
messages.残りの蜘蛛の巣の人格を、同じように天殺する。: Sacrifice the remaining House members the same way.
messages.蜘蛛の巣 親指の子方(ヒースクリフ): マッチ勝利時に振動爆発。: [The House of Spiders: The Thumb Apprentice](persona:0716) (Heathcliff): Tremor Burst on Clash wins.
messages.人差し指代行者-開花E.G.O::代行(ドンキホーテ): 基本攻撃スキル使用時に: [The Index Proxy - Effloresced E.G.O:: Procuration](persona:0314) (Don Quixote): 2 Poise when using basic attack skills, and Sinking on Critical hits.
messages.蜘蛛の巣 小指の子方(シンクレア): 毎ターン呼吸回数1とクリティカルダメージ量: [The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice](persona:1015) (Sinclair): 1 Poise Count and Crit DMG Up 1 each turn.
messages.「信仰と侵蝕」(報酬に血紅色のたてがみ)を更新で探す。出なければ、強いギフトが報: Reroll for Faith & Erosion (Blood-red Mane in its rewards). If it does not appear, any pack with strong reward Gifts works.
messages.血紅色のたてがみ: 憤怒・色欲の攻撃スキルを持つ人格に効く。そのターンに被弾しな: **Blood-red Mane**: works on Identities with Wrath or Lust attack skills. If not hit that turn, gain Haste 2 and Defense Power Up 2 next turn; if hit, gain Bind 2 and +2 Clash Power.
messages.最初の通常戦闘で天殺する。: Sacrifice allies in the first normal Encounter.
messages.ヘルズチキン。イベントマスを多く踏む。: Hell's Chicken. Visit many event nodes.
messages.鶏の舞踏会のイベントでは「知らんぷりをする。」を選び、タンゴチキンのタレ(相手よ: In the chicken dance event, choose the option to pretend not to notice to get Tango Marinade (+(Speed ÷ 3) Clash Power when faster than the target, max +3).
messages.「弾丸が打った終止符」。第5回ヴァルプルギスのストーリーをイージーでクリアすると: Full-Stopped by a Bullet. It appears after you clear the 5th Walpurgis Night story on Easy, and only on floors 3–4.
messages.最初の戦闘で、Lv1の囚人を全員倒させる。: In the first Encounter, let enemies defeat all Lv 1 Sinners.
messages.刀良秀は全スキルを守備にする。: Put all of Blade Ryōshū's skills on Defense.
messages.ほかの人格は非常に不利なときだけマッチさせ、一方攻撃になったスキルは守備に変える: Clash with the others only when badly disadvantaged, and switch any skills that become one-sided attacks to Defense.
messages.限定ギフト「歯車の破片」をイベントで取る(呼吸があると毎ターン防御レベル増加2・: Get the pack-exclusive Gift Gear Shrapnel through its event (with Poise, gain Defense Level Up 2 and Defense Power Up 1 each turn, and +10% damage on the first Coin that hits). Once solo, the +12 check bonus makes the event a sure success.
messages.余裕があれば、黒炎のパイプ(Ⅲ、貫通)も合成で狙う。編成1番が毎ターン攻撃威力増: If you have spare resources, also aim for Darkflame Smoking Pipe (Tier Ⅲ, Pierce) through fusion. Position 1 gains Attack Power Up 2 and Fragile 1 every turn, and gains 5 Poise before attacking an enemy with lowered Defense Level.
messages.3号線(5〜10層): 孵化しない火種(致死ダメージを戦闘ごとに1回耐える): **Line 3** (floors 5–10): Unhatched Embers (survive lethal damage once per Encounter)
messages.余裕があれば行く: 良秀に合う限定ギフトがあるので、報酬を見て選ぶ。: **Visit if you can**: these packs have exclusive Gifts that suit Blade Ryōshū, so pick them by their rewards.
messages.時間殺人時間 BokGak(4〜10層): 緊急付与型捜査官バッジ(++なら良秀: **Timekilling Time BokGak** (floors 4–10): Emergency Investigator Badge (at ++, Blade Ryōshū also survives lethal damage once per Encounter). The regular Timekilling Time does not offer it.
messages.経験記憶(5〜10層): 白磁の硯滴、無文の鍔、菖蒲剣、砕けた木製刑具(速度や呼: **Mnestic Experience** (floors 5–10): Baekja Water Dropper, Unadorned Sword-guard, Flagroot Cane Sword, Crushed Wooden Manacle (more damage based on Speed and Poise, and more)
messages.教本(5〜10層): 赤色のネクタイ(火傷を付与するスキル3のマッチ威力+2・ダ: **Textbook** (floors 5–10): Red Necktie (+2 Clash Power and +30% damage for S3 skills that inflict Burn)
messages.1号線(5〜10層): 蛇の抜け殻(毎ターン防御レベル増加2、それに応じて攻撃レ: **Line 1** (floors 5–10): Snake Slough (Defense Level Up 2 every turn, which also raises Offense Level)
messages.斬撃のランク4は、斬撃を指定して合成で作る。: Make the Tier Ⅳ Slash Gifts by fusing with Slash selected.
messages.割れた大剣: 斬撃の基本攻撃スキルのマッチ威力+2。基本攻撃スキルがすべて斬撃の: **Broken Greatsword**: +2 Clash Power for Slash basic attack skills. Allies whose basic attack skills are all Slash gain Slash DMG Up 2 every turn.
messages.切り取られた記憶: 編成1・2番の斬撃攻撃スキルの基本威力+2、マッチ勝利時のダ: **Sundered Memory**: +2 Base Power on Slash attack skills for positions 1–2, +30% damage on Clash wins, and more.
messages.振動の溶け落ちた目玉と暴雨もそろえる。効果は「取りたいギフト」にまとめた。: Also collect the Tremor Gifts Melted Eyeball and Downpour. Their effects are summarized in "Gifts to Get".
messages.5号線の砕ける定めの火砲は、毎ターン火力(1につき与ダメージ量+10%)と軟弱(: Line 5's Shatterbound Cannon grants 2 each of Firepower (+10% damage dealt per point) and Delicateness (+10% damage taken per point) every turn, with the amount rising from turn 2 (each up to 10). It trades defense for damage. Skip it if you value stability.
messages.月の記憶(敵の耐性をすべて脆弱にする。唯一のランク5)を合成する。《三千大世界》: Fuse Lunar Memory (all enemy resistances become Fatal; the only Tier Ⅴ Gift). If you brought Great Trichiliocosm, do not use Poise, Bleed, or Burn Gifts as materials.
messages.合成で使った斬撃のギフトを作り直し、余ったコストでランク4から順に強化する。: Remake the Slash Gifts used in the fusion, then spend leftover Cost enhancing Gifts from Tier Ⅳ down.
messages.11層からはショップの値段が上がるので、ギフトはここまでに仕上げる。: Shop prices rise from floor 11, so finish your Gifts here.
messages.11層から制約を設定できる。15層まですべて選んで制約60にする。: You can set Adversity from floor 11. Select everything through floor 15 for 60 Adversity.
messages.苦難は、敵の加算コインを強化するものと頑強を避け、体力増加や防御レベル増加を選ぶ: For Tribulations, avoid ones that strengthen enemies' positive Coins or make them sturdier. Choose HP or Defense Level increases instead.
messages.コードパープルとラ・マンチャランドの主に1回ずつ行く。挿翅虎も候補になる。: Visit Code Purple and The Master of La Manchaland once each. Chachihu is also an option.
messages.コードパープル: クリア報酬は廉価版K社アンプル。編成1番の人格が、致死ダメージ: **Code Purple**: rewards Mid-range K Corp. Ampule. The Identity in position 1 fully restores HP after one lethal hit.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの主: クリア報酬は家族の恨み。出血を付与するスキルの攻撃が終: **The Master of La Manchaland**: rewards The Family's Resentment. After an attack with a Bleed-applying skill ends, heal 30% of the HP damage dealt (max 20).
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの主のボスは、ダンテが喚いたターンには全スキルを守備にする。雑: On turns when Dante cries out during The Master of La Manchaland's boss fight, put every skill on Defense. You cannot attack the main body until all minions are defeated.
messages.第十三層: 「とある図書館の、ある本の中へ」。制約で敵に3000のバリアが付くの: **Floor 13**: Into a Certain Library's Book. Adversity gives enemies 3000 Shield, making one-hit kills difficult. Win Clashes carefully.
messages.第十四層: 「重荷を背負った者たち」。ギフト次第ではマッチが怪しくなるが、最も苦: **Floor 14**: Bearers of Weight. Depending on your Gifts, Clashes may get shaky, but only turn 1 is truly tough. As turns pass, slots increase and damage pushes through.
messages.第十五層: 「永劫のくびき」。戦闘は長引くが、敵は弱い。: **Floor 15**: Bridle of Infinity. The fights run long, but the enemies are weak.
messages.刀良秀の呼吸・出血・火傷・斬撃のギフトは、15層までに見かけたものをほぼすべて取: You will pick up nearly every Poise, Bleed, Burn, and Slash Gift for Blade Ryōshū on the way to floor 15. This section lists the other Gifts worth prioritizing.
messages.攻略を楽にする汎用ギフト: Universal Gifts that make the run easier
messages.月の記憶: 敵の耐性をすべて脆弱にする。第十層で合成する。: **Lunar Memory**: all enemy resistances become Fatal. Fuse it on floor 10.
messages.縁の欠片: 獲得時に編成人格のレベル+5。: **Piece of Relationship**: Identity levels +5 on acquisition.
messages.秘密保持誓約書: ターン開始時に良秀へ体力最大値49%のバリアと与ダメージ量+1: **Non-disclosure Agreement**: at turn start, Blade Ryōshū gets a Shield of 49% max HP and +10% damage dealt. It grows with each hit up to +40% and is removed when she takes damage.
messages.タンゴチキンのタレ: 相手より速いとマッチ威力+(速度÷3)、最大+3。: **Tango Marinade**: +(Speed ÷ 3) Clash Power when faster than the target, max +3.
messages.くびき(2号線): 階層×2%だけ体力最大値が増える(最大+20%)。: **Bridle** (Line 2): max HP rises by floor × 2% (up to +20%).
messages.孵化しない火種(3号線): 致死ダメージを戦闘ごとに1回耐え、体力20%を回復。: **Unhatched Embers** (Line 3): survive lethal damage once per Encounter and recover 20% HP.
messages.緊急付与型捜査官バッジ(時間殺人時間 BokGak): ++まで強化すると編成1: **Emergency Investigator Badge** (Timekilling Time BokGak): at ++ it also covers Blade Ryōshū in position 1, letting her survive lethal damage once per Encounter at 80% HP.
messages.白磁の硯滴: 編成1番が毎ターンクイック2を得て、敵より速いと速度差1につきダメ: **Baekja Water Dropper**: position 1 gains Haste 2 every turn, and +3% damage per point of Speed above the enemy (up to +30%).
messages.無文の鍔: 呼吸1につき斬撃スキルのダメージ量+1%(最大+15%)。: **Unadorned Sword-guard**: +1% Slash skill damage per Poise (up to +15%).
messages.菖蒲剣: 攻撃を受けると呼吸4とクリティカルダメージ量増加1。: **Flagroot Cane Sword**: when attacked, gain 4 Poise and Crit DMG Up 1.
messages.砕けた木製刑具: 斬撃スキルで敵に防御レベル減少1。: **Crushed Wooden Manacle**: Slash skills inflict Defense Level Down 1.
messages.赤色のネクタイ(教本): 火傷を付与するスキル3のマッチ威力+2・ダメージ量+3: **Red Necktie** (Textbook): +2 Clash Power and +30% damage for S3 skills that inflict Burn. Rend Space inflicts Burn, so it works well on Blade Ryōshū once her S1 are swapped to S3.
messages.蛇の抜け殻(1号線): 毎ターン防御レベル増加2を得て、防御レベル増加4につき攻: **Snake Slough** (Line 1): gain Defense Level Up 2 every turn, and +1 Offense Level per 4 Defense Level Up.
messages.振動の溶け落ちた目玉と暴雨: Tremor Gifts: Melted Eyeball and Downpour
messages.良秀は振動を付与しないが、この2つはそろえると働く。振動を指定して合成する。: Blade Ryōshū does not inflict Tremor, but these two work once you have both. Fuse them with Tremor selected.
messages.暴雨(ランク4): ターン開始時、全ての敵に振動を付与し、ターン終了時に全ての敵: **Downpour** (Tier Ⅳ): at turn start, inflicts Tremor on all enemies, and at turn end, triggers Tremor Burst on all enemies.
messages.溶け落ちた目玉: 振動爆発した敵に、次のターン攻撃レベル減少5と防御レベル減少5: **Melted Eyeball**: enemies hit by Tremor Burst receive Offense Level Down 5 and Defense Level Down 5 next turn (up to 3 times per turn).
messages.2つそろうと、2ターン目から毎ターン、敵の攻撃レベルと防御レベルが5下がる。片方: With both, enemies lose 5 Offense and Defense Level every turn from turn 2. Either one alone does not lower enemy Offense Level.
messages.スキル交換: 刀良秀のスキル1をすべてスキル3(空間斬)に換える。スキル2(傲慢: **Skill swaps**: Replace all of Blade Ryōshū's S1 with S3 (Rend Space). Keeping one S2 (Pride) lets you use it for Pride checks in events.
messages.購入: 刀良秀の呼吸・出血・火傷・斬撃のギフトは買う。欲しいものが無ければキーワ: **Purchases**: Buy Blade Ryōshū's Poise, Bleed, Burn, and Slash Gifts. If nothing useful is available, use Keyword Reroll (two free each time thanks to Blessings). Early on, always buy these three Cost-boosting Gifts when you see them.
messages.生存の道しるべ: 階層ボスを倒すと、コストを追加で(80+戦闘に参加した人格数×: **Milepost of Survival**: defeating a floor boss grants (80 + participating Identities × 5) extra Cost.
messages.意地汚いハンマー: 戦闘勝利時、倒した敵の数×3のコストを得る。: **Voracious Hammer**: on Encounter victory, gain Cost equal to defeated enemies × 3.
messages.売却: 加護の効果で、ショップごとに1回だけ売値が上がる。プレステージカードと合: **Selling**: Blessings raise sale prices once per shop. With Prestige Card, buying and immediately selling earns a profit.
messages.合成: ランク4は素材のランク合計8(3+3+2)、ランク3は合計6で作る。特別: **Fusion**: Fuse Tier Ⅳ Gifts from materials totaling 8 tiers (3+3+2), and Tier Ⅲ from 6. Special shops need 1 less. With a keyword selected, success is 60% with two materials and 90% with three. Blessings add one extra Gift to a fusion once per shop.
messages.強化: コストを使うほど、次の階層で特別なショップが出やすい(販売数が多い)。呼: **Enhancement**: Spending more Cost makes a special shop (with more stock) likelier on the next floor. Enhance Poise Gifts first.
messages.ランダム合成(9層から): 合成では汎用のギフトを指定できない。そのキーワードの: **Random fusion (from floor 9)**: Fusion cannot target universal Gifts. Once you own every Tier Ⅳ Gift of a keyword, fusing with that keyword gives a random result, and owned Tier Ⅳ Gifts do not appear, so universal Tier Ⅳ Gifts become likely. Finish the Slash Tier Ⅳ Gifts first, then fuse with Slash selected to collect universal Tier Ⅳ Gifts such as Ancient Effigy (Haste 5 next turn for the fastest ally) and Non-disclosure Agreement.
messages.13層以降の血鬼になれなかった者たち・緑の黎明は、通常戦闘でマッチの管理が面倒な: From floor 13, skip Who Couldn't be Bloodfiends and The Dawn of Green; they are normal battles where managing Clashes is tedious.
messages.13層以降の終わりなき袋小路は、反撃する敵が多いので取らない。: From floor 13, skip Impenetrable Path because many enemies counter.
messages.13層以降の開花する緑林は取らない。ドンベクの「開花」が5溜まると敗北し、1人だ: From floor 13, skip Efflorescing Greenery. You lose when Dongbaek's Bloom reaches 5, and alone you can hardly dodge every attack.
messages.13層以降の3号線は、通常戦闘の手数が足りず、バリアを持った速い雑魚に押されやす: From floor 13, Line 3's normal battles leave you short on actions, and fast minions with Shield can overwhelm you. Line 3 - Terminus and A Beautiful Voice are also dangerous solo.
messages.1人なので、即死するイベントに失敗するとそこで終わる。時間殺人時間のマスにあるボ: Solo, failing an instant-death event ends the run. Do not play the voice recorder in Timekilling Time's node. Line 5's rose event and the wrapping ribbon event also deal heavy damage on failure.
messages.行動不能を付ける敵や、混乱し続ける呪いのギフトに弱い。1人なので、止められるとそ: Weak to enemies that inflict action prevention and curse Gifts that keep her Staggered. Alone, being stopped means losing.
messages.乱入ボスは、11・12層なら勝てる。13〜15層でも勝てるが慣れが要り、乱入のギ: Intruding bosses are winnable on floors 11–12. They can be beaten on floors 13–15 too, but that takes practice, and the run is clearable without their Gifts, so do not force it.
messages.星明かりを使わない(加護を取らない)15層は別物の難しさになる。まずは加護をすべ: Floor 15 without Starlight (no Blessings) is a different level of difficulty. Clear it with every Blessing first.
messages.Lv1の囚人をなかなか倒させられないときは、第一層で「愛することのできない」を選: If enemies will not defeat your Lv 1 Sinners, choose The Unloving on floor 1 and let Baba Yaga trample them (after the first wave, put everyone on Defense and wait). The Corrosion version of Ryōshū's E.G.O [Thoracalgia](ego:0408), which prioritizes the ally with the lowest HP, also works.
messages.【リンバス】刀良秀ソロの組み方と編成例｜Limbus Assistant: Blade Ryōshū Solo | Mirror Dungeon Floor 15 at 60 Adversity | Limbus Assistant
messages.リンバスの刀良秀ソロ。蜘蛛の巣の刀(良秀)が蜘蛛の巣の味方を「天殺」して強化を集: Clear Limbus Company Mirror Dungeon floor 15 at 60 Adversity with Blade Ryōshū alone. Covers the Tiansha order, Gift Observation, pack choices per floor, and the shop routine.
